teaching_sense.en_definition: A song of praise, especially one sung or recited in religious worship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达赞美的歌，尤指宗教礼拜中歌唱或诵读的颂歌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għanja ta' tifħir, speċjalment waħda li titkanta jew tingħad waqt it-talb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赞歌；宗教礼拜中歌唱或诵读的颂歌。

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċelebrazzjoni, il-kor kanta kantiklu ta' tifħir.
formal.en: During the celebration, the choir sang a canticle of praise.
formal.zh: 庆典期间，唱诗班唱了一首赞美颂歌。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Taf dan il-kantiklu? Pawlu: Iva, inkantawh fil-knisja.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you know this canticle? Pawlu: Yes, we sing it in church.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你会这首颂歌吗？保罗：会，我们在教堂里唱。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会这首颂歌吗？
messages.en: Do you know this canticle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 会，我们在教堂里唱。
messages.en: Yes, we sing it in church.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象唱诗班打开歌本唱颂歌，把 kantiklu 与“礼拜中的赞美歌”这个场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A song expressing praise, particularly one used in religious prayer or worship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达赞美的歌曲，尤指用于宗教祈祷或礼拜的颂歌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għanja li tesprimi tifħir, speċjalment waħda użata fit-talb jew fil-qima.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赞歌；用于宗教祈祷或礼拜的颂歌。

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi kantiku li jitkanta fl-aħħar tat-talb.
formal.en: The programme includes a canticle sung at the end of the prayers.
formal.zh: 节目单中包含一首在祈祷结束时演唱的颂歌。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Liema kantiku se nkantaw illum? David: Dak li tgħallimna lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Which canticle are we singing today? David: The one we learned yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们今天唱哪首颂歌？戴维：昨天学的那首。

messages.speaker: Rita (唱诗班成员)
messages.zh: 我们今天唱哪首颂歌？
messages.en: Which canticle are we singing today?

messages.speaker: David (唱诗班成员)
messages.zh: 昨天学的那首。
messages.en: The one we learned yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kantiku 写在颂歌曲谱的封面上，看到它就联想到“祈祷时唱的赞美歌”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who sings, including someone who leads the singing or chanting in a church.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 唱歌的人，也可指在教堂中带领歌唱或吟诵的领唱者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkanta, fosthom min imexxi l-kant jew l-għana fil-knisja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 歌手；演唱者。
教堂中的领唱者或吟诵者。

formal.mt: Il-kantur tal-knisja mexxa l-kant waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The church chanter led the singing during the ceremony.
formal.zh: 教堂领唱者在仪式期间带领大家歌唱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu l-kantur fuq il-palk? Mark: Huwa ħija; illejla se jkanta żewġ kanzunetti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is the singer on the stage? Mark: He is my brother; tonight he is singing two songs.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：舞台上的歌手是谁？马克：他是我哥哥，今晚他要唱两首歌。

messages.speaker: Lara (观众)
messages.zh: 舞台上的歌手是谁？
messages.en: Who is the singer on the stage?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa ħija; illejla se jkanta żewġ kanzunetti.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa ħija; illejla se jkanta żewġ kanzunetti.
messages.zh: 他是我哥哥，今晚他要唱两首歌。
messages.en: He is my brother; tonight he is singing two songs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个人在舞台上当歌手、在教堂里做领唱，用两个唱歌场景记住 kantur 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person in charge of a group, organisation, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责管理或带领某个团体、机构或活动的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi grupp, organizzazzjoni jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责人；主管；某个机构或团体的首长。
首领；首长；居于主要领导地位的人。
领导者；带领团体行动的人。

formal.mt: Il-kap tad-dipartiment approva l-pjan għas-sena li ġejja.
formal.en: The head of department approved the plan for the coming year.
formal.zh: 部门负责人批准了下一年度的计划。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu l-kap tal-grupp tagħna? Adam: Pawlu; staqsih fejn se niltaqgħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is our group leader? Adam: Pawlu; ask him where we are meeting.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们的小组组长是谁？亚当：保罗，问问他我们在哪里集合。

messages.speaker: Nina (小组成员)
messages.zh: 我们的小组组长是谁？
messages.en: Who is our group leader?

messages.speaker: Adam (小组成员)
messages.zh: 保罗，问问他我们在哪里集合。
messages.en: Pawlu; ask him where we are meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在小组座位图最前面标上 kap，联想“带领大家、负责作决定的人”，串起负责人、首长和领导者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An archipelago and country in West Africa, officially named the Republic of Cape Verde.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 佛得角，西非的一个群岛及国家，正式名称为佛得角共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arċipelagu u pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika tal-Kap Verde.

sense_translations.en_definition: Cape Verde (an archipelago and country in West Africa; official name: Repubblika tal-Kap Verde)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 佛得角，西非的群岛及国家；正式名称为佛得角共和国，马耳他语为 Repubblika tal-Kap Verde。

formal.mt: Ir-Repubblika tal-Kap Verde hija pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent magħmul minn grupp ta' gżejjer.
formal.en: The Republic of Cape Verde is a country in West Africa made up of a group of islands.
formal.zh: 佛得角共和国是西非一个由群岛组成的国家。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn tixtieq tmur għal vaganza? David: Nixtieq inżur il-Kap Verde u nara l-gżejjer.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where would you like to go on holiday? David: I'd like to visit Cape Verde and see the islands.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你想去哪里度假？David：我想去佛得角，看看那里的岛屿。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where would you like to go on holiday?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq inżur il-Kap Verde u nara l-gżejjer.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq inżur il-Kap Verde u nara l-gżejjer.
messages.zh: 我想去佛得角，看看那里的岛屿。
messages.en: I'd like to visit Cape Verde and see the islands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Kap Verde 写在西非群岛的地图卡上，同时标注“佛得角”和“国家”，一次记住地名的群岛与国家两层含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To serve as the chief or person in charge of a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 担任某个团体的首领或负责人，处于领导地位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun il-kap ta' grupp u jkollu r-responsabbiltà li jmexxih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 担任首领；担任负责人；处于领导地位。

collocations.en: served as chief for a year
served as chief during a difficult period
collocations.zh: 在困难时期担任负责人

formal.mt: Pawlu kapa għal sena, u matul dak iż-żmien il-grupp temm il-proġett.
formal.en: Pawlu served as chief for a year, and during that time the group completed the project.
formal.zh: 保罗担任了一年负责人，小组在此期间完成了项目。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Pawlu kapa għal sena biss? Mark: Iva, imbagħad ħa postu ħuh.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did Pawlu serve as chief for only a year? Mark: Yes, then his brother took his place.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：保罗只当了一年负责人吗？马克：是的，后来由他哥哥接任。

messages.speaker: Anna (小组成员)
messages.zh: 保罗只当了一年负责人吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu serve as chief for only a year?

messages.speaker: Mark (小组成员)
messages.zh: 是的，后来由他哥哥接任。
messages.en: Yes, then his brother took his place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kapa 放进“他担任了一年负责人”的任职时间线上，记住这里表达的是担任领导这一动作或状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The principal ship of a fleet, from which the fleet is commanded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 舰队中供指挥人员指挥整个舰队的主要舰船，即旗舰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bastiment ewlieni ta' flotta, li minnu titmexxa l-flotta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舰队的旗舰，即承担舰队指挥职能的主要舰船。

formal.mt: Il-kapitana tal-flotta daħlet fil-port qabel il-bastimenti l-oħra.
formal.en: The fleet's flagship entered the harbour before the other ships.
formal.zh: 舰队旗舰先于其他舰船驶入港口。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema vapur huwa l-kapitana? Toni: Dak ta' quddiem; il-bqija tal-flotta warajh.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which ship is the flagship? Toni: The one in front; the rest of the fleet is behind it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：哪艘船是旗舰？托尼：最前面那艘，舰队其余的船都在它后面。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.zh: 哪艘船是旗舰？
messages.en: Which ship is the flagship?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ta' quddiem; il-bqija tal-flotta warajh.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ta' quddiem; il-bqija tal-flotta warajh.
messages.zh: 最前面那艘，舰队其余的船都在它后面。
messages.en: The one in front; the rest of the fleet is behind it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象舰队图中一艘船上画着指挥台，并给它贴上 kapitana，把这个词和“舰队旗舰”的画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An office responsible for harbour administration and matters concerning ships using the harbour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处理港口管理以及进出港船舶相关事务的办公室。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċċju li jieħu ħsieb l-amministrazzjoni tal-port u affarijiet marbuta mal-bastimenti li jużawh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 港务办公室；处理港口及船舶相关事务的办公机构。

collocations.zh: 港务办公室的工作人员

formal.mt: Il-kaptan ippreżenta d-dokumenti tal-bastiment fil-kapitanerija.
formal.en: The captain presented the ship's documents at the harbour office.
formal.zh: 船长在港务办公室提交了船舶文件。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hi l-kapitanerija? Rita: Ħdejn id-daħla tal-port; tista' tistaqsi hemm.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the harbour office? Rita: Next to the harbour entrance; you can ask there.
colloquial.zh: 马克：港务办公室在哪里？丽塔：在港口入口旁边，你可以去那里询问。

messages.speaker: Mark (船员)
messages.zh: 港务办公室在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the harbour office?

messages.speaker: Rita (港口工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn id-daħla tal-port; tista' tistaqsi hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn id-daħla tal-port; tista' tistaqsi hemm.
messages.zh: 在港口入口旁边，你可以去那里询问。
messages.en: Next to the harbour entrance; you can ask there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象船长拿着船舶文件走进港口办公室，在门牌上写 kapitanerija，用“港口办事地点”帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A covering for the head, often attached to a coat, jacket, or other garment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 罩住头部的帽状部分，通常连接在外套、夹克或其他衣物上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata għar-ras li spiss tkun imwaħħla ma' kowt, ġakketta jew ilbies ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兜帽；风帽；通常与衣服相连、可罩住头部的部分。

collocations.en: cover his head with the hood

formal.mt: Din il-ġakketta għandha kapoċċ li jipproteġi r-ras mix-xita.
formal.en: This jacket has a hood that protects the head from the rain.
formal.zh: 这件夹克带有兜帽，可以保护头部免受雨淋。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Qed tagħmel ix-xita; għatti rasek bil-kapoċċ. Ben: Tajjeb, hekk ma jixxarrabx xagħri.
colloquial.en: Mum: It's raining; cover your head with your hood. Ben: Okay, that way my hair won't get wet.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：下雨了，把兜帽戴上。本站：好的，这样头发就不会淋湿了。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tagħmel ix-xita; għatti rasek bil-kapoċċ.
messages.mt_standard: Qed tagħmel ix-xita; għatti rasek bil-kapoċċ.
messages.zh: 下雨了，把兜帽戴上。
messages.en: It's raining; cover your head with your hood.

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 好的，这样头发就不会淋湿了。
messages.en: Okay, that way my hair won't get wet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象下雨时把外套后面的兜帽拉到头上，把 kapoċċ 和“罩住头、挡住雨”的动作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movable fold of skin that covers and protects the eye.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 覆盖并保护眼睛、可以张开和闭合的皮肤组织，即眼睑或眼皮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-ġilda li tinfetaħ u tingħalaq biex tgħatti u tipproteġi l-għajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眼睑；眼皮。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa, il-kappell tal-għajn ta' fuq huwa mmarkat b'vleġġa.
formal.en: In the picture, the upper eyelid is marked with an arrow.
formal.zh: 图中的上眼睑用箭头标了出来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn qed tħoss il-ħakk? Pawlu: Fil-kappell tal-għajn ta' fuq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where do you feel the itching? Pawlu: On my upper eyelid.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你哪里觉得痒？Pawlu：上眼皮。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哪里觉得痒？
messages.en: Where do you feel the itching?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 上眼皮。
messages.en: On my upper eyelid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上闭眼、睁眼的动作记忆：能盖住眼球的那层眼皮，就是 kappell tal-għajn。

gloss_zh: 摩羯座（星座或黄道十二宫之一）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a constellation and of the zodiac sign Capricorn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摩羯座的名称，既可指天文学中的星座，也可指黄道十二宫中的摩羯座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' kostellazzjoni u tas-sinjal taż-żodijaku li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ Capricorn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摩羯座，指天文学中的星座。
摩羯座，指黄道十二宫中的星座符号。

formal.mt: F'din il-mappa tas-sema, il-kostellazzjoni tal-Kaprikornu hija mmarkata bl-isem tagħha.
formal.en: On this sky map, the constellation Capricorn is labelled with its name.
formal.zh: 这张星图标出了摩羯座及其名称。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu s-sinjal tiegħek taż-żodijaku? Mark: Jien Kaprikornu. U int?
colloquial.en: Lara: What is your zodiac sign? Mark: I'm a Capricorn. And you?
colloquial.zh: Lara：你是什么星座？Mark：我是摩羯座。你呢？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是什么星座？
messages.en: What is your zodiac sign?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我是摩羯座。你呢？
messages.en: I'm a Capricorn. And you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Kaprikornu 放在两张学习卡上：星图卡记天文星座，生日聊天卡记黄道星座，同一个名称对应两种语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to sigh often; used to describe someone who tends to sigh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人容易叹气或经常叹息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħabta jitniehed ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱叹气的；有经常叹息倾向的。

collocations.en: a man who tends to sigh
a person who tends to sigh

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-ġar bħala raġel karban li jitniehed ta' spiss.
formal.en: In the story, the author describes the neighbour as a man inclined to sigh, who sighs frequently.
formal.zh: 故事中，作者把那位邻居描写成一个爱叹气、时常发出叹息的男人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tgħid li Pawlu karban? Toni: Għax jitniehed ta' spiss, anki waqt li nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you say Pawlu tends to sigh? Toni: Because he sighs often, even while we're talking.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么说 Pawlu 爱叹气？Toni：因为他常常叹气，连我们聊天时也这样。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说 Pawlu 爱叹气？
messages.en: Why do you say Pawlu tends to sigh?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jitniehed ta' spiss, anki waqt li nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jitniehed ta' spiss, anki waqt li nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 因为他常常叹气，连我们聊天时也这样。
messages.en: Because he sighs often, even while we're talking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人物卡旁连续出现几个“唉”的气泡，再写上 karban；用反复叹气的画面记住这个描述人的形容词。

gloss_zh: 蹒跚行走；一瘸一拐地走

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk along with difficulty, taking uneven or awkward steps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路费力、步伐不稳或不顺畅地向前走，即蹒跚行走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mexa b'diffikultà u b'passi mhux regolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蹒跚地向前走；一瘸一拐地走。

formal.mt: Wara li weġġa' siequ, ir-raġel karfas bil-mod sal-bank u qagħad bilqiegħda.
formal.en: After hurting his foot, the man hobbled slowly to the bench and sat down.
formal.zh: 脚受伤后，那名男子慢慢地蹒跚走到长椅旁，坐了下来。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Mark karfas sal-bieb? Luqa: Għax weġġa' siequ u sabha diffiċli jimxi.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did Mark hobble to the door? Luqa: Because he hurt his foot and found it difficult to walk.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Mark 为什么一瘸一拐地走到门口？Luqa：因为他的脚受伤了，走路很费劲。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么一瘸一拐地走到门口？
messages.en: Why did Mark hobble to the door?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax weġġa' siequ u sabha diffiċli jimxi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax weġġa' siequ u sabha diffiċli jimxi.
messages.zh: 因为他的脚受伤了，走路很费劲。
messages.en: Because he hurt his foot and found it difficult to walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手指在桌面上模仿不均匀的脚步，再读 karfas，把词和蹒跚前进的动作连起来；它表示行走动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Celery, a vegetable whose stalks and leaves are used in food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 芹菜，一种茎和叶可用于烹调的蔬菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa li z-zkuk u l-weraq tagħha jintużaw fl-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芹菜。

formal.mt: Għal din is-soppa, aħsel il-karfus u qattgħu f'biċċiet żgħar qabel iżżidu mal-borma.
formal.en: For this soup, wash the celery and cut it into small pieces before adding it to the pot.
formal.zh: 做这道汤时，先将芹菜洗净切成小块，再放入锅中。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandna karfus għas-soppa? Ben: Iva, hemm ftit fil-friġġ. Se nqattgħu issa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do we have celery for the soup? Ben: Yes, there's some in the fridge. I'll chop it now.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我们有煮汤用的芹菜吗？Ben：有，冰箱里有一些。我现在就切。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 我们有煮汤用的芹菜吗？
messages.en: Do we have celery for the soup?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ftit fil-friġġ. Se nqattgħu issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ftit fil-friġġ. Se nqattgħu issa.
messages.zh: 有，冰箱里有一些。我现在就切。
messages.en: Yes, there's some in the fridge. I'll chop it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在厨房学习卡上把 karfus 配成一根芹菜的图；与 karfas 对照记忆：karfus 是蔬菜，karfas 是蹒跚走路。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant called alexanders in English, scientifically named Smyrnium olusatrum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指英语称为 alexanders、学名为 Smyrnium olusatrum 的植物，中文可译为亚历山大芹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala alexanders, bl-isem xjentifiku Smyrnium olusatrum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亚历山大芹，指学名为 Smyrnium olusatrum、英语名为 alexanders 的植物。

formal.mt: Fil-gwida tal-pjanti, il-karfus il-ħmir jidher bl-isem xjentifiku Smyrnium olusatrum.
formal.en: In the plant guide, alexanders appears under the scientific name Smyrnium olusatrum.
formal.zh: 植物图鉴中，亚历山大芹列在学名 Smyrnium olusatrum 之下。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'jisimha din il-pjanta fir-ritratt? Ġanni: Karfus il-ħmir. Fil-ktieb hemm ukoll l-isem Smyrnium olusatrum.
colloquial.en: Rita: What is this plant in the photo called? Ġanni: Alexanders. The book also gives the name Smyrnium olusatrum.
colloquial.zh: Rita：照片里的这种植物叫什么？Ġanni：亚历山大芹。书里还列出了 Smyrnium olusatrum 这个名称。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant in the photo called?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Karfus il-ħmir. Fil-ktieb hemm ukoll l-isem Smyrnium olusatrum.
messages.mt_standard: Karfus il-ħmir. Fil-ktieb hemm ukoll l-isem Smyrnium olusatrum.
messages.zh: 亚历山大芹。书里还列出了 Smyrnium olusatrum 这个名称。
messages.en: Alexanders. The book also gives the name Smyrnium olusatrum.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 karfus il-ħmir 整体写在植物卡上，背面配 alexanders 和学名；特别圈出 il-ħmir，避免与单独的 karfus 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant known in English as fool's watercress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种英语称为 fool's watercress 的植物，中文可译为假豆瓣菜；学习时应把整个短语作为植物名称记忆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' pjanta li bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ fool's watercress.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 假豆瓣菜，指英语名为 fool's watercress 的植物。

formal.mt: Il-folja tal-istudju turi ritratt tal-karfus tal-ilma u tagħti l-isem Ingliż fool's watercress.
formal.en: The study sheet shows a photograph of fool's watercress and gives its English name.
formal.zh: 学习资料展示了假豆瓣菜的照片，并列出了它的英语名称 fool's watercress。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif ngħid fool's watercress bil-Malti? Samwel: Karfus tal-ilma. Ikteb l-isem kollu ħdejn ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Lina: How do I say fool's watercress in Maltese? Samwel: Karfus tal-ilma. Write the full name next to the photo.
colloquial.zh: Lina：fool's watercress 用马耳他语怎么说？Samwel：Karfus tal-ilma。把完整名称写在照片旁边。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: fool's watercress 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say fool's watercress in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Samwel (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Karfus tal-ilma. Ikteb l-isem kollu ħdejn ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Karfus tal-ilma. Ikteb l-isem kollu ħdejn ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: Karfus tal-ilma。把完整名称写在照片旁边。
messages.en: Karfus tal-ilma. Write the full name next to the photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 karfus tal-ilma 与 fool's watercress 成对记在同一张植物卡上，圈出 tal-ilma；再与 karfus il-ħmir 并排比较完整名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant known in English as water dropwort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英语称为 water dropwort 的水芹类植物名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' pjanta magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala water dropwort.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水芹属植物；英语称为 water dropwort 的植物。

formal.mt: Fil-gwida tal-pjanti, il-karfus tal-wied jidher f'ritratt ħdejn deskrizzjoni qasira.
formal.en: In the plant guide, water dropwort appears in a photograph beside a short description.
formal.zh: 在植物指南中，水芹类植物的照片旁附有简短说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Fil-gwida jisimha karfus tal-wied.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the name of this plant in the photograph? Pawlu: In the guide, it's called water dropwort.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这种植物叫什么？保罗：指南里把它叫作 karfus tal-wied，也就是水芹类植物。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What's the name of this plant in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 指南里把它叫作 karfus tal-wied，也就是水芹类植物。
messages.en: In the guide, it's called water dropwort.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上植物图卡记忆，看到 karfus tal-wied 就回想水芹类植物；整组识记，不凭词形推断具体物种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A folk name used for the devil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 民间用来称呼魔鬼的一个名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem popolari li jintuża għax-xitan.

sense_translations.en_definition: a folk name for the devil
sense_translations.zh_definition: 魔鬼的一个民间名称或俗称。

collocations.en: karfusu as a name for the devil

formal.mt: Fin-nota dwar il-kliem tal-istorja, l-awtur jispjega li karfusu huwa isem popolari għax-xitan.
formal.en: In the note on the story's vocabulary, the author explains that karfusu is a folk name for the devil.
formal.zh: 在故事的词语注释中，作者说明 karfusu 是魔鬼的一个民间称呼。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser karfusu f'din l-istorja? Nannu: Huwa isem popolari għax-xitan.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does karfusu mean in this story? Grandpa: It's a folk name for the devil.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个故事里的 karfusu 是什么意思？爷爷：那是魔鬼的一个民间称呼。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 karfusu 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does karfusu mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Nannu (爷爷)
messages.zh: 那是魔鬼的一个民间称呼。
messages.en: It's a folk name for the devil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象民间故事中出现魔鬼，旁边写着 karfusu；把它记成故事里的魔鬼称呼，不与相近拼写的植物词混淆。

gloss_zh: 慷慨高尚的；心地善良的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Generous and noble in character, or kind-hearted in dealing with others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人本性慷慨、品格高尚、宽宏大度，或待人心地善良。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu karattru ġeneruż u nobbli, jew qalb tajba lejn l-oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 本性慷慨的；高尚的；正直可敬的；宽宏大度的。
心地善良的；心肠好的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, Pawlu huwa bniedem karim li jgħin lill-ġirien tiegħu mingħajr ma jistenna xejn lura.
formal.en: In the story, Pawlu is a generous, kind-hearted person who helps his neighbours without expecting anything in return.
formal.zh: 故事中的保罗为人慷慨善良，帮助邻居而不求回报。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu reġa' għen lill-ġar tiegħu llum. Lara: Kemm hu karim! Dejjem jaħseb fl-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu helped his neighbour again today. Lara: He's so kind-hearted! He always thinks of others.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗今天又帮了邻居。拉拉：他真善良！总是替别人着想。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu reġa' għen lill-ġar tiegħu llum.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu reġa' għen lill-ġar tiegħu llum.
messages.zh: 保罗今天又帮了邻居。
messages.en: Pawlu helped his neighbour again today.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu karim! Dejjem jaħseb fl-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu karim! Dejjem jaħseb fl-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 他真善良！总是替别人着想。
messages.en: He's so kind-hearted! He always thinks of others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一个不求回报、主动帮助邻居的人来记 karim：既可强调慷慨高尚的品格，也可强调善良的心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Concerned with helping people in need, especially through charitable work or giving.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与帮助有需要者有关的，尤其指慈善活动、捐助或乐善好施的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-għajnuna lil min hu fil-bżonn, speċjalment permezz tal-karità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慈善的；从事或支持慈善的；乐善好施的。

formal.mt: L-għaqda karitattevoli organizzat ġbir ta' fondi biex tgħin lill-familji fil-bżonn.
formal.en: The charitable organisation held a fundraiser to help families in need.
formal.zh: 该慈善组织举办了筹款活动，帮助有需要的家庭。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għal min qed tiġbru l-flus? Maja: Għal għaqda karitattevoli li tgħin lill-familji.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who are you collecting money for? Maja: For a charitable organisation that helps families.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们在为谁筹款？玛雅：为一个帮助家庭的慈善组织。

messages.speaker: Mark (路人)
messages.zh: 你们在为谁筹款？
messages.en: Who are you collecting money for?

messages.speaker: Maja (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal għaqda karitattevoli li tgħin lill-familji.
messages.mt_standard: Għal għaqda karitattevoli li tgħin lill-familji.
messages.zh: 为一个帮助家庭的慈善组织。
messages.en: For a charitable organisation that helps families.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 karitattevoli 写在慈善募款箱的图卡上，再连读 għaqda karitattevoli，记住它能修饰慈善组织和慈善工作。

gloss_zh: 比尔基卡拉的；比尔基卡拉人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or connected with Birkirkara.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自或涉及比尔基卡拉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu minn Birkirkara jew għandu x'jaqsam ma' Birkirkara.

sense_translations.en_definition: of, from or relating to Birkirkara
sense_translations.zh_definition: 比尔基卡拉的；来自比尔基卡拉的；与比尔基卡拉有关的。
比尔基卡拉本地人或居民。

collocations.zh: 来自比尔基卡拉的作家
比尔基卡拉的文化遗产

formal.mt: Il-kittieb Karkariż ippreżenta studju dwar il-wirt kulturali ta' Birkirkara.
formal.en: The writer from Birkirkara presented a study on Birkirkara's cultural heritage.
formal.zh: 这位来自比尔基卡拉的作家介绍了一项关于当地文化遗产的研究。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int Karkariż? Mark: Iva, noqgħod Birkirkara.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you from Birkirkara? Mark: Yes, I live in Birkirkara.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你是比尔基卡拉人吗？马克：是的，我住在比尔基卡拉。

messages.speaker: Lara (新同学)
messages.zh: 你是比尔基卡拉人吗？
messages.en: Are you from Birkirkara?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，我住在比尔基卡拉。
messages.en: Yes, I live in Birkirkara.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Birkirkara 地名卡与 Karkariż 人物卡配对：修饰作家时表示当地的，作为名词时表示当地人或居民。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fertility of land, or a stretch of fertile land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 土地的肥沃性质，也可指一片肥沃的土地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fertilità tal-art, jew medda art għammiela.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肥沃；土地的肥力。
一片肥沃的土地；一片沃土。

collocations.en: a stretch of fertile land near the village

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi karma ħdejn ir-raħal li tintuża għat-tkabbir tal-ħxejjex.
formal.en: The report describes a stretch of fertile land near the village that is used for growing vegetables.
formal.zh: 报告描述了村庄附近一片用于种植蔬菜的肥沃土地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser karma hawn? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser medda art għammiela; tista' tfisser ukoll il-fertilità tal-art.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does karma mean here? Pawlu: Here it means a stretch of fertile land; it can also mean the fertility of the land.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 karma 是什么意思？保罗：这里指一片沃土；它也可以表示土地的肥沃性质。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 karma 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does karma mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser medda art għammiela; tista' tfisser ukoll il-fertilità tal-art.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser medda art għammiela; tista' tfisser ukoll il-fertilità tal-art.
messages.zh: 这里指一片沃土；它也可以表示土地的肥沃性质。
messages.en: Here it means a stretch of fertile land; it can also mean the fertility of the land.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 karma 配两幅图：一幅写土壤肥力，一幅圈出整片沃土；用性质与地块的区别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To live with limited financial means and keep one's spending modest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依靠有限的钱财或微薄收入过日子，生活开支保持简朴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħix bi ftit flus u b'infiq modest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 靠微薄收入或有限的钱财度日；过简朴的生活。

collocations.en: lived on modest means for many years
collocations.zh: 多年来靠微薄收入生活

formal.mt: Wara li naqas id-dħul tiegħu, Pawlu karmad għal diversi snin u naqqas l-ispejjeż tiegħu.
formal.en: After his income fell, Pawlu lived on modest means for several years and reduced his expenses.
formal.zh: 收入减少后，保罗靠有限的钱财生活了好几年，并削减了开支。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif għex Pawlu meta kellu ftit xogħol? Mark: Karmad bi ftit flus u xtara biss dak li kellu bżonn.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Pawlu get by when he had little work? Mark: He lived on little money and bought only what he needed.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗工作很少的时候怎么过日子？马克：他靠少量钱财度日，只买必需品。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għex Pawlu meta kellu ftit xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għex Pawlu meta kellu ftit xogħol?
messages.zh: 保罗工作很少的时候怎么过日子？
messages.en: How did Pawlu get by when he had little work?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Karmad bi ftit flus u xtara biss dak li kellu bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Karmad bi ftit flus u xtara biss dak li kellu bżonn.
messages.zh: 他靠少量钱财度日，只买必需品。
messages.en: He lived on little money and bought only what he needed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张只列必需品的购物清单，把 karmad 与靠少量钱财过日子相连；记住它描述生活方式这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave a tart taste in the mouth after being tasted or eaten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物或饮品尝过之后在口中留下酸涩的味道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħalli togħma qarsa fil-ħalq wara li wieħed iduqu jew jieklu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to leave a tart taste in the mouth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在口中留下酸涩味；使嘴里留下酸味。

collocations.en: fruit that left a tart taste in my mouth
collocations.zh: 在我口中留下酸涩味的水果

collocations.en: wine that left a tart taste in my mouth
collocations.zh: 在我口中留下酸涩味的葡萄酒

formal.mt: Fin-noti tat-togħma, il-kittieb qal li l-inbid karmas f'ħalqu u ħalla togħma qarsa.
formal.en: In the tasting notes, the writer said that the wine left a tart taste in his mouth.
formal.zh: 在品尝记录中，作者写道，这款葡萄酒在他口中留下了酸涩味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok il-frott? Pawlu: Kien qares wisq; karmas f'ħalqi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you like the fruit? Pawlu: It was too sour; it left a tart taste in my mouth.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢那水果吗？保罗：太酸了，嘴里留下了酸涩味。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢那水果吗？
messages.en: Did you like the fruit?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 太酸了，嘴里留下了酸涩味。
messages.en: It was too sour; it left a tart taste in my mouth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象尝过酸水果后嘴里仍有酸涩味，把 karmas 与余味停留的画面相连，记住重点是留下味道这一动作。

gloss_zh: 欢乐嬉闹；尤指狂欢节期间的玩乐

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lively fun and playful activity, especially during carnival.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 热闹的玩乐和嬉闹，尤其指狂欢节期间的欢乐活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajat ta' ferħ, ċajt u logħob, speċjalment waqt il-karnival.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玩乐，嬉闹；尤指狂欢节期间的欢乐活动

formal.mt: Waqt il-festa, it-tfal għamlu karnivalata fil-pjazza, bil-kostumi u bil-mużika.
formal.en: During the celebration, the children had carnival fun in the square, with costumes and music.
formal.zh: 庆祝活动期间，孩子们穿着盛装，伴着音乐，在广场上欢乐嬉闹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nagħmlu bil-kostumi? Pawlu: Nilbsuhom u nagħmlu karnivalata mal-ħbieb!
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we do with the costumes? Pawlu: Let's put them on and have some carnival fun with our friends!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些服装拿来做什么好？保罗：穿上它们，和朋友们一起欢乐嬉闹吧！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些服装拿来做什么好？
messages.en: What shall we do with the costumes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 穿上它们，和朋友们一起欢乐嬉闹吧！
messages.en: Let's put them on and have some carnival fun with our friends!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上朋友穿着节庆服装一起嬉闹的画面，记住它指欢乐玩乐。

gloss_zh: 狂欢节式的；具有狂欢节气氛的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the lively, playful, or extravagant character of a carnival.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有狂欢节般热闹、嬉闹或夸张特色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ferħ, il-logħob jew l-esaġerazzjoni tal-karnival.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狂欢节式的；具有狂欢节般热闹、嬉闹或夸张特色的

formal.mt: Il-kostumi mlewna u l-mużika taw karattru karnivalesk lill-ispettaklu.
formal.en: The colourful costumes and music gave the show a carnivalesque character.
formal.zh: 色彩鲜艳的服装与音乐赋予了这场演出狂欢节般的特色。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kien l-ispettaklu? Mark: Kien karnivalesk, bil-maskri u biż-żfin!
colloquial.en: Sara: What was the show like? Mark: It was carnivalesque, with masks and dancing!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：演出怎么样？马克：很有狂欢节风格，有面具，还有舞蹈！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 演出怎么样？
messages.en: What was the show like?

messages.speaker: Mark (观众)
messages.zh: 很有狂欢节风格，有面具，还有舞蹈！
messages.en: It was carnivalesque, with masks and dancing!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面具、舞蹈和鲜艳服装，再用这个形容词描述整场演出的狂欢节风格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A freshwater fish called a carp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为鲤鱼的淡水鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta li tgħix fl-ilma ħelu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鲤鱼

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenti raw karpa tgħum qrib wiċċ l-ilma fl-għadira.
formal.en: During the observation, the students saw a carp swimming near the surface of the pond.
formal.zh: 观察期间，学生们看见一条鲤鱼在池塘里靠近水面的地方游动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ħuta hi dik fl-għadira? Toni: Dik karpa. Ara kemm hi kbira!
colloquial.en: Lara: What fish is that in the pond? Toni: That's a carp. Look how big it is!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：池塘里的那是什么鱼？托尼：那是鲤鱼。你看它多大！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 池塘里的那是什么鱼？
messages.en: What fish is that in the pond?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik karpa. Ara kemm hi kbira!
messages.mt_standard: Dik karpa. Ara kemm hi kbira!
messages.zh: 那是鲤鱼。你看它多大！
messages.en: That's a carp. Look how big it is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把卡片正面写上这个词，背面画一条池塘里的鲤鱼，用鱼的画面帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 使呻吟；使乞求；也作名词指爱抱怨的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone groan or to make someone beg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人发出呻吟，或使某人不得不乞求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jokrob jew jitlob bil-ħerqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人呻吟；使某人发出痛苦的哼声
使某人乞求；使某人不得不苦苦请求
爱抱怨或哼哼唧唧诉苦的人

collocations.en: a whiner who complains about everything
collocations.zh: 一个凡事都要抱怨的人

formal.mt: L-uġigħ qawwi karrab lill-pazjent waqt l-eżami mediku.
formal.en: The severe pain made the patient groan during the medical examination.
formal.zh: 体检期间，剧烈的疼痛使病人发出了呻吟。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex għajjat Pietru? David: L-uġigħ f'dahru karrab lil Pietru meta pprova jqum.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did Pietru cry out? David: The pain in his back made Pietru groan when he tried to get up.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：彼得为什么叫出声了？戴维：彼得想站起来时，背部的疼痛让他呻吟起来。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 彼得为什么叫出声了？
messages.en: Why did Pietru cry out?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-uġigħ f'dahru karrab lil Pietru meta pprova jqum.
messages.mt_standard: L-uġigħ f'dahru karrab lil Pietru meta pprova jqum.
messages.zh: 彼得想站起来时，背部的疼痛让他呻吟起来。
messages.en: The pain in his back made Pietru groan when he tried to get up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记动词的使动关系：某事使人呻吟或乞求；再单独记名词义为爱抱怨的人。

gloss_zh: 爱抱怨的；爱哼哼唧唧诉苦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to complain or whine frequently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于经常抱怨或哼哼唧唧诉苦的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jilmenta jew jokrob ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱抱怨的；动不动就哼哼唧唧诉苦的

collocations.en: a boy who tends to whine
collocations.zh: 一个爱哼哼唧唧抱怨的男孩

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-awtur juża ton karrabi biex jesprimi n-nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon tiegħu.
formal.en: In his letter, the writer uses a whining tone to express his dissatisfaction.
formal.zh: 作者在信中用哼哼唧唧的抱怨语气表达自己的不满。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif tkellem miegħek? Samwel: B'ton karrabi; ma kien kuntent b'xejn.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did he speak to you? Samwel: In a whining tone; he wasn't happy with anything.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他跟你说话时是什么语气？塞缪尔：一副哼哼唧唧的抱怨腔，什么都不满意。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 他跟你说话时是什么语气？
messages.en: How did he speak to you?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: B'ton karrabi; ma kien kuntent b'xejn.
messages.mt_standard: B'ton karrabi; ma kien kuntent b'xejn.
messages.zh: 一副哼哼唧唧的抱怨腔，什么都不满意。
messages.en: In a whining tone; he wasn't happy with anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人说话总带抱怨腔，用这个形容词描述他的语气和爱诉苦的倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make land fertile and able to produce abundant crops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使土地变得肥沃，并能丰盛地出产作物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel l-art fertili u kapaċi tagħti ħsad abbundanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使肥沃并富有生产力；使土地丰产

collocations.en: made the land fertile and productive
made the soil fertile and productive
collocations.zh: 使土壤肥沃并有利于丰产

formal.mt: L-użu regolari tal-kompost karrem l-art u għen biex il-ħsad ikun aktar abbundanti.
formal.en: Regular use of compost made the land fertile and productive and helped produce a more abundant harvest.
formal.zh: 定期使用堆肥使土地肥沃丰产，有助于获得更丰盛的收成。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif saret daqshekk fertili din l-art? Ġużeppi: Il-kompost karrem l-art; issa l-ħxejjex jikbru aħjar.
colloquial.en: Rita: How did this land become so fertile? Ġużeppi: The compost made the land fertile and productive; the vegetables grow better now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这块地怎么变得这么肥沃了？朱塞佩：堆肥让土地肥沃丰产，现在蔬菜长得更好了。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif saret daqshekk fertili din l-art?
messages.mt_standard: Kif saret daqshekk fertili din l-art?
messages.zh: 这块地怎么变得这么肥沃了？
messages.en: How did this land become so fertile?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (种植者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kompost karrem l-art; issa l-ħxejjex jikbru aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kompost karrem l-art; issa l-ħxejjex jikbru aħjar.
messages.zh: 堆肥让土地肥沃丰产，现在蔬菜长得更好了。
messages.en: The compost made the land fertile and productive; the vegetables grow better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词连成一幅过程图：加入堆肥，土地变肥沃，作物收成增加。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sheet of paper that can be used for writing or drawing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可用于书写或绘画的一张纸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Folja tal-karta li tista' tintuża għall-kitba jew għat-tpinġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一张纸；纸页

collocations.en: write on a sheet of paper

formal.mt: Kull student għandu jikteb ismu u t-tweġibiet tiegħu fuq kartella vojta.
formal.en: Each student should write their name and answers on a blank sheet of paper.
formal.zh: 每位学生应在一张空白纸上写下自己的姓名和答案。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Għandek kartella vojta? Ben: Iva, hawn waħda. Tista' tikteb fuqha.
colloquial.en: Emma: Do you have a blank sheet of paper? Ben: Yes, here's one. You can write on it.
colloquial.zh: 埃玛：你有空白纸吗？本：有，这里有一张。你可以在上面写。

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.zh: 你有空白纸吗？
messages.en: Do you have a blank sheet of paper?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn waħda. Tista' tikteb fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn waħda. Tista' tikteb fuqha.
messages.zh: 有，这里有一张。你可以在上面写。
messages.en: Yes, here's one. You can write on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习这个义项时，想象同学递来一张空白纸，随后你就在纸页上写字。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large sign displaying a written message for people to read.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 写有文字、供公众阅读的大型标语牌或告示牌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tabella kbira b'messaġġ miktub biex jarawh u jaqrawh in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 标语牌；告示牌

formal.mt: Quddiem id-daħla tqiegħed kartellun bil-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ.
formal.en: A placard showing the opening hours was placed in front of the entrance.
formal.zh: 入口前放置了一块标有开放时间的告示牌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tikteb fuq il-kartellun? Mark: Se nikteb 'Żommu l-park nadif'.
colloquial.en: Maja: What will you write on the placard? Mark: I'll write 'Keep the park clean'.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你准备在标语牌上写什么？Mark：我准备写“保持公园清洁”。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备在标语牌上写什么？
messages.en: What will you write on the placard?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我准备写“保持公园清洁”。
messages.en: I'll write 'Keep the park clean'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kartellun 想成入口处醒目的大牌子：文字要让大家看见，记住“标语牌、告示牌”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Letters exchanged between people, considered together as correspondence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们相互寄送的书信，通常作为一组往来通信来理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ittri li persuni jibagħtu lil xulxin, meqjusa flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 往来通信；书信

collocations.zh: 两位作家之间的往来书信

formal.mt: L-arkivju jżomm il-karteġġ bejn iż-żewġ kittieba għal skopijiet ta' riċerka.
formal.en: The archive preserves the correspondence between the two writers for research purposes.
formal.zh: 档案馆保存着这两位作家之间的往来书信，供研究使用。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'sibt fil-kaxxa tan-nanna? Luqa: Il-karteġġ tagħha ma' ħabiba antika. Hemm ħafna ittri!
colloquial.en: Marija: What did you find in Grandma's box? Luqa: Her correspondence with an old friend. There are lots of letters!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你在奶奶的箱子里找到了什么？卢卡：她和一位老朋友的往来书信。有好多封呢！

messages.speaker: Marija (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你在奶奶的箱子里找到了什么？
messages.en: What did you find in Grandma's box?

messages.speaker: Luqa (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-karteġġ tagħha ma' ħabiba antika. Hemm ħafna ittri!
messages.mt_standard: Il-karteġġ tagħha ma' ħabiba antika. Hemm ħafna ittri!
messages.zh: 她和一位老朋友的往来书信。有好多封呢！
messages.en: Her correspondence with an old friend. There are lots of letters!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象盒子里按日期整理的一叠来信和回信，用整组往来书信记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rumble, as thunder does, or to grind material into smaller particles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指雷发出隆隆声，也指把材料研磨成较小的颗粒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss qawwi u baxx, bħar-ragħad, jew jitħan materjal f'partiċelli iżgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隆隆作响，指雷声
研磨；磨碎

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl ir-ragħad karwat bil-qawwa, u filgħodu nstabet ħafna ilma fit-toroq.
formal.en: During the night the thunder rumbled loudly, and in the morning a great deal of water was found in the streets.
formal.zh: 夜间雷声隆隆，早晨发现街道上积了很多水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt kif karwat ir-ragħad? Mark: Iva, tant kien qawwi li qajjimni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear how the thunder rumbled? Mark: Yes, it was so loud that it woke me up.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听到雷声怎样隆隆作响了吗？Mark：听到了，声音大得把我吵醒了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你听到雷声怎样隆隆作响了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear how the thunder rumbled?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tant kien qawwi li qajjimni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tant kien qawwi li qajjimni.
messages.zh: 听到了，声音大得把我吵醒了。
messages.en: Yes, it was so loud that it woke me up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 karwat 配两幅记忆画面：天空雷声隆隆，磨坊正在磨麦；靠主语和宾语区分两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A covering spread over a bed, such as a coverlet or blanket.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铺盖在床上的织物，如床罩、薄盖被或毯子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata li tinfirex fuq sodda, bħal kutra jew għata ħafifa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 床罩；铺在床上的盖布
薄床罩；薄盖被
毯子

formal.mt: Fuq kull sodda tqiegħdet karwata nadifa qabel il-wasla tal-mistednin.
formal.en: A clean bed covering was placed on each bed before the guests arrived.
formal.zh: 客人到达前，每张床上都铺放了一条干净的床上盖物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed inħoss il-bard. Fejn hi l-karwata? Mark: Fuq is-siġġu ħdejn is-sodda; ħudha.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm feeling cold. Where's the blanket? Mark: On the chair beside the bed; take it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我觉得冷。毯子在哪里？Mark：在床边的椅子上，拿去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss il-bard. Fejn hi l-karwata?
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss il-bard. Fejn hi l-karwata?
messages.zh: 我觉得冷。毯子在哪里？
messages.en: I'm feeling cold. Where's the blanket?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 在床边的椅子上，拿去吧。
messages.en: On the chair beside the bed; take it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 karwata 与“铺床、盖身”联系：铺开是床罩，盖上可作毯子，三个义项都围绕床上盖物。

gloss_zh: 易磨得粗的；易发出雷鸣般隆隆声的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to grind material coarsely or to make a rumbling sound like thunder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容容易把材料磨得较粗，或容易发出雷鸣般隆隆声的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jitħan materjal oħxon jew jagħmel ħoss baxx u qawwi bħar-ragħad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于把材料磨得较粗的
容易发出雷鸣般隆隆声的

collocations.en: a mechanism that tends to grind coarsely
collocations.zh: 容易把材料磨得较粗的机械装置

collocations.en: a motor that tends to rumble like thunder
collocations.zh: 容易发出雷鸣般隆隆声的电动机

formal.mt: Il-mekkaniżmu huwa karwati: it-tħin tiegħu jħalli partiċelli kbar, u għalhekk mhuwiex adattat għal trab fin.
formal.en: The mechanism tends to grind coarsely: its grinding leaves large particles, so it is unsuitable for producing fine powder.
formal.zh: 该装置容易磨得较粗：研磨后仍留有较大的颗粒，因此不适合制取细粉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-mutur karwati; isma' x'ħoss jagħmel! Mark: Veru, qisu ragħad. Nitbiegħdu ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: This motor tends to rumble; listen to the noise it makes! Mark: True, it sounds like thunder. Let's move a little farther away.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这台电动机老是隆隆响，听听它的声音！Mark：确实，像打雷一样。我们走远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-mutur karwati; isma' x'ħoss jagħmel!
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-mutur karwati; isma' x'ħoss jagħmel!
messages.zh: 这台电动机老是隆隆响，听听它的声音！
messages.en: This motor tends to rumble; listen to the noise it makes!

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 确实，像打雷一样。我们走远一点吧。
messages.en: True, it sounds like thunder. Let's move a little farther away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 karwati 时抓住“容易如此”的性质：研磨常留粗颗粒，发声常像打雷；它是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Oppressive toward others or inclined to vilify them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容对他人施加压迫，或惯于用恶意言语贬损他人的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħqar lil ħaddieħor jew għandu tendenza jżeblaħ lin-nies u jħammeġ isimhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压迫人的；苛压他人的
惯于诋毁、污蔑他人的

collocations.en: a writer inclined to vilify others

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-mexxej kasbari juża l-biża' biex iġiegħel lin-nies jobduh.
formal.en: In the novel, the oppressive leader uses fear to make people obey him.
formal.zh: 小说中，那位苛压民众的领导者利用恐惧迫使人们服从。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tgħid li dak il-kittieb kasbari? Mark: Għax dejjem iżeblaħ lin-nies flok jiddiskuti l-ideat tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you saying that writer is inclined to vilify others? Mark: Because he always insults people instead of discussing their ideas.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么说那位作者惯于诋毁别人？Mark：因为他总是辱骂别人，而不讨论他们的观点。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħid li dak il-kittieb kasbari?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħid li dak il-kittieb kasbari?
messages.zh: 你为什么说那位作者惯于诋毁别人？
messages.en: Why are you saying that writer is inclined to vilify others?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem iżeblaħ lin-nies flok jiddiskuti l-ideat tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem iżeblaħ lin-nies flok jiddiskuti l-ideat tagħhom.
messages.zh: 因为他总是辱骂别人，而不讨论他们的观点。
messages.en: Because he always insults people instead of discussing their ideas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两种伤人方式记 kasbari：凭权力压迫人，凭言语诋毁人；共同记住其负面评价。

gloss_zh: 做无关紧要的事消磨时间

teaching_sense.en_definition: To waste time occupying oneself with something unimportant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把时间耗在无关紧要的事情上，闲混或瞎忙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħli l-ħin jagħmel xi ħaġa bla importanza.

sense_translations.en_definition: to idle away one's time doing something of no importance
sense_translations.zh_definition: 做些无关紧要的事情来消磨时间；闲混

collocations.en: he idled away his time on unimportant things
collocations.zh: 他把时间耗在无关紧要的事情上

collocations.en: he idled away his time after the meal
collocations.zh: 他饭后做些无关紧要的事消磨时间

formal.mt: Minflok lesta x-xogħol tiegħu, Mark kaskas b'affarijiet bla importanza sa nofsinhar.
formal.en: Instead of finishing his work, Mark idled away his time on unimportant things until noon.
formal.zh: Mark 没有完成自己的工作，而是做些无关紧要的事情，一直消磨到中午。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark x'għamel dalgħodu? Lara: Kaskas bil-karti fuq l-iskrivanija u ma lesta xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Mark do this morning? Lara: He fiddled about with the papers on the desk and got nothing finished.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 今天上午做了什么？Lara：他摆弄桌上的纸张消磨时间，什么也没完成。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: Mark 今天上午做了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark do this morning?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kaskas bil-karti fuq l-iskrivanija u ma lesta xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Kaskas bil-karti fuq l-iskrivanija u ma lesta xejn.
messages.zh: 他摆弄桌上的纸张消磨时间，什么也没完成。
messages.en: He fiddled about with the papers on the desk and got nothing finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人反复摆弄桌上纸张，看似忙碌却毫无进展；用这个场景记 kaskas 的“闲混、瞎忙”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The annulment of a judicial decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 司法判决被撤销或废止。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tħassir ta' sentenza ġudizzjarja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撤销、废止司法判决

formal.mt: Il-manwal jiddefinixxi l-kassazzjoni bħala t-tħassir ta' sentenza ġudizzjarja.
formal.en: The manual defines cassation as the annulment of a judicial decision.
formal.zh: 该手册将 kassazzjoni 定义为对司法判决的撤销。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'kassazzjoni' f'dan it-test? Mark: Tfisser it-tħassir ta' sentenza tal-qorti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'kassazzjoni' mean in this text? Mark: It means the annulment of a court judgment.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇文章里的 kassazzjoni 是什么意思？Mark：意思是撤销法院判决。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 kassazzjoni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'kassazzjoni' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 意思是撤销法院判决。
messages.en: It means the annulment of a court judgment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kassazzjoni 与一份标上“已撤销”的法院判决联系起来，记住它表示判决撤销这一法律概念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A raised structure at the bow or stern of a ship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 船首或船尾高起的楼状结构，分别称为艏楼或艉楼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura għolja fil-pruwa jew fil-poppa ta' bastiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 艏楼；艉楼，即船首或船尾高起的楼状结构

formal.mt: Id-disinn tal-bastiment juri kassru fil-pruwa u ieħor fil-poppa.
formal.en: The ship's drawing shows a forecastle at the bow and an aftcastle at the stern.
formal.zh: 船舶图纸显示，船首有一座艏楼，船尾有一座艉楼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik il-parti għolja fuq il-mudell x'inhi? Mark: Dak il-kassru tal-pruwa; hemm ieħor fil-poppa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that raised part on the model? Mark: That's the forecastle; there's another raised structure at the stern.
colloquial.zh: Maja：模型上那个高起来的部分是什么？Mark：那是艏楼；船尾还有一座艉楼。

messages.speaker: Maja (博物馆访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik il-parti għolja fuq il-mudell x'inhi?
messages.mt_standard: Dik il-parti għolja fuq il-mudell x'inhi?
messages.zh: 模型上那个高起来的部分是什么？
messages.en: What's that raised part on the model?

messages.speaker: Mark (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-kassru tal-pruwa; hemm ieħor fil-poppa.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-kassru tal-pruwa; hemm ieħor fil-poppa.
messages.zh: 那是艏楼；船尾还有一座艉楼。
messages.en: That's the forecastle; there's another raised structure at the stern.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一条船，船头船尾各有高起的小楼；用位置区分艏楼和艉楼，再把两者都连到 kassru。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A percussion instrument clicked to mark a rhythm; also the fish Chromis chromis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 敲击发声、用于打节奏的响板；也指地中海雀鲷这种鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument tal-perkussjoni li jintuża biex jinżamm ir-ritmu; ukoll il-ħuta Chromis chromis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 响板，一种敲击发声的打击乐器。
地中海雀鲷，学名为 Chromis chromis 的鱼。

collocations.zh: 海中的一条地中海雀鲷

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-mużika, l-istudent uża kastanjola tal-injam biex iżomm ir-ritmu.
formal.en: In the music exercise, the student used a wooden castanet to keep the rhythm.
formal.zh: 在音乐练习中，学生用一块木制响板打节奏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt kastanjola fil-baħar. Luqa: Il-ħuta qed tgħid? Maja: Iva, il-ħuta, mhux l-istrument!
colloquial.en: Maja: I saw a damselfish in the sea. Luqa: You mean the fish? Maja: Yes, the fish, not the instrument!
colloquial.zh: Maja：我在海里看到了一条 kastanjola。Luqa：你说的是那种鱼？Maja：对，是鱼，不是乐器！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在海里看到了一条地中海雀鲷。
messages.en: I saw a damselfish in the sea.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 你说的是那种鱼？
messages.en: You mean the fish?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，是鱼，不是乐器！
messages.en: Yes, the fish, not the instrument!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面区分同形词：音乐课上响板打节奏，海水里面小鱼游；看到音乐或海洋语境再选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A beaver, an animal with large front teeth and a broad, flat tail that lives near water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 河狸，一种生活在水边、长有大门齿和宽扁尾巴的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal li jgħix qrib l-ilma u għandu snien kbar ta' quddiem u denb wiesa' u ċatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 河狸，一种常在水边活动、尾巴宽扁的啮齿动物。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa, il-kastur jidher ħdejn ix-xmara, u d-denb wiesa' u ċatt tiegħu jidher ċar.
formal.en: In the picture, the beaver appears beside the river, and its broad, flat tail is clearly visible.
formal.zh: 图片中的河狸在河边，它宽而扁的尾巴清晰可见。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dak l-annimal ħdejn l-ilma! Pawlu: Dak kastur. Nina: Kif għaraftu? Pawlu: Mid-denb wiesa' u ċatt tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that animal beside the water! Pawlu: That's a beaver. Nina: How did you recognize it? Pawlu: By its broad, flat tail.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看水边那只动物！Pawlu：那是河狸。Nina：你怎么认出来的？Pawlu：看它宽而扁的尾巴。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看水边那只动物！
messages.en: Look at that animal beside the water!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是河狸。
messages.en: That's a beaver.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么认出来的？
messages.en: How did you recognize it?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 看它宽而扁的尾巴。
messages.en: By its broad, flat tail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 kastur，就想象河边一只露出宽扁尾巴的河狸；把单词贴在尾巴旁边，用外形画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Catalonia, an autonomous community in northeastern Spain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加泰罗尼亚，位于西班牙东北部的一个自治区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Komunità awtonoma fil-Grigal ta' Spanja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Catalonia (an autonomous community in northeast Spain)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 加泰罗尼亚，西班牙东北部的一个自治区。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-ġeografija, l-istudenta tidentifika l-Katalonja bħala komunità awtonoma fil-Grigal ta' Spanja.
formal.en: In the geography report, the student identifies Catalonia as an autonomous community in northeastern Spain.
formal.zh: 在地理报告中，这名学生指出，加泰罗尼亚是位于西班牙东北部的一个自治区。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tinsab il-Katalonja? Luqa: Fil-Grigal ta' Spanja. Maja: Tista' turihieli fuq il-mappa? Luqa: Iva, ara hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Catalonia? Luqa: In northeastern Spain. Maja: Can you show it to me on the map? Luqa: Yes, look here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：加泰罗尼亚在哪里？Luqa：在西班牙东北部。Maja：你能在地图上指给我看吗？Luqa：可以，看这里。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 加泰罗尼亚在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Catalonia?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.zh: 在西班牙东北部。
messages.en: In northeastern Spain.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你能在地图上指给我看吗？
messages.en: Can you show it to me on the map?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.zh: 可以，看这里。
messages.en: Yes, look here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Katalonja 和中文“加泰罗尼亚”并排写在地图上，再用箭头指向西班牙东北部，同时记住名称和位置。

gloss_zh: 发出咯咯声；备食时唤引家禽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a cackling sound like a chicken, or to call fowls towards their food while preparing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像鸡一样发出咯咯声；也指在准备饲料时发声唤引家禽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss bħat-tiġieġ, jew isejjaħ lit-tjur biex jiġbedhom lejh waqt li jħejjilhom l-ikel.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a cackling sound (e.g. as chickens do)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出咯咯的叫声，例如鸡发出的声音。

sense_translations.en_definition: to attract fowls when preparing their food
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在给家禽准备食物时，发声将它们唤引过来。

collocations.mt: jkatkat waqt li jħejji l-ikel għat-tiġieġ
collocations.en: to call the chickens while preparing their food

formal.mt: Il-bidwi katkat waqt li ħejja l-ikel għat-tiġieġ, sabiex jiġbidhom lejh.
formal.en: The farmer called the chickens while preparing their food, so as to draw them towards him.
formal.zh: 农民给鸡准备食物时发声唤鸡，让它们聚到自己身边。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Pawlu: It-tiġieġa qed tkatkat. Sara: Qisha qed tkellem lit-tiġieġ l-oħra! Pawlu: Iva, ismagħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's that sound? Pawlu: The hen is cackling. Sara: It sounds as if she's talking to the other chickens! Pawlu: Yes, listen to her.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那是什么声音？Pawlu：母鸡在咯咯叫。Sara：听起来像在跟其他鸡说话！Pawlu：是啊，你听。

messages.speaker: Sara (孩子)
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 母鸡在咯咯叫。
messages.en: The hen is cackling.

messages.speaker: Sara (孩子)
messages.zh: 听起来像在跟其他鸡说话！
messages.en: It sounds as if she's talking to the other chickens!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 是啊，你听。
messages.en: Yes, listen to her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kat-kat 的重复节奏当作课堂记忆口令：一幅画是鸡在咯咯叫，另一幅是农民端着饲料唤鸡；这只是记忆联想。

gloss_zh: 推脱的借口；为逃避某事而找的托词

teaching_sense.en_definition: An excuse made in order to avoid doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了逃避某件事或不做某项任务而提出的借口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skuża li tingħata biex wieħed jevita li jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为逃避某事而编出的借口或推脱之词。

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju miktub, l-impjegat jagħti katletta biex jevita l-kompitu li ngħatalu.
formal.en: In the written example, the employee gives an excuse to avoid the task assigned to him.
formal.zh: 在这个书面例句中，雇员提出借口，想逃避分配给自己的任务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma nistax ngħin illum; għandi ħafna x'nagħmel. Luqa: Din katletta oħra? Maja: Le, tassew għandi x'nagħmel. Ngħinek għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: I can't help today; I have a lot to do. Luqa: Is this another excuse? Maja: No, I really do have things to do. I'll help you tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我今天帮不了忙，有好多事情要做。Luqa：这又是一个推脱的借口吗？Maja：不是，我真的有事要做。我明天帮你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax ngħin illum; għandi ħafna x'nagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax ngħin illum; għandi ħafna x'nagħmel.
messages.zh: 我今天帮不了忙，有好多事情要做。
messages.en: I can't help today; I have a lot to do.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 这又是一个推脱的借口吗？
messages.en: Is this another excuse?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tassew għandi x'nagħmel. Ngħinek għada.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tassew għandi x'nagħmel. Ngħinek għada.
messages.zh: 不是，我真的有事要做。我明天帮你。
messages.en: No, I really do have things to do. I'll help you tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把写着 katletta 的“借口卡”挡在任务前面；记住重点是为了推脱而提出的理由，而不是任何普通解释。

gloss_zh: 爱找借口的；惯于推脱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to find excuses, especially to avoid doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人倾向于找借口，尤其爱借此逃避做事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jsib skużi, speċjalment biex jevita li jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱找借口的，惯于用托词推脱的。

collocations.en: a man who tends to make excuses
a boy who tends to make excuses

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-karattru huwa katlettuż: kull darba li jingħata kompitu, isib skuża biex ma jagħmlux.
formal.en: In the story, the character tends to make excuses: whenever he is given a task, he finds an excuse not to do it.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物很爱找借口：每次接到任务，他都会找理由不去做。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark reġa' sab skuża biex ma jgħinx. Nina: Kemm hu katlettuż! Sara: Din id-darba se nitolbu jgħid ċar jekk jistax jgħin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Mark has found another excuse not to help. Nina: He's always making excuses! Sara: This time I'll ask him to say clearly whether he can help.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 又找借口不帮忙了。Nina：他可真爱找借口！Sara：这次我要请他明确说清楚能不能帮忙。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark reġa' sab skuża biex ma jgħinx.
messages.mt_standard: Mark reġa' sab skuża biex ma jgħinx.
messages.zh: Mark 又找借口不帮忙了。
messages.en: Mark has found another excuse not to help.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 他可真爱找借口！
messages.en: He's always making excuses!

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din id-darba se nitolbu jgħid ċar jekk jistax jgħin.
messages.mt_standard: Din id-darba se nitolbu jgħid ċar jekk jistax jgħin.
messages.zh: 这次我要请他明确说清楚能不能帮忙。
messages.en: This time I'll ask him to say clearly whether he can help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 katletta 记成一张“借口卡”，再把 katlettuż 记成总拿出借口卡的人；前者指借口，后者形容爱找借口的倾向。

gloss_zh: 小船的横座板；横向座凳

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thwart: a seat or bench extending across a small boat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 横跨小船船身、供人坐的座板或长凳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bank jew tavla li tgħaddi minn naħa għall-oħra tad-dgħajsa u li wieħed joqgħod bilqiegħda fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船的横座板，横跨小船船身的座位或长凳。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa tad-dgħajsa, il-katnott huwa bank tal-injam li jgħaddi minn naħa għall-oħra u jservi bħala sedil.
formal.en: In the picture of the boat, the thwart is a wooden bench extending from one side to the other and serving as a seat.
formal.zh: 在这张船的图片中，横座板是一条从船身一侧横跨到另一侧、供人坐的木凳。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn noqgħod fid-dgħajsa? Pawlu: Fuq il-katnott, dak il-bank tal-injam fin-nofs. Maja: Dan li jgħaddi minn naħa għall-oħra? Pawlu: Iva, eżatt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I sit in the boat? Pawlu: On the thwart, that wooden bench in the middle. Maja: This one that goes from one side to the other? Pawlu: Yes, exactly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我在船上该坐哪里？Pawlu：坐横座板，就是中间那条木凳。Maja：是这条从一侧横跨到另一侧的吗？Pawlu：对，就是它。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.zh: 我在船上该坐哪里？
messages.en: Where should I sit in the boat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (船夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-katnott, dak il-bank tal-injam fin-nofs.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-katnott, dak il-bank tal-injam fin-nofs.
messages.zh: 坐横座板，就是中间那条木凳。
messages.en: On the thwart, that wooden bench in the middle.

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan li jgħaddi minn naħa għall-oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Dan li jgħaddi minn naħa għall-oħra?
messages.zh: 是这条从一侧横跨到另一侧的吗？
messages.en: This one that goes from one side to the other?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (船夫)
messages.zh: 对，就是它。
messages.en: Yes, exactly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一只小船，在船身左右两侧之间画一条横着的座板，并标上 katnott；用“船中横板供人坐”的画面记住名词义。

gloss_zh: 有增加作用的；有倍增倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to increase an amount or number, or to cause multiplication.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于使数量增加，或促使某事物成倍增多的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jżid il-kwantità jew in-numru, jew iwassal biex xi ħaġa timmultiplika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于增加数量或扩大程度的。
倾向于使数量倍增或成倍增多的。

collocations.en: an effect tending to increase or multiply something
collocations.zh: 具有增加或倍增作用的效应

collocations.en: a process tending to increase or multiply something
collocations.zh: 促使数量增加或倍增的过程

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-awtur jiddeskrivi effett kattari li jwassal għal żieda fil-produzzjoni.
formal.en: In the report, the author describes an augmentative effect that leads to increased production.
formal.zh: 作者在报告中描述了一种促使产量增加的效应。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tifhem b'effett kattari? Mark: Effett li jżid il-kwantità jew iwassal biex xi ħaġa timmultiplika.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you mean by an augmentative effect? Mark: An effect that increases the amount or causes something to multiply.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你说的增加效应是什么意思？马克：就是使数量增加，或让某事物成倍增多的效应。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 你说的增加效应是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean by an augmentative effect?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Effett li jżid il-kwantità jew iwassal biex xi ħaġa timmultiplika.
messages.mt_standard: Effett li jżid il-kwantità jew iwassal biex xi ħaġa timmultiplika.
messages.zh: 就是使数量增加，或让某事物成倍增多的效应。
messages.en: An effect that increases the amount or causes something to multiply.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kattari 配上一幅数量不断上升、随后成倍增长的图，分别记住“增加”和“倍增”两个义项；这是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pipe that carries sewage as part of a drainage system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 排水系统中用于输送污水的管道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Katusa li minnha jgħaddi l-ilma maħmuġ bħala parti mis-sistema tad-dranaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污水管；用于排送污水的管道。

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni sabet katusa tad-dranaġġ miksura, u għalhekk ġiet irrakkomandata t-tiswija tagħha.
formal.en: The inspection found a broken sewer pipe, so its repair was recommended.
formal.zh: 检查发现一根污水管破裂，因此建议对其进行维修。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-ilma mhux nieżel? Pawlu: Hemm katusa tad-dranaġġ misduda; irridu niftħuha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why isn't the water draining? Pawlu: There's a blocked sewer pipe; we need to unblock it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：水怎么排不下去？保罗：有根污水管堵了，我们得把它疏通。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.zh: 水怎么排不下去？
messages.en: Why isn't the water draining?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (水管工)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm katusa tad-dranaġġ misduda; irridu niftħuha.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm katusa tad-dranaġġ misduda; irridu niftħuha.
messages.zh: 有根污水管堵了，我们得把它疏通。
messages.en: There's a blocked sewer pipe; we need to unblock it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语贴在“污水沿管道流走”的示意图旁，再搭配“堵塞、疏通、更换”三个场景记忆。

gloss_zh: 凿出空穴；挖空；锤打成圆形

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a cavity in something, make it hollow, or hammer it until it becomes round.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体上凿出空穴、将其内部挖空，或通过锤打使其变圆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħofra f'xi ħaġa, jagħmilha vojta minn ġewwa, jew isawwatha bil-martell sakemm tiġi tonda.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a cavity in sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某物上凿出或挖出一个空穴。
将某物内部挖空，使其成为中空的。
用锤反复敲打，直至物体变圆。

collocations.en: he made a cavity in the stone
collocations.zh: 他在石头上凿出了空穴

formal.mt: L-artiġjan kava l-biċċa injam biex jagħmel reċipjent żgħir.
formal.en: The craftsman hollowed out the piece of wood to make a small container.
formal.zh: 工匠把那块木料内部挖空，做成一个小容器。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-artiġjan kava l-injam? Mark: Biex jagħmel skutella; neħħa l-parti ta' ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the craftsman hollow out the wood? Mark: To make a bowl; he removed the inside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：工匠为什么把木料挖空？马克：为了做一只碗，他把里面的部分去掉了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 工匠为什么把木料挖空？
messages.en: Why did the craftsman hollow out the wood?

messages.speaker: Mark (工艺教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jagħmel skutella; neħħa l-parti ta' ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jagħmel skutella; neħħa l-parti ta' ġewwa.
messages.zh: 为了做一只碗，他把里面的部分去掉了。
messages.en: To make a bowl; he removed the inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三格工艺图记 kava：先凿一个洞，再挖空内部，另画锤打变圆；三个动作分别对应三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A concave or inward-curving part at the base of a column.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 柱子底座处向内凹入的部位或凹曲部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti mħaffra jew mgħawġa lejn ġewwa fil-bażi ta' kolonna.

sense_translations.en_definition: concavity at the base of a column
sense_translations.zh_definition: 柱子底座处的凹部或内凹曲面。

collocations.en: the concavity at the base of the column

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tar-restawr jiddeskrivi l-ħsara fil-kavatura fil-bażi tal-kolonna.
formal.en: The restoration report describes the damage to the concavity at the base of the column.
formal.zh: 修复报告描述了柱基凹部的损伤情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tinsab il-kavatura? Mark: Fil-bażi tal-kolonna; ara dik il-parti li tidħol 'il ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the column-base concavity? Mark: At the base of the column; look at that part that curves inward.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：柱基凹部在哪里？马克：就在柱子的底座上，看那块向内凹进去的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 柱基凹部在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the column-base concavity?

messages.speaker: Mark (建筑导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-bażi tal-kolonna; ara dik il-parti li tidħol 'il ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-bażi tal-kolonna; ara dik il-parti li tidħol 'il ġewwa.
messages.zh: 就在柱子的底座上，看那块向内凹进去的地方。
messages.en: At the base of the column; look at that part that curves inward.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一根柱子，在底座向内凹的地方画箭头并写 kavatura，记住它特指柱基凹部，不能泛指所有空洞。

gloss_zh: 浅圆鱼篮；风车磨坊接粉斗；石块起吊平台

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shallow circular fish basket; a cone-shaped wooden flour hopper in a windmill; or a wooden hoist platform with side boards for lifting stone blocks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指运鱼用的浅圆形容器、风车磨坊中承接面粉的锥形木斗，或带侧挡板、用于向高处吊运石块的木平台。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent baxx u tond għall-ġarr tal-ħut; reċipjent tal-injam f'għamla ta' kon li jiġbor id-dqiq f'mitħna tar-riħ; jew pjattaforma tal-injam bi twavel mal-ġnub biex jittellgħu blokok tal-ġebel.

sense_translations.en_definition: fish basket (shallow circular container made of reed or tin, used for carrying fish)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鱼篮；用芦苇或马口铁制成、用于运鱼的浅圆形容器。

sense_translations.en_definition: hopper (cone-shaped wooden vessel in a windmill that collects flour from the feed chute)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 接粉斗；风车磨坊中用于承接送料槽落下面粉的锥形木制容器。

sense_translations.en_definition: hoist platform (wooden platform with side boards used for lifting stone blocks to higher levels)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 起吊平台；带有侧挡板、用于将石块吊运至高处的木制平台。

collocations.en: a fish basket full of fish
the hoist platform for lifting stone

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema poġġew il-blokok tal-ġebel fuq il-kavetta tal-injam bi twavel mal-ġnub biex itellgħuhom għal livell ogħla.
formal.en: The workers placed the stone blocks on the wooden hoist platform with side boards to lift them to a higher level.
formal.zh: 工人将石块放在带侧挡板的木制起吊平台上，以便把它们吊运到更高处。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se npoġġi l-ħut? Pawlu: Fil-kavetta, dak ir-reċipjent baxx u tond ħdejk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall I put the fish? Pawlu: In the fish basket, that shallow round container beside you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：鱼要放在哪里？保罗：放在鱼篮里，就是你旁边那个浅浅的圆形容器。

messages.speaker: Maja (鱼摊助手)
messages.zh: 鱼要放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put the fish?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (鱼贩)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kavetta, dak ir-reċipjent baxx u tond ħdejk.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kavetta, dak ir-reċipjent baxx u tond ħdejk.
messages.zh: 放在鱼篮里，就是你旁边那个浅浅的圆形容器。
messages.en: In the fish basket, that shallow round container beside you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kavetta 画三张场景卡：鱼摊的浅圆篮、磨坊的锥形接粉斗、工地的带挡板吊台；靠场景区分三个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hollow space or cavity within something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物内部形成的空腔或空穴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju vojt jew ħofra ġewwa xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空腔；物体内部的空穴。

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni wriet kavita żgħira ġewwa l-blokka tal-ġebel.
formal.en: The inspection revealed a small cavity inside the stone block.
formal.zh: 检查发现石块内部有一个小空腔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm ġewwa din il-ġebla? Mark: Hemm kavita żgħira; ara l-ispazju vojt fin-nofs.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's inside this stone? Mark: There's a small cavity; look at the empty space in the middle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这块石头里面有什么？马克：有个小空腔，你看中间那块空的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这块石头里面有什么？
messages.en: What's inside this stone?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm kavita żgħira; ara l-ispazju vojt fin-nofs.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm kavita żgħira; ara l-ispazju vojt fin-nofs.
messages.zh: 有个小空腔，你看中间那块空的地方。
messages.en: There's a small cavity; look at the empty space in the middle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把石头的剖面画出来，在内部留一块空白并标 kavita；用“里面有个空的地方”来记这个名词。

gloss_zh: 高加索的；与高加索有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Caucasus region or its people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与高加索地区或其居民有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mar-reġjun tal-Kawkasu jew man-nies tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高加索的；与高加索地区或其居民有关的。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-wirt Kawkasiku permezz ta' testi u ritratti.
formal.en: The study examines Caucasian heritage through texts and photographs.
formal.zh: 这项研究通过文字材料和照片考察高加索文化遗产。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser Kawkasiku f'dan it-test? Mark: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Kawkasu, bħal pajsaġġ Kawkasiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does Caucasian mean in this text? Mark: It means related to the Caucasus, as in a Caucasian landscape.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文章里的 Kawkasiku 是什么意思？马克：意思是与高加索有关，比如高加索地区的景观。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 Kawkasiku 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does Caucasian mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Kawkasu, bħal pajsaġġ Kawkasiku.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Kawkasu, bħal pajsaġġ Kawkasiku.
messages.zh: 意思是与高加索有关，比如高加索地区的景观。
messages.en: It means related to the Caucasus, as in a Caucasian landscape.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Kawkasiku 写在“景观、文化遗产”等名词旁，记成“高加索的”；与地名 Kawkasu 对照，区分修饰语和地方名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of the geographic region called the Caucasus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地理区域“高加索”的专有名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju tar-reġjun ġeografiku magħruf bħala l-Kawkasu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高加索，地理区域的名称。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta ħarsa ġenerali lejn ir-reġjun tal-Kawkasu.
formal.en: The report presents an overview of the Caucasus region.
formal.zh: 这份报告介绍了高加索地区的概况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema reġjun qed tfittex fuq il-mappa? Mark: Il-Kawkasu; nixtieq insir naf aktar dwaru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which region are you looking for on the map? Mark: The Caucasus; I'd like to learn more about it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在地图上找哪个地区？马克：高加索，我想多了解一下那里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema reġjun qed tfittex fuq il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Liema reġjun qed tfittex fuq il-mappa?
messages.zh: 你在地图上找哪个地区？
messages.en: Which region are you looking for on the map?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-Kawkasu; nixtieq insir naf aktar dwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Il-Kawkasu; nixtieq insir naf aktar dwaru.
messages.zh: 高加索，我想多了解一下那里。
messages.en: The Caucasus; I'd like to learn more about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图练习卡上把 Kawkasu 对应到“高加索地区”，记住它是地名；再与表示“高加索的”的 Kawkasiku 成对复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To handle something badly, making it confused, disorganized, or unsuccessful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因处理不当而把事情弄糟、弄乱，或把原本清楚的内容搞混。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħawwad xi ħaġa jew jagħmilha ħażin, b'mod li joħloq taħwid jew iħassar ir-riżultat.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a hash of things
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把事情办得一团糟。
把事情搞混，使内容或安排变得混乱。
弄糟；搞砸；弄乱。

collocations.en: made a mess of the plan

formal.mt: Meta biddel l-ordni tal-paġni, l-impjegat kawlat ir-rapport u għamilha diffiċli biex jinqara.
formal.en: When he changed the order of the pages, the employee made a mess of the report and made it difficult to read.
formal.zh: 那名员工更改页面顺序后，把报告弄乱了，使报告变得难以阅读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-karti kollha mħalltin? Mark: Ħija kawlat kollox meta kien qed ifittex l-ittra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are all the papers mixed up? Mark: My brother messed everything up while he was looking for the letter.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些纸怎么全混在一起了？马克：我哥哥找那封信的时候，把一切都弄乱了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些纸怎么全混在一起了？
messages.en: Why are all the papers mixed up?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija kawlat kollox meta kien qed ifittex l-ittra.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija kawlat kollox meta kien qed ifittex l-ittra.
messages.zh: 我哥哥找那封信的时候，把一切都弄乱了。
messages.en: My brother messed everything up while he was looking for the letter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人翻找信件，把整叠纸翻成一团乱；用 kawlat 记住“把事情搞糟”这个动作。

gloss_zh: 蔬菜杂烩汤；杂烩；一团混乱；浓汤

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vegetable soup, often containing meat; also a mixture of things or a confused mess.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种蔬菜杂烩汤，常加入肉类；也可指混杂的东西或一团混乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Soppa tal-ħaxix li spiss ikun fiha l-laħam; ukoll taħlita ta' affarijiet jew sitwazzjoni mħawda.

sense_translations.en_definition: a kind of vegetable soup (often with added meat)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种蔬菜汤，常加入肉类。
各种东西混在一起的杂烩；杂乱的混合物。
一团混乱；杂乱无章的状态。
用蔬菜、谷物等煮成的浓汤或杂烩汤。

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar ġiet servuta kawlata bil-ħaxix u biċċiet tal-laħam.
formal.en: A vegetable soup with pieces of meat was served for lunch.
formal.zh: 午餐供应了加入肉块的蔬菜杂烩汤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fhimt xi ħaġa minn dawn in-noti? Mark: Le, hemm kawlata sħiħa; irridu nqegħduhom fl-ordni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you understand anything from these notes? Mark: No, they are a complete mess; we need to put them in order.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些笔记你看懂什么了吗？马克：没有，简直是一团糟；我们得把它们整理好。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fhimt xi ħaġa minn dawn in-noti?
messages.mt_standard: Fhimt xi ħaġa minn dawn in-noti?
messages.zh: 这些笔记你看懂什么了吗？
messages.en: Did you understand anything from these notes?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hemm kawlata sħiħa; irridu nqegħduhom fl-ordni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hemm kawlata sħiħa; irridu nqegħduhom fl-ordni.
messages.zh: 没有，简直是一团糟；我们得把它们整理好。
messages.en: No, they are a complete mess; we need to put them in order.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个场景并排记：锅里各种蔬菜混煮是杂烩汤，桌上各种笔记混放是一团乱，二者都可用 kawlata。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Careful and alert to possible problems, considering risks before acting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对可能出现的问题保持警觉，并在行动前考虑风险的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joqgħod attent għall-perikli u jaħseb sew qabel jaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 警惕的；留心的；行事谨慎、考虑周全的。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur adotta approċċ kawt fl-interpretazzjoni tar-riżultati, peress li d-data kienet limitata.
formal.en: The researcher adopted a cautious approach to interpreting the results because the data was limited.
formal.zh: 由于数据有限，研究人员在解读结果时采取了审慎的态度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se taqsam it-triq hawn? Mark: Iva, imma se nkun kawt; hemm ħafna karozzi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to cross the road here? Mark: Yes, but I'll be cautious; there are lots of cars.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要在这里过马路吗？马克：是的，不过我会小心；车很多。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要在这里过马路吗？
messages.en: Are you going to cross the road here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma se nkun kawt; hemm ħafna karozzi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma se nkun kawt; hemm ħafna karozzi.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我会小心；车很多。
messages.en: Yes, but I'll be cautious; there are lots of cars.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象过马路前先停下、左右观察的人，用 kawt 描写他“保持警觉、谨慎行事”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An action or measure taken beforehand to prevent a possible problem or reduce a risk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为防止可能发生的问题或降低风险而预先采取的措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżura li tittieħed minn qabel biex tevita problema possibbli jew tnaqqas ir-riskju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预先采取的防范措施；预防办法。

formal.mt: Bħala kawtelatorju, l-organizzaturi żammew kopja oħra tal-lista tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: As a precaution, the organizers kept an additional copy of the participant list.
formal.zh: 作为预防措施，组织者另外保存了一份参与者名单。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ġibt torċa oħra? Mark: Bħala kawtelatorju, jekk l-ewwel waħda ma taħdimx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you bring another torch? Mark: As a precaution, in case the first one doesn't work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么又带了一支手电筒？马克：以防万一，怕第一支不能用。

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么又带了一支手电筒？
messages.en: Why did you bring another torch?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħala kawtelatorju, jekk l-ewwel waħda ma taħdimx.
messages.mt_standard: Bħala kawtelatorju, jekk l-ewwel waħda ma taħdimx.
messages.zh: 以防万一，怕第一支不能用。
messages.en: As a precaution, in case the first one doesn't work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住出门多带一支手电筒的画面：问题尚未发生，先做准备，这项准备就是 kawtelatorju。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strongly built protective structure used to shelter people, especially during military attacks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于保护人员、抵御攻击的坚固掩体，尤其用于军事环境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura msaħħa li tintuża biex tipproteġi lin-nies, speċjalment waqt attakki militari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掩体；用于防御或躲避攻击的坚固工事。

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi l-post tal-kaxxabank militari u d-daħla prinċipali tiegħu.
formal.en: The plan shows the location of the military bunker and its main entrance.
formal.zh: 平面图标出了军用掩体的位置及其主要入口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-bini baxx? Mark: Dak kaxxabank; id-daħla tiegħu tinsab fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that low building? Mark: That's a bunker; its entrance is on the other side.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那座低矮的建筑是什么？马克：那是个掩体；入口在另一边。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 那座低矮的建筑是什么？
messages.en: What's that low building?

messages.speaker: Mark (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kaxxabank; id-daħla tiegħu tinsab fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kaxxabank; id-daħla tiegħu tinsab fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
messages.zh: 那是个掩体；入口在另一边。
messages.en: That's a bunker; its entrance is on the other side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kaxxabank 和“人进入坚固掩体寻求保护”的画面绑定记忆，重点记建筑的防护用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong lockable container used to protect money, important documents, or other valuables.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可上锁的坚固箱柜，用来保护钱财、重要文件或其他贵重物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kaxxa b'saħħitha li tissakkar u tintuża biex jinżammu fiha flus, dokumenti importanti jew oġġetti ta' valur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保险箱；存放钱财、重要文件或贵重物品的坚固上锁箱柜。

formal.mt: Id-dokumenti oriġinali għandhom jinżammu fil-kaxxaforti tal-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The original documents should be kept in the office safe.
formal.zh: 文件原件应保存在办公室的保险柜内。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nista' nħalli l-passaport? Mark: Fil-kaxxaforti tal-kamra; tista' tagħżel il-kodiċi tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I leave my passport? Mark: In the room safe; you can choose your own code.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的护照可以放在哪里？马克：放在房间的保险箱里；你可以自己设置密码。

messages.speaker: Maja (酒店住客)
messages.zh: 我的护照可以放在哪里？
messages.en: Where can I leave my passport?

messages.speaker: Mark (酒店职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kaxxaforti tal-kamra; tista' tagħżel il-kodiċi tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kaxxaforti tal-kamra; tista' tagħżel il-kodiċi tiegħek.
messages.zh: 放在房间的保险箱里；你可以自己设置密码。
