messages.en: In the room safe; you can choose your own code.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把护照和现金放进厚重箱柜，再输入密码锁好；这个保护贵重物品的箱柜就是 kaxxaforti。

gloss_zh: 储物柜；可上锁的个人物品柜

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small storage compartment or cupboard, usually lockable, used for personal belongings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 存放个人物品的小型柜子或储物格，通常可以上锁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Armarju żgħir jew kompartiment, ġeneralment li jissakkar, fejn jinżammu affarijiet personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储物柜；通常可上锁、供个人存放物品的小柜或储物格。

collocations.en: a locker in the changing room

formal.mt: Kull membru jista' juża kaxxarizz fil-kamra tat-tibdil biex iżomm fih l-affarijiet personali tiegħu.
formal.en: Each member may use a locker in the changing room to store their personal belongings.
formal.zh: 每位会员均可使用更衣室里的一个储物柜存放个人物品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi l-basket waqt it-taħriġ? Mark: Uża l-kaxxarizz ħdejn il-bieb; hawn iċ-ċavetta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put my bag during training? Mark: Use the locker next to the door; here's the key.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：训练时我的包放在哪里？马克：用门旁边的储物柜吧；钥匙在这里。

messages.speaker: Maja (健身房会员)
messages.zh: 训练时我的包放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put my bag during training?

messages.speaker: Mark (健身房职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża l-kaxxarizz ħdejn il-bieb; hawn iċ-ċavetta.
messages.mt_standard: Uża l-kaxxarizz ħdejn il-bieb; hawn iċ-ċavetta.
messages.zh: 用门旁边的储物柜吧；钥匙在这里。
messages.en: Use the locker next to the door; here's the key.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kaxxarizz 放进健身房场景：换好衣服，把包收进个人小柜，再拿走钥匙，就记住了“储物柜”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk with difficulty while experiencing pain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路时感到疼痛，因而行走艰难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi b'diffikultà u bl-uġigħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to walk with difficulty and in pain
sense_translations.zh_definition: 艰难而疼痛地行走；忍着疼痛吃力地走路。

collocations.en: walked painfully and with difficulty to the door
walked with difficulty and in pain after the injury

formal.mt: Wara l-korriment f'siequ, ir-raġel kaxxax sal-karozza bl-għajnuna ta' sieħbu.
formal.en: After injuring his foot, the man walked painfully and with difficulty to the car with his friend's help.
formal.zh: 脚部受伤后，那名男子在朋友的帮助下，忍痛艰难地走到了汽车旁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar missierek sal-karozza lbieraħ? Mark: Kaxxax bil-mod; siequ kienet għadha tweġġgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did your father get to the car yesterday? Mark: He walked slowly and painfully, with difficulty; his foot was still hurting.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你爸爸昨天是怎么走到汽车旁的？马克：他忍痛慢慢挪过去，走得很吃力；他的脚还在疼。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸昨天是怎么走到汽车旁的？
messages.en: How did your father get to the car yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kaxxax bil-mod; siequ kienet għadha tweġġgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Kaxxax bil-mod; siequ kienet għadha tweġġgħu.
messages.zh: 他忍痛慢慢挪过去，走得很吃力；他的脚还在疼。
messages.en: He walked slowly and painfully, with difficulty; his foot was still hurting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚痛的人每走一步都很吃力，用 kaxxax 同时记住“走得困难”和“伴随疼痛”两个要点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong chest or box used to keep money or valuable objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来存放钱财或贵重物品的坚固箱子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kaxxa b'saħħitha li tintuża biex jinżammu fiha flus jew oġġetti ta' valur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 存放钱财或贵重物品的箱子；钱箱。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesponi kaxxettun tal-injam li fih kienu jinżammu flus u ġojjelli.
formal.en: The museum displays a wooden coffer in which money and jewellery used to be kept.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出一个木制钱箱，过去用来存放钱财和珠宝。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm f'dak il-kaxxettun? Mark: Muniti qodma u xi ġojjelli tan-nanna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's in that coffer? Mark: Old coins and some of Grandma's jewellery.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个钱箱里有什么？马克：旧硬币，还有奶奶的一些珠宝。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个钱箱里有什么？
messages.en: What's in that coffer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Muniti qodma u xi ġojjelli tan-nanna.
messages.mt_standard: Muniti qodma u xi ġojjelli tan-nanna.
messages.zh: 旧硬币，还有奶奶的一些珠宝。
messages.en: Old coins and some of Grandma's jewellery.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kaxxettun 和一个装着硬币、珠宝的结实木箱联系起来，用“打开钱箱看宝物”的画面记住词义。

gloss_zh: 鸡巴（粗俗）；表示恼怒的粗话

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vulgar slang word for a penis, also used as an expression of anger or irritation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指阴茎的粗俗俚语，也用作表达愤怒或烦躁的粗话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma vulgari għall-pene, li tintuża wkoll biex tesprimi rabja jew irritazzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: slang term for a penis (vulgar; originating from Italian)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指阴茎的粗俗俚语，相当于“鸡巴”；源自意大利语。
表达愤怒或烦躁的粗话，语气可相当于“妈的”。

collocations.zh: 妈的！（表示愤怒或烦躁的粗话）

collocations.en: What the fuck do you want?

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu tar-rumanz, il-kelma 'kazz' tesprimi l-irritazzjoni tal-karattru u għandha reġistru vulgari.
formal.en: In the novel's dialogue, the word 'kazz' expresses the character's irritation and has a vulgar register.
formal.zh: 在小说的对话中，kazz 一词表达人物的烦躁，属于粗俗用语。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kazz! Erġajt tlift iċ-ċwievet. Maja: Ara fil-but tal-ġakketta.
colloquial.en: Mark: Fuck! I've lost my keys again. Maja: Look in your jacket pocket.
colloquial.zh: 马克：妈的！我又把钥匙弄丢了。玛雅：看看你的夹克口袋。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 妈的！我又把钥匙弄丢了。
messages.en: Fuck! I've lost my keys again.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看看你的夹克口袋。
messages.en: Look in your jacket pocket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kazz 记成两张有语体标记的卡片：一张写粗俗身体称呼，一张画丢钥匙后的怒喊；两种用法都带粗俗色彩。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to become angry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人生气或发怒；惹恼某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jirrabja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人生气；惹怒某人。

formal.mt: Id-dewmien bla spjegazzjoni kazzaz lil kull min kien qed jistenna.
formal.en: The unexplained delay angered everyone who was waiting.
formal.zh: 没有解释的延误惹怒了所有正在等候的人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: L-istorbju kazzaz lil Pawlu. Mark: Mela ejja nitkellmu aktar bil-kwiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: The noise made Pawlu angry. Mark: Then let's speak more quietly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：噪音把保罗惹生气了。马克：那我们说话小声一点吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 噪音把保罗惹生气了。
messages.en: The noise made Pawlu angry.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们说话小声一点吧。
messages.en: Then let's speak more quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“噪音出现，保罗生气”这条因果链记 kazzaz：重点是某件事或某个人把别人惹生气，而不只是自己感到生气。

gloss_zh: 对他人过失大惊小怪的人；自命清高者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who displays shock at other people's wrongdoing, often with a self-righteous manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对他人的不当行为表现得十分震惊、往往带有自以为道德高尚态度的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiskandalizza ruħha bl-għemil ħażin ta' ħaddieħor u spiss tqis lilha nnifisha aħjar mill-oħrajn.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who evinces shock at the misdeeds of others
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对他人的不当行为或过错表现出震惊的人。
自命清高、以道德标准挑剔别人的人。

collocations.zh: 以道德优越的口吻说话

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru jidher bħala każajr li jikkundanna l-iżbalji ta' kulħadd iżda jinjora tiegħu stess.
formal.en: In the novel, the character appears as a prig who condemns everyone's mistakes but ignores his own.
formal.zh: 在小说中，这个人物是个自命清高者，谴责所有人的错误，却忽视自己的错误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jitkellem bħal każajr? Mark: Għax jaħseb li hu qatt ma jiżbalja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is he talking like such a prig? Mark: Because he thinks he never makes mistakes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么说话这么自命清高？马克：因为他觉得自己从来不会犯错。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么说话这么自命清高？
messages.en: Why is he talking like such a prig?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jaħseb li hu qatt ma jiżbalja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jaħseb li hu qatt ma jiżbalja.
messages.zh: 因为他觉得自己从来不会犯错。
messages.en: Because he thinks he never makes mistakes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个总指着别人说“这也太不像话了”的人，把 każajr 记成这种爱摆道德架子的人；这是情景记忆。

gloss_zh: 颇为偏执的；自命清高的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat bigoted or self-righteous, especially in judging other people's conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有些偏执，或在评判他人行为时显得自命清高的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ftit magħluq għal fehmiet differenti jew b'attitudni ta' superjorità morali meta jiġġudika lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颇为偏执的；对不同观点抱有较强偏见的。
自命清高的；以道德优越感挑剔他人的。

collocations.zh: 偏执或自命清高的态度

formal.mt: It-ton każajri tal-artiklu jagħti l-impressjoni li l-awtur iqis ruħu moralment superjuri għall-qarrejja.
formal.en: The article's priggish tone gives the impression that the author considers himself morally superior to the readers.
formal.zh: 文章自命清高的口吻让人觉得，作者认为自己在道德上高于读者。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-kumment għandu ton każajri, hux? Pawlu: Iva, qisu min kitbu jaħseb li hu biss jaf x'inhu tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Sara: This comment has a priggish tone, doesn't it? Pawlu: Yes, as if whoever wrote it thinks only he knows what's right.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这条评论的口吻很自命清高，对吧？保罗：是啊，好像写评论的人觉得只有自己知道什么是对的。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kumment għandu ton każajri, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kumment għandu ton każajri, hux?
messages.zh: 这条评论的口吻很自命清高，对吧？
messages.en: This comment has a priggish tone, doesn't it?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qisu min kitbu jaħseb li hu biss jaf x'inhu tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qisu min kitbu jaħseb li hu biss jaf x'inhu tajjeb.
messages.zh: 是啊，好像写评论的人觉得只有自己知道什么是对的。
messages.en: Yes, as if whoever wrote it thinks only he knows what's right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 każajri 放进“自命清高的口吻”这个短语记忆：先想象挑剔别人的语气，再回忆它是描述态度的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Kazakhstan, a country in Central Asia and Eastern Europe, officially called the Republic of Kazakhstan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 哈萨克斯坦，位于中亚和东欧的国家，正式名称为哈萨克斯坦共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Asja Ċentrali u fl-Ewropa tal-Lvant, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika tal-Każakistan.

sense_translations.en_definition: Kazakhstan (a country in Central Asia and Eastern Europe; official name: Repubblika tal-Każakistan)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 哈萨克斯坦，位于中亚和东欧的国家；正式名称为哈萨克斯坦共和国。

collocations.zh: 前往哈萨克斯坦的旅行

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-Każakistan bħala pajjiż fl-Asja Ċentrali u fl-Ewropa tal-Lvant.
formal.en: The report describes Kazakhstan as a country in Central Asia and Eastern Europe.
formal.zh: 报告将哈萨克斯坦描述为一个位于中亚和东欧的国家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur il-Każakistan ma' ħabib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Kazakhstan with a friend of mine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要去哪里度假？马克：我要和一个朋友去哈萨克斯坦。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur il-Każakistan ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur il-Każakistan ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我要和一个朋友去哈萨克斯坦。
messages.en: I'm going to Kazakhstan with a friend of mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 Każakistan 与中文“哈萨克斯坦”和地图上的国家轮廓配对记忆；书写国家名称时记得首字母大写。

gloss_zh: 哈萨克斯坦的；哈萨克斯坦人；哈萨克语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Kazakhstan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自或涉及哈萨克斯坦的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Każakistan jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' dan il-pajjiż.

sense_translations.en_definition: Kazakh (of, from or relating to Kazakhstan)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 哈萨克斯坦的；来自哈萨克斯坦或与该国有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Kazakh (native or inhabitant of Kazakhstan) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 哈萨克斯坦本地人或居民，通常指男性。
哈萨克语。

collocations.zh: 一名来自哈萨克斯坦的男学生
一位哈萨克斯坦男作家

formal.mt: Il-kittieb Każakistani ppreżenta r-rumanz tiegħu waqt il-festival tal-letteratura.
formal.en: The Kazakh writer presented his novel at the literature festival.
formal.zh: 这位哈萨克斯坦作家在文学节上介绍了自己的小说。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dak l-istudent Każakistani? Pawlu: Jismu Timur u qiegħed fil-klassi tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is that Kazakh student? Pawlu: His name is Timur, and he's in my class.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那个来自哈萨克斯坦的男学生是谁？保罗：他叫帖木儿，和我同班。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 那个来自哈萨克斯坦的男学生是谁？
messages.en: Who is that Kazakh student?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jismu Timur u qiegħed fil-klassi tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Jismu Timur u qiegħed fil-klassi tiegħi.
messages.zh: 他叫帖木儿，和我同班。
messages.en: His name is Timur, and he's in my class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“国家相关、国家居民、语言名称”三张卡片记 Każakistani；看到它时先检查句中是在修饰人，还是作为名词使用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term meaning somewhat big, given as a diminutive form of 'kbir'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“有点大、稍大”的词，是 kbir 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tfisser xi ftit kbir, forma diminuttiva ta' 'kbir'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有点大的；稍大的；为 kbir 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Il-pakkett huwa kbajjar u ma jidħolx fil-kaxxa ż-żgħira.
formal.en: The parcel is somewhat large and does not fit in the small box.
formal.zh: 这个包裹有点大，放不进小箱子里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kelb għadu żgħir? Mark: Għadu żgħir fl-età, imma diġà kbajjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this dog still young? Mark: He's still young, but he's already somewhat big.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这只狗还小吗？马克：年龄还小，不过个头已经有点大了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这只狗还小吗？
messages.en: Is this dog still young?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu żgħir fl-età, imma diġà kbajjar.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu żgħir fl-età, imma diġà kbajjar.
messages.zh: 年龄还小，不过个头已经有点大了。
messages.en: He's still young, but he's already somewhat big.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kbajjar 和“有点大”的包裹配对记忆：虽然材料称它为 kbir 的指小形式，实际词义仍是“稍大”，不要直接记成“小”。

gloss_zh: 统治者；上层人士；长老；特权阶层

teaching_sense.en_definition: People who hold high social standing or authority; depending on context, rulers, upper-class people, elders, or the privileged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 社会地位较高或拥有权威的人；随语境可指统治者、上层人士、长老或享有特权者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nies b'pożizzjoni għolja jew b'awtorità fis-soċjetà; skont il-kuntest, mexxejja, nies tal-klassi għolja, anzjani jew privileġġati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 统治者；掌握统治权的人。
上层阶级成员；社会上层人士。
长老；群体中年长且受尊重的人。
享有特权的人；特权阶层。

collocations.en: the country's rulers or leading figures
collocations.zh: 国家的统治者或显要人物

collocations.en: the privileges of the upper ranks

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-kbarat tal-pajjiż kienu jieħdu d-deċiżjonijiet politiċi.
formal.en: The report describes how the country's rulers used to make political decisions.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该国统治者过去如何作出政治决策。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jitkellem fil-laqgħa tar-raħal? Pawlu: L-ewwel jitkellmu l-kbarat tar-raħal, imbagħad kulħadd jista' jgħid tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will speak at the village meeting? Pawlu: The village elders will speak first, then everyone can have their say.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：村里的会议由谁发言？保罗：先由村里的长老发言，然后大家都可以发表意见。

messages.speaker: Maja (村民)
messages.zh: 村里的会议由谁发言？
messages.en: Who will speak at the village meeting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (村民)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel jitkellmu l-kbarat tar-raħal, imbagħad kulħadd jista' jgħid tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel jitkellmu l-kbarat tar-raħal, imbagħad kulħadd jista' jgħid tiegħu.
messages.zh: 先由村里的长老发言，然后大家都可以发表意见。
messages.en: The village elders will speak first, then everyone can have their say.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议前排坐着一群有地位的人，用这一画面记住词义，再按上下文区分统治者、上层人士、长老和特权者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of starting a fire by making fuel begin to burn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使燃料开始燃烧、把火生起来的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tqabbad il-materjal biex jibda jaqbad in-nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引火；使燃料开始燃烧、生起火来的动作。

collocations.en: kindling a fire with dry firewood

formal.mt: Il-kbis tan-nar għandu jsir f'post sigur u 'l bogħod minn materjal li jaqbad malajr.
formal.en: The kindling of a fire should take place in a safe location, away from material that catches fire easily.
formal.zh: 生火应在安全地点进行，并远离容易着火的材料。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'għandna bżonn għall-kbis tan-nar? Rita: Ħatab niexef u ftit karta; kollox lest hawn.
colloquial.en: Mark: What do we need to get the fire started? Rita: Dry firewood and a little paper; everything is ready here.
colloquial.zh: 马克：生火需要些什么？丽塔：干柴和一点纸；东西都在这里准备好了。

messages.speaker: Mark (露营同伴)
messages.zh: 生火需要些什么？
messages.en: What do we need to get the fire started?

messages.speaker: Rita (露营同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħatab niexef u ftit karta; kollox lest hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Ħatab niexef u ftit karta; kollox lest hawn.
messages.zh: 干柴和一点纸；东西都在这里准备好了。
messages.en: Dry firewood and a little paper; everything is ready here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把点火过程想成一段短视频：放纸、添干柴、点燃；kbis记的是生火这个动作，不是那堆柴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remain in a state of suffering, weakness or declining vitality, often for a long time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长时间处于痛苦、虚弱或精神日渐消沉的状态；憔悴或苦熬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibqa' għal żmien twil fi stat ta' tbatija jew dgħufija, bla saħħa jew bla ħeġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 憔悴、萎靡；在痛苦或困顿中长期苦熬。

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-priġunier keba għal snin sħaħ mingħajr tama li jinħeles.
formal.en: In the story, the prisoner languished for years without hope of release.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名囚犯苦熬了多年，看不到获释的希望。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif għadda dak iż-żmien il-karattru tal-ktieb? Ben: Keba waħdu f'dik id-dar, jistenna aħbar li qatt ma waslet.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the character in the book spend that period? Ben: He languished alone in that house, waiting for news that never came.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：书里的人物那段时间是怎么过的？本：他独自在那栋房子里苦熬，等着始终没有传来的消息。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għadda dak iż-żmien il-karattru tal-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għadda dak iż-żmien il-karattru tal-ktieb?
messages.zh: 书里的人物那段时间是怎么过的？
messages.en: How did the character in the book spend that period?

messages.speaker: Ben (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Keba waħdu f'dik id-dar, jistenna aħbar li qatt ma waslet.
messages.mt_standard: Keba waħdu f'dik id-dar, jistenna aħbar li qatt ma waslet.
messages.zh: 他独自在那栋房子里苦熬，等着始终没有传来的消息。
messages.en: He languished alone in that house, waiting for news that never came.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历一页页翻过，一个人仍在窗边苦等、日渐憔悴，用持续消沉的画面记住keba。

gloss_zh: 煎炸前裹面粉；卷轴；一小把

teaching_sense.en_definition: To coat food with flour before frying it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在煎炸食物之前，给食物表面裹上面粉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi l-ikel bid-dqiq qabel jaqlih.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cover with flour before frying
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在煎炸之前给食物裹上面粉。
卷轴；用于绕线等的轴具。
少量；一小把。

collocations.en: coat the meat with flour before frying it

formal.mt: Kebb il-ħut fid-dqiq, neħħi d-dqiq żejjed u aqlih fiż-żejt jaħraq.
formal.en: Coat the fish with flour, remove the excess flour and fry it in hot oil.
formal.zh: 给鱼裹上面粉，抖去多余的面粉，再放入热油中煎炸。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Inpoġġi l-ħut fit-taġen issa? Omm: L-ewwel kebb il-ħut fid-dqiq, imbagħad poġġih fiż-żejt jaħraq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall I put the fish in the pan now? Mum: First coat the fish with flour, then put it in the hot oil.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：现在把鱼放进锅里吗？妈妈：先给鱼裹上面粉，然后放进热油里。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 现在把鱼放进锅里吗？
messages.en: Shall I put the fish in the pan now?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel kebb il-ħut fid-dqiq, imbagħad poġġih fiż-żejt jaħraq.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel kebb il-ħut fid-dqiq, imbagħad poġġih fiż-żejt jaħraq.
messages.zh: 先给鱼裹上面粉，然后放进热油里。
messages.en: First coat the fish with flour, then put it in the hot oil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做三张独立词义卡：动词画鱼裹面粉，名词分别画卷轴和一小把东西；按词性分开记忆，避免混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wind thread or similar material, reel something in, or wrap something in a covering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把线等材料缠绕起来、收卷回来，或用某种材料包住物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idawwar ħajt jew materjal simili biex jiġbru, jiġbed xi ħaġa lura billi jdawwarha, jew jgħatti xi ħaġa b'materjal madwarha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to wind (used of thread, wool etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 缠绕、卷绕线、毛线等材料。
通过卷绕把线等收回来；收卷。
包裹；用纸、布等材料包住。

collocations.en: wind the thread onto a reel

formal.mt: Kebbeb il-ħajt fuq ir-rukkell b'mod uniformi biex tevita li jitħabbel.
formal.en: Wind the thread evenly onto the reel to prevent it from tangling.
formal.zh: 把线均匀地绕在线轴上，以免缠结。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-rigal lest biex nagħtuh lil Sara? Mark: Għadu le. Kebbeb ir-rigal f'din il-karta u jien nikteb il-kartolina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the present ready for us to give to Sara? Mark: Not yet. Wrap the present in this paper and I will write the card.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：送给萨拉的礼物准备好了吗？马克：还没有。你用这张纸把礼物包好，我来写贺卡。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rigal lest biex nagħtuh lil Sara?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rigal lest biex nagħtuh lil Sara?
messages.zh: 送给萨拉的礼物准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the present ready for us to give to Sara?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu le. Kebbeb ir-rigal f'din il-karta u jien nikteb il-kartolina.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu le. Kebbeb ir-rigal f'din il-karta u jien nikteb il-kartolina.
messages.zh: 还没有。你用这张纸把礼物包好，我来写贺卡。
messages.en: Not yet. Wrap the present in this paper and I will write the card.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个连续动作记忆：线绕上轴、鱼线收回来、纸包住礼物；分别对应绕线、收卷和包裹。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who winds thread, wool or similar material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事绕线或把毛线等材料卷绕起来的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkebbeb ħajt, suf jew materjal simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行卷绕的人；绕线者。

formal.mt: Il-kebbieb tal-ħajt jiżgura li l-ħajt jinġabar fuq ir-rukkelli mingħajr għoqod.
formal.en: The thread winder ensures that the thread is collected onto the reels without knots.
formal.zh: 绕线工确保线卷绕到线轴上时不打结。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Min se jiġbor dan il-ħajt fuq ir-rukkelli? Pawlu: Ġużeppi huwa kebbieb tas-sengħa; staqsi lilu.
colloquial.en: Lina: Who will wind this thread onto the reels? Pawlu: Ġużeppi is a skilled winder; ask him.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：谁来把这些线绕到线轴上？保罗：朱塞佩是熟练的绕线工；问问他吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (作坊学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jiġbor dan il-ħajt fuq ir-rukkelli?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jiġbor dan il-ħajt fuq ir-rukkelli?
messages.zh: 谁来把这些线绕到线轴上？
messages.en: Who will wind this thread onto the reels?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (作坊师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġużeppi huwa kebbieb tas-sengħa; staqsi lilu.
messages.mt_standard: Ġużeppi huwa kebbieb tas-sengħa; staqsi lilu.
messages.zh: 朱塞佩是熟练的绕线工；问问他吧。
messages.en: Ġużeppi is a skilled winder; ask him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在单词旁画一位正在绕线的工人，把注意力放在做动作的人身上，记住kebbieb指绕线者。

gloss_zh: 倾向于卷绕的；会卷绕的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to wind or coil material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有卷绕材料的倾向或特性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jkebbeb jew jiġbor materjal billi jdawru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于卷绕的；具有缠绕或卷收特性的。

collocations.en: a mechanism that tends to wind material
a device that tends to wind material

formal.mt: L-apparat għandu mekkaniżmu kebbiebi li jiġbor il-ħajt fuq rukkell.
formal.en: The device has a winding mechanism that collects the thread onto a reel.
formal.zh: 该装置具有卷绕机构，可将线收卷到线轴上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li dan l-apparat huwa kebbiebi? Toni: Jiġifieri li għandu t-tendenza jkebbeb il-ħajt u jiġbru fuq ir-rukkell.
colloquial.en: Sara: What do you mean when you say this device is kebbiebi? Toni: I mean that it tends to wind the thread and collect it onto the reel.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你说这个装置是kebbiebi，是什么意思？托尼：就是说它具有把线卷绕并收在线轴上的特性。

messages.speaker: Sara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li dan l-apparat huwa kebbiebi?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li dan l-apparat huwa kebbiebi?
messages.zh: 你说这个装置是kebbiebi，是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean when you say this device is kebbiebi?

messages.speaker: Toni (指导老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li għandu t-tendenza jkebbeb il-ħajt u jiġbru fuq ir-rukkell.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li għandu t-tendenza jkebbeb il-ħajt u jiġbru fuq ir-rukkell.
messages.zh: 就是说它具有把线卷绕并收在线轴上的特性。
messages.en: I mean that it tends to wind the thread and collect it onto the reel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把kebbiebi写在会卷线的装置旁，作为描述特性的标签；再与指人的kebbieb对照，记清形容词和名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who lights a fire or a lamp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 点燃炉火、火堆或灯的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqabbad nar jew tixgħel lampa.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who lights a fire or lamp
sense_translations.zh_definition: 点火或点灯的人。

collocations.en: a person who lights the fire

formal.mt: Qabel bdiet iċ-ċerimonja, il-kebbies xegħel il-lampi fis-sala.
formal.en: Before the ceremony began, the person responsible for lighting the lamps lit those in the hall.
formal.zh: 仪式开始前，负责点灯的人点亮了大厅里的灯。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jkun il-kebbies tan-nar illejla? Pawlu: Jien se nqabbad in-nar qabel jaslu l-mistednin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will be the fire lighter tonight? Pawlu: I'll light the fire before the guests arrive.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今晚谁负责点火？保罗：我来，我会在客人到达前把火点起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun il-kebbies tan-nar illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun il-kebbies tan-nar illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚谁负责点火？
messages.en: Who will be the fire lighter tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien se nqabbad in-nar qabel jaslu l-mistednin.
messages.mt_standard: Jien se nqabbad in-nar qabel jaslu l-mistednin.
messages.zh: 我来，我会在客人到达前把火点起来。
messages.en: I'll light the fire before the guests arrive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人拿着火柴，依次点燃炉火和灯：kebbies 指执行点火、点灯动作的人。

gloss_zh: 有纵火倾向的；可作燃料的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to set things on fire, or suitable for use as fuel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容有放火倾向的人，或能够用作燃料的材料；具体意思取决于所修饰的对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza li jqabbad in-nar, jew li jista' jintuża bħala fjuwil.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the propensity to set on fire
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有放火或纵火倾向的。

sense_translations.en_definition: able to be used as fuel
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够用作燃料的。

collocations.en: a person with a tendency to set things on fire
material suitable for use as fuel

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-injam bħala materjal kebbiesi li jista' jintuża għat-tisħin.
formal.en: The report describes the wood as material suitable for use as fuel for heating.
formal.zh: 报告将这种木材描述为可用作取暖燃料的材料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-injam kebbiesi? Toni: Iva, nistgħu nużawh bħala fjuwil fil-fuklar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can this wood be used as fuel? Toni: Yes, we can use it as fuel in the fireplace.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这种木材能作燃料吗？托尼：能，我们可以把它放进壁炉里当燃料用。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这种木材能作燃料吗？
messages.en: Can this wood be used as fuel?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu nużawh bħala fjuwil fil-fuklar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu nużawh bħala fjuwil fil-fuklar.
messages.zh: 能，我们可以把它放进壁炉里当燃料用。
messages.en: Yes, we can use it as fuel in the fireplace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分开记：形容人时想到放火倾向，形容材料时想到投入炉中的燃料。

gloss_zh: 妻子不忠的丈夫；遭伴侣背叛的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A man whose wife is unfaithful, or more generally a person whose spouse or partner is unfaithful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指妻子不忠的丈夫，也可泛指配偶或伴侣不忠而遭受背叛的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li martu mhix fidila lejh, jew persuna li l-konjuġi jew is-sieħeb tagħha mhuwiex fidil lejha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妻子与他人有不忠关系的丈夫，俗称被戴绿帽子的丈夫。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. whose spouse or partner is unfaithful
sense_translations.zh_definition: 配偶或伴侣不忠、遭受感情背叛的人。

collocations.en: a man whose wife is unfaithful

collocations.zh: 被称为妻子不忠的丈夫

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist huwa deskritt bħala kebbiex għax martu għandha relazzjoni ma' raġel ieħor.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist is described as a cuckold because his wife is having a relationship with another man.
formal.zh: 小说将主人公描写为遭妻子背叛的丈夫，因为他的妻子与另一个男人有私情。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex l-awtur isejjaħlu kebbiex? Mark: Għax martu mhix fidila lejh, iżda hu għadu ma jafx.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does the author call him a cuckold? Mark: Because his wife is unfaithful to him, but he doesn't know yet.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：作者为什么称他为遭妻子背叛的丈夫？马克：因为他的妻子对他不忠，但他还不知道。

messages.speaker: Nina (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 作者为什么称他为遭妻子背叛的丈夫？
messages.en: Why does the author call him a cuckold?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax martu mhix fidila lejh, iżda hu għadu ma jafx.
messages.mt_standard: Għax martu mhix fidila lejh, iżda hu għadu ma jafx.
messages.zh: 因为他的妻子对他不忠，但他还不知道。
messages.en: Because his wife is unfaithful to him, but he doesn't know yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条关系箭头：伴侣的不忠指向遭背叛的人；kebbiex 指承受背叛的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To annoy or trouble someone and make them feel irritated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人烦躁、恼火或感到烦恼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idejjaq lil xi ħadd jew iġiegħlu jħoss dwejjaq u irritazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惹恼某人，使某人烦躁或烦恼。

formal.mt: L-istorbju kontinwu kedded lir-residenti u wassal għal diversi ilmenti.
formal.en: The constant noise irritated the residents and led to several complaints.
formal.zh: 持续不断的噪声使居民烦躁，引发了多起投诉。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-ħoss tal-magna kedded lil ommi dalgħodu. Mark: Nagħlaq il-bieb biex ma tismagħhiex daqshekk.
colloquial.en: Nina: The noise from the machine annoyed my mother this morning. Mark: I'll close the door so she won't hear it as much.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今天早上机器的声音把我妈妈吵烦了。马克：我把门关上，让她少听到一点。

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħoss tal-magna kedded lil ommi dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħoss tal-magna kedded lil ommi dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 今天早上机器的声音把我妈妈吵烦了。
messages.en: The noise from the machine annoyed my mother this morning.

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħlaq il-bieb biex ma tismagħhiex daqshekk.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħlaq il-bieb biex ma tismagħhiex daqshekk.
messages.zh: 我把门关上，让她少听到一点。
messages.en: I'll close the door so she won't hear it as much.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kedded 记成一段惹人烦躁的连续噪声：关注它让别人产生恼火情绪的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who irritates or vexes others, or an oppressor who makes others suffer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人烦恼、恼火的人；也指压迫他人、使他人受苦的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ddejjaq lil ħaddieħor, jew li taħqru u ġġiegħlu jbati.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who irritates or vexes another
sense_translations.zh_definition: 惹恼别人、使别人烦恼的人。
压迫他人、使他人受苦的人。

collocations.en: a person who annoys the neighbours

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ħakkiem jidher bħala keddied tal-poplu li juża l-biża' biex iżomm il-poter.
formal.en: In the novel, the ruler appears as an oppressor of the people who uses fear to maintain power.
formal.zh: 小说中的统治者是一个压迫人民的人，依靠恐惧维持权力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak ir-raġel sar il-keddied tal-ġirien bil-mużika qawwija tiegħu. Toni: Se nitkellem miegħu u nitolbu jbaxxi l-volum.
colloquial.en: Lara: That man has become a nuisance to the neighbours with his loud music. Toni: I'll speak to him and ask him to turn the volume down.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：那个人总放很响的音乐，已经成了让邻居头疼的人。托尼：我去跟他说，请他把音量调低。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel sar il-keddied tal-ġirien bil-mużika qawwija tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel sar il-keddied tal-ġirien bil-mużika qawwija tiegħu.
messages.zh: 那个人总放很响的音乐，已经成了让邻居头疼的人。
messages.en: That man has become a nuisance to the neighbours with his loud music.

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nitkellem miegħu u nitolbu jbaxxi l-volum.
messages.mt_standard: Se nitkellem miegħu u nitolbu jbaxxi l-volum.
messages.zh: 我去跟他说，请他把音量调低。
messages.en: I'll speak to him and ask him to turn the volume down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给两幅人物画像贴上 keddied：一位不断惹人烦恼，另一位压迫别人；共同点是让他人受苦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing annoyance or distress, or imposing oppressive treatment on people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容令人烦恼、苦恼的事物或行为，也形容具有压迫性、使人受压迫的制度或做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib dwejjaq jew irritazzjoni, jew li jaħqar lin-nies u jġegħelhom ibatu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人烦恼、恼火或苦恼的。
压迫性的，使人受到压迫或苛待的。

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza kif ir-reġim keddiedi kkontrolla l-ħajja ta' kuljum taċ-ċittadini permezz tal-biża'.
formal.en: The study analyses how the oppressive regime controlled citizens' daily lives through fear.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了实行压迫的政权如何借助恐惧控制公民的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-aġir keddiedi qed idejjaq lil kulħadd fl-uffiċċju. Ben: Għandna nitkellmu dwaru fil-laqgħa u nsibu soluzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: This vexatious behaviour is upsetting everyone in the office. Ben: We should discuss it at the meeting and find a solution.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种烦人的行为让办公室里的每个人都很苦恼。本：我们应该在会上讨论一下，找个解决办法。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-aġir keddiedi qed idejjaq lil kulħadd fl-uffiċċju.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-aġir keddiedi qed idejjaq lil kulħadd fl-uffiċċju.
messages.zh: 这种烦人的行为让办公室里的每个人都很苦恼。
messages.en: This vexatious behaviour is upsetting everyone in the office.

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna nitkellmu dwaru fil-laqgħa u nsibu soluzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna nitkellmu dwaru fil-laqgħa u nsibu soluzzjoni.
messages.zh: 我们应该在会上讨论一下，找个解决办法。
messages.en: We should discuss it at the meeting and find a solution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 keddiedi 放在行为或政权旁作描述：行为令人烦恼，政权使人受压迫，记牢它是形容词。

gloss_zh: 给衣物缝折边；把边角掖入

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fold and sew the edge of a garment, or to tuck an edge or loose part into place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把衣物的边缘折起并缝好；也指把布料等的边角掖入适当位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Itwi u ħit it-tarf ta' libsa, jew daħħal tarf ta' drapp f'postu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给衣物的边缘折边并缝好。
把边角或松散部分掖入、塞好。

collocations.en: tucked the edge of the sheet under the mattress
collocations.zh: 把床单边掖到床垫下面

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat keffef il-qalziet skont it-tul mitlub mill-klijent.
formal.en: The tailor hemmed the trousers to the length requested by the customer.
formal.zh: 裁缝按照顾客要求的长度给裤子缝好了折边。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min keffef il-qalziet tiegħek? Mark: Il-ħajjat ħdejn id-dar. Issa t-tul tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who hemmed your trousers? Mark: The tailor near my house. They're the right length now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你的裤子是谁缝的折边？Mark：我家附近的裁缝。现在长度合适了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的裤子是谁缝的折边？
messages.en: Who hemmed your trousers?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħajjat ħdejn id-dar. Issa t-tul tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħajjat ħdejn id-dar. Issa t-tul tajjeb.
messages.zh: 我家附近的裁缝。现在长度合适了。
messages.en: The tailor near my house. They're the right length now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把裤脚折进去再缝好：keffef记动作；换成床单边，则联想到把边角掖进去。

gloss_zh: 专门给衣物缝折边的人；缝边工

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who folds and sews the edges of garments to make hems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给衣物边缘折边并缝好的人，可指专做这类工作的缝边工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titwi u tħit it-truf tal-ħwejjeġ biex tagħmel il-keffiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who sews hems on garments
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给衣物缝折边的人；缝边工。

formal.mt: Il-keffief ħadem b'attenzjoni biex il-keffiet tal-qliezet kollha jkunu dritti.
formal.en: The garment hemmer worked carefully to ensure that all the trouser hems were straight.
formal.zh: 缝边工细心操作，确保所有裤子的折边都平直。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf lil xi keffief tajjeb? Pawlu: Iva, hemm wieħed ħdejn is-suq. Ħadli ħsieb il-qliezet kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know a good garment hemmer? Pawlu: Yes, there's one near the market. He took care of all my trousers.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你认识手艺好的缝边工吗？Pawlu：认识，市场附近有一位。我的裤子都是他处理的。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 你认识手艺好的缝边工吗？
messages.en: Do you know a good garment hemmer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm wieħed ħdejn is-suq. Ħadli ħsieb il-qliezet kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm wieħed ħdejn is-suq. Ħadli ħsieb il-qliezet kollha.
messages.zh: 认识，市场附近有一位。我的裤子都是他处理的。
messages.en: Yes, there's one near the market. He took care of all my trousers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把keffef与keffief配对记：前者是缝折边的动作，后者是坐在缝纫台前做这件事的人。

gloss_zh: 能给衣物缝折边的；具备缝边能力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the ability to make hems by folding and sewing the edges of garments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具备把衣物边缘折起并缝好的能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jagħmel il-keffiet billi jitwi u jħit it-truf tal-ħwejjeġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有给衣物缝折边的能力的。

collocations.zh: 具备缝折边功能的设备

formal.mt: Għal dan ix-xogħol, il-ħanut jeħtieġ ħaddiem keffiefi li jaħdem bi preċiżjoni.
formal.en: For this job, the shop needs a worker capable of hemming who works accurately.
formal.zh: 这项工作需要店里配备一名会缝折边、操作精确的工人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna bżonn ħaddiem keffiefi għal dawn il-qliezet. Toni: Nista' nagħmilhom jien; naf nagħmel il-keffiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: We need a worker who can hem these trousers. Toni: I can do them; I know how to make hems.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这些裤子需要找个会缝折边的工人来处理。Toni：我来做吧，我会缝折边。

messages.speaker: Lara (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna bżonn ħaddiem keffiefi għal dawn il-qliezet.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna bżonn ħaddiem keffiefi għal dawn il-qliezet.
messages.zh: 这些裤子需要找个会缝折边的工人来处理。
messages.en: We need a worker who can hem these trousers.

messages.speaker: Toni (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nagħmilhom jien; naf nagħmel il-keffiet.
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nagħmilhom jien; naf nagħmel il-keffiet.
messages.zh: 我来做吧，我会缝折边。
messages.en: I can do them; I know how to make hems.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡片上给keffiefi旁边画一个“会缝边”的能力勾号，提醒自己它是形容能力的形容词。

gloss_zh: 具有裹覆作用的；形成笼罩效果的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect of wrapping something up or covering it like a shroud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生包裹、裹覆或如裹尸布般笼罩某物的效果的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jdawwar jew jgħatti xi ħaġa bħalma tagħmel kefen.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a shrouding or wrapping effect
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有笼罩、遮覆或包裹效果的。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċpar keffieni għatta l-wied u ħeba l-irħula mill-vista.
formal.en: The shrouding mist covered the valley and hid the villages from view.
formal.zh: 笼罩四周的雾气覆盖了山谷，使村庄消失在视野中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'keffieni' f'din id-deskrizzjoni taċ-ċpar? Ben: Ifisser li ċ-ċpar jgħatti kollox, qisu jdawwar il-post f'kisja.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'keffieni' mean in this description of the mist? Ben: It means the mist covers everything, as if wrapping the place in a covering.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这段描写雾气的文字里，keffieni是什么意思？Ben：意思是雾把一切都罩住，仿佛给这个地方裹上了一层外衣。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这段描写雾气的文字里，keffieni是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'keffieni' mean in this description of the mist?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li ċ-ċpar jgħatti kollox, qisu jdawwar il-post f'kisja.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li ċ-ċpar jgħatti kollox, qisu jdawwar il-post f'kisja.
messages.zh: 意思是雾把一切都罩住，仿佛给这个地方裹上了一层外衣。
messages.en: It means the mist covers everything, as if wrapping the place in a covering.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一层雾像布一样裹住山谷，用这个画面记keffieni的“有裹覆、笼罩效果的”这一性质。

gloss_zh: 用裹尸布包裹遗体的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of wrapping a dead body in a shroud.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用裹尸布包裹遗体这一行为，指包裹的过程本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ġisem mejjet jitgeżwer f'kefen.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of wrapping in a shroud
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用裹尸布包裹遗体的行为或过程。

collocations.en: the wrapping of the body in a shroud
the process of wrapping in a shroud
collocations.zh: 以裹尸布包裹遗体的过程

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kefna tal-ġisem bħala wieħed mill-passi fit-tħejjija għad-difna.
formal.en: The report describes wrapping the body in a shroud as one of the steps in preparing for burial.
formal.zh: 报告把用裹尸布包裹遗体描述为安葬准备中的一个步骤。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fil-ktieb hemm il-kelma 'kefna'. Tfisser id-drapp? David: Le, hawn tfisser l-att li l-ġisem jitgeżwer fil-kefen.
colloquial.en: Sara: The book has the word 'kefna'. Does it mean the cloth? David: No, here it means the act of wrapping the body in the shroud.
colloquial.zh: Sara：书里有个词kefna，是指那块布吗？David：不是，这里指用裹尸布包裹遗体这一行为。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 书里有个词kefna，是指那块布吗？
messages.en: The book has the word 'kefna'. Does it mean the cloth?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn tfisser l-att li l-ġisem jitgeżwer fil-kefen.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn tfisser l-att li l-ġisem jitgeżwer fil-kefen.
messages.zh: 不是，这里指用裹尸布包裹遗体这一行为。
messages.en: No, here it means the act of wrapping the body in the shroud.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给kefna配一张“正在包裹遗体”的动作图，记住它是名词化的行为概念，不是布料本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deceit or secret scheming intended to mislead someone or gain an unfair advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为误导他人或谋取不正当优势而进行的欺骗、暗中策划或算计。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qerq jew ippjanar bil-moħbi biex wieħed iqarraq b'ħaddieħor jew jikseb vantaġġ mhux ġust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗；使他人受蒙蔽的行为。
暗中策划；为达到目的而进行的算计。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat talab trasparenza sabiex il-proċess ikun ħieles mill-kejd u mill-qerq.
formal.en: The committee called for transparency so that the process would be free from scheming and deception.
formal.zh: 委员会要求公开透明，以使整个程序免受暗中算计和欺骗的影响。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tafdax dak il-pjan? Mark: Għax hu mimli kejd; qalulna ħaġa u beħsiebhom jagħmlu oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't you trust that plan? Mark: Because it's full of deceit; they told us one thing and intend to do another.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么不相信那个计划？Mark：因为里面全是算计；他们对我们说一套，打算做的却是另一套。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么不相信那个计划？
messages.en: Why don't you trust that plan?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu mimli kejd; qalulna ħaġa u beħsiebhom jagħmlu oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu mimli kejd; qalulna ħaġa u beħsiebhom jagħmlu oħra.
messages.zh: 因为里面全是算计；他们对我们说一套，打算做的却是另一套。
messages.en: Because it's full of deceit; they told us one thing and intend to do another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把kejd放进“嘴上说合作，背后另有计划”的画面中，同时记住它可以指欺骗，也可以指暗中算计。

gloss_zh: 行骗；耍阴招；背叛并欺骗

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave deceitfully, act in an underhand way, or betray someone who trusted you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以欺骗或不光明的手段行事；也可指背叛并欺骗信任自己的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġixxa bil-qerq jew b'mod moħbi u mhux onest, jew ittradixxa lil xi ħadd li kien jafdak.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行事不诚实；以欺骗的方式对待他人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to act in an underhand manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 暗中耍手段；以不光明的方式行事。
背叛并欺骗原本信任自己的人；出卖同伙或伙伴。

collocations.zh: 背叛并欺骗了自己的伙伴

collocations.en: acted deceitfully to gain an advantage

formal.mt: Is-sieħeb kejjed lill-kollega tiegħu billi żamm il-ħlas kollu għalih, minkejja l-ftehim li jaqsmuh.
formal.en: The partner double-crossed his colleague by keeping the entire payment, despite their agreement to share it.
formal.zh: 这名合伙人违背平分报酬的约定，独吞了全部款项，背叛并欺骗了同事。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jaħdem aktar ma' Toni? Ben: Għax Toni kejjed lil sieħbu u ħa l-flus kollha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why doesn't Pawlu want to work with Toni anymore? Ben: Because Toni double-crossed his partner and took all the money.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Pawlu为什么不想再和Toni合作了？Ben：因为Toni出卖了自己的伙伴，把钱全拿走了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jaħdem aktar ma' Toni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx jaħdem aktar ma' Toni?
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么不想再和Toni合作了？
messages.en: Why doesn't Pawlu want to work with Toni anymore?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Toni kejjed lil sieħbu u ħa l-flus kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Toni kejjed lil sieħbu u ħa l-flus kollha.
messages.zh: 因为Toni出卖了自己的伙伴，把钱全拿走了。
messages.en: Because Toni double-crossed his partner and took all the money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把kejd与kejjed并排记：kejd是“欺骗、算计”这个名词，kejjed则把画面变成某人正在耍手段或出卖伙伴。

gloss_zh: 使柔韧物弯曲；已获得足量的某物

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bend something pliable, such as a branch; also, to have had a sufficient quantity of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使树枝等柔韧的物体弯曲；也指已经享用或获得了足够数量的某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għawweġ xi ħaġa flessibbli, bħal fergħa; jew ħa kwantità biżżejjed minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to bend sth. pliable (such as the branch of a tree)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使柔韧、可弯曲的物体弯曲，例如树枝。

sense_translations.en_definition: to have had sth. in sufficient quantity
sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经享用、取得或拥有足够数量的某物。

collocations.en: bent the reeds to make a basket

formal.mt: L-artiġjan kejjef il-qasab bil-mod biex jagħti forma tonda lill-qoffa.
formal.en: The craftsperson gently bent the reeds to give the basket a round shape.
formal.zh: 工匠慢慢地把芦苇弯曲，使篮子形成圆形。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min kejjef din il-fergħa? Toni: Jien, biex nagħtiha forma ta' ark. Għadha sħiħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who bent this branch? Toni: I did, to give it an arch shape. It's still in one piece.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这根树枝是谁弯的？Toni：我弯的，想把它弄成拱形。它还是完整的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这根树枝是谁弯的？
messages.en: Who bent this branch?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, biex nagħtiha forma ta' ark. Għadha sħiħa.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, biex nagħtiha forma ta' ark. Għadha sħiħa.
messages.zh: 我弯的，想把它弄成拱形。它还是完整的。
messages.en: I did, to give it an arch shape. It's still in one piece.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给kejjef画两张独立记忆卡：一张是柔软树枝弯成弧线，另一张是数量达到“足够”刻度；两义分别记忆。

gloss_zh: 使人倦怠；使人无精打采

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel sluggish and lacking in energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人精神不振、行动迟缓或缺乏活力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu bla enerġija u bla ħeġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人倦怠、无精打采。

collocations.zh: 炎热使大家都无精打采。

collocations.en: The heavy meal made Pawlu sluggish.
collocations.zh: 油腻丰盛的一餐使保罗倦怠起来。

formal.mt: Is-sħana qawwija kejjet lill-ħaddiema u naqqset ir-ritmu tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The intense heat made the workers lethargic and slowed the pace of work.
formal.zh: 酷热使工人们精神不振，工作节奏也随之放慢。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex m'għandekx enerġija llum? Pawlu: L-ikel tqil kejjet lili wkoll; irrid nimxi ftit.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why do you have no energy today? Pawlu: The heavy meal made me sluggish too; I need to walk a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你今天怎么没精神？保罗：那顿丰盛的饭也让我懒洋洋的；我得走动一下。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天怎么没精神？
messages.en: Why do you have no energy today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ikel tqil kejjet lili wkoll; irrid nimxi ftit.
messages.mt_standard: L-ikel tqil kejjet lili wkoll; irrid nimxi ftit.
messages.zh: 那顿丰盛的饭也让我懒洋洋的；我得走动一下。
messages.en: The heavy meal made me sluggish too; I need to walk a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象吃完大餐后整个人没了精神，用这个画面记住它表示“使人倦怠”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who cheats others or makes dishonest plans to gain an advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过欺骗别人或暗中谋划不诚实的手段来谋取好处的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqarraq b'ħaddieħor jew tagħmel pjanijiet qarrieqa biex tikseb vantaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗别人或以作弊手段谋利的人；骗子。
善于暗中谋划、耍手段以达到目的的人。

collocations.en: a person who cheats at games

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kejjied ifassal pjan biex jieħu l-flus mingħand il-ġirien tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the schemer devises a plan to take money from his neighbours.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个耍手段的人设计了一个计划，企图从邻居那里拿走钱财。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tridx tilgħab ma' Toni? Mark: Għax hu kejjied; jaħbi l-karti biex jirbaħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't you want to play with Toni? Mark: Because he's a cheat; he hides cards to win.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不愿意和托尼玩？马克：因为他是个作弊的人；他为了赢会把牌藏起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx tilgħab ma' Toni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx tilgħab ma' Toni?
messages.zh: 你为什么不愿意和托尼玩？
messages.en: Why don't you want to play with Toni?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu kejjied; jaħbi l-karti biex jirbaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu kejjied; jaħbi l-karti biex jirbaħ.
messages.zh: 因为他是个作弊的人；他为了赢会把牌藏起来。
messages.en: Because he's a cheat; he hides cards to win.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“藏牌作弊”和“暗中设局”放在同一个人物身上，记住这个名词的两种相关用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who measures dimensions, amounts, or distances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 测定尺寸、数量或距离的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkejjel qisien, kwantitajiet jew distanzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行测量或量度的人。

formal.mt: Il-kejjiel tal-art kejjel id-distanza bejn iż-żewġ ħitan u niżżel ir-riżultat fir-rapport.
formal.en: The land measurer measured the distance between the two walls and recorded the result in the report.
formal.zh: 土地测量人员量出了两面墙之间的距离，并将结果记入报告。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jkejjel id-drapp? Ġanni: Il-kejjiel qiegħed ħdejn il-mejda; staqsih jgħinek.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who will measure the cloth? Ġanni: The measurer is beside the table; ask him to help you.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁来量这块布？詹尼：量布的人就在桌子旁边；请他帮你吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 谁来量这块布？
messages.en: Who will measure the cloth?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kejjiel qiegħed ħdejn il-mejda; staqsih jgħinek.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kejjiel qiegħed ħdejn il-mejda; staqsih jgħinek.
messages.zh: 量布的人就在桌子旁边；请他帮你吧。
messages.en: The measurer is beside the table; ask him to help you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个手拿卷尺的人，量土地也量布料；这个词指执行测量的人。

gloss_zh: 丰产的；容易获得丰收的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to produce an abundant yield, especially when referring to crops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于产出大量收成的，通常用于描述农作物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħti ħsad abbundanti, speċjalment meta jingħad dwar l-uċuħ tar-raba'.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to yield in abundance (usually used of harvesting)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易获得大量收成的；丰产的，通常用于收获或农作物的语境。

collocations.en: wheat that tends to yield abundantly
barley that tends to yield abundantly

formal.mt: Il-bidwi għażel qamħ kejjieli bit-tama li jikseb ħsad abbundanti.
formal.en: The farmer chose wheat that tends to yield abundantly, hoping to obtain a plentiful harvest.
formal.zh: 农民选择了丰产的小麦，希望获得充足的收成。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex għażilt dan il-qamħ? Pietru: Għax hu kejjieli; nittama li jagħtina ħsad tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you choose this wheat? Pietru: Because it tends to yield abundantly; I hope it gives us a good harvest.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么选这种小麦？彼得：因为它丰产；希望它能让我们有个好收成。

messages.speaker: Marija (农民的邻居)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这种小麦？
messages.en: Why did you choose this wheat?

messages.speaker: Pietru (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu kejjieli; nittama li jagħtina ħsad tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu kejjieli; nittama li jagħtina ħsad tajjeb.
messages.zh: 因为它丰产；希望它能让我们有个好收成。
messages.en: Because it tends to yield abundantly; I hope it gives us a good harvest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中画出麦穗饱满、粮仓渐满的场景，把这个形容词与“丰产”一起记。

gloss_zh: 使人受辱的；令人难堪的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Making someone feel humiliated or deprived of dignity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到受辱、难堪或尊严受到损害的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu umiljat jew imċaħħad mid-dinjità tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人受辱的；使人感到尊严受损的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-trattament bħala kejjieni għax ċaħħad lill-ħaddiema mid-dinjità tagħhom.
formal.en: The report describes the treatment as humiliating because it deprived the workers of their dignity.
formal.zh: 报告将这种对待描述为有辱尊严，因为它损害了工人们的尊严。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tlaqt mil-laqgħa? David: Dak il-kumment kien kejjieni; ħassejtni umiljat quddiem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you leave the meeting? David: That comment was humiliating; I felt humiliated in front of everyone.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么离开会议？戴维：那句话太伤自尊了；我觉得自己在大家面前受了辱。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么离开会议？
messages.en: Why did you leave the meeting?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-kumment kien kejjieni; ħassejtni umiljat quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-kumment kien kejjieni; ħassejtni umiljat quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 那句话太伤自尊了；我觉得自己在大家面前受了辱。
messages.en: That comment was humiliating; I felt humiliated in front of everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象当众听到一句伤自尊的话，用“令人受辱的评论”记住这个形容词。

gloss_zh: 狡猾的人；诡计多端的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who uses cunning to achieve a purpose or gain an advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 善于运用狡猾手段来达到目的或取得好处的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tuża l-makakkerija biex tilħaq għan jew tikseb vantaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狡猾、善于耍心机的人。

formal.mt: Fil-ħrafa, il-kejjiet juża kliem sabiħ biex jikseb il-fiduċja tal-oħrajn u jilħaq l-għan tiegħu.
formal.en: In the fable, the cunning person uses pleasing words to gain others' trust and achieve his purpose.
formal.zh: 寓言中，那个狡猾的人用花言巧语取得别人的信任，以达到自己的目的。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Taħseb li qed jgħinna biss biex ikun qalbu tajba? Luqa: Ma naħsibx; hu kejjiet u dejjem ifittex xi vantaġġ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you think he's helping us just to be kind? Luqa: I don't think so; he's a cunning person and always looks for an advantage.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你觉得他帮我们只是出于好心吗？卢卡：我觉得不是；他很狡猾，总想捞点好处。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li qed jgħinna biss biex ikun qalbu tajba?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li qed jgħinna biss biex ikun qalbu tajba?
messages.zh: 你觉得他帮我们只是出于好心吗？
messages.en: Do you think he's helping us just to be kind?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma naħsibx; hu kejjiet u dejjem ifittex xi vantaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ma naħsibx; hu kejjiet u dejjem ifittex xi vantaġġ.
messages.zh: 我觉得不是；他很狡猾，总想捞点好处。
messages.en: I don't think so; he's a cunning person and always looks for an advantage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个满脸笑容却暗藏小算盘的人，记住这个名词指“狡猾的人”。

gloss_zh: 使人倦怠的；使人懒散的；使人冷漠的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing people to become lethargic, idle, or indifferent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人精神不振、懒于行动，或变得漠不关心的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lin-nies iħossuhom bla enerġija, jibqgħu bla ma jagħmlu xejn jew jitilfu l-interess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人倦怠、无精打采的。
使人闲懒、无所作为的。
使人失去兴趣、变得漠不关心的。

collocations.en: an effect that causes lethargy, idleness, or indifference
collocations.zh: 使人倦怠、懒散或冷漠的作用

collocations.en: an environment that encourages lethargy or idleness
collocations.zh: 使人倦怠或懒散的环境

formal.mt: L-ambjent kien kejjieti: in-nuqqas ta' attività u ta' skop ħalla lin-nies bla ħeġġa u bla interess.
formal.en: The environment induced lethargy and indifference: the lack of activity and purpose left people without enthusiasm or interest.
formal.zh: 这种环境使人倦怠而冷漠：缺乏活动和目标让人们失去了热情与兴趣。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Hawnhekk ma jiġri xejn; lanqas għadni rrid nagħmel xi ħaġa. Samwel: Dan l-ambjent kejjieti. Ejja noħorġu nimxu ftit.
colloquial.en: Elena: Nothing happens here; I don't even feel like doing anything anymore. Samwel: This environment makes you idle and listless. Let's go out for a short walk.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这里什么事都没有；我现在连做点什么都不想了。萨姆韦尔：这种环境让人懒散又没精神。我们出去走走吧。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ma jiġri xejn; lanqas għadni rrid nagħmel xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ma jiġri xejn; lanqas għadni rrid nagħmel xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 这里什么事都没有；我现在连做点什么都不想了。
messages.en: Nothing happens here; I don't even feel like doing anything anymore.

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-ambjent kejjieti. Ejja noħorġu nimxu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-ambjent kejjieti. Ejja noħorġu nimxu ftit.
messages.zh: 这种环境让人懒散又没精神。我们出去走走吧。
messages.en: This environment makes you idle and listless. Let's go out for a short walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成一种环境带来的三种结果：身体没精神、行动变懒散、态度不关心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of sluggishness, laziness, or inactivity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 精神不振、懒于行动或无所事事的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' nuqqas ta' enerġija, għażż jew nuqqas ta' attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倦怠；缺乏精神和活力的状态。
懒惰；不愿付出努力的状态或习性。
闲懒；无所事事或不从事活动的状态。

formal.mt: Wara sigħat twal mingħajr attività, il-parteċipanti ħassew sens ta' kejt u kellhom bżonn pawża qasira.
formal.en: After long hours without activity, the participants felt lethargic and needed a short break.
formal.zh: 长时间没有活动后，参与者感到倦怠，需要短暂休息。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Illum għandi sens ta' kejt u ma rrid nagħmel xejn. Ben: Ejja nimxu ftit; forsi hekk negħlbu l-kejt.
colloquial.en: Nina: I feel lethargic today and don't want to do anything. Ben: Let's walk a little; perhaps that will help us overcome the lethargy.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我今天懒洋洋的，什么都不想做。本：我们走动一下吧；也许这样能克服这股倦怠。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum għandi sens ta' kejt u ma rrid nagħmel xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Illum għandi sens ta' kejt u ma rrid nagħmel xejn.
messages.zh: 我今天懒洋洋的，什么都不想做。
messages.en: I feel lethargic today and don't want to do anything.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who places a crown on someone else's head.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqiegħed kuruna fuq ras persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为别人戴上王冠、执行加冕的人。

gloss_zh: 发言人；代表某团体讲话的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who speaks on behalf of a group or organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 代表某个团体或组织对外讲话、表达其立场的人。

formal.zh: 协会发言人在新闻发布会上阐述了协会的立场。

gloss_zh: 用温水或药液敷身体疼痛部位

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用温水或药液敷身体上疼痛的部位。

messages.zh: 每天是谁清扫院子？
messages.en: Who sweeps the yard every day?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, imma nhar ta' Ħadd jgħinni ħija.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, imma nhar ta' Ħadd jgħinni ħija.
messages.zh: 是我，不过星期天我兄弟会帮忙。
messages.en: I do, but on Sundays my brother helps me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上每天都画着一把扫帚，把 kennes 记成反复进行的清扫活动，并用 kuljum“每天”帮助记住频率。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sheltered from wind or exposure, or comfortably snug, especially when describing a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容地方有遮蔽、能避风，或让人感到舒适温暖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun imħares mir-riħ jew mill-espożizzjoni, jew li jagħti sens ta' kumdità u sħana, speċjalment meta jingħad għal post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有遮蔽的；能避风的，形容地方。
舒适温暖的；安适惬意的。

formal.mt: Il-bank jinsab f'post kenni ħdejn il-ħajt, fejn il-viżitaturi jistgħu jistrieħu 'l bogħod mir-riħ.
formal.en: The bench is in a sheltered spot beside the wall, where visitors can rest out of the wind.
formal.zh: 长椅位于墙边一处避风的地方，游客可以在那里休息，避开风吹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu kenni dan l-appartament! Luqa: Iva, speċjalment filgħaxija meta nixegħlu l-lampa.
colloquial.en: Maja: This apartment is so snug! Luqa: Yes, especially in the evening when we turn on the lamp.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这套公寓真温馨舒适！卢卡：是啊，尤其是晚上打开灯的时候。

messages.speaker: Maja (来访朋友)
messages.zh: 这套公寓真温馨舒适！
messages.en: This apartment is so snug!

messages.speaker: Luqa (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment filgħaxija meta nixegħlu l-lampa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment filgħaxija meta nixegħlu l-lampa.
messages.zh: 是啊，尤其是晚上打开灯的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially in the evening when we turn on the lamp.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从大风中走进一个暖和的小角落：外有遮挡是“避风”，身心放松是“舒适”，用这幅画面记住 kenni 的两个义项。

gloss_zh: 庇护者；提供栖身处的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gives someone shelter or a protected place to stay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为别人提供庇护或安全栖身之处的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti kenn jew post imħares fejn joqgħod xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 庇护他人的人；为他人提供栖身处的人。

collocations.zh: 为旅人提供栖身处的人

collocations.en: a person who shelters people in need

formal.mt: Il-kennien fetaħ daru lill-familja u offrielha post sigur fejn tgħaddi l-lejl.
formal.en: The shelter provider opened his home to the family and offered them a safe place to spend the night.
formal.zh: 这位庇护者向那家人敞开家门，为他们提供了安全的过夜之处。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min hu dak ir-raġel? Samwel: Hu l-kennien tagħna; tana post fejn norqdu meta ma kellniex fejn immorru.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who is that man? Samwel: He's the man who gave us shelter; he gave us somewhere to sleep when we had nowhere to go.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：那个男人是谁？萨姆韦尔：他是收留我们的人；我们无处可去时，他给了我们睡觉的地方。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man?

messages.speaker: Samwel (受助者)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-kennien tagħna; tana post fejn norqdu meta ma kellniex fejn immorru.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-kennien tagħna; tana post fejn norqdu meta ma kellniex fejn immorru.
messages.zh: 他是收留我们的人；我们无处可去时，他给了我们睡觉的地方。
messages.en: He's the man who gave us shelter; he gave us somewhere to sleep when we had nowhere to go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kennien 时，把注意力放在开门收留别人的“人”身上：画面中心是庇护者，帮助自己牢牢记住这是人物名词。

gloss_zh: 提供庇护的；起遮护作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Giving shelter or protection from exposure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够提供庇护，或使人免受风雨等侵袭的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti kenn jew protezzjoni mir-riħ, mix-xita jew minn espożizzjoni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提供庇护的；具有遮护作用的。

formal.mt: Is-saqaf kennieni fuq id-daħla jipproteġi lill-viżitaturi mix-xita waqt li jistennew.
formal.en: The sheltering roof over the entrance protects visitors from the rain while they wait.
formal.zh: 入口上方起遮护作用的屋顶，让等候中的游客免受雨淋。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn nistgħu nieqfu sakemm tgħaddi x-xita? David: Taħt dak is-saqaf kennieni; hemm nibqgħu nexfin.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where can we stop until the rain passes? David: Under that sheltering roof; we'll stay dry there.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我们可以在哪里等雨停？戴维：到那个能挡雨的屋顶下面去；在那里就不会淋湿。

messages.speaker: Elena (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nistgħu nieqfu sakemm tgħaddi x-xita?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nistgħu nieqfu sakemm tgħaddi x-xita?
messages.zh: 我们可以在哪里等雨停？
messages.en: Where can we stop until the rain passes?

messages.speaker: David (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħt dak is-saqaf kennieni; hemm nibqgħu nexfin.
messages.mt_standard: Taħt dak is-saqaf kennieni; hemm nibqgħu nexfin.
messages.zh: 到那个能挡雨的屋顶下面去；在那里就不会淋湿。
messages.en: Under that sheltering roof; we'll stay dry there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kennieni 贴在替人挡雨的屋顶上，记住它描述“提供遮护”的性质；再和指庇护者本人的 kennien 对照练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A worker whose job is to sweep and clean streets.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以清扫街道、清理路面垃圾为工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaddiem li xogħlu hu li jiknes u jnaddaf it-toroq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 街道清扫工；负责扫街的工人。

collocations.en: a street sweeper with a broom

formal.mt: Il-kennies beda jnaddaf il-pjazza kmieni filgħodu, qabel ma fetħu l-ħwienet.
formal.en: The street sweeper began cleaning the square early in the morning, before the shops opened.
formal.zh: 街道清扫工一大早就在商店开门前开始清扫广场。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex ċaqlaqt il-karozza? Ġorġ: Biex il-kennies ikun jista' jnaddaf ħdejn il-bankina.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you move the car? Ġorġ: So the street sweeper can clean beside the pavement.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么把车挪走了？乔治：好让清扫工能清理人行道旁边。

messages.speaker: Marta (邻居)
messages.zh: 你为什么把车挪走了？
messages.en: Why did you move the car?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (车主)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex il-kennies ikun jista' jnaddaf ħdejn il-bankina.
messages.mt_standard: Biex il-kennies ikun jista' jnaddaf ħdejn il-bankina.
messages.zh: 好让清扫工能清理人行道旁边。
messages.en: So the street sweeper can clean beside the pavement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清晨街上拿着扫帚工作的清扫工，把 kennies 与“扫街的人”绑定；和 kennes 一起练习时，分别记人物与动作。

gloss_zh: 面包师清扫烤炉用的刷子

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brush that bakers use to sweep the inside of an oven.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面包师用来清扫烤炉内部的刷子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xkupilja li jużaw il-furnara biex jikinsu ġewwa l-forn.

sense_translations.en_definition: a brush used by bakers to sweep out their ovens
sense_translations.zh_definition: 面包师用来清扫烤炉内部的刷子。

collocations.en: to sweep the oven with the baker's brush
collocations.zh: 用面包师的炉刷清扫烤炉

formal.mt: Il-furnar uża l-kenniesa biex neħħa l-irmied minn ġewwa l-forn.
formal.en: The baker used the oven brush to remove the ash from inside the oven.
formal.zh: 面包师用炉刷清除了烤炉内部的灰烬。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hi l-kenniesa tal-forn? Rita: Ħdejn il-bieb; għadni kif naddaft il-forn biha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the oven brush? Rita: By the door; I've just cleaned the oven with it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：清扫烤炉的刷子在哪儿？丽塔：在门边；我刚用它清理了烤炉。

messages.speaker: Mark (面包师)
messages.zh: 清扫烤炉的刷子在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the oven brush?

messages.speaker: Rita (面包房同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-bieb; għadni kif naddaft il-forn biha.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-bieb; għadni kif naddaft il-forn biha.
messages.zh: 在门边；我刚用它清理了烤炉。
messages.en: By the door; I've just cleaned the oven with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kenniesa 和面包师伸进烤炉扫灰的长刷画面联系起来，记住它是清炉工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hearth or fireplace where a fire is kept for warmth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生火取暖的炉床或壁炉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fid-dar fejn jinżamm in-nar għat-tisħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 炉床；壁炉，即屋内生火的地方。

formal.mt: Filgħaxija, il-familja nġabret ħdejn il-kenun biex tisħon.
formal.en: In the evening, the family gathered beside the fireplace to warm up.
formal.zh: 傍晚，一家人聚在壁炉旁取暖。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn il-bard! Nistgħu noqogħdu ħdejn il-kenun? Toni: Żgur, ġib siġġu u oqgħod hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: It's cold in here! Can we sit beside the fireplace? Toni: Of course, bring a chair and sit here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里好冷！我们可以坐到壁炉旁吗？托尼：当然，搬把椅子坐这儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (来访朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn il-bard! Nistgħu noqogħdu ħdejn il-kenun?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn il-bard! Nistgħu noqogħdu ħdejn il-kenun?
messages.zh: 这里好冷！我们可以坐到壁炉旁吗？
messages.en: It's cold in here! Can we sit beside the fireplace?

messages.speaker: Toni (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, ġib siġġu u oqgħod hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, ġib siġġu u oqgħod hawn.
messages.zh: 当然，搬把椅子坐这儿吧。
messages.en: Of course, bring a chair and sit here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一家人围着 kenun 烤火，用温暖的壁炉画面同时记住炉床和壁炉两个译法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat ugly or rather unattractive in appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外观有些丑、不太好看的，程度较轻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ftit ikrah fid-dehra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有点丑的；有些难看的。

formal.mt: Id-disinn tal-bini huwa kerhieni, għalkemm l-ispazju ta' ġewwa huwa komdu.
formal.en: The building's design is somewhat ugly, although the interior space is comfortable.
formal.zh: 这栋建筑的设计有些难看，不过内部空间很舒适。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Jogħġbok dan il-kulur? Mark: Għalija huwa kerhieni; nippreferi l-blu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you like this colour? Mark: I find it a bit ugly; I prefer blue.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你喜欢这个颜色吗？马克：我觉得有点难看；我更喜欢蓝色。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这个颜色吗？
messages.en: Do you like this colour?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我觉得有点难看；我更喜欢蓝色。
messages.en: I find it a bit ugly; I prefer blue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kerhieni 配一张只打低一点分的设计图，记住语义是有点丑，别把程度记成丑极了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sing, especially when referring to certain kinds of birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸣唱，尤其用于描述某些鸟类发出鸣声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikanta, speċjalment meta jingħad dwar ċerti tipi ta' għasafar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sing (used especially of certain species of birds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸣唱，尤用于某些种类的鸟。

formal.mt: L-għasfur kerker fuq fergħa filwaqt li l-osservatur baqa' jisma' fis-skiet.
formal.en: The bird sang on a branch while the observer continued listening in silence.
formal.zh: 鸟儿在树枝上鸣唱，观察者继续静静聆听。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt l-għasfur? Kerker fuq dik il-fergħa. Toni: Iva, smajt! Ejja nisimgħu ftit ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear the bird? It sang on that branch. Toni: Yes, I did! Let's listen a little longer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见那只鸟了吗？它刚在那根树枝上鸣唱。托尼：听见了！我们再听一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt l-għasfur? Kerker fuq dik il-fergħa.
messages.mt_standard: Smajt l-għasfur? Kerker fuq dik il-fergħa.
messages.zh: 你听见那只鸟了吗？它刚在那根树枝上鸣唱。
messages.en: Did you hear the bird? It sang on that branch.

messages.speaker: Toni (观鸟朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, smajt! Ejja nisimgħu ftit ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, smajt! Ejja nisimgħu ftit ieħor.
messages.zh: 听见了！我们再听一会儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, I did! Let's listen a little longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读 kerker 时想象树枝上的鸟一声接一声鸣唱；这只是声音联想，用来记住鸟鸣这一用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel afraid or horrified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到害怕，或使其受到强烈惊吓而惊骇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss biża' jew orrur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吓唬；使害怕。
使惊骇；使感到恐怖。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont tal-inċident kerr lil min semgħu.
formal.en: The account of the incident horrified those who heard it.
formal.zh: 对那起事件的叙述使听到的人感到惊骇。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak il-ħoss kerr lil ħija. Mark: Kien qawwi ħafna, imma kollox sew issa.
colloquial.en: Lara: That noise frightened my brother. Mark: It was very loud, but everything is all right now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个声音吓到我弟弟了。马克：声音确实很大，不过现在一切都好了。

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 那个声音吓到我弟弟了。
messages.en: That noise frightened my brother.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien qawwi ħafna, imma kollox sew issa.
messages.mt_standard: Kien qawwi ħafna, imma kollox sew issa.
messages.zh: 声音确实很大，不过现在一切都好了。
messages.en: It was very loud, but everything is all right now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kerr 放在突然巨响和听者受惊的画面中，记住它表示使别人害怕，强烈时可译为使惊骇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tenant or a person who hires something for temporary use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承租房屋的租户，或付费租用某物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikri dar jew xi ħaġa oħra biex tużaha għal żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 租户；承租房屋或处所的人。
租用某物的人；承租人。

formal.mt: Il-kerrej tal-appartament bagħat talba bil-miktub lis-sid biex jissewwa l-bieb.
formal.en: The apartment's tenant sent the landlord a written request to have the door repaired.
formal.zh: 公寓租户向房东提交了书面请求，希望修理房门。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Int il-kerrej ta' din il-karozza? Pawlu: Iva, krejtha għal tlett ijiem u għada nroddha lura.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are you the person hiring this car? Pawlu: Yes, I hired it for three days and I'm returning it tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这辆车是你租的吗？保罗：是的，我租了三天，明天归还。

messages.speaker: Rita (租车公司职员)
messages.zh: 这辆车是你租的吗？
messages.en: Are you the person hiring this car?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (租车顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, krejtha għal tlett ijiem u għada nroddha lura.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, krejtha għal tlett ijiem u għada nroddha lura.
messages.zh: 是的，我租了三天，明天归还。
messages.en: Yes, I hired it for three days and I'm returning it tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象 kerrej 手里拿着租来的房门钥匙或车钥匙：核心都是付费取得暂时使用权的人。

gloss_zh: 空间狭小的公寓楼；分隔成小套间的住宅楼

teaching_sense.en_definition: A residential building divided into small apartments, usually with limited living space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 分隔成多个小型住宅单元的楼房，通常居住空间较为狭小。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini maqsum f'appartamenti żgħar fejn l-ispazju għall-għajxien ikun limitat.

sense_translations.en_definition: tenement building (usually thought of as consisting of small apartments with limited space)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 分隔成多个小套间的住宅楼，通常使人联想到居住空间有限的公寓楼。

collocations.zh: 一栋老旧的小套间住宅楼

collocations.en: an apartment in a tenement building
collocations.zh: 小套间住宅楼中的一套公寓

formal.mt: Il-kerrejja għandha diversi appartamenti żgħar, iżda l-ispazju komuni huwa limitat.
formal.en: The tenement building has several small apartments, but the shared space is limited.
formal.zh: 这栋住宅楼设有几个小型公寓，但公共空间有限。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn toqgħod issa? Toni: F'appartament żgħir f'kerrejja ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where do you live now? Toni: In a small apartment in a tenement building near the square.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你现在住在哪里？Toni：住在广场附近一栋小套间住宅楼里的小公寓。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你现在住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live now?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 住在广场附近一栋小套间住宅楼里的小公寓。
messages.en: In a small apartment in a tenement building near the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一栋楼里挤着许多小套间的画面，重点记住它在本词条中指整栋住宅楼。

gloss_zh: 使事物变丑的人；破坏外观者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes something ugly or damages its appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变得难看，或破坏其外观的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel xi ħaġa kerha jew tħassar id-dehra tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使事物变丑、造成外观难看的人。

collocations.en: a person who spoils the landscape
a person who makes the city look ugly

formal.mt: Min iħammeġ il-pjazza u jħassar id-dehra tagħha jsir kerrieh tal-ambjent.
formal.en: Anyone who dirties the square and spoils its appearance becomes someone who makes the surroundings ugly.
formal.zh: 弄脏广场、破坏其外观的人，就成了破坏环境面貌的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt kif dak ir-raġel mela l-ħajt bir-reklami? Mark: Iva, sar kerrieh tal-pjazza; ħassar id-dehra tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see how that man covered the wall with advertisements? Mark: Yes, he has made the square ugly; he spoiled its appearance.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你看到那个人把墙上贴满广告了吗？Mark：看到了，他成了破坏广场面貌的人，把这里弄难看了。

messages.speaker: Lara (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt kif dak ir-raġel mela l-ħajt bir-reklami?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt kif dak ir-raġel mela l-ħajt bir-reklami?
messages.zh: 你看到那个人把墙上贴满广告了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how that man covered the wall with advertisements?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sar kerrieh tal-pjazza; ħassar id-dehra tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sar kerrieh tal-pjazza; ħassar id-dehra tagħha.
messages.zh: 看到了，他成了破坏广场面貌的人，把这里弄难看了。
messages.en: Yes, he has made the square ugly; he spoiled its appearance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把整洁墙面贴得杂乱难看：这个词记的是造成难看的人，而不是那面墙。

gloss_zh: 有使事物变丑倾向的；损害美观的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to make something ugly or less attractive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使事物变丑、降低外观美感的倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jagħmel xi ħaġa kerha jew inqas sabiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于使事物变丑的；容易损害美观的。

collocations.en: an effect that tends to make something ugly
decoration that tends to make something look worse
collocations.zh: 反而容易破坏美观的装饰

formal.mt: L-użu ta' kuluri li ma jaqblux jista' jkollu effett kerriehi fuq id-dehra tal-bini.
formal.en: Using colours that clash can have an uglifying effect on the appearance of the building.
formal.zh: 使用不协调的颜色，可能会对建筑外观产生损害美观的效果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Jogħġbok dan it-tiżjin fuq il-bieb? Pawlu: Le, għandu effett kerriehi; il-bieb kien isbaħ mingħajru.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you like this decoration on the door? Pawlu: No, it makes it look worse; the door looked nicer without it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你喜欢门上的这个装饰吗？Pawlu：不喜欢，它反而破坏美观，门原来没有它时更好看。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢门上的这个装饰吗？
messages.en: Do you like this decoration on the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandu effett kerriehi; il-bieb kien isbaħ mingħajru.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandu effett kerriehi; il-bieb kien isbaħ mingħajru.
messages.zh: 不喜欢，它反而破坏美观，门原来没有它时更好看。
messages.en: No, it makes it look worse; the door looked nicer without it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“装饰加上去却更丑了”的画面记忆；这个形容词描述使外观变差的倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To chill or be very cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变冷，或处于非常寒冷的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksaħ jew ikun kiesaħ ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变冷；冷下来。
非常冷；冷得厉害。

collocations.en: it became very cold during the night

formal.mt: It-temp kerċaħ matul il-lejl, u filgħodu l-mixi fil-beraħ kien diffiċli.
formal.en: The weather turned very cold during the night, and walking outdoors was difficult in the morning.
formal.zh: 天气在夜间变得十分寒冷，早晨在户外行走很困难。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-temp kerċaħ sew illum! Pawlu: Iva, ħu ġakketta qabel toħroġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: The weather has turned really cold today! Pawlu: Yes, take a jacket before you go out.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天天气变得真冷！保罗：是啊，出门前带件外套。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 今天天气变得真冷！
messages.en: The weather has turned really cold today!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 是啊，出门前带件外套。
messages.en: Yes, take a jacket before you go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用气温计突然下降的画面记 kerċaħ：既可着眼于冷下来，也可着眼于冷得厉害。

gloss_zh: 面色苍白、看起来有病的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who looks pale and unwell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面色苍白、外表显得生病的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tidher pallida u marida.

sense_translations.en_definition: a person who looks pale and ill
sense_translations.zh_definition: 看起来面色苍白、带有病容的人。

collocations.en: to look like someone pale and ill
collocations.zh: 看起来像个面色苍白的病人

collocations.en: a sickly-looking person with a pale face
collocations.zh: 一个脸色苍白、带着病容的人

formal.mt: Il-karattru fir-rakkont huwa kerċuħ b'wiċċ pallidu u ħarsa għajjiena.
formal.en: The character in the story is a sickly-looking person with a pale face and a tired expression.
formal.zh: 故事中的这个人物面色苍白，神情疲惫，显得一脸病容。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Pawlu jidher qisu kerċuħ illum. Maja: Iva, għandu wiċċu pallidu; ejja naraw jekk għandux bżonn l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Toni: Pawlu looks pale and ill today. Maja: Yes, his face is pale; let's see whether he needs help.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：保罗今天看起来脸色苍白，像生病了。玛雅：是啊，他脸色很白；我们去看看他需不需要帮助。

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗今天看起来脸色苍白，像生病了。
messages.en: Pawlu looks pale and ill today.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu wiċċu pallidu; ejja naraw jekk għandux bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu wiċċu pallidu; ejja naraw jekk għandux bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 是啊，他脸色很白；我们去看看他需不需要帮助。
messages.en: Yes, his face is pale; let's see whether he needs help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kerċuħ 贴在故事里脸色苍白的人物画像旁，记住这是指人的名词，描述的是病容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To incite people to act, especially by stirring up conflict or trouble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 煽动或挑唆他人采取行动，尤其指挑起冲突或制造事端。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqanqal lil ħaddieħor biex jaġixxi, speċjalment biex jikkawża ġlied jew inkwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 煽动；唆使；促使他人采取某种行动。
挑起事端；煽动冲突；制造不和。

collocations.en: to stir people up against one another

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif wieħed mill-parteċipanti keskes lill-oħrajn kontra l-organizzaturi.
formal.en: The report explains how one of the participants incited the others against the organisers.
formal.zh: 报告说明了一名参与者如何煽动其他人反对组织者。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex bdew jiġġieldu l-ġirien? David: Xi ħadd keskes lil wieħed kontra l-ieħor b'xi kliem li ma kienx minnu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the neighbours start fighting? David: Someone stirred one up against the other with things that weren't true.
colloquial.zh: Sara：邻居们为什么吵起来了？David：有人说了些不实的话，挑唆他们互相对立。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 邻居们为什么吵起来了？
messages.en: Why did the neighbours start fighting?

messages.speaker: David (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd keskes lil wieħed kontra l-ieħor b'xi kliem li ma kienx minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd keskes lil wieħed kontra l-ieħor b'xi kliem li ma kienx minnu.
messages.zh: 有人说了些不实的话，挑唆他们互相对立。
messages.en: Someone stirred one up against the other with things that weren't true.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人在两个人之间来回传话，把小分歧越挑越大；用这个动作场景记住“挑唆、煽动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who incites others to act, especially someone who stirs up conflict or trouble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 煽动他人采取行动的人，尤其指挑拨关系或挑起事端的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqanqal lil ħaddieħor biex jaġixxi, speċjalment biex jikkawża ġlied jew inkwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 煽动、唆使他人行动的人；挑唆者。

collocations.en: someone who stirs up trouble among the neighbours
collocations.zh: 在邻居之间挑拨是非的人

formal.mt: Il-keskies xerred kliem falz biex iqanqal il-ġlied bejn iż-żewġ gruppi.
formal.en: The instigator spread false statements to provoke conflict between the two groups.
formal.zh: 这名煽动者散布不实言论，企图挑起两个群体之间的冲突。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex dejjem jinqala' l-inkwiet f'dan il-grupp? Karl: Hemm keskies li jgħid affarijiet differenti lil kull wieħed.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why does trouble always break out in this group? Karl: There's an instigator who tells each person different things.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这个群体里为什么总是闹矛盾？Karl：有个挑唆者，对每个人都说不同的话。

messages.speaker: Rita (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dejjem jinqala' l-inkwiet f'dan il-grupp?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dejjem jinqala' l-inkwiet f'dan il-grupp?
