messages.zh: 这个群体里为什么总是闹矛盾？
messages.en: Why does trouble always break out in this group?

messages.speaker: Karl (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm keskies li jgħid affarijiet differenti lil kull wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm keskies li jgħid affarijiet differenti lil kull wieħed.
messages.zh: 有个挑唆者，对每个人都说不同的话。
messages.en: There's an instigator who tells each person different things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“挑唆”这个动作换成镜头中的主角：专门挑起矛盾的那个人，就是这个名词要记的人。

gloss_zh: 攻击、袭击；争抢游戏、撒糖争抢活动；制作库斯库斯的筛子

teaching_sense.en_definition: An attack or a scramble to grab objects; also a game in which children scramble for tossed sweets, or a sieve used in making couscous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指攻击、袭击或争抢物品的活动；也指把糖果抛起让儿童争抢的游戏，另可指制作库斯库斯的一种筛子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attakk jew attività li fiha n-nies jaħtfu oġġetti; ukoll logħba li fiha jintefa' l-ħelu fl-arja biex jiġbruh it-tfal, jew għarbiel biex isir il-kuskus.

sense_translations.en_definition: An attack or assault; muss (a game in which small objects are thrown down to be scrambled for); grab racket
sense_translations.zh_definition: 攻击或袭击；把小物件撒下供人争抢的游戏；争抢物品的喧闹活动。

sense_translations.en_definition: The name of a sort of entertainment consisting of throwing a handful of sweets in the air to see the children scramble for them
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种娱乐活动的名称：把一把糖果抛向空中，让儿童争相捡取。

sense_translations.en_definition: A kind of sieve for making couscous
sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作库斯库斯时使用的一种筛子。

formal.mt: Għall-preparazzjoni tal-kuskus, tintuża keskiesa biex tgħarbel il-qmuħ.
formal.en: When preparing couscous, a keskiesa sieve is used to sift the grains.
formal.zh: 制作库斯库斯时，会用一种称为 keskiesa 的筛子筛理颗粒。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'se nagħmlu għat-tfal fil-festa? Ġanni: Nagħmlu keskiesa bil-ħelu: nitfgħu ftit fl-arja u t-tfal jiġbruh.
colloquial.en: Marta: What shall we organise for the children at the party? Ġanni: Let's have a sweet-tossing game: we'll throw some sweets into the air and the children will pick them up.
colloquial.zh: Marta：聚会上给孩子们安排什么活动？Ġanni：玩撒糖争抢游戏吧：我们把一些糖果抛向空中，让孩子们捡。

messages.speaker: Marta (聚会组织者)
messages.zh: 聚会上给孩子们安排什么活动？
messages.en: What shall we organise for the children at the party?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (聚会志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmlu keskiesa bil-ħelu: nitfgħu ftit fl-arja u t-tfal jiġbruh.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmlu keskiesa bil-ħelu: nitfgħu ftit fl-arja u t-tfal jiġbruh.
messages.zh: 玩撒糖争抢游戏吧：我们把一些糖果抛向空中，让孩子们捡。
messages.en: Let's have a sweet-tossing game: we'll throw some sweets into the air and the children will pick them up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分别画三张记忆卡：冲上去袭击、孩子争抢撒下的糖、厨房筛库斯库斯；按语境选择对应义项，不把它们硬解释成同一来源。

gloss_zh: 能煽动他人的；有挑动作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of inciting others to act or stirring them into conflict or trouble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够煽动他人行动，或能够挑起冲突、事端的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li kapaċi jqanqal lil ħaddieħor biex jaġixxi jew jidħol f'ġlied jew inkwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够煽动、唆使他人行动的；具有挑动作用的。

collocations.en: a speech capable of inciting people
words capable of stirring people up

formal.mt: Id-diskors kien keskiesi u seta' jqanqal lill-udjenza kontra l-grupp l-ieħor.
formal.en: The speech was capable of inciting people and could have stirred the audience against the other group.
formal.zh: 这番讲话具有煽动作用，可能挑动听众反对另一个群体。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex waqqaft dak id-diskors? Simon: Għax kien keskiesi; seta' jqanqal lin-nies biex jiġġieldu.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why did you stop that speech? Simon: Because it was inciting; it could have stirred people up to fight.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你为什么叫停那番讲话？Simon：因为它有煽动作用，可能会挑动人们打起来。

messages.speaker: Elena (活动参与者)
messages.zh: 你为什么叫停那番讲话？
messages.en: Why did you stop that speech?

messages.speaker: Simon (活动主持人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien keskiesi; seta' jqanqal lin-nies biex jiġġieldu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien keskiesi; seta' jqanqal lin-nies biex jiġġieldu.
messages.zh: 因为它有煽动作用，可能会挑动人们打起来。
messages.en: Because it was inciting; it could have stirred people up to fight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句话像火星一样能点燃争执；这个形容词描述话语具有煽动能力，重点记住“能挑动别人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To observe and assess someone before attacking them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在攻击某人之前先观察、判断对方，摸清其情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Josserva u jeżamina lil xi ħadd qabel jattakkah.

sense_translations.en_definition: to study sb. before attacking them
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在发动攻击前观察、研究某人，摸清对方的情况。

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-ġellied kess lill-avversarju tiegħu qabel beda l-attakk.
formal.en: In the story, the fighter studied his opponent before beginning the attack.
formal.zh: 故事中，战士在开始攻击前先观察了对手。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ġellied dam iħares lejn l-ieħor? Toni: Kess lill-avversarju qabel attakkah.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the fighter spend so long looking at the other man? Toni: He was studying his opponent before attacking him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个战士为什么盯着另一个人看了那么久？托尼：他在攻击前先摸清对手。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ġellied dam iħares lejn l-ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ġellied dam iħares lejn l-ieħor?
messages.zh: 那个战士为什么盯着另一个人看了那么久？
messages.en: Why did the fighter spend so long looking at the other man?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 他在攻击前先摸清对手。
messages.en: He was studying his opponent before attacking him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把情景记成“先观察对手，再发动攻击”；这个词的观察带有攻击前摸底的目的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something cold or lower its temperature.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物温度降低，让它冷却或变冷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa kiesħa jew inaqqsilha t-temperatura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物冷却、变凉或冰凉。
使某物变冷。

formal.mt: Il-persunal kessaħ l-ilma qabel servieh lill-mistednin.
formal.en: The staff chilled the water before serving it to the guests.
formal.zh: 工作人员先把水冷却，再端给客人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min kessaħ il-meraq? Mark: Jien. Poġġejtu fil-friġġ qabel wasalt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who chilled the juice? Mark: I did. I put it in the fridge before you arrived.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：谁把果汁冰凉了？马克：我呀。你来之前我把它放进冰箱了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把果汁冰凉了？
messages.en: Who chilled the juice?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我呀。你来之前我把它放进冰箱了。
messages.en: I did. I put it in the fridge before you arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一杯温水放进冰箱：动作是“使它变冷”，记住这是让温度下降的动词。

gloss_zh: 覆盖者；做覆盖工作的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who covers something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用某种材料把物体盖住、覆上的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħatti xi ħaġa b'xi materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某物加上覆盖物的人；覆盖者。

collocations.en: the work of the person doing the covering

formal.mt: Il-kessej tas-soqfa għatta s-saqaf b'materjal li ma jgħaddix ilma minnu.
formal.en: The roof-covering worker covered the roof with waterproof material.
formal.zh: 屋顶覆盖作业人员用防水材料覆盖了屋顶。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jgħatti s-saqaf? Pawlu: Il-kessej jasal għada filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is going to cover the roof? Pawlu: The worker doing the covering will arrive tomorrow morning.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁来给屋顶铺覆盖层？保罗：做覆盖工作的师傅明天早上到。

messages.speaker: Nina (房主)
messages.zh: 谁来给屋顶铺覆盖层？
messages.en: Who is going to cover the roof?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (施工负责人)
messages.zh: 做覆盖工作的师傅明天早上到。
messages.en: The worker doing the covering will arrive tomorrow morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中画一位正在铺覆盖材料的工人：这个名词指“做覆盖的人”，用人物画面来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container used to cool its contents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于给其中物品降温、使其冷却的容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jintuża biex ikessaħ dak li jitqiegħed fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于冷却物品的容器。

collocations.en: put the drinks in the cooling container

formal.mt: Il-persunal poġġa l-fliexken fil-kessieħ biex ix-xorb jiksaħ qabel l-ikla.
formal.en: The staff placed the bottles in the cooling container so that the drinks would cool before the meal.
formal.zh: 工作人员把瓶子放入冷却容器，让饮料在用餐前凉下来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-fliexken? Toni: Fil-kessieħ, ħdejn il-flixkun tal-ilma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where should I put these bottles? Toni: In the cooling container, next to the water bottle.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些瓶子放哪儿？托尼：放进冷却容器，挨着那瓶水。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些瓶子放哪儿？
messages.en: Where should I put these bottles?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 放进冷却容器，挨着那瓶水。
messages.en: In the cooling container, next to the water bottle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个装着饮料瓶、用来降温的容器；把“容器”这个具体形象和词义绑在一起。

gloss_zh: 能冷却的；有降温作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the ability to cool something or lower its temperature.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使某物冷却、降低其温度的能力或作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila li jkessaħ xi ħaġa jew inaqqsilha t-temperatura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有冷却能力的；能够起降温作用的。

formal.mt: L-apparat kessieħi jnaqqas it-temperatura tal-ilma waqt l-esperiment.
formal.en: The cooling equipment lowers the water temperature during the experiment.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，具有冷却能力的设备会降低水温。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan l-apparat isaħħan l-ilma? Lara: Le, huwa apparat kessieħi; jagħmel l-ilma iktar kiesaħ.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this device heat the water? Lara: No, it is a cooling device; it makes the water colder.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个设备给水加热吗？劳拉：不，它有冷却功能，会让水变得更冷。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 这个设备给水加热吗？
messages.en: Does this device heat the water?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa apparat kessieħi; jagħmel l-ilma iktar kiesaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa apparat kessieħi; jagħmel l-ilma iktar kiesaħ.
messages.zh: 不，它有冷却功能，会让水变得更冷。
messages.en: No, it is a cooling device; it makes the water colder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在设备旁贴一张“能降温”的标签来记：这个形容词说明具有冷却能力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cold or chilly weather, or the cold felt in such weather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寒冷或凉飕飕的天气，也指这种天气带来的冷意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Temp b'temperatura baxxa, jew is-sensazzjoni ta' bard li jinħass f'dan it-temp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寒冷；冷飕飕的天气。

formal.mt: Minħabba l-kesħa, l-attivitajiet tat-tfal se jsiru ġewwa.
formal.en: Because of the cold weather, the children's activities will take place indoors.
formal.zh: 由于天气寒冷，儿童活动将在室内举行。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'kesħa hawn barra! Ġużeppi: Ejja nidħlu ġewwa u nagħmlu ftit te.
colloquial.en: Anna: It's so cold out here! Ġużeppi: Let's go inside and make some tea.
colloquial.zh: Anna：外面真冷啊！Ġużeppi：我们进去泡点茶吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 外面真冷啊！
messages.en: It's so cold out here!

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nidħlu ġewwa u nagħmlu ftit te.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nidħlu ġewwa u nagħmlu ftit te.
messages.zh: 我们进去泡点茶吧。
messages.en: Let's go inside and make some tea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和出门缩脖子、回屋喝热茶的画面连起来，记住它是表示寒冷天气的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To invent excuses in order to avoid doing one's work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为了逃避自己应做的工作而编造借口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jivvinta skużi biex jevita li jagħmel ix-xogħol tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make up excuses to avoid doing one's work
sense_translations.zh_definition: 编造借口，以逃避自己应做的工作。

collocations.en: made up excuses to avoid working
invented excuses to get out of the work

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-impjegat ketlet biex jevita x-xogħol li kien ingħata.
formal.en: In the account, the employee invented excuses to avoid the work he had been assigned.
formal.zh: 叙述中，那名雇员编造借口，逃避分配给他的工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għenkom tnaddfu? Toni: Le, reġa' ketlet biex ma jaħdimx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu help you clean up? Toni: No, he made up excuses again to avoid working.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗帮你们打扫了吗？托尼：没有，他又编借口不干活。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 保罗帮你们打扫了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu help you clean up?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, reġa' ketlet biex ma jaħdimx.
messages.mt_standard: Le, reġa' ketlet biex ma jaħdimx.
messages.zh: 没有，他又编借口不干活。
messages.en: No, he made up excuses again to avoid working.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“轮到干活，借口就来了”的小场景；词义同时包含编借口和逃避工作。

gloss_zh: 微不足道的小东西；紧得难受的衣服

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something small and insignificant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 很小而且不重要、微不足道的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa żgħira u bla importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微小且无足轻重的东西。

sense_translations.en_definition: a very tight-fitting and uncomfortable garment
sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿起来非常紧身、令人不舒服的衣服。

collocations.zh: 一件无足轻重的小东西
穿着一件紧得难受的衣服

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-kamra, l-awtur isemmi kettufa bla importanza li kienet fuq l-ixkaffa.
formal.en: In the description of the room, the author mentions an insignificant little object that was on the shelf.
formal.zh: 作者描写房间时，提到了架子上一件微不足道的小东西。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex trid tibdel il-flokk? Mark: Dan il-flokk sar kettufa; tant hu ssikkat li ma nistax niċċaqlaq sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you want to change your shirt? Mark: This shirt has become uncomfortably tight; it is so tight that I cannot move properly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么想换件上衣？马克：这件上衣已经紧得难受了，紧得我都活动不开。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么想换件上衣？
messages.en: Why do you want to change your shirt?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-flokk sar kettufa; tant hu ssikkat li ma nistax niċċaqlaq sew.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-flokk sar kettufa; tant hu ssikkat li ma nistax niċċaqlaq sew.
messages.zh: 这件上衣已经紧得难受了，紧得我都活动不开。
messages.en: This shirt has become uncomfortably tight; it is so tight that I cannot move properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张独立画面记两个义项：架上不起眼的小东西，以及穿上后紧得活动不开的衣服。

gloss_zh: 加热至高温；烧至白热；烙印；烧灼止血

teaching_sense.en_definition: To heat something to a very high temperature, burn white hot, brand, or cauterise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物加热到很高的温度、烧至白热，或进行烙印、烧灼处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isaħħan xi ħaġa ħafna, jaħraq sa ma jsir abjad bis-sħana, jagħmel marka b'ħadida taħraq, jew jaħraq tessut biex iwaqqaf il-fsada.

sense_translations.en_definition: to heat up to a high temperature
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物加热到很高的温度。
烧至白热状态；因高温而发出白光。
用烧热的烙具打上印记；烙印。
烧灼组织或伤口，以止血等。

collocations.en: heated the iron to a high temperature
branded a mark into the wood

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, il-ħaddiem kewa l-ħadid sa temperatura għolja qabel tah il-forma mixtieqa.
formal.en: According to the report, the worker heated the iron to a high temperature before shaping it as required.
formal.zh: 报告记载，工人先把铁加热到高温，再将其加工成所需形状。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif għamel dik il-marka fuq il-kaxxa? Pawlu: Kewa marka fl-injam b'ħadida taħraq.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did he make that mark on the box? Pawlu: He branded a mark into the wood with a hot iron.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他怎么在箱子上弄出那个印记的？保罗：他用烧热的铁器在木头上烙了个印记。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għamel dik il-marka fuq il-kaxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għamel dik il-marka fuq il-kaxxa?
messages.zh: 他怎么在箱子上弄出那个印记的？
messages.en: How did he make that mark on the box?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工匠)
messages.zh: 他用烧热的铁器在木头上烙了个印记。
messages.en: He branded a mark into the wood with a hot iron.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“高热”串起四幅学习画面：加热金属、烧到白亮、烙下印记、医疗烧灼；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A meteor seen as a brief streak of light across the night sky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 夜空中短暂划过、呈现一道亮光的流星。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meteor li jidher bħala linja ta' dawl li tgħaddi malajr fis-sema bil-lejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流星；划过天空的短暂亮光。

collocations.en: a shooting star in the sky

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tas-sema, l-istudenti raw kewkba feġġa tgħaddi malajr.
formal.en: During their observation of the sky, the students saw a shooting star pass swiftly overhead.
formal.zh: 观察天空时，学生们看见一颗流星迅速划过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt dik il-kewkba feġġa? — Lara: Iva! Għaddiet tant malajr li bilkemm stajt naraha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see that shooting star? — Lara: Yes! It passed so quickly that I could barely see it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见刚才那颗流星了吗？——拉拉：看见了！它划得太快，我差点没看清。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见刚才那颗流星了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that shooting star?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Għaddiet tant malajr li bilkemm stajt naraha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Għaddiet tant malajr li bilkemm stajt naraha.
messages.zh: 看见了！它划得太快，我差点没看清。
messages.en: Yes! It passed so quickly that I could barely see it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组和夜空中一闪而过的亮线联想起来，记作“流星”，并与停留在原处的星星区分。

gloss_zh: 繁星密布的；布满星星的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Covered or scattered with stars, especially describing the night sky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布满或散布着星星的，尤其用于描写夜空。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mimli kwiekeb jew bi kwiekeb imxerrdin fih, speċjalment meta jingħad għas-sema bil-lejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 繁星密布的；星星散布其间的。

formal.mt: Il-poeta jiddeskrivi sema kewkbi li jixħet dawl ħafif fuq il-baħar.
formal.en: The poet describes a star-strewn sky casting a faint light over the sea.
formal.zh: 诗人描写了繁星密布的天空，微弱的星光洒在海面上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħares 'il fuq, kemm hu sabiħ dan is-sema kewkbi! — Maja: Iva, ejja nibqgħu hawn ftit u nħarsu lejn il-kwiekeb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look up, how beautiful this star-strewn sky is! — Maja: Yes, let's stay here a little and look at the stars.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：抬头看，这片繁星密布的天空多美啊！——玛雅：是啊，我们在这里待一会儿，看看星星吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares 'il fuq, kemm hu sabiħ dan is-sema kewkbi!
messages.mt_standard: Ħares 'il fuq, kemm hu sabiħ dan is-sema kewkbi!
messages.zh: 抬头看，这片繁星密布的天空多美啊！
messages.en: Look up, how beautiful this star-strewn sky is!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nibqgħu hawn ftit u nħarsu lejn il-kwiekeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nibqgħu hawn ftit u nħarsu lejn il-kwiekeb.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们在这里待一会儿，看看星星吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's stay here a little and look at the stars.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张撒满亮点的深蓝色画布，用 kewkbi 描述它“繁星密布”的状态，记住这是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become filled or scattered with stars.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得布满星星，呈现繁星散布的景象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir mimli kwiekeb jew jibdew jidhru ħafna kwiekeb fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得繁星密布；开始呈现布满星星的景象。

collocations.en: the sky became strewn with stars
became strewn with stars after sunset

formal.mt: Meta dalam u għadda s-sħab, is-sema kewkeb fuq ir-raħal.
formal.en: When darkness fell and the clouds passed, the sky above the village became strewn with stars.
formal.zh: 夜幕降临、云层散去后，村庄上空变得繁星密布。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kif kewkeb is-sema! — Lara: Iva, ftit ilu kien għad hemm ħafna sħab.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how the sky has filled with stars! — Lara: Yes, a little while ago there were still lots of clouds.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，天空已经满是星星了！——拉拉：是啊，刚才还满是云呢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，天空已经满是星星了！
messages.en: Look how the sky has filled with stars!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit ilu kien għad hemm ħafna sħab.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit ilu kien għad hemm ħafna sħab.
messages.zh: 是啊，刚才还满是云呢。
messages.en: Yes, a little while ago there were still lots of clouds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kewkeb 记成一段天空逐渐亮起星点的动画，重点是“变得”，与 kewkbi 描述已有状态相区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make excuses for something, often to avoid a task or responsibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某事找借口，常用于逃避任务或责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib skużi għal xi ħaġa, spiss biex jevita xogħol jew responsabbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 找借口；以各种理由推托。

collocations.en: made excuses to avoid the work

formal.mt: Meta ntalab jispjega għaliex ma lestiex ir-rapport, l-impjegat kewtel minflok ta tweġiba ċara.
formal.en: When asked to explain why he had not finished the report, the employee made excuses instead of giving a clear answer.
formal.zh: 被要求解释为何没有完成报告时，这名员工找起了借口，没有给出明确答复。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark ma ġiex jgħinna? — Maja: Kewtel u qal li kellu wisq x'jagħmel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't Mark come to help us? — Maja: He made excuses and said he had too much to do.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么没来帮我们？——玛雅：他找了借口，说自己有太多事情要做。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么没来帮我们？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark come to help us?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kewtel u qal li kellu wisq x'jagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Kewtel u qal li kellu wisq x'jagħmel.
messages.zh: 他找了借口，说自己有太多事情要做。
messages.en: He made excuses and said he had too much to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人面对未完成的任务接连说出理由，把 kewtel 与“找借口、推托”的动作连在一起记。

gloss_zh: 爱挑小毛病的；爱提琐碎异议的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who raises objections about small or unimportant details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人总对细小或不重要的事情提出异议、挑毛病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal xi ħadd li joġġezzjona għal dettalji żgħar jew affarijiet bla importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容爱提出琐碎异议、专挑小毛病的人。

collocations.en: a person who raises trivial objections

formal.mt: Il-kumitat tilef ħafna ħin għax membru kewtieli baqa' joġġezzjona għal dettalji bla importanza.
formal.en: The committee lost a great deal of time because a nitpicking member kept objecting to unimportant details.
formal.zh: 委员会浪费了大量时间，因为一位爱挑小毛病的成员不断对无关紧要的细节提出异议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark reġa' lmenta dwar il-kulur tat-titlu. — Lara: Kemm hu kewtieli! Għadna lanqas bdejna niddiskutu l-kontenut.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark complained about the title's colour again. — Lara: He's such a nitpicker! We haven't even started discussing the content yet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克又抱怨标题的颜色了。——拉拉：他可真爱挑小毛病！我们连内容都还没开始讨论呢。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark reġa' lmenta dwar il-kulur tat-titlu.
messages.mt_standard: Mark reġa' lmenta dwar il-kulur tat-titlu.
messages.zh: 马克又抱怨标题的颜色了。
messages.en: Mark complained about the title's colour again.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu kewtieli! Għadna lanqas bdejna niddiskutu l-kontenut.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu kewtieli! Għadna lanqas bdejna niddiskutu l-kontenut.
messages.zh: 他可真爱挑小毛病！我们连内容都还没开始讨论呢。
messages.en: He's such a nitpicker! We haven't even started discussing the content yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象开会时有人只盯着标题颜色反复反对，用 kewtieli 形容这种爱挑琐碎毛病的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who applies brands or carries out cauterisation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给对象烙上印记，或执行烧灼操作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel marki bil-ħadid jaħraq jew twettaq kawterizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 施烙印或执行烧灼操作的人。

collocations.zh: 技艺熟练的施烙印者或施烧灼者
施烙印者或施烧灼者的工具

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-kewwej huwa l-persuna responsabbli biex tagħmel il-marki bil-ħadid jaħraq.
formal.en: In the text, the brander is the person responsible for making marks with a heated iron.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，施烙印者是负责用烧热的烙铁制作印记的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser kewwej f'din l-istorja? — Maja: Hawnhekk ifisser il-persuna li tagħmel il-marki bil-ħadid jaħraq.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does kewwej mean in this story? — Maja: Here it means the person who makes marks with a heated iron.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个故事里的 kewwej 是什么意思？——玛雅：这里指用烧热的烙铁制作印记的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 kewwej 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does kewwej mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Maja (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ifisser il-persuna li tagħmel il-marki bil-ħadid jaħraq.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ifisser il-persuna li tagħmel il-marki bil-ħadid jaħraq.
messages.zh: 这里指用烧热的烙铁制作印记的人。
messages.en: Here it means the person who makes marks with a heated iron.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kewwej 和手持烙铁的操作者形象关联，记住它指执行烙印或烧灼的人，而不是工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause something to exist or bring it into being.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物产生，使其从尚不存在变为存在。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib xi ħaġa fl-eżistenza jew jagħmel li tibda teżisti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使产生；使存在；创造出。

collocations.en: brought a new world into being

formal.mt: Permezz tal-immaġinazzjoni tiegħu, l-awtur kewwen dinja ġdida b'liġijiet u drawwiet tagħha.
formal.en: Through his imagination, the author brought a new world into being, with its own laws and customs.
formal.zh: 作者凭借想象力创造出一个新世界，其中有它自己的法律和习俗。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser li l-awtur kewwen dinja? — Maja: Ifisser li ħalaqha fl-immaġinazzjoni tiegħu u taha ħajja fil-kitba.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does it mean that the author brought a world into being? — Maja: It means he created it in his imagination and gave it life in his writing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：说作者创造出了一个世界，是什么意思？——玛雅：意思是他在想象中创造了它，并通过文字赋予它生命。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li l-awtur kewwen dinja?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li l-awtur kewwen dinja?
messages.zh: 说作者创造出了一个世界，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that the author brought a world into being?

messages.speaker: Maja (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li ħalaqha fl-immaġinazzjoni tiegħu u taha ħajja fil-kitba.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li ħalaqha fl-immaġinazzjoni tiegħu u taha ħajja fil-kitba.
messages.zh: 意思是他在想象中创造了它，并通过文字赋予它生命。
messages.en: It means he created it in his imagination and gave it life in his writing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象作者在空白纸上写出一个原本不存在的世界，把 kewwen 记作“使某物从无到有”。

gloss_zh: 倒液者；分注或滗液的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who pours liquids or transfers them carefully from one container to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责倾倒液体，或将液体从一个容器小心倒入另一个容器的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tferra' likwidi jew tgħaddihom bil-galbu minn reċipjent għal ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who pours or decants liquids
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾倒液体的人；把液体分注或滗入另一容器的人。

collocations.en: a person who pours or decants wine

formal.mt: Waqt l-ikla, il-kewwies tal-inbid mela t-tazzi tal-mistednin bil-galbu.
formal.en: During the meal, the wine pourer carefully filled the guests' glasses.
formal.zh: 用餐期间，负责斟酒的人小心地为宾客们倒满酒杯。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jkun il-kewwies tal-inbid illejla? — Mark: Jien; int tista' tqassam it-tazzi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will pour the wine tonight? — Mark: I will; you can hand out the glasses.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今晚谁来负责斟酒？——马克：我来，你可以分发杯子。

messages.speaker: Maja (聚餐组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun il-kewwies tal-inbid illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun il-kewwies tal-inbid illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚谁来负责斟酒？
messages.en: Who will pour the wine tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我来，你可以分发杯子。
messages.en: I will; you can hand out the glasses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚餐时一人拿瓶斟酒、另一人递杯，把 kewwies 对应到负责倒液体的那个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Careful with money and resources, avoiding unnecessary spending or waste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用金钱和资源时精打细算，避免不必要的开支或浪费的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juża l-flus u r-riżorsi bil-għaqal u jevita nfiq jew ħela bla bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 节俭的；善于节省、不随意浪费的。

collocations.zh: 一个精打细算的购物者

formal.mt: Xerrej kewwiesi jqabbel il-prezzijiet u jixtri biss dak li għandu bżonn.
formal.en: A thrifty shopper compares prices and buys only what he needs.
formal.zh: 精打细算的购物者会比较价格，只购买自己需要的东西。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex iżżomm dawn il-vażetti? Pawlu: Għax jien kewwiesi; nista' nerġa' nużahom minflok nixtri oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you keep these jars? Pawlu: Because I'm thrifty; I can reuse them instead of buying new ones.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么留着这些罐子？保罗：因为我很节俭；我可以重复使用它们，省得再买。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么留着这些罐子？
messages.en: Why do you keep these jars?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jien kewwiesi; nista' nerġa' nużahom minflok nixtri oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jien kewwiesi; nista' nerġa' nużahom minflok nixtri oħrajn.
messages.zh: 因为我很节俭；我可以重复使用它们，省得再买。
messages.en: Because I'm thrifty; I can reuse them instead of buying new ones.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kewwiesi 和重复使用玻璃罐的画面相连：东西还能用，就精打细算地留下来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing great fear, horror, or shock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引起强烈恐惧、惊骇或震惊的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqajjem biża' kbira, terrur jew xokk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恐怖的；令人惊骇、胆战心惊的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jagħti rakkont kexkiexi ta' dak li ġara matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The report gives a horrific account of what happened during the night.
formal.zh: 报告对夜间发生的事情作了令人惊骇的叙述。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien il-film? Mark: Kien kexkiexi! Għalaqt għajnejja f'xi xeni.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was the film like? Mark: It was horrific! I closed my eyes during some scenes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：电影怎么样？马克：太恐怖了！有些场景我都闭上眼睛了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影怎么样？
messages.en: What was the film like?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien kexkiexi! Għalaqt għajnejja f'xi xeni.
messages.mt_standard: Kien kexkiexi! Għalaqt għajnejja f'xi xeni.
messages.zh: 太恐怖了！有些场景我都闭上眼睛了。
messages.en: It was horrific! I closed my eyes during some scenes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kexkiexi 时想象看电影吓得闭眼的画面，用强烈恐惧感记住“令人惊骇的”。

gloss_zh: 翻找；为寻找某物而翻 rummage

teaching_sense.en_definition: To search for something by moving and looking through the contents of a place or container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为寻找某物而拨动、翻动某处或容器中的物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifittex xi ħaġa billi jqalleb l-oġġetti f'post jew f'kontenitur.

sense_translations.en_definition: to rummage in search of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为了寻找某物而翻找、翻动物品。

formal.mt: L-istudent kexwex fil-borża biex isib in-noti tal-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The student rummaged through his bag to find the lesson notes.
formal.zh: 学生在包里翻找，想找到课堂笔记。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sibt iċ-ċavetta? Mark: Pawlu kexwex fil-kexxun u sabha taħt il-karti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you find the key? Mark: Pawlu rummaged through the drawer and found it under the papers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们在哪里找到钥匙的？马克：保罗翻了抽屉，在纸张下面找到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你们在哪里找到钥匙的？
messages.en: Where did you find the key?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu kexwex fil-kexxun u sabha taħt il-karti.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu kexwex fil-kexxun u sabha taħt il-karti.
messages.zh: 保罗翻了抽屉，在纸张下面找到了。
messages.en: Pawlu rummaged through the drawer and found it under the papers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kexwex 记成找钥匙时翻动抽屉的动作：既在寻找，又把里面的东西翻来翻去。

gloss_zh: 含糊地说话；口齿不清地说

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak unclearly, so that the words are difficult to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话含糊、发音不清，使别人难以听懂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem b'mod mhux ċar, hekk li jkun diffiċli tifhem kliemu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含糊不清地说话，使话语难以辨清。

collocations.en: he spoke indistinctly because of tiredness

collocations.zh: 他回答时说得含糊不清

formal.mt: Ix-xhud keċwen waqt it-tweġiba, u l-imħallef talbu jirrepeti kliemu b'mod aktar ċar.
formal.en: The witness spoke indistinctly while answering, and the judge asked him to repeat his words more clearly.
formal.zh: 证人回答时口齿不清，法官请他更清楚地重复一遍。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu keċwen u ma fhimtx x'qal. Ben: Staqsih jerġa' jgħidlek, għax forsi kien għajjien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Pawlu mumbled, and I didn't understand what he said. Ben: Ask him to say it again; perhaps he was tired.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗说得含含糊糊，我没听懂他说了什么。本：请他再说一遍吧，他可能累了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu keċwen u ma fhimtx x'qal.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu keċwen u ma fhimtx x'qal.
messages.zh: 保罗说得含含糊糊，我没听懂他说了什么。
messages.en: Pawlu mumbled, and I didn't understand what he said.

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsih jerġa' jgħidlek, għax forsi kien għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsih jerġa' jgħidlek, għax forsi kien għajjien.
messages.zh: 请他再说一遍吧，他可能累了。
messages.en: Ask him to say it again; perhaps he was tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句话的字音都蒙上雾，听者只好请对方重说：keċwen 的重点是说不清。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who drives or sends someone else away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把别人赶走、逐离某处的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkeċċi lil ħaddieħor jew iġġiegħlu jitlaq minn post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把他人赶走或驱逐出去的人。

collocations.en: a person who drives outsiders away
a person who drives guests away

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-keċċej ma jħalli lil ħadd jibqa' fil-bitħa u jordna lil kulħadd jitlaq.
formal.en: In the story, the person driving people away lets nobody remain in the courtyard and orders everyone to leave.
formal.zh: 故事中的驱赶者不准任何人留在院子里，命令所有人离开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed isejħu lil Toni keċċej tal-mistednin? Lara: Għax kull darba li jiġu l-ħbieb, jgħidilhom jitilqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are they calling Toni someone who drives guests away? Lara: Because whenever friends come over, he tells them to leave.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们为什么说托尼是个赶客的人？劳拉：因为朋友们每次过来，他都叫他们离开。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed isejħu lil Toni keċċej tal-mistednin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed isejħu lil Toni keċċej tal-mistednin?
messages.zh: 他们为什么说托尼是个赶客的人？
messages.en: Why are they calling Toni someone who drives guests away?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kull darba li jiġu l-ħbieb, jgħidilhom jitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kull darba li jiġu l-ħbieb, jgħidilhom jitilqu.
messages.zh: 因为朋友们每次过来，他都叫他们离开。
messages.en: Because whenever friends come over, he tells them to leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门口有人挥手喊离开，再把人物标成 keċċej：记住它指赶人的那个人。

gloss_zh: 亵渎神圣的言语；淫秽言语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Language that is blasphemous or obscene.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 亵渎神圣事物或内容淫秽的言语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem li joffendi dak li hu sagru jew li jkun oxxen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亵渎神圣的言语；冒犯神明或神圣事物的话。
淫秽言语；内容下流、不雅的话。

collocations.zh: 亵渎性言语和淫秽话语

formal.mt: Ir-regoli tal-laqgħa jipprojbixxu l-kfir u kull kliem li joffendi lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The meeting rules prohibit blasphemous or obscene language and any words that offend participants.
formal.zh: 会议规则禁止亵渎性或淫秽言语，以及任何冒犯与会者的话。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex waqqaft il-filmat? Pawlu: Għax fih ħafna kfir, u hawn it-tfal.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you stop the video? Pawlu: Because it contains a lot of blasphemous or obscene language, and the children are here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把视频停了？保罗：因为里面有很多亵渎性或淫秽的话，孩子们又在这里。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 你为什么把视频停了？
messages.en: Why did you stop the video?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fih ħafna kfir, u hawn it-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Għax fih ħafna kfir, u hawn it-tfal.
messages.zh: 因为里面有很多亵渎性或淫秽的话，孩子们又在这里。
messages.en: Because it contains a lot of blasphemous or obscene language, and the children are here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kfir 放进“需要停止播放的不雅言语”这个场景，分别记住亵渎神圣和淫秽两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The obscuring of something from view or the effacement of its visible marks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物被遮蔽，或使其可见痕迹被抹除的过程或结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħabi ta' xi ħaġa mid-dehra jew it-tħassir tal-marki viżibbli tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遮蔽；使某物被掩盖而不再显露。
抹除；使文字、标记或其他可见痕迹消失。

formal.mt: Il-kfis tal-kitba fuq il-ġebla jagħmilha diffiċli biex tinqara d-data.
formal.en: The effacement of the writing on the stone makes the date difficult to read.
formal.zh: 石头上的文字被抹除，使日期难以辨认。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistax naqra l-isem? Mark: Minħabba l-kfis tal-ittri; baqa' biss ftit marki.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't I read the name? Mark: Because of the effacement of the letters; only a few marks remain.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我怎么读不出这个名字？马克：因为字母被抹除了，只剩下一点痕迹。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 我怎么读不出这个名字？
messages.en: Why can't I read the name?

messages.speaker: Mark (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-kfis tal-ittri; baqa' biss ftit marki.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-kfis tal-ittri; baqa' biss ftit marki.
messages.zh: 因为字母被抹除了，只剩下一点痕迹。
messages.en: Because of the effacement of the letters; only a few marks remain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅图记 kfis：一幅是光被遮住，一幅是字被擦去，分别对应“遮蔽”和“抹除”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, ring-shaped sweet pastry; the diminutive form of kagħka.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种小型环状甜糕点；该词是 kagħka 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaġina ħelwa żgħira f'forma ta' ċirku; il-forma diminuttiva ta' kagħka.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small sweet pastry in the shape of a ring (the diminutive form of 'kagħka')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种小型环状甜糕点；是 kagħka 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small ring pastry with coffee
collocations.zh: 配咖啡吃的小环形糕点

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla, kull mistieden ingħata kgħajka ħelwa ma' tazza kafè.
formal.en: After the meal, each guest was given a small sweet ring pastry with a cup of coffee.
formal.zh: 饭后，每位客人都得到一个小环形甜糕点和一杯咖啡。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nixtieq kgħajka u kafè, jekk jogħġbok. Rita: Żgur. Trid il-kafè bil-ħalib?
colloquial.en: Mark: I'd like a small ring pastry and a coffee, please. Rita: Certainly. Would you like milk in the coffee?
colloquial.zh: 马克：请给我一个小环形甜糕点和一杯咖啡。丽塔：好的。咖啡要加牛奶吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq kgħajka u kafè, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq kgħajka u kafè, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我一个小环形甜糕点和一杯咖啡。
messages.en: I'd like a small ring pastry and a coffee, please.

messages.speaker: Rita (咖啡店店员)
messages.zh: 好的。咖啡要加牛奶吗？
messages.en: Certainly. Would you like milk in the coffee?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象咖啡杯旁一个小小的甜糕点圈，用“小、甜、环形”三个特点一起记住 kgħajka。

gloss_zh: 燃起火焰；因某事激动起来

teaching_sense.en_definition: To catch fire and begin to burn, or to become emotionally worked up about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始燃烧、冒出火焰；也指因某事而情绪激动起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu n-nar u jibda jaqbad, jew jitqanqal ħafna minħabba xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被引燃；开始燃起火焰。

sense_translations.en_definition: to get worked up about sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因某事激动起来；因某事变得情绪激昂。

collocations.en: got worked up about the issue

formal.mt: L-injam niexef kibes malajr, u l-fjammi bdew jinfirxu.
formal.en: The dry wood caught fire quickly, and the flames began to spread.
formal.zh: 干木头很快燃起，火焰开始蔓延。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark kibes daqshekk fuq il-kwistjoni? Ben: Għax ħaseb li ħadd ma kien qed jisimgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark get so worked up about the issue? Ben: Because he thought nobody was listening to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么对这件事这么激动？本：因为他觉得没人听他说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark kibes daqshekk fuq il-kwistjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark kibes daqshekk fuq il-kwistjoni?
messages.zh: 马克为什么对这件事这么激动？
messages.en: Why did Mark get so worked up about the issue?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħaseb li ħadd ma kien qed jisimgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħaseb li ħadd ma kien qed jisimgħu.
messages.zh: 因为他觉得没人听他说话。
messages.en: Because he thought nobody was listening to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“木头燃起来”和“情绪燃起来”两个画面并记两义；这是帮助理解的教学联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of melancholy or distress, including sorrowful longing that wears a person down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 忧郁、愁苦的状态，也可指因深切思念而日渐憔悴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' swied il-qalb jew niket, li jista' jinkludi tbatija kbira minħabba x-xewqa għal xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忧郁；低沉而带愁绪的心境。
愁苦；内心的痛苦或悲苦。
因强烈思念或渴望而日渐消瘦、憔悴。

formal.mt: Fil-poeżija, il-kibi tal-kelliem jikxef kemm iħoss in-nuqqas ta' daru.
formal.en: In the poem, the speaker's melancholy reveals how deeply he misses his home.
formal.zh: 诗中，抒情者的忧郁流露出他对家乡深切的思念。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-kanzunetta tagħtini sens ta' kibi. Luqa: Lili wkoll; tfakkarni fi żmien meta kont 'il bogħod minn dari.
colloquial.en: Sara: This song gives me a feeling of melancholy. Luqa: Me too; it reminds me of a time when I was far from home.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这首歌让我有种忧郁的感觉。卢卡：我也是；它让我想起远离家乡的那段日子。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kanzunetta tagħtini sens ta' kibi.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kanzunetta tagħtini sens ta' kibi.
messages.zh: 这首歌让我有种忧郁的感觉。
messages.en: This song gives me a feeling of melancholy.

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lili wkoll; tfakkarni fi żmien meta kont 'il bogħod minn dari.
messages.mt_standard: Lili wkoll; tfakkarni fi żmien meta kont 'il bogħod minn dari.
messages.zh: 我也是；它让我想起远离家乡的那段日子。
messages.en: Me too; it reminds me of a time when I was far from home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象远行者听着旧歌，先忧郁、再愁苦，甚至因思念而憔悴；把三义都归入内心状态这个名词框架。

gloss_zh: 苦苦思念；怀旧；感到忧郁

teaching_sense.en_definition: To long sadly for something, feel nostalgia, or experience melancholy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带着悲伤渴念某物，也指产生怀旧之情或感到忧郁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss xewqa mnikkta għal xi ħaġa, nostalġija, jew swied il-qalb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苦苦思念某物；因渴望某物而忧伤。
产生怀旧之情；怀念过去的人、事或时光。
感到忧郁；陷入低沉愁绪。

formal.mt: Matul is-snin li għex barra minn Malta, l-awtur kieb għal daru u għall-ħajja ta' qabel.
formal.en: During the years he lived outside Malta, the author pined for his home and his former life.
formal.zh: 在旅居马耳他以外的那些年里，这位作家深切怀念自己的家和从前的生活。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Pawlu kieb għal daru meta kien barra? Ben: Iva, kien iċempel lill-familja tiegħu kuljum.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did Pawlu pine for home when he was abroad? Ben: Yes, he used to call his family every day.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：保罗在国外时很想家吗？本：是啊，他那时每天都给家里打电话。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu kieb għal daru meta kien barra?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu kieb għal daru meta kien barra?
messages.zh: 保罗在国外时很想家吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu pine for home when he was abroad?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien iċempel lill-familja tiegħu kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien iċempel lill-familja tiegħu kuljum.
messages.zh: 是啊，他那时每天都给家里打电话。
messages.en: Yes, he used to call his family every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看旧照片时“想念家乡、怀念童年、心生忧郁”，用这三个正在发生的心理活动记住它是动词。

gloss_zh: 含泪伤感的；悲伤的；忧郁的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tearful, sad, or marked by a quiet feeling of melancholy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带着泪意、悲伤或忧郁的，可形容人及其神态、声音等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri dmugħ, niket jew swied il-qalb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含泪伤感的；容易落泪的。
悲伤的；难过的。
忧郁的；带有低沉愁绪的。

formal.mt: Il-kantant interpreta l-għanja b'leħen kiebi li saħħaħ is-sens ta' telf fil-kliem.
formal.en: The singer performed the song in a melancholy voice that deepened the sense of loss in the lyrics.
formal.zh: 歌手以忧郁的嗓音演绎这首歌，加深了歌词中的失落感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek dak il-ħars kiebi? Luqa: Qed naħseb fil-ħabib tiegħi li telaq ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you have that sorrowful look? Luqa: I'm thinking about my friend who left yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的眼神怎么这么难过？卢卡：我在想昨天离开的那位朋友。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的眼神怎么这么难过？
messages.en: Why do you have that sorrowful look?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naħseb fil-ħabib tiegħi li telaq ilbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naħseb fil-ħabib tiegħi li telaq ilbieraħ.
messages.zh: 我在想昨天离开的那位朋友。
messages.en: I'm thinking about my friend who left yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给人物画像贴上“含泪的、悲伤的、忧郁的”三个标签，记住这个词用来描述情绪特征，是形容词。

gloss_zh: 胜过某人；表现超过某人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To perform better than another person or surpass them in an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某项活动或表现上做得比另一个人更好，超过对方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel aħjar minn ħaddieħor jew jaqbeż lil xi ħadd fil-ħila jew fir-riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胜过某人；在能力、成绩或表现上超过某人。

formal.mt: Fil-kompetizzjoni tal-kitba, Mark kief lill-kompetituri tiegħu b'rakkont oriġinali u miktub tajjeb.
formal.en: In the writing competition, Mark outdid his competitors with an original, well-written story.
formal.zh: 在写作比赛中，马克凭借一篇构思新颖、文笔出色的故事胜过了其他参赛者。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min kief lil kulħadd fil-kwizz? Ben: Mark! Wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet kollha sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who outdid everyone in the quiz? Ben: Mark! He answered all the questions correctly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁在知识问答中胜过了所有人？本：马克！他把所有题都答对了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 谁在知识问答中胜过了所有人？
messages.en: Who outdid everyone in the quiz?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 马克！他把所有题都答对了。
messages.en: Mark! He answered all the questions correctly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象知识问答成绩榜上，一个人的分数超过其他人；把“做得更好、胜过某人”的比较画面与这个动词相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Renting a place or an item for use in return for payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过付费租用房屋或物品的，用来描述承租者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jikri post jew oġġett biex jużah bi ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 承租的；付费租用某处或某物的。

formal.mt: Il-klijent kieri talab kopja tal-ftehim qabel ma ħallas.
formal.en: The renting customer requested a copy of the agreement before paying.
formal.zh: 承租的客户在付款前索取了一份协议副本。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min hu dak l-istudent kieri? Pawlu: Jismu Mark u qed jikri l-kamra ta' fuq.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is that renting student? Pawlu: His name is Mark, and he is renting the upstairs room.
colloquial.zh: Marija：那个租房的学生是谁？Pawlu：他叫Mark，正在租楼上的房间。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 那个租房的学生是谁？
messages.en: Who is that renting student?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (房东)
messages.mt_spoken: Jismu Mark u qed jikri l-kamra ta' fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Jismu Mark u qed jikri l-kamra ta' fuq.
messages.zh: 他叫Mark，正在租楼上的房间。
messages.en: His name is Mark, and he is renting the upstairs room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把kieri贴在租客人物卡上，联想他付租金、拿钥匙的画面，记住它描述承租状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small vessel used for drinking, such as a glass or a cup.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于喝水或其他饮料的小容器，如玻璃杯或杯子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent żgħir li jintuża biex wieħed jixrob minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玻璃杯、杯子，泛指任何小型饮用容器。

formal.mt: Fuq il-mejda tqiegħed kies ilma għal kull mistieden.
formal.en: A glass of water was placed on the table for each guest.
formal.zh: 桌上为每位客人放了一杯水。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tagħtini kies ilma, jekk jogħġbok? Lara: Żgur, hawn kies nadif.
colloquial.en: Mark: Could you give me a glass of water, please? Lara: Of course, here is a clean glass.
colloquial.zh: Mark：请给我一杯水，好吗？Lara：当然，这里有个干净的杯子。

messages.speaker: Mark (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħtini kies ilma, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħtini kies ilma, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请给我一杯水，好吗？
messages.en: Could you give me a glass of water, please?

messages.speaker: Lara (主人)
messages.zh: 当然，这里有个干净的杯子。
messages.en: Of course, here is a clean glass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在心里给桌上的小杯子贴上kies标签，再依次想象空杯和装水的杯子，巩固容器含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unwilling to make an effort, or lacking energy and moving slowly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不愿费力做事的，或缺乏精神、行动迟缓的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jridx jagħmel sforz, jew li għandu ftit enerġija u jimxi bil-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 懒惰的；不愿努力或动手做事的。
倦怠的；精神不足、行动迟缓的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel kieti dejjem iħalli x-xogħol għal ħaddieħor.
formal.en: In the story, the lazy boy always leaves the work to someone else.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个懒惰的男孩总把工作留给别人做。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed timxi daqshekk bil-mod? Mark: Illum inħossni kieti; ma rqadtx biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you walking so slowly? Mark: I feel lethargic today; I did not get enough sleep.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么走得这么慢？Mark：我今天没什么精神，觉没睡够。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum inħossni kieti; ma rqadtx biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Illum inħossni kieti; ma rqadtx biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 我今天没什么精神，觉没睡够。
messages.en: I feel lethargic today; I did not get enough sleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张人物图记kieti：一张是不愿干活，一张是困倦没力气，分别对应懒惰和倦怠。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intense heat that feels burning hot or scorching.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 令人感到灼烫、如同受到炙烤的强烈热度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sħana qawwija ħafna li tinħass taħraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灼烫的热度；令人感觉烫得厉害的热。
炙热；仿佛要把东西烤焦的强烈热度。

collocations.en: the scorching heat of the sun
the intense heat of the oven

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema waqfu fid-dell biex jistrieħu mill-kiewi tax-xemx.
formal.en: The workers stopped in the shade to take a break from the scorching heat of the sun.
formal.zh: 工人们停在阴凉处休息，暂时避开太阳的灼热。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kiewi ħiereġ minn dan il-forn! Pawlu: Iva, ejja noqogħdu ftit aktar 'il bogħod.
colloquial.en: Lara: What intense heat is coming out of this oven! Pawlu: Yes, let's stand a little farther away.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个烤箱冒出来的热气真烫！Pawlu：是啊，我们站远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个烤箱冒出来的热气真烫！
messages.en: What intense heat is coming out of this oven!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja noqogħdu ftit aktar 'il bogħod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja noqogħdu ftit aktar 'il bogħod.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们站远一点吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's stand a little farther away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把kiewi想成烤箱打开时扑面而来的热浪；本条按名词记，中文抓住灼热这股热度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to add another person, thing, or action to one already mentioned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于在已经提到的人、事物或动作之外，再补充另一项，意思是“以及”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex iżżid persuna, ħaġa jew azzjoni ma' oħra li tkun diġà ssemmiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以及；也包括；用于连接并补充另一项。

collocations.en: he reads as well as writes

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi eżerċizzji bil-miktub kif ukoll diskussjonijiet fi gruppi.
formal.en: The course includes written exercises as well as group discussions.
formal.zh: 这门课程包括书面练习以及小组讨论。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se ġġib għall-piknik? Mark: Se nġib il-ħobż kif ukoll ftit frott.
colloquial.en: Sara: What will you bring to the picnic? Mark: I will bring bread as well as some fruit.
colloquial.zh: Sara：野餐你会带什么？Mark：我会带面包，也带一些水果。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 野餐你会带什么？
messages.en: What will you bring to the picnic?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nġib il-ħobż kif ukoll ftit frott.
messages.mt_standard: Se nġib il-ħobż kif ukoll ftit frott.
messages.zh: 我会带面包，也带一些水果。
messages.en: I will bring bread as well as some fruit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把kif ukoll画成购物清单上的加号：前面已有面包，后面再添水果，整组记作以及。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An astronomical event in which the sun or moon appears partly or completely darkened.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 太阳或月亮看起来部分或全部变暗的天文现象，即日食或月食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fenomenu astronomiku li fih ix-xemx jew il-qamar jidher jiddallam parzjalment jew kompletament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次食现象，即日食或月食。

formal.mt: L-istudenti qraw rapport dwar kifsa tal-qamar u ddiskutew ir-ritratti fil-klassi.
formal.en: The students read a report about a lunar eclipse and discussed the photographs in class.
formal.zh: 学生们阅读了一篇关于月食的报告，并在课堂上讨论了其中的照片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt ir-ritratti tal-kifsa tal-qamar? Toni: Iva, u għoġobni r-ritratt fejn tidher l-aktar ċara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the photographs of the lunar eclipse? Toni: Yes, and I liked the photograph in which it is clearest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看了那些月食照片吗？Toni：看了，我喜欢月食最清楚的那张。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你看了那些月食照片吗？
messages.en: Did you see the photographs of the lunar eclipse?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għoġobni r-ritratt fejn tidher l-aktar ċara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għoġobni r-ritratt fejn tidher l-aktar ċara.
messages.zh: 看了，我喜欢月食最清楚的那张。
messages.en: Yes, and I liked the photograph in which it is clearest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给日食和月食两张图片都贴上kifsa，再用tax-xemx和tal-qamar区分太阳与月亮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of striking a ball with the foot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用脚踢球的一次动作，也可说踢出的一脚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa mogħtija lil ballun bis-sieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 踢球的一脚；用脚击球的动作。

formal.mt: Il-plejer ta kikk qawwi u l-ballun wasal għand sieħbu.
formal.en: The player delivered a powerful kick, and the ball reached his teammate.
formal.zh: 那名球员有力地踢出一脚，球传到了队友那里。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Rajt dak il-kikk lejn il-lasta? Maja: Iva, iżda l-ballun għadda minn fuqha.
colloquial.en: Toni: Did you see that kick towards the goal? Maja: Yes, but the ball went over it.
colloquial.zh: Toni：你看见朝球门踢的那一脚了吗？Maja：看见了，不过球从球门上方飞过去了。

messages.speaker: Toni (球迷)
messages.zh: 你看见朝球门踢的那一脚了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that kick towards the goal?

messages.speaker: Maja (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda l-ballun għadda minn fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda l-ballun għadda minn fuqha.
messages.zh: 看见了，不过球从球门上方飞过去了。
messages.en: Yes, but the ball went over it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读kikk时想象脚碰球的瞬间，把它记为可以数的一脚；再配上qawwi记住有力的一脚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The kick that starts or restarts play in a football match.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 足球比赛开始或重新开始时进行的开球。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-daqqa lill-ballun li biha tibda jew terġa' tibda l-logħba tal-futbol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开球；足球比赛开始或重新开始时踢出的球。

formal.mt: Il-ħin tal-kikoff tħabbar fil-programm tal-partita, u l-plejers daħlu fil-grawnd ftit qabel.
formal.en: The kick-off time was announced in the match programme, and the players entered the pitch shortly beforehand.
formal.zh: 比赛节目单公布了开球时间，球员们在开球前不久进入球场。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'ħin hu l-kikoff? Lara: Fis-sebgħa; ejja naslu ftit qabel.
colloquial.en: Mark: What time is kick-off? Lara: At seven; let's arrive a little early.
colloquial.zh: Mark：几点开球？Lara：七点，我们提前一点到吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷)
messages.zh: 几点开球？
messages.en: What time is kick-off?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 七点，我们提前一点到吧。
messages.en: At seven; let's arrive a little early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把kikoff与比赛时钟开始走动的画面绑定：哨声响、球被踢出，记住这是开球时刻。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the kidneys, or having the shape of a kidney.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与肾脏有关的，或形状像肾脏的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-kliewi jew li għandu forma ta' kilwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肾的；与肾脏有关的；肾形的。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jispjega t-termini ewlenin marbuta mal-mard kilwi.
formal.en: The chapter explains the main terms associated with renal disease.
formal.zh: 本章解释与肾脏疾病有关的主要术语。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan il-kontorn huwa kilwi? Pawlu: Iva, għandu forma ta' kilwa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this outline kidney-shaped? Pawlu: Yes, it has the shape of a kidney.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这个轮廓是肾形的吗？保罗：是的，它的形状像一个肾。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 这个轮廓是肾形的吗？
messages.en: Is this outline kidney-shaped?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 是的，它的形状像一个肾。
messages.en: Yes, it has the shape of a kidney.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个肾形轮廓，旁边写上 kilwi；用同一幅图记住“肾的”和“肾形的”两种含义。

gloss_zh: 以化学方式；从化学角度

teaching_sense.en_definition: By chemical means, or from the point of view of chemistry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过化学方法，或从化学性质与过程的角度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mezzi kimiċi jew mill-aspett tal-kimika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以化学方式；在化学性质或化学过程方面。

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju analizza kimikament il-kampjun tal-ilma.
formal.en: The laboratory chemically analysed the water sample.
formal.zh: 实验室对水样进行了化学分析。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan id-drapp ġie trattat kimikament? Mark: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has this fabric been chemically treated? Mark: Yes, that is what the label says.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这块布经过化学处理了吗？马克：是的，标签上是这样写的。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这块布经过化学处理了吗？
messages.en: Has this fabric been chemically treated?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 是的，标签上是这样写的。
messages.en: Yes, that is what the label says.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kimikament 写在“处理”和“分析”两个动作旁，记成回答“用什么方式”：用化学方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The arrangement or activity of paying to use property or equipment, or to employ someone's services, for an agreed period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在约定期间付费使用房产、设备，或雇用他人提供服务的安排或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-arranġament jew l-attività li tħallas biex tuża proprjetà jew tagħmir, jew biex timpjega lil xi ħadd, għal żmien miftiehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 租用；付费取得房屋或物品一定时期使用权的行为。
雇用；或付费临时租用车辆、设备等。
租赁；依据约定或合同在一定期限内付费使用资产。

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt ta' kiri jispeċifika t-tul tal-ftehim u l-ħlas ta' kull xahar.
formal.en: The lease agreement specifies the duration of the arrangement and the monthly payment.
formal.zh: 租赁合同明确规定了协议期限和每月应付金额。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm jiswa l-kiri ta' karozza għal ġurnata? David: Tletin ewro, u trid iġġibha lura sa filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Anna: How much does renting a car for a day cost? David: Thirty euros, and you need to bring it back by the evening.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：租一天汽车多少钱？戴维：三十欧元，而且你需要在晚上之前归还。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm jiswa l-kiri ta' karozza għal ġurnata?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm jiswa l-kiri ta' karozza għal ġurnata?
messages.zh: 租一天汽车多少钱？
messages.en: How much does renting a car for a day cost?

messages.speaker: David (租车店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tletin ewro, u trid iġġibha lura sa filgħaxija.
messages.mt_standard: Tletin ewro, u trid iġġibha lura sa filgħaxija.
messages.zh: 三十欧元，而且你需要在晚上之前归还。
messages.en: Thirty euros, and you need to bring it back by the evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象柜台上的租车合同，把 kiri 连到“付费使用一段时间”；遇到人员服务时，再联系“雇用”。

gloss_zh: 建筑抹灰料；包裹；覆盖层

teaching_sense.en_definition: Plaster applied in construction, or material that wraps or covers something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑中用于抹覆表面的灰泥，或包住、盖住物体的材料与覆盖层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li jintuża biex jinksew il-ħitan fil-bini, jew materjal li jdawwar jew jgħatti xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑用灰泥；用于墙面等表面抹灰的材料。
包裹；包在物体外面的包装材料。
覆盖物；覆盖在物体表面的层或材料。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema applikaw saff ġdid ta' kisi fuq il-ħajt qabel iż-żebgħa.
formal.en: The workers applied a new layer of plaster to the wall before painting.
formal.zh: 工人在粉刷之前给墙面抹上了一层新灰泥。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Inneħħi l-kisi minn fuq il-mejda? Toni: Għadu le; ħallih hemm biex jipproteġiha mit-trab.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall I remove the covering from the table? Toni: Not yet; leave it there to protect the table from dust.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我要把桌上的覆盖物拿掉吗？托尼：先别拿，让它留在那里挡灰尘。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 我要把桌上的覆盖物拿掉吗？
messages.en: Shall I remove the covering from the table?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu le; ħallih hemm biex jipproteġiha mit-trab.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu le; ħallih hemm biex jipproteġiha mit-trab.
messages.zh: 先别拿，让它留在那里挡灰尘。
messages.en: Not yet; leave it there to protect the table from dust.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“外面盖上一层”串联 kisi：墙上是灰泥层，物品外是包装，表面则是覆盖物。

gloss_zh: 人群中的争抢；拥挤抢取

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scramble in which people in a crowd struggle to get something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一群人挤在一起，为了拿到某物而争抢的场面或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħbit u ġlied fost folla ta' nies biex jieħdu jew jiksbu xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: Scramble, a struggle in a crowd to get something; scrambling
sense_translations.zh_definition: 争抢；人群中为了抢到某物而发生的拥挤争夺；争先抢取的行为。

formal.mt: Meta tqassmu r-rigali, inqala' kiskes fost il-folla.
formal.en: When the gifts were handed out, a scramble broke out among the crowd.
formal.zh: 分发礼物时，人群中出现了争抢。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex tlaqt minn ħdejn il-mejda? Ġużeppi: Kien hemm kiskes għar-rigali, u ppreferejt nistenna.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you move away from the table? Ġużeppi: There was a scramble for the gifts, and I preferred to wait.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么从桌边走开了？朱塞佩：大家都在争抢礼物，我宁愿等一等。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么从桌边走开了？
messages.en: Why did you move away from the table?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm kiskes għar-rigali, u ppreferejt nistenna.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm kiskes għar-rigali, u ppreferejt nistenna.
messages.zh: 大家都在争抢礼物，我宁愿等一等。
messages.en: There was a scramble for the gifts, and I preferred to wait.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象许多只手同时伸向最后几张票，把 kiskes 记成“人群挤着抢东西”的整个场面。

gloss_zh: 破损；骨折；一大块面包；受冷落感；窘迫感；道路弯处

teaching_sense.en_definition: A breakage or fracture; also a hunk of bread, a feeling of being snubbed or embarrassed, or a bend in a road, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指破损或骨折，也可依语境指一大块面包、受冷落或尴尬的感觉，以及道路的转弯处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkissir jew ksur f'xi ħaġa; tista' tfisser ukoll biċċa ħobż, sensazzjoni ta' ċaħda jew mistħija, jew liwja fit-triq, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次破损、断裂；物体损坏的情况。
骨折；骨头发生断裂的损伤。
一大块面包；一块厚实的面包。

sense_translations.en_definition: the feeling of having been snubbed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到冷落、怠慢或被人轻视后的失落感。
尴尬、难为情或窘迫的感觉。

sense_translations.en_definition: a turn or bend in the road
sense_translations.zh_definition: 道路的转弯处或弯曲路段。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi kisra fit-triq ftit qabel il-pont.
formal.en: The map shows a bend in the road shortly before the bridge.
formal.zh: 地图显示，在到达桥梁之前不远处，道路有一个弯。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tgħaddili kisra ħobż, jekk jogħġbok? Luqa: Żgur, ħu din mal-ġobon.
colloquial.en: Nina: Could you pass me a hunk of bread, please? Luqa: Of course, have this one with the cheese.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：请递给我一大块面包，好吗？卢卡：当然，拿这块配奶酪吃吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (用餐的朋友)
messages.zh: 请递给我一大块面包，好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me a hunk of bread, please?

messages.speaker: Luqa (用餐的朋友)
messages.zh: 当然，拿这块配奶酪吃吧。
messages.en: Of course, have this one with the cheese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kisra 做六格语境卡：物体破损、骨折、面包块、受冷落、难为情、道路转弯；看搭配选义，不强行合成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To obtain or succeed in getting something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 得到某物，或成功取得所需的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikseb jew jirnexxilu jieħu xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获得；取得；得到某物。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur kisseb permess biex juża d-dokumenti fl-istudju tiegħu.
formal.en: The researcher obtained permission to use the documents in his study.
formal.zh: 研究人员获得了在研究中使用这些文件的许可。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Pawlu kisseb il-permess għall-attività? Mark: Iva, u issa jista' jibbukkja s-sala.
colloquial.en: Elena: Did Pawlu obtain permission for the event? Mark: Yes, and now he can book the hall.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：保罗获得举办活动的许可了吗？马克：获得了，现在他可以预订礼堂了。

messages.speaker: Elena (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 保罗获得举办活动的许可了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu obtain permission for the event?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动协办者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u issa jista' jibbukkja s-sala.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u issa jista' jibbukkja s-sala.
messages.zh: 获得了，现在他可以预订礼堂了。
messages.en: Yes, and now he can book the hall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kisseb 放进“他终于取得许可”的动作画面，重点记住这是表示“获得”的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who obtains something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 取得或得到某物的人；具体取得什么，由上下文说明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikseb xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获得某物的人；取得者。

collocations.en: the person who obtains the prize
the person who obtains the permit

formal.mt: Il-kissieb tal-premju għandu jippreżenta dokument ta' identità qabel jirċevih.
formal.en: The person who obtains the prize must present an identity document before receiving it.
formal.zh: 获得奖项的人必须在领取奖品之前出示身份证明文件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min hu l-kissieb tal-premju? David: Huwa Pawlu; se jirċevih illum wara nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is the person obtaining the prize? David: It is Pawlu; he will receive it this afternoon.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：获得奖项的人是谁？戴维：是保罗，他今天下午会领取奖品。

messages.speaker: Marija (活动参加者)
messages.zh: 获得奖项的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the person obtaining the prize?

messages.speaker: David (活动工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa Pawlu; se jirċevih illum wara nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa Pawlu; se jirċevih illum wara nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 是保罗，他今天下午会领取奖品。
messages.en: It is Pawlu; he will receive it this afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给领取奖品的人画一个名牌，写上 kissieb；记成“获得东西的那个人”，并与表示动作的 kisseb 分开记。

gloss_zh: 占有欲强的；不愿分享的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strongly wanting to keep things for oneself and unwilling to share them with others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 很想把东西据为己有，不愿让别人分享或使用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jrid iżomm l-affarijiet għalih u ma jkunx irid jaqsamhom ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 占有欲强的；倾向于把东西留给自己、不愿与人分享的。

collocations.zh: 对自己的玩具有很强的占有欲

formal.mt: L-istudent kien kissiebi fejn jidħlu l-kotba tiegħu u ma ried isellef ebda wieħed lil sħabu.
formal.en: The student was possessive about his books and did not want to lend any of them to his classmates.
formal.zh: 这名学生对自己的书占有欲很强，一本也不愿借给同学。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex ħuk ma jħalliniex nilagħbu bil-ballun tiegħu? Toni: Huwa kissiebi ħafna, imma nista' nsaqsih biex jilgħab magħna.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why won't your brother let us play with his ball? Toni: He's very possessive, but I can ask him to play with us.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你哥哥为什么不让我们玩他的球？托尼：他占有欲很强，不过我可以问问他愿不愿意和我们一起玩。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħuk ma jħalliniex nilagħbu bil-ballun tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħuk ma jħalliniex nilagħbu bil-ballun tiegħu?
messages.zh: 你哥哥为什么不让我们玩他的球？
messages.en: Why won't your brother let us play with his ball?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa kissiebi ħafna, imma nista' nsaqsih biex jilgħab magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa kissiebi ħafna, imma nista' nsaqsih biex jilgħab magħna.
messages.zh: 他占有欲很强，不过我可以问问他愿不愿意和我们一起玩。
messages.en: He's very possessive, but I can ask him to play with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人紧抱自己的玩具，说什么都不肯分享，用这个画面记住“占有欲强”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work is to break stones into smaller pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以敲打、破碎石块为工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tkisser il-ġebel f'biċċiet iżgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敲碎石块的人；碎石工。

collocations.en: to work as a stone breaker

formal.mt: Il-kissier qasam il-ġebel il-kbir f'biċċiet iżgħar sabiex ikun jista' jintuża fix-xogħol tat-triq.
formal.en: The stone breaker broke the large stones into smaller pieces so that they could be used in the road work.
formal.zh: 碎石工把大石块敲成较小的石块，以便用于道路施工。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'xogħol kien jagħmel nannuk? Pawlu: Kien jaħdem bħala kissier u jkisser il-ġebel b'martell kbir.
colloquial.en: Lara: What work did your grandfather do? Pawlu: He worked as a stone breaker and broke stones with a large hammer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你爷爷以前做什么工作？保罗：他是碎石工，用大锤敲碎石块。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷以前做什么工作？
messages.en: What work did your grandfather do?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien jaħdem bħala kissier u jkisser il-ġebel b'martell kbir.
messages.mt_standard: Kien jaħdem bħala kissier u jkisser il-ġebel b'martell kbir.
messages.zh: 他是碎石工，用大锤敲碎石块。
messages.en: He worked as a stone breaker and broke stones with a large hammer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词配上一幅工人挥锤敲石头的画面，记住它指“碎石的人”。

gloss_zh: 爱打碎东西的；容易打坏东西的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to break or smash things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有打破、砸碎东西的倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jkisser jew ifarrak l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the propensity to break or smash
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有打破或砸碎东西的倾向的；爱打坏东西的。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to break things
a person prone to smashing things

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel huwa deskritt bħala kissieri għax spiss ikisser il-ġugarelli tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the boy is described as prone to breaking things because he often breaks his toys.
formal.zh: 故事把这个男孩描述为容易打坏东西的人，因为他经常弄坏自己的玩具。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nagħtuh il-karozza tal-ħġieġ biex jilgħab biha? Mark: Aħjar le; huwa kissieri ħafna. Nagħtuh waħda tal-lastku.
colloquial.en: Anna: Shall we give him the glass car to play with? Mark: Better not; he tends to break things. Let's give him a rubber one.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们把玻璃小汽车给他玩吗？马克：还是别吧，他很容易打坏东西。给他一辆橡胶的吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħtuh il-karozza tal-ħġieġ biex jilgħab biha?
messages.mt_standard: Nagħtuh il-karozza tal-ħġieġ biex jilgħab biha?
messages.zh: 我们把玻璃小汽车给他玩吗？
messages.en: Shall we give him the glass car to play with?

messages.speaker: Mark (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar le; huwa kissieri ħafna. Nagħtuh waħda tal-lastku.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar le; huwa kissieri ħafna. Nagħtuh waħda tal-lastku.
messages.zh: 还是别吧，他很容易打坏东西。给他一辆橡胶的吧。
messages.en: Better not; he tends to break things. Let's give him a rubber one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象玩具一到某人手里就被弄坏，用反复出现的画面记住“有打坏东西的倾向”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of the body on either side of the neck where the arm joins the upper body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颈部两侧、手臂与躯干相连接的身体部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-ġisem fuq kull naħa tal-għonq fejn id-driegħ jingħaqad mal-bqija tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肩；肩膀，即手臂与躯干相连接的部位。

collocations.en: to carry a bag on his shoulder

formal.mt: Wara li ġarr il-kaxxi, ir-raġel ħass uġigħ fil-kitf tal-lemin.
formal.en: After carrying the boxes, the man felt pain in his right shoulder.
formal.zh: 搬完箱子后，这名男子感到右肩疼痛。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed iżżomm idek fuq kitfek? David: Il-borża kienet tqila u issa qed juġagħni kitfi.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you holding your hand on your shoulder? David: The bag was heavy, and now my shoulder hurts.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么用手按着肩膀？戴维：袋子太重了，现在我的肩膀疼。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iżżomm idek fuq kitfek?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iżżomm idek fuq kitfek?
messages.zh: 你为什么用手按着肩膀？
messages.en: Why are you holding your hand on your shoulder?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-borża kienet tqila u issa qed juġagħni kitfi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-borża kienet tqila u issa qed juġagħni kitfi.
messages.zh: 袋子太重了，现在我的肩膀疼。
messages.en: The bag was heavy, and now my shoulder hurts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 kitf 就轻拍自己的肩膀，再想象肩上背着袋子，把词和身体位置连起来。

gloss_zh: 紧身衣物；紧贴身体的衣服

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clothes that fit very closely around the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 紧贴身体、穿起来较紧的衣物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies issikkat li joqgħod qrib ħafna tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧身衣物；紧贴身体的衣服。

collocations.zh: 穿着不舒服的紧身衣物

formal.mt: Għall-eżerċizzju, għażel ilbies li jippermetti l-moviment, għax kitfa tista' tillimita l-moviment tal-ġisem.
formal.en: For exercise, choose clothing that allows movement, because tight-fitting clothes can restrict the body's movement.
formal.zh: 运动时应选择便于活动的衣物，因为紧身衣物可能限制身体活动。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ma rridx nilbes din il-kitfa; bilkemm nista' niċċaqlaq. Sara: Mela agħżel ilbies usa' biex tkun komda.
colloquial.en: Nina: I don't want to wear these tight clothes; I can hardly move. Sara: Then choose looser clothes so you'll be comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我不想穿这身紧身衣服，几乎动都动不了。萨拉：那就选宽松一点的，穿着舒服些。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma rridx nilbes din il-kitfa; bilkemm nista' niċċaqlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Ma rridx nilbes din il-kitfa; bilkemm nista' niċċaqlaq.
messages.zh: 我不想穿这身紧身衣服，几乎动都动不了。
messages.en: I don't want to wear these tight clothes; I can hardly move.

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela agħżel ilbies usa' biex tkun komda.
messages.mt_standard: Mela agħżel ilbies usa' biex tkun komda.
messages.zh: 那就选宽松一点的，穿着舒服些。
messages.en: Then choose looser clothes so you'll be comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一身衣服紧贴身体，抬手都费劲，用穿衣的触感记住“紧身衣物”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To write repeatedly or as a regular activity, for example by contributing articles over time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把写作作为经常进行的活动，或持续、定期地撰写文章。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tikteb b'mod regolari, pereżempju billi tikkontribwixxi artikli għal żmien twil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常写作；有规律地写文章或撰稿。

formal.mt: Għal ħafna snin, l-għalliem kitteb kull ġimgħa fir-rivista tal-iskola dwar il-qari u l-letteratura.
formal.en: For many years, the teacher wrote every week in the school magazine about reading and literature.
formal.zh: 多年来，这位教师每周都在校刊上撰写有关阅读与文学的文章。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Missierek kien jikteb għall-gazzetta? Ben: Iva, kitteb fiha kull ġimgħa għal għaxar snin.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did your father use to write for the newspaper? Ben: Yes, he wrote for it every week for ten years.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你父亲以前给报纸写稿吗？本：是的，他连续十年每周都给那份报纸撰稿。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你父亲以前给报纸写稿吗？
messages.en: Did your father use to write for the newspaper?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kitteb fiha kull ġimgħa għal għaxar snin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kitteb fiha kull ġimgħa għal għaxar snin.
messages.zh: 是的，他连续十年每周都给那份报纸撰稿。
messages.en: Yes, he wrote for it every week for ten years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一本每周都有新文章的日历，突出反复、定期写作，而非只写一次。

gloss_zh: 给人穿紧身衣；把衣服做得过小；赢走全部彩头

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dress someone in clothes that fit tightly around the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给某人穿上紧贴身体的衣服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tlibbes lil xi ħadd ħwejjeġ issikkati li joqogħdu qrib ħafna tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给人穿上紧身衣物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make clothes too small for sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把衣服做得对某人来说太小、太紧。

sense_translations.en_definition: to take all the winnings in a game
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在一场游戏或赌局中赢走全部彩头或赢款。

collocations.en: dressed the boy in tight clothes
the tailor made the clothes too small for the customer
collocations.zh: 裁缝把给顾客做的衣服做得太小

collocations.en: took all the winnings in the game
collocations.zh: 在游戏中赢走全部彩头

formal.mt: Għar-rappreżentazzjoni, id-disinjatur kittef lill-attur bi ħwejjeġ issikkati li kienu jillimitaw il-moviment tiegħu.
formal.en: For the performance, the designer dressed the actor in tight clothes that restricted his movement.
formal.zh: 为了演出，设计师给演员穿上了限制其活动的紧身衣物。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min rebaħ il-flus fil-logħba tal-bieraħ? Toni: Pawlu kittef; ħa r-rebħ kollu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who won the money in yesterday's game? Toni: Pawlu took the lot; he collected all the winnings.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：昨天那局的钱是谁赢的？托尼：保罗全赢走了，所有赢款都归他了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天那局的钱是谁赢的？
messages.en: Who won the money in yesterday's game?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗全赢走了，所有赢款都归他了。
messages.en: Pawlu took the lot; he collected all the winnings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个独立画面记义：给人穿紧衣、裁缝把衣服做小、玩家收走全部赢款；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sow hemp or flax seeds so that the plants will grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 播下大麻或亚麻的种子，以种植这些作物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tiżra' ż-żerriegħa tal-qanneb jew tal-kittien biex jikbru dawn il-pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 播种大麻或亚麻。

formal.mt: Fir-rebbiegħa, il-bidwi kitten il-kittien f'għalqa li kien ħejja għaż-żrigħ.
formal.en: In spring, the farmer sowed flax in a field that he had prepared for sowing.
formal.zh: 春天，农民在已准备好播种的田地里播下了亚麻种子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'żera' nannuk f'dik l-għalqa? Pawlu: Din is-sena kitten il-kittien; issa qed jistenna li jinbet.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did your grandfather sow in that field? Pawlu: This year he sowed flax; now he's waiting for it to sprout.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你爷爷在那块田里种了什么？保罗：今年他播种了亚麻，现在正等着它发芽。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷在那块田里种了什么？
messages.en: What did your grandfather sow in that field?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din is-sena kitten il-kittien; issa qed jistenna li jinbet.
messages.mt_standard: Din is-sena kitten il-kittien; issa qed jistenna li jinbet.
messages.zh: 今年他播种了亚麻，现在正等着它发芽。
messages.en: This year he sowed flax; now he's waiting for it to sprout.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象农民把标着“大麻”和“亚麻”的种子撒进田里，把这个动词与播种动作绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 爱写作的；倾向于写作的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to write often or to express thoughts in writing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 常常愿意写作，或倾向于用文字表达想法的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jikteb ta' spiss jew jesprimi ħsibijiet bil-kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于写作的；爱动笔表达的。

collocations.en: a student who tends to write

formal.mt: L-istudent kittiebi jesprimi l-ħsibijiet tiegħu f'kitba qasira kuljum.
formal.en: The student who is inclined to write expresses his thoughts in a short piece of writing every day.
formal.zh: 这名爱写作的学生每天都用一篇短文表达自己的想法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dejjem għandek xi ħaġa x'tikteb! Mark: Iva, jien bniedem kittiebi; inħobb inniżżel il-ħsibijiet tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: You always have something to write! Mark: Yes, I'm someone who likes to write; I enjoy putting my thoughts down.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你总有东西可写！马克：是呀，我就是个爱写作的人，喜欢把想法记下来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你总有东西可写！
messages.en: You always have something to write!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien bniedem kittiebi; inħobb inniżżel il-ħsibijiet tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien bniedem kittiebi; inħobb inniżżel il-ħsibijiet tiegħi.
messages.zh: 是呀，我就是个爱写作的人，喜欢把想法记下来。
messages.en: Yes, I'm someone who likes to write; I enjoy putting my thoughts down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个随身带本子、想到什么就动笔的人，用 kittiebi 形容他爱写作的倾向。

gloss_zh: 赢走全部奖金或赢款的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who takes all the winnings in a game.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在一场游戏中赢走全部奖金或赢款的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu r-rebħ kollu f'logħba.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who takes all the winnings
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拿走全部奖金或赢款的人。

collocations.en: the person who takes all the winnings in the game
collocations.zh: 这场游戏中赢走全部奖金的人
把全部赢款收入囊中的赢家

formal.mt: Skont ir-regoli tal-logħba, il-kittief jieħu r-rebħ kollu.
formal.en: Under the rules of the game, the person who wins everything takes all the winnings.
formal.zh: 按照游戏规则，通吃的赢家拿走全部赢款。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min ħa r-rebħ kollu? Pawlu: Mark kien il-kittief tal-lejla; ħa kollox hu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who took all the winnings? Pawlu: Mark was tonight's winner who took everything; he got the lot.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁把赢款全拿走了？保罗：马克是今晚通吃的赢家，全让他拿走了。

messages.speaker: Lara (游戏参与者)
messages.zh: 谁把赢款全拿走了？
messages.en: Who took all the winnings?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (游戏参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark kien il-kittief tal-lejla; ħa kollox hu.
messages.mt_standard: Mark kien il-kittief tal-lejla; ħa kollox hu.
messages.zh: 马克是今晚通吃的赢家，全让他拿走了。
messages.en: Mark was tonight's winner who took everything; he got the lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定格在一个人收走桌上全部赢款的瞬间：kittief 指这个通吃的赢家。

gloss_zh: 通吃赢款的；衣物容易紧贴身体的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Taking all the winnings in a game; also describing a garment that tends to fit tightly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容在游戏中通吃全部赢款的；也形容衣物容易穿得紧贴身体的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jieħu r-rebħ kollu f'logħba; jew, meta jingħad dwar ilbies, li għandu tendenza joqgħod issikkat mal-ġisem.

sense_translations.en_definition: taking all the winnings in a game
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在游戏中赢走全部奖金或赢款的。

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to fit tightly (used of garments)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易紧贴身体、穿着偏紧的，用于衣物。

collocations.en: a player who takes all the winnings
a waistcoat that tends to fit tightly
collocations.zh: 一件穿着容易偏紧的马甲

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, kittiefi jiddeskrivi kemm plejer li jieħu r-rebħ kollu kif ukoll ġlekk li joqgħod issikkat mal-ġisem.
formal.en: In the exercise, kittiefi describes both a player who takes all the winnings and a waistcoat that fits tightly against the body.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，kittiefi 既形容通吃全部赢款的玩家，也形容紧贴身体的马甲。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ġlekk kittiefi wisq għalija; bilkemm nista' nagħlqu. Lara: Ipprova wieħed akbar, ħalli tkun aktar komdu.
colloquial.en: Mark: This waistcoat is too tight-fitting for me; I can barely fasten it. Lara: Try a bigger one so you'll be more comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这件马甲对我来说太紧身了，几乎扣不上。拉拉：试试大一号的，穿着会舒服些。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ġlekk kittiefi wisq għalija; bilkemm nista' nagħlqu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ġlekk kittiefi wisq għalija; bilkemm nista' nagħlqu.
messages.zh: 这件马甲对我来说太紧身了，几乎扣不上。
messages.en: This waistcoat is too tight-fitting for me; I can barely fasten it.

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova wieħed akbar, ħalli tkun aktar komdu.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova wieħed akbar, ħalli tkun aktar komdu.
messages.zh: 试试大一号的，穿着会舒服些。
messages.en: Try a bigger one so you'll be more comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两幅画记忆：玩家收走全部赢款，马甲紧贴身体；用所修饰的名词判断 kittiefi 的义项。
