teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to produce hemp abundantly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有大量出产大麻这种纤维作物的倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jipproduċi l-qanneb bil-kotra.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to produce hemp in abundance
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于大量出产大麻的；容易盛产大麻的。

collocations.en: farmland that tends to produce hemp abundantly
land inclined to yield abundant hemp
collocations.zh: 容易获得大麻丰收的土地

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi r-raba' bħala kittieni minħabba li jipproduċi l-qanneb bil-kotra.
formal.en: The report describes the farmland as inclined to produce hemp abundantly because it yields hemp in large quantities.
formal.zh: 报告将这片农地描述为容易盛产大麻的土地，因为它的大麻产量很高。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħid li dan ir-raba' kittieni? Pawlu: Għax il-qanneb jikber bil-kotra hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you say this farmland tends to produce hemp abundantly? Pawlu: Because hemp grows here in abundance.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说这片农地容易盛产大麻？保罗：因为这里的大麻长得很多。

messages.speaker: Maja (农业学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li dan ir-raba' kittieni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li dan ir-raba' kittieni?
messages.zh: 你为什么说这片农地容易盛产大麻？
messages.en: Why do you say this farmland tends to produce hemp abundantly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.zh: 因为这里的大麻长得很多。
messages.en: Because hemp grows here in abundance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一整片大麻长势繁盛的农地，把 kittieni 与“大麻产量丰盛”这一具体画面相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to disclose information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人透露或披露信息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiżvela informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人透露；促使某人披露信息。

collocations.en: caused the witness to disclose information
caused the interviewee to disclose information

formal.mt: L-intervistatur kixxef lix-xhud permezz ta' mistoqsijiet preċiżi, u x-xhud żvela dak li kien jaf.
formal.en: The interviewer caused the witness to disclose information through precise questions, and the witness revealed what he knew.
formal.zh: 访谈者通过准确的提问促使证人披露信息，证人随后说出了自己知道的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif irnexxielek issir taf id-dettalji? Mark: Pawlu kixxef lill-intervistat b'mistoqsija waħda, u dak qal kollox.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did you manage to find out the details? Mark: Pawlu got the interviewee to disclose them with one question, and he told us everything.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你是怎么弄清那些细节的？马克：保罗问了一个问题，就让受访者开了口，对方把一切都告诉了我们。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你是怎么弄清那些细节的？
messages.en: How did you manage to find out the details?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu kixxef lill-intervistat b'mistoqsija waħda, u dak qal kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu kixxef lill-intervistat b'mistoqsija waħda, u dak qal kollox.
messages.zh: 保罗问了一个问题，就让受访者开了口，对方把一切都告诉了我们。
messages.en: Pawlu got the interviewee to disclose them with one question, and he told us everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“提问者让知情者开口”的两人画面：kixxef 的重点是促使别人披露。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who investigates, or someone who discovers something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行调查的人，或发现某种事物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tinvestiga, jew xi ħadd li jiskopri xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 调查者；开展调查工作的人。
发现者；发现某事或某物的人。

formal.mt: Il-kixxief eżamina d-dokumenti u qabbel ix-xhieda qabel kiteb ir-rapport.
formal.en: The investigator examined the documents and compared the testimonies before writing the report.
formal.zh: 调查者在撰写报告之前检查了文件，并对照了各份证词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min sab dan il-post? Mark: Pawlu; hu l-kixxief ta' dan il-post, u llum se jurihulna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who found this place? Mark: Pawlu; he's the discoverer of this place, and today he's going to show it to us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：是谁发现这个地方的？马克：保罗，他是这个地方的发现者，今天要带我们去看看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 是谁发现这个地方的？
messages.en: Who found this place?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu; hu l-kixxief ta' dan il-post, u llum se jurihulna.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu; hu l-kixxief ta' dan il-post, u llum se jurihulna.
messages.zh: 保罗，他是这个地方的发现者，今天要带我们去看看。
messages.en: Pawlu; he's the discoverer of this place, and today he's going to show it to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个拿着放大镜的人：查证事实时是调查者，找到新事物时是发现者，两义都指人。

gloss_zh: 善于发现的；有助于发现的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to discover things, or making discovery possible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于发现事物的，或能够帮助实现发现的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jiskopri xi ħaġa, jew li jagħmel l-iskoperta possibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于发现事物的；具有发现倾向的。
使发现成为可能的；有助于发现的。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur uża metodu kixxiefi li għenu jsib rabtiet bejn id-data.
formal.en: The researcher used a method that enabled discovery and helped him find connections in the data.
formal.zh: 研究者使用了一种有助于发现的方法，从而找出了数据之间的联系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sibt dik ir-rabta? Mark: Għandi moħħ kixxiefi; inħobb infittex rabtiet li ma jidhrux mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did you find that connection? Mark: I have a mind inclined to discover; I like looking for connections that aren't immediately obvious.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你是怎么发现那个联系的？马克：我有个爱发现的头脑，喜欢寻找那些一开始看不出来的联系。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你是怎么发现那个联系的？
messages.en: How did you find that connection?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi moħħ kixxiefi; inħobb infittex rabtiet li ma jidhrux mill-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi moħħ kixxiefi; inħobb infittex rabtiet li ma jidhrux mill-ewwel.
messages.zh: 我有个爱发现的头脑，喜欢寻找那些一开始看不出来的联系。
messages.en: I have a mind inclined to discover; I like looking for connections that aren't immediately obvious.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把形容对象分开记：头脑偏向“爱发现”，方法偏向“帮助发现”，都可用 kixxiefi 描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small kitchen with limited space for preparing food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于准备食物、空间较小的厨房。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kċina żgħira bi spazju limitat għat-tħejjija tal-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小厨房；面积较小的烹饪空间。

formal.mt: L-appartament jinkludi kiċinett mgħammar bi friġġ u apparat għat-tisjir.
formal.en: The apartment includes a kitchenette equipped with a refrigerator and cooking appliances.
formal.zh: 这套公寓设有小厨房，配备冰箱和烹饪电器。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Hemm kiċinett fil-kamra? Rita: Iva, tista' tagħmel il-kafè u ssajjar xi ħaġa ħafifa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is there a kitchenette in the room? Rita: Yes, you can make coffee and cook something light.
colloquial.zh: 马克：房间里有小厨房吗？丽塔：有，可以煮咖啡，也可以做点简单的饭菜。

messages.speaker: Mark (住客)
messages.zh: 房间里有小厨房吗？
messages.en: Is there a kitchenette in the room?

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' tagħmel il-kafè u ssajjar xi ħaġa ħafifa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' tagħmel il-kafè u ssajjar xi ħaġa ħafifa.
messages.zh: 有，可以煮咖啡，也可以做点简单的饭菜。
messages.en: Yes, you can make coffee and cook something light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公寓角落里紧凑排列的水槽、炉具和小冰箱，用这个迷你做饭空间记住“小厨房”。

gloss_zh: 与 kewn 同义的名词

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun used as a synonym of kewn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个与马耳他语名词 kewn 同义的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem li għandu l-istess tifsira bħal kewn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 kewn 同义的词。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, l-istudenti għandhom iqabblu kjien mas-sinonimu tiegħu kewn.
formal.en: In this vocabulary exercise, students should match kjien with its synonym kewn.
formal.zh: 在这道词汇练习中，学生应将 kjien 与它的同义词 kewn 配对。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma' liema kelma nqabbel kjien f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Qabblu ma' kewn; iż-żewġ kelmiet huma sinonimi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which word should I match kjien with in this exercise? Mark: Match it with kewn; the two words are synonyms.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习里，我应该把 kjien 和哪个词配在一起？马克：把它和 kewn 配在一起，这两个词是同义词。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' liema kelma nqabbel kjien f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' liema kelma nqabbel kjien f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 这道练习里，我应该把 kjien 和哪个词配在一起？

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)

messages.mt_standard: Qabblu ma' kewn; iż-żewġ kelmiet huma sinonimi.
messages.zh: 把它和 kewn 配在一起，这两个词是同义词。
messages.en: Match it with kewn; the two words are synonyms.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张双面词卡，一面写 kjien，另一面写 kewn；用翻卡配对记住两者的同义关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter an event or task in a calendar or schedule for a particular date or time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把活动或任务登记在日历或日程表中，安排在特定日期或时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħħal avveniment jew biċċa xogħol fil-kalendarju għal data jew ħin partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把活动或任务记入日历；排入日程。

collocations.en: entered an appointment in the calendar

formal.mt: Is-segretarju kkalenda l-laqgħa tal-kumitat għall-Ħamis fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The secretary scheduled the committee meeting for Thursday at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 秘书把委员会会议安排在星期四上午九点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-laqgħa tagħna daħlet fil-kalendarju? Mark: Iva, Pawlu kkalenda l-laqgħa għall-Ġimgħa fl-għaxra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has our meeting been entered in the calendar? Mark: Yes, Pawlu scheduled the meeting for Friday at ten.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们的会议记入日历了吗？马克：记了，保罗把会议安排在星期五十点。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 我们的会议记入日历了吗？
messages.en: Has our meeting been entered in the calendar?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Pawlu kkalenda l-laqgħa għall-Ġimgħa fl-għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Pawlu kkalenda l-laqgħa għall-Ġimgħa fl-għaxra.
messages.zh: 记了，保罗把会议安排在星期五十点。
messages.en: Yes, Pawlu scheduled the meeting for Friday at ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在日历方格里写下会议时间，把 kkalenda 记成“将事情放进日程格子”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move forward or develop towards a further stage or completion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向前发展，逐步进入下一阶段或接近完成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mexa 'l quddiem jew żviluppa lejn stadju ieħor jew lejn it-tlestija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 取得进展；向前发展或推进。

formal.mt: Il-proġett kkamina tajjeb matul l-ewwel xahar, u t-tim temm l-ewwel fażi fil-ħin.
formal.en: The project progressed well during the first month, and the team completed the first phase on time.
formal.zh: 项目在第一个月进展顺利，团队按时完成了第一阶段。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar ix-xogħol illum? Lara: Kkamina tajjeb; issa fadal biss l-aħħar parti.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the work go today? Lara: It progressed well; now only the last part remains.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天工作进行得怎么样？拉拉：进展顺利，现在只剩最后一部分了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 今天工作进行得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the work go today?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kkamina tajjeb; issa fadal biss l-aħħar parti.
messages.mt_standard: Kkamina tajjeb; issa fadal biss l-aħħar parti.
messages.zh: 进展顺利，现在只剩最后一部分了。
messages.en: It progressed well; now only the last part remains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把项目进度条逐格向前的画面配给 kkamina，再用 tajjeb 和 bil-mod 分别记顺利与缓慢的进展。

gloss_zh: 使组织坏死；发生坏疽或坏死

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause body tissue to become gangrenous or die, or for tissue itself to become gangrenous or die.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使身体组织发生坏疽或坏死；也指组织本身发生坏疽或坏死。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel tessut tal-ġisem imut jew jiżviluppa gangrena; jew, dwar it-tessut innifsu, miet jew żviluppa gangrena.

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause gangrene in, to necrotize
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使身体部位发生坏疽；使组织坏死。
发生坏疽；组织坏死。

collocations.en: an infection that caused the tissue to become gangrenous
collocations.zh: 导致组织发生坏疽的感染

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jiddeskrivi infezzjoni li kkankrat parti mit-tessut madwar il-ferita.
formal.en: The medical report describes an infection that caused some of the tissue around the wound to become gangrenous.
formal.zh: 医疗报告描述了一次感染，感染使伤口周围的部分组织发生了坏疽。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ifisser li t-tessut kkankra? Mark: Ifisser li t-tessut miet jew żviluppa gangrena.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does it mean that the tissue became necrotic? Mark: It means that the tissue died or developed gangrene.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：说组织发生坏死是什么意思？马克：意思是组织死亡了，或者发生了坏疽。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 说组织发生坏死是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that the tissue became necrotic?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li t-tessut miet jew żviluppa gangrena.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li t-tessut miet jew żviluppa gangrena.
messages.zh: 意思是组织死亡了，或者发生了坏疽。
messages.en: It means that the tissue died or developed gangrene.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅句法图记 kkankra：“感染使组织坏死”与“组织自身坏死”，分别对应使动和自发变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To impose a penalty for wrongdoing, or to subject people to harsh and oppressive treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因过错而施加处罚；也指以严酷的方式压迫他人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta kastig lil xi ħadd għal għemil ħażin, jew ittratta lin-nies b'mod aħrax u oppressiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惩罚；因某人的过错而给予处罚。
压迫；使他人遭受严酷或不公正的对待。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ħakkiem kkastiga lill-poplu b'taxxi eċċessivi u restrizzjonijiet ħorox.
formal.en: In the novel, the ruler oppressed the people with excessive taxes and harsh restrictions.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，统治者用过重的税收和严苛的限制压迫人民。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Tom ma jistax jilgħab illum? Pawlu: Missieru kkastiga lil Tom għax kiser it-tieqa apposta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't Tom play today? Pawlu: His father punished Tom because he broke the window on purpose.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：汤姆今天为什么不能玩？保罗：他爸爸处罚了他，因为他故意打破了窗户。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Tom ma jistax jilgħab illum?

messages.en: Why can't Tom play today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Missieru kkastiga lil Tom għax kiser it-tieqa apposta.
messages.zh: 他爸爸处罚了他，因为他故意打破了窗户。
messages.en: His father punished Tom because he broke the window on purpose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kkastiga 放进两个场景记忆：因过错受处罚，以及人民遭严酷压迫；靠上下文区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 采取预防措施；事先防备

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take protective measures in advance against possible danger, loss, or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为防范可能出现的危险、损失或困难，提前采取保护措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħa miżuri minn qabel biex jipproteġi ruħu minn periklu, telf jew diffikultà possibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 采取预防措施；预先做好防备。

formal.mt: Qabel il-vjaġġ, ir-riċerkatur kkawtela ruħu billi ħa kopji tad-dokumenti importanti.
formal.en: Before the journey, the researcher took precautions by making copies of the important documents.
formal.zh: 出发前，研究人员复印了重要文件，事先做好防备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ħa żewġ kopji tal-indirizz? Sara: Kkawtela ruħu, f'każ li jitlef waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark take two copies of the address? Sara: He took precautions in case he loses one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么带了两份地址？萨拉：他事先做好防备，以免丢掉其中一份。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ħa żewġ kopji tal-indirizz?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ħa żewġ kopji tal-indirizz?

messages.en: Why did Mark take two copies of the address?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kkawtela ruħu, f'każ li jitlef waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Kkawtela ruħu, f'każ li jitlef waħda.
messages.zh: 他事先做好防备，以免丢掉其中一份。
messages.en: He took precautions in case he loses one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前多备一份重要文件，把 kkawtela ruħu 整体记成“提前为自己做好防备”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To search for and pursue wild animals in order to catch or kill them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寻找并追逐野生动物，以捕获或猎杀它们。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fittex u ġera wara annimali selvaġġi biex jaqbadhom jew joqtolhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打猎；追捕野生动物。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi kif ir-raġel kkaċċja l-fniek fil-kampanja.
formal.en: The story describes how the man hunted rabbits in the countryside.
formal.zh: 这篇故事描述了那名男子如何在乡间猎捕兔子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel in-nannu fir-rakkont? Mark: Kkaċċja l-fniek, imbagħad mar lura d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the grandfather do in the story? Mark: He hunted rabbits, then went back home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里的爷爷做了什么？马克：他猎捕兔子，然后回家了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的爷爷做了什么？
messages.en: What did the grandfather do in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kkaċċja l-fniek, imbagħad mar lura d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Kkaċċja l-fniek, imbagħad mar lura d-dar.
messages.zh: 他猎捕兔子，然后回家了。
messages.en: He hunted rabbits, then went back home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kkaċċja 与“在树林里追寻猎物”的画面绑定，连同 l-fniek（兔子）一起记成猎捕动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an event, condition, or result happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某件事情、某种状况或某个结果发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wassal biex tiġri xi ħaġa jew biex jinħoloq ċertu riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成；引起；使某种结果发生。

formal.mt: L-inċident kkaġuna dewmien fit-trasport pubbliku matul il-għodu.
formal.en: The accident caused delays to public transport during the morning.
formal.zh: 这起事故造成了上午公共交通的延误。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex wasalt tard? Pawlu: Inċident fit-triq kkaġuna dewmien kbir.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you arrive late? Pawlu: An accident on the road caused a long delay.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么迟到了？保罗：路上的一起事故造成了很长时间的延误。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 路上的一起事故造成了很长时间的延误。
messages.en: An accident on the road caused a long delay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“事故→延误”的因果箭头记 kkaġuna：箭头前是原因，箭头后是它造成的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strike a ball with the foot so that it moves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用脚踢球，使球移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laqat ballun b'siequ biex iċaqalqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 踢球；用脚击球，使球移动。

collocations.en: kicked the ball towards the goal
kicked the ball with the left foot

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar minuta tal-partita, il-plejer kkikkja l-ballun lejn il-lasta, iżda l-gowler waqqfu.
formal.en: In the last minute of the match, the player kicked the ball towards the goal, but the goalkeeper stopped it.
formal.zh: 比赛最后一分钟，那名球员把球踢向球门，但守门员将球挡住了。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Min kkikkja l-ballun fuq il-bejt? Mark: Tom, imma ma riedx jibagħtu hemm!
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Who kicked the ball onto the roof? Mark: Tom, but he didn't mean to send it there!
colloquial.zh: 保罗：谁把球踢到屋顶上去了？马克：汤姆，不过他不是故意把球踢到那儿的！

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把球踢到屋顶上去了？
messages.en: Who kicked the ball onto the roof?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tom, imma ma riedx jibagħtu hemm!
messages.mt_standard: Tom, imma ma riedx jibagħtu hemm!
messages.zh: 汤姆，不过他不是故意把球踢到那儿的！

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arrange things into groups according to shared features or stated criteria.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据共同特征或明确标准，把事物分成不同类别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqassam affarijiet fi gruppi skont karatteristiċi komuni jew kriterji stabbiliti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按照特征或标准分类、归类。

collocations.zh: 按主题对文件进行了分类
把动物分成了不同类别

formal.mt: Il-bibljotekarju kklassifika l-kotba skont is-suġġett biex il-qarrejja jsibuhom aktar faċilment.
formal.en: The librarian classified the books by subject so that readers could find them more easily.
formal.zh: 图书管理员按主题对书籍进行了分类，以便读者更容易找到它们。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se nsib ir-ritratti tal-vaganza? Mark: Ħija kklassifika r-ritratti skont is-sena; fittex fil-folder tas-sena l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: How am I going to find the holiday photos? Mark: My brother classified the photos by year; look in last year's folder.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我要怎么找到度假的照片？马克：我哥哥按年份把照片分类了，去找去年的文件夹吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要怎么找到度假的照片？
messages.en: How am I going to find the holiday photos?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija kklassifika r-ritratti skont is-sena; fittex fil-folder tas-sena l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija kklassifika r-ritratti skont is-sena; fittex fil-folder tas-sena l-oħra.
messages.zh: 我哥哥按年份把照片分类了，去找去年的文件夹吧。
