cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“给照片分文件夹”的画面绑定：先选年份等标准，再把同类放到一起，就是分类。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To direct people by giving orders, or to exercise control over a group or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过发出命令指挥他人，或对某个群体、局面行使控制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tmexxi nies billi tagħti ordnijiet, jew teżerċita kontroll fuq grupp jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下令指挥；掌控、控制。

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, l-uffiċjal kkmanda lit-truppi u ta struzzjonijiet ċari lil kull grupp.
formal.en: During the exercise, the officer commanded the troops and gave clear instructions to each group.
formal.zh: 演习期间，军官指挥部队，并向每个小组下达了明确指令。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min kkmanda l-operazzjoni fl-eżerċizzju tal-lum? Pawlu: Il-kaptan; aħna segwejna l-ordnijiet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who commanded the operation in today's exercise? Pawlu: The captain; we followed his orders.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天演习中的行动由谁指挥？保罗：上尉，我们按照他的命令行动。

messages.speaker: Lara (学员)
messages.zh: 今天演习中的行动由谁指挥？
messages.en: Who commanded the operation in today's exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同组学员)
messages.zh: 上尉，我们按照他的命令行动。
messages.en: The captain; we followed his orders.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象指挥官发出命令、各组照令行动：这个词的重点是拥有指挥权并控制行动方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become thicker and form a clot or solid mass, or to cause a substance to do so.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体变稠并形成凝块或固体团块，或使某种物质发生这种变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Issir eħxen u tifforma għoqda jew massa solida, jew iġġiegħel sustanza tagħmel dan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凝固、凝结成块；使凝固。

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, il-ħalib kkoagula u fforma massa aktar soda.
formal.en: During the experiment, the milk coagulated and formed a firmer mass.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，牛奶发生凝结，形成了较为结实的团块。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-ħalib m'għadux likwidu bħal qabel? Toni: Kkoagula; ara l-biċċiet li ffurmaw.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why isn't the milk liquid like before anymore? Toni: It coagulated; look at the lumps that formed.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么牛奶不像刚才那样是液体了？托尼：它凝结了，看看形成的那些块。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħalib m'għadux likwidu bħal qabel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħalib m'għadux likwidu bħal qabel?
messages.zh: 为什么牛奶不像刚才那样是液体了？
messages.en: Why isn't the milk liquid like before anymore?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 它凝结了，看看形成的那些块。
messages.en: It coagulated; look at the lumps that formed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“原本能流动，后来结成块”的变化画面；看到血液凝块或牛奶凝结，就联想这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To organize laws, rules, or principles into a clear, systematic written body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把法律、规则或原则整理成清晰、有系统的书面体系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Torganizza liġijiet, regoli jew prinċipji f'ġabra miktuba b'mod ċar u sistematiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把法律、规则等系统整理并编纂成文。

collocations.zh: 将行为规则系统编纂成文

formal.mt: Il-kumitat kkodifika r-regoli tal-assoċjazzjoni f'dokument wieħed biex il-membri jkunu jistgħu jikkonsultawhom faċilment.
formal.en: The committee codified the association's rules in a single document so that members could consult them easily.
formal.zh: 委员会将协会规则系统编入同一份文件，方便会员查阅。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn nista' nsib ir-regoli kollha tal-klabb? Mark: Il-kumitat kkodifika kollox f'dan il-ktejjeb; issa tista' ssibhom kollha hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where can I find all the club rules? Mark: The committee codified everything in this booklet; now you can find them all here.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：在哪里能找到俱乐部的全部规则？马克：委员会把所有规则都系统编进这本小册子了，现在这里就能全部查到。

messages.speaker: Nina (俱乐部会员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nsib ir-regoli kollha tal-klabb?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nsib ir-regoli kollha tal-klabb?
messages.zh: 在哪里能找到俱乐部的全部规则？
messages.en: Where can I find all the club rules?

messages.speaker: Mark (俱乐部秘书)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumitat kkodifika kollox f'dan il-ktejjeb; issa tista' ssibhom kollha hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumitat kkodifika kollox f'dan il-ktejjeb; issa tista' ssibhom kollha hawn.
messages.zh: 委员会把所有规则都系统编进这本小册子了，现在这里就能全部查到。
messages.en: The committee codified everything in this booklet; now you can find them all here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把散落在不同纸张上的规则按主题整理成一本手册；这个整理成体系的动作就是编纂。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work together with another person or group toward a shared task or goal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与其他人或团体共同工作，以完成共同任务或实现共同目标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdem flimkien ma' persuna jew grupp ieħor biex twettqu kompitu jew tilħqu għan komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与他人合作、协作完成工作。

collocations.en: collaborated with a team of researchers
collocations.zh: 与一个研究团队开展了合作

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur kkollabora ma' żewġ skejjel biex jiġbor informazzjoni dwar id-drawwiet tal-qari.
formal.en: The researcher collaborated with two schools to gather information about reading habits.
formal.zh: 这位研究人员与两所学校合作，收集有关阅读习惯的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għenek tagħmel il-filmat? Luqa: Ħija kkollabora miegħi; jien ktibt it-test u hu ġibed il-filmat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who helped you make the video? Luqa: My brother collaborated with me; I wrote the script and he filmed it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁帮你做了这个视频？卢卡：我哥哥和我合作，我写脚本，他负责拍摄。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁帮你做了这个视频？
messages.en: Who helped you make the video?

messages.speaker: Luqa (视频创作者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija kkollabora miegħi; jien ktibt it-test u hu ġibed il-filmat.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija kkollabora miegħi; jien ktibt it-test u hu ġibed il-filmat.
messages.zh: 我哥哥和我合作，我写脚本，他负责拍摄。
messages.en: My brother collaborated with me; I wrote the script and he filmed it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“两个人分工做同一个视频”来记忆：一人写脚本、一人拍摄，目标相同、一起完成，就是合作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To compare copies of a text carefully for differences, or to gather pages into their correct order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仔细对照文本的不同副本以找出差异，或将书页收集并按正确顺序整理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqabbel bir-reqqa kopji ta' test biex issib differenzi, jew tiġbor paġni fl-ordni t-tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对照校勘文本；核对并按顺序整理书页或材料。

collocations.en: collated two copies of the text
collocations.zh: 对照校勘了文本的两个副本

collocations.en: collated the pages of the report
collocations.zh: 核对并按顺序整理了报告的书页

formal.mt: L-editur kkollazzjona żewġ kopji tal-manuskritt u niżżel id-differenzi f'lista separata.
formal.en: The editor collated two copies of the manuscript and recorded the differences in a separate list.
formal.zh: 编辑对照校勘了手稿的两个副本，并将差异记入一份单独的清单。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dawn iż-żewġ kopji jgħidu l-istess ħaġa? Ben: L-editur kkollazzjona t-testi u sab żewġ differenzi; ara hawn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do these two copies say the same thing? Ben: The editor collated the texts and found two differences; look here.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这两个副本的内容一样吗？本：编辑对照校勘了文本，发现两处差异，你看这里。

messages.speaker: Anna (编辑助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn iż-żewġ kopji jgħidu l-istess ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn iż-żewġ kopji jgħidu l-istess ħaġa?
messages.zh: 这两个副本的内容一样吗？
messages.en: Do these two copies say the same thing?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-editur kkollazzjona t-testi u sab żewġ differenzi; ara hawn.
messages.mt_standard: L-editur kkollazzjona t-testi u sab żewġ differenzi; ara hawn.
messages.zh: 编辑对照校勘了文本，发现两处差异，你看这里。
messages.en: The editor collated the texts and found two differences; look here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上并排放着两个文本副本，用手指逐行对照并圈出差异；整理书页时则逐页核对顺序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To place things together or close to one another in a particular arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照一定安排，把事物放在一起或彼此靠近的位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqiegħed affarijiet flimkien jew qrib xulxin skont arranġament partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将事物并置、放在一起或安排在相邻位置。

collocations.en: placed the two pictures next to each other
placed the objects together on the same table
collocations.zh: 把物件集中放在同一张桌子上

formal.mt: Il-kuratur kkolloka ż-żewġ pitturi ħdejn xulxin biex il-viżitaturi jkunu jistgħu jqabblu l-kuluri tagħhom.
formal.en: The curator placed the two paintings next to each other so that visitors could compare their colours.
formal.zh: 策展人将两幅画并置，方便参观者比较它们的色彩。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dawn iż-żewġ ritratti qegħdin ħdejn xulxin? Toni: Id-disinjatur kkolloka r-ritratti hekk biex inkunu nistgħu naraw id-differenza.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are these two photos next to each other? Toni: The designer placed the photos together like that so we can see the difference.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么这两张照片放在一起？托尼：设计师这样并排放置照片，是为了让我们看出差别。

messages.speaker: Lara (展览参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dawn iż-żewġ ritratti qegħdin ħdejn xulxin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dawn iż-żewġ ritratti qegħdin ħdejn xulxin?
messages.zh: 为什么这两张照片放在一起？
messages.en: Why are these two photos next to each other?

messages.speaker: Toni (展览讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-disinjatur kkolloka r-ritratti hekk biex inkunu nistgħu naraw id-differenza.
messages.mt_standard: Id-disinjatur kkolloka r-ritratti hekk biex inkunu nistgħu naraw id-differenza.
messages.zh: 设计师这样并排放置照片，是为了让我们看出差别。
messages.en: The designer placed the photos together like that so we can see the difference.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把两张照片并排摆好，方便比较”的空间画面记忆；抓住物件被放到一起这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To establish a colony in a territory and bring it under the control of an outside power.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某片领土建立殖民地，并使其受到外来势力的控制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tistabbilixxi kolonja f'territorju u tqiegħdu taħt il-kontroll ta' qawwa barranija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某地建立殖民地并实施殖民统治。

collocations.zh: 在一座岛屿建立了殖民统治
在一片新领土建立了殖民统治

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-imperu kkolonizza l-gżira u impona l-liġijiet tiegħu fuq l-abitanti.
formal.en: In the novel, the empire colonized the island and imposed its laws on the inhabitants.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，帝国对岛屿实施殖民统治，并强迫居民遵守帝国的法律。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel l-imperu fil-ktieb li qed taqra? Luqa: Kkolonizza l-gżira; issa l-abitanti jridu jerġgħu jiksbu l-indipendenza.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the empire do in the book you're reading? Luqa: It colonized the island; now the inhabitants want to regain their independence.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你正在读的书里，那个帝国做了什么？卢卡：它殖民了那座岛，现在岛上的居民想重新获得独立。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel l-imperu fil-ktieb li qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel l-imperu fil-ktieb li qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你正在读的书里，那个帝国做了什么？
messages.en: What did the empire do in the book you're reading?

messages.speaker: Luqa (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kkolonizza l-gżira; issa l-abitanti jridu jerġgħu jiksbu l-indipendenza.
messages.mt_standard: Kkolonizza l-gżira; issa l-abitanti jridu jerġgħu jiksbu l-indipendenza.
messages.zh: 它殖民了那座岛，现在岛上的居民想重新获得独立。
messages.en: It colonized the island; now the inhabitants want to regain their independence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住小说中的三个相连画面：外来势力进入岛屿、建立殖民地、强加自身统治，以此理解殖民这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To finish a task or make something complete by supplying everything required.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完成任务，或补齐所需内容，使某事物完整。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Temm xogħol jew żied dak kollu li kien meħtieġ biex xi ħaġa tkun sħiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完成；做完；补齐。

formal.mt: L-istudent kkompleta l-kors u rċieva ċertifikat.
formal.en: The student completed the course and received a certificate.
formal.zh: 这名学生完成了课程，并获得了证书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark kkompleta l-formola? Lara: Iva, imlieha kollha u bagħatha dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark complete the form? Lara: Yes, he filled it all in and sent it this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark填完表格了吗？Lara：填完了，他把所有内容都填好了，今天早上已经发出去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: Mark填完表格了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark complete the form?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imlieha kollha u bagħatha dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imlieha kollha u bagħatha dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 填完了，他把所有内容都填好了，今天早上已经发出去了。
messages.en: Yes, he filled it all in and sent it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把待办清单的最后一格打勾，联想“全部完成”；填表、修课、做任务都可用这个画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To create a piece of music or a written work by arranging its parts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过组织音符或文字，创作乐曲或文字作品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoloq biċċa mużika jew kitba billi għaqqad u rranġa l-partijiet tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 创作；作曲；撰写作品。

formal.mt: Il-kompożitur kkompona biċċa mużika ġdida għall-orkestra tal-iskola.
formal.en: The composer composed a new piece of music for the school orchestra.
formal.zh: 这位作曲家为学校管弦乐团创作了一首新乐曲。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min kkompona din il-kanzunetta? Luqa: Ħija. Ilbieraħ daqqhieli fuq il-pjanu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who composed this song? Luqa: My brother. He played it for me on the piano yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这首歌是谁创作的？Luqa：我哥哥。他昨天用钢琴弹给我听了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这首歌是谁创作的？
messages.en: Who composed this song?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥。他昨天用钢琴弹给我听了。
messages.en: My brother. He played it for me on the piano yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一个个音符排列成完整旋律，用“音符组成作品”的画面记住“创作、作曲”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To share information, ideas, or feelings with another person or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向他人或群体传递信息、想法或感受，或与其沟通。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wassal informazzjoni, ideat jew sentimenti lil persuna oħra jew lil grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沟通；交流；传达信息。

formal.mt: Id-direttur kkomunika d-deċiżjoni lill-impjegati permezz ta' ittra uffiċjali.
formal.en: The director communicated the decision to the employees through an official letter.
formal.zh: 主管通过正式信函向员工传达了这一决定。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Pawlu kkomunika miegħek dwar il-laqgħa? Mark: Iva, qalli li se tibda fit-tlieta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did Pawlu communicate with you about the meeting? Mark: Yes, he told me it would start at three.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Pawlu就会议的事联系过你吗？Mark：联系过，他告诉我会议三点开始。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: Pawlu就会议的事联系过你吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu communicate with you about the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qalli li se tibda fit-tlieta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qalli li se tibda fit-tlieta.
messages.zh: 联系过，他告诉我会议三点开始。
messages.en: Yes, he told me it would start at three.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中画两个人传递信息的箭头：与谁沟通看对象，把什么传达出去看内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To acknowledge something one has done, especially a mistake, wrongdoing, or something previously concealed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 承认自己做过的事，尤其是错误、过失或先前隐瞒的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammetta xi ħaġa li għamel, speċjalment żball, ħtija jew xi ħaġa li qabel kien ħeba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坦白；承认；在宗教语境中也可指告解。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-istudent kkonfessa li kien ikkopja x-xogħol ta' sieħbu.
formal.en: In his letter, the student admitted that he had copied his classmate's work.
formal.zh: 这名学生在信中承认，他抄袭了同学的作业。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min kiser it-tazza? Lara: Ben kkonfessa li kien hu. Qal li se jixtri oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who broke the cup? Lara: Ben admitted it was him. He said he would buy another one.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把杯子打破了？Lara：Ben承认是他打破的。他说会再买一个。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把杯子打破了？
messages.en: Who broke the cup?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ben kkonfessa li kien hu. Qal li se jixtri oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Ben kkonfessa li kien hu. Qal li se jixtri oħra.
messages.zh: Ben承认是他打破的。他说会再买一个。
messages.en: Ben admitted it was him. He said he would buy another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人举手说“是我做的”，用主动说出隐瞒事实的场景记住“坦白、承认”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give or form the different grammatical forms of a verb, such as those for person, number, or tense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据人称、数或时态等语法要求，列出或构成动词的不同形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta jew ifforma l-forom differenti ta' verb skont il-persuna, l-għadd jew iż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使动词变位；列出动词的变位形式。

collocations.en: conjugated the verb in the past tense
collocations.zh: 列出了该动词的过去时变位

formal.mt: L-għalliem kkonjuga l-verb fil-passat u spjega kull forma lill-istudenti.
formal.en: The teacher conjugated the verb in the past tense and explained each form to the students.
formal.zh: 老师列出了该动词的过去时变位，并向学生解释了每一种形式。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif għamel Luqa dan l-eżerċizzju? Maja: Kkonjuga l-verb għal kull persuna. Ejja nħarsu lejn it-tweġibiet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Luqa do this exercise? Maja: He conjugated the verb for each person. Let's look at his answers.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Luqa是怎么做这道练习的？Maja：他按各个人称写出了动词变位。我们看看他的答案吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: Luqa是怎么做这道练习的？
messages.en: How did Luqa do this exercise?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kkonjuga l-verb għal kull persuna. Ejja nħarsu lejn it-tweġibiet tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Kkonjuga l-verb għal kull persuna. Ejja nħarsu lejn it-tweġibiet tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他按各个人称写出了动词变位。我们看看他的答案吧。
messages.en: He conjugated the verb for each person. Let's look at his answers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象动词随着“我、你、他”和时间换上不同外衣；给动词换语法外衣，就是进行变位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring an activity to an end, or to reach a judgment after considering information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使活动结束或完成；也指考虑信息后作出判断、得出结论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Temm attività jew xogħol, jew wasal għal konklużjoni wara li qies l-informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结束；完成；使某项活动或工作告终。

sense_translations.en_definition: to conclude, arrive at a conclusion
sense_translations.zh_definition: 得出结论；根据所考虑的信息作出判断。

collocations.en: concluded that there was an error
collocations.zh: 得出了存在错误的结论

formal.mt: Wara li eżamina d-data, ir-riċerkatur kkonkluda li kien hemm bżonn ta' studju ieħor.
formal.en: After examining the data, the researcher concluded that another study was needed.
formal.zh: 研究人员检查数据后得出结论，认为还需要开展另一项研究。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-laqgħa għadha għaddejja? Mark: Le, id-direttur kkonkluda l-laqgħa għaxar minuti ilu. Issa nistgħu nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the meeting still going on? Mark: No, the director concluded the meeting ten minutes ago. We can leave now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：会议还在开吗？Mark：没有，主管十分钟前已经结束会议了。我们现在可以走了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 会议还在开吗？
messages.en: Is the meeting still going on?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, id-direttur kkonkluda l-laqgħa għaxar minuti ilu. Issa nistgħu nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, id-direttur kkonkluda l-laqgħa għaxar minuti ilu. Issa nistgħu nitilqu.
messages.zh: 没有，主管十分钟前已经结束会议了。我们现在可以走了。
messages.en: No, the director concluded the meeting ten minutes ago. We can leave now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个收尾画面记忆：会议散场是“结束”，看完证据写下判断是“得出结论”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To try to ease another person's sadness through comforting words or actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过安慰的话语或行动，设法减轻他人的悲伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ipprova jtaffi d-dwejjaq ta' persuna oħra bi kliem jew b'għemil ta' faraġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to console (try to alleviate someone's sadness)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 安慰；设法减轻某人的悲伤。

formal.mt: L-għalliem kkonsla lill-istudent wara li dan ma għaddiex mill-eżami.
formal.en: The teacher consoled the student after the student failed the exam.
formal.zh: 这名学生考试没有及格，老师随后安慰了他。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif inhu Ben wara t-telfa? Luqa: Għadu mdejjaq, imma Mark kkonsla lil Ben u qagħad jitkellem miegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: How is Ben after the defeat? Luqa: He's still upset, but Mark consoled Ben and spent time talking with him.
colloquial.zh: Sara：输了比赛后，Ben怎么样？Luqa：他还是很难过，不过Mark安慰了他，还陪他聊了一会儿。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 输了比赛后，Ben怎么样？
messages.en: How is Ben after the defeat?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu mdejjaq, imma Mark kkonsla lil Ben u qagħad jitkellem miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu mdejjaq, imma Mark kkonsla lil Ben u qagħad jitkellem miegħu.
messages.zh: 他还是很难过，不过Mark安慰了他，还陪他聊了一会儿。
messages.en: He's still upset, but Mark consoled Ben and spent time talking with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象坐在难过的朋友身旁，轻声说话并陪着他；把这个减轻悲伤的动作记作“安慰”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give money, time, work, or ideas to help a shared activity or result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为共同的活动或成果提供金钱、时间、劳动或想法，作出贡献。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta flus, ħin, xogħol jew ideat biex jgħin f'attività jew f'riżultat komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贡献；出力；提供帮助或捐助。

formal.mt: Il-voluntier kkontribwixxa għall-proġett billi għen fit-tindif tal-ġnien.
formal.en: The volunteer contributed to the project by helping to clean the garden.
formal.zh: 这名志愿者通过帮忙清理花园，为该项目作出了贡献。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min kkontribwixxa għall-flus tar-rigal? Lara: Ben ta għaxar ewro, u Sara tat ħamsa. Jien se nagħti ħamsa wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who contributed money towards the gift? Lara: Ben gave ten euros, and Sara gave five. I'll give five too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁出钱买礼物了？Lara：Ben出了十欧元，Sara出了五欧元。我也会出五欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁出钱买礼物了？
messages.en: Who contributed money towards the gift?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ben ta għaxar ewro, u Sara tat ħamsa. Jien se nagħti ħamsa wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Ben ta għaxar ewro, u Sara tat ħamsa. Jien se nagħti ħamsa wkoll.
messages.zh: Ben出了十欧元，Sara出了五欧元。我也会出五欧元。
messages.en: Ben gave ten euros, and Sara gave five. I'll give five too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家一起完成拼图，有人出钱、有人出力、有人出主意；每人添上的一块就是“贡献”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put right a mistake or something incorrect; also, to point out someone's wrongdoing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 纠正错误或不正确的内容；也可指指出某人的过错并加以训诫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jirranġa żball jew xi ħaġa mhux korretta; ukoll, li jwissi lil xi ħadd dwar imġiba ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纠正；改正错误。
修正、纠正不妥之处；责备、训诫某人。

formal.mt: L-editur kkoreġa l-iżbalji fit-test qabel il-pubblikazzjoni.
formal.en: The editor corrected the errors in the text before publication.
formal.zh: 编辑在出版前纠正了文本中的错误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad hemm żball fl-indirizz? Mark: Le, Pawlu kkoreġa l-indirizz dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there still a mistake in the address? Mark: No, Pawlu corrected the address this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：地址里还有错误吗？Mark：没有，Pawlu 今天早上已经把地址改对了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 地址里还有错误吗？
messages.en: Is there still a mistake in the address?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 没有，Pawlu 今天早上已经把地址改对了。
messages.en: No, Pawlu corrected the address this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kkoreġa 和红笔改错的画面连起来记：先圈出错误，再把内容改正确；用于人时，也可能表示指出过错、加以训诫。

gloss_zh: 从事海盗活动；在海上劫掠

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act as a pirate by attacking or robbing ships at sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以海盗身份在海上袭击或抢劫船只，从事海盗活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaġixxi bħala pirata billi jattakka jew jisraq bastimenti fuq il-baħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to pirate, to engage in piracy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 当海盗；从事海上劫掠活动。

collocations.en: engaged in piracy along the coast

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kaptan kkorseġġja għal snin sħaħ u attakka bastimenti merkantili.
formal.en: In the story, the captain engaged in piracy for years and attacked merchant ships.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，船长多年从事海盗活动，袭击商船。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel il-kaptan f'dan ir-rakkont? Ninu: Kkorseġġja tul il-kosta u seraq il-merkanzija minn fuq il-bastimenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the captain do in this story? Ninu: He engaged in piracy along the coast and stole cargo from ships.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个故事里的船长做了什么？Ninu：他沿海岸进行海盗劫掠，抢走船上的货物。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的船长做了什么？
messages.en: What did the captain do in this story?

messages.speaker: Ninu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kkorseġġja tul il-kosta u seraq il-merkanzija minn fuq il-bastimenti.
messages.mt_standard: Kkorseġġja tul il-kosta u seraq il-merkanzija minn fuq il-bastimenti.
messages.zh: 他沿海岸进行海盗劫掠，抢走船上的货物。
messages.en: He engaged in piracy along the coast and stole cargo from ships.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kkorseġġja 放进海盗故事来记：海盗船靠近商船，登船抢走货物。用完整场景帮助记住“从事海盗活动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To run here and there around a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某个地方跑来跑去，四处奔跑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġri minn naħa għal oħra f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跑来跑去；四处奔跑。

collocations.en: ran from one side to another

formal.mt: Matul il-ħin tal-logħob, it-tifel kkorsja fil-bitħa mal-ħbieb tiegħu.
formal.en: During playtime, the boy ran about in the yard with his friends.
formal.zh: 游戏时间里，男孩和朋友们在院子里跑来跑去。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex il-kelb għajjien daqshekk? Toni: Kkorsja fil-ġnien wara l-ballun għal siegħa sħiħa!
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is the dog so tired? Toni: He ran about in the garden chasing the ball for a whole hour!
colloquial.zh: Marta：狗怎么这么累？Toni：它在花园里追着球跑来跑去，整整跑了一个小时！

messages.speaker: Marta (姐姐)
messages.zh: 狗怎么这么累？
messages.en: Why is the dog so tired?

messages.speaker: Toni (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Kkorsja fil-ġnien wara l-ballun għal siegħa sħiħa!
messages.mt_standard: Kkorsja fil-ġnien wara l-ballun għal siegħa sħiħa!
messages.zh: 它在花园里追着球跑来跑去，整整跑了一个小时！
messages.en: He ran about in the garden chasing the ball for a whole hour!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kkorsja 时想象小狗追球：左边跑一下，右边跑一下，整个院子都跑遍。重点抓住“跑来跑去”的动态画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To form something, make up part of it, or amount to a particular thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 组成某事物或成为其中一部分；也指构成某种情况或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jifforma xi ħaġa jew parti minnha, jew li jkun meqjus bħala xi ħaġa partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 构成；组成；成为某事物的组成部分。

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' tagħmir kkostitwixxa ostaklu għat-tlestija tal-proġett.
formal.en: The lack of equipment constituted an obstacle to completing the project.
formal.zh: 设备不足构成了完成项目的障碍。

colloquial.mt: Sara: In-nuqqas ta' tagħmir kien problema? David: Iva, kkostitwixxa ostaklu kbir; ma stajniex inkomplu x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was the lack of equipment a problem? David: Yes, it constituted a major obstacle; we couldn't carry on with the work.
colloquial.zh: Sara：设备不足是个问题吗？David：是的，这构成了很大的障碍；我们没法继续工作。

messages.speaker: Sara (项目同事)
messages.zh: 设备不足是个问题吗？
messages.en: Was the lack of equipment a problem?

messages.speaker: David (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kkostitwixxa ostaklu kbir; ma stajniex inkomplu x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kkostitwixxa ostaklu kbir; ma stajniex inkomplu x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 是的，这构成了很大的障碍；我们没法继续工作。
messages.en: Yes, it constituted a major obstacle; we couldn't carry on with the work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kkostitwixxa 放进句框“这构成了……”来记：构成障碍、构成问题、构成重要部分。每次补上具体内容，练习它的连接作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stop working suddenly, especially of a computer or program, or to collide violently, especially of a vehicle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指电脑或程序突然停止正常运行、崩溃；也指车辆等发生猛烈碰撞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jieqaf jaħdem f'daqqa, speċjalment kompjuter jew programm, jew li jaħbat bil-qawwa, speċjalment vettura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 崩溃、突然停止运行；撞毁、发生猛烈碰撞。

formal.mt: Il-programm kkraxxja waqt l-ipproċessar tad-data, u l-utent kellu jerġa' jiftħu.
formal.en: The program crashed while processing the data, and the user had to open it again.
formal.zh: 程序在处理数据时崩溃，用户不得不重新打开它。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex waqaft tikteb? Mark: Il-kompjuter kkraxxja! Nittama li d-dokument ġie ssejvjat.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you stop writing? Mark: The computer crashed! I hope the document was saved.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你怎么不写了？Mark：电脑崩溃了！希望文档已经保存了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你怎么不写了？
messages.en: Why did you stop writing?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kompjuter kkraxxja! Nittama li d-dokument ġie ssejvjat.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kompjuter kkraxxja! Nittama li d-dokument ġie ssejvjat.
messages.zh: 电脑崩溃了！希望文档已经保存了。
messages.en: The computer crashed! I hope the document was saved.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kkraxxja 时联想英语 crash，再配两个画面：电脑突然停止运行，或车辆猛烈碰撞。用主语判断具体是哪一种“崩溃或碰撞”。

gloss_zh: 把款项记入账户；将功劳归于

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter money into an account, or to acknowledge someone as responsible for an achievement or contribution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把款项记入某个账户；也指承认某人的贡献，把成就或功劳归于某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jżid ammont ta' flus f'kont, jew li jagħraf il-mertu ta' xi ħadd għal kisba jew kontribut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把款项记入账户；承认贡献或将功劳归于某人。

collocations.en: credited the team with the success

formal.mt: Il-bank kkredita l-kont tal-klijent bl-ammont tar-rifużjoni.
formal.en: The bank credited the customer's account with the refund amount.
formal.zh: 银行把退款金额记入了客户的账户。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Waslet ir-rifużjoni? Toni: Iva, il-bank kkredita l-kont tiegħi dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the refund arrived? Toni: Yes, the bank credited my account this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：退款到账了吗？Toni：到了，银行今天早上已经把钱记入我的账户了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 退款到账了吗？
messages.en: Has the refund arrived?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-bank kkredita l-kont tiegħi dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-bank kkredita l-kont tiegħi dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 到了，银行今天早上已经把钱记入我的账户了。
messages.en: Yes, the bank credited my account this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kkredita 想成两种“记到名下”：钱记到账户名下，功劳记到贡献者名下。用“款项入账”和“承认贡献”两个场景分别练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To add or apply colour to something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给某物涂上颜色，使其着色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti jew iżid il-kulur lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂色；着色；给某物加上颜色。

formal.mt: L-istudent kkulura l-mappa biex juri ż-żoni differenti b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The student coloured the map to show the different areas clearly.
formal.zh: 学生给地图着色，以清楚地显示不同区域。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min kkulura dawn il-fjuri bl-aħmar? Pawlu: Jien! U żidt ftit isfar fin-nofs.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who coloured these flowers red? Pawlu: I did! And I added a little yellow in the middle.
colloquial.zh: Marta：谁把这些花涂成了红色？Pawlu：我！我还在中间加了一点黄色。

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.zh: 谁把这些花涂成了红色？
messages.en: Who coloured these flowers red?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! U żidt ftit isfar fin-nofs.
messages.mt_standard: Jien! U żidt ftit isfar fin-nofs.
messages.zh: 我！我还在中间加了一点黄色。
messages.en: I did! And I added a little yellow in the middle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kkulura 和一本待涂色的画册连起来：拿起彩笔，白色花朵变成红色。再用“给图片涂色”这个完整搭配帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 委托创作；委托制作或开展工作

teaching_sense.en_definition: To formally ask someone to produce a work or carry out a task, usually for payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式委托某人创作作品、制作物品或完成某项工作，通常支付报酬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqabbad lil xi ħadd joħloq xogħol jew iwettaq biċċa xogħol, normalment bi ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 委托创作或制作；委托某人完成工作。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill kkummissjona rapport dwar il-ħtiġijiet tat-trasport fir-raħal.
formal.en: The council commissioned a report on transport needs in the village.
formal.zh: 议会委托编写了一份关于该村交通需求的报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min talab din il-pittura għall-ħanut? Mark: Sid il-ħanut kkummissjona l-pittura mingħand artista lokali.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who requested this painting for the shop? Mark: The shop owner commissioned the painting from a local artist.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁为店里订制了这幅画？Mark：店主委托一位本地艺术家创作了这幅画。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 谁为店里订制了这幅画？
messages.en: Who requested this painting for the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Sid il-ħanut kkummissjona l-pittura mingħand artista lokali.
messages.mt_standard: Sid il-ħanut kkummissjona l-pittura mingħand artista lokali.
messages.zh: 店主委托一位本地艺术家创作了这幅画。
messages.en: The shop owner commissioned the painting from a local artist.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kkummissjona 时想象店主向画家提出要求，再由画家完成新作品。把“提出委托—对方制作”的过程连成画面，也可换成委托编写报告。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To think carefully about something before making a decision or forming an opinion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在作出决定或形成看法之前，仔细思考某件事及其相关因素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħseb sew dwar xi ħaġa qabel tieħu deċiżjoni jew tifforma opinjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 考虑；仔细思考或斟酌某件事。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ikkunsidra l-ispejjeż u l-benefiċċji qabel approva l-proġett.
formal.en: The committee considered the costs and benefits before approving the project.
formal.zh: 委员会在批准项目之前，考虑了成本与收益。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Diġà ddeċidejt liema kors se tagħżel? Mark: Għadni le. Irrid nikkunsidra l-għażliet kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you decided which course to choose yet? Mark: Not yet. I want to consider all the options.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你已经决定选哪门课程了吗？马克：还没有。我想考虑一下所有选项。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà ddeċidejt liema kors se tagħżel?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà ddeċidejt liema kors se tagħżel?
messages.zh: 你已经决定选哪门课程了吗？
messages.en: Have you decided which course to choose yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Irrid nikkunsidra l-għażliet kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Irrid nikkunsidra l-għażliet kollha.
messages.zh: 还没有。我想考虑一下所有选项。
messages.en: Not yet. I want to consider all the options.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面前摆着几个课程选项，逐一比较后再决定，用这个画面记住“考虑、斟酌”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express disagreement with someone in an argument.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因意见不合而与他人争论或争执。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Targumenta ma' xi ħadd għax ma taqbilx miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 争论；因意见不合而与人争执。

formal.mt: Il-kerrej kkustinja mas-sid dwar min kellu jħallas għat-tiswijiet.
formal.en: The tenant argued with the owner about who should pay for the repairs.
formal.zh: 租客与房东就应由谁支付维修费发生了争论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu kien irrabjat? Mark: Kkustinja ma' ħuh dwar min kellu juża l-karozza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was Pawlu angry? Mark: He argued with his brother about who should use the car.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么生气？马克：他和兄弟为了该由谁用车争了起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么生气？
messages.en: Why was Pawlu angry?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kkustinja ma' ħuh dwar min kellu juża l-karozza.
messages.mt_standard: Kkustinja ma' ħuh dwar min kellu juża l-karozza.
messages.zh: 他和兄弟为了该由谁用车争了起来。
messages.en: He argued with his brother about who should use the car.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“两个人争着用同一辆车”的场景，记住它表示意见不合时的争论。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To state the current price of a financial security, or to repeat or refer to someone else's statement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 报出某种金融证券的当前价格；或复述、引用他人已经说过的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti l-prezz kurrenti ta' titolu finanzjarju, jew tirrepeti jew tirreferi għal kliem li qal ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to quote (to name the current price of a financial security)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 报价：报出某种金融证券的当前价格。

sense_translations.en_definition: to quote (to refer to a statement that has been made by someone else)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 引用：援引他人已经作出的陈述或说过的话。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-analista kkwota l-prezz kurrenti tal-ishma u kkwota wkoll stqarrija tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: In his report, the analyst quoted the current share price and also quoted a statement by the company.
formal.zh: 分析师在报告中报出了股票的当前价格，也引用了公司的一份声明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġibt dik is-sentenza? Mark: Ikkwotajt kliem l-għalliem. Hu qalha fil-lezzjoni tal-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you get that sentence from? Mark: I quoted the teacher's words. He said it in yesterday's lesson.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你那句话是从哪里来的？马克：我引用了老师的话。他在昨天的课上说过。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你那句话是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where did you get that sentence from?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikkwotajt kliem l-għalliem. Hu qalha fil-lezzjoni tal-bieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Ikkwotajt kliem l-għalliem. Hu qalha fil-lezzjoni tal-bieraħ.
messages.zh: 我引用了老师的话。他在昨天的课上说过。
messages.en: I quoted the teacher's words. He said it in yesterday's lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个记忆框：一个写股票价格，一个画引号；分别对应“报出证券现价”和“引用话语”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of related families whose members share a common ancestry or family identity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由具有共同祖先或共同家族认同的多个亲属家庭组成的群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' familji marbutin bejniethom permezz ta' antenati jew identità familjari komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 氏族；宗族，即具有共同血缘或家族认同的亲属群体。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi r-rabtiet bejn il-familji li jiffurmaw il-klann.
formal.en: The study describes the ties between the families that make up the clan.
formal.zh: 这项研究描述了组成该氏族的各个家庭之间的联系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fil-ktieb, dawn il-familji kollha huma tal-istess klann? Mark: Iva, għandhom antenat komuni.
colloquial.en: Maja: In the book, do all these families belong to the same clan? Mark: Yes, they have a common ancestor.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：书里的这些家庭都属于同一个氏族吗？马克：对，他们有共同的祖先。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-ktieb, dawn il-familji kollha huma tal-istess klann?
messages.mt_standard: Fil-ktieb, dawn il-familji kollha huma tal-istess klann?
messages.zh: 书里的这些家庭都属于同一个氏族吗？
messages.en: In the book, do all these families belong to the same clan?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 对，他们有共同的祖先。
messages.en: Yes, they have a common ancestor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一棵族谱上分出许多家庭，但枝条连向共同祖先；整片亲属群体就是氏族。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woodwind instrument with a single reed, played by blowing through a mouthpiece and using fingers to control holes and keys.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种使用单片簧片的木管乐器，通过吹奏吹嘴并用手指控制音孔和按键来发声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument tal-injam b'ilsien wieħed, li jindaqq billi tonfoħ fil-biċċa tal-ħalq u tikkontrolla t-toqob u l-imfietaħ bis-swaba'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 单簧管，一种使用单片簧片发声的木管乐器。

formal.mt: Fil-kunċert tal-iskola, Sara daqqet il-klarinett ma' grupp ta' studenti oħra.
formal.en: At the school concert, Sara played the clarinet with a group of other students.
formal.zh: 在学校音乐会上，萨拉与其他几名学生一起演出，吹奏了单簧管。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'strument qed titgħallem iddoqq? Mark: Il-klarinett. Għandi lezzjoni llum wara l-iskola.
colloquial.en: Maja: What instrument are you learning to play? Mark: The clarinet. I have a lesson after school today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在学什么乐器？马克：单簧管。我今天放学后有一节课。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你在学什么乐器？
messages.en: What instrument are you learning to play?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-klarinett. Għandi lezzjoni llum wara l-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Il-klarinett. Għandi lezzjoni llum wara l-iskola.
messages.zh: 单簧管。我今天放学后有一节课。
messages.en: The clarinet. I have a lesson after school today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词形与一支带按键的单簧管图片配对，再想象自己吹气、手指按键，记住这件乐器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be placed in a category according to shared features or an established system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够根据共同特征或既定体系划入某个类别的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jitqiegħed f'kategorija skont karatteristiċi komuni jew sistema stabbilita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可分类的；能够依据特征或分类体系归入某一类别的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjuni huma klassifikabbli skont il-forma, id-daqs u l-materjal tagħhom.
formal.en: The samples are classifiable by their shape, size, and material.
formal.zh: 这些样本可以按照形状、大小及材质分类。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn il-buttuni huma klassifikabbli skont il-kulur? Mark: Iva. Nistgħu npoġġu l-ħomor f'kaxxa u l-blu f'oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are these buttons classifiable by colour? Mark: Yes. We can put the red ones in one box and the blue ones in another.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些纽扣可以按颜色分类吗？马克：可以。我们可以把红色的放进一个盒子，把蓝色的放进另一个。

messages.speaker: Maja (手工课学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn il-buttuni huma klassifikabbli skont il-kulur?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-buttuni huma klassifikabbli skont il-kulur?
messages.zh: 这些纽扣可以按颜色分类吗？
messages.en: Are these buttons classifiable by colour?

messages.speaker: Mark (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Nistgħu npoġġu l-ħomor f'kaxxa u l-blu f'oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Nistgħu npoġġu l-ħomor f'kaxxa u l-blu f'oħra.
messages.zh: 可以。我们可以把红色的放进一个盒子，把蓝色的放进另一个。
messages.en: Yes. We can put the red ones in one box and the blue ones in another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把不同颜色的纽扣放进贴有标签的盒子；能按规则放入类别，就是“可分类的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or system that assigns things to categories according to their features.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据事物的特征，将其归入不同类别的人或系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew sistema li tqassam l-affarijiet f'kategoriji skont il-karatteristiċi tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分类者；将事物归入不同类别的分类器或分类系统。

formal.mt: Il-klassifikatur awtomatiku jqassam id-dokumenti skont is-suġġett tagħhom.
formal.en: The automatic classifier sorts the documents according to their subject.
formal.zh: 自动分类器根据文档的主题对其进行分类。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-klassifikatur jagħraf bejn aħbar u reklam? Mark: Iva, imma xi drabi jiżbalja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can this classifier tell a news item from an advertisement? Mark: Yes, but it sometimes makes mistakes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个分类器能区分新闻和广告吗？Mark：能，但有时会出错。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-klassifikatur jagħraf bejn aħbar u reklam?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-klassifikatur jagħraf bejn aħbar u reklam?
messages.zh: 这个分类器能区分新闻和广告吗？
messages.en: Can this classifier tell a news item from an advertisement?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.zh: 能，但有时会出错。
messages.en: Yes, but it sometimes makes mistakes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上的文档被逐一放进不同标签的盒子，把 klassifikatur 与负责分类的人或工具联系起来。

gloss_zh: 以古典方式；按古典传统

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a manner that follows classical forms, traditions, or methods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以遵循古典形式、传统或方法的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jsegwi forom, tradizzjonijiet jew metodi klassiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以古典方式；按照古典传统或规范。

collocations.zh: 受过古典音乐训练的音乐家

collocations.en: a piece performed in a classical manner
collocations.zh: 以古典方式演绎的曲目

formal.mt: Il-pjanista, imħarrġa klassikament, tat interpretazzjoni preċiża u sensittiva tas-sonata.
formal.en: The classically trained pianist gave a precise and sensitive interpretation of the sonata.
formal.zh: 这位受过古典音乐训练的女钢琴家准确而细腻地演绎了这首奏鸣曲。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int imħarreġ klassikament? Pawlu: Iva, studjajt il-pjanu għal għaxar snin, imma nħobb il-jazz ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you classically trained? Pawlu: Yes, I studied piano for ten years, but I like jazz too.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你受过古典音乐训练吗？Pawlu：是的，我学了十年钢琴，不过我也喜欢爵士乐。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你受过古典音乐训练吗？
messages.en: Are you classically trained?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (音乐家)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, studjajt il-pjanu għal għaxar snin, imma nħobb il-jazz ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, studjajt il-pjanu għal għaxar snin, imma nħobb il-jazz ukoll.
messages.zh: 是的，我学了十年钢琴，不过我也喜欢爵士乐。
messages.en: Yes, I studied piano for ten years, but I like jazz too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钢琴家按照古典传统练琴，用 klassikament 回答“以什么方式训练或演奏”，记住它是副词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who judges or treats people unfairly because of their social class.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因他人的社会阶级或阶层而对其抱有偏见、给予不公平待遇的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiġġudika jew tittratta lil ħaddieħor b'mod inġust minħabba l-klassi soċjali tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持阶级偏见者；因社会阶层而歧视他人的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, id-direttur huwa klassista li jiġġudika lill-ħaddiema skont il-familji tagħhom.
formal.en: In the novel, the director is a classist who judges workers according to their family backgrounds.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，主管是一个持阶级偏见的人，他根据工人的家庭背景评判他们。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed issejjaħlu klassista? Mark: Għax jgħid li min ġej minn familja fqira ma jistax ikun mexxej tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you calling him a classist? Mark: Because he says that someone from a poor family cannot be a good leader.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么说他持有阶级偏见？Mark：因为他说，出身贫困家庭的人不可能成为好领导。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他持有阶级偏见？
messages.en: Why are you calling him a classist?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jgħid li min ġej minn familja fqira ma jistax ikun mexxej tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jgħid li min ġej minn familja fqira ma jistax ikun mexxej tajjeb.
messages.zh: 因为他说，出身贫困家庭的人不可能成为好领导。
messages.en: Because he says that someone from a poor family cannot be a good leader.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 klassista 记成一个先看家境再评价别人的人物形象；本词条指持有偏见的“人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scholar who studies the languages, literature, or culture of ancient Greece and Rome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究古希腊、古罗马语言、文学或文化的学者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tistudja l-lingwi, il-letteratura jew il-kultura tal-Greċja u ta' Ruma tal-qedem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古典学者，研究古希腊、古罗马语言、文学或文化的人。

collocations.zh: 一位研究拉丁语的古典学者

formal.mt: Il-klassiċista analizza t-test Latin u spjega t-tifsira tiegħu lill-istudenti.
formal.en: The classicist analysed the Latin text and explained its meaning to the students.
formal.zh: 这位古典学者分析了拉丁文文本，并向学生解释其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jagħti t-taħdita dwar il-poeżija Griega? Mark: Klassiċista mill-università. Jistudja testi Griegi u Latini.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is giving the talk on Greek poetry? Mark: A classicist from the university. He studies Greek and Latin texts.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来讲希腊诗歌？马克：大学里的一位古典学者。他研究希腊文和拉丁文文本。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jagħti t-taħdita dwar il-poeżija Griega?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jagħti t-taħdita dwar il-poeżija Griega?
messages.zh: 谁来讲希腊诗歌？
messages.en: Who is giving the talk on Greek poetry?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Klassiċista mill-università. Jistudja testi Griegi u Latini.
messages.mt_standard: Klassiċista mill-università. Jistudja testi Griegi u Latini.
messages.zh: 大学里的一位古典学者。他研究希腊文和拉丁文文本。
messages.en: A classicist from the university. He studies Greek and Latin texts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位学者桌上同时放着希腊文和拉丁文书籍，用这个人物画面记住“古典学者”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An approach to art or literature that takes classical Greek and Roman models as ideals and values order, balance, and proportion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以古希腊、古罗马的典范为理想，并重视秩序、均衡与比例的艺术或文学取向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Approċċ fl-arti jew fil-letteratura li jieħu mudelli Griegi u Rumani tal-qedem bħala ideali u jagħti valur lill-ordni, lill-bilanċ u lill-proporzjon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古典主义，即以古典典范为理想、重视秩序、均衡和比例的艺术或文学取向。

formal.mt: L-esej jispjega kif l-ordni u l-bilanċ fil-kompożizzjoni jirriflettu l-prinċipji tal-klassiċiżmu.
formal.en: The essay explains how order and balance in the composition reflect the principles of classicism.
formal.zh: 这篇文章解释了构图中的秩序与均衡如何体现古典主义的原则。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għandi nfittex f'din il-pittura biex nifhem il-klassiċiżmu? Mark: Ħares lejn il-bilanċ u l-proporzjonijiet tal-figuri.
colloquial.en: Maja: What should I look for in this painting to understand classicism? Mark: Look at the balance and the proportions of the figures.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：要理解古典主义，我应该观察这幅画的哪些地方？马克：看看画面的均衡和人物的比例。

messages.speaker: Maja (美术学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għandi nfittex f'din il-pittura biex nifhem il-klassiċiżmu?
messages.mt_standard: X'għandi nfittex f'din il-pittura biex nifhem il-klassiċiżmu?
messages.zh: 要理解古典主义，我应该观察这幅画的哪些地方？
messages.en: What should I look for in this painting to understand classicism?

messages.speaker: Mark (美术教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn il-bilanċ u l-proporzjonijiet tal-figuri.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn il-bilanċ u l-proporzjonijiet tal-figuri.
messages.zh: 看看画面的均衡和人物的比例。
messages.en: Look at the balance and the proportions of the figures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在记忆卡上画一幅布局均衡、人物比例协调的画，旁边写“古典主义：秩序、均衡、比例”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Prejudice or unfair treatment based on a person's social class.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以个人所属的社会阶级或阶层为依据的偏见或不公平待遇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Preġudizzju jew trattament inġust ibbażat fuq il-klassi soċjali ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阶级偏见或阶级歧视，即因社会阶层不同而区别对待他人的观念或做法。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-klassiżmu jista' jillimita l-opportunitajiet ta' studenti minn familji bi dħul baxx.
formal.en: The report describes how classism can limit opportunities for students from low-income families.
formal.zh: 报告说明了阶级歧视如何限制低收入家庭学生的机会。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qalu li ma nistax ningħaqad magħhom għax il-familja tiegħi mhix sinjura. Nina: Dak hu klassiżmu; il-flus tal-familja ma jurux il-valur ta' persuna.
colloquial.en: Lara: They said I cannot join them because my family is not rich. Nina: That is classism; a family's money does not show a person's worth.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他们说我家不富裕，所以不能加入他们。Nina：那就是阶级歧视；家庭财富不能说明一个人的价值。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalu li ma nistax ningħaqad magħhom għax il-familja tiegħi mhix sinjura.
messages.mt_standard: Qalu li ma nistax ningħaqad magħhom għax il-familja tiegħi mhix sinjura.
messages.zh: 他们说我家不富裕，所以不能加入他们。
messages.en: They said I cannot join them because my family is not rich.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu klassiżmu; il-flus tal-familja ma jurux il-valur ta' persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu klassiżmu; il-flus tal-familja ma jurux il-valur ta' persuna.
messages.zh: 那就是阶级歧视；家庭财富不能说明一个人的价值。
messages.en: That is classism; a family's money does not show a person's worth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 klassiżmu 对应到“按家境分高低”的观念与行为，再与指人的 klassista 成对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A conflict or collision between people, ideas, interests, or things that do not fit together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人、观点、利益或彼此不相配的事物之间发生的冲突或碰撞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Konflitt jew ħabta bejn persuni, ideat, interessi jew affarijiet li ma jaqblux bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冲突、碰撞或不协调，可指意见、利益或事物之间的不相容。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa żvelat klaxx bejn il-prijoritajiet tal-amministrazzjoni u dawk tal-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The meeting revealed a clash between the administration's priorities and those of the workers.
formal.zh: 会议显露出管理层与工人在优先事项上的冲突。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex waqfet id-diskussjoni? Maja: Kien hemm klaxx ta' opinjonijiet, u ddeċidejna li nieħdu pawża.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did the discussion stop? Maja: There was a clash of opinions, and we decided to take a break.
colloquial.zh: Mark：讨论为什么停下来了？Maja：大家的意见发生了冲突，我们决定先休息一下。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 讨论为什么停下来了？
messages.en: Why did the discussion stop?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm klaxx ta' opinjonijiet, u ddeċidejna li nieħdu pawża.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm klaxx ta' opinjonijiet, u ddeċidejna li nieħdu pawża.
messages.zh: 大家的意见发生了冲突，我们决定先休息一下。
messages.en: There was a clash of opinions, and we decided to take a break.

cognitive_memory_aid: 可借英语 clash 的相近外形联想 klaxx，脑中画出两支意见箭头迎面相撞，记住“冲突”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small dog, expressed using the diminutive form of kelb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小狗；这是 kelb 的指小形式，强调狗的体型小。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelb żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' kelb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小狗，kelb 的指小形式。

collocations.en: I take the little dog for a walk

formal.mt: Il-voluntiera sabet klejjeb ħdejn il-bieb tax-xelter u poġġietu f'post sħun.
formal.en: The volunteer found a little dog beside the shelter door and placed it somewhere warm.
formal.zh: 女志愿者在收容所门边发现了一只小狗，并把它安置在温暖的地方。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ta' min hu dan il-klejjeb ħelu? Pawlu: Tiegħi! Jismu Bubi u jħobb jilgħab bil-ballun.
colloquial.en: Lara: Whose cute little dog is this? Pawlu: Mine! His name is Bubi, and he loves playing with a ball.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这只可爱的小狗是谁的？Pawlu：我的！它叫 Bubi，很喜欢玩球。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ta' min hu dan il-klejjeb ħelu?
messages.mt_standard: Ta' min hu dan il-klejjeb ħelu?
messages.zh: 这只可爱的小狗是谁的？
messages.en: Whose cute little dog is this?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiegħi! Jismu Bubi u jħobb jilgħab bil-ballun.
messages.mt_standard: Tiegħi! Jismu Bubi u jħobb jilgħab bil-ballun.
messages.zh: 我的！它叫 Bubi，很喜欢玩球。
messages.en: Mine! His name is Bubi, and he loves playing with a ball.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kelb 和 klejjeb 配成“大狗旁边站小狗”的记忆图；klejjeb 是指小形式，看到它就想到体型小。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Greed for obtaining more, or a very strong desire for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想要攫取更多的贪婪，或对某事物的强烈欲望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Regħba biex wieħed jikseb aktar, jew xewqa qawwija ħafna għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪婪；一味想要攫取或占有更多的欲望。
强烈欲望；对某事物极其迫切的渴求。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-klib għall-flus iwassal lin-negozjant biex jittratta lill-ħaddiema b'mod inġust.
formal.en: In the story, greed for money leads the merchant to treat the workers unfairly.
formal.zh: 在故事中，对金钱的贪欲使商人不公平地对待工人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser klib f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Hawn ifisser xewqa qawwija ħafna għas-setgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does klib mean in this sentence? Mark: Here it means a very intense desire for power.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这句话里的 klib 是什么意思？Mark：这里指对权力极其强烈的欲望。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 klib 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does klib mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser xewqa qawwija ħafna għas-setgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser xewqa qawwija ħafna għas-setgħa.
messages.zh: 这里指对权力极其强烈的欲望。
messages.en: Here it means a very intense desire for power.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只不停伸向更多金币的手，记住 klib 的“贪婪”；再把欲望对象换成权力，理解“强烈渴求”。

gloss_zh: 环绕；戴上花环或冠冕的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of encircling something, especially a head with a wreath or crown.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某物围绕起来的动作，尤其指用花环或冠冕环绕头部、为其加冠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ddawwar xi ħaġa, speċjalment ir-ras b'girlanda jew b'kuruna.

sense_translations.en_definition: encircling (especially with a wreath or crown)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 环绕的动作，尤其指用花环或冠冕环绕头部、为其加冠。

collocations.en: encircling the head with a wreath

formal.mt: Il-pittura turi l-klil tar-ras tar-rebbieħ b'girlanda bħala sinjal ta' unur.
formal.en: The painting depicts the encircling of the winner's head with a wreath as a sign of honour.
formal.zh: 这幅画描绘了为获胜者戴上花环以示荣誉的场景。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ifisser klil fid-deskrizzjoni tal-pittura? Pawlu: Hawn ifisser li jdawru ras ir-rebbieħ b'girlanda.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does klil mean in the description of the painting? Pawlu: Here it means placing a wreath around the winner's head.
colloquial.zh: Lara：画作说明里的 klil 是什么意思？Pawlu：这里指给获胜者的头部戴上花环。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 画作说明里的 klil 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does klil mean in the description of the painting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser li jdawru ras ir-rebbieħ b'girlanda.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser li jdawru ras ir-rebbieħ b'girlanda.
messages.zh: 这里指给获胜者的头部戴上花环。
messages.en: Here it means placing a wreath around the winner's head.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把圆形花环套到获胜者头上，用这个环绕并加冠的动作记住 klil；本条强调动作本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wreath worn on the head, for example as a decoration during a celebration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在头上的环形装饰物，例如庆典中佩戴的花环。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċirku ta' fjuri jew materjal ieħor li jintlibes fuq ir-ras bħala tiżjin.

sense_translations.en_definition: a wreath worn on the head
sense_translations.zh_definition: 戴在头上的花环或环形头饰。

collocations.en: a wreath of flowers worn on the head
to wear a wreath on one's head

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, it-tifla libset klila tal-fjuri fuq rasha.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the girl wore a wreath of flowers on her head.
formal.zh: 仪式期间，女孩头上戴着一个花环。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-klila tal-fjuri għalik. Lara: Grazzi! Se nilbisha għall-festa.
colloquial.en: Maja: This flower wreath is for you. Lara: Thanks! I'll wear it for the celebration.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个花环是送给你的。Lara：谢谢！我要戴着它参加庆典。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个花环是送给你的。
messages.en: This flower wreath is for you.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢！我要戴着它参加庆典。
messages.en: Thanks! I'll wear it for the celebration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象庆典上头戴一圈鲜花，把 klila 与“戴在头上的花环”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fitting that guides a rope or cable along its intended path.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引导绳索或缆绳按指定方向通过的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jiggwida ħabel jew kejbil fid-direzzjoni mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 导缆器；用于引导绳索或缆绳走向的装置。

collocations.en: to pass the rope through the fairlead

formal.mt: Il-ħabel jgħaddi mill-klitt biex jibqa' fid-direzzjoni mixtieqa.
formal.en: The rope passes through the fairlead to keep it running in the intended direction.
formal.zh: 绳索穿过导缆器，以保持预定的走向。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Minn fejn ngħaddi l-ħabel? Rita: Għaddih minn dan il-klitt.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where should I pass the rope? Rita: Pass it through this fairlead.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我该把绳索从哪里穿过去？Rita：把它穿过这个导缆器。

messages.speaker: Mark (船员学徒)
messages.zh: 我该把绳索从哪里穿过去？
messages.en: Where should I pass the rope?

messages.speaker: Rita (船员)
messages.zh: 把它穿过这个导缆器。
messages.en: Pass it through this fairlead.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象绳索穿过一个引导装置，把 klitt 的用途记成“给缆绳指路”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Online content or a headline designed mainly to attract clicks, often by exaggerating or withholding information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主要为了吸引点击而设计的网络内容或标题，常通过夸大或故意留下悬念来引人打开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontenut jew titlu fuq l-internet maħsub l-aktar biex iġiegħel lin-nies jikklikkjaw, spiss b'esaġerazzjoni jew billi jħalli barra informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 点击诱饵；以吸引点击为主要目的、常使用夸张标题的网络内容。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iwissi li l-klixka tista' tagħti impressjoni żbaljata tal-kontenut ta' artiklu.
formal.en: The report warns that clickbait can give a misleading impression of an article's content.
formal.zh: 报告提醒，点击诱饵可能使人对文章内容产生错误印象。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-titlu jgħid li mhux se nemmen dak li ġara! Maja: Dik tidher klixka. Aqra l-artiklu qabel taqsmu.
colloquial.en: Lara: The headline says I won't believe what happened! Maja: That looks like clickbait. Read the article before sharing it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：标题说我绝对不会相信发生了什么！Maja：那看着像标题党。先读文章，再分享。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-titlu jgħid li mhux se nemmen dak li ġara!
messages.mt_standard: It-titlu jgħid li mhux se nemmen dak li ġara!
messages.zh: 标题说我绝对不会相信发生了什么！
messages.en: The headline says I won't believe what happened!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik tidher klixka. Aqra l-artiklu qabel taqsmu.
messages.mt_standard: Dik tidher klixka. Aqra l-artiklu qabel taqsmu.
messages.zh: 那看着像标题党。先读文章，再分享。
messages.en: That looks like clickbait. Read the article before sharing it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 klixka 配上一幅“夸张标题钓走点击”的画面，记住它指点击诱饵。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element chlorine, referred to in contexts such as water treatment and disinfection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素氯，常见于水处理和消毒等语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku kloru, li jissemma f'kuntesti bħat-trattament u d-diżinfezzjoni tal-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 氯，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi r-riżultati tal-kejl tal-livell ta' kloru fl-ilma.
formal.en: The report includes the results of measurements of the chlorine level in the water.
formal.zh: 报告包含水中氯含量的测量结果。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qed inħoss riħa ta' kloru ħdejn il-pixxina. Rita: Iva, jien ukoll qed inħossha.
colloquial.en: Mark: I can smell chlorine near the swimming pool. Rita: Yes, I can smell it too.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我在泳池旁闻到了氯的气味。Rita：是的，我也闻到了。

messages.speaker: Mark (泳客)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss riħa ta' kloru ħdejn il-pixxina.
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss riħa ta' kloru ħdejn il-pixxina.
messages.zh: 我在泳池旁闻到了氯的气味。
messages.en: I can smell chlorine near the swimming pool.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我也闻到了。
messages.en: Yes, I can smell it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“水质报告里的氯含量”作记忆场景，把 kloru 与中文“氯”直接配对。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An excessive desire to take or possess more, especially money or resources, without regard for others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过度想要获取或占有更多东西，尤其是金钱或资源，并且不顾他人的贪婪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa eċċessiva li wieħed jieħu jew ikollu aktar, speċjalment flus jew riżorsi, mingħajr ma jqis lill-oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掠夺性的贪婪；不顾他人而一味攫取的贪得无厌。
贪婪；过度渴望获得更多财富、物品或利益。

formal.mt: L-awtur juri kif il-klubija għall-flus teqred il-fiduċja bejn il-karattri.
formal.en: The author shows how greed for money destroys trust between the characters.
formal.zh: 作者展现了对金钱的贪婪如何摧毁人物之间的信任。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħa kollox għalih u ma ħalla xejn għall-oħrajn. Lara: Dik klubija. Kulħadd kellu jieħu sehmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: He took everything for himself and left nothing for the others. Lara: That's greed. Everyone should have had their share.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他把所有东西都拿走了，一点也没留给别人。Lara：那就是贪婪。每个人都应该分到自己的一份。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħa kollox għalih u ma ħalla xejn għall-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Ħa kollox għalih u ma ħalla xejn għall-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 他把所有东西都拿走了，一点也没留给别人。
messages.en: He took everything for himself and left nothing for the others.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik klubija. Kulħadd kellu jieħu sehmu.
messages.mt_standard: Dik klubija. Kulħadd kellu jieħu sehmu.
messages.zh: 那就是贪婪。每个人都应该分到自己的一份。
messages.en: That's greed. Everyone should have had their share.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把大家的份额全揽走，用这幅“还想要更多”的画面记 klubija。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small room; the diminutive form of the Maltese word kamra.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小房间；马耳他语 kamra（房间）的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' kamra.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small room (the diminutive form of 'kamra')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小房间，是 kamra（房间）的指小形式。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tad-dar jinkludi kmajmra għall-ħażna ħdejn il-kċina.
formal.en: The house plan includes a small storage room next to the kitchen.
formal.zh: 房屋平面图中，厨房旁设有一间小储藏室。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hemm post kwiet fejn nista' naqra? Maja: Iva, hemm kmajmra fuq wara b'siġġu komdu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there a quiet place where I can read? Maja: Yes, there's a little room at the back with a comfortable chair.
colloquial.zh: Lara：有可以安静看书的地方吗？Maja：有，后面有间小房间，里面有把舒服的椅子。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm post kwiet fejn nista' naqra?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm post kwiet fejn nista' naqra?
messages.zh: 有可以安静看书的地方吗？
messages.en: Is there a quiet place where I can read?

messages.speaker: Maja (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm kmajmra fuq wara b'siġġu komdu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm kmajmra fuq wara b'siġġu komdu.
messages.zh: 有，后面有间小房间，里面有把舒服的椅子。
messages.en: Yes, there's a little room at the back with a comfortable chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kamra“房间”和 kmajmra“小房间”成对记，再想象一间只放得下椅子的小屋。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person in command of a military unit or a ship, such as a commandant or captain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责指挥军事单位或船只的人，如指挥官、舰长或船长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi u tagħti l-ordnijiet f'unità militari jew fuq vapur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指挥官；舰长或船长，指承担指挥职责的人。

formal.mt: Il-kmandant tal-vapur informa lill-ekwipaġġ dwar il-ħin tat-tluq.
formal.en: The captain of the ship informed the crew of the departure time.
formal.zh: 船长向船员通知了出发时间。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min se jgħidilna meta nitilqu? Rita: Il-kmandant. Qed jistenna li kulħadd ikun lest.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who will tell us when we're leaving? Rita: The captain. He's waiting for everyone to be ready.
colloquial.zh: Mark：谁会告诉我们什么时候出发？Rita：船长。他在等大家都准备好。

messages.speaker: Mark (新船员)
messages.zh: 谁会告诉我们什么时候出发？
messages.en: Who will tell us when we're leaving?

messages.speaker: Rita (船员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kmandant. Qed jistenna li kulħadd ikun lest.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kmandant. Qed jistenna li kulħadd ikun lest.
messages.zh: 船长。他在等大家都准备好。
messages.en: The captain. He's waiting for everyone to be ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象船上负责发出命令的人，把 kmandant 与“指挥官、船长”的职责相连。

gloss_zh: 热敷；用温水或洗剂敷治

teaching_sense.en_definition: The application of warm water or lotion to an aching part of the body to soothe pain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将温水或洗剂敷用于身体疼痛部位，以缓解疼痛的处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-applikazzjoni ta' ilma sħun jew lozjoni fuq parti tal-ġisem biex ittaffi l-uġigħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: application of warm water or lotion against ache
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用温水或洗剂敷于疼痛部位以缓解疼痛。
热敷处理；将温热的水或洗剂敷用于身体局部的操作。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-kmied bħala applikazzjoni ta' ilma sħun jew lozjoni biex ittaffi l-uġigħ.
formal.en: The text describes fomentation as the application of warm water or lotion to soothe pain.
formal.zh: 课文将热敷描述为用温水或洗剂敷治以缓解疼痛的处理。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser kmied f'din is-sentenza? Maja: Hawn ifisser li tapplika ilma sħun jew lozjoni biex ittaffi l-uġigħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does kmied mean in this sentence? Maja: Here it means applying warm water or lotion to soothe pain.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这句话里的 kmied 是什么意思？Maja：这里指用温水或洗剂敷治，以缓解疼痛。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 kmied 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does kmied mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser li tapplika ilma sħun jew lozjoni biex ittaffi l-uġigħ.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser li tapplika ilma sħun jew lozjoni biex ittaffi l-uġigħ.
messages.zh: 这里指用温水或洗剂敷治，以缓解疼痛。
messages.en: Here it means applying warm water or lotion to soothe pain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“温水或洗剂、敷在疼痛处、缓解疼痛”三个画面记住 kmied 的敷治含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lines and folds that form on the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤表面形成的细纹和褶皱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Linji u tinjiet li jiffurmaw fuq il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 皮肤上的皱纹。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, jidher il-kmix fuq il-wiċċ tar-raġel.
formal.en: In the photograph, the wrinkles on the man's face are visible.
formal.zh: 照片中可以看到那位男子脸上的皱纹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara l-kmix madwar għajnejja f'dan ir-ritratt! Lara: Jidher meta titbissem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at the wrinkles around my eyes in this photo! Lara: They show when you smile.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看这张照片里我眼睛周围的皱纹！拉拉：你微笑时就会显出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara l-kmix madwar għajnejja f'dan ir-ritratt!
messages.mt_standard: Ara l-kmix madwar għajnejja f'dan ir-ritratt!
messages.zh: 看这张照片里我眼睛周围的皱纹！
messages.en: Look at the wrinkles around my eyes in this photo!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你微笑时就会显出来。
messages.en: They show when you smile.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象微笑时眼角出现的一道道细纹，把 kmix 和“皮肤上的皱纹”这个画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small nook or a place sheltered from the sun.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个小角落，也可指能够躲避阳光的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rokna żgħira jew post għall-kenn mix-xemx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小角落；一个较小、较隐蔽的空间。

sense_translations.en_definition: a sheltered place form the sun
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够遮挡阳光、供人避晒的地方。

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien hemm knejna fid-dell fejn il-viżitaturi jistgħu jistrieħu.
formal.en: In the garden there is a shaded nook where visitors can rest.
formal.zh: 花园里有一处阴凉的小角落，游客可以在那里休息。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ix-xemx qawwija. Hemm fejn noqogħdu fid-dell? Nina: Iva, hemm knejna taħt is-siġra. Ejja noqogħdu hemm.
colloquial.en: Mark: The sun is strong. Is there somewhere we can sit in the shade? Nina: Yes, there's a nook under the tree. Let's sit there.
colloquial.zh: 马克：太阳很晒。有地方可以坐在阴凉处吗？妮娜：有，树下有个小角落。我们坐那里吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xemx qawwija. Hemm fejn noqogħdu fid-dell?
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xemx qawwija. Hemm fejn noqogħdu fid-dell?
messages.zh: 太阳很晒。有地方可以坐在阴凉处吗？
messages.en: The sun is strong. Is there somewhere we can sit in the shade?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm knejna taħt is-siġra. Ejja noqogħdu hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm knejna taħt is-siġra. Ejja noqogħdu hemm.
messages.zh: 有，树下有个小角落。我们坐那里吧。
messages.en: Yes, there's a nook under the tree. Let's sit there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 knejna 想成树下刚好能坐下的小角落，一个画面同时记住“小角落”和“遮阳处”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Shady or sheltered, describing a place that offers shade or protection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容地方阴凉、有遮挡，能够提供阴影或庇护。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun fid-dell jew joffri kenn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 背阴的；有树荫或其他阴影遮挡阳光的。
有遮蔽的；受到遮挡而较少暴露于风吹日晒的。

formal.mt: Il-bitħa għandha post knejni fejn it-tfal jistgħu jistrieħu fid-dell.
formal.en: The courtyard has a shaded spot where children can rest in the shade.
formal.zh: 院子里有一处阴凉的地方，孩子们可以在那里乘凉休息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se nieklu? Pawlu: Hemm post knejni ħdejn il-ħajt. Ejja noqogħdu hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are we going to eat? Pawlu: There's a shady spot by the wall. Let's sit there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们去哪里吃饭？保罗：墙边有个阴凉的地方。我们坐那里吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去哪里吃饭？
messages.en: Where are we going to eat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm post knejni ħdejn il-ħajt. Ejja noqogħdu hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm post knejni ħdejn il-ħajt. Ejja noqogħdu hemm.
messages.zh: 墙边有个阴凉的地方。我们坐那里吧。
messages.en: There's a shady spot by the wall. Let's sit there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 post knejni，就想象一个被树荫遮住的位置；knejni 描述这个地方“阴凉、有遮蔽”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of cleaning a floor or another surface with a broom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用扫帚清理地面或其他表面的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tindif tal-art jew ta' wiċċ ieħor permezz ta' xkupa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用扫帚清扫的动作或工作。

formal.mt: Il-knis tal-art isir kuljum qabel jinfetaħ il-ħanut.
formal.en: The floor is swept every day before the shop opens.
formal.zh: 商店每天开门前都要清扫地面。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Il-knis tal-kċina lest? Ben: Kważi. Għad fadal ftit frak taħt il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Mum: Is the kitchen sweeping finished? Ben: Almost. There are still a few crumbs under the table.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：厨房扫好了吗？本：快了。桌子底下还有一点碎屑。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 厨房扫好了吗？
messages.en: Is the kitchen sweeping finished?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Għad fadal ftit frak taħt il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Għad fadal ftit frak taħt il-mejda.
messages.zh: 快了。桌子底下还有一点碎屑。
messages.en: Almost. There are still a few crumbs under the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 knis 配上一把扫帚正在扫地的画面，记住它指“清扫这项活动”，可搭配地面或街道。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which a liquid thickens or forms a clot, especially blood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体变稠或形成凝块的过程，尤指血液凝固。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih likwidu, speċjalment id-demm, jagħqad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凝固；凝结，尤其指血液形成凝块的过程。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jispjega l-proċess tal-koagulazzjoni tad-demm.
formal.en: The chapter explains the process of blood coagulation.
formal.zh: 这一章解释了血液凝固的过程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser koagulazzjoni? Mark: Meta likwidu jagħqad, bħad-demm meta jifforma embolu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does coagulation mean? Mark: It's when a liquid clots, like blood when it forms a clot.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：凝固是什么意思？马克：就是液体凝结起来，比如血液形成凝块。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 凝固是什么意思？
messages.en: What does coagulation mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta likwidu jagħqad, bħad-demm meta jifforma embolu.
messages.mt_standard: Meta likwidu jagħqad, bħad-demm meta jifforma embolu.
messages.zh: 就是液体凝结起来，比如血液形成凝块。
messages.en: It's when a liquid clots, like blood when it forms a clot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 koagulazzjoni 想成液体逐渐凝成一块的连续画面，再用“血液凝固”这个搭配帮助回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called cobalt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为“钴”的化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku li jissejjaħ kobalt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钴，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-kampjun fih il-kobalt.
formal.en: The report indicates that the sample contains cobalt.
formal.zh: 报告指出，该样品含有钴。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu l-kobalt? Pawlu: Huwa element kimiku. Illum qrajna dwaru fil-klassi.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is cobalt? Pawlu: It's a chemical element. We read about it in class today.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：钴是什么？保罗：它是一种化学元素。我们今天上课读到了关于它的内容。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 钴是什么？
messages.en: What is cobalt?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku. Illum qrajna dwaru fil-klassi.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku. Illum qrajna dwaru fil-klassi.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素。我们今天上课读到了关于它的内容。
messages.en: It's a chemical element. We read about it in class today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张三语元素卡，正面写 kobalt，背面并列写“钴、cobalt”，用相近的外形辅助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A number that multiplies a variable or another quantity in a mathematical expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数学表达式中与变量或其他量相乘的数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Numru li jimmultiplika varjabbli jew kwantità oħra f'espressjoni matematika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 系数；数学表达式中与变量或其他量相乘的数。

formal.mt: Fl-espressjoni 3x + 2, il-koeffiċjent ta' x huwa 3.
formal.en: In the expression 3x + 2, the coefficient of x is 3.
formal.zh: 在表达式 3x + 2 中，x 的系数是 3。

colloquial.mt: Ben: F'5x, liema hu l-koeffiċjent? Maja: Huwa 5, għax 5 jimmultiplika x.
colloquial.en: Ben: In 5x, which number is the coefficient? Maja: It's 5, because 5 multiplies x.
colloquial.zh: 本：在 5x 中，哪个数是系数？玛雅：是 5，因为 5 与 x 相乘。

messages.speaker: Ben (学生)
messages.zh: 在 5x 中，哪个数是系数？
messages.en: In 5x, which number is the coefficient?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 是 5，因为 5 与 x 相乘。
messages.en: It's 5, because 5 multiplies x.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 3x 中把数字 3 圈出来，旁边写 koeffiċjent；每次看到变量前相乘的数，就联想“系数”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An owl, a bird with large eyes and a broad head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 猫头鹰，一种眼睛大、头部较宽的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur b'għajnejn kbar u ras wiesgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猫头鹰；猫头鹰这类鸟。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher kokk wieqaf fuq fergħa ta' siġra.
formal.en: The photograph shows an owl perched on a tree branch.
formal.zh: 照片中有一只猫头鹰停在树枝上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa! Huwa kokk? Mark: Iva, ara kemm għandu għajnejh kbar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that bird on the branch! Is it an owl? Mark: Yes, look how big its eyes are.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看树枝上的那只鸟！是猫头鹰吗？马克：是的，看它的眼睛多大。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa! Huwa kokk?
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa! Huwa kokk?
messages.zh: 看树枝上的那只鸟！是猫头鹰吗？
messages.en: Look at that bird on the branch! Is it an owl?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara kemm għandu għajnejh kbar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara kemm għandu għajnejh kbar.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cockroach, especially a small one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蟑螂，尤其指体型较小的蟑螂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wirdiena, speċjalment waħda żgħira.

sense_translations.en_definition: a cockroach, especially a small one
sense_translations.zh_definition: 蟑螂，尤指小蟑螂。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab kokroċ taħt l-armarju tal-kċina.
formal.en: During the inspection, a cockroach was found under the kitchen cupboard.
formal.zh: 检查时，在厨房橱柜下发现了一只蟑螂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm kokroċ ħdejn il-bieb! Pawlu: Rajtu. Se nġib xi ħaġa biex naqbadha.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a cockroach by the door! Pawlu: I saw it. I'll get something to catch it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门边有只蟑螂！保罗：我看见了。我去拿个东西把它捉住。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)

teaching_sense.en_definition: The person who steers a rowing boat and directs its rowers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责掌舵并指挥划桨队员的舵手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi dgħajsa tal-qdif u tagħti l-istruzzjonijiet lill-qaddiefa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赛艇等划桨船只上负责掌舵、指挥队员的舵手。

formal.mt: Matul it-tellieqa, il-koksin ta istruzzjonijiet ċari lill-qaddiefa.
formal.en: During the race, the coxswain gave the rowers clear instructions.
formal.zh: 比赛期间，舵手向划桨队员发出了清晰的指令。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jkun il-koksin illum? Mark: Pawlu. Aħna nisimgħu l-istruzzjonijiet tiegħu waqt il-qdif.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will be the coxswain today? Mark: Pawlu. We'll follow his instructions while rowing.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天谁当舵手？马克：保罗。划船时我们听他的指令。

messages.speaker: Sara (划船队员)
messages.zh: 今天谁当舵手？
messages.en: Who will be the coxswain today?

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu. Aħna nisimgħu l-istruzzjonijiet tiegħu waqt il-qdif.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu. Aħna nisimgħu l-istruzzjonijiet tiegħu waqt il-qdif.

teaching_sense.en_definition: An infectious intestinal disease called cholera.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为霍乱的肠道传染病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda infettiva tal-imsaren.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 霍乱，一种肠道传染病。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tas-saħħa pubblika jiddeskrivi l-miżuri għall-prevenzjoni tal-kolera.

formal.zh: 公共卫生报告介绍了预防霍乱的措施。

colloquial.en: Lara: What are you reading about? Nina: Cholera. I have a presentation about this disease.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你在读什么方面的内容？妮娜：霍乱。我有一个关于这种疾病的课堂报告。

gloss_zh: 盘绕；卷成圈；另作名词指钟表发条轴

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wind something into loops, or to take the shape of a coil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把绳索等盘绕成圈，或自身卷曲成盘绕的形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawwar ħabel jew xi ħaġa simili f'ħoloq, jew ħa għamla ta' ħoloq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把绳索、电缆等盘绕成圈。

sense_translations.en_definition: to take the shape of a coil

formal.zh: 工作结束后，技术员把电缆盘好，放进了箱子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of winding a rope, cable, or similar object into coils.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将绳索、电缆等盘绕成圈的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li ddawwar ħabel, kejbil jew xi ħaġa simili f'ħoloq.
