messages.zh: 这份礼物是谁选的？
messages.en: Who chose this gift?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għażilnieh kollettivament; kulħadd ta l-opinjoni tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għażilnieh kollettivament; kulħadd ta l-opinjoni tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我们一起选的，每个人都发表了意见。
messages.en: We chose it collectively; everyone gave their opinion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把kollettivament放在“决定、行动”旁边记：它说明事情是大家共同完成的，回答“怎样做”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who supports organizing society or activities around shared interests and collective action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主张围绕共同利益和集体行动来组织社会或活动的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappoġġa l-organizzazzjoni tas-soċjetà jew tal-attivitajiet madwar interessi komuni u azzjoni kollettiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 集体主义者；支持集体主义理念的人。

collocations.zh: 思想上奉行集体主义的人

formal.mt: Bħala kollettivista, l-awtur jenfasizza r-responsabbiltà komuni u l-kooperazzjoni bejn il-membri tas-soċjetà.
formal.en: As a collectivist, the author emphasizes shared responsibility and cooperation among members of society.
formal.zh: 作为一名集体主义者，这位作者强调共同责任以及社会成员之间的合作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tgħid li int kollettivista? David: Għax nemmen li għandna nagħtu prijorità lill-ġid komuni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you say you're a collectivist? David: Because I believe we should give priority to the common good.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么说自己是集体主义者？David：因为我认为我们应该优先考虑共同利益。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说自己是集体主义者？
messages.en: Why do you say you're a collectivist?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax nemmen li għandna nagħtu prijorità lill-ġid komuni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax nemmen li għandna nagħtu prijorità lill-ġid komuni.
messages.zh: 因为我认为我们应该优先考虑共同利益。
messages.en: Because I believe we should give priority to the common good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给kollettivista配一张人物卡：卡片上的人支持集体主义。先记“持这种观点的人”，再与思想本身区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of people considered together as a social whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为一个社会整体来看待的一群人，即集体或共同体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' persuni meqjus bħala ħaġa waħda fil-ħajja soċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 集体；共同体；被视为一个整体的人群。

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu jtejjeb il-ħajja tal-kollettività u jħeġġeġ il-parteċipazzjoni tal-membri kollha.
formal.en: The project should improve the life of the collectivity and encourage all its members to participate.
formal.zh: 这个项目应改善整个共同体的生活，并鼓励所有成员参与。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex irridu nisimgħu lil kulħadd? Ġorġ: Għax id-deċiżjoni taffettwa lill-kollettività kollha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why do we need to listen to everyone? Ġorġ: Because the decision affects the whole community.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们为什么要听取每个人的意见？Ġorġ：因为这个决定会影响整个共同体。

messages.speaker: Marija (居民)
messages.zh: 我们为什么要听取每个人的意见？
messages.en: Why do we need to listen to everyone?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (邻居)
messages.zh: 因为这个决定会影响整个共同体。
messages.en: Because the decision affects the whole community.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把许多人的照片圈在同一个圆圈里：kollettività指这个由人组成的整体，可记作“大家这个集体”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A principle or system that gives priority to the interests and action of a group over those of separate individuals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重视群体利益与集体行动，并将其置于个体利益之上的思想原则或制度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prinċipju jew sistema li tagħti prijorità lill-interessi u lill-azzjoni tal-grupp fuq dawk tal-individwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 集体主义；强调集体利益优先及共同采取行动的思想或制度。

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel il-kollettiviżmu mal-individwaliżmu u janalizza kif kull wieħed jifhem ir-responsabbiltà soċjali.
formal.en: The study compares collectivism with individualism and analyzes how each understands social responsibility.
formal.zh: 这项研究比较集体主义与个人主义，并分析两者如何理解社会责任。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu l-kollettiviżmu? Adam: Huwa ħsieb li jagħti prijorità lill-ġid tal-grupp fuq l-interessi tal-individwu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is collectivism? Adam: It is a way of thinking that gives priority to the good of the group over individual interests.
colloquial.zh: Nina：什么是集体主义？Adam：它是一种将群体福祉置于个人利益之上的思想。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 什么是集体主义？
messages.en: What is collectivism?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa ħsieb li jagħti prijorità lill-ġid tal-grupp fuq l-interessi tal-individwu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa ħsieb li jagħti prijorità lill-ġid tal-grupp fuq l-interessi tal-individwu.
messages.zh: 它是一种将群体福祉置于个人利益之上的思想。
messages.en: It is a way of thinking that gives priority to the good of the group over individual interests.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡对照记忆：kollettiviżmu写“集体主义这种思想”，kollettivista写“支持这种思想的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gathers objects, often objects of a particular kind kept as a collection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收集物品的人，常指专门收集并保存某一类物品的收藏者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiġbor oġġetti, spiss ta' tip partikolari, u żżommhom f'kollezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收集者；收藏者；从事收集工作的人。

formal.mt: Il-kollettur sellef lill-mużew għaxar muniti rari għall-wirja.
formal.en: The collector lent the museum ten rare coins for the exhibition.
formal.zh: 这位收藏者向博物馆出借了十枚稀有钱币，用于展览。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Għaliex iżżomm dawn il-bolol kollha? Luqa: Jien kollettur tal-bolol; inħobb insib wieħed minn kull pajjiż.
colloquial.en: Emma: Why do you keep all these stamps? Luqa: I'm a stamp collector; I like finding one from each country.
colloquial.zh: Emma：你为什么留着这么多邮票？Luqa：我是集邮者，喜欢从每个国家找一枚邮票。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么留着这么多邮票？
messages.en: Why do you keep all these stamps?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien kollettur tal-bolol; inħobb insib wieħed minn kull pajjiż.
messages.mt_standard: Jien kollettur tal-bolol; inħobb insib wieħed minn kull pajjiż.
messages.zh: 我是集邮者，喜欢从每个国家找一枚邮票。
messages.en: I'm a stamp collector; I like finding one from each country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把邮票逐张放进收藏册，给这个人贴上kollettur标签；记住它指收集的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The whole of something, including all its parts or members.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 包含所有部分或成员的整体，即某事物的全部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-intier ta' xi ħaġa, bil-partijiet jew bil-membri kollha tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全体；整体；包含全部部分或成员的总和。

formal.mt: L-analiżi għandha tqis il-kollija tal-fatti qabel tasal għal konklużjoni.
formal.en: The analysis should consider the totality of the facts before reaching a conclusion.
formal.zh: 分析应考虑全部事实，然后再得出结论。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi tfisser il-kelma kollija f'dan it-test? Toni: Tfisser l-intier; hawn qed jitkellem dwar il-fatti kollha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does the word kollija mean in this text? Toni: It means the whole; here it refers to all the facts taken together.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这篇文章里的kollija是什么意思？Toni：意思是整体，这里指合在一起考虑的全部事实。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma kollija f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma kollija f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的kollija是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word kollija mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser l-intier; hawn qed jitkellem dwar il-fatti kollha flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser l-intier; hawn qed jitkellem dwar il-fatti kollha flimkien.
messages.zh: 意思是整体，这里指合在一起考虑的全部事实。
messages.en: It means the whole; here it refers to all the facts taken together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一幅已经拼齐的拼图：kollija对应包含每一块的完整整体，用“全部合起来”帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Introduces a clause referring to everything that someone does, says, has, or otherwise describes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引出一个从句，表示该从句所描述的一切事物或全部内容，如所说、所做或拥有的一切。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintroduċi sentenza li tirreferi għal dak kollu li persuna tagħmel, tgħid, għandha jew tiddeskrivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: ……的一切；凡是……的全部事物或内容。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirreġistra kollma ġie diskuss waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The report records everything that was discussed during the meeting.
formal.zh: 报告记录了会议期间讨论的全部内容。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'għandi nġib għall-piknik? Ben: Ġib kollma għandek bżonn biex tiekol u tixrob.
colloquial.en: Anna: What should I bring for the picnic? Ben: Bring everything you need for eating and drinking.
colloquial.zh: Anna：野餐我该带什么？Ben：把你吃喝所需要的东西都带上。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 野餐我该带什么？
messages.en: What should I bring for the picnic?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġib kollma għandek bżonn biex tiekol u tixrob.
messages.mt_standard: Ġib kollma għandek bżonn biex tiekol u tixrob.
messages.zh: 把你吃喝所需要的东西都带上。
messages.en: Bring everything you need for eating and drinking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把kollma记成一个等待后文填满的框：“……的一切”。后面接“你需要、他说过”等内容，就能组成完整意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A combination of words that commonly occur together in a language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种语言中经常一起使用的词语组合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda ta' kliem li spiss jintuża flimkien f'lingwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词语搭配；语言中惯常共同出现的词语组合。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jagħżlu kollokazzjoni mit-test u jużawha f'sentenza ġdida.
formal.en: The students should choose a collocation from the text and use it in a new sentence.
formal.zh: 学生应从课文中选出一个词语搭配，并用它另造一个句子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi kollokazzjoni? Mark: Kliem li spiss nużaw flimkien, bħal 'xita qawwija'.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is a collocation? Mark: Words we often use together, such as 'heavy rain'.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：什么是词语搭配？马克：就是我们经常一起使用的词，比如“大雨”。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 什么是词语搭配？
messages.en: What is a collocation?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kliem li spiss nużaw flimkien, bħal 'xita qawwija'.
messages.mt_standard: Kliem li spiss nużaw flimkien, bħal 'xita qawwija'.
messages.zh: 就是我们经常一起使用的词，比如“大雨”。
messages.en: Words we often use together, such as 'heavy rain'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把常常结伴出现的词想成固定搭档：看到“大雨”这个组合，就联想 kollokazzjoni 表示词语搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The main section of the large intestine, where water is absorbed from digested material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大肠的主要部分，参与吸收消化后物质中的水分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ewlenija tal-musrana l-kbira, fejn jiġi assorbit l-ilma mill-materjal diġerit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结肠，大肠的主要部分。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-pożizzjoni tal-kolon u tispjega r-rwol tiegħu fl-assorbiment tal-ilma.
formal.en: The diagram shows the position of the colon and explains its role in water absorption.
formal.zh: 该图展示结肠的位置，并解释它在吸收水分方面的作用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-kolon f'din l-istampa? Mark: Hawn, din il-parti tal-musrana l-kbira.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the colon in this picture? Mark: Here, this part of the large intestine.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张图里的结肠在哪里？马克：这里，就是大肠的这一部分。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这张图里的结肠在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the colon in this picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 这里，就是大肠的这一部分。
messages.en: Here, this part of the large intestine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在消化系统示意图上圈出结肠，再把 kolon 写在旁边，用位置和图像一起记住这个身体部位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which an outside power establishes control over a territory, often through settlement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外来势力在某一地区建立控制的过程，通常伴随移民定居。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih qawwa minn barra tistabbilixxi kontroll fuq territorju, spiss billi tibgħat nies joqogħdu fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 殖民；外来势力在某地建立控制并可能进行移民定居的过程。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-effetti tal-kolonizzazzjoni fuq il-lingwa u l-organizzazzjoni tas-soċjetà.
formal.en: The study examines the effects of colonization on language and the organization of society.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察殖民对语言和社会组织方式的影响。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fuq xiex se tikteb l-esej? Mark: Fuq il-kolonizzazzjoni u kif bidlet il-ħajja tan-nies.
colloquial.en: Lara: What will you write your essay about? Mark: About colonization and how it changed people's lives.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的论文准备写什么？马克：写殖民，以及它如何改变人们的生活。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你的论文准备写什么？
messages.en: What will you write your essay about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-kolonizzazzjoni u kif bidlet il-ħajja tan-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-kolonizzazzjoni u kif bidlet il-ħajja tan-nies.
messages.zh: 写殖民，以及它如何改变人们的生活。
messages.en: About colonization and how it changed people's lives.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kolonizzazzjoni 放进一条过程时间线：外来势力进入、建立控制、社会发生变化，帮助记住“殖民化”这一过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a colony, colonial rule, or the period when a territory was governed as a colony.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与殖民地、殖民统治或某地处于殖民统治之下的时期有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' kolonja, mal-ħakma fuqha jew mal-perjodu ta' dik il-ħakma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 殖民的；殖民地的；与殖民统治或殖民时期有关的。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi l-amministrazzjoni kolonjali u l-mod kif kienet tieħu d-deċiżjonijiet.
formal.en: The chapter describes the colonial administration and how it made decisions.
formal.zh: 这一章介绍殖民行政机构及其作出决策的方式。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din is-sala tal-mużew dwar liema żmien hi? Mark: Dwar il-perjodu kolonjali; ejja naqraw dan il-pannell.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which period is this museum room about? Mark: The colonial period; let's read this panel.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：博物馆这个展厅介绍哪个时期？马克：殖民时期；我们来读读这块展板。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din is-sala tal-mużew dwar liema żmien hi?
messages.mt_standard: Din is-sala tal-mużew dwar liema żmien hi?
messages.zh: 博物馆这个展厅介绍哪个时期？
messages.en: Which period is this museum room about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar il-perjodu kolonjali; ejja naqraw dan il-pannell.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar il-perjodu kolonjali; ejja naqraw dan il-pannell.
messages.zh: 殖民时期；我们来读读这块展板。
messages.en: The colonial period; let's read this panel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kolonjali 想成历史展板上的形容标签，贴在“时期”或“统治”旁边，就得到“殖民时期”和“殖民统治”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who supports or promotes the establishment or maintenance of colonial rule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持或推动建立、维持殖民统治的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappoġġa jew tippromwovi t-twaqqif jew iż-żamma tal-ħakma kolonjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 殖民主义者；支持或推行殖民统治的人。

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkritika l-kolonjalista li jiddefendi ż-żamma tal-ħakma kolonjali.
formal.en: The author criticizes the colonialist who defends the maintenance of colonial rule.
formal.zh: 作者批评了那名为维持殖民统治辩护的殖民主义者。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex it-test isejjaħlu kolonjalista? Mark: Għax kien jappoġġa l-ħakma kolonjali.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the text call him a colonialist? Mark: Because he supported colonial rule.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：课文为什么称他为殖民主义者？马克：因为他支持殖民统治。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 课文为什么称他为殖民主义者？
messages.en: Why does the text call him a colonialist?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 因为他支持殖民统治。
messages.en: Because he supported colonial rule.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kolonjalista 记在人物卡片上，卡片写着“支持殖民统治的人”，用人物身份来记住“殖民主义者”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An island country in the Indian Ocean off the coast of East Africa, officially called the Union of the Comoros.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于东非海岸外印度洋上的岛国，正式国名为科摩罗联盟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż magħmul minn gżejjer fl-Oċean Indjan 'il barra mill-kosta tal-Afrika tal-Lvant, bl-isem uffiċjali Unjoni tal-Komoros.

sense_translations.en_definition: Comoros (a country and group of islands in the Indian Ocean off the coast of East Africa; official name: Unjoni tal-Komoros)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 科摩罗，位于东非海岸外印度洋上的国家及群岛；正式国名为科摩罗联盟。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi l-Komoros fl-Oċean Indjan, 'il barra mill-kosta tal-Afrika tal-Lvant.
formal.en: The map shows the Comoros in the Indian Ocean, off the coast of East Africa.
formal.zh: 地图显示，科摩罗位于东非海岸外的印度洋上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn huma l-Komoros fuq il-mappa? Mark: Fl-Oċean Indjan, 'il barra mill-kosta tal-Afrika tal-Lvant.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are the Comoros on the map? Mark: In the Indian Ocean, off the coast of East Africa.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：科摩罗在地图上的什么位置？马克：在印度洋上，东非海岸外。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 科摩罗在地图上的什么位置？
messages.en: Where are the Comoros on the map?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-Oċean Indjan, 'il barra mill-kosta tal-Afrika tal-Lvant.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-Oċean Indjan, 'il barra mill-kosta tal-Afrika tal-Lvant.
messages.zh: 在印度洋上，东非海岸外。
messages.en: In the Indian Ocean, off the coast of East Africa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图上先找东非，再望向海岸外的印度洋岛屿，把 Komoros 与中文“科摩罗”并排标记，结合位置记忆国名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In grammar, the object of a verb; in mathematics, the elements of a universal set that do not belong to a specified set.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在语法中指动词的宾语；在数学中指全集内不属于某个指定集合的元素所组成的集合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-grammatika, l-oġġett ta' verb; fil-matematika, is-sett tal-elementi tas-sett universali li ma jappartjenux għal sett partikolari.

sense_translations.en_definition: complement object (in grammar, the object of a verb
sense_translations.zh_definition: 宾语；语法中由动词支配、表示动作所涉及对象的成分。

sense_translations.en_definition: complement of a set (in mathematics, the elements which are not in a set)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 补集；在给定全集内，不属于某个指定集合的所有元素组成的集合。

formal.mt: Fis-sentenza 'Marija qrat ktieb', il-kelma 'ktieb' hija l-komplement tal-verb 'qrat'.
formal.en: In the sentence 'Marija read a book', the word 'book' is the object of the verb 'read'.
formal.zh: 在“玛丽娅读了一本书”这个句子中，“书”是动词“读”的宾语。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Jekk is-sett universali hu {1, 2, 3} u A hu {1}, x'inhu l-komplement ta' A? Mark: Hu {2, 3}, għax dawn l-elementi mhumiex f'A.
colloquial.en: Lara: If the universal set is {1, 2, 3} and A is {1}, what is the complement of A? Mark: It is {2, 3}, because those elements are not in A.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：如果全集是 {1, 2, 3}，A 是 {1}，那么 A 的补集是什么？马克：是 {2, 3}，因为这些元素不在 A 中。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk is-sett universali hu {1, 2, 3} u A hu {1}, x'inhu l-komplement ta' A?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk is-sett universali hu {1, 2, 3} u A hu {1}, x'inhu l-komplement ta' A?
messages.zh: 如果全集是 {1, 2, 3}，A 是 {1}，那么 A 的补集是什么？
messages.en: If the universal set is {1, 2, 3} and A is {1}, what is the complement of A?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu {2, 3}, għax dawn l-elementi mhumiex f'A.
messages.mt_standard: Hu {2, 3}, għax dawn l-elementi mhumiex f'A.
messages.zh: 是 {2, 3}，因为这些元素不在 A 中。
messages.en: It is {2, 3}, because those elements are not in A.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 komplement 配两张课堂图：语法图用箭头从“读”指向宾语“书”；集合图把全集中 A 外面的部分涂色，表示补集。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Adding something useful to another thing, or working with it so that together they form a more complete whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够为另一事物提供有用补充，或与之配合形成更完整整体的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jżid xi ħaġa utli ma' ħaġa oħra jew jaħdem magħha biex flimkien jiffurmaw ħaġa aktar sħiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 互补的；能够相互配合或提供补充的。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi materjal komplementarju biex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jipprattikaw wara kull lezzjoni.
formal.en: The course includes supplementary material so that students can practise after each lesson.
formal.zh: 课程包含补充材料，供学生在每节课后练习。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-vidjo hu parti mil-lezzjoni? Mark: Hu materjal komplementarju; jagħtik aktar eżempji tas-suġġett.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this video part of the lesson? Mark: It is supplementary material; it gives you more examples of the topic.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个视频是课内内容吗？马克：这是补充材料，会提供更多与这个主题有关的例子。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个视频是课内内容吗？
messages.en: Is this video part of the lesson?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu materjal komplementarju; jagħtik aktar eżempji tas-suġġett.
messages.mt_standard: Hu materjal komplementarju; jagħtik aktar eżempji tas-suġġett.
messages.zh: 这是补充材料，会提供更多与这个主题有关的例子。
messages.en: It is supplementary material; it gives you more examples of the topic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课本旁放着一本练习册，两者配合帮助学习；用这个画面记住 komplementarju 表示“互补的、起补充作用的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To the fullest extent, with nothing remaining or excluded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示程度达到全部，没有剩余或例外。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod sħiħ, mingħajr ma jibqa' xejn jew ikun hemm eċċezzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完全地；彻底地

formal.mt: Il-bini nbidel kompletament wara x-xogħol ta' restawr.
formal.en: The building changed completely after the restoration work.
formal.zh: 修复工程结束后，这座建筑完全变了样。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fhimt l-ispjegazzjoni? Mark: Iva, issa nifhem kompletament.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you understand the explanation? Mark: Yes, now I understand completely.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听懂解释了吗？马克：听懂了，现在我完全明白了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你听懂解释了吗？
messages.en: Did you understand the explanation?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 听懂了，现在我完全明白了。
messages.en: Yes, now I understand completely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象进度条达到百分之百：kompletament强调动作或状态达到完全的程度。

gloss_zh: 完整的；已完成的；已结束的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having all the necessary parts, or having been fully finished.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具备所有必要部分，或已经全部完成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-partijiet kollha meħtieġa, jew li tlesta għalkollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完整的；齐全的；包含所有必要部分的
已经做好的；已完成的
已结束的；已全部完成的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport huwa komplut u jinkludi d-dokumenti kollha meħtieġa.
formal.en: The report is complete and includes all the required documents.
formal.zh: 报告内容完整，包含所有必需的文件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Is-sett tal-kotba huwa komplut? Mark: Iva, hemm l-għaxar kotba kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the set of books complete? Mark: Yes, all ten books are there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这套书齐全吗？马克：齐全，十本都在。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这套书齐全吗？
messages.en: Is the set of books complete?

messages.speaker: Mark (书店店员)
messages.zh: 齐全，十本都在。
messages.en: Yes, all ten books are there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记忆：拼图一块不少是完整，作业全部做完是完成，都可联想到komplut。

gloss_zh: 可传达的；可传播的；可传染的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be communicated to others, or transmitted from one person to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够向他人传达的；也可指能够在人与人之间传播或传染的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jitwassal lil ħaddieħor, jew jgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可传达的；可传播的；用于疾病时指可传染的

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddistingwi bejn għarfien komunikabbli u esperjenza li diffiċli tesprimiha bil-kliem.
formal.en: The author distinguishes between communicable knowledge and experience that is difficult to express in words.
formal.zh: 作者区分了可以传授的知识与难以用语言表达的体验。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser marda komunikabbli? Mark: Tfisser marda li tista' tgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does a communicable disease mean? Mark: It means a disease that can pass from one person to another.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：可传染的疾病是什么意思？马克：就是能够从一个人传给另一个人的疾病。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 可传染的疾病是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a communicable disease mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser marda li tista' tgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser marda li tista' tgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra.
messages.zh: 就是能够从一个人传给另一个人的疾病。
messages.en: It means a disease that can pass from one person to another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一支箭头从一个人指向另一个人：知识能传达，疾病能传染，都是这里的可传递。

gloss_zh: 可传达性；可传播性；传染性

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or degree of being able to be communicated or transmitted to others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够向他人传达或传播的性质或程度；用于疾病时指传染性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew il-grad ta' kemm xi ħaġa tista' titwassal lil ħaddieħor jew tgħaddi minn persuna għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可传达性；可传播性；用于疾病时指传染性

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza l-komunikabilità tal-għarfien bejn gruppi b'esperjenzi differenti.
formal.en: The study analyses the communicability of knowledge between groups with different experiences.
formal.zh: 该研究分析了知识在具有不同经历的群体之间的可传授性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-komunikabilità tal-għarfien? Mark: Tfisser kemm dak li nafu jista' jitwassal lil ħaddieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the communicability of knowledge mean? Mark: It means how far what we know can be conveyed to others.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：知识的可传授性是什么意思？马克：就是我们所知道的东西能够在多大程度上传达给别人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 知识的可传授性是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the communicability of knowledge mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser kemm dak li nafu jista' jitwassal lil ħaddieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser kemm dak li nafu jista' jitwassal lil ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 就是我们所知道的东西能够在多大程度上传达给别人。
messages.en: It means how far what we know can be conveyed to others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把可传递当作一种可以讨论的性质来记：komunikabilità问的是能否传递以及传递程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who receives Holy Communion in a Christian religious service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在基督教宗教仪式中领受圣餐的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirċievi t-Tqarbin waqt ċelebrazzjoni Nisranija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 领圣餐者；领受圣餐的信徒

formal.mt: Kull komunikant resaq lejn l-artal biex jirċievi t-Tqarbin.
formal.en: Each communicant approached the altar to receive Holy Communion.
formal.zh: 每位领圣餐者都走近祭台，领受圣餐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser komunikant f'dan il-ktieb? Mark: Ifisser persuna li tirċievi t-Tqarbin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does communicant mean in this book? Mark: It means a person who receives Holy Communion.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书里的komunikant是什么意思？马克：指领受圣餐的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这本书里的komunikant是什么意思？
messages.en: What does communicant mean in this book?

messages.speaker: Mark (宗教课老师)
messages.zh: 指领受圣餐的人。
messages.en: It means a person who receives Holy Communion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用教堂里有人走向祭台领圣餐的画面记忆：komunikant指这位领圣餐的人。

gloss_zh: 乐于交流的；善于表达的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Willing and able to share thoughts, feelings, or information with others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愿意并善于与他人交流想法、感受或信息的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun lest u kapaċi jaqsam ħsibijiet, sentimenti jew informazzjoni ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乐于交流的；善于表达的；愿意分享想法或信息的

collocations.zh: 有助于交流的表达风格

formal.mt: L-għalliem huwa komunikattiv u jħeġġeġ lill-istudenti jesprimu l-ideat tagħhom.
formal.en: The teacher is communicative and encourages students to express their ideas.
formal.zh: 这位老师善于交流，并鼓励学生表达自己的想法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sibt lill-kollega l-ġdid? Mark: Huwa komunikattiv ħafna; malajr bdejna nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you think of the new colleague? Mark: He is very communicative; we soon got talking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得新同事怎么样？马克：他很乐于交流，我们很快就聊起来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你觉得新同事怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of the new colleague?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa komunikattiv ħafna; malajr bdejna nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa komunikattiv ħafna; malajr bdejna nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 他很乐于交流，我们很快就聊起来了。
messages.en: He is very communicative; we soon got talking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位主动开口、也愿意分享想法的新同事，用这个人的交流特点记住komunikattiv。

gloss_zh: 健谈；善于交流的特质；表达感染力

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of expressing oneself readily and engaging others in communication.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易表达自己、乐于与人交谈并能带动交流的特质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila li wieħed jesprimi ruħu faċilment u jinvolvi lill-oħrajn fil-konversazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 健谈；乐于交流、善于表达的特质

formal.mt: Il-komunikattiva tal-preżentatur għenet biex l-udjenza tipparteċipa fid-diskussjoni.
formal.en: The presenter's communicativeness helped the audience take part in the discussion.
formal.zh: 主持人的交流感染力促进了观众参与讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għażiltu biex imexxi l-laqgħa? Mark: Għandu komunikattiva kbira u jdaħħal lil kulħadd fid-diskussjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you choose him to lead the meeting? Mark: He has great communicativeness and gets everyone involved in the discussion.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么选他主持会议？马克：他很善于交流，能让大家都参与讨论。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么选他主持会议？
messages.en: Why did you choose him to lead the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (会议组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu komunikattiva kbira u jdaħħal lil kulħadd fid-diskussjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu komunikattiva kbira u jdaħħal lil kulħadd fid-diskussjoni.
messages.zh: 他很善于交流，能让大家都参与讨论。
messages.en: He has great communicativeness and gets everyone involved in the discussion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 此处按名词记忆：把主持人带动全场交谈的本领装进一个盒子，盒名就是komunikattiva。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who supports communism or belongs to a communist party.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持共产主义的人，或共产党的成员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappoġġja l-komuniżmu jew li hija membru ta' partit komunista.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共产主义者；共产党人

formal.mt: Fil-memorji tiegħu, l-awtur jispjega għaliex sar komunista meta kien żagħżugħ.
formal.en: In his memoirs, the author explains why he became a communist when he was young.
formal.zh: 作者在回忆录中解释了自己年轻时成为共产主义者的原因。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jgħid il-karattru dwar il-fehmiet politiċi tiegħu? Mark: Jgħid li huwa komunista u jispjega għaliex.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the character say about his political views? Mark: He says that he is a communist and explains why.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个角色怎么介绍自己的政治观点？马克：他说自己是共产主义者，并解释了原因。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jgħid il-karattru dwar il-fehmiet politiċi tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: X'jgħid il-karattru dwar il-fehmiet politiċi tiegħu?
messages.zh: 这个角色怎么介绍自己的政治观点？
messages.en: What does the character say about his political views?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jgħid li huwa komunista u jispjega għaliex.
messages.mt_standard: Jgħid li huwa komunista u jispjega għaliex.
messages.zh: 他说自己是共产主义者，并解释了原因。
messages.en: He says that he is a communist and explains why.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把komunista放进人物介绍卡的政治立场一栏：这里是名词，指支持共产主义的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a community or shared by its members.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与社区有关的，或由社区成员共同使用、参与的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-komunità jew li jintuża flimkien mill-membri tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 社区的；集体共有或共同使用的。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentru komunitarju joffri attivitajiet edukattivi għar-residenti ta' kull età.
formal.en: The community centre offers educational activities for residents of all ages.
formal.zh: 社区中心为各个年龄段的居民提供教育活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu għada? Mark: Fil-ġnien komunitarju ħdejn id-dar tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet tomorrow? Mark: In the community garden near my house.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们明天在哪里见面？马克：在我家附近的社区共享花园。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在我家附近的社区共享花园。
messages.en: In the community garden near my house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把社区中心和共享花园放在同一幅画面里：komunitarju 描述大家共同参与或使用的事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sharing or close spiritual connection; in Christian worship, Holy Communion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 共同分享或精神上的紧密相通；在基督教礼拜中也指圣餐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qsim ta' xi ħaġa jew għaqda spiritwali mill-qrib; fil-qima Nisranija, it-tqarbin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共享；共同参与；思想或精神上的相通。
圣餐；基督教中领受圣体等的宗教礼仪。

collocations.zh: 初领圣体；第一次领圣餐

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi l-ħbiberija bħala komunjoni ta' ideat u sentimenti.
formal.en: The author describes friendship as a sharing of ideas and feelings.
formal.zh: 作者把友谊描述为思想与情感的共享和相通。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-familja kollha sejra l-knisja l-Ħadd? Pawlu: Għax oħti se tagħmel l-Ewwel Komunjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the whole family going to church on Sunday? Pawlu: Because my sister is making her First Holy Communion.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么全家星期日都要去教堂？保罗：因为我妹妹要初领圣体。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-familja kollha sejra l-knisja l-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-familja kollha sejra l-knisja l-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 为什么全家星期日都要去教堂？
messages.en: Why is the whole family going to church on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax oħti se tagħmel l-Ewwel Komunjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax oħti se tagħmel l-Ewwel Komunjoni.
messages.zh: 因为我妹妹要初领圣体。
messages.en: Because my sister is making her First Holy Communion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景分别记义：朋友共享思想是 komunjoni，教堂里领圣餐也用 komunjoni，靠上下文辨别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who takes part in Holy Communion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加圣餐、领受圣体的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu sehem fil-Komunjoni Mqaddsa billi titqarben.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 领圣餐者；参加圣餐并领受圣体的人。

formal.mt: Il-komunjonist resaq lejn l-artal biex jirċievi l-Ewkaristija.
formal.en: The communionist approached the altar to receive the Eucharist.
formal.zh: 领圣体者走近祭台，准备领受圣体。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser il-kelma komunjonist? David: Hija persuna li titqarben.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does the word komunjonist mean? David: It is a person who receives Holy Communion.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：komunjonist 这个词是什么意思？戴维：指领圣餐的人。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: komunjonist 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word komunjonist mean?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.zh: 指领圣餐的人。
messages.en: It is a person who receives Holy Communion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 komunjonist 配上一张人物卡：这张卡指正在领圣餐的人，记住它表示参与者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A solid shape with a circular base that narrows to a single point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 底面为圆形、向上逐渐收拢到一个顶点的立体形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma solida b'bażi ċirkolari li tidjieq sa punt wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圆锥；具有圆形底面和一个顶点的锥体。

formal.mt: Biex tikkalkula l-volum ta' kon, trid tkun taf ir-raġġ tal-bażi u l-għoli tiegħu.
formal.en: To calculate the volume of a cone, you need to know its base radius and height.
formal.zh: 计算圆锥的体积，需要知道它的底面半径和高。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-forma hija ċilindru? Ben: Le, hija kon. Ara kif tispiċċa f'ponta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this shape a cylinder? Ben: No, it is a cone. Look at how it ends in a point.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个形状是圆柱吗？本：不是，是圆锥。你看，它收拢成一个尖顶。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这个形状是圆柱吗？
messages.en: Is this shape a cylinder?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hija kon. Ara kif tispiċċa f'ponta.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hija kon. Ara kif tispiċċa f'ponta.
messages.zh: 不是，是圆锥。你看，它收拢成一个尖顶。
messages.en: No, it is a cone. Look at how it ends in a point.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 kon 时想象一个圆底尖顶的纸模型：底面是圆，侧面向同一个顶点收拢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gives a lecture or delivers a talk to an audience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面向听众进行讲授或发表演讲的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti taħdita jew titkellem quddiem udjenza dwar suġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讲授者；讲座主讲人；演讲者。

formal.mt: Il-konferenzier mistieden se jagħti taħdita dwar il-ħarsien tal-baħar.
formal.en: The guest speaker will give a talk on marine conservation.
formal.zh: 受邀主讲人将就海洋保护进行讲座。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min hu dak ħdejn il-mikrofonu? Ġorġ: Hu l-konferenzier tal-lejla. Se jitkellem dwar il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who is that by the microphone? Ġorġ: He is tonight's speaker. He will talk about the sea.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：麦克风旁边那个人是谁？乔治：他是今晚的主讲人，要讲海洋方面的话题。

messages.speaker: Marta (听众)
messages.zh: 麦克风旁边那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that by the microphone?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-konferenzier tal-lejla. Se jitkellem dwar il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-konferenzier tal-lejla. Se jitkellem dwar il-baħar.
messages.zh: 他是今晚的主讲人，要讲海洋方面的话题。
messages.en: He is tonight's speaker. He will talk about the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象讲台前拿着麦克风、面对听众讲解的人，用 konferenzier 给这位主讲人贴标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a particular religious faith or its professed beliefs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某一宗教信仰、教派或其公开奉行的信条有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' fidi reliġjuża partikolari jew mat-twemmin tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宗教信仰的；属于或体现某一教派及其信条的。

collocations.zh: 以特定宗教信仰为依据的教学

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-karattru konfessjonali tal-istituzzjoni u r-rabta tagħha ma' fidi partikolari.
formal.en: The report describes the institution's confessional character and its connection with a particular faith.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该机构的宗教性质及其与某一特定信仰的联系。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Hawn jgħidu li t-tagħlim huwa konfessjonali. Xi jfisser? Mark: Ifisser li huwa marbut ma' fidi reliġjuża partikolari.
colloquial.en: Anna: It says here that the teaching is confessional. What does that mean? Mark: It means that it is connected with a particular religious faith.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这里说教学具有特定宗教信仰性质，是什么意思？马克：意思是教学与某一特定宗教信仰相关。

messages.speaker: Anna (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn jgħidu li t-tagħlim huwa konfessjonali. Xi jfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn jgħidu li t-tagħlim huwa konfessjonali. Xi jfisser?
messages.zh: 这里说教学具有特定宗教信仰性质，是什么意思？
messages.en: It says here that the teaching is confessional. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li huwa marbut ma' fidi reliġjuża partikolari.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li huwa marbut ma' fidi reliġjuża partikolari.
messages.zh: 意思是教学与某一特定宗教信仰相关。
messages.en: It means that it is connected with a particular religious faith.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konfessjonali 写在机构或教学的说明牌上，提醒自己它是描述宗教信仰性质的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small room or booth in a church where a person makes a religious confession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 教堂内供信徒进行告解的小房间或隔间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra żgħira jew kompartiment fil-knisja fejn persuna tqerr għand saċerdot.

sense_translations.en_definition: confessional (small room where confession is performed)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 告解室；教堂中供信徒向神父告解的小房间或隔间。

formal.mt: Il-konfessjonarju tal-injam jinsab fil-ġenb tal-knisja, qrib id-daħla.
formal.en: The wooden confessional is situated at the side of the church, near the entrance.
formal.zh: 木制告解亭位于教堂侧面，靠近入口。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn hu l-konfessjonarju? Pawlu: Hemm fuq ix-xellug, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where is the confessional? Pawlu: Over there on the left, next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：告解室在哪里？保罗：在那边左侧，门旁边。

messages.speaker: Lina (访客)
messages.zh: 告解室在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the confessional?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教堂工作人员)
messages.zh: 在那边左侧，门旁边。
messages.en: Over there on the left, next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在教堂平面图上画一个小隔间并标上 konfessjonarju，用具体空间记住“告解室”这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who openly professes Christian faith.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公开承认并表明自己基督教信仰的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tistqarr il-fidi Nisranija tagħha fil-beraħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: confessor (one who confesses faith in Christianity)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣认基督信仰者；公开表明自己基督教信仰的人。

collocations.en: a confessor of the Christian faith
a courageous confessor of the faith

formal.mt: It-test jippreżenta lil dan il-bniedem bħala konfessur tal-fidi Nisranija li stqarr it-twemmin tiegħu fil-beraħ.
formal.en: The text presents this man as a confessor of the Christian faith who openly professed his beliefs.
formal.zh: 文本把这个人描述为公开表明自身信仰的基督信仰宣认者。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex it-test isejjaħlu konfessur? David: Għax stqarr il-fidi Nisranija tiegħu fil-beraħ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why does the text call him a confessor? David: Because he openly professed his Christian faith.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：为什么文章称他为信仰宣认者？戴维：因为他公开表明了自己的基督教信仰。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么文章称他为信仰宣认者？
messages.en: Why does the text call him a confessor?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax stqarr il-fidi Nisranija tiegħu fil-beraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għax stqarr il-fidi Nisranija tiegħu fil-beraħ.
messages.zh: 因为他公开表明了自己的基督教信仰。
messages.en: Because he openly professed his Christian faith.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人公开说出“我信奉基督教”，用 konfessur 标记这位宣认信仰的人，抓住“公开表明信仰”来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Given a particular shape or a clearly defined outline.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被塑造成某种形状的，或具有明确轮廓的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ngħata għamla partikolari jew kontorn ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成形的；轮廓已被勾勒出的。

collocations.en: a model shaped like a star
an object shaped with rounded lines
collocations.zh: 以圆润线条塑形的物体

formal.mt: Il-blokk tal-ġebel huwa konfigurat f'għamla ta' għasfur, b'kontorn sempliċi u ċar.
formal.en: The stone block is shaped into a bird, with a simple, clear outline.
formal.zh: 这块石料被塑造成一只鸟，轮廓简洁清晰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-mudell huwa konfigurat bħal stilla? Pawlu: Iva, ħares lejn il-ħames ponot tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this model shaped like a star? Pawlu: Yes, look at its five points.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个模型是塑造成星形的吗？保罗：对，你看它的五个尖角。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-mudell huwa konfigurat bħal stilla?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-mudell huwa konfigurat bħal stilla?
messages.zh: 这个模型是塑造成星形的吗？
messages.en: Is this model shaped like a star?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (美术老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħares lejn il-ħames ponot tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħares lejn il-ħames ponot tiegħu.
messages.zh: 对，你看它的五个尖角。
messages.en: Yes, look at its five points.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块石料被雕成小鸟：看到具体形状和清楚轮廓，就用 konfigurat 描述它已经成形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The way the parts of something are arranged or set up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个事物各部分的排列方式或设置方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif il-partijiet ta' xi ħaġa jkunu rranġati jew issettjati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 配置；各部分的排列布局或设置方式。

formal.mt: Qabel tibdel il-konfigurazzjoni tan-netwerk, agħmel kopja tas-settings attwali.
formal.en: Before changing the network configuration, make a copy of the current settings.
formal.zh: 更改网络配置之前，请备份当前设置。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex il-kompjuter mhux qed jaqbad man-netwerk? Sara: Il-konfigurazzjoni mhix tajba; ejja niċċekkjaw is-settings.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why isn't the computer connecting to the network? Sara: The configuration isn't right; let's check the settings.
colloquial.zh: 马克：电脑为什么连不上网络？萨拉：配置不对，我们检查一下设置吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kompjuter mhux qed jaqbad man-netwerk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kompjuter mhux qed jaqbad man-netwerk?
messages.zh: 电脑为什么连不上网络？
messages.en: Why isn't the computer connecting to the network?

messages.speaker: Sara (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-konfigurazzjoni mhix tajba; ejja niċċekkjaw is-settings.
messages.mt_standard: Il-konfigurazzjoni mhix tajba; ejja niċċekkjaw is-settings.
messages.zh: 配置不对，我们检查一下设置吧。
messages.en: The configuration isn't right; let's check the settings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konfigurazzjoni 想成一张布局设置图：零件怎么摆、选项怎么设，合起来就是配置。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the shape of a cone, or relating to a cone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有圆锥形状的，或与圆锥有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu għamla ta' kon jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' kon.

sense_translations.en_definition: conical (of or relating to a cone)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 圆锥的；与圆锥有关的。
圆锥形的；底部呈圆形、向顶端逐渐收尖的。

formal.mt: It-torri għandu saqaf koniku li jispiċċa f'ponta waħda.
formal.en: The tower has a conical roof that ends in a single point.
formal.zh: 这座塔有一个圆锥形屋顶，顶部收成一个尖点。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema kappell trid għall-festa? Ben: Dak koniku, li jidher bħal kon tal-ġelat rasu 'l isfel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which hat do you want for the party? Ben: The conical one, which looks like an upside-down ice cream cone.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：聚会你想戴哪顶帽子？本：那顶圆锥形的，看起来像倒过来的冰淇淋筒。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 聚会你想戴哪顶帽子？
messages.en: Which hat do you want for the party?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak koniku, li jidher bħal kon tal-ġelat rasu 'l isfel.
messages.mt_standard: Dak koniku, li jidher bħal kon tal-ġelat rasu 'l isfel.
messages.zh: 那顶圆锥形的，看起来像倒过来的冰淇淋筒。
messages.en: The conical one, which looks like an upside-down ice cream cone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 koniku 就在脑中画一顶派对尖帽：下面圆、上面尖，这个形状就是圆锥形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to take different verb forms according to grammatical features such as person, number, or tense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指动词可以根据人称、数或时态等语法特征改变形式的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jieħu forom verbali differenti skont il-persuna, l-għadd jew iż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可变位的；指动词能够按人称、数或时态等发生形式变化的。

collocations.en: a verb that can be conjugated in the past tense
collocations.zh: 可以作过去时变位的动词

formal.mt: Il-verb 'kiteb' huwa konjugabbli: fost il-forom tiegħu hemm 'ktibt', 'kiteb' u 'kitbu'.
formal.en: The verb 'kiteb' is conjugable: its forms include 'ktibt', 'kiteb', and 'kitbu'.
formal.zh: 动词 kiteb（写）可以变位，其形式包括 ktibt、kiteb 和 kitbu。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-verb huwa konjugabbli? Rita: Iva, ibdel il-persuna u ara kif tinbidel il-forma tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this verb conjugable? Rita: Yes, change the person and see how its form changes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个动词可以变位吗？丽塔：可以，换个人称，看看它的形式怎样变化。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个动词可以变位吗？
messages.en: Is this verb conjugable?

messages.speaker: Rita (语言老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ibdel il-persuna u ara kif tinbidel il-forma tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ibdel il-persuna u ara kif tinbidel il-forma tiegħu.
messages.zh: 可以，换个人称，看看它的形式怎样变化。
messages.en: Yes, change the person and see how its form changes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konjugabbli 记成动词的“可换装”标签：换人称或时态时能够换形式，就是可变位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The changing of a verb's form to express grammatical features such as person, number, or tense, or the set of forms produced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动词为表达人称、数或时态等语法特征而发生的形式变化，也指这些变化构成的一组形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bidla fil-forma ta' verb skont il-persuna, l-għadd jew iż-żmien, jew il-ġabra ta' dawn il-forom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动词变位；动词按人称、数、时态等变化的过程或整组形式。

formal.mt: It-tabella turi l-konjugazzjoni tal-verb 'kiteb' fil-passat għal kull persuna.
formal.en: The table shows the past-tense conjugation of the verb 'kiteb' for each person.
formal.zh: 该表列出了动词 kiteb（写）在过去时中各个人称的变位形式。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Dejjem ninsa l-konjugazzjoni ta' dan il-verb. Emma: Ejja ngħidu l-forom flimkien: 'jien ktibt, int ktibt, hu kiteb'.
colloquial.en: Luca: I always forget the conjugation of this verb. Emma: Let's say the forms together: 'I wrote, you wrote, he wrote'.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我总是忘记这个动词的变位。艾玛：我们一起说这些形式吧：“jien ktibt（我写了）、int ktibt（你写了）、hu kiteb（他写了）”。

messages.speaker: Luca (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dejjem ninsa l-konjugazzjoni ta' dan il-verb.
messages.mt_standard: Dejjem ninsa l-konjugazzjoni ta' dan il-verb.
messages.zh: 我总是忘记这个动词的变位。
messages.en: I always forget the conjugation of this verb.

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja ngħidu l-forom flimkien: 'jien ktibt, int ktibt, hu kiteb'.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja ngħidu l-forom flimkien: 'jien ktibt, int ktibt, hu kiteb'.
messages.zh: 我们一起说这些形式吧：“jien ktibt（我写了）、int ktibt（你写了）、hu kiteb（他写了）”。
messages.en: Let's say the forms together: 'I wrote, you wrote, he wrote'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konjugazzjoni 想成动词的换装表：沿着我、你、他逐行读，观察同一个动词怎样变位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ditch or trench, usually dug around a tree to collect water near its roots.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挖出的沟或沟槽，通常围着树挖，用来让水汇集在树根附近。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħofra jew kanal fl-art, normalment imħaffer madwar siġra biex jiġbor l-ilma qrib l-għeruq.

sense_translations.en_definition: a ditch or trench (usually dug out around a tree)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 沟或沟槽，通常指围着树挖出的沟。

collocations.en: to dig a ditch around a tree

formal.mt: Wara t-tħawwil, il-ġardinar ħaffer konka madwar is-siġra biex l-ilma jinġabar qrib l-għeruq.
formal.en: After planting, the gardener dug a ditch around the tree so that water would collect near the roots.
formal.zh: 栽种之后，园丁在树周围挖了一圈沟，让水汇集在树根附近。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn inferra' l-ilma għal din is-siġra? Ġużeppi: Fil-konka ta' madwarha, biex ma jinfirex mal-mogħdija.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where should I pour the water for this tree? Ġużeppi: Into the ditch around it, so it doesn't spread onto the path.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：给这棵树浇的水要倒在哪里？朱塞佩：倒进树周围的沟里，这样水就不会流到小路上。

messages.speaker: Anna (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inferra' l-ilma għal din is-siġra?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inferra' l-ilma għal din is-siġra?
messages.zh: 给这棵树浇的水要倒在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I pour the water for this tree?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-konka ta' madwarha, biex ma jinfirex mal-mogħdija.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-konka ta' madwarha, biex ma jinfirex mal-mogħdija.
messages.zh: 倒进树周围的沟里，这样水就不会流到小路上。
messages.en: Into the ditch around it, so it doesn't spread onto the path.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 konka 时画一棵树，再围着树画一圈凹沟；把水倒进沟里，树根附近就能蓄住水。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The protection and careful management of nature, resources, or cultural objects to prevent loss or damage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为防止损失或损坏而对自然环境、资源或文化物品进行的保护与妥善管理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħarsien u l-immaniġġjar bir-reqqa tan-natura, tar-riżorsi jew ta' oġġetti kulturali biex jiġi evitat telf jew ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保护；保育；对自然、资源或文化遗产等的维护和保存。

formal.mt: Il-proġett ta' konservazzjoni għandu l-għan li jipproteġi l-abitat u jnaqqas il-ħsara kkawżata mill-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The conservation project aims to protect the habitat and reduce damage caused by visitors.
formal.zh: 这项保育工程旨在保护栖息地，并减少游客造成的破坏。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma nistgħux nimxu barra mill-mogħdija? Mark: Għall-konservazzjoni tan-natura; hemm pjanti żgħar li nistgħu ngħaffġu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why can't we walk off the path? Mark: To conserve nature; there are small plants we might trample.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么不能走到小路外面？马克：为了保护自然，那里有小植物，我们可能会踩坏它们。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux nimxu barra mill-mogħdija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux nimxu barra mill-mogħdija?
messages.zh: 为什么不能走到小路外面？
messages.en: Why can't we walk off the path?

messages.speaker: Mark (自然导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-konservazzjoni tan-natura; hemm pjanti żgħar li nistgħu ngħaffġu.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-konservazzjoni tan-natura; hemm pjanti żgħar li nistgħu ngħaffġu.
messages.zh: 为了保护自然，那里有小植物，我们可能会踩坏它们。
messages.en: To conserve nature; there are small plants we might trample.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konservazzjoni 联想到步道旁的小植物：留在步道上、减少踩踏，就是用行动保护和保育。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Large in amount, size, degree, or importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在数量、规模、程度或重要性上相当大的，达到值得注意的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li huwa kbir fl-ammont, fid-daqs, fil-grad jew fl-importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相当大的；数量可观的；程度显著的

formal.mt: L-istudju jeħtieġ ammont konsiderabbli ta' ħin u riżorsi.
formal.en: The study requires a considerable amount of time and resources.
formal.zh: 这项研究需要投入相当多的时间和资源。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandna bżonn ħafna flus għat-tiswijiet? Pawlu: Iva, se jkollna bżonn ammont konsiderabbli.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do we need a lot of money for the repairs? Pawlu: Yes, we will need a considerable amount.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：维修需要很多钱吗？保罗：是的，我们会需要一笔可观的钱。

messages.speaker: Marija (妻子)
messages.zh: 维修需要很多钱吗？
messages.en: Do we need a lot of money for the repairs?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se jkollna bżonn ammont konsiderabbli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se jkollna bżonn ammont konsiderabbli.
messages.zh: 是的，我们会需要一笔可观的钱。
messages.en: Yes, we will need a considerable amount.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konsiderabbli 与英语 considerable 对照记忆，再想象一笔可观的维修费；用 ammont konsiderabbli 记住它作形容词，描述数量相当大。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To a large or noticeable degree, especially when describing a change or difference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示达到相当大或明显的程度，常用来描述变化幅度或差异。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sa grad kbir jew li jinħass sew, speċjalment meta tiddeskrivi bidla jew differenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相当地；大幅地；显著地，表示程度或变化幅度较大

formal.mt: L-ispiża tal-proġett żdiedet konsiderabilment matul is-sena.
formal.en: The cost of the project increased considerably during the year.
formal.zh: 该项目的成本在这一年中大幅增加。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-prezz niżel? Pawlu: Iva, naqas konsiderabilment minn meta rajnieh l-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has the price gone down? Pawlu: Yes, it has decreased considerably since we last saw it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：价格降了吗？保罗：是的，比我们上次看到时降了很多。

messages.speaker: Marija (妻子)
messages.zh: 价格降了吗？
messages.en: Has the price gone down?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naqas konsiderabilment minn meta rajnieh l-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naqas konsiderabilment minn meta rajnieh l-aħħar.
messages.zh: 是的，比我们上次看到时降了很多。
messages.en: Yes, it has decreased considerably since we last saw it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konsiderabilment 与英语 considerably 对照记忆，想象价格标签明显下降；用 naqas konsiderabilment 记住它作副词，说明减少的幅度很大。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Careful thought about something, especially before making a decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某件事情进行认真思考，尤其指作决定之前的考虑和权衡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsieb bir-reqqa dwar xi ħaġa, speċjalment qabel ma tittieħed deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 考虑；深思；思量。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ħa f'konsiderazzjoni l-ħtiġijiet tal-istudenti qabel ma ħa deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The committee took the students' needs into consideration before making a decision.
formal.zh: 委员会在作出决定之前，把学生的需求纳入了考虑。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nistgħu nieħdu l-prezz f'konsiderazzjoni qabel nagħżlu? Pawlu: Dażgur. Ejja naraw kemm nistgħu nonfqu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can we take the price into consideration before choosing? Pawlu: Of course. Let's see how much we can spend.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我们能不能先考虑一下价格，再作选择？保罗：当然。我们看看能花多少钱吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nieħdu l-prezz f'konsiderazzjoni qabel nagħżlu?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nieħdu l-prezz f'konsiderazzjoni qabel nagħżlu?
messages.zh: 我们能不能先考虑一下价格，再作选择？
messages.en: Can we take the price into consideration before choosing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dażgur. Ejja naraw kemm nistgħu nonfqu.
messages.mt_standard: Dażgur. Ejja naraw kemm nistgħu nonfqu.
messages.zh: 当然。我们看看能花多少钱吧。
messages.en: Of course. Let's see how much we can spend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象作决定前，把价格、时间和需求逐一放到心里的天平上；这个认真权衡的过程就是 konsiderazzjoni。搭配 f'konsiderazzjoni 一起记，表示“纳入考虑”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Large enough in amount, degree, or importance to be noticeable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量、程度或重要性相当大，达到值得注意的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kbir biżżejjed fl-ammont, fil-grad jew fl-importanza biex wieħed jinnotah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相当大的；数量可观的；程度显著的。

formal.mt: Il-proġett jeħtieġ ammont konsiderevoli ta' ħin u riżorsi.
formal.en: The project requires a considerable amount of time and resources.
formal.zh: 这个项目需要投入相当多的时间和资源。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għamilt progress konsiderevoli fil-Malti dan ix-xahar. Pawlu: Tajjeb ħafna! Issa tifhem aktar meta nitkellmu?
colloquial.en: Marija: I've made considerable progress in Maltese this month. Pawlu: That's great! Do you understand more now when we talk?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这个月我的马耳他语进步很大。保罗：太好了！现在我们聊天时，你能听懂更多了吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilt progress konsiderevoli fil-Malti dan ix-xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Għamilt progress konsiderevoli fil-Malti dan ix-xahar.
messages.zh: 这个月我的马耳他语进步很大。
messages.en: I've made considerable progress in Maltese this month.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna! Issa tifhem aktar meta nitkellmu?
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna! Issa tifhem aktar meta nitkellmu?
messages.zh: 太好了！现在我们聊天时，你能听懂更多了吗？
messages.en: That's great! Do you understand more now when we talk?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象学习进度条明显向前跳了一大截，用 progress konsiderevoli 记住“显著进步”；再联想到一大笔时间或资源，记住它表示数量或程度相当大。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To a large or noticeable degree, especially when describing a change or difference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示变化或差异达到相当大、明显可察觉的程度，常译为“显著地”或“大幅地”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sa grad kbir jew b'mod li jidher ċar, speċjalment meta jkun hemm bidla jew differenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相当大程度地；显著地；大幅地。

formal.mt: Il-konsum tal-ilma naqas konsiderevolment wara t-tiswija tal-pajp.
formal.en: Water consumption decreased considerably after the pipe was repaired.
formal.zh: 水管修好后，用水量大幅下降。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-kont tad-dawl naqas konsiderevolment dan ix-xahar. Pawlu: Veru! Ħallasna għoxrin ewro inqas mix-xahar li għadda.
colloquial.en: Marija: The electricity bill went down considerably this month. Pawlu: It really did! We paid twenty euros less than last month.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这个月的电费降了不少。保罗：确实！我们比上个月少付了二十欧元。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kont tad-dawl naqas konsiderevolment dan ix-xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kont tad-dawl naqas konsiderevolment dan ix-xahar.
messages.zh: 这个月的电费降了不少。
messages.en: The electricity bill went down considerably this month.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru! Ħallasna għoxrin ewro inqas mix-xahar li għadda.
messages.mt_standard: Veru! Ħallasna għoxrin ewro inqas mix-xahar li għadda.
messages.zh: 确实！我们比上个月少付了二十欧元。
messages.en: It really did! We paid twenty euros less than last month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它与一张前后对比图一起记：柱子明显升高或降低，就用 konsiderevolment 强调“变化幅度相当大”；它说明程度，不说明变化方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The presence or introduction of unwanted or harmful substances in something, making it dirty, impure, or unsafe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不需要的或有害的物质进入或存在于某物之中，使其受到污染、变得不纯净或不安全的状态或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-preżenza jew id-dħul ta' sustanzi mhux mixtieqa jew ta' ħsara f'xi ħaġa, li jagħmluha maħmuġa, impura jew mhux sikura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污染；沾染，指物品、物质或环境受到不需要的或有害物质的影响。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika kontaminazzjoni tal-ilma u jitlob aktar testijiet.
formal.en: The report indicates water contamination and calls for further testing.
formal.zh: 报告指出水受到污染，并要求进一步检测。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed iżżomm il-laħam nej separat mill-insalata? Mark: Biex nevita l-kontaminazzjoni tal-ikel.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you keeping the raw meat separate from the salad? Mark: To avoid food contamination.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么把生肉和沙拉分开放？马克：为了避免食品受到污染。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iżżomm il-laħam nej separat mill-insalata?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iżżomm il-laħam nej separat mill-insalata?
messages.zh: 你为什么把生肉和沙拉分开放？
messages.en: Why are you keeping the raw meat separate from the salad?

messages.speaker: Mark (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 为了避免食品受到污染。
messages.en: To avoid food contamination.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一杯清水混入脏东西，用 kontaminazzjoni 给“受到污染”这个过程命名；再把清水换成食物，连着记住“水污染”和“食品污染”两个搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flying jib: a triangular sail set forward of the other headsails on a sailing vessel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外艏三角帆，帆船上设置在其他艏帆前方的一种三角帆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' qlugħ trijangulari li jittella' quddiem il-qlugħ l-ieħor ta' quddiem fuq bastiment bil-qlugħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外艏三角帆，位于其他艏帆前方的三角帆。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq tal-bastiment, l-ekwipaġġ ikkontrolla l-kontraflokk biex jiżgura li kien f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: Before the vessel's departure, the crew checked the flying jib to ensure that it was in good condition.
formal.zh: 船只出发前，船员检查了外艏三角帆，确保其状况良好。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'jissejjaħ dak il-qlugħ ta' quddiem? Pawlu: Dak hu l-kontraflokk. Marija: Mela fir-ritratt se nimmarkah bħala kontraflokk.
colloquial.en: Marija: What is that sail at the front called? Pawlu: That's the flying jib. Marija: Then I'll label it as the flying jib in the photo.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：前面那面帆叫什么？保罗：那是外艏三角帆。玛丽娅：那我就在照片上把它标成外艏三角帆。

messages.speaker: Marija (航海学员)
messages.zh: 前面那面帆叫什么？
messages.en: What is that sail at the front called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (航海教练)
messages.zh: 那是外艏三角帆。
messages.en: That's the flying jib.

messages.speaker: Marija (航海学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela fir-ritratt se nimmarkah bħala kontraflokk.
messages.mt_standard: Mela fir-ritratt se nimmarkah bħala kontraflokk.
messages.zh: 那我就在照片上把它标成外艏三角帆。
messages.en: Then I'll label it as the flying jib in the photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一艘帆船，把 kontraflokk 标在其他艏帆前方的三角帆旁，用位置图记住“外艏三角帆”；这是图像联想，不是词源拆解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mizzen topsail: an upper sail carried on the mizzen mast, toward the rear of a sailing vessel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 后桅上帆，设置在帆船后部后桅上方的一面帆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qlugħ ta' fuq tal-arblu ta' wara ta' bastiment bil-qlugħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 后桅上帆，设置在后桅上部的帆。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq tal-bastiment, l-ekwipaġġ ikkontrolla l-kontramezzana biex jiżgura li kienet f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: Before the vessel's departure, the crew checked the mizzen topsail to ensure that it was in good condition.
formal.zh: 船只出发前，船员检查了后桅上帆，确保其状况良好。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'jissejjaħ dak il-qlugħ ta' fuq fuq l-arblu ta' wara? Pawlu: Dik hi l-kontramezzana. Marija: Mela fir-ritratt se nimmarkaha bħala kontramezzana.
colloquial.en: Marija: What is that upper sail on the rear mast called? Pawlu: That's the mizzen topsail. Marija: Then I'll label it as the mizzen topsail in the photo.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：后面那根桅杆上方的帆叫什么？保罗：那是后桅上帆。玛丽娅：那我就在照片上把它标成后桅上帆。

messages.speaker: Marija (航海学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jissejjaħ dak il-qlugħ ta' fuq fuq l-arblu ta' wara?
messages.mt_standard: X'jissejjaħ dak il-qlugħ ta' fuq fuq l-arblu ta' wara?
messages.zh: 后面那根桅杆上方的帆叫什么？
messages.en: What is that upper sail on the rear mast called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (航海教练)
messages.zh: 那是后桅上帆。
messages.en: That's the mizzen topsail.

messages.speaker: Marija (航海学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela fir-ritratt se nimmarkaha bħala kontramezzana.
messages.mt_standard: Mela fir-ritratt se nimmarkaha bħala kontramezzana.
messages.zh: 那我就在照片上把它标成后桅上帆。
messages.en: Then I'll label it as the mizzen topsail in the photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一艘帆船，把 kontramezzana 标在后桅上部的帆旁，用“后桅＋上方”的位置图记住“后桅上帆”；这是图像联想，不是词源拆解。

gloss_zh: 展帆索；用于拉展帆角的索具

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rope in a sailing vessel's rigging used to spread a lower corner of a sail outward.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帆船索具中的一种绳索，用于向外拉展帆的下角，使帆展开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħabel fl-armar ta' bastiment li jintuża biex jiġbed kantuniera t'isfel ta' qlugħ lejn barra u jżommu mifrux.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 展帆索，用于向外拉展帆下角的绳索。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, il-baħri eżamina l-kontramura biex jiżgura li l-ħabel kien f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: Before departure, the sailor inspected the passaree to ensure that the rope was in good condition.
formal.zh: 启航前，水手检查了展帆索，确保绳索状况良好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tissikka l-kontramura? Pawlu: Biex il-kantuniera tal-qlugħ tibqa' miġbuda lejn barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you tightening the passaree? Pawlu: To keep the corner of the sail pulled outward.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么在收紧展帆索？Pawlu：为了让帆角保持向外拉开的状态。

messages.speaker: Maja (航海学员)
messages.zh: 你为什么在收紧展帆索？
messages.en: Why are you tightening the passaree?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (水手)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex il-kantuniera tal-qlugħ tibqa' miġbuda lejn barra.
messages.mt_standard: Biex il-kantuniera tal-qlugħ tibqa' miġbuda lejn barra.
messages.zh: 为了让帆角保持向外拉开的状态。
messages.en: To keep the corner of the sail pulled outward.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面记忆：看到 kontramura，就想象一根绳索把帆的下角向外拉开；再配对记住“收紧”和“放松”两个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A square sail set above the topsail on a sailing vessel's mast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帆船桅杆上设置在中桅帆上方的横帆，称为上桅帆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qlugħ kwadru li jintrama fuq arblu ta' bastiment, 'il fuq mill-qlugħ tan-nofs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上桅帆，位于中桅帆上方的横帆。

formal.mt: Fid-dijagramma tal-bastiment, il-kontrapappafik jidher 'il fuq mill-qlugħ tan-nofs.
formal.en: In the diagram of the vessel, the topgallant sail is shown above the topsail.
formal.zh: 在船舶示意图中，上桅帆画在中桅帆的上方。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema wieħed hu l-kontrapappafik? Mark: Dak il-qlugħ kwadru hemm fuq, 'il fuq mill-qlugħ tan-nofs.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which one is the topgallant sail? Mark: That square sail up there, above the topsail.
colloquial.zh: Lara：哪一面是上桅帆？Mark：就是上面那面横帆，在中桅帆的上方。

messages.speaker: Lara (航海学员)
messages.zh: 哪一面是上桅帆？
messages.en: Which one is the topgallant sail?

messages.speaker: Mark (航海教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-qlugħ kwadru hemm fuq, 'il fuq mill-qlugħ tan-nofs.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-qlugħ kwadru hemm fuq, 'il fuq mill-qlugħ tan-nofs.
messages.zh: 就是上面那面横帆，在中桅帆的上方。
messages.en: That square sail up there, above the topsail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用位置记忆：在帆船图上先找到中桅帆，再向上找上桅帆，并给它标上 kontrapappafik；同时联想升帆与降帆两个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spar on a sailing vessel known as a monkey gaff.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帆船上的一种斜桁，英语称为 monkey gaff。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lastun fuq bastiment bil-qlugħ, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala 'monkey gaff'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船用小斜桁。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-ispezzjoni, il-kontrapik huwa mniżżel fost il-partijiet li jeħtieġu tiswija.
formal.en: In the inspection report, the monkey gaff is listed among the parts requiring repair.
formal.zh: 检查报告将小斜桁列为需要修理的部件之一。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Liema parti hi l-kontrapik? Rita: Din hawn. Ejja nurik fejn tidher fil-pjanta.
colloquial.en: Mark: Which part is the monkey gaff? Rita: This one here. Let me show you where it appears on the plan.
colloquial.zh: 马克：哪个部件是小斜桁？丽塔：就是这里这个。我指给你看它在图纸上的位置。

messages.speaker: Mark (航海学员)
messages.zh: 哪个部件是小斜桁？
messages.en: Which part is the monkey gaff?

messages.speaker: Rita (航海教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hawn. Ejja nurik fejn tidher fil-pjanta.
messages.mt_standard: Din hawn. Ejja nurik fejn tidher fil-pjanta.
messages.zh: 就是这里这个。我指给你看它在图纸上的位置。
messages.en: This one here. Let me show you where it appears on the plan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kontrapik 写在帆船小斜桁的示意图旁，再配上“安装、检查”两个动作，借助部件与动作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structural member of a vessel described as a false keel or keelson.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 船体结构中的一种龙骨相关构件，可指假龙骨或内龙骨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti strutturali ta' bastiment marbuta mal-karina, deskritta bħala karina falza jew karina interna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 假龙骨；内龙骨。

collocations.en: inspection of the false keel or keelson
collocations.zh: 假龙骨或内龙骨的检查

collocations.en: repair of the false keel or keelson
collocations.zh: 假龙骨或内龙骨的修理

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi deskrizzjoni tal-kontrapirmiżżan u ritratti li juru l-kundizzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The report includes a description of the false keel or keelson and photographs showing its condition.
formal.zh: 报告包括对假龙骨或内龙骨的描述，以及显示其状况的照片。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn jidher il-kontrapirmiżżan f'din il-pjanta? Pawlu: Hawn, ħdejn dan in-numru. Ejja naqraw id-deskrizzjoni flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where does the false keel or keelson appear on this plan? Pawlu: Here, beside this number. Let's read the description together.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张图纸上的假龙骨或内龙骨在哪里？保罗：这里，在这个编号旁边。我们一起读一下说明。

messages.speaker: Lara (造船学徒)
messages.zh: 这张图纸上的假龙骨或内龙骨在哪里？
messages.en: Where does the false keel or keelson appear on this plan?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (造船师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn, ħdejn dan in-numru. Ejja naqraw id-deskrizzjoni flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn, ħdejn dan in-numru. Ejja naqraw id-deskrizzjoni flimkien.
messages.zh: 这里，在这个编号旁边。我们一起读一下说明。
messages.en: Here, beside this number. Let's read the description together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kontrapirmiżżan 做成图纸标签，旁边并列写“假龙骨、内龙骨”；用同一词条对应两个中文义项来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shortening or tightening, especially of a muscle; also a reduction in size or the shortening of a linguistic form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缩短或收紧，尤指肌肉的收缩；也可指规模缩小或语言形式的缩约。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqassir jew issikkar, speċjalment ta' muskolu; ukoll tnaqqis fid-daqs jew tqassir ta' forma lingwistika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收缩；缩短；语言形式的缩约

formal.mt: Waqt il-kontrazzjoni, il-muskolu jiqsar u jiġbed l-għadma biex joħloq moviment.
formal.en: During contraction, the muscle shortens and pulls the bone to produce movement.
formal.zh: 收缩时，肌肉缩短并牵拉骨骼，从而产生运动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'kontrazzjoni' f'din is-sentenza dwar il-muskoli? Mark: Tfisser li muskolu jiqsar u jissikka.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'kontrazzjoni' mean in this sentence about muscles? Mark: It means that a muscle shortens and tightens.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句讲肌肉的话里，kontrazzjoni 是什么意思？马克：意思是肌肉缩短并收紧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'kontrazzjoni' f'din is-sentenza dwar il-muskoli?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'kontrazzjoni' f'din is-sentenza dwar il-muskoli?
messages.zh: 这句讲肌肉的话里，kontrazzjoni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'kontrazzjoni' mean in this sentence about muscles?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li muskolu jiqsar u jissikka.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li muskolu jiqsar u jissikka.
messages.zh: 意思是肌肉缩短并收紧。
messages.en: It means that a muscle shortens and tightens.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kontrazzjoni 配上“握拳时肌肉收紧”的画面，记住核心意思“收缩”；再用“把长表达缩短”联想语言中的“缩约”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gives writing, ideas, work, money, or other support to a publication, project, or shared activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向刊物、项目或共同活动提供文章、想法、劳动、金钱或其他支持的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti kitbiet, ideat, xogħol, flus jew appoġġ ieħor għal pubblikazzjoni, proġett jew attività komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贡献者；提供文章的投稿人；提供资金或其他支持的捐助者

collocations.zh: 定期投稿人；经常提供支持的贡献者

formal.mt: Kull kontributur għar-rivista għandu jibgħat l-artiklu tiegħu lill-editur sal-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: Each contributor to the magazine should send their article to the editor by the end of the month.
formal.zh: 每位杂志投稿人应在月底前将自己的文章交给编辑。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Se nkun kontributur għar-rivista tal-iskola! Maja: Tajjeb! Fuq xiex se tikteb? Mark: Se nikteb dwar il-futbol.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm going to be a contributor to the school magazine! Maja: Great! What are you going to write about? Mark: I'm going to write about football.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我要给校刊投稿了！玛雅：太好了！你打算写什么？马克：我打算写足球。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学兼校刊投稿人)
messages.zh: 我要给校刊投稿了！
messages.en: I'm going to be a contributor to the school magazine!

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 太好了！你打算写什么？
messages.en: Great! What are you going to write about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学兼校刊投稿人)
messages.zh: 我打算写足球。
messages.en: I'm going to write about football.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kontributur 想成“给共同成果添一份力的人”：给杂志添文章是投稿人，给项目添劳动或资金也是贡献者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Helping to bring about a result, usually together with other factors.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 促成某种结果的，通常与其他因素共同起作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħinu biex iseħħ riżultat, ġeneralment flimkien ma' fatturi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 促成的；对某种结果起作用的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika n-nuqqas ta' persunal u l-problemi tekniċi bħala fatturi kontribwenti għad-dewmien fil-proġett.
formal.en: The report identifies staff shortages and technical problems as contributory factors in the project's delay.
formal.zh: 报告将人员短缺和技术问题列为促成项目延期的因素。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex wasalna tard? Mark: It-traffiku u x-xita kienu fatturi kontribwenti, imma tlaqna tard ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did we arrive late? Mark: Traffic and rain were contributory factors, but we also left late.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们为什么迟到了？Mark：堵车和下雨都是促成因素，不过我们出发也晚了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did we arrive late?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-traffiku u x-xita kienu fatturi kontribwenti, imma tlaqna tard ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: It-traffiku u x-xita kienu fatturi kontribwenti, imma tlaqna tard ukoll.
messages.zh: 堵车和下雨都是促成因素，不过我们出发也晚了。
messages.en: Traffic and rain were contributory factors, but we also left late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进 fatturi kontribwenti（促成因素）一起记：想象堵车、下雨和晚出门共同造成迟到，每个因素都推了一把。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word that connects words, phrases, or clauses in a sentence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在句子中连接词、短语或分句的词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tgħaqqad kliem, frażijiet jew propożizzjonijiet f'sentenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 连词，即连接词语、短语或分句的词。

collocations.en: a conjunction that joins two phrases

formal.mt: Fis-sentenza 'Marija taqra u Pawlu jikteb', il-kelma 'u' hija konġunzjoni li tgħaqqad żewġ propożizzjonijiet.
formal.en: In the sentence 'Marija reads and Pawlu writes', the word 'and' is a conjunction joining two clauses.
formal.zh: 在句子“玛丽娅读书，保罗写字”中，马耳他语的 u（和）是连接两个分句的连词。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kelma 'imma' hija konġunzjoni? Toni: Iva, bħal f''Irrid noħroġ, imma qed tagħmel ix-xita'.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the word 'but' a conjunction? Toni: Yes, as in 'I want to go out, but it's raining'.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：imma（但是）是连词吗？托尼：是的，比如“我想出去，但是正在下雨”。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: imma（但是）是连词吗？
messages.en: Is the word 'but' a conjunction?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bħal f''Irrid noħroġ, imma qed tagħmel ix-xita'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bħal f''Irrid noħroġ, imma qed tagħmel ix-xita'.
messages.zh: 是的，比如“我想出去，但是正在下雨”。
messages.en: Yes, as in 'I want to go out, but it's raining'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 konġunzjoni 想成句子里的小桥：u（和）与 imma（但是）都把两边的内容连接起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The organization of people, activities, or movements so that they work together effectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人员、活动或动作进行组织安排，使其有效配合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-organizzazzjoni ta' persuni, attivitajiet jew movimenti sabiex jaħdmu flimkien b'mod effettiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 协调；使人员、活动或动作相互配合的组织安排。

formal.mt: Koordinazzjoni effettiva bejn it-timijiet hija meħtieġa biex il-proġett jitlesta fil-ħin.
formal.en: Effective coordination between teams is needed to complete the project on time.
formal.zh: 团队之间需要有效协调，才能按时完成项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-koordinazzjoni tal-festa? Mark: Jien. Int ġib l-ikel, u Lara tieħu ħsieb il-mużika.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will handle the coordination of the party? Mark: I will. You bring the food, and Lara will take care of the music.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁来负责聚会的统筹协调？Mark：我来。你带食物，Lara负责音乐。

messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-koordinazzjoni tal-festa?

messages.zh: 我来。你带食物，Lara负责音乐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The outer cover of a magazine or periodical, usually displaying its title and a main image.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 杂志或期刊最外面的封面，通常印有刊名和主要图片。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qoxra ta' barra ta' rivista jew pubblikazzjoni perjodika, li normalment turi t-titlu u stampa ewlenija.

sense_translations.en_definition: outer cover (of a magazine or periodical)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 杂志或期刊的外封面

formal.mt: Il-kopertina tar-rivista turi ritratt tal-port u t-titlu tal-artiklu ewlieni.
formal.en: The magazine cover displays a photograph of the harbour and the title of the main article.
formal.zh: 这本杂志的封面展示了一张港口照片和主打文章的标题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-kopertina tar-rivista l-ġdida? Mark: Iva, għoġbitni l-istampa fuqha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen the cover of the new magazine? Mark: Yes, I liked the picture on it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看过新杂志的封面了吗？马克：看过，我挺喜欢上面的图片。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看过新杂志的封面了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the cover of the new magazine?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看过，我挺喜欢上面的图片。
messages.en: Yes, I liked the picture on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿起一本杂志，先看到刊名和大图的那一面，就是 kopertina；把这个词与杂志封面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Qur'an, the sacred scripture of Islam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 《古兰经》，伊斯兰教的神圣经典。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ktieb imqaddes tal-Iżlam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 《古兰经》

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, l-għalliem qara silta mill-Koran u spjega t-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher read a passage from the Qur'an and explained its meaning.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师读了一段《古兰经》经文，并解释了它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed taqra? Adam: Qed naqra traduzzjoni tal-Koran bil-Malti.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you reading? Adam: I'm reading a Maltese translation of the Qur'an.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在读什么？亚当：我在读《古兰经》的马耳他语译本。

messages.en: I'm reading a Maltese translation of the Qur'an.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Koran 与中文书名《古兰经》成对记忆，再用“阅读这部经典”的场景练习 jaqra l-Koran。

teaching_sense.en_definition: South Korea, a country in Asia in the southern part of the Korean Peninsula.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 韩国，位于亚洲朝鲜半岛南部的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Asja li jinsab fil-parti tan-Nofsinhar tal-Peniżola Koreana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 韩国，亚洲的一个国家

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-pożizzjoni ġeografika tal-Korea t'Isfel fil-parti tan-Nofsinhar tal-Peniżola Koreana.
formal.en: The report describes South Korea's geographical position in the southern part of the Korean Peninsula.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了韩国位于朝鲜半岛南部的地理位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għal liema pajjiż qed tfittex mappa? Mark: Għall-Korea t'Isfel; għandi proġett tal-ġeografija dwarha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which country are you looking for a map of? Mark: South Korea; I have a geography project about it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在找哪个国家的地图？马克：韩国的；我有一项关于韩国的地理作业。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal liema pajjiż qed tfittex mappa?

teaching_sense.en_definition: North Korea, a country in Asia in the northern part of the Korean Peninsula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 朝鲜，亚洲的一个国家

formal.mt: L-istudenti identifikaw il-Korea ta' Fuq fuq mappa tal-Asja.
formal.en: The students identified North Korea on a map of Asia.
formal.zh: 学生们在亚洲地图上找出了朝鲜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-Korea ta' Fuq fuq din il-mappa? Daniel: Hawn, fil-parti ta' fuq tal-Peniżola Koreana.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is North Korea on this map? Daniel: Here, in the upper part of the Korean Peninsula.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张地图上朝鲜在哪里？丹尼尔：这里，在朝鲜半岛的上半部。

messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-Korea ta' Fuq fuq din il-mappa?

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having soil that supports good plant growth and productive crops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容土地肥沃，适合植物生长并有利于农作物丰产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħamrija tajba għat-tkabbir tal-pjanti u li jista' jagħti ħsad tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肥沃的，适宜植物生长的

formal.mt: It-terren kormi f'dan il-wied huwa adattat għat-tkabbir tal-ħxejjex.
formal.en: The fertile land in this valley is suitable for growing vegetables.
formal.zh: 这片山谷中的肥沃土地适合种植蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan it-terren tajjeb biex niżirgħu fih? Rita: Iva, huwa kormi u l-pjanti jikbru tajjeb fih.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this land good for planting? Rita: Yes, it is fertile and plants grow well in it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这块地适合播种吗？丽塔：适合，土地很肥沃，植物在这里长得很好。

messages.en: Yes, it is fertile and plants grow well in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一片土壤肥沃、蔬菜茂盛的田地，用 terren kormi 给画面命名，把 kormi 与“肥沃”绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 对伴侣或配偶不忠；出轨

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be romantically or sexually unfaithful to one's partner or spouse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在感情或性关系上背叛自己的伴侣或配偶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun infidil lejn is-sieħeb, is-sieħba jew il-konjuġi tiegħu f'relazzjoni romantika jew sesswali.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be unfaithful to one's partner or spouse (lit. to raise horns)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对自己的伴侣或配偶不忠；出轨（字面义为使角竖起）

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru prinċipali korna lil martu u tilef il-fiduċja tagħha.

formal.zh: 小说中，主人公背叛了妻子，失去了她的信任。

colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Sara's character leave him in the series? Rita: Because he cheated on his partner and she found out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电视剧里萨拉演的角色为什么离开了他？丽塔：因为他出轨了，被她发现了。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对伴侣或配偶的不忠；出轨行为

gloss_zh: 妻子对其不忠的；被妻子背叛的

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个男人遭到妻子在感情或性关系上的背叛。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被妻子背叛的；妻子对其不忠的（指男子）

collocations.en: a man whose wife is unfaithful to him
collocations.zh: 一个被妻子背叛的男人

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供参加教宗选举秘密会议的枢机主教盛放食物的木制容器；也指角蝰这种蛇。
