collocations.en: a wooden food vessel for cardinals in conclave
collocations.zh: 供秘密选举会议中的枢机主教使用的木制食器

formal.mt: Fit-test dwar il-konklavi, il-kelma 'kornuta' tirreferi għal reċipjent tal-injam li fih jitqiegħed l-ikel għall-kardinali.
formal.en: In the text about the conclave, the word 'kornuta' refers to a wooden vessel in which food is placed for the cardinals.
formal.zh: 在这篇介绍教宗选举秘密会议的文章中，kornuta 指为枢机主教盛放食物的木制容器。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi kornuta f'dan il-ktieb dwar is-sriep? Pawlu: Hija lifgħa bil-qrun. Hawnhekk il-kelma tirreferi għal serp.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is a kornuta in this book about snakes? Pawlu: It is a horned viper. Here the word refers to a snake.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这本介绍蛇的书里，kornuta 是什么？Pawlu：是角蝰。这里这个词指一种蛇。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi kornuta f'dan il-ktieb dwar is-sriep?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi kornuta f'dan il-ktieb dwar is-sriep?
messages.zh: 这本介绍蛇的书里，kornuta 是什么？
messages.en: What is a kornuta in this book about snakes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija lifgħa bil-qrun. Hawnhekk il-kelma tirreferi għal serp.
messages.mt_standard: Hija lifgħa bil-qrun. Hawnhekk il-kelma tirreferi għal serp.
messages.zh: 是角蝰。这里这个词指一种蛇。
messages.en: It is a horned viper. Here the word refers to a snake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张语境卡：教会会议旁放木制食器，动物图鉴旁画角蝰；用场景区分同形词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have an abundance of something, especially vegetation, or to grow and flourish vigorously.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大量生有某物，尤其指草木繁多；也指萌发、生长旺盛或繁茂发展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu ħafna minn xi ħaġa, speċjalment siġar jew pjanti, jew jikber u jitkattar bil-qawwa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to abound in sth. (such as trees)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量生有或富有某物，例如树木繁多。
迅速萌发并蓬勃生长。
茂盛生长；蓬勃发展。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita tar-rebbiegħa, il-wied korom bis-siġar u bil-fjuri.
formal.en: After the spring rain, the valley abounded in trees and flowers.
formal.zh: 春雨过后，山谷里树木繁茂，鲜花盛开。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Rajt il-ġnien dan l-aħħar? Ġużeppi: Iva, wara x-xita korom bil-fjuri!
colloquial.en: Marija: Have you seen the garden lately? Ġużeppi: Yes, after the rain it was full of flowers!
colloquial.zh: Marija：你最近看过花园吗？Ġużeppi：看过，下雨后里面开满了花！

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 你最近看过花园吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the garden lately?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (邻居)
messages.zh: 看过，下雨后里面开满了花！
messages.en: Yes, after the rain it was full of flowers!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象春雨后花草一下长满山谷：从“数量多”连到“萌发快”，再连到“长得旺”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a crown; in anatomy, describing structures or a plane associated with the coronal orientation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与冠有关的；在解剖学中，形容冠状结构或把身体分为前后两部分的冠状面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mal-kuruna; fl-anatomija, jiddeskrivi strutturi koronali jew pjan li jaqsam il-ġisem f'parti ta' quddiem u parti ta' wara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冠状的；与冠有关的；解剖学中也指冠状面的。

formal.mt: Fl-anatomija, il-pjan koronali jaqsam il-ġisem f'parti ta' quddiem u parti ta' wara.
formal.en: In anatomy, the coronal plane divides the body into front and back portions.
formal.zh: 在解剖学中，冠状面把身体分为前后两部分。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan hu l-pjan koronali? Mark: Iva, aħseb fih bħala pjan li jifred il-quddiem minn wara.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this the coronal plane? Mark: Yes, think of it as a plane separating the front from the back.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这是冠状面吗？Mark：对，把它想成一个分开前部和后部的平面。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这是冠状面吗？
messages.en: Is this the coronal plane?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, aħseb fih bħala pjan li jifred il-quddiem minn wara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, aħseb fih bħala pjan li jifred il-quddiem minn wara.
messages.zh: 对，把它想成一个分开前部和后部的平面。
messages.en: Yes, think of it as a plane separating the front from the back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习冠状面时，想象一块与脸平行的透明玻璃，把身体分成前后两部分来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To injure someone severely or cause disabling injury; in a separate sense, to have a miscarriage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人严重受伤或造成伤残；另一个独立义项指流产，即妊娠自然终止。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iweġġa' lil xi ħadd serjament jew jikkawżalu diżabilità; f'tifsira oħra, mara titlef it-tqala b'mod spontanju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人严重受伤。
使某人因受伤而残疾或丧失部分身体功能。
流产；妊娠自然终止。

formal.mt: L-inċident korra lis-sewwieq, li ttieħed l-isptar għall-kura.
formal.en: The accident severely injured the driver, who was taken to hospital for treatment.
formal.zh: 这起事故使司机严重受伤，随后他被送往医院接受治疗。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'ġara lil Pawlu? David: L-inċident korra lil Pawlu, imma issa qed jieħu l-kura fl-isptar.
colloquial.en: Anna: What happened to Pawlu? David: The accident severely injured Pawlu, but he is receiving treatment in hospital now.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Pawlu 怎么了？David：事故使他受了重伤，不过他现在正在医院接受治疗。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Pawlu?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-inċident korra lil Pawlu, imma issa qed jieħu l-kura fl-isptar.
messages.mt_standard: L-inċident korra lil Pawlu, imma issa qed jieħu l-kura fl-isptar.
messages.zh: 事故使他受了重伤，不过他现在正在医院接受治疗。
messages.en: The accident severely injured Pawlu, but he is receiving treatment in hospital now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分开记两张语义卡：“重伤、伤残”是一组，“流产”另列一组；读句子时先辨认语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a correct or accurate way, without mistakes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以正确或准确的方式；没有出错地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod korrett jew preċiż, mingħajr żbalji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正确地；准确无误地。

formal.mt: Biex it-tweġiba tiġi aċċettata, l-istudent irid jikteb in-numru korrettament.
formal.en: For the answer to be accepted, the student must write the number correctly.
formal.zh: 学生必须正确写出数字，答案才会被接受。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Qed nippronunzja din il-kelma korrettament? Rita: Iva, qed tgħidha tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Luca: Am I pronouncing this word correctly? Rita: Yes, you are saying it right.
colloquial.zh: Luca：我这个词发音正确吗？Rita：对，你读得很对。

messages.speaker: Luca (学生)
messages.zh: 我这个词发音正确吗？
messages.en: Am I pronouncing this word correctly?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.zh: 对，你读得很对。
messages.en: Yes, you are saying it right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住中文的“正确地”：把它放在书写、回答、发音这些动作旁，提醒自己这是描述方式的副词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or state of being correct or accurate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内容、答案或做法正确、准确这一性质或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew il-qagħda ta' xi ħaġa li tkun korretta jew preċiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正确性；准确无误的性质或状态。

formal.mt: Qabel il-pubblikazzjoni, l-editur għandu jivverifika l-korrettezza tal-informazzjoni.
formal.en: Before publication, the editor should verify the accuracy of the information.
formal.zh: 发布前，编辑应核实信息的准确性。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Iċċekkjajt il-korrettezza tat-tweġiba? Samwel: Iva, erġajt għamilt il-kalkolu u sibt l-istess riżultat.
colloquial.en: Elena: Did you check the correctness of the answer? Samwel: Yes, I did the calculation again and got the same result.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你检查过答案的正确性了吗？Samwel：检查过，我重新算了一遍，得到了同样的结果。

messages.speaker: Elena (同学)
messages.zh: 你检查过答案的正确性了吗？
messages.en: Did you check the correctness of the answer?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, erġajt għamilt il-kalkolu u sibt l-istess riżultat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, erġajt għamilt il-kalkolu u sibt l-istess riżultat.
messages.zh: 检查过，我重新算了一遍，得到了同样的结果。
messages.en: Yes, I did the calculation again and got the same result.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“正确性”当成答案旁的一枚核对标记：这个名词说的是可被检查的性质，不是做事的方式。

gloss_zh: 纠正的；矫正的；用于补救的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intended to correct an error, fault, or problem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旨在纠正错误、矫正缺陷或补救问题的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħsub biex jikkoreġi żball, difett jew problema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于纠正错误、矫正缺陷或补救问题的。

formal.mt: Wara li ġew identifikati l-iżbalji, it-tim ħejja pjan korrettiv biex itejjeb il-proċess.
formal.en: After the errors were identified, the team prepared a corrective plan to improve the process.
formal.zh: 找出错误后，团队制定了一项纠正计划，以改进流程。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex tajtni dan l-eżerċizzju? Alan: Huwa eżerċizzju korrettiv biex jgħinek b'dan l-iżball fil-kitba.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you give me this exercise? Alan: It is a corrective exercise to help you with this writing error.
colloquial.zh: Marta：为什么给我这个练习？Alan：这是一个纠错练习，帮助你改正这个书写错误。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么给我这个练习？
messages.en: Why did you give me this exercise?

messages.speaker: Alan (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa eżerċizzju korrettiv biex jgħinek b'dan l-iżball fil-kitba.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa eżerċizzju korrettiv biex jgħinek b'dan l-iżball fil-kitba.
messages.zh: 这是一个纠错练习，帮助你改正这个书写错误。
messages.en: It is a corrective exercise to help you with this writing error.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师针对错题安排专门练习：korrettiv 强调练习或措施的用途是“纠正问题”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intended to correct an error, fault, or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旨在纠正错误、缺点或困难的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħsub biex jikkoreġi żball, difett jew diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纠正性的；用于改正错误或矫正问题的。

formal.mt: L-għalliem ħejja eżerċizzju korrettorju biex jgħin lill-istudenti jevitaw żball komuni.
formal.en: The teacher prepared a corrective exercise to help students avoid a common mistake.
formal.zh: 教师准备了一项纠正性练习，帮助学生避免一个常见错误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed nagħmlu dan l-eżerċizzju? Toni: Huwa eżerċizzju korrettorju biex ma nerġgħux nagħmlu l-istess żball.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we doing this exercise? Toni: It is a corrective exercise so that we do not make the same mistake again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么要做这个练习？托尼：这是纠正性练习，让我们不再犯同样的错误。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我们为什么要做这个练习？
messages.en: Why are we doing this exercise?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa eżerċizzju korrettorju biex ma nerġgħux nagħmlu l-istess żball.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa eżerċizzju korrettorju biex ma nerġgħux nagħmlu l-istess żball.
messages.zh: 这是纠正性练习，让我们不再犯同样的错误。
messages.en: It is a corrective exercise so that we do not make the same mistake again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师圈出错题后安排专项练习：korrettorju 描述练习具有“纠正作用”，用来修饰事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who corrects errors or revises material, especially someone who checks written proofs before publication.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 纠正错误或修订材料的人，尤指在出版前检查文字校样的校对员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikkoreġi żbalji jew tirrevedi materjal, speċjalment min jiċċekkja l-provi ta' test qabel il-pubblikazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纠正错误或作出修订的人；校对员。

formal.mt: Qabel il-pubblikazzjoni, il-korrettur tal-provi ċċekkja l-ortografija u l-punteġġjatura tal-artiklu.
formal.en: Before publication, the proofreader checked the article's spelling and punctuation.
formal.zh: 出版前，校对员检查了文章的拼写和标点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nibgħat it-test għall-istampar? Mark: Stenna ftit. Il-korrettur għadu qed jiċċekkjah.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I send the text for printing? Mark: Wait a moment. The proofreader is still checking it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我可以把文字送去印刷了吗？马克：稍等，校对员还在检查。

messages.speaker: Sara (编辑)
messages.zh: 我可以把文字送去印刷了吗？
messages.en: Can I send the text for printing?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit. Il-korrettur għadu qed jiċċekkjah.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit. Il-korrettur għadu qed jiċċekkjah.
messages.zh: 稍等，校对员还在检查。
messages.en: Wait a moment. The proofreader is still checking it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 korrettur 联想到拿红笔检查校样的人：记住这是“负责纠错的人”，再搭配 tal-provi 记住“校对员”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to institutions or measures for the custody and rehabilitation of offenders.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与对违法者实施监管及教育改造的机构或措施有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut ma' istituzzjonijiet jew miżuri għall-kustodja u r-riabilitazzjoni ta' persuni li jkunu kisru l-liġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惩教的；与违法者的监管、矫正及教育改造有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi programm korrezzjonali li jinkludi edukazzjoni u taħriġ għax-xogħol.
formal.en: The report describes a correctional programme that includes education and job training.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了一项包含教育与职业培训的矫正教育项目。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se jsir it-taħriġ? Pawlu: Fiċ-ċentru korrezzjonali. Se ngħinu fil-programm edukattiv.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where will the training take place? Pawlu: At the correctional centre. We will help with the educational programme.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：培训在哪里进行？保罗：在惩教中心。我们会协助开展教育项目。

messages.speaker: Nina (志愿者)
messages.zh: 培训在哪里进行？
messages.en: Where will the training take place?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fiċ-ċentru korrezzjonali. Se ngħinu fil-programm edukattiv.
messages.mt_standard: Fiċ-ċentru korrezzjonali. Se ngħinu fil-programm edukattiv.
messages.zh: 在惩教中心。我们会协助开展教育项目。
messages.en: At the correctional centre. We will help with the educational programme.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 korrezzjonali 放进“惩教中心开展教育培训”的画面，整组记住 ċentru korrezzjonali，突出司法矫正语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of correcting an error, or a change made to put something right.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 改正错误的行为，或为使内容正确而作出的修改。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tikkoreġi żball, jew bidla li ssir biex xi ħaġa tkun korretta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纠正；改正；对错误作出的更正或修改。

formal.mt: L-editur għamel korrezzjoni fid-data tal-laqgħa qabel ma ppubblika l-avviż.
formal.en: The editor corrected the meeting date before publishing the notice.
formal.zh: 编辑在发布通知前更正了会议日期。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-indirizz f'dan il-messaġġ huwa tajjeb? Ben: Kważi. Trid tagħmel korrezzjoni fin-numru tad-dar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the address in this message right? Ben: Almost. You need to make a correction to the house number.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这条消息里的地址对吗？本：基本对，但你得更正门牌号。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这条消息里的地址对吗？
messages.en: Is the address in this message right?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Trid tagħmel korrezzjoni fin-numru tad-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Trid tagħmel korrezzjoni fin-numru tad-dar.
messages.zh: 基本对，但你得更正门牌号。
messages.en: Almost. You need to make a correction to the house number.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把错误门牌号划掉再写正确数字：这一次“更正”就是 korrezzjoni，可连同 tagħmel korrezzjoni 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be corrected or put right.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够得到纠正、改正或修正的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġi kkoreġut jew imsewwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可纠正的；能够改正或修正的。

formal.mt: L-iżball fid-dokument huwa korreġġibbli u għandu jiġi kkoreġut qabel il-pubblikazzjoni.
formal.en: The mistake in the document is correctable and should be corrected before publication.
formal.zh: 文件中的这个错误可以改正，应在发布前予以修正。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għamilt żball fid-data. Huwa korreġġibbli? Toni: Iva, tista' tbiddel id-data qabel tibgħat il-formola.
colloquial.en: Nina: I made a mistake in the date. Is it correctable? Toni: Yes, you can change the date before sending the form.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我把日期写错了，可以改正吗？Toni：可以，你能在发送表格前修改日期。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 我把日期写错了，可以改正吗？
messages.en: I made a mistake in the date. Is it correctable?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' tbiddel id-data qabel tibgħat il-formola.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' tbiddel id-data qabel tibgħat il-formola.
messages.zh: 可以，你能在发送表格前修改日期。
messages.en: Yes, you can change the date before sending the form.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把写错但还能擦掉重写的日期当作记忆图：重点是“能够改正”，而不是已经正确。

gloss_zh: 流产；自然流产；身体损伤

teaching_sense.en_definition: A physical injury; in a pregnancy context, abortion or miscarriage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体受到的损伤；在妊娠语境中，也可指流产或自然流产，须结合上下文理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsara lill-ġisem; fil-kuntest tat-tqala, jista' jfisser ukoll abort jew telf spontanju tat-tqala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流产；终止妊娠。
自然流产；妊娠的非人为中止。
身体损伤；受伤。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jiddeskrivi korriment fl-ispalla li seħħ waqt it-taħriġ.
formal.en: The medical report describes a shoulder injury sustained during training.
formal.zh: 医疗报告记载了训练时发生的一处肩部损伤。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex mhux se tilgħab illum? Luqa: Għandi korriment fl-irkoppa u għadni ma nistax niġri.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why aren't you playing today? Luqa: I have a knee injury and still cannot run.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你今天为什么不上场？卢卡：我的膝盖受伤了，还不能跑。

messages.speaker: Anna (队友)
messages.zh: 你今天为什么不上场？
messages.en: Why aren't you playing today?

messages.speaker: Luqa (球员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi korriment fl-irkoppa u għadni ma nistax niġri.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi korriment fl-irkoppa u għadni ma nistax niġri.
messages.zh: 我的膝盖受伤了，还不能跑。
messages.en: I have a knee injury and still cannot run.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 korriment 做两张语境卡：运动卡画受伤膝盖，妊娠卡写流产；读到它时先找身体部位或妊娠线索，再判断具体词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A published notice that corrects an error in an earlier text or publication.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为更正先前文本或出版物中的错误而发布的勘误说明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avviż ippubblikat biex jikkoreġi żball f'test jew pubblikazzjoni preċedenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勘误；针对已发表文本中错误的更正说明。

formal.mt: Ir-rivista ppubblikat korriġenda biex tikkoreġi ċifra fit-tabella tal-artiklu.
formal.en: The journal published a corrigendum to correct a figure in the article's table.
formal.zh: 期刊发布了勘误说明，更正文章表格中的一个数值。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex din iċ-ċifra hija differenti? David: Ir-rivista ppubblikat korriġenda. Iċ-ċifra fl-ewwel verżjoni kienet żbaljata.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is this figure different? David: The journal published a corrigendum. The figure in the first version was wrong.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这个数值怎么不一样？戴维：期刊发布了勘误，第一版的数值有误。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 这个数值怎么不一样？
messages.en: Why is this figure different?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rivista ppubblikat korriġenda. Iċ-ċifra fl-ewwel verżjoni kienet żbaljata.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rivista ppubblikat korriġenda. Iċ-ċifra fl-ewwel verżjoni kienet żbaljata.
messages.zh: 期刊发布了勘误，第一版的数值有误。
messages.en: The journal published a corrigendum. The figure in the first version was wrong.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象期刊发表后附上一张“原数值有误，现予更正”的说明：korriġenda 就记作正式发表的勘误。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pirate who attacks or plunders ships at sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在海上袭击或劫掠船只的海盗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tattakka jew tisraq bastimenti fuq il-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海盗；在海上袭击或劫掠船只的人。
勇敢的；有胆量的。
聪明的；机灵的。

collocations.en: a courageous or clever boy, according to context
collocations.zh: 勇敢或机灵的男孩，具体含义取决于语境

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, korsar jersaq lejn bastiment merkantili u jitlob lill-kaptan iċedi t-tagħbija.
formal.en: In the story, a pirate approaches a merchant ship and demands that the captain surrender the cargo.
formal.zh: 故事中，一名海盗逼近商船，要求船长交出货物。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Ta' min se tilbes għall-festa? Samwel: Ta' korsar, b'kappell kbir u xabla tal-plastik!
colloquial.en: Ella: Who are you dressing up as for the party? Samwel: A pirate, with a big hat and a plastic sword!
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：你准备在派对上装扮成谁？萨穆埃尔：海盗，戴大帽子，拿塑料剑！

messages.speaker: Ella (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备在派对上装扮成谁？
messages.en: Who are you dressing up as for the party?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ta' korsar, b'kappell kbir u xabla tal-plastik!
messages.mt_standard: Ta' korsar, b'kappell kbir u xabla tal-plastik!
messages.zh: 海盗，戴大帽子，拿塑料剑！
messages.en: A pirate, with a big hat and a plastic sword!

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用海盗帽记住 korsar 的名词义，再另做“勇敢的”“机灵的”两张形容词卡；这些是并列词义，不要把海盗身份当成人物性格。

gloss_zh: 科西嘉的；科西嘉人；科西嘉语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Corsica, its people, or its language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与科西嘉岛、当地居民或科西嘉语有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut ma' Korsika, man-nies tagħha jew mal-lingwa tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 科西嘉的；与科西嘉岛、科西嘉人或科西嘉语有关的。
科西嘉人。
科西嘉语。

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi qari minn kittieb Korsikan u diskussjoni dwar il-Korsikan bħala lingwa.
formal.en: The programme includes a reading by a Corsican writer and a discussion of Corsican as a language.
formal.zh: 活动包括科西嘉作家的朗读，以及关于科西嘉语的讨论。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Minn fejn hu l-ħabib il-ġdid tiegħek? Leo: Huwa Korsikan. Marta: Jitkellem bil-Korsikan ukoll? Leo: Iva, u qed jgħallimni ftit kliem.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where is your new friend from? Leo: He is a Corsican. Marta: Does he speak Corsican too? Leo: Yes, and he is teaching me a few words.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你的新朋友是哪里人？莱奥：他是科西嘉人。玛尔塔：他也说科西嘉语吗？莱奥：说，他还在教我几个词。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn hu l-ħabib il-ġdid tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn hu l-ħabib il-ġdid tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的新朋友是哪里人？
messages.en: Where is your new friend from?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.zh: 他是科西嘉人。
messages.en: He is a Corsican.

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 他也说科西嘉语吗？
messages.en: Does he speak Corsican too?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u qed jgħallimni ftit kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u qed jgħallimni ftit kliem.
messages.zh: 说，他还在教我几个词。
messages.en: Yes, and he is teaching me a few words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“地方特色、当地人、当地语言”三格卡记 Korsikan：修饰作家时是形容词，指人时是居民名称，搭配 jitkellem bil-Korsikan 时指语言。

gloss_zh: 宇宙的；来自宇宙空间的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the universe or to phenomena originating in outer space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与宇宙有关的，或描述来自宇宙空间的事物和现象的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-univers jew ma' fenomeni li ġejjin mill-ispazju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宇宙的；与宇宙空间及其中的现象有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif ir-raġġi kosmiċi jistgħu jiġu osservati permezz ta' strumenti speċjali.
formal.en: The report describes how cosmic rays can be observed using special instruments.
formal.zh: 报告描述了如何利用专门仪器观测宇宙射线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu t-trab kosmiku? Mark: Huwa trab li jinsab fl-ispazju, u xi parti minnu tasal ukoll fid-Dinja.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is cosmic dust? Mark: It is dust found in space, and some of it also reaches Earth.
colloquial.zh: Maja：什么是宇宙尘埃？Mark：就是存在于太空中的尘埃，其中一部分也会到达地球。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是宇宙尘埃？
messages.en: What is cosmic dust?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa trab li jinsab fl-ispazju, u xi parti minnu tasal ukoll fid-Dinja.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa trab li jinsab fl-ispazju, u xi parti minnu tasal ukoll fid-Dinja.
messages.zh: 就是存在于太空中的尘埃，其中一部分也会到达地球。
messages.en: It is dust found in space, and some of it also reaches Earth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kosmiku 和“宇宙尘埃”的画面绑定：想象尘埃漂浮在星际，记住它描述与宇宙有关的事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the study of the universe, especially its origin, structure, and development.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与宇宙学有关的，尤其涉及宇宙起源、结构和演化的研究。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-istudju tal-univers, speċjalment tal-oriġini, l-istruttura u l-iżvilupp tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宇宙学的；涉及宇宙起源、结构和演化研究的。

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel żewġ mudelli kosmoloġiċi biex jispjega l-iżvilupp tal-univers.
formal.en: The study compares two cosmological models to explain the development of the universe.
formal.zh: 这项研究比较了两种宇宙学模型，以解释宇宙的演化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'juri dan il-mudell kosmoloġiku? Pawlu: Juri kif l-univers seta' żviluppa maż-żmien.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does this cosmological model show? Pawlu: It shows how the universe may have developed over time.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个宇宙学模型展示了什么？Pawlu：它展示了宇宙可能如何随时间演化。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个宇宙学模型展示了什么？
messages.en: What does this cosmological model show?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Juri kif l-univers seta' żviluppa maż-żmien.
messages.mt_standard: Juri kif l-univers seta' żviluppa maż-żmien.
messages.zh: 它展示了宇宙可能如何随时间演化。
messages.en: It shows how the universe may have developed over time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时把 kosmoloġiku 放进“研究宇宙的模型”这一场景，与较宽泛的 kosmiku“宇宙的”作对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a partly recognized country on the Balkan Peninsula in Southeastern Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 科索沃，位于欧洲东南部巴尔干半岛、获得部分国家承认的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' pajjiż rikonoxxut minn parti mill-pajjiżi tad-dinja, li jinsab fil-Peniżola Balkana fix-Xlokk tal-Ewropa.

sense_translations.en_definition: Kosovo (a partly-recognized country on the Balkan Peninsula in Southeastern Europe)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 科索沃，位于欧洲东南部巴尔干半岛、获得部分国家承认的国家。

formal.mt: Għall-proġett tal-ġeografija, l-istudenti sabu l-Kosovo fuq mappa tal-Peniżola Balkana.
formal.en: For their geography project, the students located Kosovo on a map of the Balkan Peninsula.
formal.zh: 为完成地理项目，学生们在巴尔干半岛地图上找出了科索沃的位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn jinsab il-Kosovo? Mark: Fil-Peniżola Balkana. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Kosovo? Mark: On the Balkan Peninsula. Let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: Maja：科索沃在哪里？Mark：在巴尔干半岛。我们在地图上找找吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 科索沃在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Kosovo?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-Peniżola Balkana. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-Peniżola Balkana. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在巴尔干半岛。我们在地图上找找吧。
messages.en: On the Balkan Peninsula. Let's find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 Kosovo 与中文“科索沃”和巴尔干半岛地图一起记忆；词条键小写，正文中的专名首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a country in West Africa, also called Côte d'Ivoire or Ivory Coast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 科特迪瓦，又称象牙海岸，是位于西非的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent, magħruf ukoll bħala Côte d'Ivoire.

sense_translations.en_definition: Ivory Coast, Côte d'Ivoire (a country in West Africa; official name: Repubblika tal-Kosta tal-Avorju)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 象牙海岸，即科特迪瓦，位于西非；正式国名为科特迪瓦共和国，马耳他语为 Repubblika tal-Kosta tal-Avorju。

formal.mt: It-test tal-ġeografija jitlob lill-istudenti jsibu l-Kosta tal-Avorju fuq mappa tal-Afrika tal-Punent.
formal.en: The geography test asks students to locate Ivory Coast on a map of West Africa.
formal.zh: 地理测验要求学生在西非地图上找出科特迪瓦的位置。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-Kosta tal-Avorju u Côte d'Ivoire huma l-istess pajjiż? Pawlu: Iva, huma żewġ ismijiet għall-istess pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are Ivory Coast and Côte d'Ivoire the same country? Pawlu: Yes, they are two names for the same country in West Africa.
colloquial.zh: Lara：象牙海岸和科特迪瓦是同一个国家吗？Pawlu：是的，它们是同一个西非国家的两个名称。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-Kosta tal-Avorju u Côte d'Ivoire huma l-istess pajjiż?
messages.mt_standard: Il-Kosta tal-Avorju u Côte d'Ivoire huma l-istess pajjiż?
messages.zh: 象牙海岸和科特迪瓦是同一个国家吗？
messages.en: Are Ivory Coast and Côte d'Ivoire the same country?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huma żewġ ismijiet għall-istess pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huma żewġ ismijiet għall-istess pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent.
messages.zh: 是的，它们是同一个西非国家的两个名称。
messages.en: Yes, they are two names for the same country in West Africa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Kosta tal-Avorju、Ivory Coast、科特迪瓦写在同一张西非地图卡片上，练习三个名称指向同一个国家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Forming an essential part of something, or serving to establish an organization or institution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成某事物基本部分的，或用于设立组织、机构的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jifforma parti essenzjali minn xi ħaġa, jew li jistabbilixxi organizzazzjoni jew istituzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 构成的，组成的；起基本构成作用的，也可指用于设立组织或机构的。

formal.mt: L-att kostituttiv tal-assoċjazzjoni jiddeskrivi l-għanijiet tagħha u l-istruttura bażika tagħha.
formal.en: The association's founding document describes its aims and basic structure.
formal.zh: 该协会的设立文件说明了其宗旨和基本结构。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nista' naqra dwar l-għanijiet tal-assoċjazzjoni? Mark: Fl-att kostituttiv tagħha. Għandi kopja hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I read about the association's aims? Mark: In its founding document. I have a copy here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我在哪里能读到这个协会的宗旨？Mark：在它的设立文件里。我这里有一份。

messages.speaker: Maja (新会员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' naqra dwar l-għanijiet tal-assoċjazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' naqra dwar l-għanijiet tal-assoċjazzjoni?
messages.zh: 我在哪里能读到这个协会的宗旨？
messages.en: Where can I read about the association's aims?

messages.speaker: Mark (协会秘书)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-att kostituttiv tagħha. Għandi kopja hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-att kostituttiv tagħha. Għandi kopja hawn.
messages.zh: 在它的设立文件里。我这里有一份。
messages.en: In its founding document. I have a copy here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kostituttiv 放在“构成要素”和“设立文件”两个搭配中记忆，抓住“构成或建立某物”的共同意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a constitution, or in accordance with its rules and principles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与宪法有关的，或符合宪法规则和原则的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' kostituzzjoni, jew li jaqbel mar-regoli u l-prinċipji tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宪法的；涉及宪法的；符合宪法规定的。

formal.mt: L-artiklu janalizza proposta għal riforma kostituzzjonali u jispjega l-għanijiet tagħha.
formal.en: The article analyzes a proposal for constitutional reform and explains its aims.
formal.zh: 这篇文章分析了一项宪法改革提案，并解释了其目标。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dwar xiex inhi din il-laqgħa? Pawlu: Dwar ir-riforma kostituzzjonali. Se jispjegaw il-bidliet proposti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this meeting about? Pawlu: Constitutional reform. They will explain the proposed changes.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这场会议是讨论什么的？Pawlu：宪法改革。他们会解释拟议的修改。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这场会议是讨论什么的？
messages.en: What is this meeting about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar ir-riforma kostituzzjonali. Se jispjegaw il-bidliet proposti.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar ir-riforma kostituzzjonali. Se jispjegaw il-bidliet proposti.
messages.zh: 宪法改革。他们会解释拟议的修改。
messages.en: Constitutional reform. They will explain the proposed changes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“宪法权利、宪法改革”两个场景：kostituzzjonali 用来修饰与宪法有关或符合宪法的事物。

gloss_zh: 立宪主义者；宪政支持者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who supports government under a constitution and advocates respect for constitutional limits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持依照宪法治理国家，并主张遵守宪法所规定权力界限的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tappoġġja tmexxija skont kostituzzjoni u tiddefendi r-rispett għal-limiti tal-poter stabbiliti fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 立宪主义者；主张依宪法施政并遵守宪法权力界限的人。

collocations.zh: 一位立宪主义者的观点

formal.mt: Fl-esej tiegħu, il-kostituzzjonalista jargumenta li l-gvern għandu jirrispetta l-limiti stabbiliti fil-kostituzzjoni.
formal.en: In his essay, the constitutionalist argues that the government should respect the limits established in the constitution.
formal.zh: 这位立宪主义者在文章中主张，政府应当遵守宪法规定的权力界限。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiġifieri kostituzzjonalista? Mark: Persuna li temmen li l-gvern għandu jimxi skont il-kostituzzjoni u jirrispetta l-limiti tal-poter tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does constitutionalist mean? Mark: A person who believes that the government should act according to the constitution and respect the limits of its power.
colloquial.zh: Maja：立宪主义者是什么意思？Mark：就是认为政府应依照宪法行事，并遵守自身权力界限的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 立宪主义者是什么意思？
messages.en: What does constitutionalist mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna li temmen li l-gvern għandu jimxi skont il-kostituzzjoni u jirrispetta l-limiti tal-poter tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna li temmen li l-gvern għandu jimxi skont il-kostituzzjoni u jirrispetta l-limiti tal-poter tiegħu.
messages.zh: 就是认为政府应依照宪法行事，并遵守自身权力界限的人。
messages.en: A person who believes that the government should act according to the constitution and respect the limits of its power.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kostituzzjonalista 配一张人物卡片：这个人举着宪法，提醒政府遵守权力界限，记住它是指人的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A part or element that combines with others to form a whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与其他部分结合而构成整体的组成部分或要素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti jew element li jingħaqad ma' oħrajn biex jifforma ħaġa sħiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 组成部分；构成整体的成分或要素。

formal.mt: In-nitroġenu huwa kostitwenti ewlieni tal-arja, filwaqt li l-ossiġenu huwa kostitwenti ieħor.
formal.en: Nitrogen is a main constituent of air, while oxygen is another constituent.
formal.zh: 氮是空气的主要成分，氧则是另一种组成成分。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-arja hija kollha ossiġenu? Pawlu: Le, l-ossiġenu huwa kostitwenti wieħed biss. Fl-arja hemm ukoll in-nitroġenu u gassijiet oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is air entirely oxygen? Pawlu: No, oxygen is only one constituent. Air also contains nitrogen and other gases.
colloquial.zh: Lara：空气全都是氧气吗？Pawlu：不是，氧气只是其中一种成分。空气中还有氮气和其他气体。

gloss_zh: 选民群体；全体有投票权者

teaching_sense.en_definition: The people of a country, state, or electoral district who are entitled to vote, considered collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个国家、州或选区内依法享有投票权的人所构成的整体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grupp ta' nies f'pajjiż, stat jew distrett elettorali li għandhom id-dritt li jivvutaw.

sense_translations.en_definition: constituency, electorate (collective people of a country, state, or electoral district who are entitled to vote)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 选民群体；一个国家、州或选区内全体有投票权的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant għandu jisma' l-opinjonijiet tal-kostitwenza kollha qabel jieħu deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The representative should listen to the views of the entire electorate before making a decision.
formal.zh: 代表在作出决定前，应听取全体选民的意见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kandidat għandu ħafna appoġġ? Mark: Iva, imma għad irid jisma' lill-kostitwenza kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does the candidate have much support? Mark: Yes, but he still needs to listen to the entire electorate.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这位候选人得到的支持多吗？Mark：多，但他仍然需要听取全体选民的意见。

messages.zh: 这位候选人得到的支持多吗？

messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għad irid jisma' lill-kostitwenza kollha.
messages.zh: 多，但他仍然需要听取全体选民的意见。

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把所有有投票权的人圈在一起：kostitwenza 指圈内的选民整体，记忆重点放在人群上。

gloss_zh: 大量的；数量众多的；充满的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Present in great numbers or abundance, especially when describing living things or a plentiful supply.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人、动物或其他事物数量很多，呈现丰盛或密集的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'numru kbir jew fi kwantità kbira, speċjalment meta nitkellmu dwar ħlejjaq jew riżorsi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量聚集的；形容生物数量繁多、密集充满的状态。
数量众多的；大量存在的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small piece or sheet of paper; the diminutive form of karta.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa jew folja żgħira tal-karta; il-forma diminuttiva ta' karta.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small paper (the diminutive form of 'karta')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小张纸；小纸片，karta 的指小形式。

a folded small piece of paper

formal.zh: 地址写在信封内一张折起来的小纸片上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek krajta biex nikteb in-numru? Toni: Iva, hawn waħda, u hawn pinna wkoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you got a small piece of paper so I can write down the number? Toni: Yes, here's one, and here's a pen too.

gloss_zh: 颅骨学家；颅骨学研究者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A specialist who studies skulls, particularly their structure, shape, and variation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专门研究颅骨，尤其是颅骨结构、形态及其差异的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċjalista li jistudja l-kranji, b'mod partikolari l-istruttura, il-forma u l-varjazzjonijiet tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颅骨学家；从事颅骨结构、形态和差异研究的专家。

formal.mt: Il-kranjologu kejjel il-kranji u rreġistra d-differenzi fil-forma tagħhom.
formal.en: The craniologist measured the skulls and recorded the differences in their shape.
formal.zh: 颅骨学家测量了这些颅骨，并记录了它们的形态差异。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jispjegalna dawn il-kranji? Toni: Kranjologu mill-università; jasal dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is going to explain these skulls to us? Toni: A craniologist from the university; he'll be here soon.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁来给我们讲解这些颅骨？Toni：大学里的一位颅骨学家，他很快就到。

messages.zh: 大学里的一位颅骨学家，他很快就到。
messages.en: A craniologist from the university; he'll be here soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象研究桌前拿着颅骨做测量的专家，把 kranjologu 贴在人物名牌上，记住这个词指研究者本人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The study of the skull, including its structure, shape, and variation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究颅骨结构、形态及其差异的学问。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju tal-kranju, inklużi l-istruttura, il-forma u l-varjazzjonijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颅骨学；研究颅骨结构、形态和差异的学科。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu dwar il-kranjoloġija jiddeskrivi l-istruttura tal-kranju u d-differenzi fil-forma tiegħu.
formal.en: The chapter on craniology describes the structure of the skull and differences in its shape.
formal.zh: 有关颅骨学的章节介绍了颅骨的结构及其形态差异。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed taqra? Mark: Ktieb dwar il-kranjoloġija; jispjega kif inhu magħmul il-kranju.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading? Mark: A book about craniology; it explains how the skull is structured.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在读什么？Mark：一本关于颅骨学的书，讲颅骨的结构。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to craniology or to the study of the structure and shape of skulls.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-kranjoloġija jew mal-istudju tal-istruttura u l-forma tal-kranju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颅骨学的；有关颅骨结构和形态研究的。

formal.mt: L-istudju kranjoloġiku jqabbel il-forma u d-daqs ta' diversi kranji.
formal.en: The craniological study compares the shape and size of several skulls.
formal.zh: 这项颅骨学研究比较了多个颅骨的形状和大小。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-eżami tal-forma esterna tal-kranju u tal-karatteristiċi tal-wiċċ tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颅骨外形观察法；对颅骨外部形状及表面特征的观察与考察。

gloss_zh: 颅骨外形观察者；颅相观察者

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事颅骨外形观察，考察颅骨外部形状及表面特征的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tipprattika l-kranjoskopija billi teżamina l-forma esterna tal-kranji u l-karatteristiċi tal-wiċċ tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颅骨外形观察者；从事颅骨外部形状和表面特征考察的人。

collocations.zh: 颅骨外形观察者的观察记录

formal.mt: Il-kranjoskopu eżamina l-wiċċ estern tal-kranju u kiteb deskrizzjoni tal-forma tiegħu.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住资金箭头：还款流向 kreditur；有钱要收回来的一方，就是债权人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat ugly or unattractive; a diminutive form of 'ikrah'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有点丑、不太好看的；是 ikrah 的指小形式，在此表达较轻程度的难看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ftit ikrah jew mhux sabiħ ħafna; forma diminuttiva ta' 'ikrah'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有点丑的；不太好看的（ikrah 的指小形式）。

formal.mt: Fir-reċensjoni, l-awtur iddeskriva l-kulur tal-qoxra bħala krejjah.
formal.en: In the review, the writer described the colour of the cover as somewhat ugly.
formal.zh: 在评论中，作者把封面的颜色描述为有点难看。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jogħġbok dan il-flokk? Lara: Il-kulur ftit krejjah, imma l-flokk komdu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like this shirt? Lara: The colour is a bit unattractive, but the shirt is comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢这件上衣吗？拉拉：颜色有点不好看，不过穿着很舒服。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这件上衣吗？
messages.en: Do you like this shirt?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kulur ftit krejjah, imma l-flokk komdu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kulur ftit krejjah, imma l-flokk komdu.
messages.zh: 颜色有点不好看，不过穿着很舒服。
messages.en: The colour is a bit unattractive, but the shirt is comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ikrah 的“丑”想成调低了一档：krejjah 表示“有点丑”，用轻轻皱眉的表情帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Groaning, or earnest pleading, including begging for mercy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呻吟声或呻吟的行为；也指苦苦哀求，包括求饶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħsejjes ta' tbatija jew uġigħ; ukoll talb imqanqal u insistenti, inkluż talb għall-ħniena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呻吟；因痛苦或不适而发出的呻吟声。
哀求；苦苦恳求，包括求饶。

formal.mt: L-infermiera semgħet il-krib tal-pazjent u resqet lejh.
formal.en: The nurse heard the patient's groaning and approached him.
formal.zh: 护士听到患者的呻吟声，便走到他身旁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt il-krib għall-ħniena fl-aħħar tax-xena? Mark: Iva, il-karattru kien qed jitlobhom biex jaħfrulu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you hear the pleading for mercy at the end of the scene? Mark: Yes, the character was asking them to forgive him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你听到那场戏结尾的求饶声了吗？马克：听到了，那个角色在求他们原谅他。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那场戏结尾的求饶声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the pleading for mercy at the end of the scene?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-karattru kien qed jitlobhom biex jaħfrulu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-karattru kien qed jitlobhom biex jaħfrulu.
messages.zh: 听到了，那个角色在求他们原谅他。
messages.en: Yes, the character was asking them to forgive him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面分别记义：病人低声呻吟，人物苦苦求饶；两种情境都可帮助记住 krib。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to criminology, the study of crime, its causes, and criminal behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与犯罪学有关的，即涉及犯罪、犯罪原因和犯罪行为研究的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-kriminoloġija, l-istudju tal-kriminalità, il-kawżi tagħha u l-imġiba kriminali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯罪学的；与犯罪及犯罪行为研究有关的。

formal.mt: L-istudju kriminoloġiku jeżamina r-rabta bejn il-kundizzjonijiet soċjali u l-kriminalità.
formal.en: The criminological study examines the relationship between social conditions and crime.
formal.zh: 这项犯罪学研究考察社会条件与犯罪之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed taqra? Pawlu: Rapport kriminoloġiku dwar il-kawżi tas-serq.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you reading? Pawlu: A criminological report about the causes of theft.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在读什么？保罗：一份研究盗窃原因的犯罪学报告。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生)
messages.zh: 一份研究盗窃原因的犯罪学报告。
messages.en: A criminological report about the causes of theft.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本研究“为何犯罪”的学术报告，把 kriminoloġiku 和“犯罪学的”整组搭配记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a deep, rich red colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈浓重深红色或绯红色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' lewn aħmar skur u qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 深红色的；绯红色的。

formal.mt: Il-purtieri krimżi taw lis-sala dehra eleganti.
formal.en: The crimson curtains gave the hall an elegant appearance.
formal.zh: 深红色窗帘使大厅显得十分典雅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema libsa se tilbes illejla? Sara: Il-libsa krimżi, dik ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which dress are you wearing tonight? Sara: The crimson dress, the one by the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今晚你要穿哪条连衣裙？萨拉：那条深红色的，就是窗边那条。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚你要穿哪条连衣裙？
messages.en: Which dress are you wearing tonight?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那条深红色的，就是窗边那条。
messages.en: The crimson dress, the one by the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑海里挂起一幅浓重深红色窗帘，再贴上 krimżi 标签，用颜色画面记住“绯红色的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called krypton.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为“氪”的化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bħala kripton.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 氪，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: L-istudenti fittxew il-kripton fit-tabella perjodika waqt il-lezzjoni tal-kimika.
formal.en: The students looked for krypton in the periodic table during the chemistry lesson.
formal.zh: 化学课上，学生们在元素周期表中寻找氪。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn insib il-kripton f'din it-tabella? Lara: Hawn, ħdejn l-isem bl-Ingliż, krypton.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where can I find krypton in this table? Lara: Here, next to its English name, krypton.
colloquial.zh: 马克：在这张表里哪里能找到氪？拉拉：这里，就在它的英文名称 krypton 旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 在这张表里哪里能找到氪？
messages.en: Where can I find krypton in this table?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这里，就在它的英文名称 krypton 旁边。
messages.en: Here, next to its English name, krypton.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把马耳他语 kripton、英语 krypton 和汉字“氪”写在同一张元素卡上，对照拼写记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Christ, the name or title used for Jesus in Christian religious contexts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督，在基督教宗教语境中用于称呼耶稣的名称或称号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem jew titlu użat għal Ġesù fil-kuntest tar-reliġjon Nisranija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 基督。

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jippreżenta t-tagħlim ta' Kristu permezz ta' siltiet qosra.
formal.en: This chapter presents the teachings of Christ through short passages.
formal.zh: 本章通过简短的篇章介绍基督的教导。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fuq xiex qed taqra? Pawlu: Qed naqra ktieb dwar il-ħajja ta' Ġesù Kristu.
colloquial.en: Marija: What are you reading about? Pawlu: I'm reading a book about the life of Jesus Christ.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你在读什么内容？保罗：我在读一本关于耶稣基督生平的书。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读什么内容？
messages.en: What are you reading about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naqra ktieb dwar il-ħajja ta' Ġesù Kristu.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naqra ktieb dwar il-ħajja ta' Ġesù Kristu.
messages.zh: 我在读一本关于耶稣基督生平的书。
messages.en: I'm reading a book about the life of Jesus Christ.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ġesù Kristu 整体记作“耶稣基督”，用固定搭配记住 Kristu 的含义和大写形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Croatia, a country on the Balkan Peninsula in Southeastern Europe, officially called Repubblika tal-Kroazja.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 克罗地亚，位于欧洲东南部巴尔干半岛的国家，正式名称为克罗地亚共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fil-Peniżola Balkana fix-Xlokk tal-Ewropa, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika tal-Kroazja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Croatia (a country on the Balkan Peninsula in Southeastern Europe; official name: Repubblika tal-Kroazja)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 克罗地亚，位于欧洲东南部巴尔干半岛的国家；正式名称为克罗地亚共和国。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jimmarkaw il-Kroazja fuq il-mappa tal-Ewropa.
formal.en: The students should mark Croatia on the map of Europe.
formal.zh: 学生应在欧洲地图上标出克罗地亚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se tmur għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur il-Kroazja ma' ħabib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Croatia with a friend of mine.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你准备去哪里度假？马克：我要和一位朋友去克罗地亚。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur il-Kroazja ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur il-Kroazja ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我要和一位朋友去克罗地亚。
messages.en: I'm going to Croatia with a friend of mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在欧洲地图上给克罗地亚贴上 Kroazja 标签，再用“去克罗地亚旅行”的场景帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coleslaw, a salad made with finely cut cabbage and a dressing, often served as a side dish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 凉拌卷心菜沙拉，以切细的卷心菜拌入调味汁制成，常用作配菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insalata magħmula minn kaboċċa mqattgħa rqiqa u zalza, li spiss tiġi servuta bħala akkumpanjament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凉拌卷心菜沙拉。

formal.mt: L-ikla tinkludi tiġieġ, patata u porzjon krombija bħala akkumpanjament.
formal.en: The meal includes chicken, potatoes and a portion of coleslaw as a side dish.
formal.zh: 这份餐食包括鸡肉、土豆，以及一份作为配菜的凉拌卷心菜沙拉。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid ftit krombija mat-tiġieġ? Ben: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma porzjon żgħir biss.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like some coleslaw with the chicken? Ben: Yes, please, but just a small portion.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你想配着鸡肉吃一点凉拌卷心菜沙拉吗？本：好的，谢谢，不过只要一小份。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想配着鸡肉吃一点凉拌卷心菜沙拉吗？
messages.en: Would you like some coleslaw with the chicken?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma porzjon żgħir biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma porzjon żgħir biss.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢，不过只要一小份。
messages.en: Yes, please, but just a small portion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象餐盘旁有一小碗卷心菜丝沙拉，把这碗配菜与 krombija 一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Chromium, the name of a chemical element.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铬，一种化学元素的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' element kimiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铬，化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jiddeskrivi l-analiżi ta' kampjun tal-kromu.
formal.en: The laboratory report describes the analysis of a chromium sample.
formal.zh: 实验室报告描述了对一份铬样品的分析。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser kromu bl-Ingliż? Adam: Chromium; huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does kromu mean in English? Adam: Chromium; it is the name of a chemical element.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：kromu 用英语怎么说？亚当：Chromium，就是化学元素铬的名称。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)

messages.en: Chromium; it is the name of a chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张“铬—kromu—chromium”三语卡片，再用“铬样品”的实验室画面帮助回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act regarded as despicable or ugly in a moral sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在道德上令人鄙视或被认为丑恶的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att li jitqies jistmellu jew ikrah fis-sens morali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卑劣的行为，令人鄙视的行径。
丑恶的行为，在道德上令人反感的举动。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ikkundanna l-kruhata u talab li l-vittma tingħata appoġġ.
formal.en: The committee condemned the despicable act and called for the victim to receive support.
formal.zh: 委员会谴责了这一卑劣行为，并要求为受害者提供支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt kif daħqu bit-tifel quddiem kulħadd? Toni: Iva, dik kienet kruhata. Imisshom jitolbuh skuża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see how they mocked the boy in front of everyone? Toni: Yes, that was a despicable act. They should apologise to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到他们当着所有人的面嘲笑那个男孩了吗？托尼：看到了，那种行为太卑劣了。他们应该向他道歉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt kif daħqu bit-tifel quddiem kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt kif daħqu bit-tifel quddiem kulħadd?
messages.zh: 你看到他们当着所有人的面嘲笑那个男孩了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how they mocked the boy in front of everyone?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik kienet kruhata. Imisshom jitolbuh skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik kienet kruhata. Imisshom jitolbuh skuża.
messages.zh: 看到了，那种行为太卑劣了。他们应该向他道歉。
messages.en: Yes, that was a despicable act. They should apologise to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“当众欺负别人是一件丑恶的事”作记忆场景，把 kruhata 记成具体的一次卑劣行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ugliness; a synonym of kruha, referring to the quality of being ugly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 丑陋或丑恶这一性质；与 kruha 同义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' dak li hu ikrah; sinonimu ta' kruha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 kruha 同义，指丑陋或丑恶。

formal.mt: L-awtur jenfasizza l-kruhija tal-imġiba tal-karattru lejn nies vulnerabbli.
formal.en: The author emphasises the ugliness of the character's behaviour towards vulnerable people.
formal.zh: 作者着重表现了这个人物对待弱势者时行为的丑恶。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'taħseb dwar il-faċċata l-ġdida? David: Il-kruhija tagħha tħassar id-dehra tat-triq kollha.
colloquial.en: Elena: What do you think of the new facade? David: Its ugliness spoils the appearance of the whole street.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你觉得新外立面怎么样？戴维：它太丑了，破坏了整条街的观感。

messages.speaker: Elena (邻居)

messages.en: What do you think of the new facade?

messages.speaker: David (邻居)

messages.mt_standard: Il-kruhija tagħha tħassar id-dehra tat-triq kollha.
messages.zh: 它太丑了，破坏了整条街的观感。
messages.en: Its ugliness spoils the appearance of the whole street.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kruhija 与 kruha 并排写在“丑陋”这张词卡上；学习时把它作为一种性质来理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small fracture, such as a small break in a bone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小的断裂或骨折，例如骨头上的一处轻微断裂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ksur żgħir, pereżempju f'għadma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小骨折；小的断裂。

collocations.en: a small fracture in a bone
a small fracture in a finger

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jindika ksejra f'għadma tal-id.
formal.en: The medical report indicates a small fracture in a bone of the hand.
formal.zh: 医疗报告显示手部一块骨头有一处小骨折。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'qallek it-tabib dwar subgħajk? Sam: Qalli li għandi ksejra u spjegali x'għandi nagħmel.
colloquial.en: Rita: What did the doctor tell you about your finger? Sam: He told me I have a small fracture and explained what I should do.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：医生怎么说你的手指？萨姆：他说我有一处小骨折，还向我说明了该怎么做。

messages.zh: 他说我有一处小骨折，还向我说明了该怎么做。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Xenon, the name of a chemical element.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 氙，一种化学元素的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' element kimiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 氙，化学元素。

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jiktbu l-isem ksenon ħdejn xenon fil-lista bilingwi tal-elementi kimiċi.
formal.en: The students should write the name ksenon beside xenon in the bilingual list of chemical elements.
formal.zh: 学生应在化学元素双语表中，将马耳他语名称 ksenon 写在英语 xenon 旁边。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif ngħidu xenon bil-Malti? Luqa: Ngħidu ksenon. Se niktbu ħdejn l-isem bl-Ingliż fin-noti tiegħi.

messages.mt_spoken: Ngħidu ksenon. Se niktbu ħdejn l-isem bl-Ingliż fin-noti tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħidu ksenon. Se niktbu ħdejn l-isem bl-Ingliż fin-noti tiegħi.
messages.zh: 说 ksenon。我要把它写在笔记里的英语名称旁边。
messages.en: We say ksenon. I'll write it beside the English name in my notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将“氙—ksenon—xenon”写成一组三语对应，观察两种外语拼写，再遮住其中一项练习回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The obtaining of something, or the ownership of what has been obtained.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 取得某物的过程，或对已取得之物的拥有。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih wieħed jikseb xi ħaġa, jew il-fatt li jkollu dik il-ħaġa tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所有；拥有某物的状态或权利。
取得；获得某物的过程或行为。

formal.mt: Il-ksib ta' permess huwa meħtieġ qabel ma jibda x-xogħol.
formal.en: Obtaining permission is necessary before the work begins.
formal.zh: 开始工作之前，必须取得许可。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif sejjer il-ksib tal-permess? Pawlu: Għadni qed nistenna tweġiba.
colloquial.en: Marta: How is getting the permit going? Pawlu: I'm still waiting for a reply.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：许可证办得怎么样了？保罗：我还在等回复。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 许可证办得怎么样了？
messages.en: How is getting the permit going?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 我还在等回复。
messages.en: I'm still waiting for a reply.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ksib 放进“取得许可”和“获取知识”两个场景中记忆，再把“取得之后拥有”连接到拥有义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of obtaining something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 取得或获得某物的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih wieħed jikseb xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 取得；获得某物的行为或过程。

formal.mt: Il-kors jiffoka fuq il-ksiba ta' ħiliet ġodda permezz ta' eżerċizzji prattiċi.
formal.en: The course focuses on the acquisition of new skills through practical exercises.
formal.zh: 这门课程侧重于通过实践练习习得新技能。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-ksiba ta' dawn il-ħiliet tieħu ħafna żmien? Mark: Ftit, imma bil-prattika titgħallem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does acquiring these skills take a long time? Mark: A little while, but you learn with practice.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：学会这些技能要花很长时间吗？马克：要一点时间，不过多练习就能学会。

messages.speaker: Sara (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ksiba ta' dawn il-ħiliet tieħu ħafna żmien?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ksiba ta' dawn il-ħiliet tieħu ħafna żmien?
messages.zh: 学会这些技能要花很长时间吗？
messages.en: Does acquiring these skills take a long time?

messages.speaker: Mark (导师)
messages.zh: 要一点时间，不过多练习就能学会。
messages.en: A little while, but you learn with practice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ksiba 就想象学习者获得一项新技能，用“技能的习得、经验的获得”两组搭配帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The breaking of an object or a fracture in a hard material or bone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体的破损或断裂，也指硬质材料或骨骼上的裂断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tkissir ta' oġġett jew qasma f'materjal iebes jew f'għadma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破损；物体破裂或被打碎的情况。
断裂；硬质材料的裂断，亦指骨折。

formal.mt: L-imballaġġ għandu jipproteġi l-oġġetti mill-ksir waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The packaging should protect the objects from breakage during transport.
formal.zh: 包装应保护物品，防止其在运输过程中破损。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex poġġejt il-karti bejn il-platti? Toni: Biex nevitaw il-ksir meta nċaqalquhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you put paper between the plates? Toni: To avoid breakage when we move them.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么在盘子之间放纸？托尼：这样搬动时可以避免破损。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在盘子之间放纸？
messages.en: Why did you put paper between the plates?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 这样搬动时可以避免破损。
messages.en: To avoid breakage when we move them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ksir 配上两个画面：玻璃碎裂和骨头断裂；共同抓住“完整的硬物裂开”这个意思。

gloss_zh: 违反；破裂；毁坏；破损或骨折

teaching_sense.en_definition: A breach of a rule or agreement, or the breaking, rupture, or wrecking of something, including a bone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对规则或协议的违反；也指物体的破裂、毁坏或破损，包括骨折。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' ħarsien ta' regola jew ftehim, jew it-tkissir, il-qsim jew it-tiġrif ta' xi ħaġa, inkluża għadma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 违反；违背规则、义务或协议。
破裂；原本连续或相连的部分裂开或断开。
毁坏；严重损毁或毁坏后的残破状态。
破损或断裂，包括骨骼断裂，即骨折。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ksur tal-kuntratt u l-konsegwenzi tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the breach of contract and its consequences.
formal.zh: 报告描述了违约行为及其后果。

colloquial.mt: Marija: It-tabib sab xi ksur? David: Le, qal li m'hemm l-ebda ksur.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did the doctor find any fractures? David: No, he said there are no fractures.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：医生发现有骨折吗？戴维：没有，他说没有骨折。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生发现有骨折吗？
messages.en: Did the doctor find any fractures?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qal li m'hemm l-ebda ksur.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qal li m'hemm l-ebda ksur.
messages.zh: 没有，他说没有骨折。
messages.en: No, he said there are no fractures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“规则被打破”和“物体被打破”两个学习画面整理 ksur：前者帮助记违反，后者帮助记破裂、毁坏和骨折。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to break easily when handled, bent, or struck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在拿取、弯折或受撞击时容易破碎或折断的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jinkiser faċilment meta jintmess, jitgħawweġ jew jintlaqat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 易碎的；容易破裂或折断的。

formal.mt: Dan il-materjal huwa ksuri u għandu jiġi mmaniġġjat b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: This material breaks easily and should be handled carefully.
formal.zh: 这种材料容易破裂，应小心拿取。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-ħġieġ huwa ksuri? Samwel: Iva, żommu b'attenzjoni.
colloquial.en: Rita: Does this glass break easily? Samwel: Yes, hold it carefully.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这种玻璃容易碎吗？萨姆韦尔：是的，拿的时候小心。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.zh: 这种玻璃容易碎吗？
messages.en: Does this glass break easily?

messages.speaker: Samwel (店员)
messages.zh: 是的，拿的时候小心。
messages.en: Yes, hold it carefully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ksuri 想成贴在玻璃上的“易碎”标签：它描述物品容易碎的性质，并不表示物品已经碎了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cold weather; also artificial or affected behaviour intended to make an impression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寒冷的天气；也指为给人留下某种印象而表现出的矫饰或做作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Temp kiesaħ; ukoll imġiba artifiċjali jew magħmula apposta biex wieħed jagħmel impressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 矫饰；为了显得与众不同或给人留下印象而表现出的做作言行。
寒冷天气；气温低、使人感到冷的天气。

formal.mt: Minħabba l-ksuħ qawwi, l-attività se ssir ġewwa.
formal.en: Because of the intense cold, the activity will take place indoors.
formal.zh: 由于天气严寒，活动将在室内举行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ksuħ illum! Ġanni: Ħu l-kowt qabel toħroġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: It's so cold today! Ġanni: Take your coat before you go out.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：今天真冷啊！詹尼：出门前带上外套。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 今天真冷啊！
messages.en: It's so cold today!

messages.speaker: Ġanni (父亲)
messages.zh: 出门前带上外套。
messages.en: Take your coat before you go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 ksuħ 建立两张独立记忆卡：一张画寒冷天气，一张画做作表情；分别记住两义，不推想词源联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small book with few pages, such as an information booklet or a short popular publication.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 页数较少的小型书册，可用于提供信息，也可刊载简短的通俗读物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ktieb żgħir bi ftit paġni, li jista' jagħti informazzjoni jew ikun pubblikazzjoni popolari qasira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小册子；篇幅较短、页数较少的书册。
廉价通俗小书；刊载故事、诗歌等内容的小册子。

formal.mt: Il-mużew iqassam ktejjeb ta' informazzjoni lill-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The museum distributes an information booklet to visitors.
formal.zh: 博物馆向参观者发放信息手册。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandek ktejjeb dwar il-wirja? Luqa: Iva, ħu wieħed minn fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you have a booklet about the exhibition? Luqa: Yes, take one from the table.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你有介绍展览的小册子吗？卢卡：有，从桌上拿一本吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (参观者)
messages.zh: 你有介绍展览的小册子吗？
messages.en: Do you have a booklet about the exhibition?

messages.speaker: Luqa (展馆工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu wieħed minn fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu wieħed minn fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 有，从桌上拿一本吧。
messages.en: Yes, take one from the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象展馆入口摆着一本薄薄的小册子，把 ktejjeb 和“信息手册、诗歌小册”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or process of forming written words or composing a text.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 写出文字或组织成篇的活动与过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività jew il-proċess li bih wieħed jikteb kliem jew jikkomponi test.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 书写；写作；写出文字或撰写文本的活动。

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tinkludi eżerċizzji fil-ktib bl-idejn.
formal.en: The lesson includes exercises in writing by hand.
formal.zh: 这节课包含手写练习。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Tippreferi l-ktib bl-idejn jew fuq il-kompjuter? Pietru: Bl-idejn, speċjalment meta nikteb ittra.
colloquial.en: Elena: Do you prefer writing by hand or on a computer? Pietru: By hand, especially when I write a letter.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你更喜欢手写还是用电脑写？彼得：手写，尤其是写信的时候。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tippreferi l-ktib bl-idejn jew fuq il-kompjuter?
messages.mt_standard: Tippreferi l-ktib bl-idejn jew fuq il-kompjuter?
messages.zh: 你更喜欢手写还是用电脑写？
messages.en: Do you prefer writing by hand or on a computer?

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.zh: 手写，尤其是写信的时候。
messages.en: By hand, especially when I write a letter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ktib 时想象笔尖正在纸上移动，抓住“书写这项活动”；再用“手写”和“写信”两个搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Writing or a written text; a synonym of kitba.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指书写活动或写出的文字，与 kitba 同义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jikteb jew test miktub; sinonimu ta' kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 kitba 同义，表示书写或写出的文字。

formal.mt: Il-ktiba fuq il-formola għandha tkun ċara u tinqara faċilment.
formal.en: The writing on the form should be clear and easy to read.
formal.zh: 表格上的字应当清楚、易于辨认。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' taqra l-ktiba tiegħi? Lara: Iva, hija ċara ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you read my writing? Lara: Yes, it is very clear.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看得懂我的字吗？拉拉：看得懂，写得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你看得懂我的字吗？
messages.en: Can you read my writing?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 看得懂，写得很清楚。
messages.en: Yes, it is very clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ktiba 和同义词 kitba 并排写在纸上，再配一幅手写便条的画面，记住两者都与书写有关。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An increase in amount or number; also abundance or multiplication, according to context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指数量的增加，也可表示充裕或数学中的乘法，具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żieda fl-għadd jew fil-kwantità; jista' jfisser ukoll abbundanza jew multiplikazzjoni, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加；数量或程度的上升。
充裕；某种事物数量丰富的状态。
乘法；将数相乘的数学运算。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ktir fil-produzzjoni matul l-aħħar sena.
formal.en: The report describes the increase in production over the past year.
formal.zh: 报告描述了过去一年产量的增加。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'ktir' f'din is-sentenza? Lara: Hawnhekk ifisser żieda fil-produzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'ktir' mean in this sentence? Lara: Here it means an increase in production.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句话里的 ktir 是什么意思？拉拉：这里表示产量的增加。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 ktir 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ktir' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这里表示产量的增加。
messages.en: Here it means an increase in production.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ktir 画三张提示卡：上升箭头代表增加，满篮水果代表充裕，乘号代表乘法；读句子时按语境选卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A three-dimensional solid with six rectangular faces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有六个矩形面的三维几何体，即长方体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġisem ġeometriku bi tliet dimensjonijiet u sitt uċuħ rettangolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长方体；由六个矩形面围成的立体。

collocations.en: a box shaped like a cuboid

formal.mt: Biex issib il-volum ta' kubojd, immultiplika t-tul bil-wisa' u bl-għoli.
formal.en: To find the volume of a cuboid, multiply its length by its width and height.
formal.zh: 计算长方体的体积时，将长、宽、高相乘。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din il-kaxxa għandha forma ta' kubojd? Rita: Iva, għandha sitt uċuħ rettangolari.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this box shaped like a cuboid? Rita: Yes, it has six rectangular faces.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个盒子是长方体形状的吗？丽塔：是的，它有六个矩形面。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kaxxa għandha forma ta' kubojd?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kaxxa għandha forma ta' kubojd?
messages.zh: 这个盒子是长方体形状的吗？
messages.en: Is this box shaped like a cuboid?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.zh: 是的，它有六个矩形面。
messages.en: Yes, it has six rectangular faces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 kubojd 就想象一个鞋盒，依次摸过长、宽、高，再数六个矩形面，把词义和立体形状连起来。

gloss_zh: 骑在别人背上；背着骑行

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piggyback ride, with one person riding on another person's back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人骑在另一个人的背上，由对方背着走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rikba fuq dahar persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骑在别人背上，由别人背着走。

collocations.zh: 一次骑在别人背上的体验

formal.mt: Matul il-mixja, il-missier ġarr lil ibnu kukkużejt meta t-tifel għeja.
formal.en: During the walk, the father carried his son piggyback when the boy became tired.
formal.zh: 散步时，男孩走累了，父亲就背着儿子走。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Pa, tagħtini rikba kukkużejt? Pawlu: Iva, itla' fuq dahri u żomm sew.
colloquial.en: Luca: Dad, will you give me a piggyback ride? Pawlu: Yes, climb onto my back and hold on tight.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：爸爸，你能让我骑在你背上吗？保罗：可以，爬到我背上来，抓紧。

messages.speaker: Luca (儿子)
messages.zh: 爸爸，你能让我骑在你背上吗？
messages.en: Dad, will you give me a piggyback ride?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, itla' fuq dahri u żomm sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, itla' fuq dahri u żomm sew.
messages.zh: 可以，爬到我背上来，抓紧。
messages.en: Yes, climb onto my back and hold on tight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子趴在爸爸背上，双手抓紧、双脚悬空，用这个背人画面记住 kukkużejt。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A movement in which the body turns completely over, with the head passing down and the feet passing over it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体整个翻转一圈、头部向下而双脚从上方翻过的动作，即翻筋斗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment li fih il-ġisem idur dawra sħiħa, bir-ras 'l isfel u s-saqajn jgħaddu minn fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 筋斗；身体整个翻转一圈的动作。

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tal-ġinnastika, l-għalliema wriet lill-istudenti kif jagħmlu kukrumbajsa fuq it-tapit.
formal.en: During the gymnastics lesson, the teacher showed the students how to do a somersault on the mat.
formal.zh: 体操课上，老师向学生示范如何在垫子上翻筋斗。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajtni nagħmel kukrumbajsa? Nina: Iva, dort dawra sħiħa fuq it-tapit!
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see me do a somersault? Nina: Yes, you rolled right over on the mat!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看到我翻筋斗了吗？妮娜：看到了，你在垫子上完整地翻了一圈！

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你看到我翻筋斗了吗？
messages.en: Did you see me do a somersault?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dort dawra sħiħa fuq it-tapit!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dort dawra sħiħa fuq it-tapit!
messages.zh: 看到了，你在垫子上完整地翻了一圈！
messages.en: Yes, you rolled right over on the mat!

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 kukrumbajsa 时想象身体像一个圆圈翻过去，再用 jagħmel kukrumbajsa 整组记住翻筋斗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cuckoo birds, known for their distinctive calls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 杜鹃鸟，也称布谷鸟，以独特的叫声为人熟知；此处对应复数义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasafar magħrufa għas-sejħa karatteristika tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杜鹃鸟；布谷鸟，复数。

formal.mt: L-istudenti semgħu s-sejħa tal-kukù waqt żjara fil-kampanja.
formal.en: The students heard the call of cuckoos during a visit to the countryside.
formal.zh: 学生们在一次乡间参观中听到了杜鹃鸟的叫声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhuma dawk l-għasafar li qed nisimgħu? Toni: Dawk huma kukù; isma' s-sejħa tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are those birds we can hear? Toni: Those are cuckoos; listen to their call.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们听见的是些什么鸟？托尼：那些是杜鹃鸟，听听它们的叫声。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhuma dawk l-għasafar li qed nisimgħu?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhuma dawk l-għasafar li qed nisimgħu?
messages.zh: 我们听见的是些什么鸟？
messages.en: What are those birds we can hear?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawk huma kukù; isma' s-sejħa tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Dawk huma kukù; isma' s-sejħa tagħhom.
messages.zh: 那些是杜鹃鸟，听听它们的叫声。
messages.en: Those are cuckoos; listen to their call.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kukù 的读音与脑中布谷鸟的叫声联想起来，并用几只鸟的画面提醒自己此处是复数义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Whenever something happens, meaning on every occasion that it happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示每次某种情况发生时，即每当或无论何时。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kull darba li tiġri xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 每当；无论何时。

formal.mt: Kulmeta l-istudenti jużaw sors ġdid, għandhom jiktbu t-titlu u l-isem tal-awtur.
formal.en: Whenever students use a new source, they should write down its title and the author's name.
formal.zh: 学生每次使用新的资料来源时，都应记下其标题和作者姓名。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nċempillek jekk ma nifhimx l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Iva, ċempilli kulmeta jkollok bżonn l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I call you if I don't understand the exercise? Mark: Yes, call me whenever you need help.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：如果我不懂这道练习，可以给你打电话吗？马克：可以，需要帮助时随时给我打电话。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nċempillek jekk ma nifhimx l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nċempillek jekk ma nifhimx l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 如果我不懂这道练习，可以给你打电话吗？
messages.en: Can I call you if I don't understand the exercise?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ċempilli kulmeta jkollok bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ċempilli kulmeta jkollok bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 可以，需要帮助时随时给我打电话。
messages.en: Yes, call me whenever you need help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上圈出每一次相同事件，把每一个圈都读作 kulmeta，记住它强调每逢发生的时候。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Whoever does something or meets a stated condition, without specifying a particular person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指任何做某事或符合所述条件的人，不限定具体是谁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kull persuna li tagħmel xi ħaġa jew tissodisfa kundizzjoni msemmija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无论谁；任何……的人；凡是……的人。

formal.mt: Kulmin irid jipparteċipa fil-kors għandu jimla l-formola sa nhar il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: Whoever wants to participate in the course should complete the form by Friday.
formal.zh: 凡是想参加课程的人，都应在星期五之前填好表格。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min jista' jiġi għal-laqgħa? Sara: Kulmin għandu interess; ġib lil ħuk ukoll.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who can come to the meeting? Sara: Whoever is interested; bring your brother too.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁可以来参加聚会？萨拉：有兴趣的人都可以，把你兄弟也带来吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁可以来参加聚会？
messages.en: Who can come to the meeting?

messages.speaker: Sara (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kulmin għandu interess; ġib lil ħuk ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Kulmin għandu interess; ġib lil ħuk ukoll.
messages.zh: 有兴趣的人都可以，把你兄弟也带来吧。
messages.en: Whoever is interested; bring your brother too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门口写着有兴趣者都欢迎，无论走来的是谁都适用，用这扇开放的门记住 kulmin。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In relation to culture, including a community's traditions, arts, and ways of life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 就文化而言，涉及一个群体的传统、艺术或生活方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fir-rigward tal-kultura, bħat-tradizzjonijiet, l-arti u l-mod ta' ħajja ta' komunità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在文化方面；从文化角度而言。

formal.mt: Dan il-festival huwa kulturalment importanti għax jagħti spazju lill-mużika u lit-tradizzjonijiet tal-komunità.
formal.en: This festival is culturally important because it gives space to the community's music and traditions.
formal.zh: 这个节日在文化上很重要，因为它为社区的音乐和传统提供了展示空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex trid iżżur dak il-post? Toni: Għax huwa kulturalment interessanti, speċjalment għall-mużika u l-ikel tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you want to visit that place? Toni: Because it is culturally interesting, especially for its music and food.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么想去那个地方？托尼：因为那里在文化方面很有意思，尤其是音乐和饮食。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么想去那个地方？
messages.en: Why do you want to visit that place?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa kulturalment interessanti, speċjalment għall-mużika u l-ikel tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa kulturalment interessanti, speċjalment għall-mużika u l-ikel tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为那里在文化方面很有意思，尤其是音乐和饮食。
messages.en: Because it is culturally interesting, especially for its music and food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象戴上文化视角的眼镜，看音乐、饮食和传统时说 kulturalment，记住它表示从文化方面看。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substance used to give or change the color of a material or product.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来赋予或改变材料、产品颜色的物质，如着色剂或染料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża biex tagħti jew tibdel il-kulur ta' materjal jew prodott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 着色剂；用于给材料或产品上色的染料。

formal.mt: Fil-workshop, l-istudenti użaw kuluranti għat-tessuti biex jagħtu kuluri differenti lill-biċċiet tad-drapp.
formal.en: In the workshop, the students used textile dyes to give the pieces of fabric different colors.
formal.zh: 在工作坊中，学生们用纺织品染料把布料染成不同颜色。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif se nagħmlu l-krema tal-kejk blu? Mark: Għandna kuluranti għall-ikel; nistgħu nużaw ftit mill-blu.
colloquial.en: Lara: How are we going to make the cake cream blue? Mark: We have food colorants; we can use a little of the blue one.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们怎么把蛋糕奶油变成蓝色？马克：我们有食用着色剂，可以用一点蓝色的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nagħmlu l-krema tal-kejk blu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nagħmlu l-krema tal-kejk blu?
messages.zh: 我们怎么把蛋糕奶油变成蓝色？
messages.en: How are we going to make the cake cream blue?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna kuluranti għall-ikel; nistgħu nużaw ftit mill-blu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna kuluranti għall-ikel; nistgħu nużaw ftit mill-blu.
messages.zh: 我们有食用着色剂，可以用一点蓝色的。
messages.en: We have food colorants; we can use a little of the blue one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象白色奶油滴入蓝色着色剂后变蓝，把 kuluranti 与使东西获得颜色的物质联系起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duck of the species Anas platyrhynchos, known in English as the mallard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 绿头鸭，学名为 Anas platyrhynchos 的一种鸭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Papra tal-ispeċi Anas platyrhynchos.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绿头鸭（Anas platyrhynchos）。

collocations.zh: 一只正在游泳的绿头鸭

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, ġie rreġistrat kuluvert ħdejn l-għadira.
formal.en: During the observation, a mallard was recorded beside the pond.
formal.zh: 观察期间，记录到一只绿头鸭出现在池塘旁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik il-papra! X'jisimha? Pawlu: Dik kuluvert. Maja: Ħa nieħu ritratt tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that duck! What is it called? Pawlu: That's a mallard. Maja: Let me take a photo of it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看那只鸭子！它叫什么？保罗：那是绿头鸭。玛雅：让我给它拍张照片。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看那只鸭子！它叫什么？
messages.en: Look at that duck! What is it called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是绿头鸭。
messages.en: That's a mallard.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 让我给它拍张照片。
messages.en: Let me take a photo of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuluvert 和一张标有“绿头鸭”的鸟类识别卡配对记忆，再用“拍照、游泳”两个场景反复造句。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duck of the species Tadorna ferruginea, known in English as the ruddy shelduck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 赤麻鸭，学名为 Tadorna ferruginea 的一种鸭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Papra tal-ispeċi Tadorna ferruginea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赤麻鸭（Tadorna ferruginea）。

collocations.en: a sighting of a ruddy shelduck
collocations.zh: 一次赤麻鸭的目击记录

collocations.en: a photograph of a ruddy shelduck

formal.mt: Il-gwida tinkludi ritratt ta' kuluvert aħmar u l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu, Tadorna ferruginea.
formal.en: The guide includes a photograph of a ruddy shelduck and its scientific name, Tadorna ferruginea.
formal.zh: 这本指南收录了一张赤麻鸭的照片及其学名 Tadorna ferruginea。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għasfur hemm f'dan ir-ritratt? Mark: Dak kuluvert aħmar. Lara: Se nfittex ismu fil-gwida.
colloquial.en: Lara: What bird is in this photo? Mark: That's a ruddy shelduck. Lara: I'll look up its name in the guide.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张照片里是什么鸟？马克：那是赤麻鸭。拉拉：我要在指南里查查它的名字。

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 这张照片里是什么鸟？
messages.en: What bird is in this photo?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟向导)
messages.zh: 那是赤麻鸭。
messages.en: That's a ruddy shelduck.

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 我要在指南里查查它的名字。
messages.en: I'll look up its name in the guide.

cognitive_memory_aid: aħmar 表示“红色”，可借它联想中文名里的“赤”；把整个 kuluvert aħmar 作为“赤麻鸭”这个物种名称记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duck of the species Anas strepera, known in English as the gadwall.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 赤膀鸭，学名为 Anas strepera 的一种鸭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Papra tal-ispeċi Anas strepera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赤膀鸭（Anas strepera）。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-osservazzjoni ġie rreġistrat kuluvert griż ħdejn l-ilma.
formal.en: A gadwall beside the water was recorded in the observation report.
formal.zh: 观察报告记录了一只出现在水边的赤膀鸭。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dik il-papra x'inhi? Toni: Dik kuluvert griż. Nina: Tista' turini isimha fil-ktieb?
colloquial.en: Nina: What kind of duck is that? Toni: That's a gadwall. Nina: Can you show me its name in the book?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那是什么鸭？托尼：那是赤膀鸭。妮娜：你能在书里指给我看它的名字吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 那是什么鸭？
messages.en: What kind of duck is that?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.zh: 那是赤膀鸭。
messages.en: That's a gadwall.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 你能在书里指给我看它的名字吗？
messages.en: Can you show me its name in the book?

cognitive_memory_aid: griż 表示“灰色”，可给词卡画一个灰色边框；卡片中央写“赤膀鸭”，提醒自己物种中文名不能逐字翻译。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duck of the species Tadorna tadorna, known in English as the common shelduck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 翘鼻麻鸭，学名为 Tadorna tadorna 的一种鸭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Papra tal-ispeċi Tadorna tadorna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 翘鼻麻鸭（Tadorna tadorna）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a common shelduck
a sighting of a common shelduck
collocations.zh: 一次翘鼻麻鸭的目击记录

formal.mt: L-istudenti identifikaw kuluvert tas-salib billi qabblu r-ritratt mal-gwida.
formal.en: The students identified a common shelduck by comparing the photograph with the guide.
formal.zh: 学生们将照片与指南对照，辨认出了一只翘鼻麻鸭。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Sibt l-isem tal-papra fir-ritratt? David: Iva, dik kuluvert tas-salib. Sara: Ħa nikteb l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you find the name of the duck in the photo? David: Yes, that's a common shelduck. Sara: Let me write the name under the photo.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你查到照片里那只鸭的名字了吗？戴维：查到了，那是翘鼻麻鸭。萨拉：让我把名字写在照片下面。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你查到照片里那只鸭的名字了吗？
messages.en: Did you find the name of the duck in the photo?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 查到了，那是翘鼻麻鸭。
messages.en: Yes, that's a common shelduck.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 让我把名字写在照片下面。
messages.en: Let me write the name under the photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuluvert tas-salib 分成两段朗读，再整组对应“翘鼻麻鸭”；用照片与名称配对记忆，不从名称猜测鸟的外形。

gloss_zh: 佣金代理人；佣金经纪人

teaching_sense.en_definition: An agent who arranges business transactions for another person or organization in return for a commission.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 替他人或机构安排商业交易，并以佣金作为报酬的代理人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li torganizza tranżazzjonijiet kummerċjali f'isem ħaddieħor u titħallas b'kummissjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 佣金代理人；通过代办或促成交易赚取佣金的人。

collocations.en: to work as a commission agent
an agreement with a commission agent
collocations.zh: 与佣金代理人订立的协议

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija qabdet kummissjonant biex isib xerrejja għall-prodotti tagħha.
formal.en: The company engaged a commission agent to find buyers for its products.
formal.zh: 公司聘请了一名佣金代理人，为其产品寻找买家。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'xogħol tagħmel? Pawlu: Naħdem bħala kummissjonant; insib xerrejja u nitħallas b'kummissjoni. Mark: Mela l-ħlas tiegħek jiddependi mill-bejgħ?
colloquial.en: Mark: What do you do for work? Pawlu: I work as a commission agent; I find buyers and get paid a commission. Mark: So your payment depends on sales?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你做什么工作？保罗：我是佣金代理人，负责找买家，收取佣金。马克：所以你的报酬取决于销售情况？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你做什么工作？
messages.en: What do you do for work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (佣金代理人)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħdem bħala kummissjonant; insib xerrejja u nitħallas b'kummissjoni.
