messages.mt_standard: Naħdem bħala kummissjonant; insib xerrejja u nitħallas b'kummissjoni.
messages.zh: 我是佣金代理人，负责找买家，收取佣金。
messages.en: I work as a commission agent; I find buyers and get paid a commission.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 所以你的报酬取决于销售情况？
messages.en: So your payment depends on sales?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kummissjonant 配上“找买家、促交易、收佣金”三个连续画面，用实际工作流程记住这是佣金代理人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official appointed to oversee a particular area of responsibility or carry out an official task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 获任命负责特定事务、履行官方职责的专员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċjal maħtur biex jieħu ħsieb qasam partikolari jew iwettaq dmir uffiċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专员；获任命负责特定事务的官员。

formal.mt: Il-kummissjonarju ppreżenta rapport dwar il-ħidma tal-uffiċċju tiegħu.
formal.en: The commissioner presented a report on the work of his office.
formal.zh: 专员提交了一份关于其办公室工作的报告。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jitkellem fil-laqgħa? David: Il-kummissjonarju se jispjega r-rapport. Anna: Tajjeb, irrid nisma' x'għandu jgħid.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who will speak at the meeting? David: The commissioner will explain the report. Anna: Good, I want to hear what he has to say.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁会在会上发言？戴维：专员会讲解这份报告。安娜：好，我想听听他怎么说。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 谁会在会上发言？
messages.en: Who will speak at the meeting?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.zh: 专员会讲解这份报告。
messages.en: The commissioner will explain the report.

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 好，我想听听他怎么说。
messages.en: Good, I want to hear what he has to say.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 kummissjonarju，就想象一位获任命的专员在会上提交报告；与 kummissjonant 的“收佣金”工作场景分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A two-legged instrument used to draw circles; also a caliper instrument used to measure dimensions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于画圆的双脚工具，即圆规；也可指用来测量尺寸的卡钳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'żewġ saqajn biex tpinġi ċrieki; ukoll għodda biex tkejjel dimensjonijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: compass, pair of compasses (tool used to draw circles)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 圆规；用于画圆或圆弧的双脚绘图工具。
卡钳；用于测量物体尺寸的量具。

collocations.en: to draw a circle with a pair of compasses

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-ġeometrija, l-istudent juża kumpass biex ipinġi ċirku b'raġġ ta' tliet ċentimetri.
formal.en: In the geometry lesson, the student uses a pair of compasses to draw a circle with a radius of three centimetres.
formal.zh: 在几何课上，学生用圆规画一个半径为三厘米的圆。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek kumpass biex inkejjel il-ħxuna ta' din il-biċċa? Toni: Iva, qiegħed fil-kaxxa tal-għodda. Lara: Grazzi, ħa niċċekkja l-kejl.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have calipers so I can measure the thickness of this piece? Toni: Yes, they're in the toolbox. Lara: Thanks, let me check the measurement.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有卡钳吗？我想量一下这块东西的厚度。托尼：有，在工具箱里。拉拉：谢谢，我来核对一下尺寸。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek kumpass biex inkejjel il-ħxuna ta' din il-biċċa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek kumpass biex inkejjel il-ħxuna ta' din il-biċċa?
messages.zh: 你有卡钳吗？我想量一下这块东西的厚度。
messages.en: Do you have calipers so I can measure the thickness of this piece?

messages.speaker: Toni (工匠)
messages.zh: 有，在工具箱里。
messages.en: Yes, they're in the toolbox.

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.zh: 谢谢，我来核对一下尺寸。
messages.en: Thanks, let me check the measurement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kumpass 画成两张工具卡：数学课上张开两脚画圆的是圆规，工作台上夹量厚度的是卡钳，用动作区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part or amount left after another part has been used, taken, or dealt with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某一部分被使用、取走或处理之后留下的其余部分或数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti jew l-ammont li jibqa' wara li parti oħra tkun intużat, ittieħdet jew ġiet trattata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剩余部分；其余的人、事物或数量。
赞美话；表达欣赏或称赞的话语。

formal.mt: L-ewwel parti tar-rapport tlestiet illum; il-kumplament se jitlesta għada.
formal.en: The first part of the report was completed today; the remainder will be completed tomorrow.
formal.zh: 报告的第一部分已于今天完成，其余部分将于明天完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-preżentazzjoni tiegħek kienet ċara ħafna! Mark: Grazzi tal-kumplament! Maja: Għoġobni kif spjegajt l-eżempji.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your presentation was very clear! Mark: Thanks for the compliment! Maja: I liked how you explained the examples.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的演讲讲得非常清楚！马克：谢谢夸奖！玛雅：我很喜欢你讲解例子的方式。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你的演讲讲得非常清楚！
messages.en: Your presentation was very clear!

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 谢谢夸奖！
messages.en: Thanks for the compliment!

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我很喜欢你讲解例子的方式。
messages.en: I liked how you explained the examples.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 kumplament 建两张场景卡：一张是完成一半后“剩余的工作”，另一张是听到称赞后“谢谢夸奖”，分别练习两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dependent on a condition being met; subject to a stated requirement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 须满足某个条件才成立或生效的；附带明确要求的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddependi fuq kundizzjoni li trid titwettaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有条件的；以满足某项要求为前提的。

formal.mt: L-approvazzjoni hija kundizzjonali: ix-xogħol jista' jibda biss wara li jaslu d-dokumenti kollha.
formal.en: The approval is conditional: work may begin only after all the documents have arrived.
formal.zh: 这项批准附带条件：只有收到全部文件后，工作才可以开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-offerta hija kundizzjonali? Mark: Iva, trid tibgħat id-dokumenti qabel il-Ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the offer conditional? Mark: Yes, you need to send the documents before Friday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这项提议附带条件吗？Mark：是的，你需要在星期五之前寄出文件。

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)
messages.zh: 这项提议附带条件吗？
messages.en: Is the offer conditional?

messages.speaker: Mark (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, trid tibgħat id-dokumenti qabel il-Ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, trid tibgħat id-dokumenti qabel il-Ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，你需要在星期五之前寄出文件。
messages.en: Yes, you need to send the documents before Friday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kundizzjonali 想成盖在批准书上的“满足条件才有效”印章，用它描述批准、提议等事物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a way that depends on a condition being met.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以满足某项条件为前提地；用于说明接受、批准等行为附带要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jiddependi fuq kundizzjoni li trid titwettaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有条件地；以某项条件得到满足为前提地。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva l-proposta kundizzjonalment, bil-kundizzjoni li l-baġit jiġi rivedut.
formal.en: The committee approved the proposal conditionally, requiring the budget to be revised.
formal.zh: 委员会有条件地批准了该提案，要求对预算作出修订。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Aċċettaw il-proposta tagħna? Pawlu: Iva, imma aċċettawha kundizzjonalment: irridu nnaqqsu l-ispiża.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did they accept our proposal? Pawlu: Yes, but they accepted it conditionally: we need to reduce the cost.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他们接受我们的提案了吗？Pawlu：接受了，不过是有条件地接受：我们需要降低成本。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 他们接受我们的提案了吗？
messages.en: Did they accept our proposal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma aċċettawha kundizzjonalment: irridu nnaqqsu l-ispiża.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma aċċettawha kundizzjonalment: irridu nnaqqsu l-ispiża.
messages.zh: 接受了，不过是有条件地接受：我们需要降低成本。
messages.en: Yes, but they accepted it conditionally: we need to reduce the cost.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 kundizzjonalment 回答“怎样接受或批准”：想象点头之后又补一句“但须满足条件”，突出中文的“地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The surrounding words or circumstances that help explain the meaning of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帮助理解某句话、事件或行为的前后文字或相关情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kliem jew iċ-ċirkostanzi ta' madwar xi ħaġa li jgħinu biex tinftiehem it-tifsira tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 语境；上下文；理解某事所需的相关背景。

collocations.en: in the context of the sentence

collocations.zh: 缺乏上下文；没有背景信息

formal.mt: It-tifsira ta' din il-kelma għandha tiġi interpretata fil-kuntest tas-sentenza kollha.
formal.en: The meaning of this word should be interpreted in the context of the whole sentence.
formal.zh: 这个词的含义应结合整个句子的语境来理解。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qal hekk? David: Aqra l-messaġġ ta' qabel; mingħajr kuntest diffiċli tifhem.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did he say that? David: Read the previous message; it is hard to understand without context.
colloquial.zh: Nina：他为什么那么说？David：读一下前一条消息吧；没有上下文很难理解。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么那么说？
messages.en: Why did he say that?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqra l-messaġġ ta' qabel; mingħajr kuntest diffiċli tifhem.
messages.mt_standard: Aqra l-messaġġ ta' qabel; mingħajr kuntest diffiċli tifhem.
messages.zh: 读一下前一条消息吧；没有上下文很难理解。
messages.en: Read the previous message; it is hard to understand without context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuntest 想成一句话周围的相框：先看前后文字和事情背景，再判断框中那句话的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cupid, a mythological figure associated with love.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 丘比特，与爱情相关的神话人物之名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' figura mitoloġika marbuta mal-imħabba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丘比特，象征爱情的神话人物。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ddeskrivew il-figura ta' Kupidu li tidher fl-istampa.
formal.en: The students described the figure of Cupid shown in the picture.
formal.zh: 学生们描述了图画中出现的丘比特形象。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dak fuq il-kartolina? Ben: Dak hu Kupidu; għażilt din il-kartolina għat-tema tal-imħabba.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is that on the card? Ben: That is Cupid; I chose this card for its theme of love.
colloquial.zh: Sara：贺卡上那个人物是谁？Ben：那是丘比特；我选这张贺卡是因为它的爱情主题。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 贺卡上那个人物是谁？
messages.en: Who is that on the card?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu Kupidu; għażilt din il-kartolina għat-tema tal-imħabba.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu Kupidu; għażilt din il-kartolina għat-tema tal-imħabba.
messages.zh: 那是丘比特；我选这张贺卡是因为它的爱情主题。
messages.en: That is Cupid; I chose this card for its theme of love.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Kupidu 与写着“爱情”的人物卡片配对记忆；这是人物专名，书写时注意开头的大写 K。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A covering placed over a surface or object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 覆在物体或表面上的东西或一层材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa jew saff ta' materjal li jgħatti oġġett jew wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 覆盖物；覆盖在物体表面的材料或层。

formal.mt: Qabel ma jitnaddaf l-oġġett, għandha titneħħa l-kupritura protettiva.
formal.en: Before the object is cleaned, the protective covering should be removed.
formal.zh: 清洁该物体之前，应先移去保护性覆盖物。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Nista' nneħħi din il-kupritura? Ġanni: Iva, neħħiha bil-mod biex ma tobrox il-wiċċ.
colloquial.en: Marta: Can I remove this covering? Ġanni: Yes, remove it slowly so you do not scratch the surface.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我可以把这层覆盖物拿掉吗？Ġanni：可以，慢慢拿掉，免得刮伤表面。

messages.speaker: Marta (家人)
messages.zh: 我可以把这层覆盖物拿掉吗？
messages.en: Can I remove this covering?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, neħħiha bil-mod biex ma tobrox il-wiċċ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, neħħiha bil-mod biex ma tobrox il-wiċċ.
messages.zh: 可以，慢慢拿掉，免得刮伤表面。
messages.en: Yes, remove it slowly so you do not scratch the surface.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kupritura 时想象物体外面盖着一层保护材料，再做出揭开它的动作，把词义固定为“覆盖物”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Curium, a chemical element.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素锔的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ curium.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锔，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fit-tabella tal-elementi, l-isem Malti kurju jidher ħdejn l-isem Ingliż curium.
formal.en: In the table of elements, the Maltese name kurju appears beside the English name curium.
formal.zh: 在这张元素表中，马耳他语名称 kurju 列在英语名称 curium 旁边。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif ngħidu curium bil-Malti? Mark: Ngħidu kurju; huwa isem ta' element kimiku.
colloquial.en: Lina: How do we say curium in Maltese? Mark: We say kurju; it is the name of a chemical element.
colloquial.zh: Lina：curium 用马耳他语怎么说？Mark：说 kurju；它是一种化学元素的名称。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: curium 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do we say curium in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħidu kurju; huwa isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħidu kurju; huwa isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.zh: 说 kurju；它是一种化学元素的名称。
messages.en: We say kurju; it is the name of a chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语元素卡：kurju—curium—锔；把三个名称放进同一个方格，按化学元素名称整体记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The long part at the back of a woman's dress that trails behind her.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 女式礼服背后延长并拖曳在穿着者身后的裙尾部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti twila ta' wara ta' libsa ta' mara li titkaxkar warajha.

sense_translations.en_definition: the train on a lady's dress
sense_translations.zh_definition: 女式礼服后方拖曳的长裙尾；礼服拖尾。

formal.mt: Il-libsa għandha kurkar twil li għandu jintrefa' meta min jilbisha jitla' t-taraġ.
formal.en: The dress has a long train that should be lifted when the wearer goes up the stairs.
formal.zh: 这件礼服带有长拖尾，穿着者上楼梯时应将拖尾提起。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Tista' żżommli l-kurkar waqt li nitla' t-taraġ? Rita: Żgur, nerfgħu ftit biex ma tirfisx fuqu.
colloquial.en: Ella: Can you hold my dress train while I go up the stairs? Rita: Of course, I will lift it a little so you do not step on it.
colloquial.zh: Ella：我上楼梯时，你能帮我托着礼服拖尾吗？Rita：当然，我把它稍微提起来，免得你踩到。

messages.speaker: Ella (礼服穿着者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' żżommli l-kurkar waqt li nitla' t-taraġ?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' żżommli l-kurkar waqt li nitla' t-taraġ?
messages.zh: 我上楼梯时，你能帮我托着礼服拖尾吗？
messages.en: Can you hold my dress train while I go up the stairs?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, nerfgħu ftit biex ma tirfisx fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, nerfgħu ftit biex ma tirfisx fuqu.
messages.zh: 当然，我把它稍微提起来，免得你踩到。
messages.en: Of course, I will lift it a little so you do not step on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kurkar 配上一幅礼服背后拖着长裙尾的画；再想象上楼时提起裙尾，记住它指礼服的拖尾部分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing the trailing part of a mourning dress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于描述丧服后方拖曳部分的；与丧服拖尾有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tirreferi għall-parti ta' libsa tal-luttu li titkaxkar wara min jilbisha.

sense_translations.en_definition: as 'trail of a mourning dress' referring, no doubt, to a disused custom
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于指“丧服的拖尾”，显然涉及一种已不再沿用的习俗。

collocations.mt: l-użu ta' 'kurkara' fid-deskrizzjoni ta' libsa tal-luttu
collocations.en: the use of 'kurkara' in describing a mourning dress
collocations.zh: kurkara 在描述丧服时的用法

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-aġġettiv 'kurkara' jirreferi għall-parti ta' libsa tal-luttu li titkaxkar wara min jilbisha.
formal.en: In this exercise, the adjective 'kurkara' refers to the part of a mourning dress that trails behind the wearer.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，形容词 kurkara 指向丧服上拖曳在穿着者身后的部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'kurkara' f'din id-deskrizzjoni? Anton: Tirreferi għall-parti tal-libsa tal-luttu li titkaxkar wara min jilbisha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'kurkara' mean in this description? Anton: It refers to the part of the mourning dress that trails behind the wearer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这段描述中的 kurkara 是什么意思？Anton：它指丧服上拖曳在穿着者身后的部分。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这段描述中的 kurkara 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'kurkara' mean in this description?

messages.speaker: Anton (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tirreferi għall-parti tal-libsa tal-luttu li titkaxkar wara min jilbisha.
messages.mt_standard: Tirreferi għall-parti tal-libsa tal-luttu li titkaxkar wara min jilbisha.
messages.zh: 它指丧服上拖曳在穿着者身后的部分。
messages.en: It refers to the part of the mourning dress that trails behind the wearer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 kurkara 单独制作“丧服拖尾”画面卡，并标注形容词；与 kurkar 的普通礼服拖尾画面对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant species Allium polyanthum, known as many-flowered garlic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Allium polyanthum 的多花蒜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Allium polyanthum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多花蒜，学名 Allium polyanthum。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-eżemplari ġie identifikat bħala kurrat salvaġġ, Allium polyanthum.
formal.en: In the report, the specimen was identified as many-flowered garlic, Allium polyanthum.
formal.zh: 报告将这份标本鉴定为多花蒜，学名 Allium polyanthum。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Skont it-tikketta, hija kurrat salvaġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this plant in the photograph called? Pawlu: According to the label, it is many-flowered garlic.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这种植物叫什么？保罗：按照标签上的名称，它是多花蒜。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 按照标签上的名称，它是多花蒜。
messages.en: According to the label, it is many-flowered garlic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整词写在多花蒜标本卡上，并与学名 Allium polyanthum 配对记忆，避免和另外两种蒜名混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant species Allium neapolitanum, known as white garlic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Allium neapolitanum、英文称为 white garlic 的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Allium neapolitanum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白蒜，学名 Allium neapolitanum。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jelenka l-kurrat ta' Napli bl-isem xjentifiku Allium neapolitanum.
formal.en: The catalogue lists white garlic under the scientific name Allium neapolitanum.
formal.zh: 目录以学名 Allium neapolitanum 收录白蒜。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema ritratt għandna nużaw għall-kurrat ta' Napli? Mark: Dan, għax it-tikketta tgħid Allium neapolitanum.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which photograph should we use for white garlic? Mark: This one, because its label says Allium neapolitanum.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：白蒜这一项该用哪张照片？马克：这张，因为它的标签写着 Allium neapolitanum。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema ritratt għandna nużaw għall-kurrat ta' Napli?
messages.mt_standard: Liema ritratt għandna nużaw għall-kurrat ta' Napli?
messages.zh: 白蒜这一项该用哪张照片？
messages.en: Which photograph should we use for white garlic?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan, għax it-tikketta tgħid Allium neapolitanum.
messages.mt_standard: Dan, għax it-tikketta tgħid Allium neapolitanum.
messages.zh: 这张，因为它的标签写着 Allium neapolitanum。
messages.en: This one, because its label says Allium neapolitanum.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张白蒜识别卡，正面写 kurrat ta' Napli，背面写 Allium neapolitanum；把完整名称作为一个单位记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant species Allium commutatum, known as sea garlic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Allium commutatum、英文称为 sea garlic 的海蒜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Allium commutatum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海蒜，学名 Allium commutatum。

formal.mt: Il-paġna dwar il-kurrat tax-xatt tinkludi l-isem xjentifiku Allium commutatum u ritratt tal-pjanta.
formal.en: The page about sea garlic includes the scientific name Allium commutatum and a photograph of the plant.
formal.zh: 介绍海蒜的页面列出了学名 Allium commutatum，并附有植物照片。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan hu l-kurrat tax-xatt? Toni: Iva, hekk jgħid il-ktieb; l-isem xjentifiku hu Allium commutatum.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this sea garlic? Toni: Yes, that is what the book says; its scientific name is Allium commutatum.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这是海蒜吗？托尼：是的，书上是这样写的；它的学名是 Allium commutatum。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这是海蒜吗？
messages.en: Is this sea garlic?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk jgħid il-ktieb; l-isem xjentifiku hu Allium commutatum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk jgħid il-ktieb; l-isem xjentifiku hu Allium commutatum.
messages.zh: 是的，书上是这样写的；它的学名是 Allium commutatum。
messages.en: Yes, that is what the book says; its scientific name is Allium commutatum.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张画有海浪的学习卡提示中文名海蒜，同时写上 kurrat tax-xatt 和 Allium commutatum；图画仅作记忆提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A line that bends, or a bend in something such as a road.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 弯曲的线，或道路等事物的弯曲部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Linja li titgħawweġ, jew parti minn triq jew minn xi ħaġa oħra li titgħawweġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 曲线；弯曲部分，如道路上的弯道。

formal.mt: Id-disinn juri kurva li tgħaqqad iż-żewġ punti.
formal.en: The drawing shows a curve connecting the two points.
formal.zh: 图中有一条连接这两个点的曲线。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed issuq bil-mod? David: Għax hemm kurva qawwija quddiemna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you driving slowly? David: Because there is a sharp bend ahead of us.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么开得这么慢？戴维：因为前面有一个急弯。

messages.speaker: Sara (乘客)
messages.zh: 你为什么开得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you driving slowly?

messages.speaker: David (司机)
messages.zh: 因为前面有一个急弯。
messages.en: Because there is a sharp bend ahead of us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 kurva 旁边画一条弯曲的线，再把它想成道路上的弯道，用同一个弯形连接两个常用场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container used to hold and pour liquids; a jug or pitcher.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放和倾倒液体的壶，如餐桌上的盛水壶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jintuża biex jinżamm u jitferra' likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盛液体并用于倒取的壶；盛水壶。

formal.mt: Fuq kull mejda tqiegħed kus tal-ilma ħdejn it-tazzi.
formal.en: A water jug was placed beside the glasses on each table.
formal.zh: 每张桌子的玻璃杯旁都放了一壶水。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tgħaddili l-kus, jekk jogħġbok? Lara: Żgur, hawn hu. Trid tazza wkoll?
colloquial.en: Mark: Could you pass me the jug, please? Lara: Of course, here it is. Would you like a glass too?
colloquial.zh: 马克：请把水壶递给我，好吗？拉拉：当然，给你。你也要一个玻璃杯吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (用餐者)
messages.zh: 请把水壶递给我，好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me the jug, please?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, hawn hu. Trid tazza wkoll?
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, hawn hu. Trid tazza wkoll?
messages.zh: 当然，给你。你也要一个玻璃杯吗？
messages.en: Of course, here it is. Would you like a glass too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象餐桌上拿起大壶给玻璃杯倒水的动作，把 kus 与盛水、倒水这组画面一起记住。

gloss_zh: 好诉讼的；动辄打官司的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to start lawsuits or to take disputes to court.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于提起诉讼或把争端诉诸法院的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jiftaħ kawżi jew iwassal tilwim il-qorti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好诉讼的；容易把纠纷诉诸法院的。

collocations.zh: 一个动辄提起诉讼的客户

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru kustinjuż jippreferi jiftaħ kawża milli jilħaq ftehim.
formal.en: In the novel, the litigious character prefers filing a lawsuit to reaching an agreement.
formal.zh: 小说中，这个好诉讼的角色宁愿提起诉讼，也不愿达成协议。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed issejjaħlu kustinjuż? Pawlu: Għax kull darba li jkollu tilwima, irid imur il-qorti.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you calling him litigious? Pawlu: Because whenever he has a dispute, he wants to go to court.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么说他好打官司？保罗：因为他每次遇到纠纷，都想上法庭。

messages.speaker: Nina (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他好打官司？
messages.en: Why are you calling him litigious?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kull darba li jkollu tilwima, irid imur il-qorti.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kull darba li jkollu tilwima, irid imur il-qorti.
messages.zh: 因为他每次遇到纠纷，都想上法庭。
messages.en: Because whenever he has a dispute, he wants to go to court.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个角色遇到纠纷就拿起诉状，把 kustinjuż 记作好诉讼的；重点记上法庭的倾向，而非一般爱争论。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Kuwait, a country in West Asia in the Middle East, officially called the State of Kuwait.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 科威特，位于中东地区的西亚国家，正式名称为科威特国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Asja tal-Punent, fil-Lvant Nofsani, bl-isem uffiċjali Stat tal-Kuwajt.

sense_translations.en_definition: Kuwait (a country in West Asia in the Middle East; official name: Stat tal-Kuwajt)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 科威特，位于中东地区的西亚国家；正式名称为科威特国，马耳他语为 Stat tal-Kuwajt。

formal.mt: L-Istat tal-Kuwajt jinsab fl-Asja tal-Punent, fir-reġjun tal-Lvant Nofsani.
formal.en: The State of Kuwait is located in West Asia, in the Middle East region.
formal.zh: 科威特国位于西亚的中东地区。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn sejjer għax-xogħol din id-darba? Mark: Sejjer il-Kuwajt għal ftit jiem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going for work this time? Mark: I am going to Kuwait for a few days.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这次你要去哪里出差？马克：我要去科威特几天。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 这次你要去哪里出差？
messages.en: Where are you going for work this time?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 我要去科威特几天。
messages.en: I am going to Kuwait for a few days.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Kuwajt、Kuwait、科威特并排写在国家卡上，通过拼写相似处配对记忆，并记住马耳他语国名首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small stove used for cooking or heating food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于烹饪或加热食物的小型炉子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stufa żgħira li tintuża biex jissajjar jew jissaħħan l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小炉子；小型炉灶。

collocations.en: to turn on the small stove
to cook on the small stove

formal.mt: Il-kuċinetta għandha titqiegħed fuq wiċċ stabbli qabel l-użu.
formal.en: The small stove should be placed on a stable surface before use.
formal.zh: 使用前，应将小炉子放在稳固的表面上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nsaħħan is-soppa fuq il-kuċinetta? Rita: Iva, u itfiha meta tkun lest.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I heat the soup on the small stove? Rita: Yes, and turn it off when you are finished.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我可以用小炉子热汤吗？丽塔：可以，用完记得关掉。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我可以用小炉子热汤吗？
messages.en: Can I heat the soup on the small stove?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u itfiha meta tkun lest.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u itfiha meta tkun lest.
messages.zh: 可以，用完记得关掉。
messages.en: Yes, and turn it off when you are finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kuċinetta 配一幅小炉子上放着一锅汤的图，并在旁边写上“小”，用画面记牢这个词强调炉子体积较小。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stove used for cooking or heating food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于烹饪或加热食物的炉灶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jipproduċi s-sħana biex jissajjar jew jissaħħan l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 炉灶；用于烹饪的炉子。

formal.mt: Wara li tlesti t-tisjir, kun żgur li l-kuċiniera tkun mitfija.
formal.en: After you finish cooking, make sure that the stove is turned off.
formal.zh: 做完饭后，请确保炉灶已经关闭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kuċiniera għadha mixgħula? Mark: Le, tfejtha wara li sajjart.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the stove still on? Mark: No, I turned it off after cooking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：炉灶还开着吗？马克：没有，我做完饭就关了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 炉灶还开着吗？
messages.en: Is the stove still on?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 没有，我做完饭就关了。
messages.en: No, I turned it off after cooking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuċiniera 贴在厨房炉灶的图片旁，反复联想“开炉、做饭、关炉”三个动作；再与表示小炉子的 kuċinetta 成对复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The common buzzard, a bird of prey with the scientific name Buteo buteo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 普通鵟，一种猛禽，学名为 Buteo buteo。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża magħruf bl-isem xjentifiku Buteo buteo.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 普通鵟（Buteo buteo）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a common buzzard

formal.mt: Il-paġna dwar il-kuċċarda prima tinkludi ritratt u l-isem xjentifiku Buteo buteo.
formal.en: The page about the common buzzard includes a photograph and the scientific name Buteo buteo.
formal.zh: 介绍普通鵟的页面附有照片及其学名 Buteo buteo。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn insib il-kuċċarda prima f'dan il-ktieb? Pawlu: Fittex 'Buteo buteo' fl-indiċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I find the common buzzard in this book? Pawlu: Look for 'Buteo buteo' in the index.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书里哪里能找到普通鵟的介绍？保罗：在索引里找 Buteo buteo。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn insib il-kuċċarda prima f'dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn insib il-kuċċarda prima f'dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书里哪里能找到普通鵟的介绍？
messages.en: Where can I find the common buzzard in this book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟伙伴)
messages.zh: 在索引里找 Buteo buteo。
messages.en: Look for 'Buteo buteo' in the index.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuċċarda prima、普通鵟和 Buteo buteo 写成三行词卡，特别圈出学名中重复的 buteo，作为回忆这个物种的提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The rough-legged buzzard, a bird of prey with the scientific name Buteo lagopus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 毛脚鵟，一种猛禽，学名为 Buteo lagopus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża magħruf bl-isem xjentifiku Buteo lagopus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毛脚鵟（Buteo lagopus）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a rough-legged buzzard

formal.mt: It-tikketta taħt ir-ritratt tagħti l-isem kuċċarda tal-kalzetti u l-isem xjentifiku Buteo lagopus.
formal.en: The label below the photograph gives the name rough-legged buzzard and the scientific name Buteo lagopus.
formal.zh: 照片下方的标签标出了毛脚鵟的名称及其学名 Buteo lagopus。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif ngħid 'rough-legged buzzard' bil-Malti? Pawlu: Kuċċarda tal-kalzetti; hawn għandek ritratt tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do I say 'rough-legged buzzard' in Maltese? Pawlu: Kuċċarda tal-kalzetti; here is a photograph of one.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：毛脚鵟用马耳他语怎么说？保罗：Kuċċarda tal-kalzetti；这里有一张它的照片。

messages.speaker: Lara (语言学习者)
messages.zh: 毛脚鵟用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say 'rough-legged buzzard' in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Kuċċarda tal-kalzetti; hawn għandek ritratt tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Kuċċarda tal-kalzetti; hawn għandek ritratt tagħha.
messages.zh: Kuċċarda tal-kalzetti；这里有一张它的照片。
messages.en: Kuċċarda tal-kalzetti; here is a photograph of one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kuċċarda tal-kalzetti 分成两段朗读，再把整词与毛脚鵟图片及 Buteo lagopus 配对；较长的后半段帮助你区分这三个鵟类名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The long-legged buzzard, a bird of prey with the scientific name Buteo rufinus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 棕尾鵟，一种猛禽，学名为 Buteo rufinus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża magħruf bl-isem xjentifiku Buteo rufinus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棕尾鵟（Buteo rufinus）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a long-legged buzzard

formal.mt: Il-gwida tidentifika l-għasfur fir-ritratt bħala kuċċarda ħamra, Buteo rufinus.
formal.en: The guide identifies the bird in the photograph as a long-legged buzzard, Buteo rufinus.
formal.zh: 指南将照片中的鸟辨认为棕尾鵟，学名 Buteo rufinus。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Skont il-gwida, huwa kuċċarda ħamra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this bird in the photograph called? Pawlu: According to the guide, it is a long-legged buzzard.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：照片里的这种鸟叫什么？保罗：根据指南，它是棕尾鵟。

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 照片里的这种鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟伙伴)
messages.zh: 根据指南，它是棕尾鵟。
messages.en: According to the guide, it is a long-legged buzzard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 kuċċarda ħamra 制作一张红色边框的词卡，正面写马耳他语，背面配棕尾鵟图片和 Buteo rufinus，用颜色帮助区分词条。

gloss_zh: 挫伤后皮肤上的青蓝色痕迹

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bluish discoloration of the skin caused by bruising.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤受到碰撞或挫伤后出现的青蓝色痕迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lewn ikħal li jidher fuq il-ġilda wara daqqa.

sense_translations.en_definition: bluish tinge on the skin after bruising
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挫伤后皮肤上出现的青蓝色。

collocations.en: a bluish bruise mark on the arm

collocations.zh: 碰撞后出现的青蓝色痕迹

formal.mt: Wara li ħabat mat-tarf tal-mejda, dehret kuħħala fuq id-driegħ tiegħu.
formal.en: After he bumped into the edge of the table, a bluish bruise mark appeared on his arm.
formal.zh: 他撞到桌沿后，手臂上出现了一块青蓝色瘀痕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek dik il-kuħħala fuq driegħek? Mark: Ilbieraħ ħbatt mal-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you have that bluish bruise mark on your arm? Mark: I bumped into the door yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你手臂上怎么有那块青蓝色瘀痕？马克：我昨天撞到门了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek dik il-kuħħala fuq driegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek dik il-kuħħala fuq driegħek?
messages.zh: 你手臂上怎么有那块青蓝色瘀痕？
messages.en: Why do you have that bluish bruise mark on your arm?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我昨天撞到门了。
messages.en: I bumped into the door yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手臂撞到桌角后浮出青蓝色，把 kuħħala 与碰撞后的皮肤颜色联系起来记。

gloss_zh: 报出纸牌游戏中的点数

teaching_sense.en_definition: To announce how many points one has in a game of cards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在纸牌游戏中报出自己有多少点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddikjara kemm għandu punti f'logħba tal-karti.

sense_translations.en_definition: to declare the number of one's points in a game of cards
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在纸牌游戏中宣布自己的点数。

collocations.en: declared his points during the card game
collocations.zh: 在纸牌游戏中报出了自己的点数

formal.mt: Waqt il-logħba tal-karti, il-plejer kuża għoxrin punt, u dawn tniżżlu fuq il-karta tal-punteġġ.
formal.en: During the card game, the player declared twenty points, and these were entered on the score sheet.
formal.zh: 在纸牌游戏中，这名玩家报出了二十点，随后这些点数被记在计分表上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm-il punt kuża Mark? Toni: Kuża għoxrin punt; jien ktibthom hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: How many points did Mark declare? Toni: He declared twenty points; I wrote them down here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克报了多少点？托尼：他报了二十点；我把它记在这里了。

messages.speaker: Lara (牌友)
messages.zh: 马克报了多少点？
messages.en: How many points did Mark declare?

messages.speaker: Toni (计分员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kuża għoxrin punt; jien ktibthom hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Kuża għoxrin punt; jien ktibthom hawn.
messages.zh: 他报了二十点；我把它记在这里了。
messages.en: He declared twenty points; I wrote them down here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象牌桌上玩家开口报二十点，旁边的人立即记分，把 kuża 与报出自己的牌局点数这一动作绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shot consisting of a single uninterrupted sequence of photographic exposures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次连续拍摄所形成的镜头，即中间没有中断的一段影像。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sekwenza waħda ta' immaġnijiet fotografiċi miġbuda mingħajr interruzzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: shot (photography: single unbroken sequence of photographic exposures)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 镜头：一次连续、不中断拍摄所形成的一段影像。

formal.mt: Il-film jibda bi kwadratura twila li turi t-triq kollha mingħajr interruzzjoni.
formal.en: The film begins with a long uninterrupted shot showing the entire street.
formal.zh: 影片以一个持续较长、没有中断的镜头开场，展示整条街道。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-kwadratura twila wisq? Mark: Le, żomm il-kamera mixgħula sakemm jgħaddi l-karozzin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this shot too long? Mark: No, keep the camera running until the horse-drawn carriage passes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个镜头是不是太长了？Mark：不长，继续拍，直到马车过去。

messages.speaker: Maja (摄影学员)
messages.zh: 这个镜头是不是太长了？
messages.en: Is this shot too long?

messages.speaker: Mark (摄影老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, żomm il-kamera mixgħula sakemm jgħaddi l-karozzin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, żomm il-kamera mixgħula sakemm jgħaddi l-karozzin.
messages.zh: 不长，继续拍，直到马车过去。
messages.en: No, keep the camera running until the horse-drawn carriage passes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象摄影机从开始到结束一直拍摄，把 kwadratura 和“一段不中断的镜头”连在一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small picture, such as a small image displayed on a wall or placed on a desk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尺寸较小的画或图片，例如挂在墙上或摆在桌上的小画。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stampa żgħira, bħal waħda li titdendel mal-ħajt jew titqiegħed fuq skrivanija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小画；尺寸较小的图片。

formal.mt: Fuq l-iskrivanija tqiegħed kwadrett li juri d-dar tal-familja.
formal.en: A small picture showing the family home was placed on the desk.
formal.zh: 书桌上摆放了一幅描绘家庭住宅的小画。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn inpoġġi dan il-kwadrett? Pawlu: Poġġih fuq l-ixkaffa ħdejn il-kotba.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall I put this small picture? Pawlu: Put it on the shelf next to the books.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这幅小画放在哪里？Pawlu：放在书旁边的架子上吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 这幅小画放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put this small picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 放在书旁边的架子上吧。
messages.en: Put it on the shelf next to the books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象书桌上摆着一幅小画，指着画面说 kwadrett，用具体的小图片帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 1,000,000,000,000,000, equal to a thousand trillion.
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 1,000,000,000,000,000, jiġifieri elf triljun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 千万亿，即一千个万亿，数值为10¹⁵。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jiktbu kwadriljun bħala ċifra waħda segwita minn ħmistax-il żero.
formal.en: In this exercise, students should write a quadrillion as the digit one followed by fifteen zeros.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，学生应把一千万亿写成数字1后面跟十五个零。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm għandu żerijiet kwadriljun? Ben: Ħmistax. Ikteb wieħed u warajh ħmistax-il żero.
colloquial.en: Lara: How many zeros does a quadrillion have? Ben: Fifteen. Write a one followed by fifteen zeros.
colloquial.zh: Lara：一千万亿有几个零？Ben：十五个。写一个1，再在后面写十五个零。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 一千万亿有几个零？
messages.en: How many zeros does a quadrillion have?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħmistax. Ikteb wieħed u warajh ħmistax-il żero.
messages.mt_standard: Ħmistax. Ikteb wieħed u warajh ħmistax-il żero.
messages.zh: 十五个。写一个1，再在后面写十五个零。
messages.en: Fifteen. Write a one followed by fifteen zeros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kwadriljun 配上数字卡片“1后面十五个零”，再读作“一千个万亿”，用数值固定词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The night heron, the bird species Nycticorax nycticorax.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 夜鹭，学名为 Nycticorax nycticorax 的鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tat-tip ta' russett bl-isem xjentifiku Nycticorax nycticorax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夜鹭（学名：Nycticorax nycticorax）。

collocations.en: a night heron beside the water
a photograph of a night heron

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi ritratt ta' kwakka u jagħti l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Nycticorax nycticorax.
formal.en: The report includes a photograph of a night heron and gives its scientific name, Nycticorax nycticorax.
formal.zh: 报告附有一张夜鹭的照片，并列出其学名 Nycticorax nycticorax。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dak l-għasfur ħdejn l-ilma! X'inhu? David: Dik kwakka. Ħares lejha bit-tromba.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that bird beside the water! What is it? David: That's a night heron. Look at it through the binoculars.
colloquial.zh: Nina：看水边那只鸟！那是什么鸟？David：那是夜鹭。用双筒望远镜看看它。

messages.speaker: Nina (观鸟初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-għasfur ħdejn l-ilma! X'inhu?
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-għasfur ħdejn l-ilma! X'inhu?
messages.zh: 看水边那只鸟！那是什么鸟？
messages.en: Look at that bird beside the water! What is it?

messages.speaker: David (观鸟向导)
messages.zh: 那是夜鹭。用双筒望远镜看看它。
messages.en: That's a night heron. Look at it through the binoculars.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在夜鹭图片下同时标注 kwakka 和“夜鹭”，想象自己用望远镜认鸟，建立图像与词语的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of four musicians or singers performing together, or a piece of music for four performers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由四名演奏者或歌手组成的表演组合，也指供四人演奏或演唱的乐曲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' erba' mużiċisti jew kantanti li jdoqqu jew ikantaw flimkien, jew biċċa mużika għal erba' interpreti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 四重奏或四重唱；由四名表演者组成的组合，或为四人创作的乐曲。

collocations.zh: 弦乐四重奏；弦乐四重奏团

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-kunċert jinkludi kwartett tal-kordi li se jindaqq minn erba' studenti.
formal.en: The concert programme includes a string quartet to be performed by four students.
formal.zh: 音乐会节目包括一首弦乐四重奏作品，将由四名学生演奏。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kemm se tkunu fuq il-palk? Ġużeppi: Erbgħa. Se ndoqqu fi kwartett.
colloquial.en: Marija: How many of you will be on stage? Ġużeppi: Four. We'll be playing in a quartet.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你们几个人上台？Ġużeppi：四个。我们将组成四重奏演出。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们几个人上台？
messages.en: How many of you will be on stage?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (乐手)
messages.zh: 四个。我们将组成四重奏演出。
messages.en: Four. We'll be playing in a quartet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象舞台上并排站着四位乐手，一边数一二三四，一边说 kwartett，把“四人合奏”记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small star; the diminutive form of kewkba.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小星星，是 kewkba（星星）的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kewkba żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' kewkba.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small star (the diminutive form of 'kewkba')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一颗小星星；kewkba（星星）的指小形式。

collocations.en: a little star in the sky

formal.mt: Fuq kull karta, l-għalliema pinġiet kwejkba ħdejn l-isem tat-tifel jew tat-tifla.
formal.en: On each card, the teacher drew a little star next to the child's name.
formal.zh: 老师在每张卡片上都画了一颗小星星，放在孩子的名字旁边。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Nista' npinġi kwejkba hawn? Rita: Iva, pinġiha ħdejn il-qamar.
colloquial.en: Emma: Can I draw a little star here? Rita: Yes, draw it next to the moon.
colloquial.zh: Emma：我可以在这里画一颗小星星吗？Rita：可以，画在月亮旁边吧。

messages.speaker: Emma (孩子)
messages.zh: 我可以在这里画一颗小星星吗？
messages.en: Can I draw a little star here?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 可以，画在月亮旁边吧。
messages.en: Yes, draw it next to the moon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画一颗星写 kewkba，再画一颗更小的星写 kwejkba，用大小对照记住“小星星”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Open to doubt or criticism because its truth, reliability, or acceptability is uncertain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 真实性、可靠性或可接受性尚有疑问，因而值得质疑或商榷的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqajjem dubji jew kritika għax il-verità, l-affidabbiltà jew l-aċċettabbiltà tiegħu mhijiex ċerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有疑问的；可靠性、正确性或妥当性值得质疑的。

formal.mt: L-awtur ibbaża l-konklużjoni tiegħu fuq sors kwestjonabbli li ma jagħti ebda referenza.
formal.en: The author based his conclusion on a questionable source that provides no references.
formal.zh: 作者的结论依据一个可靠性存疑的来源，该来源没有提供任何参考文献。

colloquial.mt: Daniel: Se tuża dan is-sit għall-proġett? Lea: Għadu kwestjonabbli. L-ewwel irrid niċċekkja min kiteb l-informazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Daniel: Are you going to use this website for the project? Lea: It's still questionable. First I want to check who wrote the information.
colloquial.zh: Daniel：你打算在项目中使用这个网站吗？Lea：它的可靠性还有疑问。我想先查查这些信息是谁写的。

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.zh: 你打算在项目中使用这个网站吗？
messages.en: Are you going to use this website for the project?

messages.speaker: Lea (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu kwestjonabbli. L-ewwel irrid niċċekkja min kiteb l-informazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu kwestjonabbli. L-ewwel irrid niċċekkja min kiteb l-informazzjoni.
messages.zh: 它的可靠性还有疑问。我想先查查这些信息是谁写的。
messages.en: It's still questionable. First I want to check who wrote the information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给一条来源不明的信息画上问号，并标注 kwestjonabbli，记住“值得质疑、需要核实”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A written set of questions used to collect information or opinions from people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为收集人们的信息或意见而编制的一组书面问题，即调查问卷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sett ta' mistoqsijiet bil-miktub maħsub biex jiġbor informazzjoni jew opinjonijiet mingħand in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 调查问卷；用于收集信息或意见的一组书面问题。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti huma mitluba jimlew kwestjonarju anonimu dwar is-servizzi tal-librerija.
formal.en: Participants are asked to complete an anonymous questionnaire about the library's services.
formal.zh: 参与者需填写一份有关图书馆服务的匿名调查问卷。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Imlejt il-kwestjonarju li bagħtulna? Samwel: Għadni le. Se nimlieh wara l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you filled in the questionnaire they sent us? Samwel: Not yet. I'll fill it in after lunch.
colloquial.zh: Anna：他们发给我们的调查问卷，你填了吗？Samwel：还没有。我午饭后填。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 他们发给我们的调查问卷，你填了吗？
messages.en: Have you filled in the questionnaire they sent us?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Se nimlieh wara l-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Se nimlieh wara l-ikel.
messages.zh: 还没有。我午饭后填。
messages.en: Not yet. I'll fill it in after lunch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收到一张列满问题、需要逐项填写的表格，把 kwestjonarju 与“调查问卷”这个使用场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of five equal parts of a whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把一个整体平均分成五份后，其中的一份。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti waħda minn ħames partijiet indaqs ta' ħaġa sħiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 五分之一，即五个相等部分中的一个。

formal.mt: Kwint tas-somma totali ġie allokat għax-xiri tal-kotba.
formal.en: A fifth of the total amount was allocated to purchasing books.
formal.zh: 总金额的五分之一被拨用于购买书籍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu kwint ta' mitt ewro? Mark: Għoxrin ewro, għax taqsam mija b'ħamsa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much is a fifth of a hundred euros? Mark: Twenty euros, because you divide a hundred by five.
colloquial.zh: Maja：一百欧元的五分之一是多少？Mark：二十欧元，因为要把一百除以五。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu kwint ta' mitt ewro?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu kwint ta' mitt ewro?
messages.zh: 一百欧元的五分之一是多少？
messages.en: How much is a fifth of a hundred euros?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoxrin ewro, għax taqsam mija b'ħamsa.
messages.mt_standard: Għoxrin ewro, għax taqsam mija b'ħamsa.
messages.zh: 二十欧元，因为要把一百除以五。
messages.en: Twenty euros, because you divide a hundred by five.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个圆，平均切成五块，再涂其中一块，把 kwint 与“五分之一”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 1,000,000,000,000,000,000, equal to a billion multiplied by a billion.
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 1,000,000,000,000,000,000, jiġifieri biljun immultiplikat b'biljun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一百亿亿，即十亿个十亿，等于10的18次方。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, kwintiljun jinkiteb bħala wieħed segwit minn tmintax-il żero.
formal.en: In this exercise, a quintillion is written as one followed by eighteen zeros.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，一百亿亿写成数字1后面接十八个零。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm għandu żerijiet kwintiljun? Mark: Tmintax. Ikteb wieħed u warajh tmintax-il żero.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many zeros does a quintillion have? Mark: Eighteen. Write a one followed by eighteen zeros.
colloquial.zh: Maja：一百亿亿有多少个零？Mark：十八个。写一个1，再在后面写十八个零。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 一百亿亿有多少个零？
messages.en: How many zeros does a quintillion have?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tmintax. Ikteb wieħed u warajh tmintax-il żero.
messages.mt_standard: Tmintax. Ikteb wieħed u warajh tmintax-il żero.
messages.zh: 十八个。写一个1，再在后面写十八个零。
messages.en: Eighteen. Write a one followed by eighteen zeros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kwintiljun 配上数字卡片“1后面十八个零”，再用“十亿乘十亿”核对数量。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A quoted financial price, or a passage taken from someone's spoken or written words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指金融市场中的报价，也指从某人的讲话或文字中摘录的引文。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prezz ikkwotat fis-suq finanzjarju, jew silta meħuda mill-kliem mitkellem jew miktub ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金融报价，指证券等金融资产所报出的价格。

sense_translations.en_definition: quotation, quote (fragment of a human expression)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 引文；引语，即从某人的口头表达或书面文字中摘录的一段话。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jagħti l-kwotazzjoni tal-ishma u jinkludi kwotazzjoni diretta mid-diskors tad-direttur.
formal.en: The report gives the share price quotation and includes a direct quotation from the director's speech.
formal.zh: 报告列出了股票报价，并直接引用了董事讲话中的一段话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-kwotazzjoni minn liema ktieb hi? Mark: Minn dak li qrajna lbieraħ; in-numru tal-paġna hemm taħtha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which book is this quotation from? Mark: The one we read yesterday; the page number is underneath it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这段引文出自哪本书？Mark：我们昨天读的那本；下面写着页码。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kwotazzjoni minn liema ktieb hi?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kwotazzjoni minn liema ktieb hi?
messages.zh: 这段引文出自哪本书？
messages.en: Which book is this quotation from?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn dak li qrajna lbieraħ; in-numru tal-paġna hemm taħtha.
messages.mt_standard: Minn dak li qrajna lbieraħ; in-numru tal-paġna hemm taħtha.
messages.zh: 我们昨天读的那本；下面写着页码。
messages.en: The one we read yesterday; the page number is underneath it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡片记 kwotazzjoni：一张画股票价格，一张画带引号的句子，分别对应报价和引文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of exposing something covered or making previously unknown information known.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 揭开覆盖物、使某物显露的行为，或将原先不为人知的信息披露出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li titneħħa għata biex tidher xi ħaġa, jew li ssir magħrufa informazzjoni li qabel ma kinitx magħrufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 揭开；使显露，即移去遮盖而让某物露出。
披露；公开，即使原先未知或未公开的信息为人所知。

formal.mt: Il-kxif ta' informazzjoni kunfidenzjali mingħajr permess jista' jagħmel ħsara lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: Disclosure of confidential information without permission can harm the participants.
formal.zh: 未经许可披露机密信息可能对参与者造成伤害。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara wara l-kxif tal-verità? Mark: Kulħadd fl-aħħar fehem għaliex il-laqgħa tħassret.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened after the truth came out? Mark: Everyone finally understood why the meeting had been cancelled.
colloquial.zh: Maja：真相揭露后发生了什么？Mark：大家终于明白会议为什么取消了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 真相揭露后发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened after the truth came out?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kulħadd fl-aħħar fehem għaliex il-laqgħa tħassret.
messages.mt_standard: Kulħadd fl-aħħar fehem għaliex il-laqgħa tħassret.
messages.zh: 大家终于明白会议为什么取消了。
messages.en: Everyone finally understood why the meeting had been cancelled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象揭开一块布，下面的东西显露出来；再把画面换成秘密公开，串联 kxif 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small kitchen; the diminutive form of kċina.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面积较小的厨房；kċina的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kċina żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' kċina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小厨房；kċina的指小形式。

formal.mt: L-appartament jinkludi kċejna mgħammra tajjeb, kamra tas-sodda u kamra tal-banju.
formal.en: The apartment includes a well-equipped small kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom.
formal.zh: 这套公寓包括一间设备齐全的小厨房、一间卧室和一间浴室。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn nista' nagħmel kafè? Toni: Hemm kċejna ħdejn il-kamra tiegħek; issib kollox hemm.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where can I make some coffee? Toni: There is a little kitchen next to your room; you will find everything there.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我可以在哪里煮咖啡？托尼：你房间旁边有个小厨房；需要的东西都在那里。

messages.speaker: Sara (住客)
messages.zh: 我可以在哪里煮咖啡？
messages.en: Where can I make some coffee?

messages.speaker: Toni (房东)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm kċejna ħdejn il-kamra tiegħek; issib kollox hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm kċejna ħdejn il-kamra tiegħek; issib kollox hemm.
messages.zh: 你房间旁边有个小厨房；需要的东西都在那里。
messages.en: There is a little kitchen next to your room; you will find everything there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把kċina和kċejna并排画出来：前者画普通厨房，后者画迷你厨房，用大小对比记住指小含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a slight blue colour or a blue tinge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色略微带蓝，或呈现淡淡蓝色调的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ftit lewn ikħal jew jagħti fl-ikħal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 略带蓝色的；泛蓝的。

formal.mt: Id-dawl kħajjel tal-lampa jagħti lill-kamra dehra kiesħa.
formal.en: The lamp's bluish light gives the room a cold appearance.
formal.zh: 灯具泛蓝的光线使房间显得冷清。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan id-drapp jidher griż għalik? Maja: Iva, imma ħdejn it-tieqa għandu lewn kħajjel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this fabric look grey to you? Maja: Yes, but by the window it has a bluish hue.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你觉得这块布看起来是灰色的吗？玛雅：是的，不过在窗边它有点泛蓝。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得这块布看起来是灰色的吗？
messages.en: Does this fabric look grey to you?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ħdejn it-tieqa għandu lewn kħajjel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ħdejn it-tieqa għandu lewn kħajjel.
messages.zh: 是的，不过在窗边它有点泛蓝。
messages.en: Yes, but by the window it has a bluish hue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 kħajjel 时想象灰布在窗边透出一点蓝色，重点记住“略带蓝色”的程度感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing a slight blue colour or a faint blue tinge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 显出少许蓝色，或带有淡淡蓝色调的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri ftit lewn ikħal jew jagħti kemxejn fl-ikħal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 略带蓝色的；泛蓝的。

formal.mt: Il-ħġieġ tat-tieqa għandu lewn kħajli li jidher aktar ċar fid-dawl tax-xemx.
formal.en: The window glass has a bluish hue that is more noticeable in sunlight.
formal.zh: 窗玻璃略带蓝色，这种色调在阳光下更加明显。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-vażun huwa trasparenti? Rita: Iva, imma għandu lewn kħajli. Żommu ħdejn id-dawl u tarah.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this vase transparent? Rita: Yes, but it has a bluish hue. Hold it near the light and you'll see it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个花瓶是透明的吗？丽塔：是的，不过它略带蓝色。拿到光线附近就看得出来。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个花瓶是透明的吗？
messages.en: Is this vase transparent?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għandu lewn kħajli. Żommu ħdejn id-dawl u tarah.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għandu lewn kħajli. Żommu ħdejn id-dawl u tarah.
messages.zh: 是的，不过它略带蓝色。拿到光线附近就看得出来。
messages.en: Yes, but it has a bluish hue. Hold it near the light and you'll see it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kħajli 和透光时泛蓝的玻璃花瓶联系起来：整体透明，却能看出淡淡蓝色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become blue or take on a blue colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色发生变化，变成蓝色或显出蓝色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu kulur blu jew jibda jidher blu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变蓝；呈现蓝色。

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, il-likwidu kħal wara li żdiedet iż-żebgħa.
formal.en: During the experiment, the liquid turned blue after the dye was added.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，加入染料后，液体变蓝了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara, id-drapp kħal! Ben: Iva, iż-żebgħa bidlitlu l-kulur.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look, the fabric has turned blue! Ben: Yes, the dye changed its colour.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看，布料变蓝了！本：对，是染料让它变了颜色。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 看，布料变蓝了！
messages.en: Look, the fabric has turned blue!

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 对，是染料让它变了颜色。
messages.en: Yes, the dye changed its colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象白布放进蓝色染液，取出时已经变蓝；用这个颜色变化画面记住动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bluish tinge, or the quality of being blue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体略带的蓝色，也指呈蓝色这一颜色特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lewn ħafif ta' blu, jew il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li tkun blu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 略微泛出的蓝色；淡淡的蓝色调。
呈蓝色的性质或状态；蓝色特征。

formal.mt: Il-pittur żied kħulija ħafifa mad-dellijiet biex jagħti sens ta' kesħa lix-xena.
formal.en: The painter added a faint bluish tinge to the shadows to give the scene a sense of coldness.
formal.zh: 画家在阴影中添了一抹淡蓝色，使画面产生清冷感。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan l-abjad għandu kħulija ħafifa, hux? Pawlu: Iva, speċjalment ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Nina: This white has a faint bluish tinge, doesn't it? Pawlu: Yes, especially near the window.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个白色有点泛蓝，对吧？保罗：对，尤其是在窗边。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-abjad għandu kħulija ħafifa, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-abjad għandu kħulija ħafifa, hux?
messages.zh: 这个白色有点泛蓝，对吧？
messages.en: This white has a faint bluish tinge, doesn't it?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，尤其是在窗边。
messages.en: Yes, especially near the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把白纸边缘的一抹淡蓝与整片蓝天并排想象，分别记住“泛蓝色调”和“蓝色特征”两个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ruler bearing the title tsar or czar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拥有“沙皇”这一君主称号的统治者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħakkiem li għandu t-titlu ta' kżar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙皇，一种君主称号，也指拥有这一称号的统治者。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-kżar jilqa' lill-mistednin fis-sala l-kbira tal-palazz.
formal.en: In the story, the tsar receives the guests in the palace's great hall.
formal.zh: 故事中，沙皇在宫殿的大厅接待宾客。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak bil-kuruna fl-istampa? Mark: Hu l-kżar; ħdejh hemm il-familja tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the person wearing a crown in the picture? Mark: He's the tsar; his family is beside him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：画里戴王冠的那个人是谁？Mark：他是沙皇，旁边是他的家人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 画里戴王冠的那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the person wearing a crown in the picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-kżar; ħdejh hemm il-familja tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-kżar; ħdejh hemm il-familja tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他是沙皇，旁边是他的家人。
messages.en: He's the tsar; his family is beside him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给戴王冠的沙皇画像贴上 kżar 标签，再配读“沙皇的宫殿”，用人物与场景帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A son of a tsar, especially one identified as heir to the throne.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沙皇的儿子，尤指作为王位继承人的沙皇皇太子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iben ta' kżar, speċjalment dak magħruf bħala l-werriet tat-tron.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙皇之子，尤指沙皇皇太子或王位继承人。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-edukazzjoni tal-kżarneviċċ tinkludi l-istudju tal-lingwi u tal-istorja.
formal.en: In the novel, the tsarevich's education includes the study of languages and history.
formal.zh: 小说中，沙皇皇太子所受的教育包括语言和历史学习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kżarneviċċ f'din l-istorja hu iben il-kżar? Mark: Iva, u f'din l-istorja hu wkoll il-werriet tat-tron.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the tsarevich in this story the tsar's son? Mark: Yes, and in this story he is also the heir to the throne.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个故事里的皇太子是沙皇的儿子吗？Mark：是的，而且在这个故事里，他也是王位继承人。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kżarneviċċ f'din l-istorja hu iben il-kżar?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kżarneviċċ f'din l-istorja hu iben il-kżar?
messages.zh: 这个故事里的皇太子是沙皇的儿子吗？
messages.en: Is the tsarevich in this story the tsar's son?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u f'din l-istorja hu wkoll il-werriet tat-tron.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u f'din l-istorja hu wkoll il-werriet tat-tron.
messages.zh: 是的，而且在这个故事里，他也是王位继承人。
messages.en: Yes, and in this story he is also the heir to the throne.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个人物卡：沙皇标 kżar，沙皇之子标 kżarneviċċ；通过父子关系区分两个称号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: April Fools' Day, the first of April, when people play practical jokes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愚人节，即四月一日，人们在这一天开玩笑或捉弄别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ewwel jum ta' April, meta n-nies jagħmlu ċajt u daħk b'xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 愚人节，即四月一日。

formal.mt: Fl-Ewwel ta' April, l-istudenti kitbu stejjer umoristiċi għall-gazzetta tal-iskola.
formal.en: On April Fools' Day, the students wrote humorous stories for the school newspaper.
formal.zh: 愚人节当天，学生们为校报写了幽默故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum l-Ewwel ta' April; għamilt xi ċajta? Toni: Iva, għedt lil ħija li l-qattus tgħallem jitkellem!
colloquial.en: Maja: Today is April Fools' Day; did you play a joke on anyone? Toni: Yes, I told my brother that the cat had learned to talk!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天是愚人节，你捉弄谁了吗？托尼：有啊，我跟哥哥说猫学会说话了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum l-Ewwel ta' April; għamilt xi ċajta?
messages.mt_standard: Illum l-Ewwel ta' April; għamilt xi ċajta?
messages.zh: 今天是愚人节，你捉弄谁了吗？
messages.en: Today is April Fools' Day; did you play a joke on anyone?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għedt lil ħija li l-qattus tgħallem jitkellem!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għedt lil ħija li l-qattus tgħallem jitkellem!
messages.zh: 有啊，我跟哥哥说猫学会说话了！
messages.en: Yes, I told my brother that the cat had learned to talk!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 l-Ewwel ta' April 和日历上四月一日的笑脸连起来记：日期一到，就想到愚人节玩笑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: New Year's Day, the first day of January.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 元旦，即一月一日，也就是新一年的第一天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ewwel jum ta' Jannar, li huwa l-ewwel jum tas-sena l-ġdida.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 元旦；新年第一天，即一月一日。

formal.mt: Fl-Ewwel tas-Sena, il-familja nġabret għal ikla biex tiċċelebra l-bidu tas-sena l-ġdida.
formal.en: On New Year's Day, the family gathered for a meal to celebrate the start of the new year.
formal.zh: 元旦当天，一家人聚餐庆祝新一年的开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tagħmel fl-Ewwel tas-Sena? Toni: Se niekol mal-familja, u wara noħroġ nimxi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you going to do on New Year's Day? Toni: I'll have a meal with my family and go for a walk afterwards.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：元旦你打算做什么？托尼：和家人吃饭，然后出去散步。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 元旦你打算做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to do on New Year's Day?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se niekol mal-familja, u wara noħroġ nimxi.
messages.mt_standard: Se niekol mal-familja, u wara noħroġ nimxi.
messages.zh: 和家人吃饭，然后出去散步。
messages.en: I'll have a meal with my family and go for a walk afterwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 l-Ewwel tas-Sena 想成新日历翻开的第一页，页上写着一月一日，对应元旦当天。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Easter, the Christian festival celebrating the resurrection of Jesus; another name for Għid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 复活节，基督教庆祝耶稣复活的节日；与 Għid 同义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-festa Nisranija li tiċċelebra l-qawmien ta' Ġesù mill-mewt; isem ieħor għall-Għid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Għid 的同义名称，意为“复活节”。

formal.mt: Il-programm taċ-ċelebrazzjoni tal-Għid il-Kbir jinkludi quddiesa filgħodu u laqgħa għall-familji wara nofsinhar.
formal.en: The Easter celebration programme includes Mass in the morning and a gathering for families in the afternoon.
formal.zh: 复活节庆祝活动的安排包括上午的弥撒和下午的家庭聚会。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn se tieklu fl-Għid il-Kbir? Pawlu: Għand in-nanna; il-familja kollha se tiltaqa' hemm.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where are you having your meal at Easter? Pawlu: At Grandma's; the whole family is meeting there.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：复活节你们去哪里吃饭？保罗：去奶奶家，全家都会在那里聚一聚。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 复活节你们去哪里吃饭？
messages.en: Where are you having your meal at Easter?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għand in-nanna; il-familja kollha se tiltaqa' hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Għand in-nanna; il-familja kollha se tiltaqa' hemm.
messages.zh: 去奶奶家，全家都会在那里聚一聚。
messages.en: At Grandma's; the whole family is meeting there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 l-Għid il-Kbir 整体写在“复活节”日历格上，再用家庭聚餐的画面帮助记住这个节日名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A greeting used when meeting or addressing someone in the morning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 早晨见面或向人打招呼时使用的问候语，相当于“早上好”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima li tintuża meta tiltaqa' ma' xi ħadd jew tkellmu filgħodu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 早上好；早晨使用的问候语。

formal.mt: L-għodwa t-tajba lil kulħadd. Illum se niddiskutu l-programm tal-laqgħa.
formal.en: Good morning, everyone. Today we will discuss the meeting agenda.
formal.zh: 大家早上好。今天我们将讨论会议议程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-għodwa t-tajba, Mark! Trid kafè? Mark: L-għodwa t-tajba! Iva, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Good morning, Mark! Would you like coffee? Mark: Good morning! Yes, thank you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark，早上好！要喝咖啡吗？Mark：早上好！要，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark，早上好！要喝咖啡吗？
messages.en: Good morning, Mark! Would you like coffee?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 早上好！要，谢谢。
messages.en: Good morning! Yes, thank you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句话与早晨端起咖啡、向朋友问好的画面绑定，作为完整问候语记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a town in Malta within Marsamxett, associated in the supplied place-name sense with a fishing place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他马尔萨姆谢特范围内的一座城镇名称；所给地名释义保留了“捕鱼之地”的含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' belt f'Malta fil-port ta' Marsamxett, marbut fit-tifsira mogħtija ma' post tas-sajd.

sense_translations.en_definition: (toponymy) Fishing-place now surviving only as the name of a town in Malta inside Marsamxett as far as Ta' Xbiex with a parish church dating from 1867
sense_translations.zh_definition: （地名学）捕鱼之地，如今仅作为马耳他一座城镇的名称保留下来；该镇位于马尔萨姆谢特范围内，延伸至 Ta' Xbiex，堂区教堂始建于1867年。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir fl-Imsida, u l-parteċipanti għandhom jaslu qabel id-disgħa.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in Msida, and participants should arrive before nine.
formal.zh: 会议将在姆西达举行，与会者应在九点前到达。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn toqgħod? Pawlu: Noqgħod fl-Imsida. Anna: Għada se nkun l-Imsida wkoll.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where do you live? Pawlu: I live in Msida. Anna: I'll be in Msida tomorrow too.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你住在哪里？保罗：我住在姆西达。安娜：我明天也会在姆西达。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我住在姆西达。
messages.en: I live in Msida.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我明天也会在姆西达。
messages.en: I'll be in Msida tomorrow too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 L-Imsida 当作完整地名记忆，再用“Noqgħod fl-Imsida”整句练习“我住在姆西达”。

gloss_zh: 姆塔尔法（马耳他城镇名）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a small town on a hill in the north of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他北部一座位于山丘上的小城镇名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' belt żgħira fuq għolja fit-Tramuntana ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: A small town on a hill in the north of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他北部一座位于山丘上的小城镇。

formal.mt: L-Imtarfa hija belt żgħira fuq għolja fit-Tramuntana ta' Malta.
formal.en: Mtarfa is a small town on a hill in the north of Malta.
formal.zh: 姆塔尔法是马耳他北部一座位于山丘上的小城镇。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn sejjer il-Ħadd? David: Se nżur l-Imtarfa. Trid tiġi miegħi? Marija: Iva, niġi.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where are you going on Sunday? David: I'm going to visit Mtarfa. Would you like to come with me? Marija: Yes, I'll come.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你星期天去哪里？戴维：我要去姆塔尔法逛逛。你想一起去吗？玛丽亚：好，我去。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你星期天去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going on Sunday?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nżur l-Imtarfa. Trid tiġi miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Se nżur l-Imtarfa. Trid tiġi miegħi?
messages.zh: 我要去姆塔尔法逛逛。你想一起去吗？
messages.en: I'm going to visit Mtarfa. Would you like to come with me?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我去。
messages.en: Yes, I'll come.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 L-Imtarfa 配一张“山丘上的小镇”心像，用所给地理特征帮助记住这个地名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The greatest in amount or degree; the utmost.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示数量最多或程度最高的；也可表示达到最大限度的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri l-akbar kwantità jew l-ogħla grad possibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最多的；数量或程度最高的。
最大的；达到最高程度或最大限度的。

collocations.zh: 以最大的专注；极其仔细地

formal.mt: L-applikazzjonijiet kollha għandhom jiġu eżaminati bl-iżjed attenzjoni.
formal.en: All applications should be examined with the utmost attention.
formal.zh: 所有申请都应得到极其仔细的审查。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min qara l-iżjed kotba dan ix-xahar? Mark: Rita! Qrat ħamsa, u jien qrajt tnejn biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who read the most books this month? Mark: Rita! She read five, and I only read two.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个月谁读的书最多？马克：丽塔！她读了五本，我只读了两本。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min qara l-iżjed kotba dan ix-xahar?
messages.mt_standard: Min qara l-iżjed kotba dan ix-xahar?
messages.zh: 这个月谁读的书最多？
messages.en: Who read the most books this month?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Rita! Qrat ħamsa, u jien qrajt tnejn biss.
messages.mt_standard: Rita! Qrat ħamsa, u jien qrajt tnejn biss.
messages.zh: 丽塔！她读了五本，我只读了两本。
messages.en: Rita! She read five, and I only read two.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放在数量排行榜的顶端记忆：书最多是数量之最，注意力最大是程度之最。

gloss_zh: 别；不愿；既不……也不；除外；当……时；既然

teaching_sense.en_definition: A negative word used with a negated second-person imperfect verb to tell someone not to do something, and also used to express negative intention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 否定副词，可与第二人称未完成式的否定动词连用，表达“别做某事”的禁止，也可表达不打算或不愿做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avverbju ta' ċaħda li jista' jintuża ma' verb fit-tieni persuna tal-imperfett fin-negattiv biex jesprimi projbizzjoni, u li jintuża wkoll biex jesprimi intenzjoni negattiva.

sense_translations.en_definition: Used—optionally—with a negated second-person imperfect verb to express the negated imperative.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 可选择性地与第二人称未完成式的否定动词连用，表达否定命令，即“别……”“不要……”。
用于表达否定意愿，即不打算或不愿做某事。
既不……也不……；两者都不。
除……以外；用于引出排除在外的情况或对象。
当……时；用于引出时间从句。
既然；由于，用于引出作为理由或前提的情况。

formal.mt: La tidħolx fil-laboratorju mingħajr il-permess tal-għalliem.
formal.en: Do not enter the laboratory without the teacher's permission.
formal.zh: 未经老师许可，请勿进入实验室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: La tinsiex iġġib il-ktieb għada. Mark: Tinkwetax, diġà qegħdtu fil-basket.
colloquial.en: Maja: Don't forget to bring the book tomorrow. Mark: Don't worry, I've already put it in my bag.
colloquial.zh: Maja：别忘了明天把书带来。Mark：放心，我已经把它放进包里了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 别忘了明天把书带来。
messages.en: Don't forget to bring the book tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 放心，我已经把它放进包里了。
messages.en: Don't worry, I've already put it in my bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用 la tinsiex 记“别忘了”，再把副词用法与连词用法分卡整理；遇到 la 时结合后面的动词和上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the lips, especially to speech sounds produced using one or both lips.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与嘴唇有关的，尤指发音时使用一片或两片嘴唇的语音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam max-xufftejn, speċjalment ma' ħsejjes li jinħadmu b'xoffa waħda jew bit-tnejn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 唇的；与嘴唇有关的；语音学中指由嘴唇参与发出的唇音的。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss /m/ huwa ħoss labjali li jinħadem billi jingħalqu ż-żewġ xufftejn.
formal.en: The sound /m/ is a labial sound produced by closing both lips.
formal.zh: /m/是通过闭合双唇发出的唇音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex /m/ jissejjaħ ħoss labjali? Mark: Għax tagħlaq ix-xufftejn meta tlissnu. Ipprova għid 'mmm'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is /m/ called a labial sound? Mark: Because you close your lips when you pronounce it. Try saying 'mmm'.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么把/m/叫作唇音？Mark：因为发这个音时要闭合嘴唇。试着发一下“mmm”。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么把/m/叫作唇音？
messages.en: Why is /m/ called a labial sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax tagħlaq ix-xufftejn meta tlissnu. Ipprova għid 'mmm'.
messages.mt_standard: Għax tagħlaq ix-xufftejn meta tlissnu. Ipprova għid 'mmm'.
messages.zh: 因为发这个音时要闭合嘴唇。试着发一下“mmm”。
messages.en: Because you close your lips when you pronounce it. Try saying 'mmm'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 闭上双唇发“mmm”，感受嘴唇参与发音，再读 ħoss labjali，把形容词与实际口型联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who talks a great deal, often continuing about small or unimportant matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人话很多，常围绕琐事说个不停。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem ħafna, spiss fuq affarijiet żgħar jew bla importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容话很多、爱不停闲聊的人。
形容絮絮叨叨、围绕琐事说个不停的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġar lablabi jibqa' jitkellem anki meta l-oħrajn jippruvaw itemmu l-laqgħa.
formal.en: In the story, the talkative neighbour keeps talking even when the others try to end the meeting.
formal.zh: 故事中，那位话多的邻居在其他人试图结束聚会时仍说个不停。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu llum lablabi ħafna! | Rita: Iva, ilu nofs siegħa jirrakkonta x'ġara fil-ħanut.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu is really chatty today! | Rita: Yes, he's been telling us what happened at the shop for half an hour.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗今天可真能说！｜丽塔：是啊，他讲店里发生的事已经讲了半个小时。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗今天可真能说！
messages.en: Pawlu is really chatty today!

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilu nofs siegħa jirrakkonta x'ġara fil-ħanut.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilu nofs siegħa jirrakkonta x'ġara fil-ħanut.
messages.zh: 是啊，他讲店里发生的事已经讲了半个小时。
messages.en: Yes, he's been telling us what happened at the shop for half an hour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它配上一位聊天停不下来的邻居来记：重点是话多，另一个义项进一步突出絮叨琐事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Since or given that; used to present a circumstance as the reason for a conclusion or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“既然、由于”，把某种情况作为得出结论或采取行动的理由。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tfisser billi jew minħabba li, u tintroduċi raġuni għal konklużjoni jew azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由于；鉴于。表示作为依据或理由的情况，保留本义项的介词词性标注。
既然；由于。连接表示理由的分句与后续结论或行动。

formal.mt: Ladarba d-dokumenti kollha huma lesti, il-kumitat jista' jibda l-evalwazzjoni.
formal.en: Since all the documents are ready, the committee can begin the evaluation.
formal.zh: 既然所有文件均已备齐，委员会就可以开始评估。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ladarba int sejjer il-ħanut, tista' ġġibli l-ħobż? | Pawlu: Żgur, nixtrilek ħobża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Since you're going to the shop, could you get me some bread? | Pawlu: Sure, I'll buy you a loaf.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：既然你要去商店，能帮我带点面包吗？｜保罗：当然，我给你买一条。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ladarba int sejjer il-ħanut, tista' ġġibli l-ħobż?
messages.mt_standard: Ladarba int sejjer il-ħanut, tista' ġġibli l-ħobż?
messages.zh: 既然你要去商店，能帮我带点面包吗？
messages.en: Since you're going to the shop, could you get me some bread?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 当然，我给你买一条。
messages.en: Sure, I'll buy you a loaf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 套进“既然条件已经成立，就采取下一步行动”的句框来记；这里的 since 表示理由。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To utter a curse against someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某物发出诅咒或咒骂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħareġ kliem ta' saħta kontra xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诅咒；向某人或某物说出带有诅咒意味的话。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ir-raġel lagħan lil min kien qarraq bih u telaq mir-raħal.
formal.en: In the novel, the man cursed the person who had deceived him and left the village.
formal.zh: 小说中，那个男人诅咒了欺骗他的人，随后离开了村庄。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Toni meta nduna li serquh? | Pawlu: Lagħan lil min serqu, imbagħad ċempel lill-pulizija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Toni do when he realised he'd been robbed? | Pawlu: He cursed whoever had robbed him, then called the police.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：托尼发现自己被偷了之后做了什么？｜保罗：他咒骂了偷他东西的人，然后报了警。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel Toni meta nduna li serquh?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel Toni meta nduna li serquh?
messages.zh: 托尼发现自己被偷了之后做了什么？
messages.en: What did Toni do when he realised he'd been robbed?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lagħan lil min serqu, imbagħad ċempel lill-pulizija.
messages.mt_standard: Lagħan lil min serqu, imbagħad ċempel lill-pulizija.
messages.zh: 他咒骂了偷他东西的人，然后报了警。
messages.en: He cursed whoever had robbed him, then called the police.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词放进故事人物愤怒诅咒敌人的画面中，记住它表达说出诅咒这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A children's game played with five pebbles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种使用五颗小石子进行的儿童游戏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba tat-tfal li tintlagħab b'ħames ċagħqiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用五颗小石子玩的儿童游戏。

collocations.zh: 供这种游戏使用的五颗小石子

formal.mt: Għall-attività, l-għalliema ħejjiet ħames ċagħqiet biex turi lit-tfal il-lagħbija.
formal.en: For the activity, the teacher prepared five pebbles to show the children the game.
formal.zh: 为了开展活动，老师准备了五颗小石子，向孩子们介绍这种游戏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tilgħab il-lagħbija miegħi? | Pawlu: Iva, għandi ħames ċagħqiet hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to play the five-pebble game with me? | Pawlu: Yes, I've got five pebbles here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想和我玩五颗小石子游戏吗？｜保罗：想，我这里有五颗小石子。

messages.speaker: Maja (玩伴)
messages.zh: 你想和我玩五颗小石子游戏吗？
messages.en: Do you want to play the five-pebble game with me?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (玩伴)
messages.zh: 想，我这里有五颗小石子。
messages.en: Yes, I've got five pebbles here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中摆出五颗小石子和一起玩的孩子，把“五颗”与“儿童游戏”作为一组线索记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make or cause someone to lick something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人做出舔某物的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jilgħaq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人舔；让某人去舔某物。

collocations.en: made the boy lick the spoon
made the girl lick a little honey

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-missier lagħgħaq lit-tifel il-kuċċarina biex iduq il-krema.
formal.en: In the story, the father had the boy lick the spoon to taste the cream.
formal.zh: 故事中，父亲让男孩舔了舔勺子，尝尝奶油。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif daqha l-krema t-tifel? | Pawlu: Missieru lagħgħaq lit-tifel il-kuċċarina.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the boy taste the cream? | Pawlu: His father had him lick the spoon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男孩是怎么尝奶油的？｜保罗：他爸爸让他舔了舔勺子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男孩是怎么尝奶油的？
messages.en: How did the boy taste the cream?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他爸爸让他舔了舔勺子。
messages.en: His father had him lick the spoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“爸爸让孩子舔勺子”的双人场景记忆：一人促成动作，另一人才是实际舔的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single lick; also a superficial amount of knowledge about a subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次舔的动作；也指对某个领域只有粗浅的了解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa bl-ilsien fuq xi ħaġa; ukoll għarfien superfiċjali ta' suġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舔一下；一次用舌头舔的动作。
粗浅的知识；对某个领域仅有的表面了解。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant kellu biss lagħqa ta' għarfien dwar is-suġġett u għalhekk talab spjegazzjoni aktar dettaljata.
formal.en: The participant had only superficial knowledge of the subject and therefore requested a more detailed explanation.
formal.zh: 这位参与者对该主题只有粗浅了解，因此要求更详细的说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nieħu lagħqa mill-ġelat tiegħek? | Pawlu: Żgur, ħu ftit u għidli jekk jogħġbokx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I have a lick of your ice cream? | Pawlu: Sure, try a little and tell me if you like it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我能舔一口你的冰淇淋吗？｜保罗：当然，尝一点，告诉我你喜不喜欢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我能舔一口你的冰淇淋吗？
messages.en: Can I have a lick of your ice cream?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, ħu ftit u għidli jekk jogħġbokx.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, ħu ftit u għidli jekk jogħġbokx.
messages.zh: 当然，尝一点，告诉我你喜不喜欢。
messages.en: Sure, try a little and tell me if you like it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项并排记成“舔一下”和“知识浅尝”：前者是动作次数，后者是仅懂一点的程度。

gloss_zh: 阿谀奉承的；溜须拍马的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who flatters an influential person excessively to gain favour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容为了讨好有影响力的人而过分奉承、溜须拍马的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jfaħħar iżżejjed lil xi ħadd b'influwenza biex jikseb il-favur tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阿谀奉承的；为讨好别人而溜须拍马的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-impjegat lagħqi jfaħħar kull deċiżjoni tad-direttur bit-tama li jikseb promozzjoni.
formal.en: In the novel, the sycophantic employee praises every decision the director makes in the hope of gaining a promotion.
formal.zh: 小说中，那位溜须拍马的员工赞美主管的每一个决定，希望借此获得晋升。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tgħid li Toni lagħqi? | Pawlu: Għax ifaħħar lill-kap il-ħin kollu biex jieħu dak li jrid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you saying Toni is a suck-up? | Pawlu: Because he praises the boss all the time to get what he wants.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说托尼爱拍马屁？｜保罗：因为他为了得到自己想要的东西，整天夸老板。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħid li Toni lagħqi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħid li Toni lagħqi?
messages.zh: 你为什么说托尼爱拍马屁？
messages.en: Why are you saying Toni is a suck-up?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ifaħħar lill-kap il-ħin kollu biex jieħu dak li jrid.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ifaħħar lill-kap il-ħin kollu biex jieħu dak li jrid.
messages.zh: 因为他为了得到自己想要的东西，整天夸老板。
messages.en: Because he praises the boss all the time to get what he wants.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个为了升职而事事夸老板的人，把“过分奉承”和“想获好处”一起记住，体会其中的贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reduce the speed or pace of an action or movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 降低动作或移动的速度，使步调变慢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Naqqas il-ħeffa ta' azzjoni jew ta' moviment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放慢速度；减缓动作或行进的步调。

formal.mt: L-għalliem qal lill-istudent: "Lajjem il-qari biex il-kliem ikun ċar."
formal.en: The teacher told the student: "Slow down your reading so that the words are clear."
formal.zh: 老师对学生说：“读慢一点，让每个词都清楚。”

colloquial.mt: Anna: Lajjem il-pass, għax ma nistax inlaħħaq miegħek! Mark: Tajjeb, nimxu aktar bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Anna: Slow your pace, because I can't keep up with you! Mark: Okay, let's walk more slowly.
colloquial.zh: Anna：走慢一点，我跟不上你了！Mark：好，我们走慢些。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lajjem il-pass, għax ma nistax inlaħħaq miegħek!
messages.mt_standard: Lajjem il-pass, għax ma nistax inlaħħaq miegħek!
messages.zh: 走慢一点，我跟不上你了！
messages.en: Slow your pace, because I can't keep up with you!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我们走慢些。
messages.en: Okay, let's walk more slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友走得太快，你伸手示意并说 lajjem il-pass，把这个动词和放慢脚步一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is not a member of the clergy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不属于神职人员的普通信徒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li mhijiex membru tal-kleru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平信徒；非神职人员。
世俗的；非宗教性质的。
哎呀；哇，用来表达惊讶或赞叹。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat jinkludi saċerdot u lajk li jirrappreżenta lill-membri tal-parroċċa.
formal.en: The committee includes a priest and a layman who represents the members of the parish.
formal.zh: 委员会包括一名神父和一名代表堂区成员的平信徒。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lajk, kemm hu sabiħ dan il-ġnien! Ben: Iva, speċjalment meta jkunu miftuħa l-fjuri.
colloquial.en: Lara: Wow, this garden is so beautiful! Ben: Yes, especially when the flowers are in bloom.
colloquial.zh: Lara：哇，这个花园真漂亮！Ben：是啊，尤其是鲜花盛开的时候。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lajk, kemm hu sabiħ dan il-ġnien!
messages.mt_standard: Lajk, kemm hu sabiħ dan il-ġnien!
messages.zh: 哇，这个花园真漂亮！
messages.en: Wow, this garden is so beautiful!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment meta jkunu miftuħa l-fjuri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment meta jkunu miftuħa l-fjuri.
