messages.zh: 是啊，尤其是鲜花盛开的时候。
messages.en: Yes, especially when the flowers are in bloom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 lajk 做三张场景卡：普通信徒、世俗国家、惊讶喊哇；依靠句中位置区分三种词性。

gloss_zh: 平信徒的；非神职人员的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to lay people rather than members of the clergy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与平信徒或非神职人员有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-lajċi, jiġifieri persuni li mhumiex membri tal-kleru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平信徒的；非神职人员的。

formal.mt: Id-dokument jenfasizza l-importanza tal-parteċipazzjoni lajkali fil-ħajja tal-parroċċa.
formal.en: The document emphasises the importance of lay participation in parish life.
formal.zh: 这份文件强调平信徒参与堂区生活的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi tfisser għaqda lajkali? Ġużeppi: Tfisser għaqda ta' nies li mhumiex membri tal-kleru.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does a lay association mean? Ġużeppi: It means an association of people who are not members of the clergy.
colloquial.zh: Rita：平信徒团体是什么意思？Ġużeppi：就是由非神职人员组成的团体。

messages.speaker: Rita (新成员)
messages.zh: 平信徒团体是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a lay association mean?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (团体成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser għaqda ta' nies li mhumiex membri tal-kleru.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser għaqda ta' nies li mhumiex membri tal-kleru.
messages.zh: 就是由非神职人员组成的团体。
messages.en: It means an association of people who are not members of the clergy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lajkali 放在团体或参与后面练读，记住它用来描述平信徒相关的事物，是形容词。

gloss_zh: 平信徒群体；全体非神职信徒

teaching_sense.en_definition: The members of a religious community who are not clergy, considered as a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教团体中非神职信徒的总称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-membri ta' komunità reliġjuża li mhumiex membri tal-kleru, meqjusa bħala grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平信徒群体，指全体非神职信徒。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa kienet iddedikata għar-rwol tal-lajkat fil-ħajja tal-komunità.
formal.en: The meeting was dedicated to the role of the laity in community life.
formal.zh: 这次会议专门讨论平信徒群体在团体生活中的角色。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Meta jgħidu l-lajkat, ikunu qed jitkellmu fuq persuna waħda? Toni: Le, fuq il-membri kollha li mhumiex tal-kleru.
colloquial.en: Nina: When they say the laity, are they talking about one person? Toni: No, about all the members who are not clergy.
colloquial.zh: Nina：说平信徒群体时，是在说一个人吗？Toni：不是，是指所有非神职的成员。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta jgħidu l-lajkat, ikunu qed jitkellmu fuq persuna waħda?
messages.mt_standard: Meta jgħidu l-lajkat, ikunu qed jitkellmu fuq persuna waħda?
messages.zh: 说平信徒群体时，是在说一个人吗？
messages.en: When they say the laity, are they talking about one person?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fuq il-membri kollha li mhumiex tal-kleru.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fuq il-membri kollha li mhumiex tal-kleru.
messages.zh: 不是，是指所有非神职的成员。
messages.en: No, about all the members who are not clergy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把所有非神职信徒圈在同一个大圆里，圆圈标上 lajkat，提醒自己这是群体总称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person in a religious community who has not been ordained as a member of the clergy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教团体中未领受圣秩、不属于神职人员的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna f'komunità reliġjuża li ma rċevietx l-ordinazzjoni u mhijiex membru tal-kleru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平信徒，指未领受圣秩的非神职人员。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem huwa lajku li jgħin fl-organizzazzjoni tal-attivitajiet tal-parroċċa.
formal.en: The speaker is a layman who helps organise parish activities.
formal.zh: 这位发言者是一名协助组织堂区活动的平信徒。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Dak ir-raġel huwa qassis? Luqa: Le, huwa lajku li jgħin fil-parroċċa.
colloquial.en: Emma: Is that man a priest? Luqa: No, he is a layman who helps in the parish.
colloquial.zh: Emma：那位男士是神父吗？Luqa：不是，他是在堂区帮忙的平信徒。

messages.speaker: Emma (访客)
messages.zh: 那位男士是神父吗？
messages.en: Is that man a priest?

messages.speaker: Luqa (堂区成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa lajku li jgħin fil-parroċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa lajku li jgħin fil-parroċċa.
messages.zh: 不是，他是在堂区帮忙的平信徒。
messages.en: No, he is a layman who helps in the parish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位帮忙布置堂区活动的普通信徒，用 lajku 标记这个人，重点记住他没有领受圣秩。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At a slow pace, without moving or acting quickly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以缓慢的速度移动或做事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'pass bil-mod, mingħajr ħeffa fil-moviment jew fl-azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慢慢地；缓缓地，表示动作或行进速度较慢。

formal.mt: Il-grupp mexa lajma lajma tul il-mogħdija dejqa sakemm wasal ħdejn il-baħar.
formal.en: The group walked slowly along the narrow path until it reached the sea.
formal.zh: 一行人沿着狭窄的小路缓缓前行，直到来到海边。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed timxi lajma lajma? Karl: Għax jien għajjien u għandi bżonn nieħu pawża.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are you walking so slowly? Karl: Because I'm tired and need to take a break.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你为什么走得这么慢？Karl：因为我累了，需要休息一下。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jien għajjien u għandi bżonn nieħu pawża.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jien għajjien u għandi bżonn nieħu pawża.
messages.zh: 因为我累了，需要休息一下。
messages.en: Because I'm tired and need to take a break.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读两遍 lajma 时配上两次缓慢迈步，把整个短语和中文慢慢地连起来记；这是动作速度的提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which institutions or social life become less subject to religious authority or influence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 机构或社会生活逐渐减少宗教权威控制或宗教影响的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih l-istituzzjonijiet jew il-ħajja soċjali jsiru inqas suġġetti għall-awtorità jew għall-influwenza reliġjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 世俗化，即机构或社会生活逐渐减少宗教控制或影响的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-lajċizzazzjoni tal-istituzzjonijiet u l-bidliet fil-mod kif jitmexxew.
formal.en: The report examines the secularisation of institutions and changes in how they are run.
formal.zh: 这份报告考察机构的世俗化及其管理方式的变化。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser lajċizzazzjoni? David: Tfisser proċess li fih tonqos l-influwenza reliġjuża, pereżempju fuq istituzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does secularisation mean? David: It means a process in which religious influence decreases, for example over an institution.
colloquial.zh: Sara：世俗化是什么意思？David：指宗教影响逐渐减弱的过程，比如对某个机构的影响减弱。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 世俗化是什么意思？
messages.en: What does secularisation mean?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser proċess li fih tonqos l-influwenza reliġjuża, pereżempju fuq istituzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser proċess li fih tonqos l-influwenza reliġjuża, pereżempju fuq istituzzjoni.
messages.zh: 指宗教影响逐渐减弱的过程，比如对某个机构的影响减弱。
messages.en: It means a process in which religious influence decreases, for example over an institution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一条逐渐变化的时间线记住世俗化：这个词强调变化过程，可与表示原则的世俗主义对照。

gloss_zh: 世俗主义；政教分离原则

teaching_sense.en_definition: The principle that the state and public institutions should be independent of religious authorities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主张国家和公共机构独立于宗教权威的原则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prinċipju li l-istat u l-istituzzjonijiet pubbliċi jkunu indipendenti mill-awtoritajiet reliġjużi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 世俗主义，主张国家及公共事务独立于宗教权威。

formal.mt: L-esej jiddiskuti l-lajċiżmu u r-relazzjoni bejn l-istat u l-awtoritajiet reliġjużi.
formal.en: The essay discusses secularism and the relationship between the state and religious authorities.
formal.zh: 这篇文章讨论世俗主义以及国家与宗教权威之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'inhu l-lajċiżmu? Pawlu: Huwa l-prinċipju li l-istat ikun indipendenti mill-awtoritajiet reliġjużi.
colloquial.en: Marija: What is secularism? Pawlu: It is the principle that the state should be independent of religious authorities.
colloquial.zh: Marija：什么是世俗主义？Pawlu：就是国家应独立于宗教权威的原则。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是世俗主义？
messages.en: What is secularism?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa l-prinċipju li l-istat ikun indipendenti mill-awtoritajiet reliġjużi.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa l-prinċipju li l-istat ikun indipendenti mill-awtoritajiet reliġjużi.
messages.zh: 就是国家应独立于宗教权威的原则。
messages.en: It is the principle that the state should be independent of religious authorities.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放在国家与宗教分开管理的示意图旁，记住它表示一种原则或主张。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gap or missing part in information, a text, or an account.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信息、文本或叙述中缺失的部分或尚未填补的空白。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti nieqsa jew vojt fl-informazzjoni, f'test jew f'rakkont.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缺漏；文本、资料或知识中的空白。

formal.mt: L-istudju l-ġdid jimla lakuna importanti fl-għarfien tagħna dwar dan is-suġġett.
formal.en: The new study fills an important gap in our knowledge of this subject.
formal.zh: 这项新研究填补了我们对这一主题认识中的一处重要空白。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm lakuna fin-noti tiegħi dwar din il-lezzjoni. Pawlu: Nista' nselliflek in-noti tiegħi biex timlieha.
colloquial.en: Maja: There is a gap in my notes on this lesson. Pawlu: I can lend you my notes so you can fill it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我这节课的笔记漏了一部分。Pawlu：我可以把我的笔记借给你，让你补上。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm lakuna fin-noti tiegħi dwar din il-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm lakuna fin-noti tiegħi dwar din il-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 我这节课的笔记漏了一部分。
messages.en: There is a gap in my notes on this lesson.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nselliflek in-noti tiegħi biex timlieha.
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nselliflek in-noti tiegħi biex timlieha.
messages.zh: 我可以把我的笔记借给你，让你补上。
messages.en: I can lend you my notes so you can fill it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象笔记中间留着一块空白，把 lakuna 与“缺了一块，需要补上”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to state a minimum amount or the least action that is expected or acceptable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示数量的最低限度，或所期待、可接受的最低程度的行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biex jindika l-inqas ammont jew l-inqas azzjoni mistennija jew aċċettabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 至少；起码，表示最低数量或最低要求。

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant għandu jattendi lamank żewġ laqgħat matul il-kors.
formal.en: Each participant must attend at least two meetings during the course.
formal.zh: 每位参与者在课程期间必须至少参加两次会议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma nafx jekk għandix ħin biex naqra l-kapitlu kollu. Mark: Aqra lamank l-ewwel paġna qabel il-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: I don't know whether I have time to read the whole chapter. Mark: Read at least the first page before the lesson.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我不知道有没有时间读完整章。Mark：上课前至少先读第一页吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx jekk għandix ħin biex naqra l-kapitlu kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx jekk għandix ħin biex naqra l-kapitlu kollu.
messages.zh: 我不知道有没有时间读完整章。
messages.en: I don't know whether I have time to read the whole chapter.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqra lamank l-ewwel paġna qabel il-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Aqra lamank l-ewwel paġna qabel il-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 上课前至少先读第一页吧。
messages.en: Read at least the first page before the lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lamank 想成数量下方的一条底线：可以更多，但“至少”要达到这里。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A decorative light fixture that hangs from the ceiling and has several lights or branches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悬挂在天花板上、带有多个灯位或分枝的装饰性吊灯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lampa dekorattiva mdendla mis-saqaf, b'diversi dwal jew friegħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 枝形吊灯；悬挂于天花板、具有多个灯位的装饰灯具。

collocations.en: a chandelier hanging from the ceiling
collocations.zh: 悬挂在天花板上的枝形吊灯

formal.mt: Lampadarju tal-kristall idawwal is-sala prinċipali tal-binja.
formal.en: A crystal chandelier illuminates the building's main hall.
formal.zh: 一盏水晶枝形吊灯照亮了这座建筑的主厅。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt il-lampadarju l-ġdid fis-salott? David: Iva, jogħġobni ħafna, imma rridu nnaddfuh bil-galbu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you seen the new chandelier in the living room? David: Yes, I like it a lot, but we need to clean it carefully.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你看到客厅里新装的枝形吊灯了吗？David：看到了，我很喜欢，不过清洁时得小心。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你看到客厅里新装的枝形吊灯了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the new chandelier in the living room?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jogħġobni ħafna, imma rridu nnaddfuh bil-galbu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jogħġobni ħafna, imma rridu nnaddfuh bil-galbu.
messages.zh: 看到了，我很喜欢，不过清洁时得小心。
messages.en: Yes, I like it a lot, but we need to clean it carefully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 lampadarju 时想象大厅天花板上垂下一盏多枝水晶灯，用整幅画面记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lamp that produces light by burning oil, usually through a wick.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以油为燃料、通常通过灯芯燃烧来照明的灯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lampa li tagħti d-dawl billi taħraq iż-żejt, ġeneralment permezz ta' ftila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 油灯；燃烧油料来提供照明的灯具。

collocations.en: the wick of the oil lamp

formal.mt: Il-lampier espost fil-mużew għandu reċipjent għaż-żejt u ftila.
formal.en: The oil lamp displayed in the museum has an oil container and a wick.
formal.zh: 博物馆中展出的这盏油灯有储油容器和灯芯。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-lampier għadu jaħdem? Ġużeppi: Iva, imma l-ewwel irridu nimlewh biż-żejt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this oil lamp still work? Ġużeppi: Yes, but first we need to fill it with oil.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这盏油灯还能用吗？Ġużeppi：能，不过得先给它加油。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 这盏油灯还能用吗？
messages.en: Does this oil lamp still work?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (祖父)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel irridu nimlewh biż-żejt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel irridu nimlewh biż-żejt.
messages.zh: 能，不过得先给它加油。
messages.en: Yes, but first we need to fill it with oil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lampier 配上“油、灯芯、小火苗”三个画面，看到这个词就想起一盏油灯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An apparatus used to distil a liquid by heating it and collecting the condensed vapour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将液体加热，并收集蒸气冷凝所得液体的蒸馏装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat użat biex jiddistilla likwidu billi jsaħħnu u jiġbor il-likwidu li jifforma meta l-fwar jiksaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒸馏器；用来进行液体蒸馏的设备。
曲颈蒸馏器；带有导出蒸气部分的蒸馏装置。

formal.mt: Matul id-dimostrazzjoni, l-għalliema użat lampik biex turi kif il-fwar jiksaħ u jerġa' jsir likwidu.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the teacher used an alembic to show how vapour cools and becomes liquid again.
formal.zh: 演示时，老师用曲颈蒸馏器展示蒸气如何冷却并重新变成液体。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għal xiex jintuża dan il-lampik? Toni: Biex jiddistilla likwidu; ejja nistaqsu lill-għalliema kif jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Marija: What is this alembic used for? Toni: To distil a liquid; let's ask the teacher how it works.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这个曲颈蒸馏器是做什么用的？Toni：用来蒸馏液体；我们问问老师它是怎么工作的吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 这个曲颈蒸馏器是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this alembic used for?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jiddistilla likwidu; ejja nistaqsu lill-għalliema kif jaħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jiddistilla likwidu; ejja nistaqsu lill-għalliema kif jaħdem.
messages.zh: 用来蒸馏液体；我们问问老师它是怎么工作的吧。
messages.en: To distil a liquid; let's ask the teacher how it works.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 lampik 时沿着“液体受热、蒸气导出、冷凝成滴”的路线想一遍，把词义绑定蒸馏器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A light installed beside a street or road to illuminate it when it is dark.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设置在街道或道路旁、在黑暗时提供照明的灯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lampa mwaħħla ħdejn triq biex iddawwalha meta jkun id-dlam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 路灯；为街道或道路提供照明的灯。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill se jsewwi l-lampjun li jinsab ħdejn il-waqfa tal-karozzi tal-linja.
formal.en: The council will repair the streetlight beside the bus stop.
formal.zh: 地方议会将维修公交车站旁的路灯。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn se niltaqgħu llejla? Ben: Taħt il-lampjun ħdejn il-ħanut tal-kantuniera.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where shall we meet tonight? Ben: Under the streetlight beside the shop on the corner.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我们今晚在哪里见面？Ben：在街角商店旁边的路灯下。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今晚在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet tonight?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 在街角商店旁边的路灯下。
messages.en: Under the streetlight beside the shop on the corner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象夜晚约朋友在路灯下见面，用“街角那盏灯”的场景记住 lampjun。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a sudden or unexpected way, without warning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以突然或出乎意料的方式发生，事先没有预兆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod f'daqqa jew mhux mistenni, mingħajr twissija minn qabel.

sense_translations.en_definition: suddenly, all of a sudden, unexpectedly, out of the blue
sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然；一下子；出乎意料地；毫无预兆地。

collocations.en: he appeared out of the blue

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, id-dawl intefa lampravisa u d-diskussjoni waqfet għal ftit.
formal.en: During the meeting, the lights suddenly went out and the discussion stopped briefly.
formal.zh: 会议期间，灯突然灭了，讨论短暂停顿。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex tlaqt lampravisa lbieraħ? Samwel: Ċempluli mid-dar u kelli nitlaq mill-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why did you leave so suddenly yesterday? Samwel: I got a call from home and had to leave straight away.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你昨天怎么突然走了？Samwel：家里给我打了电话，我得马上离开。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨天怎么突然走了？
messages.en: Why did you leave so suddenly yesterday?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċempluli mid-dar u kelli nitlaq mill-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Ċempluli mid-dar u kelli nitlaq mill-ewwel.
messages.zh: 家里给我打了电话，我得马上离开。
messages.en: I got a call from home and had to leave straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lampravisa 配上“灯啪地灭了”的画面，记住事情突然发生、事先没有预兆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The fish known as the blue butterfish, with the scientific name Stromateus fiatola.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Stromateus fiatola、英语称为 blue butterfish 的蓝鲳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta magħrufa bl-isem Ingliż blue butterfish u bl-isem xjentifiku Stromateus fiatola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蓝鲳，学名 Stromateus fiatola。

collocations.en: a photograph of a blue butterfish

formal.mt: Il-gwida tinkludi ritratt tal-lampuka tal-istillerija u tagħti l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Stromateus fiatola.
formal.en: The guide includes a photograph of the blue butterfish and gives its scientific name, Stromateus fiatola.
formal.zh: 这本指南收录了蓝鲳的照片，并列出了它的学名 Stromateus fiatola。

colloquial.mt: Klara: X'jisimha din il-ħuta fir-ritratt? Noel: Hija lampuka tal-istillerija; fil-gwida hemm ukoll l-isem xjentifiku tagħha.
colloquial.en: Klara: What is the fish in this photograph called? Noel: It is a blue butterfish; the guide also gives its scientific name.
colloquial.zh: Klara：照片里的这条鱼叫什么？Noel：这是蓝鲳；指南里也列了它的学名。

messages.speaker: Klara (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这条鱼叫什么？
messages.en: What is the fish in this photograph called?

messages.speaker: Noel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija lampuka tal-istillerija; fil-gwida hemm ukoll l-isem xjentifiku tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Hija lampuka tal-istillerija; fil-gwida hemm ukoll l-isem xjentifiku tagħha.
messages.zh: 这是蓝鲳；指南里也列了它的学名。
messages.en: It is a blue butterfish; the guide also gives its scientific name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lampuka tal-istillerija 整组写在蓝鲳图片旁，再配上 Stromateus fiatola 学名卡片，按完整鱼名记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The marine fish Centrolophus niger, known in English as blackfish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种学名为 Centrolophus niger、英语称为 blackfish 的海鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta tal-baħar bl-isem xjentifiku Centrolophus niger, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala blackfish.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑色海鱼，特指学名为 Centrolophus niger 的鱼。

formal.mt: F'dan il-katalgu, l-isem lampuka tat-Torok jirreferi għall-ħuta Centrolophus niger.
formal.en: In this catalogue, the name lampuka tat-Torok refers to the fish Centrolophus niger.
formal.zh: 在本目录中，lampuka tat-Torok 这一名称指学名为 Centrolophus niger 的鱼。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandek lampuka tat-Torok illum? Pawlu: Iva, tridha sħiħa jew imqatta'?
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you have blackfish today? Pawlu: Yes, would you like it whole or cut up?
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你今天有这种黑色海鱼卖吗？保罗：有，你要整条的还是切好的？

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.zh: 你今天有这种黑色海鱼卖吗？
messages.en: Do you have blackfish today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (鱼贩)
messages.zh: 有，你要整条的还是切好的？
messages.en: Yes, would you like it whole or cut up?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语当作鱼名标签记忆，并配上一张标有学名的海鱼图片，避免仅凭其中一个词猜鱼种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A raspberry plant, or the small soft fruit that it produces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 覆盆子植株，也指这种植物结出的小而柔软的果实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li tagħmel frott żgħir u artab, jew il-frott ta' din il-pjanta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 覆盆子植株，指植物本身。
覆盆子果实，指可以食用的浆果。

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien tal-iskola tħawlet pjanta tal-lampun biex l-istudenti josservaw kif jikber il-frott.
formal.en: A raspberry plant was planted in the school garden so that students could observe how the fruit grows.
formal.zh: 学校花园里种下了一株覆盆子，让学生观察果实如何生长。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid ftit lampun mal-jogurt? Ben: Iva, grazzi. Poġġili ftit fil-platt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like some raspberries with your yogurt? Ben: Yes, thanks. Put some on my plate.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想在酸奶里加点覆盆子吗？本：想，谢谢。给我盘子里放一点吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想在酸奶里加点覆盆子吗？
messages.en: Would you like some raspberries with your yogurt?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。给我盘子里放一点吧。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Put some on my plate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画一起记：花园里的一株覆盆子和碗里的一把覆盆子；同一个词可指植物，也可指果实。

gloss_zh: 上浆；浆洗中的上浆工序

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of applying starch to fabric to make it firmer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给织物施加淀粉浆，使布料变得较挺的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih jitqiegħed il-lamtu fuq id-drapp biex isir aktar iebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上浆，即用淀粉浆处理织物，使其较为挺括。

formal.mt: Wara l-lamtatura, il-qomos għandhom jitħallew jinxfu qabel ma jiġu mgħoddija.
formal.en: After starching, the shirts should be left to dry before being ironed.
formal.zh: 上浆后，应先让衬衫晾干，再进行熨烫。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Trid il-lamtatura wkoll għal dawn il-qomos? Mark: Iva, speċjalment għall-għenuq.
colloquial.en: Rita: Would you like these shirts starched as well? Mark: Yes, especially the collars.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这些衬衫也需要上浆吗？马克：需要，尤其是领子。

messages.speaker: Rita (洗衣店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid il-lamtatura wkoll għal dawn il-qomos?
messages.mt_standard: Trid il-lamtatura wkoll għal dawn il-qomos?
messages.zh: 这些衬衫也需要上浆吗？
messages.en: Would you like these shirts starched as well?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 需要，尤其是领子。
messages.en: Yes, especially the collars.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象软塌的衬衫领子经过上浆后挺起来，把这个词和“给布料上浆的过程”连在一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of an aircraft coming down onto the ground at the end of a flight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 飞机在飞行结束时下降并接触地面的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-inżul ta' ajruplan fuq l-art fi tmiem titjira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 着陆；降落，例如飞机下降并接触地面。

formal.mt: Il-landing tal-ajruplan sar mingħajr diffikultà minkejja r-riħ qawwi.
formal.en: The aircraft's landing took place without difficulty despite the strong wind.
formal.zh: 尽管风很大，飞机仍顺利完成了着陆。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif kien il-landing? Adam: Tajjeb ħafna, bilkemm ħassejtu.
colloquial.en: Nina: How was the landing? Adam: Very good; I barely felt it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：降落时怎么样？亚当：很平稳，我几乎没感觉到。

messages.speaker: Nina (接机的朋友)
messages.zh: 降落时怎么样？
messages.en: How was the landing?

messages.speaker: Adam (乘客)
messages.zh: 很平稳，我几乎没感觉到。
messages.en: Very good; I barely felt it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借助熟悉的英语拼写，把 landing 与飞机轮子接触跑道的画面绑定，再练习整句询问降落是否平稳。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage with a folding roof.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种由马牵引、装有可折叠车篷的四轮马车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Karozzella b'erba' roti, miġbuda miż-żwiemel, b'saqaf li jista' jintlewa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兰道式马车，一种带可折叠车篷的四轮马车。

formal.mt: Il-landò espost fil-mużew għandu erba' roti u saqaf li jista' jintlewa.
formal.en: The landau displayed in the museum has four wheels and a folding roof.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出的这辆兰道式马车有四个轮子和可折叠的车篷。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak landò? Toni: Iva, ħares lejn is-saqaf tiegħu; jista' jintlewa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is that a landau? Toni: Yes, look at its roof; it can be folded.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那是兰道式马车吗？托尼：是的，看看它的车篷，可以折叠起来。

messages.speaker: Sara (参观者)
messages.zh: 那是兰道式马车吗？
messages.en: Is that a landau?

messages.speaker: Toni (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħares lejn is-saqaf tiegħu; jista' jintlewa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħares lejn is-saqaf tiegħu; jista' jintlewa.
messages.zh: 是的，看看它的车篷，可以折叠起来。
messages.en: Yes, look at its roof; it can be folded.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“兰道”辅助记音，再想象四轮马车的车篷像折扇一样收起；拼写时留意末尾带重音符号的 ò。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of being sleepy and less alert.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到想睡觉、精神不够清醒的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' ngħas li fiha wieħed iħossu inqas attent u jkun irid jorqod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困意；昏昏欲睡、想要睡觉的感觉。

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa ta' wara nofsinhar, ħassejt lanja u sibt diffikultà biex nibqa' attent.
formal.en: During the afternoon meeting, I felt drowsy and found it difficult to stay attentive.
formal.zh: 下午开会时，我感到困倦，很难保持注意力。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandi lanja wara l-ikel. Pietru: Trid tistrieħ ftit qabel noħorġu?
colloquial.en: Anna: I feel drowsy after the meal. Pietru: Would you like to rest a little before we go out?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：吃完饭我有点犯困。彼得：出门前你想先休息一会儿吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 吃完饭我有点犯困。
messages.en: I feel drowsy after the meal.

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.zh: 出门前你想先休息一会儿吗？
messages.en: Would you like to rest a little before we go out?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象午饭后眼皮慢慢下垂的感觉，配合整句 Għandi lanja 记忆，表达“我有困意、我犯困了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called lanthanum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种名为“镧”的化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku li jissejjaħ lantanju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镧，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-lezzjoni, l-istudent iddeskriva l-lantanju bħala element kimiku.
formal.en: In the lesson report, the student described lanthanum as a chemical element.
formal.zh: 学生在课堂报告中将镧描述为一种化学元素。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-lantanju? Pawlu: Huwa element kimiku; illum qrajna dwaru fil-klassi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is lanthanum? Pawlu: It is a chemical element; we read about it in class today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：镧是什么？Pawlu：它是一种化学元素；我们今天上课读到了它。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 镧是什么？
messages.en: What is lanthanum?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku; illum qrajna dwaru fil-klassi.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku; illum qrajna dwaru fil-klassi.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素；我们今天上课读到了它。
messages.en: It is a chemical element; we read about it in class today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lantanju 写在“镧”的元素学习卡上，再配一句“这是化学元素”，整句联想有助于记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pear: a fruit typically narrower near the stalk and wider at the bottom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 梨，一种通常靠近果柄处较窄、下部较宽的水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta li ġeneralment tkun idjaq ħdejn iz-zokk u usa' fil-parti t'isfel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梨，指梨这种水果或其中一个果实。

formal.mt: Qabel ma tqatta' l-lanġasa, aħsilha sew taħt ilma ġieri.
formal.en: Before cutting the pear, wash it thoroughly under running water.
formal.zh: 切梨之前，应先用流动的水将它充分洗净。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Trid lanġasa wara l-ikel? Luqa: Iva, imma aħsilha l-ewwel, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Marija: Would you like a pear after the meal? Luqa: Yes, but wash it first, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：饭后想吃个梨吗？卢卡：想，不过请先洗一下。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 饭后想吃个梨吗？
messages.en: Would you like a pear after the meal?

messages.speaker: Luqa (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma aħsilha l-ewwel, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma aħsilha l-ewwel, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 想，不过请先洗一下。
messages.en: Yes, but wash it first, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 拿一个真实的梨练习说 lanġasa，再接上“熟的”和“削皮”两个场景，把名词与具体水果一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the shape of a pear, with a narrower upper part and a wider lower part.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状像梨的，通常上部较窄、下部较宽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu għamla ta' lanġasa, b'parti ta' fuq idjaq u parti t'isfel usa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梨形的；形状像梨、通常上窄下宽的。

formal.mt: Il-vażun lanġasi għandu parti ta' fuq dejqa u parti t'isfel usa'.
formal.en: The pear-shaped vase has a narrow upper part and a wider lower part.
formal.zh: 这个梨形花瓶上部较窄，下部较宽。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Liema vażun trid? David: Dak lanġasi, ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Elena: Which vase would you like? David: The pear-shaped one, next to the window.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你想要哪个花瓶？戴维：窗边那个梨形的。

messages.speaker: Elena (家居店店员)
messages.zh: 你想要哪个花瓶？
messages.en: Which vase would you like?

messages.speaker: David (顾客)
messages.zh: 窗边那个梨形的。
messages.en: The pear-shaped one, next to the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lanġasa“梨”和 lanġasi“梨形的”并排做词卡：前者画水果，后者画梨形花瓶，借画面区分名词与形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have the hair or fur stand on end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 毛发竖立起来，呈现炸毛的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu x-xagħar jew il-pil wieqaf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毛发竖起；炸毛。

formal.mt: Il-qattus lanżat meta ra l-kelb jersaq lejh.
formal.en: The cat bristled when it saw the dog approaching.
formal.zh: 猫看到狗向自己靠近时，毛发竖了起来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex lanżat il-qattus? Mark: Beża' mill-kelb. Ħallih jikkalma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the cat bristle? Mark: It was frightened of the dog. Let it calm down.
colloquial.zh: Sara：猫为什么炸毛了？Mark：它怕那只狗。让它平静下来吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 猫为什么炸毛了？
messages.en: Why did the cat bristle?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 它怕那只狗。让它平静下来吧。
messages.en: It was frightened of the dog. Let it calm down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 lanżat 就想象猫受惊后全身炸毛的画面，用“毛发竖起来”记住这个动作。

gloss_zh: 硬毛；扫帚的粗硬纤维；容易怨怼、动怒的心态

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stiff hair or a coarse fibre, such as one found on a broom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一根硬毛，或扫帚上那样的粗硬纤维。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xagħra iebsa jew fibra ħarxa, bħal dawk ta' xkupa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 硬毛；刚毛。

sense_translations.en_definition: the rough fibres on a broom
sense_translations.zh_definition: 扫帚上的粗硬纤维。
（比喻）心怀不平、容易觉得受了冒犯并动怒的心态。

collocations.en: the coarse fibres of the broom

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstabet lanżita iebsa fuq il-mejda, ħdejn ix-xkupilja.
formal.en: During the inspection, a stiff bristle was found on the table beside the brush.
formal.zh: 检查时，桌上刷子旁边发现了一根硬毛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi din fuq il-mejda? Toni: Lanżita tax-xkupilja. Neħħiha qabel inpoġġu l-platti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this on the table? Toni: A bristle from the brush. Remove it before we put the plates down.
colloquial.zh: Lara：桌上这个是什么？Toni：刷子上掉下来的硬毛。我们放盘子之前，把它拿掉吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 桌上这个是什么？
messages.en: What is this on the table?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lanżita tax-xkupilja. Neħħiha qabel inpoġġu l-platti.
messages.mt_standard: Lanżita tax-xkupilja. Neħħiha qabel inpoġġu l-platti.
messages.zh: 刷子上掉下来的硬毛。我们放盘子之前，把它拿掉吧。
messages.en: A bristle from the brush. Remove it before we put the plates down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先摸想象中的扫帚硬毛来记 lanżita，再把“硬、扎人”的触感联想到容易受冒犯的心态；这是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of repairing something by patching or mending it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过打补丁或缝补等方式修复物品的工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol ta' tiswija ta' xi ħaġa billi jitqiegħdu rqajja' jew jissewwew il-partijiet imqattgħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打补丁；修补；缝补。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi taħriġ fil-lapazzatura tal-ħwejjeġ biex il-parteċipanti jkunu jistgħu jsewwu tiċrit żgħir.
formal.en: The course includes training in mending clothes so that participants can repair small tears.
formal.zh: 课程包括衣物缝补训练，让参与者能够修补小破口。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-ġakketta għadha tista' tintlibes? Rita: Iva, bi ftit lapazzatura tkun tajba.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can this jacket still be worn? Rita: Yes, with a little mending it will be fine.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这件外套还能穿吗？Rita：能，稍微补一补就好了。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件外套还能穿吗？
messages.en: Can this jacket still be worn?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bi ftit lapazzatura tkun tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bi ftit lapazzatura tkun tajba.
messages.zh: 能，稍微补一补就好了。
messages.en: Yes, with a little mending it will be fine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 lapazzatura 配一幅旧衣服打补丁的图，把它记成“修补这项工作”，而不是某一块补丁。

gloss_zh: 说话口吃的人；犹豫不决的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who stammers, or a person who hesitates.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话时有口吃的人；也可指犹豫不决的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem bi tbatija billi tirrepeti ħsejjes, jew persuna li toqgħod lura milli tiddeċiedi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话口吃的人。
犹豫不决的人；做决定时迟疑的人。

collocations.en: a person who stammers when speaking
a person who hesitates over decisions

formal.mt: Il-laqlieq għandu jingħata biżżejjed ħin biex jesprimi ruħu mingħajr ma jiġi interrott.
formal.en: A person who stammers should be given enough time to express themselves without being interrupted.
formal.zh: 应给口吃者足够的时间表达自己，不要打断他们。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Meta jkolli nagħżel, jien laqlieq: nibqa' naħsibha. Anna: Ħu ftit ħin u mbagħad agħżel dak li tippreferi.
colloquial.en: Mark: When I have to choose, I am a hesitant person: I keep thinking it over. Anna: Take a little time and then choose what you prefer.
colloquial.zh: Mark：要做选择时，我就是个犹豫不决的人，总是想来想去。Anna：花点时间想想，然后选你更喜欢的。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta jkolli nagħżel, jien laqlieq: nibqa' naħsibha.
messages.mt_standard: Meta jkolli nagħżel, jien laqlieq: nibqa' naħsibha.
messages.zh: 要做选择时，我就是个犹豫不决的人，总是想来想去。
messages.en: When I have to choose, I am a hesitant person: I keep thinking it over.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu ftit ħin u mbagħad agħżel dak li tippreferi.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu ftit ħin u mbagħad agħżel dak li tippreferi.
messages.zh: 花点时间想想，然后选你更喜欢的。
messages.en: Take a little time and then choose what you prefer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 laqlieq 放在“某个人”的名词卡上，分别配说话停顿和选择迟疑两幅图；两个义项分开记，不把口吃等同于性格犹豫。

gloss_zh: 容易口吃的；说话容易结巴的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to stammer when speaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话时容易口吃、重复语音或出现停顿的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jirrepeti ħsejjes jew jieqaf bi tbatija waqt li jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易口吃的；有说话结巴倾向的。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to stammer
collocations.zh: 一个说话容易口吃的男孩

collocations.en: a speaker who tends to stammer
collocations.zh: 一位说话容易口吃的发言者

formal.mt: L-għalliem ta ħin biżżejjed lit-tifel laqlieqi biex itemm it-tweġiba tiegħu.
formal.en: The teacher gave the boy who tends to stammer enough time to finish his answer.
formal.zh: 老师给了这个说话容易口吃的男孩足够的时间，让他把答案说完。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Jien laqlieqi u kultant nieqaf waqt li nitkellem. Maja: Ħu l-ħin tiegħek; qed nisma'.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: I tend to stammer, and sometimes I pause while speaking. Maja: Take your time; I am listening.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：我说话容易结巴，有时说到一半会停下来。Maja：慢慢说，我在听。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien laqlieqi u kultant nieqaf waqt li nitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Jien laqlieqi u kultant nieqaf waqt li nitkellem.
messages.zh: 我说话容易结巴，有时说到一半会停下来。
messages.en: I tend to stammer, and sometimes I pause while speaking.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 慢慢说，我在听。
messages.en: Take your time; I am listening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 laqlieqi 与 laqlieq 并排做卡片：前者回答“这个人说话怎样”，后者可以指“这个人”，借此记住形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring people together so that they meet, or to convene a meeting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安排或促使人们见面；召集人们开会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib persuni flimkien biex jiltaqgħu, jew isejjaħ laqgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使见面；安排相见；使人们聚到一起。
召集会议；召集人们开会。

formal.mt: Id-direttur laqqa' l-kumitat biex jiddiskuti l-proposta l-ġdida.
formal.en: The director convened the committee to discuss the new proposal.
formal.zh: 主任召集委员会开会，讨论新提案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif iltqajtu int u Mark? Nina: Pawlu laqqa' lili u lil Mark waqt ikla mal-ħbieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did you and Mark meet? Nina: Pawlu brought Mark and me together at a meal with friends.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你和 Mark 是怎么认识的？Nina：Pawlu 在一次朋友聚餐时安排我和 Mark 见了面。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你和 Mark 是怎么认识的？
messages.en: How did you and Mark meet?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu laqqa' lili u lil Mark waqt ikla mal-ħbieb.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu laqqa' lili u lil Mark waqt ikla mal-ħbieb.
messages.zh: Pawlu 在一次朋友聚餐时安排我和 Mark 见了面。
messages.en: Pawlu brought Mark and me together at a meal with friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个组织者把两个人带到同一张桌前：laqqa' 强调“使人相见”；桌边坐上委员会成员时，就联想到“召集开会”。

gloss_zh: 会嫁接的；会接种疫苗的；爱给人起绰号的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to graft plants or administer vaccinations; also inclined to give nicknames.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有能力进行植物嫁接或疫苗接种的；也可形容喜欢给人起绰号的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaf ilaqqam pjanti jew jagħti tilqim; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi lil min għandu tendenza jagħti laqmijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会嫁接的；具备植物嫁接能力的。
会接种疫苗的；具备实施疫苗接种能力的。
爱给人起绰号的；有给人取外号倾向的。

collocations.en: a nurse able to administer vaccinations
a friend who tends to give nicknames

formal.mt: Għax-xogħol ta' għada, il-ġnien għandu bżonn ġardinar laqqami li jaf ilaqqam is-siġar.
formal.en: For tomorrow's work, the garden needs a gardener with the ability to graft trees.
formal.zh: 为完成明天的工作，园方需要一名会给树木嫁接的园丁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark jagħti laqam lil kull min jaf? Toni: Hu laqqami; dejjem joħroġ b'xi laqam ġdid.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does Mark give everyone he knows a nickname? Toni: He tends to give nicknames; he is always coming up with a new one.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 为什么给认识的每个人都起绰号？Toni：他就是爱起绰号，总能想出新的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark jagħti laqam lil kull min jaf?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark jagħti laqam lil kull min jaf?
messages.zh: Mark 为什么给认识的每个人都起绰号？
messages.en: Why does Mark give everyone he knows a nickname?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu laqqami; dejjem joħroġ b'xi laqam ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Hu laqqami; dejjem joħroġ b'xi laqam ġdid.
messages.zh: 他就是爱起绰号，总能想出新的。
messages.en: He tends to give nicknames; he is always coming up with a new one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 laqqami 画三张人物卡：会嫁接的园丁、会接种的护士、爱起绰号的朋友；按场景选择义项，前两项记能力，第三项记习惯。

gloss_zh: 捡取剩余物；吃得一干二净；拾穗；拾取者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gather what remains, especially leftover material or grain left after harvesting; also to eat every remaining scrap.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 捡取别人取用后剩下的东西，尤指收割后遗留的谷穗；也指把食物残余吃得一干二净。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġbor dak li jkun fadal, bħas-sbul wara l-ħsad; ukoll tiekol kull farka li jkun għad fadal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拿取或捡取剩下的东西。
把食物吃得一干二净，连最后一点碎屑也不剩。
拾穗；捡拾收割后遗留在田里的谷穗。
拾取者；捡拾东西的人。

collocations.zh: 把每一点碎屑都吃干净了

formal.mt: Wara l-ħsad, ir-raġel laqqat is-sbul li kien baqa' fl-għalqa.
formal.en: After the harvest, the man gleaned the ears of grain left in the field.
formal.zh: 收割后，那名男子捡拾了田里遗留的谷穗。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fadal xi ħaġa fil-platt? Pawlu: Le, ħija laqqat kull farka!
colloquial.en: Marta: Is there anything left on the plate? Pawlu: No, my brother ate every last crumb!
colloquial.zh: Marta：盘子里还剩什么吗？Pawlu：没有，我哥哥连一点碎屑都吃干净了！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 盘子里还剩什么吗？
messages.en: Is there anything left on the plate?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，我哥哥连一点碎屑都吃干净了！
messages.en: No, my brother ate every last crumb!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“收割后拾穗、饭后清盘”两个画面记住共同点：把剩下的也收走或吃净；作名词时另记为拾取者。

gloss_zh: 石块；用来击中目标的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rock, or an object used to strike a target.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一块石头，或用来击中某个目标的物件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebla, jew oġġett li jintuża biex jolqot mira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 石头；石块。

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. used to hit a target
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来击中目标的东西；投击物或击打物。

collocations.en: an object for hitting the target

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, il-parteċipant uża laqqata biex jolqot il-mira.
formal.en: During the exercise, the participant used an object to strike the target.
formal.zh: 练习时，参与者用一件投击物击中了目标。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'għandek f'idek? Toni: Laqqata żgħira; sibtha ħdejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Rita: What have you got in your hand? Toni: A small rock; I found it beside the tree.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你手里拿着什么？Toni：一块小石头，我在树旁找到的。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你手里拿着什么？
messages.en: What have you got in your hand?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 一块小石头，我在树旁找到的。
messages.en: A small rock; I found it beside the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象手心的一块石头，再想象它作为击中靶子的物件；把“石块”和“击中目标的东西”并列记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to pick things up or collect them as a habit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人习惯捡拾东西或经常收集物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu d-drawwa jiġbor affarijiet jew jiġbor dak li jsib.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to pick or collect habitually
sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯于捡拾或收集东西的；有经常收集物品倾向的。

collocations.en: a boy who habitually collects things
collocations.zh: 一个惯于收集东西的男孩

collocations.en: a man with a habit of picking things up
collocations.zh: 一个有捡拾东西习惯的男人

formal.mt: It-tifel laqqati jiġbor ġebel żgħir waqt kull mixja u jżommu f'kaxxa.
formal.en: The boy who habitually collects things gathers small stones on every walk and keeps them in a box.
formal.zh: 这个惯于收集东西的男孩每次散步都捡小石头，放在盒子里保存。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għandu daqshekk ġebel fil-kaxxa? Ben: Għax hu laqqati; kull darba li joħroġ jiġbor xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does he have so many stones in the box? Ben: Because he is always collecting things; every time he goes out, he picks something up.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他盒子里怎么有这么多石头？Ben：因为他爱收集东西，每次出门都会捡点什么。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他盒子里怎么有这么多石头？
messages.en: Why does he have so many stones in the box?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu laqqati; kull darba li joħroġ jiġbor xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu laqqati; kull darba li joħroġ jiġbor xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 因为他爱收集东西，每次出门都会捡点什么。
messages.en: Because he is always collecting things; every time he goes out, he picks something up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个每次散步都把口袋装满小物件的人；重点记住“经常如此”的收集习惯，而不只是一次捡拾。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To chip or cut material into small pieces, or to shape it into a wedge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把材料削切成小片、小块，或把材料削成楔形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqta' materjal f'biċċiet żgħar jew tagħtih għamla ta' feles.

sense_translations.en_definition: to chip or cut into small pieces
sense_translations.zh_definition: 削切成小片或小块。

sense_translations.en_definition: to shape in the form of a wedge
sense_translations.zh_definition: 削成楔形；加工成一端较薄的楔状。
削木者；把木材削成小片的人。

collocations.en: chipped the wood into small pieces

collocations.mt: laqqax biċċa injam f'għamla ta' feles
collocations.en: shaped a piece of wood into a wedge
collocations.zh: 把一块木头削成了楔形

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem laqqax biċċa injam f'għamla ta' feles biex iżomm il-bieb miftuħ.
formal.en: The worker shaped a piece of wood into a wedge to keep the door open.
formal.zh: 工人把一块木头削成楔形，用来抵住门，让门保持敞开。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min laqqax din il-biċċa injam? Mark: Jien; ridt nagħmel feles żgħir għall-bieb.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who shaped this piece of wood? Mark: I did; I wanted to make a small wedge for the door.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这块木头是谁削的？Mark：我削的，我想做个小木楔来抵门。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 这块木头是谁削的？
messages.en: Who shaped this piece of wood?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; ridt nagħmel feles żgħir għall-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; ridt nagħmel feles żgħir għall-bieb.
messages.zh: 我削的，我想做个小木楔来抵门。
messages.en: I did; I wanted to make a small wedge for the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象削木时落下一片片木屑，手中的木块渐渐成为门底的木楔；作名词时记为做这项工作的人。

gloss_zh: 能削木的；具备削木能力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the ability to chip wood into small pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人具备把木材削成小片的能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jaqta' l-injam f'laqx jew f'biċċiet żgħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to chip wood
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有削木能力的；能够把木材削成小片的。

collocations.en: a worker able to chip wood
collocations.zh: 一个具备削木能力的工人

collocations.en: a man who can chip wood

formal.mt: Għal dan ix-xogħol hemm bżonn ħaddiem laqqaxi li kapaċi jaqta' l-injam f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: This job requires a worker who is able to chip wood into small pieces.
formal.zh: 这项工作需要一名能够把木材削成小片的工人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandna bżonn xi ħadd laqqaxi għal dan l-injam. Ġorġ: Staqsi lil Toni; jaf jaqta' l-injam f'biċċiet żgħar.
colloquial.en: Sara: We need someone who can chip this wood. Ġorġ: Ask Toni; he knows how to cut wood into small pieces.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们需要一个会削木的人来处理这些木头。Ġorġ：问问Toni吧，他会把木材削成小片。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna bżonn xi ħadd laqqaxi għal dan l-injam.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna bżonn xi ħadd laqqaxi għal dan l-injam.
messages.zh: 我们需要一个会削木的人来处理这些木头。
messages.en: We need someone who can chip this wood.

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil Toni; jaf jaqta' l-injam f'biċċiet żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil Toni; jaf jaqta' l-injam f'biċċiet żgħar.
messages.zh: 问问Toni吧，他会把木材削成小片。
messages.en: Ask Toni; he knows how to cut wood into small pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词放进“谁会削木”的提问里记忆：重点是具备这项能力，像技能表上勾选了“会削木”。

gloss_zh: 促成人们见面的人；牵线者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who brings people together or arranges for them to meet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 介绍人们相识、安排他们见面或促成会面的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tlaqqa' lin-nies ma' xulxin jew tirranġa biex jiltaqgħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who gets people to meet
sense_translations.zh_definition: 促成人们见面的人；安排会面或介绍双方相识的牵线者。

collocations.en: a person who brings neighbours together

collocations.mt: laqqiegħ ta' nies minn gruppi differenti
collocations.en: a person who brings together people from different groups
collocations.zh: 介绍不同群体的人相互认识的牵线者

formal.mt: Il-laqqiegħ irranġa laqgħa bejn ir-rappreżentanti taż-żewġ gruppi biex isiru jafu lil xulxin.
formal.en: The person bringing them together arranged a meeting between representatives of the two groups so that they could get to know one another.
formal.zh: 牵线者安排了两个群体的代表会面，让他们相互认识。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif sirt taf lil Marija? David: Permezz ta' Pawlu; hu l-laqqiegħ li rranġa biex niltaqgħu.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did you get to know Marija? David: Through Pawlu; he is the person who arranged for us to meet.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你是怎么认识Marija的？David：通过Pawlu，他就是安排我们见面的牵线者。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是怎么认识Marija的？
messages.en: How did you get to know Marija?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Permezz ta' Pawlu; hu l-laqqiegħ li rranġa biex niltaqgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Permezz ta' Pawlu; hu l-laqqiegħ li rranġa biex niltaqgħu.
messages.zh: 通过Pawlu，他就是安排我们见面的牵线者。
messages.en: Through Pawlu; he is the person who arranged for us to meet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两位互不相识的人，中间有个人说“我介绍你们认识”；把中间这位促成会面的人记作 laqqiegħ。

gloss_zh: 倾向于牵线联系他人的；爱促成人们相识的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to connect people by introducing them or bringing them together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人倾向于介绍别人相识，或主动把人们联系到一起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jlaqqa' lin-nies u jgħinhom isiru jafu lil xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于联系人们、介绍他人相识或促成人们聚到一起的。

collocations.en: a person inclined to bring people together
collocations.zh: 一个爱促成人们相识的人
喜欢为他人牵线联系的性格

formal.mt: Il-koordinatur huwa bniedem laqqiegħi li spiss jintroduċi membri ġodda lil nies b'interessi simili.
formal.en: The coordinator is someone inclined to connect people and often introduces new members to people with similar interests.
formal.zh: 这位协调员喜欢促成人们相识，经常把新成员介绍给兴趣相近的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Luqa dejjem jintroduċini lil xi ħadd ġdid. Rita: Għandu karattru laqqiegħi; iħobb jgħin lin-nies isiru jafu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Luqa is always introducing me to someone new. Rita: He has a disposition to connect people; he likes helping people get to know one another.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Luqa总是给我介绍新朋友。Rita：他就是喜欢为人牵线的性格，爱帮大家相互认识。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Luqa dejjem jintroduċini lil xi ħadd ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Luqa dejjem jintroduċini lil xi ħadd ġdid.
messages.zh: Luqa总是给我介绍新朋友。
messages.en: Luqa is always introducing me to someone new.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu karattru laqqiegħi; iħobb jgħin lin-nies isiru jafu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu karattru laqqiegħi; iħobb jgħin lin-nies isiru jafu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 他就是喜欢为人牵线的性格，爱帮大家相互认识。
messages.en: He has a disposition to connect people; he likes helping people get to know one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚会中总爱说“你们应该认识一下”的朋友；这个形容词描写他爱联系人、爱介绍人的倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to chip at wood as a habitual activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人有经常削木的倾向或习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza joqgħod jaqta' l-injam f'laqx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于削木的；惯于把木材一点点削成木屑的。

collocations.en: a man inclined to chip at wood
a worker with a tendency to chip at wood
collocations.zh: 一个有削木习惯的工人

formal.mt: Ir-raġel laqxi jqatta' parti mill-ħin liberu tiegħu jaqta' biċċiet tal-injam f'laqx.
formal.en: The man who habitually chips at wood spends part of his free time cutting pieces of wood into shavings.
formal.zh: 这名惯于削木的男子会花一部分空闲时间，把木块一点点削成木屑。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex hemm il-laqx kollu ħdejn is-siġġu? Samwel: Ħija laqxi; kull meta joqgħod hemm jibda jaqta' biċċa injam.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why are there all these wood shavings beside the chair? Samwel: My brother is always chipping at wood; whenever he sits there, he starts cutting a piece of wood.
colloquial.zh: Elena：椅子旁怎么有这么多木屑？Samwel：我哥哥爱削木，每次坐在那里就开始削一块木头。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm il-laqx kollu ħdejn is-siġġu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm il-laqx kollu ħdejn is-siġġu?
messages.zh: 椅子旁怎么有这么多木屑？
messages.en: Why are there all these wood shavings beside the chair?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija laqxi; kull meta joqgħod hemm jibda jaqta' biċċa injam.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija laqxi; kull meta joqgħod hemm jibda jaqta' biċċa injam.
messages.zh: 我哥哥爱削木，每次坐在那里就开始削一块木头。
messages.en: My brother is always chipping at wood; whenever he sits there, he starts cutting a piece of wood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象某人一坐下就开始削木，椅边总有木屑；用“常常削木”记 laqxi，用“具备削木能力”区分 laqqaxi。

gloss_zh: 猪油复合脂；以猪油为基础的混合油脂

teaching_sense.en_definition: A compound or mixture based on lard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以猪油为基础制成的复合脂或混合油脂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħlita ta' xaħam ibbażata fuq il-lardu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猪油复合脂；以猪油为基础的混合油脂。

collocations.en: a small amount of lard compound

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tispeċifika ammont żgħir ta' lardina għall-għaġina.
formal.en: The recipe specifies a small amount of lard compound for the dough.
formal.zh: 食谱规定在面团中使用少量猪油复合脂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għandi nżid mat-taħlita? Mark: Żid ftit lardina u ħawwad sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: What should I add to the mixture? Mark: Add a little lard compound and mix well.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：混合物里该加什么？马克：加一点猪油复合脂，再搅拌均匀。

messages.speaker: Maja (烹饪学员)
messages.zh: 混合物里该加什么？
messages.en: What should I add to the mixture?

messages.speaker: Mark (烹饪老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Żid ftit lardina u ħawwad sew.
messages.mt_standard: Żid ftit lardina u ħawwad sew.
messages.zh: 加一点猪油复合脂，再搅拌均匀。
messages.en: Add a little lard compound and mix well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lardina 记在“混合油脂”标签旁，并与表示猪油的 lardu 对照，重点记住它是复合脂。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fat from a pig's abdomen, used as lard in cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 取自猪腹部、可用于烹饪的脂肪，即猪油。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xaħam miż-żaqq tal-ħanżir, użat fit-tisjir.

sense_translations.en_definition: lard (fat from the abdomen of a pig)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 猪油，指来自猪腹部的脂肪。

formal.mt: Din ir-riċetta tuża l-lardu bħala xaħam għat-tisjir.
formal.en: This recipe uses lard as a cooking fat.
formal.zh: 这份食谱使用猪油作为烹饪油脂。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandna lardu għar-riċetta? Pawlu: Iva, hemm biċċa lardu fil-friġġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do we have lard for the recipe? Pawlu: Yes, there's a piece of lard in the fridge.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们有做这道菜要用的猪油吗？保罗：有，冰箱里有一块。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 我们有做这道菜要用的猪油吗？
messages.en: Do we have lard for the recipe?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 有，冰箱里有一块猪油。
messages.en: Yes, there's a piece of lard in the fridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象厨房里标着 lardu 的一块猪油，把“猪腹部脂肪”和“烹饪油脂”两个画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the larynx, the part of the throat involved in producing voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与喉这一参与发声的器官有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-larinġi, il-parti tal-gerżuma involuta fil-produzzjoni tal-vuċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喉的；与喉部有关的。

formal.mt: It-test tal-anatomija jiddeskrivi nerv laringali u l-funzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The anatomy text describes a laryngeal nerve and its function.
formal.zh: 这篇解剖学课文描述了一条喉神经及其功能。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser laringali hawn? David: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-larinġi.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does laringali mean here? David: It means relating to the larynx.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的 laringali 是什么意思？戴维：意思是与喉有关的。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 laringali 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does laringali mean here?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.zh: 意思是与喉有关的。
messages.en: It means relating to the larynx.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 laringali 时，想象解剖图上喉部旁的标签；配合 nerv laringali“喉神经”记住它是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Oranges: citrus fruit eaten fresh or used to make juice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 橙子，一种可以鲜食或榨汁的柑橘类水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frott taċ-ċitru li jittiekel frisk jew jintuża biex isir il-meraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 橙子；可泛指这种水果或多个橙子。

formal.mt: Il-ħanut ibigħ larinġ frisk u meraq tal-larinġ.
formal.en: The shop sells fresh oranges and orange juice.
formal.zh: 这家商店出售新鲜橙子和橙汁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit larinġ? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Nagħmlu ftit meraq?
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some oranges? Mark: Yes, thanks. Shall we make some juice?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想要些橙子吗？马克：想，谢谢。我们榨点果汁好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想要些橙子吗？
messages.en: Would you like some oranges?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。我们榨点果汁好吗？
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Shall we make some juice?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 larinġ 放在一篮橙子的画面上，再接着记 meraq tal-larinġ“橙汁”，用水果和饮料串联记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where stone is extracted from the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从地面或地下开采石料的场所，即采石场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post minn fejn jinqata' u jinħareġ il-ġebel mill-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 采石场；开采石料的场所。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi latmija antika u l-ġebel li nħareġ minnha.
formal.en: The report describes an old quarry and the stone extracted from it.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一座旧采石场及其开采出的石料。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'hemm wara dik l-għolja? Maja: Hemm latmija antika.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's behind that hill? Maja: There's an old quarry.
colloquial.zh: 马克：那座小山后面有什么？玛雅：有一座旧采石场。

messages.speaker: Mark (游客)
messages.zh: 那座小山后面有什么？
messages.en: What's behind that hill?

messages.speaker: Maja (导游)
messages.zh: 有一座旧采石场。
messages.en: There's an old quarry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一处开采石料的大坑，在入口写上 latmija；用“采石场里取石头”的完整场景帮助记忆。

gloss_zh: 拉脱维亚的；拉脱维亚人（通常指男性）；拉脱维亚语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Latvia, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自拉脱维亚，或与拉脱维亚及其人民、文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu mil-Latvja jew għandu x'jaqsam mal-Latvja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: Latvian (of, from or relating to Latvia)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉脱维亚的；来自拉脱维亚或与拉脱维亚有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Latvian (native or inhabitant of Latvia) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉脱维亚人，指拉脱维亚本地人或居民，通常用于男性。
拉脱维亚语。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jippreżenta awtur Latvjan li jikteb bil-Latvjan.
formal.en: The article introduces a Latvian author who writes in Latvian.
formal.zh: 这篇文章介绍了一位用拉脱维亚语写作的拉脱维亚作家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak ir-raġel Latvjan? Mark: Iva, hu Latvjan u jitkellem bil-Latvjan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that man Latvian? Mark: Yes, he's Latvian and speaks Latvian.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男人是拉脱维亚人吗？马克：是的，他是拉脱维亚人，也说拉脱维亚语。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男人是拉脱维亚人吗？
messages.en: Is that man Latvian?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu Latvjan u jitkellem bil-Latvjan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu Latvjan u jitkellem bil-Latvjan.
messages.zh: 是的，他是拉脱维亚人，也说拉脱维亚语。
messages.en: Yes, he's Latvian and speaks Latvian.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Latvjan 配三张卡片：“拉脱维亚的”描述词、“拉脱维亚人”人物卡、“拉脱维亚语”语言卡，按句中位置区分。

gloss_zh: 中世纪宗教诗作；晨赞祷课

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medieval poetic work on religious themes; also, the prayer service of lauds following matins.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以宗教为主题的中世纪诗作；也指夜祷之后举行的晨赞祷课。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Opra poetika medjevali b'temi reliġjużi; ukoll servizz ta' talb ta' tifħir li jiġi wara l-matutin.

sense_translations.en_definition: a medieval poetic work with religious themes
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以宗教题材为主题的中世纪诗歌作品。
晨赞祷课，即在夜祷之后举行的祈祷礼仪。

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza lawda medjevali b'temi reliġjużi.
formal.en: The study analyses a medieval poetic work with religious themes.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了一部以宗教为主题的中世纪诗作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed taqra? Pawlu: Qed naqra lawda, poeżija medjevali b'tema reliġjuża.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you reading? Pawlu: I'm reading a lawda, a medieval poem on a religious theme.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在读什么？保罗：我在读一首 lawda，也就是以宗教为主题的中世纪诗。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naqra lawda, poeżija medjevali b'tema reliġjuża.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naqra lawda, poeżija medjevali b'tema reliġjuża.
messages.zh: 我在读一首 lawda，也就是以宗教为主题的中世纪诗。
messages.en: I'm reading a lawda, a medieval poem on a religious theme.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lawda 放进两个宗教场景：书页上的中世纪宗教诗，以及夜祷之后的晨赞祷课；用场景区分两个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called lawrencium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素铹的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku magħruf bl-isem lawrenzju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铹，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jintroduċi l-element kimiku lawrenzju.
formal.en: The chapter introduces the chemical element lawrencium.
formal.zh: 本章介绍化学元素铹。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu l-lawrenzju? Maja: Hu element kimiku; bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ lawrencium.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is lawrenzju? Maja: It's a chemical element; in English it's called lawrencium.
colloquial.zh: 马克：lawrenzju 是什么？玛雅：是一种化学元素，中文叫铹，英语叫 lawrencium。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: lawrenzju 是什么？
messages.en: What is lawrenzju?

messages.speaker: Maja (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu element kimiku; bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ lawrencium.
messages.mt_standard: Hu element kimiku; bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ lawrencium.
messages.zh: 是一种化学元素，中文叫铹，英语叫 lawrencium。
messages.en: It's a chemical element; in English it's called lawrencium.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语元素卡：“lawrenzju—lawrencium—铹”，把三个名称一起朗读，固定它作为化学元素名称的用法。

gloss_zh: 淫荡的；带有色情意味的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing or expressing sexual desire in an indecent or offensive way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以猥亵或令人反感的方式表现性欲的；淫荡的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri jew jesprimi xewqa sesswali b'mod indeċenti jew offensiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淫荡的；表现出猥亵性欲的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kumment bħala laxxiv u offensiv.
formal.en: The report describes the comment as lascivious and offensive.
formal.zh: 报告将这条评论描述为带有猥亵意味且令人反感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-kumment kien laxxiv. Mark: Iva, kien offensiv ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: That comment was lascivious. Mark: Yes, it was offensive too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那条评论带有猥亵意味。Mark：是的，也很冒犯人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那条评论带有猥亵意味。
messages.en: That comment was lascivious.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，也很冒犯人。
messages.en: Yes, it was offensive too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词放进“猥亵评论、色眯眯目光”两个画面中记忆，抓住带有性意味且不雅的评价。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of showing or expressing sexual desire in an indecent way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以不雅方式表现性欲的性质或状态；淫荡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' kliem jew imġiba li juru xewqa sesswali b'mod indeċenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淫荡；言语或行为中表现出的猥亵情欲。

formal.mt: L-artiklu janalizza l-laxxività fid-diskors tal-personaġġ prinċipali.
formal.en: The article analyses the lasciviousness in the main character's speech.
formal.zh: 这篇文章分析了主要人物言语中的淫荡意味。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser laxxività hawn? Pawlu: Tfisser il-kwalità ta' kliem jew imġiba li juru xewqa sesswali b'mod indeċenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does laxxività mean here? Pawlu: It means the quality of words or behaviour that show sexual desire indecently.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这里的 laxxività 是什么意思？Pawlu：指言语或行为以不雅方式表现性欲的性质。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 laxxività 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does laxxività mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser il-kwalità ta' kliem jew imġiba li juru xewqa sesswali b'mod indeċenti.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser il-kwalità ta' kliem jew imġiba li juru xewqa sesswali b'mod indeċenti.
messages.zh: 指言语或行为以不雅方式表现性欲的性质。
messages.en: It means the quality of words or behaviour that show sexual desire indecently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 laxxività 记在“这种言语的淫荡性质”下面：它是抽象名词，表示一种性质或状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Indecent sexual desire or the expression of such desire in words or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不雅的性欲，或言语、行为中对这种欲望的表现；淫荡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa sesswali indeċenti jew l-espressjoni tagħha fil-kliem jew fl-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淫荡；言语或行为中表现出的猥亵情欲。

formal.mt: Il-kritiku jiddiskuti l-laxxivja fil-kitba u l-effett tagħha fuq il-qarrej.
formal.en: The critic discusses the lasciviousness in the writing and its effect on the reader.
formal.zh: 评论家讨论了文字中的淫荡意味及其对读者的影响。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kelma laxxivja tiddeskrivi lill-persuna? Toni: Hawn tiddeskrivi l-laxxivja fil-kliem tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does the word laxxivja describe the person? Toni: Here it describes the lasciviousness in that person's words.
colloquial.zh: Lara：laxxivja 这个词是在描述那个人吗？Toni：这里说的是那个人话语中的淫荡意味。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: laxxivja 这个词是在描述那个人吗？
messages.en: Does the word laxxivja describe the person?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.zh: 这里说的是那个人话语中的淫荡意味。
messages.en: Here it describes the lasciviousness in that person's words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 laxxivja 和“话语中的淫荡意味”一起记；本条与 laxxività 所给的英语释义相同，都是抽象名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move something upwards or put it in a higher position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物向上抬起，或使其处于更高的位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mexxa xi ħaġa 'l fuq jew poġġieha f'pożizzjoni ogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抬起；举起；使向上移动。
使升高；将某物移至较高的位置。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem laza l-kaxxa u poġġieha fuq l-ixkaffa.
formal.en: The worker raised the box and placed it on the shelf.
formal.zh: 工人抬起箱子，把它放到了架子上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min laza l-kaxxa fuq il-mejda? Mark: Pawlu laza l-kaxxa; jien ftaħtha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who lifted the box onto the table? Mark: Pawlu lifted the box; I opened it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把箱子抬到桌上了？Mark：Pawlu 抬的箱子，我把它打开了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 谁把箱子抬到桌上了？
messages.en: Who lifted the box onto the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: Pawlu 抬的箱子，我把它打开了。
messages.en: Pawlu lifted the box; I opened it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把箱子从地面抬到桌上，用向上的箭头连接 laza，同时记住“抬起”和“使升高”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To blink while looking through one's spectacles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴着眼镜看东西时眨眼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel teptip b'għajnejh minn wara n-nuċċali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 透过所戴的眼镜看东西时眨眼。

collocations.en: blinked through his spectacles while reading
collocations.zh: 戴着眼镜读书时眨了眨眼

formal.mt: Il-professur laċċaċ minn wara n-nuċċali qabel kompla jaqra l-ittra.
formal.en: The professor blinked behind his spectacles before continuing to read the letter.
formal.zh: 教授在眼镜后眨了眨眼，然后继续读信。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt lil nannuk meta laċċaċ minn wara n-nuċċali? | Pawlu: Iva, imbagħad poġġa l-ktieb fil-ġenb u ħares lejna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see your grandfather blink behind his spectacles? | Pawlu: Yes, then he put the book aside and looked at us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见你爷爷在眼镜后眨眼了吗？｜保罗：看见了，然后他把书放到一旁，看向我们。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt lil nannuk meta laċċaċ minn wara n-nuċċali?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt lil nannuk meta laċċaċ minn wara n-nuċċali?
messages.zh: 你看见你爷爷在眼镜后眨眼了吗？
messages.en: Did you see your grandfather blink behind his spectacles?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imbagħad poġġa l-ktieb fil-ġenb u ħares lejna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imbagħad poġġa l-ktieb fil-ġenb u ħares lejna.
messages.zh: 看见了，然后他把书放到一旁，看向我们。
messages.en: Yes, then he put the book aside and looked at us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“镜片后面眨眨眼”的完整画面，把眼镜与眨眼两个信息一起绑定，避免只记成普通眨眼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who rinses things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行冲洗或漂洗的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tlaħlaħ l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冲洗或漂洗东西的人。

formal.mt: Il-laħlieħ tal-platti għandu jneħħi s-sapun kollu bl-ilma.
formal.en: The person rinsing the dishes should remove all the soap with water.
formal.zh: 负责冲洗盘子的人应当用水冲掉所有肥皂。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jkun il-laħlieħ tal-platti llum? Mark: Jien; inti aħsilhom u jien inlaħlaħhom.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who will rinse the dishes today? Mark: I will; you wash them and I'll rinse them.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今天谁负责冲洗盘子？马克：我来；你洗，我来冲。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun il-laħlieħ tal-platti llum?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun il-laħlieħ tal-platti llum?
messages.zh: 今天谁负责冲洗盘子？
messages.en: Who will rinse the dishes today?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; inti aħsilhom u jien inlaħlaħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; inti aħsilhom u jien inlaħlaħhom.
messages.zh: 我来；你洗，我来冲。
messages.en: I will; you wash them and I'll rinse them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 laħlieħ 写在水槽旁那个人的围裙上，记住它指“冲洗的人”；与表示冲洗过程的 laħliħ 分开记。

gloss_zh: 倾向于冲洗的；惯于漂洗的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to rinse things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有冲洗或漂洗东西的倾向或习惯的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jlaħlaħ l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于冲洗或漂洗的；惯于进行冲洗的。

collocations.en: a worker who tends to rinse things
a character inclined to rinse things
collocations.zh: 一个惯于冲洗东西的角色

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju, il-ħaddiem laħlieħi għandu t-tendenza li jlaħlaħ l-għodda wara kull użu.
formal.en: In the example, the worker described as laħlieħi tends to rinse the tools after each use.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，用 laħlieħi 形容的工人习惯每次使用工具后都冲洗工具。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tiddeskrivi lil Pawlu bħala laħlieħi? Toni: Għax għandu d-drawwa li jlaħlaħ kollox.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you describe Pawlu as laħlieħi? Toni: Because he has a habit of rinsing everything.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么用 laħlieħi 形容保罗？托尼：因为他习惯什么都冲洗一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tiddeskrivi lil Pawlu bħala laħlieħi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tiddeskrivi lil Pawlu bħala laħlieħi?
messages.zh: 你为什么用 laħlieħi 形容保罗？
messages.en: Why do you describe Pawlu as laħlieħi?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu d-drawwa li jlaħlaħ kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu d-drawwa li jlaħlaħ kollox.
messages.zh: 因为他习惯什么都冲洗一下。
messages.en: Because he has a habit of rinsing everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个拿起东西就习惯冲洗的人，把 laħlieħi 当作描述这种习惯的标签，记住这里是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of rinsing something with water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用水冲洗或漂洗某物的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tlaħlaħ xi ħaġa bl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冲洗；漂洗的动作或过程。

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil, isir laħliħ bl-ilma nadif biex jitneħħa s-sapun.
formal.en: After washing, rinsing with clean water is carried out to remove the soap.
formal.zh: 洗涤后，用清水漂洗，以去除肥皂。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-ħwejjeġ għadhom bis-sapun? Anna: Iva, għandhom bżonn laħliħ ieħor.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do the clothes still have soap in them? Anna: Yes, they need another rinse.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：衣服里还有肥皂吗？安娜：有，还需要再漂洗一次。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 衣服里还有肥皂吗？
messages.en: Do the clothes still have soap in them?

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 有，还需要再漂洗一次。
messages.en: Yes, they need another rinse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 laħliħ 贴在洗衣流程中的“清水漂洗”步骤上；它指过程，与指冲洗者的 laħlieħ 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant belonging to the genus Tillandsia, often called an airplant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于铁兰属（Tillandsia）的一种植物，常称为空气凤梨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ġeneru Tillandsia, spiss imsejħa pjanta tal-arja.

sense_translations.en_definition: a plant, member of the Tillandsia genus, often referred to as an airplant
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种铁兰属（Tillandsia）植物，常称为空气凤梨。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tidentifika l-laħmija bħala pjanta tal-ġeneru Tillandsia.
formal.en: The label identifies the airplant as a plant of the genus Tillandsia.
formal.zh: 标签将这株空气凤梨标明为铁兰属植物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Mark: Din laħmija, pjanta tal-ġeneru Tillandsia.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this plant called? Mark: It's a laħmija, a plant of the genus Tillandsia.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种植物叫什么？马克：叫 laħmija，是一种铁兰属植物。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Mark (花店店员)
messages.zh: 叫 laħmija，是一种铁兰属植物。
messages.en: It's a laħmija, a plant of the genus Tillandsia.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张空气凤梨图片卡，同时标上 laħmija、Tillandsia 和“铁兰属植物”，用图像联结三个名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A promotion to a higher position or rank.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 升到更高职位或级别的一次晋升。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avvanz għal kariga jew grad ogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次晋升；升职。

formal.mt: Wara snin ta' xogħol tajjeb, Marija ngħatat laħqa fil-kariga.
formal.en: After years of good work, Marija was given a promotion.
formal.zh: 经过多年出色工作，玛丽娅获得了职位晋升。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Smajt li Marija ħadet laħqa? Pawlu: Iva, issa hi l-kap tat-tim!
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you hear that Marija got a promotion? Pawlu: Yes, she's the team leader now!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你听说玛丽娅升职了吗？保罗：听说了，她现在是组长了！

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 你听说玛丽娅升职了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that Marija got a promotion?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 听说了，她现在是组长了！
messages.en: Yes, she's the team leader now!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象职位表上名字向上移动一格，把 laħqa 写在向上的箭头旁，记作“一次晋升”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To insist on something or persist in asking for it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 坚持某项要求或主张，不轻易放弃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibqa' jinsisti fuq xi ħaġa jew jitlobha bil-qawwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坚持要求某事；执意主张某事。

collocations.en: he insisted on being given an answer

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant laħħ fuq it-talba għal spjegazzjoni bil-miktub.
formal.en: The representative insisted on the request for a written explanation.
formal.zh: 代表坚持要求获得书面解释。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Pawlu aċċetta li jistenna? Rita: Le, laħħ biex ikellem lill-maniġer minnufih.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did Pawlu agree to wait? Rita: No, he insisted on speaking to the manager immediately.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗同意等一等了吗？丽塔：没有，他坚持要马上和经理说话。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗同意等一等了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu agree to wait?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, laħħ biex ikellem lill-maniġer minnufih.
messages.mt_standard: Le, laħħ biex ikellem lill-maniġer minnufih.
messages.zh: 没有，他坚持要马上和经理说话。
messages.en: No, he insisted on speaking to the manager immediately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人反复重申同一要求，把 laħħ 与“我坚持要这样”这一场景一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 使及时赶到；及时赶上；应付；使事物接合者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To help someone arrive in time, to make it in time oneself, or to cope with demands.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人及时到达，自己及时赶上，或应付工作等方面的要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħin lil xi ħadd jasal fil-ħin, jasal fil-ħin hu stess, jew ikun kapaċi jkampa max-xogħol u ma' talbiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人能够及时到达。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make it just in time
sense_translations.zh_definition: 刚好及时赶到；赶在最后时刻赶上。
应付得来；能够处理所面临的任务或压力。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who causes sth. to reach or join another
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物达到另一物或与另一物接合的人。

collocations.en: he caught the bus in time

formal.mt: Minkejja ż-żieda fit-talbiet, it-tim laħħaq max-xogħol kollu.
formal.en: Despite the increase in requests, the team coped with all the work.
formal.zh: 尽管请求数量增加，团队仍处理好了全部工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark laħħaq il-karozza tal-linja? Toni: Iva, wasal eżatt qabel telqet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark catch the bus in time? Toni: Yes, he arrived just before it left.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克赶上公交车了吗？托尼：赶上了，他在车开走前刚好到了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克赶上公交车了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark catch the bus in time?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 赶上了，他在车开走前刚好到了。
messages.en: Yes, he arrived just before it left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记忆：赶上即将开走的车，以及忙碌时仍应付得来工作；另将表示人的名词义单独记卡。

gloss_zh: 促使某人获任职位的；促成晋升的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Helping to promote someone to a position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够帮助或促使某人获任某个职位的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħin lil xi ħadd jinħatar f'kariga.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 促使某人获任某一职位的；促成某人晋升的。

collocations.en: a role that helps someone gain a position
collocations.zh: 有助于某人获任职位的作用

collocations.en: support that helps someone gain a position
collocations.zh: 有助于某人获任职位的支持

formal.mt: L-appoġġ tad-direttur kellu rwol laħħaqi fil-ħatra ta' Mark bħala kap tat-tim.
formal.en: The director's support helped secure Mark's appointment as team leader.
formal.zh: 主任的支持对马克获任组长起到了促成作用。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'tifhem b'appoġġ laħħaqi? Pawlu: Appoġġ li jgħin lil xi ħadd jinħatar f'kariga.
colloquial.en: Marta: What do you mean by support described as laħħaqi? Pawlu: Support that helps someone get appointed to a position.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：用 laħħaqi 形容支持是什么意思？保罗：就是帮助某人获任职位的支持。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 用 laħħaqi 形容支持是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean by support described as laħħaqi?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Appoġġ li jgħin lil xi ħadd jinħatar f'kariga.
messages.mt_standard: Appoġġ li jgħin lil xi ħadd jinħatar f'kariga.
messages.zh: 就是帮助某人获任职位的支持。
messages.en: Support that helps someone get appointed to a position.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在记忆卡上画一份任命书和一只提供帮助的手，把 laħħaqi 记作描述“促成任职”的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small dress; the diminutive form of libsa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一件小连衣裙或小裙装；是 libsa 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Libsa żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' libsa.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small dress (the diminutive form of 'libsa')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一件小连衣裙或小裙装（libsa 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: a little dress for the doll

formal.mt: Il-ħajjata ħietet lbejsa ħamra għall-pupa.
formal.en: The seamstress sewed a little red dress for the doll.
formal.zh: 女裁缝给玩偶缝了一件红色小裙子。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din il-lbejsa għall-pupa? Rita: Iva, u għandha żewġ bwiet żgħar!
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this little dress for the doll? Rita: Yes, and it has two little pockets!
colloquial.zh: Anna：这件小裙子是给玩偶的吗？Rita：是的，而且还有两个小口袋！

messages.speaker: Anna (女儿)
messages.zh: 这件小裙子是给玩偶的吗？
messages.en: Is this little dress for the doll?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għandha żewġ bwiet żgħar!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għandha żewġ bwiet żgħar!
messages.zh: 是的，而且还有两个小口袋！
messages.en: Yes, and it has two little pockets!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 libsa 的裙装画面缩小成玩偶的小裙子来记 lbejsa；本条明确给出它是指小形式。

gloss_zh: 面包瓤；面包内部的柔软部分

teaching_sense.en_definition: The soft inner part of bread, as distinct from its crust.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面包内部柔软的部分，即面包瓤，与外层面包皮相区别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ratba ta' ġewwa tal-ħobż, differenti mill-qoxra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面包瓤，即面包内部柔软的部分。

formal.mt: Il-kok uża l-lbieba tal-ħobż biex jipprepara l-mili.
formal.en: The cook used the soft inner part of the bread to prepare the stuffing.
formal.zh: 厨师用面包瓤制作馅料。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tippreferi l-qoxra jew il-lbieba? Toni: Il-lbieba, għax hi ratba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you prefer the crust or the soft inside? Toni: The soft inside, because it is soft.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你更喜欢面包皮还是面包瓤？Toni：面包瓤，因为它软。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你更喜欢面包皮还是面包瓤？
messages.en: Do you prefer the crust or the soft inside?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 面包瓤，因为它软。
messages.en: The soft inside, because it is soft.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象掰开面包后手指按到里面柔软的瓤；本条的 crumb 指面包内部组织，不是掉落的碎屑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: On the day immediately before today.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在今天的前一天；昨天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-jum ta' qabel illum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 昨天；在今天的前一天。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa saret lbieraħ filgħodu fil-binja tal-kunsill.
formal.en: The meeting took place yesterday morning in the council building.
formal.zh: 会议于昨天早上在议会大楼举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mort il-ħanut lbieraħ? Mark: Iva, mort lbieraħ filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you go to the shop yesterday? Mark: Yes, I went yesterday evening.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你昨天去商店了吗？Mark：去了，我是昨天晚上去的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨天去商店了吗？
messages.en: Did you go to the shop yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 去了，我是昨天晚上去的。
messages.en: Yes, I went yesterday evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上从今天向前退一格，把那一格标成 lbieraħ；再配上早上、晚上练习完整时间短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: On the day two days before today; the day before yesterday.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在今天之前的第二天；前天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jumejn ilu; fil-jum ta' qabel ilbieraħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: two days ago; the day before yesterday
sense_translations.zh_definition: 两天前；前天，即昨天的前一天。

collocations.en: the morning of the day before yesterday
the evening of the day before yesterday

formal.mt: Il-kumitat irċieva d-dokument lbiraħtlula filgħodu.
formal.en: The committee received the document the morning of the day before yesterday.
formal.zh: 委员会于前天早上收到了该文件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Wasalt lbieraħ? Pawlu: Le, wasalt lbiraħtlula filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you arrive yesterday? Pawlu: No, I arrived the evening of the day before yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你是昨天到的吗？Pawlu：不是，我是前天晚上到的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是昨天到的吗？
messages.en: Did you arrive yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，我是前天晚上到的。
messages.en: No, I arrived the evening of the day before yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上从今天向前退两格，把第二格标成 lbiraħtlula；与只退一格的 lbieraħ 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of running away or cowering in fear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因害怕而逃跑或畏缩的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jaħrab jew jinġabar fih innifsu minħabba l-biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逃跑；逃离的行为
因恐惧而畏缩；蜷缩躲避

collocations.en: cowering in the face of danger

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi l-lbit tar-raġel hekk kif jara l-periklu.
formal.en: The author describes the man's flight as soon as he sees the danger.
formal.zh: 作者描写了那名男子一见到危险便逃跑的情景。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak il-lbit kollu meta rajt il-kelb? Pawlu: Bżajt li kien se jigdimni!
