colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you run away like that when you saw the dog? Pawlu: I was afraid it was going to bite me!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到那只狗，怎么就那样逃跑了？保罗：我怕它要咬我！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien dak il-lbit kollu meta rajt il-kelb?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien dak il-lbit kollu meta rajt il-kelb?
messages.zh: 你看到那只狗，怎么就那样逃跑了？
messages.en: Why did you run away like that when you saw the dog?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我怕它要咬我！
messages.en: I was afraid it was going to bite me!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lbit 配成两个害怕时的画面：转身逃跑，或缩起身子；记住它是行为名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A drenching that makes someone or something thoroughly wet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或物完全湿透的一次淋浇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tixrib qawwi li jħalli lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa mxarrba għal kollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淋透；浇得全湿

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema ħadu lebbetta xita waqt li kienu qed isewwu s-saqaf.
formal.en: The workers got a drenching from the rain while they were repairing the roof.
formal.zh: 工人们修理屋顶时，被雨淋得全身湿透。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex għandek ħwejġek kollha mxarrbin? Mark: Ħadt lebbetta xita fit-triq lejn id-dar!
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are all your clothes wet? Mark: I got drenched in the rain on the way home!
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你的衣服怎么全湿了？马克：我回家路上被雨淋透了！

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 你的衣服怎么全湿了？
messages.en: Why are all your clothes wet?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadt lebbetta xita fit-triq lejn id-dar!
messages.mt_standard: Ħadt lebbetta xita fit-triq lejn id-dar!
messages.zh: 我回家路上被雨淋透了！
messages.en: I got drenched in the rain on the way home!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一阵雨把衣服从领口到袖口全部淋透，用 lebbetta 记住这种彻底湿透的经历。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who rides a horse at high speed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 骑着马快速奔驰的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirkeb żiemel b'veloċità kbira.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who rides a horse at speed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 策马疾驰的人；骑马快速奔驰者

formal.mt: Il-lebbiet mexxa ż-żiemel b'ħeffa tul il-mogħdija miftuħa.
formal.en: The fast rider guided the horse swiftly along the open path.
formal.zh: 那名疾驰的骑手驾着马，沿着开阔的小径快速前进。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak il-lebbiet? Toni: Huwa Pawlu; ara kemm qed jiġri malajr biż-żiemel!
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that rider going so fast? Toni: It's Pawlu; look how fast he's riding the horse!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个策马疾驰的人是谁？托尼：是保罗；看他骑得多快！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个策马疾驰的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that rider going so fast?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa Pawlu; ara kemm qed jiġri malajr biż-żiemel!
messages.mt_standard: Huwa Pawlu; ara kemm qed jiġri malajr biż-żiemel!
messages.zh: 是保罗；看他骑得多快！
messages.en: It's Pawlu; look how fast he's riding the horse!

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 lebbiet 就想象马背上的人飞快掠过；记忆重点同时包括骑马的人和疾驰的速度。

gloss_zh: 能缓和傲气等的；使人收敛的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the effect of tempering arrogance or a similar attitude.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有缓和傲慢或类似态度、使其有所收敛的作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jtaffi l-kburija jew atteġġament simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能缓和傲慢等态度的；使傲气有所收敛的

formal.mt: Il-kritika kellha effett lebbieti fuq il-kburija tal-mexxej.
formal.en: The criticism had a tempering effect on the leader's arrogance.
formal.zh: 这些批评使那位领导者的傲气有所收敛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadu jaħseb li jaf kollox? Mark: Le, it-telfa kellha effett lebbieti fuqu; issa jisma' aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does he still think he knows everything? Mark: No, the defeat tempered his arrogance; now he listens more.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他还觉得自己什么都懂吗？马克：不了，那次失败让他收敛了傲气；现在他更愿意听别人说了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 他还觉得自己什么都懂吗？
messages.en: Does he still think he knows everything?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, it-telfa kellha effett lebbieti fuqu; issa jisma' aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, it-telfa kellha effett lebbieti fuqu; issa jisma' aktar.
messages.zh: 不了，那次失败让他收敛了傲气；现在他更愿意听别人说了。
messages.en: No, the defeat tempered his arrogance; now he listens more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lebbieti 放进效应一词旁：一次挫折让昂起的头低下来，便是使傲气收敛的作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone crave something or awaken a strong desire for it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人很想得到某物，或勾起对它的强烈渴望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jixtieq xi ħaġa ħafna jew iqajjem fih xewqa qawwija għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人渴望某物；使某人很想得到某物
勾起渴望；激起强烈的欲求

collocations.zh: 勾起孩子们吃糖果的欲望

formal.mt: Ir-reklam lebleb lit-tfal għall-ħelu li deher fuq l-iskrin.
formal.en: The advertisement made the children crave the sweets shown on the screen.
formal.zh: 这则广告勾起了孩子们对屏幕上那些糖果的渴望。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex trid kejk issa? Marija: Dak ir-ritratt lebleb lili wkoll għall-kejk!
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you want cake now? Marija: That picture made me crave cake too!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么现在想吃蛋糕了？玛丽亚：那张照片让我也馋起蛋糕了！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么现在想吃蛋糕了？
messages.en: Why do you want cake now?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-ritratt lebleb lili wkoll għall-kejk!
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-ritratt lebleb lili wkoll għall-kejk!
messages.zh: 那张照片让我也馋起蛋糕了！
messages.en: That picture made me crave cake too!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看到蛋糕照片后突然很想吃：lebleb 表示照片勾起渴望这个动作，注意它是动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling of wanting something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 很想得到某物的强烈感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa qawwija li wieħed ikollu jew jikseb xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈的渴望；对某物的馋想

formal.mt: Il-karattru jiddeskrivi l-leblib tiegħu għall-ħelu bħala xewqa diffiċli biex jirreżisti.
formal.en: The character describes his craving for sweets as a desire that is difficult to resist.
formal.zh: 这个人物把自己对糖果的馋想描述为一种难以抵挡的欲望。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi leblib qawwi għall-ħelu llum. Lara: Trid biċċa ċikkulata?
colloquial.en: Nina: I've got a strong craving for sweets today. Lara: Would you like a piece of chocolate?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我今天特别馋甜食。拉拉：你想吃块巧克力吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天特别馋甜食。
messages.en: I've got a strong craving for sweets today.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃块巧克力吗？
messages.en: Would you like a piece of chocolate?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文的馋劲来记 leblib：它给心里那股很想要的感觉命名，可以搭配糖果等渴望对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A craving or an intense desire for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某物的一股渴望或强烈欲望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa qawwija ħafna għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一股渴望；一种强烈的馋想
对某物的强烈欲望；非常迫切的向往

collocations.zh: 想吃冰激凌的一股馋劲

collocations.en: an intense longing for the sea

formal.mt: Wara snin 'il bogħod mill-gżira, ħass leblieba qawwija għall-baħar.
formal.en: After years away from the island, he felt an intense longing for the sea.
formal.zh: 离开那座岛多年以后，他对大海产生了强烈的向往。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Ġietni leblieba għall-ġelat. David: Ejja nixtru wieħed kull wieħed wara l-mixja.
colloquial.en: Elena: I've got a craving for ice cream. David: Let's get one each after our walk.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我突然很想吃冰激凌。戴维：散完步我们一人买一个吧。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 我突然很想吃冰激凌。
messages.en: I've got a craving for ice cream.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nixtru wieħed kull wieħed wara l-mixja.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nixtru wieħed kull wieħed wara l-mixja.
messages.zh: 散完步我们一人买一个吧。
messages.en: Let's get one each after our walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leblieba 记成心里冒出的一股强烈渴望：既能馋冰激凌，也能深深向往大海。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cry with broken, catching breaths.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 哭泣时呼吸一顿一顿，发出抽噎声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibki b'nifs maqtugħ u b'ħsejjes ta' sob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽泣；啜泣；抽抽噎噎地哭

formal.mt: It-tifel leffaq bil-biki sakemm waslet ommu u qagħdet ħdejh.
formal.en: The boy sobbed until his mother arrived and sat beside him.
formal.zh: 男孩一直抽泣，直到母亲赶来，坐到他身旁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex leffaq it-tifel? Mark: Tilef il-ġugarell favorit tiegħu, imma issa sibnieh.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the boy sob? Mark: He lost his favourite toy, but we've found it now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那男孩为什么抽泣？马克：他弄丢了最喜欢的玩具，不过我们现在找到了。

messages.speaker: Sara (孩子的姨妈)
messages.zh: 那男孩为什么抽泣？
messages.en: Why did the boy sob?

messages.speaker: Mark (孩子的父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tilef il-ġugarell favorit tiegħu, imma issa sibnieh.
messages.mt_standard: Tilef il-ġugarell favorit tiegħu, imma issa sibnieh.
messages.zh: 他弄丢了最喜欢的玩具，不过我们现在找到了。
messages.en: He lost his favourite toy, but we've found it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 leffaq 时配上哭得一吸一顿的画面；重点记住带抽噎的哭泣动作，而不只是流眼泪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wrap something thoroughly so that it is well covered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物仔细包好，使其被充分覆盖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kesa xi ħaġa sew billi dawwar karta, drapp jew materjal ieħor magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仔细地包裹；把某物包严实

collocations.en: wrapped the vase thoroughly in thick cloth

formal.mt: Qabel it-trasport, il-ħaddiem leffef il-vażun f'drapp oħxon biex jipproteġih.
formal.en: Before transport, the worker wrapped the vase thoroughly in thick cloth to protect it.
formal.zh: 运输前，工人用厚布把花瓶包严实，以保护它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ippakkja l-vażun? Mark: Pawlu leffef il-vażun sew; lest biex inġorruh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who packed the vase? Mark: Paul wrapped it thoroughly; it is ready for us to carry.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把花瓶包好了？马克：保罗把花瓶包得很严实；可以搬走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把花瓶包好了？
messages.en: Who packed the vase?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu leffef il-vażun sew; lest biex inġorruh.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu leffef il-vażun sew; lest biex inġorruh.
messages.zh: 保罗把花瓶包得很严实；可以搬走了。
messages.en: Paul wrapped it thoroughly; it is ready for us to carry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给花瓶仔细裹上厚布，把 leffef 与“包得严严实实”这个动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who wraps things, such as gifts or parcels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把礼物、包件等物品包起来的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ddawwar karta, drapp jew materjal ieħor ma' oġġetti biex tgħattihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包裹东西的人；负责包装的人

formal.mt: Il-leffief tar-rigali għażel karta ħoxna biex jipproteġi l-oġġetti delikati.
formal.en: The gift wrapper chose thick paper to protect the delicate items.
formal.zh: 负责包装礼物的人选用了厚纸，以保护易损物品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu l-leffief tar-rigali llum? Pawlu: Jien! Ġib il-karta u nibda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is wrapping the gifts today? Paul: I am! Bring the paper and I will start.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天谁负责包礼物？保罗：我！把纸拿来，我就开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 今天谁负责包礼物？
messages.en: Who is wrapping the gifts today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 我！把纸拿来，我就开始。
messages.en: I am! Bring the paper and I will start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leffief 想成礼品台后拿着包装纸的人，重点记住它指“做包装的人”。

gloss_zh: 爱包裹东西的；惯于包裹的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to wrap things or to do so habitually.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人倾向于把东西包起来，或经常这样做。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jdawwar karta, drapp jew materjal ieħor ma' l-oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于包裹东西的；惯于把东西包起来的

collocations.en: a man inclined to wrap things
collocations.zh: 一个习惯把东西包起来的男人

collocations.en: a worker inclined to wrap things
collocations.zh: 一个惯于包裹物品的工人

formal.mt: Pawlu huwa ħaddiem leffiefi: qabel ipoġġi l-għodod fil-kaxxa, idawwar drapp ma' kull waħda.
formal.en: Paul is a worker inclined to wrap things: before putting the tools in the box, he wraps each one in cloth.
formal.zh: 保罗是个习惯包裹物品的工人：把工具放进箱子之前，他会用布把每件工具包起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu għandu daqshekk karta? Mark: Għax hu leffiefi; iħobb igeżwer kollox, anki ktieb wieħed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Paul have so much paper? Mark: Because he tends to wrap things; he likes wrapping everything, even a single book.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么有这么多纸？马克：因为他爱包东西；什么都喜欢包起来，连单独一本书也要包。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么有这么多纸？
messages.en: Why does Paul have so much paper?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu leffiefi; iħobb igeżwer kollox, anki ktieb wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu leffiefi; iħobb igeżwer kollox, anki ktieb wieħed.
messages.zh: 因为他爱包东西；什么都喜欢包起来，连单独一本书也要包。
messages.en: Because he tends to wrap things; he likes wrapping everything, even a single book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个见到东西就想拿纸包起来的人，用 leffiefi 描述这种习惯，而不是一次动作。

gloss_zh: 容易抽泣的；动辄啜泣的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to sob or to start sobbing easily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人容易抽泣，或遇到事情便容易啜泣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jibki bis-sulluzzu jew li jibda jagħmel hekk malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易抽泣的；有啜泣倾向的

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel huwa leffieqi u jibda jibki bis-sulluzzu meta jħossu waħdu.
formal.en: In the story, the boy is prone to sobbing and starts to sob when he feels alone.
formal.zh: 故事中的男孩容易抽泣，一感到孤单就会啜泣起来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Leo jidher leffieqi llum. Omm: Għajjien ħafna; noqogħdu ftit miegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Leo seems prone to sobbing today. Mum: He is very tired; let us sit with him for a while.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：利奥今天好像很容易抽泣。妈妈：他太累了；我们陪他坐一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 利奥今天好像很容易抽泣。
messages.en: Leo seems prone to sobbing today.

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 他太累了；我们陪他坐一会儿吧。
messages.en: He is very tired; let us sit with him for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leffieqi 与“一难过就一抽一抽地哭”联系起来，记住重点是容易啜泣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat food greedily and quickly, taking it in eager mouthfuls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 急切而贪馋地大口吃东西；狼吞虎咽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kiel l-ikel b'għaġla u b'regħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪馋地吃；大口猛吃
狼吞虎咽地吃下
大口快速地吃东西；猛吃食物

collocations.zh: 把所有面包都大口吃光了

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, it-tifel leflef l-ikel li sab fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: After the long walk, the boy wolfed down the food he found on the table.
formal.zh: 走了很长一段路之后，男孩把桌上的食物狼吞虎咽地吃了下去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar il-ħobż kollu? Mark: Pawlu leflef kollox; kien bil-ġuħ ħafna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did all the bread go? Mark: Paul gobbled it all up; he was very hungry!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：面包都到哪儿去了？马克：保罗全都狼吞虎咽地吃掉了；他饿坏了！

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 面包都到哪儿去了？
messages.en: Where did all the bread go?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu leflef kollox; kien bil-ġuħ ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu leflef kollox; kien bil-ġuħ ħafna!
messages.zh: 保罗全都狼吞虎咽地吃掉了；他饿坏了！
messages.en: Paul gobbled it all up; he was very hungry!

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 leflef 时想象连续几大口把面包吃光，用快速进食的画面记住这个动作。

gloss_zh: 狼吞虎咽的人；吃东西很急的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who eats food greedily and quickly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃东西急切、大口猛吃的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiekol b'għaġla u b'regħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狼吞虎咽地吃东西的人

collocations.zh: 一个特别爱狼吞虎咽的人

collocations.en: a person who gobbles food at the table

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-leflief spiċċa l-ikla tiegħu qabel ma l-oħrajn bdew jieklu.
formal.en: In the story, the food gobbler finished his meal before the others began eating.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个狼吞虎咽的人在其他人动筷之前就吃完了自己的饭。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu diġà spiċċa l-ikla? Mark: Iva, leflief kbir! Aħna għadna kemm bdejna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has Paul already finished his meal? Mark: Yes, he is a real food gobbler! We have only just started.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗已经吃完饭了？马克：是啊，他吃东西可真急！我们才刚开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗已经吃完饭了？
messages.en: Has Paul already finished his meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, leflief kbir! Aħna għadna kemm bdejna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, leflief kbir! Aħna għadna kemm bdejna.
messages.zh: 是啊，他吃东西可真急！我们才刚开始。
messages.en: Yes, he is a real food gobbler! We have only just started.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给餐桌上总是最先吃光的人贴上 leflief 的词卡，记住这个名词指人。

gloss_zh: 贪食的；惯于狼吞虎咽的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a greedy appetite or tending to eat food very quickly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容食欲贪盛，或吃东西时惯于大口快速吞食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu aptit kbir jew it-tendenza li jiekol b'għaġla u b'regħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪食的；食欲很旺盛的
惯于狼吞虎咽地吃东西的

collocations.en: a boy who tends to gobble food
collocations.zh: 一个吃东西容易狼吞虎咽的男孩

formal.mt: Il-kelb lefliefi kiel l-ikel kollu mill-iskutella fi ftit mumenti.
formal.en: The voracious dog ate all the food from the bowl in a few moments.
formal.zh: 那只贪食的狗片刻之间就把碗里的食物吃光了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kelb tiegħek dejjem jiekol daqshekk malajr? Mark: Iva, lefliefi ħafna; hekk kif inpoġġi l-ikel, jibda jiekol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does your dog always eat that quickly? Mark: Yes, he is very voracious; as soon as I put the food down, he starts eating.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的狗总是吃得这么快吗？马克：是啊，它特别贪食；我一把食物放下，它就开始吃。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelb tiegħek dejjem jiekol daqshekk malajr?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelb tiegħek dejjem jiekol daqshekk malajr?
messages.zh: 你的狗总是吃得这么快吗？
messages.en: Does your dog always eat that quickly?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, lefliefi ħafna; hekk kif inpoġġi l-ikel, jibda jiekol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, lefliefi ħafna; hekk kif inpoġġi l-ikel, jibda jiekol.
messages.zh: 是啊，它特别贪食；我一把食物放下，它就开始吃。
messages.en: Yes, he is very voracious; as soon as I put the food down, he starts eating.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象食盆刚落地就急着猛吃的小狗，用 lefliefi 描述它贪食、吃得急的特点。

gloss_zh: 狼吞虎咽的行为；大口猛吃

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of eating food greedily and quickly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 急切地大口吞食食物这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jiekol l-ikel b'għaġla u b'regħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大口急吃食物的行为；狼吞虎咽
把食物大口快速吃下去的行为

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-leflif tal-ikel juri kemm il-vjaġġatur kien bil-ġuħ wara l-mixja twila.
formal.en: In the story, the gobbling of food shows how hungry the traveller was after the long walk.
formal.zh: 故事中，旅人狼吞虎咽的行为表现出他长途步行后有多么饥饿。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'kien dak il-leflif kollu waqt l-ikla? Pawlu: Kont bil-ġuħ ħafna; lanqas indunajt kemm kont qed niekol malajr.
colloquial.en: Sara: What was all that gobbling during the meal? Paul: I was very hungry; I did not even realise how quickly I was eating.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：刚才吃饭时怎么那么狼吞虎咽？保罗：我饿坏了；连自己吃得有多快都没注意到。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'kien dak il-leflif kollu waqt l-ikla?
messages.mt_standard: X'kien dak il-leflif kollu waqt l-ikla?
messages.zh: 刚才吃饭时怎么那么狼吞虎咽？
messages.en: What was all that gobbling during the meal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont bil-ġuħ ħafna; lanqas indunajt kemm kont qed niekol malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Kont bil-ġuħ ħafna; lanqas indunajt kemm kont qed niekol malajr.
messages.zh: 我饿坏了；连自己吃得有多快都没注意到。
messages.en: I was very hungry; I did not even realise how quickly I was eating.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一段大口猛吃的画面命名为 leflif，记住这个名词指进食行为本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of eating food very quickly and greedily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃东西时十分急促、大口吞咽的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tiekol l-ikel malajr ħafna u b'għaġla kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狼吞虎咽地吃东西。

sense_translations.en_definition: eating food by scoffing it down
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把食物急急忙忙、大口大口地吞下去。

collocations.en: one bout of hurried eating after another
collocations.zh: 一阵接一阵地急急吞食

formal.mt: Il-leflifa tal-ikel waqt l-ikla kienet evidenti. Il-platt tbattal fi ftit minuti.
formal.en: The hurried wolfing down of food during the meal was evident. The plate was emptied in a few minutes.
formal.zh: 用餐时狼吞虎咽的样子十分明显。盘子里的食物几分钟就被吃光了。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'leflifa! Għadek kif bdejt tiekol u diġà spiċċajt. Pawlu: Kelli ġuħ kbir; id-darba li jmiss niekol aktar bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Marta: You really wolfed that down! You only just started eating and you're already finished. Pawlu: I was very hungry; next time I'll eat more slowly.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你吃得真是狼吞虎咽！才刚开始就已经吃完了。保罗：我太饿了，下次会吃慢一点。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'leflifa! Għadek kif bdejt tiekol u diġà spiċċajt.
messages.mt_standard: X'leflifa! Għadek kif bdejt tiekol u diġà spiċċajt.
messages.zh: 你吃得真是狼吞虎咽！才刚开始就已经吃完了。
messages.en: You really wolfed that down! You only just started eating and you're already finished.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli ġuħ kbir; id-darba li jmiss niekol aktar bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli ġuħ kbir; id-darba li jmiss niekol aktar bil-mod.
messages.zh: 我太饿了，下次会吃慢一点。
messages.en: I was very hungry; next time I'll eat more slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leflifa 配上一幅“刚端上来的饭转眼吃光”的画面，记住它指狼吞虎咽这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sobbing or in a state of tearful, broken crying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于抽泣状态的，哭得断断续续、声音哽咽的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun qed jibki b'nifs imقطع u b'ħoss ta' tnehid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于抽泣、哽咽着哭的状态。

formal.mt: It-tifel kien lefqan meta waslet l-għalliema. Hija qagħdet ħdejh sakemm ikkalma.
formal.en: The boy was sobbing when the teacher arrived. She stayed beside him until he calmed down.
formal.zh: 老师到来时，男孩正在抽泣。她陪在他身边，直到他平静下来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għadek lefqan, Ben? Ben: Tlift il-kelb tiegħi, imma missieri qed ifittxu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you still sobbing, Ben? Ben: I've lost my dog, but my father is looking for him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：本，你怎么还在抽泣？本：我的狗走丢了，不过爸爸正在找它。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 本，你怎么还在抽泣？
messages.en: Why are you still sobbing, Ben?

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlift il-kelb tiegħi, imma missieri qed ifittxu.
messages.mt_standard: Tlift il-kelb tiegħi, imma missieri qed ifittxu.
messages.zh: 我的狗走丢了，不过爸爸正在找它。
messages.en: I've lost my dog, but my father is looking for him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lefqan 和“哭得一抽一抽、说话也哽咽”的表情连起来，记住它描述人的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual game played as part of a tournament match.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 锦标赛对局中的一局比赛，用来划分整场对局的进程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba waħda li tintlagħab bħala parti minn partita f'turnew.

sense_translations.en_definition: leg (a game played in a tournament)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 锦标赛中的一局比赛。

formal.mt: Fit-turnew tad-darts, Mark rebaħ l-ewwel legg tal-partita.
formal.en: In the darts tournament, Mark won the first leg of the match.
formal.zh: 在飞镖锦标赛中，马克赢下了这场对局的第一局。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min rebaħ dan il-legg? Mark: Jien, imma l-partita għadha ma spiċċatx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who won this leg? Mark: I did, but the match is not over yet.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这一局谁赢了？马克：我赢了，不过整场比赛还没结束。

messages.speaker: Lara (观众)
messages.zh: 这一局谁赢了？
messages.en: Who won this leg?

messages.speaker: Mark (参赛者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, imma l-partita għadha ma spiċċatx.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, imma l-partita għadha ma spiċċatx.
messages.zh: 我赢了，不过整场比赛还没结束。
messages.en: I did, but the match is not over yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整场比赛想成分格的计分板，每完成一格就是一个 legg；本词条记比赛的一局。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To drink quickly in large gulps, sometimes finishing a drink in one go.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 快速地大口喝，有时指一口气把一杯饮料喝完。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tixrob malajr b'belgħat kbar, xi drabi sakemm tispiċċa x-xarba f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咕咚咕咚地猛喝；快速而大量地喝。
一大口一大口地喝。
一口气喝下一杯饮料；把一杯饮料迅速喝完。

collocations.en: he downed a glass of juice
collocations.zh: 他一口气喝下了一杯果汁

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja, it-tifel legleg tazza ilma u poġġa bilqiegħda.
formal.en: After the walk, the boy gulped down a glass of water and sat down.
formal.zh: 散步后，男孩大口喝完一杯水，然后坐了下来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar il-meraq kollu? Toni: Ħija legleg it-tazza kollha f'daqqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did all the juice go? Toni: My brother downed the whole glass in one go.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：果汁怎么全没了？托尼：我哥哥一口气把整杯都喝了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 果汁怎么全没了？
messages.en: Where did all the juice go?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥一口气把整杯都喝了。
messages.en: My brother downed the whole glass in one go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读 legleg 时配合想象连续两次大口吞咽，把重复的声音当作动作记忆提示，并非词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who drinks a lot, especially alcoholic drinks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喝东西很多的人，尤其可指经常大量喝酒的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tixrob ħafna, speċjalment xorb alkoħoliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喝得很多的人；尤其可指大量饮酒的人。

collocations.en: someone who drinks a lot of beer
known as someone who drinks a lot

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, sid il-ħanut huwa magħruf bħala leglieg li jqatta' ħafna ħin fil-bar.
formal.en: In the novel, the shopkeeper is known as a heavy drinker who spends a lot of time at the bar.
formal.zh: 在小说中，店主以嗜酒闻名，经常长时间待在酒吧。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex fil-ktieb isejħulu leglieg? Pawlu: Għax jixrob ħafna birra kuljum.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do they call him a heavy drinker in the book? Pawlu: Because he drinks a lot of beer every day.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：书里为什么叫他嗜饮者？保罗：因为他每天都喝很多啤酒。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 书里为什么叫他嗜饮者？
messages.en: Why do they call him a heavy drinker in the book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 因为他每天都喝很多啤酒。
messages.en: Because he drinks a lot of beer every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 leglieg 配一张人物卡，卡上写着喝得很多的人；用人物画面区别表示喝这一动作的词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to drink a lot, especially alcoholic drinks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于喝很多的，尤其用来形容爱大量饮酒的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza li jixrob ħafna, speċjalment xorb alkoħoliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有大量喝饮料或饮酒倾向的；嗜饮的。

collocations.en: a man who tends to drink a lot
collocations.zh: 一个爱大量喝酒的男人

collocations.en: a character who tends to drink a lot

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-protagonist bħala raġel legliegi li spiss jordna aktar xorb.
formal.en: The author describes the protagonist as a man who tends to drink a lot and often orders more drinks.
formal.zh: 作者把主人公描写成一个嗜饮的男人，他常常再点些酒喝。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhu l-protagonist ta' dan ir-rumanz? Mark: Hu legliegi; kważi f'kull kapitlu tarah jixrob.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the protagonist of this novel like? Mark: He tends to drink a lot; you see him drinking in almost every chapter.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这部小说的主人公是怎样的人？马克：他很嗜饮；几乎每一章都能看到他喝酒。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu l-protagonist ta' dan ir-rumanz?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu l-protagonist ta' dan ir-rumanz?
messages.zh: 这部小说的主人公是怎样的人？
messages.en: What is the protagonist of this novel like?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu legliegi; kważi f'kull kapitlu tarah jixrob.
messages.mt_standard: Hu legliegi; kważi f'kull kapitlu tarah jixrob.
messages.zh: 他很嗜饮；几乎每一章都能看到他喝酒。
messages.en: He tends to drink a lot; you see him drinking in almost every chapter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 legliegi 写在人物旁边作为性格标签，记成嗜饮的；与名词 leglieg 的嗜饮者作词性对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of drinking in large gulps or quickly downing drinks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大口吞喝或迅速把饮料灌下去的动作、过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jixrob b'belgħat kbar jew jispiċċa x-xorb malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迅速喝完饮料；把饮料一口气灌下去的动作。
大口喝饮料或酒的动作。
大口吞喝；接连以大口咽下液体的动作。

formal.mt: Fis-skiet tal-kamra, il-leglig tal-ilma kien jinstema' ċar.
formal.en: In the quiet room, the gulping of water could be clearly heard.
formal.zh: 房间里很安静，可以清楚听见大口喝水的声音。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Toni: Hu l-leglig tal-ilma; ħija qed jixrob ħdejna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that sound? Toni: It is the gulping of water; my brother is drinking beside us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是什么声音？托尼：是大口喝水的声音；我哥哥正在我们旁边喝水。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What is that sound?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-leglig tal-ilma; ħija qed jixrob ħdejna.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-leglig tal-ilma; ħija qed jixrob ħdejna.
messages.zh: 是大口喝水的声音；我哥哥正在我们旁边喝水。
messages.en: It is the gulping of water; my brother is drinking beside us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给一段大口喝水的视频取标题 leglig，记它是动作的名称；用中文的大口吞喝帮助锁定名词用法。

gloss_zh: 一次大量饮酒；一场豪饮

teaching_sense.en_definition: An occasion or episode during which someone drinks a large amount of alcohol.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某一次集中大量饮酒的经历或场合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Okkażjoni li fiha wieħed jixrob ħafna alkoħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次大量饮酒的经历；一场豪饮。

collocations.en: after a bout of heavy drinking
a prolonged bout of heavy drinking

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru wasal id-dar tard wara legliga mal-ħbieb.
formal.en: In the story, the character arrived home late after a bout of heavy drinking with friends.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个人物与朋友大量饮酒后，很晚才回到家。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kienet il-festa tal-bieraħ? Pawlu: Għal xi wħud spiċċat f'legliga; jien tlaqt kmieni.
colloquial.en: Sara: How was yesterday's party? Pawlu: For some people it turned into a bout of heavy drinking; I left early.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：昨天的聚会怎么样？保罗：有些人到后来喝得很多；我早早就走了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的聚会怎么样？
messages.en: How was yesterday's party?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xi wħud spiċċat f'legliga; jien tlaqt kmieni.
messages.mt_standard: Għal xi wħud spiċċat f'legliga; jien tlaqt kmieni.
messages.zh: 有些人到后来喝得很多；我早早就走了。
messages.en: For some people it turned into a bout of heavy drinking; I left early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上圈出一次喝了很多酒的聚会，把整次经历标为 legliga；记住它强调一次事件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling of wanting someone or something, especially something absent or difficult to obtain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某物的强烈渴望，尤其指对不在身边或不易得到之物的向往。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa qawwija għal xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, speċjalment meta jkunu 'l bogħod jew diffiċli biex jintlaħqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 深切渴望；对某人或某物的思念与向往。
强烈欲求；迫切想得到或享用某物的感觉。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-istudent esprima lehba qawwija għal daru u għall-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: In his letter, the student expressed a strong longing for his home and his family.
formal.zh: 这名学生在信中表达了对家乡和家人的深切思念。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandi lehba għall-ħelu llum. Pawlu: Trid biċċa kejk mat-te?
colloquial.en: Marta: I'm really craving something sweet today. Pawlu: Would you like a piece of cake with your tea?
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我今天特别想吃甜食。保罗：要不要来块蛋糕配茶？

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天特别想吃甜食。
messages.en: I'm really craving something sweet today.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 要不要来块蛋糕配茶？
messages.en: Would you like a piece of cake with your tea?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lehba 放进两个画面：游子想家、嘴馋想吃糖；共同点都是心里强烈地想要。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Watchful and ready to notice or respond to danger or changes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 留心周围情况，随时准备察觉危险或变化并作出反应的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attent għal dak li jiġri madwaru u lest biex jinduna bil-periklu jew b'xi bidla u jirreaġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 警惕的；持续留意潜在危险或问题的。
警觉的；能迅速注意到情况并作出反应的。

formal.mt: Matul l-ispezzjoni, il-gwardjan baqa' lehbien u osserva kull moviment qrib id-daħla.
formal.en: During the inspection, the guard remained vigilant and observed every movement near the entrance.
formal.zh: 检查期间，守卫始终保持警惕，留意入口附近的一举一动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek lehbien wara dawk is-sigħat kollha? Mark: Iva, imma dalwaqt nieħu pawża.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you still alert after all those hours? Mark: Yes, but I'll take a break soon.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：过了这么多个小时，你还保持着警觉吗？马克：是的，不过我很快就会休息一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek lehbien wara dawk is-sigħat kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek lehbien wara dawk is-sigħat kollha?
messages.zh: 过了这么多个小时，你还保持着警觉吗？
messages.en: Are you still alert after all those hours?

messages.speaker: Mark (值班同事)
messages.zh: 是的，不过我很快就会休息一下。
messages.en: Yes, but I'll take a break soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lehbien 贴在守卫的形象旁：眼睛留意四周，耳朵捕捉动静，记住它描述警觉状态。

gloss_zh: 渴望；强烈想要；对……怀有情欲

teaching_sense.en_definition: To desire someone or something strongly, with longing, craving, or sexual desire depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强烈地想念或想要某人、某物；依语境可表示向往、迫切欲求或情欲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixtieq ħafna lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa; skont il-kuntest, ix-xewqa tista' tkun ta' ħerqa, ta' bżonn qawwi jew sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 深切渴望；热切盼望某人或某物。
强烈想要；迫切渴求某物。
对某人怀有强烈情欲；带有性欲地渴望。

formal.mt: Wara snin twal barra minn Malta, ir-raġel leheb għal daru u għall-ħajja li kien ħalla warajh.
formal.en: After many years away from Malta, the man longed for his home and the life he had left behind.
formal.zh: 离开马耳他多年后，这名男子深切思念家乡以及自己离开前的生活。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif ħassu Pawlu meta kien barra? Lara: Leheb għal daru; kien jitkellem fuqha kuljum.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did Pawlu feel when he was abroad? Lara: He longed for home; he talked about it every day.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗在国外时感觉怎么样？拉拉：他很想家，每天都会说起家里的事。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassu Pawlu meta kien barra?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassu Pawlu meta kien barra?
messages.zh: 保罗在国外时感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How did Pawlu feel when he was abroad?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Leheb għal daru; kien jitkellem fuqha kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Leheb għal daru; kien jitkellem fuqha kuljum.
messages.zh: 他很想家，每天都会说起家里的事。
messages.en: He longed for home; he talked about it every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leheb 记成“强烈想要”这个动作，再看对象判断：家乡对应思念，食物对应嘴馋，人物语境也可能表达情欲。

gloss_zh: 给予灵感的人或事物；灵感来源

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or thing that gives someone inspiration or stimulates creative thought.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能给予他人灵感、激发创作或思考的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li tagħti ispirazzjoni lil xi ħadd jew tqanqal il-ħsieb kreattiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予灵感的人或事物；能启发他人思考或创作的灵感来源。

collocations.en: a source of inspiration for the poet
a source of inspiration for artists

formal.mt: Il-baħar kien lehiem għall-poeta, li ddedika ħafna mix-xogħlijiet tiegħu lill-kosta Maltija.
formal.en: The sea was a source of inspiration for the poet, who dedicated many of his works to the Maltese coast.
formal.zh: 大海是这位诗人的灵感来源，他的许多作品都以马耳他海岸为题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġiet l-idea għal din il-pittura? Toni: Il-ġnien ta' nannuwi kien il-lehiem tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the idea for this painting come from? Toni: My grandfather's garden was my source of inspiration.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这幅画的构思是从哪里来的？托尼：我祖父的花园是我的灵感来源。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġiet l-idea għal din il-pittura?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġiet l-idea għal din il-pittura?
messages.zh: 这幅画的构思是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where did the idea for this painting come from?

messages.speaker: Toni (画家)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġnien ta' nannuwi kien il-lehiem tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġnien ta' nannuwi kien il-lehiem tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我祖父的花园是我的灵感来源。
messages.en: My grandfather's garden was my source of inspiration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象画家指着花园说 lehiem：记住它指带来灵感的具体人或事物，可以追问“灵感来自谁或什么”。

gloss_zh: 富有启发性的；能激发灵感的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to give people inspiration or stimulate creative thought.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有启发他人、激发灵感或创造性思考的倾向或特质的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jagħti ispirazzjoni lin-nies jew iqanqal il-ħsieb kreattiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易给人启发的；具有激发灵感作用的。

formal.mt: L-awtur ta diskors lehiemi dwar kif l-osservazzjoni tal-ħajja ta' kuljum tista' twassal għal ideat ġodda.
formal.en: The author gave an inspiring speech about how observing everyday life can lead to new ideas.
formal.zh: 这位作家发表了一场富有启发性的演讲，讲述观察日常生活如何带来新的构思。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għoġbok il-ktieb? Mark: Iva, kien lehiemi; tani ħafna ideat għat-tpinġija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you like the book? Mark: Yes, it was inspiring; it gave me lots of ideas for drawing.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你喜欢这本书吗？马克：喜欢，很能激发灵感，给了我很多画画的点子。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这本书吗？
messages.en: Did you like the book?

messages.speaker: Mark (绘画爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien lehiemi; tani ħafna ideat għat-tpinġija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien lehiemi; tani ħafna ideat għat-tpinġija.
messages.zh: 喜欢，很能激发灵感，给了我很多画画的点子。
messages.en: Yes, it was inspiring; it gave me lots of ideas for drawing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lehiemi 写在一本读后点子不断的书旁：用它描述“能启发人的”特质，搭配书或演讲来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of material attached to an object that gives identifying or descriptive information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 附在物品上，用来标明名称、内容、价格或其他说明信息的标签。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa karta jew materjal ieħor imwaħħla ma' oġġett biex tagħti ismu, il-kontenut tiegħu, il-prezz jew informazzjoni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 标签；附在物品上、用于识别或提供说明信息的标示签。

formal.mt: Il-lejbil fuq il-flixkun jindika l-ingredjenti, il-kwantità u d-data ta' skadenza tal-prodott.
formal.en: The label on the bottle indicates the product's ingredients, quantity, and expiry date.
formal.zh: 瓶子上的标签标明了产品的成分、含量和有效期。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm jiswa dan il-vażett? Rita: Ħares lejn il-lejbil; il-prezz hemm miktub.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does this jar cost? Rita: Look at the label; the price is written there.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这一罐多少钱？丽塔：看一下标签，价格写在上面。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这一罐多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this jar cost?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn il-lejbil; il-prezz hemm miktub.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn il-lejbil; il-prezz hemm miktub.
messages.zh: 看一下标签，价格写在上面。
messages.en: Look at the label; the price is written there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lejbil 与英语 label 对照记忆，再想象瓶身上写着成分和价格的小纸签，把词和实物联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spend the night in a particular place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某个地方度过夜晚或留宿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqatta' l-lejl f'xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某处过夜；在某个地方留宿一晚。

collocations.en: he spent the night at the hotel
he spent the night at a friend's place

formal.mt: Minħabba t-temp ħażin, il-vjaġġatur lejjel fir-raħal u kompla l-vjaġġ tiegħu l-għada filgħodu.
formal.en: Because of the bad weather, the traveller spent the night in the village and continued his journey the following morning.
formal.zh: 由于天气恶劣，这名旅客在村里过了一夜，第二天早晨继续赶路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Toni mar lura d-dar ilbieraħ? Sara: Le, lejjel għand ħabib għax tilef l-aħħar karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Toni go home yesterday? Sara: No, he spent the night at a friend's place because he missed the last bus.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：托尼昨天回家了吗？萨拉：没有，他错过了末班公交车，就在朋友家过夜了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼昨天回家了吗？
messages.en: Did Toni go home yesterday?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, lejjel għand ħabib għax tilef l-aħħar karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Le, lejjel għand ħabib għax tilef l-aħħar karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 没有，他错过了末班公交车，就在朋友家过夜了。
messages.en: No, he spent the night at a friend's place because he missed the last bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lejjel 放进“错过末班车，留在朋友家直到天亮”的情景，记住它表达在某处过夜这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Christmas Eve, the final night immediately before Christmas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 圣诞节到来之前的最后一夜，即圣诞前夜或平安夜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-lejl eżatt qabel il-Milied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣诞前夜，即圣诞节到来之前的最后一夜。

formal.mt: F'Lejlet il-Milied, il-mużew se jagħlaq fis-siegħa ta' waranofsinhar.
formal.en: On Christmas Eve, the museum will close at one in the afternoon.
formal.zh: 圣诞前夜当天，博物馆将于下午一点闭馆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nagħmlu f'Lejlet il-Milied? Mark: Nieklu flimkien id-dar u mbagħad niftħu r-rigali.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are we doing on Christmas Eve? Mark: We'll eat together at home and then open the presents.
colloquial.zh: Maja：圣诞前夜我们做什么？Mark：我们在家一起吃饭，然后拆礼物。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 圣诞前夜我们做什么？
messages.en: What are we doing on Christmas Eve?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nieklu flimkien id-dar u mbagħad niftħu r-rigali.
messages.mt_standard: Nieklu flimkien id-dar u mbagħad niftħu r-rigali.
messages.zh: 我们在家一起吃饭，然后拆礼物。
messages.en: We'll eat together at home and then open the presents.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把日历上的圣诞节圈起来，再指向它正前方的那一夜：Lejlet il-Milied 就记作圣诞前夜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The eve or night before an event, also used in expressions meaning on the eve of that event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个事件之前的一夜或前夕，也用于表示事情发生在该事件前夕的时间表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-lejl jew iż-żmien eżatt qabel avveniment, ukoll f'espressjonijiet li juru meta ssir xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某件事发生的前夕。
某件事发生之前的那一夜。

collocations.en: on the eve of the exam; the night before the exam
collocations.zh: 在考试前夕；考试前一夜

collocations.en: on the eve of the wedding; the night before the wedding
collocations.zh: 在婚礼前夕；婚礼前一夜

formal.mt: Lejliet il-konferenza, l-organizzaturi bagħtu l-programm finali lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: On the eve of the conference, the organisers sent the final programme to the participants.
formal.zh: 会议前夕，主办方向与会者发送了最终议程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta ħejjejt il-bagalja? Pawlu: Lejliet il-vjaġġ, għax filgħodu tlaqna kmieni.
colloquial.en: Sara: When did you pack your suitcase? Pawlu: The night before the trip, because we left early in the morning.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你什么时候收拾的行李？Pawlu：出发前一晚，因为我们早上很早就走了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你什么时候收拾的行李？
messages.en: When did you pack your suitcase?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lejliet il-vjaġġ, għax filgħodu tlaqna kmieni.
messages.mt_standard: Lejliet il-vjaġġ, għax filgħodu tlaqna kmieni.
messages.zh: 出发前一晚，因为我们早上很早就走了。
messages.en: The night before the trip, because we left early in the morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大事发生前一晚正在收拾书包或行李，把 lejliet 和后面的事件一起记成“……前夕”。

gloss_zh: 圣诞节最后一夜之前的数个夜晚

teaching_sense.en_definition: The nights before the final night of Christmas, treated as a named Christmas period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指圣诞节最后一夜之前的数个夜晚，作为这一圣诞时段的名称使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem għall-iljieli ta' qabel l-aħħar lejl tal-Milied.

sense_translations.en_definition: Christmas Eve (nights before the final night of Christmas).
sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣诞前夕时段，特指圣诞节最后一夜之前的数个夜晚。

collocations.en: the nights of the period before the final night of Christmas
collocations.zh: 圣诞节最后一夜之前这一时段的各个夜晚

collocations.en: the programme for the nights before the final night of Christmas
collocations.zh: 圣诞节最后一夜之前数晚的活动安排

formal.mt: Il-programm ta' Lejliet il-Milied jinkludi attivitajiet fl-iljieli ta' qabel l-aħħar lejl tal-Milied.
formal.en: The programme for Lejliet il-Milied includes activities on the nights before the final night of Christmas.
formal.zh: Lejliet il-Milied 的活动安排涵盖圣诞节最后一夜之前的数个夜晚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-programm ta' Lejliet il-Milied huwa għal lejl wieħed? Toni: Le, l-attivitajiet huma f'diversi ljieli qabel l-aħħar lejl tal-Milied.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the Lejliet il-Milied programme for just one night? Toni: No, the activities take place over several nights before the final night of Christmas.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Lejliet il-Milied 的活动只有一晚吗？Toni：不是，活动分布在圣诞节最后一夜之前的几个晚上。

messages.speaker: Lara (活动参加者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-programm ta' Lejliet il-Milied huwa għal lejl wieħed?
messages.mt_standard: Il-programm ta' Lejliet il-Milied huwa għal lejl wieħed?
messages.zh: Lejliet il-Milied 的活动只有一晚吗？
messages.en: Is the Lejliet il-Milied programme for just one night?

messages.speaker: Toni (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, l-attivitajiet huma f'diversi ljieli qabel l-aħħar lejl tal-Milied.
messages.mt_standard: Le, l-attivitajiet huma f'diversi ljieli qabel l-aħħar lejl tal-Milied.
messages.zh: 不是，活动分布在圣诞节最后一夜之前的几个晚上。
messages.en: No, the activities take place over several nights before the final night of Christmas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 本词条用连续几个夜晚的日历格来记：这些格子位于圣诞节最后一夜之前，注意这里指多个夜晚。

gloss_zh: 微微发光；明亮闪耀；显得艳俗

teaching_sense.en_definition: To glimmer or shine brightly, or to look gaudy through excessive visual brilliance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出微光或明亮地闪耀，也可指外观过于耀眼而显得艳俗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti dawl ħafif jew jiddi ħafna, jew li jidher jgħajjat iżżejjed fid-dehra tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出微弱、隐约的光。
明亮地发光或闪耀。
外观过分鲜艳或耀眼，显得艳俗。

formal.mt: Waqt il-wirja, il-ġojjell lellex taħt id-dawl qawwi tal-lampa.
formal.en: During the exhibition, the jewel shone brightly under the strong light of the lamp.
formal.zh: 展览期间，那件珠宝在灯具的强光下熠熠生辉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt iċ-ċurkett meta ħriġna fix-xemx? Mark: Iva, lellex ħafna! Ġewwa bilkemm deher.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the ring when we went out into the sun? Mark: Yes, it really sparkled! Indoors it was barely visible.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们走到阳光下时，你看到那枚戒指了吗？Mark：看到了，闪得很亮！在室内几乎看不出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们走到阳光下时，你看到那枚戒指了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the ring when we went out into the sun?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, lellex ħafna! Ġewwa bilkemm deher.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, lellex ħafna! Ġewwa bilkemm deher.
messages.zh: 看到了，闪得很亮！在室内几乎看不出来。
messages.en: Yes, it really sparkled! Indoors it was barely visible.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一盏可调亮度的灯记 lellex：先微光，再闪亮，最后亮得花哨刺眼，串起三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Yellowish in colour, or glittering in appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色略带黄色的，或外观闪闪发亮的；具体含义由所描述的事物和语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu lewn safrani, jew li jiddi u jleqq fid-dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微黄的；略带黄色的。
闪闪发亮的；呈现闪烁光泽的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun tal-karta għandu kulur lelluxi, aktar milli abjad pur.
formal.en: The paper sample has a yellowish colour rather than a pure white colour.
formal.zh: 这份纸张样本的颜色略微发黄，并非纯白。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema drapp trid għall-kostum? Nina: Dak lelluxi; jogħġobni kif jiddi taħt id-dawl.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which fabric do you want for the costume? Nina: The glittering one; I like how it shines under the light.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你想用哪块布做演出服？Nina：那块闪亮的，我喜欢它在灯光下发亮的样子。

messages.speaker: Sara (裁缝)
messages.zh: 你想用哪块布做演出服？
messages.en: Which fabric do you want for the costume?

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak lelluxi; jogħġobni kif jiddi taħt id-dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Dak lelluxi; jogħġobni kif jiddi taħt id-dawl.
messages.zh: 那块闪亮的，我喜欢它在灯光下发亮的样子。
messages.en: The glittering one; I like how it shines under the light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 lelluxi 配两张记忆卡：一张是微黄纸张，一张是闪亮布料，分别对应颜色和光泽。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep one's lips tightly closed, or to press one's lips together in a pursed expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 紧闭嘴巴而不说话，或把双唇收紧、抿拢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jżomm xofftejh magħluqin sewwa bla ma jitkellem, jew li jagħfas xofftejh ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧闭嘴巴；不肯开口或透露信息。
收紧并抿拢双唇。

collocations.en: pressed his lips together and remained silent

formal.mt: Meta l-intervistatur staqsa dwar il-ftehim, il-maniġer lemaq u ma ta ebda tweġiba.
formal.en: When the interviewer asked about the agreement, the manager pressed his lips together and gave no answer.
formal.zh: 采访者问及该协议时，经理抿紧嘴唇，没有作答。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel Pawlu meta sema' l-prezz? Toni: Lemaq, ħares lejja u ma qal xejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Pawlu do when he heard the price? Toni: He pursed his lips, looked at me and said nothing.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu 听到价格时有什么反应？Toni：他抿了抿嘴，看了我一眼，什么也没说。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 听到价格时有什么反应？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do when he heard the price?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lemaq, ħares lejja u ma qal xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Lemaq, ħares lejja u ma qal xejn.
messages.zh: 他抿了抿嘴，看了我一眼，什么也没说。
messages.en: He pursed his lips, looked at me and said nothing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 lemaq 时配合抿紧双唇的动作：嘴唇收拢是动作，不肯开口是这个动作常见的情境。

gloss_zh: 用漏斗灌入；经漏斗倾倒

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pour a substance through a funnel into a container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 借助漏斗，把某种物质倒入容器中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jferra' xi sustanza f'reċipjent permezz ta' lembut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使物质通过漏斗倒入；用漏斗灌装。

collocations.en: poured the oil through a funnel into the bottle
poured the water through a funnel into the container
collocations.zh: 用漏斗把水倒入容器中

formal.mt: L-assistent lembet il-likwidu fil-flixkun nadif biex jevita t-tixrid.
formal.en: The assistant poured the liquid through a funnel into the clean bottle to avoid spilling it.
formal.zh: 助手用漏斗把液体灌入干净的瓶子，以免洒出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif daħħal Mark iż-żejt f'dak il-flixkun dejjaq? Sara: Lembet iż-żejt bil-mod, u ma xerred xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark get the oil into that narrow bottle? Sara: He poured it slowly through a funnel and didn't spill any.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 是怎么把油倒进那个窄口瓶的？Sara：他用漏斗慢慢灌进去，一点也没洒。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif daħħal Mark iż-żejt f'dak il-flixkun dejjaq?
messages.mt_standard: Kif daħħal Mark iż-żejt f'dak il-flixkun dejjaq?
messages.zh: Mark 是怎么把油倒进那个窄口瓶的？
messages.en: How did Mark get the oil into that narrow bottle?

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lembet iż-żejt bil-mod, u ma xerred xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Lembet iż-żejt bil-mod, u ma xerred xejn.
messages.zh: 他用漏斗慢慢灌进去，一点也没洒。
messages.en: He poured it slowly through a funnel and didn't spill any.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lembet 记成一段动作短片：拿起漏斗，对准瓶口，慢慢灌入；重点是“经漏斗倒入”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A funnel that guides a substance into a narrow opening, or a spout through which a liquid is poured.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引导物质进入狭小开口的漏斗，也可指容器上供液体流出的壶嘴或导流嘴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'fetħa wiesgħa u tarf dejjaq biex tgħaddi sustanza għal ġo reċipjent, jew parti minn reċipjent li minnha jitferra' l-likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漏斗；上口较宽、下端较窄，用于引导物质进入容器的工具。
壶嘴或导流嘴；容器上让液体定向流出的部分。

formal.mt: Qiegħed lembut nadif fil-fetħa tal-flixkun u ferra' l-likwidu bil-mod.
formal.en: Place a clean funnel in the opening of the bottle and pour the liquid slowly.
formal.zh: 将干净的漏斗放入瓶口，再缓缓倒入液体。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu l-lembut? Għandi bżonnu biex nimla dan il-flixkun. Nina: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-kuċċarini.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where's the funnel? I need it to fill this bottle. Nina: In the drawer next to the teaspoons.
colloquial.zh: Mark：漏斗在哪里？我得用它把这个瓶子灌满。Nina：在抽屉里，小勺子旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-lembut? Għandi bżonnu biex nimla dan il-flixkun.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-lembut? Għandi bżonnu biex nimla dan il-flixkun.
messages.zh: 漏斗在哪里？我得用它把这个瓶子灌满。
messages.en: Where's the funnel? I need it to fill this bottle.

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 在抽屉里，小勺子旁边。
messages.en: In the drawer next to the teaspoons.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“引导液体走窄口”的画面记 lembut：独立工具是漏斗，接在容器上的出水部分是壶嘴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Situated on the right side, opposite the left side.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于右边或右侧的，与左边相对。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab fuq il-lemin, fuq in-naħa opposta għax-xellug.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 右边的；右侧的，与左边相对。

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi għandhom jużaw il-bieb lemini biex jidħlu fis-sala.
formal.en: Visitors should use the right-hand door to enter the hall.
formal.zh: 访客应从右侧的门进入大厅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn poġġejt iċ-ċavetta? Mark: Fil-but lemini tal-ġakketta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you put the key? Mark: In the right pocket of the jacket.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把钥匙放哪儿了？马克：在夹克右边的口袋里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把钥匙放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the key?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在夹克右边的口袋里。
messages.en: In the right pocket of the jacket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把钥匙放进右侧口袋，同时默念 il-but lemini，用身体方位记住“右边的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spread and flatten dough or a similar mixture with a rolling pin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用擀面杖把面团或类似的材料擀开、擀平。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifrex u jċattat l-għaġina jew taħlita simili b'lenbuba.

sense_translations.en_definition: to spread with a rolling pin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用擀面杖擀开、擀平。

collocations.en: roll out on a floured table
collocations.zh: 在撒了面粉的桌面上擀开

formal.mt: Lenbeb l-għaġina fuq mejda bid-dqiq sakemm tkun irqiqa u uniformi.
formal.en: Roll out the dough on a floured table until it is thin and even.
formal.zh: 在撒了面粉的桌面上把面团擀开，直到薄厚均匀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tlenbeb l-għaġina waqt li nipprepara l-mili? Mark: Iva, għaddili l-lenbuba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you roll out the dough while I prepare the filling? Mark: Yes, pass me the rolling pin.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我准备馅料时，你能把面团擀开吗？马克：可以，把擀面杖递给我。

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tlenbeb l-għaġina waqt li nipprepara l-mili?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tlenbeb l-għaġina waqt li nipprepara l-mili?
messages.zh: 我准备馅料时，你能把面团擀开吗？
messages.en: Can you roll out the dough while I prepare the filling?

messages.speaker: Mark (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，把擀面杖递给我。
messages.en: Yes, pass me the rolling pin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手推动擀面杖，把厚面团擀成薄片；用这个完整动作记住 lenbeb。

gloss_zh: 易滚动的；容易滚起来的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to roll or to move by rolling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有容易滚动或以滚动方式移动的倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jirrombla jew jiċċaqlaq billi jirrombla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易滚动的；有滚动倾向的。

collocations.en: an object that tends to roll
a toy that tends to roll

formal.mt: Oġġett lenbiebi għandu jitqiegħed f'kontenitur biex ma jaqax minn fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: An object that tends to roll should be placed in a container so that it does not fall off the table.
formal.zh: 容易滚动的物体应放进容器，以免从桌上掉下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex poġġejt il-ġugarell fil-kaxxa? Mark: Għax hu lenbiebi u ma rridx li jaqa' minn fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you put the toy in the box? Mark: Because it tends to roll, and I don't want it to fall off the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把玩具放进盒子里？马克：因为它容易滚动，我不想让它从桌上掉下去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把玩具放进盒子里？
messages.en: Why did you put the toy in the box?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu lenbiebi u ma rridx li jaqa' minn fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu lenbiebi u ma rridx li jaqa' minn fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 因为它容易滚动，我不想让它从桌上掉下去。
messages.en: Because it tends to roll, and I don't want it to fall off the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个轻碰就滚向桌边的玩具，用“容易滚起来”的画面记住 lenbiebi。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small cylinder around which thread is wound for storage or use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供线缠绕在外侧、便于存放或使用的小圆筒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċilindru żgħir li madwaru jitkebbeb il-ħajt biex jinżamm jew jintuża.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small cylinder around which thread is reeled
sense_translations.zh_definition: 供线缠绕的小圆筒；线轴。

formal.mt: Il-ħajt jinżamm imkebbeb madwar lenbub biex ma jitħabbilx waqt il-ħażna.
formal.en: The thread is kept wound around a spool so that it does not become tangled during storage.
formal.zh: 线缠绕在线轴上存放，以免打结缠乱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-lenbub bil-ħajt aħmar? Mark: Fil-kaxxa tal-ħjata, ħdejn l-imqass.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the spool with the red thread? Mark: In the sewing box, next to the scissors.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：绕着红线的线轴在哪里？马克：在针线盒里，剪刀旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (缝纫学员)
messages.zh: 绕着红线的线轴在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the spool with the red thread?

messages.speaker: Mark (缝纫老师)
messages.zh: 在针线盒里，剪刀旁边。
messages.en: In the sewing box, next to the scissors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象红线一圈圈绕在小圆筒外面，把 lenbub 和针线盒里的线轴一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cylindrical kitchen tool rolled over dough to flatten and spread it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在面团上来回滚动、将其擀平擀开的圆柱形厨房工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda ċilindrika tal-kċina li titmexxa fuq l-għaġina biex iċċattatha u tifrexha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擀面杖，用于把面团擀平擀开。
警棍，警察使用的短棍。
短棒；手持的棍棒。

formal.mt: Uża lenbuba nadifa biex tifrex l-għaġina b'mod uniformi qabel taqtagħha.
formal.en: Use a clean rolling pin to spread the dough evenly before cutting it.
formal.zh: 切面团之前，先用干净的擀面杖将其擀得薄厚均匀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek lenbuba? Irrid nagħmel it-torta. Mark: Iva, hemm waħda tal-injam fil-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a rolling pin? I want to make the pie. Mark: Yes, there's a wooden one in the drawer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有擀面杖吗？我想做馅饼。马克：有，抽屉里有一根木制的。

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 你有擀面杖吗？我想做馅饼。
messages.en: Do you have a rolling pin? I want to make the pie.

messages.speaker: Mark (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 有，抽屉里有一根木制的。
messages.en: Yes, there's a wooden one in the drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用厨房里擀面团的长圆棒记住 lenbuba，再按语境区分擀面杖、警棍和短棒三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the shape of a cylinder, with a circular cross-section and straight sides.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状像圆柱，横截面为圆形、侧面沿长度方向平直的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma ta' ċilindru, b'sezzjoni trasversali tonda u ġnub dritti.

sense_translations.en_definition: in the shape of a cylinder
sense_translations.zh_definition: 圆柱形的；形状像圆筒的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun tqiegħed f'kontenitur lenbubi b'għatu li jagħlaq sew.
formal.en: The sample was placed in a cylindrical container with a tightly closing lid.
formal.zh: 样本被放入一个盖子能够严密闭合的圆筒形容器中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema kontenitur trid, dak kwadru? Mark: Le, dak lenbubi ħdejn it-tazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which container do you want, the square one? Mark: No, the cylindrical one next to the cup.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要哪个容器，方形的那个吗？马克：不是，要杯子旁边那个圆筒形的。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你要哪个容器，方形的那个吗？
messages.en: Which container do you want, the square one?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 不是，要杯子旁边那个圆筒形的。
messages.en: No, the cylindrical one next to the cup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个上下是圆面、侧边笔直的罐子，用这个圆柱轮廓记住 lenbubi 所描述的形状。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with a wide opening that narrows into a tube, used to guide liquid or small particles into a container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 上口宽、下端收窄成管，用于把液体或细小颗粒导入容器的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'fetħa wiesgħa li tidjieq f'tubu, użata biex tgħaddi likwidu jew frak żgħir għal ġo reċipjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漏斗，用于将液体或细小颗粒导入窄口容器。

formal.mt: Poġġi lenbut fl-għonq tal-flixkun u ferra' l-likwidu bil-mod biex ma jixteridx.
formal.en: Place a funnel in the neck of the bottle and pour the liquid slowly to avoid spilling it.
formal.zh: 把漏斗放进瓶口，缓缓倒入液体，以免洒出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se nferra' ż-żejt f'dan il-flixkun żgħir? Mark: Uża l-lenbut; qiegħed ħdejn is-sink.
colloquial.en: Maja: How am I going to pour the oil into this small bottle? Mark: Use the funnel; it's next to the sink.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我要怎么把油倒进这个小瓶子里？马克：用漏斗吧，就在水槽旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nferra' ż-żejt f'dan il-flixkun żgħir?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nferra' ż-żejt f'dan il-flixkun żgħir?
messages.zh: 我要怎么把油倒进这个小瓶子里？
messages.en: How am I going to pour the oil into this small bottle?

messages.speaker: Mark (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 用漏斗吧，就在水槽旁边。
messages.en: Use the funnel; it's next to the sink.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象液体从宽口汇入细管，再流进小瓶，用“上宽下窄”的漏斗画面记住 lenbut。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gleam or shine visible when light is emitted or reflected from a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体发光或表面反射光线时显出的亮光、闪光或光泽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dija jew tleqqija li tidher meta oġġett jagħti d-dawl jew wiċċ jirriflettih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪光；表面映出的亮光。
发亮；显出的光泽或光辉。

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif, dehret leqqa ċara fuq il-wiċċ tal-fidda.
formal.en: After cleaning, a clear shine appeared on the surface of the silver.
formal.zh: 清洁后，银器表面显出了明亮的光泽。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara x'leqqa fuq din il-kuċċarina! Mark: Għadni kif naddaft l-fidda kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at the shine on this spoon! Mark: I've just cleaned all the silver.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看这把勺子多有光泽！马克：我刚把所有银器都清洁好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 看这把勺子多有光泽！
messages.en: Look at the shine on this spoon!

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 我刚把所有银器都清洁好了。
messages.en: I've just cleaned all the silver.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象擦亮银勺后表面映出一道光；把 leqqa 记成眼睛看到的“闪光或光泽”这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Giving off or reflecting light with a bright, shiny appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出或反射光线，呈现明亮、有光泽或闪烁外观的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti jew jirrifletti d-dawl u jidher ileqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 泛着明亮光泽的；光亮的。
闪闪发亮的；闪烁的。
发光的；照耀的。

formal.mt: Il-wiċċ leqqien tal-metall jirrifletti d-dawl.
formal.en: The gleaming surface of the metal reflects the light.
formal.zh: 金属光亮的表面反射着光线。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara kemm hu leqqien dan iċ-ċurkett! Mark: Iva, għadni kemm naddaftu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look how shiny this ring is! Mark: Yes, I have just cleaned it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看，这枚戒指多亮啊！马克：是啊，我刚把它擦干净。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hu leqqien dan iċ-ċurkett!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hu leqqien dan iċ-ċurkett!
messages.zh: 看，这枚戒指多亮啊！
messages.en: Look how shiny this ring is!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我刚把它擦干净。
messages.en: Yes, I have just cleaned it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leqqien 和擦亮的戒指联系起来：表面亮、光点闪、物体发光，都围绕眼睛看见的光泽来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in Southern Africa, officially called the Kingdom of Lesotho.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非洲南部的一个国家，正式名称为莱索托王国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika, bl-isem uffiċjali Renju tal-Lesoto.

sense_translations.en_definition: Lesotho (a country in Southern Africa; official name: Renju tal-Lesoto)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 莱索托，非洲南部的一个国家；正式名称为莱索托王国，马耳他语作 Renju tal-Lesoto。

collocations.zh: 对莱索托的访问；莱索托之行

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juża l-isem uffiċjali Renju tal-Lesoto meta jirreferi għal dan il-pajjiż fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika.
formal.en: The report uses the official name Kingdom of Lesotho when referring to this country in Southern Africa.
formal.zh: 报告提到这个非洲南部国家时，使用其正式名称“莱索托王国”。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn jinsab il-Lesoto? Daniel: Fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Lesotho? Daniel: In Southern Africa. Let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：莱索托在哪里？丹尼尔：在非洲南部。我们在地图上找找吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 莱索托在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Lesotho?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在非洲南部。我们在地图上找找吧。
messages.en: In Southern Africa. Let's find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Lesoto 与中文“莱索托”配对记忆，再在脑中加上一张非洲南部地图；国家名称书写时首字母大写。

gloss_zh: 准备好的；做完的；已完成的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ready for an action or use, or finished after the necessary work has been done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经准备好，可以行动或使用的；也指所需工作已经做完的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu mħejji għal azzjoni jew għall-użu, jew li x-xogħol fuqu jkun intemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 准备好的；可以开始行动或投入使用的。
做完的；已经结束的。
已完成的；所需部分或步骤均已完成的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport lest u jista' jintbagħat lill-kumitat illum.
formal.en: The report is complete and can be sent to the committee today.
formal.zh: 报告已完成，今天可以提交给委员会。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int lest biex nitilqu? Mark: Iva, jien lest. Ħa nieħu l-basket.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you ready for us to leave? Mark: Yes, I'm ready. Let me get the bag.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你准备好出发了吗？马克：准备好了。我拿一下包。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备好出发了吗？
messages.en: Are you ready for us to leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien lest. Ħa nieħu l-basket.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien lest. Ħa nieħu l-basket.
messages.zh: 准备好了。我拿一下包。
messages.en: Yes, I'm ready. Let me get the bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 lest：人拿好包就是“准备好了”，报告写完就是“完成了”；两者都表示已达到可继续的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put the tongue out, especially of a snake, or to take up liquid by repeated movements of the tongue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伸吐舌头，尤其指蛇吐舌；也指用舌头反复舔取液体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ ilsienu, speċjalment serp, jew jieħu likwidu billi jilagħqu ripetutament.

sense_translations.en_definition: to poke the tongue out (used especially of a snake)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 伸出舌头；吐舌，尤其用于描述蛇。
用舌头反复舔取某物，尤指舔饮液体。

collocations.en: the snake flicked its tongue out

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, is-serp letlet ilsienu diversi drabi.
formal.en: During the observation, the snake put its tongue out several times.
formal.zh: 观察期间，蛇数次吐出舌头。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt x'għamel is-serp? Pawlu: Iva, letlet ilsienu u mbagħad daħal taħt il-ġebla.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see what the snake did? Pawlu: Yes, it put its tongue out and then went under the stone.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看见那条蛇刚才做什么了吗？保罗：看见了，它吐出舌头，然后钻到了石头下面。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看见那条蛇刚才做什么了吗？
messages.en: Did you see what the snake did?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, letlet ilsienu u mbagħad daħal taħt il-ġebla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, letlet ilsienu u mbagħad daħal taħt il-ġebla.
messages.zh: 看见了，它吐出舌头，然后钻到了石头下面。
messages.en: Yes, it put its tongue out and then went under the stone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 letlet 时想象舌尖一伸一收的连续动作：蛇是吐舌，猫喝奶是舔饮；这是动作联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to lap up liquid with the tongue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于用舌头舔取液体的；爱舔饮的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jieħu likwidu billi jilagħqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于舔饮的；惯于用舌头舔取液体的。

formal.mt: Il-qattus letlieti resaq lejn l-iskutella u beda jilgħaq l-ilma.
formal.en: The cat, inclined to lap, approached the bowl and began lapping the water.
formal.zh: 那只爱舔饮的猫走近碗，开始舔水喝。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu letlieti dan il-qattus! Daniel: Iva, malli jsib skutella ilma, jibda jilgħaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: This cat really likes lapping! Daniel: Yes, whenever it finds a bowl of water, it starts lapping.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这只猫真爱舔水喝！丹尼尔：是啊，它一发现一碗水，就开始舔饮。

messages.speaker: Maja (宠物主人)
messages.zh: 这只猫真爱舔水喝！
messages.en: This cat really likes lapping!

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, malli jsib skutella ilma, jibda jilgħaq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, malli jsib skutella ilma, jibda jilgħaq.
messages.zh: 是啊，它一发现一碗水，就开始舔饮。
messages.en: Yes, whenever it finds a bowl of water, it starts lapping.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给一只总去水碗边舔水的猫贴上 letlieti 标签：它描述“爱舔饮”的倾向，是形容特点的词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of repeatedly taking up something, especially liquid, with the tongue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用舌头反复舔取某物的动作，尤指舔饮液体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha jittieħed xi ħaġa, speċjalment likwidu, permezz ta' movimenti ripetuti tal-ilsien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某物的反复舔取；尤指用舌头舔饮液体的动作。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss tal-letlit tal-ilma nstema' fil-kamra kwieta.
formal.en: The sound of water being lapped could be heard in the quiet room.
formal.zh: 安静的房间里可以听见舔水的声音。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak il-ħoss? Mark: Dak il-ħoss tal-letlit tal-ilma; il-qattus qed jixrob.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's that sound? Mark: That's the sound of water being lapped; the cat is drinking.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那是什么声音？马克：那是舔水的声音，猫正在喝水。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 那是什么声音？
messages.en: What's that sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-ħoss tal-letlit tal-ilma; il-qattus qed jixrob.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-ħoss tal-letlit tal-ilma; il-qattus qed jixrob.
messages.zh: 那是舔水的声音，猫正在喝水。
messages.en: That's the sound of water being lapped; the cat is drinking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 letlit 当作镜头中的“舔饮这件事”：可以观察这个动作，也可以听见它的声音；用名词视角来记。

gloss_zh: 无音乐及仪式排场的；大钩钓线；系鱼笼的主绳

teaching_sense.en_definition: Said of a religious service held without music or elaborate ceremonial.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容宗教礼拜不配音乐、没有繁复仪式排场的；如简式弥撒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal quddies li jsir mingħajr mużika jew ċerimonji elaborati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简式的；不配音乐、没有仪式排场的，尤用于宗教礼拜。
装有大鱼钩的钓线。

sense_translations.en_definition: main rope tied to fishing pots
sense_translations.zh_definition: 系着捕鱼笼的主绳。

collocations.en: Low Mass without music or elaborate ceremonial
collocations.zh: 不配音乐、没有繁复仪式的简式弥撒

collocations.en: a fishing line with large hooks
the main rope attached to the fishing pots

formal.mt: Il-programm jindika li filgħodu jkun hemm quddies lett, mingħajr mużika jew ċerimonji elaborati.
formal.en: The programme indicates that there will be Low Mass in the morning, without music or elaborate ceremonial.
formal.zh: 日程表注明，上午将举行不配音乐、没有繁复仪式的简式弥撒。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-lett hu l-ħabel ewlieni marbut man-nases tas-sajd? Pawlu: Iva, iċċekkjah qabel inniżżlu n-nases fl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this lett the main rope attached to the fishing pots? Pawlu: Yes, check it before we lower the pots into the water.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这根 lett 就是系着捕鱼笼的主绳吗？保罗：是的，把笼子放进水里之前检查一下。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒渔民)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-lett hu l-ħabel ewlieni marbut man-nases tas-sajd?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-lett hu l-ħabel ewlieni marbut man-nases tas-sajd?
messages.zh: 这根 lett 就是系着捕鱼笼的主绳吗？
messages.en: Is this lett the main rope attached to the fishing pots?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (渔民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iċċekkjah qabel inniżżlu n-nases fl-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iċċekkjah qabel inniżżlu n-nases fl-ilma.
messages.zh: 是的，把笼子放进水里之前检查一下。
messages.en: Yes, check it before we lower the pots into the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用场景分开记 lett：教堂里形容简式礼拜；渔船上作为名词，指大钩钓线或系鱼笼的主绳，不必强行串成同一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sticky or slimy substance or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摸起来黏糊糊或滑腻腻的物质或东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li twaħħal jew li tkun tiżloq u twaħħal mal-mess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黏糊糊或黏滑的东西。

collocations.en: sticky or slimy stuff on the floor
to remove the sticky or slimy stuff

formal.mt: Qabel ma tintuża l-kamra, għandu jitneħħa l-lewt li hemm fuq l-art.
formal.en: Before the room is used, the sticky or slimy substance on the floor must be removed.
formal.zh: 使用房间前，必须清除地板上的黏滑物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan il-lewt fuq il-mejda? Toni: Ma nafx, imma se nneħħih b'ċarruta mxarrba.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this sticky stuff on the table? Toni: I don't know, but I'll remove it with a damp cloth.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桌上这黏糊糊的东西是什么？托尼：不知道，不过我会用湿布把它擦掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 桌上这黏糊糊的东西是什么？
messages.en: What's this sticky stuff on the table?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx, imma se nneħħih b'ċarruta mxarrba.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx, imma se nneħħih b'ċarruta mxarrba.
messages.zh: 不知道，不过我会用湿布把它擦掉。
messages.en: I don't know, but I'll remove it with a damp cloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上一团擦不掉的黏糊物，把 lewt 和伸手后黏住的触感一起记住。

gloss_zh: 少量分发食物或施舍物；分期还债

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give out food or alms in small quantities, or to repay a debt in instalments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物或施舍物少量分发出去；也指把债务分成若干期偿还。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqassam ikel jew karità fi kwantitajiet żgħar, jew iħallas dejn bin-nifs.

sense_translations.en_definition: to give out small quantities of food or alms
sense_translations.zh_definition: 少量分发食物或施舍物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to repay a debt in instalments
sense_translations.zh_definition: 分期偿还债务。

collocations.en: gave out small quantities of food to the poor
collocations.zh: 把食物少量分发给穷人

formal.mt: Il-voluntier lewwaq l-ikel lill-familji fil-bżonn, u ta porzjon żgħir lil kull persuna.
formal.en: The volunteer distributed food in small quantities to families in need, giving each person a small portion.
formal.zh: 志愿者向有需要的家庭少量分发食物，给每人一小份。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Toni lewwaq id-dejn jew ħallsu f'daqqa? Pawlu: Lewwaq id-dejn; ħallas ftit kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Toni repay the debt in instalments or pay it all at once? Pawlu: He repaid it in instalments; he paid a little each month.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：托尼是分期还债，还是一次还清的？保罗：分期还的，每个月还一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Toni lewwaq id-dejn jew ħallsu f'daqqa?
messages.mt_standard: Toni lewwaq id-dejn jew ħallsu f'daqqa?
messages.zh: 托尼是分期还债，还是一次还清的？
messages.en: Did Toni repay the debt in instalments or pay it all at once?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lewwaq id-dejn; ħallas ftit kull xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Lewwaq id-dejn; ħallas ftit kull xahar.
messages.zh: 分期还的，每个月还一点。
messages.en: He repaid it in instalments; he paid a little each month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅少量分出的画面记 lewwaq：一份份发食物，一笔笔还债；这是记忆联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move material with a shovel or work the ground with a spade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用铲子移动土、沙等材料，或用锹铲土、翻土。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċaqlaq materjal b'pala jew jaħdem il-ħamrija bi spada.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用铲子铲起或移动材料。
用锹铲土或翻土。

collocations.en: shovelled the sand with a shovel
worked the soil with a spade

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem lewwaħ ir-ramel bil-pala u ġabru f'munzell ħdejn il-ħajt.
formal.en: The worker shovelled the sand and gathered it into a pile beside the wall.
formal.zh: 工人用铲子铲沙，把沙子堆在墙边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min lewwaħ il-ħamrija bi spada dalgħodu? Toni: Missieri; qed iħejji l-ġnien għat-tħawwil.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who worked the soil with a spade this morning? Toni: My father; he's preparing the garden for planting.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天早上是谁用锹翻的土？托尼：我爸爸，他在整理花园，准备种东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Min lewwaħ il-ħamrija bi spada dalgħodu?
messages.mt_standard: Min lewwaħ il-ħamrija bi spada dalgħodu?
messages.zh: 今天早上是谁用锹翻的土？
messages.en: Who worked the soil with a spade this morning?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.zh: 我爸爸，他在整理花园，准备种东西。
messages.en: My father; he's preparing the garden for planting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lewwaħ 配上一把铲子：铲沙是移动材料，拿锹翻土则对应另一个义项。

gloss_zh: 使物体弯曲的人；弯折者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who bends something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某个物体弄弯或折弯的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħawweġ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使物体弯曲的人；弯折者。

formal.mt: Il-lewwej tal-metall għawweġ il-virga skont il-kejl mogħti fit-tpinġija.
formal.en: The person bending the metal bent the rod according to the measurements given in the drawing.
formal.zh: 弯折金属的人按照图纸给出的尺寸把金属杆折弯。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-lewwej tal-wajer f'dan il-grupp? Toni: Pawlu; hu jgħawweġ il-wajer biex nagħmlu l-forom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the wire bender in this group? Toni: Pawlu; he bends the wire so we can make the shapes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个小组里谁负责弯折金属丝？托尼：保罗，他把金属丝弯好，方便我们做造型。

messages.speaker: Maja (手工小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-lewwej tal-wajer f'dan il-grupp?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-lewwej tal-wajer f'dan il-grupp?
messages.zh: 这个小组里谁负责弯折金属丝？
messages.en: Who is the wire bender in this group?

messages.speaker: Toni (手工小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu; hu jgħawweġ il-wajer biex nagħmlu l-forom.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu; hu jgħawweġ il-wajer biex nagħmlu l-forom.
messages.zh: 保罗，他把金属丝弯好，方便我们做造型。
messages.en: Pawlu; he bends the wire so we can make the shapes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 lewwej，想象一个人双手把金属丝弯成圆圈；记住这个名词指做弯折动作的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause people to argue, or to quarrel with someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人发生争吵；也指自己与他人争吵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil oħrajn jitlewmu, jew jitlewwem ma' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人争吵；引起他人争执。
争吵；与人发生口角。

collocations.en: caused the two siblings to argue
collocations.zh: 使两兄弟姐妹争吵起来

formal.mt: Il-kumment dwar il-flus lewwem liż-żewġ aħwa, li ma qablux dwar kif kellha tinqasam l-ispiża.
formal.en: The comment about money caused the two siblings to argue, as they disagreed about how the cost should be shared.
formal.zh: 那句有关钱的话引起了两兄弟姐妹的争吵，因为他们对如何分摊费用意见不一。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu lewwem ma' sieħbu? Toni: Ma qablux dwar il-logħba, imma issa reġgħu qed jitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu quarrel with his friend? Toni: They disagreed about the game, but now they're talking again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么和朋友吵架了？托尼：他们对比赛有分歧，不过现在又说上话了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么和朋友吵架了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu quarrel with his friend?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma qablux dwar il-logħba, imma issa reġgħu qed jitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Ma qablux dwar il-logħba, imma issa reġgħu qed jitkellmu.
messages.zh: 他们对比赛有分歧，不过现在又说上话了。
messages.en: They disagreed about the game, but now they're talking again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一场口角记 lewwem：一句话能使别人吵起来，一个人也能和朋友吵起来，分别对应两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something dirty, or to eat something quickly and greedily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物弄脏；也指急切地大口吃下食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħammeġ xi ħaġa, jew jiekol xi ħaġa malajr u b'regħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物弄脏。
狼吞虎咽地吃下；急切地大口吞食。

collocations.zh: 狼吞虎咽地吃光了所有食物

formal.mt: Waqt li kien qed jaħdem fil-ġnien, il-ħaddiem lewwet il-qmis bit-tajn u kellu jibdilha.
formal.en: While working in the garden, the worker dirtied his shirt with mud and had to change it.
formal.zh: 工人在花园干活时把衬衫沾上泥弄脏了，只好换一件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Toni lewwet l-ikel kollu diġà? Pawlu: Iva, kien bil-ġuħ ħafna u kiel kollox f'ħames minuti!
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Toni gobbled down all the food already? Pawlu: Yes, he was very hungry and ate everything in five minutes!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：托尼已经把吃的全都狼吞虎咽地吃光了吗？保罗：是啊，他饿坏了，五分钟就吃完了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼已经把吃的全都狼吞虎咽地吃光了吗？
messages.en: Has Toni gobbled down all the food already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien bil-ġuħ ħafna u kiel kollox f'ħames minuti!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien bil-ġuħ ħafna u kiel kollox f'ħames minuti!
messages.zh: 是啊，他饿坏了，五分钟就吃完了！
messages.en: Yes, he was very hungry and ate everything in five minutes!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 lewwet 配两张独立记忆卡：一张是泥巴弄脏衬衫，一张是饿得大口吃饭；按宾语区分义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To add almonds to food, especially sweets.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 往食物中加入杏仁，尤其指给甜食添加杏仁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żied il-lewż ma' ikel, speċjalment ma' ħelu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 添加杏仁，例如往甜食中加入杏仁。

formal.mt: Il-kok lewweż il-ħelu biex jagħtih togħma tal-lewż.
formal.en: The chef added almonds to the sweets to give them an almond flavour.
formal.zh: 厨师往甜食中加入杏仁，使其带有杏仁风味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kejk kważi lest. X'nista' nżid? Pawlu: Lewweż il-kejk biex tagħtih ftit aktar togħma.
colloquial.en: Maja: The cake is almost ready. What can I add? Pawlu: Add almonds to the cake to give it a little more flavour.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：蛋糕快做好了，还能加点什么？保罗：加些杏仁，让蛋糕的味道更丰富一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 蛋糕快做好了，还能加点什么？
messages.en: The cake is almost ready. What can I add?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lewweż il-kejk biex tagħtih ftit aktar togħma.
messages.mt_standard: Lewweż il-kejk biex tagħtih ftit aktar togħma.
messages.zh: 加些杏仁，让蛋糕的味道更丰富一点。
messages.en: Add almonds to the cake to give it a little more flavour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词配上“往蛋糕里撒杏仁”的画面，记住它表示添加杏仁这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who tends to reproach others or argue with them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常责备别人或喜欢与人争辩的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li spiss iċċanfar lil ħaddieħor jew targumenta miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱责备他人或好争辩的人。

collocations.en: a reproachful or argumentative person in the group
collocations.zh: 小组里爱责备或争辩的人

collocations.en: someone who finds fault with everything
collocations.zh: 对什么都要挑剔责备的人

formal.mt: Fil-laqgħa, il-lewwiem ikkritika kull proposta mingħajr ma offra soluzzjoni.
formal.en: At the meeting, the fault-finder criticised every proposal without offering a solution.
formal.zh: 会上，那个爱挑剔的人批评了每一项提议，却没有提出解决办法。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ħadd ma jrid jiddiskuti miegħu? Pawlu: Għax hu lewwiem; dejjem isib xi ħaġa fuq xiex jargumenta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does nobody want to discuss things with him? Pawlu: Because he is argumentative; he always finds something to argue about.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么没人愿意跟他讨论？保罗：因为他是个好争辩的人，总能找到事情来争论。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħadd ma jrid jiddiskuti miegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħadd ma jrid jiddiskuti miegħu?
messages.zh: 为什么没人愿意跟他讨论？
messages.en: Why does nobody want to discuss things with him?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
