messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu lewwiem; dejjem isib xi ħaġa fuq xiex jargumenta.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu lewwiem; dejjem isib xi ħaġa fuq xiex jargumenta.
messages.zh: 因为他是个好争辩的人，总能找到事情来争论。
messages.en: Because he is argumentative; he always finds something to argue about.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象讨论中总要责备别人、接着争论的人，把这个词牢牢记成“这样的人”这个名词。

gloss_zh: 责备的；好争吵的；好争辩的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing reproach, inclined to quarrel, or inclined to argue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容带有责备意味的，或性情上爱争吵、爱争辩的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi ċanfira, jew li għandu tendenza jiġġieled bil-kliem jew jargumenta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示责备的；带有责怪意味的。
好争吵的；容易与人发生口角的。
好争辩的；喜欢与人争论的。

collocations.zh: 好争吵或好争辩的性格

formal.mt: Fl-ittra, l-awtur juża ton lewwiemi biex jesprimi d-diżappunt tiegħu.
formal.en: In the letter, the writer uses a reproachful tone to express his disappointment.
formal.zh: 写信人在信中用责备的语气表达自己的失望。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed titkellem b'ton lewwiemi? Irrid biss nifhem x'ġara. Mark: Skużani. Ejja nitkellmu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you speaking in a reproachful tone? I just want to understand what happened. Mark: Sorry. Let's talk calmly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么用责备的语气说话？我只是想弄清发生了什么。马克：对不起，我们平静地说吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed titkellem b'ton lewwiemi? Irrid biss nifhem x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed titkellem b'ton lewwiemi? Irrid biss nifhem x'ġara.
messages.zh: 你为什么用责备的语气说话？我只是想弄清发生了什么。
messages.en: Why are you speaking in a reproachful tone? I just want to understand what happened.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 对不起，我们平静地说吧。
messages.en: Sorry. Let's talk calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三格记忆：语气在责备、相处爱争吵、讨论爱争辩；这里描述性质，属于形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who applies colour to something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给图画、物件等添加颜色或上色的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti l-kulur lil xi ħaġa, bħal disinn jew oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某物着色或上色的人。

formal.mt: Il-lewwien jagħti l-kulur lid-disinni skont l-istruzzjonijiet tal-artist.
formal.en: The colourist colours the drawings according to the artist's instructions.
formal.zh: 上色者按照艺术家的指示给图画着色。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jagħti l-kulur lil dan id-disinn? Toni: Il-lewwien se jagħmel dan wara li l-artist ilesti l-linji.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will colour this drawing? Toni: The colourist will do that after the artist finishes the lines.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁来给这幅画上色？托尼：等艺术家画完线条，上色的人就会来做。

messages.speaker: Sara (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jagħti l-kulur lil dan id-disinn?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jagħti l-kulur lil dan id-disinn?
messages.zh: 谁来给这幅画上色？
messages.en: Who will colour this drawing?

messages.speaker: Toni (指导员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-lewwien se jagħmel dan wara li l-artist ilesti l-linji.
messages.mt_standard: Il-lewwien se jagħmel dan wara li l-artist ilesti l-linji.
messages.zh: 等艺术家画完线条，上色的人就会来做。
messages.en: The colourist will do that after the artist finishes the lines.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象线稿旁拿着彩笔的人，把词和“负责上色的人”相连，记住它指人，是名词。

gloss_zh: 色彩丰富的；倾向于增添色彩的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Full of colour, or tending to add colour to something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容色彩丰富的，或倾向于为某物增添色彩的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna kuluri, jew li għandu tendenza jżid il-kulur ma' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 色彩丰富的；多彩的。
倾向于增添颜色或色彩的。

formal.mt: L-artist għażel disinn lewwieni b'ħafna kuluri għall-qoxra tal-ktieb.
formal.en: The artist chose a colourful design with many colours for the book cover.
formal.zh: 艺术家为书籍封面选用了色彩丰富、包含多种颜色的设计。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema disinn tippreferi għall-qoxra? Pawlu: Dan id-disinn lewwieni; il-kuluri tiegħu jogħġbuni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which design do you prefer for the cover? Pawlu: This colourful design; I really like its colours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：封面你更喜欢哪个设计？保罗：这个色彩丰富的设计，我很喜欢它的配色。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 封面你更喜欢哪个设计？
messages.en: Which design do you prefer for the cover?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-disinn lewwieni; il-kuluri tiegħu jogħġbuni ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-disinn lewwieni; il-kuluri tiegħu jogħġbuni ħafna.
messages.zh: 这个色彩丰富的设计，我很喜欢它的配色。
messages.en: This colourful design; I really like its colours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先看一张多彩图，再想象给画面添颜色的效果，分别记住“多彩的”和“增添色彩的”。

gloss_zh: 节省的人；用度节制的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who uses money, materials, or other resources sparingly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 花钱或使用物资等资源时注意节省、用度节制的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tuża l-flus, il-materjal jew riżorsi oħra bil-qies u tevita l-ħela.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who is sparing in their ways
sense_translations.zh_definition: 行事节省、在花费或用物方面有所节制的人。

collocations.en: a person who is sparing in spending
a person who uses water sparingly

formal.mt: Il-lewwieq jixtri biss dak li għandu bżonn u jevita l-ħela ta' flus u materjal.
formal.en: The thrifty person buys only what he needs and avoids wasting money and materials.
formal.zh: 节省的人只购买自己需要的东西，避免浪费金钱和物资。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu jixtri ħafna affarijiet? Mark: Le, hu lewwieq. Jixtri biss dak li għandu bżonn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does Pawlu buy lots of things? Mark: No, he is a thrifty person. He only buys what he needs.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗会买很多东西吗？马克：不会，他是个节省的人，只买自己需要的东西。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗会买很多东西吗？
messages.en: Does Pawlu buy lots of things?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hu lewwieq. Jixtri biss dak li għandu bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hu lewwieq. Jixtri biss dak li għandu bżonn.
messages.zh: 不会，他是个节省的人，只买自己需要的东西。
messages.en: No, he is a thrifty person. He only buys what he needs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象购物前先看清单、用水时随手关紧水龙头的人，把词记成“用度节制的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to quarrel or readily get into arguments with other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容容易与人争吵、动不动就起争执的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jiġġieled bil-kliem jew jidħol f'argumenti mal-oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱争吵的；容易与人起争执的。

collocations.zh: 一个爱与人争吵的邻居

formal.mt: Il-medjatur talab lir-raġel lewwieqi biex jitkellem bil-kalma u jħalli lill-oħrajn itemmu kliemhom.
formal.en: The mediator asked the quarrelsome man to speak calmly and let the others finish speaking.
formal.zh: 调解员请那位爱争吵的男子平静地说话，并让其他人把话说完。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx toqgħod ħdejn Pawlu? Lara: Għax hu lewwieqi; anki fuq ħaġa żgħira jibda jargumenta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want to sit next to Pawlu? Lara: Because he's quarrelsome; he starts arguing even over something small.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不想坐在保罗旁边？拉拉：因为他爱争吵，一点小事也会争起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx toqgħod ħdejn Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx toqgħod ħdejn Pawlu?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想坐在保罗旁边？
messages.en: Why don't you want to sit next to Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu lewwieqi; anki fuq ħaġa żgħira jibda jargumenta.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu lewwieqi; anki fuq ħaġa żgħira jibda jargumenta.
messages.zh: 因为他爱争吵，一点小事也会争起来。
messages.en: Because he's quarrelsome; he starts arguing even over something small.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lewwieqi 和“一点小事也要争”的人物画面绑定，记住它描述爱争吵的性格倾向。

gloss_zh: 铲料的人；用铲子作业的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who moves material with a shovel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用铲子铲起、搬移沙土等材料的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiġbor jew iċċaqlaq materjal bil-pala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用铲子铲料或搬移物料的人。

formal.mt: Il-lewwieħ ġabar ir-ramel bil-pala u tefgħu fil-karrettun.
formal.en: The shoveller scooped up the sand with a shovel and put it into the cart.
formal.zh: 铲沙的人用铲子铲起沙子，把沙子装进小车。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min se jċaqlaq dan ir-ramel? Toni: Il-lewwieħ se jpoġġih fil-karrettun bil-pala.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is going to move this sand? Toni: The shoveller will put it into the cart with a shovel.
colloquial.zh: 马克：谁来搬这些沙子？托尼：铲沙的人会用铲子把沙子装进小车。

messages.speaker: Mark (工友)
messages.zh: 谁来搬这些沙子？
messages.en: Who is going to move this sand?

messages.speaker: Toni (工友)
messages.zh: 铲沙的人会用铲子把沙子装进小车。
messages.en: The shoveller will put it into the cart with a shovel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位拿铲子铲沙的工人，把整个词记成“做铲料工作的人”，注意这是名词。

gloss_zh: 倾向于铲动的；有推冲作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to shovel, or producing a thrusting effect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容倾向于用铲子铲动的，或能够产生推冲作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza li juża l-pala, jew li għandu effett ta' spinta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于用铲子铲动的。
具有推冲作用的；能产生推力效果的。

collocations.zh: 倾向于用铲子作业的工人

formal.mt: Il-mekkaniżmu jipproduċi moviment lewwieħi li jimbotta l-materjal 'il quddiem.
formal.en: The mechanism produces a thrusting movement that pushes the material forwards.
formal.zh: 该机构产生推冲运动，将材料向前推动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-materjal miexi 'l quddiem? Mark: Dan il-moviment lewwieħi qed jimbuttah.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the material moving forwards? Mark: This thrusting movement is pushing it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：材料为什么在往前移动？马克：这个推冲运动正在推动它。

messages.speaker: Maja (学员)
messages.zh: 材料为什么在往前移动？
messages.en: Why is the material moving forwards?

messages.speaker: Mark (指导员)
messages.zh: 这个推冲运动正在推动它。
messages.en: This thrusting movement is pushing it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅动作图分别记忆：一幅是倾向于拿铲子铲动，另一幅是向前推冲；两义都是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small quantity of something, including an amount that can be held in one hand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物的少量，也可指一只手能抓起或握住的一把。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwantità żgħira ta' xi ħaġa, jew daqs kemm wieħed jista' jżomm f'idu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 少量；一点。
一把；一只手能抓起或握住的量。

formal.mt: Żid lewħ dqiq mal-għaġina u ħawwad sakemm it-taħlita tkun lixxa.
formal.en: Add a small quantity of flour to the dough and mix until the mixture is smooth.
formal.zh: 往面团中加入少量面粉，搅拌至均匀顺滑。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm ross inżid mas-soppa? Marija: Żid lewħ ross biss; diġà hemm ħafna ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Nina: How much rice should I add to the soup? Marija: Add just a handful of rice; there's already plenty of vegetables.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：汤里要加多少米？玛丽亚：只加一把米就好，里面已经有很多蔬菜了。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 汤里要加多少米？
messages.en: How much rice should I add to the soup?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Żid lewħ ross biss; diġà hemm ħafna ħaxix.
messages.mt_standard: Żid lewħ ross biss; diġà hemm ħafna ħaxix.
messages.zh: 只加一把米就好，里面已经有很多蔬菜了。
messages.en: Add just a handful of rice; there's already plenty of vegetables.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 lewħ 时想象手心里的一小把米：先抓住“量少”的感觉，再联系“一把”的手掌画面；它不是固定的克数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an almond-like shape, broader in the middle and narrower towards the ends.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状像杏仁的，通常中间较宽、两端较窄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma bħal lewża, usa' fin-nofs u idjaq lejn it-truf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杏仁形的；形状像杏仁的。

formal.mt: Il-mudell għandu kontorn lewżi, usa' fin-nofs u idjaq fiż-żewġt itruf.
formal.en: The model has an almond-shaped outline, broader in the middle and narrower at both ends.
formal.zh: 这个模型的轮廓呈杏仁形，中间较宽，两端较窄。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Liema disinn trid għall-ornament? Rita: Irrid disinn lewżi, qisu lewża żgħira.
colloquial.en: Mark: What design do you want for the ornament? Rita: I want an almond-shaped design, like a little almond.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个装饰品你想用什么形状的设计？丽塔：我想要杏仁形的，像一颗小杏仁。

messages.speaker: Mark (手工艺人)
messages.zh: 这个装饰品你想用什么形状的设计？
messages.en: What design do you want for the ornament?

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid disinn lewżi, qisu lewża żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid disinn lewżi, qisu lewża żgħira.
messages.zh: 我想要杏仁形的，像一颗小杏仁。
messages.en: I want an almond-shaped design, like a little almond.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 lewżi 就在脑中画一颗杏仁：中间鼓、两头收，借轮廓记住“杏仁形的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person learned in law, especially someone who studies or interprets legal principles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 精通法律、研究或阐释法律原则的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna esperta fil-liġi li tistudja jew tinterpreta l-prinċipji legali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法学家；精通法律及其原理的学者。

collocations.en: the opinion of a legal scholar

formal.mt: Il-leġista analizza t-test tal-liġi u spjega l-prinċipji li fuqhom kienet mibnija. L-analiżi tiegħu ġiet diskussa fis-seminar.
formal.en: The legal scholar analysed the text of the law and explained the principles on which it was based. His analysis was discussed at the seminar.
formal.zh: 这位法学家分析了法律文本，并解释了其依据的原则。研讨会上讨论了他的分析。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jispjegalna dan it-test legali? Toni: Se jiġi leġista li jistudja dan is-suġġett.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will explain this legal text to us? Toni: A legal scholar who studies this subject is coming.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：谁来给我们解释这份法律文本？托尼：会来一位研究这个课题的法学家。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jispjegalna dan it-test legali?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jispjegalna dan it-test legali?
messages.zh: 谁来给我们解释这份法律文本？
messages.en: Who will explain this legal text to us?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Se jiġi leġista li jistudja dan is-suġġett.
messages.mt_standard: Se jiġi leġista li jistudja dan is-suġġett.
messages.zh: 会来一位研究这个课题的法学家。
messages.en: A legal scholar who studies this subject is coming.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leġista 想成坐在法律书旁解释条文的学者，用“研究法律的人”这一画面记忆。

gloss_zh: 立法的；与制定法律有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the making of laws or to the institutions and procedures involved in making them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与制定法律有关的，或涉及立法机构及立法程序的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mat-tfassil u l-approvazzjoni tal-liġijiet jew mal-istituzzjonijiet u l-proċeduri involuti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 立法的；有关法律制定或立法机关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-proċess leġiżlattiv mill-preżentazzjoni tal-abbozz sal-approvazzjoni tiegħu. Kull stadju huwa deskritt separatament.
formal.en: The report explains the legislative process from the presentation of the bill to its approval. Each stage is described separately.
formal.zh: 报告解释了从提交法案到法案获准通过的立法程序，并分别介绍了每个阶段。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex il-proposta għadha ma saritx liġi? David: Għadha għaddejja mill-proċess leġiżlattiv.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why hasn't the proposal become law yet? David: It is still going through the legislative process.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这项提案为什么还没有成为法律？戴维：它还在走立法程序。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-proposta għadha ma saritx liġi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-proposta għadha ma saritx liġi?
messages.zh: 这项提案为什么还没有成为法律？
messages.en: Why hasn't the proposal become law yet?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 它还在走立法程序。
messages.en: It is still going through the legislative process.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住搭配 proċess leġiżlattiv“立法程序”，让这个词跟在名词后面表示“与立法有关的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes laws, especially a member of a body with the authority to pass them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与制定法律的人，尤指有权通过法律的机构的成员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel il-liġijiet, speċjalment membru ta' korp li għandu s-setgħa japprovahom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 立法者；参与制定和通过法律的立法机关成员。

collocations.zh: 经选举产生的立法机关成员

formal.mt: Il-leġiżlatur ippropona emenda għall-abbozz ta' liġi. Huwa spjega kif il-bidla kienet se tagħmel it-test aktar ċar.
formal.en: The legislator proposed an amendment to the bill. He explained how the change would make the text clearer.
formal.zh: 这位立法机关成员提出了法案修正案，并解释了该项修改将如何使文本更加清晰。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Nistgħu nitkellmu ma' leġiżlatur dwar din il-proposta? Mark: Iva, nistgħu nitolbu laqgħa u nispjegaw it-tħassib tagħna.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can we speak to a legislator about this proposal? Mark: Yes, we can request a meeting and explain our concerns.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我们能就这项提案和一位立法机关成员谈谈吗？马克：可以，我们可以申请会面，说明我们的顾虑。

messages.speaker: Rita (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nitkellmu ma' leġiżlatur dwar din il-proposta?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nitkellmu ma' leġiżlatur dwar din il-proposta?
messages.zh: 我们能就这项提案和一位立法机关成员谈谈吗？
messages.en: Can we speak to a legislator about this proposal?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu nitolbu laqgħa u nispjegaw it-tħassib tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu nitolbu laqgħa u nispjegaw it-tħassib tagħna.
messages.zh: 可以，我们可以申请会面，说明我们的顾虑。
messages.en: Yes, we can request a meeting and explain our concerns.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leġiżlatur 配上“一位议员举手表决法案”的画面，重点记住它指参与立法的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The body of representatives with the authority to make and pass laws.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由代表组成、拥有制定和通过法律权力的机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-korp ta' rappreżentanti li għandu s-setgħa jfassal u japprova l-liġijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 立法机关；拥有制定和通过法律职权的代表机构。

formal.mt: Il-leġiżlatura eżaminat l-abbozz ta' liġi qabel il-vot finali. Il-membri tagħha ddiskutew l-emendi proposti.
formal.en: The legislature examined the bill before the final vote. Its members discussed the proposed amendments.
formal.zh: 立法机关在最终表决前审议了法案，其成员讨论了所提出的修正案。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Min se jivvota fuq dan l-abbozz ta' liġi? Omar: Il-membri tal-leġiżlatura, wara li jiddiskutuh.
colloquial.en: Lina: Who will vote on this bill? Omar: The members of the legislature, after they discuss it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：谁来对这项法案进行表决？奥马尔：立法机关的成员，他们会先进行讨论。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jivvota fuq dan l-abbozz ta' liġi?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jivvota fuq dan l-abbozz ta' liġi?
messages.zh: 谁来对这项法案进行表决？
messages.en: Who will vote on this bill?

messages.speaker: Omar (老师)
messages.zh: 立法机关的成员，他们会先进行讨论。
messages.en: The members of the legislature, after they discuss it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象整座议会大厅和其中的代表，把 leġiżlatura 记成拥有立法职权的整个机构。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Laws considered collectively, or the process of making and passing laws.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 法律法规的总称，也指制定和通过法律的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-liġijiet meqjusa flimkien, jew il-proċess tat-tfassil u l-approvazzjoni tal-liġijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 立法；制定法律的过程，也可统指相关法律法规。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-leġiżlazzjoni dwar il-protezzjoni tal-konsumatur. Huwa jidentifika wkoll oqsma fejn hemm bżonn ta' regoli aktar ċari.
formal.en: The report examines legislation on consumer protection. It also identifies areas where clearer rules are needed.
formal.zh: 报告审视了消费者保护方面的法律法规，也指出了哪些领域需要更清晰的规定。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Din il-leġiżlazzjoni ġdida tapplika wkoll għall-ħwienet żgħar? Karl: Ejja naqraw it-test flimkien biex naraw eżatt għal min tapplika.
colloquial.en: Emma: Does this new legislation also apply to small shops? Karl: Let's read the text together to see exactly whom it applies to.
colloquial.zh: 埃玛：这些新法律法规也适用于小商店吗？卡尔：我们一起读读条文，看看究竟适用于哪些人。

messages.speaker: Emma (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-leġiżlazzjoni ġdida tapplika wkoll għall-ħwienet żgħar?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-leġiżlazzjoni ġdida tapplika wkoll għall-ħwienet żgħar?
messages.zh: 这些新法律法规也适用于小商店吗？
messages.en: Does this new legislation also apply to small shops?

messages.speaker: Karl (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqraw it-test flimkien biex naraw eżatt għal min tapplika.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqraw it-test flimkien biex naraw eżatt għal min tapplika.
messages.zh: 我们一起读读条文，看看究竟适用于哪些人。
messages.en: Let's read the text together to see exactly whom it applies to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leġiżlazzjoni 联想到桌上一整套法律文件，再联系这些规定被制定出来的过程，记住两个相关用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large military unit consisting of many soldiers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由许多士兵组成的大型军事单位，即军团。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità militari kbira magħmula minn ħafna suldati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 军团；由大量士兵组成的军事单位。

collocations.zh: 一个由士兵组成的军团

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kmandant ordna lil-leġjun biex jipproteġi l-belt.
formal.en: In the story, the commander ordered the legion to protect the city.
formal.zh: 在故事中，指挥官命令军团保护这座城市。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min huma dawk is-suldati kollha fl-istampa? Mark: Huma parti minn leġjun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who are all those soldiers in the picture? Mark: They are part of a legion.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图片里那么多士兵是什么人？马克：他们属于一个军团。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min huma dawk is-suldati kollha fl-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: Min huma dawk is-suldati kollha fl-istampa?
messages.zh: 图片里那么多士兵是什么人？
messages.en: Who are all those soldiers in the picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 他们属于一个军团。
messages.en: They are part of a legion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 leġjun 和英语 legion 对照记忆，脑中想象整支军团列队行进，重点记它表示集体单位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soldier who belongs to a legion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 隶属于某个军团的士兵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suldat li jagħmel parti minn leġjun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 军团士兵；军团中的一名成员。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, leġjunarju baqa' għassa ħdejn il-bieb tal-kamp.
formal.en: In the story, a legionary remained on guard beside the camp gate.
formal.zh: 在故事中，一名军团士兵留在营地大门旁站岗。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dak ir-raġel fil-film? Pawlu: Hu leġjunarju, suldat f'leġjun.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is that man in the film? Pawlu: He is a legionary, a soldier in a legion.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：电影里那个男人是什么人？保罗：他是军团士兵，也就是军团中的一名士兵。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里那个男人是什么人？
messages.en: Who is that man in the film?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他是军团士兵，也就是军团中的一名士兵。
messages.en: He is a legionary, a soldier in a legion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 leġjun 的整支军团画面缩小到其中一名士兵，用 leġjunarju 记这个具体的人；这是词义对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shine or gleam by giving off or reflecting light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出或反射光亮，呈现闪耀的样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddi jew jagħti dehra ta' tleqqija billi joħroġ jew jirrifletti d-dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发光；照耀。
闪着亮光；呈现明亮的光泽。

formal.mt: Id-deheb leġġeġ taħt id-dawl tal-mużew. It-tleqqija tiegħu ġibdet l-attenzjoni tal-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The gold gleamed under the museum lighting. Its brilliance attracted the visitors' attention.
formal.zh: 黄金在博物馆的灯光下闪耀。它的光泽吸引了参观者的注意。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt kif leġġeġ iċ-ċurkett fix-xemx? Nina: Iva, malli dawwart idi beda jidher ħafna aktar ileqq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see how the ring gleamed in the sun? Nina: Yes, as soon as I turned my hand it looked much shinier.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你看到戒指刚才在阳光下怎么闪了吗？妮娜：看到了，我一转手，它就显得亮多了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到戒指刚才在阳光下怎么闪了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how the ring gleamed in the sun?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, malli dawwart idi beda jidher ħafna aktar ileqq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, malli dawwart idi beda jidher ħafna aktar ileqq.
messages.zh: 看到了，我一转手，它就显得亮多了。
messages.en: Yes, as soon as I turned my hand it looked much shinier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象戒指转向阳光时突然闪亮，把 leġġeġ 与“发光、闪耀”的动作一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To emit repeated brief flashes of light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接连发出短暂的亮光，反复闪烁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti sensiela ta' teptip jew dawl qasir, darba wara oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复闪光；接连发出短促的亮光。

formal.mt: Matul il-prova, id-dawl aħmar leħħeħ għal ftit sekondi biex juri li s-sistema kienet qed taħdem.
formal.en: During the test, the red light flashed repeatedly for a few seconds to show that the system was working.
formal.zh: 测试期间，红灯连续闪烁了几秒钟，表明系统正在运行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt id-dawl ħdejn il-bieb? Pawlu: Iva, leħħeħ għal ftit u mbagħad intefa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see the light next to the door? Pawlu: Yes, it flashed repeatedly for a little while and then went out.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看见门旁边的灯了吗？保罗：看见了，闪了一阵子，然后就灭了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你看见门旁边的灯了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the light next to the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, leħħeħ għal ftit u mbagħad intefa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, leħħeħ għal ftit u mbagħad intefa.
messages.zh: 看见了，闪了一阵子，然后就灭了。
messages.en: Yes, it flashed repeatedly for a little while and then went out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 leħħeħ 就想象指示灯“亮、灭、亮、灭”的连续画面，重点记住反复闪光这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of wrapping something in paper, cloth, or another covering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用纸、布或其他材料把物品包起来的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li ddawwar xi ħaġa b'karta, drapp jew materjal ieħor biex tgħattiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包裹；用材料把物品包起来的动作或过程。

formal.mt: Il-lfif tar-rigali għandu jsir b'attenzjoni sabiex il-karta ma titqattax u l-pakketti jingħalqu sew.
formal.en: Gift wrapping should be done carefully so that the paper does not tear and the packages are properly closed.
formal.zh: 包装礼物时应仔细操作，避免包装纸撕裂，并确保包裹封好。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tgħinni fil-lfif tar-rigali llejla? Ben: Żgur, inti aqta' l-karta u jien norbot iż-żigarelli.
colloquial.en: Sara: Will you help me with the gift wrapping tonight? Ben: Sure, you cut the paper and I'll tie the ribbons.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今晚你能帮我包装礼物吗？本：当然，你来剪纸，我来系丝带。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚你能帮我包装礼物吗？
messages.en: Will you help me with the gift wrapping tonight?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, inti aqta' l-karta u jien norbot iż-żigarelli.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, inti aqta' l-karta u jien norbot iż-żigarelli.
messages.zh: 当然，你来剪纸，我来系丝带。
messages.en: Sure, you cut the paper and I'll tie the ribbons.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lfif 配上“纸张绕住礼物”的连续动作，重点记它表示包裹的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Crying with repeated, interrupted breaths, often because of sadness or distress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因悲伤或难受而哭泣，呼吸断断续续、一抽一抽的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biki b'nifs imqatta', spiss minħabba dwejjaq jew tbatija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽泣；伴随断续吸气的哭泣。

formal.mt: Bejn lfiq u ieħor, it-tifel spjega lill-għalliema li kien tilef il-kelb tiegħu.
formal.en: Between sobs, the boy explained to the teacher that he had lost his dog.
formal.zh: 男孩抽抽噎噎地向老师解释，他把自己的狗弄丢了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Smajt il-lfiq fil-kamra; kollox sew? Marija: Iva, it-tifla kienet imbeżżgħa, imma issa waqfet tibki.
colloquial.en: Anna: I heard sobbing in the room; is everything all right? Marija: Yes, the girl was frightened, but she has stopped crying now.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我听见房间里有人抽泣，一切都好吗？玛丽亚：没事，小女孩刚才受了惊，现在已经不哭了。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 我听见房间里有人抽泣，一切都好吗？
messages.en: I heard sobbing in the room; is everything all right?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tifla kienet imbeżżgħa, imma issa waqfet tibki.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tifla kienet imbeżżgħa, imma issa waqfet tibki.
messages.zh: 没事，小女孩刚才受了惊，现在已经不哭了。
messages.en: Yes, the girl was frightened, but she has stopped crying now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 lfiq 时想象哭声被吸气打断的节奏：“哭一下、吸一下”，对应中文的抽泣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of passing the tongue over a surface, food, or part of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用舌头接触或扫过物体表面、食物或身体部位的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tgħaddi l-ilsien fuq wiċċ xi ħaġa, fuq l-ikel jew fuq parti tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舔；用舌头舔舐的动作。

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni dwar l-iġjene, l-għalliema spjegat li l-lgħaq tas-swaba' għandu jiġi evitat meta wieħed ikun qed iħejji l-ikel.
formal.en: During the hygiene lesson, the teacher explained that licking one's fingers should be avoided when preparing food.
formal.zh: 在卫生课上，老师说明准备食物时应避免舔手指。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-lgħaq tas-swaba' mhux meħtieġ; hawn srievet ħdejk. Ben: Sewwa, se nimsaħ idejja bis-srievet.
colloquial.en: Marija: There's no need to lick your fingers; there are napkins next to you. Ben: All right, I'll wipe my hands with the napkins.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：不用舔手指，你旁边有餐巾。本：好，我用餐巾擦手。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-lgħaq tas-swaba' mhux meħtieġ; hawn srievet ħdejk.
messages.mt_standard: Il-lgħaq tas-swaba' mhux meħtieġ; hawn srievet ħdejk.
messages.zh: 不用舔手指，你旁边有餐巾。
messages.en: There's no need to lick your fingers; there are napkins next to you.

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 好，我用餐巾擦手。
messages.en: All right, I'll wipe my hands with the napkins.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lgħaq 记成一段舌头扫过嘴唇的小动画，强调这是“舔舐这一动作”的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of uttering curses against someone or something, often in anger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常因愤怒而对某人或某事说出诅咒、咒骂之语的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tgħid kliem ta' saħta kontra xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, spiss minħabba r-rabja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诅咒；说出咒骂之语的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif id-diskussjoni ntemmet b'lgħin u theddid minflok bi ftehim bejn iż-żewġ naħat.
formal.en: The report describes how the discussion ended in cursing and threats instead of an agreement between the two sides.
formal.zh: 报告描述了讨论如何以咒骂和威胁告终，双方未能达成协议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tlaqt minn ħdejn il-bieb? Lara: Għax beda l-lgħin u ma ridtx nibqa' nisma' dak il-kliem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you move away from the door? Lara: Because the cursing started, and I didn't want to keep listening to that language.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么从门边走开了？拉拉：因为有人开始咒骂，我不想继续听那些话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么从门边走开了？
messages.en: Why did you move away from the door?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax beda l-lgħin u ma ridtx nibqa' nisma' dak il-kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax beda l-lgħin u ma ridtx nibqa' nisma' dak il-kliem.
messages.zh: 因为有人开始咒骂，我不想继续听那些话。
messages.en: Because the cursing started, and I didn't want to keep listening to that language.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lgħin 和愤怒人物嘴边的咒骂气泡联系起来，记住它指说出诅咒之语的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inspiration that gives someone an idea or stimulates creative thought.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人产生想法或激发创作思路的灵感、启发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ispirazzjoni li tagħti idea lil xi ħadd jew tqanqal il-ħsieb kreattiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灵感；促使人产生新想法或进行创作的启发。

formal.mt: Għall-poeta, il-baħar kien sors ta' lhim għall-ġabra l-ġdida.
formal.en: For the poet, the sea was a source of inspiration for the new collection.
formal.zh: 对这位诗人而言，大海是创作新诗集的灵感来源。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ġibt il-lhim għal din il-poeżija? Mark: Minn mixja ħdejn il-baħar. Hemm ġietni l-idea.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you get the inspiration for this poem? Mark: From a walk by the sea. That's where the idea came to me.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这首诗的灵感是从哪里来的？Mark：来自一次海边散步。我就是在那里想到的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġibt il-lhim għal din il-poeżija?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġibt il-lhim għal din il-poeżija?
messages.zh: 这首诗的灵感是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where did you get the inspiration for this poem?

messages.speaker: Mark (诗人)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn mixja ħdejn il-baħar. Hemm ġietni l-idea.
messages.mt_standard: Minn mixja ħdejn il-baħar. Hemm ġietni l-idea.
messages.zh: 来自一次海边散步。我就是在那里想到的。
messages.en: From a walk by the sea. That's where the idea came to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把海边散步时突然想到一句诗的画面当作记忆钩子：脑中冒出的创作火花就是灵感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Heavy or laboured breathing, including wheezing or panting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 粗重或费力的呼吸，可指带有喘鸣声的呼吸，也可指运动后急促喘气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nifs tqil jew bi tbatija, li jista' jkun mgħaġġel jew ikollu tisfir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗重的呼吸；明显费力或声音较重的呼吸。
喘鸣；呼吸时发出类似哨音的声音。
气喘；急促地喘气，尤指运动或用力之后。

formal.mt: Wara l-ġirja, l-atleta kellu lhiġ qawwi u waqaf biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: After the run, the athlete was panting heavily and stopped to rest.
formal.zh: 跑步后，这名运动员喘得很厉害，便停下来休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek dan il-lhiġ kollu? Mark: Għadni kif tlajt it-taraġ niġri. Ħa nistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you panting so much? Mark: I've just run up the stairs. Let me rest a little.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么喘得这么厉害？Mark：我刚跑着上楼。让我歇一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么喘得这么厉害？
messages.en: Why are you panting so much?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni kif tlajt it-taraġ niġri. Ħa nistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni kif tlajt it-taraġ niġri. Ħa nistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 我刚跑着上楼。让我歇一会儿。
messages.en: I've just run up the stairs. Let me rest a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象跑上楼后扶着栏杆喘气，把这个词连到呼吸粗重、急促或带哨音的共同画面。

gloss_zh: 关系代词：谁、……的；连词：引出“……这件事”

teaching_sense.en_definition: A relative pronoun introducing a clause that identifies or describes a person or thing, corresponding to who, which, or that.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引导关系从句，说明前面的某个人或事物，相当于英语的 who、which 或 that；汉语常译为“……的”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pronom relattiv li jintroduċi sentenza li tidentifika jew tiddeskrivi persuna jew ħaġa msemmija qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关系代词，指代前文的人或事物并引出说明，汉语通常用“……的”表达。
连词，引出陈述内容的从句，相当于英语 that；汉语常不单独译出。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ikkonferma li d-dokument li rċieva kien komplut.
formal.en: The committee confirmed that the document which it had received was complete.
formal.zh: 委员会确认，收到的文件是完整的。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-ktieb li selliftek? Mark: Naħseb li qiegħed fuq il-mejda. Ħa niċċekkja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the book that I lent you? Mark: I think it's on the table. Let me check.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我借给你的那本书在哪里？Mark：我想在桌上。我看看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我借给你的那本书在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the book that I lent you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li qiegħed fuq il-mejda. Ħa niċċekkja.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li qiegħed fuq il-mejda. Ħa niċċekkja.
messages.zh: 我想在桌上。我看看。
messages.en: I think it's on the table. Let me check.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 li 想成连接句子的细线：接在名词后常组成“……的”，接在“我想、我知道”后则引出所想所知的内容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ritual pouring of a liquid, such as wine, as an offering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在仪式中倒出酒等液体作为供献的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tferrigħ ta' likwidu, bħall-inbid, bħala offerta waqt rit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奠酒；在仪式中倾倒酒等液体作为供献。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi libazzjoni li fiha jitferra' ftit inbid bħala offerta.
formal.en: The text describes a libation in which a little wine is poured out as an offering.
formal.zh: 这篇文字描述了一次奠酒：倒出少量葡萄酒作为供献。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'inhi libazzjoni? Pawlu: Meta jitferra' likwidu, bħal ftit inbid, bħala offerta waqt rit.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is a libation? Pawlu: It is when a liquid, such as a little wine, is poured out as an offering during a ritual.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：什么是奠酒？保罗：就是在仪式中倒出液体，例如少量葡萄酒，作为供献。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是奠酒？
messages.en: What is a libation?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta jitferra' likwidu, bħal ftit inbid, bħala offerta waqt rit.
messages.mt_standard: Meta jitferra' likwidu, bħal ftit inbid, bħala offerta waqt rit.
messages.zh: 就是在仪式中倒出液体，例如少量葡萄酒，作为供献。
messages.en: It is when a liquid, such as a little wine, is poured out as an offering during a ritual.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象仪式中把少量酒倒出供献的画面，将这个词与“奠酒”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To run away suddenly, for example because of fear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然跑开或逃走，例如因受到惊吓而逃离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħrab tiġri f'daqqa, pereżempju minħabba l-biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跑开；逃走，例如因害怕而惊逃。
因害怕而畏缩、蜷缩或躲避。

sense_translations.en_definition: to ride a horse at speed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 骑马疾驰；快速策马前行。

collocations.en: ran off as soon as he heard the noise

formal.mt: Skont ir-rakkont, it-tifel libbet malli sema' ħoss qawwi fil-bitħa.
formal.en: According to the account, the boy ran off as soon as he heard a loud noise in the courtyard.
formal.zh: 据叙述，男孩一听见院子里传来巨响就跑开了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex libbet it-tifel? Mark: Beża' mill-kelb, imma issa qiegħed ma' ommu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the boy run off? Mark: He was frightened of the dog, but now he is with his mother.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男孩为什么跑开了？马克：他怕那只狗，不过现在已经和妈妈在一起了。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 那个男孩为什么跑开了？
messages.en: Why did the boy run off?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Beża' mill-kelb, imma issa qiegħed ma' ommu.
messages.mt_standard: Beża' mill-kelb, imma issa qiegħed ma' ommu.
messages.zh: 他怕那只狗，不过现在已经和妈妈在一起了。
messages.en: He was frightened of the dog, but now he is with his mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个独立画面记义：受惊跑开、害怕畏缩、骑马疾驰；阅读时靠上下文选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who dresses, especially when describing how that person dresses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿衣着装的人，尤其用于描述某人的穿着方式或风格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tilbes, speċjalment meta jiġi deskritt kif tilbes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿衣着装的人；可用于说明某人如何穿着。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-karattru bħala libbies eleganti li jagħżel ħwejġu b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: The author describes the character as an elegant dresser who chooses his clothes carefully.
formal.zh: 作者将这个人物描写成一个穿着优雅、认真挑选衣服的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk dejjem jidher pulit. Mark: Iva, hu libbies eleganti, anki meta joħroġ għal kafè.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your brother always looks neat. Mark: Yes, he is an elegant dresser, even when he goes out for coffee.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥看起来总是很整洁。马克：是啊，他很会穿衣，连出门喝咖啡都穿得很优雅。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥看起来总是很整洁。
messages.en: Your brother always looks neat.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu libbies eleganti, anki meta joħroġ għal kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu libbies eleganti, anki meta joħroġ għal kafè.
messages.zh: 是啊，他很会穿衣，连出门喝咖啡都穿得很优雅。
messages.en: Yes, he is an elegant dresser, even when he goes out for coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词记作“穿衣的人”，再配上“优雅、整洁”等形容词，描述人的着装。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of freeing someone or something from control, confinement, or oppression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物摆脱控制、拘禁或压迫，获得自由的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih persuna jew xi ħaġa tinħeles mill-kontroll, mill-priġunerija jew mill-oppressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解放；使摆脱控制、拘禁或压迫而获得自由。

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jiddeskrivi l-liberazzjoni ta' komunità mill-oppressjoni.
formal.en: The novel describes a community's liberation from oppression.
formal.zh: 这部小说描写了一个群体摆脱压迫、获得解放的过程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fuq xiex inhu l-ktieb? Luqa: Fuq il-liberazzjoni ta' nies li kienu miżmuma priġunieri.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is the book about? Luqa: It is about the liberation of people who were being held prisoner.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这本书讲什么？卢卡：讲一群被囚禁的人获得解放的故事。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is the book about?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-liberazzjoni ta' nies li kienu miżmuma priġunieri.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-liberazzjoni ta' nies li kienu miżmuma priġunieri.
messages.zh: 讲一群被囚禁的人获得解放的故事。
messages.en: It is about the liberation of people who were being held prisoner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象牢门打开、人们走向自由的画面，把整个词与“解放的过程”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in West Africa on the Atlantic Ocean, with Monrovia as its capital.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于西非、濒临大西洋的国家，首都是蒙罗维亚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent, fuq l-Oċean Atlantiku, bil-belt kapitali Monrovia.

sense_translations.en_definition: Liberia (a country in West Africa, on the Atlantic Ocean, with Monrovia as its capital; official name: Repubblika tal-Liberja)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 利比里亚，位于西非大西洋沿岸的国家，首都为蒙罗维亚；正式名称为利比里亚共和国。

formal.mt: Il-Liberja tinsab fl-Afrika tal-Punent, fuq l-Oċean Atlantiku, u l-kapitali tagħha hija Monrovia.
formal.en: Liberia is in West Africa, on the Atlantic Ocean, and its capital is Monrovia.
formal.zh: 利比里亚位于西非，濒临大西洋，首都是蒙罗维亚。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn tinsab il-Liberja fuq il-mappa? Pawlu: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent, ħdejn l-Oċean Atlantiku.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where is Liberia on the map? Pawlu: In West Africa, beside the Atlantic Ocean.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：利比里亚在地图上的什么位置？保罗：在西非，靠着大西洋。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 利比里亚在地图上的什么位置？
messages.en: Where is Liberia on the map?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 在西非，靠着大西洋。
messages.en: In West Africa, beside the Atlantic Ocean.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Liberja 与“西非、大西洋、蒙罗维亚”三项一起记，并留意它比 Libja 多出 er。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The right to express what one thinks without fear of being harmed for speaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达自己想法而不必因发言受到伤害、为此担惊受怕的权利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dritt li tesprimi dak li taħseb mingħajr biża' li ssirlek ħsara minħabba dak li tgħid.

sense_translations.en_definition: freedom of speech, free speech (right to speak without fear of harm)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 言论自由；能够发言、表达意见而不必担心因此受到伤害的权利。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jenfasizza l-importanza tal-libertà tal-kelma biex in-nies ikunu jistgħu jesprimu l-opinjonijiet tagħhom mingħajr biża'.
formal.en: The article emphasizes the importance of freedom of speech so that people can express their opinions without fear.
formal.zh: 文章强调言论自由的重要性，使人们能够无所畏惧地表达自己的意见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma naqbilx ma' dak li qal. Mark: Lanqas jien, imma nirrispetta l-libertà tal-kelma tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: I disagree with what he said. Mark: So do I, but I respect his freedom of speech.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我不同意他说的话。马克：我也不同意，不过我尊重他的言论自由。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma naqbilx ma' dak li qal.
messages.mt_standard: Ma naqbilx ma' dak li qal.
messages.zh: 我不同意他说的话。
messages.en: I disagree with what he said.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lanqas jien, imma nirrispetta l-libertà tal-kelma tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Lanqas jien, imma nirrispetta l-libertà tal-kelma tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我也不同意，不过我尊重他的言论自由。
messages.en: So do I, but I respect his freedom of speech.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“表达意见而不必害怕受伤害”的场景记住整条短语，固定对应“言论自由”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in North Africa, officially named the State of Libya.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于北非的国家，正式名称为利比亚国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika ta' Fuq, bl-isem uffiċjali Stat tal-Libja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Libya (a country in North Africa; official name: Stat tal-Libja)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 利比亚，位于北非的国家；正式名称为利比亚国。

formal.mt: Il-Libja hija pajjiż fl-Afrika ta' Fuq, u l-isem uffiċjali tagħha huwa Stat tal-Libja.
formal.en: Libya is a country in North Africa, and its official name is the State of Libya.
formal.zh: 利比亚是北非国家，正式名称为利比亚国。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-Libja tinsab fl-Afrika ta' Fuq? Luqa: Iva. Ejja nsibuha fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is Libya in North Africa? Luqa: Yes. Let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：利比亚在北非吗？卢卡：是的。我们在地图上找找它吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 利比亚在北非吗？
messages.en: Is Libya in North Africa?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.zh: 是的。我们在地图上找找它吧。
messages.en: Yes. Let's find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把较短的 Libja 与“北非利比亚”一起记，再与较长的西非国家名 Liberja 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pass the tongue over something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用舌头接触并掠过某物的表面，即舔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaddi lsienek minn fuq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舔；用舌头接触并掠过物体表面。
阿谀奉承；为了讨好别人而刻意吹捧或逢迎。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel liegħaq il-ġelat qabel ma beda jdub.
formal.en: In the story, the boy licked the ice cream before it began to melt.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩在冰淇淋开始融化之前舔了舔它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jidħak it-tifel? Mark: Il-kelb liegħaq il-ġelat tiegħu!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the boy laughing? Mark: The dog licked his ice cream!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男孩为什么在笑？马克：狗舔了他的冰淇淋！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男孩为什么在笑？
messages.en: Why is the boy laughing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 狗舔了他的冰淇淋！
messages.en: The dog licked his ice cream!

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“舔冰淇淋”记住具体动作，再另记“阿谀奉承”的人物场景，依上下文区分两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone an idea, creative inspiration, or motivation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给人以启发，激发创作灵感或行动的动力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lil xi ħadd idea, ispirazzjoni jew ħeġġa biex jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 启发；激发灵感或鼓舞行动。

formal.mt: Il-pajsaġġ tal-gżira liehem lill-poeta biex jikteb ġabra ġdida ta' poeżiji.
formal.en: The island's landscape inspired the poet to write a new collection of poems.
formal.zh: 岛上的景色激发了诗人的灵感，促使他创作了一部新的诗集。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'liehem lil ħuk biex jikteb din il-kanzunetta? Nina: Vjaġġ qasir ħdejn il-baħar tah l-idea.
colloquial.en: Sara: What inspired your brother to write this song? Nina: A short trip by the sea gave him the idea.
colloquial.zh: Sara：是什么启发你哥哥写了这首歌？Nina：一次短暂的海边旅行给了他灵感。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'liehem lil ħuk biex jikteb din il-kanzunetta?
messages.mt_standard: X'liehem lil ħuk biex jikteb din il-kanzunetta?
messages.zh: 是什么启发你哥哥写了这首歌？
messages.en: What inspired your brother to write this song?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Vjaġġ qasir ħdejn il-baħar tah l-idea.
messages.mt_standard: Vjaġġ qasir ħdejn il-baħar tah l-idea.
messages.zh: 一次短暂的海边旅行给了他灵感。
messages.en: A short trip by the sea gave him the idea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到liehem就想象诗人望着海景突然有了创作点子；用“景色启发人”的完整画面记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To breathe heavily or with a wheezing sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呼吸粗重，或呼吸时发出喘鸣声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu n-nifs b'toqol jew b'ħoss ta' tisfir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喘粗气；呼吸粗重。
喘鸣；呼吸时发出哨鸣般的声音。

formal.mt: Wara t-tellieqa, l-atleta lieheġ għal ftit minuti qabel ma n-nifs tiegħu reġa' lura għan-normal.
formal.en: After the race, the athlete breathed heavily for a few minutes before his breathing returned to normal.
formal.zh: 比赛结束后，那名运动员喘了几分钟粗气，呼吸才恢复正常。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaf Pawlu f'nofs it-telgħa? Mark: Lieheġ ħafna u kellu bżonn jistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu stop halfway up the hill? Mark: He was breathing heavily and needed a short rest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu为什么爬到半坡就停下了？Mark：他喘得很厉害，需要休息一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么爬到半坡就停下了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stop halfway up the hill?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lieheġ ħafna u kellu bżonn jistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Lieheġ ħafna u kellu bżonn jistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 他喘得很厉害，需要休息一下。
messages.en: He was breathing heavily and needed a short rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把lieheġ和爬坡后停下来大口喘气的画面绑定；若呼吸还带哨鸣声，就对应它的“喘鸣”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to glitter or sparkle when catching the light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易在光照下闪亮或呈现闪烁光泽的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jleqq jew jagħti leħħiet ta' dawl meta jaqa' d-dawl fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易闪亮或闪烁的；带有闪耀光泽的。

formal.mt: Id-disinjatur għażel drapp liemi biex il-kostum jispikka taħt id-dwal tal-palk.
formal.en: The designer chose shimmering fabric so that the costume would stand out under the stage lights.
formal.zh: 设计师选用了带有闪烁光泽的布料，让服装在舞台灯光下更加醒目。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema drapp jogħġbok għall-kostum? Maja: Dan id-drapp liemi; ara kif ileqq meta nċaqalqu!
colloquial.en: Lara: Which fabric do you like for the costume? Maja: This shimmering fabric; look how it sparkles when we move it!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你喜欢用哪块布做服装？Maja：这块有闪烁光泽的布；你看，移动时它多闪亮！

messages.speaker: Lara (裁缝)
messages.zh: 你喜欢用哪块布做服装？
messages.en: Which fabric do you like for the costume?

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-drapp liemi; ara kif ileqq meta nċaqalqu!
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-drapp liemi; ara kif ileqq meta nċaqalqu!
messages.zh: 这块有闪烁光泽的布；你看，移动时它多闪亮！
messages.en: This shimmering fabric; look how it sparkles when we move it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把liemi贴在一块随角度变化而闪光的布料上；记住它描述物体的闪亮性质，是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bar used to move or lift something by leverage; also a call-up for compulsory military service or the service itself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 借助支点移动或抬起物体的杠杆；另指征召入伍、征兵或义务兵役。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Virga li tintuża biex iċċaqlaq jew terfa' xi ħaġa billi sserraħ fuq punt ta' appoġġ; ukoll sejħa għal servizz militari obbligatorju jew is-servizz innifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杠杆；利用支点撬动或抬起物体的杆状工具。
征召入伍；征兵；义务兵役。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża lieva tal-ħadid biex jerfa' l-għatu tqil mingħajr ma jagħmel ħsara lill-qafas.
formal.en: The worker used an iron lever to lift the heavy cover without damaging the frame.
formal.zh: 工人用铁制杠杆抬起沉重的盖子，同时避免损坏框架。

colloquial.mt: Sara: F'dan ir-rumanz, x'ifisser li Mark irċieva avviż tal-lieva? Pawlu: Ifisser li sejħulu biex jagħmel is-servizz militari.
colloquial.en: Sara: In this novel, what does it mean that Mark received a call-up notice? Pawlu: It means he was called up for military service.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这部小说里说Mark收到征召通知，是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是他被征召去服兵役了。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan ir-rumanz, x'ifisser li Mark irċieva avviż tal-lieva?
messages.mt_standard: F'dan ir-rumanz, x'ifisser li Mark irċieva avviż tal-lieva?
messages.zh: 这部小说里说Mark收到征召通知，是什么意思？
messages.en: In this novel, what does it mean that Mark received a call-up notice?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li sejħulu biex jagħmel is-servizz militari.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li sejħulu biex jagħmel is-servizz militari.
messages.zh: 意思是他被征召去服兵役了。
messages.en: It means he was called up for military service.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给lieva准备两张场景卡：工人撬盖子记“杠杆”，人物收到入伍通知记“征兵”；根据上下文分别识别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who puts bait on a hook or in a trap to attract an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把诱饵装在鱼钩上或放入陷阱中，以吸引动物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqiegħed il-lixka fuq ganċ jew f'nassa biex tiġbed annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放置诱饵的人；给鱼钩或陷阱装饵的人。

formal.mt: Il-likkiem ħejja l-ganċijiet bil-lixka qabel ma beda s-sajd.
formal.en: The baiter prepared the hooks with bait before fishing began.
formal.zh: 捕鱼开始前，装饵者给鱼钩装好了诱饵。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Min se jpoġġi l-lixka fuq il-ganċijiet? Pawlu: Jien se nagħmel ix-xogħol tal-likkiem illum.
colloquial.en: Toni: Who is going to put the bait on the hooks? Pawlu: I'll do the baiter's job today.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：谁来给鱼钩装饵？保罗：今天我来做装饵的工作。

messages.speaker: Toni (钓鱼伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jpoġġi l-lixka fuq il-ganċijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jpoġġi l-lixka fuq il-ganċijiet?
messages.zh: 谁来给鱼钩装饵？
messages.en: Who is going to put the bait on the hooks?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (钓鱼伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien se nagħmel ix-xogħol tal-likkiem illum.
messages.mt_standard: Jien se nagħmel ix-xogħol tal-likkiem illum.
messages.zh: 今天我来做装饵的工作。
messages.en: I'll do the baiter's job today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位专门给鱼钩装饵的人，把人物名牌写成 likkiem；重点记住这个名词指人。

gloss_zh: 用于放饵的；用于装饵的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used for placing or presenting bait to attract an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于放置或呈现诱饵，以吸引动物的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintuża biex titqiegħed jew tiġi ppreżentata l-lixka sabiex jinġibed annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于放置诱饵或装饵的。

collocations.en: a hook used to present bait

formal.mt: It-tagħmir likkiemi jintuża biex titqiegħed il-lixka fil-post magħżul.
formal.en: The baiting equipment is used to place bait at the selected location.
formal.zh: 放饵器具用于把诱饵放到选定的位置。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għal xiex jintuża dan il-ganċ? Toni: Dan hu ganċ likkiemi; inpoġġu l-lixka fuqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this hook used for? Toni: This is a hook used to present bait; we put the bait on it.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这个鱼钩是做什么用的？托尼：这是挂饵用的鱼钩，我们把诱饵装在上面。

messages.speaker: Lara (钓鱼初学者)
messages.zh: 这个鱼钩是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this hook used for?

messages.speaker: Toni (钓鱼教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu ganċ likkiemi; inpoġġu l-lixka fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu ganċ likkiemi; inpoġġu l-lixka fuqu.
messages.zh: 这是挂饵用的鱼钩，我们把诱饵装在上面。
messages.en: This is a hook used to present bait; we put the bait on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 likkiemi 写在放饵器具的用途标签上，记成“用于放饵的”；与指人的 likkiem 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person appointed to wind up a company's affairs by dealing with its assets and debts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受任处理公司资产和债务、办理公司结束经营事务的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna maħtura biex tagħlaq l-affarijiet ta' kumpanija billi tieħu ħsieb l-assi u d-djun tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清算人；负责处理公司清算事务的人。

formal.mt: Il-likwidatur ħejja rapport dwar l-assi u d-djun tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: The liquidator prepared a report on the company's assets and debts.
formal.zh: 清算人编写了一份关于公司资产和债务的报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min qed jieħu ħsieb l-assi tal-kumpanija issa? Mark: Il-likwidatur; qed iħejji rapport dwarhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is handling the company's assets now? Mark: The liquidator; he is preparing a report on them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：现在谁在处理公司的资产？马克：清算人，他正在编写相关报告。

messages.speaker: Maja (公司员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Min qed jieħu ħsieb l-assi tal-kumpanija issa?
messages.mt_standard: Min qed jieħu ħsieb l-assi tal-kumpanija issa?
messages.zh: 现在谁在处理公司的资产？
messages.en: Who is handling the company's assets now?

messages.speaker: Mark (公司会计)
messages.zh: 清算人，他正在编写相关报告。
messages.en: The liquidator; he is preparing a report on them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 likwidatur 想成拿着资产清单和债务清单的人；用“清算人写报告”的画面固定其人物含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of winding up a company's affairs, including realizing assets and settling debts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 结束公司事务的过程，包括变卖资产和清偿债务等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jingħalqu l-affarijiet ta' kumpanija, jinbiegħu l-assi tagħha u jitħallsu d-djun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清算；结束公司事务并处理其资产、债务的过程。

formal.mt: Matul il-proċess ta' likwidazzjoni, tħejjiet lista tal-assi u tad-djun tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: During the liquidation process, a list of the company's assets and debts was prepared.
formal.zh: 清算过程中编制了公司的资产和债务清单。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kumpanija għadha tbigħ il-prodotti tagħha? David: Le, tinsab f'likwidazzjoni u qed jinbiegħ l-apparat tagħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the company still selling its products? David: No, it is in liquidation, and its equipment is being sold.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这家公司还在销售自己的产品吗？戴维：没有，公司正在清算，它的设备正在出售。

messages.speaker: Sara (前员工)
messages.zh: 这家公司还在销售自己的产品吗？
messages.en: Is the company still selling its products?

messages.speaker: David (前同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tinsab f'likwidazzjoni u qed jinbiegħ l-apparat tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tinsab f'likwidazzjoni u qed jinbiegħ l-apparat tagħha.
messages.zh: 没有，公司正在清算，它的设备正在出售。
messages.en: No, it is in liquidation, and its equipment is being sold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“列资产、卖设备、处理债务”的连续画面记 likwidazzjoni；它表示清算过程，likwidatur 表示办理清算的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The availability of cash or assets that can readily be converted into cash to meet payments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可用于支付的现金或可迅速变现资产的充足程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-disponibbiltà ta' flus kontanti jew assi li jistgħu jinbidlu malajr fi flus biex isiru l-ħlasijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流动性；资产迅速变为现金的能力，或可用资金的充足程度。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-kumpanija għandha likwidità biżżejjed biex tħallas l-ispejjeż ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The report shows that the company has sufficient liquidity to pay its day-to-day expenses.
formal.zh: 报告显示，公司有足够的流动资金支付日常开支。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex għadna ma ħallasniex il-kont? Mark: Għandna nuqqas ta' likwidità din il-ġimgħa; qed nistennew ħlas mingħand klijent.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why haven't we paid the bill yet? Mark: We have a liquidity shortage this week; we are waiting for a payment from a client.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们为什么还没付这笔账？马克：这周流动资金不足，我们正在等客户付款。

messages.speaker: Anna (办公室经理)
messages.zh: 我们为什么还没付这笔账？
messages.en: Why haven't we paid the bill yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (公司会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna nuqqas ta' likwidità din il-ġimgħa; qed nistennew ħlas mingħand klijent.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna nuqqas ta' likwidità din il-ġimgħa; qed nistennew ħlas mingħand klijent.
messages.zh: 这周流动资金不足，我们正在等客户付款。
messages.en: We have a liquidity shortage this week; we are waiting for a payment from a client.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 likwidità 时想一张今天就要付的账单：重点是有没有可立即使用的钱，以及资产能否迅速变现。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The glinting, glittering, or shining of light on a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体表面呈现的闪光、闪烁或发亮现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tleqq jew id-dija li tidher fuq wiċċ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪光；表面出现短促亮光的现象。
闪烁；许多细小亮点闪动的现象。
发亮；呈现光亮的状态。

formal.mt: Il-fotografu qabad il-limi fuq l-ilma fid-dawl ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The photographer captured the glittering on the water in the morning light.
formal.zh: 摄影师捕捉到了晨光中水面的粼粼闪光。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tara l-limi fuq l-ilma? Ben: Iva, ix-xemx qed tagħmel il-baħar qisu mimli stilel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you see the glittering on the water? Ben: Yes, the sun is making the sea look as if it is full of stars.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你看到水面上的闪光了吗？本：看到了，阳光让海面看起来像布满了星星。

messages.speaker: Lara (散步的朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到水面上的闪光了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the glittering on the water?

messages.speaker: Ben (散步的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ix-xemx qed tagħmel il-baħar qisu mimli stilel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ix-xemx qed tagħmel il-baħar qisu mimli stilel.
messages.zh: 看到了，阳光让海面看起来像布满了星星。
messages.en: Yes, the sun is making the sea look as if it is full of stars.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 limi 配上阳光照水面的动态图，依次观察一下闪光、点点闪烁和整体发亮，串起三个名词义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A faint or brief light that is just visible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 隐约可见的一点微弱或短暂的光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawl dgħajjef jew qasir li bilkemm jidher.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一点微光；隐约可见的微弱闪光。

formal.mt: Mit-tieqa mbiegħda dehret limja ta' dawl fid-dlam tal-lejl.
formal.en: A glimmer of light appeared from the distant window in the darkness of the night.
formal.zh: 在夜色中，远处的窗户透出了一线微光。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed tara dik il-limja hemmhekk? Sam: Iva, ġejja mit-tieqa tad-dar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you see that glimmer over there? Sam: Yes, it is coming from the house window.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看到那边的一点微光了吗？萨姆：看到了，是从那所房子的窗户透出来的。

messages.speaker: Nina (同行的朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到那边的一点微光了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that glimmer over there?

messages.speaker: Sam (同行的朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，是从那所房子的窗户透出来的。
messages.en: Yes, it is coming from the house window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象漆黑夜里远处窗户透出一点点亮光，把 limja 与这“一点微光”绑定，突出光弱而隐约可见。

gloss_zh: 睡眼惺忪的；眼睛朦胧的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having eyes that look tired and cannot see clearly, especially after waking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容眼睛因困倦等原因显得朦胧、看不清楚，尤其指刚睡醒时的样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu għajnejh imċajpra, speċjalment minħabba n-ngħas jew għax għadu kemm qam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 睡眼惺忪的；眼睛朦胧的。

formal.mt: Meta qam kmieni filgħodu, Mark kien għadu limpoċċ u kellu bżonn ftit ħin biex jaqra l-ittra.
formal.en: When he got up early in the morning, Mark was still bleary-eyed and needed a little time to read the letter.
formal.zh: 马克清晨起床时仍然睡眼惺忪，需要缓一缓才能读那封信。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadek limpoċċ? Mark: Iva, għadni kemm qomt. Agħtini minuta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you still bleary-eyed? Mark: Yes, I've only just got up. Give me a minute.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你还睡眼惺忪的吗？马克：是啊，我刚起床。给我一分钟。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你还睡眼惺忪的吗？
messages.en: Are you still bleary-eyed?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kemm qomt. Agħtini minuta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kemm qomt. Agħtini minuta.
messages.zh: 是啊，我刚起床。给我一分钟。
messages.en: Yes, I've only just got up. Give me a minute.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 limpoċċ 与清晨揉眼睛、看不清闹钟的画面联系起来，记作“睡眼惺忪的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The shapes and features of a person's face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人面部各部分的形状与轮廓特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forom u l-karatteristiċi ta' wiċċ persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面部轮廓；容貌特征。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, id-dawl artab juri b'mod ċar il-lineamenti tal-wiċċ.
formal.en: In the photograph, the soft light clearly reveals the facial features.
formal.zh: 照片中，柔和的光线清楚地呈现出面部轮廓。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dan ir-ritratt jixbah lil ħuk. Toni: Iva, għandna lineamenti simili, speċjalment madwar l-għajnejn.
colloquial.en: Elena: This portrait looks like your brother. Toni: Yes, we have similar facial features, especially around the eyes.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这幅肖像看着像你哥哥。托尼：是啊，我们的面部特征很像，尤其是眼睛周围。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 这幅肖像看着像你哥哥。
messages.en: This portrait looks like your brother.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna lineamenti simili, speċjalment madwar l-għajnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna lineamenti simili, speċjalment madwar l-għajnejn.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们的面部特征很像，尤其是眼睛周围。
messages.en: Yes, we have similar facial features, especially around the eyes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象画肖像时依次描出眉眼、鼻子和下巴，把这些面部轮廓一起记作 lineamenti。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Following a straight line or having a relationship represented by a straight line.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿直线排列或变化的；也指某种关系可以用直线表示。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jimxi f'linja dritta jew li juri relazzjoni li tista' tiġi rrappreżentata b'linja dritta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 线性的；直线的。

formal.mt: Il-graff juri relazzjoni lineari bejn in-numru ta' oġġetti u l-prezz totali, meta l-prezz ta' kull oġġett jibqa' l-istess.
formal.en: The graph shows a linear relationship between the number of items and the total price when the price of each item stays the same.
formal.zh: 在每件物品单价不变时，图表显示物品数量与总价之间呈线性关系。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex din ir-relazzjoni tissejjaħ lineari? Adam: Għax il-punti fuq il-graff jinsabu fuq linja dritta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is this relationship called linear? Adam: Because the points on the graph lie on a straight line.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么这种关系叫线性关系？亚当：因为图上的点落在一条直线上。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么这种关系叫线性关系？
messages.en: Why is this relationship called linear?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-punti fuq il-graff jinsabu fuq linja dritta.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-punti fuq il-graff jinsabu fuq linja dritta.
messages.zh: 因为图上的点落在一条直线上。
messages.en: Because the points on the graph lie on a straight line.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画出一条直线，把 lineari 与“点沿直线排列、关系用直线表示”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long, strong structural piece used to support part of a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑中用于承托其他部分的长而坚固的构件，即梁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa twila u b'saħħitha li tintuża biex iġġorr parti minn bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梁；横梁。

formal.mt: Il-linja skwerra tal-injam issostni parti mis-saqaf tal-kamra.
formal.en: The wooden beam supports part of the room's ceiling.
formal.zh: 这根木梁承托着房间天花板的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi dik il-biċċa twila tal-injam hemm fuq? Ġużeppi: Dik linja skwerra. Issostni s-saqaf.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that long piece of wood up there? Ġużeppi: That's a beam. It supports the ceiling.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：上面那根长木头是什么？朱塞佩：那是根梁，用来支撑天花板。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi dik il-biċċa twila tal-injam hemm fuq?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi dik il-biċċa twila tal-injam hemm fuq?
messages.zh: 上面那根长木头是什么？
messages.en: What's that long piece of wood up there?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (木匠)
messages.zh: 那是根梁，用来支撑天花板。
messages.en: That's a beam. It supports the ceiling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 linja skwerra 作为一个整体记忆，想象头顶一根承托天花板的长梁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A horizontal punctuation mark used as a dash or a hyphen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 横线形的标点符号，可指破折号或连字符；具体用途由上下文决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sinjal tal-punteġġ f'forma ta' linja orizzontali, użat biex jifred partijiet ta' sentenza jew jgħaqqad elementi ta' kelma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破折号；连字符。

formal.mt: Fil-forma 'il-ktieb', il-linjetta tgħaqqad l-artiklu man-nom.
formal.en: In the form 'il-ktieb', the hyphen joins the article to the noun.
formal.zh: 在 'il-ktieb' 这一形式中，连字符把冠词与名词连接起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nikteb 'il-ktieb'? Mark: Poġġi linjetta bejn 'il' u 'ktieb'. Maja: Sewwa, issa fhimt.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I write 'il-ktieb'? Mark: Put a hyphen between 'il' and 'ktieb'. Maja: Right, now I understand.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：'il-ktieb' 怎么写？马克：在 'il' 和 'ktieb' 之间加一个连字符。玛雅：好，我现在明白了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 'il-ktieb' 怎么写？
messages.en: How do I write 'il-ktieb'?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 在 'il' 和 'ktieb' 之间加一个连字符。
messages.en: Put a hyphen between 'il' and 'ktieb'.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 好，我现在明白了。
messages.en: Right, now I understand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象文字中间的一小横：连接词语时理解为连字符，分隔句子内容时可理解为破折号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who speaks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话或讲话的人；指人，而非说话这个动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话的人；讲话者。

formal.mt: Lissien tajjeb jagħżel kliemu bir-reqqa u jagħti ħin lis-semmiegħa biex jifhmu.
formal.en: A good speaker chooses his words carefully and gives listeners time to understand.
formal.zh: 善于讲话的人会仔细斟酌用词，并给听众理解的时间。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min jista' jispjega dan lill-grupp? Pawlu: Staqsi lil Mark. Hu lissien tajjeb u jispjega kollox ċar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who can explain this to the group? Pawlu: Ask Mark. He's a good speaker and explains everything clearly.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：谁能向大家解释一下这个？保罗：问问马克吧。他很会讲话，什么都解释得清楚。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 谁能向大家解释一下这个？
messages.en: Who can explain this to the group?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil Mark. Hu lissien tajjeb u jispjega kollox ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil Mark. Hu lissien tajjeb u jispjega kollox ċar.
messages.zh: 问问马克吧。他很会讲话，什么都解释得清楚。
messages.en: Ask Mark. He's a good speaker and explains everything clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个站起来向大家讲话的人，把 lissien 记在人物身上，再用 lissien tajjeb 练习“善于讲话的人”。

gloss_zh: 石版印刷的；平版印刷的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to lithography, a method of producing printed images from a prepared flat surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与石版印刷或平版印刷这种利用经过处理的平面制作印刷图像的方法有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-litografija, metodu ta' stampar ta' stampi minn wiċċ ċatt ippreparat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 石版印刷的；平版印刷的。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jispjega l-proċess litografiku użat biex saret din l-istampa.
formal.en: The catalogue explains the lithographic process used to produce this print.
formal.zh: 目录介绍了制作这幅版画所采用的石版印刷工艺。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din l-istampa saret bi proċess litografiku? Mark: Iva, u fil-katalgu hemm spjegazzjoni ta' kif saret.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was this print made using a lithographic process? Mark: Yes, and the catalogue explains how it was made.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这幅版画是用石版印刷工艺制作的吗？Mark：是的，目录里介绍了它的制作方法。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-istampa saret bi proċess litografiku?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-istampa saret bi proċess litografiku?
messages.zh: 这幅版画是用石版印刷工艺制作的吗？
messages.en: Was this print made using a lithographic process?

messages.speaker: Mark (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u fil-katalgu hemm spjegazzjoni ta' kif saret.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u fil-katalgu hemm spjegazzjoni ta' kif saret.
messages.zh: 是的，目录里介绍了它的制作方法。
messages.en: Yes, and the catalogue explains how it was made.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 litografiku 和“版画制作工艺”这一画面配对记忆，再用 proċess litografiku 整组练习，记住它是描述印刷方式的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Following the direct meaning of words rather than a figurative or implied meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遵循词语直接表达的意思，而不采用比喻义或言外之意的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsegwi t-tifsira diretta tal-kliem, mingħajr sens figurattiv jew moħbi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 字面的；按词语直接意义理解或表达的。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tat-test, għandna niddistingwu bejn it-tifsira litterali u t-tifsira figurattiva.
formal.en: In analysing the text, we should distinguish between the literal meaning and the figurative meaning.
formal.zh: 分析文本时，我们应当区分字面意义和比喻意义。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi nifhem din il-frażi fis-sens litterali? Pawlu: Le, hawn qed jużaha bħala metafora.
colloquial.en: Sara: Should I understand this phrase literally? Pawlu: No, here the writer is using it as a metaphor.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个短语应该按字面意思理解吗？Pawlu：不用，作者在这里把它用作比喻。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi nifhem din il-frażi fis-sens litterali?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi nifhem din il-frażi fis-sens litterali?
messages.zh: 这个短语应该按字面意思理解吗？
messages.en: Should I understand this phrase literally?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn qed jużaha bħala metafora.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn qed jużaha bħala metafora.
messages.zh: 不用，作者在这里把它用作比喻。
messages.en: No, here the writer is using it as a metaphor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 litterali，就想象逐字查看一句话，只问“这些字直接说了什么”。用 tifsira litterali 记“字面意义”，用 traduzzjoni litterali 记“直译”。

gloss_zh: 立陶宛的；立陶宛人；立陶宛语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Lithuania, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自或涉及立陶宛及其人民、文化的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mil-Litwanja jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' dan il-pajjiż, in-nies tiegħu jew il-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: Lithuanian (of, from or relating to Lithuania)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 立陶宛的；来自立陶宛或与立陶宛有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Lithuanian (native or inhabitant of Lithuania) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 立陶宛人；立陶宛的本地人或居民，通常指男性。
立陶宛语。

formal.mt: Il-kittieb Litwan ippreżenta r-rumanz tiegħu, miktub bil-Litwan.
formal.en: The Lithuanian writer presented his novel, written in Lithuanian.
formal.zh: 这位立陶宛作家介绍了他用立陶宛语写成的小说。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħabib il-ġdid tiegħek hu Litwan? Mark: Iva, u qed jgħallimni ftit kliem bil-Litwan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your new friend Lithuanian? Mark: Yes, and he is teaching me a few words in Lithuanian.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的新朋友是立陶宛人吗？Mark：是的，他还在教我几个立陶宛语单词。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的新朋友是立陶宛人吗？
messages.en: Is your new friend Lithuanian?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u qed jgħallimni ftit kliem bil-Litwan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u qed jgħallimni ftit kliem bil-Litwan.
messages.zh: 是的，他还在教我几个立陶宛语单词。
messages.en: Yes, and he is teaching me a few words in Lithuanian.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Litwan 画三张卡：作家旁写“立陶宛的”，人物旁写“立陶宛人”，对话气泡旁写“立陶宛语”；通过句子位置区分三个义项。

gloss_zh: 立陶宛的；立陶宛人；立陶宛语，与 Litwan 同义

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Lithuania; a synonym of Litwan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自或涉及立陶宛的，与形容词 Litwan 同义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mil-Litwanja jew li għandu x'jaqsam magħha; sinonimu ta' Litwan.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of Litwan: Lithuanian (of, from or relating to Lithuania)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 Litwan 同义：立陶宛的；来自立陶宛或与立陶宛有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of Litwan: Lithuanian (native or inhabitant of Lithuania) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 Litwan 同义：立陶宛人，指立陶宛的本地人或居民，通常为男性。
与 Il-Litwan 同义：立陶宛语。

formal.mt: L-artist Litwanjan ta taħdita dwar ix-xogħol tiegħu bil-Litwanjan.
formal.en: The Lithuanian artist gave a talk about his work in Lithuanian.
formal.zh: 这位立陶宛艺术家用立陶宛语作了一场介绍自己作品的讲座。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan l-artist huwa Litwanjan? Pawlu: Iva, u fil-filmat jitkellem bil-Litwanjan.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this artist Lithuanian? Pawlu: Yes, and in the video he speaks Lithuanian.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这位艺术家是立陶宛人吗？Pawlu：是的，他在视频里说的是立陶宛语。

messages.speaker: Sara (参观者)
messages.zh: 这位艺术家是立陶宛人吗？
messages.en: Is this artist Lithuanian?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (讲解员)
messages.zh: 是的，他在视频里说的是立陶宛语。
messages.en: Yes, and in the video he speaks Lithuanian.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Litwanjan 与 Litwan 并排写成同义词卡，再分别配上国别标签、人物和语言气泡。记忆重点是同义关系以及形容词、人名词、语言名词的区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of bending something or making it curve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物弯折或形成曲线的动作、过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tgħawweġ xi ħaġa jew tagħtiha forma mgħawġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弯折、弯曲或使之形成曲线的动作。

formal.mt: Il-liwi tal-metall għandu jsir bil-mod sabiex il-biċċa ma tinkisirx.
formal.en: The bending of the metal should be done slowly so that the piece does not break.
formal.zh: 金属折弯应缓慢进行，以免工件断裂。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-liwi ta' dan il-wajer diffiċli? Toni: Le, imma agħmlu bil-mod biex ma jinkisirx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is bending this wire difficult? Toni: No, but do it slowly so it does not break.
colloquial.zh: Lara：把这根金属丝弯过来难吗？Toni：不难，不过要慢慢来，免得折断。

messages.speaker: Lara (手工课学生)
messages.zh: 把这根金属丝弯过来难吗？
messages.en: Is bending this wire difficult?

messages.speaker: Toni (手工课老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imma agħmlu bil-mod biex ma jinkisirx.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imma agħmlu bil-mod biex ma jinkisirx.
messages.zh: 不难，不过要慢慢来，免得折断。
messages.en: No, but do it slowly so it does not break.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根直金属丝慢慢弯成弧线，把整个动作标为 liwi。它表示“弯曲这件事”，练习时搭配 tal-metall 或 tal-irkoppa，明确弯曲的对象。

gloss_zh: 磨平；使表面平滑的处理

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of making a surface smooth by removing roughness or unevenness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 去除表面粗糙或不平之处，使其变得平滑的处理过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li jagħmel wiċċ lixx billi jneħħi l-ħruxija jew l-irregolaritajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使平滑；磨平、抹平等表面处理过程。

formal.mt: Il-lixxatura tal-injam għandha titlesta qabel ma jiġi applikat il-verniċ.
formal.en: The smoothing of the wood should be completed before the varnish is applied.
formal.zh: 木材表面的磨平处理应在涂清漆之前完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nibda npinġi din il-biċċa injam? Mark: Stenna ftit, għad trid ftit lixxatura.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I start painting this piece of wood? Mark: Wait a moment; it still needs a little smoothing.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我可以开始给这块木头上色了吗？Mark：再等一下，它还需要稍微打磨平滑。

messages.speaker: Maja (手工爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nibda npinġi din il-biċċa injam?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nibda npinġi din il-biċċa injam?
messages.zh: 我可以开始给这块木头上色了吗？
messages.en: Can I start painting this piece of wood?

messages.speaker: Mark (木工)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit, għad trid ftit lixxatura.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit, għad trid ftit lixxatura.
messages.zh: 再等一下，它还需要稍微打磨平滑。
messages.en: Wait a moment; it still needs a little smoothing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lixxatura 记成“粗糙表面变平滑”的连续画面：先摸到毛刺，再打磨，最后摸到光滑表面。这个名词指中间的平滑处理过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To restrain something or keep its force, extent, or expression under control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 抑制或约束某事物，使其力量、程度或表现保持在控制之中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Irażżan xi ħaġa jew iżomm il-qawwa, il-firxa jew l-espressjoni tagħha taħt kontroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抑制；约束；限制其发展或表现。
控制住；使保持在可控制的范围内。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat liġem l-infiq billi stabbilixxa limitu ċar għal kull proġett.
formal.en: The committee kept spending under control by setting a clear limit for each project.
formal.zh: 委员会为每个项目设定了明确限额，从而控制住了开支。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Mark għajjat meta sema' l-kumment? Sara: Le, liġem ir-rabja tiegħu u wieġeb bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did Mark shout when he heard the comment? Sara: No, he restrained his anger and answered calmly.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Mark听到那句评论时大喊了吗？Sara：没有，他克制住怒气，平静地作了回答。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark听到那句评论时大喊了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark shout when he heard the comment?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, liġem ir-rabja tiegħu u wieġeb bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Le, liġem ir-rabja tiegħu u wieġeb bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 没有，他克制住怒气，平静地作了回答。
messages.en: No, he restrained his anger and answered calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把liġem放进“控制怒气”和“控制开支”两个句框，记住共同核心是使某事保持受控；注意它只有一个ġ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A serious shortage of something needed, especially a basic resource.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所需事物严重不足的状态，尤其指基本资源的匮乏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas kbir ta' xi ħaġa meħtieġa, speċjalment ta' riżorsa essenzjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 匮乏；所需事物的严重短缺。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-liġwa ta' ilma fir-raħal wara xhur mingħajr xita.
formal.en: The report describes the dearth of water in the village after months without rain.
formal.zh: 报告描述了数月无雨后村里的缺水状况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed niġbru l-ikel? Mark: Hemm liġwa ta' ikel f'dak ir-raħal, u rridu ngħinu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we collecting food? Mark: There is a dearth of food in that village, and we want to help.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么要募集食物？马克：那个村子食物匮乏，我们想帮忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (志愿者)
messages.zh: 我们为什么要募集食物？
messages.en: Why are we collecting food?

messages.speaker: Mark (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm liġwa ta' ikel f'dak ir-raħal, u rridu ngħinu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm liġwa ta' ikel f'dak ir-raħal, u rridu ngħinu.
messages.zh: 那个村子食物匮乏，我们想帮忙。
messages.en: There is a dearth of food in that village, and we want to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 liġwa 与空水桶、空粮袋的画面一起记；练习 liġwa ta' 加所缺资源，表达某物匮乏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To restrain someone or something; also to put a bridle on a horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 约束或抑制某人、某事物；也指给马戴上笼头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Irażżan lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa; ukoll iqiegħed l-ilġiem fuq żiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 约束；抑制；使受到控制。
给马戴上笼头。

formal.mt: Qabel ir-rikba, is-sid liġġem iż-żiemel u ċċekkja li t-tagħmir kien imqiegħed sew.
formal.en: Before the ride, the owner bridled the horse and checked that the equipment was properly fitted.
formal.zh: 骑行前，马主给马戴上笼头，并检查装备是否佩戴妥当。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Iż-żiemel lest għar-rikba? Pawlu: Iva, Mark diġà liġġem iż-żiemel u ċċekkja s-sarġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the horse ready for the ride? Pawlu: Yes, Mark has already bridled the horse and checked the saddle.
colloquial.zh: Maja：马准备好可以骑了吗？Pawlu：好了，Mark已经给马戴上笼头，也检查过马鞍了。

messages.speaker: Maja (骑马学员)
messages.zh: 马准备好可以骑了吗？
messages.en: Is the horse ready for the ride?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (骑术教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Mark diġà liġġem iż-żiemel u ċċekkja s-sarġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Mark diġà liġġem iż-żiemel u ċċekkja s-sarġ.
messages.zh: 好了，Mark已经给马戴上笼头，也检查过马鞍了。
messages.en: Yes, Mark has already bridled the horse and checked the saddle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到liġġem的双ġ就联想双手给马戴笼头的动作，先记具体义，再用“约束怒气”练习抽象义；这只是记忆联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who puts a bridle on a horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给马戴上笼头的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqiegħed l-ilġiem fuq żiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给马戴上笼头的人。

collocations.en: a skilled person who bridles horses
an experienced person who bridles horses
collocations.zh: 有给马上笼头经验的人

formal.mt: Il-liġġiem resaq lejn iż-żiemel bil-kalma u qiegħed l-ilġiem b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: The person bridling the horse approached it calmly and fitted the bridle carefully.
formal.zh: 负责给马上笼头的人平静地走近马，小心地戴好了笼头。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak ħdejn iż-żiemel? Mark: Dak il-liġġiem; qed iqiegħed l-ilġiem qabel ir-rikba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that beside the horse? Mark: That's the person who bridles the horse; he's fitting the bridle before the ride.
colloquial.zh: Lara：马旁边那个人是谁？Mark：那是给马上笼头的人；他正在骑行前给马戴笼头。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.zh: 马旁边那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that beside the horse?

messages.speaker: Mark (马场工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-liġġiem; qed iqiegħed l-ilġiem qabel ir-rikba.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-liġġiem; qed iqiegħed l-ilġiem qabel ir-rikba.
messages.zh: 那是给马上笼头的人；他正在骑行前给马戴笼头。
messages.en: That's the person who bridles the horse; he's fitting the bridle before the ride.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把liġġiem写在马旁工作人员的姓名牌上，提醒自己这个名词指“给马上笼头的人”；与动作词liġġem分开记。

gloss_zh: 有抑制作用的；起约束作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that curbs, restrains, or limits something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有抑制、约束或限制某事物的作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu effett li jrażżan jew jillimita xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: havving a curbing or restraining effect
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有抑制或约束作用的。

formal.mt: Il-limitu tal-baġit kellu effett liġġiemi fuq l-infiq tal-proġett.
formal.en: The budget limit had a restraining effect on the project's spending.
formal.zh: 预算限额对项目开支起到了约束作用。
