colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-limitu l-ġdid għen biex jikkontrollaw l-infiq? Sara: Iva, kellu effett liġġiemi; issa jaħsbuha sew qabel jixtru xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did the new limit help them control spending? Sara: Yes, it had a restraining effect; now they think carefully before buying anything.
colloquial.zh: Nina：新的限额帮助他们控制开支了吗？Sara：有，起到了约束作用；现在他们买东西前都会仔细考虑。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-limitu l-ġdid għen biex jikkontrollaw l-infiq?
messages.mt_standard: Il-limitu l-ġdid għen biex jikkontrollaw l-infiq?
messages.zh: 新的限额帮助他们控制开支了吗？
messages.en: Did the new limit help them control spending?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kellu effett liġġiemi; issa jaħsbuha sew qabel jixtru xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kellu effett liġġiemi; issa jaħsbuha sew qabel jixtru xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 有，起到了约束作用；现在他们买东西前都会仔细考虑。
messages.en: Yes, it had a restraining effect; now they think carefully before buying anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把liġġiemi和effett一起记成“有约束作用的效果”，想象预算限额让购物清单缩短；它描述作用性质，是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lisbon, the capital and a port city of Portugal, at the mouth of the Tagus River on the Atlantic Ocean.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 里斯本，葡萄牙首都和港口城市，位于大西洋沿岸的塔霍河河口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-belt kapitali tal-Portugall u belt portwali fil-bokka tax-xmara Tagus, fuq l-Oċean Atlantiku.

sense_translations.en_definition: Lisbon (a port city on the Iberian Peninsula, at the mouth of the Tagus River on the Atlantic Ocean; the capital city of Portugal)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 里斯本：伊比利亚半岛上的港口城市，位于大西洋沿岸的塔霍河河口，是葡萄牙首都。

formal.mt: Liżbona, il-kapitali tal-Portugall, tinsab fil-bokka tax-xmara Tagus.
formal.en: Lisbon, the capital of Portugal, is situated at the mouth of the Tagus River.
formal.zh: 葡萄牙首都里斯本位于塔霍河河口。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se tmur għall-vaganza? Pawlu: Se mmur Liżbona u noqgħod hemm għal tlett ijiem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going on holiday? Pawlu: I am going to Lisbon and staying there for three days.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你打算去哪里度假？Pawlu：我要去里斯本，在那里待三天。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (旅行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur Liżbona u noqgħod hemm għal tlett ijiem.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur Liżbona u noqgħod hemm għal tlett ijiem.
messages.zh: 我要去里斯本，在那里待三天。
messages.en: I am going to Lisbon and staying there for three days.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图上的葡萄牙首都位置贴上“Liżbona＝里斯本”，再画一条河流汇入大西洋。把城市名称与首都、河口、港口三个提示一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work with steady effort, care, and diligence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续投入精力，认真而勤勉地工作或做事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħadem b'ħeġġa, b'attenzjoni u bi sforz kontinwu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勤奋工作；认真勤勉地做事。

collocations.en: he worked diligently at his job
he applied himself diligently to his studies

formal.mt: Matul ix-xahar, l-impjegat liżem fix-xogħol u temm ir-rapport fil-ħin.
formal.en: Throughout the month, the employee worked diligently and completed the report on time.
formal.zh: 整个月里，这名员工勤奋工作，按时完成了报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar Pawlu fl-eżami? Mark: Mar tajjeb ħafna; liżem fl-istudju għal ġimgħat sħaħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu do in the exam? Mark: He did very well; he studied diligently for weeks.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 考得怎么样？Mark：考得很好；他连续好几个星期都在勤奋学习。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: Pawlu 考得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Pawlu do in the exam?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mar tajjeb ħafna; liżem fl-istudju għal ġimgħat sħaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Mar tajjeb ħafna; liżem fl-istudju għal ġimgħat sħaħ.
messages.zh: 考得很好；他连续好几个星期都在勤奋学习。
messages.en: He did very well; he studied diligently for weeks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 liżem 配上“每天认真投入、持续完成任务”的学习画面，突出勤勉和持续努力。例句中的 liżem 可记为“他勤奋做了”，分别搭配工作和学习场景练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have the effect of making someone more diligent in their work or studies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生使某人在工作或学习中变得更加勤勉、用功的效果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu l-effett li jagħmel lil xi ħadd aktar ħabrieki fix-xogħol jew fl-istudju.

sense_translations.en_definition: to have the effect of making sb. diligent
sense_translations.zh_definition: 起到使某人勤勉、用功的作用。

formal.mt: L-inkoraġġiment tal-għalliema liżżem lill-istudent u għenu jaħdem b'aktar attenzjoni.
formal.en: The teacher's encouragement made the student more diligent and helped him work more attentively.
formal.zh: 老师的鼓励使这名学生更加用功，也帮助他更加专心地学习。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Mark sar jistudja kuljum. Maja: Iva, il-kliem tal-għalliema liżżem lil Mark.
colloquial.en: Rita: Mark has started studying every day. Maja: Yes, the teacher's words made Mark more diligent.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克现在开始每天学习了。玛雅：是啊，老师的话让马克变得更用功了。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 马克现在开始每天学习了。
messages.en: Mark has started studying every day.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kliem tal-għalliema liżżem lil Mark.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kliem tal-għalliema liżżem lil Mark.
messages.zh: 是啊，老师的话让马克变得更用功了。
messages.en: Yes, the teacher's words made Mark more diligent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师鼓励之后，学生开始天天认真读书；记住重点是使别人变勤勉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plucked string instrument with a rounded body and a neck, called a lute.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种具有圆鼓形琴身和琴颈、通过拨弦演奏的乐器，即鲁特琴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali tal-kordi, b'kaxxa fit-tond u għonq, li jindaqq billi jitnittfu l-kordi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鲁特琴，一种拨弦乐器。

formal.mt: Fil-kunċert, il-mużiċist daqq il-ljut u spjega kif jiġu rranġati l-kordi tiegħu.
formal.en: At the concert, the musician played the lute and explained how its strings are arranged.
formal.zh: 音乐会上，乐手弹奏了鲁特琴，并介绍了它的琴弦排列方式。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak l-istrument ħdejn it-tieqa? Mark: Dak ljut. Trid tisma' kif jindaqq?
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that instrument by the window? Mark: That's a lute. Do you want to hear how it's played?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：窗边那个是什么乐器？马克：那是鲁特琴。你想听听它弹起来的声音吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 窗边那个是什么乐器？
messages.en: What's that instrument by the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (乐手)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ljut. Trid tisma' kif jindaqq?
messages.mt_standard: Dak ljut. Trid tisma' kif jindaqq?
messages.zh: 那是鲁特琴。你想听听它弹起来的声音吗？
messages.en: That's a lute. Do you want to hear how it's played?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面记忆：圆鼓鼓的琴身配上琴颈，手指轻拨琴弦，这就是鲁特琴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Everyone in the group being referred to, with nobody excluded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所指群体中的所有人，一个也不排除；可依语境表示我们、你们或他们全体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-nies kollha tal-grupp li qed jissemma, mingħajr ma jitħalla barra ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大家；所指群体中的所有人。

formal.mt: Aħna lkoll għandna responsabbiltà li nżommu l-ispazji komuni nodfa.
formal.en: All of us have a responsibility to keep shared spaces clean.
formal.zh: 我们每个人都有责任保持公共空间清洁。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Se tiġu lkoll għall-ikla? Mark: Iva, aħna lkoll ġejjin, anki Maja.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are you all coming to the meal? Mark: Yes, all of us are coming, even Maja.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你们大家都会来吃饭吗？马克：会，我们全都来，连玛雅也来。

messages.speaker: Rita (聚餐组织者)
messages.zh: 你们大家都会来吃饭吗？
messages.en: Are you all coming to the meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, aħna lkoll ġejjin, anki Maja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, aħna lkoll ġejjin, anki Maja.
messages.zh: 会，我们全都来，连玛雅也来。
messages.en: Yes, all of us are coming, even Maja.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象合照时把大家全部圈进去，一个人也不漏；这个整组画面帮助记住所有人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slow down or proceed at a reduced speed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 降低速度；以比原来更慢的速度行动或进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas il-pass jew il-veloċità u jimxi jew jaħdem aktar bil-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放慢速度；减速。

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq llajma meta resaq lejn iż-żona fejn kienu qed jaħdmu l-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The driver slowed down as he approached the area where the workers were working.
formal.zh: 司机接近工人施工的区域时放慢了车速。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark għadu ma wasalx? Rita: Llajma fit-triq għax kien hemm ħafna ilma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why hasn't Mark arrived yet? Rita: He slowed down on the road because there was a lot of water.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克怎么还没到？丽塔：路上积水很多，所以他放慢了速度。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么还没到？
messages.en: Why hasn't Mark arrived yet?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Llajma fit-triq għax kien hemm ħafna ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Llajma fit-triq għax kien hemm ħafna ilma.
messages.zh: 路上积水很多，所以他放慢了速度。
messages.en: He slowed down on the road because there was a lot of water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把播放速度从正常调慢，或开车遇到积水后减速，用速度下降的画面记忆。

gloss_zh: 使世俗化；使脱离教会管理

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an institution, activity, or system secular, or transfer it from religious to lay control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使机构、活动或制度世俗化，或将其由宗教人员、教会管理转交给世俗人员管理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel istituzzjoni, attività jew sistema sekulari, jew jgħaddi t-tmexxija tagħha minn idejn reliġjużi għal idejn lajċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使世俗化；使脱离宗教或教会管理，转由世俗人员负责。

collocations.en: transferred the administration to lay control
collocations.zh: 使行政管理转由世俗人员负责

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-kumitat il-ġdid llajċizza l-istituzzjoni billi għadda t-tmexxija tagħha lil persuni lajċi.
formal.en: In this example, the new committee secularized the institution by transferring its management to laypeople.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，新委员会通过将管理权交给世俗人员，使该机构实现了世俗化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser li l-kumitat llajċizza l-istituzzjoni? Rita: Ifisser li t-tmexxija tagħha għaddiet minn idejn reliġjużi għal idejn lajċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does it mean that the committee secularized the institution? Rita: It means its management passed from religious to lay hands.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：说委员会使这个机构世俗化，是什么意思？丽塔：意思是它的管理权从宗教人员手中转交给了世俗人员。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li l-kumitat llajċizza l-istituzzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li l-kumitat llajċizza l-istituzzjoni?
messages.zh: 说委员会使这个机构世俗化，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that the committee secularized the institution?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li t-tmexxija tagħha għaddiet minn idejn reliġjużi għal idejn lajċi.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li t-tmexxija tagħha għaddiet minn idejn reliġjużi għal idejn lajċi.
messages.zh: 意思是它的管理权从宗教人员手中转交给了世俗人员。
messages.en: It means its management passed from religious to lay hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用管理权交接图记忆：从宗教人员交到世俗人员手中，联想到使机构世俗化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To distil a liquid by heating it to produce vapour and then cooling the vapour back into liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过加热使液体形成蒸气，再冷却蒸气使其重新凝结为液体，即进行蒸馏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddistilla likwidu billi jsaħħnu biex isir fwar u mbagħad ikessaħ il-fwar biex jerġa' jsir likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒸馏；使液体汽化后再冷凝，以分离或纯化。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni fil-laboratorju, it-tekniku llampika l-ilma u ġabar il-likwidu f'reċipjent nadif.
formal.en: During the laboratory demonstration, the technician distilled the water and collected the liquid in a clean container.
formal.zh: 在实验室演示中，技术员蒸馏了水，并用干净的容器收集液体。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel it-tekniku bl-ilma? Mark: Llampika l-ilma: saħħnu, imbagħad kessaħ il-fwar u ġabar il-qtar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the technician do with the water? Mark: He distilled it: he heated it, then cooled the vapour and collected the drops.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：技术员对那些水做了什么？马克：他把水蒸馏了：先加热，再冷却蒸气，收集凝结的水滴。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 技术员对那些水做了什么？
messages.en: What did the technician do with the water?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Llampika l-ilma: saħħnu, imbagħad kessaħ il-fwar u ġabar il-qtar.
messages.mt_standard: Llampika l-ilma: saħħnu, imbagħad kessaħ il-fwar u ġabar il-qtar.
messages.zh: 他把水蒸馏了：先加热，再冷却蒸气，收集凝结的水滴。
messages.en: He distilled it: he heated it, then cooled the vapour and collected the drops.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三幅图记忆蒸馏：液体受热、蒸气上升、冷却成滴；把整个过程连到这个词。

gloss_zh: 燃起；猛然燃烧；非常饥饿

teaching_sense.en_definition: To burn with a flame or flare up; also, to be very hungry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 燃起火焰或突然猛烈燃烧；也表示非常饥饿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħraq b'fjamma jew jaqbad f'daqqa; ukoll, ikun bil-ġuħ ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 燃起火焰；突然旺盛地燃烧。
非常饥饿；饿得厉害。

formal.mt: In-nar llampja għal ftit sekondi, u dawk li kienu fil-qrib tbiegħdu minnu.
formal.en: The fire flared up for a few seconds, and those nearby moved away from it.
formal.zh: 火焰猛地旺了几秒钟，附近的人纷纷退开。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex Mark kiel hekk malajr? Maja: Llampja bil-ġuħ wara x-xogħol; lanqas kellu ħin jiekol f'nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did Mark eat so quickly? Maja: He was very hungry after work; he hadn't even had time to eat at midday.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克怎么吃得这么快？玛雅：他下班后饿得厉害，中午连吃饭的时间都没有。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么吃得这么快？
messages.en: Why did Mark eat so quickly?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Llampja bil-ġuħ wara x-xogħol; lanqas kellu ħin jiekol f'nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Llampja bil-ġuħ wara x-xogħol; lanqas kellu ħin jiekol f'nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 他下班后饿得厉害，中午连吃饭的时间都没有。
messages.en: He was very hungry after work; he hadn't even had time to eat at midday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两幅情景图记忆：炉火突然旺起，以及下班后饿得急着吃饭；两义分别练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply starch to fabric so that it becomes firmer and holds its shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给衣物或布料上浆，使其挺括并保持形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Japplika l-lamtu fuq drapp jew ħwejjeġ biex isiru aktar iebsin u jżommu l-għamla tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给衣物或布料上浆，使其挺括。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem llamta t-tvalja qabel ma għaddieha, biex iżżomm l-għamla tagħha fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: The worker starched the tablecloth before ironing it so that it would hold its shape on the table.
formal.zh: 工作人员先给桌布上浆，再熨烫，使其铺在桌上时保持挺括。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex din il-qmis daqshekk iebsa? Pawlu: Għax missieri llamta l-qmis qabel ma għaddieha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why is this shirt so stiff? Pawlu: Because my father starched it before ironing it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这件衬衫为什么这么硬挺？保罗：因为我爸爸熨之前给它上了浆。

messages.speaker: Marija (女儿)
messages.zh: 这件衬衫为什么这么硬挺？
messages.en: Why is this shirt so stiff?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax missieri llamta l-qmis qabel ma għaddieha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax missieri llamta l-qmis qabel ma għaddieha.
messages.zh: 因为我爸爸熨之前给它上了浆。
messages.en: Because my father starched it before ironing it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 llamta 和硬挺的衬衫领口联系起来：先上浆，再熨平，用这个动作顺序记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come down onto the ground or another landing surface after travelling through the air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从空中下降，到达地面或其他降落表面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinżel mill-ajru u jasal fuq l-art jew fuq wiċċ ieħor fejn jista' jinżel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 降落，着陆；从空中落到地面或其他降落表面。

formal.mt: L-ajruplan llandja fl-ajruport fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu, skont l-iskeda.
formal.en: The aircraft landed at the airport at nine in the morning, according to schedule.
formal.zh: 飞机按照时刻表，于上午九点在机场降落。

colloquial.mt: Anna: L-ajruplan ta' ħuk wasal? Ben: Iva, llandja għaxar minuti ilu. Dalwaqt joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has your brother's plane arrived? Ben: Yes, it landed ten minutes ago. He'll be out soon.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你哥哥坐的飞机到了吗？本：到了，十分钟前降落的。他很快就出来。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥坐的飞机到了吗？
messages.en: Has your brother's plane arrived?

messages.speaker: Ben (接机人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, llandja għaxar minuti ilu. Dalwaqt joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, llandja għaxar minuti ilu. Dalwaqt joħroġ.
messages.zh: 到了，十分钟前降落的。他很快就出来。
messages.en: Yes, it landed ten minutes ago. He'll be out soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 llandja，就想象飞机轮子接触跑道的一刻，把从空中到地面的动作记成降落。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel sleepy and less alert, as though one might soon fall asleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到困倦、精神不集中，仿佛很快就会睡着。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss in-ngħas u jkun inqas attent, bħallikieku se jorqod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到困倦，处于昏昏欲睡的状态。

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla ta' nofsinhar, l-istudent llanja u sabha diffiċli biex jikkonċentra fuq il-qari.
formal.en: After lunch, the student felt drowsy and found it difficult to concentrate on reading.
formal.zh: 午饭后，那名学生感到困倦，难以集中精力阅读。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Pawlu waqaf jaqra? Rita: Llanja wara l-ikla u mar jistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did Pawlu stop reading? Rita: He felt drowsy after the meal and went to rest for a while.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗为什么不读了？丽塔：他吃完饭犯困，就去休息一会儿了。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么不读了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stop reading?

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Llanja wara l-ikla u mar jistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Llanja wara l-ikla u mar jistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 他吃完饭犯困，就去休息一会儿了。
messages.en: He felt drowsy after the meal and went to rest for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用饭后眼皮变沉的画面记 llanja：重点是已经犯困、想睡，还不一定真正睡着。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put a vessel into the water, or to introduce and begin a project, product, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使船只下水，或推出、启动一项计划、产品或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iniżżel bastiment fl-ilma, jew jagħti bidu għal proġett jew attività jew jintroduċi prodott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使船只下水，使其浮于水面。
推出或启动，使计划、产品或活动开始。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill llanċja proġett ġdid biex itejjeb is-servizzi fil-lokalità.
formal.en: The council launched a new project to improve services in the locality.
formal.zh: 地方议会启动了一项新项目，以改善当地服务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi d-dgħajsa l-ġdida? Mark: Fil-baħar! Missieri llanċja d-dgħajsa dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the new boat? Mark: In the sea! My father launched it this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那条新船在哪儿？马克：在海里！我爸爸今天早上让它下水了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那条新船在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is the new boat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在海里！我爸爸今天早上让它下水了。
messages.en: In the sea! My father launched it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个开始的画面记 llanċja：船开始在水上漂，项目开始运作；分别对应下水和启动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To repair something damaged or torn, especially by covering a hole with a patch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 修补破损或撕裂的东西，尤其指用补片盖住破洞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isewwi xi ħaġa mqattgħa jew bil-ħsara, speċjalment billi jgħatti toqba b'roqgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打补丁，修补破损之处。

collocations.en: patched a hole in the jacket

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat llapazza t-toqba fil-ġakketta b'biċċa drapp tal-istess kulur.
formal.en: The tailor patched the hole in the jacket with a piece of fabric of the same colour.
formal.zh: 裁缝用一块同色布料补好了夹克上的破洞。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-qalziet kien imqatta', hux? Luqa: Iva, imma n-nannu llapazza t-toqba. Issa nista' nerġa' nilbsu.
colloquial.en: Sara: These trousers were torn, weren't they? Luqa: Yes, but Grandpa patched the hole. Now I can wear them again.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这条裤子原来破了，对吧？卢卡：对，不过爷爷把洞补好了。现在我又能穿了。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 这条裤子原来破了，对吧？
messages.en: These trousers were torn, weren't they?

messages.speaker: Luqa (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma n-nannu llapazza t-toqba. Issa nista' nerġa' nilbsu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma n-nannu llapazza t-toqba. Issa nista' nerġa' nilbsu.
messages.zh: 对，不过爷爷把洞补好了。现在我又能穿了。
messages.en: Yes, but Grandpa patched the hole. Now I can wear them again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 llapazza 记成补洞动作：破裤子上盖一块布，再缝牢；用修补前后的画面对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 把培根或猪肉塞入肉中

teaching_sense.en_definition: To insert bacon or pork into a piece of meat as part of its preparation for cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 烹调准备时，把培根或猪肉塞入一块肉的内部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idaħħal biċċiet tal-bejken jew tal-majjal ġo biċċa laħam bħala parti mit-tħejjija għat-tisjir.

sense_translations.en_definition: to lard (to stuff meat with bacon or pork)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在肉中塞入培根或猪肉，作为烹调前的处理。

formal.mt: Il-kok llardja l-biċċa taċ-ċanga bi strixxi tal-bejken qabel ma poġġieha fil-forn.
formal.en: The chef larded the piece of beef with strips of bacon before putting it in the oven.
formal.zh: 厨师把培根条塞入那块牛肉中，然后将牛肉放进烤箱。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhuma dawn il-biċċiet ġewwa l-laħam? Toni: Bejken. Il-kok llardja l-laħam qabel sajru.
colloquial.en: Nina: What are these pieces inside the meat? Toni: Bacon. The chef larded the meat before cooking it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：肉里面这些小块是什么？托尼：培根。厨师烹调前把培根塞进肉里了。

messages.speaker: Nina (食客)
messages.zh: 肉里面这些小块是什么？
messages.en: What are these pieces inside the meat?

messages.speaker: Toni (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Bejken. Il-kok llardja l-laħam qabel sajru.
messages.mt_standard: Bejken. Il-kok llardja l-laħam qabel sajru.
messages.zh: 培根。厨师烹调前把培根塞进肉里了。
messages.en: Bacon. The chef larded the meat before cooking it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 llardja 时想象肉里藏着培根条，抓住塞进内部这个动作，就能记住这种烹调处理。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To manufacture or make an object with skill and careful workmanship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 运用熟练技艺和细致工艺制造或制作物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimmanifattura jew jagħmel oġġett b'ħila u b'xogħol magħmul bir-reqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以熟练、精巧的工艺制造或制作。

collocations.zh: 精工制作了一张小桌子

formal.mt: L-artiġjan llavra kaxxa tal-injam b'għatu li jagħlaq sewwa u b'dettalji fini.
formal.en: The artisan skillfully crafted a wooden box with a well-fitting lid and fine details.
formal.zh: 工匠精心制作了一个木盒，盒盖严密贴合，细节精致。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Min għamel din il-mejda? David: In-nannu llavra din il-mejda fil-ħanut tax-xogħol tiegħu. Ara kemm hi maħduma tajjeb!
colloquial.en: Elena: Who made this table? David: Grandpa skillfully crafted it in his workshop. Look how well it is made!
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：这张桌子是谁做的？戴维：爷爷在自己的作坊里精工制作的。你看，做得多好！

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张桌子是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made this table?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu llavra din il-mejda fil-ħanut tax-xogħol tiegħu. Ara kemm hi maħduma tajjeb!
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu llavra din il-mejda fil-ħanut tax-xogħol tiegħu. Ara kemm hi maħduma tajjeb!
messages.zh: 爷爷在自己的作坊里精工制作的。你看，做得多好！
messages.en: Grandpa skillfully crafted it in his workshop. Look how well it is made!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 llavra 和工匠细做木盒的画面绑定：盒盖贴合、边角细致，用这些细节记住精工制作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make or enact laws through a body with the authority to do so.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由具有相应权限的机构制定或通过法律。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel jew jgħaddi liġijiet permezz ta' korp li għandu s-setgħa jagħmel dan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 立法，制定或通过法律。

formal.mt: Il-parlament lleġiżla biex isaħħaħ il-protezzjoni tal-konsumaturi u jiċċara d-dmirijiet tal-bejjiegħa.
formal.en: Parliament legislated to strengthen consumer protection and clarify sellers' duties.
formal.zh: 议会通过立法加强消费者保护，并明确卖方的义务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħwienet iridu juru din l-informazzjoni? Mark: Għax il-parlament lleġiżla dwar dan. Issa hemm obbligu fil-liġi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do shops have to display this information? Mark: Because parliament legislated on it. It is now a legal requirement.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：商店为什么必须展示这些信息？马克：因为议会已经就这件事立法了。现在这是法律要求。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħwienet iridu juru din l-informazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħwienet iridu juru din l-informazzjoni?
messages.zh: 商店为什么必须展示这些信息？
messages.en: Why do shops have to display this information?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-parlament lleġiżla dwar dan. Issa hemm obbligu fil-liġi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-parlament lleġiżla dwar dan. Issa hemm obbligu fil-liġi.
messages.zh: 因为议会已经就这件事立法了。现在这是法律要求。
messages.en: Because parliament legislated on it. It is now a legal requirement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用议会表决后形成法律的场景记 lleġiżla：把讨论的议题写成具有约束力的法律，就是立法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sell assets for cash, or to close a business by settling its financial affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把资产变卖为现金，或通过处理资产、清偿债务等手续结束企业经营。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibigħ assi biex jiksibhom fi flus, jew jagħlaq negozju billi jirranġa l-affarijiet finanzjarji tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清算；变卖资产以取得现金，或清理企业财务并结束经营。

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija llikwidat parti mill-assi tagħha biex tħallas id-djun.
formal.en: The company liquidated part of its assets to pay its debts.
formal.zh: 该公司变卖了部分资产来偿还债务。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex il-kumpanija llikwidat dawk l-assi? Sara: Biex ikollha l-flus biex tħallas id-djun tagħha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did the company liquidate those assets? Sara: To have the money to pay its debts.
colloquial.zh: 马克：公司为什么变卖那些资产？萨拉：为了筹到钱偿还债务。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 公司为什么变卖那些资产？
messages.en: Why did the company liquidate those assets?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ikollha l-flus biex tħallas id-djun tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ikollha l-flus biex tħallas id-djun tagħha.
messages.zh: 为了筹到钱偿还债务。
messages.en: To have the money to pay its debts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和英语 liquidate 配对记忆：想象把公司的资产换成现金，再用现金清偿债务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a surface flat or bring things to the same height.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把表面弄平，或使不同部分达到相同高度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel wiċċ ċatt jew iġib affarijiet fl-istess għoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄平；使表面平整，或使各部分处于同一高度。

formal.mt: Il-bennejja llivellaw l-art qabel ma bdew iqiegħdu l-madum.
formal.en: The builders levelled the floor before they began laying the tiles.
formal.zh: 建筑工人在开始铺瓷砖之前，把地面找平了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad hemm ħofor fl-art? Pawlu: Le, il-bennejja llivellawha dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are there still holes in the ground? Pawlu: No, the builders levelled it this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：地上还有坑吗？保罗：没有，工人们今天早上已经把地面弄平了。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.zh: 地上还有坑吗？
messages.en: Are there still holes in the ground?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 没有，工人们今天早上已经把地面弄平了。
messages.en: No, the builders levelled it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它和英语 level 一起记：脑中画一块高低不平的地面，再把凸起和凹坑整理成水平面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of noticing or perceiving something, including seeing it briefly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 察觉到某物的行为，也可指短暂看见、瞥见某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jinduna b'xi ħaġa jew jaraha, anki għal waqt qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感知或察觉到某物的行为。
短暂看见某物的行为；瞥见。

collocations.en: the act of glimpsing a face

formal.mt: Il-lmiħ ta' moviment fit-tarf tat-triq ġiegħel lis-sewwieq inaqqas il-veloċità.
formal.en: The perception of movement at the edge of the road made the driver slow down.
formal.zh: 察觉到路边有东西移动，司机便放慢了车速。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt min kien ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Kien biss lmiħ ta' wiċċ; ma stajtx nagħraf min kien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see who was by the door? Mark: It was only a glimpse of a face; I couldn't tell who it was.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看清门边是谁了吗？马克：只瞥见了一张脸，没能认出是谁。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看清门边是谁了吗？
messages.en: Did you see who was by the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien biss lmiħ ta' wiċċ; ma stajtx nagħraf min kien.
messages.mt_standard: Kien biss lmiħ ta' wiċċ; ma stajtx nagħraf min kien.
messages.zh: 只瞥见了一张脸，没能认出是谁。
messages.en: It was only a glimpse of a face; I couldn't tell who it was.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象眼角捕捉到一个身影：察觉到了，却未必看清。这个词是名词，表示察觉或瞥见这一行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to movement from one place to another or to the ability to move.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与从一处移动到另一处有关的，或与移动能力有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mal-moviment minn post għal ieħor jew mal-kapaċità li wieħed jiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 移动的；移行的；与从一处移动到另一处的能力或作用有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kapaċità lokomottiva tal-annimal f'ambjenti differenti.
formal.en: The report describes the animal's locomotive ability in different environments.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该动物在不同环境中的移行能力。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi tfisser 'kapaċità lokomottiva'? Sara: Tfisser il-kapaċità li tiċċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does 'locomotive ability' mean? Sara: It means the ability to move from one place to another.
colloquial.zh: 马克：“移行能力”是什么意思？萨拉：就是从一个地方移动到另一个地方的能力。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: “移行能力”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'locomotive ability' mean?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser il-kapaċità li tiċċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser il-kapaċità li tiċċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor.
messages.zh: 就是从一个地方移动到另一个地方的能力。
messages.en: It means the ability to move from one place to another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本条放在名词旁边记：它描述移动的能力或系统。搭配阴性名词时，例子中会出现 lokomottiva。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A railway engine that provides the power to pull or push a train.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供动力、牵引或推动列车的铁路机车，即火车头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magna tal-ferrovija li tipprovdi l-qawwa biex tiġbed jew timbotta l-vaguni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铁路机车；为列车提供牵引或推动动力的火车头。

formal.mt: Il-lokomottiva elettrika ġibdet il-vaguni 'l barra mill-istazzjon.
formal.en: The electric locomotive pulled the carriages out of the station.
formal.zh: 电力机车牵引着车厢驶出了车站。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik il-magna quddiem il-vaguni x'inhi? Pawlu: Dik hija l-lokomottiva; tiġbed il-vaguni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that engine in front of the carriages? Pawlu: That is the locomotive; it pulls the carriages.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：车厢前面的那台机器是什么？保罗：那是火车头，用来牵引车厢。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 车厢前面的那台机器是什么？
messages.en: What is that engine in front of the carriages?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.zh: 那是火车头，用来牵引车厢。
messages.en: That is the locomotive; it pulls the carriages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一列火车最前面的动力机车，把 lokomottiva 和英语名词 locomotive 配对记成火车头。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Movement from one place to another, especially the movement of a living body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一个地方移动到另一个地方的过程，尤指生物身体的位置移动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment minn post għal ieħor, speċjalment ta' ġisem ħaj.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 移行；从一处移动到另一处的运动，尤指生物的位置移动。

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel modi differenti ta' lokomozzjoni, bħall-mixi u l-għawm.
formal.en: The study compares different modes of locomotion, such as walking and swimming.
formal.zh: 该研究比较了步行、游泳等不同的移行方式。

colloquial.mt: Mark: L-għawm huwa mod ta' lokomozzjoni? Sara: Iva, għax bih tiċċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor fl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is swimming a mode of locomotion? Sara: Yes, because it lets you move from one place to another in the water.
colloquial.zh: 马克：游泳算是一种移行方式吗？萨拉：算，因为游泳能让你在水中从一个地方移动到另一个地方。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 游泳算是一种移行方式吗？
messages.en: Is swimming a mode of locomotion?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax bih tiċċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor fl-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax bih tiċċaqlaq minn post għal ieħor fl-ilma.
messages.zh: 算，因为游泳能让你在水中从一个地方移动到另一个地方。
messages.en: Yes, because it lets you move from one place to another in the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用走路、游泳、爬行三个画面记忆：方式虽然不同，共同点都是身体从一处移动到另一处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mammal with a long body and dense fur that swims well and lives in or near water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种身体修长、毛皮浓密、善于游泳，生活在水中或水边的哺乳动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal mammiferu b'ġisem twil u pil dens, li jgħum tajjeb u jgħix fl-ilma jew qribu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水獭，一种善于游泳、常在水中或水边活动的哺乳动物。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, il-lontra ħarġet mill-ilma u waqfet fuq il-blat.
formal.en: During the observation, the otter came out of the water and stopped on the rocks.
formal.zh: 观察期间，那只水獭从水中出来，停在了岩石上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara l-lontra ħdejn il-blat? Mark: Iva! Issa daħlet fl-ilma u qed tgħum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see the otter by the rocks? Mark: Yes! It has just gone into the water and is swimming.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到岩石旁的水獭了吗？马克：看到了！它刚下水，正在游泳。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到岩石旁的水獭了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the otter by the rocks?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Issa daħlet fl-ilma u qed tgħum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Issa daħlet fl-ilma u qed tgħum.
messages.zh: 看到了！它刚下水，正在游泳。
messages.en: Yes! It has just gone into the water and is swimming.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lontra 写在水獭图片旁，想象它从岩石滑入水中；用水边活动的画面把词形和动物对应起来。

gloss_zh: 卢格曼，《古兰经》中提到的智者

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a wise man mentioned in the Qur'an.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 卢格曼，《古兰经》中提到的一位智者的名字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' raġel għaref imsemmi fil-Koran.

sense_translations.en_definition: Luqman (a wise man mentioned in the Qur'an)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 卢格曼（《古兰经》中提到的一位智者）。

collocations.zh: 阅读有关卢格曼的内容

formal.mt: It-test jintroduċi lil Loqman bħala raġel għaref imsemmi fil-Koran.
formal.en: The text introduces Luqman as a wise man mentioned in the Qur'an.
formal.zh: 这篇文字介绍了卢格曼，指出他是《古兰经》中提到的一位智者。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min hu Loqman? Sara: Huwa raġel għaref imsemmi fil-Koran.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is Luqman? Sara: He is a wise man mentioned in the Qur'an.
colloquial.zh: 马克：卢格曼是谁？萨拉：他是《古兰经》中提到的一位智者。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 卢格曼是谁？
messages.en: Who is Luqman?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.zh: 他是《古兰经》中提到的一位智者。
messages.en: He is a wise man mentioned in the Qur'an.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张人名卡片：马耳他语 Loqman、英语 Luqman、中文卢格曼，再在旁边标注《古兰经》中的智者。

gloss_zh: 拾穗；收割后捡拾的剩余作物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gathering of ears of grain or other produce left behind after a harvest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收割后捡拾田间遗留谷穗或其他作物的行为，也指这样捡拾的一份收获。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġbir ta' sbul jew prodotti oħra li jibqgħu fl-għalqa wara l-ħsad, jew dak li jinġabar b'dan il-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收割后捡拾遗留谷穗或作物的行为；一次拾穗所得。

collocations.en: a gleaning of ears of grain
collocations.zh: 捡拾遗留谷穗；捡得的一份谷穗

formal.mt: Wara l-ħsad, il-familja għamlet lqata ta' sbul li kien baqa' fl-għalqa.
formal.en: After the harvest, the family gathered ears of grain that had been left in the field.
formal.zh: 收割后，这家人到田里拾取遗留的谷穗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġbart f'dik il-qoffa? Pawlu: Din lqata ta' sbul; ġbart dak li baqa' wara l-ħsad.
colloquial.en: Maja: What have you collected in that basket? Pawlu: These are gleaned ears of grain; I collected what was left after the harvest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在那个篮子里装了些什么？保罗：这是拾来的谷穗，我捡的是收割后剩下的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在那个篮子里装了些什么？
messages.en: What have you collected in that basket?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (拾穗者)
messages.mt_spoken: Din lqata ta' sbul; ġbart dak li baqa' wara l-ħsad.
messages.mt_standard: Din lqata ta' sbul; ġbart dak li baqa' wara l-ħsad.
messages.zh: 这是拾来的谷穗，我捡的是收割后剩下的。
messages.en: These are gleaned ears of grain; I collected what was left after the harvest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lqata 配上一幅收割后弯腰捡谷穗的画面：重点是捡拾田间剩余作物，可连着 lqata ta' sbul 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of receiving a person or something that is delivered or offered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接收送来或交付的事物，或接待到来的人这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jirċievi lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li tasal jew tingħata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接收、接受或接待这一行为。

formal.mt: Il-lqigħ tal-mistednin jibda fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu, qabel ma tiftaħ il-konferenza.
formal.en: The receiving of guests begins at nine in the morning, before the conference opens.
formal.zh: 来宾接待工作于上午九点开始，随后会议开幕。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-lqigħ tal-mistednin? Mark: Jien. Se noqgħod ħdejn il-bieb biex nilqagħhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will take care of receiving the guests? Mark: I will. I'll stand by the door to welcome them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁来负责接待客人？马克：我来。我会站在门边迎接他们。

messages.speaker: Sara (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-lqigħ tal-mistednin?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-lqigħ tal-mistednin?
messages.zh: 谁来负责接待客人？
messages.en: Who will take care of receiving the guests?

messages.speaker: Mark (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Se noqgħod ħdejn il-bieb biex nilqagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Se noqgħod ħdejn il-bieb biex nilqagħhom.
messages.zh: 我来。我会站在门边迎接他们。
messages.en: I will. I'll stand by the door to welcome them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 lqigħ 时想象接待处伸手接过包裹、迎进客人：共同焦点都是接收这一行为，而不是所接收的物品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of hitting something or making brief, light contact by brushing against it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 击中或碰撞某物的动作，也可指经过时与某物发生的短暂轻擦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li xi ħaġa tolqot oħra, b'daqqa jew b'kuntatt ħafif waqt li tgħaddi magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 击打、击中或碰撞的动作。
经过时轻轻擦碰某人或某物。

formal.mt: Il-kisi protettiv inaqqas il-ħsara kkawżata mil-lqit ripetut tal-ġebel mal-ħġieġ.
formal.en: The protective coating reduces the damage caused by stones repeatedly hitting the glass.
formal.zh: 保护涂层能减轻石子反复撞击玻璃造成的损伤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-fergħa weġġgħetlek driegħek? Toni: Le, kien biss lqit ħafif mal-ġilda meta għaddejt minn ħdejha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the branch hurt your arm? Toni: No, it only brushed lightly against my skin as I walked past it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：树枝弄伤你的胳膊了吗？托尼：没有，我从旁边走过时，它只是轻轻擦了一下皮肤。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 树枝弄伤你的胳膊了吗？
messages.en: Did the branch hurt your arm?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien biss lqit ħafif mal-ġilda meta għaddejt minn ħdejha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien biss lqit ħafif mal-ġilda meta għaddejt minn ħdejha.
messages.zh: 没有，我从旁边走过时，它只是轻轻擦了一下皮肤。
messages.en: No, it only brushed lightly against my skin as I walked past it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lqit 想成接触力度的两个画面：石子撞玻璃是击中，树枝擦手臂是轻擦；结合上下文判断是哪一种接触。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Friendly in manner and easy to approach, interact with, or deal with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 待人友善、容易接近，并且容易相处或沟通办事的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu bi ħbiberija u jkun faċli biex tersaq lejh, titkellem miegħu jew tiftiehem miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 友善的；待人亲切的。
容易打交道的；容易沟通、相处或商量的。

collocations.en: an owner who is easy to deal with
collocations.zh: 一位容易打交道的店主或业主

formal.mt: Il-maniġer huwa bniedem lqugħi li jisma' l-mistoqsijiet tal-impjegati u jiddiskuti magħhom bil-kalma.
formal.en: The manager is a friendly, approachable person who listens to employees' questions and discusses them calmly.
formal.zh: 这位经理友善、容易接近，会听取员工的问题并与他们平静地讨论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Is-sid faċli titkellem miegħu? Ben: Iva, hu lqugħi ħafna. Staqsieh u jispjegalek kollox bil-paċenzja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the owner easy to talk to? Ben: Yes, he's very approachable. Ask him and he'll explain everything patiently.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：店主好说话吗？本：是的，他很容易打交道。你问他，他会耐心地给你解释清楚。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 店主好说话吗？
messages.en: Is the owner easy to talk to?

messages.speaker: Ben (熟客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu lqugħi ħafna. Staqsieh u jispjegalek kollox bil-paċenzja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu lqugħi ħafna. Staqsieh u jispjegalek kollox bil-paċenzja.
messages.zh: 是的，他很容易打交道。你问他，他会耐心地给你解释清楚。
messages.en: Yes, he's very approachable. Ask him and he'll explain everything patiently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位微笑听你提问、耐心解释的店主，用 lqugħi 描述他：既有态度友善，也有容易沟通的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young slave; the diminutive form of the noun 'lsir'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年幼的奴隶；名词 lsir 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilsir ta' età żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva tan-nom 'lsir'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 年幼的奴隶，名词 lsir 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a young slave in the story
collocations.zh: 故事中的一名年幼奴隶

collocations.en: a young slave in the palace
collocations.zh: 宫殿中的一名年幼奴隶

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, jidher lsajjar li jgħix fil-palazz u jixtieq jikseb il-libertà tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, a young slave appears who lives in the palace and wishes to gain his freedom.
formal.zh: 故事中出现了一名住在宫殿里的年幼奴隶，他希望获得自由。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu dak it-tifel fil-ġrajja? Adam: Hu lsajjar li jgħix fil-palazz. Aktar tard insiru nafu kif jikseb il-libertà tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is that boy in the story? Adam: He's a young slave who lives in the palace. Later we find out how he gains his freedom.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：故事里的那个男孩是谁？亚当：他是一名住在宫殿里的年幼奴隶。后面我们会知道他怎样获得自由。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 故事里的那个男孩是谁？
messages.en: Who is that boy in the story?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu lsajjar li jgħix fil-palazz. Aktar tard insiru nafu kif jikseb il-libertà tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Hu lsajjar li jgħix fil-palazz. Aktar tard insiru nafu kif jikseb il-libertà tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他是一名住在宫殿里的年幼奴隶。后面我们会知道他怎样获得自由。
messages.en: He's a young slave who lives in the palace. Later we find out how he gains his freedom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把已给出的 lsir 与 lsajjar 做成一对词卡：前者记奴隶，后者配年幼角色的插图，记住其指小形式和年龄含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small tongue; the diminutive form of the noun 'lsien'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小舌头；名词 lsien 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilsien żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva tan-nom 'lsien'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small tongue (the diminutive form of 'lsien')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小舌头，名词 lsien 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher qattus b'ħalqu miftuħ u b'lsejjen roża.
formal.en: The picture shows a cat with its mouth open and a little pink tongue.
formal.zh: 图片中，一只猫张着嘴，露出粉红色的小舌头。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Ara l-qattus! Għandu lsejjen roża. Luka: Iva, qed jilgħaq saqajh biex jitnaddaf.
colloquial.en: Ella: Look at the cat! It has a little pink tongue. Luka: Yes, it's licking its paws to clean itself.
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：看那只猫！它有一条粉红色的小舌头。卢卡：是啊，它正在舔爪子清洁自己。

messages.speaker: Ella (朋友)
messages.zh: 看那只猫！它有一条粉红色的小舌头。
messages.en: Look at the cat! It has a little pink tongue.

messages.speaker: Luka (猫主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed jilgħaq saqajh biex jitnaddaf.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed jilgħaq saqajh biex jitnaddaf.
messages.zh: 是啊，它正在舔爪子清洁自己。
messages.en: Yes, it's licking its paws to clean itself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lsien 舌头与 lsejjen 小舌头并排记，给后者画一只伸出粉红小舌头的猫，帮助记住指小含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flame, especially one seen as a tongue-shaped part of a fire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 火焰，尤其指形状像舌头一样伸展或跃动的一道火焰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fjamma, speċjalment waħda li tidher twila u dejqa bħal ilsien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火焰；呈舌状的一道火焰。

formal.mt: Lsien tan-nar għoli tela' mill-fuklar meta qabdet iz-zokk il-kbir.
formal.en: A tall flame rose from the fireplace when the large log caught fire.
formal.zh: 大木柴燃起来时，一道高高的火焰从壁炉中升起。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Rajt dak il-lsien tan-nar? Ġanni: Iva, tela' għoli ħafna meta qabad iz-zokk.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did you see that flame? Ġanni: Yes, it rose very high when the log caught fire.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你看到那道火焰了吗？詹尼：看到了，木柴燃起来时，火焰蹿得很高。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到那道火焰了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that flame?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tela' għoli ħafna meta qabad iz-zokk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tela' għoli ħafna meta qabad iz-zokk.
messages.zh: 看到了，木柴燃起来时，火焰蹿得很高。
messages.en: Yes, it rose very high when the log caught fire.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文火舌来对应 lsien tan-nar：想象细长火焰像舌头一样向上伸展，把整个短语作为一个名词单位记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be reached or attained, as a goal, level, or result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指目标、水平或结果被达到、得以实现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintlaħaq għan, livell jew riżultat mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被达到；得以达成。

formal.mt: L-għan tal-kampanja ltaħaq wara tliet xhur ta' xogħol kontinwu.
formal.en: The campaign's goal was reached after three months of continuous work.
formal.zh: 经过三个月的持续努力，活动目标得以达成。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif marret il-kampanja? Mark: Tajjeb ħafna! L-għan ltaħaq, u ġbarna l-flus kollha li kellna bżonn.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did the campaign go? Mark: Very well! The goal was reached, and we raised all the money we needed.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：活动进展得怎么样？马克：非常好！目标达成了，我们筹齐了所需的全部款项。

messages.speaker: Sara (志愿者)
messages.zh: 活动进展得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the campaign go?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna! L-għan ltaħaq, u ġbarna l-flus kollha li kellna bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna! L-għan ltaħaq, u ġbarna l-flus kollha li kellna bżonn.
messages.zh: 非常好！目标达成了，我们筹齐了所需的全部款项。
messages.en: Very well! The goal was reached, and we raised all the money we needed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用目标旁边打上完成勾的画面记 ltaħaq，并整句记住 l-għan ltaħaq：把注意力放在目标已经被达到的结果上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become wrapped in a covering, or to dress warmly against the cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被包在某种覆盖物中；也指为了御寒而把自己穿裹得暖和。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mgeżwer f'xi ħaġa, jew jilbes ħwejjeġ sħan biex jilqa' għall-bard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被包裹；被裹起来。
穿上暖和的衣服；把自己穿裹得暖和。

formal.mt: It-tifel lteff sew qabel ħareġ fil-bard.
formal.en: The boy dressed warmly before going out into the cold.
formal.zh: 男孩在出门迎着寒冷之前，把自己穿裹得很暖和。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu lteff daqshekk? Mark: Għax barra hemm ħafna bard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu wrap up so warmly? Mark: Because it is very cold outside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么穿裹得这么严实？马克：因为外面很冷。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么穿裹得这么严实？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu wrap up so warmly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为外面很冷。
messages.en: Because it is very cold outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人先裹进毯子，再穿厚衣出门：把“被包裹”和“穿得暖和”连成同一个御寒画面来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be seen, especially briefly or only for a moment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人看见，尤其指短暂露出而被瞥见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidher lil xi ħadd, speċjalment għal ħin qasir jew għal mument biss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被短暂地瞥见；被匆匆看见。
被看见；出现在人的视线中。

formal.mt: Wiċċ raġel ltemaħ fit-tieqa għal mument, imbagħad għeb.
formal.en: A man's face was glimpsed at the window for a moment, then disappeared.
formal.zh: 一个男人的脸在窗口被短暂瞥见，随后便消失了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min kien dak li ltemaħ fit-tieqa? Ġanni: Naħseb li kien il-ġar, imma ma rajtux sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who was that person who was glimpsed at the window? Ġanni: I think it was the neighbour, but I did not see him clearly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：刚才在窗口一闪而过、被看见的是谁？詹尼：我想是邻居，不过我没看清他。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Min kien dak li ltemaħ fit-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Min kien dak li ltemaħ fit-tieqa?
messages.zh: 刚才在窗口一闪而过、被看见的是谁？
messages.en: Who was that person who was glimpsed at the window?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li kien il-ġar, imma ma rajtux sew.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li kien il-ġar, imma ma rajtux sew.
messages.zh: 我想是邻居，不过我没看清他。
messages.en: I think it was the neighbour, but I did not see him clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“窗边人影闪一下”的画面记忆：重点是人影被看见，不是某个人主动去看；停留短时就是“被瞥见”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become bent or curved instead of remaining straight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由直变弯，呈现弯折或弧形状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu forma mgħawġa jew kurva minflok jibqa' dritt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弯折；变成弯曲状态。
呈弧形；弯成曲线。

formal.mt: Il-wajer ltewa taħt il-piż u ma baqax dritt.
formal.en: The wire bent under the weight and was no longer straight.
formal.zh: 金属丝在重压下弯曲，不再笔直。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan il-wajer m'għadux dritt? Toni: Ltewa meta waqgħet il-kaxxa fuqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is this wire no longer straight? Toni: It bent when the box fell on it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这根金属丝怎么不直了？托尼：箱子掉到上面时把它压弯了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 这根金属丝怎么不直了？
messages.en: Why is this wire no longer straight?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 箱子掉到上面时把它压弯了。
messages.en: It bent when the box fell on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中把一根直金属丝压成弧线：有明显折弯可记“被弯折”，平滑弯曲可记“呈弧形”，两者都离开了笔直状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lemon fruit, used for its juice or peel in food and drinks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 柠檬这种水果，其果汁或果皮可用于食物和饮品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frott taċ-ċitru li l-meraq jew il-qoxra tiegħu jintużaw fl-ikel u fix-xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柠檬；可指柠檬这种水果或若干柠檬。

formal.mt: Żid ftit meraq tal-lumi mal-ilma u ħawwad sew.
formal.en: Add a little lemon juice to the water and stir well.
formal.zh: 往水里加入少许柠檬汁，并充分搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek lumi għat-te? Sara: Iva, trid ftit meraq jew porzjon lumi?
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have any lemon for the tea? Sara: Yes, would you like a little juice or a slice of lemon?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有可以加进茶里的柠檬吗？萨拉：有，你要一点柠檬汁，还是一片柠檬？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有可以加进茶里的柠檬吗？
messages.en: Do you have any lemon for the tea?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, trid ftit meraq jew porzjon lumi?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, trid ftit meraq jew porzjon lumi?
messages.zh: 有，你要一点柠檬汁，还是一片柠檬？
messages.en: Yes, would you like a little juice or a slice of lemon?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象泡茶时挤柠檬汁、再放一片柠檬：用这个厨房画面记住 lumi，并把 meraq tal-lumi 整体记成“柠檬汁”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small light; in a separate sense, a dry-volume unit officially equal to 1.849 imperial cubic inches (30.31 mL).
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小灯或小光源；另一个义项是干量单位，官方值为1.849英制立方英寸，即30.31毫升。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawl żgħir; f'tifsira oħra, unità ta' volum niexef li uffiċjalment hija ugwali għal 1.849 pulzier kubu imperjali (30.31 mL).

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小灯；小光源。

sense_translations.en_definition: a unit of dry volume that is officially 1.849 imperial cubic inches (30.31 mL).
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种干量单位，官方值为1.849英制立方英寸（30.31毫升）。

collocations.en: a small light beside the bed

collocations.mt: lumin bħala kejl ta' volum niexef
collocations.en: lumin as a measure of dry volume

formal.mt: Bħala unità ta' volum niexef, lumin wieħed huwa uffiċjalment ugwali għal 1.849 pulzier kubu imperjali (30.31 mL).
formal.en: As a dry-volume unit, one lumin is officially equal to 1.849 imperial cubic inches (30.31 mL).
formal.zh: 作为干量单位，一 lumin 的官方值为1.849英制立方英寸（30.31毫升）。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nħalli lumin ħdejn is-sodda? Omm: Iva, ħalli dawl żgħir biex tara jekk tqum bil-lejl.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I leave a small light beside the bed? Mum: Yes, leave a small light so you can see if you get up at night.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我可以在床边留一盏小灯吗？妈妈：可以，留盏小灯，这样你夜里起床时就看得见。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我可以在床边留一盏小灯吗？
messages.en: Can I leave a small light beside the bed?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħalli dawl żgħir biex tara jekk tqum bil-lejl.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħalli dawl żgħir biex tara jekk tqum bil-lejl.
messages.zh: 可以，留盏小灯，这样你夜里起床时就看得见。
messages.en: Yes, leave a small light so you can see if you get up at night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张独立图卡：一张画床边小灯，一张画标着30.31毫升的量器；两张都写 lumin，用场景分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sweet lemon, a citrus fruit of the species Citrus limetta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 甜柠檬，指学名为 Citrus limetta 的柑橘类水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frott taċ-ċitru magħruf bħala lumi ħelu, tal-ispeċi Citrus limetta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甜柠檬，学名 Citrus limetta。

formal.mt: Il-lumiċell huwa frott taċ-ċitru tal-ispeċi Citrus limetta, magħruf bħala lumi ħelu.
formal.en: The sweet lemon is a citrus fruit of the species Citrus limetta.
formal.zh: 甜柠檬是一种柑橘类水果，学名为 Citrus limetta。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan il-frott? Toni: Dan lumiċell, jiġifieri lumi ħelu. Trid idduqu?
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this fruit? Toni: This is a sweet lemon. Would you like to taste it?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是什么水果？托尼：这是甜柠檬。你想尝尝吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这是什么水果？
messages.en: What is this fruit?

messages.speaker: Toni (水果摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan lumiċell, jiġifieri lumi ħelu. Trid idduqu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan lumiċell, jiġifieri lumi ħelu. Trid idduqu?
messages.zh: 这是甜柠檬。你想尝尝吗？
messages.en: This is a sweet lemon. Would you like to taste it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡片上画一颗贴着“甜”字的柠檬，旁边写 lumiċell 和 Citrus limetta，帮助把具体品种与普通柠檬区分开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male given name corresponding to Luke or Lucas in English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男性名字，对应英语中的 Luke 或 Lucas，中文可译为卢卡或路加。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' raġel li jikkorrispondi għal Luke jew Lucas bl-Ingliż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 男性人名，对应英语 Luke、Lucas，可译为卢卡、路加。

formal.mt: Luqa bagħat it-talba bil-miktub u rċieva tweġiba l-għada.
formal.en: Luqa submitted the request in writing and received a reply the following day.
formal.zh: 卢卡以书面形式提交了申请，并在第二天收到了答复。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jismu l-istudent il-ġdid? Sara: Jismu Luqa. Għada se nistudjaw miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the new student's name? Sara: His name is Luqa. Tomorrow we are going to study with him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新来的学生叫什么名字？萨拉：他叫卢卡。明天我们要和他一起学习。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 新来的学生叫什么名字？
messages.en: What is the new student's name?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jismu Luqa. Għada se nistudjaw miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Jismu Luqa. Għada se nistudjaw miegħu.
messages.zh: 他叫卢卡。明天我们要和他一起学习。
messages.en: His name is Luqa. Tomorrow we are going to study with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新同学佩戴写着“Luqa／卢卡”的姓名牌，见面时练习 Jismu Luqa；把它作为人名记忆，并注意首字母大写。

gloss_zh: 卢森堡；卢森堡省；卢森堡市；卢森堡县

teaching_sense.en_definition: Luxembourg, a small country in Western Europe; the same name also refers to its capital, a canton containing the capital, and a Belgian province.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 卢森堡，西欧的一个小国；这一名称也可指其首都、包含首都的县，以及比利时的一个省。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż żgħir fl-Ewropa tal-Punent; l-istess isem jirreferi wkoll għall-belt kapitali tiegħu, għal canton li jinkludi l-kapitali, u għal provinċja fil-Belġju.

sense_translations.en_definition: Luxembourg (a small country in Western Europe)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 卢森堡，位于西欧的一个小国。
卢森堡省，比利时瓦隆地区的一个省。

sense_translations.en_definition: Luxembourg, Luxembourg City (the capital city of Luxembourg)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 卢森堡市，卢森堡的首都。

sense_translations.en_definition: Luxembourg (one of the twelve cantons of the country of Luxembourg, which includes its capital city)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 卢森堡县，卢森堡全国十二个县之一，包含该国首都。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-isem Lussemburgu jirreferi għall-pajjiż, mhux għall-provinċja fil-Belġju.
formal.en: In the report, the name Luxembourg refers to the country, not to the province in Belgium.
formal.zh: 报告中的“卢森堡”指这个国家，而非比利时的卢森堡省。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se nżur il-Lussemburgu. Mark: Il-pajjiż jew il-belt? Maja: Il-belt kapitali.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm going to visit Luxembourg. Mark: The country or the city? Maja: The capital city.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我要去卢森堡看看。马克：你指这个国家，还是那座城市？玛雅：首都那座城市。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要去卢森堡看看。
messages.en: I'm going to visit Luxembourg.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你指这个国家，还是那座城市？
messages.en: The country or the city?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 首都那座城市。
messages.en: The capital city.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把同一个地名配上四张标签：国家、省、首都、县；遇到 Lussemburgu，先看上下文中的行政单位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element lutetium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素镥的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-element kimiku msejjaħ lutezju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镥，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun ta' lutezju ġie ttikkettat qabel l-analiżi.
formal.en: The sample of lutetium was labelled before the analysis.
formal.zh: 这份镥样品在分析前已贴好标签。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-lutezju? Mark: Huwa element kimiku. Maja: Mela nikteb '镥' ħdejn l-isem.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is lutetium? Mark: It's a chemical element. Maja: Then I'll write '镥' beside the name.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：lutezju 是什么？马克：是一种化学元素。玛雅：那我就在这个名称旁边写上“镥”。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: lutezju 是什么？
messages.en: What is lutetium?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 是一种化学元素。
messages.en: It's a chemical element.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 那我就在这个名称旁边写上“镥”。
messages.en: Then I'll write '镥' beside the name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张元素词卡，正面写 lutezju，背面写“镥”；配合“样品”和“化学元素”两个短语反复认读。

gloss_zh: 卢祖船（船首绘有双眼图案的马耳他传统彩绘渔船）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional Maltese fishing boat painted in bright colours, typically with a pair of eye designs on its bow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他传统渔船，船身涂有鲜艳色彩，船首通常绘有一对眼睛图案。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dgħajsa tradizzjonali Maltija tas-sajd, miżbugħa b'kuluri jgħajtu, li tipikament għandha żewġ għajnejn impinġija fuq il-pruwa.

sense_translations.en_definition: luzzu (a traditional brightly-painted Maltese fishing boat, characteristically adorned with a pair of eye designs on the bow)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 卢祖船，一种色彩鲜艳的马耳他传统渔船，其典型特征是船首绘有一对眼睛图案。

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt juri luzzu b'kuluri jgħajtu u b'żewġ għajnejn impinġija fuq il-pruwa.
formal.en: The photograph shows a brightly coloured luzzu with two eyes painted on its bow.
formal.zh: 照片中是一艘色彩鲜艳的卢祖船，船首绘有两只眼睛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak il-luzzu! Mark: Dak bl-għajnejn fuq il-pruwa? Maja: Iva, jogħġbuni ħafna l-kuluri tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that luzzu! Mark: The one with eyes on its bow? Maja: Yes, I really like its colours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看那艘卢祖船！马克：船首画着眼睛的那艘吗？玛雅：对，我很喜欢它的颜色。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 看那艘卢祖船！
messages.en: Look at that luzzu!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 船首画着眼睛的那艘吗？
messages.en: The one with eyes on its bow?

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 对，我很喜欢它的颜色。
messages.en: Yes, I really like its colours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 luzzu 记成一幅图：鲜艳的小渔船迎面驶来，船首有一对眼睛；用这三个视觉特征一起记词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electric light; in another sense, a switch used to turn a light on or off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于照明的电灯；另一个义项指控制灯亮灭的开关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawl li jaħdem bl-elettriku; f'tifsira oħra, swiċċ biex tixgħel jew titfi d-dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电灯；电力照明灯。
开关；用于接通或切断电路的装置。

formal.mt: Il-luċilettrika fil-kamra tipprovdi biżżejjed dawl għall-qari.
formal.en: The electric light in the room provides enough light for reading.
formal.zh: 房间里的电灯提供了足够的阅读照明。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hi l-luċilettrika biex nixgħel id-dawl? Mark: Fuq il-ħajt, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the switch so I can turn on the light? Mark: On the wall, next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：开灯的开关在哪里？马克：在墙上，门旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-luċilettrika biex nixgħel id-dawl?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-luċilettrika biex nixgħel id-dawl?
messages.zh: 开灯的开关在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the switch so I can turn on the light?

messages.speaker: Mark (主人)
messages.zh: 在墙上，门旁边。
messages.en: On the wall, next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“手按墙上开关，头顶电灯亮起”画成连续动作：一个词联系开关和电灯两个义项，具体指什么要看句子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The geographical region known as the Middle East.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 称为“中东”的地理区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-reġjun ġeografiku magħruf bħala l-Lvant Nofsani.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中东。

collocations.en: the countries of the Middle East
a map of the Middle East

formal.mt: L-istudenti użaw mappa biex jidentifikaw il-pajjiżi tal-Lvant Nofsani.
formal.en: The students used a map to identify the countries of the Middle East.
formal.zh: 学生们借助地图辨认中东各国。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek mappa tal-Lvant Nofsani? Mark: Iva, tinsab f'dan il-ktieb. Maja: Tajjeb, ejja nħarsu lejha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a map of the Middle East? Mark: Yes, there's one in this book. Maja: Good, let's look at it together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有中东地图吗？马克：有，这本书里就有。玛雅：好，我们一起看看。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 你有中东地图吗？
messages.en: Do you have a map of the Middle East?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 有，这本书里就有。
messages.en: Yes, there's one in this book.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 好，我们一起看看。
messages.en: Good, let's look at it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Lvant Nofsani 当作完整地名词组记忆，在地图卡片上同时标注“中东”和“Middle East”，避免只记其中一个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small shovel; the diminutive form of luħ.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小铲子；是 luħ 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pala żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' luħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small shovel (the diminutive form of 'luħ')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小铲子，是 luħ 的指小形式。

collocations.en: to dig with a small shovel

formal.mt: L-istudent uża lwejjaħ biex iħaffer toqba żgħira fil-ħamrija.
formal.en: The student used a small shovel to dig a small hole in the soil.
formal.zh: 学生用一把小铲子在土里挖了一个小洞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tini l-lwejjaħ, jekk jogħġbok? Mark: Hawn hu. Xi trid tħawwel? Maja: Din il-pjanta żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you pass me the small shovel, please? Mark: Here it is. What do you want to plant? Maja: This little plant.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：请把小铲子递给我，好吗？马克：给你。你想种什么？玛雅：这株小植物。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 请把小铲子递给我，好吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the small shovel, please?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 给你。你想种什么？
messages.en: Here it is. What do you want to plant?

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 这株小植物。
messages.en: This little plant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把已给出的 luħ 与 lwejjaħ 并排写下，给后者画一把迷你铲子，用大小对照记住它的指小意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Control or restraint; also, the bit placed in a horse's mouth to help guide it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 控制或约束；也指放在马嘴里、用于引导马匹的马衔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontroll jew trażżin; ukoll, il-biċċa li titqiegħed f'ħalq iż-żiemel biex tgħin tidderiġih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 控制；约束；使行为或情绪受到节制。
马衔；放在马嘴里、用于引导和控制马匹的器具。

formal.mt: Il-mexxej għandu jżomm ir-rabja fil-lġim sabiex ikun jista' jisma' l-opinjonijiet kollha qabel jieħu deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The leader should keep anger under control so that they can hear all opinions before making a decision.
formal.zh: 负责人应控制怒气，以便在作决定前听取所有意见。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tiċċekkja l-lġim taż-żiemel? Mark: Biex niżgura li qiegħed sew f'ħalqu qabel nibdew.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you checking the horse's bit? Mark: To make sure it is positioned properly in its mouth before we start.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么在检查马衔？马克：出发前要确保它在马嘴里的位置合适。

messages.speaker: Lara (骑术学员)
messages.zh: 你为什么在检查马衔？
messages.en: Why are you checking the horse's bit?

messages.speaker: Mark (骑术教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex niżgura li qiegħed sew f'ħalqu qabel nibdew.
messages.mt_standard: Biex niżgura li qiegħed sew f'ħalqu qabel nibdew.
messages.zh: 出发前要确保它在马嘴里的位置合适。
messages.en: To make sure it is positioned properly in its mouth before we start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡记 lġim：一张画马嘴里的马衔，一张画控制怒气的人，分别对应两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A description of someone who is somewhat irritable or easily annoyed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对有些容易生气或略显烦躁的人的描述，程度较轻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Deskrizzjoni ta' xi ħadd li hu xi ftit irritabbli jew li jiddejjaq malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有些易怒的；稍微容易烦躁或生气的。

collocations.en: to be somewhat irritable in the morning

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-missier jidher lħejjeħ filgħodu, iżda aktar tard jitkellem bil-kalma.
formal.en: In the story, the father seems somewhat irritable in the morning, but later speaks calmly.
formal.zh: 故事中的父亲早晨显得有些烦躁，但稍后说话便平静了下来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu jidher lħejjeħ illum. Ġralu xi ħaġa? Mark: Ma raqadx sew. Nagħtuh ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu seems a bit irritable today. Did something happen to him? Mark: He didn't sleep well. Let's give him a little time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu今天好像有点烦躁。他遇到什么事了吗？Mark：他没睡好。给他一点时间吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu jidher lħejjeħ illum. Ġralu xi ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu jidher lħejjeħ illum. Ġralu xi ħaġa?
messages.zh: Pawlu今天好像有点烦躁。他遇到什么事了吗？
messages.en: Pawlu seems a bit irritable today. Did something happen to him?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma raqadx sew. Nagħtuh ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Ma raqadx sew. Nagħtuh ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 他没睡好。给他一点时间吧。
messages.en: He didn't sleep well. Let's give him a little time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住中文里的“有点”二字，联想没睡好时轻微烦躁的样子，避免直接理解成大发雷霆。

gloss_zh: 易骤然闪起或燃起；难相处；易怒；放肆

teaching_sense.en_definition: A description of a tendency to flash or flare up; when describing a person, it can convey a readily provoked temperament.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对容易骤然闪起或燃起的倾向的描述；用于人时，可表达容易动怒的脾性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Deskrizzjoni ta' tendenza li xi ħaġa tixgħel f'daqqa; dwar persuna, tista' tindika li tirrabja malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易骤然闪起或燃起；具有突然闪亮或火势突起的倾向。
难相处的；用于形容人不好应付。
易怒的；容易因小事烦躁或生气的。
放肆的；言行冒失、不够尊重他人的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-ġar hu raġel lħiħ li jirrabja malajr meta xi ħadd ma jaqbilx miegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the neighbour is an irritable man who quickly gets angry when someone disagrees with him.
formal.zh: 小说中的邻居是个易怒的男人，别人一有不同意见，他就很快生气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tgħid li hu lħiħ? Mark: Għax jirrabja fuq kollox u diffiċli titkellem miegħu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you saying he's difficult? Mark: Because he gets angry about everything, and it's hard to have a calm conversation with him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么说他难相处？Mark：因为他什么事都生气，很难跟他心平气和地交谈。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħid li hu lħiħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħid li hu lħiħ?
messages.zh: 你为什么说他难相处？
messages.en: Why are you saying he's difficult?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jirrabja fuq kollox u diffiċli titkellem miegħu bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jirrabja fuq kollox u diffiċli titkellem miegħu bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 因为他什么事都生气，很难跟他心平气和地交谈。
messages.en: Because he gets angry about everything, and it's hard to have a calm conversation with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“突然起火”的画面辅助区分各义：事物可骤然燃起，人可脾气易燃；放肆义另配顶嘴场景。这只是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of reaching a place, level, or goal, or of advancing to a higher position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 到达某处、达到某一水平或目标的行为，也可指职位或等级上的晋升。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tasal f'post, tilħaq livell jew għan, jew titla' għal kariga ogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动词 laħaq 的动作名词，用来表示相应的行为或过程。
到达；达到某个地点、水平或目标。
晋升；升任较高的职位或等级。

formal.mt: Il-pjan jistabbilixxi passi ċari għal-lħuq tal-għanijiet edukattivi.
formal.en: The plan sets out clear steps for achieving the educational goals.
formal.zh: 该计划为实现教育目标规定了明确步骤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer bil-lħuq tal-għanijiet tiegħek? Mark: Tnejn diġà lħaqthom. Issa qed naħdem fuq it-tielet.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are you getting on with achieving your goals? Mark: I've already achieved two. Now I'm working on the third.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的目标完成得怎么样了？Mark：已经实现两个了。现在正在努力实现第三个。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的目标完成得怎么样了？
messages.en: How are you getting on with achieving your goals?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tnejn diġà lħaqthom. Issa qed naħdem fuq it-tielet.
messages.mt_standard: Tnejn diġà lħaqthom. Issa qed naħdem fuq it-tielet.
messages.zh: 已经实现两个了。现在正在努力实现第三个。
messages.en: I've already achieved two. Now I'm working on the third.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一架通向目标的梯子：走到目标是达到，走上更高职位是晋升；借同一画面记住两个具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An excessive desire to acquire or keep money and possessions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对获取或占有金钱、财物的过度欲望，即贪婪或贪财。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa żejda li wieħed jikseb jew iżomm il-flus u l-ġid għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪婪；尤其指对金钱和财物的过分贪求。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont juri kif il-lħuħija għall-flus tista' teqred il-fiduċja bejn il-ħbieb.
formal.en: The story shows how avarice for money can destroy trust between friends.
formal.zh: 这个故事展示了贪财如何破坏朋友之间的信任。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex irid iżomm il-flus kollha għalih? Mark: Din lħuħija. Il-flus suppost jinqasmu bejn kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does he want to keep all the money for himself? Mark: That's avarice. The money is supposed to be shared among everyone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他为什么想把钱全部据为己有？Mark：这就是贪婪。这笔钱本来应该分给大家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex irid iżomm il-flus kollha għalih?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex irid iżomm il-flus kollha għalih?
messages.zh: 他为什么想把钱全部据为己有？
messages.en: Why does he want to keep all the money for himself?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din lħuħija. Il-flus suppost jinqasmu bejn kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Din lħuħija. Il-flus suppost jinqasmu bejn kulħadd.
messages.zh: 这就是贪婪。这笔钱本来应该分给大家。
messages.en: That's avarice. The money is supposed to be shared among everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把所有钱袋都抱在怀里，仍然伸手索取，用这个画面记住过度贪求财物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term expressing eagerness or avid interest in something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达热切、渴望或对某事兴趣强烈的词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tesprimi ħerqa jew xewqa kbira għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热切的；渴望的。
兴趣强烈的；热衷的；渴求的。

formal.mt: Fin-noti tal-lezzjoni, il-kelma 'lżiem' hija spjegata permezz tal-idea ta' ħerqa u xewqa kbira.
formal.en: In the lesson notes, the word 'lżiem' is explained through the idea of eagerness and strong desire.
formal.zh: 课堂笔记用热切和强烈渴望这一概念来解释 lżiem 一词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'lżiem'? Mark: Aħseb f'xi ħadd b'ħerqa kbira biex jitgħallem. Maja: Issa nifhem l-idea.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'lżiem' mean? Mark: Think of someone very eager to learn. Maja: Now I understand the idea.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：lżiem 是什么意思？马克：想象一个非常渴望学习的人。玛雅：现在我明白这个意思了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: lżiem 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'lżiem' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb f'xi ħadd b'ħerqa kbira biex jitgħallem.
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb f'xi ħadd b'ħerqa kbira biex jitgħallem.
messages.zh: 想象一个非常渴望学习的人。
messages.en: Think of someone very eager to learn.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 现在我明白这个意思了。
messages.en: Now I understand the idea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“迫不及待想学”和“对阅读十分着迷”两个画面记住 lżiem 的热切与热衷含义，分别对应 eager 和 avid。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A polite expression used to respond to someone who has thanked you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 回应他人感谢时使用的客气用语，相当于“不客气”或“不用谢”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' korteżija li tintuża bħala tweġiba lil min jirringrazzjak.

sense_translations.en_definition: you're welcome (said in response to an expression of gratitude)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不客气；不用谢，用于回应感谢。

collocations.en: You're welcome; I'm always ready to help.
collocations.zh: 不用谢，我随时愿意帮忙。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, wieġeb għall-kelma 'grazzi' bl-espressjoni 'm'hemmx imniex'.
formal.en: In the exercise, respond to the word 'thank you' with the expression 'you're welcome'.
formal.zh: 在练习中，用“m'hemmx imniex（不客气）”回应“grazzi（谢谢）”。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Grazzi talli ġibtli l-ktieb. Mark: M'hemmx imniex, bil-qalb!
colloquial.en: Maja: Thanks for bringing me the book. Mark: You're welcome, my pleasure!
colloquial.zh: Maja：谢谢你把书带给我。Mark：不客气，我很乐意！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢你把书带给我。
messages.en: Thanks for bringing me the book.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不客气，我很乐意！
messages.en: You're welcome, my pleasure!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句当作感谢后的固定回应：听见 grazzi，就练习接 m'hemmx imniex，相当于中文“不用谢”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to say that you do not understand something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示自己不理解某件事、某句话或某种说法时使用的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tuża biex tgħid li ma tifhimx xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我不明白；我不理解；在听话场景中也可译为“我听不懂”。

collocations.en: I don't understand what you are saying

formal.mt: Ma nifhimx it-tieni parti tal-istruzzjonijiet; nitlob spjegazzjoni aktar ċara.
formal.en: I do not understand the second part of the instructions; I request a clearer explanation.
formal.zh: 我不理解说明的第二部分，请给予更清楚的解释。

colloquial.mt: Lin: Ma nifhimx din il-kelma. Tista' tispjegaha? Anna: Iva, nagħtik eżempju sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Lin: I don't understand this word. Can you explain it? Anna: Yes, I'll give you a simple example.
colloquial.zh: 琳：我不明白这个词。你能解释一下吗？安娜：可以，我给你举个简单的例子。

messages.speaker: Lin (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nifhimx din il-kelma. Tista' tispjegaha?
messages.mt_standard: Ma nifhimx din il-kelma. Tista' tispjegaha?
messages.zh: 我不明白这个词。你能解释一下吗？
messages.en: I don't understand this word. Can you explain it?

messages.speaker: Anna (老师)
messages.zh: 可以，我给你举个简单的例子。
messages.en: Yes, I'll give you a simple example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ma 和 nifhimx 末尾的 x 想成否定表达的两端，整句配上困惑表情记成“我不明白”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement used to tell someone that you do not speak Maltese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于告诉对方自己不会说马耳他语的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frażi li tuża biex tgħid lil xi ħadd li ma tafx titkellem bil-Malti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我不会说马耳他语。

collocations.en: Excuse me, I don't speak Maltese.
collocations.zh: 不好意思，我不会说马耳他语。

collocations.mt: Ma nitkellimx bil-Malti. Tista' tkellimni bl-Ingliż?
collocations.en: I don't speak Maltese. Can you speak to me in English?
collocations.zh: 我不会说马耳他语。你能用英语跟我说吗？

formal.mt: Il-viżitatur qal lir-receptionist: 'Ma nitkellimx bil-Malti. Tista' tkellimni bl-Ingliż?'
formal.en: The visitor said to the receptionist, 'I don't speak Maltese. Can you speak to me in English?'
formal.zh: 访客对接待员说：“我不会说马耳他语。你能用英语跟我说吗？”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Skużani, ma nitkellimx bil-Malti. Mark: Ebda problema, nista' nkellmek bl-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Excuse me, I don't speak Maltese. Mark: No problem, I can speak to you in English.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：不好意思，我不会说马耳他语。马克：没问题，我可以用英语跟你说。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 不好意思，我不会说马耳他语。
messages.en: Excuse me, I don't speak Maltese.

messages.speaker: Mark (接待员)
messages.zh: 没问题，我可以用英语跟你说。
messages.en: No problem, I can speak to you in English.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句分成两块记：ma nitkellimx 是“我不说”，bil-Malti 是“用马耳他语”；语言名 Malti 首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement used to tell someone that you do not speak English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于告诉对方自己不会说英语的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frażi li tuża biex tgħid lil xi ħadd li ma tafx titkellem bl-Ingliż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我不会说英语。

collocations.en: Excuse me, I don't speak English.
collocations.zh: 不好意思，我不会说英语。

collocations.mt: Ma nitkellimx bl-Ingliż. Tista' tkellimni bil-Malti?
collocations.en: I don't speak English. Can you speak to me in Maltese?
collocations.zh: 我不会说英语。你能用马耳他语跟我说吗？

formal.mt: Il-klijent qal lill-impjegat: 'Ma nitkellimx bl-Ingliż. Tista' tkellimni bil-Malti?'
formal.en: The customer said to the employee, 'I don't speak English. Can you speak to me in Maltese?'
formal.zh: 顾客对工作人员说：“我不会说英语。你能用马耳他语跟我说吗？”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Skużani, ma nitkellimx bl-Ingliż. Mark: Tajjeb, nista' nkellmek bil-Malti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Excuse me, I don't speak English. Mark: All right, I can speak to you in Maltese.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：不好意思，我不会说英语。马克：好的，我可以用马耳他语跟你说。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 不好意思，我不会说英语。
messages.en: Excuse me, I don't speak English.

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 好的，我可以用马耳他语跟你说。
messages.en: All right, I can speak to you in Maltese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“我不会说”的 ma nitkellimx，再接 bl-Ingliż“用英语”；与 bil-Malti 成对练习，留意 bl- 和 bil- 的拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: People with similar interests, habits or character tend to associate with one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 兴趣、习惯或性情相近的人往往聚在一起；也可借交往对象来评论一个人的特点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nies b'interessi, drawwiet jew karattru simili għandhom it-tendenza li jagħmlu kumpanija ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.en_definition: birds of a feather flock together
sense_translations.zh_definition: 物以类聚，人以群分；兴趣或性情相近的人常会走到一起。

collocations.mt: Kif jgħid il-qawl, ma' min rajtek xebbahtek.
collocations.en: As the proverb says, birds of a feather flock together.
collocations.zh: 正如谚语所说，物以类聚，人以群分。

collocations.mt: Hawn jgħodd il-qawl: ma' min rajtek xebbahtek.
collocations.en: The proverb applies here: birds of a feather flock together.
collocations.zh: 这里正应了那句谚语：物以类聚，人以群分。

formal.mt: Il-qawl "ma' min rajtek xebbahtek" ifakkarna li n-nies spiss jagħżlu ħbieb li għandhom interessi jew drawwiet simili għal tagħhom.
formal.en: The proverb 'birds of a feather flock together' reminds us that people often choose friends with interests or habits similar to their own.
formal.zh: “物以类聚，人以群分”这句谚语提醒我们，人们常会选择兴趣或习惯与自己相近的朋友。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dawk it-tlieta dejjem flimkien, jitkellmu fuq il-kotba. Ben: Ma' min rajtek xebbahtek! It-tlieta jħobbu jaqraw.
colloquial.en: Marta: Those three are always together, talking about books. Ben: Birds of a feather flock together! All three love reading.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：那三个人总在一起聊书。本：物以类聚，人以群分嘛！他们三个都爱读书。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawk it-tlieta dejjem flimkien, jitkellmu fuq il-kotba.
messages.mt_standard: Dawk it-tlieta dejjem flimkien, jitkellmu fuq il-kotba.
messages.zh: 那三个人总在一起聊书。
messages.en: Those three are always together, talking about books.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' min rajtek xebbahtek! It-tlieta jħobbu jaqraw.
messages.mt_standard: Ma' min rajtek xebbahtek! It-tlieta jħobbu jaqraw.
messages.zh: 物以类聚，人以群分嘛！他们三个都爱读书。
messages.en: Birds of a feather flock together! All three love reading.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象三位爱读书的朋友围坐聊天，把整句 ma' min rajtek xebbahtek 配在画面下，直接联想到中文的物以类聚、人以群分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A heap of dung or animal droppings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 堆在一起的动物粪便，即粪堆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Munzell ta' ħmieġ tal-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粪堆；堆积在一起的动物粪便。

collocations.en: to remove the heap of dung

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem neħħa l-mabgħar minn ħdejn il-bieb tar-razzett.
formal.en: The worker removed the heap of dung from beside the farm gate.
formal.zh: 工人清除了农场大门旁的粪堆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm mabgħar ħdejn il-bieb. Mark: Rajtu. Se nneħħih bil-pala. Maja: Grazzi, imbagħad nista' ngħaddi minn hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a heap of dung beside the gate. Mark: I've seen it. I'll remove it with the shovel. Maja: Thanks, then I can get through there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门旁边有一堆粪便。马克：我看见了。我会用铲子把它清走。玛雅：谢谢，这样我就能从那里过去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场工作人员)
messages.zh: 门旁边有一堆粪便。
messages.en: There's a heap of dung beside the gate.

messages.speaker: Mark (农场工人)
messages.zh: 我看见了。我会用铲子把它清走。
messages.en: I've seen it. I'll remove it with the shovel.

messages.speaker: Maja (农场工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, imbagħad nista' ngħaddi minn hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, imbagħad nista' ngħaddi minn hemm.
messages.zh: 谢谢，这样我就能从那里过去了。
messages.en: Thanks, then I can get through there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mabgħar 配上一幅“用铲子清走粪堆”的图；再与 mabqar 的牛群图对照，特别看清 għ 和 q 的差别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A herd of cattle, considered as a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聚在一起的一群牛，作为一个整体来称呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' baqar meqjus bħala merħla waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一群牛；牛群。

collocations.en: a herd of cattle on the farm

formal.mt: Il-bidwi mexxa l-mabqar mill-għalqa lejn ir-razzett.
formal.en: The farmer led the herd of cattle from the field towards the farm.
formal.zh: 农民把牛群从田地带回农场方向。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-mabqar? Mark: Għadu fl-għalqa. Maja: Ejja mmorru naraw il-baqar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the herd? Mark: It's still in the field. Maja: Let's go and see the cattle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：牛群在哪里？马克：还在田里。玛雅：我们去看看那些牛吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场访客)
messages.zh: 牛群在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the herd?

messages.speaker: Mark (农民)
messages.zh: 还在田里。
messages.en: It's still in the field.

messages.speaker: Maja (农场访客)
messages.zh: 我们去看看那些牛吧。
messages.en: Let's go and see the cattle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 mabqar 就想象一群牛一起走过田野，重点记住“群体”；与 mabgħar 对照练习，q 配牛群，għ 配粪堆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A machine used to spin fibres into yarn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把纤维纺成纱线的机器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magna li tintuża biex jinħadmu l-fibri f'ħajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纺纱机；将纤维加工成纱线的机器。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema jużaw il-mabram biex jagħmlu ħajt mill-fibri.
formal.en: The workers use the spinning machine to make yarn from fibres.
formal.zh: 工人使用纺纱机把纤维纺成纱线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tagħmel din il-magna? Pawlu: Dan mabram; jagħmel il-ħajt mill-fibri.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this machine do? Pawlu: This is a spinning machine; it makes yarn from fibres.
