colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这台机器是做什么的？保罗：这是纺纱机，把纤维纺成纱线。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 这台机器是做什么的？
messages.en: What does this machine do?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工人)
messages.zh: 这是纺纱机，把纤维纺成纱线。
messages.en: This is a spinning machine; it makes yarn from fibres.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mabram 和“松散纤维进去、连续纱线出来”的画面绑定，记住它指纺纱机器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large amount of news or information about recent events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大量关于近况或近期事件的消息，强调消息很多。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd kbir ta' aħbarijiet dwar dak li ġara dan l-aħħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量消息；一大堆新闻。

collocations.en: bring a great deal of news
a great deal of news about the village

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, Pawlu bagħat mabxar dwar il-ħajja fir-raħal.
formal.en: In his letter, Pawlu sent a great deal of news about life in the village.
formal.zh: 保罗在信中讲了许多关于村里生活的近况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ġibt xi aħbarijiet mir-raħal? Pawlu: Ġibt mabxar! Poġġi bilqiegħda ħa ngħidlek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you bring any news from the village? Pawlu: I've brought loads of news! Sit down and I'll tell you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你带来村里的什么消息了吗？保罗：消息可多了！坐下来，我讲给你听。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你带来村里的什么消息了吗？
messages.en: Did you bring any news from the village?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġibt mabxar! Poġġi bilqiegħda ħa ngħidlek.
messages.mt_standard: Ġibt mabxar! Poġġi bilqiegħda ħa ngħidlek.
messages.zh: 消息可多了！坐下来，我讲给你听。
messages.en: I've brought loads of news! Sit down and I'll tell you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友回来后有一大堆近况要讲，用 mabxar 记“消息很多”，不要只记成一条消息。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An island and country off the east coast of Africa, officially called the Republic of Madagascar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于非洲东海岸外的岛屿及国家，正式名称为马达加斯加共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gżira u pajjiż 'il barra mill-kosta tal-Lvant tal-Afrika, bl-isem uffiċjali ta' Repubblika tal-Madagaskar.

sense_translations.en_definition: Madagascar (an island and country off the east coast of Africa; official name: Repubblika tal-Madagaskar)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马达加斯加，位于非洲东海岸外的岛屿及国家；正式名称为马达加斯加共和国。

collocations.zh: 前往马达加斯加的旅行

formal.mt: Il-Madagaskar huwa gżira u pajjiż 'il barra mill-kosta tal-Lvant tal-Afrika.
formal.en: Madagascar is an island and country off the east coast of Africa.
formal.zh: 马达加斯加是位于非洲东海岸外的岛屿及国家。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn tixtieq tmur għal vaganza? Mark: Nixtieq immur il-Madagaskar.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where would you like to go on holiday? Mark: I'd like to go to Madagascar.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你想去哪里度假？马克：我想去马达加斯加。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where would you like to go on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想去马达加斯加。
messages.en: I'd like to go to Madagascar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Madagaskar 与中文“马达加斯加”的读音对应，再想象非洲东岸外的一座大岛，连起名称与地理位置。

gloss_zh: 聚居的一簇房屋；住宅群

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of dwellings situated close together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 彼此相邻、集中分布的一簇住宅，着重指房屋聚在一起形成的群落。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' djar li jinsabu qrib xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 聚集在一起的一簇住宅；住宅群。

collocations.en: a cluster of dwellings near the river

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi madar żgħir ħdejn ix-xmara.
formal.en: The map shows a small cluster of dwellings beside the river.
formal.zh: 地图显示河边有一小簇住宅。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'hemm hemmhekk ħdejn ix-xmara? Pawlu: Hemm madar żgħir, bi ftit djar qrib xulxin.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's over there beside the river? Pawlu: There's a small cluster of dwellings, with a few houses close together.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：河边那边有什么？保罗：有一小簇住宅，几间房子挨得很近。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.zh: 河边那边有什么？
messages.en: What's over there beside the river?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (向导)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm madar żgħir, bi ftit djar qrib xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm madar żgħir, bi ftit djar qrib xulxin.
messages.zh: 有一小簇住宅，几间房子挨得很近。
messages.en: There's a small cluster of dwellings, with a few houses close together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 madar 时画三四间靠在一起的小屋，并在整组外面画圈；用“这一簇住宅”帮助记住它的整体含义。

gloss_zh: 珍珠母层；阴地蕨属植物

teaching_sense.en_definition: The smooth, pearly layer inside certain shells, used as a decorative material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某些贝壳内侧光滑、具有珍珠光泽的层，可用作装饰材料，称为珍珠母层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-saff lixx u jleqq bħal perla fuq ġewwa ta' ċerti qxur tal-baħar, li jintuża għat-tiżjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珍珠母层，某些贝壳内侧具有珍珠光泽的层。

sense_translations.en_definition: moonwort (any fern of the genus Botrychium)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴地蕨属植物，指 Botrychium 属中的任何一种蕨类。

formal.mt: Il-kaxxa hija mżejna b'biċċiet żgħar tal-madriperla.
formal.en: The box is decorated with small pieces of mother-of-pearl.
formal.zh: 这个盒子用小片珍珠母贝作装饰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn xiex huma magħmula dawn il-buttuni? Rita: Mill-madriperla; ara kif jiddi l-wiċċ tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are these buttons made of? Rita: Mother-of-pearl; look how their surface shines.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些纽扣是什么做的？丽塔：珍珠母贝；你看它们的表面多亮。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn xiex huma magħmula dawn il-buttuni?
messages.mt_standard: Minn xiex huma magħmula dawn il-buttuni?
messages.zh: 这些纽扣是什么做的？
messages.en: What are these buttons made of?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mill-madriperla; ara kif jiddi l-wiċċ tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Mill-madriperla; ara kif jiddi l-wiċċ tagħhom.
messages.zh: 珍珠母贝；你看它们的表面多亮。
messages.en: Mother-of-pearl; look how their surface shines.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 madriperla 做两张图卡：一张画贝壳内侧的珠光层，一张画阴地蕨；材料和植物两个义项分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tiles used to cover surfaces such as floors or walls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于铺设地面或覆盖墙面等表面的砖片，常指瓷砖或地砖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċiet ċatti li jintużaw biex jgħattu l-art jew il-ħitan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 砖片；瓷砖或地砖，可指一片或多片。

formal.mt: Il-madum tal-art għandu jitnaddaf qabel ma tinfetaħ is-sala.
formal.en: The floor tiles must be cleaned before the hall is opened.
formal.zh: 大厅开放前必须清洁地砖。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Liema madum nagħżlu għall-kċina? Mark: Dan il-madum abjad jogħġobni.
colloquial.en: Lina: Which tiles shall we choose for the kitchen? Mark: I like these white tiles.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：厨房选哪种瓷砖？马克：我喜欢这些白色瓷砖。

messages.speaker: Lina (家人)
messages.zh: 厨房选哪种瓷砖？
messages.en: Which tiles shall we choose for the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 我喜欢这些白色瓷砖。
messages.en: I like these white tiles.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 madum 写在一张厨房地面图旁，想象许多方形瓷砖排成整面；用“铺地、贴墙的砖片”固定词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A worker who builds walls and other structures by laying bricks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过砌砖来建造墙壁及其他结构的工人，即砌砖工或泥瓦匠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaddiem li jibni ħitan u strutturi oħra billi jqiegħed il-briks u jgħaqqadhom bit-tikħil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 砌砖工；从事砌墙等工作的泥瓦匠。

formal.mt: Il-madumier bena ħajt ġdid tal-briks madwar il-bitħa.
formal.en: The bricklayer built a new brick wall around the yard.
formal.zh: 砌砖工在院子周围砌了一道新砖墙。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Lil min se tqabbad biex jibni l-ħajt? Pawlu: Naf madumier tas-sengħa; se nċempillu llum.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will you hire to build the wall? Pawlu: I know a skilled bricklayer; I'll call him today.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你打算雇谁来砌墙？保罗：我认识一位手艺好的砌砖工，今天就给他打电话。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min se tqabbad biex jibni l-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min se tqabbad biex jibni l-ħajt?
messages.zh: 你打算雇谁来砌墙？
messages.en: Who will you hire to build the wall?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Naf madumier tas-sengħa; se nċempillu llum.
messages.mt_standard: Naf madumier tas-sengħa; se nċempillu llum.
messages.zh: 我认识一位手艺好的砌砖工，今天就给他打电话。
messages.en: I know a skilled bricklayer; I'll call him today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 madumier 配上一位拿着泥刀砌砖墙的工人图像；整词记作“砌砖工”，用人物动作帮助区别材料与职业。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dish made of earthenware, used for holding or serving food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用陶土制成、用来盛放或端上食物的盘状器皿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Platt magħmul mit-tafal, li jintuża biex jitqiegħed jew jiġi servut l-ikel fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陶盘；用陶土制成的盛食器皿。

collocations.en: an earthenware dish full of food

formal.mt: Il-ħobż ġie servut f'mafrad tat-tafal fiċ-ċentru tal-mejda.
formal.en: The bread was served in an earthenware dish in the centre of the table.
formal.zh: 面包盛在陶盘里，摆在桌子中央。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi l-ħobż? Rita: Poġġih fil-mafrad, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall I put the bread? Rita: Put it in the earthenware dish, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：面包放在哪里？丽塔：请放在陶盘里。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.zh: 面包放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put the bread?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 请放在陶盘里。
messages.en: Put it in the earthenware dish, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mafrad 与桌上一只盛着面包的陶盘配对，想象手指摸到陶器表面；用“陶土做的食盘”固定含义。

gloss_zh: 役牛栏；牛舍中的役牛栏位

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stall in which an ox is kept.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于安置役牛的栏位，通常是牛舍内供牛停留、休息的空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fi stalla fejn jinżamm gendus tax-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 役牛栏；供役牛停留和休息的栏位。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi naddaf il-mafrat qabel ma daħħal il-gendus fih.
formal.en: The farmer cleaned the ox stall before bringing the ox into it.
formal.zh: 农夫先清理了役牛栏，然后把牛牵进去。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Il-mafrat lest għall-gendus? Mark: Iva, naddaftu u poġġejt tiben frisk fih.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Is the stall ready for the ox? Mark: Yes, I've cleaned it and put fresh straw in it.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：役牛栏准备好让牛进去了吗？马克：好了，我已经清理过，还铺了新鲜的稻草。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农夫)
messages.zh: 役牛栏准备好让牛进去了吗？
messages.en: Is the stall ready for the ox?

messages.speaker: Mark (农场帮工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naddaftu u poġġejt tiben frisk fih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naddaftu u poġġejt tiben frisk fih.
messages.zh: 好了，我已经清理过，还铺了新鲜的稻草。
messages.en: Yes, I've cleaned it and put fresh straw in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 mafrat 想象一头役牛站在铺着稻草的栏位里，把词写在栏门上；与 mafrad 的陶盘图分开练习末尾字母。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where evaporation occurs; also, a place with hot springs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生蒸发的场所；也指有温泉的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn isseħħ l-evaporazzjoni; jista' jfisser ukoll post b'għejun sħan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生蒸发的场所。
有温泉的地方。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-kelma mafwar tindika l-post fejn isseħħ l-evaporazzjoni tal-ilma.
formal.en: In the report, the word mafwar denotes the place where water evaporation occurs.
formal.zh: 在这份报告中，mafwar 一词指水分发生蒸发的场所。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-post għaliex jissejjaħ mafwar? Toni: Għax hawn għejun sħan; mafwar jista' jfisser post bħal dan ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this place called a mafwar? Toni: Because there are hot springs here; mafwar can mean a place like this too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个地方为什么叫 mafwar？Toni：因为这里有温泉；mafwar 也可以指这样的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 这个地方为什么叫 mafwar？
messages.en: Why is this place called a mafwar?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hawn għejun sħan; mafwar jista' jfisser post bħal dan ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hawn għejun sħan; mafwar jista' jfisser post bħal dan ukoll.
messages.zh: 因为这里有温泉；mafwar 也可以指这样的地方。
messages.en: Because there are hot springs here; mafwar can mean a place like this too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mafwar 配成两张地点卡：一张画水分蒸发，一张画温泉；共同记住它表示场所，再用上下文区分两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A storage place where coal is kept until it is needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 储存煤炭、供需要时取用的地方，即煤仓或储煤处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew maħżen fejn jinżamm il-faħam sakemm ikun hemm bżonnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 煤仓；用于储存煤炭的场所。

collocations.en: a coal store full of coal
the door of the coal store

formal.mt: Il-faħam għandu jinżamm fil-mafħam sakemm ikun meħtieġ.
formal.en: The coal should be kept in the coal store until it is needed.
formal.zh: 煤炭应存放在煤仓内，待需要时取用。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn inpoġġi dawn l-ixkejjer tal-faħam? Mark: Fil-mafħam, ħdejn l-ixkejjer l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where shall I put these sacks of coal? Mark: In the coal store, beside the other sacks.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这些煤袋放在哪里？马克：放到煤仓里，挨着其他袋子。

messages.speaker: Rita (工人)
messages.zh: 这些煤袋放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put these sacks of coal?

messages.speaker: Mark (仓库管理员)
messages.zh: 放到煤仓里，挨着其他袋子。
messages.en: In the coal store, beside the other sacks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 mafħam 时想象一间堆着黑色煤袋的小仓房，把词贴在仓门上；重点记住它表示储煤的地方。

gloss_zh: 马格里布；非洲西北部地区

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Maghreb, a predominantly Arabic-speaking region in northwest Africa, including Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, and western Libya.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马格里布，非洲西北部以阿拉伯语为主要语言的地区，包括摩洛哥、阿尔及利亚、突尼斯及利比亚西部等地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reġjun fil-majjistral tal-Afrika fejn l-Għarbi huwa l-lingwa ewlenija, li jinkludi l-Marokk, l-Alġerija, it-Tuneżija u l-punent tal-Libja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Maghreb (the predominantly Arabic-speaking geographic region comprising northwest Africa, particularly the region of Africa north of the Sahara and west of the Nile; the coastal plains of Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, and western Libya)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马格里布：非洲西北部以阿拉伯语为主要语言的地理区域，尤指撒哈拉沙漠以北、尼罗河以西的非洲地区，包括摩洛哥、阿尔及利亚、突尼斯及利比亚西部的沿海平原。

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jippreżenta ħarsa ġenerali lejn il-ġeografija tal-Magreb.
formal.en: This chapter presents an overview of the geography of the Maghreb.
formal.zh: 本章概述马格里布地区的地理情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn jinsab il-Magreb? Adam: Fil-majjistral tal-Afrika; il-Marokk u t-Tuneżija jagħmlu parti minnu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the Maghreb? Adam: In northwest Africa; Morocco and Tunisia are part of it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马格里布在哪里？亚当：在非洲西北部，摩洛哥和突尼斯都属于这个地区。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 马格里布在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the Maghreb?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-majjistral tal-Afrika; il-Marokk u t-Tuneżija jagħmlu parti minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-majjistral tal-Afrika; il-Marokk u t-Tuneżija jagħmlu parti minnu.
messages.zh: 在非洲西北部，摩洛哥和突尼斯都属于这个地区。
messages.en: In northwest Africa; Morocco and Tunisia are part of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Magreb 放在非洲地图的左上方记忆：想到摩洛哥、阿尔及利亚和突尼斯，就能定位马格里布地区。

gloss_zh: 马格里布的；马格里布人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to the Maghreb region of northwest Africa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自或涉及非洲西北部马格里布地区的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Magreb jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' dan ir-reġjun.

sense_translations.en_definition: Maghrebi (of, from or relating to Maghreb)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马格里布的；来自马格里布地区的；与该地区有关的。
马格里布人；马格里布地区的本地人或居民。

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi taħdita minn kittieb Magrebin dwar il-letteratura tar-reġjun.
formal.en: The programme includes a talk by a Maghrebi writer about the region's literature.
formal.zh: 活动安排包括一位马格里布作家关于该地区文学的讲座。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Dan il-kittieb huwa Magrebin? Sami: Iva, ġej mill-Marokk.
colloquial.en: Lina: Is this writer Maghrebi? Sami: Yes, he comes from Morocco.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这位作家是马格里布人吗？萨米：是的，他来自摩洛哥。

messages.speaker: Lina (读者)
messages.zh: 这位作家是马格里布人吗？
messages.en: Is this writer Maghrebi?

messages.speaker: Sami (书店店员)
messages.zh: 是的，他来自摩洛哥。
messages.en: Yes, he comes from Morocco.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Magreb 与 Magrebin 配对记：前者是地区名称，后者可描述该地区的人或事物，也可作名词指当地人。

gloss_zh: 瘦的；瘦肉的；微薄的；稀少的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thin or lean, or small and insufficient in amount.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体瘦或脂肪少的；也可形容数量少、微薄或不足。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ftit xaħam, jew li huwa ftit u mhux biżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瘦的；脂肪少的；单薄的。
贫乏的；微薄的；稀少或不足的。

formal.mt: Minkejja d-dħul magru tiegħu, irnexxielu jħallas l-ispejjeż essenzjali.
formal.en: Despite his meagre income, he managed to pay the essential expenses.
formal.zh: 尽管收入微薄，他仍设法支付了必要开支。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Nixtieq ftit laħam magru, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Żgur. Kemm trid?
colloquial.en: Rita: I'd like some lean meat, please. Mark: Certainly. How much would you like?
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：请给我一些瘦肉。马克：好的，您要多少？

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq ftit laħam magru, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq ftit laħam magru, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我一些瘦肉。
messages.en: I'd like some lean meat, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (肉店店员)
messages.zh: 好的，您要多少？
messages.en: Certainly. How much would you like?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“少”串联 magru 的义项：肉里脂肪少是“瘦”，收入数量少是“微薄”，同一个词可描述不同对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who habitually chews things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人有经常咀嚼东西的习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu d-drawwa li jomgħod xi ħaġa ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯于咀嚼东西的；形容经常嚼东西的人。

collocations.en: a boy who habitually chews things
to be someone who habitually chews things
collocations.zh: 有经常咀嚼东西的习惯

formal.mt: Fit-test, it-tifel huwa deskritt bħala magħadi għax spiss jomgħod xi ħaġa waqt li jaqra.
formal.en: In the text, the boy is described as a habitual chewer because he often chews something while reading.
formal.zh: 文中把这个男孩描述为惯于咀嚼东西的人，因为他看书时经常嚼着什么。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser magħadi? Pawlu: Xi ħadd li għandu d-drawwa li jomgħod xi ħaġa ta' spiss, bħal ħija waqt li jistudja.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does magħadi mean? Pawlu: Someone who habitually chews something, like my brother when he studies.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：magħadi 是什么意思？保罗：就是惯于嚼东西的人，比如我哥哥学习时就常这样。

messages.speaker: Maja (学习者)
messages.zh: magħadi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does magħadi mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd li għandu d-drawwa li jomgħod xi ħaġa ta' spiss, bħal ħija waqt li jistudja.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd li għandu d-drawwa li jomgħod xi ħaġa ta' spiss, bħal ħija waqt li jistudja.
messages.zh: 就是惯于嚼东西的人，比如我哥哥学习时就常这样。
messages.en: Someone who habitually chews something, like my brother when he studies.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个学习时总在嚼东西的人，用这个反复出现的动作记住 magħadi，重点是“习惯如此”。

gloss_zh: 咀嚼；一小团嚼过的烟草

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of chewing; also, a small amount of tobacco that has been chewed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次咀嚼的动作；也可指一小团已经嚼过的烟草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tomgħod xi ħaġa; ukoll, ammont żgħir ta' tabakk li jkun ġie mimgħud.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次咀嚼；嚼的动作。

sense_translations.en_definition: a small amount of chewed tobacco
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小团已经嚼过的烟草。

collocations.en: a small amount of chewed tobacco

formal.mt: Wara magħda waħda, it-tifel waqaf għax l-ikel kien għadu sħun wisq.
formal.en: After one chew, the boy stopped because the food was still too hot.
formal.zh: 男孩嚼了一下便停了下来，因为食物还太烫。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għadek ma doqtx il-ħobż? Luqa: Iva, tajtu magħda waħda biss. Għadu sħun!
colloquial.en: Marta: Haven't you tasted the bread yet? Luqa: Yes, I've only given it one chew. It's still hot!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你还没尝面包吗？卢卡：尝了，不过只嚼了一下。还烫着呢！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还没尝面包吗？
messages.en: Haven't you tasted the bread yet?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tajtu magħda waħda biss. Għadu sħun!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tajtu magħda waħda biss. Għadu sħun!
messages.zh: 尝了，不过只嚼了一下。还烫着呢！
messages.en: Yes, I've only given it one chew. It's still hot!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 magħda 配上嘴巴嚼一下的画面；遇到 tabakk 时，再切换成一小团嚼过的烟草。

gloss_zh: 拐弯抹角地说；避免直说；借类比或比喻说明

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express something indirectly, by talking around the point or by using an analogy or metaphor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 间接表达意思，可以是绕着要点说、避免直说，也可以是用类比或比喻说明观点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titkellem b'mod indirett, billi ddur mal-punt jew tuża analoġija jew metafora biex twassal ħsieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拐弯抹角地说话，绕着主题而不直接切入要点。
避免直截了当地表达；不把意思直接说出来。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a point by analogy or metaphor
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过类比或比喻来说明一个观点。

collocations.en: he talked around the point instead of answering directly
collocations.zh: 他没有直接回答，而是绕着要点说

collocations.en: he made his point through a metaphor
collocations.zh: 他用一个比喻说明了观点

formal.mt: Fir-risposta tiegħu, il-kelliem magħdar b'metafora dwar vapur biex jispjega l-importanza tal-kooperazzjoni.
formal.en: In his reply, the speaker used a metaphor about a ship to explain the importance of cooperation.
formal.zh: 发言者在回答时借船作比喻，说明合作的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu qal għaliex ma ġiex? Mark: Le, magħdar u baqa' jitkellem fuq affarijiet oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Pawlu say why he didn't come? Mark: No, he beat about the bush and kept talking about other things.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗说他为什么没来了吗？马克：没有，他拐弯抹角，一直在说别的事。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗说他为什么没来了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu say why he didn't come?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, magħdar u baqa' jitkellem fuq affarijiet oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, magħdar u baqa' jitkellem fuq affarijiet oħra.
messages.zh: 没有，他拐弯抹角，一直在说别的事。
messages.en: No, he beat about the bush and kept talking about other things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一条弯曲的说话路线：magħdar 可以绕开直说，也可以借一个比喻把意思送到。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To crush or work food with the teeth, including chewing it vigorously.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用牙齿嚼动或嚼碎食物，也可指用力地嚼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfarrak jew taħdem l-ikel bis-snien; jista' jfisser ukoll li tomgħod bis-saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咀嚼；用牙齿嚼动或嚼碎食物。
用力地嚼；使劲咀嚼。

formal.mt: Iż-żiemel magħgħad il-ħuxlief bis-saħħa qabel dar lejn il-bieb tal-istalla.
formal.en: The horse vigorously chewed the hay before turning towards the stable door.
formal.zh: 马使劲嚼了嚼干草，然后转向马厩的门。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tifel kiel il-biċċa ħobż? David: Iva, magħgħad kull gidma bil-mod u mbagħad talab oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the boy eat the piece of bread? David: Yes, he chewed each bite slowly and then asked for another piece.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：孩子吃了那块面包吗？戴维：吃了，他每一口都慢慢嚼，吃完又要了一块。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子吃了那块面包吗？
messages.en: Did the boy eat the piece of bread?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, magħgħad kull gidma bil-mod u mbagħad talab oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, magħgħad kull gidma bil-mod u mbagħad talab oħra.
messages.zh: 吃了，他每一口都慢慢嚼，吃完又要了一块。
messages.en: Yes, he chewed each bite slowly and then asked for another piece.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习 magħgħad 时想象牙齿反复嚼动；普通力度是咀嚼，加大力度就对应使劲嚼。

gloss_zh: 养鱼围池；养鱼用的围水区

teaching_sense.en_definition: An enclosed area of water used for breeding fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围起来供鱼类繁育、养殖使用的一片水域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti magħluqa tal-ilma fejn jitrabba l-ħut.

sense_translations.en_definition: a water enclosure to breed fish
sense_translations.zh_definition: 供繁育、养殖鱼类使用的围水区或围池。

collocations.en: a water enclosure for breeding fish

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema spezzjonaw il-magħlaq fejn kien qed jitrabba l-ħut.
formal.en: The workers inspected the water enclosure where the fish were being bred.
formal.zh: 工作人员检查了正在用于养鱼的围水区。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn qed trabbu l-ħut? Ġużeppi: F'dak il-magħlaq ħdejn ix-xatt. Trid tarah?
colloquial.en: Marija: Where are you raising the fish? Ġużeppi: In that water enclosure near the shore. Would you like to see it?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你们在哪儿养鱼？朱塞佩：在岸边的那个养鱼围池里。你想去看看吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (访客)
messages.zh: 你们在哪儿养鱼？
messages.en: Where are you raising the fish?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (养鱼员)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dak il-magħlaq ħdejn ix-xatt. Trid tarah?
messages.mt_standard: F'dak il-magħlaq ħdejn ix-xatt. Trid tarah?
messages.zh: 在岸边的那个养鱼围池里。你想去看看吗？
messages.en: In that water enclosure near the shore. Would you like to see it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 magħlaq 画一片围起来的水，再画几条正在养殖的鱼，把水域和养鱼用途一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The stalk, stem, or main axis of a plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物的茎或主轴，即支撑枝叶的茎部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iz-zokk jew l-assi prinċipali ta' pjanta li jġorr il-weraq u l-friegħi.

sense_translations.en_definition: stalk (stem or main axis of a plant)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物的茎，即植物的茎干或主轴。

formal.mt: L-istudenta kejlet it-tul tal-magħleb tal-pjanta u niżżlet ir-riżultat fin-noti tagħha.
formal.en: The student measured the length of the plant's stalk and recorded the result in her notes.
formal.zh: 这名学生测量了植物茎的长度，并把结果记在笔记中。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Liema parti rrid inkejjel? Mario: Il-magħleb tal-pjanta, minn fejn joħroġ mill-ħamrija sa fuq.
colloquial.en: Elena: Which part should I measure? Mario: The plant's stalk, from where it comes out of the soil to the top.
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：我要量哪个部位？马里奥：量植物的茎，从它露出土面的地方一直量到顶端。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.zh: 我要量哪个部位？
messages.en: Which part should I measure?

messages.speaker: Mario (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-magħleb tal-pjanta, minn fejn joħroġ mill-ħamrija sa fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Il-magħleb tal-pjanta, minn fejn joħroġ mill-ħamrija sa fuq.
messages.zh: 量植物的茎，从它露出土面的地方一直量到顶端。
messages.en: The plant's stalk, from where it comes out of the soil to the top.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在植物简图上把中间的主茎涂亮，旁边标 magħleb，让单词对应具体的植物部位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Food given to animals, especially farm animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供动物食用的饲料，尤其指喂养农场牲畜的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel li jingħata lill-annimali, speċjalment lill-bhejjem tar-razzett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 饲料；供动物食用的食物。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħażen il-magħlef f'post niexef qabel waslet ix-xitwa.
formal.en: The farmer stored the fodder in a dry place before winter arrived.
formal.zh: 农民在冬季来临前把饲料存放在干燥的地方。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fadal biżżejjed magħlef għall-baqar? Anton: Għal-lum iva, imma għada rridu nixtru aktar.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is there enough fodder left for the cattle? Anton: For today, yes, but tomorrow we need to buy more.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：剩下的饲料够喂牛吗？安东：今天够，不过明天得再买一些。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场工人)
messages.zh: 剩下的饲料够喂牛吗？
messages.en: Is there enough fodder left for the cattle?

messages.speaker: Anton (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal-lum iva, imma għada rridu nixtru aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Għal-lum iva, imma għada rridu nixtru aktar.
messages.zh: 今天够，不过明天得再买一些。
messages.en: For today, yes, but tomorrow we need to buy more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一袋 magħlef 倒进牛的食槽；把它记成动物吃的饲料，连同喂养场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suffering from diseases or afflicted by illness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身患疾病、多病的，或受到病痛折磨的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jbati minn mard jew ikun milqut minn ħafna mard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多病的；疾病缠身、受病痛折磨的。

collocations.en: an elderly man afflicted by illness
collocations.zh: 一位受病痛折磨的老人

formal.mt: Ir-raġel magħlul ma setax jattendi l-laqgħa minħabba l-mard li kien qed ibati minnu.
formal.en: The ailing man could not attend the meeting because of the illnesses he was suffering from.
formal.zh: 这名疾病缠身的男子因病无法出席会议。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif inhu n-nannu tiegħek? Pietru: Għadu magħlul, imma jieħu gost meta mmur inżuru.
colloquial.en: Anna: How is your grandfather? Pietru: He's still ailing, but he enjoys it when I visit him.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你爷爷怎么样了？彼得：他仍受病痛折磨，不过我去看他时，他很开心。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷怎么样了？
messages.en: How is your grandfather?

messages.speaker: Pietru (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu magħlul, imma jieħu gost meta mmur inżuru.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu magħlul, imma jieħu gost meta mmur inżuru.
messages.zh: 他仍受病痛折磨，不过我去看他时，他很开心。
messages.en: He's still ailing, but he enjoys it when I visit him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 magħlul 放进 raġel magħlul 一起记，想象一位疾病缠身、正在休息的人，记住它描述患病状态。

gloss_zh: 马格里布；北非；摩洛哥；伊斯兰教昏礼时间；西方

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Maghreb, a region in the northwestern part of Africa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马格里布，非洲西北部的一个地区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-Magħreb huwa reġjun fil-parti tal-majjistral tal-Afrika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马格里布，非洲西北部地区的名称。
北非，即非洲北部地区。
摩洛哥，位于北非的一个国家。

sense_translations.en_definition: maghrib, the sunset time of the Islamic prayer
sense_translations.zh_definition: 伊斯兰教昏礼的时间，即日落时分。
西方、西部；也可指作为地域或文化概念的西方。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kultura u l-istorja tal-pajjiżi tal-Magħreb.
formal.en: The report describes the culture and history of the countries of the Maghreb.
formal.zh: 这份报告介绍了马格里布各国的文化和历史。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed taqra? Samir: Qed naqra ktieb dwar il-Magħreb.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you reading? Samir: I'm reading a book about the Maghreb.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在读什么？萨米尔：我在读一本关于马格里布的书。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Samir (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在读一本关于马格里布的书。
messages.en: I'm reading a book about the Maghreb.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用语境卡片记忆：地图上的 Magħreb 先联想马格里布地区；再分别记住北非、摩洛哥、西方和昏礼时间这些义项。地名与日落时间分开造句，避免混用。

gloss_zh: 马格里布的；摩洛哥的或具有摩洛哥血统的；马格里布体阿拉伯书法的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Maghreb region or its people and culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与马格里布地区、当地居民或其文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mar-reġjun tal-Magħreb, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tagħhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: Of or relating to the Maghreb or its people.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马格里布的；与马格里布地区或其居民有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Moroccan, a person from Morocco or of Moroccan descent.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 摩洛哥的；形容来自摩洛哥或具有摩洛哥血统的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: concerning a certain style of Arabic calligraphy, the so-called Maghrebi script (خَطّ مَغْرِبِيّ (ḵaṭṭ maḡribiyy), قَلَم مَغْرِبِيّ (qalam maḡribiyy))
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与一种称为马格里布体的阿拉伯书法字体有关的。

formal.mt: Il-manuskritt huwa miktub bi stil Magħrebi ta' kaligrafija Għarbija.
formal.en: The manuscript is written in a Maghrebi style of Arabic calligraphy.
formal.zh: 这份手稿采用马格里布风格的阿拉伯书法书写。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ikel Magħrebi? Karim: Iva. Trid idduq? Maja: Iva, nixtieq nipprova ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this Maghrebi food? Karim: Yes. Would you like a taste? Maja: Yes, I'd like to try a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是马格里布风味的食物吗？卡里姆：是的。你想尝尝吗？玛雅：想，我想尝一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是马格里布风味的食物吗？
messages.en: Is this Maghrebi food?

messages.speaker: Karim (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的。你想尝尝吗？
messages.en: Yes. Would you like a taste?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，我想尝一点。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to try a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Magħrebi 放在名词旁边记：ikel Magħrebi 是马格里布风味的食物，stil Magħrebi 是马格里布风格。遇到人物语境再考虑摩洛哥相关义，遇到书法语境则联想马格里布体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A press or mill used to crush material and extract liquid, such as oil from olives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过挤压原料来提取液体的压榨机或榨坊，例如从橄榄中榨取橄榄油的设备或场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magna jew post fejn jingħasar materjal biex minnu jittieħed likwidu, bħaż-żejt miż-żebbuġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压榨机；榨坊，指挤压原料以提取液体的设备或加工场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Magna jew post fejn jingħasar materjal, pereżempju ż-żebbuġ biex isir iż-żejt.

formal.mt: Iż-żebbuġ jinġieb fil-magħsra biex minnu jiġi estratt iż-żejt.
formal.en: The olives are brought to the mill so that oil can be extracted from them.
formal.zh: 橄榄被运到榨坊，以便从中提取橄榄油。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se nieħdu ż-żebbuġ? Pawlu: Fil-magħsra ħdejn ir-raħal.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are we taking the olives? Pawlu: To the mill near the village.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们要把橄榄送到哪里？保罗：送到村子附近的榨坊。

messages.speaker: Lara (果园主人)
messages.zh: 我们要把橄榄送到哪里？
messages.en: Where are we taking the olives?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (果园工人)
messages.zh: 送到村子附近的榨坊。
messages.en: To the mill near the village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 magħsra 和“橄榄进去、油流出来”的画面绑定：既可以记压榨设备，也可以记安放设备的榨坊。这是场景记忆法，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trough used for mixing and kneading dough.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来混合面料并揉制面团的槽状容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent f'għamla ta' ħawt li fih jitħalltu l-ingredjenti u tinħadem l-għaġina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 揉面槽；供和面、揉面使用的槽状容器。

collocations.en: to work the dough in the kneading trough

formal.mt: Il-furnar poġġa d-dqiq u l-ilma fil-magħġen u beda jaħdem l-għaġina.
formal.en: The baker put the flour and water into the kneading trough and began working the dough.
formal.zh: 面包师把面粉和水放进揉面槽，开始揉面。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se nagħmlu l-għaġina? Toni: Fil-magħġen tal-injam. Għadni kif naddaftu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where are we going to make the dough? Toni: In the wooden kneading trough. I've just cleaned it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们在哪儿和面？托尼：在那个木制揉面槽里。我刚把它清理干净。

messages.speaker: Nina (面包店学徒)
messages.zh: 我们在哪儿和面？
messages.en: Where are we going to make the dough?

messages.speaker: Toni (面包师)
messages.zh: 在那个木制揉面槽里。我刚把它清理干净。
messages.en: In the wooden kneading trough. I've just cleaned it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 magħġen 想成面包师双手揉面的长槽，重点记住它是盛放面团的器具。

gloss_zh: 被选中的；当选而尚未就任的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Selected from among alternatives; when used with an office title, elected but not yet in office.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从多个选项中被选定的；用于职务名称时，也可表示已经当选但尚未就任的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ntgħażel minn fost diversi għażliet; ma' titlu ta' kariga, li ġie elett iżda għadu ma bediex jaqdi dik il-kariga.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被选中的；经过选择而确定的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ntgħażel minn fost oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 当选而尚未就任的，常与职务名称连用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie elett għal kariga iżda għadu ma bediex jaqdiha.

collocations.zh: 当选而尚未就任的总统

formal.mt: Il-president magħżul se jibda jaqdi l-kariga tiegħu x-xahar id-dieħel.
formal.en: The president-elect will take office next month.
formal.zh: 当选总统将于下个月就任。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan hu r-rigal magħżul għal Marija? Pawlu: Iva, għażilnieh flimkien ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this the gift chosen for Marija? Pawlu: Yes, we chose it together yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是给玛丽娅选定的礼物吗？保罗：是的，我们昨天一起选的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu r-rigal magħżul għal Marija?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu r-rigal magħżul għal Marija?
messages.zh: 这是给玛丽娅选定的礼物吗？
messages.en: Is this the gift chosen for Marija?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我们昨天一起选的。
messages.en: Yes, we chose it together yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 magħżul 想成选项旁边已经打好的勾：礼物打勾就是“选定的”；总统人选打勾、还在等待就职，就是“当选而尚未就任的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bruise or contusion caused by a blow or impact.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到撞击或碰打后形成的瘀伤、挫伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ferita minn daqqa jew ħabta li tista' tħalli marka b'kulur differenti fuq il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瘀伤；挫伤。

formal.mt: Wara l-waqgħa, it-tifel kellu makkatura fuq id-driegħ.
formal.en: After the fall, the boy had a bruise on his arm.
formal.zh: 摔倒后，男孩的手臂上出现了一处瘀伤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ġiet dik il-makkatura? Mark: Ħbatt driegħi mal-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you get that bruise? Mark: I bumped my arm against the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你那处瘀伤是怎么来的？马克：我的手臂撞到门上了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你那处瘀伤是怎么来的？
messages.en: How did you get that bruise?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的手臂撞到门上了。
messages.en: I bumped my arm against the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 makkatura 和“撞门后手臂青了一块”的画面一起记，看到这个词就回想身体上的瘀伤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stain or mark on a surface; also a bad name or a stain on someone's reputation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体表面的污渍或印痕；也指名声上的污点、污名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marka fuq wiċċ jew materjal; ukoll ħsara lir-reputazzjoni ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污渍；印痕；物体表面留下的斑点或痕迹。
污名；恶名；受损的名声。

formal.mt: Din il-gidba ħalliet makkja fuq ir-reputazzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: This lie left a stain on his reputation.
formal.zh: 这个谎言给他的名声留下了污点。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm makkja fuq il-qmis tiegħek. Pawlu: Waqqajt ftit kafè fuqha dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: There's a stain on your shirt. Pawlu: I spilled a little coffee on it this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的衬衫上有块污渍。保罗：今天早上我洒了点咖啡在上面。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的衬衫上有块污渍。
messages.en: There's a stain on your shirt.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天早上我洒了点咖啡在上面。
messages.en: I spilled a little coffee on it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 makkja：衣服上是咖啡污渍，名声上是污点；从具体表面联想到抽象名誉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stain on cloth, paper, or another surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布料、纸张或其他表面上的污渍、污斑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marka ta' ħmieġ, linka jew sustanza oħra fuq drapp, karta jew wiċċ ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污渍；污斑。

formal.mt: Il-paġna għandha makkjatura tal-linka ħdejn il-firma.
formal.en: The page has an ink stain next to the signature.
formal.zh: 这页纸的签名旁边有一块墨水渍。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-makkjatura kienet hawn qabel? Nina: Le, waqgħet qatra meraq fuq it-tvalja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was this stain here before? Nina: No, a drop of juice fell onto the tablecloth.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块污渍原来就在这里吗？妮娜：不是，有一滴果汁滴到桌布上了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这块污渍原来就在这里吗？
messages.en: Was this stain here before?

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, waqgħet qatra meraq fuq it-tvalja.
messages.mt_standard: Le, waqgħet qatra meraq fuq it-tvalja.
messages.zh: 不是，有一滴果汁滴到桌布上了。
messages.en: No, a drop of juice fell onto the tablecloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 makkjatura 写在想象中的桌布污斑旁，连同“果汁滴下，留下污渍”的小场景一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 有斑点的；斑驳的；杂色的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having small spots, patches, or areas of different colours.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面带有小斑点、色块或不同颜色区域的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tikek jew irqajja' ta' kuluri differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有细小斑点的；带斑的；颜色斑驳的；杂色的。

formal.mt: Għall-kostum intgħażel drapp makkjettat b'tikek żgħar suwed.
formal.en: Fabric speckled with small black spots was chosen for the costume.
formal.zh: 这套服装选用了带有黑色小斑点的布料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema qattus hu tiegħek? Mark: Dak il-qattus makkjettat ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which cat is yours? Mark: That spotted cat next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：哪只猫是你的？马克：门旁边那只带斑点的猫。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 哪只猫是你的？
messages.en: Which cat is yours?

messages.speaker: Mark (猫主人)
messages.zh: 门旁边那只带斑点的猫。
messages.en: That spotted cat next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只身上布满不同色斑的猫，用 qattus makkjettat 整组记住“有斑点、颜色斑驳”的样子。

gloss_zh: 漫画讽刺画家；性格演员

teaching_sense.en_definition: An artist who draws caricatures, or an actor who plays distinctive character roles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 绘制夸张人物漫画的画家；或擅长扮演鲜明人物类型的性格演员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Artist li jpinġi karikaturi, jew attur li jinterpreta rwoli ta' karattri distintivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漫画讽刺画家；通过夸张人物特征作画的人。
性格演员；擅长扮演具有鲜明个性或特定人物类型的演员。

collocations.zh: 绘制夸张人物漫画的画家

collocations.en: a character actor in the theatre

formal.mt: Il-makkjettist ħejja karikaturi tal-kelliema għall-wirja.
formal.en: The caricaturist prepared caricatures of the speakers for the exhibition.
formal.zh: 这位漫画讽刺画家为展览绘制了几位演讲者的夸张人物画。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jagħmel ir-rwol tal-ġar stramb? Pawlu: Makkjettist li rajt fit-teatru s-sena l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will play the eccentric neighbour? Pawlu: A character actor I saw at the theatre last year.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁来演那个古怪的邻居？保罗：一位我去年在剧场看过演出的性格演员。

messages.speaker: Sara (戏剧社成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jagħmel ir-rwol tal-ġar stramb?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jagħmel ir-rwol tal-ġar stramb?
messages.zh: 谁来演那个古怪的邻居？
messages.en: Who will play the eccentric neighbour?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (戏剧社成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Makkjettist li rajt fit-teatru s-sena l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Makkjettist li rajt fit-teatru s-sena l-oħra.
messages.zh: 一位我去年在剧场看过演出的性格演员。
messages.en: A character actor I saw at the theatre last year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“画纸与舞台”两个场景记 makkjettist：画纸上夸张人物特征，舞台上塑造鲜明角色；这是词义联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes false accusations to damage another person's reputation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以虚假指控损害他人名誉的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel akkużi foloz biex tagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诬蔑者；通过虚假指控中伤他人名誉的人。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-malafamatur ixerred akkużi foloz biex jagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni tal-għalliem.
formal.en: In the story, the calumniator spreads false accusations to damage the teacher's reputation.
formal.zh: 故事中，诬蔑者散布虚假指控，企图损害老师的名誉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex issejjaħlu malafamatur? Nina: Għax qed ixerred gideb dwar il-ġar biex iħassarlu ismu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you call him a calumniator? Nina: Because he's spreading lies about the neighbour to ruin his good name.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么说他是诬蔑者？妮娜：因为他在散布关于邻居的谎言，想毁掉邻居的名声。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是诬蔑者？
messages.en: Why do you call him a calumniator?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed ixerred gideb dwar il-ġar biex iħassarlu ismu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed ixerred gideb dwar il-ġar biex iħassarlu ismu.
messages.zh: 因为他在散布关于邻居的谎言，想毁掉邻居的名声。
messages.en: Because he's spreading lies about the neighbour to ruin his good name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 malafamatur 放进“编造指控、损害名誉”的故事里记，重点抓住“虚假内容”和“中伤他人”两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in Southern Africa, officially called the Republic of Malawi.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非洲南部的国家，正式名称为马拉维共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika tal-Malawi.

sense_translations.en_definition: Malawi (a country in Southern Africa; official name: Repubblika tal-Malawi)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马拉维，非洲南部的国家；正式名称为马拉维共和国。

formal.mt: Ir-Repubblika tal-Malawi hija pajjiż fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika.
formal.en: The Republic of Malawi is a country in Southern Africa.
formal.zh: 马拉维共和国是非洲南部的一个国家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn jinsab il-Malawi? Mark: Fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika. Ejja nfittxuh fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Malawi? Mark: In Southern Africa. Let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马拉维在哪里？马克：在非洲南部。我们在地图上找找它吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 马拉维在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Malawi?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika. Ejja nfittxuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika. Ejja nfittxuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在非洲南部。我们在地图上找找它吧。
messages.en: In Southern Africa. Let's find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Malawi 与中文“马拉维”及非洲南部的地图位置一起记；书写国家名称时保留首字母大写。

gloss_zh: 马来西亚的；马来西亚人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from or relating to Malaysia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自或涉及马来西亚这个国家的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Malażja jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' dan il-pajjiż.

sense_translations.en_definition: Malaysian (of, from or relating to Malaysia)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马来西亚的；来自马来西亚的；与马来西亚有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Malaysian (native or inhabitant of Malaysia) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马来西亚人，指出生或居住在马来西亚的人，通常指男性。

formal.mt: L-istudent Malazjan ippreżenta r-rapport tiegħu waqt il-laqgħa tal-grupp.
formal.en: The Malaysian student presented his report during the group meeting.
formal.zh: 这名马来西亚学生在小组会议上汇报了自己的报告。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Minn fejn hu l-istudent il-ġdid? Pawlu: Hu Malazjan. Anna: Ejja nistednuh joqgħod magħna.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the new student from? Pawlu: He's Malaysian. Anna: Let's invite him to sit with us.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：新同学是哪里人？保罗：他是马来西亚人。安娜：我们邀请他和我们一起坐吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 新同学是哪里人？
messages.en: Where is the new student from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 他是马来西亚人。
messages.en: He's Malaysian.

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 我们邀请他和我们一起坐吧。
messages.en: Let's invite him to sit with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把不带点的 z 与“马来西亚护照”这幅画面绑定，记住本词表达国家归属；与 Malażjan 的族群和语言义分开学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in Southeast Asia called Malaysia in English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 东南亚国家马来西亚，英语名称为 Malaysia。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fix-Xlokk tal-Asja, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala Malaysia.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马来西亚，东南亚的一个国家。

formal.mt: L-istudenti sabu l-Malażja fuq mappa tax-Xlokk tal-Asja.
formal.en: The students found Malaysia on a map of Southeast Asia.
formal.zh: 学生们在东南亚地图上找到了马来西亚。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganzi? Pawlu: Se mmur il-Malażja. Sara: Il-Malażja tinsab fix-Xlokk tal-Asja, hux?
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going on holiday? Pawlu: I'm going to Malaysia. Sara: Malaysia is in Southeast Asia, right?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你准备去哪里度假？保罗：我要去马来西亚。萨拉：马来西亚在东南亚，对吧？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要去马来西亚。
messages.en: I'm going to Malaysia.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马来西亚在东南亚，对吧？
messages.en: Malaysia is in Southeast Asia, right?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“Malażja—Malaysia—马来西亚”三语对照卡记忆，再配上东南亚地图；注意马耳他语拼写中的 ż。

gloss_zh: 马来人的；马来语的；马来人；马来语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Malay people, their language or their culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与马来人、马来语或马来文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-poplu Malażjan, mal-lingwa tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马来的；马来人的；马来语的。
马来人，指属于马来族群的人。
马来语。

formal.mt: It-test jintroduċi l-ilsien Malażjan permezz ta' kliem u sentenzi qosra.
formal.en: The text introduces the Malay language through words and short sentences.
formal.zh: 这篇课文通过词语和短句介绍马来语。

colloquial.mt: Lara: B'liema lingwa hi miktuba din il-kelma? Mark: Bil-Malażjan. Lara: Tista' tgħidli xi tfisser?
colloquial.en: Lara: What language is this word written in? Mark: Malay. Lara: Can you tell me what it means?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个词是用什么语言写的？马克：马来语。拉拉：你能告诉我它是什么意思吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: B'liema lingwa hi miktuba din il-kelma?
messages.mt_standard: B'liema lingwa hi miktuba din il-kelma?
messages.zh: 这个词是用什么语言写的？
messages.en: What language is this word written in?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 马来语。
messages.en: Malay.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 你能告诉我它是什么意思吗？
messages.en: Can you tell me what it means?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把带点的 ż 与“马来族群、马来语”绑定记忆；用“马来语课本”作画面，与表示马来西亚国籍的 Malazjan 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A king, monarch or ruler who exercises authority over a country or people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对一个国家或一群人民行使统治权的国王、君主或统治者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Re, monarka jew ħakkiem li għandu s-setgħa fuq pajjiż jew poplu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国王；君主；统治者。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-malek sejjaħ lill-kunsill biex jiddiskuti l-futur tar-renju.
formal.en: In the story, the king summoned the council to discuss the future of the kingdom.
formal.zh: 故事中，国王召集议事会，讨论王国的未来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak bil-kuruna fl-istampa? Ninu: Dak il-malek tar-rakkont. Maja: Mela dak hu li jgħix fil-palazz?
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that wearing a crown in the picture? Ninu: That's the king in the story. Maja: So is he the one who lives in the palace?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图里那个戴王冠的人是谁？尼努：那是故事里的国王。玛雅：那么，住在宫殿里的就是他吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 图里那个戴王冠的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that wearing a crown in the picture?

messages.speaker: Ninu (同学)
messages.zh: 那是故事里的国王。
messages.en: That's the king in the story.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela dak hu li jgħix fil-palazz?
messages.mt_standard: Mela dak hu li jgħix fil-palazz?
messages.zh: 那么，住在宫殿里的就是他吗？
messages.en: So is he the one who lives in the palace?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位戴王冠的 malek 坐在宫殿中发布命令，把“王冠、宫殿、统治者”三个画面连起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in West Africa whose official name is the Republic of Mali.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 西非国家马里，正式名称为马里共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika tal-Mali.

sense_translations.en_definition: Mali (a country in West Africa; official name: Repubblika tal-Mali)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马里，位于西非的国家，正式名称为马里共和国。

formal.mt: L-istudenti sabu l-Mali fuq il-mappa tal-Afrika u kitbu l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu: ir-Repubblika tal-Mali.
formal.en: The students located Mali on the map of Africa and wrote its official name: the Republic of Mali.
formal.zh: 学生们在非洲地图上找到了马里，并写下了它的正式名称：马里共和国。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu l-Mali fuq din il-mappa? David: Hawn, fl-Afrika tal-Punent. Sara: Issa sibtu, grazzi!
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is Mali on this map? David: Here, in West Africa. Sara: I've found it now, thanks!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马里在这张地图的哪里？戴维：这里，在西非。萨拉：我现在找到了，谢谢！

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-Mali fuq din il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-Mali fuq din il-mappa?
messages.zh: 马里在这张地图的哪里？
messages.en: Where is Mali on this map?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 这里，在西非。
messages.en: Here, in West Africa.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 我现在找到了，谢谢！
messages.en: I've found it now, thanks!

cognitive_memory_aid: Mali 与中文“马里”读音容易对应；想象在西非地图上贴一张“马里”标签，记住这是国家名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being malicious or showing a wish to harm others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有恶意、恶毒或想要伤害他人的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min ikun malinn jew juri xewqa li jagħmel ħsara lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶意；恶毒；存心伤害他人的性质。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rakkont, l-istudenta spjegat kif il-malinjità tal-karattru tidher fil-kliem u fl-għemil tiegħu.
formal.en: In her analysis of the story, the student explained how the character's malignity appears in his words and actions.
formal.zh: 在故事分析中，这名学生解释了该角色的恶毒如何体现在他的言语和行为中。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dak il-kumment kien mimli malinjità. Toni: Iva, kien maħsub biex iweġġagħha. Rita: Aħjar nitkellmu magħha u naraw kif inhi.
colloquial.en: Rita: That comment was full of malice. Toni: Yes, it was meant to hurt her. Rita: We'd better talk to her and see how she is.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：那句话充满了恶意。托尼：是的，就是想伤害她。丽塔：我们最好去和她聊聊，看看她怎么样。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 那句话充满了恶意。
messages.en: That comment was full of malice.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，就是想伤害她。
messages.en: Yes, it was meant to hurt her.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar nitkellmu magħha u naraw kif inhi.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar nitkellmu magħha u naraw kif inhi.
messages.zh: 我们最好去和她聊聊，看看她怎么样。
messages.en: We'd better talk to her and see how she is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 malinjità 放进“充满恶意的话”这个场景中记忆；它是名词，表示话语或行为中体现的恶毒性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Malicious or harmful; in a medical context, malignant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 怀有恶意或具有伤害性的；在医学语境中表示恶性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri ħażen jew intenzjoni li jagħmel ħsara; f'kuntest mediku, li huwa ta' natura kanċeruża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶意的；恶毒的；恶性的，医学语境中可用于描述恶性肿瘤等。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport mediku, it-tumur ġie deskritt bħala malinn.
formal.en: In the medical report, the tumour was described as malignant.
formal.zh: 医学报告将该肿瘤描述为恶性。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex qal hekk? Ġorġ: Naħseb li kellu ħsieb malinn. Lina: Ejja nistaqsuh x'ried jgħid.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why did he say that? George: I think he had a malicious thought in mind. Lina: Let's ask him what he meant.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：他为什么那么说？乔治：我觉得他存着恶意。莉娜：我们问问他是什么意思吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么那么说？
messages.en: Why did he say that?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.zh: 我觉得他存着恶意。
messages.en: I think he had a malicious thought in mind.

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们问问他是什么意思吧。
messages.en: Let's ask him what he meant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 malinn 配两张卡片：“恶毒的念头”和“恶性肿瘤”。看到它先看所修饰的名词，再选择中文意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from or relating to Mali or its people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自或涉及马里及其人民的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Mali jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' dan il-pajjiż jew mal-poplu tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马里的；马里人的；与马里有关的。
马里人。

formal.mt: L-artist Maljan ippreżenta x-xogħol tiegħu waqt wirja fl-iskola.
formal.en: The Malian artist presented his work during an exhibition at the school.
formal.zh: 这位马里艺术家在学校举办的展览中展示了自己的作品。

colloquial.mt: Emma: L-artist li ltqajna miegħu hu Maljan? Luke: Iva, ġej mill-Mali. Emma: Ħadt gost nitkellem miegħu dwar ix-xogħol tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Emma: Is the artist we met Malian? Luke: Yes, he's from Mali. Emma: I enjoyed talking to him about his work.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：我们见到的那位艺术家是马里人吗？卢克：是的，他来自马里。艾玛：和他聊他的作品很愉快。

messages.speaker: Emma (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: L-artist li ltqajna miegħu hu Maljan?
messages.mt_standard: L-artist li ltqajna miegħu hu Maljan?
messages.zh: 我们见到的那位艺术家是马里人吗？
messages.en: Is the artist we met Malian?

messages.speaker: Luke (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他来自马里。
messages.en: Yes, he's from Mali.

messages.speaker: Emma (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadt gost nitkellem miegħu dwar ix-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħadt gost nitkellem miegħu dwar ix-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.zh: 和他聊他的作品很愉快。
messages.en: I enjoyed talking to him about his work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mali“马里”和 Maljan“马里的、马里人”并排做词卡，用“来自马里的艺术家”连接国家名与人物称呼。

gloss_zh: 发髻，盘在脑后的紧实发团

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hairstyle in which the hair is gathered into a tight roll at the back of the head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将头发在脑后紧紧盘成一团的发式，即发髻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament tax-xagħar li fih ix-xagħar jinġabar u jitgeżwer sewwa f'għoqda fuq wara tar-ras.

sense_translations.en_definition: bun (a tight roll of hair worn at the back of the head)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发髻，指将头发在脑后紧紧盘成的发团。

collocations.en: to put the hair into a bun

formal.mt: Qabel il-wirja, iż-żeffiena ġabret xagħarha f'maljatura fuq wara ta' rasha.
formal.en: Before the performance, the dancer gathered her hair into a bun at the back of her head.
formal.zh: 演出前，舞者将头发在脑后盘成了一个发髻。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Tista' tagħmilli maljatura? Nina: Iva, għandek lastiku tax-xagħar? Marta: Iva, hawn wieħed.
colloquial.en: Marta: Can you put my hair into a bun? Nina: Yes, do you have a hair tie? Marta: Yes, here's one.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你能帮我盘个发髻吗？妮娜：可以，你有发圈吗？玛尔塔：有，这里有一个。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能帮我盘个发髻吗？
messages.en: Can you put my hair into a bun?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，你有发圈吗？
messages.en: Yes, do you have a hair tie?

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，这里有一个。
messages.en: Yes, here's one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 一边读 maljatura，一边想象把长发收拢、绕紧、固定在脑后；用这三个动作记住“发髻”的具体形状。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Socks, stockings, tights and similar knitted garments worn on the feet or legs, considered collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 袜子、长筒袜、连裤袜等穿在脚部或腿部的针织衣物的统称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kalzetti, kalzetti twal, tajts u ħwejjeġ simili li jintlibsu fuq is-saqajn jew ir-riġlejn, meqjusa flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 袜类；包括短袜、长筒袜和连裤袜等的袜品总称。

formal.mt: Il-ħanut joffri għażla wiesgħa ta' maljerija għall-adulti u għat-tfal.
formal.en: The shop offers a wide selection of hosiery for adults and children.
formal.zh: 该店提供种类丰富的成人及儿童袜品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn nista' nixtri kalzetti għax-xitwa? Rita: Hemm ħanut tal-maljerija ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where can I buy socks for winter? Rita: There's a hosiery shop near the square.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：哪里可以买到冬天穿的袜子？丽塔：广场附近有一家袜品店。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 哪里可以买到冬天穿的袜子？
messages.en: Where can I buy socks for winter?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 广场附近有一家袜品店。
messages.en: There's a hosiery shop near the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象商店里摆满短袜、长袜和连裤袜，把整片袜品区标成 maljerija，记住它表示袜类总称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reduce fabric or clothing to rags; also, to adulterate a substance by mixing something else into it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使布料或衣物破损成碎布、破布；也指往某种物质中掺入其他东西，使其不再纯正。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel drapp jew ħwejjeġ ċraret; ukoll, ħallat sustanza ma' xi ħaġa oħra b'mod li naqqas il-purità tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使布料或衣物变成破布、碎布。
掺假；掺入其他物质而降低原物的纯度或品质。

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol iebes mallat il-ħwejjeġ tal-ħaddiem.
formal.en: The hard work reduced the worker's clothes to rags.
formal.zh: 繁重的工作使那名工人的衣服磨损成了破布。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex dan l-inbid għandu togħma daqshekk ħafifa? Nina: Forsi xi ħadd mallat l-inbid bl-ilma.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why does this wine taste so weak? Nina: Perhaps someone adulterated the wine with water.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这葡萄酒怎么味道这么淡？妮娜：可能有人往酒里掺了水。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan l-inbid għandu togħma daqshekk ħafifa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan l-inbid għandu togħma daqshekk ħafifa?
messages.zh: 这葡萄酒怎么味道这么淡？
messages.en: Why does this wine taste so weak?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi xi ħadd mallat l-inbid bl-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi xi ħadd mallat l-inbid bl-ilma.
messages.zh: 可能有人往酒里掺了水。
messages.en: Perhaps someone adulterated the wine with water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面配对记忆 mallat：衣服磨成破布，酒里掺入清水；分别对应弄烂和掺假两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cloth used for household cleaning or other chores; also, small miscellaneous items or odds and ends.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做清洁等家务时使用的布；也指各种零零碎碎的小物件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp li jintuża għat-tindif jew għal xogħol ieħor tad-dar; ukoll, affarijiet żgħar u mħallta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 家务用布；用于擦拭、清洁等家务劳动的布。
零碎杂物；各种细小、杂七杂八的物件。

collocations.en: a piece of cloth for household chores
a box of odds and ends

formal.mt: Għat-tindif tal-mejda, uża biċċa mallut nadifa u niedja.
formal.en: To clean the table, use a clean, damp household cloth.
formal.zh: 清洁桌面时，请使用一块干净、微湿的家务用布。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'hemm f'din il-kaxxa? Pawlu: Mallut biss: buttuni, biċċiet ta' spag u affarijiet żgħar oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's in this box? Pawlu: Just odds and ends: buttons, bits of string and other small things.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个盒子里有什么？保罗：只是些零碎杂物：纽扣、几段绳子和其他小东西。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 这个盒子里有什么？
messages.en: What's in this box?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mallut biss: buttuni, biċċiet ta' spag u affarijiet żgħar oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Mallut biss: buttuni, biċċiet ta' spag u affarijiet żgħar oħra.
messages.zh: 只是些零碎杂物：纽扣、几段绳子和其他小东西。
messages.en: Just odds and ends: buttons, bits of string and other small things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mallut 放进家务收纳画面：桌边一块擦拭布，盒里一堆零碎物；两个位置帮助区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 马耳他女性本地人或居民

teaching_sense.en_definition: A female person who is a native or inhabitant of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出生于马耳他或居住在马耳他的女性；本词条中用作指人的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ta' sess femminili li hija nattiva ta' Malta jew li tgħix f'Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: female Maltese (female native or inhabitant of Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他女性；马耳他的女性本地人或女性居民。

collocations.zh: 一位来自戈佐岛的马耳他女性
一位居住在国外的马耳他女性

formal.mt: Il-kelliema mistiedna hija Maltija li taħdem fil-qasam tal-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The guest speaker is a Maltese woman who works in education.
formal.zh: 受邀发言者是一位从事教育工作的马耳他女性。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Minn fejn hi l-ħabiba l-ġdida tiegħek? Emma: Hi Maltija minn Għawdex.
colloquial.en: Luca: Where is your new friend from? Emma: She's a Maltese woman from Gozo.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：你的新朋友是哪里人？艾玛：她是来自戈佐岛的马耳他女性。

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn hi l-ħabiba l-ġdida tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn hi l-ħabiba l-ġdida tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的新朋友是哪里人？
messages.en: Where is your new friend from?

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 她是来自戈佐岛的马耳他女性。
messages.en: She's a Maltese woman from Gozo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位女性自我介绍说 Jien Maltija，把人物、马耳他和女性身份连在一起，记住这里是指人的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cruel, harmful or seriously unfair treatment of a person or an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对人或动物施加残酷、有害或严重不公的对待。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament krudili, ta' ħsara jew serjament inġust lejn persuna jew annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虐待；对人或动物的恶劣对待。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' maltrattament tal-annimali u l-miżuri meħuda biex jiġu protetti.
formal.en: The report describes a case of animal ill-treatment and the measures taken to protect the animals.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起虐待动物事件，以及为保护这些动物而采取的措施。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħadu l-kelb f'dak iċ-ċentru? Toni: Minħabba l-maltrattament li sofra; issa qed jieħdu ħsiebu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did they take the dog to that centre? Toni: Because of the ill-treatment it suffered; they're looking after it now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们为什么把那只狗送到那个中心？托尼：因为它曾遭受虐待；现在有人在照顾它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们为什么把那只狗送到那个中心？
messages.en: Why did they take the dog to that centre?

messages.speaker: Toni (动物中心志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-maltrattament li sofra; issa qed jieħdu ħsiebu.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-maltrattament li sofra; issa qed jieħdu ħsiebu.
messages.zh: 因为它曾遭受虐待；现在有人在照顾它。
messages.en: Because of the ill-treatment it suffered; they're looking after it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maltrattament 和一张制止虐待的宣传画配对记忆：看到受伤害的人或动物，就联想到恶劣对待这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bird of the species Turdus merula, known in English as the blackbird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指乌鸫这一鸟种，学名为 Turdus merula；学习时应把整个短语作为鸟名记忆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Turdus merula, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala blackbird.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌鸫，学名 Turdus merula。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, ġie rreġistrat malvizz iswed fuq fergħa ta' siġra.
formal.en: During the garden observation, a blackbird was recorded on a tree branch.
formal.zh: 在花园观察过程中，记录到一只停在树枝上的乌鸫。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhu dak l-għasfur fuq il-ħajt? Karl: Dak malvizz iswed. Ejja narawh minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Lina: What's that bird on the wall? Karl: That's a blackbird. Let's watch it from here.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：墙上那只是什么鸟？卡尔：那是乌鸫。我们就在这里看它吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 墙上那只是什么鸟？
messages.en: What's that bird on the wall?

messages.speaker: Karl (观鸟爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak malvizz iswed. Ejja narawh minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Dak malvizz iswed. Ejja narawh minn hawn.
messages.zh: 那是乌鸫。我们就在这里看它吧。
messages.en: That's a blackbird. Let's watch it from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张乌鸫图片卡，把 malvizz iswed 和 Turdus merula 并排写在图下，整组对应记忆，避免只记成泛指的黑鸟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A name for the bird species Turdus merula, called the blackbird in English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乌鸫这一鸟种的名称，指学名为 Turdus merula 的鸟；作为完整鸟名学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għall-għasfur tal-ispeċi Turdus merula, li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ blackbird.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌鸫，学名 Turdus merula。

formal.mt: Il-paġna tinkludi ritratt ta' malvizz tat-troffa flimkien mal-isem xjentifiku Turdus merula.
formal.en: The page includes a photograph of a blackbird alongside the scientific name Turdus merula.
formal.zh: 这一页附有一张乌鸫照片，并列出了学名 Turdus merula。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'jissejjaħ l-għasfur f'dan ir-ritratt? David: Malvizz tat-troffa; bl-Ingliż jgħidulu blackbird.
colloquial.en: Anna: What's the bird in this photograph called? David: Malvizz tat-troffa; in English it's called a blackbird.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这张照片里的鸟叫什么？戴维：马耳他语叫 malvizz tat-troffa，也就是乌鸫，英语叫 blackbird。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这张照片里的鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What's the bird in this photograph called?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.zh: 马耳他语叫 malvizz tat-troffa，也就是乌鸫，英语叫 blackbird。
messages.en: Malvizz tat-troffa; in English it's called a blackbird.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在同一张乌鸫图片上贴两张名称卡：malvizz tat-troffa 和 malvizz iswed；用共同学名 Turdus merula 把它们连起来记。

gloss_zh: 妈妈；原件；动词的词典基本形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: An affectionate word for one's mother; also an original or the basic form under which a verb is listed in a dictionary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对母亲的亲昵称呼“妈妈”；也可指原件，或词典中用作动词词条的基本形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' għożża għall-omm; tista' tfisser ukoll oriġinal jew il-forma bażika li biha verb jidher bħala entrata f'dizzjunarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妈妈；对母亲的亲昵称呼。
原件；作为复制依据的原本。

sense_translations.en_definition: basic form of a verb (the basic form of a verb used as a dictionary entry)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 动词的基本形式，即词典中用作动词词条的形式。

collocations.en: the dictionary form of the verb

formal.mt: Biex issib verb fid-dizzjunarju, fittex il-mamma tiegħu.
formal.en: To find a verb in the dictionary, look for its basic dictionary form.
formal.zh: 要在词典里找到一个动词，请查找它的词典基本形式。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hi l-mamma? Pawlu: Qiegħda fil-kċina, qed tagħmel it-te.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where's Mum? Pawlu: She's in the kitchen, making tea.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：妈妈在哪里？保罗：她在厨房里泡茶。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 妈妈在哪里？
messages.en: Where's Mum?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (儿子)
messages.zh: 她在厨房里泡茶。
messages.en: She's in the kitchen, making tea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项分场景记：家里叫“妈妈”，文件谈“原件”，查动词找“基本形式”；这是学习分类，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a place or things messy or untidy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把地方或物品弄乱，使其变得杂乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel post jew affarijiet imħarbta u bla ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄乱；把某处弄得一团糟。

collocations.en: made a mess of the kitchen
made a mess of the room

formal.mt: Waqt it-tisjir, it-tifel mander il-kċina u wara għen biex inaddafha.
formal.en: While cooking, the boy made a mess of the kitchen and afterwards helped clean it.
formal.zh: 那个男孩做饭时把厨房弄得一团糟，之后帮忙把厨房打扫干净。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min mander il-mejda? Toni: Ħija. Ħalla l-karti u ż-żebgħa kullimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who made a mess of the table? Toni: My brother. He left paper and paint everywhere.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把桌子弄得一团糟？托尼：我兄弟。他把纸和颜料弄得到处都是。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把桌子弄得一团糟？
messages.en: Who made a mess of the table?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija. Ħalla l-karti u ż-żebgħa kullimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija. Ħalla l-karti u ż-żebgħa kullimkien.
messages.zh: 我兄弟。他把纸和颜料弄得到处都是。
messages.en: My brother. He left paper and paint everywhere.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象做完手工后纸张、颜料散满桌面，把 mander 和“把整洁处弄乱”的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element manganese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素锰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ manganese.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锰，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-laboratorju, l-istudent semma l-manganiż fost l-elementi studjati.
formal.en: In the laboratory report, the student mentioned manganese among the elements studied.
formal.zh: 在实验室报告中，这名学生将锰列为研究过的元素之一。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif ngħidu manganese bil-Malti? Mark: Manganiż. Ikteb il-kelma ħdejn l-isem bl-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do we say manganese in Maltese? Mark: Manganiż. Write the word next to the English name.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：manganese 用马耳他语怎么说？马克：Manganiż。把这个词写在英文名称旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: manganese 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do we say manganese in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Manganiż. Ikteb il-kelma ħdejn l-isem bl-Ingliż.
messages.mt_standard: Manganiż. Ikteb il-kelma ħdejn l-isem bl-Ingliż.
messages.zh: Manganiż。把这个词写在英文名称旁边。
messages.en: Manganiż. Write the word next to the English name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语元素卡，把“锰—manganiż—manganese”并排写，再配上实验样品标签来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A machine with rollers used to press laundry or squeeze water out of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用滚筒压平衣物或挤出衣物中水分的机器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magna bir-rombli li tintuża biex tagħfas il-ħwejjeġ jew toħroġ l-ilma minnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轧衣机；通过滚筒压平衣物或挤出水分的机器。

collocations.en: to pass laundry through the mangle

formal.mt: Fil-wirja hemm mangnu antik li kien jintuża biex joħroġ l-ilma mill-ħwejjeġ.
formal.en: The exhibition includes an old mangle that was used to squeeze water out of laundry.
formal.zh: 展览中有一台旧式轧衣机，过去用来挤出衣物中的水分。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għalxiex kien jintuża dan il-mangnu? Rita: Biex joħroġ l-ilma mill-ħwejjeġ; kienu jgħadduhom bejn ir-rombli.
colloquial.en: Nina: What was this mangle used for? Rita: To squeeze water out of laundry; people passed the clothes between the rollers.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这台轧衣机以前是做什么用的？丽塔：用来挤出衣物里的水；人们把衣物送进两个滚筒之间。

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.zh: 这台轧衣机以前是做什么用的？
messages.en: What was this mangle used for?

messages.speaker: Rita (讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex joħroġ l-ilma mill-ħwejjeġ; kienu jgħadduhom bejn ir-rombli.
messages.mt_standard: Biex joħroġ l-ilma mill-ħwejjeġ; kienu jgħadduhom bejn ir-rombli.
messages.zh: 用来挤出衣物里的水；人们把衣物送进两个滚筒之间。
messages.en: To squeeze water out of laundry; people passed the clothes between the rollers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象湿床单穿过两根滚筒，水被挤出来；把这台机器的画面贴上 mangnu 标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A public written declaration of a person's or group's aims, principles, or proposed actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或团体公开发表、阐明目标、原则或行动主张的书面声明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni pubblika bil-miktub li tispjega l-għanijiet, il-prinċipji jew l-azzjonijiet proposti ta' persuna jew grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣言；公开阐述立场、原则或目标的声明。

formal.mt: L-għaqda ppubblikat manifest li jispjega l-prinċipji tagħha u l-għanijiet għas-sena li ġejja.
formal.en: The association published a manifesto explaining its principles and its aims for the coming year.
formal.zh: 该协会发表了一份宣言，阐述其原则和来年的目标。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qrajt il-manifest tal-għaqda? Sara: Iva, u għoġbitni l-proposta dwar il-librerija.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you read the association's manifesto? Sara: Yes, and I liked the proposal about the library.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你读过协会的宣言了吗？萨拉：读过了，我很喜欢其中关于图书馆的提议。

messages.speaker: Mark (协会成员)
messages.zh: 你读过协会的宣言了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the association's manifesto?

messages.speaker: Sara (协会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għoġbitni l-proposta dwar il-librerija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għoġbitni l-proposta dwar il-librerija.
messages.zh: 读过了，我很喜欢其中关于图书馆的提议。
messages.en: Yes, and I liked the proposal about the library.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张向公众公布的纸，上面写着“我们的原则与目标”，标题就是 manifest，宣言。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to managers or to the work of managing an organization, team, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与经理、管理人员或组织、团队及活动的管理工作有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-maniġers jew max-xogħol ta' tmexxija ta' organizzazzjoni, tim jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 管理的；经理的；与管理职责或管理工作有关的。

formal.mt: Il-kors jiżviluppa ħiliet maniġerjali bħall-ippjanar tax-xogħol u t-tmexxija ta' tim.
formal.en: The course develops managerial skills such as work planning and team leadership.
formal.zh: 本课程培养工作规划、团队领导等管理技能。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tapplika għal dik il-kariga maniġerjali? David: Iva, għandi esperjenza fit-tmexxija ta' tim żgħir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to apply for that managerial position? David: Yes, I have experience leading a small team.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你准备申请那个管理职位吗？戴维：是的，我有带领小团队的经验。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tapplika għal dik il-kariga maniġerjali?
messages.mt_standard: Se tapplika għal dik il-kariga maniġerjali?
messages.zh: 你准备申请那个管理职位吗？
messages.en: Are you going to apply for that managerial position?

messages.speaker: David (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi esperjenza fit-tmexxija ta' tim żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi esperjenza fit-tmexxija ta' tim żgħir.
messages.zh: 是的，我有带领小团队的经验。
messages.en: Yes, I have experience leading a small team.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maniġerjali 放在招聘广告的“管理技能”和“管理职位”旁边，用这两个搭配记住它的形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The organization and direction of a business, team or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对企业、团队或活动进行组织、指导和管理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-organizzazzjoni u t-tmexxija ta' negozju, tim jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 管理；对企业、团队或活动的组织与经营。

formal.mt: Il-kors jiffoka fuq il-maniġment tan-negozju u l-ippjanar finanzjarju.
formal.en: The course focuses on business management and financial planning.
formal.zh: 本课程重点讲授企业经营管理与财务规划。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer il-kors tal-maniġment? Mark: Tajjeb, qed nitgħallem kif norganizza x-xogħol tat-tim.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is the management course going? Mark: Well, I'm learning how to organize the team's work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：管理课程学得怎么样？马克：挺好，我正在学习怎样组织团队的工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 管理课程学得怎么样？
messages.en: How is the management course going?

messages.speaker: Mark (管理课程学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, qed nitgħallem kif norganizza x-xogħol tat-tim.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, qed nitgħallem kif norganizza x-xogħol tat-tim.
messages.zh: 挺好，我正在学习怎样组织团队的工作。
messages.en: Well, I'm learning how to organize the team's work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象团队负责人分配任务，记住 maniġment 表示管理；与 maniġġament 对照抄写，本词只有一个 ġ。

gloss_zh: 处理；管理；骑术；阴谋活动

teaching_sense.en_definition: The handling or management of something, especially the way it is controlled or used.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对事物的处理或管理，尤其指控制、操作或使用它的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif wieħed jieħu ħsieb, jikkontrolla jew juża xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处理；操作；管理。
骑术；骑乘和驾驭马匹的技艺。
阴谋；暗中策划或操纵的活动。

formal.mt: Il-maniġġ korrett tal-għodda jnaqqas ir-riskju ta' inċidenti.
formal.en: Correct handling of tools reduces the risk of accidents.
formal.zh: 正确操作工具能降低事故风险。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-maniġġ ta' dan iż-żiemel huwa diffiċli? Mark: Iva, trid ħafna paċenzja miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this horse difficult to handle? Mark: Yes, you need a lot of patience with him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这匹马难驾驭吗？马克：是的，你得对它很有耐心。

messages.speaker: Maja (骑术学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-maniġġ ta' dan iż-żiemel huwa diffiċli?
messages.mt_standard: Il-maniġġ ta' dan iż-żiemel huwa diffiċli?
messages.zh: 这匹马难驾驭吗？
messages.en: Is this horse difficult to handle?

messages.speaker: Mark (骑术教练)
messages.zh: 是的，你得对它很有耐心。
messages.en: Yes, you need a lot of patience with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面分别记义：操作工具是处理，驾驭马匹是骑术，暗中布局是阴谋；注意依上下文区分。

gloss_zh: 可处理的；可管理的；应付得来的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Possible to handle, control or deal with without excessive difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够处理、控制或应付，难度不至于过大的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jista' jieħu ħsiebu, jikkontrollah jew ilaħħaq miegħu mingħajr wisq diffikultà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可处理的；可管理的；能够应付的。

formal.mt: Il-proġett tqassam f'partijiet żgħar biex ix-xogħol ikun aktar maniġġabbli.
formal.en: The project was divided into small parts to make the work more manageable.
formal.zh: 项目被分成若干小部分，以便更容易开展工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ix-xogħol kollu maniġġabbli? Mark: Iva, jekk naqsmuh bejnietna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is all this work manageable? Mark: Yes, if we divide it between us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这么多工作能应付得来吗？马克：能，只要我们分着做。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 这么多工作能应付得来吗？
messages.en: Is all this work manageable?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 能，只要我们分着做。
messages.en: Yes, if we divide it between us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一大堆工作想成分装后能拿稳的小盒子：能够处理、应付得来，就是 maniġġabbli。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of organizing and directing work, people or resources.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对工作、人员或资源进行组织、安排和指导的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-organizzazzjoni u t-tmexxija tax-xogħol, tan-nies jew tar-riżorsi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 管理；对工作、人员或资源的组织与经营。

formal.mt: Il-maniġġament effettiv tar-riżorsi jgħin lill-organizzazzjoni tilħaq l-għanijiet tagħha.
formal.en: Effective resource management helps the organization achieve its goals.
formal.zh: 有效的资源管理有助于组织实现目标。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-maniġġament tal-proġett? Mark: Jien, u int tista' tgħinni bl-iskeda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will handle the project management? Mark: I will, and you can help me with the schedule.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来负责项目管理？马克：我来，你可以帮我安排日程。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-maniġġament tal-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-maniġġament tal-proġett?
messages.zh: 谁来负责项目管理？
messages.en: Who will handle the project management?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, u int tista' tgħinni bl-iskeda.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, u int tista' tgħinni bl-iskeda.
messages.zh: 我来，你可以帮我安排日程。
messages.en: I will, and you can help me with the schedule.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把人员、时间和资源排进同一张计划表，记住 maniġġament 指组织安排的管理活动；拼写时留意双写 ġġ。

gloss_zh: 磁化器；使物体磁化的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device or person that makes an object magnetic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体获得磁性的装置，或进行磁化操作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat jew persuna li jagħmel oġġett manjetiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磁化器；使物体获得磁性的装置或操作者。

formal.mt: It-tekniku uża manjetizzatur biex jagħmel il-ponta tat-tornavit manjetika.
formal.en: The technician used a magnetizer to make the screwdriver tip magnetic.
formal.zh: 技术员使用磁化器使螺丝刀头获得磁性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek manjetizzatur għal dan it-tornavit? Mark: Iva, hawn wieħed. Nistgħu nużawh biex il-ponta tiġbed il-viti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a magnetizer for this screwdriver? Mark: Yes, here's one. We can use it so the tip attracts screws.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有能给这把螺丝刀磁化的磁化器吗？马克：有，这里有一个。我们可以用它让刀头吸住螺丝。

messages.speaker: Maja (维修学徒)
messages.zh: 你有能给这把螺丝刀磁化的磁化器吗？
messages.en: Do you have a magnetizer for this screwdriver?

messages.speaker: Mark (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn wieħed. Nistgħu nużawh biex il-ponta tiġbed il-viti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn wieħed. Nistgħu nużawh biex il-ponta tiġbed il-viti.
messages.zh: 有，这里有一个。我们可以用它让刀头吸住螺丝。
messages.en: Yes, here's one. We can use it so the tip attracts screws.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象螺丝刀经过一个小装置后能吸起螺丝：让工具获得磁性的装置就是 manjetizzatur；拼写留意双写 zz。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which a material becomes magnetic or acquires magnetic properties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使材料获得磁性或变得具有磁性的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih materjal isir manjetiku jew jikseb proprjetajiet manjetiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磁化；使材料获得磁性的过程。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-esperiment, l-istudenti ddeskrivew il-manjetizzazzjoni ta' biċċa ħadid.
formal.en: In the experiment report, the students described the magnetization of a piece of iron.
formal.zh: 学生们在实验报告中描述了一块铁的磁化过程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif saret manjetika din il-biċċa ħadid? Pawlu: Permezz tal-manjetizzazzjoni; hekk tissejjaħ il-bidla li rajna fl-esperiment.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did this piece of iron become magnetic? Pawlu: Through magnetization; that is what the change we saw in the experiment is called.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块铁怎么有了磁性？保罗：通过磁化；我们在实验中看到的这种变化就叫磁化。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif saret manjetika din il-biċċa ħadid?
messages.mt_standard: Kif saret manjetika din il-biċċa ħadid?
messages.zh: 这块铁怎么有了磁性？
messages.en: How did this piece of iron become magnetic?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Permezz tal-manjetizzazzjoni; hekk tissejjaħ il-bidla li rajna fl-esperiment.
messages.mt_standard: Permezz tal-manjetizzazzjoni; hekk tissejjaħ il-bidla li rajna fl-esperiment.
messages.zh: 通过磁化；我们在实验中看到的这种变化就叫磁化。
messages.en: Through magnetization; that is what the change we saw in the experiment is called.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 manjetizzazzjoni 连到“普通铁块获得磁性”的实验画面，记住它表示磁化这一过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The physical phenomenon by which magnets attract certain materials and attract or repel other magnets.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 磁体吸引某些材料，并与其他磁体相吸或相斥的物理现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fenomenu fiżiku li bih il-kalamiti jiġbdu ċerti materjali u jiġbdu jew jimbuttaw kalamiti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磁性；磁力；磁体相吸、相斥等磁现象。

formal.mt: L-istudenti studjaw il-manjetiżmu billi osservaw kif kalamita tiġbed klipps tal-ħadid.
formal.en: The students studied magnetism by observing how a magnet attracts iron clips.
formal.zh: 学生们通过观察磁铁如何吸引铁夹来学习磁现象。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dawn il-klipps jeħlu mal-kalamita? Mark: Minħabba l-manjetiżmu. Ara kif tiġbidhom lejha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do these clips stick to the magnet? Mark: Because of magnetism. Look how it pulls them towards it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些夹子为什么会吸在磁铁上？马克：因为磁力。看，它把夹子吸过去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这些夹子为什么会吸在磁铁上？
messages.en: Why do these clips stick to the magnet?
