messages.speaker: Mark (科学教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-manjetiżmu. Ara kif tiġbidhom lejha.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-manjetiżmu. Ara kif tiġbidhom lejha.
messages.zh: 因为磁力。看，它把夹子吸过去了。
messages.en: Because of magnetism. Look how it pulls them towards it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象磁铁把铁夹吸起的实验画面，把 manjetiżmu 与磁性、磁力这一现象联系起来，而不是与某件工具混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element magnesium, a light metal with the symbol Mg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素镁，一种轻金属，元素符号为 Mg。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku bis-simbolu Mg, li huwa metall ħafif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镁；元素符号为 Mg 的金属元素。

formal.mt: Fit-tabella tal-elementi, il-manjeżju jidher bis-simbolu Mg.
formal.en: In the periodic table, magnesium appears with the symbol Mg.
formal.zh: 在元素周期表中，镁以符号 Mg 表示。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser Mg fuq din it-tabella? Mark: Huwa s-simbolu tal-manjeżju. Nina: Mela nikteb manjeżju fin-noti tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does Mg mean on this table? Mark: It is the symbol for magnesium. Nina: Then I will write magnesium in my notes.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这张表上的 Mg 是什么意思？马克：它是镁的元素符号。妮娜：那我就在笔记里写上“镁”。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser Mg fuq din it-tabella?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser Mg fuq din it-tabella?
messages.zh: 这张表上的 Mg 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does Mg mean on this table?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 它是镁的元素符号。
messages.en: It is the symbol for magnesium.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 那我就在笔记里写上“镁”。
messages.en: Then I will write magnesium in my notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在元素卡片上把 manjeżju、Mg 和“镁”并排写，通过名称、符号、中文三项配对来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adverb meaning 'not even' to emphasize a negative statement, or 'if only' to express a wish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 副词，既可表示“连……也不”，加强否定语气，也可表示“要是……就好了”，表达愿望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avverbju li jsaħħaħ ċaħda fis-sens ta' 'lanqas', jew jesprimi xewqa fis-sens ta' 'li kieku'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 连……也不；甚至不，用于强调否定。
要是……就好了；但愿，用于表达愿望。

collocations.en: if only I had more time
collocations.zh: 要是我有更多时间就好了

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tal-ittra, l-awtur esprima x-xewqa tiegħu: 'Mank kelli aktar ħin biex inkompli nistudja.'
formal.en: At the end of the letter, the writer expressed his wish: 'If only I had more time to continue studying.'
formal.zh: 在信的末尾，作者表达了自己的愿望：“要是我有更多时间继续学习就好了。”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qrajt xi ħaġa lbieraħ? Toni: Le, mank paġna waħda ma qrajt. Maja: Mank kellna ftit ħin liberu!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you read anything yesterday? Toni: No, I did not read even a single page. Maja: If only we had a little free time!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你昨天读了点什么吗？托尼：没有，我连一页都没读。玛雅：要是我们有点空闲时间就好了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨天读了点什么吗？
messages.en: Did you read anything yesterday?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, mank paġna waħda ma qrajt.
messages.mt_standard: Le, mank paġna waħda ma qrajt.
messages.zh: 没有，我连一页都没读。
messages.en: No, I did not read even a single page.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 要是我们有点空闲时间就好了！
messages.en: If only we had a little free time!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 mank 配两幅画：空白阅读记录表示“连一页也没读”，望着时钟叹气表示“要是有时间就好了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack or shortcoming in something, or a defect that alters physical appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某方面的不足或缺陷；也指改变身体外观的形貌缺损。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas jew difett f'xi ħaġa, jew difett li jibdel id-dehra fiżika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不足；欠缺；某方面未达到应有程度的缺陷。
形貌缺损；外貌因损伤或缺陷而发生的改变。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport identifika mankament fid-disinn tal-bini: ma kienx hemm biżżejjed dawl naturali.
formal.en: The report identified a deficiency in the building's design: there was not enough natural light.
formal.zh: 报告指出了这座建筑在设计上的一项不足：自然采光不够。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sibt l-appartament? David: Għandu mankament wieħed: il-kċina mudlama wisq. Sara: Iva, tieqa oħra kienet tgħin.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you find the apartment? David: It has one shortcoming: the kitchen is too dark. Sara: Yes, another window would help.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你觉得那套公寓怎么样？戴维：有一个不足：厨房太暗了。萨拉：是啊，多一扇窗会有帮助。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得那套公寓怎么样？
messages.en: How did you find the apartment?

messages.speaker: David (看房者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu mankament wieħed: il-kċina mudlama wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu mankament wieħed: il-kċina mudlama wisq.
messages.zh: 有一个不足：厨房太暗了。
messages.en: It has one shortcoming: the kitchen is too dark.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，多一扇窗会有帮助。
messages.en: Yes, another window would help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mankament 记成评估表上的“缺陷”一栏：用于设计时是功能不足，用于外貌时是形貌缺损。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A light object attached to a string and flown in the wind for recreation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用线牵引、借风飞起的轻质玩具，即风筝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett ħafif marbut ma' ħajta li jittajjar fir-riħ għad-divertiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 风筝；用线牵引并借风在空中飞起的玩具。

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività fil-beraħ, kull tifel u tifla tgħallmu kif itajru manoċċa.
formal.en: During the outdoor activity, every child learned how to fly a kite.
formal.zh: 在户外活动中，每个孩子都学习了如何放风筝。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Illum hemm ir-riħ. Immorru ntajru l-manoċċa? Ben: Iva! Se nġib il-manoċċa l-ħamra. Lina: Tajjeb, jien inżomm il-ħajta.
colloquial.en: Lina: It is windy today. Shall we go and fly the kite? Ben: Yes! I will bring the red kite. Lina: Good, I will hold the string.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：今天有风。我们去放风筝吧？本：好啊！我去拿红色的风筝。莉娜：好，我来牵线。

messages.speaker: Lina (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum hemm ir-riħ. Immorru ntajru l-manoċċa?
messages.mt_standard: Illum hemm ir-riħ. Immorru ntajru l-manoċċa?
messages.zh: 今天有风。我们去放风筝吧？
messages.en: It is windy today. Shall we go and fly the kite?

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.zh: 好啊！我去拿红色的风筝。
messages.en: Yes! I will bring the red kite.

messages.speaker: Lina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 好，我来牵线。
messages.en: Good, I will hold the string.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只红色风筝迎风升起，手里还牵着线；每看到这个画面，就完整读出 manoċċa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place or area containing many holes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布满许多孔洞或坑洞的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew medda art mimlija toqob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 满是孔洞的地方；到处都有洞孔或坑洞的区域。

collocations.en: a place riddled with holes in the rock
collocations.zh: 岩石中满是孔洞的地方

collocations.en: to become a place riddled with holes

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tas-sit tindika manqab fil-blat, b'toqob ta' daqsijiet differenti.
formal.en: The site description identifies an area of rock riddled with holes of different sizes.
formal.zh: 这处地点的说明记载了一片岩石孔洞区，其中分布着大小不一的孔洞。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed timxi daqshekk bil-mod? Samwel: Hawn manqab; hemm toqob kullimkien. Rita: Mela ngħaddu min-naħa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are you walking so slowly? Samwel: This place is riddled with holes; there are holes everywhere. Rita: Then let us go around the other side.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么走得这么慢？萨姆韦尔：这里满是坑洞，到处都是洞。丽塔：那我们从另一边绕过去吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 你为什么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Samwel (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 这里满是坑洞，到处都是洞。
messages.en: This place is riddled with holes; there are holes everywhere.

messages.speaker: Rita (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 那我们从另一边绕过去吧。
messages.en: Then let us go around the other side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 manqab 配上一整片密密麻麻的洞孔图，记忆重点放在“满是洞的地方”，而非单独一个洞。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with a cutting edge used to cut or shape materials such as wood or stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有刃口、用于凿削或修整木材、石材等材料的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'xifer li jaqta', użata biex taqta' jew tagħti forma lill-injam jew lill-ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凿子；用于凿削、雕刻或修整材料的有刃工具。

formal.mt: L-artiġjan uża manqax biex jagħti forma lid-dettalji fit-tiżjin tal-injam.
formal.en: The craftsperson used a chisel to shape the details in the wooden decoration.
formal.zh: 工匠用凿子修整木制装饰上的细节。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'għodda għandek bżonn għal dan ix-xogħol? Ġorġ: Għandi bżonn manqax għall-injam. Marija: Hemm wieħed fuq il-bank, ħdejn il-martell.
colloquial.en: Marija: What tool do you need for this job? Ġorġ: I need a wood chisel. Marija: There is one on the workbench, next to the hammer.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：做这项活儿你需要什么工具？乔治：我需要一把木工凿。玛丽娅：工作台上有一把，就在锤子旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (木工同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għodda għandek bżonn għal dan ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: X'għodda għandek bżonn għal dan ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 做这项活儿你需要什么工具？
messages.en: What tool do you need for this job?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (木匠)
messages.zh: 我需要一把木工凿。
messages.en: I need a wood chisel.

messages.speaker: Marija (木工同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm wieħed fuq il-bank, ħdejn il-martell.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm wieħed fuq il-bank, ħdejn il-martell.
messages.zh: 工作台上有一把，就在锤子旁边。
messages.en: There is one on the workbench, next to the hammer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 manqax 放进“锤子旁边的一把凿子”这个工具场景，再用“修整木雕细节”的动作巩固词义。

gloss_zh: 捕鸟装置；捕鸟人的藏身处

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structure used to trap birds, or a hiding place used by bird trappers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于捕鸟的装置或构筑物；也指捕鸟人躲藏的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura użata biex jinqabdu l-għasafar, jew post fejn jinħbew dawk li jaqbduhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捕鸟装置；为捕捉鸟类而设置的构筑物。
捕鸟人的藏身处；捕鸟者隐蔽躲藏的地方。

collocations.en: to conceal oneself in the bird trapper's hide

formal.mt: Il-mudell fil-mużew juri mansab u jispjega l-funzjoni tiegħu bħala struttura għall-qbid tal-għasafar.
formal.en: The model in the museum shows a bird-trapping structure and explains its function.
formal.zh: 博物馆中的模型展示了一处捕鸟装置，并说明了它的用途。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fil-ġrajja, fejn kien qed jinħeba r-raġel? Luqa: Fil-mansab, biex l-għasafar ma jarawhx. Anna: Mela hawn il-kelma tfisser il-post fejn jinħeba.
colloquial.en: Anna: In the story, where was the man hiding? Luqa: In the bird trapper's hide, so the birds would not see him. Anna: So here the word means the place where he hides.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：故事里，那个人躲在哪里？卢卡：躲在捕鸟人的藏身处，免得鸟看见他。安娜：所以这个词在这里指的是他躲藏的地方。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-ġrajja, fejn kien qed jinħeba r-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: Fil-ġrajja, fejn kien qed jinħeba r-raġel?
messages.zh: 故事里，那个人躲在哪里？
messages.en: In the story, where was the man hiding?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.zh: 躲在捕鸟人的藏身处，免得鸟看见他。
messages.en: In the bird trapper's hide, so the birds would not see him.

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela hawn il-kelma tfisser il-post fejn jinħeba.
messages.mt_standard: Mela hawn il-kelma tfisser il-post fejn jinħeba.
messages.zh: 所以这个词在这里指的是他躲藏的地方。
messages.en: So here the word means the place where he hides.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 mansab 画两格示意图：一格标“捕鸟的装置”，另一格标“捕鸟人躲藏的位置”，靠语境区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 易使人虚弱的；有损体力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to weaken a person or contribute to physical infirmity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易使人体力衰弱或身体变得虚弱的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jdgħajjef lill-persuna jew jagħmilha aktar fraġli fiżikament.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to cause weakness or infirmity
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于使人虚弱或体弱的。

collocations.en: a factor tending to cause weakness

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' mistrieħ jista' jkollu effett mantari fuq il-ġisem.
formal.en: A lack of rest can have a weakening effect on the body.
formal.zh: 缺乏休息可能对身体产生使人虚弱的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'mantari' hawn? Pawlu: Ifisser li jista' jdgħajjef il-ġisem, bħal nuqqas ta' mistrieħ għal żmien twil.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'mantari' mean here? Pawlu: It means something that can weaken the body, such as a prolonged lack of rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 mantari 是什么意思？保罗：指可能使身体虚弱的，比如长期缺乏休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 mantari 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mantari' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jista' jdgħajjef il-ġisem, bħal nuqqas ta' mistrieħ għal żmien twil.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jista' jdgħajjef il-ġisem, bħal nuqqas ta' mistrieħ għal żmien twil.
messages.zh: 指可能使身体虚弱的，比如长期缺乏休息。
messages.en: It means something that can weaken the body, such as a prolonged lack of rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mantari 和“熬夜后体力下降”的画面配对，记住它描述的是容易使人虚弱的作用或因素。

gloss_zh: 维护；保养；离婚或分居配偶的赡养费

teaching_sense.en_definition: Work or care that keeps something in good condition; also, money paid to support a spouse or former spouse after separation or divorce.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为使事物保持良好状态而进行的维护或保养；也指分居或离婚后支付给配偶或前配偶的赡养费。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol jew kura biex xi ħaġa tinżamm f'kundizzjoni tajba; ukoll flus imħallsa għall-għajxien tal-konjuġi jew tal-eks konjuġi wara separazzjoni jew divorzju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 维护；保养；使设备、建筑等保持良好状态的工作。
分居或离婚后支付给配偶或前配偶的赡养费。

formal.mt: Il-manteniment regolari tal-lift jgħin biex jinżamm f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: Regular maintenance helps keep the lift in good condition.
formal.zh: 定期维护有助于使电梯保持良好状态。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-lift mhux jaħdem illum? Mark: Qed isirlu l-manteniment. Uża t-taraġ għalissa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why isn't the lift working today? Mark: It's undergoing maintenance. Use the stairs for now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：电梯今天为什么不能用？马克：正在做维护，暂时走楼梯吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (住户)
messages.zh: 电梯今天为什么不能用？
messages.en: Why isn't the lift working today?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed isirlu l-manteniment. Uża t-taraġ għalissa.
messages.mt_standard: Qed isirlu l-manteniment. Uża t-taraġ għalissa.
messages.zh: 正在做维护，暂时走楼梯吧。
messages.en: It's undergoing maintenance. Use the stairs for now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记 manteniment：给机器做保养，给分居或离婚后的配偶付赡养费；具体词义要看对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To provide financial support, raise someone through care and support, or keep something in a continuing or satisfactory condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提供经济支持，照料并抚养某人，或使某种状态或事物得以维持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti appoġġ finanzjarju, irabbi lil xi ħadd, jew iżomm xi ħaġa fi stat tajjeb jew kontinwu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在经济上支持；负担某人的生活费用。
抚养；养育并照料孩子成长。
维持；维护；使事物保持某种状态。

collocations.en: brought up and supported his children
collocations.zh: 抚养并供养了自己的孩子

formal.mt: Għal ħafna snin, Ġużeppi mantna l-familja bid-dħul mix-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: For many years, Ġużeppi supported the family with the income from his work.
formal.zh: 多年来，朱塞佩一直用工作收入供养家庭。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min mantna l-familja meta kont żgħir? Toni: Missieri, u ommi kienet tieħu ħsiebna d-dar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who supported the family when you were little? Toni: My father did, and my mother looked after us at home.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你小时候是谁供养家里的？托尼：我父亲，我母亲在家照顾我们。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min mantna l-familja meta kont żgħir?
messages.mt_standard: Min mantna l-familja meta kont żgħir?
messages.zh: 你小时候是谁供养家里的？
messages.en: Who supported the family when you were little?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri, u ommi kienet tieħu ħsiebna d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri, u ommi kienet tieħu ħsiebna d-dar.
messages.zh: 我父亲，我母亲在家照顾我们。
messages.en: My father did, and my mother looked after us at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mantna 放进“挣钱供家、照料孩子、维持状态”三个画面，按宾语分别记成供养、抚养和维持。

gloss_zh: 机动动作；操纵；船舶索具

teaching_sense.en_definition: A planned or skilful movement used to position or control something; also, the ropes and associated equipment used to handle a sailing vessel's sails.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为调整位置或控制行动而进行的有计划或有技巧的动作；也指帆船上用于操控船帆的绳索及相关装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment ippjanat jew magħmul b'ħila biex tinbidel il-pożizzjoni jew jiġi kkontrollat xi ħaġa; ukoll il-ħbula u t-tagħmir marbut mal-immaniġġjar tal-qlugħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 机动动作；为调整位置或达到某种目的而进行的操纵或行动。
船舶索具；用于支撑或操控船帆等的绳索及相关装置。

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq wettaq manuvra bil-mod biex idaħħal il-vettura fl-ispazju dejjaq.
formal.en: The driver carried out a slow maneuver to guide the vehicle into the narrow space.
formal.zh: 司机缓慢操纵车辆，将其驶入狭窄的空位。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif se ddaħħal il-karozza hemm? David: B'manuvra bil-mod. Tista' tgħidli kemm baqa' spazju wara?
colloquial.en: Sara: How are you going to get the car in there? David: With a slow maneuver. Can you tell me how much room is left behind?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你打算怎么把车停进去？戴维：慢慢调整就行。你能告诉我后面还剩多少空间吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (乘客)
messages.zh: 你打算怎么把车停进去？
messages.en: How are you going to get the car in there?

messages.speaker: David (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: B'manuvra bil-mod. Tista' tgħidli kemm baqa' spazju wara?
messages.mt_standard: B'manuvra bil-mod. Tista' tgħidli kemm baqa' spazju wara?
messages.zh: 慢慢调整就行。你能告诉我后面还剩多少空间吗？
messages.en: With a slow maneuver. Can you tell me how much room is left behind?

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用倒车入位记 manuvra 的“操纵动作”，再另配帆船绳索图记“索具”，两个义项分开练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ease with which a vehicle or other moving object can be steered, turned, or moved into a desired position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 车辆或其他移动物体容易被操纵、转向或调整到所需位置的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-faċilità li biha vettura jew oġġett ieħor jista' jiġi mdawwar, ikkontrollat jew imċaqlaq għall-pożizzjoni mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 机动性；操纵灵活性；转向和调整位置的容易程度。

collocations.zh: 狭窄空间内的操纵灵活性

formal.mt: Il-manuvrabilità tajba tal-vettura tiffaċilita l-ipparkjar fi toroq dojoq.
formal.en: The vehicle's good manoeuvrability makes parking on narrow streets easier.
formal.zh: 车辆良好的机动性使其更容易在狭窄街道上停车。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din il-karozza faċli tipparkjaha? Lara: Iva, għandha manuvrabilità tajba, anki fi spazji żgħar.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this car easy to park? Lara: Yes, it has good manoeuvrability, even in small spaces.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这辆车好停吗？拉拉：好停，它很灵活，即使空间小也容易操纵。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这辆车好停吗？
messages.en: Is this car easy to park?

messages.speaker: Lara (汽车销售员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandha manuvrabilità tajba, anki fi spazji żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandha manuvrabilità tajba, anki fi spazji żgħar.
messages.zh: 好停，它很灵活，即使空间小也容易操纵。
messages.en: Yes, it has good manoeuvrability, even in small spaces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小车在窄巷里轻松转弯，用“好不好转、好不好停”这两个问题记住 manuvrabilità 表示操纵灵活程度。

gloss_zh: 搬运重物，尤指石料；手册；说明书；工地搬石工

teaching_sense.en_definition: To carry or haul a heavy load with effort, especially stones.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 费力地搬运沉重的东西，尤其指搬运石料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġorr tagħbija tqila bi tbatija, speċjalment ġebel.

sense_translations.en_definition: to lug a heavy burden (esp. stones)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 费力地搬运重物，尤指石料。
手册；供查阅或指导使用的书。
说明书；介绍操作步骤或使用方法的书。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. whose job is to carry stones on a building site
sense_translations.zh_definition: 工地搬石工；以在建筑工地搬运石料为工作的人。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem manwal il-ġebel minn ħdejn il-bieb sal-parti ta' wara tal-bitħa.
formal.en: The worker lugged the stones from beside the door to the back of the yard.
formal.zh: 工人费力地把石料从门旁搬到了院子后部。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi jfisser 'manwal' f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Hawn huwa verb: il-ħaddiem ġarr ġebel tqil. F''aqra l-manwal', huwa nom u jfisser ktieb ta' struzzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does 'manwal' mean in this sentence? Pawlu: Here it's a verb: the worker carried heavy stones. In 'read the manual', it's a noun meaning an instruction book.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这句话里的 manwal 是什么意思？保罗：这里是动词，指工人搬运沉重的石料。在“阅读手册”里，它是名词，指说明书。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 manwal 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'manwal' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn huwa verb: il-ħaddiem ġarr ġebel tqil. F''aqra l-manwal', huwa nom u jfisser ktieb ta' struzzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn huwa verb: il-ħaddiem ġarr ġebel tqil. F''aqra l-manwal', huwa nom u jfisser ktieb ta' struzzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 这里是动词，指工人搬运沉重的石料。在“阅读手册”里，它是名词，指说明书。
messages.en: Here it's a verb: the worker carried heavy stones. In 'read the manual', it's a noun meaning an instruction book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 manwal 配三张图：搬石头的动作、一本说明手册、一位工地搬石工；先判断词性，再选择对应意思。

gloss_zh: 手工的；用手完成的；不用机器的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Performed or operated by hand, especially without the help of machinery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手完成或操作的，尤其指不借助机器进行的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir jew jitħaddem bl-idejn, speċjalment mingħajr l-għajnuna ta' makkinarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手工的；手动的；由人用手进行或操作的。
用双手完成的；手工制作或进行的。

sense_translations.en_definition: done without the aid of machinery
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不借助机器完成的。

formal.mt: Il-proċess jinkludi xogħol manwali li jitwettaq mingħajr l-użu ta' magni.
formal.en: The process includes manual work carried out without the use of machines.
formal.zh: 该流程包括不使用机器完成的手工劳动。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-kaxxa għamiltha b'magna? Toni: Le, kollha xogħol manwali. Qtajt u għaqqadt il-biċċiet bl-idejn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you make this box with a machine? Toni: No, it's all manual work. I cut and joined the pieces by hand.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个盒子是你用机器做的吗？托尼：不是，全是手工做的。我用手把各个部件切好，再拼接起来。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个盒子是你用机器做的吗？
messages.en: Did you make this box with a machine?

messages.speaker: Toni (手工爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kollha xogħol manwali. Qtajt u għaqqadt il-biċċiet bl-idejn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kollha xogħol manwali. Qtajt u għaqqadt il-biċċiet bl-idejn.
messages.zh: 不是，全是手工做的。我用手把各个部件切好，再拼接起来。
messages.en: No, it's all manual work. I cut and joined the pieces by hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 manwali，就想象双手正在切割、拼接或转动旋钮；用“手工劳动”和“手动控制”两个搭配帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the two openings of the nose through which air passes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼻子的两个通气开口之一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda miż-żewġ fetħiet tal-imnieħer li minnhom tgħaddi l-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻孔；鼻部供空气进出的开口。

formal.mt: Fid-disinn, vleġġa tindika l-manħar tal-lemin.
formal.en: In the drawing, an arrow indicates the right nostril.
formal.zh: 图中的箭头指向右鼻孔。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi manħar misdud. Pawlu: Liema wieħed, tax-xellug jew tal-lemin?
colloquial.en: Lara: One of my nostrils is blocked. Pawlu: Which one, the left or the right?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我有一个鼻孔堵住了。保罗：哪一个，左边还是右边？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我有一个鼻孔堵住了。
messages.en: One of my nostrils is blocked.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 哪一个，左边还是右边？
messages.en: Which one, the left or the right?

cognitive_memory_aid: 在鼻子的简图上圈出一个通气小孔，旁边写 manħar，提醒自己它指单个鼻孔。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A map showing the world, including its continents and oceans.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 展示整个世界及其各大洲和海洋的地图。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mappa li turi d-dinja kollha, inklużi l-kontinenti u l-oċeani.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 世界地图；展示全球地理分布的地图。

collocations.en: a political map of the world
a physical map of the world

formal.mt: L-istudenti użaw mappamondu biex jidentifikaw il-kontinenti u l-oċeani.
formal.en: The students used a world map to identify the continents and oceans.
formal.zh: 学生们使用世界地图辨认各大洲和海洋。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi Malta fuq il-mappamondu? Mark: Hawn, fil-Baħar Mediterran, fin-nofsinhar ta' Sqallija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Malta on the world map? Mark: Here, in the Mediterranean Sea, south of Sicily.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马耳他在世界地图上的哪里？马克：这里，在地中海，西西里岛以南。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 马耳他在世界地图上的哪里？
messages.en: Where is Malta on the world map?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn, fil-Baħar Mediterran, fin-nofsinhar ta' Sqallija.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn, fil-Baħar Mediterran, fin-nofsinhar ta' Sqallija.
messages.zh: 这里，在地中海，西西里岛以南。
messages.en: Here, in the Mediterranean Sea, south of Sicily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mappamondu 和教室墙上的整幅世界地图配对，再练习“在世界地图上找马耳他”，用完整场景记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where people read.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人阅读书籍或其他文字材料的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn wieħed jaqra kotba jew materjal ieħor miktub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阅读的地方；读书处。

collocations.zh: 供学生使用的阅读场所

formal.mt: L-iskola ħejjiet maqar kwiet fejn l-istudenti jistgħu jaqraw wara l-lezzjonijiet.
formal.en: The school has prepared a quiet reading place where students can read after lessons.
formal.zh: 学校设置了一处安静的阅读场所，学生可以在课后在那里读书。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn nista' noqgħod naqra bil-kwiet? Pawlu: Hemm maqar ħdejn il-ġnien; ejja nurik.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where can I sit and read quietly? Pawlu: There is a reading place beside the garden; come, I'll show you.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我可以在哪里安静地坐着读书？保罗：花园旁边有一处阅读场所，来，我带你看看。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: 我可以在哪里安静地坐着读书？
messages.en: Where can I sit and read quietly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm maqar ħdejn il-ġnien; ejja nurik.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm maqar ħdejn il-ġnien; ejja nurik.
messages.zh: 花园旁边有一处阅读场所，来，我带你看看。
messages.en: There is a reading place beside the garden; come, I'll show you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maqar 配上一幅安静读书角的画面，记住它指阅读的地方。

gloss_zh: 爱负面批评的；爱挑毛病的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to criticise negatively or repeatedly find faults.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于作负面批评或反复挑出别人、事物缺点的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jikkritika b'mod negattiv jew isib id-difetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于作负面批评的；爱贬评的。
爱挑毛病的；惯于寻找缺点的。

formal.mt: Atteġġjament maqdari jista' jnaqqas il-fiduċja tal-istudenti, speċjalment meta l-kritika ma tinkludix suġġerimenti utli.
formal.en: A negatively critical attitude can reduce students' confidence, especially when criticism includes no useful suggestions.
formal.zh: 惯于负面批评的态度可能削弱学生的信心，尤其是在批评没有附带有用建议时。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark dejjem isib xi ħaġa ħażina fix-xogħol tiegħi. Nina: Kultant ikun maqdari wisq; staqsih x'tista' ttejjeb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Mark always finds something wrong with my work. Nina: Sometimes he is too fault-finding; ask him what you can improve.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克总能在我的工作里挑出毛病。妮娜：他有时太爱挑剔了；问问他你可以改进什么。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark dejjem isib xi ħaġa ħażina fix-xogħol tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Mark dejjem isib xi ħaġa ħażina fix-xogħol tiegħi.
messages.zh: 马克总能在我的工作里挑出毛病。
messages.en: Mark always finds something wrong with my work.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kultant ikun maqdari wisq; staqsih x'tista' ttejjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Kultant ikun maqdari wisq; staqsih x'tista' ttejjeb.
messages.zh: 他有时太爱挑剔了；问问他你可以改进什么。
messages.en: Sometimes he is too fault-finding; ask him what you can improve.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人看作业时总圈出缺点，把 maqdari 与爱挑毛病的态度一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A temple or another place used for religious worship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于宗教礼拜的神庙或其他敬拜场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tempju jew post ieħor fejn issir il-qima reliġjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神庙；供奉神明和举行宗教仪式的建筑。
礼拜场所；进行宗教敬拜的地方。

collocations.en: the entrance to the place of worship

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi għandhom iżommu s-skiet fil-maqdas biex jirrispettaw lil dawk li jkunu qed jitolbu.
formal.en: Visitors should remain quiet in the place of worship to respect those who are praying.
formal.zh: 访客应在礼拜场所内保持安静，以尊重正在祈祷的人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nistgħu nidħlu f'dan il-maqdas? David: Iva, imma nitkellmu bil-mod għax hemm nies jitolbu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can we enter this place of worship? David: Yes, but let's speak softly because people are praying.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们可以进入这处礼拜场所吗？戴维：可以，不过要轻声说话，因为有人在祈祷。

messages.speaker: Anna (游客)
messages.zh: 我们可以进入这处礼拜场所吗？
messages.en: Can we enter this place of worship?

messages.speaker: David (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nitkellmu bil-mod għax hemm nies jitolbu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nitkellmu bil-mod għax hemm nies jitolbu.
messages.zh: 可以，不过要轻声说话，因为有人在祈祷。
messages.en: Yes, but let's speak softly because people are praying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maqdas 放进神庙入口的场景，联想进入后轻声说话、尊重礼拜者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place regarded as holy, such as a temple or a place of worship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被视为神圣的地方，例如神庙或宗教礼拜场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post meqjus qaddis, bħal tempju jew post ta' qima.

sense_translations.en_definition: a holy place; a temple or place of worship
sense_translations.zh_definition: 神圣的地方；神庙或宗教礼拜场所。

collocations.en: a visit to the holy place

formal.mt: Għall-komunità lokali, dan il-maqdes huwa post ta' talb u riflessjoni.
formal.en: For the local community, this holy place is a place of prayer and reflection.
formal.zh: 对当地社群而言，这处圣地是祈祷与静思的地方。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan il-post jissejjaħ maqdes? Ġużeppi: Għax in-nies iqisuh post qaddis u jiġu hawn biex jitolbu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is this place called a holy place? Ġużeppi: Because people regard it as sacred and come here to pray.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么这里被称为圣地？朱塞佩：因为人们认为这里神圣，并且来这里祈祷。

messages.speaker: Sara (参访者)
messages.zh: 为什么这里被称为圣地？
messages.en: Why is this place called a holy place?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax in-nies iqisuh post qaddis u jiġu hawn biex jitolbu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax in-nies iqisuh post qaddis u jiġu hawn biex jitolbu.
messages.zh: 因为人们认为这里神圣，并且来这里祈祷。
messages.en: Because people regard it as sacred and come here to pray.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maqdes 写在圣地图片旁，用祈祷和静思的场景记住它的神圣含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object or device used to lock something or fasten it securely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于把物件锁住、扣住或牢固固定的器具或装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett jew apparat li jintuża biex jissakkar jew jintrabat sew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. used to lock or fasten
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于锁闭或扣紧某物的东西；锁闭或紧固装置。

collocations.en: a metal locking or fastening device

formal.mt: Qabel it-trasport, iċċekkja li l-maqfel tal-kaxxa jkun magħluq sew.
formal.en: Before transport, check that the box's fastening device is securely closed.
formal.zh: 运输前，请检查箱子的扣紧装置是否已经牢固闭合。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex din il-kaxxa ma tingħalaqx sew? Rita: Il-maqfel inkiser; irridu nibdluh.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why won't this box close properly? Rita: The fastening device has broken; we need to replace it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个箱子为什么关不严？丽塔：扣紧装置坏了，我们得把它换掉。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din il-kaxxa ma tingħalaqx sew?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din il-kaxxa ma tingħalaqx sew?
messages.zh: 这个箱子为什么关不严？
messages.en: Why won't this box close properly?

messages.speaker: Rita (维修人员)
messages.zh: 扣紧装置坏了，我们得把它换掉。
messages.en: The fastening device has broken; we need to replace it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象箱子上的锁扣啪地扣紧，把 maqfel 与锁住或固定物件的装置联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument used for measuring, or a device used for calculations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于测量的仪器，或用于进行计算的器具；具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument li jintuża għall-kejl, jew apparat li jintuża biex isiru l-kalkoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 测量仪器；用于测定尺寸或其他量值的器具。
计算器；用于进行数学计算的器具。

formal.mt: Fit-taħriġ, l-istudenti użaw maqjes biex ikejlu t-tul tal-oġġetti u rreġistraw ir-riżultati f'tabella.
formal.en: During training, the students used a measuring instrument to measure the lengths of objects and recorded the results in a table.
formal.zh: 训练时，学生使用测量仪器测量物件的长度，并把结果记录在表格中。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandek maqjes biex niċċekkja dan it-total? Luqa: Iva, hawn wieħed; daħħal in-numri u ara r-riżultat.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you have a calculator so I can check this total? Luqa: Yes, here's one; enter the numbers and look at the result.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你有计算器吗？我想核对这个总数。卢卡：有，这里有一个；输入数字，看看结果。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek maqjes biex niċċekkja dan it-total?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek maqjes biex niċċekkja dan it-total?
messages.zh: 你有计算器吗？我想核对这个总数。
messages.en: Do you have a calculator so I can check this total?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn wieħed; daħħal in-numri u ara r-riżultat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn wieħed; daħħal in-numri u ara r-riżultat.
messages.zh: 有，这里有一个；输入数字，看看结果。
messages.en: Yes, here's one; enter the numbers and look at the result.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 maqjes 画两张学习卡：一张测量长度，一张计算总数，用场景区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 骄傲的；虚荣的；受人尊重的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Proud or vain, or held in honour by other people, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可形容人骄傲或虚荣，也可表示受到他人尊重、敬重；应根据上下文判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kburi jew vanituż, jew miżmum f'ġieħ minn ħaddieħor, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骄傲的；自豪的。
虚荣的；过分看重自己并渴望赞美的。
受到他人尊重或敬重的。

collocations.zh: 为自己的成功感到骄傲

formal.mt: L-għalliem kien maqjum mill-komunità għas-snin twal ta' servizz tiegħu fl-iskola.
formal.en: The teacher was honoured by the community for his many years of service at the school.
formal.zh: 这位教师因多年在学校服务而受到社群敬重。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex jgħidu li Robert hu maqjum u vanituż? Lara: Għax dejjem jitkellem fuq kemm hu bravu u jistenna t-tifħir.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do they say Robert is proud and vain? Lara: Because he always talks about how good he is and expects praise.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么大家说罗伯特骄傲又虚荣？拉拉：因为他总说自己多么出色，还期待别人夸奖。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex jgħidu li Robert hu maqjum u vanituż?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex jgħidu li Robert hu maqjum u vanituż?
messages.zh: 为什么大家说罗伯特骄傲又虚荣？
messages.en: Why do they say Robert is proud and vain?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem jitkellem fuq kemm hu bravu u jistenna t-tifħir.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem jitkellem fuq kemm hu bravu u jistenna t-tifħir.
messages.zh: 因为他总说自己多么出色，还期待别人夸奖。
messages.en: Because he always talks about how good he is and expects praise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 maqjum：自己昂首求夸奖，或别人向他致敬；再靠语境判断具体褒贬。

gloss_zh: 生气地嘟囔抱怨；闷闷不乐

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grumble and mutter angrily, or to remain gloomy and unhappy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生气地低声嘟囔、抱怨，或闷闷不乐地消沉着。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Igerger u jgemgem bir-rabja, jew jibqa' mdejjaq u bla ħeġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生气地抱怨、低声嘟囔。
闷闷不乐；没精打采地陷在不快之中。

formal.mt: Wara li tħassar il-vjaġġ, Pawlu maqmaq waħdu d-dar u ma kellux aptit jagħmel xejn.
formal.en: After the trip was cancelled, Pawlu moped alone at home and did not feel like doing anything.
formal.zh: 旅行取消后，保罗独自在家闷闷不乐，什么也不想做。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed tmaqmaq? Mark: Ilna siegħa nistennew u ħadd ma qalilna x'ġara. Rita: Ejja nistaqsu meta se nibdew.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why are you grumbling? Mark: We've been waiting for an hour and nobody has told us what happened. Rita: Let's ask when we're going to start.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么一直嘟囔抱怨？马克：我们已经等了一小时，却没人告诉我们出了什么事。丽塔：我们去问问什么时候开始吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么一直嘟囔抱怨？
messages.en: Why are you grumbling?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilna siegħa nistennew u ħadd ma qalilna x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Ilna siegħa nistennew u ħadd ma qalilna x'ġara.
messages.zh: 我们已经等了一小时，却没人告诉我们出了什么事。
messages.en: We've been waiting for an hour and nobody has told us what happened.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去问问什么时候开始吧。
messages.en: Let's ask when we're going to start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maqmaq 的重复字形当作学习提示：一遍遍低声抱怨；再联想抱怨后闷坐不乐的画面。

gloss_zh: 阴历；以月相周期为依据的历法

teaching_sense.en_definition: A calendar that organizes months according to the cycles of the Moon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照月亮的月相变化周期安排月份的历法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kalendarju li jqassam ix-xhur skont iċ-ċikli tal-qamar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴历；以月亮运行及月相周期安排月份的历法。

collocations.en: the months of the lunar calendar

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, l-istudenti jqabblu x-xhur tal-maqmar max-xhur tal-kalendarju solari.
formal.en: In this lesson, students compare the months of the lunar calendar with those of the solar calendar.
formal.zh: 在这节课上，学生比较阴历和阳历的月份。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kalendarju jimxi max-xemx? Pawlu: Le, huwa maqmar; ix-xhur tiegħu jimxu maċ-ċikli tal-qamar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this calendar follow the Sun? Pawlu: No, it is a lunar calendar; its months follow the cycles of the Moon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个历法是按太阳来安排的吗？保罗：不是，这是阴历；它的月份按月亮的周期来安排。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个历法是按太阳来安排的吗？
messages.en: Does this calendar follow the Sun?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa maqmar; ix-xhur tiegħu jimxu maċ-ċikli tal-qamar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa maqmar; ix-xhur tiegħu jimxu maċ-ċikli tal-qamar.
messages.zh: 不是，这是阴历；它的月份按月亮的周期来安排。
messages.en: No, it is a lunar calendar; its months follow the cycles of the Moon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本每页都画着月相的日历，把 maqmar 与“看月亮安排月份”一起记住。

gloss_zh: 惯于抱怨的人；闷闷不乐的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who habitually grumbles, or someone who spends time feeling gloomy and withdrawn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常发牢骚的人，也可指总是闷闷不乐、缺乏兴致的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li spiss tgerger, jew li toqgħod imdejqa u mingħajr ħeġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯于抱怨、经常发牢骚的人。
闷闷不乐、提不起精神的人。

collocations.en: a grumbler who is always complaining
a moper who keeps to himself

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġar huwa maqmieq li jsib xi ħaġa fuqiex igerger kuljum.
formal.en: In the story, the neighbour is a habitual grumbler who finds something to complain about every day.
formal.zh: 在这个故事里，邻居是个惯于发牢骚的人，每天都能找到事情抱怨。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed issejjaħlu maqmieq? Mark: Għax kull darba li niltaqgħu, igerger fuq kollox.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you calling him a grumbler? Mark: Because every time we meet, he complains about everything.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么说他是个爱发牢骚的人？马克：因为每次我们见面，他什么都要抱怨。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个爱发牢骚的人？
messages.en: Why are you calling him a grumbler?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kull darba li niltaqgħu, igerger fuq kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kull darba li niltaqgħu, igerger fuq kollox.
messages.zh: 因为每次我们见面，他什么都要抱怨。
messages.en: Because every time we meet, he complains about everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maqmieq 想成故事里的一位人物：开口就抱怨，或独坐着闷闷不乐；记住它指“人”。

gloss_zh: 爱嘟囔抱怨的；闷闷不乐的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to mutter and grumble, or to remain gloomy and listless.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人爱嘟囔、发牢骚，或常常闷闷不乐、无精打采。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jgemgem u jgerger, jew joqgħod imdejjaq u mingħajr ħeġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱低声嘟囔、发牢骚的；用于描述这种倾向或表现。
闷闷不乐、无精打采的；用于描述这种状态或倾向。

collocations.zh: 爱发牢骚或闷闷不乐的男人
爱嘟囔抱怨或闷闷不乐的男孩

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-karattru bħala raġel maqmieqi li jgemgem kull meta xi ħaġa ma togħġbux.
formal.en: The author describes the character as a grumbling man who mutters whenever something displeases him.
formal.zh: 作者把这个角色描写成一个爱发牢骚的男人，一有什么不合心意就嘟嘟囔囔。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex int daqshekk maqmieqi llum? Toni: Ilni nistenna siegħa, u ħadd ma qalli x'qed jiġri.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you so grumpy today? Toni: I have been waiting for an hour, and nobody has told me what is happening.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天怎么这么爱发牢骚？托尼：我已经等了一个小时，也没人告诉我是怎么回事。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天怎么这么爱发牢骚？
messages.en: Why are you so grumpy today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilni nistenna siegħa, u ħadd ma qalli x'qed jiġri.
messages.mt_standard: Ilni nistenna siegħa, u ħadd ma qalli x'qed jiġri.
messages.zh: 我已经等了一个小时，也没人告诉我是怎么回事。
messages.en: I have been waiting for an hour, and nobody has told me what is happening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maqmieqi 放在“一个怎样的人”这个问题后面练习：爱抱怨的、闷闷不乐的，记住其形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat someone harshly or to behave discourteously towards them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 严厉、苛刻地对待某人，或对某人表现得无礼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittratta lil xi ħadd b'ħruxija jew iġib ruħu miegħu b'nuqqas ta' kortesija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严厉地、苛刻地对待某人。
表现无礼；对人不客气、缺乏礼貌。

collocations.zh: 严厉地对待了那名工人
无礼地对待了那位顾客

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-ħaddiem stqarr li l-kap maqqat lilu quddiem il-kollegi minħabba żball żgħir.
formal.en: In the report, the worker stated that his supervisor had treated him harshly in front of his colleagues over a minor mistake.
formal.zh: 在报告中，那名工人表示，主管因为一个小错误，当着同事的面严厉地对待他。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex telaq irrabjat il-klijent? David: Il-bejjiegħ maqqat lilu meta staqsa dwar il-prezz.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did the customer leave angry? David: The salesperson treated him rudely when he asked about the price.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那位顾客为什么生气地走了？戴维：他询问价格时，售货员对他很无礼。

messages.speaker: Nina (店员)
messages.zh: 那位顾客为什么生气地走了？
messages.en: Why did the customer leave angry?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bejjiegħ maqqat lilu meta staqsa dwar il-prezz.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bejjiegħ maqqat lilu meta staqsa dwar il-prezz.
messages.zh: 他询问价格时，售货员对他很无礼。
messages.en: The salesperson treated him rudely when he asked about the price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个待人场景记 maqqat：主管苛刻地对待员工，店员无礼地对待顾客；共同点是对人态度差。

gloss_zh: 夹钳；用于夹捏或钳动的工具

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool, such as pincers, used to pinch, grip, or manipulate something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于夹捏、夹持或钳动物体的工具，例如夹钳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda, bħal tenalja, li tintuża biex toqros, taqbad jew iċċaqlaq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: implement used to pinch or ply (e.g. pincers)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于夹捏或钳动物体的器具，例如夹钳。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża maqras biex iżomm il-biċċa tal-metall f'postha waqt ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The worker used a gripping tool to hold the piece of metal in place while working.
formal.zh: 工人在操作时用夹钳把那块金属固定在原位。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tagħtini l-maqras? Rita: Iva, qiegħed ħdejn il-martell.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you pass me the pincers? Rita: Yes, they are next to the hammer.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你能把夹钳递给我吗？丽塔：可以，就在锤子旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (工匠)
messages.zh: 你能把夹钳递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the pincers?

messages.speaker: Rita (助手)
messages.zh: 可以，就在锤子旁边。
messages.en: Yes, they are next to the hammer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两片钳口合拢夹住金属，把 maqras 与“夹住东西的工具”这一动作画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A route that reaches a destination by a shorter way than the usual route.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 比通常路线更短、可以更快到达目的地的路径。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Triq li twassal għal destinazzjoni b'rotta iqsar minn dik tas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 近路；比通常路线更短的捷径。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi maqreb li jgħaddi mill-għelieqi u jwassal direttament lejn ir-raħal.
formal.en: The map shows a shortcut that passes through the fields and leads directly to the village.
formal.zh: 地图上标出了一条穿过田地、直接通往村庄的近路。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għad fadlilna ħafna biex naslu? Luqa: Le, nieħdu dan il-maqreb u naslu f'għaxar minuti.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do we still have a long way to go? Luqa: No, we will take this shortcut and arrive in ten minutes.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们还要走很远吗？卢卡：不用，我们走这条近路，十分钟就能到。

messages.speaker: Anna (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 我们还要走很远吗？
messages.en: Do we still have a long way to go?

messages.speaker: Luqa (熟悉路线的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nieħdu dan il-maqreb u naslu f'għaxar minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nieħdu dan il-maqreb u naslu f'għaxar minuti.
messages.zh: 不用，我们走这条近路，十分钟就能到。
messages.en: No, we will take this shortcut and arrive in ten minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画两条通往同一村庄的路，把更短的那条标作 maqreb，记成“少绕路的捷径”。

gloss_zh: 长有芦竹或苇秆类植物的土地；苇地

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of land where cane grows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生长着芦竹或类似苇秆植物的一片土地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa art fejn jikber il-qasab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长有芦竹或苇秆类植物的土地；苇地。

collocations.en: an area of cane beside the valley
the edge of the cane-covered land

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara, l-istudenti osservaw il-qasab li jikber fil-maqsab ħdejn il-wied.
formal.en: During the visit, the students observed the cane growing on the cane-covered land beside the valley.
formal.zh: 参观时，学生观察了山谷旁那片苇地上生长的芦竹。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn tispiċċa l-mogħdija? Ġorġ: Ħdejn il-maqsab; tara ħafna qasab hemm.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where does the path end? Ġorġ: Beside the cane-covered land; you will see plenty of cane there.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：这条小路到哪里结束？乔治：到那片苇地旁边；你会在那里看到很多芦竹。

messages.speaker: Marija (散步者)
messages.zh: 这条小路到哪里结束？
messages.en: Where does the path end?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-maqsab; tara ħafna qasab hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-maqsab; tara ħafna qasab hemm.
messages.zh: 到那片苇地旁边；你会在那里看到很多芦竹。
messages.en: Beside the cane-covered land; you will see plenty of cane there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maqsab 想成地图上一整片长满高秆植物的土地，学习时圈住地块，提醒自己它指地方。

gloss_zh: 词义未明，可能指由带刺灌木取得的棍棒

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun of uncertain meaning, possibly referring to a stick from a thorny bush.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个确切含义尚不明确的名词，可能指取自带刺灌木的棍棒；这一解释仍有疑问。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom b'tifsira mhux ċara, li jista' jirreferi għal bastun minn arbuxxell bix-xewk.

sense_translations.en_definition: bastone dell busci. obscure meaning. petrocchi explains buscio as busso; rumore and zingarelli gives augmentative form buscione, macchia, cespuglio spinoso. stck of a thorny bush (?)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义晦涩，释文作“bastone dell busci”。其中说明 Petrocchi 将 buscio 解释为 busso、rumore，Zingarelli 列出增大形式 buscione，并涉及灌木丛、带刺灌木等含义。因此可能指带刺灌木的棍棒，但原释带有问号，尚不能确定。

collocations.mt: maqsar bħala isem possibbli għal bastun
collocations.en: maqsar as a possible term for a stick
collocations.zh: maqsar 作为棍棒的一种可能称呼

formal.mt: Fin-nota tal-vokabularju, maqsar huwa ppreżentat b'tifsira mhux ċara: jista' jirreferi għal bastun minn arbuxxell bix-xewk.
formal.en: In the vocabulary note, maqsar is presented with an uncertain meaning: it may refer to a stick from a thorny bush.
formal.zh: 词汇笔记将 maqsar 列为含义尚不明确的词：它可能指取自带刺灌木的棍棒。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Maqsar ifisser bastun minn arbuxxell bix-xewk? Pietru: Jista' jkun, imma t-tifsira mhix ċerta; niżżlu hekk fin-noti.
colloquial.en: Ella: Does maqsar mean a stick from a thorny bush? Pietru: Possibly, but the meaning is uncertain; let us record it that way in our notes.
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：maqsar 是指取自带刺灌木的棍棒吗？彼得：有可能，但词义还不确定；我们在笔记里也这样注明吧。

messages.speaker: Ella (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Maqsar ifisser bastun minn arbuxxell bix-xewk?
messages.mt_standard: Maqsar ifisser bastun minn arbuxxell bix-xewk?
messages.zh: maqsar 是指取自带刺灌木的棍棒吗？
messages.en: Does maqsar mean a stick from a thorny bush?

messages.speaker: Pietru (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun, imma t-tifsira mhix ċerta; niżżlu hekk fin-noti.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun, imma t-tifsira mhix ċerta; niżżlu hekk fin-noti.
messages.zh: 有可能，但词义还不确定；我们在笔记里也这样注明吧。
messages.en: Possibly, but the meaning is uncertain; let us record it that way in our notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 maqsar 的词卡上画一根灌木棍并加大问号，把“可能是棍棒”和“词义未定”同时记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of contempt or intense dislike towards someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事的轻蔑、鄙视或强烈憎恶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment ta' disprezz jew stmerrija qawwija lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鄙视；认为某人或某事不值得尊重的轻蔑态度。
憎恶；对某人或某事极其强烈的厌恶。

formal.mt: L-awtur jesprimi maqta lejn l-abbuż tal-poter.
formal.en: The author expresses abhorrence of the abuse of power.
formal.zh: 作者表达了对滥用权力的憎恶。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tkellem b'maqta dwar ix-xogħol tiegħi? Paul: Ma nafx, iżda nifhem għaliex kliemu weġġgħek.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did he speak with disdain about my work? Paul: I don't know, but I understand why his words hurt you.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他为什么用鄙视的语气谈论我的工作？保罗：我不知道，但我理解他的话为什么让你难过。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tkellem b'maqta dwar ix-xogħol tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tkellem b'maqta dwar ix-xogħol tiegħi?
messages.zh: 他为什么用鄙视的语气谈论我的工作？
messages.en: Why did he speak with disdain about my work?

messages.speaker: Paul (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx, iżda nifhem għaliex kliemu weġġgħek.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx, iżda nifhem għaliex kliemu weġġgħek.
messages.zh: 我不知道，但我理解他的话为什么让你难过。
messages.en: I don't know, but I understand why his words hurt you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张轻蔑皱眉的脸，再把情绪加强到憎恶；用这两个画面记住本词的两种意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Equipment used to distil a liquid by vaporizing it and condensing the vapour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过使液体汽化并将蒸气冷凝来进行蒸馏的设备。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat għad-distillazzjoni tal-likwidi permezz tal-evaporazzjoni u l-kondensazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于蒸馏液体的设备；蒸馏器。

formal.mt: It-tekniku naddaf il-maqtar qabel id-distillazzjoni tal-likwidu.
formal.en: The technician cleaned the still before distilling the liquid.
formal.zh: 技术员在蒸馏液体之前清洗了蒸馏器。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan l-apparat fuq il-mejda? Toni: Dan hu maqtar; jintuża għad-distillazzjoni tal-likwidi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this equipment on the table? Toni: This is a still; it is used to distil liquids.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桌上的这个设备是什么？托尼：这是蒸馏器，用来蒸馏液体。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 桌上的这个设备是什么？
messages.en: What is this equipment on the table?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu maqtar; jintuża għad-distillazzjoni tal-likwidi.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu maqtar; jintuża għad-distillazzjoni tal-likwidi.
messages.zh: 这是蒸馏器，用来蒸馏液体。
messages.en: This is a still; it is used to distil liquids.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画出液体变成蒸气、再凝成液滴的装置，把整个装置与 maqtar 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where animals are slaughtered for meat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宰杀供肉用动物的场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jinqatlu l-annimali għall-laħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 屠宰场；宰杀供肉用动物的场所。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol fil-maqtel.
formal.en: The report describes working conditions at the slaughterhouse.
formal.zh: 报告描述了屠宰场的工作条件。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn jinsab il-maqtel li semmejt? Rita: Il-maqtel jinsab fiż-żona industrijali, ħdejn il-maħżen il-kbir.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the slaughterhouse you mentioned? Rita: The slaughterhouse is in the industrial area, next to the large warehouse.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你提到的屠宰场在哪里？丽塔：屠宰场在工业区，就在那个大仓库旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.zh: 你提到的屠宰场在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the slaughterhouse you mentioned?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-maqtel jinsab fiż-żona industrijali, ħdejn il-maħżen il-kbir.
messages.mt_standard: Il-maqtel jinsab fiż-żona industrijali, ħdejn il-maħżen il-kbir.
messages.zh: 屠宰场在工业区，就在那个大仓库旁边。
messages.en: The slaughterhouse is in the industrial area, next to the large warehouse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maqtel 想成地图上标出的屠宰场建筑，重点记住它指场所，而不是工作人员。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where the skins are removed from animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为动物剥去皮张的专门场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn titneħħa l-ġilda tal-annimali.

sense_translations.en_definition: a place where animals are skinned
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给动物剥皮的场所；动物剥皮场。

collocations.en: the workers at the animal-skinning facility
the cleaning of the animal-skinning facility
collocations.zh: 动物剥皮场的清洁工作

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif jitnaddaf il-maqxar wara x-xogħol.
formal.en: The report describes how the animal-skinning facility is cleaned after work.
formal.zh: 报告说明了工作结束后如何清洁动物剥皮场。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'isir f'dan il-maqxar? Pawlu: Hawn titneħħa l-ġilda tal-annimali; dan hu l-użu ta' dan il-post.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is done at this animal-skinning facility? Pawlu: Animal skins are removed here; that is what this place is used for.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个动物剥皮场是做什么的？保卢：这里给动物剥皮，这就是这个场所的用途。

messages.speaker: Sara (参观者)
messages.zh: 这个动物剥皮场是做什么的？
messages.en: What is done at this animal-skinning facility?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn titneħħa l-ġilda tal-annimali; dan hu l-użu ta' dan il-post.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn titneħħa l-ġilda tal-annimali; dan hu l-użu ta' dan il-post.
messages.zh: 这里给动物剥皮，这就是这个场所的用途。
messages.en: Animal skins are removed here; that is what this place is used for.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给脑中的场所门牌写上动物剥皮场，再配上 maqxar；用具体用途与屠宰场一词区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman whose main role is managing the home and doing household work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以料理家庭和处理家务为主要职责的女性；家庭主妇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li r-rwol ewlieni tagħha hu li tieħu ħsieb id-dar u tagħmel ix-xogħol domestiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 家庭主妇；主要负责料理家庭和家务的女性。

formal.mt: Fil-kwestjonarju, hija indikat li kienet mara tad-dar.
formal.en: In the questionnaire, she indicated that she was a housewife.
formal.zh: 她在问卷中填写自己是家庭主妇。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'tagħmel ommok? Lara: Ommi hi mara tad-dar; tieħu ħsieb id-dar u l-familja.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does your mother do? Lara: My mother is a housewife; she looks after the home and the family.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你妈妈是做什么的？拉拉：我妈妈是家庭主妇，负责照料家里和家人。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你妈妈是做什么的？
messages.en: What does your mother do?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ommi hi mara tad-dar; tieħu ħsieb id-dar u l-familja.
messages.mt_standard: Ommi hi mara tad-dar; tieħu ħsieb id-dar u l-familja.
messages.zh: 我妈妈是家庭主妇，负责照料家里和家人。
messages.en: My mother is a housewife; she looks after the home and the family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组配上安排家务、照料家庭的日程表，记住它表示家庭主妇这一角色。

gloss_zh: 妓女（带道德评判色彩的称呼）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A judgmental expression for a woman who provides sexual services for payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对提供有偿性服务的女性的称呼，带有道德评判色彩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni ġudikanti għal mara li toffri servizzi sesswali bi ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妓女；提供有偿性服务的女性，此表达带有道德评判色彩。

collocations.en: described as a prostitute, using a judgmental expression
collocations.zh: 被用带道德评判色彩的称呼描述为妓女

collocations.en: the meaning of the expression 'mara tad-dnub'
collocations.zh: mara tad-dnub 这一表达的含义

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tat-test, l-espressjoni 'mara tad-dnub' tindika prostituta u ġġorr ġudizzju morali.
formal.en: In the analysis of the text, the expression 'mara tad-dnub' denotes a prostitute and carries a moral judgment.
formal.zh: 在文本分析中，mara tad-dnub 这一表达指妓女，并带有道德评判。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'mara tad-dnub' f'dan it-test? Rita: Tfisser prostituta, iżda l-espressjoni fiha ġudizzju morali.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'mara tad-dnub' mean in this text? Rita: It means a prostitute, but the expression contains a moral judgment.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文本里的 mara tad-dnub 是什么意思？丽塔：意思是妓女，但这个表达带有道德评判。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文本里的 mara tad-dnub 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mara tad-dnub' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser prostituta, iżda l-espressjoni fiha ġudizzju morali.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser prostituta, iżda l-espressjoni fiha ġudizzju morali.
messages.zh: 意思是妓女，但这个表达带有道德评判。
messages.en: It means a prostitute, but the expression contains a moral judgment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组放进文本阅读卡片，旁注妓女和道德评判，同时记住含义与语气。

gloss_zh: 绑着的；固定好的；受承诺或责任约束的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tied or fastened in place, or bound to someone or something by a commitment or duty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被绑住或固定住的；也指因承诺或责任而受到约束的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżmum f'postu b'rabta, jew obbligat lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa minħabba impenn jew dmir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被绑住的；用绳子等捆绑起来的。
已系牢或固定好的。

sense_translations.en_definition: committed or duty-bound to sb. or sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人或某事负有承诺或责任的；受义务约束的。

formal.mt: Il-membru jibqa' marbut bl-obbligi tiegħu skont il-ftehim.
formal.en: The member remains bound by his obligations under the agreement.
formal.zh: 该成员仍须履行协议规定的义务。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Il-pakkett lest biex inġorruh? Maja: Iva, hu marbut sew b'ħabel, allura nistgħu nġorruh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Toni: Is the parcel ready for us to carry? Maja: Yes, it is securely tied with a rope, so we can carry it together.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：包裹准备好可以搬了吗？玛雅：可以了，它已经用绳子绑牢，我们可以一起搬。

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 包裹准备好可以搬了吗？
messages.en: Is the parcel ready for us to carry?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu marbut sew b'ħabel, allura nistgħu nġorruh flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu marbut sew b'ħabel, allura nistgħu nġorruh flimkien.
messages.zh: 可以了，它已经用绳子绑牢，我们可以一起搬。
messages.en: Yes, it is securely tied with a rope, so we can carry it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想绳子把包裹绑牢，再想承诺把人约束住；用具体的绑与抽象的责任串起三种意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In this entry, nephritis: inflammation of the kidneys.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在本词条所列义中指肾炎，即肾脏的炎症。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'din it-tifsira, infjammazzjoni tal-kliewi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肾炎；肾脏发生炎症的疾病。

collocations.en: a diagnosis of nephritis, in the sense used here
collocations.zh: 肾炎的诊断（按此处词义）

collocations.en: treatment for nephritis, in the sense used here
collocations.zh: 肾炎的治疗（按此处词义）

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, 'mard tal-kliewi' jirreferi għal infjammazzjoni tal-kliewi.
formal.en: In this text, 'mard tal-kliewi' refers to inflammation of the kidneys.
formal.zh: 在这篇文本中，mard tal-kliewi 指肾脏的炎症，即肾炎。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'mard tal-kliewi' f'din il-lista? Mark: Hawn ifisser infjammazzjoni tal-kliewi; din hi t-tifsira mogħtija.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'mard tal-kliewi' mean in this list? Mark: Here it means inflammation of the kidneys; that is the meaning given.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个词表里的 mard tal-kliewi 是什么意思？马克：这里指肾脏的炎症，也就是词表给出的肾炎这一义项。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个词表里的 mard tal-kliewi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mard tal-kliewi' mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser infjammazzjoni tal-kliewi; din hi t-tifsira mogħtija.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser infjammazzjoni tal-kliewi; din hi t-tifsira mogħtija.
messages.zh: 这里指肾脏的炎症，也就是词表给出的肾炎这一义项。
messages.en: Here it means inflammation of the kidneys; that is the meaning given.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在肾脏示意图旁写上炎症二字，把整个词组与本词条限定的肾炎义配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A great cormorant (Phalacrocorax carbo), a waterbird that dives to catch fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 普通鸬鹚，学名 Phalacrocorax carbo，是一种潜入水中捕鱼的水鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ilma tal-ispeċi Phalacrocorax carbo li jogħdos biex jaqbad il-ħut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 普通鸬鹚（Phalacrocorax carbo）。

collocations.en: a great cormorant on a rock

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, ir-riċerkatur ra margun jogħdos u jerġa' jitla' b'ħuta f'munqaru.
formal.en: During the observation, the researcher saw a great cormorant dive and resurface with a fish in its beak.
formal.zh: 观察期间，研究人员看见一只普通鸬鹚潜入水中，再浮上来时嘴里叼着一条鱼。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Qed tara dak l-għasfur fuq il-blata? Pawlu: Iva, dak margun. Għadu kemm qabad ħuta.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can you see that bird on the rock? Pawlu: Yes, that is a great cormorant. It has just caught a fish.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你看见岩石上那只鸟了吗？保罗：看见了，那是普通鸬鹚。它刚抓到一条鱼。

messages.speaker: Anna (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara dak l-għasfur fuq il-blata?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara dak l-għasfur fuq il-blata?
messages.zh: 你看见岩石上那只鸟了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that bird on the rock?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak margun. Għadu kemm qabad ħuta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak margun. Għadu kemm qabad ħuta.
messages.zh: 看见了，那是普通鸬鹚。它刚抓到一条鱼。
messages.en: Yes, that is a great cormorant. It has just caught a fish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 margun 画一张“潜水捕鱼、上岩休息”的词卡，并标上普通鸬鹚，建立动作与鸟名的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shag (Phalacrocorax aristotelis), a fish-eating seabird of the cormorant family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 欧洲鸬鹚，学名 Phalacrocorax aristotelis，是鸬鹚科的一种食鱼海鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-baħar tal-ispeċi Phalacrocorax aristotelis, mill-familja tal-margun, li jiekol il-ħut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欧洲鸬鹚（Phalacrocorax aristotelis）。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi margun tat-toppu li deher fuq l-irdum qrib il-baħar.
formal.en: The report describes a shag seen on the cliff near the sea.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一只在海边悬崖上出现的欧洲鸬鹚。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'jismu dak l-għasfur fl-istampa? Ġanni: Dak margun tat-toppu. Ejja nfittxuh fil-ktieb tal-għasafar.
colloquial.en: Rita: What is that bird in the picture called? Ġanni: That is a shag. Let's look it up in the bird book.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：图片里那只鸟叫什么？詹尼：那是欧洲鸬鹚。我们在鸟类图鉴里查一查吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里那只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is that bird in the picture called?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak margun tat-toppu. Ejja nfittxuh fil-ktieb tal-għasafar.
messages.mt_standard: Dak margun tat-toppu. Ejja nfittxuh fil-ktieb tal-għasafar.
messages.zh: 那是欧洲鸬鹚。我们在鸟类图鉴里查一查吧。
messages.en: That is a shag. Let's look it up in the bird book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 margun tat-toppu 整体写在欧洲鸬鹚的图卡上，朗读时连成一个鸟名，避免只记住前半部分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pygmy cormorant (Microcarbo pygmaeus), a small fish-eating waterbird of the cormorant family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 侏鸬鹚，学名 Microcarbo pygmaeus，是鸬鹚科的一种小型食鱼水鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir tal-ilma tal-ispeċi Microcarbo pygmaeus, mill-familja tal-margun, li jiekol il-ħut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 侏鸬鹚（Microcarbo pygmaeus）。

collocations.en: a pygmy cormorant beside the pond
a photograph of a pygmy cormorant

formal.mt: Il-gwida tidentifika l-għasfur fir-ritratt bħala margun żgħir, tal-ispeċi Microcarbo pygmaeus.
formal.en: The guide identifies the bird in the photograph as a pygmy cormorant, of the species Microcarbo pygmaeus.
formal.zh: 图鉴将照片中的鸟鉴定为侏鸬鹚，其学名为 Microcarbo pygmaeus。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan margun żgħir jew margun għadu żgħir fl-età? David: Hawnhekk margun żgħir huwa isem ta' speċi, Microcarbo pygmaeus.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this a pygmy cormorant or a cormorant that is still young? David: Here, margun żgħir is the name of a species, Microcarbo pygmaeus.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这是侏鸬鹚，还是一只年龄尚小的鸬鹚？戴维：这里的 margun żgħir 是物种名称，指 Microcarbo pygmaeus。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan margun żgħir jew margun għadu żgħir fl-età?
messages.mt_standard: Dan margun żgħir jew margun għadu żgħir fl-età?
messages.zh: 这是侏鸬鹚，还是一只年龄尚小的鸬鹚？
messages.en: Is this a pygmy cormorant or a cormorant that is still young?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk margun żgħir huwa isem ta' speċi, Microcarbo pygmaeus.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk margun żgħir huwa isem ta' speċi, Microcarbo pygmaeus.
messages.zh: 这里的 margun żgħir 是物种名称，指 Microcarbo pygmaeus。
messages.en: Here, margun żgħir is the name of a species, Microcarbo pygmaeus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 żgħir 的“小”联想侏鸬鹚的小体型，同时把整个词组当作物种名记忆，别误当成幼鸟的称呼。

gloss_zh: 玛丽亚（女子名，对应英语 Mary）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A female given name corresponding to the English name Mary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 女子名字，通常音译为“玛丽亚”，对应英语名字 Mary。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' mara li jikkorrispondi għall-isem Ingliż Mary.

sense_translations.en_definition: a female given name from Sicilian [in turn from Latin, in turn from Ancient Greek, in turn from Aramaic], equivalent to English Mary
sense_translations.zh_definition: 女子名，来自西西里语，而该名字依次可追溯至拉丁语、古希腊语和阿拉米语；对应英语 Mary，通常音译为“玛丽亚”。

formal.mt: Marija ppreżentat ir-riżultati tar-riċerka waqt il-konferenza.
formal.en: Marija presented the research results at the conference.
formal.zh: 玛丽亚在会议上介绍了研究结果。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Bongu, jien Marija. X'jismek? Luqa: Jien Luqa. Għandi pjaċir niltaqa' miegħek.
colloquial.en: Marija: Hello, I'm Marija. What's your name? Luqa: I'm Luqa. Nice to meet you.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你好，我叫玛丽亚。你叫什么名字？卢卡：我叫卢卡。很高兴认识你。

messages.speaker: Marija (新同学)
messages.zh: 你好，我叫玛丽亚。你叫什么名字？
messages.en: Hello, I'm Marija. What's your name?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien Luqa. Għandi pjaċir niltaqa' miegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Jien Luqa. Għandi pjaċir niltaqa' miegħek.
messages.zh: 我叫卢卡。很高兴认识你。
messages.en: I'm Luqa. Nice to meet you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新同学自我介绍“Jien Marija”，把人名与“玛丽亚”相连，再在词卡旁写上英语对应名 Mary。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express dissatisfaction by complaining, sometimes in a persistent or whining manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过抱怨来表达不满，有时带有反复嘟囔、哼哼唧唧地诉苦的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jilmenta biex jesprimi nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon, xi drabi b'mod ripetut u b'ton ta' tgergir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抱怨；表达对某事的不满。
哼哼唧唧地抱怨；以惹人厌烦的语气反复诉苦。

formal.mt: Minkejja li ngħata spjegazzjoni ċara, baqa' jmarmar dwar id-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: Although he was given a clear explanation, he continued to complain about the decision.
formal.zh: 尽管已经得到清楚的解释，他仍然不断抱怨这项决定。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed tmarmar? Toni: Għax ilni nistenna siegħa u għadu ma wasal ħadd.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you complaining? Toni: Because I've been waiting for an hour and nobody has arrived yet.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么一直抱怨？托尼：因为我已经等了一个小时，却还没有人来。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么一直抱怨？
messages.en: Why are you complaining?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ilni nistenna siegħa u għadu ma wasal ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ilni nistenna siegħa u għadu ma wasal ħadd.
messages.zh: 因为我已经等了一个小时，却还没有人来。
messages.en: Because I've been waiting for an hour and nobody has arrived yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读 marmar 时，把反复出现的音节想成嘴里不停嘟囔的节奏，用声音联想记住“抱怨、诉苦”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Morocco, a country in North Africa whose official name is the Kingdom of Morocco.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摩洛哥，位于北非的国家，正式名称为摩洛哥王国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika ta' Fuq li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Renju tal-Marokk.

sense_translations.en_definition: Morocco (a country in North Africa; official name: Renju tal-Marokk)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 摩洛哥，北非国家；正式名称为摩洛哥王国，马耳他语为 Renju tal-Marokk。

collocations.zh: 一次前往摩洛哥的旅行

formal.mt: Ir-Renju tal-Marokk jinsab fl-Afrika ta' Fuq.
formal.en: The Kingdom of Morocco is located in North Africa.
formal.zh: 摩洛哥王国位于北非。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganzi? Samwel: Se mmur il-Marokk ma' ħija.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where are you going on holiday? Samwel: I'm going to Morocco with my brother.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你要去哪里度假？萨姆韦尔：我要和兄弟一起去摩洛哥。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要和兄弟一起去摩洛哥。
messages.en: I'm going to Morocco with my brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Marokk 与英语 Morocco、中文“摩洛哥”并排写在北非地图上，通过相近的读音和地图位置一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Morocco, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与摩洛哥、摩洛哥人民或其文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Marokk, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摩洛哥的；与摩洛哥人民或文化有关的。
摩洛哥人。

collocations.zh: 一名住在马耳他的摩洛哥人

formal.mt: Student Marokkin ippreżenta studju dwar l-ikel Marokkin waqt is-seminar.
formal.en: A Moroccan student presented a study of Moroccan food during the seminar.
formal.zh: 一名摩洛哥学生在研讨会上介绍了一项关于摩洛哥食物的研究。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Int Marokkin? Youssef: Iva, jien Marokkin u bħalissa qed nistudja Malta.
colloquial.en: Marta: Are you Moroccan? Youssef: Yes, I'm Moroccan, and I'm currently studying in Malta.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你是摩洛哥人吗？优素福：是的，我是摩洛哥人，目前在马耳他学习。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 你是摩洛哥人吗？
messages.en: Are you Moroccan?

messages.speaker: Youssef (留学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien Marokkin u bħalissa qed nistudja Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien Marokkin u bħalissa qed nistudja Malta.
messages.zh: 是的，我是摩洛哥人，目前在马耳他学习。
messages.en: Yes, I'm Moroccan, and I'm currently studying in Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Marokk“摩洛哥”和 Marokkin 并排记：搭配 ikel 时理解为“摩洛哥的”，指一个人时理解为“摩洛哥人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A heavy digging tool such as a mattock or pickaxe; also the part of an anchor that digs into the seabed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于挖掘、刨土的重型工具，如鹤嘴锄；也指锚上嵌入海底的锚爪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tqila biex tħaffer jew tkisser l-art; ukoll il-parti tal-ankra li tidħol f'qiegħ il-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹤嘴锄；用于挖掘或破开硬土的镐。
锚爪；锚上用于抓住海底的部分。

formal.mt: Il-marra tal-ankra daħlet f'qiegħ il-baħar u żammet l-ankra f'postha.
formal.en: The anchor's fluke dug into the seabed and held the anchor in place.
formal.zh: 锚爪嵌入海底，将锚固定在原处。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek marra biex inħaffer din l-art? Pawlu: Iva, qiegħda fil-garaxx; l-art hawn iebsa ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a mattock so I can dig this ground? Pawlu: Yes, it's in the garage; the ground here is very hard.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有鹤嘴锄吗？我想挖这块地。保罗：有，在车库里；这里的土很硬。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek marra biex inħaffer din l-art?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek marra biex inħaffer din l-art?
messages.zh: 你有鹤嘴锄吗？我想挖这块地。
messages.en: Do you have a mattock so I can dig this ground?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħda fil-garaxx; l-art hawn iebsa ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħda fil-garaxx; l-art hawn iebsa ħafna.
messages.zh: 有，在车库里；这里的土很硬。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the garage; the ground here is very hard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项连成画面：鹤嘴锄刨进泥土，锚爪抓进海底；用“尖端入土”帮助记住 marra。

gloss_zh: 使变苦；使东西变苦的人；使他人处境恶化的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something a bitter taste, or make an experience emotionally bitter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物带上苦味；也可指使某种经历变得令人苦涩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel xi ħaġa morra fit-togħma, jew għamel esperjenza tnissel imrar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变苦；使产生苦味或苦涩感。
使东西变苦的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who makes things worse for another
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使别人的处境变得更糟的人；给他人增添苦楚的人。

collocations.zh: 使某人的生活充满苦楚

formal.mt: Il-kunflitt bejn il-ġirien marrar il-ħajja tar-residenti għal żmien twil.
formal.en: The conflict between the neighbours made the residents' lives bitter for a long time.
formal.zh: 邻里之间的冲突让居民们的生活长期充满苦楚。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex din iz-zalza għandha togħma morra? Mark: Dak l-ingredjent marrar it-togħma tagħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does this sauce taste bitter? Mark: That ingredient made it taste bitter.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这酱汁怎么有苦味？马克：是那个配料让它变苦了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din iz-zalza għandha togħma morra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din iz-zalza għandha togħma morra?
messages.zh: 这酱汁怎么有苦味？
messages.en: Why does this sauce taste bitter?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是那个配料让它变苦了。
messages.en: That ingredient made it taste bitter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“把甜的弄苦”这一动作，再看词性：动词表示使变苦，名词则指造成苦味或苦楚的人。

gloss_zh: 容易引起苦涩的；令人心生怨苦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to cause bitterness or leave someone feeling resentful or hurt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易使人产生苦涩、怨苦或受伤感的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jnissel imrar jew iħalli lil xi ħadd imweġġa' u mimli riżentiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易引起苦涩感或怨苦情绪的。

formal.mt: Il-kumment marrari tiegħu ħalla sens ta' imrar fost il-parteċipanti.
formal.en: His bitterness-inducing comment left the participants feeling bitter.
formal.zh: 他那番令人苦涩的评论使参与者心中留下了怨苦。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak kien kumment marrari. David: Għandek raġun; kien aħjar li tkellem b'aktar rispett.
colloquial.en: Sara: That comment was bound to leave people bitter. David: You're right; he should have spoken more respectfully.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那句话很容易让人心生怨苦。戴维：你说得对；他应该说得更尊重人一些。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 那句话很容易让人心生怨苦。
messages.en: That comment was bound to leave people bitter.

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; kien aħjar li tkellem b'aktar rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; kien aħjar li tkellem b'aktar rispett.
messages.zh: 你说得对；他应该说得更尊重人一些。
messages.en: You're right; he should have spoken more respectfully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句话让听者心里发苦：marrari 描写这种容易造成苦涩的性质，适合连着“评论、语气”一起记。

gloss_zh: 马尔萨（马耳他城镇名）；港湾

teaching_sense.en_definition: Marsa, a town and local council in the Southern Region of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马尔萨，马耳他南部大区的一个城镇及地方议会辖区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-Marsa, belt u kunsill lokali fir-Reġjun tan-Nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Marsa (a town and local council of the Southern Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马尔萨，马耳他南部大区的一个城镇及地方议会辖区。
港湾；可供船只停泊的水域。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill lokali tal-Marsa organizza laqgħa għar-residenti.
formal.en: The Marsa local council organised a meeting for residents.
formal.zh: 马尔萨地方议会为居民组织了一场会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tmur il-Marsa llum? Toni: Iva, se nżur ħabib hemmhekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to Marsa today? Toni: Yes, I'm going to visit a friend there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天要去马尔萨吗？托尼：对，我要去那里看一位朋友。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天要去马尔萨吗？
messages.en: Are you going to Marsa today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，我要去那里看一位朋友。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going to visit a friend there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用大小写分开记忆：Marsa 是地图上的城镇名，marsa 是普通名词“港湾”；两张词卡分别标注词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mars, the name of a planet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 火星，一颗行星的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-pjaneta li bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ Mars.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火星。

formal.mt: L-istudenti kitbu rapport dwar il-wiċċ ta' Marte.
formal.en: The students wrote a report about the surface of Mars.
formal.zh: 学生们撰写了一份关于火星表面的报告。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Qed taqra dwar Marte? Adam: Iva, dan il-ktieb għandu stampi sbieħ tal-pjaneta.
colloquial.en: Lina: Are you reading about Mars? Adam: Yes, this book has lovely pictures of the planet.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你在读有关火星的内容吗？亚当：对，这本书里有这颗行星的漂亮图片。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.zh: 你在读有关火星的内容吗？
messages.en: Are you reading about Mars?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan il-ktieb għandu stampi sbieħ tal-pjaneta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan il-ktieb għandu stampi sbieħ tal-pjaneta.
messages.zh: 对，这本书里有这颗行星的漂亮图片。
messages.en: Yes, this book has lovely pictures of the planet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在行星图片旁并排写下“Marte—Mars—火星”，用三语对照卡记忆，并保留专名的大写字母。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strike something with a hammer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用锤子击打或敲打某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laqat xi ħaġa b'martell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锤子敲打；以锤击打。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem martel il-biċċa metall sakemm ħadet il-forma mixtieqa.
formal.en: The worker hammered the piece of metal until it took the desired shape.
formal.zh: 工人用锤子敲打那块金属，直到它形成所需的形状。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Ġanni: Pawlu martel biċċa metall fil-garaxx.
colloquial.en: Marija: What was that noise? Ġanni: Pawlu hammered a piece of metal in the garage.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：刚才是什么声音？詹尼：保罗在车库里用锤子敲了一块金属。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (邻居)
messages.zh: 保罗在车库里用锤子敲了一块金属。
messages.en: Pawlu hammered a piece of metal in the garage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时做一个举锤敲下的动作，把 martel 和“用锤子敲打”绑定；例句中的 martel 表示已经发生的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a dark reddish-brown colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈深红褐色或栗红色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' kulur aħmar skur li jagħti fil-kannella.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 栗红色的；暗红褐色的。

formal.mt: Id-disinjatur għażel drapp marun għall-purtieri tas-sala.
formal.en: The designer chose maroon fabric for the hall curtains.
formal.zh: 设计师为大厅的窗帘选用了栗红色布料。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Liema kulur tixtieq għall-purtieri? Noel: Marun; naħseb li jaqbel mal-għamara.
colloquial.en: Rita: What colour would you like for the curtains? Noel: Maroon; I think it matches the furniture.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：窗帘你想要什么颜色？诺埃尔：栗红色；我觉得它和家具很搭。

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.zh: 窗帘你想要什么颜色？
messages.en: What colour would you like for the curtains?

messages.speaker: Noel (顾客)
messages.zh: 栗红色；我觉得它和家具很搭。
messages.en: Maroon; I think it matches the furniture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一块深红中带褐色的色卡，标上“marun—maroon—栗红色”，靠颜色对照记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of grassy land, especially one used for grazing animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长有青草的土地，尤其指可供牲畜吃草的草地或牧场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda art miksija bil-ħaxix, speċjalment fejn jirgħu l-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 草地；田野；供牲畜放牧的土地。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi jħalli n-nagħaġ jirgħu fil-marġ matul il-jum.
formal.en: The farmer lets the sheep graze in the meadow during the day.
formal.zh: 农夫白天让绵羊在草地上吃草。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn huma n-nagħaġ? Mark: Qegħdin jirgħu fil-marġ ħdejn ir-razzett.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are the sheep? Mark: They are grazing in the meadow beside the farm.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：绵羊在哪里？马克：它们正在农场旁边的草地上吃草。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 绵羊在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the sheep?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 它们正在农场旁边的草地上吃草。
messages.en: They are grazing in the meadow beside the farm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 marġ 配上一幅绵羊低头吃青草的画面，用“草地供放牧”把两个常见含义一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To beat someone by striking them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 击打、殴打某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta daqqiet lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打；殴打。

formal.mt: Ix-xhud qal li r-raġel marżeb lill-vittma quddiem il-bieb.
formal.en: The witness said that the man beat the victim in front of the door.
formal.zh: 证人说，那名男子在门前殴打了受害者。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Għaliex qed tibki? Ben: Tifel ieħor marżeb lil ħija. Emma: Ejja ngħidu lill-għalliema minnufih.
colloquial.en: Emma: Why are you crying? Ben: Another boy beat my brother. Emma: Let's tell the teacher straight away.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：你为什么哭？本：另一个男孩打了我弟弟。艾玛：我们马上告诉老师吧。

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么哭？
messages.en: Why are you crying?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 另一个男孩打了我弟弟。
messages.en: Another boy beat my brother.

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.zh: 我们马上告诉老师吧。
messages.en: Let's tell the teacher straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“谁打了谁”的句子框架记忆 marżeb：前面放施事，后面用 lil 引出被打的人，并留意字母 ż 上的点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An alternative name for Egypt, a country in North Africa and West Asia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 埃及的另一名称，指位于北非和西亚的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ieħor għall-Eġittu, pajjiż fl-Afrika ta' Fuq u fl-Asja tal-Punent.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of Eġittu: Egypt (a country in North Africa and West Asia)
sense_translations.zh_definition: Eġittu 的同义名称：埃及，位于北非和西亚的国家。

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jagħti ħarsa ġenerali lejn l-istorja ta' Masar, magħruf ukoll bħala l-Eġittu.
formal.en: This chapter provides an overview of the history of Masar, also known as Egypt.
formal.zh: 本章概述 Masar，即埃及的历史。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'dan il-ktieb sibt l-isem Masar. Liema pajjiż hu? Mark: Hu l-Eġittu. Masar huwa isem ieħor għall-istess pajjiż.
colloquial.en: Maja: I found the name Masar in this book. Which country is it? Mark: It's Egypt. Masar is another name for the same country.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我在这本书里看到了 Masar 这个名称。它是哪个国家？Mark：是埃及。Masar 是同一个国家的另一名称。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan il-ktieb sibt l-isem Masar. Liema pajjiż hu?
messages.mt_standard: F'dan il-ktieb sibt l-isem Masar. Liema pajjiż hu?
messages.zh: 我在这本书里看到了 Masar 这个名称。它是哪个国家？
messages.en: I found the name Masar in this book. Which country is it?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-Eġittu. Masar huwa isem ieħor għall-istess pajjiż.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-Eġittu. Masar huwa isem ieħor għall-istess pajjiż.
messages.zh: 是埃及。Masar 是同一个国家的另一名称。
messages.en: It's Egypt. Masar is another name for the same country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在地图上的埃及旁并排写下 Masar 和 Eġittu，把两个名称连到同一个国家来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Purgatory: a state of purification after death, according to Catholic belief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 炼狱：按照天主教信仰，死后灵魂接受净化的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' tisfija tar-ruħ wara l-mewt, skont it-twemmin Kattoliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 炼狱，天主教信仰中灵魂死后接受净化的状态。

formal.mt: Skont it-tagħlim Kattoliku, l-erwieħ fil-masfa jgħaddu minn tisfija qabel jidħlu fil-ġenna.
formal.en: According to Catholic teaching, souls in purgatory undergo purification before entering heaven.
formal.zh: 按照天主教教义，炼狱中的灵魂在进入天堂之前接受净化。
