colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser masfa f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Tfisser il-purgatorju, fejn ir-ruħ tgħaddi minn tisfija skont it-twemmin Kattoliku.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does masfa mean in this text? Pawlu: It means purgatory, where the soul undergoes purification according to Catholic belief.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这篇文章里的 masfa 是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是炼狱，按照天主教信仰，灵魂在那里接受净化。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 masfa 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does masfa mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser il-purgatorju, fejn ir-ruħ tgħaddi minn tisfija skont it-twemmin Kattoliku.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser il-purgatorju, fejn ir-ruħ tgħaddi minn tisfija skont it-twemmin Kattoliku.
messages.zh: 意思是炼狱，按照天主教信仰，灵魂在那里接受净化。
messages.en: It means purgatory, where the soul undergoes purification according to Catholic belief.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 masfa 放进“灵魂接受净化”的宗教场景中记忆，并与普通监狱的概念分开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Egyptian; relating to Egypt, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 埃及的；与埃及、埃及人民或埃及文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Eġittu, mal-poplu tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu; Eġizzjan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Eġizzjan 的同义词：埃及的，与埃及有关的。

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-wirt Masri u l-importanza tiegħu għall-istorja tal-arti.
formal.en: The study examines Egyptian heritage and its importance to the history of art.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察埃及文化遗产及其对艺术史的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'ifisser Masri f'din id-deskrizzjoni? Sam: Ifisser Eġizzjan. Hawnhekk qed jiddeskrivi l-istil tal-oġġett.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does Masri mean in this description? Sam: It means Egyptian. Here it describes the object's style.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这段说明里的 Masri 是什么意思？Sam：意思是“埃及的”。这里是在描述这件物品的风格。

messages.speaker: Rita (博物馆参观者)
messages.zh: 这段说明里的 Masri 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does Masri mean in this description?

messages.speaker: Sam (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser Eġizzjan. Hawnhekk qed jiddeskrivi l-istil tal-oġġett.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser Eġizzjan. Hawnhekk qed jiddeskrivi l-istil tal-oġġett.
messages.zh: 意思是“埃及的”。这里是在描述这件物品的风格。
messages.en: It means Egyptian. Here it describes the object's style.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Masar 记作地图上的国家名，把 Masri 放在“埃及风格”旁，借不同用法区分名称与形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stimulation of one's own genitals for sexual pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为获得性愉悦而刺激自己生殖器的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istimulazzjoni tal-partijiet ġenitali proprji biex jinkiseb pjaċir sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自慰，指为获得性愉悦而刺激自己生殖器的行为。

formal.mt: Il-fuljett dwar is-saħħa sesswali jinkludi taqsima li tispjega t-terminu masturbazzjoni b'lingwaġġ ċar u newtrali.
formal.en: The sexual health leaflet includes a section explaining the term masturbation in clear, neutral language.
formal.zh: 这份性健康宣传册设有专门章节，以清楚、中性的语言解释“自慰”这一术语。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandi mistoqsija dwar il-masturbazzjoni, imma nistħi nistaqsi. Elena: Tista' tistaqsini fil-privat. Nista' nispjegalek it-terminu b'mod ċar.
colloquial.en: Marija: I have a question about masturbation, but I feel embarrassed to ask. Elena: You can ask me in private. I can explain the term clearly.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我有个关于自慰的问题，但不好意思问。Elena：你可以私下问我。我可以把这个术语解释清楚。

messages.speaker: Marija (成年咨询者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi mistoqsija dwar il-masturbazzjoni, imma nistħi nistaqsi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi mistoqsija dwar il-masturbazzjoni, imma nistħi nistaqsi.
messages.zh: 我有个关于自慰的问题，但不好意思问。
messages.en: I have a question about masturbation, but I feel embarrassed to ask.

messages.speaker: Elena (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tistaqsini fil-privat. Nista' nispjegalek it-terminu b'mod ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tistaqsini fil-privat. Nista' nispjegalek it-terminu b'mod ċar.
messages.zh: 你可以私下问我。我可以把这个术语解释清楚。
messages.en: You can ask me in private. I can explain the term clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 masturbazzjoni 与英语 masturbation 并排制作词卡，中文标注“自慰”，借相似拼写记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fat from cod fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鳕鱼的脂肪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xaħam tal-merluzz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鳕鱼脂肪。

collocations.en: a small amount of cod fat

formal.mt: Għall-analiżi, ir-riċerkatriċi ġabret kampjun ta' masħa, jiġifieri xaħam tal-merluzz.
formal.en: For the analysis, the researcher collected a sample of masħa, meaning cod fat.
formal.zh: 研究人员为进行分析收集了一份 masħa 样本，即鳕鱼脂肪样本。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'hemm f'dan il-kontenitur? Toni: Masħa, jiġifieri xaħam tal-merluzz. Dan hu l-kampjun għall-analiżi.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's in this container? Toni: Masħa, meaning cod fat. This is the sample for analysis.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个容器里装着什么？Toni：Masħa，也就是鳕鱼脂肪。这是用来分析的样本。

messages.speaker: Nina (实验室助理)
messages.zh: 这个容器里装着什么？
messages.en: What's in this container?

messages.speaker: Toni (研究员)
messages.mt_spoken: Masħa, jiġifieri xaħam tal-merluzz. Dan hu l-kampjun għall-analiżi.
messages.mt_standard: Masħa, jiġifieri xaħam tal-merluzz. Dan hu l-kampjun għall-analiżi.
messages.zh: Masħa，也就是鳕鱼脂肪。这是用来分析的样本。
messages.en: Masħa, meaning cod fat. This is the sample for analysis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个标有 masħa 的样本瓶，瓶旁画一条鳕鱼和一小块脂肪，把鱼种与脂肪一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone angry, especially very angry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人生气，尤其指激起强烈愤怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jirrabja, speċjalment jirrabja ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惹怒；使某人生气。
使某人怒不可遏；把某人气得火冒三丈。

formal.mt: Il-kumment offensiv masħan lill-udjenza u wassal għal protesti waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The offensive comment infuriated the audience and led to protests during the meeting.
formal.zh: 那句冒犯性的话激怒了听众，并在会议期间引发抗议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark telaq daqshekk irrabjat? David: Dak il-kumment masħan lil Mark. Ħass li kienu qed jidħku bih.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Mark leave so angry? David: That comment made Mark see red. He felt they were making fun of him.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Mark 为什么那么生气地走了？David：那句话把 Mark 气坏了。他觉得他们在嘲笑他。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么那么生气地走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave so angry?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-kumment masħan lil Mark. Ħass li kienu qed jidħku bih.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-kumment masħan lil Mark. Ħass li kienu qed jidħku bih.
messages.zh: 那句话把 Mark 气坏了。他觉得他们在嘲笑他。
messages.en: That comment made Mark see red. He felt they were making fun of him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一句话让对方气红了脸”的画面记 masħan，重点记住它表示使别人生气。

gloss_zh: 斥责；痛骂；令人愤怒或鄙视的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To criticize someone angrily, often with harsh words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生气地批评或责骂某人，常带有严厉措辞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċanfar lil xi ħadd bir-rabja, spiss bi kliem iebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斥责；责骂。
严厉训斥；痛骂一顿。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who causes others to experience anger or contempt
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使别人感到愤怒或鄙视的人。

collocations.en: to give a tongue-lashing in front of everyone

formal.mt: Il-kap masħar lill-impjegat quddiem il-kollegi minħabba l-iżball fir-rapport.
formal.en: The manager scolded the employee in front of his colleagues because of the error in the report.
formal.zh: 由于报告中的错误，经理当着同事的面斥责了那名员工。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex l-għalliem masħar lil Pawlu? Luqa: Għax baqa' jitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni, anki wara t-twissija.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did the teacher scold Pawlu? Luqa: Because he kept talking during the lesson, even after the warning.
colloquial.zh: Marta：老师为什么责骂 Pawlu？Luqa：因为他上课时一直说话，受到警告后还是这样。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 老师为什么责骂 Pawlu？
messages.en: Why did the teacher scold Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax baqa' jitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni, anki wara t-twissija.
messages.mt_standard: Għax baqa' jitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni, anki wara t-twissija.
messages.zh: 因为他上课时一直说话，受到警告后还是这样。
messages.en: Because he kept talking during the lesson, even after the warning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 masħar 做两张词性卡：动词配“严厉责骂”的场景，名词配“令人愤怒或鄙视的人”。

gloss_zh: 好诋毁的；惯于表示鄙夷的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to speak disparagingly about others or express disdain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于贬损、诋毁别人，或流露鄙夷态度的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jmaqdar lil ħaddieħor jew juri disprezz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于诋毁或恶意贬损他人的。
倾向于表达鄙夷或轻蔑态度的。

formal.mt: It-ton masħari tal-ittra dgħajjef l-argument tal-awtur u għamel id-djalogu aktar diffiċli.
formal.en: The letter's disparaging tone weakened the author's argument and made dialogue more difficult.
formal.zh: 信中贬损他人的语气削弱了作者的论证，也使对话更难进行。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex ma għoġbitekx dik ir-reċensjoni? Ben: Kellha ton masħari. L-awtur kien qed juri disprezz lejn in-nies minflok jispjega l-problemi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why didn't you like that review? Ben: It had a disparaging tone. The author was showing contempt for people instead of explaining the problems.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你为什么不喜欢那篇评论？Ben：它的语气充满贬损。作者在表达对别人的鄙视，而没有解释问题。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不喜欢那篇评论？
messages.en: Why didn't you like that review?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellha ton masħari. L-awtur kien qed juri disprezz lejn in-nies minflok jispjega l-problemi.
messages.mt_standard: Kellha ton masħari. L-awtur kien qed juri disprezz lejn in-nies minflok jispjega l-problemi.
messages.zh: 它的语气充满贬损。作者在表达对别人的鄙视，而没有解释问题。
messages.en: It had a disparaging tone. The author was showing contempt for people instead of explaining the problems.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条带着轻蔑口气、处处贬低别人的评论，用 masħari 给这种语气贴上形容词标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In mathematical terms or by using mathematical methods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从数学角度而言，或通过数学方法进行计算、分析或证明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'termini tal-matematika jew bl-użu ta' metodi matematiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在数学上；用数学方法。

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat huwa matematikament korrett, iżda l-istudent għandu jispjega wkoll il-metodu li uża.
formal.en: The result is mathematically correct, but the student should also explain the method used.
formal.zh: 这个结果在数学上是正确的，但学生还应说明所用的方法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din it-tweġiba hi tajba? Mark: Iva, matematikament hi korretta, imma ikteb ukoll kif wasalt għaliha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this answer right? Mark: Yes, it is mathematically correct, but also write down how you arrived at it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个答案对吗？马克：对，数学上是正确的，不过也要写出你是怎么算出来的。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个答案对吗？
messages.en: Is this answer right?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, matematikament hi korretta, imma ikteb ukoll kif wasalt għaliha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, matematikament hi korretta, imma ikteb ukoll kif wasalt għaliha.
messages.zh: 对，数学上是正确的，不过也要写出你是怎么算出来的。
messages.en: Yes, it is mathematically correct, but also write down how you arrived at it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和演算纸联系起来：凡是强调“从数学角度看”或“用数学方法算”，就想到 matematikament。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large gun used to fire heavy projectiles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于发射重型弹丸的大型火炮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arma kbira li tintuża biex tispara projettili tqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大炮；火炮。

formal.mt: Fil-mużew hemm matfagħ antik, b'tabella li tispjega kif kien jintuża.
formal.en: The museum contains an old cannon, with a label explaining how it was used.
formal.zh: 博物馆里陈列着一门旧式大炮，旁边的说明牌介绍了它过去的用途。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak ħdejn il-bieb? Pawlu: Dak matfagħ antik; ejja naqraw it-tabella.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that beside the door? Pawlu: That is an old cannon; let's read the label.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门旁边那个是什么？保罗：那是一门旧式大炮；我们看看说明牌吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 门旁边那个是什么？
messages.en: What is that beside the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak matfagħ antik; ejja naqraw it-tabella.
messages.mt_standard: Dak matfagħ antik; ejja naqraw it-tabella.
messages.zh: 那是一门旧式大炮；我们看看说明牌吧。
messages.en: That is an old cannon; let's read the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象博物馆门口一门有长炮管的大炮，把画面和 matfagħ 配对记忆，突出它是大型火炮。

gloss_zh: 为未按时付款找理由；拖欠付款还找借口的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give reasons or excuses for failing to pay on time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为自己未能按时付款提出理由或借口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti raġunijiet jew skużi biex jiġġustifika għaliex ma ħallasx fil-ħin.

sense_translations.en_definition: to justify failure to pay on time
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为未能按时付款作解释或找借口。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who finds reasons not to pay on time
sense_translations.zh_definition: 找各种理由不按时付款的人。

collocations.en: a customer who makes excuses for not paying on time
collocations.zh: 不按时付款还找借口的顾客

formal.mt: Il-klijent mattal dwar il-ħlas u semma diversi raġunijiet għaliex ma ħallasx sad-data miftiehma.
formal.en: The customer made excuses about payment and gave several reasons for not paying by the agreed date.
formal.zh: 这位顾客就付款问题找借口，列举了几个未能在约定日期前付款的理由。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-klijent ħallas illum? Toni: Le, reġa' mattal dwar il-ħlas u qal li għadu qed jistenna flus.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did the customer pay today? Toni: No, he made excuses about payment again and said he was still waiting for money.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：顾客今天付款了吗？托尼：没有，他又为没付款找理由，说还在等钱到账。

messages.speaker: Rita (店主)
messages.zh: 顾客今天付款了吗？
messages.en: Did the customer pay today?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, reġa' mattal dwar il-ħlas u qal li għadu qed jistenna flus.
messages.mt_standard: Le, reġa' mattal dwar il-ħlas u qal li għadu qed jistenna flus.
messages.zh: 没有，他又为没付款找理由，说还在等钱到账。
messages.en: No, he made excuses about payment again and said he was still waiting for money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“账单到期，借口又来”这个场景记忆 mattal：动词指为迟付找理由，名词指这样做的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slow or late in acting, or inclined to put things off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行动迟缓、未能及时行动的，或习惯把事情往后拖的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jdum biex jaġixxi jew li għandu t-tendenza jħalli l-affarijiet għal aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迟缓的；行动或完成事情不及时的。
拖延的；习惯推迟行动的。

collocations.zh: 行动迟缓或爱拖延的员工

formal.mt: Student mattali jista' jħalli x-xogħol għall-aħħar jum, anki meta jkollu biżżejjed żmien biex ilestih qabel.
formal.en: A procrastinating student may leave the work until the final day, even when there is enough time to finish it earlier.
formal.zh: 爱拖延的学生可能把作业留到最后一天，即使本来有充足的时间提前完成。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadek ma bdejtx ix-xogħol? Mark: Le, illum kont mattali; se nibda issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you still not started the work? Mark: No, I have been procrastinating today; I will start now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你还没开始做吗？马克：还没有，我今天一直在拖延；现在就开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你还没开始做吗？
messages.en: Have you still not started the work?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum kont mattali; se nibda issa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum kont mattali; se nibda issa.
messages.zh: 还没有，我今天一直在拖延；现在就开始。
messages.en: No, I have been procrastinating today; I will start now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象作业摆在桌上却总说“等一下”：mattali 描写这种迟迟不行动、把事情往后拖的状态。

gloss_zh: 拉伸；伸展身体；为播种划整土地；铺展大袍以圈定播种区域

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stretch something or oneself; also, to mark soil for regular sowing or spread a large robe to enclose an area for sowing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拉伸某物或伸展自己的身体；也指用锹或犁在田土上划出标记以便整齐播种，或铺展一件大袍以圈定播种区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jestendi xi ħaġa jew ġismu; ukoll, jimmarka l-ħamrija b'pala jew moħriet għal żrigħ regolari, jew jifrex libsa kbira biex jiżra' fiż-żona magħluqa minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拉伸；使伸长或展开。
伸展自己的身体；伸懒腰。

sense_translations.en_definition: to mark the soil in a field either by a spade or a plough in order to sow as regularly as possible
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锹或犁在田地的土壤上划出标记，以便尽可能整齐均匀地播种。

sense_translations.en_definition: to stretch a large robe in order to sow within the enclosed area
sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺展一件大袍，以便在其圈定的区域内播种。

collocations.en: marked the soil with a plough for regular sowing
collocations.zh: 用犁在土壤上划出标记以便整齐播种

formal.mt: Qabel iż-żrigħ, il-bidwi mattar il-ħamrija bil-moħriet biex jimmarka fejn kellhom jinżergħu ż-żrieragħ.
formal.en: Before sowing, the farmer marked the soil with a plough to indicate where the seeds were to be sown.
formal.zh: 播种前，农民用犁在土壤上划出标记，标明种子应播下的位置。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex id-drapp issa jidher aktar lixx? Pawlu: Għax Toni mattar id-drapp qabel ma kejlu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does the cloth look smoother now? Pawlu: Because Toni stretched the cloth before measuring it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这块布现在怎么看起来更平整了？保罗：因为托尼量尺寸前把布拉展了。

messages.speaker: Nina (缝纫学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex id-drapp issa jidher aktar lixx?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex id-drapp issa jidher aktar lixx?
messages.zh: 这块布现在怎么看起来更平整了？
messages.en: Why does the cloth look smoother now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (缝纫老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Toni mattar id-drapp qabel ma kejlu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Toni mattar id-drapp qabel ma kejlu.
messages.zh: 因为托尼量尺寸前把布拉展了。
messages.en: Because Toni stretched the cloth before measuring it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四格画面分别记：拉布、伸懒腰、田里划播种线、铺开大袍圈定播种区；这是义项记忆法，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 织机上用于撑展织成布料的部件

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of a loom used by a weaver to stretch the woven cloth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 织机上供织工撑展已经织成的布料的部件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tan-newl li n-nissieġ juża biex iżomm id-drapp minsuġ mifrux u miġbud.

sense_translations.en_definition: that part of a loom which weaver use to stretch the woven cloth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 织机上织工用来撑展已织成布料的那个部件。

formal.mt: In-nissieġ juża l-mattru tan-newl biex iżomm id-drapp minsuġ mifrux waqt ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The weaver uses the loom's cloth-stretching part to keep the woven cloth spread out during work.
formal.zh: 织工使用织机上的撑布部件，使织成的布料在操作过程中保持展开。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għalxiex jintuża l-mattru? Ġużeppi: Bih inżommu d-drapp minsuġ mifrux; ejja nurik fuq in-newl.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the mattru used for? Ġużeppi: We use it to keep the woven cloth spread out; let me show you on the loom.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个撑布部件是做什么用的？朱塞佩：我们用它让织成的布保持展开；我在织机上指给你看。

messages.speaker: Lara (织布学员)
messages.zh: 这个撑布部件是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is the mattru used for?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (织工)
messages.mt_spoken: Bih inżommu d-drapp minsuġ mifrux; ejja nurik fuq in-newl.
messages.mt_standard: Bih inżommu d-drapp minsuġ mifrux; ejja nurik fuq in-newl.
messages.zh: 我们用它让织成的布保持展开；我在织机上指给你看。
messages.en: We use it to keep the woven cloth spread out; let me show you on the loom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mattru 画成织机上撑开布料的一个部件，旁边写“撑布”，记住它指具体部件而不是整台织机。

gloss_zh: 毛里塔尼亚的；毛里塔尼亚人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Mauritania or its people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与毛里塔尼亚或毛里塔尼亚人有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Mauritania jew man-nies tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毛里塔尼亚的；毛里塔尼亚人的。
毛里塔尼亚人。

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-laqgħa jinkludi diskors minn kittieb Mauritanjan dwar il-letteratura.
formal.en: The meeting programme includes a talk on literature by a Mauritanian writer.
formal.zh: 会议日程包括一位毛里塔尼亚作家关于文学的演讲。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kittieb hu Mauritanjan? Mark: Iva, hu mill-Mauritania u llum se jitkellem dwar il-ktieb tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this writer Mauritanian? Mark: Yes, he is from Mauritania and will talk about his book today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这位作家是毛里塔尼亚人吗？马克：是的，他来自毛里塔尼亚，今天会介绍自己的书。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.zh: 这位作家是毛里塔尼亚人吗？
messages.en: Is this writer Mauritanian?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu mill-Mauritania u llum se jitkellem dwar il-ktieb tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu mill-Mauritania u llum se jitkellem dwar il-ktieb tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，他来自毛里塔尼亚，今天会介绍自己的书。
messages.en: Yes, he is from Mauritania and will talk about his book today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mauritanjan 和国家名“毛里塔尼亚”配成一张卡：修饰作家时表示国籍，单独指人时表示毛里塔尼亚人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of going on a trip.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外出旅行或出游这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed imur fuq vjaġġ jew ħarġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to act of taking a trip
sense_translations.zh_definition: 外出旅行、出游这一行为。

collocations.en: going on a trip to the countryside
going on a trip with friends

formal.mt: Il-mawrien fil-kampanja jagħti lill-istudenti l-opportunità li josservaw in-natura barra mill-klassi.
formal.en: Going on a trip to the countryside gives students an opportunity to observe nature outside the classroom.
formal.zh: 到乡间出游让学生有机会在课堂之外观察自然。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tgħid għal ftit mawrien fil-kampanja nhar il-Ħadd? Pawlu: Idea tajba! Nistgħu mmorru mal-ħbieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: How about a little trip to the countryside on Sunday? Pawlu: Good idea! We can go with our friends.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：星期天去乡间游玩一下，怎么样？保罗：好主意！我们可以和朋友一起去。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tgħid għal ftit mawrien fil-kampanja nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tgħid għal ftit mawrien fil-kampanja nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 星期天去乡间游玩一下，怎么样？
messages.en: How about a little trip to the countryside on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 好主意！我们可以和朋友一起去。
messages.en: Good idea! We can go with our friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象周末背包出门去乡间，把整件“出去游玩”的事标为 mawrien，记住它是表示出游行为的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mauritania, a country in West Africa whose official name is the Islamic Republic of Mauritania.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 毛里塔尼亚，西非国家，正式名称为毛里塔尼亚伊斯兰共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika Iżlamika tal-Mawritanja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Mauritania (a country in West Africa; official name: Repubblika Iżlamika tal-Mawritanja)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 毛里塔尼亚，西非国家；正式名称为毛里塔尼亚伊斯兰共和国。

collocations.zh: 毛里塔尼亚伊斯兰共和国
前往毛里塔尼亚的旅行

formal.mt: Il-Mawritanja tinsab fl-Afrika tal-Punent u l-isem uffiċjali tagħha huwa r-Repubblika Iżlamika tal-Mawritanja.
formal.en: Mauritania is in West Africa, and its official name is the Islamic Republic of Mauritania.
formal.zh: 毛里塔尼亚位于西非，正式名称为毛里塔尼亚伊斯兰共和国。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tinsab il-Mawritanja? Mark: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent. Ejja nsibuha fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Mauritania? Mark: In West Africa. Let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：毛里塔尼亚在哪里？马克：在西非。我们在地图上找找它吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 毛里塔尼亚在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Mauritania?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent. Ejja nsibuha fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent. Ejja nsibuha fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在西非。我们在地图上找找它吧。
messages.en: In West Africa. Let's find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mawritanja 与“毛里塔尼亚—西非”一起写在地图卡片上，借国家名和位置建立记忆。

gloss_zh: 毛里求斯；毛里求斯主岛

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mauritius, a country in the Indian Ocean east of East Africa and Madagascar; also the country's main island.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 毛里求斯，位于东非及马达加斯加以东印度洋中的国家；也指该国的主岛毛里求斯岛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Oċean Indjan, fil-Lvant tal-Afrika tal-Lvant u ta' Madagaskar; l-isem jintuża wkoll għall-gżira ewlenija tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: Mauritius (a country in the Indian Ocean, east of East Africa and Madagascar; official name: Repubblika tal-Mawrizju)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 毛里求斯，位于东非及马达加斯加以东印度洋中的国家；正式名称为毛里求斯共和国。

sense_translations.en_definition: Mauritius (the main island of the country of Mauritius)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 毛里求斯岛，毛里求斯国家的主岛。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddistingwi bejn ir-Repubblika tal-Mawrizju bħala pajjiż u l-gżira tal-Mawrizju bħala l-gżira ewlenija tiegħu.
formal.en: The report distinguishes between the Republic of Mauritius as a country and the island of Mauritius as its main island.
formal.zh: 报告区分了作为国家的毛里求斯共和国和作为该国主岛的毛里求斯岛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawnhekk, Mawrizju jfisser il-pajjiż jew il-gżira? Pawlu: Il-gżira ewlenija; din hija mappa tal-gżira.
colloquial.en: Sara: Here, does Mauritius mean the country or the island? Pawlu: The main island; this is a map of the island.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的“毛里求斯”指国家还是岛屿？保罗：指主岛；这是一张该岛的地图。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, Mawrizju jfisser il-pajjiż jew il-gżira?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, Mawrizju jfisser il-pajjiż jew il-gżira?
messages.zh: 这里的“毛里求斯”指国家还是岛屿？
messages.en: Here, does Mauritius mean the country or the island?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-gżira ewlenija; din hija mappa tal-gżira.
messages.mt_standard: Il-gżira ewlenija; din hija mappa tal-gżira.
messages.zh: 指主岛；这是一张该岛的地图。
messages.en: The main island; this is a map of the island.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Mawrizju 画两张相连的卡片：一张写“国家”，一张写“主岛”，提醒自己按语境区分。

gloss_zh: 牧羊针，一种植物的俗名

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant known by the common name shepherd's needle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种英语俗名为 shepherd's needle 的植物，可按字面辅助记作“牧羊针”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bl-isem maxxita, li bl-Ingliż tissejjaħ shepherd's needle.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英语俗称 shepherd's needle 的植物；可按字面辅助记作“牧羊针”。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-osservazzjoni, il-pjanta ġiet irreġistrata bl-isem maxxita u ġie inkluż ritratt tal-weraq tagħha.
formal.en: In the observation report, the plant was recorded under the name shepherd's needle, and a photograph of its leaves was included.
formal.zh: 观察报告将这株植物记录为牧羊针，并附上了其叶片的照片。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Toni: Maxxita. Ikteb l-isem ħdejn ir-ritratt tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this plant called? Toni: Shepherd's needle. Write the name beside its photograph.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这株植物叫什么？托尼：牧羊针。把名称写在它的照片旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Maxxita. Ikteb l-isem ħdejn ir-ritratt tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Maxxita. Ikteb l-isem ħdejn ir-ritratt tagħha.
messages.zh: 牧羊针。把名称写在它的照片旁边。
messages.en: Shepherd's needle. Write the name beside its photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maxxita 写在植物图片旁，再配上“牧羊针”的英语俗名；用图片和名称配对记忆，不凭名称推断植物特征。

gloss_zh: 摆弄纸牌；洗牌；当牌桌老千

teaching_sense.en_definition: To handle or shuffle playing cards, or to act as a card sharp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摆弄一副纸牌或洗牌；也可指当牌桌老千，靠玩牌作弊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża jew iħawwad il-karti tal-logħob, jew jilgħab il-karti bil-qerq.

sense_translations.en_definition: to handle a pack of cards
sense_translations.zh_definition: 摆弄、操作一副纸牌。
洗牌；打乱纸牌的次序。
当牌桌老千；以熟练手法在牌局中作弊。

formal.mt: Qabel ma qassam il-karti lill-plejers, Mark mazzaz il-pakkett kollu.
formal.en: Before dealing the cards to the players, Mark shuffled the entire pack.
formal.zh: 马克在向玩家发牌之前，把整副牌洗了一遍。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min mazzaz il-karti? Pawlu: Mark. Issa nistgħu nibdew nilagħbu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who shuffled the cards? Pawlu: Mark did. Now we can start playing.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁洗了牌？保罗：马克洗的。现在我们可以开始玩了。

messages.speaker: Nina (牌友)
messages.zh: 谁洗了牌？
messages.en: Who shuffled the cards?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (牌友)
messages.zh: 马克洗的。现在我们可以开始玩了。
messages.en: Mark did. Now we can start playing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三格纸牌漫画记 mazzaz：拿着牌、打乱牌、出千作弊。前两格记普通动作，第三格记带作弊含义的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small pack or a small sheaf of things gathered together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聚在一起的一小包、一小捆或一小束东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pakkett żgħir jew ġabra żgħira ta' affarijiet miġbura jew marbuta flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小包；数量不多的一包或一捆。
小束；小捆，指聚拢或扎在一起的一小束东西。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi rabat mazzzett qamħ u poġġieh ħdejn il-bieb tal-maħżen.
formal.en: The farmer tied a small sheaf of wheat and placed it beside the storehouse door.
formal.zh: 农民扎好一小捆麦子，把它放在仓库门旁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek mazzett karti żejda? Mark: Iva, hemm wieħed fuq l-ixkaffa. Tista' tieħdu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have a small bundle of spare papers? Mark: Yes, there's one on the shelf. You can take it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你有一小叠多余的纸吗？马克：有，架子上有一叠。你可以拿走。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你有一小叠多余的纸吗？
messages.en: Do you have a small bundle of spare papers?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm wieħed fuq l-ixkaffa. Tista' tieħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm wieħed fuq l-ixkaffa. Tista' tieħdu.
messages.zh: 有，架子上有一叠。你可以拿走。
messages.en: Yes, there's one on the shelf. You can take it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一小叠纸和一小捆麦子并排放着，都贴上 mazzett 标签；抓住“少量东西聚成一束”的共同画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Carved flowers used to decorate the door of a church.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装饰教堂门的雕刻花卉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fjuri minquxin li jżejnu l-bieb ta' knisja.

sense_translations.en_definition: carved flowers adorning the door of a church
sense_translations.zh_definition: 装饰教堂门的雕刻花卉

collocations.en: the carved floral decoration of the church door
the restoration of the carved floral decoration

formal.mt: Waqt ir-restawr tal-knisja, il-mazzettun li jżejjen il-bieb ġie mnaddaf b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: During the restoration of the church, the carved flowers decorating the door were carefully cleaned.
formal.zh: 修复教堂时，装饰门的雕刻花卉得到了仔细清洁。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ara dawk il-fjuri minquxin fuq il-bieb tal-knisja! Pawlu: Dak hu l-mazzettun. Marta: Kemm għandu dettalji sbieħ!
colloquial.en: Marta: Look at those carved flowers on the church door! Pawlu: That's the carved floral decoration. Marta: It has such beautiful details!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：看教堂门上那些雕刻的花！保罗：那就是门上的雕花装饰。玛尔塔：细节真漂亮！

messages.speaker: Marta (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dawk il-fjuri minquxin fuq il-bieb tal-knisja!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dawk il-fjuri minquxin fuq il-bieb tal-knisja!
messages.zh: 看教堂门上那些雕刻的花！
messages.en: Look at those carved flowers on the church door!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.zh: 那就是门上的雕花装饰。
messages.en: That's the carved floral decoration.

messages.speaker: Marta (游客)
messages.zh: 细节真漂亮！
messages.en: It has such beautiful details!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mazzettun 和教堂门上的雕花画面连起来记：看得见花形，却是雕刻装饰。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fish of the genus Gobius; also, a naive person who is easily deceived.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 虾虎鱼属的鱼；也指天真、容易被欺骗的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta tal-ġeneru Gobius; ukoll persuna inġenwa li titqarraq faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虾虎鱼，即虾虎鱼属的鱼

sense_translations.en_definition: gullible (someone easily deceived or duped, naive)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易受骗的人；天真轻信的人

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenti raw mazzun bejn il-blat u rreġistraw il-movimenti tiegħu.
formal.en: During the observation, the students saw a goby among the rocks and recorded its movements.
formal.zh: 观察时，学生们看见岩石间有一条虾虎鱼，并记录了它的活动。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qaluli li rbaħt telefon, imma jridu l-flus l-ewwel. Sara: Tkunx mazzun! Tiħallasx qabel ma tiċċekkja. Mark: Sewwa, se niċċekkja.
colloquial.en: Mark: They told me I won a phone, but they want money first. Sara: Don't be so gullible! Don't pay before you check. Mark: Right, I'll check.
colloquial.zh: 马克：他们说我赢了一部手机，但要我先付钱。萨拉：别这么容易上当！查清楚再付钱。马克：好，我会查一下。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qaluli li rbaħt telefon, imma jridu l-flus l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Qaluli li rbaħt telefon, imma jridu l-flus l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 他们说我赢了一部手机，但要我先付钱。
messages.en: They told me I won a phone, but they want money first.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkunx mazzun! Tiħallasx qabel ma tiċċekkja.
messages.mt_standard: Tkunx mazzun! Tiħallasx qabel ma tiċċekkja.
messages.zh: 别这么容易上当！查清楚再付钱。
messages.en: Don't be so gullible! Don't pay before you check.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我会查一下。
messages.en: Right, I'll check.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 mazzun 做两张情境卡：水中岩石旁记虾虎鱼，轻信别人时记容易受骗的人；两义分别记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country on the Balkan Peninsula in Southeastern Europe, officially called the Republic of North Macedonia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于欧洲东南部巴尔干半岛的国家，正式名称为北马其顿共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fil-Peniżola Balkaniċi fix-Xlokk tal-Ewropa, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika tal-Maċedonja ta' Fuq.

sense_translations.en_definition: North Macedonia (a country on the Balkan Peninsula in Southeastern Europe; official name: Repubblika tal-Maċedonja ta’ Fuq)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 北马其顿，位于欧洲东南部巴尔干半岛的国家；正式名称为北马其顿共和国。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi żjara kulturali fil-Maċedonja ta' Fuq.
formal.en: The report describes a cultural visit to North Macedonia.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一次对北马其顿的文化访问。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Pawlu: Sejjer il-Maċedonja ta' Fuq ma' ħabib tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday? Pawlu: I'm going to North Macedonia with a friend of mine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要去哪里度假？保罗：我要和一位朋友去北马其顿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer il-Maċedonja ta' Fuq ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer il-Maċedonja ta' Fuq ma' ħabib tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我要和一位朋友去北马其顿。
messages.en: I'm going to North Macedonia with a friend of mine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Maċedonja ta' Fuq 作为完整国名记忆，并与中文“北马其顿”整组配对；开口时不要漏掉后半部分。

gloss_zh: 北马其顿的；北马其顿人（通常指男性）；马其顿语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to North Macedonia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自北马其顿的，或与北马其顿有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Maċedonja ta' Fuq jew li għandu x'jaqsam magħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: North Macedonian (of, from or relating to North Macedonia)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 北马其顿的；来自北马其顿的；与北马其顿有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: North Macedonian (native or inhabitant of North Macedonia) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 北马其顿人；北马其顿的本地人或居民，通常指男性。
马其顿语。

collocations.zh: 遇见一名北马其顿男子

formal.mt: Kittieb Maċedonjan ippreżenta r-rumanz tiegħu waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: A North Macedonian writer presented his novel at the meeting.
formal.zh: 一位北马其顿作家在会上介绍了自己的小说。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħabib tiegħek Maċedonjan? Pawlu: Iva, ġej mill-Maċedonja ta' Fuq, u qed jgħallimni ftit Maċedonjan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your friend North Macedonian? Pawlu: Yes, he's from North Macedonia, and he's teaching me a little Macedonian.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的朋友是北马其顿人吗？保罗：是的，他来自北马其顿，还在教我一点马其顿语。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的朋友是北马其顿人吗？
messages.en: Is your friend North Macedonian?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mill-Maċedonja ta' Fuq, u qed jgħallimni ftit Maċedonjan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mill-Maċedonja ta' Fuq, u qed jgħallimni ftit Maċedonjan.
messages.zh: 是的，他来自北马其顿，还在教我一点马其顿语。
messages.en: Yes, he's from North Macedonia, and he's teaching me a little Macedonian.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按语境分三格记忆：修饰作家时是“北马其顿的”，指人时是“北马其顿人”，学习或说话时可指“马其顿语”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A crane used to lift and move heavy loads.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于吊起和移动重物的起重机械。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex jerfa' u jċaqlaq tagħbijiet tqal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起重机；用于吊运重物的吊车。

collocations.en: a crane on the construction site
lift a load with the crane

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema użaw il-maċina biex jerfgħu t-travi tal-azzar.
formal.en: The workers used the crane to lift the steel beams.
formal.zh: 工人使用起重机吊起钢梁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se ttellgħu dik it-travu? Pawlu: Bil-maċina; tqila wisq biex nerfgħuha aħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are you going to lift that beam? Pawlu: With the crane; it's too heavy for us to lift.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们打算怎么把那根梁吊上去？保罗：用起重机；它太重了，我们抬不动。

messages.speaker: Maja (现场访客)
messages.zh: 你们打算怎么把那根梁吊上去？
messages.en: How are you going to lift that beam?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (建筑工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-maċina; tqila wisq biex nerfgħuha aħna.
messages.mt_standard: Bil-maċina; tqila wisq biex nerfgħuha aħna.
messages.zh: 用起重机；它太重了，我们抬不动。
messages.en: With the crane; it's too heavy for us to lift.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 maċina 就想象吊钩把沉重钢梁吊离地面，用“吊起重物”的动作锁定起重机这个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who mills grain or grinds materials.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事谷物碾磨或材料研磨工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li titħan il-qamħ jew materjali oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨坊工人；研磨工，指从事碾磨或研磨工作的人。

collocations.zh: 有经验的磨坊工人或研磨工

formal.mt: Il-maċinatur jiċċekkja l-qamħ qabel jibda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The miller checks the grain before starting work.
formal.zh: 磨坊工人在开始工作前检查谷物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jitħan dan il-qamħ? Pawlu: Il-maċinatur; illum qiegħed fil-mitħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to mill this grain? Pawlu: The miller; he's at the mill today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来磨这些谷物？保罗：磨坊工人；他今天在磨坊。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 谁来磨这些谷物？
messages.en: Who is going to mill this grain?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (磨坊职员)
messages.zh: 磨坊工人；他今天在磨坊。
messages.en: The miller; he's at the mill today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maċinatur 画成站在磨坊里工作的一个人，记忆卡上突出“人”，避免把职业名称记成机器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of grinding or milling a material into smaller particles or powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将材料磨成较小颗粒或粉末的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih materjal jitħan f'partiċelli iżgħar jew fi trab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 研磨；碾磨；将材料磨碎或磨成粉的过程。

formal.mt: Waqt il-maċinatura, il-qamħ jinbidel fi dqiq.
formal.en: During milling, the grain is turned into flour.
formal.zh: 在碾磨过程中，谷物被磨成面粉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Id-dqiq lest? Pawlu: Għadu le; il-maċinatura għadha għaddejja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the flour ready? Pawlu: Not yet; the milling is still going on.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：面粉好了吗？保罗：还没有；还在碾磨呢。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 面粉好了吗？
messages.en: Is the flour ready?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (磨坊工人)
messages.zh: 还没有；还在碾磨呢。
messages.en: Not yet; the milling is still going on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一段“谷粒逐渐变成面粉”的小动画记 maċinatura，重点放在研磨过程，而不是工人或工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool used to grind colours or pigments when preparing paint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 调制绘画颜料时，用于研磨颜色材料或颜料的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex jitħnu l-kuluri jew il-pigmenti fit-tħejjija taż-żebgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颜料研磨器；用于研磨绘画颜料的研色工具。

collocations.en: grind the pigment with a muller

formal.mt: L-artista uża l-maċinell biex jitħan il-pigment fuq pjanċa tal-ħġieġ.
formal.en: The artist used the muller to grind the pigment on a glass plate.
formal.zh: 艺术家用研色器在玻璃板上研磨颜料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tgħaddili l-maċinell? Pawlu: Ħu, qiegħed ħdejn il-pigment aħmar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you pass me the muller? Pawlu: Here you are; it's beside the red pigment.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：能把研色器递给我吗？保罗：给你，就在红色颜料旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (画家)
messages.zh: 能把研色器递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the muller?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (画室助手)
messages.zh: 给你，就在红色颜料旁边。
messages.en: Here you are; it's beside the red pigment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象画家拿着 maċinell 在玻璃板上反复研磨红色颜料，把这个词和手里的研色工具配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A neighborhood: the local area around someone's home or another place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人住所或某个地点周围的邻里地区、街坊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żona ta' madwar id-dar ta' xi ħadd jew ta' madwar post ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 街坊；住所或某个地点周围的邻里地区。

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu jtejjeb id-dawl u l-indafa fil-maġar tal-iskola.
formal.en: The project should improve lighting and cleanliness in the neighborhood around the school.
formal.zh: 这个项目应改善学校周边街区的照明与清洁状况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm ħanut tal-merċa fil-maġar tagħkom? Mark: Iva, hemm wieħed żgħir ħdejn id-dar tagħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there a grocery shop in your neighborhood? Mark: Yes, there's a small one near our house.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你们这一带有杂货店吗？Mark：有，我们家附近就有一家小店。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们这一带有杂货店吗？
messages.en: Is there a grocery shop in your neighborhood?

messages.speaker: Mark (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm wieħed żgħir ħdejn id-dar tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm wieħed żgħir ħdejn id-dar tagħna.
messages.zh: 有，我们家附近就有一家小店。
messages.en: Yes, there's a small one near our house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maġar 写在一张住家周边小地图中央，旁边画商店、学校和邻居家，借熟悉的生活范围记住“街坊、邻里地区”。

gloss_zh: 大批聚集的人群；大型人群聚集

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large gathering of people assembled in one place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 许多人聚集在同一地点形成的大型人群。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġemgħa kbira ta' nies miġburin f'post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 许多人聚集形成的大群人；大型人群聚集。

collocations.en: a large gathering in the square

formal.mt: Qabel il-kunċert, maġbar ta' nies kien qed jistenna quddiem is-sala.
formal.en: Before the concert, a large gathering of people was waiting outside the hall.
formal.zh: 音乐会开始前，一大群人正在礼堂外等候。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara x'maġbar hemm fil-pjazza! Pawlu: Iva, kulħadd qed jistenna li jibda l-kunċert.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that crowd in the square! Pawlu: Yes, everyone's waiting for the concert to start.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看，广场上聚了好大一群人！Pawlu：是啊，大家都在等音乐会开始。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，广场上聚了好大一群人！
messages.en: Look at that crowd in the square!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kulħadd qed jistenna li jibda l-kunċert.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kulħadd qed jistenna li jibda l-kunċert.
messages.zh: 是啊，大家都在等音乐会开始。
messages.en: Yes, everyone's waiting for the concert to start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 maġbar 配上广场挤满人的画面，并在卡片上写“人很多”；与 maġbra 的“一大笔钱”并排辨认，注意词尾不同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large amount of money, especially when emphasizing how much something costs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一大笔钱，常用于强调某物价格或某项开支很高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma kbira ta' flus, speċjalment meta wieħed jenfasizza kemm tiswa xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 很多钱；一大笔钱。

collocations.en: to cost a lot of money
collocations.zh: 价格昂贵；要花一大笔钱

collocations.en: to spend a lot of money

formal.mt: It-tiswija tal-bini swiet maġbra, għalhekk il-kumitat irreveda l-baġit.
formal.en: Repairing the building cost a large amount of money, so the committee revised the budget.
formal.zh: 修缮这栋建筑花了一大笔钱，因此委员会调整了预算。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-karozza tiswa maġbra! David: Naf, għalhekk qed infittex waħda orħos.
colloquial.en: Nina: This car costs a fortune! David: I know, so I'm looking for a cheaper one.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这辆车可要花一大笔钱！David：我知道，所以我正在找一辆便宜些的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这辆车可要花一大笔钱！
messages.en: This car costs a fortune!

messages.speaker: David (购车者)
messages.mt_spoken: Naf, għalhekk qed infittex waħda orħos.
messages.mt_standard: Naf, għalhekk qed infittex waħda orħos.
messages.zh: 我知道，所以我正在找一辆便宜些的。
messages.en: I know, so I'm looking for a cheaper one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maġbra 写在一堆钞票旁，整句记住 tiswa maġbra“要花一大笔钱”；再与表示大群人的 maġbar 对照，避免看错词尾。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a vivid reddish-purple color.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈鲜艳的紫红色，即品红色或洋红色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu kulur qawwi bejn l-aħmar u l-vjola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 品红色的；洋红色的，呈鲜艳紫红色的。

formal.mt: Il-qoxra tal-fuljett għandha sfond maġenta u titlu abjad.
formal.en: The brochure cover has a magenta background and a white title.
formal.zh: 这本宣传册的封面采用品红色背景和白色标题。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Liema libsa se tilbes għall-festa? Rita: Dik maġenta; inħobb ħafna dak il-kulur.
colloquial.en: Emma: Which dress are you wearing to the party? Rita: The magenta one; I really like that color.
colloquial.zh: Emma：你准备穿哪条连衣裙去聚会？Rita：品红色的那条，我很喜欢那个颜色。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备穿哪条连衣裙去聚会？
messages.en: Which dress are you wearing to the party?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik maġenta; inħobb ħafna dak il-kulur.
messages.mt_standard: Dik maġenta; inħobb ħafna dak il-kulur.
messages.zh: 品红色的那条，我很喜欢那个颜色。
messages.en: The magenta one; I really like that color.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一块鲜艳的品红色色卡连接 maġenta 与英语 magenta，再配上 libsa maġenta“品红色连衣裙”，把颜色和实物一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spring of water, or the course or running of water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 泉或泉水涌出的地方；也可指水流的流路或流动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nixxiegħa, jew il-mogħdija jew il-ġiri tal-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 泉；泉水涌出的地方。
流路；流动，尤指水的流动。

collocations.en: a watercourse or flow of water

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi l-maġra tax-xmara mill-għoljiet sal-baħar.
formal.en: The map shows the course of the river from the hills to the sea.
formal.zh: 地图显示了河流从丘陵到大海的流路。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn jgħaddi l-ilma? Toni: Segwi l-maġra tal-ilma; twasslek sal-pont.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where does the water flow? Toni: Follow the watercourse; it will take you to the bridge.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：水从哪里流过？托尼：沿着水道走，就能到桥边。

messages.speaker: Sara (徒步者)
messages.zh: 水从哪里流过？
messages.en: Where does the water flow?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 沿着水道走，就能到桥边。
messages.en: Follow the watercourse; it will take you to the bridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一幅水景记住 maġra：先看到泉水涌出，再沿着水流的路线前进，分别对应“泉”和“流路、流动”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A majority that meets a specially specified voting threshold, such as two thirds, rather than an ordinary simple majority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 达到特别规定的表决门槛的多数，例如三分之二多数；具体要求取决于所采用的规则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maġġoranza li tilħaq limitu speċjali stabbilit mir-regoli, bħal żewġ terzi, minflok maġġoranza sempliċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 特定多数；超多数，即达到特别规定的票数或比例要求的多数。

collocations.zh: 获得达到特定门槛的多数支持

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-proposta teħtieġ maġġoranza kwalifikata ta' żewġ terzi tal-voti validi biex tiġi approvata.
formal.en: In this exercise, the proposal requires a qualified majority of two thirds of the valid votes to be approved.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，提案须获得有效票三分之二的特定多数才能通过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sitta minn għaxar voti huma biżżejjed? Mark: Le, għal dan l-eżerċizzju rridu maġġoranza kwalifikata ta' żewġ terzi, jiġifieri mill-inqas seba' voti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are six out of ten votes enough? Mark: No, for this exercise we need a qualified majority of two thirds, which means at least seven votes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：十票中有六票赞成，够了吗？Mark：不够，这道练习要求三分之二的特定多数，也就是至少七票。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Sitta minn għaxar voti huma biżżejjed?
messages.mt_standard: Sitta minn għaxar voti huma biżżejjed?
messages.zh: 十票中有六票赞成，够了吗？
messages.en: Are six out of ten votes enough?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għal dan l-eżerċizzju rridu maġġoranza kwalifikata ta' żewġ terzi, jiġifieri mill-inqas seba' voti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għal dan l-eżerċizzju rridu maġġoranza kwalifikata ta' żewġ terzi, jiġifieri mill-inqas seba' voti.
messages.zh: 不够，这道练习要求三分之二的特定多数，也就是至少七票。
messages.en: No, for this exercise we need a qualified majority of two thirds, which means at least seven votes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语记成“多数还要达到特别门槛”：画十张选票，在三分之二门槛的练习里圈出至少七张；具体门槛始终看题目规则。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A majority of more than half the votes counted for a decision, without a higher special threshold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在计入某项表决的票数中超过一半的多数，无须达到更高的特别门槛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maġġoranza ta' aktar minn nofs il-voti li jingħaddu għal deċiżjoni, mingħajr limitu speċjali ogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 简单多数；普通多数，即在计入表决的票数中超过一半。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-proposta ġiet approvata b'maġġoranza sempliċi: sitta mill-għaxar voti validi kienu favur.
formal.en: In this exercise, the proposal was approved by a simple majority: six of the ten valid votes were in favor.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，提案以简单多数通过：十张有效票中有六票赞成。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħamsa minn għaxar voti jagħmlu maġġoranza sempliċi? Toni: Le, ħamsa huma eżatt nofs; għandek bżonn mill-inqas sitta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do five out of ten votes make a simple majority? Toni: No, five is exactly half; you need at least six.
colloquial.zh: Lara：十票中有五票，算简单多数吗？Toni：不算，五票正好是一半；至少需要六票。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħamsa minn għaxar voti jagħmlu maġġoranza sempliċi?
messages.mt_standard: Ħamsa minn għaxar voti jagħmlu maġġoranza sempliċi?
messages.zh: 十票中有五票，算简单多数吗？
messages.en: Do five out of ten votes make a simple majority?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħamsa huma eżatt nofs; għandek bżonn mill-inqas sitta.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħamsa huma eżatt nofs; għandek bżonn mill-inqas sitta.
messages.zh: 不算，五票正好是一半；至少需要六票。
messages.en: No, five is exactly half; you need at least six.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“十票至少六票”记住 maġġoranza sempliċi：重点是超过一半，五票只是平分；再与需要特别门槛的 maġġoranza kwalifikata 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A senior household servant who manages domestic service, often supervising other staff and attending to guests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责管理宅邸日常服务的管家或总管，通常也监督其他雇员并接待客人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qaddej ewlieni li jieħu ħsieb is-servizz f'dar kbira, jissorvelja lill-qaddejja l-oħra u jilqa' lill-mistednin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 管家；总管，负责宅邸服务并可管理其他家务雇员的人。

formal.mt: Il-maġġordom laqa' lill-mistednin fid-daħla u mbagħad mexxiehom lejn il-kamra tal-ikel.
formal.en: The butler welcomed the guests at the entrance and then led them to the dining room.
formal.zh: 管家在入口处迎接宾客，随后带他们前往餐厅。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Lil min nagħti l-kowt? Pawlu: Agħtih lill-maġġordom; qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who should I give my coat to? Pawlu: Give it to the butler; he's by the door.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我该把外套交给谁？Pawlu：交给管家吧，他就在门边。

messages.speaker: Anna (宾客)
messages.zh: 我该把外套交给谁？
messages.en: Who should I give my coat to?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (主人)
messages.zh: 交给管家吧，他就在门边。
messages.en: Give it to the butler; he's by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位在宅邸门口迎客、安排餐桌并协调其他雇员的人，把这个角色整体贴上 maġġordom 标签，记住“管家、总管”。

gloss_zh: 成年的；达到法定成年年龄的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having reached the legal age of adulthood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经达到法定成年年龄的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li laħaq l-età legali biex jitqies adult.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已成年的；已达到法定成年年龄的。

collocations.zh: 达到法定成年年龄的人

formal.mt: Għal din l-attività, kull parteċipant irid ikun maġġorenni.
formal.en: For this activity, every participant must be of legal age.
formal.zh: 参加这项活动的每个人都必须已达到法定成年年龄。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ħuk jista' jiġi għal din l-attività? Pawlu: Iva, issa huwa maġġorenni.
colloquial.en: Marta: Can your brother come to this activity? Pawlu: Yes, he is of legal age now.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你哥哥能来参加这项活动吗？保罗：可以，他现在已经成年了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk jista' jiġi għal din l-attività?
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk jista' jiġi għal din l-attività?
messages.zh: 你哥哥能来参加这项活动吗？
messages.en: Can your brother come to this activity?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，他现在已经成年了。
messages.en: Yes, he is of legal age now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maġġorenni 和“成年资格”一起记：想象填写报名表时，年龄栏已经满足成年要求。

gloss_zh: 少校；主要的；占较大部分的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A military officer holding the rank of major.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 军衔为少校的军官。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċjal militari bil-grad ta' maġġur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 少校；具有少校军衔的军官。
主要的；较大部分的；占大部分的。

formal.mt: Il-maġġur ippreżenta rapport dwar it-taħriġ tas-suldati.
formal.en: The major presented a report on the soldiers' training.
formal.zh: 少校提交了一份关于士兵训练的报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jmexxi t-taħriġ għada? Mark: Il-maġġur se jmexxih.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who will lead the training tomorrow? Mark: The major will lead it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：明天谁来带训练？马克：少校来带。

messages.speaker: Lara (士兵)
messages.zh: 明天谁来带训练？
messages.en: Who will lead the training tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (同袍)
messages.zh: 少校来带。
messages.en: The major will lead it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“少校主持训练”的画面记住名词 maġġur；遇到形容词用法时，再联想到“主要、占较大部分”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Main or major in importance, size, or effect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在重要性、规模或影响方面属于主要或重大的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li huma ewlenin jew ta' importanza, daqs jew effett kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主要的；处于核心地位的。
重大的；规模大或影响显著的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika l-problemi maġġuri u jipproponi soluzzjonijiet għalihom.
formal.en: The report identifies the major problems and proposes solutions to them.
formal.zh: 报告指出了重大问题，并提出了解决办法。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għamiltu xi bidliet maġġuri fil-pjan? David: Iva, biddilna l-post u d-data.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you make any major changes to the plan? David: Yes, we changed the venue and the date.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你们对计划做了什么重大调整吗？戴维：是的，我们改了地点和日期。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你们对计划做了什么重大调整吗？
messages.en: Did you make any major changes to the plan?

messages.speaker: David (活动负责人)
messages.zh: 是的，我们改了地点和日期。
messages.en: Yes, we changed the venue and the date.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 problemi maġġuri 记成“需要优先处理的重大问题”，再把同一形容词迁移到“重大变化”等搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of fear in response to danger or something frightening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对危险或令人害怕的事物时产生的恐惧感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' biża' quddiem periklu jew xi ħaġa li tbeżża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恐惧；害怕的情绪。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi l-maħafi li ħass ir-raġel meta sema' l-ħoss fid-dlam.
formal.en: The narrative describes the fear the man felt when he heard the noise in the dark.
formal.zh: 这篇叙事描写了那名男子在黑暗中听到声响时的恐惧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħassejt maħafi meta smajt dak il-ħoss. Lara: Nifhmek. Ejja noqogħdu hawn flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: I felt fear when I heard that noise. Lara: I understand. Let's stay here together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：听到那个声音时，我感到害怕。拉拉：我理解。我们一起待在这里吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt maħafi meta smajt dak il-ħoss.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt maħafi meta smajt dak il-ħoss.
messages.zh: 听到那个声音时，我感到害怕。
messages.en: I felt fear when I heard that noise.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我理解。我们一起待在这里吧。
messages.en: I understand. Let's stay here together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进黑暗中听见声响的画面，记住它表示心里的恐惧感。

gloss_zh: 套在牲畜颈部、用于上轭的项圈

teaching_sense.en_definition: A collar fitted around an animal's neck so that the animal can be yoked for work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 套在牲畜颈部、使其能够上轭从事劳作的项圈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kullar li jitqiegħed ma' għonq annimal biex dan jintrabat mal-madmad għax-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给牲畜上轭时使用的颈圈。

collocations.en: a yoking collar for the ox
collocations.zh: 给耕牛使用的上轭颈圈

collocations.en: put the yoking collar on the animal

formal.mt: Qabel beda x-xogħol fl-għalqa, il-bidwi libbes il-maħanqa lill-barri biex jorbtu mal-madmad.
formal.en: Before starting work in the field, the farmer fitted the yoking collar onto the ox so that he could attach it to the yoke.
formal.zh: 开始田间劳作前，农夫给耕牛戴上颈圈，以便将它连接到轭具上。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Fejn hi l-maħanqa tal-barri? Ġanni: Ħdejn il-bieb. Ġibha biex inlibbsuhielu.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Where is the ox's yoking collar? Ġanni: By the door. Bring it so we can put it on him.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：耕牛的上轭颈圈在哪里？詹尼：在门边。拿过来，我们给它戴上。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农夫)
messages.zh: 耕牛的上轭颈圈在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the ox's yoking collar?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 在门边。拿过来，我们给它戴上。
messages.en: By the door. Bring it so we can put it on him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象耕牛准备下田，先在脖子上戴好连接轭具的颈圈，用这个动作记词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A facility or workshop where ropes are made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作绳索的工厂或作坊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew fabbrika fejn isiru l-ħbula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制造绳索的工厂或作坊。

collocations.en: to work at the rope-making facility

formal.mt: Fil-maħbel, il-ħaddiema jippreparaw il-ħbula skont it-tul mitlub.
formal.en: At the rope-making facility, the workers prepare ropes to the requested length.
formal.zh: 在制绳厂里，工人按照要求的长度制作绳索。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-bini x'inhu? Pawlu: Dan huwa maħbel; hawn jagħmlu l-ħbula.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this building? Pawlu: It's a rope-making facility; they make ropes here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这栋建筑是做什么的？保罗：这是制绳厂，这里制作绳索。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这栋建筑是做什么的？
messages.en: What is this building?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan huwa maħbel; hawn jagħmlu l-ħbula.
messages.mt_standard: Dan huwa maħbel; hawn jagħmlu l-ħbula.
messages.zh: 这是制绳厂，这里制作绳索。
messages.en: It's a rope-making facility; they make ropes here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maħbel 放进“工人在作坊里制作一卷卷绳索”的画面，记住它指制绳的场所。

gloss_zh: 受支配的；被殖民的；受统治的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Under the authority, control, or rule of another person or power.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于他人或某种权力的支配、控制或统治之下的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab taħt l-awtorità, il-kontroll jew it-tmexxija ta' persuna jew qawwa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被置于支配或控制之下的；受制于他者的。
被殖民的；处于殖民统治之下的。
受统治的；由某个人或政权治理的。

collocations.en: a country colonised by a colonial power
collocations.zh: 被殖民势力统治的国家

collocations.en: a territory ruled by a king

formal.mt: Fit-test tal-eżerċizzju, il-pajjiż huwa maħkum minn qawwa barranija u d-deċiżjonijiet politiċi jittieħdu barra minnu.
formal.en: In the exercise text, the country is ruled by a foreign power and political decisions are made outside it.
formal.zh: 在练习文本中，该国受外国势力统治，政治决策在境外作出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'din l-istorja, min imexxi l-pajjiż? Mark: Il-pajjiż hu maħkum minn re li jgħix fil-kapitali.
colloquial.en: Maja: In this story, who runs the country? Mark: The country is ruled by a king who lives in the capital.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个故事里，是谁治理国家？马克：这个国家由一位住在首都的国王统治。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里，是谁治理国家？
messages.en: In this story, who runs the country?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pajjiż hu maħkum minn re li jgħix fil-kapitali.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pajjiż hu maħkum minn re li jgħix fil-kapitali.
messages.zh: 这个国家由一位住在首都的国王统治。
messages.en: The country is ruled by a king who lives in the capital.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出国家上方的一顶王冠，记住它处于统治之下，再区分受支配与被殖民的具体语境。

gloss_zh: 经耕作并每年出产作物的田地

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ploughed field that produces crops each year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过翻耕、每年都出产农作物的田地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għalqa li tinħarat u tipproduċi għelejjel kull sena.

sense_translations.en_definition: a field which is ploughed and produces yearly crops
sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过耕作、每年出产农作物的田地。

collocations.en: the ploughing of the annually productive field
collocations.zh: 对这块每年产粮的田地进行翻耕

collocations.en: the crops of the annually productive field
collocations.zh: 这块每年出产作物的田地所产的庄稼

formal.mt: Il-bidwi jieħu ħsieb il-maħkuma billi jaħratha u jiżragħha, sabiex tipproduċi għelejjel kull sena.
formal.en: The farmer tends the annually productive field by ploughing and sowing it so that it produces crops each year.
formal.zh: 农夫通过翻耕和播种照料这块田地，使它每年都能出产农作物。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: X'se niżirgħu fil-maħkuma din is-sena? Marija: Qamħ. L-ewwel irridu naħartuha.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: What shall we sow in the field this year? Marija: Wheat. First we need to plough it.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：今年我们在这块常年耕作的田里种什么？玛丽亚：小麦。我们得先翻耕。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农夫)
messages.zh: 今年我们在这块常年耕作的田里种什么？
messages.en: What shall we sow in the field this year?

messages.speaker: Marija (农场合伙人)
messages.zh: 小麦。我们得先翻耕。
messages.en: Wheat. First we need to plough it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把翻土、播种、年年收成连成一幅田园画面；本词条要作为田地名词整体记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where animals are milked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给奶牛、山羊等动物挤奶的场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn isir il-ħlib tal-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行挤奶的地方；挤奶场所。

collocations.en: the place where cows are milked
the cleaning of the milking area

formal.mt: Wara kull sessjoni ta' ħlib, il-ħaddiema jnaddfu l-maħleb u t-tagħmir kollu li ntuża.
formal.en: After each milking session, the workers clean the milking area and all the equipment that was used.
formal.zh: 每次挤奶结束后，工作人员都会清洁挤奶场所及所有用过的设备。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn se nieħdu l-baqar għall-ħlib? Ġanni: Fil-maħleb, ħdejn l-istalla. Kollox lest hemm.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where shall we take the cows for milking? Ġanni: To the milking area, beside the cowshed. Everything is ready there.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们把奶牛带到哪里挤奶？詹尼：带到牛舍旁边的挤奶处。那里都准备好了。

messages.speaker: Anna (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 我们把奶牛带到哪里挤奶？
messages.en: Where shall we take the cows for milking?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (奶农)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-maħleb, ħdejn l-istalla. Kollox lest hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-maħleb, ħdejn l-istalla. Kollox lest hemm.
messages.zh: 带到牛舍旁边的挤奶处。那里都准备好了。
messages.en: To the milking area, beside the cowshed. Everything is ready there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把奶牛领到固定区域准备挤奶，记住这个词指挤奶发生的场所。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A machine used for carding cotton, or the place where cotton is carded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于梳理棉纤维的机器，也指进行梳棉工作的场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magna għat-tqardix tal-qoton, jew il-post fejn isir dan ix-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳棉机；用于梳理棉纤维的机器。

sense_translations.en_definition: the place where cotton is carded
sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳棉场所；进行棉纤维梳理工作的地方。

collocations.en: works at the cotton carding premises

formal.mt: Il-manwal jispjega kif jintuża l-maħleġ għat-tqardix tal-qoton.
formal.en: The manual explains how the carding machine is used to card cotton.
formal.zh: 手册说明了如何使用梳棉机梳理棉纤维。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik il-magna? | Pawlu: Dak maħleġ; jintuża għat-tqardix tal-qoton.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that machine? | Pawlu: That is a cotton carding machine; it is used to card cotton.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是什么机器？ | 保罗：那是梳棉机，用来梳理棉纤维。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 那是什么机器？
messages.en: What is that machine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (讲解员)
messages.zh: 那是梳棉机，用来梳理棉纤维。
messages.en: That is a cotton carding machine; it is used to card cotton.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把棉纤维被梳理的画面与 maħleġ 联系起来：既记梳棉机器，也记进行这项工作的场所。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not firmly fastened or stretched tight; also thin and flowing in consistency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有系牢或绷紧的；也可形容质地稀、容易流动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhux marbut jew miġbud sew; għal taħlita, li għandha konsistenza rqiqa u tiċċirkola faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松的；没有固定牢或系紧的。
松弛的；没有拉紧或绷紧的。
稀的；质地不稠、容易流动的。

formal.mt: Qabel tibda x-xogħol, iċċekkja li l-ħabel ma jkunx maħlul.
formal.en: Before starting work, check that the rope is not slack.
formal.zh: 开始工作前，请检查绳子是否绷紧。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan iċ-ċinturin maħlul wisq. | Mark: Issikkah ftit biex ma jiżloqx.
colloquial.en: Lara: This belt is too loose. | Mark: Tighten it a little so it does not slip.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这条腰带太松了。 | 马克：收紧一点，免得它滑下来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这条腰带太松了。
messages.en: This belt is too loose.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 收紧一点，免得它滑下来。
messages.en: Tighten it a little so it does not slip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记 maħlul：腰带松、绳子垂、面糊稀；分别对应松动、松弛和稀流的质地。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say something in a low, indistinct voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用低而含糊的声音说话，让人不容易听清。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkellem b'leħen baxx u bi kliem li ma jinstemax ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘟囔；低声含糊地说话。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, Pawlu maħmaħ xi kliem li ħadd ma fehem.
formal.en: During the meeting, Pawlu muttered a few words that nobody understood.
formal.zh: 开会时，保罗低声嘟囔了几句话，谁也没听懂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qal Pawlu? | Lara: Ma nafx; maħmaħ xi ħaġa u telaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu say? | Lara: I do not know; he muttered something and left.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗说了什么？ | 劳拉：不知道，他嘟囔了一句就走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗说了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu say?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; maħmaħ xi ħaġa u telaq.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; maħmaħ xi ħaġa u telaq.
messages.zh: 不知道，他嘟囔了一句就走了。
messages.en: I do not know; he muttered something and left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 maħmaħ 时想象嘴里低低念着、旁人听不清；把它记作“嘟囔”这个说话动作。

gloss_zh: 嘟囔的人；说话带鼻音的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who mutters or speaks with a nasal voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 低声含糊说话的人，或说话带鼻音的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem b'leħen baxx u mhux ċar, jew b'leħen nażali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘟囔的人；说话声音低而含糊的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who talks through their nose
sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话带鼻音的人。

collocations.en: a mutterer who talks to himself
a person who speaks with a nasal voice

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-maħmieħ jitkellem tant baxx li l-karattri l-oħra ma jifhmuhx.
formal.en: In the story, the mutterer speaks so quietly that the other characters cannot understand him.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个嘟囔的人说话声音太低，其他人物听不懂他说什么。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu maħmieħ? | Maja: Persuna li titkellem baxx u mhux ċar; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll persuna li titkellem b'leħen nażali.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is a maħmieħ? | Maja: A person who speaks quietly and indistinctly; the word can also mean someone who speaks with a nasal voice.
colloquial.zh: 马克：maħmieħ 指什么样的人？ | 玛雅：低声含糊说话的人；这个词也可以指说话带鼻音的人。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: maħmieħ 指什么样的人？
messages.en: What is a maħmieħ?

messages.speaker: Maja (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna li titkellem baxx u mhux ċar; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll persuna li titkellem b'leħen nażali.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna li titkellem baxx u mhux ċar; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll persuna li titkellem b'leħen nażali.
messages.zh: 低声含糊说话的人；这个词也可以指说话带鼻音的人。
messages.en: A person who speaks quietly and indistinctly; the word can also mean someone who speaks with a nasal voice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 maħmieħ 配一张人物卡：一面是低声嘟囔者，一面是鼻音说话者；它是指人的名词。

gloss_zh: 说话嘟嘟囔囔的；说话带鼻音的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who mutters or speaks with a nasal voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人说话低而含糊，或说话带鼻音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem b'leħen baxx u mhux ċar, jew b'leħen nażali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容人说话嘟嘟囔囔、低而含糊的。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who talks through their nose
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容人说话带鼻音的。

collocations.en: a man who mutters or speaks nasally
collocations.zh: 说话嘟囔或带鼻音的男子

collocations.en: a character who mutters or speaks nasally
collocations.zh: 说话嘟囔或带鼻音的人物

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lir-raġel bħala maħmieħi: jitkellem baxx u l-kliem tiegħu mhux dejjem ċar.
formal.en: The author describes the man as muttering: he speaks quietly, and his words are not always clear.
formal.zh: 作者把这个男子描写成说话嘟嘟囔囔的人：他声音很低，话语也不总是清楚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif jitkellem il-karattru tiegħek? | Pawlu: Hu maħmieħi; jgħid il-kliem baxx u mhux ċar.
colloquial.en: Lara: How does your character speak? | Pawlu: He mutters; he says his words quietly and indistinctly.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你演的人物怎么说话？ | 保罗：他说话嘟嘟囔囔的，声音低，吐字也不清楚。

messages.speaker: Lara (导演)
messages.zh: 你演的人物怎么说话？
messages.en: How does your character speak?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu maħmieħi; jgħid il-kliem baxx u mhux ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Hu maħmieħi; jgħid il-kliem baxx u mhux ċar.
messages.zh: 他说话嘟嘟囔囔的，声音低，吐字也不清楚。
messages.en: He mutters; he says his words quietly and indistinctly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maħmieħi 放在人物旁作描述标签，记成“这个人说话嘟囔或带鼻音的”，突出形容词用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object or item that goes around the neck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围在或套在颈部周围的物件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett jew ħaġa li ddur mal-għonq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 任何环绕颈部的东西；围住或套住脖子的物件。

collocations.en: a leather item worn around the neck
a tight item around the neck

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-kostum tinkludi maħnaq tal-ġilda li jintlibes madwar l-għonq.
formal.en: The costume description includes a leather item worn around the neck.
formal.zh: 服装说明中包括一件围在颈部的皮制物件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-maħnaq issikkat wisq? | Lara: Iva, ħollu ftit biex tkun komda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this neckpiece too tight? | Lara: Yes, loosen it a little so you are comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个颈圈是不是太紧了？ | 劳拉：是的，松开一点，戴着才舒服。

messages.speaker: Maja (演员)
messages.zh: 这个颈圈是不是太紧了？
messages.en: Is this neckpiece too tight?

messages.speaker: Lara (服装师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħollu ftit biex tkun komda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħollu ftit biex tkun komda.
messages.zh: 是的，松开一点，戴着才舒服。
messages.en: Yes, loosen it a little so you are comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象沿脖子画一个圈，把圈住颈部的物件都放进 maħnaq 这张记忆图，牢记其含义范围较广。

gloss_zh: 店铺密集的区域；商店区

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area containing many shops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 商店很多、店铺集中的一片区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona mimlija ħwienet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 店铺密集的区域；有许多商店的地方。

collocations.en: a shopping area in the centre

formal.mt: Il-pjan juri maħnat qrib l-istazzjon, b'ħafna ħwienet tul it-toroq.
formal.en: The plan shows a shopping area near the station, with many shops along the streets.
formal.zh: 规划图显示车站附近有一片商店区，街道两旁分布着许多店铺。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn nistgħu nsibu diversi ħwienet qrib xulxin? | Maja: Hemm maħnat ħdejn il-pjazza; ejja mmorru hemm.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where can we find several shops close together? | Maja: There is a shopping area beside the square; let us go there.
colloquial.zh: 马克：哪里有好几家挨得很近的商店？ | 玛雅：广场旁边有一片商店区，我们去那里吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nistgħu nsibu diversi ħwienet qrib xulxin?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nistgħu nsibu diversi ħwienet qrib xulxin?
messages.zh: 哪里有好几家挨得很近的商店？
messages.en: Where can we find several shops close together?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm maħnat ħdejn il-pjazza; ejja mmorru hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm maħnat ħdejn il-pjazza; ejja mmorru hemm.
messages.zh: 广场旁边有一片商店区，我们去那里吧。
messages.en: There is a shopping area beside the square; let us go there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在心里画一张布满商店招牌的街区地图，并标上 maħnat；用整片店铺集中的区域来记这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small scarf or cloth worn around the neck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围在或系在颈部的一块小方巾或小围巾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maktur jew xalpa żgħira li tintlibes madwar l-għonq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 领巾；围在或系在脖子上的小巾。

collocations.en: tie a neckerchief around the neck

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti jintalbu jilbsu qmis bajda u maħnoqa blu madwar l-għonq.
formal.en: Participants are asked to wear a white shirt and a blue neckerchief around the neck.
formal.zh: 参与者需穿白衬衫，并在颈部系一条蓝色领巾。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif tidher din il-maħnoqa mal-qmis tiegħi? | Maja: Tidher sabiħa ħafna; orbotha ftit aktar laxka.
colloquial.en: Lara: How does this neckerchief look with my shirt? | Maja: It looks lovely; tie it a little more loosely.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这条领巾配我的衬衫怎么样？ | 玛雅：很好看，系得再松一点吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tidher din il-maħnoqa mal-qmis tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tidher din il-maħnoqa mal-qmis tiegħi?
messages.zh: 这条领巾配我的衬衫怎么样？
messages.en: How does this neckerchief look with my shirt?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tidher sabiħa ħafna; orbotha ftit aktar laxka.
messages.mt_standard: Tidher sabiħa ħafna; orbotha ftit aktar laxka.
messages.zh: 很好看，系得再松一点吧。
messages.en: It looks lovely; tie it a little more loosely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一块小方巾折好、绕颈并打结，再给它贴上 maħnoqa 的标签，记住这是具体的领巾。

gloss_zh: 声音嘶哑的；被扼住喉咙的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a rough, weak voice; also describing someone whose throat has been squeezed or constricted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容声音沙哑、发声不清；也可形容喉咙被掐住或勒住的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu leħen aħrax jew dgħajjef; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li għonqu ġie magħfus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 声音嘶哑的；嗓音沙哑的。
被掐住或勒住喉咙的；被扼喉的。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem kompla jaqra d-diskors b'leħen maħnuq.
formal.en: The speaker continued reading the speech in a hoarse voice.
formal.zh: 发言人继续用嘶哑的嗓音宣读演讲稿。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex leħnek maħnuq illum? Mark: Ilbieraħ kantajt ħafna fil-kunċert.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is your voice hoarse today? Mark: I sang a lot at the concert yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今天的声音怎么这么哑？Mark：昨天我在音乐会上唱了很久。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天的声音怎么这么哑？
messages.en: Why is your voice hoarse today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天我在音乐会上唱了很久。
messages.en: I sang a lot at the concert yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maħnuq 和“唱完演唱会嗓子哑了”的画面一起记；看到 leħen maħnuq，就想到嘶哑的声音。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A latrine: a place provided for people to relieve themselves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人排泄使用的厕所或茅厕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn in-nies jagħmlu l-bżonnijiet tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厕所；茅厕；供人排泄使用的设施。

formal.mt: Il-maħra għandha titnaddaf kuljum u jkollha l-ilma għall-ħasil tal-idejn.
formal.en: The latrine should be cleaned daily and have water for washing hands.
formal.zh: 厕所应每天清洁，并提供洗手用水。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn hi l-maħra? Pawlu: Wara l-bini, ħdejn il-bieb blu.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where is the latrine? Pawlu: Behind the building, next to the blue door.
colloquial.zh: Lina：厕所在哪里？Pawlu：在楼后面，蓝色门旁边。

messages.speaker: Lina (访客)
messages.zh: 厕所在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the latrine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工作人员)
messages.zh: 在楼后面，蓝色门旁边。
messages.en: Behind the building, next to the blue door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象问路时寻找厕所标志，把 maħra 放进“厕所在哪里”这个完整情境中记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where washing is done, including a laundromat where people wash their clothes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行洗涤的场所，也指人们使用洗衣设备清洗衣物的洗衣店。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn isir il-ħasil, inkluż post b'magni fejn in-nies jaħslu l-ħwejjeġ tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洗涤场所；进行清洗工作的地方。
自助洗衣店；提供洗衣设备供顾客清洗衣物的场所。

formal.mt: Il-maħsel għandu sitt magni tal-ħasil għall-użu tal-klijenti.
formal.en: The laundromat has six washing machines for customers to use.
formal.zh: 这家自助洗衣店有六台供顾客使用的洗衣机。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Se tieħu l-ħwejjeġ fil-maħsel illum? David: Iva, għax il-magna tagħna mhix taħdem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you taking the clothes to the laundromat today? David: Yes, because our machine isn't working.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你今天要把衣服拿去自助洗衣店吗？David：是的，因为我们家的洗衣机坏了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你今天要把衣服拿去自助洗衣店吗？
messages.en: Are you taking the clothes to the laundromat today?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax il-magna tagħna mhix taħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax il-magna tagħna mhix taħdem.
messages.zh: 是的，因为我们家的洗衣机坏了。
messages.en: Yes, because our machine isn't working.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maħsel 想成装着一排洗衣机的地方：重点记“洗涤的场所”，再联系自助洗衣店。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wood, or a stock of timber kept for use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一片树林，也可指储备起来供使用的一批木料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post bis-siġar, jew ġabra ta' injam miżmum għall-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一片树林。
一批储备木料；木材储备。

collocations.en: a stock of timber for construction

formal.mt: Il-maħtab għall-kostruzzjoni tqiegħed taħt saqaf biex jibqa' niexef.
formal.en: The stock of timber for construction was placed under a roof to keep it dry.
formal.zh: 建筑用的储备木料被放在有顶棚的地方，以保持干燥。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Hemm biżżejjed injam fil-maħtab biex nagħmlu mejda? Toni: Iva, hemm biżżejjed għal mejda żgħira.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is there enough wood in the timber stock to make a table? Toni: Yes, there's enough for a small table.
colloquial.zh: Rita：储备的木料够做一张桌子吗？Toni：够，做一张小桌子没问题。

messages.speaker: Rita (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm biżżejjed injam fil-maħtab biex nagħmlu mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm biżżejjed injam fil-maħtab biex nagħmlu mejda?
messages.zh: 储备的木料够做一张桌子吗？
messages.en: Is there enough wood in the timber stock to make a table?

messages.speaker: Toni (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm biżżejjed għal mejda żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm biżżejjed għal mejda żgħira.
messages.zh: 够，做一张小桌子没问题。
messages.en: Yes, there's enough for a small table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张画面记 maħtab：一张是成片的树，一张是备用木料；结合句子判断是哪一个意思。

gloss_zh: 香料储存容器；药品储存空间

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vessel used to store spices, or a space used to store medicinal substances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于储存香料的容器，也可指存放药品或药用物质的空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent fejn jinżammu l-ħwawar, jew spazju fejn jinżammu sustanzi mediċinali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储存香料用的容器。
存放药品或药用物质的空间。

formal.mt: Il-maħwar tal-ħwawar għandu jinżamm magħluq biex il-kontenut jibqa' niexef.
formal.en: The spice-storage vessel should be kept closed so that its contents remain dry.
formal.zh: 香料储存容器应保持关闭，以使里面的香料保持干燥。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn inpoġġi l-kannella? Marija: Poġġiha fil-maħwar u agħlaq l-għatu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where should I put the cinnamon? Marija: Put it in the spice container and close the lid.
colloquial.zh: Nina：肉桂放在哪里？Marija：放进香料容器里，再盖好盖子。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 肉桂放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the cinnamon?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 放进香料容器里，再盖好盖子。
messages.en: Put it in the spice container and close the lid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 maħwar 时想两个储存画面：厨房里装香料的容器，以及存放药品的空间；靠内容物区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A heap of stones, or a place where there are many stones.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聚集成堆的石头，也可指有很多石头的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Munzell ġebel, jew post fejn hemm ħafna ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 堆积在一起的一堆石头。

sense_translations.en_definition: a place with a lot of stones
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有很多石头的地方；多石地。

collocations.en: walk carefully in the stony area
collocations.zh: 在多石的地方小心行走

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema għandhom ineħħu l-maħġar minn quddiem id-daħla qabel jibda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The workers should remove the heap of stones from in front of the entrance before work begins.
formal.zh: 工人应在开工前清除入口前的石堆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ngħaddu minn hawn? Pawlu: Aħjar le; dan maħġar u huwa diffiċli timxi fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go through here? Pawlu: Better not; this is a stony area, and it's difficult to walk through.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们从这里过去吗？保罗：最好别，这里满是石头，很难走。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 我们从这里过去吗？
messages.en: Shall we go through here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar le; dan maħġar u huwa diffiċli timxi fih.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar le; dan maħġar u huwa diffiċli timxi fih.
messages.zh: 最好别，这里满是石头，很难走。
messages.en: Better not; this is a stony area, and it's difficult to walk through.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个石头画面记 maħġar：石头堆在一起是“石堆”，石头铺满一片地方是“多石地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To blow one's nose forcefully in order to clear mucus from it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力从鼻腔呼气，将鼻涕擤出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jonfoħ imnieħru bil-qawwa biex ineħħi l-mukus minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使劲擤鼻子；用力擤出鼻涕。

collocations.en: he blew his nose vigorously into a handkerchief
collocations.zh: 他用手帕使劲擤了鼻子

formal.mt: Qabel kompla jaqra, l-istudent ħareġ maktur u maħħat imnieħru.
formal.en: Before continuing to read, the student took out a handkerchief and blew his nose vigorously.
formal.zh: 继续阅读之前，那名学生拿出手帕，使劲擤了擤鼻子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark maħħat imnieħru daqshekk bil-qawwa? Lara: Għax kellu mnieħru misdud. Tajtu maktur.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark blow his nose so forcefully? Lara: Because his nose was blocked. I gave him a handkerchief.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么那么用力地擤鼻子？拉拉：因为他鼻子堵了。我给了他一块手帕。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark maħħat imnieħru daqshekk bil-qawwa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark maħħat imnieħru daqshekk bil-qawwa?
messages.zh: 马克为什么那么用力地擤鼻子？
messages.en: Why did Mark blow his nose so forcefully?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kellu mnieħru misdud. Tajtu maktur.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kellu mnieħru misdud. Tajtu maktur.
messages.zh: 因为他鼻子堵了。我给了他一块手帕。
messages.en: Because his nose was blocked. I gave him a handkerchief.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用拿出手帕、用力擤鼻子的连续动作记忆，重点记住这是一个动作动词。

gloss_zh: 容易流鼻涕的；常挂着鼻涕的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to have a runny nose or visible mucus around the nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容容易流鼻涕，或鼻子周围经常挂着鼻涕的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jkollu mnieħru jqattar jew mukus madwar imnieħru.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to have a snotty nose
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易流鼻涕的；鼻子常挂着鼻涕的。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to have a snotty nose
