formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel maħħati jġorr maktur fil-but biex ikun jista' jimsaħ imnieħru.
formal.en: In the story, the boy who tends to have a snotty nose carries a handkerchief in his pocket so that he can wipe his nose.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个常流鼻涕的男孩在口袋里带着手帕，方便擦鼻子。

colloquial.mt: Anna: It-tifel illum ukoll maħħati? Rita: Iva, għadu jqattar minn imnieħru. Għandu maktur fil-but.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does the boy have a snotty nose again today? Rita: Yes, his nose is still running. He has a handkerchief in his pocket.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：孩子今天也挂着鼻涕吗？丽塔：是啊，鼻子还在流鼻涕。他口袋里有手帕。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子今天也挂着鼻涕吗？
messages.en: Does the boy have a snotty nose again today?

messages.speaker: Rita (祖母)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu jqattar minn imnieħru. Għandu maktur fil-but.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu jqattar minn imnieħru. Għandu maktur fil-but.
messages.zh: 是啊，鼻子还在流鼻涕。他口袋里有手帕。
messages.en: Yes, his nose is still running. He has a handkerchief in his pocket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象口袋常备手帕的小男孩，用常流鼻涕的外观记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Empty, with nothing present inside or within the space described.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容内部没有东西、没有内容或空无一物的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vojt, mingħajr xejn ġewwa jew fl-ispazju msemmi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空的；空无一物的。

formal.mt: Id-disinn juri spazju maħħuħ fiċ-ċentru, mingħajr għamara jew oġġetti oħra.
formal.en: The design shows an empty space in the centre, without furniture or other objects.
formal.zh: 设计图显示中央留有一处空白空间，里面没有家具或其他物品。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex dan l-ispazju għadu maħħuħ? Lara: Għadna ma poġġejna xejn fih. Il-mejda tasal għada.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is this space still empty? Lara: We haven't put anything in it yet. The table arrives tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这块地方怎么还空着？拉拉：我们还没往里面放东西。桌子明天送到。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 这块地方怎么还空着？
messages.en: Why is this space still empty?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna ma poġġejna xejn fih. Il-mejda tasal għada.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna ma poġġejna xejn fih. Il-mejda tasal għada.
messages.zh: 我们还没往里面放东西。桌子明天送到。
messages.en: We haven't put anything in it yet. The table arrives tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一个什么都没有放的空间，把空无一物的画面与这个形容词相连。

gloss_zh: 储藏处；食品等物品的储藏空间

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where food or other supplies are kept until they are needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 存放食品或其他物资、留待需要时取用的储藏场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jinżammu l-ikel jew provvisti oħra sakemm ikun hemm bżonnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储藏场所；存放食品等物品的地方。

collocations.en: the door of the storage room

formal.mt: Il-maħżna tal-ikel għandha tkun nadifa, niexfa u organizzata tajjeb.
formal.en: The food-storage place should be clean, dry and well organized.
formal.zh: 食品储藏处应保持清洁、干燥，并将物品整理妥当。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandna biżżejjed ross fil-maħżna? Ġużeppi: Iva, hemm żewġ pakketti fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do we have enough rice in the storage room? Ġużeppi: Yes, there are two packets on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: Anna：储藏室里的米够吗？Ġużeppi：够，架子上还有两包。

messages.speaker: Anna (妻子)
messages.zh: 储藏室里的米够吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough rice in the storage room?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm żewġ pakketti fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm żewġ pakketti fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 够，架子上还有两包。
messages.en: Yes, there are two packets on the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maħżna 想成家里放米、面和罐头的储藏空间；记住它回答的是“东西存在哪里”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person responsible for receiving, keeping and issuing goods in a storeroom or warehouse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责接收、保管和发放仓库或储藏室内物品的人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna responsabbli biex tirċievi, iżżomm u tqassam l-oġġetti f'maħżen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仓库管理员；负责保管和收发库存物品的人。

formal.mt: Il-maħżnier jiċċekkja l-kunsinna u jirreġistra l-kwantità ta' kull oġġett.
formal.en: The storekeeper checks the delivery and records the quantity of each item.
formal.zh: 仓库管理员检查送来的货物，并记录每种物品的数量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min jista' jagħtini kaxxa oħra ta' karti? Mario: Staqsi lill-maħżnier; hu jaf fejn qegħdin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who can give me another box of paper? Mario: Ask the storekeeper; he knows where they are.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁能再给我一箱纸？Mario：问问仓库管理员，他知道放在哪里。

messages.speaker: Lara (员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jagħtini kaxxa oħra ta' karti?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jagħtini kaxxa oħra ta' karti?
messages.zh: 谁能再给我一箱纸？
messages.en: Who can give me another box of paper?

messages.speaker: Mario (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lill-maħżnier; hu jaf fejn qegħdin.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lill-maħżnier; hu jaf fejn qegħdin.
messages.zh: 问问仓库管理员，他知道放在哪里。
messages.en: Ask the storekeeper; he knows where they are.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位拿着清单清点货物的库管员来记 maħżnier；它指负责保管物品的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun referring to someone very wicked, or to evil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示极其邪恶的人，或表示邪恶的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li jirreferi għal persuna ħażina ħafna jew għall-ħażen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极其邪恶的人；大恶人。
邪恶；恶。

collocations.en: the wicked character in the fairy tale

formal.mt: Fil-ħrafa, il-maħżnu jqarraq bin-nies biex jieħu l-flus tagħhom.
formal.en: In the fairy tale, the wicked character deceives people to take their money.
formal.zh: 在这则童话中，恶人欺骗人们以夺取他们的钱财。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Min hu l-maħżnu f'din il-ħrafa? Ben: Ir-raġel li jisraq il-flus u jhedded lin-nies.
colloquial.en: Elena: Who is the wicked character in this fairy tale? Ben: The man who steals money and threatens people.
colloquial.zh: Elena：这则童话里的恶人是谁？Ben：就是那个偷钱并威胁别人的男人。

messages.speaker: Elena (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这则童话里的恶人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the wicked character in this fairy tale?

messages.speaker: Ben (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-raġel li jisraq il-flus u jhedded lin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-raġel li jisraq il-flus u jhedded lin-nies.
messages.zh: 就是那个偷钱并威胁别人的男人。
messages.en: The man who steals money and threatens people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maħżnu 放进童话人物卡片来记：卡片上写“极恶之人”；本条按名词学习，联系恶人与邪恶两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To weary or irritate someone, or to oppress people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人疲倦、厌烦或恼怒；也可指压迫他人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss għeja jew dwejjaq, jdejqu, jew jaħqar lin-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使疲倦；使感到疲惫或厌倦。
惹恼；使烦躁或不快。
压迫；使人受到欺压。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem mażaġ lill-udjenza b'diskors twil u ripetittiv.
formal.en: The speaker wearied the audience with a long and repetitive speech.
formal.zh: 发言者冗长而重复的讲话使听众感到疲倦。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Pawlu mażaġ lil kulħadd bl-istess mistoqsija. Mark: Iva, staqsieha ħafna drabi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Pawlu irritated everyone with the same question. Mark: Yes, he asked it so many times.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：保罗反复问同一个问题，把大家都惹烦了。马克：是啊，他问了好多遍。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu mażaġ lil kulħadd bl-istess mistoqsija.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu mażaġ lil kulħadd bl-istess mistoqsija.
messages.zh: 保罗反复问同一个问题，把大家都惹烦了。
messages.en: Pawlu irritated everyone with the same question.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他问了好多遍。
messages.en: Yes, he asked it so many times.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“听累了、听烦了、受欺压”三个场景记住 mażaġ 的三个义项，再根据句子判断具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To damage something or use it clumsily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物弄坏，或笨手笨脚地使用某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħsara lil xi ħaġa jew jużaha b'mod goff u mingħajr ħila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 损坏；把某物弄坏。
笨拙地使用；笨手笨脚地操作。

formal.mt: L-utent mażlaġ l-apparat waqt l-użu u kisser waħda mill-partijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The user damaged the equipment during use and broke one of its parts.
formal.zh: 使用者在操作过程中损坏了设备，弄断了其中一个部件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min mażlaġ din il-kaxxa? L-għatu miksur. Toni: Jien. Għalaqtha bis-saħħa wisq.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who damaged this box? The lid is broken. Toni: I did. I shut it too hard.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁把这个盒子弄坏了？盖子都坏了。托尼：是我。我关得太用力了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min mażlaġ din il-kaxxa? L-għatu miksur.
messages.mt_standard: Min mażlaġ din il-kaxxa? L-għatu miksur.
messages.zh: 谁把这个盒子弄坏了？盖子都坏了。
messages.en: Who damaged this box? The lid is broken.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 是我。我关得太用力了。
messages.en: I did. I shut it too hard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人笨手笨脚操作工具，随后把东西弄坏；这幅画面同时串起 mażlaġ 的“笨拙使用”和“损坏”。

gloss_zh: 共济会；共济会制度及活动

teaching_sense.en_definition: Freemasonry: the movement, organization, and practices of Freemasons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 共济会，以及与其组织、制度和活动有关的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment, l-organizzazzjoni u l-prattiki tal-mażuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共济会；共济会的组织制度与活动。

collocations.zh: 一项关于共济会的研究

formal.mt: L-awtriċi ppreżentat studju dwar il-mażunerija u spjegat it-termini ewlenin użati fir-riċerka tagħha.
formal.en: The author presented a study of Freemasonry and explained the main terms used in her research.
formal.zh: 作者介绍了一项关于共济会的研究，并解释了研究中使用的主要术语。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dwar xiex inhu dan il-ktieb? Lara: Dwar il-mażunerija. Fil-bidu jispjega xi jfisser it-terminu.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is this book about? Lara: Freemasonry. It explains what the term means at the beginning.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这本书讲什么？拉拉：讲共济会。开头解释了这个词的意思。

messages.speaker: Mark (读者)
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is this book about?

messages.speaker: Lara (图书管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar il-mażunerija. Fil-bidu jispjega xi jfisser it-terminu.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar il-mażunerija. Fil-bidu jispjega xi jfisser it-terminu.
messages.zh: 讲共济会。开头解释了这个词的意思。
messages.en: Freemasonry. It explains what the term means at the beginning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mażunerija 放进“共济会历史”和“共济会研究”两张书目卡片中，通过固定话题搭配记住这个抽象名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: After an earlier action or event; next in a sequence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示在前一个动作或事件之后，即然后、接着。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wara azzjoni jew ġrajja oħra; biex tindika dak li jmiss f'sekwenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 然后；在那之后

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jaqraw it-test u mbagħad iwieġbu l-mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: The students should read the text and then answer the questions.
formal.zh: 学生应先阅读课文，然后回答问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-ewwel nieħdu kafè? Ben: Iva, u mbagħad immorru nimxu. Lara: Tajjeb, niltaqgħu hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we have a coffee first? Ben: Yes, and then we'll go for a walk. Lara: Good, let's meet here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们先喝杯咖啡吗？本：好，然后去散步。拉拉：好，那就在这里碰面。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们先喝杯咖啡吗？
messages.en: Shall we have a coffee first?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，然后去散步。
messages.en: Yes, and then we'll go for a walk.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，那就在这里碰面。
messages.en: Good, let's meet here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mbagħad 写在时间箭头的第二步：先做一件事，箭头指过去就是然后做下一件事。

gloss_zh: 用于尊崇上帝的“当受赞颂的”

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form used reverently of God, expressing that God is blessed or worthy of praise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于尊崇上帝的表达，表示上帝当受赞颂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma użata b'qima għal Alla, biex tesprimi li jistħoqqlu t-tifħir.

sense_translations.en_definition: Used as a venerating attribute of God.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用作表达对上帝尊崇的称语，意为当受赞颂的

formal.mt: It-talba tiftaħ bil-kliem: 'Mbierek int, Mulej, Alla tagħna.'
formal.en: The prayer opens with the words: 'Blessed are you, Lord, our God.'
formal.zh: 祷文以这句话开头：“主，我们的上帝，你当受赞颂。”

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi jfisser 'Mbierek Alla'? Pawlu: Hu kliem ta' tifħir u qima lil Alla. Anna: Issa nifhem għaliex jingħad fit-talb.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does 'Blessed be God' mean? Pawlu: It is an expression of praise and reverence for God. Anna: Now I understand why it is said in prayer.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：“愿上帝受赞颂”是什么意思？保罗：这是赞美和尊崇上帝的表达。安娜：现在我明白为什么祈祷时会这样说了。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: “愿上帝受赞颂”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Blessed be God' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu kliem ta' tifħir u qima lil Alla.
messages.mt_standard: Hu kliem ta' tifħir u qima lil Alla.
messages.zh: 这是赞美和尊崇上帝的表达。
messages.en: It is an expression of praise and reverence for God.

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 现在我明白为什么祈祷时会这样说了。
messages.en: Now I understand why it is said in prayer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mbierek 放进整句 Mbierek Alla 一起记，联想祷告中尊崇上帝、称颂上帝的语气。

gloss_zh: 衣着讲究的；打扮整齐漂亮的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dressed smartly and neatly, with care given to one's appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿着整齐、讲究，外表经过用心打扮的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Liebes pulit u sabiħ, b'attenzjoni għad-dehra tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衣着讲究的；穿戴整齐漂亮的。

collocations.zh: 为庆典打扮得整整齐齐

formal.mt: Il-mistieden wasal mdandan, b'libsa skura u żraben nodfa.
formal.en: The guest arrived smartly dressed, wearing a dark suit and clean shoes.
formal.zh: 那位来宾穿着深色西装和干净的鞋子，衣着整齐地到场。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm int mdandan illum! Sejjer xi tieġ? David: Le, għandi ikla speċjali mal-familja.
colloquial.en: Anna: You're so smartly dressed today! Are you going to a wedding? David: No, I have a special meal with my family.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你今天穿得真讲究！要去参加婚礼吗？戴维：不是，我要和家人吃一顿特别的饭。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm int mdandan illum! Sejjer xi tieġ?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm int mdandan illum! Sejjer xi tieġ?
messages.zh: 你今天穿得真讲究！要去参加婚礼吗？
messages.en: You're so smartly dressed today! Are you going to a wedding?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，我要和家人吃一顿特别的饭。
messages.en: No, I have a special meal with my family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门赴宴前整理衣领、擦亮鞋子的画面，用 mdandan 描述这一身讲究的打扮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The stalks of barley left after the grain has been removed by threshing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大麦经过脱粒、谷粒被分离后剩下的茎秆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iz-zkuk tax-xgħir li jibqgħu wara d-dris, meta l-ħbub ikunu tneħħew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大麦脱粒后剩下的秸秆。

collocations.en: a heap of barley stalks left after threshing
collocations.zh: 一堆脱粒后的大麦秸秆

collocations.en: to gather the barley stalks left after threshing
collocations.zh: 收集脱粒后的大麦秸秆

formal.mt: Wara d-dris tax-xgħir, il-bidwi ġabar il-mdaqq f'gozz ħdejn il-ħajt.
formal.en: After threshing the barley, the farmer gathered the remaining stalks into a heap beside the wall.
formal.zh: 大麦脱粒后，农民把剩下的秸秆收拢成一堆，放在墙边。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'inhu dan il-gozz ħdejn il-ħajt? Ġużeppi: Dan mdaqq: iz-zkuk tax-xgħir li baqgħu wara d-dris.
colloquial.en: Rita: What's this heap beside the wall? Joseph: These are barley stalks left after threshing.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：墙边这一堆是什么？约瑟夫：这是大麦脱粒后剩下的秸秆。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场访客)
messages.zh: 墙边这一堆是什么？
messages.en: What's this heap beside the wall?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan mdaqq: iz-zkuk tax-xgħir li baqgħu wara d-dris.
messages.mt_standard: Dan mdaqq: iz-zkuk tax-xgħir li baqgħu wara d-dris.
messages.zh: 这是大麦脱粒后剩下的秸秆。
messages.en: These are barley stalks left after threshing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把收获画面分成谷粒和秸秆两堆：mdaqq 专记大麦脱粒后留下的那堆茎秆。

gloss_zh: 沮丧的；情绪低落的；沉闷的；悲伤的；不开心的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling sad, unhappy, or low in spirits; in another context, dull or lacking interest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到悲伤、不开心或情绪低落的；在其他语境中也可表示沉闷、乏味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss dwejjaq jew ma jkunx kuntent; f'kuntest ieħor, li hu monotonu jew nieqes mill-interess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沮丧的；垂头丧气的。
情绪低落的；抑郁的。
沉闷的；乏味的。
悲伤的；难过的。
不开心的；不快乐的。

formal.mt: Wara li sema' l-aħbar, l-istudent deher mdejjaq u talab ftit ħin biex joqgħod waħdu.
formal.en: After hearing the news, the student looked dejected and asked for some time alone.
formal.zh: 听到消息后，那名学生显得很沮丧，请求独自待一会儿。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Tidher mdejjaq illum. Trid titkellem? Mark: Iva, ma mortx tajjeb fl-eżami u qed inħossni ħażin.
colloquial.en: Elena: You look sad today. Do you want to talk? Mark: Yes, I didn't do well in the exam, and I'm feeling bad.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你今天看起来很难过。想聊聊吗？马克：想，我考试没考好，心里很不好受。

messages.speaker: Elena (同学)
messages.zh: 你今天看起来很难过。想聊聊吗？

messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma mortx tajjeb fl-eżami u qed inħossni ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma mortx tajjeb fl-eżami u qed inħossni ħażin.
messages.zh: 想，我考试没考好，心里很不好受。
messages.en: Yes, I didn't do well in the exam, and I'm feeling bad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mdejjaq 放进低头叹气的画面，串联难过、沮丧和不开心；遇到 dull 义再联想沉闷感。

gloss_zh: 蒙上雾气的；污秽的；不清楚的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Misted over, very dirty, or unclear, with the intended meaning determined by context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可表示表面蒙上雾气、十分肮脏，或含义不清楚，须根据语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mgħotti biċ-ċpar jew bil-fwar, maħmuġ ħafna, jew mhux ċar, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒙上雾气的；表面因雾气而模糊的。
污秽的；极脏的。
不清楚的；模糊难辨的。

formal.mt: Il-ħġieġ kien mdennes bil-fwar, u għalhekk ma kienx possibbli li wieħed jara ċar minn ġo fih.
formal.en: The glass was misted over with steam, so it was not possible to see clearly through it.
formal.zh: 玻璃蒙上了水汽，因此无法透过它看清外面。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma nistax nara minn dan il-ħġieġ? Toni: Għax mdennes bil-fwar. Imsaħ ftit b'din iċ-ċarruta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why can't I see through this glass? Tony: Because it's misted over with steam. Give it a wipe with this cloth.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么我透过这块玻璃看不清？托尼：因为上面蒙了水汽。用这块布擦一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax nara minn dan il-ħġieġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax nara minn dan il-ħġieġ?
messages.zh: 为什么我透过这块玻璃看不清？
messages.en: Why can't I see through this glass?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax mdennes bil-fwar. Imsaħ ftit b'din iċ-ċarruta.
messages.mt_standard: Għax mdennes bil-fwar. Imsaħ ftit b'din iċ-ċarruta.
messages.zh: 因为上面蒙了水汽。用这块布擦一下。
messages.en: Because it's misted over with steam. Give it a wipe with this cloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅图记 mdennes：起雾的玻璃、污秽的地面、看不清的内容；这是语境联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mdina, a city and local council in Malta's Western Region and the former capital of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姆迪纳，位于马耳他西部地区的一座城市及地方议会辖区，曾是马耳他的首都。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mdina hija belt u kunsill lokali fir-Reġjun tal-Punent ta' Malta, u kienet il-kapitali ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Mdina (a city and local council of the Western Region, Malta; the former capital city of Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 姆迪纳，马耳他西部地区的一座城市及地方议会辖区，曾是马耳他的首都。
城市；城镇。

formal.mt: L-Imdina, li kienet il-kapitali ta' Malta, tinsab fir-Reġjun tal-Punent.
formal.en: Mdina, which was Malta's capital, is located in the Western Region.
formal.zh: 姆迪纳曾是马耳他的首都，位于西部地区。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi miegħi l-Imdina għada? Luqa: Iva, nixtieq nimxi fit-toroq tagħha u nieħu ftit ritratti.
colloquial.en: Maya: Do you want to come to Mdina with me tomorrow? Luke: Yes, I'd like to walk through its streets and take a few photos.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：明天想和我一起去姆迪纳吗？卢卡：想，我想在那里的街道上走走，拍几张照片。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 明天想和我一起去姆迪纳吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come to Mdina with me tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nimxi fit-toroq tagħha u nieħu ftit ritratti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nimxi fit-toroq tagħha u nieħu ftit ritratti.
messages.zh: 想，我想在那里的街道上走走，拍几张照片。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to walk through its streets and take a few photos.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用地图分两层记忆：大写 Mdina 指姆迪纳这座特定城市；小写 mdina 的名词义是城市或城镇。

gloss_zh: 城市的；姆迪纳的；姆迪纳居民

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a town or city, or specifically to L-Imdina.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与城镇或城市有关的；也可专指与姆迪纳有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' belt jew mal-ħajja fiha, jew speċifikament mal-Imdina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 城市的；城镇的。

sense_translations.en_definition: of, from or relating to L-Imdina
sense_translations.zh_definition: 姆迪纳的、来自姆迪纳的或与姆迪纳有关的。
姆迪纳本地人或居民。

collocations.en: a native of L-Imdina who lives there

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina kif it-traffiku jaffettwa l-ambjent mdini.
formal.en: The report examines how traffic affects the urban environment.
formal.zh: 这份报告探讨交通如何影响城市环境。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk, 'mdini' jfisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Imdina? Pawlu: Iva, imma f'kuntest ieħor jista' jfisser li għandu x'jaqsam ma' belt b'mod ġenerali.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'mdini' mean related to L-Imdina here? Pawlu: Yes, but in another context it can mean related to a city in general.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 mdini 是指与姆迪纳有关吗？保罗：是的，不过在其他语境中，它也可以泛指与城市有关。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk, 'mdini' jfisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Imdina?
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk, 'mdini' jfisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Imdina?
messages.zh: 这里的 mdini 是指与姆迪纳有关吗？
messages.en: Does 'mdini' mean related to L-Imdina here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma f'kuntest ieħor jista' jfisser li għandu x'jaqsam ma' belt b'mod ġenerali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma f'kuntest ieħor jista' jfisser li għandu x'jaqsam ma' belt b'mod ġenerali.
messages.zh: 是的，不过在其他语境中，它也可以泛指与城市有关。
messages.en: Yes, but in another context it can mean related to a city in general.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义放进两张学习卡：一张画城市，一张写姆迪纳；再用词性区分“当地的”和“当地人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To lay someone or something down, or to spread something over a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或物放成躺着、平放的姿势；也指把某物铺展在一个表面上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa mimduda, jew jifrex xi ħaġa fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使躺下；将人或物放平。
把某物铺开、铺展在一个表面上。

collocations.en: laid the boy down on the bed
spread the cloth over the table

formal.mt: Qabel il-kejl, il-ħaddiem medded id-drapp fuq il-mejda sabiex ikun ċatt.
formal.en: Before measuring, the worker spread the cloth over the table so that it lay flat.
formal.zh: 测量之前，工人把布铺在桌面上，使它保持平整。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu t-tifel? Mark: Missieru medded lit-tifel fuq is-sodda għax kien għajjien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the boy? Mark: His father laid him down on the bed because he was tired.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：男孩在哪里？马克：他爸爸让他躺在床上了，因为他累了。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 男孩在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the boy?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieru medded lit-tifel fuq is-sodda għax kien għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Missieru medded lit-tifel fuq is-sodda għax kien għajjien.
messages.zh: 他爸爸让他躺在床上了，因为他累了。
messages.en: His father laid him down on the bed because he was tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个平放画面联记：把孩子放躺在床上，把布铺平在桌上；两者都用 medded 表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who lays a person or thing down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容实施放平动作的人，即把人或物放成躺着或平放的姿势的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jqiegħed persuna jew ħaġa mimduda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容把人或物放平的人。

collocations.en: a worker who lays things down
someone who lays things down carefully
collocations.zh: 小心地把人或物放平的

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'meddied' jiddeskrivi lill-ħaddiem li jqiegħed l-oġġetti mimdudin fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'meddied' describes the worker who lays the objects down flat on the table.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，meddied 用来形容把物品平放在桌上的工人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser 'meddied' f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jqiegħed persuna jew ħaġa mimduda, bħall-ħaddiem f'dan l-eżempju.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'meddied' mean in this sentence? Pawlu: It describes someone who lays a person or thing down, like the worker in this example.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个句子里的 meddied 是什么意思？保罗：它形容把人或物放平的人，比如这个例子中的工人。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 meddied 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'meddied' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jqiegħed persuna jew ħaġa mimduda, bħall-ħaddiem f'dan l-eżempju.
messages.mt_standard: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jqiegħed persuna jew ħaġa mimduda, bħall-ħaddiem f'dan l-eżempju.
messages.zh: 它形容把人或物放平的人，比如这个例子中的工人。
messages.en: It describes someone who lays a person or thing down, like the worker in this example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时把镜头对准做动作的人：他正把东西放平；用“放平东西的那个人”记住 meddied。

gloss_zh: 把人摔倒；使人在地上翻滚

teaching_sense.en_definition: To throw someone down or cause someone to roll on the floor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某人摔倒在地，或使某人在地板上翻滚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwaqqa' lil xi ħadd mal-art jew iġiegħlu jitgerbeb mal-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某人摔倒或掀倒在地。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sb. roll on the floor
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人在地板上翻滚。

collocations.en: he threw his opponent to the ground
he made his companion roll on the floor while playing
collocations.zh: 他在玩耍时把同伴弄得在地上翻滚

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ tal-lotta, l-atleta megħek lill-avversarju mal-art, u l-kowċ waqqaf l-eżerċizzju biex jispjega t-teknika.
formal.en: During wrestling practice, the athlete threw his opponent to the ground, and the coach stopped the exercise to explain the technique.
formal.zh: 在摔跤训练中，运动员把对手摔倒在地，教练随后暂停练习，讲解这一技术。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara waqt it-taħriġ? Mark: Pawlu megħek lil sieħbu mal-art, imma t-tnejn qamu u komplew jitħarrġu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened during practice? Mark: Pawlu threw his partner to the ground, but they both got up and continued training.
colloquial.zh: Maja：训练时发生什么了？Mark：Pawlu 把搭档摔倒在地，不过两个人都起来继续训练了。

messages.speaker: Maja (队友)
messages.zh: 训练时发生什么了？
messages.en: What happened during practice?

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu megħek lil sieħbu mal-art, imma t-tnejn qamu u komplew jitħarrġu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu megħek lil sieħbu mal-art, imma t-tnejn qamu u komplew jitħarrġu.
messages.zh: Pawlu 把搭档摔倒在地，不过两个人都起来继续训练了。
messages.en: Pawlu threw his partner to the ground, but they both got up and continued training.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 me għ ek 当作拼写观察练习，再用摔跤垫上先倒地、后翻滚的连续画面记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To contradict someone, question their judgment, or criticise what they say or do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反驳他人的说法，质疑其判断，或批评其言行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imur kontra dak li jgħid ħaddieħor, jiddubita mill-ġudizzju tiegħu, jew jikkritika kliemu jew għemilu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反驳；提出与他人说法相反的意见。
对他人的判断或决定提出质疑，认为本应采用另一种做法。
批评；指出某人或某事的缺点。

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskussjoni, il-membru megħer lill-kelliem u spjega għaliex ma qabilx mal-konklużjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: During the discussion, the member contradicted the speaker and explained why he disagreed with his conclusion.
formal.zh: 在讨论中，该成员反驳了发言者，并解释了自己为何不同意对方的结论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark megħer id-deċiżjoni tal-kowċ. Pawlu: Iva, qal li kellu jagħżel plejer ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark questioned the coach's decision. Pawlu: Yes, he said the coach should have chosen another player.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 质疑了教练的决定。Pawlu：是啊，他说教练本该选另一名球员。

messages.speaker: Maja (球迷)
messages.zh: Mark 质疑了教练的决定。
messages.en: Mark questioned the coach's decision.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qal li kellu jagħżel plejer ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qal li kellu jagħżel plejer ieħor.
messages.zh: 是啊，他说教练本该选另一名球员。
messages.en: Yes, he said the coach should have chosen another player.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 me għ er 配三张对话卡：你说得不对、你本该另选、这里有缺点，依次记住反驳、质疑和批评。

gloss_zh: 爱挑刺的人；爱反驳的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who habitually finds small faults or contradicts others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常挑剔小毛病或反驳他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li spiss issib difetti żgħar jew tmur kontra dak li jgħid ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱挑刺、总对小毛病挑剔的人。
爱反驳他人、与他人唱反调的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-megħier isib difett f'kull proposta, iżda rarament joffri soluzzjoni.
formal.en: In the story, the fault-finder finds a flaw in every proposal but rarely offers a solution.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个爱挑刺的人对每个提议都能找出毛病，却很少提出解决办法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu dejjem isib xi ħaġa ħażina f'kull idea. Mark: Hu megħier, imma nistgħu nitolbuh jissuġġerixxi xi ħaġa aħjar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu always finds something wrong with every idea. Mark: He is a fault-finder, but we can ask him to suggest something better.
colloquial.zh: Maja：每个点子 Pawlu 都能挑出毛病。Mark：他就是个爱挑刺的人，不过我们可以请他提出更好的建议。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu dejjem isib xi ħaġa ħażina f'kull idea.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu dejjem isib xi ħaġa ħażina f'kull idea.
messages.zh: 每个点子 Pawlu 都能挑出毛病。
messages.en: Pawlu always finds something wrong with every idea.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu megħier, imma nistgħu nitolbuh jissuġġerixxi xi ħaġa aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Hu megħier, imma nistgħu nitolbuh jissuġġerixxi xi ħaġa aħjar.
messages.zh: 他就是个爱挑刺的人，不过我们可以请他提出更好的建议。
messages.en: He is a fault-finder, but we can ask him to suggest something better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议桌旁总举手挑毛病的那个人；megħier 是给人贴的名词标签，记成爱挑刺的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to complain about small faults or repeatedly find something wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易盯着小缺点不放、经常挑剔或找毛病的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jsib id-difetti u jilmenta dwar affarijiet żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱挑小毛病的；吹毛求疵的。
倾向于挑剔或找毛病的。

formal.mt: It-ton megħieri tal-kumment naqqas il-valur tal-kritika, għax enfasizza difetti żgħar u injora l-argument ewlieni.
formal.en: The comment's carping tone reduced the value of the criticism because it emphasised minor flaws and ignored the main argument.
formal.zh: 这条评论吹毛求疵的语气削弱了批评的价值，因为它强调小缺点，却忽略了主要论点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kumment jidher ftit megħieri. Mark: Naqbel; jitkellem biss fuq żball żgħir u ma jgħid xejn fuq il-bqija.
colloquial.en: Maja: This comment seems a little nitpicky. Mark: I agree; it only talks about one small mistake and says nothing about the rest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这条评论显得有点吹毛求疵。Mark：我同意，它只谈一个小错误，对其余内容只字不提。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这条评论显得有点吹毛求疵。
messages.en: This comment seems a little nitpicky.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqbel; jitkellem biss fuq żball żgħir u ma jgħid xejn fuq il-bqija.
messages.mt_standard: Naqbel; jitkellem biss fuq żball żgħir u ma jgħid xejn fuq il-bqija.
messages.zh: 我同意，它只谈一个小错误，对其余内容只字不提。
messages.en: I agree; it only talks about one small mistake and says nothing about the rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ton megħieri 想成拿放大镜找小错的语气；它是形容词，用来描述挑剔的特点。

gloss_zh: 爱蹦跳嬉闹的；情绪任性的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to jump and frolic about, or in a changeable, capricious mood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 爱四处蹦跳嬉闹的，或处于情绪多变、任性状态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jaqbeż u jilgħab 'l hawn u 'l hemm, jew li jkun f'burdata li tinbidel malajr u jimxi skont il-kapriċċi tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱蹦蹦跳跳、四处嬉闹的。
情绪变化无常、显得任性的。

collocations.en: a boy inclined to frolic about

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel megħieżi jaqbeż minn post għal ieħor u jibdel fehmtu dwar kull logħba.
formal.en: In the story, the lively, capricious boy jumps from place to place and changes his mind about every game.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个爱嬉闹又任性的男孩从一处蹦到另一处，对每种游戏都不断改变主意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu llum megħieżi; darba jrid joħroġ u darba jrid jibqa' d-dar. Mark: Nistennew ftit sakemm jiddeċiedi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu is in a capricious mood today; one moment he wants to go out and the next he wants to stay home. Mark: Let's wait a little until he decides.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 今天有点任性多变，一会儿想出去，一会儿又想待在家里。Mark：我们等一会儿，让他决定吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu llum megħieżi; darba jrid joħroġ u darba jrid jibqa' d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu llum megħieżi; darba jrid joħroġ u darba jrid jibqa' d-dar.
messages.zh: Pawlu 今天有点任性多变，一会儿想出去，一会儿又想待在家里。
messages.en: Pawlu is in a capricious mood today; one moment he wants to go out and the next he wants to stay home.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们等一会儿，让他决定吧。
messages.en: Let's wait a little until he decides.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用身体跳来跳去、主意变来变去两幅画面记 megħieżi，分别对应嬉闹和情绪任性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scolding or an expression of strong disapproval of someone's conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人行为的训斥，或表示强烈不赞同的责难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċanfira jew espressjoni ta' diżapprovazzjoni qawwija għall-imġiba ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 训斥；因某人的过错而对其进行的责骂。
责难；对某种行为作出的严厉批评。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat esprima l-megħra tiegħu għall-imġiba tal-membru u talab spjegazzjoni bil-miktub.
formal.en: The committee expressed its censure of the member's conduct and requested a written explanation.
formal.zh: 委员会对该成员的行为表示责难，并要求其提交书面解释。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu jidher imdejjaq? Mark: Ħa megħra mingħand l-għalliem għax reġa' wasal tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does Pawlu look upset? Mark: He got a scolding from the teacher because he was late again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 为什么看起来不开心？Mark：他又迟到了，被老师训了一顿。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么看起来不开心？
messages.en: Why does Pawlu look upset?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħa megħra mingħand l-għalliem għax reġa' wasal tard.
messages.mt_standard: Ħa megħra mingħand l-għalliem għax reġa' wasal tard.
messages.zh: 他又迟到了，被老师训了一顿。
messages.en: He got a scolding from the teacher because he was late again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 megħra 放进挨了一顿训斥的场景，再换成委员会公开责难，记住日常与正式两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slowness in movement or action, or a delay in doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 移动或行动的缓慢，也指做某事时的拖延。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' ħeffa fil-moviment jew fl-azzjoni, jew dewmien biex issir xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缓慢；行动或进展速度低的状态。
拖延；某事迟迟未做或未能按时进行。

formal.mt: Il-mehel fit-tlestija tax-xogħol ġiegħel lill-organizzaturi jibdlu l-programm tal-ġurnata.
formal.en: The delay in completing the work forced the organisers to change the day's programme.
formal.zh: 工作完成时间的拖延迫使组织者调整了当天的日程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed timxi bil-mehel? Mark: Għandi ż-żraben ġodda u qed iweġġgħuni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you walking so slowly? Mark: My shoes are new and they are hurting my feet.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么走得这么慢？Mark：我的鞋是新的，穿着磨脚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ż-żraben ġodda u qed iweġġgħuni.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ż-żraben ġodda u qed iweġġgħuni.
messages.zh: 我的鞋是新的，穿着磨脚。
messages.en: My shoes are new and they are hurting my feet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象穿新鞋一步一步慢走：mehel 是缓慢或拖延，搭配 bil-mehel 就记作慢慢地。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slow in acting or progressing, or delayed beyond the expected time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容行动或进展缓慢，也可表示事情未按预期时间完成、发生了延误。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaġixxi jew jimxi bil-mod, jew li jdum aktar milli kien mistenni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做事往往缓慢的；倾向于慢慢行动的。
延误的；比预定或预期时间更晚的。

collocations.en: a worker who tends to work slowly

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol għadu mehli minħabba nuqqas ta' materjal.
formal.en: The work is still delayed because of a shortage of materials.
formal.zh: 由于材料短缺，这项工作仍处于延误状态。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għadna nistennew lil Mark? Paul: Hu dejjem mehli meta jkun qed iħejji ruħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are we still waiting for Mark? Paul: He always takes his time getting ready.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们为什么还在等马克？保罗：他准备出门时总是慢吞吞的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们为什么还在等马克？
messages.en: Why are we still waiting for Mark?

messages.speaker: Paul (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu dejjem mehli meta jkun qed iħejji ruħu.
messages.mt_standard: Hu dejjem mehli meta jkun qed iħejji ruħu.
messages.zh: 他准备出门时总是慢吞吞的。
messages.en: He always takes his time getting ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人慢吞吞地准备出门，结果工作也迟了：用 mehli 连接“动作缓慢”和“事情延误”两个画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called meitnerium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素鿏的名称，英语称为 meitnerium。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bl-isem Ingliż meitnerium.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鿏，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-kimika, l-istudenti għandhom isibu l-meitnerju fit-tabella tal-elementi u jiktbu ismu.
formal.en: In the chemistry exercise, students should find meitnerium in the table of elements and write down its name.
formal.zh: 在化学练习中，学生应在元素表中找到鿏，并写下它的名称。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu l-meitnerju? David: Huwa element kimiku. Ejja nfittxu ismu fit-tabella tal-elementi.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is meitnerium? David: It is a chemical element. Let's look for its name in the table of elements.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：鿏是什么？戴维：它是一种化学元素。我们在元素表里找找它的名字吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 鿏是什么？
messages.en: What is meitnerium?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku. Ejja nfittxu ismu fit-tabella tal-elementi.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku. Ejja nfittxu ismu fit-tabella tal-elementi.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素。我们在元素表里找找它的名字吧。
messages.en: It is a chemical element. Let's look for its name in the table of elements.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作三语元素卡：正面写 meitnerju，背面写 meitnerium 和“鿏”。对照前半段相似的字母来认词，不必推测词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A table at which people sit to eat meals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人们围坐并用餐的桌子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mejda li n-nies joqogħdu madwarha biex jieklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 餐桌；供人用餐的桌子。

formal.mt: Il-mejda tal-ikel għandha titnaddaf qabel u wara kull ikla.
formal.en: The dining table should be cleaned before and after every meal.
formal.zh: 每次用餐前后都应清洁餐桌。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn inpoġġi l-platti? Pawlu: Fuq il-mejda tal-ikel, jekk jogħġbok. L-ikel kważi lest.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where shall I put the plates? Pawlu: On the dining table, please. The food is almost ready.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：盘子放在哪里？保罗：请放在餐桌上。饭菜快好了。

messages.speaker: Marija (女儿)
messages.zh: 盘子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put the plates?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-mejda tal-ikel, jekk jogħġbok. L-ikel kważi lest.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-mejda tal-ikel, jekk jogħġbok. L-ikel kważi lest.
messages.zh: 请放在餐桌上。饭菜快好了。
messages.en: On the dining table, please. The food is almost ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mejda tal-ikel 整体贴在家里的餐桌上；每次摆盘都念一遍，把词组与“围桌吃饭”的生活场景绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A table used for grooming and keeping items such as brushes, cosmetics and a mirror.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于梳妆打扮、放置梳子和化妆用品等物品的桌子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mejda fejn wieħed jirranġa xagħru jew jagħmel il-makeup, u fejn iżomm mera u oġġetti għall-kura personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳妆台

collocations.en: to put the brush on the dressing table

formal.mt: Fil-kamra tas-sodda hemm mejda tal-mera b'żewġ kxaxen għall-oġġetti personali.
formal.en: In the bedroom there is a dressing table with two drawers for personal items.
formal.zh: 卧室里有一张梳妆台，带有两个放置个人用品的抽屉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn ħallejt ix-xkupilja tax-xagħar? Rita: Fuq il-mejda tal-mera, ħdejn il-moxt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you leave the hairbrush? Rita: On the dressing table, next to the comb.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把发刷放在哪里了？丽塔：在梳妆台上，梳子旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你把发刷放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you leave the hairbrush?

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 在梳妆台上，梳子旁边。
messages.en: On the dressing table, next to the comb.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词与镜前梳头的画面绑定：梳子、发刷都放在梳妆台上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A board or narrow table on which clothes are placed for ironing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 熨烫衣物时用来平铺和支撑衣物的板或窄台。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mejda jew tavla li fuqha jitqiegħdu l-ħwejjeġ biex jiġu mogħdija bil-ħadida tal-mogħdija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 熨衣板；烫衣板

formal.mt: Qabel tibda taħdem, poġġi l-mejda tal-mogħdija fuq art ċatta u kun żgur li hija stabbli.
formal.en: Before starting work, place the ironing board on a level floor and make sure it is stable.
formal.zh: 开始操作前，把熨衣板放在平坦的地面上，并确保其稳固。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hi l-mejda tal-mogħdija? Anna: Wara l-bieb. Iftaħha u nġiblek il-qmis.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the ironing board? Anna: Behind the door. Unfold it and I'll bring you the shirt.
colloquial.zh: 马克：熨衣板在哪里？安娜：门后面。你把它展开，我把衬衫拿给你。

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.zh: 熨衣板在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the ironing board?

messages.speaker: Anna (妻子)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara l-bieb. Iftaħha u nġiblek il-qmis.
messages.mt_standard: Wara l-bieb. Iftaħha u nġiblek il-qmis.
messages.zh: 门后面。你把它展开，我把衬衫拿给你。
messages.en: Behind the door. Unfold it and I'll bring you the shirt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先展开板子、再铺平衬衫的动作，把整组词记成熨衣时的工作台。

gloss_zh: 使物体倾斜的人；取笑他人或事物的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who tilts something, or a person who makes fun of someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指使某物倾斜的人，也可指取笑某人或某事物的人；须根据上下文区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmejjel xi ħaġa, jew persuna li tgħaddi ż-żmien b'xi ħadd jew b'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物倾斜的人

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who makes fun of sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 取笑某人或某事物的人

collocations.en: a person who makes fun of people

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-mejjiel tal-kaxxa għandu jaħdem bil-mod biex il-kontenut ma jaqax.
formal.en: In this exercise, the person tilting the box should work slowly so that the contents do not fall out.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，负责使箱子倾斜的人应缓慢操作，以免里面的东西掉出来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tridx toqgħod ħdejn Pawlu? Nina: Għax hu mejjiel; dejjem jgħaddi ż-żmien b'xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't you want to sit next to Pawlu? Nina: Because he makes fun of people; he's always mocking someone.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不想坐在保罗旁边？妮娜：因为他爱取笑人，总是在嘲弄别人。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx toqgħod ħdejn Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx toqgħod ħdejn Pawlu?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想坐在保罗旁边？
messages.en: Why don't you want to sit next to Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu mejjiel; dejjem jgħaddi ż-żmien b'xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu mejjiel; dejjem jgħaddi ż-żmien b'xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 因为他爱取笑人，总是在嘲弄别人。
messages.en: Because he makes fun of people; he's always mocking someone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两幅画面记忆：一人倾斜箱子，另一人取笑别人；两义都指人，靠语境选择。

gloss_zh: 倾斜；使物体倾斜的动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of tilting something or causing it to lean to one side.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物偏向一侧、形成倾斜的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li fiha xi ħaġa titmexxa lejn naħa waħda biex ma tibqax dritta jew ċatta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾斜；使某物倾斜的动作

formal.mt: Il-mejl tal-kontenitur għandu jsir bil-mod biex il-likwidu jitferra' mingħajr tixrid.
formal.en: The tilting of the container should be done slowly so that the liquid can be poured without spilling.
formal.zh: 应缓慢倾斜容器，使液体倒出而不洒漏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqgħu l-blalen mill-kaxxa? Toni: Minħabba l-mejl tal-kaxxa meta għollejtha minn naħa waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the balls fall out of the box? Toni: Because of the tilting of the box when I lifted it on one side.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：球为什么从箱子里掉出来了？托尼：因为我抬起箱子的一侧时，箱子倾斜了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 球为什么从箱子里掉出来了？
messages.en: Why did the balls fall out of the box?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-mejl tal-kaxxa meta għollejtha minn naħa waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-mejl tal-kaxxa meta għollejtha minn naħa waħda.
messages.zh: 因为我抬起箱子的一侧时，箱子倾斜了。
messages.en: Because of the tilting of the box when I lifted it on one side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象箱子一侧被抬高、里面的球滚向另一侧，把这个倾斜动作记作 mejl。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who hones a blade or tool to make its edge sharp.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过磨制刀刃或工具刃口，使其锋利的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ssinn xafra jew għodda biex it-tarf tagħha jsir jaqta' tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨利刀刃或工具的人

formal.mt: Il-mejlieq eżamina x-xafra qabel beda jsinnha biex tkun taqta' tajjeb.
formal.en: The person honing the blade examined it before starting to sharpen it so that it would cut well.
formal.zh: 磨刀者先检查刀刃，再开始磨制，使刀刃能够顺利切割。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din is-sikkina ma taqtax sew. Rita: Ħudha għand il-mejlieq tas-skieken biex isinnhielek.
colloquial.en: Mark: This knife doesn't cut well. Rita: Take it to the knife sharpener so he can hone it for you.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这把刀切东西不太利。丽塔：拿去给磨刀师傅，让他帮你磨一磨。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这把刀切东西不太利。
messages.en: This knife doesn't cut well.

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħudha għand il-mejlieq tas-skieken biex isinnhielek.
messages.mt_standard: Ħudha għand il-mejlieq tas-skieken biex isinnhielek.
messages.zh: 拿去给磨刀师傅，让他帮你磨一磨。
messages.en: Take it to the knife sharpener so he can hone it for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住刀刃在磨石上来回打磨的画面；mejlieq 指做这件事的人。

gloss_zh: 压向墙壁；贴墙摩擦以搔痒

teaching_sense.en_definition: To press against a wall, including to scratch oneself by pressing and rubbing against it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把身体等压向墙壁；也指把身体贴压在墙上摩擦，以搔痒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħfas ma' ħajt, jew tħokk parti minn ġismek billi tagħfasha mal-ħajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压向墙壁；紧贴着墙壁施压

sense_translations.en_definition: to scratch by pressing against the wall
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过把身体压在墙上摩擦来搔痒

collocations.en: he pressed his back against the wall
he pressed against the wall to scratch his back
collocations.zh: 他贴压着墙壁摩擦，以给背部止痒

formal.mt: Ir-raġel mekkaħ dahru mal-ħajt biex jagħmel spazju għal min kien għaddej.
formal.en: The man pressed his back against the wall to make room for people passing by.
formal.zh: 那名男子把背紧贴在墙上，给经过的人让出空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex mekkaħ dahru mal-ħajt? Toni: Għax kien qed iħoss il-ħakk u ried iħokk dahru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he press his back against the wall? Toni: Because he felt itchy and wanted to scratch his back.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么把背压在墙上？托尼：因为他觉得痒，想蹭一蹭后背。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么把背压在墙上？
messages.en: Why did he press his back against the wall?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien qed iħoss il-ħakk u ried iħokk dahru.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien qed iħoss il-ħakk u ried iħokk dahru.
messages.zh: 因为他觉得痒，想蹭一蹭后背。
messages.en: Because he felt itchy and wanted to scratch his back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用背部紧贴墙面的动作记忆：只施压是第一义，贴墙摩擦止痒是第二义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who keeps walking back and forth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 总是不停地来回走动的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li l-ħin kollu timxi 'l hemm u 'l hawn.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who walks back and forth all the time
sense_translations.zh_definition: 总是不停来回走动的人

collocations.en: a person who keeps pacing in the corridor
collocations.zh: 在走廊里不停来回走动的人

collocations.en: a person who keeps walking back and forth instead of sitting down
collocations.zh: 坐不下来、总是来回走动的人

formal.mt: Il-mekkiek baqa' miexi 'l hemm u 'l hawn fil-kuritur waqt li kien jistenna li jinfetaħ l-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The person who kept pacing continued walking back and forth in the corridor while waiting for the office to open.
formal.zh: 那个不停踱步的人在等办公室开门时，一直在走廊里来回走动。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Pawlu qatt joqgħod bilqiegħda? Toni: Bilkemm! Hu mekkiek; il-ħin kollu miexi 'l hemm u 'l hawn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does Pawlu ever sit down? Toni: Hardly! He's always pacing, walking back and forth all the time.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：保罗有坐下来的时候吗？托尼：几乎没有！他就是个闲不住、总来回走动的人。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗有坐下来的时候吗？
messages.en: Does Pawlu ever sit down?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Bilkemm! Hu mekkiek; il-ħin kollu miexi 'l hemm u 'l hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Bilkemm! Hu mekkiek; il-ħin kollu miexi 'l hemm u 'l hawn.
messages.zh: 几乎没有！他就是个闲不住、总来回走动的人。
messages.en: Hardly! He's always pacing, walking back and forth all the time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人在走廊两端不停折返；这个词指来回走动的人，不必推断其心情。

gloss_zh: 容易来回移动的；爱前后摆动的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to move repeatedly backwards and forwards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或物容易反复来回移动、前后摆动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jiċċaqlaq ripetutament 'il quddiem u lura.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to move back and forth
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易来回移动的；倾向于前后摆动的。

collocations.en: a toy that tends to move back and forth
a boy who tends to move back and forth

formal.mt: It-tifel mekkieki baqa' jiċċaqlaq 'il quddiem u lura fuq is-siġġu waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The boy, who tended to move back and forth, kept rocking forwards and backwards on his chair during the lesson.
formal.zh: 这个爱来回晃动的男孩上课时一直坐在椅子上前后摇摆。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ġugarell mekkieki, hux? Ben: Iva, kull darba li tmissu jiċċaqlaq 'il quddiem u lura.
colloquial.en: Lara: This toy tends to move back and forth, doesn't it? Ben: Yes, every time you touch it, it moves forwards and backwards.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个玩具很容易来回摆动，对吧？本：对，每次碰它，它都会前后晃。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个玩具很容易来回摆动，对吧？
messages.en: This toy tends to move back and forth, doesn't it?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kull darba li tmissu jiċċaqlaq 'il quddiem u lura.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kull darba li tmissu jiċċaqlaq 'il quddiem u lura.
messages.zh: 对，每次碰它，它都会前后晃。
messages.en: Yes, every time you touch it, it moves forwards and backwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个轻轻碰一下就前后摆动的玩具，把 mekkieki 与反复来回的动作画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 弄坏或弄脏东西的人；容易造成损坏或污损的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who damages things or makes them dirty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品弄坏或弄脏的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel ħsara lill-affarijiet jew tħammeġhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄坏或弄脏东西的人
容易弄坏或弄脏东西的；有造成损坏或污损倾向的

collocations.en: a person who makes everything dirty
a boy who tends to damage or soil things
collocations.zh: 容易弄坏或弄脏东西的男孩

formal.mt: It-tifel kien mekkieħi: ħammeġ il-mejda biż-żebgħa u kisser wieħed mill-pniezel.
formal.en: The boy tended to damage or soil things: he dirtied the table with paint and broke one of the brushes.
formal.zh: 这个男孩容易弄脏或弄坏东西：他用颜料弄脏了桌子，还弄坏了一支画笔。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min ħammeġ il-mejda u kisser il-kikkra? Mark: Dak il-mekkieħi reġa' mess kollox b'idejh maħmuġin u waqqa' l-kikkra.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who dirtied the table and broke the cup? Mark: That person who keeps making a mess touched everything with dirty hands again and dropped the cup.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：谁把桌子弄脏，还把杯子打破了？马克：那个老把东西弄脏弄坏的人，又用脏手到处摸，还把杯子摔了。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ħammeġ il-mejda u kisser il-kikkra?
messages.mt_standard: Min ħammeġ il-mejda u kisser il-kikkra?
messages.zh: 谁把桌子弄脏，还把杯子打破了？
messages.en: Who dirtied the table and broke the cup?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-mekkieħi reġa' mess kollox b'idejh maħmuġin u waqqa' l-kikkra.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-mekkieħi reġa' mess kollox b'idejh maħmuġin u waqqa' l-kikkra.
messages.zh: 那个老把东西弄脏弄坏的人，又用脏手到处摸，还把杯子摔了。
messages.en: That person who keeps making a mess touched everything with dirty hands again and dropped the cup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把脏手印和破杯子放进同一画面；单独指人时是名词，修饰男孩时是形容词。

gloss_zh: 嚼吃；咀嚼；咀嚼时发出声音

teaching_sense.en_definition: To chew or munch food, sometimes making audible chewing sounds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用牙齿嚼食物，也可着重指嚼吃时发出声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tomgħod l-ikel, xi drabi b'ħsejjes li jinstemgħu waqt it-tomgħod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嚼吃；一口口地咀嚼食物。
咀嚼；用牙齿将食物嚼碎。
咀嚼时发出声音。

formal.mt: Waqt il-pawża, it-tifel mekmek biċċa ħobż qabel kompla jaqra.
formal.en: During the break, the boy munched a piece of bread before continuing to read.
formal.zh: 休息时，男孩嚼吃了一块面包，然后继续阅读。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għamel Pawlu waqt il-film? Mark: Mekmek ftit gallettini; kont nisma' kull gidma!
colloquial.en: Sara: What did Paul do during the film? Mark: He munched some biscuits; I could hear every bite!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗看电影时做了什么？马克：他嚼了几块饼干，每咬一口我都听得见！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗看电影时做了什么？
messages.en: What did Paul do during the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mekmek ftit gallettini; kont nisma' kull gidma!
messages.mt_standard: Mekmek ftit gallettini; kont nisma' kull gidma!
messages.zh: 他嚼了几块饼干，每咬一口我都听得见！
messages.en: He munched some biscuits; I could hear every bite!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mekmek 当作记忆节拍，配合嘴巴反复咀嚼的动作；它既能说嚼食，也能突出嚼东西的声音。

gloss_zh: 爱发出咀嚼声或吮吸声的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to make audible sounds when chewing or sucking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或动物在咀嚼、吮吸时容易发出可听见的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jagħmel ħsejjes meta jomgħod jew jerdgħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to make sounds of chewing or sucking
sense_translations.zh_definition: 咀嚼或吮吸时容易发出声音的。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to chew or suck noisily
collocations.zh: 咀嚼或吮吸时爱出声的男孩

collocations.en: a dog that tends to make chewing sounds

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, it-tifel mekmieki jagħmel ħsejjes kull darba li jomgħod biċċa ħobż.
formal.en: In the story, the boy who tends to chew noisily makes sounds whenever he chews a piece of bread.
formal.zh: 故事里，这个爱嚼出声音的男孩每次嚼面包都会发出声响。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-kelb tiegħek mekmieki, hux? Toni: Iva, nisma' l-ħsejjes tiegħu kull darba li jomgħod xi ħaġa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Your dog tends to chew noisily, doesn't it? Toni: Yes, I hear it every time it chews something.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你的狗嚼东西很爱出声，对吧？托尼：对，它每次嚼东西，我都能听见。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的狗嚼东西很爱出声，对吧？
messages.en: Your dog tends to chew noisily, doesn't it?

messages.speaker: Toni (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nisma' l-ħsejjes tiegħu kull darba li jomgħod xi ħaġa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nisma' l-ħsejjes tiegħu kull darba li jomgħod xi ħaġa.
messages.zh: 对，它每次嚼东西，我都能听见。
messages.en: Yes, I hear it every time it chews something.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 mekmieki 时想象安静房间里的咀嚼声：这个形容词描述爱嚼出声或吸出声的习惯。

gloss_zh: 谋求好处；设法讨得优待

teaching_sense.en_definition: To try to obtain favours or special treatment from someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设法从别人那里获得好处、帮助或特别优待。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tipprova tikseb favuri jew trattament speċjali mingħand xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谋求他人的好处或优待；设法讨得帮助。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, l-impjegat mellaq mal-kap biex jingħata ġurnata oħra ta' leave.
formal.en: In the story, the employee sought favour with the boss to obtain an extra day of leave.
formal.zh: 故事里，这名员工向上司谋求优待，希望多获一天假。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu mellaq mal-kap? Mark: Ried li jagħtih ġurnata oħra ta' leave.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Paul seek favour with the boss? Mark: He wanted the boss to give him an extra day of leave.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗为什么向上司讨好处？马克：他想让上司多给他一天假。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么向上司讨好处？
messages.en: Why did Paul seek favour with the boss?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried li jagħtih ġurnata oħra ta' leave.
messages.mt_standard: Ried li jagħtih ġurnata oħra ta' leave.
messages.zh: 他想让上司多给他一天假。
messages.en: He wanted the boss to give him an extra day of leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 mellaq 时抓住背后的目的：想从别人那里得到一个人情或特别照顾，重点在谋求好处。

gloss_zh: 装填者；填充的、起填充作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who fills a container, space, or other object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把容器、空间或其他物件填满的人；可理解为装填者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li timla reċipjent, spazju jew oġġett ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责填充或装满某物的人；装填者。
填充某物的；起填充作用或负责装填的。

formal.mt: Il-mellej tal-fliexken jiċċekkja li kull flixkun ikun mimli sal-livell indikat.
formal.en: The person filling the bottles checks that each bottle is filled to the indicated level.
formal.zh: 负责灌装瓶子的人会检查每个瓶子是否都装到了标示的位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu l-mellej tal-boroż illum? Toni: Jien; int tista' tagħlaqhom wara li nimliehom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is filling the bags today? Toni: I am; you can close them after I fill them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天谁负责装袋？托尼：我负责；我装好后，你可以把袋子封上。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 今天谁负责装袋？
messages.en: Who is filling the bags today?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; int tista' tagħlaqhom wara li nimliehom.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; int tista' tagħlaqhom wara li nimliehom.
messages.zh: 我负责；我装好后，你可以把袋子封上。
messages.en: I am; you can close them after I fill them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象装袋分工时有人举手说自己负责填满袋子：名词 mellej 指这个人，形容词义则突出填充作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who caresses someone or something; also, a person who flatters others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻柔抚摸他人或动物的人；也可指用好听的话奉承别人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmelles lil xi ħadd jew lil xi annimal; ukoll persuna li tfaħħar lil ħaddieħor biex togħġbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抚摸者；轻柔爱抚他人或动物的人。
奉承者；用赞美的话讨好别人的人。

collocations.en: a person who flatters the boss

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-mellies ifaħħar lill-kap il-ħin kollu bit-tama li jikseb favur.
formal.en: In the story, the flatterer praises the boss constantly in the hope of obtaining a favour.
formal.zh: 故事里，这个奉承者不停地夸赞上司，希望讨得一个人情。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-qattus dejjem jiġi ħdejk? Toni: Għax jaf li jien mellies ġentili u nħobb immellsu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does the cat always come over to you? Toni: Because it knows I am gentle when I caress it and I enjoy stroking it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这只猫为什么总到你身边来？托尼：因为它知道我抚摸它很温柔，而且我喜欢摸摸它。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这只猫为什么总到你身边来？
messages.en: Why does the cat always come over to you?

messages.speaker: Toni (猫主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jaf li jien mellies ġentili u nħobb immellsu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jaf li jien mellies ġentili u nħobb immellsu.
messages.zh: 因为它知道我抚摸它很温柔，而且我喜欢摸摸它。
messages.en: Because it knows I am gentle when I caress it and I enjoy stroking it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 mellies：一幅是伸手轻抚猫的人，一幅是满口夸赞上司的人，分别对应抚摸者与奉承者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to show affection by gently stroking or caressing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于用轻轻抚摸的方式表达亲昵的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza juri l-għożża billi jmelles.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜欢轻抚、倾向于通过抚摸表达亲昵的。

collocations.en: a boy who likes to caress
a man inclined to show affection through caresses
collocations.zh: 喜欢用轻抚表达亲昵的男子

formal.mt: It-tifel melliesi kien joqgħod ħdejn il-qattus u jmelles dahru bil-mod.
formal.en: The boy, who liked to caress, would sit beside the cat and gently stroke its back.
formal.zh: 这个喜欢轻抚的男孩常坐在猫旁边，轻轻抚摸它的背。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk dejjem imelles il-kelb! Pawlu: Iva, huwa melliesi ħafna, imma joqgħod attent li ma jdejqux.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your brother is always stroking the dog! Pawlu: Yes, he really likes to caress it, but he takes care not to bother it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你弟弟总是在摸那只狗！保罗：对，他很喜欢轻抚它，不过他会注意不打扰它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弟弟总是在摸那只狗！
messages.en: Your brother is always stroking the dog!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa melliesi ħafna, imma joqgħod attent li ma jdejqux.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa melliesi ħafna, imma joqgħod attent li ma jdejqux.
messages.zh: 对，他很喜欢轻抚它，不过他会注意不打扰它。
messages.en: Yes, he really likes to caress it, but he takes care not to bother it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个总爱轻轻摸猫背的人，把 melliesi 记成描述这种轻抚倾向的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who buys and sells salt as a trade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以盐的买卖为业的人；盐商。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tinnegozja fil-melħ, billi tixtrih u tbigħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经营盐买卖的人；盐商。

collocations.en: a salt merchant at the market

formal.mt: F'din l-istorja, il-mellieħ jiżen il-melħ qabel ibigħu lill-klijenti fis-suq.
formal.en: In this story, the salt merchant weighs the salt before selling it to customers at the market.
formal.zh: 在这个故事里，盐商先称盐，再卖给市场里的顾客。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn nista' nixtri ftit melħ f'din l-istorja? Ben: Mur għand il-mellieħ; il-ħanut tiegħu ħdejn il-forn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I buy some salt in this story? Ben: Go to the salt merchant; his shop is beside the bakery.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：在这个故事里，我可以去哪里买点盐？本：去找盐商吧，他的店就在面包店旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (课堂角色扮演中的顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn nista' nixtri ftit melħ f'din l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn nista' nixtri ftit melħ f'din l-istorja?
messages.zh: 在这个故事里，我可以去哪里买点盐？
messages.en: Where can I buy some salt in this story?

messages.speaker: Ben (课堂角色扮演中的居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Mur għand il-mellieħ; il-ħanut tiegħu ħdejn il-forn.
messages.mt_standard: Mur għand il-mellieħ; il-ħanut tiegħu ħdejn il-forn.
messages.zh: 去找盐商吧，他的店就在面包店旁边。
messages.en: Go to the salt merchant; his shop is beside the bakery.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mellieħ 记成摊位后面称盐、卖盐的人；画面中心是经营盐买卖的商人这个职业身份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A slice of bread with a food such as curd or butter spread on it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面涂有凝乳、黄油等食物的一片面包。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fell ta' ħobż midluk b'xi ħaġa tal-ikel, bħall-irkotta jew il-butir.

sense_translations.en_definition: a slice of bread which has been spread with sth. (e.g. curd)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂有某种食物的一片面包，例如涂有凝乳的面包片。

collocations.en: a slice of bread spread with ricotta
collocations.zh: 涂有里科塔乳酪的面包片

collocations.en: a slice of bread spread with butter

formal.mt: Għall-kolazzjon, kull tifel ingħata mellusa bl-irkotta u tazza ħalib.
formal.en: For breakfast, each boy was given a slice of bread spread with ricotta and a glass of milk.
formal.zh: 早餐时，每个男孩都分到了一片涂有里科塔乳酪的面包和一杯牛奶。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid mellusa bil-butir? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Agħmilli waħda żgħira.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like a slice of bread with butter? Mark: Yes, thanks. Make me a small one.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想吃一片涂黄油的面包吗？马克：想，谢谢。给我做一小片吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你想吃一片涂黄油的面包吗？
messages.en: Would you like a slice of bread with butter?

messages.speaker: Mark (弟弟)
messages.zh: 想，谢谢。给我做一小片吧。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Make me a small one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mellusa 想成早餐盘里已经涂好配料的一片面包，记住它指整片面包而非涂料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman who is in the process of giving birth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正在经历分娩过程的妇女，强调生产正在进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li tkun qed twelled.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正在分娩的妇女。

collocations.en: the care of the woman giving birth
collocations.zh: 对正在分娩的妇女的照护

collocations.en: to help the woman giving birth

formal.mt: Il-qabla baqgħet ħdejn il-meluda u offritilha appoġġ waqt il-ħlas.
formal.en: The midwife stayed beside the woman giving birth and offered her support during labour.
formal.zh: 助产士一直陪在正在分娩的妇女身边，在分娩过程中给予她支持。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hi l-qabla? Rita: Qiegħda mal-meluda. Se tiġi tkellimna wara.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the midwife? Rita: She is with the woman giving birth. She will come and speak to us afterwards.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：助产士在哪里？丽塔：她正陪着正在分娩的产妇，之后会过来和我们说话。

messages.speaker: Anna (产妇家属)
messages.zh: 助产士在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the midwife?

messages.speaker: Rita (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħda mal-meluda. Se tiġi tkellimna wara.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħda mal-meluda. Se tiġi tkellimna wara.
messages.zh: 她正陪着正在分娩的产妇，之后会过来和我们说话。
messages.en: She is with the woman giving birth. She will come and speak to us afterwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用产房里助产士陪伴生产的画面记 meluda，重点是妇女正在分娩这一状态。

gloss_zh: 一粒盐；爱管闲事、窥探他人私事的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single grain of salt; also, a person who meddles in and snoops into other people's affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指单独的一粒盐；也可指爱干涉、窥探他人私事的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qamħa waħda tal-melħ; ukoll persuna li tindaħal fl-affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor u tipprova tiskopri affarijiet privati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一粒盐；单独的一颗盐粒。
爱管闲事并窥探他人私事的人。

collocations.en: a snoop who meddles in everything
collocations.zh: 什么事都要插手的窥私者

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenta poġġiet melħa waħda fuq karta sewda biex taraha aħjar.
formal.en: During the observation, the student placed a single grain of salt on black paper to see it more clearly.
formal.zh: 观察时，女学生把一粒盐放在黑纸上，以便看得更清楚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad hemm melħa fuq il-mejda? Ben: Iva, ara din il-qamħa ċkejkna ħdejn il-platt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there still a grain of salt on the table? Ben: Yes, look at this tiny grain beside the plate.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桌上还留着一粒盐吗？本：对，你看盘子旁边这小小的一粒。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 桌上还留着一粒盐吗？
messages.en: Is there still a grain of salt on the table?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara din il-qamħa ċkejkna ħdejn il-platt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara din il-qamħa ċkejkna ħdejn il-platt.
messages.zh: 对，你看盘子旁边这小小的一粒。
messages.en: Yes, look at this tiny grain beside the plate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 melħa 做两张独立的记忆卡：一张画单独一粒盐，另一张画爱窥探私事的人；靠上下文区分两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Worth remembering or likely to remain in the memory because it is special or striking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因特别或令人印象深刻而值得记住、令人难忘的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibqa' fil-memorja għax ikun speċjali jew jolqot ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人难忘的；值得铭记的。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċerimonja kienet okkażjoni memorabbli għall-istudenti u għall-familji tagħhom.
formal.en: The ceremony was a memorable occasion for the students and their families.
formal.zh: 对学生及其家人而言，这场典礼是一个值得铭记的时刻。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kienet il-vaganza? Leon: Kienet esperjenza memorabbli! Għadni niftakar kull mument.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the holiday? Leon: It was a memorable experience! I still remember every moment.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：假期过得怎么样？莱昂：那是一次难忘的经历！每个瞬间我都还记得。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 假期过得怎么样？
messages.en: How was the holiday?

messages.speaker: Leon (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet esperjenza memorabbli! Għadni niftakar kull mument.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet esperjenza memorabbli! Għadni niftakar kull mument.
messages.zh: 那是一次难忘的经历！每个瞬间我都还记得。
messages.en: It was a memorable experience! I still remember every moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 memorabbli 与英语 memorable 对照记忆，再配上难忘旅行的照片来巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A written document used to record information or communicate points for attention or action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于记录信息，或传达需要关注、处理事项的书面文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument miktub li jirreġistra informazzjoni jew iwassal punti li jeħtieġu attenzjoni jew azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 备忘录；用于记录或传达有关事项的书面文件。

formal.mt: Id-direttur bagħat memorandum lill-impjegati biex jispjega l-proċedura l-ġdida.
formal.en: The director sent a memorandum to the employees to explain the new procedure.
formal.zh: 主管向员工发送了一份备忘录，说明新的工作程序。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qrajt il-memorandum dwar il-laqgħa? Mark: Iva, il-laqgħa se tibda fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you read the memorandum about the meeting? Mark: Yes, the meeting will start at nine.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看过关于会议的备忘录了吗？马克：看过了，会议九点开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你看过关于会议的备忘录了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the memorandum about the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 看过了，会议九点开始。
messages.en: Yes, the meeting will start at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象办公桌上一份提醒会议事项的文件，用 memorandum 对应中文备忘录来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that preserves the memory of a person or event, or a written account of personal memories.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于纪念某人或某事的事物，也可指记录个人经历与回忆的文字作品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li żżomm ħajja t-tifkira ta' persuna jew ġrajja, jew kitba li tirrakkonta tifkiriet personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纪念物或纪念设施；也可指记述个人经历的回忆录。

collocations.zh: 记述他童年生活的回忆录

formal.mt: L-awtur ippubblika memorjal ta' tfulitu li fih iddeskriva l-ħajja fir-raħal.
formal.en: The author published a memoir of his childhood in which he described life in the village.
formal.zh: 作者出版了一部童年回忆录，在书中描绘了村庄里的生活。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak ħdejn il-pjazza? Pawlu: Huwa memorjal għall-vittmi tal-gwerra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that near the square? Pawlu: It is a memorial to the victims of the war.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：广场旁边那个是什么？保罗：那是纪念战争遇难者的纪念物。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.zh: 广场旁边那个是什么？
messages.en: What is that near the square?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当地居民)
messages.zh: 那是纪念战争遇难者的纪念物。
messages.en: It is a memorial to the victims of the war.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 memorjal：广场上的纪念物，以及书架上的回忆录；两者都保存记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called mendelevium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为钔的化学元素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ mendelevium.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钔，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fit-tabella perjodika, l-istudenti fittxew il-mendelevju u kitbu ismu fin-noti tagħhom.
formal.en: The students looked for mendelevium in the periodic table and wrote its name in their notes.
formal.zh: 学生们在元素周期表中查找钔，并把它的名称写在笔记里。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif ngħidu mendelevium bil-Malti? Ben: Ngħidu mendelevju. Ejja nfittxuh fit-tabella perjodika.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do we say mendelevium in Maltese? Ben: We say mendelevju. Let's look for it in the periodic table.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：mendelevium 用马耳他语怎么说？本：说 mendelevju。我们在元素周期表里找找它吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: mendelevium 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do we say mendelevium in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħidu mendelevju. Ejja nfittxuh fit-tabella perjodika.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħidu mendelevju. Ejja nfittxuh fit-tabella perjodika.
messages.zh: 说 mendelevju。我们在元素周期表里找找它吧。
messages.en: We say mendelevju. Let's look for it in the periodic table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语元素卡，把 mendelevju、mendelevium 和钔并排写下，反复遮挡互认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave wickedly or act with evil intent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以邪恶或恶意的方式行事，做出伤害他人的坏事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'mod ħażin jew jaġixxi b'intenzjoni ħażina.

sense_translations.en_definition: to act in an evil manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以邪恶的方式行事；作恶。

collocations.en: he acted wickedly towards his companions

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel mengħel ma' dawk li kienu fdawh u kkawżalhom ħafna tbatija.
formal.en: In the story, the man acted wickedly towards those who had trusted him and caused them much suffering.
formal.zh: 故事中，这名男子恶意对待曾经信任他的人，给他们造成了许多痛苦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħadd ma jafdah aktar? Leon: Għax mengħel ma' sħabu u weġġagħhom apposta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does nobody trust him anymore? Leon: Because he acted wickedly towards his companions and hurt them on purpose.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么大家都不再信任他了？莱昂：因为他恶意对待同伴，还故意伤害他们。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么大家都不再信任他了？
messages.en: Why does nobody trust him anymore?

messages.speaker: Leon (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax mengħel ma' sħabu u weġġagħhom apposta.
messages.mt_standard: Għax mengħel ma' sħabu u weġġagħhom apposta.
messages.zh: 因为他恶意对待同伴，还故意伤害他们。
messages.en: Because he acted wickedly towards his companions and hurt them on purpose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事里故意伤害同伴的反派，用这个作恶场景记 mengħel，突出行为中的恶意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of land fenced off for growing crops or other plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用围栏等围起来、供种植作物或其他植物的一块土地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa art magħluqa b'ċint biex jitkabbru fiha ħxejjex jew pjanti oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: a fenced off piece of land for cultivation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 围起来供耕种的一块土地。

collocations.en: a fenced plot for growing vegetables

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħejja mentqa żgħira ħdejn id-dar biex ikabbar fiha l-ħxejjex.
formal.en: The farmer prepared a small fenced cultivation plot beside the house to grow vegetables.
formal.zh: 农民在房屋旁整理了一小块围起来的耕地，用来种蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se nħawlu t-tadam? Pawlu: Fil-mentqa ħdejn id-dar; hemm biżżejjed spazju.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we plant the tomatoes? Pawlu: In the fenced plot beside the house; there is enough space there.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们把番茄种在哪里？保罗：种在房子旁那块围起来的耕地里，那里空间够。

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺伙伴)
messages.zh: 我们把番茄种在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we plant the tomatoes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-mentqa ħdejn id-dar; hemm biżżejjed spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-mentqa ħdejn id-dar; hemm biżżejjed spazju.
messages.zh: 种在房子旁那块围起来的耕地里，那里空间够。
messages.en: In the fenced plot beside the house; there is enough space there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mentqa 配上一幅“四周有围栏、里面种着菜”的图，连着记住围起来和供耕种这两个要点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put things together in a heap or stack, with some resting on top of others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西聚拢堆起，或将它们上下叠放。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Poġġa affarijiet f'munzell jew waħda fuq oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西聚集起来，堆成一堆。
把东西一件叠在另一件上面；码放。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem menzel il-kaxxi fil-maħżen u ħalla passaġġ ħieles bejniethom.
formal.en: The worker stacked the boxes in the storeroom and left a clear passage between them.
formal.zh: 工人把箱子码放在储藏室里，并在箱堆之间留出畅通的通道。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min menzel il-kaxxi ħdejn il-bieb? Ġużeppi: Jien, biex ikun hemm iktar spazju fil-kamra.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who stacked the boxes beside the door? Ġużeppi: I did, to make more space in the room.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：谁把箱子码在门边了？朱塞佩：我码的，这样房间里能多出些空间。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把箱子码在门边了？
messages.en: Who stacked the boxes beside the door?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, biex ikun hemm iktar spazju fil-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, biex ikun hemm iktar spazju fil-kamra.
messages.zh: 我码的，这样房间里能多出些空间。
messages.en: I did, to make more space in the room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张动作图记 menzel：石头聚成一堆对应 heap，箱子上下码齐对应 stack，核心都是把东西堆起来。

gloss_zh: 被视为的；审慎的；谨慎的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Regarded as something; also describing someone or something prudent or cautious.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示被看作某种人或事物；也可形容人或做法审慎、谨慎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitqies bħala xi ħaġa; ukoll li jaġixxi bil-għaqal jew b'kawtela.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被视为某种事物的；被认为是某种情况的。
审慎的；能周全考虑后果并作出明智判断的。
谨慎的；注意避免风险或差错的。

formal.mt: Dan il-proġett huwa meqjus bħala eżempju tajjeb ta' ppjanar fit-tul.
formal.en: This project is regarded as a good example of long-term planning.
formal.zh: 这个项目被视为长期规划的一个良好范例。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Taħseb li Mark se jixtri l-karozza llum? Lara: Ma naħsibx; hu bniedem meqjus u l-ewwel iqabbel il-prezzijiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you think Mark will buy the car today? Lara: I don't think so; he is a prudent person and compares prices first.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你觉得马克今天会买那辆车吗？拉拉：我觉得不会；他做事审慎，会先比较价格。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li Mark se jixtri l-karozza llum?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li Mark se jixtri l-karozza llum?
messages.zh: 你觉得马克今天会买那辆车吗？
messages.en: Do you think Mark will buy the car today?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma naħsibx; hu bniedem meqjus u l-ewwel iqabbel il-prezzijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Ma naħsibx; hu bniedem meqjus u l-ewwel iqabbel il-prezzijiet.
messages.zh: 我觉得不会；他做事审慎，会先比较价格。
messages.en: I don't think so; he is a prudent person and compares prices first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 meqjus 做两张语境卡：meqjus bħala 记“被视为”，形容人或举措时记“考虑周全、行动谨慎”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name used to identify a person or family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于标识个人或家族的姓氏 Mercieca。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jidentifika persuna jew familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Mercieca。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Mercieca se tippreżenta r-rapport waqt il-laqgħa ta' għada.
formal.en: Ms Mercieca will present the report at tomorrow's meeting.
formal.zh: Mercieca 女士将在明天的会议上介绍报告。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandi appuntament mas-Sur Mercieca. Rita: Tajjeb, tista' tistenna hawn; se jasal dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Anna: I have an appointment with Mr Mercieca. Rita: All right, you can wait here; he will arrive shortly.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我和 Mercieca 先生有预约。丽塔：好的，你可以在这里等，他很快就到。

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 我和 Mercieca 先生有预约。
messages.en: I have an appointment with Mr Mercieca.

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, tista' tistenna hawn; se jasal dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, tista' tistenna hawn; se jasal dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 好的，你可以在这里等，他很快就到。
messages.en: All right, you can wait here; he will arrive shortly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mercieca 写在名牌的姓氏栏，再配上 Sur 或 Sinjura 练习称呼；作为姓名使用时保留大写首字母。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arrange material or objects in successive layers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把材料或物件一层接一层地铺放、排列。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qiegħed materjal jew oġġetti f'saffi, saff fuq ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把东西分层摆放；一层层铺叠。

collocations.en: he arranged the fabric in layers
he arranged the sheets of paper in layers

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat mergħen id-drapp fuq il-mejda qabel ma beda jaqta'.
formal.en: The tailor arranged the fabric in layers on the table before beginning to cut.
formal.zh: 裁缝开始裁剪之前，先把布料在桌上分层铺好。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kif ħejja d-drapp il-ħajjat? Toni: Mergħen id-drapp fuq il-mejda, saff fuq ieħor.
colloquial.en: Elena: How did the tailor prepare the fabric? Toni: He arranged it on the table in layers, one on top of another.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：裁缝是怎么整理布料的？托尼：他把布料一层叠一层地铺在桌上。

messages.speaker: Elena (裁缝学徒)
messages.zh: 裁缝是怎么整理布料的？
messages.en: How did the tailor prepare the fabric?

messages.speaker: Toni (裁缝学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Mergħen id-drapp fuq il-mejda, saff fuq ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Mergħen id-drapp fuq il-mejda, saff fuq ieħor.
messages.zh: 他把布料一层叠一层地铺在桌上。
messages.en: He arranged it on the table in layers, one on top of another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 mergħen 时想象铺布料：先铺一层，再铺一层；用“层次分明”的画面突出逐层排列的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mark left by a healed wound, or a visible blemish on a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伤口愈合后留下的疤痕，也可指表面可见的瑕疵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sinjal li jibqa' wara li tfiq ferita, jew difett li jidher fuq wiċċ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疤痕；伤口愈合后留下的痕迹。
瑕疵；影响表面外观的斑痕或缺陷。

formal.mt: Wara li fieq il-feriment, baqa' merk żgħir fuq id-driegħ.
formal.en: After the wound healed, a small scar remained on the arm.
formal.zh: 伤口愈合后，手臂上留下了一道小疤痕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-merk fuq idek minn fejn ġie? Pawlu: Minn ferita qadima; ilha li fieqet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did that scar on your hand come from? Pawlu: From an old wound; it healed a long time ago.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你手上的这道疤是怎么来的？保罗：以前受伤留下的，伤口早就好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-merk fuq idek minn fejn ġie?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-merk fuq idek minn fejn ġie?
messages.zh: 你手上的这道疤是怎么来的？
messages.en: Where did that scar on your hand come from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn ferita qadima; ilha li fieqet.
messages.mt_standard: Minn ferita qadima; ilha li fieqet.
messages.zh: 以前受伤留下的，伤口早就好了。
messages.en: From an old wound; it healed a long time ago.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 merk 记成表面留下的一处印记：在皮肤上可以是疤痕，在布料上可以是瑕疵。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a wound to heal and leave a scar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指伤口愈合后留下疤痕，描述伤口形成疤痕的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal feriment li jfiq u jħalli merk.

sense_translations.en_definition: to form a scar after healing (used of wounds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 愈合后形成疤痕；用于描述伤口。

collocations.en: a wound that healed with a scar
collocations.zh: 愈合后留下疤痕的伤口

formal.mt: Il-feriment fid-driegħ merkek wara li fieq.
formal.en: The wound on the arm formed a scar after it healed.
formal.zh: 手臂上的伤口愈合后形成了疤痕。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-feriment f'idek fieq? Mark: Iva, imma merkek u ħalla sinjal żgħir.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has the wound on your hand healed? Mark: Yes, but it scarred over and left a small mark.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你手上的伤口好了吗？马克：好了，不过愈合后留了一小道疤。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你手上的伤口好了吗？
messages.en: Has the wound on your hand healed?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma merkek u ħalla sinjal żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma merkek u ħalla sinjal żgħir.
messages.zh: 好了，不过愈合后留了一小道疤。
messages.en: Yes, but it scarred over and left a small mark.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一个完整画面：伤口先愈合，随后留下疤；merkek 的主角是这个伤口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The metallic substance known as mercury.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 名为汞的金属物质，通称水银。
