teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sustanza metallika magħrufa bħala merkurju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汞，通称水银，一种金属元素。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tindika li dan it-termometru fih il-merkurju.
formal.en: The label indicates that this thermometer contains mercury.
formal.zh: 标签注明，这支温度计含有水银。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan it-termometru fih il-merkurju? Rita: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this thermometer contain mercury? Rita: Yes, that is what the label says.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这支温度计里面有水银吗？丽塔：有，标签上是这样写的。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这支温度计里面有水银吗？
messages.en: Does this thermometer contain mercury?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 有，标签上是这样写的。
messages.en: Yes, that is what the label says.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 merkurju 和水银温度计的画面配对记忆：看到这个词，就想到金属汞。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deteriorate through decay, rot, or erosion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因腐朽、腐烂或侵蚀而逐渐损坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeterjora jew jittiekel bil-mod minħabba taħsir jew erożjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腐朽；逐渐衰败或损坏。
腐烂；因腐败而变质或损坏。
侵蚀；逐渐磨损或蚀去。

formal.mt: Maż-żmien, l-injam mermer minħabba l-umdità.
formal.en: Over time, the wood rotted because of the damp.
formal.zh: 随着时间推移，木材因潮湿而腐烂了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan l-injam jinkiser daqshekk malajr? Toni: Għax mermer; ara kemm sar dgħajjef.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does this wood break so easily? Toni: Because it has rotted; look how weak it has become.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块木头怎么这么容易断？托尼：因为它腐烂了，你看它变得多不结实。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan l-injam jinkiser daqshekk malajr?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan l-injam jinkiser daqshekk malajr?
messages.zh: 这块木头怎么这么容易断？
messages.en: Why does this wood break so easily?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax mermer; ara kemm sar dgħajjef.
messages.mt_standard: Għax mermer; ara kemm sar dgħajjef.
messages.zh: 因为它腐烂了，你看它变得多不结实。
messages.en: Because it has rotted; look how weak it has become.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用木头慢慢腐烂、岩石慢慢被侵蚀的连续画面记 mermer，重点是正在发生的变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or condition of decay, rot, or erosion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 腐朽、腐烂或侵蚀这一过程或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew il-qagħda ta' taħsir, deterjorament jew erożjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腐朽；逐渐衰败或损坏的过程或状态。
腐烂；物质腐败变质的过程或状态。
侵蚀；物质逐渐被磨损或蚀去的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-mermir tal-injam fil-bieb il-qadim.
formal.en: The report describes the decay of the wood in the old door.
formal.zh: 报告描述了旧门木材的腐朽情况。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhuma dawn is-sinjali fuq l-injam? Ġużeppi: Huma sinjali ta' mermir; l-injam qed jitħassar.
colloquial.en: Nina: What are these marks on the wood? Ġużeppi: They are signs of rot; the wood is deteriorating.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：木头上的这些痕迹是什么？朱塞佩：这是腐烂的迹象，木头正在朽坏。

messages.speaker: Nina (屋主)
messages.zh: 木头上的这些痕迹是什么？
messages.en: What are these marks on the wood?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Huma sinjali ta' mermir; l-injam qed jitħassar.
messages.mt_standard: Huma sinjali ta' mermir; l-injam qed jitħassar.
messages.zh: 这是腐烂的迹象，木头正在朽坏。
messages.en: They are signs of rot; the wood is deteriorating.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mermir 放进“出现了腐烂迹象”这句话里记忆；它给腐烂或侵蚀这个过程命名，是名词。

gloss_zh: 结果实，通常指非当季结果

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce fruit, usually outside the usual fruiting season.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 结出果实，通常用于描述在正常结果季节之外结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti l-frott, ġeneralment barra mill-istaġun tas-soltu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to yield fruit (usually used for out of season fruits)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 结果实；通常用于描述非当季结果的情况。

formal.mt: Din is-sena, it-tin fil-ġnien merraħ barra mill-istaġun tas-soltu.
formal.en: This year, the fig tree in the garden yielded fruit outside its usual season.
formal.zh: 今年，花园里的无花果树在正常结果季节之外结出了果实。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan it-tin merraħ issa? Pawlu: Iva, ta l-frott barra mill-istaġun tas-soltu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Has this fig tree yielded fruit now? Pawlu: Yes, it produced fruit outside its usual season.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这棵无花果树在这个时候结果了？保罗：是啊，它在正常结果季节之外结了果。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 这棵无花果树在这个时候结果了？
messages.en: Has this fig tree yielded fruit now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ta l-frott barra mill-istaġun tas-soltu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ta l-frott barra mill-istaġun tas-soltu.
messages.zh: 是啊，它在正常结果季节之外结了果。
messages.en: Yes, it produced fruit outside its usual season.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象翻过正常采果季节的日历，树上却又结了果；用这个意外结果的画面记 merraħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave or cause a scar on someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某物留下疤痕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħalli jew jikkawża merk fuq xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使留下疤痕；在某人或某物上造成疤痕。

formal.mt: Il-feriment merrek il-ġilda u ħalla sinjal li baqa' jidher wara l-fejqan.
formal.en: The injury scarred the skin and left a mark that remained visible after healing.
formal.zh: 这次受伤使皮肤留下了疤痕，愈合后仍能看见。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Minn fejn ġie dak is-sinjal fuq driegħek? Mark: Inċident żgħir merrek il-ġilda hemmhekk.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where did that mark on your arm come from? Mark: A minor accident scarred the skin there.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你手臂上的那个印记是怎么来的？马克：一次小意外让那里的皮肤留了疤。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġie dak is-sinjal fuq driegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġie dak is-sinjal fuq driegħek?
messages.zh: 你手臂上的那个印记是怎么来的？
messages.en: Where did that mark on your arm come from?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 一次小意外让那里的皮肤留了疤。
messages.en: A minor accident scarred the skin there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这次受伤使皮肤留疤”记 merrek，抓住“使……留疤”；与伤口自己愈合留疤的 merkek 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing plenty of juice, especially when describing fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有丰富汁液的，尤其用于形容水果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih ħafna meraq, speċjalment meta jingħad għall-frott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多汁的；汁液丰富的。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, agħżel frott frisk u merrieqi.
formal.en: For this recipe, choose fresh, juicy fruit.
formal.zh: 制作这道食谱时，请选择新鲜多汁的水果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu l-ħawħ illum? Pawlu: Ħelu u merrieqi ħafna. Trid idduq?
colloquial.en: Maja: What are the peaches like today? Pawlu: Sweet and very juicy. Would you like a taste?
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天的桃子怎么样？Pawlu：很甜，而且汁水很多。你想尝尝吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天的桃子怎么样？
messages.en: What are the peaches like today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (水果摊贩)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħelu u merrieqi ħafna. Trid idduq?
messages.mt_standard: Ħelu u merrieqi ħafna. Trid idduq?
messages.zh: 很甜，而且汁水很多。你想尝尝吗？
messages.en: Sweet and very juicy. Would you like a taste?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 merrieqi 和咬开桃子、汁水流出的画面一起记，再朗读 frott merrieqi，建立“多汁”的直接联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to produce fruit outside the usual fruiting season.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有在正常结果季节之外结果的倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħti l-frott barra mill-istaġun tas-soltu.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to fructify out of season
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于在非当季结实的；容易在正常结果季节之外结果的。

collocations.en: a fig tree tending to bear fruit out of season
collocations.zh: 倾向于非当季结果的无花果树

collocations.en: a type tending to bear fruit out of season
collocations.zh: 倾向于非当季结果的类型

formal.mt: Il-bidwi għażel tip merrieħi ta' tin li għandu tendenza jagħti l-frott barra mill-istaġun.
formal.en: The farmer selected a type of fig tree that tends to bear fruit out of season.
formal.zh: 农民选择了一种倾向于在非当季结果的无花果树。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan it-tin għadu jagħti l-frott? Toni: Għax hu tin merrieħi; għandu tendenza jagħti l-frott barra mill-istaġun.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is this fig tree still bearing fruit? Toni: Because it is a fig tree that tends to bear fruit out of season.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这棵无花果树怎么还在结果？托尼：因为它有非当季结果的习性。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan it-tin għadu jagħti l-frott?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan it-tin għadu jagħti l-frott?
messages.zh: 这棵无花果树怎么还在结果？
messages.en: Why is this fig tree still bearing fruit?

messages.speaker: Toni (园主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu tin merrieħi; għandu tendenza jagħti l-frott barra mill-istaġun.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu tin merrieħi; għandu tendenza jagħti l-frott barra mill-istaġun.
messages.zh: 因为它有非当季结果的习性。
messages.en: Because it is a fig tree that tends to bear fruit out of season.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给树挂上“有非当季结果习性”的标签来记 merrieħi；它描述一种倾向，而不只是某一次结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Food and other everyday consumable goods bought for regular household use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 家庭日常使用和消耗的食品及其他杂货。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel u oġġetti oħra li jinxtraw għall-użu u l-konsum ta' kuljum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食品杂货；日常消耗的商品。

formal.mt: Il-familja tixtri l-merċa darba fil-ġimgħa u żżomm lista tal-affarijiet meħtieġa.
formal.en: The family buys groceries once a week and keeps a list of the things needed.
formal.zh: 这家人每周采购一次食品杂货，并保留一份所需物品清单。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għandna bżonn mill-ħanut? Mark: Ħalib, ħobż u bajd; se nixtri l-merċa wara x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: What do we need from the shop? Mark: Milk, bread and eggs; I'll buy the groceries after work.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们需要从店里买些什么？马克：牛奶、面包和鸡蛋；我下班后去买食品杂货。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 我们需要从店里买些什么？
messages.en: What do we need from the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħalib, ħobż u bajd; se nixtri l-merċa wara x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Ħalib, ħobż u bajd; se nixtri l-merċa wara x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 牛奶、面包和鸡蛋；我下班后去买食品杂货。
messages.en: Milk, bread and eggs; I'll buy the groceries after work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象购物袋里装着牛奶、面包和鸡蛋，把整袋日常消耗的东西标成 merċa，按购物场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small quantity of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种东西的少量；一点儿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont żgħir ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 少量；一点儿。

formal.mt: Żid merħa ilma mat-taħlita u ħawwad bil-mod.
formal.en: Add a small amount of water to the mixture and stir slowly.
formal.zh: 往混合物中加入少量水，然后慢慢搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kemm melħ se nżid? Pawlu: Merħa melħ biss, imbagħad induqu s-soppa.
colloquial.en: Marta: How much salt shall I add? Pawlu: Just a small amount of salt, then we'll taste the soup.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我要加多少盐？保罗：只加一点儿盐，然后我们尝尝汤。

messages.speaker: Marta (做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 我要加多少盐？
messages.en: How much salt shall I add?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Merħa melħ biss, imbagħad induqu s-soppa.
messages.mt_standard: Merħa melħ biss, imbagħad induqu s-soppa.
messages.zh: 只加一点儿盐，然后我们尝尝汤。
messages.en: Just a small amount of salt, then we'll taste the soup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 merħa 和“只要一点儿”的厨房动作一起记：少倒一点水、少放一点盐，重点是数量少，不是固定计量单位。

gloss_zh: 松弛的；液化的；软垂无力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Loose rather than taut, liquefied, or limp and lacking firmness, depending on what is described.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随所描述的对象，可表示松弛不紧的、已经液化的，或软垂无力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mhux miġbud jew issikkat; magħmul likwidu; jew bla saħħa u bla ebusija, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松的；松弛的；没有拉紧或固定紧的。
液化的；变为液体状态的。
软垂的；松软无力、缺乏挺度的。

formal.mt: Il-ħabel għandu jkun miġbud sew; jekk jibqa' merħi, it-tagħbija tista' tiċċaqlaq.
formal.en: The rope should be pulled tight; if it remains slack, the load may shift.
formal.zh: 绳子应当拉紧；如果仍然松弛，货物可能会移位。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ħabel għadu merħi? Mark: Iva, hemm bżonn niġbduh ftit iktar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this rope still slack? Mark: Yes, we need to pull it a little tighter.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这根绳子还是松的吗？马克：是的，我们得再拉紧一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (搬家帮手)
messages.zh: 这根绳子还是松的吗？
messages.en: Is this rope still slack?

messages.speaker: Mark (搬家帮手)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm bżonn niġbduh ftit iktar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm bżonn niġbduh ftit iktar.
messages.zh: 是的，我们得再拉紧一点。
messages.en: Yes, we need to pull it a little tighter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记 merħi：绳子松下来、黄油化成液体、手臂软垂下来；根据搭配分别选松弛、液化或无力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give off light as a flash or as rays spreading outward.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以闪光的形式发光，或向外发出、放射光线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħroġ dawl bħala leħħa jew bħala raġġi li jinfirxu 'l barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪光；突然发出短暂的亮光。
发出光线；射出一道道光。
放射；向外散发光芒。

collocations.en: gave off light in the darkness

formal.mt: Matul il-prova, il-fanal merżaq għal mument u mbagħad intefa.
formal.en: During the test, the lamp flashed for a moment and then went out.
formal.zh: 测试期间，灯闪亮了一瞬间，随后熄灭。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt dak id-dawl? Mark: Iva, il-fanal merżaq għal mument biss.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see that light? Mark: Yes, the lamp flashed for just a moment.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你看到刚才那道亮光了吗？Mark：看到了，那盏灯只闪了一下。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到刚才那道亮光了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that light?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-fanal merżaq għal mument biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-fanal merżaq għal mument biss.
messages.zh: 看到了，那盏灯只闪了一下。
messages.en: Yes, the lamp flashed for just a moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 merżaq 配三幅连续画面：灯闪一下、射出光线、光芒向外散开，分别对应三个动词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A beam of light traveling in a particular direction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿某一方向照射的一束光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Faxx ta' dawl li jimxi f'direzzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一束光；光束。

formal.mt: Merżuq irqiq daħal mit-tieqa u dawwal parti mill-art.
formal.en: A narrow beam of light entered through the window and illuminated part of the floor.
formal.zh: 一道细窄的光束从窗户照进来，照亮了部分地面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm linja ta' dawl mal-art? Toni: Dak merżuq li dieħel mit-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there a line of light on the floor? Toni: That's a beam of light coming through the window.
colloquial.zh: Lara：地上为什么有一道光？Toni：那是从窗户照进来的一束光。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm linja ta' dawl mal-art?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm linja ta' dawl mal-art?
messages.zh: 地上为什么有一道光？
messages.en: Why is there a line of light on the floor?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是从窗户照进来的一束光。
messages.en: That's a beam of light coming through the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗帘缝里照进来的一束光，把这束可指出的光叫作 merżuq；与表示发光动作的 merżaq 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plantain, meaning a plant belonging to the genus Plantago.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 车前属（Plantago）的植物，通常称为车前草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li tappartjeni għall-ġeneru Plantago.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 车前属及其各物种的植物；车前草。

formal.mt: Għall-eżerċizzju tal-botanika, l-istudenti osservaw pjanta tal-mesbula u għamlu tpinġija tagħha.
formal.en: For the botany exercise, the students observed a plantain plant and drew it.
formal.zh: 在植物学练习中，学生们观察了一株车前草，并把它画了下来。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif jisimha din il-pjanta? Rita: Din mesbula. Tista' tpinġi werqa tagħha għall-eżerċizzju.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is this plant called? Rita: This is plantain. You can draw one of its leaves for the exercise.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这种植物叫什么？Rita：这是车前草。你可以画一片它的叶子来完成练习。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din mesbula. Tista' tpinġi werqa tagħha għall-eżerċizzju.
messages.mt_standard: Din mesbula. Tista' tpinġi werqa tagħha għall-eżerċizzju.
messages.zh: 这是车前草。你可以画一片它的叶子来完成练习。
messages.en: This is plantain. You can draw one of its leaves for the exercise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张植物图卡，正面写 mesbula，背面写“车前草、Plantago”；用植物画面固定词义，避免和食用大蕉混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mosque, a place where Muslims gather for prayer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清真寺，即穆斯林聚集礼拜的场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn il-Musulmani jinġabru għat-talb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 清真寺；伊斯兰教的礼拜场所。

formal.mt: Il-grupp se jiltaqa' quddiem id-daħla tal-meskita qabel tibda ż-żjara.
formal.en: The group will meet in front of the mosque entrance before the visit begins.
formal.zh: 参观开始前，小组将在清真寺入口前集合。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu mal-gwida? Sami: Quddiem il-meskita, ħdejn id-daħla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we meeting the guide? Sami: In front of the mosque, by the entrance.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们在哪里和导游碰面？Sami：在清真寺前面，入口旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里和导游碰面？
messages.en: Where are we meeting the guide?

messages.speaker: Sami (同行游客)
messages.zh: 在清真寺前面，入口旁边。
messages.en: In front of the mosque, by the entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 meskita 写在旅行地图的清真寺图标旁，再练习“清真寺入口”id-daħla tal-meskita，用地点和短语共同记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wipe a surface vigorously, or to spread a substance over a surface by smearing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力擦拭表面，或将某种物质涂抹在表面上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li timsaħ wiċċ bil-qawwa, jew li tifrex sustanza fuq wiċċ billi tgħaddiha fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力擦拭；使劲擦。
涂抹；把某种物质抹开。

collocations.en: wiped the table vigorously with a cloth
smeared the paint over the board

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem meslaħ il-wiċċ tal-mejda b'ċarruta biex ineħħi t-tbajja'.
formal.en: The worker wiped the tabletop vigorously with a cloth to remove the stains.
formal.zh: 工人用布使劲擦拭桌面，以去除污渍。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'għamel Toni biż-żebgħa? Lara: Meslaħ iż-żebgħa fuq il-bord b'subgħajh.
colloquial.en: Rita: What did Toni do with the paint? Lara: He smeared the paint over the board with his finger.
colloquial.zh: Rita：Toni拿颜料做了什么？Lara：他用手指把颜料涂抹在板上。

messages.speaker: Rita (美术教师)
messages.zh: Toni拿颜料做了什么？
messages.en: What did Toni do with the paint?

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 他用手指把颜料涂抹在板上。
messages.en: He smeared the paint over the board with his finger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 meslaħ 配两个手部动作：拿布使劲擦、用手指抹开颜料；分别记住“用力擦拭”和“涂抹”。

gloss_zh: 容易抹开的；容易蹭花的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to smear or spread into marks when touched or rubbed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 触碰或摩擦时容易抹开、蹭花或留下涂抹痕迹的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jinfirex u jħalli marki meta jintmess jew jingħorok.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易抹开的；容易因触碰或摩擦而蹭花的。

formal.mt: Il-kulur għadu meslieħi; evita li tmiss it-tpinġija sakemm jinxef.
formal.en: The colour still smears easily; avoid touching the drawing until it dries.
formal.zh: 颜色仍然容易蹭花；请等它干了以后再触碰画面。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nmiss it-tpinġija? Mark: Stenna ftit; dan il-kulur għadu meslieħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I touch the drawing? Mark: Wait a little; this colour still smears easily.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我可以碰这幅画吗？Mark：再等一会儿，这个颜色还很容易蹭花。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 我可以碰这幅画吗？
messages.en: Can I touch the drawing?

messages.speaker: Mark (美术教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit; dan il-kulur għadu meslieħi.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit; dan il-kulur għadu meslieħi.
messages.zh: 再等一会儿，这个颜色还很容易蹭花。
messages.en: Wait a little; this colour still smears easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指碰到未干的颜色，画面立刻被蹭花；用 meslieħi 描述这种“容易抹开”的性质，配合 kulur meslieħi 记忆。

gloss_zh: 不停地换地方；不断变换位置

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep moving from one place or position to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不断从一个地方或位置换到另一个地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibiddel il-post fejn ikun darba wara l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不停地换地方；反复变换所在的位置。

collocations.en: kept moving from one chair to another
collocations.zh: 不停地从一把椅子换到另一把椅子

collocations.en: kept moving from one room to another
collocations.zh: 不停地从一个房间换到另一个房间

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, it-tifel mesrek minn siġġu għal ieħor u ma baqax fl-istess post.
formal.en: During the meeting, the boy kept moving from one chair to another and did not stay in the same place.
formal.zh: 开会期间，男孩不停地换椅子坐，没有一直待在同一个位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu mesrek minn kamra għal oħra dalgħodu? Lara: Għax ma sabx post kwiet biex jistudja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu keep moving from one room to another this morning? Lara: Because he couldn't find a quiet place to study.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗今天早上为什么不停地换房间？拉拉：因为他找不到安静的地方学习。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu mesrek minn kamra għal oħra dalgħodu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu mesrek minn kamra għal oħra dalgħodu?
messages.zh: 保罗今天早上为什么不停地换房间？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu keep moving from one room to another this morning?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma sabx post kwiet biex jistudja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma sabx post kwiet biex jistudja.
messages.zh: 因为他找不到安静的地方学习。
messages.en: Because he couldn't find a quiet place to study.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人一会儿换椅子，一会儿换房间，用连续换位的画面记住 mesrek。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To handle something or touch it repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手拿弄某物，或对某物反复触摸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqbad xi ħaġa b'idejh jew imissha ħafna drabi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用手拿弄、摆弄某物。
多次触摸；反复摸弄。

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività, it-tifel messes il-materjali differenti biex jesplora n-nisġa tagħhom.
formal.en: During the activity, the boy handled the different materials to explore their textures.
formal.zh: 活动期间，男孩用手拿弄不同的材料，感受它们的纹理。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min messes il-buttuni kollha tar-radju? Mark: It-tifel; ried jara kif jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who kept touching all the buttons on the radio? Mark: The boy; he wanted to see how it worked.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁把收音机上的按钮都摸了个遍？马克：那个男孩，他想看看收音机是怎么工作的。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 谁把收音机上的按钮都摸了个遍？
messages.en: Who kept touching all the buttons on the radio?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 那个男孩，他想看看收音机是怎么工作的。
messages.en: The boy; he wanted to see how it worked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 messes 配上双手拿起物品、来回摸弄的动作，同时记住拿弄和反复触摸两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who habitually touches things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 习惯伸手触摸各种东西的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha d-drawwa li tmiss l-affarijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who tends to touch things
sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜欢或习惯触摸东西的人。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to touch things
a curious person who tends to touch things
collocations.zh: 一个好奇而爱摸东西的人

formal.mt: It-tifel huwa messies: waqt iż-żjara fil-mużew, kellu bżonn tfakkira biex ma jmissx l-oġġetti esposti.
formal.en: The boy tends to touch things: during the museum visit, he needed a reminder not to touch the exhibits.
formal.zh: 这个男孩爱摸东西：参观博物馆时，需要有人提醒他不要触摸展品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex poġġejt il-vażun fuq l-ixkaffa ta' fuq? Maja: Għax ħija messies u jibqa' jaqbad kull ħaġa li jara.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you put the vase on the top shelf? Maja: Because my brother tends to touch things and keeps picking up everything he sees.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么把花瓶放到最上层的架子上？玛雅：因为我弟弟爱摸东西，看到什么都要拿起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex poġġejt il-vażun fuq l-ixkaffa ta' fuq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex poġġejt il-vażun fuq l-ixkaffa ta' fuq?
messages.zh: 你为什么把花瓶放到最上层的架子上？
messages.en: Why did you put the vase on the top shelf?

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħija messies u jibqa' jaqbad kull ħaġa li jara.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħija messies u jibqa' jaqbad kull ħaġa li jara.
messages.zh: 因为我弟弟爱摸东西，看到什么都要拿起来。
messages.en: Because my brother tends to touch things and keeps picking up everything he sees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给总想伸手摸展品的人贴上 messies 标签，记住这个名词说的是人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to touch things or stroke them affectionately.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于触摸东西，或喜欢用手轻轻抚弄的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jmiss l-affarijiet jew iżiegħel bihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱触摸或抚弄的；有触摸或爱抚倾向的。

collocations.en: a boy inclined to touch things
collocations.zh: 一个爱触摸东西的男孩

collocations.en: inclined to touch and fondle toys
collocations.zh: 喜欢触摸和抚弄玩具的

formal.mt: It-tifel huwa messiesi mal-ġugarelli rotob u jħobb jgħaddi idu fuqhom.
formal.en: The boy likes touching and fondling soft toys and enjoys running his hand over them.
formal.zh: 这个男孩喜欢触摸、抚弄柔软的玩具，爱用手轻轻摸过它们。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex it-tifel dejjem iżomm l-ors f'idu? Lara: Għax hu messiesi u jħobb imiss il-pil artab tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why does the boy always hold the teddy bear? Lara: Because he likes touching and fondling things, and he enjoys feeling its soft fur.
colloquial.zh: 马克：男孩为什么总是抱着那只玩具熊？拉拉：因为他喜欢摸摸弄弄，爱摸它柔软的绒毛。

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-tifel dejjem iżomm l-ors f'idu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-tifel dejjem iżomm l-ors f'idu?
messages.zh: 男孩为什么总是抱着那只玩具熊？
messages.en: Why does the boy always hold the teddy bear?

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu messiesi u jħobb imiss il-pil artab tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu messiesi u jħobb imiss il-pil artab tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为他喜欢摸摸弄弄，爱摸它柔软的绒毛。
messages.en: Because he likes touching and fondling things, and he enjoys feeling its soft fur.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子轻抚毛绒玩具，用 messiesi 描述爱摸爱抚弄的特点，注意它是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who wipes or scrubs surfaces to clean them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过擦拭或用力擦洗来清洁物体表面的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li timsaħ jew togħrok l-uċuħ biex tnaddafhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擦拭或擦洗物体表面的人。

collocations.en: a person who wipes or scrubs floors

formal.mt: Il-messieħ tal-art naddaf il-kuritur qabel ma waslu l-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The floor cleaner wiped the corridor clean before the visitors arrived.
formal.zh: 擦洗地面的人员在访客到达前把走廊擦干净了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ħdejn it-tieqa? Mark: Dak il-messieħ tat-twieqi; qed ineħħi t-trab mill-ħġieġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that by the window? Mark: That's the window cleaner; he's wiping the dust off the glass.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：窗边那个人是谁？马克：那是擦窗户的人，他正在擦掉玻璃上的灰尘。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 窗边那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that by the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-messieħ tat-twieqi; qed ineħħi t-trab mill-ħġieġ.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-messieħ tat-twieqi; qed ineħħi t-trab mill-ħġieġ.
messages.zh: 那是擦窗户的人，他正在擦掉玻璃上的灰尘。
messages.en: That's the window cleaner; he's wiping the dust off the glass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手拿抹布认真擦窗的人，用这个人物画面记住 messieħ 指擦拭者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A saviour figure expected or recognized within a religious belief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教信仰中所期待或认定的救赎者，即弥赛亚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Salvatur mistenni jew magħruf bħala tali fi twemmin reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弥赛亚；宗教信仰中的救世主或救赎者。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi t-tama tal-komunità fil-miġja tal-messija.
formal.en: The text describes the community's hope for the coming of the messiah.
formal.zh: 这篇文本描述了该群体对弥赛亚到来的期盼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma messija f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Hawnhekk tfisser is-salvatur li l-komunità qed tistenna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word messiah mean in this text? Pawlu: Here it means the saviour whom the community is awaiting.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文本里的 messija 是什么意思？保罗：这里指这个群体正在等待的救世主。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma messija f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma messija f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文本里的 messija 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word messiah mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk tfisser is-salvatur li l-komunità qed tistenna.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk tfisser is-salvatur li l-komunità qed tistenna.
messages.zh: 这里指这个群体正在等待的救世主。
messages.en: Here it means the saviour whom the community is awaiting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 messija、英语 messiah 和中文弥赛亚并排做成词卡，再配上等待救赎者的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of wiping a surface, for example with a cloth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 擦拭表面的动作或一次擦拭，例如用布擦一下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li timsaħ wiċċ, pereżempju b'ċarruta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次擦拭；擦一下的动作。

formal.mt: Qabel l-użu, agħti mesħa lill-wiċċ tal-mejda b'ċarruta nadifa.
formal.en: Before use, give the tabletop a wipe with a clean cloth.
formal.zh: 使用前，请用干净的布擦一下桌面。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-mejda għadha mxarrba. Ben: Nagħtiha mesħa oħra b'ċarruta niexfa.
colloquial.en: Anna: The table is still wet. Ben: I'll give it another wipe with a dry cloth.
colloquial.zh: Anna：桌子还湿着。Ben：我用干布再擦一下。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 桌子还湿着。
messages.en: The table is still wet.

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 我用干布再擦一下。
messages.en: I'll give it another wipe with a dry cloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿布在桌面擦一下，把这一回擦拭叫作 mesħa；连同 agħti mesħa“擦一下”整块记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A measure used to assess or compare an aspect of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于评估或比较某事物某一方面的衡量指标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kejl li jintuża biex jiġi evalwat jew imqabbel xi aspett ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指标；用来衡量某事物的度量标准。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juża l-ħin medju ta' stennija bħala metrika tal-kwalità tas-servizz.
formal.en: The report uses average waiting time as a metric of service quality.
formal.zh: 该报告把平均等候时间作为衡量服务质量的一项指标。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif se nkunu nafu jekk il-proġett irnexxiex? Mark: Ejja nużaw in-numru ta' parteċipanti bħala metrika tas-suċċess.
colloquial.en: Lara: How will we know whether the project was successful? Mark: Let's use the number of participants as a success metric.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们怎么知道这个项目是否成功？马克：就用参与人数作为衡量成功的指标吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nkunu nafu jekk il-proġett irnexxiex?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nkunu nafu jekk il-proġett irnexxiex?
messages.zh: 我们怎么知道这个项目是否成功？
messages.en: How will we know whether the project was successful?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nużaw in-numru ta' parteċipanti bħala metrika tas-suċċess.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nużaw in-numru ta' parteċipanti bħala metrika tas-suċċess.
messages.zh: 就用参与人数作为衡量成功的指标吧。
messages.en: Let's use the number of participants as a success metric.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 metrika 就想一张写着参与人数和等候时间的指标卡，记住它回答用什么衡量。

gloss_zh: 使用小折刀；用小折刀刺或削

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use a small folding knife, for example to stab.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用小折刀进行动作，例如刺扎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża sikkina żgħira tal-but, pereżempju biex jagħti daqqa biha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to use a pen-knife (e.g. to stab)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用小折刀，例如用它刺扎。

collocations.en: worked on a piece of wood with a penknife
collocations.zh: 用小折刀加工了一块木头

collocations.en: used a penknife to remove the bark

formal.mt: L-artiġjan mewwes biċċa injam biex jagħtiha l-forma mixtieqa.
formal.en: The craftsperson worked on a piece of wood with a penknife to give it the desired shape.
formal.zh: 工匠用小折刀加工一块木头，把它削成所需的形状。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif neħħa l-qoxra minn dik il-fergħa? Pawlu: Mewwes biex ineħħiha; uża s-sikkina żgħira tal-but tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he remove the bark from that branch? Pawlu: He used a penknife to remove it; he used his small pocket knife.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他是怎么把那根树枝的皮削掉的？保罗：他用小折刀削掉的，用的是他自己的小口袋刀。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif neħħa l-qoxra minn dik il-fergħa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif neħħa l-qoxra minn dik il-fergħa?
messages.zh: 他是怎么把那根树枝的皮削掉的？
messages.en: How did he remove the bark from that branch?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mewwes biex ineħħiha; uża s-sikkina żgħira tal-but tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Mewwes biex ineħħiha; uża s-sikkina żgħira tal-but tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他用小折刀削掉的，用的是他自己的小口袋刀。
messages.en: He used a penknife to remove it; he used his small pocket knife.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工匠打开小折刀加工木头，把 mewwes 和使用小折刀的动作连起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Habitually using a penknife to carry out small tasks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 习惯使用小折刀做事的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu d-drawwa juża mus għal xogħlijiet żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯常使用小折刀的；有使用小折刀习惯的。

collocations.en: a man who habitually uses a penknife
a worker who habitually uses a penknife
collocations.zh: 习惯用小折刀做事的工人

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem mewwiesi kien juża mus biex jaqta' l-ispag u jiftaħ il-pakketti.
formal.en: The worker, who habitually used a penknife, would use one to cut string and open parcels.
formal.zh: 这位惯用小折刀的工人常用小折刀割绳子、拆包裹。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex dejjem tuża mus biex tiftaħ il-pakketti? Toni: Jien mewwiesi; drajt nużah għal dawn l-affarijiet.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why do you always use a penknife to open parcels? Toni: I am a habitual penknife user; I have got used to using it for these things.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你怎么总用小折刀拆包裹？托尼：我习惯用小折刀了，这些事情我都用它来做。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dejjem tuża mus biex tiftaħ il-pakketti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dejjem tuża mus biex tiftaħ il-pakketti?
messages.zh: 你怎么总用小折刀拆包裹？
messages.en: Why do you always use a penknife to open parcels?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien mewwiesi; drajt nużah għal dawn l-affarijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Jien mewwiesi; drajt nużah għal dawn l-affarijiet.
messages.zh: 我习惯用小折刀了，这些事情我都用它来做。
messages.en: I am a habitual penknife user; I have got used to using it for these things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个拆包裹、割细绳都惯用小折刀的人，重点记住经常使用这一习惯。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing death or capable of causing death.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 造成死亡或能够造成死亡的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jikkawża l-mewt jew li jista' jikkawżaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 致命的；足以造成死亡的。

formal.mt: L-avviż iwissi li l-gass mewwieti jista' jikkawża l-mewt jekk jinġibed man-nifs.
formal.en: The notice warns that the deadly gas can cause death if inhaled.
formal.zh: 告示警告说，吸入这种致命气体可能导致死亡。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'hemm miktub fuq dak il-flixkun? Rita: Li fih velenu mewwieti. Tmissux.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does it say on that bottle? Rita: That it contains a deadly poison. Do not touch it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：那个瓶子上写着什么？丽塔：写着里面有致命毒物。别碰。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 那个瓶子上写着什么？
messages.en: What does it say on that bottle?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 写着里面有致命毒物。别碰。
messages.en: That it contains a deadly poison. Do not touch it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词贴在想象中的毒物警示标签上，记住它表示能够造成死亡。

gloss_zh: 使物体形成波浪状的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that makes another thing wavy or gives it a wave-like shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使其他东西产生波浪或形成波浪状的物件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tagħmel ħaġa oħra mmewġa jew tagħtiha forma ta' mewġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物形成波浪状的东西。

collocations.zh: 使头发形成波浪的工具

collocations.en: to use something that creates waviness
collocations.zh: 使用使物体形成波浪状的工具

formal.mt: Il-mewwieġ jintuża biex jagħti lix-xagħar forma ta' mewġ.
formal.en: The waving tool is used to give the hair a wavy shape.
formal.zh: 这种造波工具用于使头发形成波浪状。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Biex għamilt xagħrek hekk? Nina: Użajt mewwieġ biex nagħtih ftit mewġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did you use to do your hair like that? Nina: I used a waving tool to give it a few waves.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你用什么把头发弄成这样的？妮娜：我用了造波工具，让头发有一点波浪。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你用什么把头发弄成这样的？
messages.en: What did you use to do your hair like that?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Użajt mewwieġ biex nagħtih ftit mewġ.
messages.mt_standard: Użajt mewwieġ biex nagħtih ftit mewġ.
messages.zh: 我用了造波工具，让头发有一点波浪。
messages.en: I used a waving tool to give it a few waves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一件把直发变成波浪的工具：记住这个名词指造成波浪状的东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having waves or curves, or rising and falling in a wave-like way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有波浪般曲线的，或像波浪一样高低起伏的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma ta' mewġ jew li jogħla u jinżel bħal mewġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 波浪状的；带有波浪形弯曲的。
呈波浪般高低起伏的；绵延起伏的。

formal.mt: Il-pajsaġġ mewwieġi jidher ċar fir-ritratt, b'għoljiet li jogħlew u jinżlu waħda wara l-oħra.
formal.en: The undulating landscape is clearly visible in the photograph, with hills rising and falling one after another.
formal.zh: 照片中清楚可见起伏的地貌，山丘连绵，高低交替。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xagħrek dritt jew mewwieġi? Sara: Mewwieġi, speċjalment meta nħallih jinxef waħdu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your hair straight or wavy? Sara: Wavy, especially when I let it dry naturally.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的头发是直的还是波浪状的？萨拉：波浪状的，尤其是让它自然晾干的时候。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的头发是直的还是波浪状的？
messages.en: Is your hair straight or wavy?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mewwieġi, speċjalment meta nħallih jinxef waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Mewwieġi, speċjalment meta nħallih jinxef waħdu.
messages.zh: 波浪状的，尤其是让它自然晾干的时候。
messages.en: Wavy, especially when I let it dry naturally.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把波浪卷发和连绵山丘放在同一画面里，二者都能用这个形容词描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bite something repeatedly, gradually wearing it away or eating it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用牙齿反复咬某物，逐渐将它磨损或吃掉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jigdem xi ħaġa għal darb'oħra u għal darb'oħra, u b'hekk inaqqasha jew jiekol minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啃；反复啮咬某物。

collocations.en: he gnawed a piece of wood

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl, il-ġurdien mexmex il-kaxxa tal-kartun u għamel toqba żgħira fiha.
formal.en: During the night, the mouse gnawed the cardboard box and made a small hole in it.
formal.zh: 夜里，老鼠啃咬纸板箱，在上面啃出了一个小洞。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min għamel dik it-toqba fil-kaxxa? Ben: Il-ġurdien mexmex il-kartun matul il-lejl.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who made that hole in the box? Ben: The mouse gnawed the cardboard during the night.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：箱子上的那个洞是谁弄的？本：老鼠夜里啃了纸板。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 箱子上的那个洞是谁弄的？
messages.en: Who made that hole in the box?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 老鼠夜里啃了纸板。
messages.en: The mouse gnawed the cardboard during the night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老鼠一小口一小口把纸箱啃出洞，抓住反复用牙齿啃咬的动作。

gloss_zh: 揩油者；搜食残物者；寻觅零碎残余的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who lives at others' expense, or someone who searches for scraps and leftovers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 靠占别人便宜过活的人，或搜寻零碎残物、剩余食物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Min jgħix minn fuq ħaddieħor, jew min ifittex fdalijiet u loqom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 揩油者；靠别人供养、占别人便宜的人。
搜寻、捡拾或取食遗留残物者；食腐者。
寻觅零碎残余或剩余食物的人。

collocations.mt: mexmiex li jgħix minn fuq ħaddieħor
collocations.en: a sponger who lives at others' expense
collocations.zh: 靠占别人便宜过活的揩油者
搜寻剩余食物的搜食者

collocations.en: a seeker of scraps collecting morsels
collocations.zh: 收集零星食物的寻食者

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-mexmiex kien jidher biss waqt l-ikel u qatt ma kien iħallas sehmu.
formal.en: In the story, the sponger appeared only at mealtimes and never paid his share.
formal.zh: 故事中的揩油者只在吃饭时出现，从不支付自己应承担的那一份。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu reġa' kiel magħna bla ma ħallas sehmu? Mark: Iva, qed iġib ruħu ta' mexmiex.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Pawlu eat with us again without paying his share? Mark: Yes, he is behaving like a sponger.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗又跟我们一起吃饭，却没付自己那份钱？马克：是啊，他这表现就是在揩油。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu reġa' kiel magħna bla ma ħallas sehmu?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu reġa' kiel magħna bla ma ħallas sehmu?
messages.zh: 保罗又跟我们一起吃饭，却没付自己那份钱？
messages.en: Did Pawlu eat with us again without paying his share?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed iġib ruħu ta' mexmiex.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed iġib ruħu ta' mexmiex.
messages.zh: 是啊，他这表现就是在揩油。
messages.en: Yes, he is behaving like a sponger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记义：一人总蹭别人的饭，另一人四处寻找残余；这个名词指这样的角色。

gloss_zh: 爱揩油的；倾向搜食残物的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to live at others' expense or to search for scraps and leftovers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有占别人便宜、依赖别人供养的倾向，或有搜寻残物、剩食的倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jgħix minn fuq ħaddieħor jew ifittex fdalijiet u loqom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于揩油的；爱占别人便宜、靠别人供养的。
倾向于搜寻、捡拾或取食遗留残物的。

collocations.en: a character inclined to sponge off others

formal.mt: Il-karattru mexmiexi fir-rumanz jistenna li sħabu jħallsu għalih, iżda hu qatt ma joffri li jħallas għalihom.
formal.en: The character inclined to sponge off others in the novel expects his friends to pay for him, but never offers to pay for them.
formal.zh: 小说中这个爱揩油的角色总指望朋友替他付钱，却从不主动替朋友付钱。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex tgħid li Pawlu mexmiexi? Toni: Għax dejjem jistenna li nħallsu aħna u hu qatt ma jagħti sehmu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you say Pawlu tends to sponge off others? Toni: Because he always expects us to pay and never contributes his share.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么说保罗爱揩油？托尼：因为他总等着我们付钱，自己从不出应出的那一份。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说保罗爱揩油？
messages.en: Why do you say Pawlu tends to sponge off others?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem jistenna li nħallsu aħna u hu qatt ma jagħti sehmu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem jistenna li nħallsu aħna u hu qatt ma jagħti sehmu.
messages.zh: 因为他总等着我们付钱，自己从不出应出的那一份。
messages.en: Because he always expects us to pay and never contributes his share.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记成描述倾向的形容词：可以说人爱蹭吃，也可以说动物爱搜食残物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The transitional season between summer and winter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 夏季与冬季之间的过渡时节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żmien ta' bejn is-sajf u x-xitwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夏季与冬季之间的时节。

collocations.en: during the season between summer and winter
collocations.zh: 在夏冬之间的过渡时节

collocations.en: clothes for the season between summer and winter
collocations.zh: 适合夏冬过渡时节穿的衣服

formal.mt: Fil-mezzutemp, il-viżitaturi għandhom iġibu ġakketta ħafifa għall-ħin ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: During the season between summer and winter, visitors should bring a light jacket for the evening.
formal.zh: 在夏冬之间的过渡时节，访客应带一件薄外套，供晚间穿着。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nieħu ġakketta miegħi? Mark: Iva, fil-mezzutemp filgħaxija jista' jagħmel il-bard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall I take a jacket with me? Mark: Yes, during the season between summer and winter it can get cold in the evening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我要带件外套吗？马克：要，夏冬之间这段时节，晚上可能会冷。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要带件外套吗？
messages.en: Shall I take a jacket with me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fil-mezzutemp filgħaxija jista' jagħmel il-bard.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fil-mezzutemp filgħaxija jista' jagħmel il-bard.
messages.zh: 要，夏冬之间这段时节，晚上可能会冷。
messages.en: Yes, during the season between summer and winter it can get cold in the evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用衣柜换季来记 mezzutemp：夏装尚未收完，冬装还未全上场，中间需要薄外套的那段时节。

gloss_zh: 吃东西时咂嘴作响的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes noticeable chewing or lip-smacking noises while eating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 咀嚼食物时发出明显声响、常咂嘴的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel ħsejjes b'ħalqha waqt li tomgħod l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咀嚼时发出明显声响的人；吃东西时咂嘴的人。

collocations.en: a noisy chewer at the table

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-mistieden huwa deskritt bħala meċlieq għax jagħmel ħafna ħsejjes waqt li jomgħod.
formal.en: In the story, the guest is described as a noisy chewer because he makes a lot of noise while chewing.
formal.zh: 故事把这位客人描写成一个吃东西咂嘴的人，因为他咀嚼时发出很大的声响。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser 'meċlieq'? Pawlu: Xi ħadd li jagħmel ħafna ħsejjes meta jomgħod, bħal dak ir-raġel fir-rakkont.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'meċlieq' mean? Pawlu: Someone who makes a lot of noise when chewing, like that man in the story.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：meċlieq 是什么意思？保罗：就是咀嚼时发出很大声响的人，像故事里的那个男人。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: meċlieq 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'meċlieq' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd li jagħmel ħafna ħsejjes meta jomgħod, bħal dak ir-raġel fir-rakkont.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd li jagħmel ħafna ħsejjes meta jomgħod, bħal dak ir-raġel fir-rakkont.
messages.zh: 就是咀嚼时发出很大声响的人，像故事里的那个男人。
messages.en: Someone who makes a lot of noise when chewing, like that man in the story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在词卡上画一个吃饭时咂嘴的人，并标注“名词，指人”，帮助记住 meċlieq 的重点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to smack the lips while chewing food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人在咀嚼食物时容易或习惯咂嘴作响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jagħmel ħsejjes b'xufftejh waqt li jomgħod.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to smack the lips when chewing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 咀嚼时容易咂嘴的；吃东西时习惯发出咂嘴声的。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to smack his lips while chewing
collocations.zh: 吃东西时爱咂嘴的男孩

collocations.en: a man who tends to smack his lips while chewing
collocations.zh: 咀嚼时习惯咂嘴的男人

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi tifel meċlieqi li jagħmel ħsejjes b'xufftejh waqt l-ikel.
formal.en: The author describes a boy who tends to smack his lips and makes noises with them while eating.
formal.zh: 作者描写了一个吃东西时爱咂嘴的男孩，他进食时会用嘴唇发出声响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex it-tifel fir-rakkont jissejjaħ 'meċlieqi'? Nina: Għax għandu d-drawwa jagħmel ħsejjes b'xufftejh meta jomgħod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the boy in the story called 'meċlieqi'? Nina: Because he has a habit of making noises with his lips when chewing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里为什么用 meċlieqi 形容那个男孩？妮娜：因为他咀嚼时有咂嘴作响的习惯。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里为什么用 meċlieqi 形容那个男孩？
messages.en: Why is the boy in the story called 'meċlieqi'?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu d-drawwa jagħmel ħsejjes b'xufftejh meta jomgħod.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu d-drawwa jagħmel ħsejjes b'xufftejh meta jomgħod.
messages.zh: 因为他咀嚼时有咂嘴作响的习惯。
messages.en: Because he has a habit of making noises with his lips when chewing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 meċlieqi 写在“男孩”旁边，读成“爱咂嘴的男孩”；用修饰人物的短语记牢形容词用法。

gloss_zh: 含糊地嘟囔；说话不清楚

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mumble or speak unclearly so that the words are difficult to make out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含含糊糊地说话或嘟囔，使别人难以听清具体词句。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem b'mod mhux ċar, hekk li jkun diffiċli tifhem il-kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含糊地嘟囔；咕哝。
说话含混不清，使人难以听清。

collocations.zh: 含糊地咕哝，没有清楚地说出来

formal.mt: Waqt l-intervista, il-kandidat meċmeċ it-tweġiba u l-intervistatur talbu jirrepetiha b'mod aktar ċar.
formal.en: During the interview, the candidate mumbled his answer, and the interviewer asked him to repeat it more clearly.
formal.zh: 面试时，应聘者含糊地说出了答案，面试官请他更清楚地重复一遍。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qal Mark? Meċmeċ u ma fhimtux. Nina: Qal li se jasal tard; nitolbuh jirrepeti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Mark say? He mumbled, and I didn't understand him. Nina: He said he'll arrive late; let's ask him to repeat it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克说了什么？他含糊地嘟囔，我没听懂。妮娜：他说会晚到；我们请他再说一遍吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qal Mark? Meċmeċ u ma fhimtux.
messages.mt_standard: X'qal Mark? Meċmeċ u ma fhimtux.
messages.zh: 马克说了什么？他含糊地嘟囔，我没听懂。
messages.en: What did Mark say? He mumbled, and I didn't understand him.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal li se jasal tard; nitolbuh jirrepeti.
messages.mt_standard: Qal li se jasal tard; nitolbuh jirrepeti.
messages.zh: 他说会晚到；我们请他再说一遍吧。
messages.en: He said he'll arrive late; let's ask him to repeat it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象对方说了一串模糊的话，你只好请他重说；用“听不清的说话动作”记住 meċmeċ。

gloss_zh: 说话爱嘟囔、含糊不清的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person who mumbles and does not pronounce words clearly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人说话爱嘟囔、吐字含糊不清。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi persuna li titkellem b'mod mhux ċar u ma tlissinx il-kliem ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容说话爱嘟囔、吐字含糊的人。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem meċmieċi kellu jirrepeti diversi sentenzi biex l-udjenza tifhmu.
formal.en: The speaker who mumbled had to repeat several sentences so that the audience could understand him.
formal.zh: 这位吐字含糊的发言者不得不重复好几句话，听众才能听懂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-karattru f'din l-istorja huwa meċmieċi, hux? Pawlu: Iva, il-kliem tiegħu mhux ċar u l-oħrajn spiss jitolbuh jirrepeti.
colloquial.en: Maja: The character in this story mumbles, doesn't he? Pawlu: Yes, his words are unclear, and the others often ask him to repeat himself.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个故事里的人物说话爱嘟囔，对吧？保罗：对，他说话不清楚，其他人常常请他再说一遍。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-karattru f'din l-istorja huwa meċmieċi, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Il-karattru f'din l-istorja huwa meċmieċi, hux?
messages.zh: 这个故事里的人物说话爱嘟囔，对吧？
messages.en: The character in this story mumbles, doesn't he?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kliem tiegħu mhux ċar u l-oħrajn spiss jitolbuh jirrepeti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kliem tiegħu mhux ċar u l-oħrajn spiss jitolbuh jirrepeti.
messages.zh: 对，他说话不清楚，其他人常常请他再说一遍。
messages.en: Yes, his words are unclear, and the others often ask him to repeat himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 meċmieċi 贴在一个说话含糊的人物画像旁，记作“这个人爱嘟囔”，突出它描写人的作用。

gloss_zh: 灯芯调高时火焰突然蹿旺

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a flame on a wick to flare up when the wick is raised.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指灯芯被调高时，其上的火焰突然变旺、蹿起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għan-nar fuq ftila meta jikber f'daqqa għax il-ftila tittella'.

sense_translations.en_definition: to flare up (used of a flame on a wick when the wick is raised)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然蹿旺；用于描述灯芯被调高时，其上的火焰突然变大的情形。

collocations.zh: 油灯的火焰突然蹿旺了

collocations.en: flared up when they raised the wick
collocations.zh: 他们调高灯芯时突然蹿旺了

formal.mt: Meta għollew il-ftila, in-nar tal-musbieħ meċċeċ u dawwal il-kamra aktar.
formal.en: When they raised the wick, the lamp flame flared up and lit the room more brightly.
formal.zh: 他们调高灯芯后，油灯的火焰突然蹿旺，把房间照得更亮了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex in-nar tal-musbieħ meċċeċ hekk? Mark: Għax għollejt il-ftila; issa nbaxxiha ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the lamp flame flare up like that? Mark: Because I raised the wick; I'll lower it a little now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：油灯的火怎么一下子蹿起来了？马克：因为我把灯芯调高了；我现在把它调低一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 油灯的火怎么一下子蹿起来了？
messages.en: Why did the lamp flame flare up like that?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għollejt il-ftila; issa nbaxxiha ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għollejt il-ftila; issa nbaxxiha ftit.
messages.zh: 因为我把灯芯调高了；我现在把它调低一点。
messages.en: Because I raised the wick; I'll lower it a little now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手把灯芯往上调，火焰随即蹿高；把这个完整画面与 meċċeċ 一起记住。

gloss_zh: 举止疯狂；像疯子一样胡闹

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave wildly or irrationally, as if one were mad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 举止失常、疯狂胡闹，表现得仿佛失去了理智。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'mod selvaġġ jew bla raġuni, bħallikieku kien miġnun.

sense_translations.en_definition: to act like a mad person
sense_translations.zh_definition: 像疯子一样行动；表现得疯狂或失去理智。

collocations.en: he acted wildly during the game
he acted like a mad person in front of everyone
collocations.zh: 他当着所有人的面表现得像疯子一样

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, ir-raġel meġnen waqt il-laqgħa u beda jgħajjat mingħajr raġuni ċara.
formal.en: According to the report, the man acted wildly during the meeting and began shouting for no clear reason.
formal.zh: 根据报告，该男子在会议中举止疯狂，并开始无缘无故地大喊。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex meġnen hekk waqt il-logħba? Mark: Irrabja għax it-tim tiegħu tilef, imma issa kkalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he act so wildly during the game? Mark: He got angry because his team lost, but he has calmed down now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他为什么在比赛中那样发疯胡闹？Mark：他因为自己的球队输了而生气，不过现在已经平静下来了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么在比赛中那样发疯胡闹？
messages.en: Why did he act so wildly during the game?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrabja għax it-tim tiegħu tilef, imma issa kkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Irrabja għax it-tim tiegħu tilef, imma issa kkalma.
messages.zh: 他因为自己的球队输了而生气，不过现在已经平静下来了。
messages.en: He got angry because his team lost, but he has calmed down now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象球迷输球后大喊乱跳的画面，把 meġnen 记作描述疯狂举动的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gift given to someone on the occasion of their wedding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为庆祝某人结婚而赠送的礼物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rigal li jingħata lil xi ħadd fl-okkażjoni tat-tieġ tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结婚礼物；为祝贺新人结婚而赠送的礼品。

collocations.en: give the couple a wedding gift
collocations.zh: 送给新人一份结婚礼物

formal.mt: Il-kollegi taw meħba lill-għarajjes bħala tifkira ta' din l-okkażjoni.
formal.en: The colleagues gave the couple a wedding gift as a memento of the occasion.
formal.zh: 同事们送给新人一份结婚礼物，作为这次喜庆时刻的纪念。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nagħtu lil Sara u lil Mark għat-tieġ? Rita: Nistgħu nixtru sett ta' tazzi bħala meħba.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we give Sara and Mark for their wedding? Rita: We can buy a set of glasses as a wedding gift.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：萨拉和马克结婚，我们送什么呢？丽塔：可以买一套玻璃杯当结婚礼物。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nagħtu lil Sara u lil Mark għat-tieġ?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nagħtu lil Sara u lil Mark għat-tieġ?
messages.zh: 萨拉和马克结婚，我们送什么呢？
messages.en: What shall we give Sara and Mark for their wedding?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nixtru sett ta' tazzi bħala meħba.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nixtru sett ta' tazzi bħala meħba.
messages.zh: 可以买一套玻璃杯当结婚礼物。
messages.en: We can buy a set of glasses as a wedding gift.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 meħba 写在送给新人的礼物卡上，并想象婚礼现场；记住它专指这份“贺婚礼物”。

gloss_zh: 倦怠迟钝的；昏昏欲睡的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lacking energy and responsiveness, or feeling sleepy and close to falling asleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人精神不振、行动反应迟缓，或困倦得快要睡着。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ftit enerġija u jirreaġixxi bil-mod, jew li jkun bi ngħas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倦怠而迟钝的；缺乏活力、反应缓慢的。
困倦的；昏昏欲睡的。

formal.mt: Wara lejl mingħajr irqad, l-istudent deher meħdul u kellu diffikultà biex jikkonċentra.
formal.en: After a sleepless night, the student appeared drowsy and had difficulty concentrating.
formal.zh: 一夜未眠后，这名学生显得昏昏欲睡，难以集中注意力。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed titkellem daqshekk bil-mod? Mark: Għadni meħdul bin-ngħas; għadni kemm qomt.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are you speaking so slowly? Mark: I'm still groggy with sleep; I've only just woken up.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你怎么说话这么慢？马克：我还困得迷迷糊糊的，刚刚才起床。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 你怎么说话这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you speaking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni meħdul bin-ngħas; għadni kemm qomt.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni meħdul bin-ngħas; għadni kemm qomt.
messages.zh: 我还困得迷迷糊糊的，刚刚才起床。
messages.en: I'm still groggy with sleep; I've only just woken up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚被叫醒的人：眼皮沉、反应慢、没有精神。用这个画面把 meħdul 的“倦怠”和“困倦”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The habit or act of putting something off, or a delay before something happens or is completed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把应该做的事推后的行为或习惯，也指事情发生或完成前的延迟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-drawwa jew l-att li wieħed iħalli xi ħaġa għal aktar tard, jew dewmien biex xi ħaġa sseħħ jew titlesta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖延；迟迟不着手做或完成应该做的事情。
延迟；事情发生、进行或完成得比预期更晚。

formal.mt: Id-dokumenti għandhom jintbagħtu bla meħer sabiex il-proċess ikun jista' jkompli.
formal.en: The documents should be sent without delay so that the process can continue.
formal.zh: 应立即寄送文件，以便流程能够继续进行。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għadek ma bdejtx ir-rapport? Paul: Le, imma biżżejjed meħer. Se nibda issa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Haven't you started the report yet? Paul: No, but enough procrastination. I'll start now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你还没开始写报告吗？保罗：还没有，不过不能再拖了。我现在就开始。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 你还没开始写报告吗？
messages.en: Haven't you started the report yet?

messages.speaker: Paul (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imma biżżejjed meħer. Se nibda issa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imma biżżejjed meħer. Se nibda issa.
messages.zh: 还没有，不过不能再拖了。我现在就开始。
messages.en: No, but enough procrastination. I'll start now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把待办清单上反复推到“明天”的任务想成 meħer；再用 bla meħer“毫不拖延”提醒自己马上行动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Needed for a purpose, or required by a rule, procedure, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为达到某个目的而不可缺少的，或由规则、程序及具体情况要求具备的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hemm bżonnu għal xi għan, jew li jintalab minn regola, proċedura jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 必要的；为实现某个目的而需要的。
所要求的；按规定或具体要求必须具备的。

formal.mt: Kull applikant għandu jippreżenta d-dokument meħtieġ qabel ma tiġi eżaminata l-applikazzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: Each applicant must submit the required document before their application is examined.
formal.zh: 每位申请人都必须先提交所要求的文件，其申请才会得到审核。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi nġib il-passaport ukoll? Mark: Iva, huwa meħtieġ biex tlesti l-applikazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Should I bring my passport too? Mark: Yes, it is required to complete the application.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我也要带护照吗？马克：是的，完成申请需要护照。

messages.speaker: Lara (申请人)
messages.zh: 我也要带护照吗？
messages.en: Should I bring my passport too?

messages.speaker: Mark (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa meħtieġ biex tlesti l-applikazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa meħtieġ biex tlesti l-applikazzjoni.
messages.zh: 是的，完成申请需要护照。
messages.en: Yes, it is required to complete the application.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象办事清单上的必填勾选框：少了这一项就办不成。用 meħtieġ 同时记住“确有必要”和“按要求必须有”。

gloss_zh: 使延迟；拖延；拖欠债务偿还

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put an action or event off until later, procrastinate, or fail to repay a debt as promised.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把行动或事情推迟到以后，拖延不办，也可指未按承诺偿还债务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħalli azzjoni jew avveniment għal aktar tard, idum ma jagħmel xi ħaġa, jew jonqos milli jħallas dejn kif wiegħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使延迟；把某项行动或事情推迟到更晚。
拖延不办；迟迟不开始或完成应该做的事。
未履行偿债承诺；拖欠本应按约偿还的债务。

formal.mt: Id-debitur meħħer il-ħlas tad-dejn minkejja li kien wiegħed li jħallas fid-data miftiehma.
formal.en: The debtor put off repaying the debt despite having promised to pay on the agreed date.
formal.zh: 债务人虽然承诺在约定日期付款，却拖延了债务偿还。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark lesta x-xogħol? Rita: Le, reġa' meħħer. Qal li se jagħmlu għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Mark finished the work? Rita: No, he procrastinated again. He said he'll do it tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克把工作做完了吗？丽塔：没有，他又拖延了。他说要明天做。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 马克把工作做完了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark finished the work?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, reġa' meħħer. Qal li se jagħmlu għada.
messages.mt_standard: Le, reġa' meħħer. Qal li se jagħmlu għada.
messages.zh: 没有，他又拖延了。他说要明天做。
messages.en: No, he procrastinated again. He said he'll do it tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 meħħer 配成三个动作画面：推迟安排、拖着不做、答应还钱却未还。连写的两个 ħ 可作视觉提醒，不当作词源解释。

gloss_zh: 没精打采地小口吃；赶走；使厌恶

teaching_sense.en_definition: To nibble at food without enthusiasm; also, to drive someone away or cause repugnance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提不起兴致地一点点吃东西；也可表示把某人赶走，或使人产生厌恶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiekol ftit ftit bla ħeġġa; ukoll, ikeċċi lil xi ħadd jew iqanqal stmerrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 没精打采地小口吃东西；兴致索然地一点点吃。
把某人赶走；驱离某人。
引起厌恶或反感；使人觉得恶心。

collocations.en: he nibbled listlessly at a piece of bread
collocations.zh: 他没精打采地小口吃着一块面包

formal.mt: Waqt l-ikla, it-tifel meżmeż biċċa ħobż bla ħeġġa u ħalla l-bqija tal-ikel fil-platt.
formal.en: During the meal, the boy listlessly nibbled at a piece of bread and left the rest of the food on his plate.
formal.zh: 吃饭时，男孩没精打采地小口吃着一块面包，把其余食物留在了盘子里。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Leo kiel xi ħaġa? Rita: Meżmeż ftit ħobż biss; qal li ma kellux aptit.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did Leo eat anything? Rita: He only nibbled listlessly at a little bread; he said he had no appetite.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：莱奥吃东西了吗？丽塔：他只是没精打采地吃了几小口面包，说没胃口。

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.zh: 莱奥吃东西了吗？
messages.en: Did Leo eat anything?

messages.speaker: Rita (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Meżmeż ftit ħobż biss; qal li ma kellux aptit.
messages.mt_standard: Meżmeż ftit ħobż biss; qal li ma kellux aptit.
messages.zh: 他只是没精打采地吃了几小口面包，说没胃口。
messages.en: He only nibbled listlessly at a little bread; he said he had no appetite.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张独立情境卡记忆：没胃口地小口吃、把人赶走、某种景象令人厌恶；按语境选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who feels strong disgust or repugnance toward something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某种事物感到强烈厌恶或反感的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħoss stmerrija jew diżgust qawwi għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who feels repugnance or abhorrence
sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到厌恶、憎恶或强烈反感的人。

collocations.en: someone who feels disgust at dirty plates
collocations.zh: 看到脏盘子就感到厌恶的人

collocations.mt: meżmież li ma jiflaħx irwejjaħ ħżiena
collocations.en: a person prone to disgust who cannot stand bad smells
collocations.zh: 容易感到厌恶、受不了难闻气味的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-meżmież jirrifjuta li jidħol fil-kamra minħabba r-riħa ħażina.
formal.en: In the story, the person who feels disgust refuses to enter the room because of the bad smell.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个感到厌恶的人因为气味难闻而拒绝进入房间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx imiss il-platti? Rita: Għax hu meżmież; il-platti maħmuġin iqanqlulu stmerrija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Pawlu want to touch the plates? Rita: Because he is easily disgusted; dirty plates fill him with revulsion.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么不愿意碰这些盘子？丽塔：因为他是个容易感到厌恶的人，脏盘子让他很反感。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx imiss il-platti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ma jridx imiss il-platti?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么不愿意碰这些盘子？
messages.en: Why doesn't Pawlu want to touch the plates?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu meżmież; il-platti maħmuġin iqanqlulu stmerrija.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu meżmież; il-platti maħmuġin iqanqlulu stmerrija.
messages.zh: 因为他是个容易感到厌恶的人，脏盘子让他很反感。
messages.en: Because he is easily disgusted; dirty plates fill him with revulsion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人看到脏盘子便皱眉退后，把 meżmież 记成“感到厌恶的那个人”；这里是指人的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very particular and easily dissatisfied, especially about food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对事物要求细、容易挑剔的，尤其指对食物很挑剔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħżel ħafna u mhux faċli jogħġbu xi ħaġa, speċjalment fejn jidħol l-ikel.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to be fastidious, especially about food
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易挑剔的，尤其指对食物十分讲究、挑三拣四的。

formal.mt: It-tifel huwa meżmieżi fl-ikel u jirrifjuta ħafna tipi ta' ħaxix.
formal.en: The boy is fussy about food and refuses many kinds of vegetables.
formal.zh: 这个男孩很挑食，不肯吃许多种蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Mark jiekol is-soppa? Pawlu: Diffiċli! Hu meżmieżi fl-ikel u ma jħobbx il-biċċiet tal-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Rita: Will Mark eat the soup? Pawlu: Unlikely! He's fussy about food and doesn't like pieces of vegetables.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克会喝这汤吗？保罗：恐怕不会！他很挑食，不喜欢里面的蔬菜块。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 马克会喝这汤吗？
messages.en: Will Mark eat the soup?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Diffiċli! Hu meżmieżi fl-ikel u ma jħobbx il-biċċiet tal-ħaxix.
messages.mt_standard: Diffiċli! Hu meżmieżi fl-ikel u ma jħobbx il-biċċiet tal-ħaxix.
messages.zh: 恐怕不会！他很挑食，不喜欢里面的蔬菜块。
messages.en: Unlikely! He's fussy about food and doesn't like pieces of vegetables.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 meżmieżi 放在餐桌场景里记：这个不吃、那个嫌弃，就是“挑剔的”。它描述人的特点，词性是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Recovered from an illness or healed after an injury.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 疾病已经治愈的，或伤处已经愈合的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fieq minn marda jew minn ferita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已治愈的，已痊愈的；已愈合的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkonferma li l-pazjent huwa mfejjaq għalkollox.
formal.en: The report confirms that the patient is completely cured.
formal.zh: 报告确认，这位病人已经完全痊愈。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għadek marid? Mark: Le, issa jien mfejjaq għalkollox u erġajt bdejt naħdem.
colloquial.en: Rita: Are you still ill? Mark: No, I'm completely recovered now and I've started working again.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你还病着吗？马克：没有，我现在已经完全好了，也重新开始工作了。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 你还病着吗？
messages.en: Are you still ill?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa jien mfejjaq għalkollox u erġajt bdejt naħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa jien mfejjaq għalkollox u erġajt bdejt naħdem.
messages.zh: 没有，我现在已经完全好了，也重新开始工作了。
messages.en: No, I'm completely recovered now and I've started working again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mfejjaq 与病历上“已痊愈”的标记联系起来：描述治疗后的恢复状态，也可联想到伤处已经愈合。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Shy or bashfully reserved when interacting with other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容与人相处时羞怯、腼腆，不太敢主动表达的样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jistħi jew joqgħod lura meta jkun ma' nies oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忸怩腼腆的；羞答答而有所保留的
害羞的；羞怯的

formal.mt: It-tifel mgerrex kellu bżonn ftit ħin qabel ma beda jitkellem mal-għalliem.
formal.en: The shy boy needed a little time before he began speaking to the teacher.
formal.zh: 这个羞怯的男孩过了一会儿才开始和老师说话。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex it-tifel ma jitkellimx magħna? Pawlu: Hu ftit mgerrex; agħtih ċans jidra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why isn't the boy talking to us? Pawlu: He's a little shy; give him a chance to settle in.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那个男孩怎么不和我们说话？保罗：他有点害羞，给他一点时间适应吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (家长)
messages.zh: 那个男孩怎么不和我们说话？
messages.en: Why isn't the boy talking to us?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu ftit mgerrex; agħtih ċans jidra.
messages.mt_standard: Hu ftit mgerrex; agħtih ċans jidra.
messages.zh: 他有点害羞，给他一点时间适应吧。
messages.en: He's a little shy; give him a chance to settle in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象初次见面时低头微笑、不敢开口的人，用这个腼腆画面记住 mgerrex。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a physical impairment that severely limits normal movement or use of a limb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容因肢体损伤或障碍而明显难以正常活动的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħsara jew diżabbiltà fiżika li tillimita ħafna l-moviment jew l-użu ta' xi riġel jew driegħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肢体伤残而行动困难的

collocations.en: a bird with a disabling physical injury
collocations.zh: 因肢体受伤而活动受限的鸟

collocations.en: a horse with a disabling physical impairment
collocations.zh: 肢体伤残、行动受限的马

formal.mt: Iż-żiemel mgħajtab kellu diffikultà biex jimxi u ngħata kura mill-veterinarju.
formal.en: The horse with a disabling physical impairment had difficulty walking and received veterinary care.
formal.zh: 这匹肢体伤残的马行走困难，接受了兽医的治疗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak l-għasfur mgħajtab; bilkemm jista' jimxi. Toni: Ejja nċemplu lill-veterinarju biex naraw kif nistgħu ngħinuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that injured bird; it can barely walk. Toni: Let's call the vet to find out how we can help it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看那只肢体受伤的小鸟，它几乎走不了路。托尼：我们打电话给兽医，问问怎么帮助它吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-għasfur mgħajtab; bilkemm jista' jimxi.
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-għasfur mgħajtab; bilkemm jista' jimxi.
messages.zh: 看那只肢体受伤的小鸟，它几乎走不了路。
messages.en: Look at that injured bird; it can barely walk.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nċemplu lill-veterinarju biex naraw kif nistgħu ngħinuh.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nċemplu lill-veterinarju biex naraw kif nistgħu ngħinuh.
messages.zh: 我们打电话给兽医，问问怎么帮助它吧。
messages.en: Let's call the vet to find out how we can help it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用需要照料、因肢体受伤而难以行走的小鸟记住 mgħajtab，抓住行动受限这一点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small goat, expressed using the diminutive form of mogħża.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指小山羊，是 mogħża 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mogħża żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' mogħża.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small goat (the diminutive form of 'mogħża')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小山羊（mogħża 的指小形式）

formal.mt: Ir-raħħal żamm il-mgħajża f'post nadif u taha ilma frisk kuljum.
formal.en: The farmer kept the small goat in a clean place and gave it fresh water every day.
formal.zh: 农户把这只小山羊养在干净的地方，每天给它新鲜的饮水。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nitma' lill-mgħajża? Pawlu: Iva, agħtiha ftit ħaxix minn dan.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I feed the little goat? Pawlu: Yes, give it a little of this grass.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我可以喂这只小山羊吗？保罗：可以，给它一点这些草吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (孩子)
messages.zh: 我可以喂这只小山羊吗？
messages.en: Can I feed the little goat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农户)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, agħtiha ftit ħaxix minn dan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, agħtiha ftit ħaxix minn dan.
messages.zh: 可以，给它一点这些草吧。
messages.en: Yes, give it a little of this grass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mogħża 的山羊画面缩小成一只小山羊，配上 mgħajża 一起记住指小含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slimy or unpleasantly damp and sticky to the touch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容表面摸起来黏滑，或带有令人不适的湿黏感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun jiżloq jew niedi u jwaħħal meta tmissu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黏滑的；湿黏的，触感潮湿而黏腻的

formal.mt: Il-ġebel mgħakkar ħdejn l-ilma jista' jkun perikoluż għal min jimxi fuqu.
formal.en: The slimy stone near the water can be dangerous for anyone walking on it.
formal.zh: 水边表面黏滑的石头可能让踩在上面的人遇到危险。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Oqgħod attent, dan il-ġebel mgħakkar! Mark: Sewwa, se nimxi minn hemm fejn hu niexef.
colloquial.en: Lara: Be careful, this stone is slimy! Mark: All right, I'll walk over there where it's dry.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：小心，这里的石头黏滑！马克：好，我走那边干燥的地方。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 小心，这里的石头黏滑！
messages.en: Be careful, this stone is slimy!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, se nimxi minn hemm fejn hu niexef.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, se nimxi minn hemm fejn hu niexef.
messages.zh: 好，我走那边干燥的地方。
messages.en: All right, I'll walk over there where it's dry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象摸到水边石头时又湿又黏、脚踩上去会滑的触感，用它记住 mgħakkar。

gloss_zh: 已受洗的；受洗的基督徒

teaching_sense.en_definition: Indicates that a person has received Christian baptism and is a baptised Christian.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某人已经接受基督教洗礼，处于已受洗的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika li persuna rċeviet il-magħmudija Nisranija u hija Nisranija mgħammda.

sense_translations.en_definition: one who has been baptised, a Christian
sense_translations.zh_definition: 已接受洗礼的人；受洗的基督徒

formal.mt: Skont ir-reġistru tal-parroċċa, it-tifel huwa mgħammed f'din il-knisja.
formal.en: According to the parish register, the boy was baptised in this church.
formal.zh: 根据堂区登记簿，这个男孩是在这座教堂受洗的。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk diġà mgħammed? Mark: Iva, il-magħmudija tiegħu kienet ix-xahar li għadda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has your brother been baptised already? Mark: Yes, his baptism was last month.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你弟弟已经受洗了吗？马克：是的，他上个月受了洗。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弟弟已经受洗了吗？
messages.en: Has your brother been baptised already?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-magħmudija tiegħu kienet ix-xahar li għadda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-magħmudija tiegħu kienet ix-xahar li għadda.
messages.zh: 是的，他上个月受了洗。
messages.en: Yes, his baptism was last month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mgħammed 放进已经完成洗礼的场景来记，重点是这个人已经受洗这一状态。

gloss_zh: 成群密集的；挤满虫群等的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Filled with large numbers of small creatures moving about.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某处有大量小动物或昆虫成群活动，显得密密麻麻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun mimli b'għadd kbir ta' ħlejjaq żgħar li jiċċaqalqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有大量小生物成群活动的；密密麻麻挤满虫群等的

formal.mt: Fi żmien ix-xita, il-post ħdejn l-għadira jkun mgħarwel bin-nemus.
formal.en: During the rainy season, the area beside the pond is swarming with mosquitoes.
formal.zh: 雨季时，池塘旁的地方蚊子成群。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ejja noqogħdu ġewwa; il-ġnien mgħarwel bin-nemus. Toni: Iva, u nagħlaq il-bieb biex ma jidħlux.
colloquial.en: Maja: Let's sit inside; the garden is swarming with mosquitoes. Toni: Yes, and I'll close the door so they don't come in.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们坐里面吧，花园里蚊子成群。托尼：好，我把门关上，免得它们飞进来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu ġewwa; il-ġnien mgħarwel bin-nemus.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu ġewwa; il-ġnien mgħarwel bin-nemus.
messages.zh: 我们坐里面吧，花园里蚊子成群。
messages.en: Let's sit inside; the garden is swarming with mosquitoes.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u nagħlaq il-bieb biex ma jidħlux.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u nagħlaq il-bieb biex ma jidħlux.
messages.zh: 好，我把门关上，免得它们飞进来。
messages.en: Yes, and I'll close the door so they don't come in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象池塘边一大群蚊子密密麻麻飞动，用整个地方挤满虫群的画面记住 mgħarwel。

gloss_zh: 弯曲的；歪斜的；阴险的；有耍诡计倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bent or crooked in shape; figuratively, deceitful or underhand in character or conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状弯曲或歪斜的；比喻人的品性或行为时，可指阴险、惯用诡计的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma milwija jew mhux dritta; b'mod figurattiv, li jaġixxi bil-qerq jew b'intenzjonijiet ħżiena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弯曲的；被折弯的。
歪斜的；不直的。
阴险的；暗藏恶意的。
有耍诡计倾向的；容易采取欺诈手段的。

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni sabet pajp mgħawweġ li kellu jinbidel qabel ma jitkompla x-xogħol.
formal.en: The inspection found a bent pipe that had to be replaced before work could continue.
formal.zh: 检查发现了一根弯曲的管道，必须更换后才能继续施工。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-wajer mgħawweġ wisq biex nużawh. Mark: Għandek raġun, ejja nieħdu wieħed dritt.
colloquial.en: Maja: This wire is too bent for us to use. Mark: You're right; let's get a straight one.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这根金属丝弯得太厉害，我们没法用。Mark：你说得对，我们拿根直的吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-wajer mgħawweġ wisq biex nużawh.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-wajer mgħawweġ wisq biex nużawh.
messages.zh: 这根金属丝弯得太厉害，我们没法用。
messages.en: This wire is too bent for us to use.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, ejja nieħdu wieħed dritt.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, ejja nieħdu wieħed dritt.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我们拿根直的吧。
messages.en: You're right; let's get a straight one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象一根弯曲的金属丝，再联想做事拐弯耍诡计的人；用具体形状帮助记住比喻义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money charged for borrowing money, usually calculated as a percentage of the amount borrowed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 借用资金所需支付的费用，通常按借款金额的一定比例计算。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas għall-użu ta' flus mislufa, li normalment jiġi kkalkulat bħala persentaġġ tas-somma mislufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利息；借用资金所需支付的费用。

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jindika r-rata ta' mgħax u l-ammont totali li għandu jitħallas fuq is-self.
formal.en: The contract states the interest rate and the total amount payable on the loan.
formal.zh: 合同列明了利率以及这笔贷款应偿还的总额。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm se nħallas mgħax fuq dan is-self? Pawlu: Ir-rata tinsab hawn; ejja nikkalkulaw kemm se tħallas b'kollox.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much interest will I pay on this loan? Pawlu: The rate is here; let's calculate how much you'll pay in total.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这笔贷款我要付多少利息？Pawlu：利率在这里，我们算算你总共要付多少。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm se nħallas mgħax fuq dan is-self?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm se nħallas mgħax fuq dan is-self?
messages.zh: 这笔贷款我要付多少利息？
messages.en: How much interest will I pay on this loan?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (银行职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rata tinsab hawn; ejja nikkalkulaw kemm se tħallas b'kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rata tinsab hawn; ejja nikkalkulaw kemm se tħallas b'kollox.
messages.zh: 利率在这里，我们算算你总共要付多少。
messages.en: The rate is here; let's calculate how much you'll pay in total.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把借来的本金和额外支付的钱分成两栏；额外那一栏就是 mgħax，利率则记作 rata ta' mgħax。

gloss_zh: 倦怠的；有气无力的；虚弱的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lacking energy or strength, and therefore moving or acting slowly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺少精力或体力，因而动作缓慢、显得倦怠或虚弱的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla enerġija jew saħħa, u għalhekk jimxi jew jaġixxi bil-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倦怠的；懒洋洋而缺乏精神的。
身体虚弱的；力量减弱的。

collocations.zh: 看起来虚弱而无精打采

formal.mt: Wara l-marda, ir-raġel baqa' mgħaxxex għal diversi jiem u kellu bżonn il-mistrieħ.
formal.en: After the illness, the man remained weak for several days and needed rest.
formal.zh: 病后，这名男子连续几天仍然身体虚弱，需要休息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Illum tidher mgħaxxex; irqadt biżżejjed? Ġanni: Le, irqadt ftit ħafna u qed inħossni bla saħħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: You look listless today; did you get enough sleep? Ġanni: No, I slept very little and I'm feeling weak.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你今天看起来无精打采，睡够了吗？Ġanni：没有，我睡得很少，现在觉得没力气。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天看起来无精打采，睡够了吗？
messages.en: You look listless today; did you get enough sleep?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irqadt ftit ħafna u qed inħossni bla saħħa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irqadt ftit ħafna u qed inħossni bla saħħa.
messages.zh: 没有，我睡得很少，现在觉得没力气。
messages.en: No, I slept very little and I'm feeling weak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象没睡够时肩膀下垂、动作缓慢的样子；用这幅画面同时记住倦怠和虚弱两层意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hurrying or done quickly, sometimes without enough care or attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人急着行动，或事情做得很快，有时因此不够仔细、显得草率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun qed jgħaġġel jew isir malajr, kultant mingħajr biżżejjed ħsieb jew attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 匆忙的；急急忙忙进行的
仓促的；未经充分考虑而草率的
粗略的；匆匆带过而不够深入仔细的

formal.mt: Eżami mgħaġġel tad-dokument jista' jħalli żbalji importanti mingħajr ma jinduna bihom ħadd.
formal.en: A cursory examination of the document may leave important errors unnoticed.
formal.zh: 对文件进行粗略检查，可能会让重要错误未被发现。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex int daqshekk mgħaġġel illum? Mark: Għandi nieħu l-karozza tal-linja u fadalli biss ħames minuti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you in such a hurry today? Mark: I need to catch the bus, and I've only got five minutes left.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天怎么这么匆忙？马克：我要赶公交车，只剩五分钟了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天怎么这么匆忙？
messages.en: Why are you in such a hurry today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi nieħu l-karozza tal-linja u fadalli biss ħames minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi nieħu l-karozza tal-linja u fadalli biss ħames minuti.
messages.zh: 我要赶公交车，只剩五分钟了。
messages.en: I need to catch the bus, and I've only got five minutes left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mgħaġġel 串成三个画面：赶车很匆忙、决定太草率、检查太粗略，共同点都是太快。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of repeatedly moving the jaws and teeth to chew or bite food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复活动上下颌和牙齿来嚼咬食物的动作，也可指用力嚼咬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha wieħed iċaqlaq ix-xedaq u juża s-snien biex jomgħod l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力嚼咬；反复使劲咀嚼的动作。
咀嚼；用牙齿把食物嚼碎的动作。

formal.mt: Il-mgħid ikisser l-ikel f'biċċiet iżgħar qabel ma jinbela'.
formal.en: Chewing breaks food into smaller pieces before it is swallowed.
formal.zh: 咀嚼会在吞咽之前把食物嚼成更小的碎块。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex il-mgħid ta' dan il-ħobż qed jieħu daqshekk ħin? Ninu: Għax il-ħobż iebes ħafna; ħu biċċiet iżgħar.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is chewing this bread taking so long? Ninu: Because the bread is very hard; take smaller pieces.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这面包怎么嚼这么久？Ninu：因为面包很硬，吃小块一点吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-mgħid ta' dan il-ħobż qed jieħu daqshekk ħin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-mgħid ta' dan il-ħobż qed jieħu daqshekk ħin?
messages.zh: 这面包怎么嚼这么久？
messages.en: Why is chewing this bread taking so long?

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-ħobż iebes ħafna; ħu biċċiet iżgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-ħobż iebes ħafna; ħu biċċiet iżgħar.
messages.zh: 因为面包很硬，吃小块一点吧。
messages.en: Because the bread is very hard; take smaller pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定格在牙齿反复嚼面包的动作上；mgħid 是这个动作的名词，重点记成咀嚼这件事。

gloss_zh: 载着重物的；装满的；负担沉重的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Carrying or filled with a load; figuratively, weighed down by duties, worries, or other burdens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 携带重物或装载着货物的；比喻承担许多任务、忧虑或其他负担的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li qed iġorr tagħbija jew mimli biha; b'mod figurattiv, li għandu ħafna xogħol, responsabbiltajiet jew inkwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 载着货物的；携带重物的。
装满货物的；满载的。
负担沉重的；承受责任、工作或忧虑的。

formal.mt: It-trakk wasal mgħobbi bil-materjal meħtieġ għat-tiswija tal-bini.
formal.en: The truck arrived loaded with the material needed to repair the building.
formal.zh: 卡车抵达时，车上装载着修缮这栋建筑所需的材料。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandek ħin għal kafè llum? David: Illum jien mgħobbi bix-xogħol; nistgħu niltaqgħu għada?
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you have time for a coffee today? David: I'm swamped with work today; can we meet tomorrow?
