colloquial.zh: Rita：今天有空喝杯咖啡吗？David：我今天工作太多了，我们明天见行吗？

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天有空喝杯咖啡吗？
messages.en: Do you have time for a coffee today?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum jien mgħobbi bix-xogħol; nistgħu niltaqgħu għada?
messages.mt_standard: Illum jien mgħobbi bix-xogħol; nistgħu niltaqgħu għada?
messages.zh: 我今天工作太多了，我们明天见行吗？
messages.en: I'm swamped with work today; can we meet tomorrow?

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想一辆装满箱子的卡车，再把箱子换成待办工作；这样把实际满载和抽象负担连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Time that has already passed, including events and experiences belonging to that time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经流逝的时间，也包括属于那段时间的事件与经历。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żmien li diġà għadda, flimkien mal-ġrajjiet u l-esperjenzi ta' dak iż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过去；已经流逝的时间或往昔岁月。

formal.mt: L-istudju tal-mgħoddi jgħinna nifhmu kif inbidlet il-ħajja fil-belt.
formal.en: Studying the past helps us understand how life in the city has changed.
formal.zh: 研究过去有助于我们理解这座城市的生活发生了怎样的变化。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dawn ir-ritratti jfakkruni fil-mgħoddi. Toni: Lili wkoll; ħares kemm konna żgħar!
colloquial.en: Anna: These photos remind me of the past. Toni: Me too; look how young we were!
colloquial.zh: Anna：这些照片让我想起了从前。Toni：我也是，看看我们那时候多年轻！

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些照片让我想起了从前。
messages.en: These photos remind me of the past.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lili wkoll; ħares kemm konna żgħar!
messages.mt_standard: Lili wkoll; ħares kemm konna żgħar!
messages.zh: 我也是，看看我们那时候多年轻！
messages.en: Me too; look how young we were!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把时间线左边画成一本旧相册，标上 mgħoddi；这里记的是名词过去，而不是某个动作已经完成。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cooked or heated in water or another liquid brought to boiling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在达到沸腾的水或其他液体中煮过或加热过的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun issajjar jew issaħħan f'ilma jew likwidu ieħor jagħli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 煮过的；经沸水或其他沸腾液体煮制的。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob li r-ross mgħolli jiżdied mal-ħaxix fl-aħħar tal-preparazzjoni.
formal.en: The recipe calls for the boiled rice to be added to the vegetables at the end of preparation.
formal.zh: 食谱要求在制作的最后阶段，把煮熟的米饭加入蔬菜中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-ross mgħolli lest? Mark: Iva, lest; trid inżidlek ftit mal-ħaxix?
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the boiled rice ready? Mark: Yes, it's ready; would you like me to add some to your vegetables?
colloquial.zh: Maja：煮米饭准备好了吗？Mark：好了，要我给你的蔬菜加一点米饭吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 煮米饭准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the boiled rice ready?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, lest; trid inżidlek ftit mal-ħaxix?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, lest; trid inżidlek ftit mal-ħaxix?
messages.zh: 好了，要我给你的蔬菜加一点米饭吗？
messages.en: Yes, it's ready; would you like me to add some to your vegetables?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象锅里冒泡，旁边放着已经煮好的米饭；mgħolli 描述煮过的状态，水冷却后也仍可称作煮过的水。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mortar and gravel used as construction material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑施工所用的砂浆和砾石材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mehries u żrar li jintużaw bħala materjal għall-bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑用的砂浆和砾石。

collocations.en: a layer of construction mortar and gravel
collocations.zh: 一层建筑用砂浆和砾石

collocations.en: a pile of construction mortar and gravel
collocations.zh: 一堆建筑用砂浆和砾石

formal.mt: Qabel beda x-xogħol, il-bennej ħejja l-mhejreż meħtieġ għall-bini tal-ħajt.
formal.en: Before work began, the builder prepared the mortar and gravel needed to construct the wall.
formal.zh: 开工前，建筑工人准备好了砌墙所需的砂浆和砾石。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Fejn inpoġġi l-mhejreż? Rita: Poġġih ħdejn il-ħajt, imma ħalli l-passaġġ vojt.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Where should I put the mortar and gravel? Rita: Put it beside the wall, but keep the passage clear.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：砂浆和砾石放在哪里？Rita：放在墙边，不过要把通道留出来。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (建筑工人)
messages.zh: 砂浆和砾石放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the mortar and gravel?

messages.speaker: Rita (工地领班)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġih ħdejn il-ħajt, imma ħalli l-passaġġ vojt.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġih ħdejn il-ħajt, imma ħalli l-passaġġ vojt.
messages.zh: 放在墙边，不过要把通道留出来。
messages.en: Put it beside the wall, but keep the passage clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一处砌墙工地，把砂浆和砾石放在墙边并贴上 mhejreż 标签，用施工材料的场景记词义。

exact_key: mhux kull ma jleqq hu deheb
gloss_zh: 发光的未必都是金子；不可只看外表

teaching_sense.en_definition: A proverb warning that something attractive or impressive in appearance may not be truly valuable or good.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提醒人们不要只凭外表判断的谚语：看起来漂亮或出色的事物，未必真正有价值或品质好。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qawl li jfakkar li dak li jidher sabiħ jew ta' valur mhux bilfors ikun tajjeb jew prezzjuż.

sense_translations.en_definition: all that glitters is not gold
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发光的未必都是金子；外表吸引人的事物未必真正有价值。

collocations.mt: Ftakar li mhux kull ma jleqq hu deheb.
collocations.en: Remember that not everything that glitters is gold.
collocations.zh: 记住，发光的未必都是金子。

collocations.mt: Kif jgħid il-qawl, mhux kull ma jleqq hu deheb.
collocations.en: As the proverb says, all that glitters is not gold.
collocations.zh: 正如谚语所说，发光的未必都是金子。

formal.mt: Ir-reklam jidher attraenti, iżda mhux kull ma jleqq hu deheb; il-kwalità tal-prodott għandha tiġi eżaminata.
formal.en: The advertisement looks appealing, but all that glitters is not gold; the quality of the product should be examined.
formal.zh: 广告看起来很吸引人，但发光的未必都是金子；应当检查产品的质量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-arloġġ jidher għali, imma jiswa ftit ħafna! Pawlu: Mhux kull ma jleqq hu deheb. Ejja naraw jekk jaħdimx sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: This watch looks expensive, but it costs very little! Pawlu: All that glitters is not gold. Let's see whether it works properly.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这块表看着很贵，可是价格特别低！Pawlu：发光的未必都是金子。我们看看它运转得好不好。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-arloġġ jidher għali, imma jiswa ftit ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-arloġġ jidher għali, imma jiswa ftit ħafna!
messages.zh: 这块表看着很贵，可是价格特别低！
messages.en: This watch looks expensive, but it costs very little!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux kull ma jleqq hu deheb. Ejja naraw jekk jaħdimx sew.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux kull ma jleqq hu deheb. Ejja naraw jekk jaħdimx sew.
messages.zh: 发光的未必都是金子。我们看看它运转得好不好。
messages.en: All that glitters is not gold. Let's see whether it works properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一件闪闪发亮却质量很差的商品，把整句和“发光未必是金子”的画面绑定，记住它劝人别只看外表。

gloss_zh: 使者；信使；受派执行公务的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone sent to deliver a message or carry out an official mission.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被派去传递信息或执行正式任务的人，即使者或信使。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħadd li jintbagħat biex iwassal messaġġ jew iwettaq missjoni uffiċjali.

sense_translations.en_definition: envoy; messenger; one sent in official function
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使者；信使；受派执行公务的人。

formal.mt: Il-mibgħut tal-gvern ippreżenta l-ittra uffiċjali waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The government envoy presented the official letter during the meeting.
formal.zh: 政府使者在会议期间递交了正式信函。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu r-raġel li ġab l-ittra? Pawlu: Hu mibgħut tal-gvern; ġie biex ikellem lid-direttur.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the man who brought the letter? Pawlu: He's a government envoy; he came to speak to the director.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：送信来的那个男人是谁？保罗：他是政府派来的使者，来找主任谈话。

messages.speaker: Maja (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu r-raġel li ġab l-ittra?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu r-raġel li ġab l-ittra?
messages.zh: 送信来的那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the man who brought the letter?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (办公室同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu mibgħut tal-gvern; ġie biex ikellem lid-direttur.
messages.mt_standard: Hu mibgħut tal-gvern; ġie biex ikellem lid-direttur.
messages.zh: 他是政府派来的使者，来找主任谈话。
messages.en: He's a government envoy; he came to speak to the director.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位带着正式信函前来的人：先记“受派而来”，再联想到使者、信使和执行公务的代表。

gloss_zh: 惊愕的；惊叹的；惊得说不出话的

teaching_sense.en_definition: So surprised or amazed that one may be unable to speak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常惊讶或惊叹的，甚至一时说不出话来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tant sorpriż jew mistagħġeb li jista' jibqa' bla kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大为震惊的；惊愕不已的。
十分惊讶的；惊叹的。
惊得说不出话的；目瞪口呆的。

collocations.zh: 被意外的事情惊得目瞪口呆

formal.mt: Meta tħabbar ir-riżultat tal-kompetizzjoni, ir-rebbieħ baqa' miblugħ għal ftit mumenti.
formal.en: When the competition result was announced, the winner was left dumbstruck for a few moments.
formal.zh: 比赛结果公布时，获胜者惊得一时说不出话来。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex bqajt miblugħ meta ftaħt il-bieb? Luka: Ma kontx naf li sħabi kollha kienu hemm għas-sorpriża!
colloquial.en: Sara: Why were you dumbstruck when you opened the door? Luka: I didn't know all my friends were there for the surprise!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你开门时怎么惊得说不出话了？卢卡：我不知道朋友们都在那里，准备给我一个惊喜！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex bqajt miblugħ meta ftaħt il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex bqajt miblugħ meta ftaħt il-bieb?
messages.zh: 你开门时怎么惊得说不出话了？
messages.en: Why were you dumbstruck when you opened the door?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma kontx naf li sħabi kollha kienu hemm għas-sorpriża!
messages.mt_standard: Ma kontx naf li sħabi kollha kienu hemm għas-sorpriża!
messages.zh: 我不知道朋友们都在那里，准备给我一个惊喜！
messages.en: I didn't know all my friends were there for the surprise!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用惊喜派对练记：开门、睁大眼睛、停住说话；把惊讶、惊叹和目瞪口呆连成同一个反应画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing moisture or covered with liquid, sometimes excessively wet and sloppy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有水分或表面沾有液体的，也可指水分过多、湿糊糊的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih l-umdità jew hu miksi bil-likwidu, xi drabi tant li jsir artab u ma jżommx il-forma tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微湿的；含有一定水分的。
湿糊糊的；因水分过多而湿软、不成形的。
湿的；沾有液体或被液体浸湿的。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipant poġġa x-xugaman miblul fuq is-siġġu wara l-għawma.
formal.en: The participant placed the wet towel on the chair after the swim.
formal.zh: 游泳后，那位参与者把湿毛巾放在了椅子上。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ix-xagħar tiegħek għadu miblul? Mark: Iva, għadni kemm ħriġt mid-doċċa; agħtini x-xugaman, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is your hair still wet? Mark: Yes, I've just got out of the shower; pass me the towel, please.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你的头发还湿着吗？马克：是啊，我刚洗完澡出来，请把毛巾递给我。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 你的头发还湿着吗？
messages.en: Is your hair still wet?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kemm ħriġt mid-doċċa; agħtini x-xugaman, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kemm ħriġt mid-doċċa; agħtini x-xugaman, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 是啊，我刚洗完澡出来，请把毛巾递给我。
messages.en: Yes, I've just got out of the shower; pass me the towel, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条含水量刻度：微微潮湿、明显湿透、湿软糊成一团；用水分多少串起三个义项，再联想洗澡后的湿头发。

gloss_zh: 结实的；体格健壮的；宽厚的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sturdy and well built, especially with a broad, strong body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 结实健壮的，尤指身体宽厚、体格强壮的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'saħħtu u mibni tajjeb, speċjalment b'ġisem wiesa' u sod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结实的；强健的。
体格健壮的；身材结实的。
宽阔的；宽厚的，尤指体格。

formal.mt: Il-karattru ewlieni fir-rakkont huwa raġel mibrum b'leħen kalm.
formal.en: The main character in the story is a sturdy man with a calm voice.
formal.zh: 故事的主角是一个体格健壮、声音平静的男人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak ir-raġel mibrum ħdejn il-bieb? Pawlu: Dak ħija; għandu ġisem b'saħħtu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that well-built man by the door? Pawlu: That's my brother; he's very strongly built.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：门旁那个体格健壮的男人是谁？保罗：那是我兄弟，他身体很结实。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel mibrum ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel mibrum ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门旁那个体格健壮的男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that well-built man by the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ħija; għandu ġisem b'saħħtu ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ħija; għandu ġisem b'saħħtu ħafna.
messages.zh: 那是我兄弟，他身体很结实。
messages.en: That's my brother; he's very strongly built.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它配上宽肩壮实的人物图，连记“结实、健壮、宽厚”三个相近意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A urinal, or a toilet used for relieving oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人排泄使用的小便器，也可指厕所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat fejn wieħed jagħmel l-awrina, jew lok fejn wieħed jagħmel il-bżonnijiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小便器；便池。
厕所；卫生间。

formal.mt: Il-mibwel pubbliku jinsab fil-pjan terran, ħdejn it-taraġ.
formal.en: The public toilet is on the ground floor, next to the stairs.
formal.zh: 公共厕所位于底层，靠近楼梯。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Skużi, fejn hu l-mibwel? Rita: Hemm wieħed fit-tarf tal-kuritur, fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Mark: Excuse me, where is the toilet? Rita: There's one at the end of the corridor, on the left.
colloquial.zh: 马克：打扰一下，厕所在哪里？丽塔：走廊尽头左边有一个。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 打扰一下，厕所在哪里？
messages.en: Excuse me, where is the toilet?

messages.speaker: Rita (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm wieħed fit-tarf tal-kuritur, fuq ix-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm wieħed fit-tarf tal-kuritur, fuq ix-xellug.
messages.zh: 走廊尽头左边有一个。
messages.en: There's one at the end of the corridor, on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公共场所的厕所指示牌，再把镜头拉近到小便器，区分场所与器具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姓氏 Micallef，中文可音译为“米卡莱夫”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala l-isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个姓氏：Micallef（米卡莱夫）。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Micallef ippreżentat ir-rapport waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Ms Micallef presented the report during the meeting.
formal.zh: 米卡莱夫女士在会议上提交并介绍了报告。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif tikteb il-kunjom tiegħek? David: Micallef, b'żewġ ittri l u f waħda fl-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Anna: How do you spell your surname? David: Micallef, with two l's and one f at the end.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你的姓怎么拼？戴维：Micallef，有两个 l，结尾是一个 f。

messages.speaker: Anna (接待员)
messages.zh: 你的姓怎么拼？
messages.en: How do you spell your surname?

messages.speaker: David (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Micallef, b'żewġ ittri l u f waħda fl-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Micallef, b'żewġ ittri l u f waħda fl-aħħar.
messages.zh: Micallef，有两个 l，结尾是一个 f。
messages.en: Micallef, with two l's and one f at the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象写着 Micallef 的姓名牌，记住姓氏首字母大写，中间双写 l。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Luminous or shining, giving off or reflecting visible light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出或反射可见光的；明亮、发光或闪耀的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti jew jirrifletti d-dawl u jidher jiddi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发光的；明亮的。
发亮的；散发光辉的。
闪耀的；闪亮的。

formal.mt: Kristall middi kien espost taħt lampa żgħira fil-vetrina.
formal.en: A shining crystal was displayed under a small lamp in the display case.
formal.zh: 一块闪亮的水晶陈列在展柜里的一盏小灯下。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara kemm hu middi dan il-kristall! Luqa: Iva, qed jirrifletti d-dawl tat-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look how shiny this crystal is! Luqa: Yes, it's reflecting the light from the window.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：看，这块水晶多闪亮！卢卡：是啊，它正反射着窗外照进来的光。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hu middi dan il-kristall!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hu middi dan il-kristall!
messages.zh: 看，这块水晶多闪亮！
messages.en: Look how shiny this crystal is!

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，它正反射着窗外照进来的光。
messages.en: Yes, it's reflecting the light from the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词写在闪亮水晶的图旁，联想“明亮、发光、闪耀”的共同视觉感受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something given to another person as a present or gift.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 送给别人的物品，作为礼物或赠礼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa li tingħata lil persuna oħra bħala rigal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 礼物；赠送给他人的东西。

formal.mt: Bħala middija ta' ringrazzjament, l-istudenti taw ktieb lill-għalliema.
formal.en: As a thank-you gift, the students gave the teacher a book.
formal.zh: 学生们送给老师一本书，作为表示感谢的礼物。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ġibtlek middija żgħira. Ġużi: Grazzi! X'middija sabiħa!
colloquial.en: Marija: I brought you a little gift. Ġużi: Thank you! What a lovely gift!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我给你带了一份小礼物。朱齐：谢谢！多漂亮的礼物啊！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 我给你带了一份小礼物。
messages.en: I brought you a little gift.

messages.speaker: Ġużi (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢！多漂亮的礼物啊！
messages.en: Thank you! What a lovely gift!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友递来一个礼物盒，整句记住“给你一份小礼物”，不要与表示发光的词混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft, oily preparation spread on the skin as an ointment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂在皮肤上的柔软油性膏剂；软膏或药膏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza ratba u żejtnija li tindilek fuq il-ġilda bħala ingwent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 软膏；供涂抹皮肤使用的膏剂。

formal.mt: L-isem tal-midhen u d-data ta' skadenza huma miktuba fuq it-tubu.
formal.en: The name of the ointment and its expiry date are written on the tube.
formal.zh: 软膏的名称和有效期标注在软管上。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn poġġejt it-tubu tal-midhen? Ben: Fil-kaxxa l-bajda, ħdejn il-faxex.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where did you put the tube of ointment? Ben: In the white box, next to the bandages.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你把那管软膏放在哪里了？本：在白色盒子里，绷带旁边。

messages.speaker: Elena (家人)
messages.zh: 你把那管软膏放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the tube of ointment?

messages.speaker: Ben (家人)
messages.zh: 在白色盒子里，绷带旁边。
messages.en: In the white box, next to the bandages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象软管里挤出一点膏体，把 midhen 与“涂在皮肤上的软膏”一起记。

gloss_zh: 施行涂油礼的场所；膏抹处

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where anointing, or the ceremonial application of oil, takes place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 施行膏抹或涂油仪式的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn issir id-dilka biż-żejt bħala parti minn ċerimonja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 施行膏抹或涂油礼的场所。

collocations.en: the location of the anointing place

formal.mt: Fuq il-pjanta tas-sala, il-midhna hija mmarkata bħala l-post fejn issir id-dilka biż-żejt.
formal.en: On the hall plan, the anointing place is marked as the area where the ceremonial application of oil takes place.
formal.zh: 大厅平面图标出了涂油礼场所，即施行仪式性涂油的区域。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser midhna fuq din il-pjanta? Mark: Il-post fejn issir id-dilka biż-żejt; ara, hawn ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does midhna mean on this plan? Mark: The place where anointing with oil takes place; look, here by the door.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这张平面图上的 midhna 是什么意思？马克：指施行涂油礼的地方；看，就在门旁边。

messages.speaker: Lina (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser midhna fuq din il-pjanta?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser midhna fuq din il-pjanta?
messages.zh: 这张平面图上的 midhna 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does midhna mean on this plan?

messages.speaker: Mark (讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-post fejn issir id-dilka biż-żejt; ara, hawn ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Il-post fejn issir id-dilka biż-żejt; ara, hawn ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 指施行涂油礼的地方；看，就在门旁边。
messages.en: The place where anointing with oil takes place; look, here by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在平面图上圈出举行涂油礼的位置，记住 midhna 指场所，midhen 指软膏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cereal crops, such as corn or wheat, that are to be threshed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 准备进行脱粒的谷物，如玉米或小麦，重点在于这些谷物尚待脱粒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċereali, bħall-qamħirrum jew il-qamħ, li jkunu għad iridu jindarsu.

sense_translations.en_definition: cereal such as corn or wheat which is to be threshed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 待脱粒的谷物，例如玉米或小麦。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċereali bħall-qamħirrum jew il-qamħ li jkunu għad iridu jindarsu.

collocations.en: prepare the cereal crop for threshing
collocations.zh: 把待脱粒的谷物准备好，以便脱粒

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħejja l-midirsa għad-dris sabiex jifred il-ħbub mill-bqija tal-pjanta.
formal.en: The farmer prepared the cereal crop for threshing to separate the grains from the rest of the plant.
formal.zh: 农民把待脱粒的谷物准备好，以便通过脱粒将谷粒与植株的其余部分分离。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-midirsa lesta għad-dris? Ġużeppi: Iva, kollox lest. Nibdew bid-dris għada filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is the cereal crop ready for threshing? Ġużeppi: Yes, everything is ready. We'll start threshing tomorrow morning.
colloquial.zh: Rita：待脱粒的谷物准备好了吗？Ġużeppi：是的，都准备好了。我们明天早上开始脱粒。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 待脱粒的谷物准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the cereal crop ready for threshing?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kollox lest. Nibdew bid-dris għada filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kollox lest. Nibdew bid-dris għada filgħodu.
messages.zh: 是的，都准备好了。我们明天早上开始脱粒。
messages.en: Yes, everything is ready. We'll start threshing tomorrow morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一批小麦挂着“等待脱粒”的牌子：midirsa 指这批待处理的谷物，把“谷物”和“尚待脱粒”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a debt, especially money that must be paid back to another person or an institution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负有债务的，尤其指欠个人或机构的钱，需要偿还。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu dejn, speċjalment flus li jrid iħallas lura lil persuna jew lil istituzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负有债务的；处于欠债状态的。
欠某人某物的，尤其指欠某人钱的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li s-sid għadu midjun mal-bank u għandu jħallas il-bilanċ sal-aħħar tas-sena.
formal.en: The report indicates that the owner is still in debt to the bank and must pay the outstanding balance by the end of the year.
formal.zh: 报告指出，业主仍欠银行款项，须在年底前付清余额。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek midjun ma' Pawlu? Mark: Iva, għandi nagħtih għoxrin ewro. Se nħallsu għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still owe Pawlu money? Mark: Yes, I owe him twenty euros. I'll pay him tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你还欠 Pawlu 钱吗？Mark：是的，我欠他二十欧元，明天还给他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还欠 Pawlu 钱吗？
messages.en: Do you still owe Pawlu money?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi nagħtih għoxrin ewro. Se nħallsu għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi nagħtih għoxrin ewro. Se nħallsu għada.
messages.zh: 是的，我欠他二十欧元，明天还给他。
messages.en: Yes, I owe him twenty euros. I'll pay him tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 midjun 和一张尚未还清的借条联系起来：单独描述人时记“负债的”，后接债主时记“欠谁钱的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Situated in the shade; in a separate sense, physically frail or weak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于阴影或阴凉处的；另一个义项表示身体虚弱、体质孱弱的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab fid-dell; f'tifsira oħra, dgħajjef fiżikament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在阴影中或阴凉处的；没有受到阳光直射的。
身体虚弱的；体质孱弱的。

formal.mt: Il-ġnien joffri post midliel fejn il-viżitaturi jistgħu jistrieħu matul il-ġurnata.
formal.en: The garden provides a spot in the shade where visitors can rest during the day.
formal.zh: 花园提供了一处阴凉的地方，供游客在白天休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se noqogħdu? Mark: Hawn taħt is-siġra; dan il-post midliel. Maja: Tajjeb, hawn nistgħu nistrieħu ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we sit? Mark: Here under the tree; this spot is in the shade. Maja: Good, we can rest here for a while.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们坐哪里？Mark：就坐这棵树下吧，这里有树荫。Maja：好，我们可以在这里休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we sit?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn taħt is-siġra; dan il-post midliel.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn taħt is-siġra; dan il-post midliel.
messages.zh: 就坐这棵树下吧，这里有树荫。
messages.en: Here under the tree; this spot is in the shade.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我们可以在这里休息一会儿。
messages.en: Good, we can rest here for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 midliel 配两张独立的记忆卡：树下的位置提示“在阴凉处的”，体弱的男孩提示“孱弱的”；根据它修饰的对象选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where people receive medical care or first aid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为人们提供医疗照护或急救的场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn in-nies jirċievu kura medika jew l-ewwel għajnuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诊所；提供医疗诊治的场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fejn tingħata kura medika.

sense_translations.en_definition: a place where first aid is administered
sense_translations.zh_definition: 急救处；为伤者或突发不适者实施初步救助的场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fejn tingħata l-ewwel għajnuna.

formal.mt: Il-midwa tipprovdi kura bażika u l-ewwel għajnuna lir-residenti.
formal.en: The clinic provides basic care and first aid to residents.
formal.zh: 该诊所为居民提供基础医疗照护和急救。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn nista' nirċievi l-ewwel għajnuna? Mark: Hemm midwa ħdejn l-iskola. Immorru flimkien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where can I get first aid? Mark: There's a clinic next to the school. Let's go together.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我可以去哪里接受急救？马克：学校旁边有一家诊所。我们一起去吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (居民)
messages.zh: 我可以去哪里接受急救？
messages.en: Where can I get first aid?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm midwa ħdejn l-iskola. Immorru flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm midwa ħdejn l-iskola. Immorru flimkien.
messages.zh: 学校旁边有一家诊所。我们一起去吧。
messages.en: There's a clinic next to the school. Let's go together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 midwa 记成地图上的医疗地点标记：平时可指诊所，需要初步救助时可指急救处。用“去哪里接受照护”串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large amount of smoke.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大量聚集或弥漫的烟，可用于描述烟雾浓重的场景。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont kbir ta' duħħan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量的烟；浓烟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħafna duħħan.

collocations.en: a large amount of black smoke

formal.mt: Waqt in-nar, midħna sewda ħarġet mit-twieqi tal-maħżen.
formal.en: During the fire, a large amount of black smoke came out of the warehouse windows.
formal.zh: 火灾期间，仓库的窗户冒出了大量黑烟。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Minn fejn ġejja din il-midħna? Pawlu: Mill-borma! Inħaraq l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is all this smoke coming from? Pawlu: From the pot! The food has burned.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这么多烟是从哪里来的？Pawlu：锅里！饭烧焦了。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 这么多烟是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is all this smoke coming from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 锅里！饭烧焦了。
messages.en: From the pot! The food has burned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象饭烧焦后厨房里满是烟：midħna 强调的是一大团、大量的烟，用“满屋浓烟”的画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rub against a surface; also, to behave stupidly or wantonly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贴着某个表面蹭擦；也可指做出愚蠢举动或肆意放纵地行事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Togħrok ma' wiċċ; ukoll, iġġib ruħek b'mod iblah jew bla rażan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贴着某个表面蹭擦。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Togħrok ma' wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做蠢事；表现得愚蠢。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġġib ruħek b'mod iblah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肆意妄为；放纵、不加约束地行事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġġib ruħek bla rażan.

formal.mt: Il-qattus miegħeż mal-ħajt qabel daħal fid-dar.
formal.en: The cat rubbed against the wall before entering the house.
formal.zh: 那只猫进屋前贴着墙蹭了蹭。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel il-qattus ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Miegħeż mal-bieb u mbagħad daħal.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the cat do by the door? Mark: He rubbed against the door and then came in.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那只猫在门边做了什么？马克：它贴着门蹭了蹭，然后就进来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那只猫在门边做了什么？
messages.en: What did the cat do by the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (猫主人)
messages.zh: 它贴着门蹭了蹭，然后就进来了。
messages.en: He rubbed against the door and then came in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“猫贴着门蹭擦”的画面记住 miegħeż 的动作义，再分别记两张行为卡片：“做蠢事”和“放纵妄为”。三张卡片帮助区分义项，不表示词源关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rub something vigorously, especially to remove dirt by scrubbing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力摩擦某物，尤指通过反复擦洗来去除污垢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Togħrok xi ħaġa bis-saħħa, speċjalment biex tneħħi l-ħmieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力摩擦；使劲揉擦。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Togħrok xi ħaġa bis-saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力擦洗，以去除顽固污垢。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tnaddaf xi ħaġa billi togħrokha bis-saħħa biex tneħħi l-ħmieġ.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem miegħrek il-wiċċ tal-metall b'ċarruta u bis-sapun sakemm neħħa l-ħmieġ.
formal.en: The worker rubbed the metal surface vigorously with a cloth and soap until he removed the dirt.
formal.zh: 工人用布和肥皂使劲擦拭金属表面，直到去除了污垢。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif naddaf Mark it-taġen? Pawlu: Miegħrek it-taġen b'ċarruta u bis-sapun, u issa nadif.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Mark clean the frying pan? Pawlu: He scoured it with a cloth and soap, and now it's clean.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克是怎么把煎锅洗干净的？保罗：他用布和肥皂使劲擦洗，现在锅干净了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克是怎么把煎锅洗干净的？
messages.en: How did Mark clean the frying pan?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Miegħrek it-taġen b'ċarruta u bis-sapun, u issa nadif.
messages.mt_standard: Miegħrek it-taġen b'ċarruta u bis-sapun, u issa nadif.
messages.zh: 他用布和肥皂使劲擦洗，现在锅干净了。
messages.en: He scoured the frying pan with a cloth and soap, and now it's clean.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miegħrek 和使劲擦锅的动作连在一起记：手来回用力擦，污垢逐渐消失，就能串起“用力摩擦”和“擦洗”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Food that people eat for nourishment, including food prepared for a meal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人食用、提供营养的食物，也包括为一餐准备的饭食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li nieklu biex nitmantnew, inkluż ikel imħejji għal ikla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食物；供人食用的饭食。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikel li jittiekel biex jagħti n-nutriment.

formal.mt: Il-miekla għandha titħejja f'post nadif u tinżamm mgħottija sakemm tiġi servuta.
formal.en: The food should be prepared in a clean place and kept covered until it is served.
formal.zh: 食物应在干净的地方准备，并在上桌前保持盖好。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ġibt il-miekla għall-familja? Ġużeppi: Iva, ġibt ħobż, ġobon u frott għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you bring the food for the family? Ġużeppi: Yes, I brought bread, cheese and fruit for everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你把给家人的食物带来了吗？约瑟夫：带来了，我给大家带了面包、奶酪和水果。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 你把给家人的食物带来了吗？
messages.en: Did you bring the food for the family?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġibt ħobż, ġobon u frott għal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġibt ħobż, ġobon u frott għal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 带来了，我给大家带了面包、奶酪和水果。
messages.en: Yes, I brought bread, cheese and fruit for everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miekla 写在一张装着面包、奶酪和水果的餐桌图片旁，用“桌上这些都是食物”的画面记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place or container where money is kept.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于存放钱币的地方或容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew reċipjent fejn jinżammu l-flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 存放钱财的地方。

collocations.en: to keep money in the money container
collocations.zh: 把钱存放在储钱容器里

formal.mt: Il-muniti nżammu f'mifles żgħir ġewwa l-armarju.
formal.en: The coins were kept in a small money container inside the cupboard.
formal.zh: 硬币存放在柜子里的一个小储钱容器中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se npoġġi dawn il-muniti? Marija: Poġġihom fil-mifles ħdejn il-kotba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where should I put these coins? Marija: Put them in the money container next to the books.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些硬币该放在哪里？玛丽娅：放进书旁边的储钱容器里。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 这些硬币该放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these coins?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 放进书旁边的储钱容器里。
messages.en: Put them in the money container next to the books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mifles 和“硬币有个存放处”的画面绑定：看到硬币放进小容器，就回想这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that is covered with branches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面覆有树枝的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa miksija bil-friegħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 覆有树枝的东西。

collocations.en: a large thing covered with branches
to remove the thing covered with branches

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema neħħew il-mifragħ li kien qed jimblokka l-mogħdija.
formal.en: The workers removed the thing covered with branches that was blocking the path.
formal.zh: 工人们移走了挡住小路的那个覆有树枝的东西。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: X'hemm quddiem il-bieb? Rita: Hemm mifragħ; ejja nneħħuh biex ngħaddu.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: What is in front of the door? Rita: There is something covered with branches; let's move it so we can get through.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：门前有什么？丽塔：有个覆着树枝的东西；我们把它移开，好走过去。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 门前有什么？
messages.en: What is in front of the door?

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm mifragħ; ejja nneħħuh biex ngħaddu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm mifragħ; ejja nneħħuh biex ngħaddu.
messages.zh: 有个覆着树枝的东西；我们把它移开，好走过去。
messages.en: There is something covered with branches; let's move it so we can get through.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 mifragħ 是名词：想象一个被树枝盖住的东西，重点是“那个东西”，而非“长出分枝”的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instrument used to separate things or parts from one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于把物体或其组成部分彼此分开的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex tifred affarijiet jew partijiet minn xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于分离或分开东西的工具。

collocations.en: to separate the parts with the separating instrument
collocations.zh: 用分离工具把各部分分开

formal.mt: It-tekniku uża mifraq biex jifred iż-żewġ partijiet mingħajr ma jagħmlilhom ħsara.
formal.en: The technician used a separating instrument to separate the two parts without damaging them.
formal.zh: 技术员使用分离工具把两个部分分开，没有损坏它们。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif nista' nifred dawn iż-żewġ partijiet? Mark: Uża dan il-mifraq u aħdem bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lina: How can I separate these two parts? Mark: Use this separating instrument and work slowly.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我怎样才能把这两个部分分开？马克：用这个分离工具，慢慢操作。

messages.speaker: Lina (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' nifred dawn iż-żewġ partijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' nifred dawn iż-żewġ partijiet?
messages.zh: 我怎样才能把这两个部分分开？
messages.en: How can I separate these two parts?

messages.speaker: Mark (技师)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża dan il-mifraq u aħdem bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Uża dan il-mifraq u aħdem bil-mod.
messages.zh: 用这个分离工具，慢慢操作。
messages.en: Use this separating instrument and work slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 mifraq 配一幅“工具把两部分分开”的图；把它记作工具名称，就能抓住分离这一用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having branches, or extending outward into branches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有分枝的，或向外伸展形成分枝的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-friegħi jew li jinfirex fi friegħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有枝条的；具有分枝的。
向外分枝的；伸展成多个分枝的。

formal.mt: Il-pjanta għandha zokk mifrugħ li minnu joħorġu diversi friegħi.
formal.en: The plant has a branched stem from which several branches grow.
formal.zh: 这株植物的茎干有分枝，从中长出数根枝条。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan l-għerq jibqa' dritt? Toni: Le, huwa mifrugħ; ara kemm għandu friegħi żgħar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this root stay straight? Toni: No, it branches out; look how many little branches it has.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这条根一直是直的吗？托尼：不是，它有分枝；看，它分出了这么多细根。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这条根一直是直的吗？
messages.en: Does this root stay straight?

messages.speaker: Toni (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa mifrugħ; ara kemm għandu friegħi żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa mifrugħ; ara kemm għandu friegħi żgħar.
messages.zh: 不是，它有分枝；看，它分出了这么多细根。
messages.en: No, it branches out; look how many little branches it has.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一幅树状图记 mifrugħ：既能看静态的“有分枝”，也能沿线向外看“分枝伸展”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having already produced fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经结出过果实的，用来描述植物的结果状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li diġà ta l-frott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经结过果实的。

collocations.en: apple trees that have borne fruit
collocations.zh: 已经结过果实的苹果树

collocations.en: almond trees that have borne fruit
collocations.zh: 已经结过果实的扁桃树

formal.mt: It-tuffieħ f'din il-parti tal-ġnien huwa mifruħ, għax diġà ta l-frott.
formal.en: The apple trees in this part of the garden have borne fruit, as they have already produced a crop.
formal.zh: 花园这一片的苹果树已经结过果实，已有过收成。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-lewż diġà ta l-frott? Ġużeppi: Iva, huwa mifruħ; ġbarna l-lewż minnu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have these almond trees produced fruit yet? Ġużeppi: Yes, they have borne fruit; we collected almonds from them.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些扁桃树已经结过果实了吗？朱塞佩：是的，已经结过了；我们从树上收过扁桃。

messages.speaker: Nina (孙女)
messages.zh: 这些扁桃树已经结过果实了吗？
messages.en: Have these almond trees produced fruit yet?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (祖父)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa mifruħ; ġbarna l-lewż minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa mifruħ; ġbarna l-lewż minnu.
messages.zh: 是的，已经结过了；我们从树上收过扁桃。
messages.en: Yes, they have borne fruit; we collected almonds from them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mifruħ 记成挂着“已结果”牌子的果树；重点是已经产过果实，不只是开花或将来可能结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Open rather than closed, allowing entry, access, or passage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于打开或开放状态的，可以进入、接近或通过的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex magħluq u jippermetti d-dħul jew il-mogħdija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打开的；开着的；开放的。
开着的；处于开放状态的。

formal.mt: Il-mużew ikun miftuħ għall-pubbliku mid-disgħa ta' filgħodu sal-ħamsa ta' wara nofsinhar.
formal.en: The museum is open to the public from nine in the morning until five in the afternoon.
formal.zh: 博物馆从上午九点至下午五点向公众开放。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-ħanut għadu miftuħ? David: Iva, għadu miftuħ; nistgħu nidħlu nixtru l-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is the shop still open? David: Yes, it is still open; we can go in and buy bread.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：商店还开着吗？戴维：是的，还在营业；我们可以进去买面包。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 商店还开着吗？
messages.en: Is the shop still open?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu miftuħ; nistgħu nidħlu nixtru l-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu miftuħ; nistgħu nidħlu nixtru l-ħobż.
messages.zh: 是的，还在营业；我们可以进去买面包。
messages.en: Yes, it is still open; we can go in and buy bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一扇敞开的门，上面写着 miftuħ；再把同一画面移到商店和博物馆，就能记住“开着、开放”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool used to scratch or scrape a surface; the word can also mean a hook.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于抓挠或刮擦表面的工具；也可指钩子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda biex tobrox jew tħokk wiċċ; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll ganċ.

sense_translations.en_definition: an implement used for scratching or scraping
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于抓挠或刮擦的器具。
钩子；用于钩住物体的器具。

collocations.en: to remove paint with a scraper
to hang something on a hook

formal.mt: Ir-restawratur uża migref żgħir biex ineħħi s-saff taż-żebgħa l-qadima mill-wiċċ tal-injam.
formal.en: The restorer used a small scraper to remove the layer of old paint from the wooden surface.
formal.zh: 修复师用一把小刮具去除了木质表面的旧漆层。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandek xi ħaġa biex inneħħi din iż-żebgħa? Toni: Iva, ħu dan il-migref u obrox bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you got something I can use to remove this paint? Toni: Yes, take this scraper and scrape gently.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你有能用来去掉这层油漆的工具吗？托尼：有，拿这把刮具，轻轻地刮。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek xi ħaġa biex inneħħi din iż-żebgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek xi ħaġa biex inneħħi din iż-żebgħa?
messages.zh: 你有能用来去掉这层油漆的工具吗？
messages.en: Have you got something I can use to remove this paint?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu dan il-migref u obrox bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu dan il-migref u obrox bil-mod.
messages.zh: 有，拿这把刮具，轻轻地刮。
messages.en: Yes, take this scraper and scrape gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 migref 放进工具箱画面：刮油漆时记“刮具”，挂物品时记“钩子”，按动作区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pouting or sulking, showing displeasure through a protruding lower lip or a resentful, withdrawn manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 噘着嘴或生着闷气的，借嘴部表情或不愿理人的态度表现不满。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħroġ xofftu jew jibqa' mbikkem u mbiegħed mill-oħrajn biex juri li mhux kuntent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 噘嘴的，嘴唇向前突出以表现不满的。
生闷气的，因不满而沉默或不愿理人的。

formal.mt: Wara li tilef il-logħba, it-tifel baqa' migrież u ma riedx jitkellem ma' sħabu.
formal.en: After losing the game, the boy remained sulky and did not want to speak to his friends.
formal.zh: 输掉比赛后，男孩一直生着闷气，不愿和朋友们说话。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex int migrież, Ben? Ben: Għax ħadtuli l-aħħar biċċa kejk! Marta: Ejja, naqsam tiegħi miegħek.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are you sulking, Ben? Ben: Because you took the last piece of cake from me! Marta: Come on, I'll share mine with you.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：本，你为什么生闷气呀？本：因为你们把最后一块蛋糕拿走了！玛尔塔：来吧，我把我的分给你。

messages.speaker: Marta (姐姐)
messages.zh: 本，你为什么生闷气呀？
messages.en: Why are you sulking, Ben?

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.zh: 因为你们把最后一块蛋糕拿走了！
messages.en: Because you took the last piece of cake from me!

messages.speaker: Marta (姐姐)
messages.zh: 来吧，我把我的分给你。
messages.en: Come on, I'll share mine with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象没吃到蛋糕的男孩：嘴巴噘起、转身不说话，用同一个画面记住 migrież 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool used to kindle a fire or poke and rearrange its burning fuel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于引火，或拨动、整理燃烧中燃料的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda biex tqabbad in-nar jew tqalleb u tmexxi l-ħatab jew il-faħam li jkun qed jaqbad.

sense_translations.en_definition: implement for kindling or poking a fire
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于引火或拨火的器具。

collocations.en: to stir the coals with a fire poker

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża mikbes tal-ħadid biex iqalleb il-faħam u jżomm in-nar jaqbad.
formal.en: The worker used an iron fire poker to stir the coals and keep the fire burning.
formal.zh: 工人用铁制拨火具拨动炭块，让炉火持续燃烧。

colloquial.mt: Nina: In-nar qed jonqos. Fejn hu l-mikbes? Ġanni: Qiegħed ħdejn il-fuklar; għaddihuli ħalli nċaqlaq il-ħatab.
colloquial.en: Nina: The fire is dying down. Where's the poker? Ġanni: It's beside the fireplace; pass it to me so I can move the logs.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：火越来越小了。拨火具在哪里？詹尼：在壁炉旁边，递给我，我来挪动木柴。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nar qed jonqos. Fejn hu l-mikbes?
messages.mt_standard: In-nar qed jonqos. Fejn hu l-mikbes?
messages.zh: 火越来越小了。拨火具在哪里？
messages.en: The fire is dying down. Where's the poker?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed ħdejn il-fuklar; għaddihuli ħalli nċaqlaq il-ħatab.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed ħdejn il-fuklar; għaddihuli ħalli nċaqlaq il-ħatab.
messages.zh: 在壁炉旁边，递给我，我来挪动木柴。
messages.en: It's beside the fireplace; pass it to me so I can move the logs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mikbes 和炉边拨动木柴的动作连起来：它是帮助引火、拨火的工具，重点记住用途。

gloss_zh: 米基耶尔（男子名，对应英语 Michael）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male given name corresponding to the English name Michael.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他语男子名，可音译为“米基耶尔”，对应英语名字 Michael。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' raġel li jikkorrispondi għall-isem Ingliż Michael.

sense_translations.en_definition: a male given name from Sicilian [in turn from Latin, in turn from Hebrew], equivalent to English Michael
sense_translations.zh_definition: 源自西西里语的男子名；该名字经拉丁语上溯至希伯来语，对应英语 Michael。

formal.mt: Mikiel ippreżenta r-rapport lill-kumitat u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet tal-membri.
formal.en: Mikiel presented the report to the committee and answered the members' questions.
formal.zh: 米基耶尔向委员会提交了报告，并回答了委员们的问题。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif jismu ħuk? David: Jismu Mikiel. Trid tlaqqagħni miegħu? Anna: Iva, bil-qalb!
colloquial.en: Anna: What's your brother's name? David: His name is Mikiel. Would you like me to introduce you to him? Anna: Yes, I'd love that!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你兄弟叫什么名字？戴维：他叫米基耶尔。你想让我介绍你们认识吗？安娜：好啊，很乐意！

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟叫什么名字？
messages.en: What's your brother's name?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 他叫米基耶尔。你想让我介绍你们认识吗？
messages.en: His name is Mikiel. Would you like me to introduce you to him?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 好啊，很乐意！
messages.en: Yes, I'd love that!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mikiel 和英语人名 Michael 配成一对记忆；实际书写人名时，首字母 M 要大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of obtaining or procuring food for oneself or others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为自己或他人获取、筹措食物的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma biex wieħed jikseb l-ikel għalih innifsu jew għal ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食物的获取或筹措。

collocations.en: the procurement of food for the family
to take care of procuring food

formal.mt: Matul il-vjaġġ, persuna waħda kienet responsabbli għall-mikjel tal-grupp kollu.
formal.en: During the journey, one person was responsible for procuring food for the entire group.
formal.zh: 旅途中，由一人负责为整个团队筹措食物。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-mikjel għall-kamp? Luqa: Jien. Għada nixtri l-ħobż, il-frott u l-bqija tal-ikel.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who's going to take care of getting food for the camp? Luqa: I am. Tomorrow I'll buy the bread, fruit and the rest of the food.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：谁来负责筹措露营的食物？卢卡：我来。明天我去买面包、水果和其他食物。

messages.speaker: Marija (露营组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-mikjel għall-kamp?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-mikjel għall-kamp?
messages.zh: 谁来负责筹措露营的食物？
messages.en: Who's going to take care of getting food for the camp?

messages.speaker: Luqa (露营成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Għada nixtri l-ħobż, il-frott u l-bqija tal-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Għada nixtri l-ħobż, il-frott u l-bqija tal-ikel.
messages.zh: 我来。明天我去买面包、水果和其他食物。
messages.en: I am. Tomorrow I'll buy the bread, fruit and the rest of the food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用露营分工记 mikjel：有人负责把面包、水果等食物找来，记住“筹措食物”这个活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of obtaining or acquiring something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 取得或获得某事物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jikseb jew jakkwista xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 取得某事物的行为。

formal.mt: Il-miksba ta' permess mill-awtorità hija meħtieġa qabel ma jibda x-xogħol.
formal.en: Obtaining a permit from the authority is required before work begins.
formal.zh: 开工前必须取得主管机关的许可证。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Xadalna nagħmlu qabel nibdew? Mark: Il-miksba tal-permess. Għadna qed nistennew it-tweġiba. Elena: Mela nħejju l-bqija sadanittant.
colloquial.en: Elena: What do we still need to do before we start? Mark: Obtain the permit. We're still waiting for the reply. Elena: Then let's prepare everything else in the meantime.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：开始之前，我们还需要做什么？马克：取得许可证。我们还在等回复。埃莱娜：那我们先把其他事情准备好。

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.zh: 开始之前，我们还需要做什么？
messages.en: What do we still need to do before we start?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-miksba tal-permess. Għadna qed nistennew it-tweġiba.
messages.mt_standard: Il-miksba tal-permess. Għadna qed nistennew it-tweġiba.
messages.zh: 取得许可证。我们还在等回复。
messages.en: Obtain the permit. We're still waiting for the reply.

messages.speaker: Elena (同事)
messages.zh: 那我们先把其他事情准备好。
messages.en: Then let's prepare everything else in the meantime.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“终于拿到许可证”的画面记 miksba：重点是取得某物的行为，后接具体取得的东西。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A desk used for writing, reading, or studying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于写字、阅读或学习的桌子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mejda maħsuba biex wieħed jikteb, jaqra jew jistudja fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 书桌；供书写使用的写字台。

collocations.en: a writing desk beside the window

formal.mt: Fil-kamra tal-istudju hemm mikteb b'żewġ kxaxen għall-karti u l-pinen.
formal.en: In the study there is a writing desk with two drawers for papers and pens.
formal.zh: 书房里有一张写字台，带有两个存放纸张和笔的抽屉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se tpoġġi l-mikteb il-ġdid? Mark: Ħdejn it-tieqa, biex ikolli aktar dawl meta nikteb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where will you put the new writing desk? Mark: Beside the window, so I have more light when I write.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你准备把新书桌放在哪里？Mark：窗边，这样写字时光线更充足。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备把新书桌放在哪里？
messages.en: Where will you put the new writing desk?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn it-tieqa, biex ikolli aktar dawl meta nikteb.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn it-tieqa, biex ikolli aktar dawl meta nikteb.
messages.zh: 窗边，这样写字时光线更充足。
messages.en: Beside the window, so I have more light when I write.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mikteb 和窗边摆着纸笔的书桌画面绑定，看到这个词就想“坐下来写字的桌子”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cosmetic pencil used to apply colour to the eyelids or outline the eyes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于给眼睑着色或勾画眼部轮廓的化妆笔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lapes tal-kożmetiċi li jintuża biex jagħti l-kulur lit-tebqet il-għajn jew jimmarka l-kontorn tal-għajnejn.

sense_translations.en_definition: cosmetic pencil applied to the eyelids
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于眼睑的化妆笔；眼线笔。

collocations.en: a thin line drawn with an eyeliner pencil

formal.mt: L-artista tal-make-up użat mikħal iswed biex tiġbed linja rqiqa fuq it-tebqet il-għajn tal-mudella.
formal.en: The makeup artist used a black eyeliner pencil to draw a thin line on the model's eyelid.
formal.zh: 化妆师用黑色眼线笔在模特的眼睑上画了一条细线。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tfittex il-mikħal iswed? Lea: Iva, irrid nagħmel linja rqiqa biss. Sara: Qiegħed fil-borża ż-żgħira ħdejn il-mera.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you looking for the black eyeliner pencil? Lea: Yes, I just want to draw a thin line. Sara: It's in the little bag beside the mirror.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在找那支黑色眼线笔吗？莱娅：对，我只想画一条细细的眼线。萨拉：在镜子旁边的小包里。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在找那支黑色眼线笔吗？
messages.en: Are you looking for the black eyeliner pencil?

messages.speaker: Lea (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irrid nagħmel linja rqiqa biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irrid nagħmel linja rqiqa biss.
messages.zh: 对，我只想画一条细细的眼线。
messages.en: Yes, I just want to draw a thin line.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 在镜子旁边的小包里。
messages.en: It's in the little bag beside the mirror.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镜子旁的一支黑色化妆笔，在眼睑上画细线；把这个动作与 mikħal 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become smooth or sleek, with a more even surface or a smoother appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得平滑、光顺，表面或外观不再粗糙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir lixx jew jieħu dehra lixxa u mingħajr ħruxija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被弄平滑；经过处理而变得平滑。
变得光顺；外观变得平滑顺溜。

collocations.en: the wood became smooth after sanding
the hair became sleek after brushing

formal.mt: Wara x-xkatlar, il-wiċċ tal-injam miles u sar lest għaż-żebgħa.
formal.en: After sanding, the surface of the wood became smooth and was ready for painting.
formal.zh: 打磨后，木材表面变得平滑，可以上漆了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-wiċċ tal-mejda għadu aħrax? Pawlu: Le, miles wara x-xkatlar. Issa tista' tgħaddi idek fuqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the tabletop still rough? Pawlu: No, it became smooth after sanding. You can run your hand over it now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：桌面还粗糙吗？Pawlu：不粗糙了，打磨后变平滑了。现在可以用手摸过去了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 桌面还粗糙吗？
messages.en: Is the tabletop still rough?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, miles wara x-xkatlar. Issa tista' tgħaddi idek fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, miles wara x-xkatlar. Issa tista' tgħaddi idek fuqu.
messages.zh: 不粗糙了，打磨后变平滑了。现在可以用手摸过去了。
messages.en: No, it became smooth after sanding. You can run your hand over it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 miles 时想象手指滑过刚打磨好的木板，用“粗糙变平滑”的触感记住这个变化动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Greedy for food, or especially fond of sweets and sweet treats.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贪吃的，或特别喜欢糖果、糕点等甜食的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jiekol ħafna, jew li għandu ġibda speċjali lejn il-ħelu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪吃的；总想多吃一些的。
嗜好甜食的；特别爱吃糖果、蜜饯或甜点的。

formal.mt: Fit-test, it-tifel huwa deskritt bħala milgħaq għax dejjem jitlob aktar kejk u gallettini.
formal.en: In the text, the boy is described as greedy because he always asks for more cake and biscuits.
formal.zh: 文中把这个男孩描述为贪吃，因为他总是要求再吃一些蛋糕和饼干。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid biċċa kejk oħra? Mark: Iva, jien milgħaq għall-ħelu, imma biċċa żgħira biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Nina: Would you like another piece of cake? Mark: Yes, I have a sweet tooth, but a small piece is enough.
colloquial.zh: Nina：还想来一块蛋糕吗？Mark：想，我很爱吃甜食，不过一小块就够了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 还想来一块蛋糕吗？
messages.en: Would you like another piece of cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien milgħaq għall-ħelu, imma biċċa żgħira biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien milgħaq għall-ħelu, imma biċċa żgħira biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 想，我很爱吃甜食，不过一小块就够了。
messages.en: Yes, I have a sweet tooth, but a small piece is enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 milgħaq 配上伸手再拿一块蛋糕的人物画面，同时记住“贪吃”和“爱吃甜食”两个意思。

gloss_zh: 斗争性强的；采取强硬行动的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Forceful and determined in supporting a cause, and ready to take combative action for it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支持某项事业时态度强硬、意志坚决，并准备为之采取斗争行动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri determinazzjoni qawwija u lest jiġġieled biex jiddefendi kawża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斗争性强的；为某种主张积极斗争、态度强硬的。

formal.mt: Il-grupp militanti talab bidliet immedjati u ħabbar kampanja ta' protesti.
formal.en: The militant group demanded immediate changes and announced a campaign of protests.
formal.zh: 这个采取强硬立场的团体要求立即作出改变，并宣布开展一系列抗议活动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif tiddeskrivi lil dak l-attivist? David: Militanti ħafna; dejjem lest jissielet għall-kawża tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: How would you describe that activist? David: Very militant; he is always ready to fight for his cause.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你会怎样形容那位活动人士？David：斗争性很强；他总是准备为自己的主张抗争。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你会怎样形容那位活动人士？
messages.en: How would you describe that activist?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Militanti ħafna; dejjem lest jissielet għall-kawża tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Militanti ħafna; dejjem lest jissielet għall-kawża tiegħu.
messages.zh: 斗争性很强；他总是准备为自己的主张抗争。
messages.en: Very militant; he is always ready to fight for his cause.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用举着标语、坚决要求行动的人物形象记 militanti，重点联想“支持主张时斗争性强”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The armed forces of a country, considered collectively as an institution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为一个整体或机构而言的国家武装力量，即军队或军方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forzi armati ta' pajjiż meqjusa flimkien bħala istituzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 军队；军方，指武装力量这一整体或机构。

formal.mt: Il-militar ipparteċipa f'eżerċizzju konġunt mas-servizzi tal-emerġenza.
formal.en: The military participated in a joint exercise with the emergency services.
formal.zh: 军队与应急服务部门共同参加了一次联合演练。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk fejn jaħdem? Toni: Qiegħed fil-militar; bħalissa qed jagħmel taħriġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where does your brother work? Toni: He is in the military; he is doing training at the moment.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你哥哥在哪里工作？Toni：他在军队服役，目前正在接受训练。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥在哪里工作？
messages.en: Where does your brother work?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed fil-militar; bħalissa qed jagħmel taħriġ.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed fil-militar; bħalissa qed jagħmel taħriġ.
messages.zh: 他在军队服役，目前正在接受训练。
messages.en: He is in the military; he is doing training at the moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 il-militar 当作一个整体来记：想象营区里的整支军队，再用“军方参加演练”练习名词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of giving a place, institution, or activity a more military character through military forces, equipment, or practices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过引入军队、军事装备或军事做法，使某个地区、机构或活动具有更多军事性质的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih post, istituzzjoni jew attività jieħu karattru aktar militari permezz ta' forzi, tagħmir jew prattiki militari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 军事化；使地区、机构或活动逐渐具有军事性质的过程。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-militarizzazzjoni tar-reġjun u l-effett tagħha fuq il-ħajja taċ-ċivili.
formal.en: The report examines the militarization of the region and its effect on civilian life.
formal.zh: 报告考察了该地区的军事化及其对平民生活的影响。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'tifhem b'militarizzazzjoni tal-fruntiera? Mark: Li jiżdiedu s-suldati u t-tagħmir militari hemmhekk.
colloquial.en: Nina: What do you mean by militarization of the border? Mark: An increase in soldiers and military equipment there.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你说的边境军事化是什么意思？Mark：就是在那里增加士兵和军事装备。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你说的边境军事化是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean by militarization of the border?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li jiżdiedu s-suldati u t-tagħmir militari hemmhekk.
messages.mt_standard: Li jiżdiedu s-suldati u t-tagħmir militari hemmhekk.
messages.zh: 就是在那里增加士兵和军事装备。
messages.en: An increase in soldiers and military equipment there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张边境地图上士兵和军事装备逐渐增多，用这个动态画面记 militarizzazzjoni 所表示的军事化过程。

gloss_zh: 军国主义；军事至上主义

teaching_sense.en_definition: A belief or policy that gives military power and military values a dominant role in a country's affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主张让军事力量及军事价值观在国家事务中占据主导地位的思想或政策。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twemmin jew politika li tagħti lill-qawwa u lill-valuri militari rwol dominanti fl-affarijiet tal-pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 军国主义；军事至上主义，即推崇军事力量并使其主导国家事务的思想或政策。

formal.mt: L-esej janalizza l-militariżmu bħala ideoloġija li tagħti prijorità lill-qawwa militari fid-deċiżjonijiet tal-istat.
formal.en: The essay analyzes militarism as an ideology that gives priority to military power in state decisions.
formal.zh: 这篇文章将军国主义作为一种在国家决策中优先考虑军事力量的意识形态加以分析。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ifisser militariżmu f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Ifisser li l-qawwa u l-valuri militari jingħataw rwol dominanti fil-pajjiż.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does militarism mean in this text? Pawlu: It means that military power and military values are given a dominant role in the country.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这篇文章中的“军国主义”是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是让军事力量和军事价值观在国家中占据主导地位。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章中的“军国主义”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does militarism mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-qawwa u l-valuri militari jingħataw rwol dominanti fil-pajjiż.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-qawwa u l-valuri militari jingħataw rwol dominanti fil-pajjiż.
messages.zh: 意思是让军事力量和军事价值观在国家中占据主导地位。
messages.en: It means that military power and military values are given a dominant role in the country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 militariżmu 配一句“凡事军事优先”，借这句提示记住它表示军事力量至上的思想或政策。

gloss_zh: 被击中的；受到打击的；惊讶的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Struck or hit by something, or taken by surprise by an unexpected event or piece of news.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被某物击中的，或因突发事件、意外消息而感到惊讶的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ntlaqat minn xi ħaġa, jew li ħass sorpriża minħabba ġrajja jew aħbar mhux mistennija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到击打的；被击中的。
被打中的；遭到撞击的。
惊讶的；因出乎意料的事情而感到意外的。

collocations.en: taken aback by the unexpected news

formal.mt: Il-plejer milqut mill-ballun ħareġ mill-grawnd għal ftit minuti.
formal.en: The player who was hit by the ball left the pitch for a few minutes.
formal.zh: 被球击中的那名球员离开球场休息了几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex bqajt sieket meta smajt l-aħbar? David: Kont milqut; ma stennejtx li l-laqgħa titħassar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you go quiet when you heard the news? David: I was taken aback; I hadn't expected the meeting to be canceled.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你听到消息后为什么不说话了？David：我很惊讶，没想到会议会取消。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex bqajt sieket meta smajt l-aħbar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex bqajt sieket meta smajt l-aħbar?
messages.zh: 你听到消息后为什么不说话了？
messages.en: Why did you go quiet when you heard the news?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont milqut; ma stennejtx li l-laqgħa titħassar.
messages.mt_standard: Kont milqut; ma stennejtx li l-laqgħa titħassar.
messages.zh: 我很惊讶，没想到会议会取消。
messages.en: I was taken aback; I hadn't expected the meeting to be canceled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 milqut：球击中身体，以及意外消息让人一愣；分别对应“被击中”和“感到惊讶”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rainy; used to describe weather or a period with rain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容天气或某段时间下雨、多雨的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkollu x-xita, speċjalment meta nitkellmu dwar it-temp jew jum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 下雨的；多雨的。

formal.mt: Minħabba t-temp milwiem, l-attività fil-beraħ ġiet posposta.
formal.en: Because of the rainy weather, the outdoor activity was postponed.
formal.zh: 由于天气多雨，户外活动延期举行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Illum it-temp milwiem. Nieħdu umbrella? Mark: Iva, ħudha biex ma nixxarrbux.
colloquial.en: Lara: The weather is rainy today. Shall we take an umbrella? Mark: Yes, take it so we don't get wet.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天是下雨天。我们带把伞好吗？马克：好，带上吧，免得我们淋湿。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天是下雨天。我们带把伞好吗？
messages.en: The weather is rainy today. Shall we take an umbrella?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，带上吧，免得我们淋湿。
messages.en: Yes, take it so we don't get wet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 milwiem 和雨伞、雨天日历连成一幅图，记住它描述的是下雨或多雨的天气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lying down in a horizontal position, including lying on one's back.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体横躺着的；也可具体指背部朝下、面部朝上的仰卧姿势。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'pożizzjoni orizzontali, bħal fuq sodda jew sufan; jista' jkun ukoll fuq dahru b'wiċċu 'l fuq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仰卧的，即背部朝下、面部朝上地躺着的。
躺着的；身体处于横卧姿势的。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa, ir-raġel jidher mimdud fuq dahru b'wiċċu 'l fuq.
formal.en: In the picture, the man is shown lying on his back with his face upward.
formal.zh: 图中的男子仰卧着，脸部朝上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Pawlu? Lara: Qiegħed mimdud fuq is-sufan. Għadu kemm wasal mix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Pawlu? Lara: He's lying on the sofa. He's just got home from work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗在哪儿？拉拉：他正躺在沙发上，刚下班到家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed mimdud fuq is-sufan. Għadu kemm wasal mix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed mimdud fuq is-sufan. Għadu kemm wasal mix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 他正躺在沙发上，刚下班到家。
messages.en: He's lying on the sofa. He's just got home from work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象一个人横躺在沙发上来记 mimdud；再加上 fuq dahru，就把画面转成仰卧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Combed and arranged neatly, especially of hair that looks smooth and sleek.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指头发经过梳理、整齐顺滑的，也可强调梳得光顺的外观。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie rranġat b'moxt, speċjalment xagħar li jidher lixx u pulit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 光顺整齐的，尤指梳理后显得顺滑的头发。
梳过的；经过梳理的，指头发。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt uffiċjali, Mark jidher b'xagħru mimxut lura u liebes ġakketta skura.
formal.en: In the official photograph, Mark appears with his hair combed back and wearing a dark jacket.
formal.zh: 在正式照片中，马克的头发向后梳理，身穿深色夹克。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xagħrek mimxut sew illum! Għandek xi okkażjoni? Mark: Iva, għandi intervista dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Your hair is nicely combed today! Is there a special occasion? Mark: Yes, I have an interview this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天头发梳得真整齐！有什么特别的事吗？马克：有啊，我今天上午有面试。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xagħrek mimxut sew illum! Għandek xi okkażjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Xagħrek mimxut sew illum! Għandek xi okkażjoni?
messages.zh: 你今天头发梳得真整齐！有什么特别的事吗？
messages.en: Your hair is nicely combed today! Is there a special occasion?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有啊，我今天上午有面试。
messages.en: Yes, I have an interview this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mimxut 配上梳子划过头发后的整齐画面：既可以记“梳过”，也可以记“光顺”。

gloss_zh: 玩火者终将自焚；自作自受

teaching_sense.en_definition: A warning that someone who engages in dangerous or harmful behavior will eventually suffer its consequences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 告诫人们，反复从事危险或有害行为，最终会使自己承受恶果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qawl li jwissi li min jidħol fil-periklu jew jagħmel il-ħsara fl-aħħar ibati l-konsegwenzi.

sense_translations.en_definition: live by the sword, die by the sword
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以剑为生者必死于剑下；比喻惯于冒险或伤害他人的人最终会自食其果。

collocations.mt: Ftakar: min jilgħab man-nar fl-aħħar jinħaraq.
collocations.en: Remember: those who play with fire eventually get burned.
collocations.zh: 记住：玩火的人最终会烧到自己。

collocations.mt: Kif jgħid il-qawl, min jilgħab man-nar fl-aħħar jinħaraq.
collocations.en: As the proverb says, those who play with fire eventually get burned.
collocations.zh: 俗话说，玩火者终将自焚。

formal.mt: L-awtur jagħlaq ir-rakkont bil-qawl 'min jilgħab man-nar fl-aħħar jinħaraq', wara li l-protagonist ibati l-konsegwenzi tal-qerq tiegħu.
formal.en: The author closes the story with the proverb 'those who play with fire eventually get burned', after the protagonist suffers the consequences of his deceit.
formal.zh: 主人公因自己的欺骗行为遭受恶果后，作者以“玩火者终将自焚”这句谚语结束故事。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Se nerġa' nsuq b'veloċità għolja f'dik it-triq. Nina: Tagħmilx hekk; min jilgħab man-nar fl-aħħar jinħaraq.
colloquial.en: Luca: I'm going to drive fast on that road again. Nina: Don't do that; those who play with fire eventually get burned.
colloquial.zh: Luca：我还要在那条路上开快车。Nina：别这样，玩火迟早会烧到自己。

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nerġa' nsuq b'veloċità għolja f'dik it-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Se nerġa' nsuq b'veloċità għolja f'dik it-triq.
messages.zh: 我还要在那条路上开快车。
messages.en: I'm going to drive fast on that road again.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tagħmilx hekk; min jilgħab man-nar fl-aħħar jinħaraq.
messages.mt_standard: Tagħmilx hekk; min jilgħab man-nar fl-aħħar jinħaraq.
messages.zh: 别这样，玩火迟早会烧到自己。
messages.en: Don't do that; those who play with fire eventually get burned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按画面顺序记整句：有人玩火，最后被烧伤。用“危险行为带来自身恶果”的因果链记住谚语含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A saying that encourages patience because waiting can bring a good outcome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼓励人保持耐心的谚语，表示等待最终可能带来令人满意的结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qawl li jħeġġeġ il-paċenzja għax min jistenna jista' fl-aħħar jikseb riżultat tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耐心终有回报；耐心等待会有好结果。

collocations.mt: Kif jgħid il-qawl, min jistenna jithenna.
collocations.en: As the proverb says, patience pays off.
collocations.zh: 俗话说，耐心等待终有好结果。

formal.mt: Wara xhur ta' stennija, l-applikazzjoni ġiet aċċettata, u Maria ftakret fil-qawl 'min jistenna jithenna'.
formal.en: After months of waiting, the application was accepted, and Maria remembered the proverb 'patience pays off'.
formal.zh: 经过数月等待，申请终于获批，Maria 想起了“耐心等待终有回报”这句谚语。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Għadni qed nistenna tweġiba għall-applikazzjoni tiegħi. Lara: Ftit paċenzja oħra; min jistenna jithenna.
colloquial.en: Ben: I'm still waiting for a reply to my application. Lara: Be patient a little longer; patience pays off.
colloquial.zh: Ben：我还在等申请的回复。Lara：再耐心等一等，耐心终有回报。

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni qed nistenna tweġiba għall-applikazzjoni tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni qed nistenna tweġiba għall-applikazzjoni tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我还在等申请的回复。
messages.en: I'm still waiting for a reply to my application.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit paċenzja oħra; min jistenna jithenna.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit paċenzja oħra; min jistenna jithenna.
messages.zh: 再耐心等一等，耐心终有回报。
messages.en: Be patient a little longer; patience pays off.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句想成“先等待，后欢喜”的两格漫画，并借 jistenna 与 jithenna 相近的结尾节奏反复朗读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: From a position or space between two or more things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示从两个或多个事物之间的位置、空隙或中间出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Minn post jew spazju li jinsab bejn żewġ affarijiet jew aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从……之间；从……中间的位置或空隙出来。

formal.mt: L-għasfur ħareġ minbejn is-siġar u tar lejn il-baħar.
formal.en: The bird emerged from between the trees and flew toward the sea.
formal.zh: 那只鸟从树木之间飞出，朝大海飞去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sibt iċ-ċavetta? Pawlu: Ħriġtha minbejn il-kotba fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you find the key? Pawlu: I took it out from between the books on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在哪里找到钥匙的？保罗：我把它从书架上的书本之间拿了出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你在哪里找到钥匙的？
messages.en: Where did you find the key?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 我把它从书架上的书本之间拿了出来。
messages.en: I took it out from between the books on the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两本书，再画一支从书缝向外的箭头，用这幅图记住 minbejn 的“从中间出来”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: From what place or source; used to ask about origin or where something was obtained.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 询问来自什么地方或源自什么来源，也用于问某物从哪里得到。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Minn liema post jew sors; tintuża biex tistaqsi dwar l-oriġini jew minn fejn inkisbet xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从哪里；来自何处；源自什么地方或来源。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega minfejn ġiet l-informazzjoni u kif ġiet ivverifikata.
formal.en: The report explains where the information came from and how it was verified.
formal.zh: 报告说明了信息来自何处，以及如何对其进行核实。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ktieb sabiħ! Minfejn xtrajtu? Mark: Mill-ħanut żgħir ħdejn l-istazzjon.
colloquial.en: Lara: This book is lovely! Where did you buy it? Mark: From the little shop near the station.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这本书真漂亮！你从哪里买的？马克：从车站旁边的那家小店买的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书真漂亮！你从哪里买的？
messages.en: This book is lovely! Where did you buy it?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 从车站旁边的那家小店买的。
messages.en: From the little shop near the station.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给一件物品画一条指向来处的箭头，再加问号；看到 minfejn 就问“它从哪里来”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Swollen or bloated; enlarged or feeling uncomfortably full.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积肿大或胀起的；也可形容人感到腹部胀满、不舒服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun żdied fid-daqs jew jidher imkabbar; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jħoss żaqqu mimlija u skomda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肿胀的；身体部位比平常肿大的。
胀满的；腹部鼓胀或感觉腹胀的。

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-istampa, is-saba' jidher minfuħ meta mqabbel mas-swaba' l-oħra.
formal.en: In the description of the picture, the finger appears swollen compared with the other fingers.
formal.zh: 图片描述指出，这根手指与其他手指相比显得肿胀。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kilt wisq u issa nħossni minfuħ. Lara: Trid nieħdu l-kumplament tal-ikel magħna?
colloquial.en: Mark: I ate too much and now I feel bloated. Lara: Shall we take the rest of the food with us?
colloquial.zh: 马克：我吃得太多了，现在觉得肚子胀。拉拉：我们把剩下的食物打包带走好吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kilt wisq u issa nħossni minfuħ.
messages.mt_standard: Kilt wisq u issa nħossni minfuħ.
messages.zh: 我吃得太多了，现在觉得肚子胀。
messages.en: I ate too much and now I feel bloated.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们把剩下的食物打包带走好吗？
messages.en: Shall we take the rest of the food with us?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 minfuħ：肿起来的手指和吃得过饱的肚子，共同特点都是“胀”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expresses what someone thinks, reckons, or takes to be the case, as in mingħalija for 'I think' or 'I thought'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达某人认为或以为某事属实；例如 mingħalija 可根据语境表示“我觉得”或“我原以为”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tesprimi dak li xi ħadd jaħseb jew jassumi li hu minnu, bħal fil-forma mingħalija.

sense_translations.en_definition: to think, reckon, be under the impression that
sense_translations.zh_definition: 认为；估计；以为某事是如此。

collocations.en: I think that; I was under the impression that
you think that; you were under the impression that

formal.mt: Mingħalija li l-laqgħa kienet fit-tlieta, iżda l-istedina tgħid li tibda fl-erbgħa.
formal.en: I was under the impression that the meeting was at three, but the invitation says it starts at four.
formal.zh: 我原以为会议在三点举行，但邀请函上写着四点开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mingħalija li l-ħanut kien magħluq illum. Pawlu: Le, illum jiftaħ sad-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: I thought the shop was closed today. Pawlu: No, it's open until nine today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我原以为那家店今天不开门。保罗：不是，今天营业到九点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mingħalija li l-ħanut kien magħluq illum.
messages.mt_standard: Mingħalija li l-ħanut kien magħluq illum.
messages.zh: 我原以为那家店今天不开门。
messages.en: I thought the shop was closed today.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，今天营业到九点。
messages.en: No, it's open until nine today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mingħalija li 整块记成“我原以为……”，想象查看营业时间后发现自己记错的场景。

gloss_zh: 我不信教；我不是宗教人士

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement that the speaker is not religious.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示说话者本人不信教或不以宗教信仰为生活重心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frażi li biha l-kelliem jgħid li mhuwiex persuna reliġjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我不信教；我不是宗教人士。

collocations.mt: Miniex reliġjuż, imma nirrispetta t-twemmin tiegħek.
collocations.en: I'm not religious, but I respect your beliefs.
collocations.zh: 我不信教，但我尊重你的信仰。

formal.mt: Fl-istqarrija personali tiegħu, kiteb: 'Miniex reliġjuż, iżda nirrispetta l-libertà tat-twemmin ta' kulħadd.'
formal.en: In his personal statement, he wrote: 'I'm not religious, but I respect everyone's freedom of belief.'
formal.zh: 他在个人陈述中写道：“我不信教，但我尊重每个人的信仰自由。”

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-reliġjon hija importanti għalik? Mark: Miniex reliġjuż, imma nieħu gost nitgħallem dwar it-twemmin ta' ħaddieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is religion important to you? Mark: I'm not religious, but I enjoy learning about other people's beliefs.
colloquial.zh: Maja：宗教对你重要吗？Mark：我不信教，但我很喜欢了解别人的信仰。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 宗教对你重要吗？
messages.en: Is religion important to you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Miniex reliġjuż, imma nieħu gost nitgħallem dwar it-twemmin ta' ħaddieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Miniex reliġjuż, imma nieħu gost nitgħallem dwar it-twemmin ta' ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 我不信教，但我很喜欢了解别人的信仰。
messages.en: I'm not religious, but I enjoy learning about other people's beliefs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句放进自我介绍场景记忆：别人问信仰时回答“我不信教”，再接一句尊重对方信仰的话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a government minister or to the work and authority of a ministry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与政府部长、政府部门的工作或其职权有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' ministru jew mal-ħidma u s-setgħat ta' ministeru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 部长的；与政府部门及其职权有关的；部级的。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa ministerjali se tiffoka fuq il-kooperazzjoni bejn il-pajjiżi fil-qasam tal-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The ministerial meeting will focus on cooperation between countries in education.
formal.zh: 此次部长级会议将重点讨论各国在教育领域的合作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm tant nies ħdejn il-binja? Pawlu: Illum hemm laqgħa ministerjali dwar l-edukazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are there so many people near the building? Pawlu: There's a ministerial meeting on education today.
colloquial.zh: Sara：大楼附近怎么有这么多人？Pawlu：今天有一场关于教育的部长级会议。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm tant nies ħdejn il-binja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm tant nies ħdejn il-binja?
messages.zh: 大楼附近怎么有这么多人？
messages.en: Why are there so many people near the building?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum hemm laqgħa ministerjali dwar l-edukazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Illum hemm laqgħa ministerjali dwar l-edukazzjoni.
messages.zh: 今天有一场关于教育的部长级会议。
messages.en: There's a ministerial meeting on education today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议桌上摆着各位部长的名牌，把 ministerjali 与“部长级会议”和“部长决定”两组搭配一起记。

gloss_zh: 从死者中；从死亡中复起

teaching_sense.en_definition: From the dead, used with qam to describe rising or returning to life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与 qam 搭配，表示从死者中复起、死而复生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża ma' qam biex tfisser li xi ħadd reġa' ħa l-ħajja wara li miet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从死者中；与 qam 连用，表示从死亡中复起、复活。

formal.mt: Fit-twemmin Nisrani, Ġesù qam minn bejn l-imwiet fit-tielet jum.
formal.en: In Christian belief, Jesus rose from the dead on the third day.
formal.zh: 按照基督教信仰，耶稣在第三天从死者中复活。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi tfisser 'qam minn bejn l-imwiet'? David: Tfisser li reġa' ħa l-ħajja wara li miet.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does 'rose from the dead' mean? David: It means that he came back to life after dying.
colloquial.zh: Anna：“从死者中复活”是什么意思？David：意思是他死后又恢复了生命。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: “从死者中复活”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'rose from the dead' mean?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li reġa' ħa l-ħajja wara li miet.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li reġa' ħa l-ħajja wara li miet.
messages.zh: 意思是他死后又恢复了生命。
messages.en: It means that he came back to life after dying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qam 和整段 minn bejn l-imwiet 绑在一起记，想象人物从死者中站起的画面，对应中文“复活”。

gloss_zh: 出于自己的想象；自己编造的

teaching_sense.en_definition: From someone's own imagination or invention, typically expressed with a possessive form such as minn moħħi.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示内容出自某人自己的想象或编造；实际使用时常用 minn moħħi 等带所属标记的形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tindika li xi ħaġa ġejja mill-immaġinazzjoni ta' persuna, bħal fil-frażi minn moħħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某人自己想出来的内容；出于自己的想象或编造。

collocations.en: a story of my own invention
an excuse he made up himself

formal.mt: L-awtur spjega li l-istorja kienet minn moħħu u ma kinitx ibbażata fuq ġrajja vera.
formal.en: The author explained that the story was his own invention and was not based on a true event.
formal.zh: 作者解释说，这个故事是他自己想出来的，并非根据真实事件改编。

colloquial.mt: Maya: Din l-istorja qrajtha xi mkien? Toni: Le, ivvintajtha minn moħħi.
colloquial.en: Maya: Did you read this story somewhere? Toni: No, I made it up myself.
colloquial.zh: Maya：这个故事是你在哪里读到的吗？Toni：不是，是我自己编的。

messages.speaker: Maya (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个故事是你在哪里读到的吗？
messages.en: Did you read this story somewhere?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，是我自己编的。
messages.en: No, I made it up myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事气泡从自己的脑海冒出来：minn moħħi 是“我自己想的”，换成 minn moħħu 就联系“他自己想的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Reduced in degree, strength, or extent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 程度、力量或范围有所减小、减弱的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li naqas fil-grad, fis-saħħa jew fil-firxa tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减弱的；减少的；有所削减的。

collocations.zh: 被削弱的作用；有所缩减的角色

formal.mt: Wara r-riforma, il-kumitat kellu rwol minorat fit-teħid tad-deċiżjonijiet.
formal.en: After the reform, the committee had a diminished role in decision-making.
formal.zh: 改革之后，委员会在决策中的作用有所减弱。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-kumitat għadu jieħu d-deċiżjonijiet kollha? Mark: Le, issa għandu rwol minorat.
colloquial.en: Rita: Does the committee still make all the decisions? Mark: No, it now has a diminished role.
colloquial.zh: Rita：委员会还负责作出所有决定吗？Mark：不，现在它的作用已经减弱了。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 委员会还负责作出所有决定吗？
messages.en: Does the committee still make all the decisions?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 不，现在它的作用已经减弱了。
messages.en: No, it now has a diminished role.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一根从高变低的音量条，把 minorat 联系到“力量或程度变小”，再用“作用减弱”这一搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not yet old enough to be legally regarded as an adult.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未达到法定成年年龄的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għadu ma laħaqx l-età li fiha persuna titqies adulta skont il-liġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未成年的；尚未达到法定成年年龄的。
未成年人；尚未达到法定成年年龄的人。

formal.mt: Il-gwida tispjega kif l-organizzazzjoni tipproteġi lill-minorenni li jieħdu sehem fl-attivitajiet tagħha.
formal.en: The guide explains how the organization protects minors who take part in its activities.
formal.zh: 这份指南说明该机构如何保护参加其活动的未成年人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nimla l-formola waħdi jekk għadni minorenni? Paul: Ejja naqraw l-istruzzjonijiet biex naraw jekk hemmx bżonn il-firma ta' ġenitur.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I fill in the form on my own if I'm still underage? Paul: Let's read the instructions to see whether a parent's signature is needed.
colloquial.zh: Sara：如果我还未成年，可以自己填写表格吗？Paul：我们看看说明，确认是否需要家长签名。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nimla l-formola waħdi jekk għadni minorenni?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nimla l-formola waħdi jekk għadni minorenni?
messages.zh: 如果我还未成年，可以自己填写表格吗？
messages.en: Can I fill in the form on my own if I'm still underage?

messages.speaker: Paul (活动工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqraw l-istruzzjonijiet biex naraw jekk hemmx bżonn il-firma ta' ġenitur.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqraw l-istruzzjonijiet biex naraw jekk hemmx bżonn il-firma ta' ġenitur.
messages.zh: 我们看看说明，确认是否需要家长签名。
messages.en: Let's read the instructions to see whether a parent's signature is needed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张词卡区分词性：persuna minorenni 对应“未成年的人”，il-minorenni 对应“未成年人”，同词分别作形容词和名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The smaller part of a group, or a group with fewer members than another group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 整体中人数或数量较少的一部分，也指人数较少的群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti iżgħar ta' grupp, jew grupp b'inqas membri minn grupp ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 少数；少数群体。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħtiġijiet ta' minorità lingwistika fil-komunità.
formal.en: The report describes the needs of a linguistic minority in the community.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了社区中一个语言少数群体的需求。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm nies għażlu t-tieni proposta? Liam: Minorità biss; il-biċċa l-kbira għażlu l-ewwel waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many people chose the second proposal? Liam: Only a minority; most chose the first one.
colloquial.zh: Maja：有多少人选了第二个方案？Liam：只有少数人；大多数人选了第一个。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
