messages.zh: 有多少人选了第二个方案？
messages.en: How many people chose the second proposal?

messages.speaker: Liam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Minorità biss; il-biċċa l-kbira għażlu l-ewwel waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Minorità biss; il-biċċa l-kbira għażlu l-ewwel waħda.
messages.zh: 只有少数人；大多数人选了第一个。
messages.en: Only a minority; most chose the first one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象全班举手投票：举手人数较少的那一边就是 minorità，把词和“少数群体”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作个人姓氏的专有名称，书写时首字母大写为 Mintoff。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom ta' persuna, miktub b'ittra kapitali fil-bidu: Mintoff.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Mintoff。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Mintoff għandu jikteb ismu u kunjomu fil-parti ta' fuq tal-formola.
formal.en: Mr Mintoff should write his first name and surname at the top of the form.
formal.zh: Mintoff 先生应在表格上方填写自己的名字和姓氏。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi appuntament mas-Sur Mintoff. Mark: Tajjeb, tista' tistenna hawn.
colloquial.en: Sara: I have an appointment with Mr Mintoff. Mark: All right, you can wait here.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我和 Mintoff 先生有预约。Mark：好的，你可以在这里等。

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.zh: 我和 Mintoff 先生有预约。
messages.en: I have an appointment with Mr Mintoff.

messages.speaker: Mark (接待员)
messages.zh: 好的，你可以在这里等。
messages.en: All right, you can wait here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mintoff 想成门牌上的姓氏：前面加“先生”，就能记住它用于称呼人，而且首字母要大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Smaller in importance, extent, or seriousness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在重要性、程度或严重性上较小的；次要的或轻微的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' importanza, kobor jew serjetà iżgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 较小的；次要的；轻微的。

formal.mt: Dan il-fattur għandu rwol minur fid-deċiżjoni finali.
formal.en: This factor plays a minor role in the final decision.
formal.zh: 这一因素在最终决定中起次要作用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kien serju l-inċident? Paul: Le, kien inċident minur, u ħadd ma weġġa'.
colloquial.en: Nina: Was the incident serious? Paul: No, it was a minor incident, and nobody was hurt.
colloquial.zh: Nina：那次事件严重吗？Paul：不，只是轻微事件，没有人受伤。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 那次事件严重吗？
messages.en: Was the incident serious?

messages.speaker: Paul (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien inċident minur, u ħadd ma weġġa'.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien inċident minur, u ħadd ma weġġa'.
messages.zh: 不，只是轻微事件，没有人受伤。
messages.en: No, it was a minor incident, and nobody was hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 minur 放在一张重要性排序表的较低位置：它提示“程度较小、作用次要”，不一定指物体尺寸小。

teaching_sense.en_definition: With close attention to every small detail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 十分仔细地关注各个细节；细致地、详尽地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'attenzjoni kbira għal kull dettall żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 细致地；详尽地；逐一关注微小细节地。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat eżamina minutament kull parti tal-proposta qabel ħa deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The committee examined every part of the proposal minutely before making a decision.
formal.zh: 委员会在作出决定前，细致审查了提案的每个部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għadek taqra l-istruzzjonijiet? Liam: Qed naqrahom minutament biex ma nitlef ebda dettall.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you still reading the instructions? Liam: I'm reading them very carefully so I don't miss any detail.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么还在看说明？Liam：我在仔细读，免得漏掉任何细节。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么还在看说明？
messages.en: Why are you still reading the instructions?

messages.speaker: Liam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naqrahom minutament biex ma nitlef ebda dettall.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naqrahom minutament biex ma nitlef ebda dettall.
messages.zh: 我在仔细读，免得漏掉任何细节。
messages.en: I'm reading them very carefully so I don't miss any detail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿放大镜逐项查看说明书，用 minutament 描写这种“连小细节也仔细看”的方式；这里不是“每分钟”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hand on a clock or watch that shows the minutes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钟表上用来指示分钟的指针，即分针。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-labra ta' arloġġ li turi l-minuti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钟表的分针。

collocations.en: the minute hand points to twelve

formal.mt: Meta l-minutiera tipponta lejn is-sitta, tkun għaddiet nofs siegħa mill-aħħar siegħa sħiħa.
formal.en: When the minute hand points to six, half an hour has passed since the last full hour.
formal.zh: 当分针指向六时，距离上一个整点已经过去半小时。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Liema labra turi l-minuti? Ben: Il-minutiera, dik it-twila.
colloquial.en: Ella: Which hand shows the minutes? Ben: The minute hand, the long one.
colloquial.zh: Ella：哪根指针表示分钟？Ben：分针，就是长的那根。

messages.speaker: Ella (学生)
messages.zh: 哪根指针表示分钟？
messages.en: Which hand shows the minutes?

messages.speaker: Ben (教师)
messages.zh: 分针，就是长的那根。
messages.en: The minute hand, the long one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画一个钟面，把指示分钟的长针标成 minutiera，再让它指向六，用“半小时”的画面记住分针。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the two openings of the nose through which air passes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼻子上供空气进出的两个开口之一。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda miż-żewġ fetħiet tal-imnieħer li minnhom tgħaddi l-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻孔；鼻子上供空气进出的开口之一。

formal.mt: Fid-dijagramma, vleġġa tindika l-minħar tal-lemin bħala waħda mill-fetħiet li minnhom tidħol l-arja.
formal.en: In the diagram, an arrow marks the right nostril as one of the openings through which air enters.
formal.zh: 图中用箭头标出右鼻孔，说明它是空气进入的开口之一。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi tikka żebgħa ħdejn il-minħar? Lara: Iva, ħdejn il-minħar tax-xellug. Hawn mera.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do I have a spot of paint next to my nostril? Lara: Yes, next to your left nostril. Here's a mirror.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我的鼻孔旁边是不是沾了一个颜料点？拉拉：是的，在左鼻孔旁边。给你镜子。

messages.speaker: Nina (绘画课同学)
messages.zh: 我的鼻孔旁边是不是沾了一个颜料点？
messages.en: Do I have a spot of paint next to my nostril?

messages.speaker: Lara (绘画课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħdejn il-minħar tax-xellug. Hawn mera.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħdejn il-minħar tax-xellug. Hawn mera.
messages.zh: 是的，在左鼻孔旁边。给你镜子。
messages.en: Yes, next to your left nostril. Here's a mirror.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个鼻子，在其中一个小孔旁标上 minħar，再画空气箭头，记住它指单个鼻孔。

gloss_zh: 赢得的；被争取过来的；被征服的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Won or gained through success in a contest or effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过比赛获胜或付出努力而赢得、获得的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miksub b'rebħa f'kompetizzjoni jew permezz ta' sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赢得的；作为胜利成果而获得的。
被说服的；被争取过来而转为支持的。
被征服的；被攻克的。

collocations.en: a prize that has been won

formal.mt: Il-premju mirbuħ mit-tim jirrikonoxxi l-kwalità tax-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: The prize won by the team recognizes the quality of its work.
formal.zh: 团队赢得的奖项肯定了其工作质量。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan hu l-premju mirbuħ fit-tellieqa? Mark: Iva, irbaħtu nhar il-Ħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this the prize won in the race? Mark: Yes, I won it on Sunday.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这就是比赛中赢得的奖品吗？Mark：是的，我星期日赢的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这就是比赛中赢得的奖品吗？
messages.en: Is this the prize won in the race?

messages.speaker: Mark (参赛者)
messages.zh: 是的，我星期日赢的。
messages.en: Yes, I won it on Sunday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记 mirbuħ：奖品被赢得、听众被说服、领土被征服；共同关注“已经取得的结果”。

gloss_zh: 被堆积物掩埋的；被倾倒堆放的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Covered or buried beneath a pile of material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被泥土、碎石或其他堆积物覆盖、掩埋的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mgħotti jew midfun taħt munzell ta' ħamrija, ġebel jew materjal ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: buried under a pile or heap
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被一堆东西覆盖或掩埋的。
被倾倒、堆放的。

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol instab ħajt antik mirdum taħt saff oħxon ta' ħamrija.
formal.en: During the work, an old wall was found buried beneath a thick layer of soil.
formal.zh: 施工时发现了一堵被厚厚土层掩埋的古墙。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu l-barmil? Paul: Hemm, mirdum taħt dak il-munzell weraq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the bucket? Paul: There, buried under that pile of leaves.
colloquial.zh: Nina：桶在哪里？Paul：在那里，被那堆树叶埋住了。

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.zh: 桶在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the bucket?

messages.speaker: Paul (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm, mirdum taħt dak il-munzell weraq.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm, mirdum taħt dak il-munzell weraq.
messages.zh: 在那里，被那堆树叶埋住了。
messages.en: There, buried under that pile of leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个桶被落叶堆完全盖住，用 mirdum 标注它的状态；再联想到废物被倾倒成堆的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stimulate one's own sexual organs for sexual pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为获得性快感而刺激自己的生殖器，即自慰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jistimula l-organi sesswali tiegħu stess biex iħoss pjaċir sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自慰；为获得性快感而刺激自己的生殖器。

collocations.zh: 他在私密环境中自慰了

formal.mt: Fil-glossarju, il-verb 'mirex' huwa spjegat bħala stimulazzjoni tal-organi sesswali tal-persuna stess għall-pjaċir.
formal.en: In the glossary, the verb 'mirex' is explained as stimulation of one's own sexual organs for pleasure.
formal.zh: 词汇表将动词 mirex 解释为为获得快感而刺激自己的生殖器。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser 'mirex' f'dan it-test? Mark: Ifisser li persuna stimulat l-organi sesswali tagħha stess għall-pjaċir.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'mirex' mean in this text? Mark: It means that a person stimulated their own sexual organs for pleasure.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这篇文章里的 mirex 是什么意思？Mark：意思是一个人为获得快感而刺激了自己的生殖器。

messages.speaker: Sara (成年语言学习者)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 mirex 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mirex' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (语言教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li persuna stimulat l-organi sesswali tagħha stess għall-pjaċir.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li persuna stimulat l-organi sesswali tagħha stess għall-pjaċir.
messages.zh: 意思是一个人为获得快感而刺激了自己的生殖器。
messages.en: It means that a person stimulated their own sexual organs for pleasure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mirex 放进个人身体行为词汇卡，与中文“自慰”直接配对；用“动作指向自己”帮助记住含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stepped on physically, or treated unfairly and kept powerless.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指实际被脚踩踏的，也可形容长期受到压迫、无法自主的人或群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħadd rifes fuqu; jew, f'sens figurattiv, li jbati minn oppressjoni u inġustizzja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受压迫、受欺凌而难以反抗的。
被脚踩过或踩踏的。

collocations.en: grass that has been stepped on

formal.mt: Il-poeta jagħti leħen lil poplu mirfus li jitlob il-ġustizzja.
formal.en: The poet gives a voice to a downtrodden people calling for justice.
formal.zh: 诗人为呼求正义的受压迫民众发声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħaxix ħdejn il-bieb kollu mirfus? Pawlu: Għax kulħadd għadda minn hemm minflok uża l-mogħdija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has all the grass beside the gate been stepped on? Pawlu: Because everyone walked across there instead of using the path.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么门边的草全被踩过了？Pawlu：因为大家都从那里走，没有走小路。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħaxix ħdejn il-bieb kollu mirfus?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħaxix ħdejn il-bieb kollu mirfus?
messages.zh: 为什么门边的草全被踩过了？
messages.en: Why has all the grass beside the gate been stepped on?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kulħadd għadda minn hemm minflok uża l-mogħdija.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kulħadd għadda minn hemm minflok uża l-mogħdija.
messages.zh: 因为大家都从那里走，没有走小路。
messages.en: Because everyone walked across there instead of using the path.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mirfus 配上两个画面：草被脚踩，人被权势压住；用同一个“受压”意象区分实义与比喻义。

gloss_zh: 被骑乘的；受某人支配的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ridden by someone, or dominated by another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被人骑乘的，也可比喻受另一个人控制或支配的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħadd riekeb fuqu; jew, f'sens figurattiv, li jkun taħt il-kontroll ta' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被人骑乘的。
受某人控制、压制或支配的。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher żiemel mirkub minn suldat quddiem il-palazz.
formal.en: The photograph shows a horse being ridden by a soldier in front of the palace.
formal.zh: 照片中，一名士兵骑着马，位于宫殿前方。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark qatt ma jiddeċiedi għalih innifsu? Toni: Donnu dejjem mirkub minn ħuh; jagħmel kulma jgħidlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does Mark never make his own decisions? Toni: He always seems dominated by his brother; he does whatever his brother tells him.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 从来不自己拿主意吗？Toni：他好像总受他兄弟支配；他兄弟叫他做什么，他就做什么。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark qatt ma jiddeċiedi għalih innifsu?
messages.mt_standard: Mark qatt ma jiddeċiedi għalih innifsu?
messages.zh: Mark 从来不自己拿主意吗？
messages.en: Does Mark never make his own decisions?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Donnu dejjem mirkub minn ħuh; jagħmel kulma jgħidlu.
messages.mt_standard: Donnu dejjem mirkub minn ħuh; jagħmel kulma jgħidlu.
messages.zh: 他好像总受他兄弟支配；他兄弟叫他做什么，他就做什么。
messages.en: He always seems dominated by his brother; he does whatever his brother tells him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 mirkub 时先想有人骑在马上，再联想某人处处受别人摆布；这是帮助区分两义的画面联想。

gloss_zh: 精致的；整洁利落的；做工精良的；美观的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Refined, neat, carefully finished, and pleasing in appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容风格精致、外观整洁利落、细节处理完善，或整体令人赏心悦目的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra fina u pulita, b'dettalji maħduma bir-reqqa u li jogħġbu lill-għajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精致、雅致而不粗糙的。
外观整洁、齐整利落的。
做工精良、收尾及细节处理完善的。
美观、令人赏心悦目的。

formal.mt: Il-kabinett huwa eżempju ta' xogħol mirqum, b'kull dettall maħdum bir-reqqa.
formal.en: The cabinet is an example of finely finished craftsmanship, with every detail carefully worked.
formal.zh: 这个柜子体现了精良的工艺，每一处细节都经过悉心处理。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm hu mirqum dan il-ġnien! Ġorġ: Iva, il-mogħdijiet nodfa u l-pjanti kollha f'posthom.
colloquial.en: Nina: This garden is so neat and attractive! Ġorġ: Yes, the paths are clean and all the plants are in their proper places.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个花园真整洁漂亮！Ġorġ：是啊，小路很干净，所有植物也都布置得井井有条。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.zh: 这个花园真整洁漂亮！
messages.en: This garden is so neat and attractive!

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-mogħdijiet nodfa u l-pjanti kollha f'posthom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-mogħdijiet nodfa u l-pjanti kollha f'posthom.
messages.zh: 是啊，小路很干净，所有植物也都布置得井井有条。
messages.en: Yes, the paths are clean and all the plants are in their proper places.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“细节收得漂亮”记 mirqum：作品做工精、花园收拾齐、风格显雅致，几个义项都能对应具体画面。

gloss_zh: 非常冷的；冻僵的；冻住的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely cold, or frozen from exposure to cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容非常寒冷、冷得冻僵，或因寒冷而冻住的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu kiesaħ ħafna, jew iffriżat minħabba l-kesħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常冷的；用于人时可指冷得厉害的。
冻住的、冻僵的。

formal.mt: Wara sigħat fil-beraħ, ir-raġel wasal fil-kenn mirżuħ bil-kesħa.
formal.en: After hours outdoors, the man reached the shelter frozen with cold.
formal.zh: 在户外待了数小时后，那名男子到达避寒处时已经冻僵了。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Dħalt mirżuħ; barra hemm kesħa kbira! Maja: Ejja ħdejn il-heater. Nagħmillek te sħun.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: I've come in freezing; it's terribly cold outside! Maja: Come beside the heater. I'll make you some hot tea.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：我进来时都冻僵了，外面太冷了！Maja：到暖气旁边来，我给你泡杯热茶。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dħalt mirżuħ; barra hemm kesħa kbira!
messages.mt_standard: Dħalt mirżuħ; barra hemm kesħa kbira!
messages.zh: 我进来时都冻僵了，外面太冷了！
messages.en: I've come in freezing; it's terribly cold outside!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja ħdejn il-heater. Nagħmillek te sħun.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja ħdejn il-heater. Nagħmillek te sħun.
messages.zh: 到暖气旁边来，我给你泡杯热茶。
messages.en: Come beside the heater. I'll make you some hot tea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mirżuħ 和“进屋后仍冻得发僵”的画面绑定，记住它表达强烈寒冷，也可表示冻住或冻僵的状态。

gloss_zh: 劫掠发生地；遭抢掠的地点

teaching_sense.en_definition: A location where looting takes place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生抢掠或劫掠的地点，所指的是场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-post fejn isir is-serq u t-teħid tal-ġid bil-forza waqt sakkeġġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: the location where looting is done
sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行抢掠、劫掠的地点。

collocations.en: an inspection of the looting site

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika l-misba u jelenka l-oġġetti li nsterqu minn hemm.
formal.en: The report identifies the looting site and lists the objects stolen from there.
formal.zh: 报告指明了劫掠发生地，并列出从那里被抢走的物品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma misba f'dan it-test? Mark: Tfisser il-post fejn sar is-sakkeġġ; hawnhekk qed jitkellem dwar is-suq.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word misba mean in this text? Mark: It means the place where the looting happened; here the text is referring to the market.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这篇文章里的 misba 是什么意思？Mark：指发生劫掠的地点；这里说的是市场。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma misba f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma misba f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 misba 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word misba mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser il-post fejn sar is-sakkeġġ; hawnhekk qed jitkellem dwar is-suq.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser il-post fejn sar is-sakkeġġ; hawnhekk qed jitkellem dwar is-suq.
messages.zh: 指发生劫掠的地点；这里说的是市场。
messages.en: It means the place where the looting happened; here the text is referring to the market.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在想象中的地图上给劫掠现场画一个圆圈，再标上 misba；把这个词固定记作“地点”，避免与劫掠行为或赃物混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Blocked so that passage is obstructed; also used of a person who is constipated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容通道被堵住、无法顺畅通过；用于人时也可表示便秘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu xi ħaġa tagħlaq il-passaġġ; jingħad ukoll għal min ma jistax ibattal l-imsaren faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 堵住的、堵塞不通的。
便秘的；排便困难的。

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni sabet li l-pajp kien misdud b'akkumulazzjoni ta' ħmieġ.
formal.en: The inspection found that the pipe was blocked by a buildup of dirt.
formal.zh: 检查发现，管道因污物积聚而堵塞。

colloquial.mt: Toni: L-ilma mhux nieżel mis-sink. Taħseb li l-pajp misdud? Pawlu: Jista' jkun. Ejja naraw jekk hemmx xi ħaġa qed tagħlqu.
colloquial.en: Toni: The water isn't draining from the sink. Do you think the pipe is blocked? Pawlu: It could be. Let's see whether something is blocking it.
colloquial.zh: Toni：水槽里的水排不下去。你觉得是管道堵了吗？Pawlu：有可能。我们看看是不是有什么东西堵住了。

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ilma mhux nieżel mis-sink. Taħseb li l-pajp misdud?
messages.mt_standard: L-ilma mhux nieżel mis-sink. Taħseb li l-pajp misdud?
messages.zh: 水槽里的水排不下去。你觉得是管道堵了吗？
messages.en: The water isn't draining from the sink. Do you think the pipe is blocked?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun. Ejja naraw jekk hemmx xi ħaġa qed tagħlqu.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun. Ejja naraw jekk hemmx xi ħaġa qed tagħlqu.
messages.zh: 有可能。我们看看是不是有什么东西堵住了。
messages.en: It could be. Let's see whether something is blocking it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“通不过去”记 misdud：水管堵、鼻子堵，以及排便不畅；具体是哪一种，要看它描述的对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The title given to a written work, such as a book or poem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 赋予书籍、诗歌等文字作品的名称或标题。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem li jingħata lil xogħol miktub, bħal ktieb jew poeżija.

sense_translations.en_definition: title (e.g. of a piece of literature)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 标题、题名，例如文学作品的名称。

formal.mt: Il-misem tal-poeżija jagħti lill-qarrej ħjiel dwar it-tema ewlenija tagħha.
formal.en: The title of the poem gives the reader a clue to its main theme.
formal.zh: 诗歌的题目为读者理解其主题提供了线索。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għażilt misem għall-istorja tiegħek? Lara: Iva, se nsejħilha Il-Bieb l-Aħdar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you chosen a title for your story? Lara: Yes, I'm going to call it The Green Door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你给自己的故事选好标题了吗？Lara：选好了，我打算叫它《绿门》。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你给自己的故事选好标题了吗？
messages.en: Have you chosen a title for your story?

messages.speaker: Lara (学生作者)
messages.zh: 选好了，我打算叫它《绿门》。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going to call it The Green Door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本书的封面，把最醒目的作品名称标成 misem；每次看到封面标题，就练习说 il-misem tal-ktieb。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dense or thick, with closely packed material or growth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容材料或生长物排列紧密、质地密实，也可表示具有较大厚度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu dens jew oħxon, b'materjal jew tkabbir magħqud qrib ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 密集、浓密或质地密实的。
厚的、厚实的。

formal.mt: Għall-purtieri ntgħażel drapp misfieq biex jgħaddi inqas dawl mit-twieqi.
formal.en: Thick fabric was chosen for the curtains so that less light would pass through the windows.
formal.zh: 窗帘选用了厚实的布料，以减少透过窗户的光线。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan id-drapp misfieq wisq għal qmis tas-sajf? Mark: Naħseb li iva. Għas-sajf nagħżel wieħed irqaq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this fabric too thick for a summer shirt? Mark: I think so. For summer, I'd choose a thinner one.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这种布料用来做夏季衬衫，会不会太厚？Mark：我觉得会。夏天我会选薄一点的。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-drapp misfieq wisq għal qmis tas-sajf?
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-drapp misfieq wisq għal qmis tas-sajf?
messages.zh: 这种布料用来做夏季衬衫，会不会太厚？
messages.en: Is this fabric too thick for a summer shirt?

messages.speaker: Mark (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li iva. Għas-sajf nagħżel wieħed irqaq.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li iva. Għas-sajf nagħżel wieħed irqaq.
messages.zh: 我觉得会。夏天我会选薄一点的。
messages.en: I think so. For summer, I'd choose a thinner one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 misfieq 画成两幅图：草长得密，布织得厚；前者帮助记“密集”，后者帮助记“厚实”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A support that holds something up or helps keep it in position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 托住某物或帮助某物保持位置的支撑物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li żżomm oġġett wieqaf jew f'postu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 支撑；支撑物。

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa waħħal misgħen taħt l-ixkaffa biex iżommha f'postha.
formal.en: The carpenter attached a support beneath the shelf to keep it in position.
formal.zh: 木匠在架子下面安装了一个支撑物，使架子保持稳固。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed titħarrek l-ixkaffa? Mark: Għandha bżonn misgħen ieħor taħtha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the shelf moving? Mark: It needs another support underneath.
colloquial.zh: Maja：架子为什么在晃？Mark：它下面还需要一个支撑物。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 架子为什么在晃？
messages.en: Why is the shelf moving?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 它下面还需要一个支撑物。
messages.en: It needs another support underneath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 misgħen 和架子下方的支撑物一起记：看到它，就想到“托住东西，使其稳固”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A messiah: a figure understood in a religious context as a saviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 弥赛亚，指在宗教语境中被视为救世主的人物；与 messija 同义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Figura meqjusa bħala salvatur f'kuntest reliġjuż; sinonimu ta' messija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 messija 同义：弥赛亚，宗教语境中的救世主。

formal.mt: It-test reliġjuż jitkellem dwar it-tama fil-miġja tal-misiħ.
formal.en: The religious text discusses hope in the coming of the messiah.
formal.zh: 这篇宗教文本讨论了对弥赛亚降临的盼望。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma misiħ f'dan it-test? David: Tfisser messija, figura meqjusa bħala salvatur.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word misiħ mean in this text? David: It means messiah, a figure regarded as a saviour.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这篇文章里的 misiħ 是什么意思？David：意思是弥赛亚，即被视为救世主的人物。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma misiħ f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma misiħ f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 misiħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word misiħ mean in this text?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser messija, figura meqjusa bħala salvatur.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser messija, figura meqjusa bħala salvatur.
messages.zh: 意思是弥赛亚，即被视为救世主的人物。
messages.en: It means messiah, a figure regarded as a saviour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 misiħ 与 messija 放在同一张词卡上，背面写“弥赛亚”，用同义词配对帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cooked and ready to eat, or ripe when describing fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容食物已经煮熟；形容水果时表示已经成熟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun sar bit-tisjir, jew li jkun laħaq il-maturità meta jingħad għall-frott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 煮熟的；经过烹调而熟了的。
成熟的，尤指已经熟了的水果。

formal.mt: L-ikla tinkludi ross misjur u frott misjur bħala deżerta.
formal.en: The meal includes cooked rice and ripe fruit for dessert.
formal.zh: 这顿饭包括煮熟的米饭，以及作为餐后甜点的成熟水果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ir-ross misjur? Nista' nservih? Toni: Iva, lest. U dan il-ħawħ misjur ukoll.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the rice cooked? Can I serve it? Toni: Yes, it is ready. And this peach is ripe too.
colloquial.zh: Nina：米饭熟了吗？可以盛出来了吗？Toni：可以，已经好了。这个桃子也熟了。

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.zh: 米饭熟了吗？可以盛出来了吗？
messages.en: Is the rice cooked? Can I serve it?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, lest. U dan il-ħawħ misjur ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, lest. U dan il-ħawħ misjur ukoll.
messages.zh: 可以，已经好了。这个桃子也熟了。
messages.en: Yes, it is ready. And this peach is ripe too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文“熟”串起 misjur 的两个义项：锅里的米饭煮熟了，树上的水果成熟了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where people drink alcohol and get drunk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们饮酒并喝醉的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn in-nies jixorbu l-alkoħol u jiskru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人们喝醉酒的场所。

collocations.en: a place full of people getting drunk
collocations.zh: 挤满喝醉酒的人的场所

collocations.en: to leave the place where people get drunk
collocations.zh: 离开人们喝醉酒的场所

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru joħroġ mill-miskra u jimxi lejn id-dar.
formal.en: In the story, the character leaves the place where people get drunk and walks home.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个人物离开了人们喝醉酒的场所，步行回家。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma tridx tidħol hemm? Ġanni: Għax dik miskra; nippreferi post aktar kwiet.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why do you not want to go in there? Ġanni: Because that is a place where people get drunk; I prefer somewhere quieter.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你为什么不想进去？Ġanni：因为那里是人们喝醉酒的地方；我更想去安静一点的地方。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不想进去？
messages.en: Why do you not want to go in there?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dik miskra; nippreferi post aktar kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dik miskra; nippreferi post aktar kwiet.
messages.zh: 因为那里是人们喝醉酒的地方；我更想去安静一点的地方。
messages.en: Because that is a place where people get drunk; I prefer somewhere quieter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 miskra 时画一扇门，门里有人喝醉；用整个场景提醒自己，这个名词指的是场所。

gloss_zh: 评估；动物以后腿站立的姿态

teaching_sense.en_definition: An assessment, or the stance of an animal standing on its hind legs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指评估；也可指动物用后腿站立时采取的姿态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Valutazzjoni, jew il-pożizzjoni ta' annimal meta joqgħod fuq saqajh ta' wara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 评估；对价值或情况作出的判断。

sense_translations.en_definition: stance taken by an animal on the hind legs
sense_translations.zh_definition: 动物以后腿站立时采取的姿态。

collocations.en: an assessment of the house's value

collocations.mt: il-misla taż-żiemel fuq saqajh ta' wara
collocations.en: the horse's stance on its hind legs

formal.mt: Il-misla tal-valur tad-dar tgħin lis-sid jistabbilixxi l-prezz.
formal.en: The assessment of the house's value helps the owner set the price.
formal.zh: 对房屋价值的评估有助于房主确定价格。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Ara l-misla taż-żiemel f'dan ir-ritratt! Luqa: Iva, qiegħed fuq saqajh ta' wara.
colloquial.en: Emma: Look at the horse's stance in this photo! Luqa: Yes, it is standing on its hind legs.
colloquial.zh: Emma：看这张照片里马的站姿！Luqa：是啊，它正用后腿站立。

messages.speaker: Emma (朋友)
messages.zh: 看这张照片里马的站姿！
messages.en: Look at the horse's stance in this photo!

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fuq saqajh ta' wara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fuq saqajh ta' wara.
messages.zh: 是啊，它正用后腿站立。
messages.en: Yes, it is standing on its hind legs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 misla 做两格图：一格是房屋评估表，一格是后腿站立的马；靠语境分别提取两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bank: an institution that provides financial services such as keeping money in accounts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 银行，提供账户存款等金融服务的机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bank: istituzzjoni li toffri servizzi finanzjarji, bħal li żżomm il-flus f'kontijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 银行；提供存款等金融服务的机构。

collocations.en: to deposit money in the bank

formal.mt: Il-klijent mar il-mislef biex jiftaħ kont u jiddepożita l-flus.
formal.en: The customer went to the bank to open an account and deposit money.
formal.zh: 顾客前往银行开立账户并存款。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn sejjer dalgħodu? Mark: Sejjer il-mislef biex niddepożita xi flus.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where are you going this morning? Mark: I am going to the bank to deposit some money.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你今天早上要去哪里？Mark：我要去银行存点钱。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天早上要去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer il-mislef biex niddepożita xi flus.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer il-mislef biex niddepożita xi flus.
messages.zh: 我要去银行存点钱。
messages.en: I am going to the bank to deposit some money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mislef 放进“去银行存钱”的完整场景，再配记 kont“账户”和 flus“钱”，帮助提取词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Crucified: fastened to a cross as a form of execution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被钉在十字架上受刑的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imwaħħal ma' salib bħala forma ta' eżekuzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被钉在十字架上的；受十字架刑的。

collocations.zh: 被钉在十字架上的男子

collocations.en: to appear crucified in the painting
collocations.zh: 在画中呈现被钉在十字架上的形象

formal.mt: L-artist pinġa raġel mislub, b'żewġ persuni wieqfa ħdejn is-salib.
formal.en: The artist painted a crucified man, with two people standing beside the cross.
formal.zh: 画家画了一名被钉在十字架上的男子，十字架旁站着两个人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'juri dan il-kwadru? Pietru: Juri raġel mislub u żewġ persuni ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does this painting show? Pietru: It shows a crucified man and two people beside him.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这幅画画的是什么？Pietru：画的是一名被钉在十字架上的男子，以及他身旁的两个人。

messages.speaker: Anna (参观者)
messages.zh: 这幅画画的是什么？
messages.en: What does this painting show?

messages.speaker: Pietru (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Juri raġel mislub u żewġ persuni ħdejh.
messages.mt_standard: Juri raġel mislub u żewġ persuni ħdejh.
messages.zh: 画的是一名被钉在十字架上的男子，以及他身旁的两个人。
messages.en: It shows a crucified man and two people beside him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面记 mislub：先想十字架，再想被固定在上面的人；把整个形容词记成“被钉十字架的”。

gloss_zh: 烫伤的；因不愉快经历而心有余悸的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Scalded by hot liquid, or still affected and made cautious by a bad experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被热液体烫伤的；也形容因过去的不愉快经历而仍然顾虑、心有余悸的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġarrab ħruq b'likwidu jaħraq, jew li għadu jħoss l-effett ta' esperjenza ħażina u joqgħod aktar attent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被热水等高温液体烫伤的。
经历过不愉快的事情而心有余悸的。

collocations.en: still affected by that bad experience
collocations.zh: 仍因那次不愉快的经历而心有余悸

formal.mt: It-tifel kien mismut bl-ilma sħun u kellu bżonn il-kura.
formal.en: The boy had been scalded by hot water and needed treatment.
formal.zh: 那个男孩被热水烫伤，需要接受治疗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se terġa' tixtri minn dak il-ħanut? Mark: Le, għadni mismut mill-aħħar darba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Will you buy from that shop again? Mark: No, I'm still wary after what happened last time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还会再去那家店买东西吗？马克：不会，上次的经历还让我心有余悸。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se terġa' tixtri minn dak il-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Se terġa' tixtri minn dak il-ħanut?
messages.zh: 你还会再去那家店买东西吗？
messages.en: Will you buy from that shop again?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不会，上次的经历还让我心有余悸。
messages.en: No, I'm still wary after what happened last time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“被热水烫过，碰水先小心”的画面串联两个义项：身体被烫伤，也可比喻经历坏事后心有余悸。

gloss_zh: 羽管；卷须；动物吃剩的残屑；一滴液体；瘦子

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant tendril; the word also has separate senses referring to a quill, an animal's leftover food, a drop of liquid, or a lean person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指植物用于攀附的卷须；另有羽管、动物吃剩的残屑、少量液滴及瘦子的独立词义，需根据语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti rqiqa ta' pjanta li titkebbeb ma' xi ħaġa biex taqbad magħha; il-kelma għandha wkoll tifsiriet oħra skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羽管，即羽毛中空而较硬的管状部分。
植物的卷须，用于缠绕或攀附支撑物的细长部分。
动物吃剩下的食物碎屑或残余饲料。
一滴或极少量的液体。
身材瘦削的人；瘦子。

formal.mt: Il-misrek tad-dielja jitkebbeb mal-appoġġ u jgħin lill-pjanta titla'.
formal.en: The vine tendril coils around the support and helps the plant climb.
formal.zh: 葡萄藤的卷须缠绕在支撑物上，帮助植株攀爬。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dan li qed jitkebbeb mal-wajer? Pawlu: Dak misrek tad-dielja; jgħinha taqbad mal-wajer.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's this coiling around the wire? Pawlu: That's a vine tendril; it helps the vine grip the wire.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个缠在铁丝上的东西是什么？保罗：那是葡萄藤的卷须，帮助藤蔓抓住铁丝。

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan li qed jitkebbeb mal-wajer?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan li qed jitkebbeb mal-wajer?
messages.zh: 这个缠在铁丝上的东西是什么？
messages.en: What's this coiling around the wire?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园艺老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak misrek tad-dielja; jgħinha taqbad mal-wajer.
messages.mt_standard: Dak misrek tad-dielja; jgħinha taqbad mal-wajer.
messages.zh: 那是葡萄藤的卷须，帮助藤蔓抓住铁丝。
messages.en: That's a vine tendril; it helps the vine grip the wire.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作五张独立图片卡：羽管、卷须、动物剩食、水滴、瘦人。把 misrek 分别配图记忆，再靠句子语境选义，不强行推导词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of the Christian prayer known in English as the Lord's Prayer or Our Father.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基督教祷文的名称，中文通常称《天主经》或《主祷文》，英文称 Lord's Prayer 或 Our Father。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tat-talba Nisranija magħrufa bħala l-Missierna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 《天主经》或《主祷文》，一篇基督教祷文的名称。

collocations.en: the text of the Lord's Prayer

formal.mt: L-istudenti qraw it-test tal-Missierna bil-Malti u qabbluh mat-traduzzjoni bl-Ingliż.
formal.en: The students read the Maltese text of the Lord's Prayer and compared it with the English translation.
formal.zh: 学生们阅读了《主祷文》的马耳他语文本，并将其与英语译文作比较。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Taf tgħid il-Missierna bil-Malti? David: Iva, imma rrid nitgħallem ngħidha aktar bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can you say the Lord's Prayer in Maltese? David: Yes, but I want to learn to say it more slowly.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你会用马耳他语念《主祷文》吗？戴维：会，不过我想学着念得更慢一些。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 你会用马耳他语念《主祷文》吗？
messages.en: Can you say the Lord's Prayer in Maltese?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma rrid nitgħallem ngħidha aktar bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma rrid nitgħallem ngħidha aktar bil-mod.
messages.zh: 会，不过我想学着念得更慢一些。
messages.en: Yes, but I want to learn to say it more slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把大写形式 Missierna 当作祷文标题记在卡片正面，背面写《天主经／主祷文》，并连同“诵念这篇祷文”的搭配一起练习。

gloss_zh: 惊讶的；惊得目瞪口呆的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling surprise at something unexpected, sometimes so strongly that one is left speechless.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因出乎意料的事情而感到惊讶的；程度强时可表示惊得说不出话或目瞪口呆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss sorpriża quddiem xi ħaġa mhux mistennija, kultant tant li jibqa' bla kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惊讶的；对出乎意料的事情感到意外的。
极度惊讶的；惊得目瞪口呆或说不出话的。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur baqa' mistagħġeb bir-riżultat, għax kien differenti minn dak li kien bassar.
formal.en: The researcher was astonished by the result because it differed from what he had predicted.
formal.zh: 研究员对结果感到十分惊讶，因为它与他的预测不同。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt kemm nies ġew għall-kunċert? Mark: Iva, bqajt mistagħġeb! Ma stennejtx daqshekk nies.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see how many people came to the concert? Mark: Yes, I was amazed! I didn't expect so many people.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到有多少人来听音乐会了吗？马克：看到了，我都惊呆了！没想到会有这么多人。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到有多少人来听音乐会了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how many people came to the concert?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bqajt mistagħġeb! Ma stennejtx daqshekk nies.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bqajt mistagħġeb! Ma stennejtx daqshekk nies.
messages.zh: 看到了，我都惊呆了！没想到会有这么多人。
messages.en: Yes, I was amazed! I didn't expect so many people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看到意外结果时睁大眼睛的表情，把 mistagħġeb 放在惊讶程度尺上：轻则意外，重则目瞪口呆。

gloss_zh: 预计会到来或发生的；正被等待的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expected to arrive or happen at a particular time, or being waited for.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 预计会在某个时间到来或发生的；也指某人或某事正受到等待的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu maħsub li jasal jew iseħħ f'ħin partikolari, jew li xi ħadd qed jistennih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预计应当到来或发生的，常与时间表达搭配。
正被等待的；人们正在等候的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport huwa mistenni nhar il-Ġimgħa u se jintbagħat lill-parteċipanti kollha.
formal.en: The report is due on Friday and will be sent to all participants.
formal.zh: 报告预计于星期五出炉，并将发送给所有参与者。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta jasal il-pakkett? Pawlu: Huwa mistenni għada filgħodu; nittama li jasal qabel noħroġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: When will the parcel arrive? Pawlu: It's expected tomorrow morning; I hope it arrives before I go out.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：包裹什么时候到？保罗：预计明天上午到，希望我出门前就能收到。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 包裹什么时候到？
messages.en: When will the parcel arrive?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa mistenni għada filgħodu; nittama li jasal qabel noħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa mistenni għada filgħodu; nittama li jasal qabel noħroġ.
messages.zh: 预计明天上午到，希望我出门前就能收到。
messages.en: It's expected tomorrow morning; I hope it arrives before I go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上写着“包裹明早到”，旁边有人等候：mistenni 同时连接“预计到来”和“被人等待”两个教学画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spoken or written statement expressing information, a position, or an account of events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以口头或书面形式表达信息、立场或事件经过的陈述或声明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem bil-fomm jew bil-miktub li jesprimi informazzjoni, pożizzjoni jew rakkont ta' dak li ġara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一项陈述或声明，即以口头或书面方式表达的内容。

formal.mt: Il-mistqarrija bil-miktub tispjega l-pożizzjoni tal-kumitat dwar il-proposta.
formal.en: The written statement explains the committee's position on the proposal.
formal.zh: 这份书面声明解释了委员会对该提案的立场。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Qrajt il-mistqarrija tal-kumitat? Mark: Iva, imma ma fhimtx l-aħħar sentenza.
colloquial.en: Anna: Have you read the committee's statement? Mark: Yes, but I didn't understand the last sentence.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你读过委员会的声明了吗？马克：读过了，不过最后一句我没看懂。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 你读过委员会的声明了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the committee's statement?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ma fhimtx l-aħħar sentenza.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ma fhimtx l-aħħar sentenza.
messages.zh: 读过了，不过最后一句我没看懂。
messages.en: Yes, but I didn't understand the last sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一页写着“现将立场说明如下”的纸，把 mistqarrija 与完整陈述或声明相连，并用“书面的、清楚的”两个搭配巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period or state of resting, with activity reduced or stopped so that the body or mind can recover.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂时减少或停止活动，让身体或精神恢复的休息状态或时段；也可指安静的歇息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żmien jew stat ta' waqfien mix-xogħol jew mill-attività biex il-ġisem jew il-moħħ jirkupra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安歇；安静而平和的休息状态。
休息；暂停活动以恢复体力或精神。

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja twila, il-grupp ħa ftit mistrieħ fid-dell qabel kompla fi triqtu.
formal.en: After the long walk, the group took a short rest in the shade before continuing on its way.
formal.zh: 长途步行之后，一行人在阴凉处稍作休息，然后继续前行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid tkompli timxi? Pawlu: Għandi bżonn ftit mistrieħ. Nieqfu hawn għal għaxar minuti?
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to keep walking? Pawlu: I need a little rest. Shall we stop here for ten minutes?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你想继续走吗？保罗：我需要休息一下。我们在这里停十分钟好吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 你想继续走吗？
messages.en: Do you want to keep walking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn ftit mistrieħ. Nieqfu hawn għal għaxar minuti?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn ftit mistrieħ. Nieqfu hawn għal għaxar minuti?
messages.zh: 我需要休息一下。我们在这里停十分钟好吗？
messages.en: I need a little rest. Shall we stop here for ten minutes?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mistrieħ 想成步行途中树荫下的长椅：坐下暂停活动、恢复精神，就是“休息”；环境安静时也能体会“安歇”的意思。

gloss_zh: 羞愧的；害羞的；腼腆的；故作羞涩的；怯生生的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling shame or showing shyness, bashfulness, coyness, or timidity, depending on the situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可表示因某事感到羞愧，也可形容与人相处时害羞、腼腆、故作羞涩或怯生生，具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss mistħija minħabba xi ħaġa, jew li jsibha diffiċli jitkellem jew iġib ruħu b'kunfidenza quddiem oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羞愧的；因自己的行为或某种处境而感到难为情的。
害羞的；在人际交往中容易感到不自在的。
腼腆的；受到关注或赞扬时容易羞涩的。
故作羞涩的；含蓄躲闪、不愿直接表露态度的。
怯生生的；缺乏胆量或自信、不敢主动行动的。

collocations.zh: 为自己的所作所为感到羞愧的

formal.mt: L-istudent kien mistħi b'dak li għamel u talab skuża lil sħabu.
formal.en: The student was ashamed of what he had done and apologized to his classmates.
formal.zh: 那名学生为自己的行为感到羞愧，并向同学们道歉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma titkellimx mal-grupp? David: Għadni mistħi; għadni ma nafx lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you talk to the group? David: I'm still shy; I don't know everyone yet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么不和大家聊聊？戴维：我还有点害羞，还没认识所有人。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你怎么不和大家聊聊？
messages.en: Why don't you talk to the group?

messages.speaker: David (新同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni mistħi; għadni ma nafx lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni mistħi; għadni ma nafx lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 我还有点害羞，还没认识所有人。
messages.en: I'm still shy; I don't know everyone yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“低头脸红”的共同画面记词，再判断原因：做错事是羞愧，见生人是害羞，受夸奖是腼腆，故意躲闪可表示故作羞涩。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container in which ingredients or other materials are crushed or pounded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放食材或其他材料并在其中进行研磨、捣碎的容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li fih jitgħaffġu jew jindqqu ingredjenti jew materjali oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于研磨或捣碎东西的容器，如研钵。

collocations.en: to crush garlic in the mortar

formal.mt: Il-kok għaffeġ it-tewm fil-misħaq qabel żiedu maz-zalza.
formal.en: The cook crushed the garlic in the mortar before adding it to the sauce.
formal.zh: 厨师先在研钵里捣碎大蒜，再把它加入酱汁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu l-misħaq? Għandi bżonn ngħaffeġ it-tewm. Pawlu: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-melħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the mortar? I need to crush the garlic. Pawlu: On the table, next to the salt.
colloquial.zh: Sara：研钵在哪里？我要捣蒜。Pawlu：在桌上，盐旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-misħaq? Għandi bżonn ngħaffeġ it-tewm.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-misħaq? Għandi bżonn ngħaffeġ it-tewm.
messages.zh: 研钵在哪里？我要捣蒜。
messages.en: Where is the mortar? I need to crush the garlic.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 在桌上，盐旁边。
messages.en: On the table, next to the salt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 misħaq 时想象厨房里装着蒜瓣的石碗：这个词指承接捣碎动作的容器。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An altar used for sacrifice in a megalithic temple.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 巨石神庙中用于献祭的祭坛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Artal tas-sagrifiċċju li jinsab f'tempju megalitiku.

sense_translations.en_definition: Altar of sacrifice present in the megalithic temples
sense_translations.zh_definition: 巨石神庙中的献祭祭坛。

collocations.en: a sacrificial altar in a megalithic temple
collocations.zh: 巨石神庙中的献祭祭坛

collocations.en: a description of the sacrificial altar

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-mitbaħ bħala artal tas-sagrifiċċju f'tempju megalitiku.
formal.en: The text describes the mitbaħ as a sacrificial altar in a megalithic temple.
formal.zh: 这篇文字将 mitbaħ 描述为巨石神庙中的献祭祭坛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser mitbaħ f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Ifisser artal tas-sagrifiċċju f'tempju megalitiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does mitbaħ mean in this text? Pawlu: It means a sacrificial altar in a megalithic temple.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文字里的 mitbaħ 是什么意思？保罗：指巨石神庙中的献祭祭坛。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文字里的 mitbaħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does mitbaħ mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 指巨石神庙中的献祭祭坛。
messages.en: It means a sacrificial altar in a megalithic temple.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mitbaħ 放进“巨石神庙中的献祭祭坛”这幅画面记忆，记住本条限定的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to extinguish a flame or fire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于熄灭火焰或火的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex titfi fjamma jew nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于熄灭火焰或火的器具；灭火器。

formal.mt: Il-lista tat-tagħmir tinkludi mitfa, u d-dokument jispjega fejn tinżamm.
formal.en: The equipment list includes an extinguisher, and the document explains where it is kept.
formal.zh: 设备清单中列有灭火器，文件还说明了它的存放位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-mitfa? Mark: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the extinguisher? Mark: In the box beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：灭火器在哪里？马克：在门旁边的箱子里。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 灭火器在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the extinguisher?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 在门旁边的箱子里。
messages.en: In the box beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 mitfa，就想象一件把火焰熄灭的器具；用“找到灭火器”的场景帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device designed to put out a fire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专门用于扑灭火灾的器具，即灭火器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda maħsuba biex titfi n-nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于扑灭火灾的灭火器。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-bini juri fejn tinsab il-mitfa tan-nar f'kull sular.
formal.en: The building plan shows where the fire extinguisher is located on each floor.
formal.zh: 建筑平面图标出了每层楼灭火器的位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm mitfa tan-nar hawn? Mark: Iva, ħdejn il-bieb prinċipali.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there a fire extinguisher here? Mark: Yes, beside the main door.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里有灭火器吗？马克：有，在大门旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.zh: 这里有灭火器吗？
messages.en: Is there a fire extinguisher here?

messages.speaker: Mark (接待员)
messages.zh: 有，在大门旁边。
messages.en: Yes, beside the main door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mitfa tan-nar 整体对应“灭火器”，再联想门旁的消防设备位置，练习整组提取。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large gun that fires cannonballs or shells.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发射炮弹的大型火炮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arma kbira li tispara blalen tal-kanun jew projettili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大炮；发射炮弹的大型火炮。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-mużew jinkludi ritratt ta' mitfgħa u deskrizzjoni tal-kanna tagħha.
formal.en: The museum catalogue includes a photograph of a cannon and a description of its barrel.
formal.zh: 博物馆目录收录了一门大炮的照片及其炮管的描述。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik mitfgħa? Pawlu: Iva, ejja naqraw it-tabella ħdejha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that a cannon? Pawlu: Yes, let's read the sign beside it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是一门大炮吗？保罗：是的，我们读读它旁边的说明牌吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 那是一门大炮吗？
messages.en: Is that a cannon?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我们读读它旁边的说明牌吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's read the sign beside it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mitfgħa 配上博物馆里长炮管的画面；注意它比 mitfa 多出 għ，词义是大炮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not operating or giving light because it has been switched off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因已被关闭而不运转或不发光的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx qed jaħdem jew jagħti dawl għax ikun ġie mitfi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于关闭状态的；不运转或不亮的。
已经被关掉的；已关闭的。

formal.mt: Qabel jibda x-xogħol ta' manutenzjoni, it-tagħmir għandu jkun mitfi.
formal.en: Before maintenance work begins, the equipment must be switched off.
formal.zh: 维护工作开始前，设备必须处于关闭状态。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma weġibtx it-telefon? Mark: Kien mitfi; għadni kemm xegħeltu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why didn't you answer the phone? Mark: It was off; I've just switched it on.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么没接电话？马克：手机关机了，我刚把它打开。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么没接电话？
messages.en: Why didn't you answer the phone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 手机关机了，我刚把它打开。
messages.en: It was off; I've just switched it on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mitfi 贴在黑屏手机的想象画面上，记住它描述“已经关闭”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The place from which competitors begin a race.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参赛者开始比赛的地点，即比赛起点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-post minn fejn il-parteċipanti jibdew tiġrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赛跑或其他竞速比赛的起点。

collocations.en: the starting point of the race

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jinġabru ħdejn il-mitlaq għaxar minuti qabel tibda t-tiġrija.
formal.en: Participants must gather near the starting point ten minutes before the race begins.
formal.zh: 参赛者须在比赛开始前十分钟到起点附近集合。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se niltaqgħu qabel it-tiġrija? Mark: Ħdejn il-mitlaq, fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we meet before the race? Mark: Near the starting point, at nine.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：比赛前我们在哪里碰面？马克：九点，在起点附近。

messages.speaker: Sara (参赛者)
messages.zh: 比赛前我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet before the race?

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.zh: 九点，在起点附近。
messages.en: Near the starting point, at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mitlaq 想成跑步比赛开始前大家集合的起点，用发令前的画面记住地点含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to be found, or unable to find the right way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 找不到的、丢失的；也指找不到正确道路而迷路的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jinstab, jew li ma jafx isib it-triq it-tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丢失的、找不到的；也可指人迷路的。
偏离正确道路的；迷路的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi telefon mitluf u jitlob lil min isibu biex jgħaddih lir-reċezzjoni.
formal.en: The report describes a lost phone and asks whoever finds it to hand it in at reception.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一部丢失的电话，并请找到它的人将其交到接待处。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Naħseb li jien mitluf. Fejn hi l-pjazza? Sara: Imxi dritt u mbagħad dur fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Mark: I think I'm lost. Where is the square? Sara: Go straight ahead and then turn left.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我想我迷路了。广场在哪里？萨拉：一直往前走，然后左转。

messages.speaker: Mark (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li jien mitluf. Fejn hi l-pjazza?
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li jien mitluf. Fejn hi l-pjazza?
messages.zh: 我想我迷路了。广场在哪里？
messages.en: I think I'm lost. Where is the square?

messages.speaker: Sara (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Imxi dritt u mbagħad dur fuq ix-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Imxi dritt u mbagħad dur fuq ix-xellug.
messages.zh: 一直往前走，然后左转。
messages.en: Go straight ahead and then turn left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 mitluf：手机找不到是“丢失”，人找不到路是“迷路”，共同点都是失去方向或踪迹。

gloss_zh: 被留下的；漂泊的；荒废的；无活力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Left behind, drifting without direction, neglected, or lacking activity, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随语境表示被留下、漂流无依、荒废失修或缺乏活动与活力的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tħalla warajh, jinsab bla direzzjoni, ġie abbandunat jew hu bla ħajja u attività, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被留下的；被遗留在原处的。
漂流无依的；没有方向或依靠的。
遭遗弃而荒废的；因无人照管而破败的。
不活动的；缺乏活力或反应的。

collocations.zh: 一个被独自留下的男孩

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi bini mitluq li jeħtieġ tiswijiet qabel ma jerġa' jintuża.
formal.en: The report describes a derelict building that needs repairs before it can be used again.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一栋荒废的建筑，该建筑须经修缮才能重新使用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dak il-bini għadu mitluq? Mark: Iva, ilu snin ma jintuża.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is that building still derelict? Mark: Yes, it hasn't been used for years.
colloquial.zh: Nina：那栋建筑还荒废着吗？Mark：是啊，已经好多年没人用了。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 那栋建筑还荒废着吗？
messages.en: Is that building still derelict?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 是啊，已经好多年没人用了。
messages.en: Yes, it hasn't been used for years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把四个义项串成一幅画：东西被留下，小船随水漂，房屋渐荒废，人也没精神；这是语义联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun used to indicate that something has a particular specified weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某物具有某一指定重量的名词用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li jindika li xi ħaġa għandha piż partikolari speċifikat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有某一给定重量的；表示指定重量的名词用法。

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, in-nom mitqal jindika li xi ħaġa għandha piż speċifikat.
formal.en: In this lesson, the noun mitqal indicates that something has a specified weight.
formal.zh: 在本课中，名词 mitqal 表示某物具有某一指定重量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser mitqal f'din il-lezzjoni? Pawlu: Jindika li xi ħaġa għandha piż speċifikat.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does mitqal mean in this lesson? Pawlu: It indicates that something has a specified weight.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这课里的 mitqal 是什么意思？Pawlu：它表示某物具有某一指定重量。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这课里的 mitqal 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does mitqal mean in this lesson?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jindika li xi ħaġa għandha piż speċifikat.
messages.mt_standard: Jindika li xi ħaġa għandha piż speċifikat.
messages.zh: 它表示某物具有某一指定重量。
messages.en: It indicates that something has a specified weight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象秤旁的一张重量标签，把 mitqal 与“具有指定重量”一起记；本条词性按名词掌握。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality or sensation of being heavy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重量沉重这一性质，或让人感觉沉甸甸的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità jew is-sensazzjoni li xi ħaġa tkun tqila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沉重的性质；沉重感。

formal.mt: Il-mitqla tal-ġebla għamlitha diffiċli biex tinġarr minn persuna waħda.
formal.en: The weightiness of the stone made it difficult for one person to carry.
formal.zh: 石头十分沉重，一个人很难搬动。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tista' tgħinni nġorr din il-ġebla? Toni: Żgur, il-mitqla tagħha tinħass sew.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can you help me carry this stone? Toni: Of course, you can really feel how heavy it is.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你能帮我搬这块石头吗？Toni：当然，真能感觉到它很沉。

messages.speaker: Marija (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 你能帮我搬这块石头吗？
messages.en: Can you help me carry this stone?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.zh: 当然，真能感觉到它很沉。
messages.en: Of course, you can really feel how heavy it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手托起一块大石头时沉甸甸的感觉，把 mitqla 记成“沉重这一性质或感觉”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A striking tool with a handle and a head, used as a mallet or hammer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有柄和锤头、用于敲击的工具，可指槌或锤子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'manku u ras li tintuża biex wieħed jagħti daqqiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 槌；通常以较大的槌头敲击物体的工具。
锤子；用于敲击或钉入钉子的工具。

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa uża mitraq tal-injam biex idaħħal il-biċċa f'postha mingħajr ma jagħmel ħsara lill-wiċċ.
formal.en: The carpenter used a wooden mallet to fit the piece into place without damaging the surface.
formal.zh: 木匠用木槌把零件敲入合适的位置，同时避免损坏表面。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tgħaddili l-mitraq, jekk jogħġbok? Ġanni: Hawn hu. Trid musmar ukoll?
colloquial.en: Sara: Could you pass me the hammer, please? Ġanni: Here it is. Do you need a nail too?
colloquial.zh: Sara：请把锤子递给我，好吗？Ġanni：给你。你还需要钉子吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (修理家具的朋友)
messages.zh: 请把锤子递给我，好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me the hammer, please?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (帮忙的朋友)
messages.zh: 给你。你还需要钉子吗？
messages.en: Here it is. Do you need a nail too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中摆出两件敲击工具：木槌敲合零件，锤子钉入钉子；两幅画都挂在 mitraq 下面。

gloss_zh: tarax 的偶见分词形容词形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: An adjective occurring as an occasional participial form of the verb tarax.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动词 tarax 偶尔出现的分词形式，词性为形容词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġettiv li jseħħ kultant bħala forma partiċipjali tal-verb tarax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动词 tarax 的偶见分词形式。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi grammatikali, mitrux huwa deskritt bħala forma partiċipjali sporadika tal-verb tarax.
formal.en: In grammatical analysis, mitrux is described as a sporadic participial form of the verb tarax.
formal.zh: 在语法分析中，mitrux 被描述为动词 tarax 的偶见分词形式。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif niftakar mitrux? Pawlu: Orbot din il-forma ma' tarax u ftakar li hawnhekk hija aġġettiv.
colloquial.en: Lara: How can I remember mitrux? Pawlu: Link this form with tarax and remember that it is an adjective here.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我怎么记住 mitrux 呢？Pawlu：把这个形式和 tarax 联系起来，并记住它在这里是形容词。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 我怎么记住 mitrux 呢？
messages.en: How can I remember mitrux?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Orbot din il-forma ma' tarax u ftakar li hawnhekk hija aġġettiv.
messages.mt_standard: Orbot din il-forma ma' tarax u ftakar li hawnhekk hija aġġettiv.
messages.zh: 把这个形式和 tarax 联系起来，并记住它在这里是形容词。
messages.en: Link this form with tarax and remember that it is an adjective here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张双面卡：正面写 mitrux，背面写“tarax 的偶见分词，形容词”；先记形式关系，不自行补出词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number 100,000, equal to one hundred groups of one thousand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词，表示一百个一千，即十万，写作 100,000。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru 100,000, jiġifieri mitt grupp ta' elf.

formal.mt: Il-proġett irċieva finanzjament ta' mitt elf ewro għax-xiri ta' tagħmir ġdid.
formal.en: The project received funding of one hundred thousand euros to purchase new equipment.
formal.zh: 该项目获得了十万欧元的资金，用于购置新设备。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm tiswa dik id-dar? Mark: Mitt elf ewro, skont ir-reklam.
colloquial.en: Nina: How much does that house cost? Mark: One hundred thousand euros, according to the advertisement.
colloquial.zh: Nina：那栋房子多少钱？Mark：广告上写的是十万欧元。

messages.speaker: Nina (看房者)
messages.zh: 那栋房子多少钱？
messages.en: How much does that house cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (陪同看房的朋友)
messages.zh: 广告上写的是十万欧元。
messages.en: One hundred thousand euros, according to the advertisement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mitt elf 想成一百包、每包一千：100 × 1,000 = 100,000；换成中文计数就是十万。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An implement used to grind material into smaller particles or powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将材料磨成较小颗粒或粉末的器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex itħan materjal fi frak żgħir jew trab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于研磨材料的器具。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tispjega kif il-mitħan jintuża biex il-qamħ isir dqiq.
formal.en: The description explains how the grinding implement is used to turn wheat into flour.
formal.zh: 这段说明解释了如何用研磨器具把小麦磨成面粉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għal xiex jintuża dan il-mitħan? Pawlu: Biex itħan il-qamħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this grinding implement used for? Pawlu: To grind wheat.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个研磨器具是做什么用的？保罗：用来磨小麦。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个研磨器具是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this grinding implement used for?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 用来磨小麦。
messages.en: To grind wheat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象谷粒经过 mitħan 变成细粉，把这个词与“研磨用的器具”一起记住。

gloss_zh: 足够满足的一份；饱足量

teaching_sense.en_definition: An amount sufficient, or more than sufficient, to satisfy a need or appetite.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 足以满足需要或胃口的一份量，也可以是超过所需的充足份量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont biżżejjed, jew aktar minn biżżejjed, biex jissodisfa ħtieġa jew l-aptit.

sense_translations.en_definition: fill (sufficient or more than sufficient amount)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 足够满足的一份量；饱足量，也可指超过所需的份量。

collocations.zh: 足足的一份；饱饱的一顿

formal.mt: Wara jum twil ta' xogħol, il-ħaddiema ngħataw mixbgħa ta' ikel sħun.
formal.en: After a long day's work, the workers were given enough hot food to eat their fill.
formal.zh: 工作了漫长的一天后，工人们得到了足够吃饱的热饭菜。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kilt biżżejjed? Toni: Iva, ħadt mixbgħa tajba. Grazzi!
colloquial.en: Marija: Have you had enough to eat? Toni: Yes, I've had a good fill. Thank you!
colloquial.zh: Marija：你吃饱了吗？Toni：吃饱了，吃得很满足。谢谢！

messages.speaker: Marija (主人)
messages.zh: 你吃饱了吗？
messages.en: Have you had enough to eat?

messages.speaker: Toni (客人)
messages.zh: 吃饱了，吃得很满足。谢谢！
messages.en: Yes, I've had a good fill. Thank you!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象饭后摸着肚子说“够了，吃满足了”，把 mixbgħa 记成能满足需要的一份量，也可能多于所需。

gloss_zh: 经估计的；著名的；显赫的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Famous or illustrious; also estimated, according to context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可表示著名、享有声望或显赫，也可按语境表示经估计的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu magħruf ħafna jew illustri; jista' wkoll ifisser stmat permezz ta' kalkolu, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经估计的；著名的；声名显赫的。

collocations.zh: 一位声名显赫的艺术家

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-festival jinkludi laqgħa ma' kittieb mixhur għall-poeżiji tiegħu.
formal.en: The festival programme includes a meeting with a writer famous for his poems.
formal.zh: 文化节的活动安排包括与一位因诗作而闻名的作家见面。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dak fuq il-palk? Ġanni: Hu kittieb mixhur. Qrajt ktieb tiegħu s-sena l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is that on the stage? Ġanni: He's a famous writer. I read a book of his last year.
colloquial.zh: Sara：台上那个人是谁？Ġanni：他是一位著名作家。我去年读过他的一本书。

messages.speaker: Sara (文化节观众)
messages.zh: 台上那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that on the stage?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同行的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu kittieb mixhur. Qrajt ktieb tiegħu s-sena l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Hu kittieb mixhur. Qrajt ktieb tiegħu s-sena l-oħra.
messages.zh: 他是一位著名作家。我去年读过他的一本书。
messages.en: He's a famous writer. I read a book of his last year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“大家都知道的作家”记住 mixhur 的著名义，再在词卡另列“显赫、经估计”两个提示，遇到句子按语境选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of moving on foot, whether for travel, exercise, or pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用双脚行进的活动，可用于出行、锻炼或休闲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li timxi fuq saqajk biex tasal xi mkien, tagħmel eżerċizzju jew tieħu gost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 步行；走路这一活动。

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi nofs siegħa mixi kuljum fil-park.
formal.en: The programme includes half an hour of walking in the park every day.
formal.zh: 该计划包括每天在公园步行半小时。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Immorru bil-karozza sal-ħanut? Mark: Ejja mmorru bil-mixi; mhux 'il bogħod.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we drive to the shop? Mark: Let's walk; it isn't far.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们开车去商店吗？马克：走路去吧，不远。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们开车去商店吗？
messages.en: Shall we drive to the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 走路去吧，不远。
messages.en: Let's walk; it isn't far.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mixi 和一双步行鞋一起记；再记整块表达 bil-mixi，看到它就想到“用走路的方式去”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Subject to a lawsuit or accused of an offence or wrongdoing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成为诉讼对象的，或被指控犯有某种罪行、做了某种错事的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tressqet kawża kontrih jew li ġie akkużat b'reat jew b'xi għemil ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被提起诉讼的；被起诉的。
被指控的；被指责犯有某事的。

formal.mt: Ir-raġel mixli b'serq ċaħad l-akkuża quddiem il-qorti.
formal.en: The man accused of theft denied the charge in court.
formal.zh: 被指控盗窃的男子在法庭上否认了指控。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex mar il-qorti? Karl: Għax hu mixli b'serq, imma jgħid li ma għamel xejn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did he go to court? Karl: Because he is accused of theft, but he says he didn't do anything.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他为什么去法庭？卡尔：因为他被指控盗窃，不过他说自己什么也没做。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么去法庭？
messages.en: Why did he go to court?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu mixli b'serq, imma jgħid li ma għamel xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu mixli b'serq, imma jgħid li ma għamel xejn.
messages.zh: 因为他被指控盗窃，不过他说自己什么也没做。
messages.en: Because he is accused of theft, but he says he didn't do anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人收到诉状或指控书：mixli 标记“被诉、被指控”的状态，记忆时不要直接等同于已经有罪。

gloss_zh: 缩水的；被喝掉的（指饮料）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Reduced in size through shrinking; when describing a beverage, consumed by drinking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因收缩而变小的；修饰饮料时，表示已被饮用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ċkien; meta jiddeskrivi xarba, li ġiet ikkunsmata bix-xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收缩的；缩水变小的。
被喝掉的；已被饮用的，用于描述饮料。

collocations.zh: 用餐期间喝掉的葡萄酒

formal.mt: L-inbid mixrub waqt l-ikla kien prodott f'Malta.
formal.en: The wine consumed during the meal was produced in Malta.
formal.zh: 用餐期间饮用的葡萄酒产自马耳他。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex m'għadekx tilbes dan il-ġerż? Ben: Għax hu mixrub wara l-ħasil u m'għadux jiġini.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't you wear this sweater anymore? Ben: Because it has shrunk after washing and no longer fits me.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不再穿这件毛衣了？本：因为它洗后缩水，已经不合身了。

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你为什么不再穿这件毛衣了？
messages.en: Why don't you wear this sweater anymore?

messages.speaker: Ben (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu mixrub wara l-ħasil u m'għadux jiġini.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu mixrub wara l-ħasil u m'għadux jiġini.
messages.zh: 因为它洗后缩水，已经不合身了。
messages.en: Because it has shrunk after washing and no longer fits me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用名词切换画面：搭配毛衣想到“缩水”，搭配葡萄酒想到“被喝掉”；饮料这个义项不是形容人喝醉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A residence or other place where someone spends the winter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人度过冬季的住所，或任何用于过冬的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Residenza jew post ieħor fejn wieħed iqatta' x-xitwa.

sense_translations.en_definition: winter residence, or any place where one passes the winter
sense_translations.zh_definition: 冬季居所，或任何供人度过冬天的地方。

collocations.en: a winter residence near the sea
to spend the winter at the winter residence

formal.mt: Il-familja għażlet dar żgħira qrib il-baħar bħala mixta.
formal.en: The family chose a small house near the sea as a winter residence.
formal.zh: 这家人选择了一栋海边的小房子作为越冬住所。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn se tqattgħu x-xitwa? Ġużeppi: Fil-mixta tagħna ħdejn il-baħar; nerġgħu lura fir-rebbiegħa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where will you spend the winter? Ġużeppi: At our winter residence by the sea; we'll come back in spring.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你们准备在哪里过冬？朱塞佩：在我们海边的越冬住所，春天再回来。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 你们准备在哪里过冬？
messages.en: Where will you spend the winter?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-mixta tagħna ħdejn il-baħar; nerġgħu lura fir-rebbiegħa.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-mixta tagħna ħdejn il-baħar; nerġgħu lura fir-rebbiegħa.
messages.zh: 在我们海边的越冬住所，春天再回来。
messages.en: At our winter residence by the sea; we'll come back in spring.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一栋挂着“冬季入住、春季返回”牌子的小屋，把 mixta 固定联想到“过冬的地方”。

gloss_zh: 心怀渴望的；因匮乏而有所渴求的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling a wish or longing for something, especially because one lacks things one needs or wants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 心中有所渴望的，尤其指因缺少所需或所想之物而产生渴求的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu xewqa għal xi ħaġa, speċjalment għax jonqsu affarijiet li jeħtieġ jew jixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怀有愿望的；有所渴望的。
处于匮乏之中、因而渴求某些事物的。

formal.mt: Wara ġranet mingħajr ikel biżżejjed, it-tifel kien mixtieq għal ikla sħuna.
formal.en: After days without enough food, the boy was longing for a hot meal.
formal.zh: 连续几天吃不饱后，男孩渴望吃上一顿热饭。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif qed tħossok wara dak ix-xogħol kollu? Luqa: Għajjien u mixtieq għal ftit mistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Anna: How do you feel after all that work? Luqa: Tired and longing for a little rest.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：做了那么多工作，你感觉怎么样？卢卡：很累，盼着能休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif qed tħossok wara dak ix-xogħol kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif qed tħossok wara dak ix-xogħol kollu?
messages.zh: 做了那么多工作，你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How do you feel after all that work?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għajjien u mixtieq għal ftit mistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għajjien u mixtieq għal ftit mistrieħ.
messages.zh: 很累，盼着能休息一会儿。
messages.en: Tired and longing for a little rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“缺少什么，就盼着什么”串起两个义项：疲惫时盼休息，匮乏时盼温饱，重点记心中的渴求。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cooked by direct heat on a grill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在烤架上利用直接热力烤熟的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imsajjar fuq gradilja bis-sħana diretta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烤制的；在烤架上烤熟的。

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi ħut mixwi servut ma' insalata friska.
formal.en: The menu includes grilled fish served with a fresh salad.
formal.zh: 菜单上有搭配新鲜沙拉的烤鱼。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'tirrakkomanda llum? Rita: Il-ħut mixwi bil-lumi; tajjeb ħafna.
colloquial.en: Mark: What do you recommend today? Rita: The grilled fish with lemon; it's very good.
colloquial.zh: 马克：今天你推荐什么？丽塔：配柠檬的烤鱼，很好吃。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天你推荐什么？
messages.en: What do you recommend today?

messages.speaker: Rita (服务员)
messages.zh: 配柠檬的烤鱼，很好吃。
messages.en: The grilled fish with lemon; it's very good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象菜单上的鱼和鸡肉都带着烤架纹路：把 mixwi 当作食物旁边的“烤制”标签一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thrown or left lying somewhere; also lying face down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被扔下或随意搁置的；也可形容身体面朝下躺着的姿势。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mitfugħ jew imħolli mimdud xi mkien; ukoll mimdud wiċċu 'l isfel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扔出的；被丢下的。
俯卧的；面朝下躺着的。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, ir-raġel jidher mixħut wiċċu 'l isfel fuq ir-ramel.
formal.en: In the photograph, the man is shown lying face down on the sand.
formal.zh: 照片中的男子面朝下俯卧在沙地上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-ktieb tiegħi? Pawlu: Hemm, mixħut mal-art ħdejn is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is my book? Pawlu: There, tossed on the floor beside the sofa.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的书在哪里？保罗：在那里，被扔在沙发旁的地上。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我的书在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 在那里，被扔在沙发旁的地上。
messages.en: There, tossed on the floor beside the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个落地画面记忆：书被扔在地上，人面朝下趴在地上；分别对应“被扔下”和“俯卧”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个姓氏，用作个人姓名中的家族姓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala parti mill-isem ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个姓氏，书写形式为 Mizzi。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Mizzi se jattendi l-laqgħa bħala rappreżentant tal-iskola.
formal.en: Mr Mizzi will attend the meeting as the school's representative.
formal.zh: Mizzi 先生将作为学校代表出席会议。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif jinkiteb il-kunjom tiegħek? Mark: Mizzi, b'żewġ z.
colloquial.en: Anna: How do you spell your surname? Mark: Mizzi, with two z's.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你的姓怎么拼？马克：Mizzi，有两个 z。

messages.speaker: Anna (接待员)
messages.zh: 你的姓怎么拼？
messages.en: How do you spell your surname?

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: Mizzi，有两个 z。
messages.en: Mizzi, with two z's.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mizzi 放在名牌上的姓氏位置记忆，注意人名首字母大写，中间是两个不带点的 z。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fuse used to carry ignition to an explosive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把点火作用传至爆炸物的导火索或引信。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħabel jew strixxa li twassal in-nar lejn materjal splussiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 导火索；引信。
用于爆炸物的导火索或引信。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-miċċa bħala parti mill-apparat splussiv.
formal.en: The diagram shows the fuse as part of the explosive device.
formal.zh: 示意图将导火索标示为爆炸装置的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dak il-ħabel fl-istampa? Toni: Dik miċċa; it-tikketta ssemmiha taħt l-istampa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is that cord in the picture? Toni: That's a fuse; the label names it below the picture.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：图里那根绳状的东西是什么？托尼：那是导火索，图片下方的标签写着名称。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 图里那根绳状的东西是什么？
messages.en: What is that cord in the picture?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik miċċa; it-tikketta ssemmiha taħt l-istampa.
messages.mt_standard: Dik miċċa; it-tikketta ssemmiha taħt l-istampa.
messages.zh: 那是导火索，图片下方的标签写着名称。
messages.en: That's a fuse; the label names it below the picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用示意图中连接爆炸物的细线记住“导火索”，将词义牢牢绑定具体物件。

gloss_zh: 牵拉用具；畜力磨坊的牵引横梁

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something used for pulling, including a beam that animals turn to drive a mill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于牵拉的东西；也指由牲畜带动旋转、使磨坊运转的横梁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tintuża biex tiġbed; ukoll travu li jdawruh l-annimali biex iħaddmu mitħna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于拉动或牵引的东西。

sense_translations.en_definition: beam turned by animals to move a mill
sense_translations.zh_definition: 由牲畜带动旋转、用来驱动磨坊的横梁。

collocations.zh: 磨坊中由牲畜带动的牵引横梁

formal.mt: Fil-mudell tal-mitħna, l-annimal idawwar il-miġbed biex iħaddem il-mekkaniżmu tat-tħin.
formal.en: In the model of the mill, the animal turns the beam to operate the grinding mechanism.
formal.zh: 在磨坊模型中，牲畜带动牵引横梁旋转，使磨粉装置运作。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'inhu dak it-travu twil fil-mitħna? Luqa: Dak huwa l-miġbed; l-annimal idawru biex iħaddem il-mitħna.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is that long beam in the mill? Luqa: That is the pulling beam; the animal turns it to drive the mill.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：磨坊里那根长横梁是什么？卢卡：那是牵引横梁；牲畜带动它旋转，让磨坊运转。

messages.speaker: Marta (参观者)
messages.zh: 磨坊里那根长横梁是什么？
messages.en: What is that long beam in the mill?

messages.speaker: Luqa (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak huwa l-miġbed; l-annimal idawru biex iħaddem il-mitħna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak huwa l-miġbed; l-annimal idawru biex iħaddem il-mitħna.
messages.zh: 那是牵引横梁；牲畜带动它旋转，让磨坊运转。
messages.en: That is the pulling beam; the animal turns it to drive the mill.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“用来拉的东西”记 miġbed，再想象牲畜绕圈带动磨坊横梁，把一般用途和具体义项连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place filled with stones.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布满或堆满石头的一处地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post mimli ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 满是石头的地方。

collocations.zh: 一大片满是石头的地方

collocations.en: to pass through a stone-filled place

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija tgħaddi minn miġbel, u għalhekk il-mixi jeħtieġ attenzjoni.
formal.en: The path passes through a stone-filled place, so walking requires care.
formal.zh: 小路穿过一片满是石头的地方，因此行走时需要留神。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Nistgħu ngħaddu minn hawn? Simon: Iva, imma dan miġbel; oqgħod attenta fejn tirfes.
colloquial.en: Elena: Can we go through here? Simon: Yes, but this place is full of stones; watch where you step.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我们能从这里过去吗？西蒙：能，不过这里满是石头；注意脚下。

messages.speaker: Elena (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 我们能从这里过去吗？
messages.en: Can we go through here?

messages.speaker: Simon (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma dan miġbel; oqgħod attenta fejn tirfes.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma dan miġbel; oqgħod attenta fejn tirfes.
messages.zh: 能，不过这里满是石头；注意脚下。
messages.en: Yes, but this place is full of stones; watch where you step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miġbel 画成一块到处是石头的地面；记忆焦点是“满石头的地方”，不是某一块石头。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pulled by a force, or drawn toward someone or something by interest or attraction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到外力拉动的；也指因兴趣或吸引力而被某人或某物吸引的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun inġibed b'forza, jew li jħoss interess jew attrazzjoni lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拉动的；受到拉力作用的。
被某人或某物吸引的；对其产生兴趣或好感的。

formal.mt: L-istudent iħossu miġbud lejn l-arti u jixtieq ikompli jistudja l-pittura.
formal.en: The student feels drawn to art and wishes to continue studying painting.
formal.zh: 这名学生深受艺术吸引，希望继续学习绘画。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tħares lejn dak il-kwadru? Mark: Inħossni miġbud lejh; jogħġbuni ħafna l-kuluri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you looking at that painting? Mark: I feel drawn to it; I really like the colours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么一直看那幅画？马克：我被它吸引了；我很喜欢它的色彩。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tħares lejn dak il-kwadru?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tħares lejn dak il-kwadru?
messages.zh: 你为什么一直看那幅画？
messages.en: Why are you looking at that painting?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inħossni miġbud lejh; jogħġbuni ħafna l-kuluri.
messages.mt_standard: Inħossni miġbud lejh; jogħġbuni ħafna l-kuluri.
messages.zh: 我被它吸引了；我很喜欢它的色彩。
messages.en: I feel drawn to it; I really like the colours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两种意思串成画面：绳子把身体拉过去，艺术把注意力拉过去；都可以用 miġbud 来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gathering, especially of people who have come together in one place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聚集，尤指人们来到同一地点形成的聚会或人群。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġabra, speċjalment ta' nies li jkunu ġew flimkien f'post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次聚集或聚会，尤其指人们聚到一起。

formal.mt: Miġemgħa ta' nies inġabret quddiem il-mużew biex tisma' d-diskors tal-ftuħ.
formal.en: A gathering of people assembled in front of the museum to hear the opening speech.
formal.zh: 一群人聚集在博物馆前，聆听开幕致辞。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi dik il-miġemgħa fil-pjazza? Pawlu: In-nies qed jistennew li tibda l-mużika.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that gathering in the square? Pawlu: People are waiting for the music to start.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：广场上那群人是怎么回事？保罗：大家在等音乐开始。

messages.speaker: Lara (居民)
messages.zh: 广场上那群人是怎么回事？
messages.en: What's that gathering in the square?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nies qed jistennew li tibda l-mużika.
messages.mt_standard: In-nies qed jistennew li tibda l-mużika.
messages.zh: 大家在等音乐开始。
messages.en: People are waiting for the music to start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象广场上原本分散的人走到一起，形成一场聚集；用这幅人群画面记住 miġemgħa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fleet: a group of ships considered together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 船队或舰队，指作为一个整体看待的一组船只。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' bastimenti meqjusa flimkien bħala flotta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船队；舰队，即组成一个整体的一组船只。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi miġfna ta' bastimenti li daħlet fil-port kmieni filgħodu.
formal.en: The report describes a fleet of ships that entered the harbour early in the morning.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一支清晨驶入港口的船队。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara kemm hemm bastimenti fil-port! Toni: Iva, hemm miġfna sħiħa; ejja ngħodduhom.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look how many ships there are in the harbour! Toni: Yes, there's a whole fleet; let's count them.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看，港口里有这么多船！托尼：是啊，整整一支船队；我们来数数吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.zh: 看，港口里有这么多船！
messages.en: Look how many ships there are in the harbour!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm miġfna sħiħa; ejja ngħodduhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm miġfna sħiħa; ejja ngħodduhom.
messages.zh: 是啊，整整一支船队；我们来数数吧。
messages.en: Yes, there's a whole fleet; let's count them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把视角从一艘船拉远到整个港口，眼前多艘船组成一支船队，这个整体就是 miġfna。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The coming or arrival of someone or something, including the advent of a time or development.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人或某物的到来、抵达，也可指某个时期或新事物的来临。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa tiġi jew tasal, inkluż il-bidu ta' żmien jew żvilupp ġdid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 到来；前来这一过程或事情。
抵达；到达目的地这一事件。
来临；某个时期、新事物或新发展开始出现。

formal.mt: Il-programm jibda wara l-miġi tal-mistednin, li huma mistennija jaslu għall-ħamsa.
formal.en: The programme begins after the arrival of the guests, who are expected at five.
formal.zh: 活动安排在宾客抵达后开始，宾客预计五点到达。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta se jaslu l-mistednin? David: Qed nistennew il-miġi tagħhom għall-ħamsa; għad għandna ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Sara: When will the guests arrive? David: We're expecting their arrival at five; we still have a little time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：客人们什么时候到？戴维：我们预计他们五点到；还有一点时间。

messages.speaker: Sara (女主人)
messages.zh: 客人们什么时候到？
messages.en: When will the guests arrive?

messages.speaker: David (男主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistennew il-miġi tagħhom għall-ħamsa; għad għandna ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistennew il-miġi tagħhom għall-ħamsa; għad għandna ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 我们预计他们五点到；还有一点时间。
messages.en: We're expecting their arrival at five; we still have a little time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个到来画面串记：朋友前来、客人抵达、春天来临；分别对应 coming、arrival、advent。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An assembly or a group of people gathered together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 集会，或聚集在一起的一群人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Assemblea jew grupp ta' nies li jkunu nġabru flimkien.

sense_translations.en_definition: an assembly, a gathered group of people
sense_translations.zh_definition: 集会；聚集在一起的一群人。

collocations.zh: 大型集会；一大群聚集的人

formal.mt: Miġimgħa ta' residenti ltaqgħet fis-sala biex tiddiskuti t-titjib tal-ġnien pubbliku.
formal.en: An assembly of residents met in the hall to discuss improvements to the public garden.
formal.zh: 居民们在礼堂集会，讨论公共花园的改善事宜。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex hemm miġimgħa kbira ħdejn is-sala? Ġorġ: Ir-residenti ġew biex jitkellmu dwar il-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is there a large assembly beside the hall? Ġorġ: The residents have come to talk about the garden.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：为什么礼堂旁聚了那么多人？乔治：居民们是来讨论花园的。

messages.speaker: Rita (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm miġimgħa kbira ħdejn is-sala?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm miġimgħa kbira ħdejn is-sala?
messages.zh: 为什么礼堂旁聚了那么多人？
messages.en: Why is there a large assembly beside the hall?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-residenti ġew biex jitkellmu dwar il-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-residenti ġew biex jitkellmu dwar il-ġnien.
messages.zh: 居民们是来讨论花园的。
messages.en: The residents have come to talk about the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象居民陆续走进礼堂，坐成一群准备讨论事情；把 miġimgħa 与这幅集会画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The coming or arrival of a person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人或某物的到来、抵达这一事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li persuna jew ħaġa tiġi jew tasal.
