sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次到来或抵达；某人或某物来到的事情。

formal.mt: Mal-miġja tar-rebbiegħa, il-ġnien jinfetaħ għall-viżitaturi kuljum.
formal.en: With the arrival of spring, the garden opens to visitors every day.
formal.zh: 随着春天的到来，花园每天向游客开放。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed tħares lejn il-ħin? Ben: Qed nistenna l-miġja tal-ferrovija; oħti tinsab fuqha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are you checking the time? Ben: I'm waiting for the train's arrival; my sister is on it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么一直看时间？本：我在等火车到站；我姐妹在车上。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么一直看时间？
messages.en: Why are you checking the time?

messages.speaker: Ben (接站者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistenna l-miġja tal-ferrovija; oħti tinsab fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistenna l-miġja tal-ferrovija; oħti tinsab fuqha.
messages.zh: 我在等火车到站；我姐妹在车上。
messages.en: I'm waiting for the train's arrival; my sister is on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miġja 记成站台上的到站时刻：先等待，再看见火车抵达，整个到来事件就是它表达的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Crazy or foolish, describing someone who behaves in an extremely silly or reckless way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人行为十分荒唐、愚蠢或鲁莽，可带有说某人像疯子或傻瓜的语气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu b'mod iblah ħafna jew jagħmel affarijiet bla ħsieb u b'riskju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疯癫的；傻得荒唐或鲁莽的，用来形容人的行为。

collocations.zh: 一个疯癫或愚蠢的男人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-protagonist jidher miġnunazz meta jipprova jaqsam ix-xmara waqt maltempata.
formal.en: In the story, the protagonist seems crazy when he tries to cross the river during a storm.
formal.zh: 故事中，主人公竟想在暴风雨期间渡河，显得十分鲁莽。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Se naqbeż minn fuq dak il-ħajt! Marija: Int miġnunazz! Hu għoli wisq; ejja ngħaddu mill-bieb.
colloquial.en: Luca: I'm going to jump over that wall! Marija: You're crazy! It's far too high; let's go through the gate.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我要翻过那堵墙！玛丽娅：你疯啦！它太高了；我们走门吧。

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se naqbeż minn fuq dak il-ħajt!
messages.mt_standard: Se naqbeż minn fuq dak il-ħajt!
messages.zh: 我要翻过那堵墙！
messages.en: I'm going to jump over that wall!

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int miġnunazz! Hu għoli wisq; ejja ngħaddu mill-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Int miġnunazz! Hu għoli wisq; ejja ngħaddu mill-bieb.
messages.zh: 你疯啦！它太高了；我们走门吧。
messages.en: You're crazy! It's far too high; let's go through the gate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友明明有门可走，却坚持翻高墙，你脱口而出“你疯啦！”；用这个强烈反应记 miġnunazz。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An implement used to snip leaves off a plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于把植物叶片剪除的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex jinqatgħu l-weraq minn fuq pjanta.

sense_translations.en_definition: an implement used to snip off leaves
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于剪除叶片的工具。

collocations.en: an implement for snipping off leaves

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar juża miġrad biex jaqta' l-weraq niexef minn fuq il-pjanta.
formal.en: The gardener uses a leaf-snipping implement to cut the dry leaves off the plant.
formal.zh: 园丁使用剪叶工具，将植物上的干枯叶片剪除。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Tista' tagħtini l-miġrad? Samwel: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda. Se taqta' l-weraq niexef?
colloquial.en: Ella: Can you pass me the leaf-snipping tool? Samwel: Yes, it's on the table. Are you going to cut off the dry leaves?
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：能把剪叶工具递给我吗？萨姆韦尔：可以，就在桌上。你要剪掉干枯的叶子吗？

messages.speaker: Ella (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 能把剪叶工具递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the leaf-snipping tool?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda. Se taqta' l-weraq niexef?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda. Se taqta' l-weraq niexef?
messages.zh: 可以，就在桌上。你要剪掉干枯的叶子吗？
messages.en: Yes, it's on the table. Are you going to cut off the dry leaves?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给盆栽清理枯叶：手里拿着剪叶工具，一片片剪除叶子；把这个用途与 miġrad 绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 遍布化脓或溃疡的身体

teaching_sense.en_definition: A body covered with suppurating sores or ulcerations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遍布化脓疮口或溃疡的身体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġisem mimli ġrieħi bil-materja jew ulċeri.

sense_translations.en_definition: a body riddled with suppurations or ulcerations
sense_translations.zh_definition: 遍布化脓病灶或溃疡的身体。

collocations.en: the description of the sore-covered body
collocations.zh: 对遍布疮疡的身体的描写

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, id-deskrizzjoni tal-miġraħ turi kemm il-marda kienet ħalliet ġrieħi fuq il-ġisem tal-personaġġ.
formal.en: In the story, the description of the sore-covered body shows how extensively the disease had left wounds on the character's body.
formal.zh: 故事通过描写人物遍布疮疡的身体，展现疾病在他身上留下了多少创伤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'miġraħ' f'dan ir-rakkont? Pawlu: Ġisem mimli ġrieħi bil-materja jew ulċeri; l-awtur qed jiddeskrivi kemm kien marid ir-raġel.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'miġraħ' mean in this story? Pawlu: A body covered with suppurating sores or ulcers; the author is describing how ill the man was.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个故事里的“miġraħ”是什么意思？保罗：指遍布化脓疮口或溃疡的身体；作者在描写那个男人病得有多重。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的“miġraħ”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'miġraħ' mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġisem mimli ġrieħi bil-materja jew ulċeri; l-awtur qed jiddeskrivi kemm kien marid ir-raġel.
messages.mt_standard: Ġisem mimli ġrieħi bil-materja jew ulċeri; l-awtur qed jiddeskrivi kemm kien marid ir-raġel.
messages.zh: 指遍布化脓疮口或溃疡的身体；作者在描写那个男人病得有多重。
messages.en: A body covered with suppurating sores or ulcers; the author is describing how ill the man was.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用阅读画面记忆：miġraħ 指整个遍布脓疮或溃疡的身体，不是单独一处伤口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large quantity of something, or a crowd of people gathered together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量很多的一批事物，也可指聚集在一起的一大群人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwantità kbira ta' xi ħaġa, jew folla ta' nies miġbura flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量；数量很多的一批。
一大群人；聚集的人群。

formal.mt: Miżegħda nies inġabret fil-pjazza biex tara l-kunċert.
formal.en: A crowd of people gathered in the square to watch the concert.
formal.zh: 一大群人聚集在广场上观看音乐会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se toħroġ magħna llejla? Toni: Ma nistax; għandi miżegħda xogħol x'nagħmel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you coming out with us tonight? Toni: I can't; I have loads of work to do.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今晚和我们一起出去吗？托尼：不行，我有一大堆工作要做。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今晚和我们一起出去吗？
messages.en: Are you coming out with us tonight?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax; għandi miżegħda xogħol x'nagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax; għandi miżegħda xogħol x'nagħmel.
messages.zh: 不行，我有一大堆工作要做。
messages.en: I can't; I have loads of work to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象一大堆工作，再把画面换成挤满广场的人；共同点都是“很多”，分别记住“大量”和“人群”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing compassion and forgiveness toward someone who needs mercy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对需要宽恕或怜悯的人表现出仁慈与慈悲的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri ħniena u maħfra lejn min għandu bżonnhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仁慈的；慈悲的；愿意怜悯和宽恕的。

formal.mt: Il-mexxej kien miżerikordjuż ma' dawk li talbu l-maħfra.
formal.en: The leader was merciful toward those who asked for forgiveness.
formal.zh: 领导者仁慈地对待了那些请求宽恕的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Id-direttur kien miżerikordjuż miegħek wara dak l-iżball? Mark: Iva, ħafirli u tani ċans ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was the director merciful toward you after that mistake? Mark: Yes, he forgave me and gave me another chance.
colloquial.zh: Maja：出了那个错误以后，主管对你宽容吗？Mark：是的，他原谅了我，又给了我一次机会。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-direttur kien miżerikordjuż miegħek wara dak l-iżball?
messages.mt_standard: Id-direttur kien miżerikordjuż miegħek wara dak l-iżball?
messages.zh: 出了那个错误以后，主管对你宽容吗？
messages.en: Was the director merciful toward you after that mistake?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħafirli u tani ċans ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħafirli u tani ċans ieħor.
messages.zh: 是的，他原谅了我，又给了我一次机会。
messages.en: Yes, he forgave me and gave me another chance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“犯错后仍获得宽恕”的画面绑定，记住它强调仁慈与慈悲。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stone spout projecting from a roof to carry rainwater away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从屋顶向外伸出、用来导走雨水的石制排水嘴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti tal-ġebel li toħroġ 'il barra minn saqaf u tmexxi l-ilma tax-xita 'l barra.

sense_translations.en_definition: stone spout jutting from a roof that channels water
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从屋顶突出、用于引导排水的石制水嘴。

collocations.en: water flowing out of the roof spout
collocations.zh: 从屋顶排水嘴流出的水

formal.mt: Il-miżieb tal-ġebel joħroġ 'il barra mis-saqaf u jmexxi l-ilma tax-xita 'l bogħod mill-ħajt.
formal.en: The stone spout projects from the roof and directs rainwater away from the wall.
formal.zh: 石制排水嘴从屋顶向外伸出，将雨水导向远离墙面的地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn ħiereġ dak l-ilma? Mark: Mill-miżieb tas-saqaf; aħjar ma noqogħdux taħtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is that water coming from? Mark: From the roof spout; we'd better not stand under it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那些水是从哪里流出来的？Mark：从屋顶的排水嘴流出来的；我们最好别站在它下面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那些水是从哪里流出来的？
messages.en: Where is that water coming from?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mill-miżieb tas-saqaf; aħjar ma noqogħdux taħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Mill-miżieb tas-saqaf; aħjar ma noqogħdux taħtu.
messages.zh: 从屋顶的排水嘴流出来的；我们最好别站在它下面。
messages.en: From the roof spout; we'd better not stand under it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象屋顶伸出一张石头小嘴，雨水从嘴里流出，便能记住这个具体物件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A slippery surface, or a rink used for skating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易使人滑倒的表面；也指供人进行滑行运动的场地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wiċċ li jiżloq, jew post apposta fejn isir l-iskejzjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滑溜的表面；容易让人滑倒的地面。
供滑冰或轮滑等滑行运动使用的场地。

formal.mt: It-tfal għandhom jilbsu tagħmir protettiv meta jużaw il-miżilqa tal-iskejzjar.
formal.en: Children should wear protective equipment when using the skating rink.
formal.zh: 儿童使用滑行运动场时应穿戴防护装备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Oqgħod attent, hawn miżilqa ħdejn il-bieb! Mark: Grazzi, se nimxi bil-mod biex ma niżloqx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Be careful, there's a slippery surface here by the door! Mark: Thanks, I'll walk slowly so I don't slip.
colloquial.zh: Maja：小心，门边这里有一块很滑的地面！Mark：谢谢，我会慢慢走，免得滑倒。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod attent, hawn miżilqa ħdejn il-bieb!
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod attent, hawn miżilqa ħdejn il-bieb!
messages.zh: 小心，门边这里有一块很滑的地面！
messages.en: Be careful, there's a slippery surface here by the door!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, se nimxi bil-mod biex ma niżloqx.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, se nimxi bil-mod biex ma niżloqx.
messages.zh: 谢谢，我会慢慢走，免得滑倒。
messages.en: Thanks, I'll walk slowly so I don't slip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“脚下会滑”串起两个义项：一处是湿滑表面，一处是专门滑行的场地。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An offensive term for a person whose parents were not married to each other when the person was born.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对出生时父母并未结婚的人的侮辱性称呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma offensiva għal persuna li l-ġenituri tagħha ma kinux miżżewġin lil xulxin meta twieldet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 私生子，带贬损或侮辱意味的称呼。

formal.mt: Fil-kumment tiegħu dwar it-test, l-għalliem spjega li 'miżmer' hija kelma offensiva.
formal.en: In his commentary on the text, the teacher explained that 'miżmer' is an offensive word.
formal.zh: 教师在讲解课文时说明，miżmer 是一个带有侮辱意味的词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'miżmer' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Tfisser persuna mwielda minn ġenituri mhux miżżewġin lil xulxin, iżda hija kelma offensiva.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'miżmer' mean in this sentence? Mark: It means a person born to parents who are not married to each other, but it is an offensive word.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这句话里的 miżmer 是什么意思？Mark：指父母并未结婚时出生的人，不过这是个侮辱性称呼。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 miżmer 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'miżmer' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser persuna mwielda minn ġenituri mhux miżżewġin lil xulxin, iżda hija kelma offensiva.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser persuna mwielda minn ġenituri mhux miżżewġin lil xulxin, iżda hija kelma offensiva.
messages.zh: 指父母并未结婚时出生的人，不过这是个侮辱性称呼。
messages.en: It means a person born to parents who are not married to each other, but it is an offensive word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义和语气一起记：对应“私生子”这一贬称，阅读时识别其中的侮辱意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brothel or another place used for prostitution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 妓院，或其他用于卖淫活动的场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Burdell jew post ieħor użat għall-prostituzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妓院。
用于卖淫活动的场所。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi bini li kien jintuża bħala miżna.
formal.en: The report describes a building that was used as a brothel.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一栋曾被用作妓院的建筑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'miżna' f'dan ir-rapport? Mark: Tfisser burdell, jew post użat għall-prostituzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'miżna' mean in this report? Mark: It means a brothel, or a place used for prostitution.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这份报告里的 miżna 是什么意思？Mark：指妓院，或用于卖淫活动的场所。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这份报告里的 miżna 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'miżna' mean in this report?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser burdell, jew post użat għall-prostituzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser burdell, jew post użat għall-prostituzzjoni.
messages.zh: 指妓院，或用于卖淫活动的场所。
messages.en: It means a brothel, or a place used for prostitution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记住这是场所名词，再把两个义项对应为“妓院”和范围更宽的“卖淫场所”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A narrow street with little space across its width.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宽度较小、通行空间有限的街道或窄巷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Triq dejqa bi ftit spazju bejn iż-żewġ naħat tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狭窄的街道；窄巷。

collocations.en: the exit from the narrow street

formal.mt: Il-miżrab jgħaqqad il-pjazza ma' triq usa', iżda huwa dejjaq wisq biex jgħaddu żewġ karozzi ħdejn xulxin.
formal.en: The narrow street connects the square to a wider road, but it is too narrow for two cars to pass side by side.
formal.zh: 这条窄巷连接广场与一条较宽的道路，但狭窄得无法让两辆汽车并排通过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu ngħaddu bil-karozza minn dan il-miżrab? Mark: Aħjar inħalluha hawn u nkomplu bil-mixi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we drive through this narrow street? Mark: We'd better leave the car here and continue on foot.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们能开车穿过这条窄巷吗？Mark：最好把车留在这里，接下来步行。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu ngħaddu bil-karozza minn dan il-miżrab?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu ngħaddu bil-karozza minn dan il-miżrab?
messages.zh: 我们能开车穿过这条窄巷吗？
messages.en: Can we drive through this narrow street?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar inħalluha hawn u nkomplu bil-mixi.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar inħalluha hawn u nkomplu bil-mixi.
messages.zh: 最好把车留在这里，接下来步行。
messages.en: We'd better leave the car here and continue on foot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两侧墙壁靠得很近、汽车难以并排通过的小巷，用空间画面记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person with a very thin or skinny build.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体形很瘦、身材瘦削的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha ġisem irqiq ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 很瘦的人；瘦削的人。

collocations.en: a skinny person with long legs

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru ewlieni huwa deskritt bħala miżrek twil b'saqajn twal.
formal.en: In the story, the main character is described as a tall, skinny person with long legs.
formal.zh: 故事将主人公描写成一个个子高、双腿修长的瘦削的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta l-kittieb isejjaħlu 'miżrek', xi jrid jgħid? Mark: Li huwa persuna rqiqa ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: When the writer calls him a 'miżrek', what does he mean? Mark: That he is a very skinny person.
colloquial.zh: Maja：作者称他为 miżrek，是什么意思？Mark：意思是他是个很瘦的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta l-kittieb isejjaħlu 'miżrek', xi jrid jgħid?
messages.mt_standard: Meta l-kittieb isejjaħlu 'miżrek', xi jrid jgħid?
messages.zh: 作者称他为 miżrek，是什么意思？
messages.en: When the writer calls him a 'miżrek', what does he mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 意思是他是个很瘦的人。
messages.en: That he is a very skinny person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个身形细长的小人来记忆，并提醒自己：这个词是指人的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a musty or otherwise unpleasant smell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有霉味、闷陈气味或其他难闻气味的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu riħa ta' magħluq jew riħa ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有霉味的；带有潮湿或久闭产生的闷陈气味的。
气味难闻的；发臭的。

collocations.zh: 有霉味或难闻气味的布料

formal.mt: Wara żmien twil f'armarju magħluq, id-drapp kien miżż u kellu bżonn jinħasel.
formal.en: After a long time in a closed cupboard, the fabric smelled musty and needed washing.
formal.zh: 布料在封闭的柜子里放了很久后有了霉味，需要清洗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħriġt dan id-drapp barra? Mark: Għax hu miżż; se naħslu u nħallih jinxef fl-arja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you bring this fabric outside? Mark: Because it smells bad; I'll wash it and let it air-dry.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么把这块布拿到外面来？Mark：因为它有难闻的气味；我要洗一洗，再放着晾干。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把这块布拿到外面来？
messages.en: Why did you bring this fabric outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu miżż; se naħslu u nħallih jinxef fl-arja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu miżż; se naħslu u nħallih jinxef fl-arja.
messages.zh: 因为它有难闻的气味；我要洗一洗，再放着晾干。
messages.en: Because it smells bad; I'll wash it and let it air-dry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开久闭衣柜时闻到的闷霉味，先记住嗅觉画面，再联想到一般的难闻气味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a husband or wife; married.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经结婚、有配偶的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu mara jew raġel bħala sieħeb fiż-żwieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已婚的；已经结婚的。

formal.mt: Fl-applikazzjoni, is-Sur Borg iddikjara li huwa miżżewweġ.
formal.en: In the application, Mr Borg stated that he is married.
formal.zh: 博格先生在申请表中声明自己已婚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħuk miżżewweġ? Mark: Iva, ilu miżżewweġ sentejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is your brother married? Mark: Yes, he has been married for two years.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你哥哥结婚了吗？马克：结了，他结婚两年了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥结婚了吗？
messages.en: Is your brother married?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 结了，他结婚两年了。
messages.en: Yes, he has been married for two years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人物资料表中婚姻状态一栏写着 miżżewweġ，把整个词与“已婚”这一状态配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become musty, mouldy, or unpleasantly smelly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得带有霉味、长出霉菌，或产生难闻的气味；具体意思依语境确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu riħa ta' magħluq, titrabba l-moffa fuqu, jew jibda jinten.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得有霉味或久置不通风的气味。
发霉；表面长出霉菌。
发臭；产生难闻的气味。

formal.mt: Id-drapp miżżeż wara li tħalla għal żmien twil f'armarju niedi.
formal.en: The cloth became musty after being left in a damp cupboard for a long time.
formal.zh: 这块布在潮湿的柜子里放了很久，产生了霉味。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ħobż miżżeż; ara l-moffa fuqu. Pawlu: Veru, se narmih.
colloquial.en: Sara: This bread has gone mouldy; look at the mould on it. Pawlu: You're right, I'll throw it away.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这面包发霉了，你看上面的霉。保罗：确实，我把它扔掉。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħobż miżżeż; ara l-moffa fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħobż miżżeż; ara l-moffa fuqu.
messages.zh: 这面包发霉了，你看上面的霉。
messages.en: This bread has gone mouldy; look at the mould on it.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 确实，我把它扔掉。
messages.en: You're right, I'll throw it away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面记 miżżeż：柜中布料有霉味、面包长霉、物品发臭；注意分别对应气味、霉菌和臭味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reel on which thread or another long, thin material is wound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供线或其他细长材料缠绕、收放的卷轴或线轴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rukkell li fuqu jitkebbeb ħajt jew materjal ieħor twil u rqiq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷轴；用于缠绕线等材料的线轴。

formal.mt: Qabel tibda l-ħjata, poġġi l-mkebba tal-ħajt fil-post tagħha fuq il-magna.
formal.en: Before you start sewing, put the thread reel in its place on the machine.
formal.zh: 开始缝纫前，把线轴放到缝纫机上的相应位置。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tgħaddili l-mkebba tal-ħajt, jekk jogħġbok? Rita: Żgur, dik bil-ħajt blu?
colloquial.en: Marija: Could you pass me the thread reel, please? Rita: Sure, the one with the blue thread?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：请把线轴递给我好吗？丽塔：好，是绕着蓝线的那个吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (缝纫学员)
messages.zh: 请把线轴递给我好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me the thread reel, please?

messages.speaker: Rita (缝纫老师)
messages.zh: 好，是绕着蓝线的那个吗？
messages.en: Sure, the one with the blue thread?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蓝线一圈圈绕在线轴上，再配着 mkebba tal-ħajt 朗读，把词与可以绕线的实物联系起来。

gloss_zh: 强烈渴望的；对某人或某物十分向往的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling a strong craving or desire for something or someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某物或某人怀有强烈渴望的；涉及人时也可表达情欲上的渴望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu xewqa qawwija għal xi ħaġa jew għal xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: craving or lusting after sth. or sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 强烈渴望某物或某人；对某人怀有强烈欲望的。

collocations.en: feeling an intense desire for someone
collocations.zh: 对某人怀有强烈渴望的

formal.mt: Wara ġurnata twila ta' xogħol, Pawlu kien mlebleb għal ikla sħuna.
formal.en: After a long day at work, Pawlu was craving a hot meal.
formal.zh: 工作了漫长的一天后，保罗特别想吃上一顿热饭。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Illum jien mlebleb għal biċċa kejk. Lara: Mela ejja mmorru sal-ħanut tal-ħelu.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm really craving a piece of cake today. Lara: Then let's go to the cake shop.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我今天特别想吃一块蛋糕。拉拉：那我们去蛋糕店吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum jien mlebleb għal biċċa kejk.
messages.mt_standard: Illum jien mlebleb għal biċċa kejk.
messages.zh: 我今天特别想吃一块蛋糕。
messages.en: I'm really craving a piece of cake today.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们去蛋糕店吧。
messages.en: Then let's go to the cake shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mlebleb 记成看到蛋糕便特别想吃的状态；它强调强烈渴望，对人的语境还可能带有情欲意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become smooth, sleek, and neat in appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得光滑、柔顺而整齐，尤其可用来描写毛发表面的变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir lixx u jidher aktar pulit, bħall-pil wara t-tfarfir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得光滑柔顺；变得光洁整齐。

formal.mt: Wara t-tfarfir, il-pil tal-qattus mlies u deher aktar ileqq.
formal.en: After brushing, the cat's fur became sleek and looked shinier.
formal.zh: 梳理之后，猫的毛变得柔顺，看起来也更有光泽了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara kif mlies il-pil tal-qattus! Toni: Iva, għadni kemm farfartu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look how sleek the cat's fur has become! Toni: Yes, I've just brushed him.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看，猫的毛变得多柔顺！托尼：是啊，我刚给它梳过毛。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，猫的毛变得多柔顺！
messages.en: Look how sleek the cat's fur has become!

messages.speaker: Toni (猫主人)
messages.zh: 是啊，我刚给它梳过毛。
messages.en: Yes, I've just brushed him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用梳毛前后两张画面记 mlies：原来蓬乱，后来柔顺；重点是“变得”的过程，而非静态性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Gentle caresses, or the action of making a surface smooth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻柔的抚摸；也指使表面变平滑的抚平或平整动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mess ħafif u ġentili, jew l-azzjoni li tagħmel wiċċ lixx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻抚；表达亲近或安慰的温柔抚摸。
抚平；使表面变得平滑的动作或过程。

collocations.en: smoothing the surface of the wood

formal.mt: Il-mlis tal-wiċċ tal-injam neħħa l-ħruxija qabel iż-żebgħa.
formal.en: Smoothing the surface of the wood removed the roughness before painting.
formal.zh: 涂漆之前，对木材表面进行平整处理，消除了粗糙感。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-qattus tiegħek iħobb il-mlis? Mark: Ħafna! Joqgħod ħdejja u jistenna l-mlis fuq rasu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does your cat like being stroked? Mark: Very much! He sits beside me and waits for strokes on his head.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的猫喜欢被抚摸吗？马克：特别喜欢！它会坐在我旁边，等着我摸它的头。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的猫喜欢被抚摸吗？
messages.en: Does your cat like being stroked?

messages.speaker: Mark (猫主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħafna! Joqgħod ħdejja u jistenna l-mlis fuq rasu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħafna! Joqgħod ħdejja u jistenna l-mlis fuq rasu.
messages.zh: 特别喜欢！它会坐在我旁边，等着我摸它的头。
messages.en: Very much! He sits beside me and waits for strokes on his head.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只手轻轻摸猫，另一只手把表面抚平，用这两个动作记住名词 mlis 的“轻抚”和“抚平”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of having a smooth surface or a sleek appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面平滑的性质，或毛发等光滑柔顺的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' wiċċ lixx jew ta' pil u xagħar lixx u pulit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平滑；表面没有明显粗糙之处的性质。
光滑柔顺；毛发等平顺光洁的状态。

formal.mt: Il-mlusija tal-ħarir tinħass meta tgħaddi idek fuq id-drapp.
formal.en: The smoothness of silk can be felt when you run your hand over the fabric.
formal.zh: 用手轻轻滑过布面时，可以感受到丝绸的光滑。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ħoss il-mlusija ta' dan id-drapp. Anna: Kemm hu lixx! Nixtieq nagħmel xalpa bih.
colloquial.en: Rita: Feel the smoothness of this fabric. Anna: It's so smooth! I'd like to make a scarf with it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：摸摸这块布有多光滑。安娜：真滑！我想用它做条围巾。

messages.speaker: Rita (布店店员)
messages.zh: 摸摸这块布有多光滑。
messages.en: Feel the smoothness of this fabric.

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu lixx! Nixtieq nagħmel xalpa bih.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu lixx! Nixtieq nagħmel xalpa bih.
messages.zh: 真滑！我想用它做条围巾。
messages.en: It's so smooth! I'd like to make a scarf with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 摸丝绸时感到的“光滑质感”就是 mlusija；与 mlies 的“变得柔顺”、mlis 的“抚平动作”对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a surface smooth or shiny by polishing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过打磨或擦磨，使物体表面变得光滑或有光泽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel wiċċ lixx jew ileqq billi għorku jew illustrah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨光、抛光某个表面，使其光滑或发亮。

formal.mt: L-artiġjan mmagra l-wiċċ tal-metall sakemm sar lixx u jleqq.
formal.en: The craftsperson polished the metal surface until it became smooth and shiny.
formal.zh: 工匠抛光金属表面，直到它变得光滑发亮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min mmagra din il-mejda tal-irħam? Pawlu: Missieri. Ara kemm qed tleqq!
colloquial.en: Maja: Who polished this marble table? Pawlu: My father. Look how shiny it is!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁抛光了这张大理石桌子？保罗：我爸爸。看，多亮啊！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁抛光了这张大理石桌子？
messages.en: Who polished this marble table?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我爸爸。看，多亮啊！
messages.en: My father. Look how shiny it is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块暗淡的金属经过反复擦磨，最后能映出光线，用这个画面记住“抛光表面”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone or something weaker or less strong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或事物的力量、体力或强度降低。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa aktar dgħajfa jew b'inqas saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变弱；削弱力量或使体力衰退。

formal.mt: Il-mard twil mmajna lil ġismu, u kellu bżonn perjodu ta' mistrieħ.
formal.en: The prolonged illness weakened his body, and he needed a period of rest.
formal.zh: 长期患病使他的身体衰弱，他需要休息一段时间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tistrieħ daqshekk? Toni: Il-mard mmajna lil ġismi. Għadni għajjien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you resting so much? Toni: The illness weakened my body. I'm still tired.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么休息这么久？托尼：生病把身体拖虚弱了，我还觉得累。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么休息这么久？
messages.en: Why are you resting so much?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mard mmajna lil ġismi. Għadni għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Il-mard mmajna lil ġismi. Għadni għajjien.
messages.zh: 生病把身体拖虚弱了，我还觉得累。
messages.en: The illness weakened my body. I'm still tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把体力想成电量条，从满格慢慢降到低格；这个词提示“力量被削弱、身体变虚弱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To injure part of the body by a knock or impact, causing a bruise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因碰撞或撞击而使身体某个部位受伤，形成瘀伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Weġġa' parti tal-ġisem b'daqqa jew ħabta u kkawża tbenġila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 碰伤；挫伤，使身体部位出现瘀伤。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent mmakka driegħu meta waqa' fuq it-taraġ.
formal.en: The patient bruised his arm when he fell on the stairs.
formal.zh: 患者在楼梯上跌倒时碰伤了手臂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lil driegħek? Mark: Ħbatt mal-bieb u mmakkajt driegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to your arm? Mark: I bumped into the door and bruised my arm.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的手臂怎么了？马克：我撞到门上，把手臂碰青了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的手臂怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your arm?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我撞到门上，把手臂碰青了。
messages.en: I bumped into the door and bruised my arm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手臂撞到门框后出现一块青紫，把“碰撞后留下瘀伤”的完整画面和这个词一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave a stain on something, or figuratively to damage someone's reputation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体上留下污渍；也可比喻使某人的名誉受到玷污。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla tebgħa fuq xi ħaġa, jew b'mod figurattiv għamel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄脏某物；使某物沾上污渍。
玷污某人的名誉；使某人的声誉受损。

formal.mt: L-iskandlu mmakkja r-reputazzjoni tal-kumpanija u naqqas il-fiduċja tal-klijenti.
formal.en: The scandal stained the company's reputation and reduced customers' trust.
formal.zh: 这起丑闻玷污了公司的声誉，并降低了客户的信任。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'mmakkja l-qmis tiegħek? Ben: Il-kafè. Xerred ftit fuqha waqt il-kolazzjon.
colloquial.en: Lara: What stained your shirt? Ben: Coffee. Some spilled onto it during breakfast.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：什么把你的衬衫弄脏了？本：咖啡，吃早饭时洒了一点在上面。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 什么把你的衬衫弄脏了？
messages.en: What stained your shirt?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kafè. Xerred ftit fuqha waqt il-kolazzjon.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kafè. Xerred ftit fuqha waqt il-kolazzjon.
messages.zh: 咖啡，吃早饭时洒了一点在上面。
messages.en: Coffee. Some spilled onto it during breakfast.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记白衬衫上的污点，再把污点想象成名誉上的污点；同一个“玷污”画面串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone or something a bad reputation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某事物获得不好的名声，损害其在别人心中的形象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta fama ħażina lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人或某事物落下坏名声；败坏其名声。

collocations.en: gave the teacher a bad name
gave the shop a bad name
collocations.zh: 使这家商店落下坏名声

formal.mt: L-artiklu mmalafama lill-għalliem billi ppreżenta akkużi bla prova bħala fatti.
formal.en: The article gave the teacher a bad name by presenting unproven accusations as facts.
formal.zh: 这篇文章把未经证实的指控当作事实，败坏了老师的名声。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex is-sid tal-ħanut irrabja? David: Dak il-kumment mmalafama lill-ħanut. Qal li jbigħ ikel ħażin.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did the shop owner get angry? David: That comment gave the shop a bad name. It said the shop sells bad food.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：店主为什么生气？戴维：那条评论败坏了店铺的名声，说店里卖的食物不好。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 店主为什么生气？
messages.en: Why did the shop owner get angry?

messages.speaker: David (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-kumment mmalafama lill-ħanut. Qal li jbigħ ikel ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-kumment mmalafama lill-ħanut. Qal li jbigħ ikel ħażin.
messages.zh: 那条评论败坏了店铺的名声，说店里卖的食物不好。
messages.en: That comment gave the shop a bad name. It said the shop sells bad food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一家店被贴上“名声不好”的标签；学习时抓住结果：别人开始对它留下坏印象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak or write maliciously about someone in order to damage their reputation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 怀着恶意说或写贬损某人的话，以损害其名誉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkellem jew kiteb b'malizzja dwar xi ħadd biex jagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶意诋毁、中伤某人，损害其名誉。

collocations.zh: 恶意中伤了自己的同事
恶意诋毁了自己的对手

formal.mt: Il-kittieb mmalinja lill-avversarju tiegħu billi attribwielu intenzjonijiet ħżiena mingħajr prova.
formal.en: The writer maligned his opponent by attributing bad intentions to him without evidence.
formal.zh: 作者在没有证据的情况下指称对手怀有恶意，以此诋毁对方。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex Elena ħarġet irrabjata? Sam: Mark mmalinja lilha quddiem kulħadd. Qal li kienet tigdeb apposta.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did Elena leave angrily? Sam: Mark maligned her in front of everyone. He said she was lying deliberately.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：埃莱娜为什么生气地走了？萨姆：马克当着大家的面中伤她，说她故意撒谎。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 埃莱娜为什么生气地走了？
messages.en: Why did Elena leave angrily?

messages.speaker: Sam (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark mmalinja lilha quddiem kulħadd. Qal li kienet tigdeb apposta.
messages.mt_standard: Mark mmalinja lilha quddiem kulħadd. Qal li kienet tigdeb apposta.
messages.zh: 马克当着大家的面中伤她，说她故意撒谎。
messages.en: Mark maligned her in front of everyone. He said she was lying deliberately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人故意用恶毒言语攻击别人的名誉；记忆重点是“带着恶意诋毁”，而非普通批评。

gloss_zh: 缠结；把自己的头发编成辫子

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become tangled, or to arrange one's own hair into a plait.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 线等物体缠绕打结；也指把自己的头发交编成辫子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħabbel, jew nisġet ix-xagħar tiegħu stess f'nisġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缠结；缠绕在一起，变得难以理开。
把自己的头发编成辫子。

collocations.zh: 把自己的头发编成了辫子

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol tal-ħjata, il-ħajt mmalja u kien meħtieġ li jinħall qabel ma jitkompla x-xogħol.
formal.en: During the sewing work, the thread got tangled and had to be untangled before the work could continue.
formal.zh: 缝纫过程中，线缠结了，必须先将其理开才能继续工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min mmalja xagħrek? Pawlu: Jien stess. Domt ftit, imma rnexxieli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who plaited your hair? Pawlu: I did it myself. It took a little while, but I managed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁给你编的辫子？保罗：我自己编的。花了点时间，不过编好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁给你编的辫子？
messages.en: Who plaited your hair?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien stess. Domt ftit, imma rnexxieli.
messages.mt_standard: Jien stess. Domt ftit, imma rnexxieli.
messages.zh: 我自己编的。花了点时间，不过编好了。
messages.en: I did it myself. It took a little while, but I managed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅交错的线条图记忆：乱交错的是“缠结”，有规律地交编头发则是“给自己编辫子”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat a person or animal cruelly or roughly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以残酷或粗暴的方式对待人或动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittratta persuna jew annimal bi krudeltà jew b'mod aħrax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虐待；恶劣地对待人或动物。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, is-sid kien imaltratta lill-ħaddiema għal diversi xhur.
formal.en: According to the report, the owner had been ill-treating the workers for several months.
formal.zh: 根据报告，老板虐待工人的情况已持续数月。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex irrappurtajt lis-sid tal-kelb? Toni: Għax rajtu jimaltratta lill-kelb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you report the dog's owner? Toni: Because I saw him ill-treating the dog.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么举报狗主人？托尼：因为我看见他虐待那只狗。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么举报狗主人？
messages.en: Why did you report the dog's owner?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为我看见他虐待那只狗。
messages.en: Because I saw him ill-treating the dog.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“恶劣对待”的画面相连：想到受欺负的人或动物，就回忆“虐待、粗暴对待”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put handcuffs on someone, fastening their wrists.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给某人戴上手铐，铐住其双腕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed il-manetti fuq il-polz ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某人戴上手铐。

formal.mt: Il-pulizija mmanettaw lis-suspettat qabel ma daħħluh fil-vettura.
formal.en: The police handcuffed the suspect before putting him in the vehicle.
formal.zh: 警察给嫌疑人戴上手铐后，将他带上了警车。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamlu l-pulizija? Mark: Immanettaw lir-raġel u ħaduh magħhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the police do? Mark: They handcuffed the man and took him with them.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：警察做了什么？马克：他们给那个男人戴上手铐，把他带走了。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 警察做了什么？
messages.en: What did the police do?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 他们给那个男人戴上手铐，把他带走了。
messages.en: They handcuffed the man and took him with them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动作帮助记忆：想象两只手腕被手铐连接，看到这个词就说“给某人戴上手铐”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To damage something badly by crushing, twisting, or tearing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过挤压、扭绞或撕扯使某物严重损坏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħsara kbira lil xi ħaġa billi jgħaffiġha, jgħawwiġha jew iqattagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绞坏、压坏或撕坏，使严重变形或损坏。

formal.mt: Ir-romblu mmangna d-drapp, u għalhekk il-produzzjoni waqfet.
formal.en: The roller mangled the fabric, so production stopped.
formal.zh: 滚筒绞坏了布料，因此生产停止了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara lil din il-biċċa drapp? Pawlu: Ir-romblu mmangnaha meta nqabdet fih.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened to this piece of fabric? Pawlu: The roller mangled it when it got caught in it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这块布怎么了？保罗：它卡进滚筒里，被绞坏了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 这块布怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to this piece of fabric?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (机器操作员)
messages.zh: 它卡进滚筒里，被绞坏了。
messages.en: The roller mangled it when it got caught in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住布料卡进滚筒后扭绞破损的画面，把这个词和“绞坏、严重弄坏”一起回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show a feeling, attitude, or quality clearly through words or actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过言语或行动清楚地表露某种情感、态度或特质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri b'mod ċar sentiment, fehma jew kwalità permezz tal-kliem jew tal-għemil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表露；显示；使某种情感、态度或特征显现出来。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat immanifesta tħassib dwar id-dewmien fil-proġett.
formal.en: The committee manifested concern about the delay in the project.
formal.zh: 委员会对项目延误表达了担忧。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Mario jrid jingħaqad mat-tim? Lara: Naħseb li iva; ilbieraħ immanifesta interess fil-proġett.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does Mario want to join the team? Lara: I think so; yesterday he showed interest in the project.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马里奥想加入团队吗？拉拉：我觉得想；他昨天表现出了对这个项目的兴趣。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 马里奥想加入团队吗？
messages.en: Does Mario want to join the team?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li iva; ilbieraħ immanifesta interess fil-proġett.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li iva; ilbieraħ immanifesta interess fil-proġett.
messages.zh: 我觉得想；他昨天表现出了对这个项目的兴趣。
messages.en: I think so; yesterday he showed interest in the project.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把心里的兴趣或担忧想成走到台前：原本藏在心里，现在通过言语行动“表露出来”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To organize, direct, or administer work, resources, or an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 组织、安排或管理工作、资源或某项活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jorganizza, imexxi jew jamministra xogħol, riżorsi jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 管理；经营；办理或执行有关事务。
暗中策划；密谋；进行阴谋活动。

formal.mt: Id-direttur immaniġġa l-fondi tal-proġett skont il-baġit approvat.
formal.en: The director administered the project funds according to the approved budget.
formal.zh: 主管按照批准的预算管理了项目资金。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min immaniġġa l-proġett waqt li kont barra? Toni: Sara; qassmet ix-xogħol u żammet kollox taħt kontroll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who managed the project while I was away? Toni: Sara; she divided up the work and kept everything under control.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我不在的时候，谁管理了这个项目？托尼：萨拉；她分配了工作，把一切安排得井井有条。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Min immaniġġa l-proġett waqt li kont barra?
messages.mt_standard: Min immaniġġa l-proġett waqt li kont barra?
messages.zh: 我不在的时候，谁管理了这个项目？
messages.en: Who managed the project while I was away?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sara; qassmet ix-xogħol u żammet kollox taħt kontroll.
messages.mt_standard: Sara; qassmet ix-xogħol u żammet kollox taħt kontroll.
messages.zh: 萨拉；她分配了工作，把一切安排得井井有条。
messages.en: Sara; she divided up the work and kept everything under control.

cognitive_memory_aid: 建立两张语境卡：办公桌上安排项目是“管理”，暗中安排对付别人则是“密谋”；靠上下文分辨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a material or object magnetic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某种材料或物体具有磁性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel materjal jew oġġett manjetiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使磁化；使物体获得磁性。

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, l-istudent immanjetizza labra u osserva kif attirat oġġetti żgħar tal-ħadid.
formal.en: During the experiment, the student magnetized a needle and observed how it attracted small iron objects.
formal.zh: 实验中，学生使一根针磁化，并观察它如何吸引小铁件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex din il-labra qed tattira l-klipps? Mark: Għax Pawlu mmanjetizzaha waqt l-esperiment.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is this needle attracting the paper clips? Mark: Because Pawlu magnetized it during the experiment.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这根针为什么会吸引回形针？马克：因为保罗在实验时把它磁化了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din il-labra qed tattira l-klipps?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din il-labra qed tattira l-klipps?
messages.zh: 这根针为什么会吸引回形针？
messages.en: Why is this needle attracting the paper clips?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 因为保罗在实验时把它磁化了。
messages.en: Because Pawlu magnetized it during the experiment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根普通铁针获得磁性，随后吸住小铁件；用“让物体变得有磁性”记住整个动作。

gloss_zh: 使残缺；使伤残；毁损外形

teaching_sense.en_definition: To injure a body or body part severely, causing lasting damage or loss of normal form or use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 严重损伤身体或身体部位，使其残缺、变形或丧失正常功能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iweġġa' serjament il-ġisem jew parti minnu u jħalli ħsara permanenti fil-forma jew fil-funzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严重毁伤身体或身体部位，使其残缺不全。
使伤残；使身体部位永久失去正常功能。
毁损容貌或外形；使原有形态受到严重损害。

formal.mt: L-inċident imman ka lir-raġel u ħallieh bi ħsara permanenti f'idu.
formal.en: The accident maimed the man and left him with permanent damage to his hand.
formal.zh: 事故使那个男人伤残，给他的手留下了永久性损伤。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu ma jistax juża idu sew? Toni: Inċident fuq ix-xogħol imman ka idu meta kien żgħir.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why can't Pawlu use his hand properly? Toni: An accident at work maimed his hand when he was young.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗为什么不能正常使用他的手？托尼：他年轻时，一次工伤事故使他的手落下了残疾。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu ma jistax juża idu sew?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu ma jistax juża idu sew?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么不能正常使用他的手？
messages.en: Why can't Pawlu use his hand properly?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inċident fuq ix-xogħol imman ka idu meta kien żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Inċident fuq ix-xogħol imman ka idu meta kien żgħir.
messages.zh: 他年轻时，一次工伤事故使他的手落下了残疾。
messages.en: An accident at work maimed his hand when he was young.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项分别记成“身体残缺、功能受损、外形毁损”；共同点是严重且可能持久的损伤。

gloss_zh: 驯化；被驯化；安抚；变温顺

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tame an animal so that it becomes accustomed to people and easier to handle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 驯化动物，使其适应与人接触，变得较温顺、容易照管。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idorri annimal mal-bnedmin u jagħmlu aktar kwiet u faċli biex wieħed jieħu ħsiebu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驯化；使动物适应与人共同生活或接受人的照管。
被驯化；成为适应人类照管的动物。
安抚；使愤怒、不满或激动的情绪平息。
变得温顺、驯服或容易引导。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi mmansa ż-żiemel bil-paċenzja sakemm seta' javviċinah mingħajr biża'.
formal.en: The farmer patiently tamed the horse until he could approach it without fear.
formal.zh: 农夫耐心地驯服了那匹马，直到能够放心地靠近它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Iż-żiemel għadu jibża' min-nies? Pawlu: Le, issa mmansa u jħallina noqorbu lejh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the horse still afraid of people? Pawlu: No, it has become docile now and lets us approach it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那匹马还怕人吗？保罗：不怕了，它现在变温顺了，让我们靠近它。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 那匹马还怕人吗？
messages.en: Is the horse still afraid of people?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa mmansa u jħallina noqorbu lejh.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa mmansa u jħallina noqorbu lejh.
messages.zh: 不怕了，它现在变温顺了，让我们靠近它。
messages.en: No, it has become docile now and lets us approach it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象受惊的马慢慢安静下来：人使它温顺是“驯化”，它自身的变化是“变温顺”；对人群则可表示“安抚”。

gloss_zh: 操纵；暗中谋划；在船上工作

teaching_sense.en_definition: To guide or move a vehicle or vessel carefully; also to scheme or manipulate, or to work on a ship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小心操纵车辆或船只，使其移动或改变方向；也可指暗中谋划、操控局面，或在船上工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imexxi vettura jew bastiment b'attenzjoni; jista' jfisser ukoll li jippjana minn wara l-kwinti, jimmanipula, jew jaħdem fuq bastiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 操纵车辆、船只等移动或转向。

sense_translations.en_definition: to intrigue, to manipulate, to plot
sense_translations.zh_definition: 暗中活动、操控他人或局势，或进行密谋。
在船上工作。

formal.mt: Ix-xufier mmanuvra t-trakk b'attenzjoni biex jgħaddi mid-daħla dejqa.
formal.en: The driver carefully maneuvered the truck through the narrow entrance.
formal.zh: 司机小心操纵卡车，驶过狭窄的入口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif daħħal il-karozza f'dak l-ispazju żgħir? Mark: Mmanuvra bil-mod, u jien għentu jara kemm kien fadal spazju.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did he get the car into that small space? Mark: He maneuvered slowly, and I helped him judge how much room was left.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他怎么把车停进那么小的空位的？Mark：他慢慢挪车，我帮他看还剩多少空间。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif daħħal il-karozza f'dak l-ispazju żgħir?
messages.mt_standard: Kif daħħal il-karozza f'dak l-ispazju żgħir?
messages.zh: 他怎么把车停进那么小的空位的？
messages.en: How did he get the car into that small space?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mmanuvra bil-mod, u jien għentu jara kemm kien fadal spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Mmanuvra bil-mod, u jien għentu jara kemm kien fadal spazju.
messages.zh: 他慢慢挪车，我帮他看还剩多少空间。
messages.en: He maneuvered slowly, and I helped him judge how much room was left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象司机在窄巷中小心挪车，记住“操纵”；再单独配上“幕后谋划”和“船上工作”两张义项卡，避免混淆。

gloss_zh: 绘制地图；标绘路线或区域

teaching_sense.en_definition: To map out an area or route by showing its locations, features, or course.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把区域的地点、地貌或路线标绘出来，使其位置和走向清楚可见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifassal mappa ta' żona jew rotta biex juri l-postijiet, il-karatteristiċi jew it-triq li trid tittieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绘制或标出区域、路线等的地图。

formal.mt: It-tim mmappja ż-żona u indika l-mogħdijiet kollha fuq il-mappa.
formal.en: The team mapped out the area and marked all the paths on the map.
formal.zh: 团队绘制了该区域的地图，并在图上标出了所有小径。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nafu minn fejn se ngħaddu għada? Pawlu: Iva, Mark diġà mmappja r-rotta u bagħtilna l-mappa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do we know which way we are going tomorrow? Pawlu: Yes, Mark has already mapped out the route and sent us the map.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们知道明天走哪条路了吗？Pawlu：知道，Mark已经标好了路线，还把地图发给我们了。

messages.speaker: Sara (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Nafu minn fejn se ngħaddu għada?
messages.mt_standard: Nafu minn fejn se ngħaddu għada?
messages.zh: 我们知道明天走哪条路了吗？
messages.en: Do we know which way we are going tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Mark diġà mmappja r-rotta u bagħtilna l-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Mark diġà mmappja r-rotta u bagħtilna l-mappa.
messages.zh: 知道，Mark已经标好了路线，还把地图发给我们了。
messages.en: Yes, Mark has already mapped out the route and sent us the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出发前用笔把沿途地点和路线一一画到地图上，将整个“标绘清楚”的动作与这个词一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To strike something with a hammer, for example to drive in a nail or shape a material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用锤子敲击物体，例如把钉子钉入材料，或通过敲打使材料成形。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jolqot xi ħaġa b'martell, pereżempju biex idaħħal musmar jew jagħti forma lil materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锤子敲打或锤击。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem mmartella l-metall biex jagħtih il-forma mixtieqa.
formal.en: The worker hammered the metal to give it the desired shape.
formal.zh: 工人锤打金属，使其达到所需的形状。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'kien dak il-ħoss mill-garaxx? Mark: Pawlu mmartella ftit imsiemer biex isewwi s-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Rita: What was that noise from the garage? Mark: Pawlu hammered in a few nails to repair the chair.
colloquial.zh: Rita：刚才车库里是什么声音？Mark：Pawlu敲进了几颗钉子，修了一下椅子。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 刚才车库里是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise from the garage?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu mmartella ftit imsiemer biex isewwi s-siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu mmartella ftit imsiemer biex isewwi s-siġġu.
messages.zh: Pawlu敲进了几颗钉子，修了一下椅子。
messages.en: Pawlu hammered in a few nails to repair the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定格在锤子落向钉子的瞬间，再配上“当、当、当”的敲击声，用动作和声音一起记住“锤打”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stimulate one's own genitals for sexual pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为获得性快感而自行刺激自己的生殖器，即自慰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jistimula l-organi ġenitali tiegħu stess biex iħoss pjaċir sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自慰；为获得性快感而自行刺激自己的生殖器。

formal.mt: Waqt il-konsultazzjoni, ir-raġel qal lit-tabib li mmasturba u wara ħass uġigħ.
formal.en: During the consultation, the man told the doctor that he had masturbated and felt pain afterward.
formal.zh: 问诊时，该男子告诉医生，他自慰后感到了疼痛。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'jifisser 'mmasturba' f'dan it-test dwar is-saħħa? Rita: Ifisser li persuna stimulat l-organi ġenitali tagħha stess għal pjaċir sesswali.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does 'mmasturba' mean in this health text? Rita: It means that a person stimulated their own genitals for sexual pleasure.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这篇健康文章里的“mmasturba”是什么意思？Rita：意思是某人为获得性快感而刺激了自己的生殖器，也就是自慰。

messages.speaker: Mark (成年语言学习者)
messages.zh: 这篇健康文章里的“mmasturba”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mmasturba' mean in this health text?

messages.speaker: Rita (语言教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li persuna stimulat l-organi ġenitali tagħha stess għal pjaċir sesswali.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li persuna stimulat l-organi ġenitali tagħha stess għal pjaċir sesswali.
messages.zh: 意思是某人为获得性快感而刺激了自己的生殖器，也就是自慰。
messages.en: It means that a person stimulated their own genitals for sexual pleasure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“自己、身体、性快感”三个关键词组成中性释义卡，直接对应中文“自慰”，在健康或医学语境中记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To crush grain or another material into smaller particles or powder by grinding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过研磨把谷物或其他材料加工成细粒或粉末。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaffeġ il-qamħ jew materjal ieħor fi frak żgħir jew trab permezz tat-tħin.

sense_translations.en_definition: to grind, to mill, to grist
sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨碎；碾磨，尤指把谷物磨成粉。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem mmaċina l-qamħ u ġabar id-dqiq f'boroż nodfa.
formal.en: The worker milled the wheat and collected the flour in clean bags.
formal.zh: 工人把小麦磨成粉，并将面粉装入干净的袋子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min mmaċina l-kafè? Mark: Jien. Għadni kif lestejt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who ground the coffee? Mark: I did. I've just finished.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁磨的咖啡豆？马克：我磨的，刚刚弄好。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁磨的咖啡豆？
messages.en: Who ground the coffee?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我磨的，刚刚弄好。
messages.en: I did. I've just finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上磨坊转动的画面：小麦进去，面粉出来，记住“碾磨、磨碎”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel great surprise or wonder at something unexpected or impressive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因出乎意料或令人赞叹的事物而感到惊讶、惊奇或赞叹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jistagħġeb jew iħoss għaġeb quddiem xi ħaġa mhux mistennija jew impressjonanti.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be astonished, to be surprised, to marvel
sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到惊讶、吃惊，或对某事物惊叹、赞叹。

collocations.en: marveled at the beauty of the place
collocations.zh: 惊叹于这个地方的美丽

formal.mt: Il-viżitatur mmeravilja ruħu bid-dettalji fini tal-iskultura.
formal.en: The visitor marveled at the sculpture's fine details.
formal.zh: 参观者对雕塑精细的细节赞叹不已。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għoġbitu l-veduta lil Pawlu? Maja: Ħafna! Mmeravilja ruħu bis-sbuħija tal-baħar u baqa' jħares lejh.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Pawlu like the view? Maja: Very much! He marveled at the beauty of the sea and kept looking at it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu喜欢那里的景色吗？Maja：可喜欢了！他惊叹于大海的美，一直看个不停。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu喜欢那里的景色吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu like the view?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħafna! Mmeravilja ruħu bis-sbuħija tal-baħar u baqa' jħares lejh.
messages.mt_standard: Ħafna! Mmeravilja ruħu bis-sbuħija tal-baħar u baqa' jħares lejh.
messages.zh: 可喜欢了！他惊叹于大海的美，一直看个不停。
messages.en: Very much! He marveled at the beauty of the sea and kept looking at it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象第一次看到壮丽海景时停下脚步、睁大眼睛，说出“真令人惊叹”，把这份惊奇感与词义连接起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give a place, institution, or activity a military character, for example by introducing troops or military control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过部署军队、引入军事管制等方式，使某个地方、机构或活动具有军事性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti natura militari lil post, istituzzjoni jew attività, pereżempju billi jdaħħal truppi jew kontroll militari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使军事化；使某地、机构或活动具有军事性质或处于军事控制之下。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja fittizja, il-gvern mmilitarizza l-fruntiera billi bagħat truppi u waqqaf punti ta' kontroll militari.
formal.en: In the fictional story, the government militarized the border by sending troops and establishing military checkpoints.
formal.zh: 在这个虚构故事中，政府通过派遣军队和设置军事检查站，使边境军事化。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex hemm tant suldati mal-fruntiera f'dan il-film? Rita: Għax il-gvern mmilitarizza l-fruntiera wara l-kriżi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are there so many soldiers along the border in this film? Rita: Because the government militarized the border after the crisis.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这部电影里，边境为什么有这么多士兵？Rita：因为危机发生后，政府把边境军事化了。

messages.speaker: Mark (观影同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm tant suldati mal-fruntiera f'dan il-film?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm tant suldati mal-fruntiera f'dan il-film?
messages.zh: 这部电影里，边境为什么有这么多士兵？
messages.en: Why are there so many soldiers along the border in this film?

messages.speaker: Rita (观影同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-gvern mmilitarizza l-fruntiera wara l-kriżi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-gvern mmilitarizza l-fruntiera wara l-kriżi.
messages.zh: 因为危机发生后，政府把边境军事化了。
messages.en: Because the government militarized the border after the crisis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中对比同一处边境前后的画面：原先普通通行，后来出现军队和军事检查站，以这种变化记住“使军事化”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel longing for a person or thing because they are far away or absent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因为某人或某物远离自己或不在身边，而产生思念、怀念之情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss ix-xewqa li jerġa' jkun ma' xi ħadd jew qrib xi ħaġa li tinsab 'il bogħod jew mhix preżenti.

sense_translations.en_definition: to miss (long for someone or something that is far or absent)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 想念、思念远方或不在身边的人或事物。

formal.mt: Matul is-sena li qatta' barra minn Malta, Pawlu mmisja lil familtu u l-ħajja ta' kuljum magħhom.
formal.en: During the year he spent outside Malta, Pawlu missed his family and everyday life with them.
formal.zh: 在离开马耳他的那一年里，Pawlu想念家人，也想念与他们一起度过的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ħassu Mark meta kien barra? Sara: Mmisja lil oħtu ħafna, u kien iċemplilha kull filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Mark feel when he was abroad? Sara: He missed his sister a lot and used to call her every evening.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark在国外时感觉怎么样？Sara：他很想念姐姐，每天晚上都会给她打电话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassu Mark meta kien barra?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassu Mark meta kien barra?
messages.zh: Mark在国外时感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark feel when he was abroad?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mmisja lil oħtu ħafna, u kien iċemplilha kull filgħaxija.
messages.mt_standard: Mmisja lil oħtu ħafna, u kien iċemplilha kull filgħaxija.
messages.zh: 他很想念姐姐，每天晚上都会给她打电话。
messages.en: He missed his sister a lot and used to call her every evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象身在远方时翻看家人的照片，心里盼着重聚，用这份“人不在身边却惦念着”的感觉记住“想念”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change some features or details of something, often to improve it or adapt it to a need.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 改变事物的部分特征或细节，通常是为了改进它，或使其适应某种需要。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibiddel xi karatteristiċi jew dettalji ta' xi ħaġa, spiss biex itejjibha jew jadattaha għal ħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修改、改动或调整某事物。

formal.mt: Il-perit mmodifika d-disinn biex id-daħla tkun usa' u aktar aċċessibbli.
formal.en: The architect modified the design to make the entrance wider and more accessible.
formal.zh: 建筑师修改了设计，使入口更宽，也更便于通行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadna se niltaqgħu fid-disgħa? Mark: Le, Pawlu mmodifika l-pjan. Se niltaqgħu fl-għaxra quddiem l-istazzjon.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are we still meeting at nine? Mark: No, Pawlu changed the plan. We are meeting at ten in front of the station.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们还是九点见面吗？Mark：不是，Pawlu改了计划。我们十点在车站前见面。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们还是九点见面吗？
messages.en: Are we still meeting at nine?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Pawlu mmodifika l-pjan. Se niltaqgħu fl-għaxra quddiem l-istazzjon.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Pawlu mmodifika l-pjan. Se niltaqgħu fl-għaxra quddiem l-istazzjon.
messages.zh: 不是，Pawlu改了计划。我们十点在车站前见面。
messages.en: No, Pawlu changed the plan. We are meeting at ten in front of the station.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿起笔，在已有计划上改时间、改细节；把“原来已有内容，现在作些调整”的动作与“修改”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take exclusive control of a market, resource, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 独自控制某个市场、资源或活动，排除或限制他人参与。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu kontroll esklużiv fuq suq, riżorsa jew attività u jillimita l-parteċipazzjoni ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 垄断；独占。

collocations.zh: 独占了讨论的发言时间

formal.mt: Id-distributur mmonopolizza s-suq u ħalla ftit spazju għall-kompetituri.
formal.en: The distributor monopolized the market and left little room for competitors.
formal.zh: 该经销商垄断了市场，留给竞争者的空间很小。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tkellimtx fil-laqgħa? Pawlu: Għax Mark mmonopolizza d-diskussjoni u ma ħalliniex nitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't you speak at the meeting? Pawlu: Because Mark monopolized the discussion and didn't let us speak.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么没在会上发言？保罗：因为马克一直霸占着发言时间，不让我们说话。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么没在会上发言？
messages.en: Why didn't you speak at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Mark mmonopolizza d-diskussjoni u ma ħalliniex nitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Mark mmonopolizza d-diskussjoni u ma ħalliniex nitkellmu.
messages.zh: 因为马克一直霸占着发言时间，不让我们说话。
messages.en: Because Mark monopolized the discussion and didn't let us speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把市场摊位全包下，连讨论时也一直抢话：把“垄断市场”和“独占发言”连在一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To impose a monetary penalty on someone for breaking a rule or law.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某人违反规定或法律而要求其缴纳罚金。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimponi fuq xi ħadd ħlas bħala piena għal ksur ta' regola jew liġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人处以罚款。

collocations.en: imposed a fine of one hundred euros

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal mmulta lis-sewwieq għax ipparkja quddiem il-bieb tal-garaxx.
formal.en: The officer fined the driver for parking in front of the garage door.
formal.zh: 执法人员因司机把车停在车库门前而对其处以罚款。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex int imdejjaq? Toni: L-uffiċjal mmulta mitt ewro għax ipparkjajt ħażin.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you upset? Toni: The officer imposed a fine of one hundred euros because I parked improperly.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你为什么不高兴？托尼：因为我违规停车，执法人员开了一百欧元的罚单。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不高兴？
messages.en: Why are you upset?

messages.speaker: Toni (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: L-uffiċjal mmulta mitt ewro għax ipparkjajt ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: L-uffiċjal mmulta mitt ewro għax ipparkjajt ħażin.
messages.zh: 因为我违规停车，执法人员开了一百欧元的罚单。
messages.en: The officer imposed a fine of one hundred euros because I parked improperly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张写着金额的停车罚单记忆：这个动词表示“开罚单、处以罚金”，重点是处罚的动作。

gloss_zh: 住宅旁的小片树木种植地；姆奈德拉神庙

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small plantation of trees beside a dwelling; also, as Mnajdra, the name of a temple in southern Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 住宅旁种植树木的一小片土地；用作专名 Mnajdra 时，指马耳他南部的一座神庙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Roqgħa żgħira ta' siġar imħawla ħdejn dar; bħala Mnajdra, isem ta' tempju fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: small plantation of trees alongside a dwelling
sense_translations.zh_definition: 住宅旁的一小片树木种植地。

sense_translations.en_definition: a temple in the south of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他南部的一座神庙，名为姆奈德拉。

collocations.en: a small plantation of trees beside the house
collocations.zh: 房屋旁的小片树木种植地

collocations.en: a visit to the temple of Mnajdra

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'mnajdra' tista' tfisser roqgħa żgħira ta' siġar ħdejn dar, filwaqt li l-isem 'Mnajdra' jirreferi għal tempju fin-nofsinhar ta' Malta.
formal.en: The word 'mnajdra' can mean a small plantation of trees beside a dwelling, while the name 'Mnajdra' refers to a temple in southern Malta.
formal.zh: mnajdra 一词可指住宅旁的小片树木种植地，而专名 Mnajdra 指马耳他南部的一座神庙。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Hawnhekk 'mnajdra' tfisser it-tempju? Ġużeppi: Le, f'din is-sentenza tfisser roqgħa żgħira ta' siġar ħdejn id-dar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does 'mnajdra' mean the temple here? Ġużeppi: No, in this sentence it means a small plantation of trees beside the house.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这里的 mnajdra 指神庙吗？朱塞佩：不是，在这个句子里，它指房屋旁的一小片树木种植地。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 mnajdra 指神庙吗？
messages.en: Does 'mnajdra' mean the temple here?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'din is-sentenza tfisser roqgħa żgħira ta' siġar ħdejn id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'din is-sentenza tfisser roqgħa żgħira ta' siġar ħdejn id-dar.
messages.zh: 不是，在这个句子里，它指房屋旁的一小片树木种植地。
messages.en: No, in this sentence it means a small plantation of trees beside the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两幅小图：一幅是屋旁种着几棵树，另一幅是名叫 Mnajdra 的神庙；靠上下文区分普通名词与专名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small saw, expressed by the diminutive form of munxar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小型锯子；是 munxar 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Munxar żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'munxar'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small saw (the diminutive form of 'munxar')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小锯子，是 munxar 的指小形式。

collocations.en: to cut with a small saw

formal.mt: Għal din il-biċċa xogħol, uża mnajxar biex taqta' l-biċċa njama fid-daqs meħtieġ.
formal.en: For this task, use a small saw to cut the piece of wood to the required size.
formal.zh: 做这项工作时，用小锯子把木料锯成所需的尺寸。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Tista' tagħtini l-mnajxar? Karl: Iva, qiegħed fil-kaxxa tal-għodda.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can you pass me the small saw? Karl: Yes, it's in the toolbox.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：能把小锯子递给我吗？卡尔：可以，它在工具箱里。

messages.speaker: Rita (木工学徒)
messages.zh: 能把小锯子递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the small saw?

messages.speaker: Karl (木工师傅)
messages.zh: 可以，它在工具箱里。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the toolbox.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 munxar 和 mnajxar 写在大小两把锯子旁：前者是锯子，后者是小锯子，用图像记住已给出的指小关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exclamation invoking God's mercy, used to express relief or gratitude.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以蒙上帝怜悯之意表达庆幸或感激的感叹语，可按语境理解为“谢天谢地”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li ssemmi l-ħniena ta' Alla u turi serħan il-moħħ jew gratitudni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒙上帝怜悯；用作表达庆幸或感激的感叹语。

collocations.en: Thank God we arrived on time!
collocations.zh: 谢天谢地，我们及时赶到了！

formal.mt: Meta waslet l-aħbar li kulħadd kien qawwi u sħiħ, il-missier qal: 'Mnalla ħadd ma weġġa'!'
formal.en: When the news arrived that everyone was safe and sound, the father said, 'Thank God nobody was hurt!'
formal.zh: 得知所有人都平安无事后，父亲说：“谢天谢地，没有人受伤！”

colloquial.mt: Marta: Sibthom iċ-ċwievet? David: Iva, kienu fil-but. Mnalla sibthom!
colloquial.en: Marta: Did you find the keys? David: Yes, they were in my pocket. Thank God I found them!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你找到钥匙了吗？戴维：找到了，就在口袋里。谢天谢地，总算找到了！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你找到钥匙了吗？
messages.en: Did you find the keys?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 找到了，就在口袋里。谢天谢地，总算找到了！
messages.en: Yes, they were in my pocket. Thank God I found them!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象丢失的钥匙终于找到了，先松一口气再说 mnalla；把它和“谢天谢地”的庆幸语气一起记。

gloss_zh: 以什么借口；凭什么托词

teaching_sense.en_definition: With what pretence or under what pretext.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 询问以什么借口、托词或表面理由行事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'liema skuża jew pretest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以什么借口；凭什么托词。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, l-avverbju 'mnejnsafejn' jiġi spjegat bil-frażi 'b'liema pretest'.
formal.en: In the vocabulary exercise, the adverb 'mnejnsafejn' is explained by the phrase 'under what pretext'.
formal.zh: 在词汇练习中，副词 mnejnsafejn 用“以什么借口”这一短语来解释。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser 'mnejnsafejn'? Luqa: Tfisser 'b'liema skuża jew pretest'.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'mnejnsafejn' mean? Luqa: It means 'with what excuse or pretext'.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：mnejnsafejn 是什么意思？卢卡：意思是“以什么借口或托词”。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: mnejnsafejn 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mnejnsafejn' mean?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.zh: 意思是“以什么借口或托词”。
messages.en: It means 'with what excuse or pretext'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在词卡上画一个写着“借口？”的问号，把整个词连同“以什么借口”一起记，不自行拆分词根。

gloss_zh: Mnejqa 田地名；复数 Mnejqat 也用作田地名

teaching_sense.en_definition: A field name at St Agata, south of Ħal Safi; the plural form Mnejqat names two fields at Bir Miftuħ.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本条词性标为形容词，所给词义为地名：Mnejqa 是 Ħal Safi 以南圣阿加塔一处田地的名称；复数形式 Mnejqat 是 Bir Miftuħ 两处田地的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'din l-entrata huwa mmarkat bħala aġġettiv, iżda t-tifsira mogħtija hija isem ta' għalqa f'Sant'Agata, fin-nofsinhar ta' Ħal Safi; il-plural 'Mnejqat' huwa isem ta' żewġ għelieqi f'Bir Miftuħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: the name of a field in st. agata, sount of ħal safi, and the plural mnejqat as the name of two fields at bir miftuħ
sense_translations.zh_definition: 位于 Ħal Safi 以南圣阿加塔的一处田地的名称；其复数形式 Mnejqat 也用作 Bir Miftuħ 两处田地的名称。

collocations.en: the name Mnejqat at Bir Miftuħ

formal.mt: Mnejqa huwa l-isem ta' għalqa f'Sant'Agata, fin-nofsinhar ta' Ħal Safi; il-forma plurali Mnejqat issemmi żewġ għelieqi f'Bir Miftuħ.
formal.en: Mnejqa is the name of a field at St Agata, south of Ħal Safi; the plural form Mnejqat names two fields at Bir Miftuħ.
formal.zh: Mnejqa 是 Ħal Safi 以南圣阿加塔一处田地的名称；复数形式 Mnejqat 则指称 Bir Miftuħ 的两处田地。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Mnejqa u Mnejqat huma l-istess isem? Ġanni: Mnejqat hija l-forma plurali; hawn Mnejqa ssemmi għalqa f'Sant'Agata, u Mnejqat issemmi żewġ għelieqi f'Bir Miftuħ.
colloquial.en: Elena: Are Mnejqa and Mnejqat the same name? Ġanni: Mnejqat is the plural form; here Mnejqa names a field at St Agata, and Mnejqat names two fields at Bir Miftuħ.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：Mnejqa 和 Mnejqat 是同一个名称吗？詹尼：Mnejqat 是复数形式；这里 Mnejqa 指圣阿加塔的一处田地，Mnejqat 指 Bir Miftuħ 的两处田地。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mnejqa u Mnejqat huma l-istess isem?
messages.mt_standard: Mnejqa u Mnejqat huma l-istess isem?
messages.zh: Mnejqa 和 Mnejqat 是同一个名称吗？
messages.en: Are Mnejqa and Mnejqat the same name?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Mnejqat hija l-forma plurali; hawn Mnejqa ssemmi għalqa f'Sant'Agata, u Mnejqat issemmi żewġ għelieqi f'Bir Miftuħ.
messages.mt_standard: Mnejqat hija l-forma plurali; hawn Mnejqa ssemmi għalqa f'Sant'Agata, u Mnejqat issemmi żewġ għelieqi f'Bir Miftuħ.
messages.zh: Mnejqat 是复数形式；这里 Mnejqa 指圣阿加塔的一处田地，Mnejqat 指 Bir Miftuħ 的两处田地。
messages.en: Mnejqat is the plural form; here Mnejqa names a field at St Agata, and Mnejqat names two fields at Bir Miftuħ.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一块田标 Mnejqa，再画两块田标 Mnejqat；把单数名称与复数名称分别记住，避免凭词性标签猜出其他含义。

gloss_zh: 小巧柔和的鼻子；仅见于植物名 bumnejħer

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, gentle nose, occurring only within bumnejħer, the name of a small coriander.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示小巧柔和的鼻子，但仅见于植物名 bumnejħer 中；该植物名指一种小香菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imnieħer żgħir u delikat; jinsab biss fl-isem tal-pjanta 'bumnejħer', kosbor żgħir.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small gentle nose occurring only in plant-name bumnejħer, a small coriander
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小巧柔和的鼻子，仅见于植物名 bumnejħer 中；该名称指一种小香菜。

collocations.zh: 名称 bumnejħer 中的 mnejħer

formal.mt: F'din in-nota, 'mnejħer' jiġi spjegat bħala imnieħer żgħir u delikat, iżda jinsab biss fl-isem tal-pjanta 'bumnejħer'.
formal.en: In this note, 'mnejħer' is explained as a small, gentle nose, but it occurs only within the plant name 'bumnejħer'.
formal.zh: 本注释将 mnejħer 解释为小巧柔和的鼻子，但它仅见于植物名 bumnejħer 中。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nuża 'mnejħer' biex niddeskrivi mnieħer xi ħadd? Mark: Le, hawnhekk nitgħallmuh biss bħala parti mill-isem tal-pjanta 'bumnejħer'.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I use 'mnejħer' to describe someone's nose? Mark: No, here we learn it only as part of the plant name 'bumnejħer'.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我能用 mnejħer 来形容某人的鼻子吗？马克：不能，这里我们只把它作为植物名 bumnejħer 的一部分来学习。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża 'mnejħer' biex niddeskrivi mnieħer xi ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża 'mnejħer' biex niddeskrivi mnieħer xi ħadd?
messages.zh: 我能用 mnejħer 来形容某人的鼻子吗？
messages.en: Can I use 'mnejħer' to describe someone's nose?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawnhekk nitgħallmuh biss bħala parti mill-isem tal-pjanta 'bumnejħer'.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawnhekk nitgħallmuh biss bħala parti mill-isem tal-pjanta 'bumnejħer'.
messages.zh: 不能，这里我们只把它作为植物名 bumnejħer 的一部分来学习。
messages.en: No, here we learn it only as part of the plant name 'bumnejħer'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 bumnejħer 这个完整植物名中圈出 mnejħer，旁边画一个小鼻子作记忆图；记住它在本词条中只随植物名出现。

gloss_zh: minżla 的指小形式，存留于特定地名中

teaching_sense.en_definition: A diminutive form of minżla, preserved in the place name Mnejżliet tal-Gawwija, east of Bingħisa Point.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: minżla 的指小形式，存留于地名 Mnejżliet tal-Gawwija 中；该地位于 Bingħisa 岬角以东、Għar Girdwa 与 il-Mara 之间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma diminuttiva ta' minżla, li tibqa' teżisti fl-isem tal-post Mnejżliet tal-Gawwija, bejn Għar Girdwa u il-Mara, fil-lvant tal-ponta ta' Bingħisa.

sense_translations.en_definition: diminutive form of minżla, surviving in (toponym) mnejżliet tal-gawwija, place between għar girdwa and il-mara, east of the point of bingħisa
sense_translations.zh_definition: minżla 的指小形式，存留于地名 mnejżliet tal-gawwija 中；该地位于 Bingħisa 岬角以东、Għar Girdwa 与 il-Mara 之间。

collocations.en: mnejżla in the study of place names

formal.mt: Il-forma diminuttiva mnejżla tibqa' teżisti fl-isem tal-post Mnejżliet tal-Gawwija, fil-lvant tal-ponta ta' Bingħisa.
formal.en: The diminutive form mnejżla survives in the place name Mnejżliet tal-Gawwija, east of Bingħisa Point.
formal.zh: 指小形式 mnejżla 存留于地名 Mnejżliet tal-Gawwija 中，该地位于 Bingħisa 岬角以东。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn insibu l-forma mnejżla? Pawlu: Fl-isem tal-post Mnejżliet tal-Gawwija.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where do we find the form mnejżla? Pawlu: In the place name Mnejżliet tal-Gawwija.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们在哪里能见到 mnejżla 这个形式？保罗：在地名 Mnejżliet tal-Gawwija 中。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里能见到 mnejżla 这个形式？
messages.en: Where do we find the form mnejżla?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 在地名 Mnejżliet tal-Gawwija 中。
messages.en: In the place name Mnejżliet tal-Gawwija.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与地图上的 Mnejżliet tal-Gawwija 一起记：重点识别它是 minżla 的指小形式，并记住它在这个地名中的存留用法。

gloss_zh: 脱去衣服的；未穿衣的；裸露的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having had clothing removed, wearing no clothes, or left bare without a covering or decoration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 衣服已被脱去、没有穿衣服的；也可指失去遮盖或装饰而裸露的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tneħħewlu l-ħwejjeġ, li hu bla ħwejjeġ, jew li tħalla mikxuf mingħajr għata jew tiżjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已脱去衣服的；衣服已被脱掉的。
没有穿衣服的；赤身的。
裸露的；没有遮盖或装饰的。

collocations.en: a wall bare of all decoration

formal.mt: Il-ħajt tas-sala baqa' mneżża' minn kull tiżjin wara li tneħħew il-kwadri.
formal.en: The hall wall was left bare of all decoration after the pictures were removed.
formal.zh: 画作移走后，大厅的墙壁变得光秃秃的，没有任何装饰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dak ir-raġel hu mneżża' minn ħwejġu? Mark: Għadu kemm ħareġ mill-baħar u qed ibiddel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has that man taken his clothes off? Mark: He has just come out of the sea and is getting changed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男人为什么脱了衣服？马克：他刚从海里出来，正在换衣服。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dak ir-raġel hu mneżża' minn ħwejġu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dak ir-raġel hu mneżża' minn ħwejġu?
messages.zh: 那个男人为什么脱了衣服？
messages.en: Why has that man taken his clothes off?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu kemm ħareġ mill-baħar u qed ibiddel.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu kemm ħareġ mill-baħar u qed ibiddel.
messages.zh: 他刚从海里出来，正在换衣服。
messages.en: He has just come out of the sea and is getting changed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两幅画面：人脱去衣服，墙摘去装饰。共同点都是少了原来的覆盖物，用它串起“脱衣、未穿衣、裸露”三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A swear-word exclamation used to express strong annoyance, anger, or frustration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达强烈恼怒、生气或挫败感的粗俗感叹语，相当于“该死！”或“他妈的！”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Esclamazzjoni vulgari li tesprimi dwejjaq, rabja jew frustrazzjoni qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 该死！；他妈的！用于强烈表达恼怒或不耐烦的粗俗感叹语。

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu, l-esclamazzjoni "mniegħel" tesprimi l-frustrazzjoni qawwija tal-karattru meta jitlef iċ-ċwievet.
formal.en: In the dialogue, the exclamation "mniegħel" expresses the character's intense frustration when he loses his keys.
formal.zh: 在这段对话中，人物丢失钥匙时用感叹语“mniegħel”表达强烈的懊恼。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Mniegħel, tlift iċ-ċwievet! Maja: Ħares fil-but tal-ġakketta.
colloquial.en: Mark: Damn, I've lost my keys! Maja: Look in your jacket pocket.
colloquial.zh: 马克：该死，我把钥匙弄丢了！玛雅：看看你夹克的口袋。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 该死，我把钥匙弄丢了！
messages.en: Damn, I've lost my keys!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看看你夹克的口袋。
messages.en: Look in your jacket pocket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“钥匙突然找不到”的情景记忆：先脱口喊出 mniegħel，再说出了什么事；同时记住这是带粗俗语气的感叹词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling sleepy and less alert, as if about to fall asleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到困倦、精神不够清醒，像是快要睡着的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss in-ngħas u ma jkunx attent għalkollox, bħallikieku se jorqod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困倦的；昏昏欲睡的；因想睡觉而不够清醒的。

formal.mt: Matul il-lezzjoni ta' filgħodu, it-tifel deher mniegħes u kellu diffikultà biex jikkonċentra.
formal.en: During the morning lesson, the boy appeared drowsy and had difficulty concentrating.
formal.zh: 上早课时，那个男孩显得昏昏欲睡，很难集中注意力。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Inħossni mniegħes ħafna llum. Sara: Mela mur strieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Luca: I feel very drowsy today. Sara: Then go and rest for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我今天觉得特别困。萨拉：那就去休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天觉得特别困。
messages.en: I feel very drowsy today.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那就去休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: Then go and rest for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象早课上眼皮越来越沉的男孩，把 tifel mniegħes 与画面绑定；说自己的状态时，整句记住 inħossni mniegħes。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ban or prohibition that forbids an action or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 禁止某种行为或活动的禁令；也指禁止这一规定或措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ordni jew regola li ma tħallix li ssir xi azzjoni jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁令；禁止某项行为或活动的规定。
禁止；不准进行某项行为或活动的规定或措施。

formal.mt: L-avviż jistabbilixxi mnigħ fuq id-dħul fil-bini waqt ix-xogħlijiet.
formal.en: The notice establishes a ban on entry into the building during the works.
formal.zh: 该告示规定，施工期间禁止进入这栋建筑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma nistgħux nidħlu? Pawlu: Hemm mnigħ fuq id-dħul sakemm jispiċċaw ix-xogħlijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why can't we go in? Pawlu: There is a ban on entry until the works are finished.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们为什么不能进去？保罗：施工完成前有禁止进入的规定。

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.zh: 我们为什么不能进去？
messages.en: Why can't we go in?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm mnigħ fuq id-dħul sakemm jispiċċaw ix-xogħlijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm mnigħ fuq id-dħul sakemm jispiċċaw ix-xogħlijiet.
messages.zh: 施工完成前有禁止进入的规定。
messages.en: There is a ban on entry until the works are finished.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mnigħ 想成入口处的一块禁令牌；再把 fuq 后面接的内容想成牌上写明的禁止事项，例如进入或销售。

gloss_zh: 沮丧的；情绪低落的；悲伤凄凉的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deeply sad, dejected, or emotionally desolate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 深感悲伤、沮丧或情绪低落的；也可形容内心凄凉、孤苦的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss dwejjaq jew niket kbir, jew li jkun qalbu maqtugħa u bla faraġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沮丧的；垂头丧气的。
情绪低落的；消沉的。
内心凄凉的；悲伤孤苦、缺乏慰藉的。

formal.mt: Wara li sema' l-aħbar, ir-raġel baqa' sieket u deher mnikket ħafna.
formal.en: After hearing the news, the man remained silent and looked deeply saddened.
formal.zh: 听到消息后，那个男人一直沉默着，显得十分悲伤。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Illum inħossni mnikket. Maja: Trid titkellem ftit? Nista' noqgħod miegħek.
colloquial.en: Luca: I feel down today. Maja: Would you like to talk for a bit? I can stay with you.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我今天心情很低落。玛雅：想聊一会儿吗？我可以陪着你。

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天心情很低落。
messages.en: I feel down today.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid titkellem ftit? Nista' noqgħod miegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Trid titkellem ftit? Nista' noqgħod miegħek.
messages.zh: 想聊一会儿吗？我可以陪着你。
messages.en: Would you like to talk for a bit? I can stay with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“低头沉默、脸上带着悲伤”的画面记住 wiċċ mnikket；再练习 inħossni mnikket，把外在表情和内在低落联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Derived from a source, or begotten as offspring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某个来源产生或衍生而来的；也指作为后代被生育出来的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej minn sors ieħor, jew li tnissel bħala wild.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 源自……的；由……衍生而来的。
所生的；作为子嗣被生育出来的。

collocations.en: a term derived from another word
collocations.zh: 由另一个词衍生而来的术语

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudent għandu jidentifika terminu mnissel minn kelma oħra u jispjega r-rabta bejniethom.
formal.en: In the exercise, the student must identify a term derived from another word and explain the relationship between them.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，学生需要找出一个由其他词衍生而来的术语，并解释两者的关系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser "mnissel minn" hawn? Pawlu: Ifisser li dan it-terminu ġej minn kelma oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does "mnissel minn" mean here? Pawlu: It means that this term comes from another word.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的“mnissel minn”是什么意思？保罗：意思是这个术语源自另一个词。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“mnissel minn”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does "mnissel minn" mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li dan it-terminu ġej minn kelma oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li dan it-terminu ġej minn kelma oħra.
messages.zh: 意思是这个术语源自另一个词。
messages.en: It means that this term comes from another word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条从来源指向结果的箭头：词语可以由别的词衍生，孩子可以由父母所生；用这两个画面分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not pure or clean, or made dirty through pollution or contamination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不纯净或不洁净的；因污染或混入污物而变脏的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex safi jew nadif, jew li sar maħmuġ minħabba t-tniġġis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不纯净的；不洁的。
受污染的；被污物或污染物弄脏的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif l-ilma tax-xmara sar mniġġes wara li ntrema l-iskart fiha.
formal.en: The report describes how the river water became polluted after waste was dumped into it.
formal.zh: 报告描述了废物被倾倒进河流后，河水受到污染的情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-ilma jidher mniġġes. Mark: Iva, hemm ħafna skart fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: This water looks polluted. Mark: Yes, there is a lot of waste in it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这水看起来受污染了。马克：是啊，里面有很多垃圾。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这水看起来受污染了。
messages.en: This water looks polluted.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，里面有很多垃圾。
messages.en: Yes, there is a lot of waste in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中并排放两杯水，一杯清澈，一杯混入垃圾；给后者贴上 ilma mniġġes，借“不再纯净”的画面连接两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rule or order that forbids an action or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不允许某种行为或活动的规定或命令。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Regola jew ordni li ma tħallix issir xi azzjoni jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 禁止；禁令。

formal.mt: Il-mnugħa fuq id-dħul f'din iż-żona tapplika għall-viżitaturi kollha.
formal.en: The prohibition on entering this area applies to all visitors.
formal.zh: 禁止进入此区域的规定适用于所有访客。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistgħux nidħlu? Pawlu: Hemm mnugħa fuq id-dħul għax qed isir ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't we go in? Pawlu: There is a prohibition on entry because work is being carried out.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们为什么不能进去？Pawlu：因为正在施工，这里禁止进入。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 我们为什么不能进去？
messages.en: Why can't we go in?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm mnugħa fuq id-dħul għax qed isir ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm mnugħa fuq id-dħul għax qed isir ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 因为正在施工，这里禁止进入。
