messages.en: There is a prohibition on entry because work is being carried out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mnugħa 和门口的禁止进入标志一起记：看到标志，就想到禁令这一名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small coins, especially those used for paying small amounts or giving change.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小面额的硬币，尤其指用于支付小额费用或找零的零钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Muniti żgħar, speċjalment dawk użati għal ħlasijiet żgħar jew biex tingħata l-bqija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小面额硬币；零钱。

formal.mt: Il-kaxxier għadd l-imnut qabel ma tahom lill-klijent bħala bqija.
formal.en: The cashier counted the small coins before giving them to the customer as change.
formal.zh: 收银员数好小面额硬币后，将其作为找零交给顾客。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek ftit mnut? Għandi bżonn għoxrin ċenteżmu. Rita: Iva, hawn żewġ muniti ta' għaxar ċenteżmi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a few small coins? I need twenty cents. Rita: Yes, here are two ten-cent coins.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你有零钱吗？我需要二十分。Rita：有，这里有两枚十分的硬币。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek ftit mnut? Għandi bżonn għoxrin ċenteżmu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek ftit mnut? Għandi bżonn għoxrin ċenteżmu.
messages.zh: 你有零钱吗？我需要二十分。
messages.en: Do you have a few small coins? I need twenty cents.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn żewġ muniti ta' għaxar ċenteżmi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn żewġ muniti ta' għaxar ċenteżmi.
messages.zh: 有，这里有两枚十分的硬币。
messages.en: Yes, here are two ten-cent coins.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象口袋里叮当作响的几枚小硬币，把 mnut 与付小钱、找零钱的场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change made to something to adjust or improve it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为调整或改进某事物而作出的修改或改动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla li ssir f'xi ħaġa biex tiġi aġġustata jew imtejba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修改；改动；调整。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva modifika fil-pjan biex jitnaqqsu l-ispejjeż.
formal.en: The committee approved a modification to the plan to reduce costs.
formal.zh: 委员会批准了对计划的一项修改，以降低成本。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-pjan lest? Toni: Kważi. Għandi bżonn nagħmel modifika żgħira fil-ħin tat-tluq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the plan ready? Toni: Almost. I need to make a small modification to the departure time.
colloquial.zh: Lara：计划准备好了吗？Toni：差不多了。我需要稍微改一下出发时间。

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 计划准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the plan ready?

messages.speaker: Toni (行程组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Għandi bżonn nagħmel modifika żgħira fil-ħin tat-tluq.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Għandi bżonn nagħmel modifika żgħira fil-ħin tat-tluq.
messages.zh: 差不多了。我需要稍微改一下出发时间。
messages.en: Almost. I need to make a small modification to the departure time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 modifika 想成计划纸上圈出的一处改动；配合 modifika żgħira 记住“小修改”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be changed or adjusted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够被修改或调整的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jinbidel jew jiġi aġġustat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可修改的；可调整的。

formal.mt: Id-dokument għandu jintbagħat f'format modifikabbli biex ikunu jistgħu jsiru l-korrezzjonijiet.
formal.en: The document should be sent in a modifiable format so that corrections can be made.
formal.zh: 文档应以可修改的格式发送，以便进行更正。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-fajl modifikabbli? Noel: Iva, tista' tibdel it-test u żżid ir-ritratti tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this file modifiable? Noel: Yes, you can change the text and add your photos.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个文件可以修改吗？Noel：可以，你能修改文字，也能添加自己的照片。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 这个文件可以修改吗？
messages.en: Is this file modifiable?

messages.speaker: Noel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' tibdel it-test u żżid ir-ritratti tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' tibdel it-test u żżid ir-ritratti tiegħek.
messages.zh: 可以，你能修改文字，也能添加自己的照片。
messages.en: Yes, you can change the text and add your photos.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个还能编辑的文件，用 modifikabbli 回答“能不能改”；整个词表示可修改的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of changing or adjusting something, or a change made to it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事物进行修改或调整的行为，也指作出的改动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tinbidel jew tiġi aġġustata xi ħaġa, jew il-bidla li ssir fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修改或调整的行为；所作的改动。

formal.mt: Il-modifikazzjoni tas-sistema se tnaqqas il-konsum tal-enerġija.
formal.en: The modification of the system will reduce energy consumption.
formal.zh: 对系统的这项修改将降低能源消耗。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex il-mejda tidher differenti? David: Għamilna modifikazzjoni fid-disinn biex ikun hemm aktar spazju għar-riġlejn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why does the table look different? David: We made a modification to the design to provide more legroom.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这张桌子怎么看起来不一样了？David：我们修改了设计，让腿部空间更大。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 这张桌子怎么看起来不一样了？
messages.en: Why does the table look different?

messages.speaker: David (家具设计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilna modifikazzjoni fid-disinn biex ikun hemm aktar spazju għar-riġlejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għamilna modifikazzjoni fid-disinn biex ikun hemm aktar spazju għar-riġlejn.
messages.zh: 我们修改了设计，让腿部空间更大。
messages.en: We made a modification to the design to provide more legroom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 modifikazzjoni 配上设计修改前后的两张图，记住它既可指修改这件事，也可指作出的改动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Goats, considered as a group or as a kind of farm animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 山羊，通常用于谈论多只山羊或作为一类家畜的山羊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimali tar-razzett li jistgħu jitrabbew għall-ħalib, imsemmija bħala grupp jew bħala tip ta' annimal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 山羊；多只山羊或山羊这一类动物。

formal.mt: Ir-razzett iżomm merħla mogħoż għall-produzzjoni tal-ħalib.
formal.en: The farm keeps a herd of goats for milk production.
formal.zh: 这家农场饲养一群山羊用于产奶。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn huma l-mogħoż illum? Ġużeppi: Qegħdin fl-għalqa wara r-razzett.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where are the goats today? Ġużeppi: They are in the field behind the farm.
colloquial.zh: Lina：山羊今天在哪里？Ġużeppi：它们在农场后面的田里。

messages.speaker: Lina (访客)
messages.zh: 山羊今天在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the goats today?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农场主)
messages.zh: 它们在农场后面的田里。
messages.en: They are in the field behind the farm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面区分词形：mogħoż 配一群山羊，mogħża 配一只山羊，再用羊奶搭配巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 给定的；给予的；有某种倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Provided, assigned, or specified for someone to use or follow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经给予、分配或指定，供人使用或遵循的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ingħata, ġie assenjat jew ġie speċifikat biex jintuża jew jiġi segwit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予的；给定的；指定的。
有某种倾向的；喜好或惯于从事某事的。

collocations.en: inclined to read; fond of reading

formal.mt: Il-kandidat għandu jlesti l-eżerċizzju fil-ħin mogħti.
formal.en: The candidate must complete the exercise within the allotted time.
formal.zh: 考生必须在给定的时间内完成练习。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ħuk iħobb jaqra? Ben: Iva, hu mogħti ħafna għall-qari; dejjem għandu ktieb miegħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Does your brother like reading? Ben: Yes, he is very fond of reading; he always has a book with him.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你哥哥喜欢阅读吗？Ben：是的，他非常爱读书，身边总带着一本书。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥喜欢阅读吗？
messages.en: Does your brother like reading?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu mogħti ħafna għall-qari; dejjem għandu ktieb miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu mogħti ħafna għall-qari; dejjem għandu ktieb miegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，他非常爱读书，身边总带着一本书。
messages.en: Yes, he is very fond of reading; he always has a book with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个完整搭配分开记义：il-ħin mogħti 是给定时间，mogħti għall-qari 是喜爱阅读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A goat: a farm animal with hooves, often horns, and sometimes a beard.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一只山羊：一种有蹄的家畜，通常有角，有的长有胡须。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal tar-razzett bid-dwiefer maqsumin, li spiss ikollu l-qrun u kultant id-daqna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 山羊；一只山羊。

formal.mt: Il-veterinarju eżamina l-mogħża qabel ma ta parir lis-sid dwar l-għalf.
formal.en: The veterinarian examined the goat before advising the owner about its feed.
formal.zh: 兽医检查了这只山羊，随后向主人提出了饲料方面的建议。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Nista' nitma' lil dik il-mogħża bajda? Karl: Iva, agħtiha ftit ħuxlief minn dan.
colloquial.en: Emma: Can I feed that white goat? Karl: Yes, give it a little of this hay.
colloquial.zh: Emma：我可以喂那只白山羊吗？Karl：可以，给它一点这里的干草。

messages.speaker: Emma (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nitma' lil dik il-mogħża bajda?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nitma' lil dik il-mogħża bajda?
messages.zh: 我可以喂那只白山羊吗？
messages.en: Can I feed that white goat?

messages.speaker: Karl (饲养员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, agħtiha ftit ħuxlief minn dan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, agħtiha ftit ħuxlief minn dan.
messages.zh: 可以，给它一点这里的干草。
messages.en: Yes, give it a little of this hay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mogħża 和一只白山羊的图片绑定，再念 mogħża bajda；与表示多只山羊的 mogħoż 对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 像山羊的；具有山羊外貌特征的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling a goat in appearance or physical features.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容外貌或身体特征与山羊相似的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixbah lil mogħża fid-dehra jew fil-karatteristiċi fiżiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 像山羊的；外形与山羊相似的。

formal.mt: Il-maskra għandha wiċċ mogħżi, b'geddum twil u qrun żgħar.
formal.en: The mask has a goat-like face, with a long muzzle and small horns.
formal.zh: 这副面具有一张像山羊的脸，口鼻部细长，长着小角。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għamilt il-maskra b'dan il-wiċċ mogħżi? Mark: Għax il-karattru fl-istorja jixbah lil mogħża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you give the mask this goat-like face? Mark: Because the character in the story looks like a goat.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把面具做成这张像山羊的脸？马克：因为故事里的角色长得像山羊。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għamilt il-maskra b'dan il-wiċċ mogħżi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għamilt il-maskra b'dan il-wiċċ mogħżi?
messages.zh: 你为什么把面具做成这张像山羊的脸？
messages.en: Why did you give the mask this goat-like face?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-karattru fl-istorja jixbah lil mogħża.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-karattru fl-istorja jixbah lil mogħża.
messages.zh: 因为故事里的角色长得像山羊。
messages.en: Because the character in the story looks like a goat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一副长着小角和长嘴的山羊面具，把 mogħżi 与“外貌像山羊”连在一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moldova, a country in Eastern Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摩尔多瓦，位于东欧的一个国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-Moldova, pajjiż fl-Ewropa tal-Lvant.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摩尔多瓦，东欧国家。

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni tal-ġeografija, l-istudenti jsibu l-Moldova fuq mappa tal-Ewropa tal-Lvant.
formal.en: In this geography lesson, students locate Moldova on a map of Eastern Europe.
formal.zh: 在这节地理课上，学生们在东欧地图上找出摩尔多瓦。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Fejn tinsab il-Moldova fuq din il-mappa? Mark: Hawn, fl-Ewropa tal-Lvant.
colloquial.en: Elena: Where is Moldova on this map? Mark: Here, in Eastern Europe.
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：摩尔多瓦在这张地图的哪里？马克：在这里，位于东欧。

messages.speaker: Elena (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn tinsab il-Moldova fuq din il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn tinsab il-Moldova fuq din il-mappa?
messages.zh: 摩尔多瓦在这张地图的哪里？
messages.en: Where is Moldova on this map?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 在这里，位于东欧。
messages.en: Here, in Eastern Europe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把大写的 Moldova 与中文“摩尔多瓦”并排写在东欧地图旁，用国家名和地理位置一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moldova, a country also called Il-Moldova in Maltese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摩尔多瓦，国家名称；马耳他语中也称 Il-Moldova。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' pajjiż li jissejjaħ ukoll Il-Moldova.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Il-Moldova 的同义名称，指摩尔多瓦。

collocations.zh: 在摩尔多瓦的访问或游览

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-vjaġġ jinkludi żjara fil-Moldovja.
formal.en: The travel programme includes a visit to Moldova.
formal.zh: 旅行安排包括游览摩尔多瓦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur il-Moldovja ma' ħabib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Moldova with a friend.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要去哪里度假？马克：我要和一个朋友去摩尔多瓦。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要和一个朋友去摩尔多瓦。
messages.en: I'm going to Moldova with a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Moldovja 写在“摩尔多瓦”地图标签旁，再连读 lejn il-Moldovja，记住“去摩尔多瓦”的搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element molybdenum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钼，一种化学元素的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bħala molibdenu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钼，化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proprjetajiet tal-molibdenu.
formal.en: The report describes the properties of molybdenum.
formal.zh: 报告描述了钼的性质。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'hemm f'dan il-kontenitur? Pawlu: Hemm kampjun ta' molibdenu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's in this container? Pawlu: There's a sample of molybdenum.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个容器里是什么？保罗：里面有一份钼样品。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这个容器里是什么？
messages.en: What's in this container?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 里面有一份钼样品。
messages.en: There's a sample of molybdenum.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 molibdenu 与英语 molybdenum 并排记忆，两者都对应“钼”；再用“钼样品”这个实验室画面巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove hair from the skin or a part of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给皮肤或身体某个部位脱毛，除去其上的毛发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tneħħi x-xagħar minn fuq il-ġilda jew minn parti tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱毛；除去皮肤或身体部位上的毛发。

formal.mt: Il-professjonist moloħ id-driegħ tal-klijent b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: The professional carefully depilated the client's arm.
formal.zh: 专业人员仔细地为顾客的手臂脱了毛。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għamillek il-professjonist? Lara: Moloħ id-driegħ tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did the professional do for you? Lara: He depilated my arm.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：专业人员给你做了什么？拉拉：他给我的手臂脱了毛。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 专业人员给你做了什么？
messages.en: What did the professional do for you?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他给我的手臂脱了毛。
messages.en: He depilated my arm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 moloħ 放进“手臂脱毛”的动作画面，连着 moloħ id-driegħ 一起记；这里记的是去除毛发这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The little ringed plover, the bird species Charadrius dubius.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 金眶鸻，学名为 Charadrius dubius 的鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Charadrius dubius.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金眶鸻，学名 Charadrius dubius。

collocations.en: a photograph of a little ringed plover
a sighting of a little ringed plover
collocations.zh: 一次金眶鸻的目击记录

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi osservazzjoni ta' monakella u ritratt tal-għasfur.
formal.en: The report includes a sighting of a little ringed plover and a photograph of the bird.
formal.zh: 报告收录了一次金眶鸻的目击记录及该鸟的照片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għasfur hemm f'dan ir-ritratt? Toni: Dik monakella.
colloquial.en: Maja: What bird is in this photograph? Toni: That's a little ringed plover.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张照片里是什么鸟？托尼：那是金眶鸻。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 这张照片里是什么鸟？
messages.en: What bird is in this photograph?

messages.speaker: Toni (观鸟向导)
messages.zh: 那是金眶鸻。
messages.en: That's a little ringed plover.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作三语鸟名卡，把 monakella、little ringed plover 和“金眶鸻”写在同一面，再用学名 dubius 核对这一词条。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The ringed plover, the bird species Charadrius hiaticula.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剑鸻，学名为 Charadrius hiaticula 的鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Charadrius hiaticula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剑鸻，学名 Charadrius hiaticula。

collocations.en: a photograph of a ringed plover
a sighting of a ringed plover

formal.mt: Il-gwida tinkludi ritratt ta' monakella prima u l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Charadrius hiaticula.
formal.en: The guide includes a photograph of a ringed plover and its scientific name, Charadrius hiaticula.
formal.zh: 指南收录了一张剑鸻的照片及其学名 Charadrius hiaticula。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ritratt ta' monakella prima? Toni: Iva, din monakella prima.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this a photograph of a ringed plover? Toni: Yes, this is a ringed plover.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这是剑鸻的照片吗？托尼：是的，这是剑鸻。

messages.speaker: Sara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 这是剑鸻的照片吗？
messages.en: Is this a photograph of a ringed plover?

messages.speaker: Toni (观鸟向导)
messages.zh: 是的，这是剑鸻。
messages.en: Yes, this is a ringed plover.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 monakella prima 当作完整鸟名记忆，在卡片上将 prima 圈出，并与“剑鸻、hiaticula”配对，避免漏掉第二个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Kentish plover, the bird species Charadrius alexandrinus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 环颈鸻，学名为 Charadrius alexandrinus 的鸟类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Charadrius alexandrinus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 环颈鸻，学名 Charadrius alexandrinus。

collocations.en: a photograph of a Kentish plover
a sighting of a Kentish plover
collocations.zh: 一次环颈鸻的目击记录

formal.mt: L-istudent irreġistra osservazzjoni ta' monakella żgħira fin-noti tiegħu.
formal.en: The student recorded a sighting of a Kentish plover in his notes.
formal.zh: 这名学生在笔记中记录了一次环颈鸻的目击。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif jissejjaħ dan l-għasfur? Pawlu: Din monakella żgħira; l-isem xjentifiku tagħha hu Charadrius alexandrinus.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this bird called? Pawlu: This is a Kentish plover; its scientific name is Charadrius alexandrinus.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这种鸟叫什么？保罗：这是环颈鸻；它的学名是 Charadrius alexandrinus。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这种鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din monakella żgħira; l-isem xjentifiku tagħha hu Charadrius alexandrinus.
messages.mt_standard: Din monakella żgħira; l-isem xjentifiku tagħha hu Charadrius alexandrinus.
messages.zh: 这是环颈鸻；它的学名是 Charadrius alexandrinus。
messages.en: This is a Kentish plover; its scientific name is Charadrius alexandrinus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 monakella żgħira 整体贴在“环颈鸻”的词卡上，并配上 Kentish plover；不要因英语另一鸟名含 little 就混淆对应关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to money or to a system of currency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与货币或货币制度有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-flus jew mas-sistema tal-munita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货币的；与货币有关的。

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega l-għanijiet tal-politika monetarja.
formal.en: The document explains the objectives of monetary policy.
formal.zh: 文件解释了货币政策的目标。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi jfisser monetarju? Sara: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-flus, bħal fil-frażi politika monetarja.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does monetarju mean? Sara: It means relating to money, as in the phrase monetary policy.
colloquial.zh: 马克：monetarju 是什么意思？萨拉：意思是与货币有关的，比如“货币政策”这个词组中的用法。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: monetarju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does monetarju mean?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-flus, bħal fil-frażi politika monetarja.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam mal-flus, bħal fil-frażi politika monetarja.
messages.zh: 意思是与货币有关的，比如“货币政策”这个词组中的用法。
messages.en: It means relating to money, as in the phrase monetary policy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 monetarju 与英语 monetary 对照记为“货币的”，再整组背 politika monetarja，顺便留意搭配中的词尾变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Mongolia, its people, or their language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与蒙古、蒙古人或蒙古语有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Mongolja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-lingwa tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒙古的；蒙古人的；蒙古语的。
蒙古人。
蒙古语。

formal.mt: L-istudent Mongoljan kiteb test dwar il-kultura Mongoljana.
formal.en: The Mongolian student wrote a text about Mongolian culture.
formal.zh: 这名蒙古学生写了一篇关于蒙古文化的文章。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħabib tiegħek Mongoljan? Mark: Iva, hu Mongoljan, u qed jgħallimni ftit Mongoljan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your friend Mongolian? Mark: Yes, he's Mongolian, and he's teaching me a little Mongolian.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的朋友是蒙古人吗？马克：是的，他是蒙古人，而且正在教我一点蒙古语。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的朋友是蒙古人吗？
messages.en: Is your friend Mongolian?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu Mongoljan, u qed jgħallimni ftit Mongoljan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu Mongoljan, u qed jgħallimni ftit Mongoljan.
messages.zh: 是的，他是蒙古人，而且正在教我一点蒙古语。
messages.en: Yes, he's Mongolian, and he's teaching me a little Mongolian.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Mongoljan 画三张关联卡：“蒙古的”修饰名词，“蒙古人”指人，“蒙古语”指语言；用上下文区分这三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cooked in hot oil or fat by frying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用热油或油脂煎炸而成的，用来描述食物的烹调方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imsajjar fiż-żejt jew fix-xaħam jaħraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 油炸的；煎炸的。

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi ħut moqli servut ma' insalata friska.
formal.en: The menu includes fried fish served with a fresh salad.
formal.zh: 菜单包括配新鲜沙拉的煎炸鱼。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid ħut moqli għall-ikel? Mark: Iva, u ftit insalata miegħu, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like fried fish for lunch? Mark: Yes, and a little salad with it, please.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：午饭想吃煎鱼吗？马克：想，再配一点沙拉，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 午饭想吃煎鱼吗？
messages.en: Would you like fried fish for lunch?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ftit insalata miegħu, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ftit insalata miegħu, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 想，再配一点沙拉，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, and a little salad with it, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 moqli 和锅里滋滋作响的鱼联系起来，整组记住 ħut moqli，就是“煎炸的鱼”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The nearby area or the surroundings of a particular place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个地方附近的区域或周边一带，常用于表达位置邻近。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-inħawi qrib post partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 附近；邻近的地方。
在……附近；在……周边一带。

collocations.en: in the neighbourhood of the school

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi t-toroq u s-servizzi fil-moqraba tal-iskola.
formal.en: The map shows the streets and services in the neighbourhood of the school.
formal.zh: 地图标出了学校附近的街道和服务设施。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm spiżerija fil-moqraba? Pawlu: Iva, hemm waħda fit-triq ta' wara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there a pharmacy nearby? Pawlu: Yes, there is one on the street behind us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：附近有药房吗？保罗：有，后面那条街上有一家。

messages.speaker: Maja (路人)
messages.zh: 附近有药房吗？
messages.en: Is there a pharmacy nearby?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm waħda fit-triq ta' wara.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm waħda fit-triq ta' wara.
messages.zh: 有，后面那条街上有一家。
messages.en: Yes, there is one on the street behind us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在心里画一个围着学校的小圆圈，把圈内的“附近一带”标成 moqraba，并连着 fil-moqraba 一起记。

gloss_zh: 被扔掉的；被丢弃的；无人照管的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thrown away, discarded, or left without proper care.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被扔掉或丢弃的，也可指被搁置、缺乏照管的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mitfugħ jew imħolli mingħajr kura jew attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扔掉的。
被丢弃的；被弃置不用的。
被忽视的；缺乏照管的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ġnien mormi li jeħtieġ tindif u kura regolari.
formal.en: The report describes a neglected garden that needs cleaning and regular care.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一处无人打理的花园，需要清理和定期养护。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ktieb mormi jew xi ħadd għadu jridu? Ben: Għadni rridu jien; ħallejtu hemm għal ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has this book been discarded, or does someone still want it? Ben: I still want it; I only left it there for a little while.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这本书是被丢掉的，还是有人还要？本：我还要，只是暂时放在那里。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb mormi jew xi ħadd għadu jridu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb mormi jew xi ħadd għadu jridu?
messages.zh: 这本书是被丢掉的，还是有人还要？
messages.en: Has this book been discarded, or does someone still want it?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni rridu jien; ħallejtu hemm għal ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni rridu jien; ħallejtu hemm għal ftit.
messages.zh: 我还要，只是暂时放在那里。
messages.en: I still want it; I only left it there for a little while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象角落里一件落满灰的旧物：可能被扔掉，也可能长期没人管，用这个画面串起 mormi 的三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Whining or repeated expressions of dissatisfaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带着不满反复抱怨的言语或行为，也可指哼哼唧唧地发牢骚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgergir jew ilmenti ripetuti li juru nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哼哼唧唧地抱怨；带着不满发牢骚。
抱怨；埋怨的话。

formal.mt: Il-mormrar kontinwu dwar id-dewmien ma wassal għal ebda soluzzjoni.
formal.en: The constant complaints about the delay did not lead to any solution.
formal.zh: 对延误不停地抱怨，并没有带来任何解决办法。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu dan il-mormrar kollu? Tom: Ili nistenna ħafna; ejja naraw meta se nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is all this whining about? Tom: I have been waiting a long time; let's find out when we are leaving.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：怎么一直在发牢骚？汤姆：我等很久了，咱们问问什么时候出发吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么一直在发牢骚？
messages.en: What is all this whining about?

messages.speaker: Tom (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ili nistenna ħafna; ejja naraw meta se nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Ili nistenna ħafna; ejja naraw meta se nitilqu.
messages.zh: 我等很久了，咱们问问什么时候出发吧。
messages.en: I have been waiting a long time; let's find out when we are leaving.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读 mormrar 时，想象有人等车时反复嘟囔不满；这是帮助记住“发牢骚”的声音联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an extremely bitter taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 味道非常苦的，强调苦味程度很强。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu togħma morra ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常苦的；苦得厉害的。

formal.mt: Il-kafè ġie deskritt bħala morr tosku waqt il-prova tat-togħma.
formal.en: The coffee was described as very bitter during the tasting.
formal.zh: 在品尝过程中，这款咖啡被形容为非常苦。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-kafè morr tosku! Lara: Trid ftit zokkor fih?
colloquial.en: Mark: This coffee is really bitter! Lara: Would you like a little sugar in it?
colloquial.zh: 马克：这咖啡苦得厉害！拉拉：要往里面加一点糖吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (客人)
messages.zh: 这咖啡苦得厉害！
messages.en: This coffee is really bitter!

messages.speaker: Lara (主人)
messages.zh: 要往里面加一点糖吗？
messages.en: Would you like a little sugar in it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 morr tosku 整组记成“苦得直皱眉”，配上一口极苦咖啡的画面，记住它强调苦味很重。

gloss_zh: 莫斯塔（马耳他北部地区的城市及地方议会）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a city and local council in the Northern Region of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他北部地区的一座城市及其地方议会的名称，中文可译为“莫斯塔”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' belt u kunsill lokali fir-Reġjun tat-Tramuntana ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Mosta (a city and local council of the Northern Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 莫斯塔（马耳他北部地区的一座城市及地方议会）。

formal.mt: Il-Mosta hija belt fir-Reġjun tat-Tramuntana ta' Malta u għandha kunsill lokali.
formal.en: Mosta is a city in Malta's Northern Region and has a local council.
formal.zh: 莫斯塔是马耳他北部地区的一座城市，设有地方议会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu għada? Ben: Fiċ-ċentru tal-Mosta, fl-għaxra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet tomorrow? Ben: In the centre of Mosta, at ten.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们明天在哪里见面？本：十点在莫斯塔市中心见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 十点在莫斯塔市中心见。
messages.en: In the centre of Mosta, at ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mosta 与中文地名“莫斯塔”配对，在马耳他地图的北部区域做一个记忆标记；作为专名书写时首字母大写。

gloss_zh: 强壮的；健壮有力的；精力旺盛的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Physically strong, vigorous, and capable of exerting considerable force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体强健、富有活力且具有较大力量的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'saħħtu ħafna, mimli ħajja u kapaċi jagħmel sforz fiżiku kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强壮的；有力的。
精力旺盛的；健壮有活力的。
体力强大的；身体强健有力的。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem mosħaħ għen lit-tim iġorr il-kaxxi tqal.
formal.en: The strong worker helped the team carry the heavy boxes.
formal.zh: 那位健壮的工人帮助团队搬运沉重的箱子。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kemm hu mosħaħ ħuk! Ġarr dik il-kaxxa waħdu. Pawlu: Iva, imma għal dik l-oħra se ngħinu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Your brother is so strong! He carried that box by himself. Pawlu: Yes, but we will help him with the other one.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你哥哥真强壮！他一个人就搬走了那个箱子。保罗：是啊，不过另一个箱子我们会帮他搬。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu mosħaħ ħuk! Ġarr dik il-kaxxa waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu mosħaħ ħuk! Ġarr dik il-kaxxa waħdu.
messages.zh: 你哥哥真强壮！他一个人就搬走了那个箱子。
messages.en: Your brother is so strong! He carried that box by himself.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għal dik l-oħra se ngħinu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għal dik l-oħra se ngħinu.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过另一个箱子我们会帮他搬。
messages.en: Yes, but we will help him with the other one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个精神饱满、轻松搬起重箱的人，把 mosħaħ 同“强壮、有活力、力气大”三个特点一起记。

gloss_zh: 织机经轴（卷绕纵向经线的轴）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The beam of a loom around which the lengthwise warp threads are wound, also known in Gozo as 'il-ħobża tan-newl'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 织机上用于卷绕经线的轴；经线是沿织机纵向绷紧的线，在戈佐也称为 il-ħobża tan-newl。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-assi tan-newl li madwaru jitkebbu l-ħjut imġebbda fit-tul tan-newl; f'Għawdex magħruf ukoll bħala 'il-ħobża tan-newl'.

sense_translations.en_definition: (known in Gozo also as 'il-ħobża tan-newl') The beam of a loom around which the warp, i.e. the threads stretched lengthwise in loom, rolls
sense_translations.zh_definition: 织机上卷绕经线的轴，即卷绕沿织机纵向绷紧的线的轴；在戈佐也称为 il-ħobża tan-newl。

collocations.en: the warp beam of the loom
to wind the threads onto the warp beam

formal.mt: Il-motwa hija l-assi tan-newl li madwaru jitkebbu l-ħjut li jkunu mġebbda fit-tul tan-newl.
formal.en: The motwa is the beam of the loom around which the threads stretched lengthwise in the loom are wound.
formal.zh: motwa 是织机上的经轴，用于卷绕沿织机纵向绷紧的经线。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-parti tan-newl x'jisimha? Marija: Dik hija l-motwa; il-ħjut jitkebbu madwarha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this part of the loom called? Marija: That is the warp beam; the threads are wound around it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：织机的这个部件叫什么？玛丽亚：那是经轴，线就卷在它上面。

messages.speaker: Lara (编织学员)
messages.zh: 织机的这个部件叫什么？
messages.en: What is this part of the loom called?

messages.speaker: Marija (编织老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hija l-motwa; il-ħjut jitkebbu madwarha.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hija l-motwa; il-ħjut jitkebbu madwarha.
messages.zh: 那是经轴，线就卷在它上面。
messages.en: That is the warp beam; the threads are wound around it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象织机上的一根轴，许多纵向经线整齐卷在上面；把“卷着经线的轴”这个具体画面贴上 motwa 标签。

gloss_zh: 家用陶器；家用陶制容器

teaching_sense.en_definition: A household vessel made of clay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用陶土制成、供家庭日常使用的容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent magħmul mit-tafal għall-użu fid-dar.

sense_translations.en_definition: a domestic vessel made of clay
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种供家庭使用的陶制容器。

formal.mt: Fil-wirja hemm moħfija tat-tafal li kienet tintuża fid-dar.
formal.en: The exhibition includes a clay vessel that was used in the home.
formal.zh: 展览中有一件过去在家中使用的陶制容器。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi dik il-moħfija fuq l-ixkaffa? Pawlu: Hija reċipjent tat-tafal li kienet tuża n-nanna fid-dar.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that clay vessel on the shelf? Pawlu: It is a clay container that Grandma used at home.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：架子上那件陶器是什么？保罗：那是奶奶以前在家里用的陶制容器。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 架子上那件陶器是什么？
messages.en: What is that clay vessel on the shelf?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (祖父)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija reċipjent tat-tafal li kienet tuża n-nanna fid-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Hija reċipjent tat-tafal li kienet tuża n-nanna fid-dar.
messages.zh: 那是奶奶以前在家里用的陶制容器。
messages.en: It is a clay container that Grandma used at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象奶奶家架子上的一件陶土容器，用“家用、陶制、能盛东西”三个画面记住 moħfija。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a gentle, sweet, or kindly manner toward others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容待人或表达方式温柔、亲切，使人感到舒适。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu manjiera ġentili u ħelwa ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a gentle or sweet manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 举止温柔的；态度亲切和善的。

formal.mt: L-għalliem tkellem b'ton moħliel biex jgħin lit-tifel iħossu aktar kalm.
formal.en: The teacher spoke in a gentle tone to help the boy feel calmer.
formal.zh: 老师用温柔的语气说话，帮助男孩平静下来。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għoġobni kif kellimt lit-tifel b'dak it-ton moħliel. David: Kien imbeżża', u ridt ngħinu jikkalma.
colloquial.en: Nina: I liked how you spoke to the boy in that gentle tone. David: He was scared, and I wanted to help him calm down.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我很喜欢你刚才用那么温柔的语气和那个男孩说话。戴维：他很害怕，我想帮他平静下来。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoġobni kif kellimt lit-tifel b'dak it-ton moħliel.
messages.mt_standard: Għoġobni kif kellimt lit-tifel b'dak it-ton moħliel.
messages.zh: 我很喜欢你刚才用那么温柔的语气和那个男孩说话。
messages.en: I liked how you spoke to the boy in that gentle tone.

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien imbeżża', u ridt ngħinu jikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Kien imbeżża', u ridt ngħinu jikkalma.
messages.zh: 他很害怕，我想帮他平静下来。
messages.en: He was scared, and I wanted to help him calm down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人轻声安慰害怕的孩子，把 moħliel 和“温柔语气、亲切态度”的画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cruel or unjust treatment that keeps people under oppressive control, including tyrannical rule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过残酷或不公正的手段控制、压制他人的行为，也可指暴虐统治。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament kiefer jew inġust li bih in-nies jinżammu taħt kontroll, inkluż tmexxija tirannika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压迫；以不公正或残酷的方式限制他人的自由与生活。
暴政；以残酷、专横的方式进行统治。

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jiddeskrivi l-ġlieda ta' komunità kontra l-moħqrija ta' ħakkiem kiefer.
formal.en: The novel describes a community's struggle against the tyranny of a cruel ruler.
formal.zh: 这部小说描写了一个群体反抗残暴统治者暴政的斗争。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex telqu dawk in-nies fl-istorja? Ġużi: Għax ma felħux aktar il-moħqrija tal-ħakkiem.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did those people leave in the story? Ġużi: Because they could no longer endure the ruler's oppression.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：故事里的那些人为什么离开？朱泽：因为他们再也忍受不了统治者的压迫。

messages.speaker: Marija (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 故事里的那些人为什么离开？
messages.en: Why did those people leave in the story?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma felħux aktar il-moħqrija tal-ħakkiem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma felħux aktar il-moħqrija tal-ħakkiem.
messages.zh: 因为他们再也忍受不了统治者的压迫。
messages.en: Because they could no longer endure the ruler's oppression.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用小说中人们被残暴统治者压制的画面记 moħqrija；聚焦遭受的“压迫”和统治层面的“暴政”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dry or scorched; also describing soil that is infertile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容干燥、被灼晒得焦干的状态，也可形容土壤贫瘠、不适合生长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Niexef jew maħruq bis-sħana; jingħad ukoll dwar ħamrija li mhix għammiela.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干燥的；缺少水分的。
被高温或烈日灼得焦干的。
形容土壤贫瘠、缺乏肥力的。

formal.mt: Wara ġimgħat mingħajr xita, il-qasam sar moħrar u l-wiċċ tal-ħamrija beda jinqasam.
formal.en: After weeks without rain, the field became parched and the surface of the soil began to crack.
formal.zh: 数周没有下雨后，田地变得焦干，土壤表面开始开裂。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex ma ħawwilniex hawn? Pietru: Dan it-terren moħrar; il-ħamrija mhix għammiela u għandha bżonn titjieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why didn't we plant here? Pietru: This ground is barren; the soil is infertile and needs improvement.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们为什么没在这里种植？彼得：这块地很贫瘠，土壤缺乏肥力，需要改良。

messages.speaker: Anna (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 我们为什么没在这里种植？
messages.en: Why didn't we plant here?

messages.speaker: Pietru (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-terren moħrar; il-ħamrija mhix għammiela u għandha bżonn titjieb.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-terren moħrar; il-ħamrija mhix għammiela u għandha bżonn titjieb.
messages.zh: 这块地很贫瘠，土壤缺乏肥力，需要改良。
messages.en: This ground is barren; the soil is infertile and needs improvement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 moħrar 配上三张学习卡：缺水的地面、烈日晒焦的田地、贫瘠的土壤，分别记住三个义项。

gloss_zh: 像待解谜题一样的；有待解开的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing something that presents a riddle still to be solved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某事像一个尚待解开的谜题，需要寻找答案或解释。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jippreżenta taħbila li għad trid tissolva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有待解开的谜题；用于形容尚需破解的事物。

collocations.en: a case that remains a riddle
a message that presents a riddle
collocations.zh: 像谜题一样有待解读的信息

formal.mt: Il-każ jibqa' moħġaġ sakemm tinstab spjegazzjoni għall-indizji kollha.
formal.en: The case remains a riddle until an explanation is found for all the clues.
formal.zh: 在所有线索都得到解释之前，这个案例仍是一个待解之谜。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-messaġġ għadu moħġaġ għalija. Toni: Ejja naqraw l-indizji flimkien u nippruvaw insolvu t-taħbila.
colloquial.en: Sara: This message is still a riddle to me. Toni: Let's read the clues together and try to solve the puzzle.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这条信息对我来说仍是个谜。托尼：我们一起看看线索，试着把谜解开吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这条信息对我来说仍是个谜。
messages.en: This message is still a riddle to me.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqraw l-indizji flimkien u nippruvaw insolvu t-taħbila.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqraw l-indizji flimkien u nippruvaw insolvu t-taħbila.
messages.zh: 我们一起看看线索，试着把谜解开吧。
messages.en: Let's read the clues together and try to solve the puzzle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 moħġaġ 配上一封写满线索却还没读懂的信，记住它描述“谜题尚待解开”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression telling someone to pay attention or be careful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于提醒对方集中注意力，或在有风险时小心行事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni biex tgħid lil xi ħadd joqgħod attent jew jieħu ħsieb biex jevita periklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 注意；集中精神留意正在发生或讲解的事情。
小心；留神可能出现的危险或错误。

formal.mt: Fl-istruzzjonijiet għall-eżerċizzju hemm din it-twissija: "Moħħok hemm: aqra kull mistoqsija sew qabel twieġeb."
formal.en: The exercise instructions include this reminder: "Pay attention: read each question carefully before answering."
formal.zh: 练习说明中有这样一句提醒：“注意：回答前要仔细阅读每一道题。”

colloquial.mt: Rita: Moħħok hemm, l-art tiżloq! Ben: Grazzi talli għedtli; se nimxi bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Rita: Be careful, the floor is slippery! Ben: Thanks for telling me; I'll walk slowly.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：小心，地面很滑！本：谢谢你提醒我，我会慢慢走。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 小心，地面很滑！
messages.en: Be careful, the floor is slippery!

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi talli għedtli; se nimxi bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi talli għedtli; se nimxi bil-mod.
messages.zh: 谢谢你提醒我，我会慢慢走。
messages.en: Thanks for telling me; I'll walk slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师讲重点和朋友提醒路滑这两个场景：moħħok hemm 既可提醒“注意听”，也可提醒“小心”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in East Africa and Southern Africa, officially named the Republic of Mozambique.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 莫桑比克，位于东非和南部非洲的国家，正式名称为莫桑比克共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Lvant u fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika tal-Możambik.

sense_translations.en_definition: Mozambique (a country in East Africa and Southern Africa; official name: Repubblika tal-Możambik)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 莫桑比克（位于东非和南部非洲的国家；正式名称为莫桑比克共和国）。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ħejjew rapport dwar il-Możambik u l-pożizzjoni tiegħu fl-Afrika.
formal.en: The students prepared a report on Mozambique and its location in Africa.
formal.zh: 学生们准备了一份关于莫桑比克及其在非洲所处位置的报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fuq liema pajjiż qed tagħmel il-proġett? Mark: Fuq il-Możambik. Trid tara fejn jinsab fuq il-mappa?
colloquial.en: Lara: Which country are you doing your project on? Mark: Mozambique. Would you like to see where it is on the map?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的项目在介绍哪个国家？马克：莫桑比克。你想看看它在地图上的位置吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq liema pajjiż qed tagħmel il-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq liema pajjiż qed tagħmel il-proġett?
messages.zh: 你的项目在介绍哪个国家？
messages.en: Which country are you doing your project on?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-Możambik. Trid tara fejn jinsab fuq il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-Możambik. Trid tara fejn jinsab fuq il-mappa?
messages.zh: 莫桑比克。你想看看它在地图上的位置吗？
messages.en: Mozambique. Would you like to see where it is on the map?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mo-żam-bik 分段朗读，再指着地图说“莫桑比克”；用地图位置和国名声音一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person of the same age as another; used to express that two people are the same age.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一个人年龄相同的人；用于表示两个人同岁或同龄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna tal-istess età bħal persuna oħra; jintuża biex jingħad li żewġ persuni għandhom l-istess età.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同龄的；与另一人同岁。

collocations.en: someone the same age as me

formal.mt: Pawlu huwa mpar tiegħi; it-tnejn għandna għoxrin sena.
formal.en: Paul is the same age as me; we are both twenty years old.
formal.zh: 保罗与我同岁；我们都是二十岁。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm għandek żmien? Jien għandi tmintax-il sena. Adam: Jien ukoll! Mela aħna mpar.
colloquial.en: Nina: How old are you? I'm eighteen. Adam: Me too! So we're the same age.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你多大？我十八岁。亚当：我也是！那我们同岁。

messages.speaker: Nina (新同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandek żmien? Jien għandi tmintax-il sena.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandek żmien? Jien għandi tmintax-il sena.
messages.zh: 你多大？我十八岁。
messages.en: How old are you? I'm eighteen.

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.zh: 我也是！那我们同岁。
messages.en: Me too! So we're the same age.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人举起写着相同年龄的卡片，再说 aħna mpar，把整个短句记成“我们同岁”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The appearance or visible aspect of something, a view, or the facade of a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物呈现出来的外观、可见的景象，或建筑物的正面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dehra ta' xi ħaġa, veduta, jew il-faċċata ta' bini.

sense_translations.en_definition: (De Soldanis treats this plural word as singular) Aspect; view, sight. Facade
sense_translations.zh_definition: （De Soldanis 将这个复数词按单数处理）外观；景观、景象；建筑物的正面。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-mqagħad tal-bini u t-tiżjin ta' madwar il-bieb ewlieni.
formal.en: The report describes the building's facade and the decoration around the main entrance.
formal.zh: 报告描述了建筑物的正面，以及主入口周围的装饰。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara l-mqagħad ta' din id-dar. Kemm għandu dettalji! Toni: Iva, speċjalment madwar it-twieqi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look at the facade of this house. It has so many details! Toni: Yes, especially around the windows.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：看看这栋房子的正面，细节真多！托尼：是啊，尤其是窗户周围。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara l-mqagħad ta' din id-dar. Kemm għandu dettalji!
messages.mt_standard: Ara l-mqagħad ta' din id-dar. Kemm għandu dettalji!
messages.zh: 看看这栋房子的正面，细节真多！
messages.en: Look at the facade of this house. It has so many details!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，尤其是窗户周围。
messages.en: Yes, especially around the windows.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在一栋房子前观察门窗，把 mqagħad 与“眼前呈现的外观、建筑正面”联系起来。

gloss_zh: 有些严厉的；有些失礼的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat severe in manner or tone, or somewhat discourteous toward another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 态度或语气有些严厉的，或对别人有些不礼貌的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ftit aħrax fil-mod jew fit-ton, jew xi ftit nieqes mill-kortesija ma' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有些严厉的；略显严苛的。
有些失礼的；略欠礼貌的。

formal.mt: Fit-tweġiba tiegħu, id-direttur uża ton mqajjat li seta' jinftiehem bħala nuqqas ta' kortesija.
formal.en: In his reply, the director used a somewhat severe tone that could be understood as discourteous.
formal.zh: 主任在回复中使用了有些严厉的语气，可能会让人觉得不够礼貌。

colloquial.mt: Marta: It-ton tiegħu kien ftit mqajjat, hux? David: Iva, seta' qal l-istess ħaġa b'aktar kortesija.
colloquial.en: Marta: His tone was a little harsh, wasn't it? David: Yes, he could have said the same thing more politely.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：他的语气有点生硬，对吧？戴维：是啊，同样的意思，他可以说得更礼貌一些。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: It-ton tiegħu kien ftit mqajjat, hux?
messages.mt_standard: It-ton tiegħu kien ftit mqajjat, hux?
messages.zh: 他的语气有点生硬，对吧？
messages.en: His tone was a little harsh, wasn't it?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, seta' qal l-istess ħaġa b'aktar kortesija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, seta' qal l-istess ħaġa b'aktar kortesija.
messages.zh: 是啊，同样的意思，他可以说得更礼貌一些。
messages.en: Yes, he could have said the same thing more politely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句话语气稍硬，让听者皱眉：mqajjat 可记为“有点严厉，也可能显得失礼”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small sty or enclosure for pigs; the diminutive form of maqjel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 饲养猪的小圈舍；是 maqjel 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maqjel żgħir fejn jinżammu l-ħnieżer; il-forma diminuttiva ta' maqjel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小猪圈（maqjel 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: the door of the small sty

formal.mt: Il-bidwi naddaf il-mqajjel u poġġa tiben frisk qabel daħħal il-qżieqeż.
formal.en: The farmer cleaned the small sty and put down fresh straw before bringing in the piglets.
formal.zh: 农夫清扫了小猪圈，铺上新鲜稻草，然后才把小猪赶进去。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn inpoġġi dan it-tiben? Pawlu: Fil-mqajjel, jekk jogħġbok. Għadni kemm naddaftu.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where should I put this straw? Pawlu: In the small sty, please. I've just cleaned it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这些稻草放在哪里？保罗：请放进小猪圈里。我刚把它清扫干净。

messages.speaker: Lina (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 这些稻草放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this straw?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-mqajjel, jekk jogħġbok. Għadni kemm naddaftu.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-mqajjel, jekk jogħġbok. Għadni kemm naddaftu.
messages.zh: 请放进小猪圈里。我刚把它清扫干净。
messages.en: In the small sty, please. I've just cleaned it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 maqjel 和 mqajjel 画成一大一小两个猪圈；看到 mqajjel，就想起较小的那个圈舍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Awake rather than asleep, or in one's senses and able to think clearly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有睡着、处于清醒状态的；也指神志清楚、能够清晰思考的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhux rieqed, jew li għandu moħħu f'sikktu u jista' jaħseb b'mod ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 醒着的；没有睡着的。
神志清醒的；头脑清楚的。

formal.mt: Meta waslet l-infermiera, il-pazjent kien mqajjem u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet b'mod ċar.
formal.en: When the nurse arrived, the patient was awake and answered the questions clearly.
formal.zh: 护士到来时，病人醒着，并且清楚地回答了问题。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għadek mqajjem? Ħsibt li rqadt. Ben: Iva, għadni mqajjem. Qed nispiċċa naqra dan il-kapitlu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you still awake? I thought you'd fallen asleep. Ben: Yes, I'm still awake. I'm finishing this chapter.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你还醒着？我以为你睡着了。本：是啊，我还没睡。我正把这一章读完。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 你还醒着？我以为你睡着了。
messages.en: Are you still awake? I thought you'd fallen asleep.

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni mqajjem. Qed nispiċċa naqra dan il-kapitlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni mqajjem. Qed nispiċċa naqra dan il-kapitlu.
messages.zh: 是啊，我还没睡。我正把这一章读完。
messages.en: Yes, I'm still awake. I'm finishing this chapter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“灯还亮着，人还醒着”的画面记 mqajjem；再从“醒着”联想到“神志也清楚”。

gloss_zh: 勉强的；不自然的；不恰当的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Forced or lacking naturalness, or inappropriate for the situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 显得勉强、不自然的；也指不适合当前场合或情境的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher sfurzat jew mhux naturali, jew li ma jkunx xieraq għas-sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 勉强的；刻意而不自然的。
不恰当的；不合时宜的。

formal.mt: Il-kumment mqanżaħ waqt iċ-ċerimonja ħoloq skumdità fost il-mistednin.
formal.en: The inappropriate comment during the ceremony made the guests uncomfortable.
formal.zh: 仪式期间那句不恰当的评论让来宾感到不自在。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dak id-daħk deher mqanżaħ, hux? Sam: Iva, ma tantx sab iċ-ċajta tad-daħk.
colloquial.en: Rita: That laughter seemed forced, didn't it? Sam: Yes, he didn't find the joke very funny.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：那笑声听起来挺勉强的，对吧？萨姆：是啊，他并不觉得那个笑话有多好笑。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 那笑声听起来挺勉强的，对吧？
messages.en: That laughter seemed forced, didn't it?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma tantx sab iċ-ċajta tad-daħk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma tantx sab iċ-ċajta tad-daħk.
messages.zh: 是啊，他并不觉得那个笑话有多好笑。
messages.en: Yes, he didn't find the joke very funny.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到不好笑的笑话却硬挤出笑声，用这个画面记“勉强”；再配上场合不合适的评论，记住另一义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to mean even when emphasizing something, or at least when expressing a minimum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强调某种情况时表示“甚至、哪怕”；提出最低数量或最低要求时表示“至少”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża fis-sens ta' anki biex jenfasizza xi ħaġa, jew ta' għall-inqas biex jesprimi minimu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甚至；连……也；哪怕。
至少；起码；最低限度也要。

collocations.en: even for just a few minutes

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant għandu jaqra t-test mqar darba qabel id-diskussjoni.
formal.en: Each participant should read the text at least once before the discussion.
formal.zh: 每位参与者都应在讨论前至少读一遍文本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ejja żurna, mqar għal ftit minuti. Leo: Illum għandi ħafna x'nagħmel, imma ngħaddi mqar biex insellmilkom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Come and visit us, even for just a few minutes. Leo: I've got a lot to do today, but I'll stop by at least to say hello.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：来看看我们吧，哪怕只待几分钟。利奥：我今天有很多事要做，不过至少会顺路来跟你们打个招呼。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja żurna, mqar għal ftit minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja żurna, mqar għal ftit minuti.
messages.zh: 来看看我们吧，哪怕只待几分钟。
messages.en: Come and visit us, even for just a few minutes.

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum għandi ħafna x'nagħmel, imma ngħaddi mqar biex insellmilkom.
messages.mt_standard: Illum għandi ħafna x'nagħmel, imma ngħaddi mqar biex insellmilkom.
messages.zh: 我今天有很多事要做，不过至少会顺路来跟你们打个招呼。
messages.en: I've got a lot to do today, but I'll stop by at least to say hello.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mqar 放进“哪怕几分钟，至少来一次”的邀请里；前半记强调，后半记最低要求。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pasta in the form of tubes, prepared by cooking and often served with sauce.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈管状的意大利面，煮熟后常搭配酱汁食用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaġin f'għamla ta' tubi, li jissajjar u spiss jittiekel biz-zalza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通心粉；管状意大利面。

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar, il-kċina se toffri mqarrun biz-zalza tat-tadam u insalata friska.
formal.en: For lunch, the kitchen will offer macaroni with tomato sauce and a fresh salad.
formal.zh: 午餐时，厨房将供应番茄酱通心粉和新鲜沙拉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi trid għall-ikel? Mark: Nagħmlu mqarrun biz-zalza? Maja: Iva, u nżidu ftit ġobon.
colloquial.en: Maja: What would you like to eat? Mark: Shall we make macaroni with sauce? Maja: Yes, and let's add a little cheese.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想吃什么？马克：我们做酱汁通心粉吧？玛雅：好，再加一点奶酪。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃什么？
messages.en: What would you like to eat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们做酱汁通心粉吧？
messages.en: Shall we make macaroni with sauce?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，再加一点奶酪。
messages.en: Yes, and let's add a little cheese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mqarrun 和一盘中空管状面联系起来，再想象淋上番茄酱，记住它指通心粉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Work paid according to the number of pieces or units completed rather than the time spent working.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按完成的件数或工作量计算报酬，而非按工作时间计算报酬的工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol li jitħallas skont l-għadd ta' biċċiet jew unitajiet li jitlestew, aktar milli skont il-ħin tax-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 计件工作；按完成件数或单位工作量支付报酬的劳动。

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jispeċifika li x-xogħol isir bil-mqietgħa u li l-ħlas jiddependi mill-għadd ta' biċċiet lesti.
formal.en: The agreement specifies that the work is done on a piecework basis and that payment depends on the number of completed pieces.
formal.zh: 协议明确规定，工作采用计件方式，报酬取决于完成的件数。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan ix-xogħol jitħallas bis-siegħa? Pawlu: Le, bil-mqietgħa. Sara: Mela l-ħlas jiddependi minn kemm inlesti biċċiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this work paid by the hour? Pawlu: No, by the piece. Sara: So the pay depends on how many pieces I finish.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这份工作按小时付钱吗？保罗：不是，按件付钱。萨拉：那报酬就取决于我完成多少件。

messages.speaker: Sara (求职者)
messages.zh: 这份工作按小时付钱吗？
messages.en: Is this work paid by the hour?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (主管)
messages.zh: 不是，按件付钱。
messages.en: No, by the piece.

messages.speaker: Sara (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela l-ħlas jiddependi minn kemm inlesti biċċiet.
messages.mt_standard: Mela l-ħlas jiddependi minn kemm inlesti biċċiet.
messages.zh: 那报酬就取决于我完成多少件。
messages.en: So the pay depends on how many pieces I finish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 mqietgħa 时想象桌上每完成一件就放一枚计酬筹码，用数件数的画面记住计件工作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Naughty or mischievous behaviour, especially playful behaviour that causes trouble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 顽皮、淘气的行为，尤其指因玩闹而惹出麻烦的举动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba ta' min jagħmel praspura jew ma jobdix, speċjalment waqt il-logħob.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淘气；不听话或违反行为要求的表现。
顽皮；爱恶作剧、因玩闹而惹麻烦的表现。

formal.mt: L-għalliema spjegat li l-mqorbija waqt il-lezzjoni kienet qed tfixkel lill-bqija tal-klassi.
formal.en: The teacher explained that the naughtiness during the lesson was disturbing the rest of the class.
formal.zh: 老师说明，课堂上的淘气行为正在干扰班里其他同学。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Min ħeba ż-żarbun tiegħi? Nina: Jien, kienet biċċa mqorbija. Omm: Agħtihuli lura, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mum: Who hid my shoe? Nina: I did; it was a bit of mischief. Mum: Give it back to me, please.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：谁把我的鞋藏起来了？妮娜：是我，就是闹着玩的。妈妈：请把它还给我。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 谁把我的鞋藏起来了？
messages.en: Who hid my shoe?

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 是我，就是闹着玩的。
messages.en: I did; it was a bit of mischief.

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 请把它还给我。
messages.en: Give it back to me, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用孩子偷偷藏鞋又忍不住笑的画面记 mqorbija，同时联想淘气和爱恶作剧这两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An attitude of resisting authority or expressing opposition to established views.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反抗权威或对既有观点表达异议的态度与倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attitudni ta' reżistenza għall-awtorità jew ta' oppożizzjoni għall-fehmiet stabbiliti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反叛性；不愿服从权威或既定要求的倾向。
持异议；公开反对既定权威或主流立场的态度。

formal.mt: L-awtur jesplora l-mrad politiku permezz ta' karattru li jikkritika pubblikament lill-awtoritajiet.
formal.en: The author explores political dissidence through a character who publicly criticizes the authorities.
formal.zh: 作者通过一位公开批评当局的人物，探讨政治异议这一主题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-karattru dejjem jisfida lill-kap? Mark: Għandu spirtu ta' mrad. Lara: Iva, ma jaċċetta l-ebda ordni mingħajr mistoqsijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the character always challenge the boss? Mark: He has a rebellious spirit. Lara: Yes, he never accepts an order without asking questions.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个人物为什么总是挑战上司？马克：他有一种反叛精神。拉拉：是啊，他接到任何命令都要问个明白。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这个人物为什么总是挑战上司？
messages.en: Why does the character always challenge the boss?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 他有一种反叛精神。
messages.en: He has a rebellious spirit.

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma jaċċetta l-ebda ordni mingħajr mistoqsijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma jaċċetta l-ebda ordni mingħajr mistoqsijiet.
messages.zh: 是啊，他接到任何命令都要问个明白。
messages.en: Yes, he never accepts an order without asking questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mrad 放进有人举手质疑权威的场景：强调不服从时记反叛性，强调不同立场时记异议。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A handle used to turn a wheel by hand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人用手操作、使轮子转动的手柄或摇柄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Manku li jintuża biex wieħed idawwar rota b'idu.

sense_translations.en_definition: a handle to turn a wheel
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于转动轮子的手柄；摇柄。

formal.mt: Biex iddawwar ir-rota, aqbad il-mradd u mexxih bil-mod.
formal.en: To turn the wheel, grip the handle and move it slowly.
formal.zh: 要转动轮子，请握住摇柄并缓慢转动。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif indawwar din ir-rota? Pawlu: Aqbad il-mradd hawn. Nina: Issa fhimt; indawru bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do I turn this wheel? Pawlu: Grip the handle here. Nina: I understand now; I'll turn it slowly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个轮子怎么转？保罗：握住这里的摇柄。妮娜：现在明白了，我慢慢转。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.zh: 这个轮子怎么转？
messages.en: How do I turn this wheel?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (师傅)
messages.zh: 握住这里的摇柄。
messages.en: Grip the handle here.

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.zh: 现在明白了，我慢慢转。
messages.en: I understand now; I'll turn it slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只手握住轮子旁伸出的摇柄，手柄一转轮子就转，用这个动作记住 mradd。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who breastfeeds a child, especially a wet nurse feeding another person's baby.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给孩子哺乳的人，尤指受托为他人的婴儿哺乳的乳母。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tredda' tarbija, speċjalment tarbija ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乳母；为他人的婴儿哺乳的人。
给孩子喂母乳、进行哺乳的人。

collocations.en: the role of a wet nurse

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-familja tqabbad mradda' biex tredda' lit-tarbija.
formal.en: In the story, the family hires a wet nurse to breastfeed the baby.
formal.zh: 故事中，这家人雇用一位乳母给婴儿哺乳。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser mradda' f'dan ir-rakkont? Mark: Persuna li tredda' lit-tarbija ta' ħaddieħor. Maja: Mela hawn qed jitkellmu dwar min jagħtiha l-ħalib tas-sider.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does mradda' mean in this story? Mark: A person who breastfeeds someone else's baby. Maja: So here they mean the person who feeds the baby breast milk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个故事里的 mradda' 是什么意思？马克：给别人的婴儿哺乳的人。玛雅：所以这里说的是给这个婴儿喂母乳的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 mradda' 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does mradda' mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna li tredda' lit-tarbija ta' ħaddieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna li tredda' lit-tarbija ta' ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 给别人的婴儿哺乳的人。
messages.en: A person who breastfeeds someone else's baby.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela hawn qed jitkellmu dwar min jagħtiha l-ħalib tas-sider.
messages.mt_standard: Mela hawn qed jitkellmu dwar min jagħtiha l-ħalib tas-sider.
messages.zh: 所以这里说的是给这个婴儿喂母乳的人。
messages.en: So here they mean the person who feeds the baby breast milk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 mradda' 时把画面聚焦在给婴儿喂母乳的人身上；受托喂养别人孩子时，就是乳母。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thick wall forming a substantial barrier or part of a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 厚实的墙体，可构成建筑物的一部分或一道屏障。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħajt oħxon li jifforma parti minn bini jew jifred post minn ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厚墙；厚实的墙体。

formal.mt: Il-mramma tal-ġebel tifred il-bitħa mit-triq u għandha tinżamm f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: The thick stone wall separates the courtyard from the street and should be kept in good condition.
formal.zh: 这道厚石墙将庭院与街道隔开，应保持其状况良好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se npoġġu l-bank? Mark: Ħdejn il-mramma, għax hemm aktar dell.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we put the bench? Mark: Beside the thick wall, because there is more shade there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们把长椅放在哪里？马克：放在厚墙旁边吧，那里阴凉些。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们把长椅放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put the bench?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-mramma, għax hemm aktar dell.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-mramma, għax hemm aktar dell.
messages.zh: 放在厚墙旁边吧，那里阴凉些。
messages.en: Beside the thick wall, because there is more shade there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mramma 和庭院边厚厚的石墙画在同一张词卡上，借助墙体的厚度记住它。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become bitter in taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 味道变苦，开始带有苦味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu togħma morra jew isir morr fit-togħma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变苦；味道开始发苦。
苦涩；苦的性质或感受。
苦味；味觉上的苦涩感。
悲伤；内心的愁苦。

collocations.en: a bitter taste in the mouth

formal.mt: It-te mrar għax il-weraq tħalla fl-ilma għal żmien twil wisq.
formal.en: The tea became bitter because the leaves were left in the water for too long.
formal.zh: 茶叶在水中浸泡过久，茶变苦了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tixrob l-ilma? Pawlu: Dan il-kafè ħallieli mrar fil-ħalq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you drinking water? Pawlu: This coffee left a bitter taste in my mouth.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么在喝水？保罗：这杯咖啡让我嘴里留下了苦味。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在喝水？
messages.en: Why are you drinking water?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 这杯咖啡让我嘴里留下了苦味。
messages.en: This coffee left a bitter taste in my mouth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两格画面记 mrar：茶在杯中变苦对应动词，口中苦味和心中愁苦对应名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bitter taste perceived in food, drink, or the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在食物、饮料或口中感受到的一种苦味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Togħma morra li tinħass fl-ikel, fix-xorb jew fil-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种苦味；味觉上的苦涩感。

collocations.en: a bitter taste in the mouth

formal.mt: Wara li xorob it-te, il-parteċipant innota mrara qawwija fil-ħalq.
formal.en: After drinking the tea, the participant noted a strong bitter taste in the mouth.
formal.zh: 喝茶后，参与者注意到口中有浓重的苦味。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għoġbok it-te? Toni: Mhux wisq; ħallieli mrara fil-ħalq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you like the tea? Toni: Not very much; it left a bitter taste in my mouth.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你喜欢这茶吗？托尼：不太喜欢，喝完嘴里有股苦味。

messages.speaker: Nina (主人)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这茶吗？
messages.en: Did you like the tea?

messages.speaker: Toni (客人)
messages.zh: 不太喜欢，喝完嘴里有股苦味。
messages.en: Not very much; it left a bitter taste in my mouth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象喝完一口苦茶，嘴里还留着一股苦味；把这个具体味觉与 mrara 连在一起记。

gloss_zh: 受养育者；受某种观念熏陶者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person brought up in a particular environment or instilled with particular values or habits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某种环境中长大，或受到特定价值观、习惯熏陶的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li trabbiet f'ambjent partikolari jew li ngħatat ċerti valuri jew drawwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某种环境中受养育、长大的人。
受到某种观念、价值或习惯灌输与熏陶的人。

collocations.en: brought up in an environment of respect
collocations.zh: 在相互尊重的环境中长大的
受到家庭价值观熏陶的

formal.mt: Student mrawwem fir-rispett lejn l-oħrajn jagħti spazju lil sħabu biex jesprimu l-fehmiet tagħhom.
formal.en: A student brought up to respect others gives classmates room to express their views.
formal.zh: 从小受到尊重他人观念熏陶的学生，会给同学表达意见的空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dejjem tistenna lil kulħadd qabel tibda tiekol? Mark: Jien mrawwem hekk; id-dar dejjem konna nistennew lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you always wait for everyone before you start eating? Mark: I was brought up that way; at home we always waited for one another.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么总要等大家到齐才开始吃？马克：我从小就是这样被教养的；在家里我们一直都会互相等候。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dejjem tistenna lil kulħadd qabel tibda tiekol?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dejjem tistenna lil kulħadd qabel tibda tiekol?
messages.zh: 你为什么总要等大家到齐才开始吃？
messages.en: Why do you always wait for everyone before you start eating?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien mrawwem hekk; id-dar dejjem konna nistennew lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Jien mrawwem hekk; id-dar dejjem konna nistennew lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 我从小就是这样被教养的；在家里我们一直都会互相等候。
messages.en: I was brought up that way; at home we always waited for one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一家人等齐才吃饭的画面记 mrawwem：长期的养育和熏陶，体现在一个人的习惯里。

gloss_zh: 大理石般的；有大理石纹的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling marble in appearance or having a pattern like the veins of marble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外观像大理石的，或带有类似大理石纹理的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher bħall-irħam jew għandu disinn li jixbah il-vini tal-irħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大理石般的；呈大理石外观或具有大理石纹理的。

formal.mt: Il-pannell għandu wiċċ mraħħam b'vini griżi fuq sfond abjad.
formal.en: The panel has a marbled surface with grey veins on a white background.
formal.zh: 这块面板的表面呈大理石纹，白色底面上分布着灰色纹路。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema disinn tippreferi għal din il-mejda? Lara: Id-disinn mraħħam, dak bil-vini griżi. Sara: Iva, jogħġobni wkoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which design do you prefer for this table? Lara: The marbled design, the one with grey veins. Sara: Yes, I like it too.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张桌子你更喜欢哪种图案？拉拉：大理石纹的，就是带灰色纹路的那个。萨拉：嗯，我也喜欢。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema disinn tippreferi għal din il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Liema disinn tippreferi għal din il-mejda?
messages.zh: 这张桌子你更喜欢哪种图案？
messages.en: Which design do you prefer for this table?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 大理石纹的，就是带灰色纹路的那个。
messages.en: The marbled design, the one with grey veins.

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 嗯，我也喜欢。
messages.en: Yes, I like it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mraħħam 配上一张白底灰色流纹的图片，用大理石般的外观记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Offered at a price lower than the usual or original price.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以低于平时价格或原价的价格出售的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinbiegħ bi prezz aktar baxx mill-prezz tas-soltu jew minn dak oriġinali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打折的；以折扣价出售的。

formal.mt: Matul il-promozzjoni, dan il-prodott se jinbiegħ bi prezz mraħħas ta' għoxrin ewro.
formal.en: During the promotion, this product will be sold at a discounted price of twenty euros.
formal.zh: 促销期间，这款商品将以二十欧元的折扣价出售。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-flokk mraħħas? Rita: Iva, illum jiswa għaxar ewro minflok ħmistax. Mark: Tajjeb, nieħu wieħed.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this shirt discounted? Rita: Yes, today it costs ten euros instead of fifteen. Mark: Great, I'll take one.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这件上衣打折吗？丽塔：是的，今天十欧元，原价十五欧元。马克：好，我买一件。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件上衣打折吗？
messages.en: Is this shirt discounted?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum jiswa għaxar ewro minflok ħmistax.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum jiswa għaxar ewro minflok ħmistax.
messages.zh: 是的，今天十欧元，原价十五欧元。
messages.en: Yes, today it costs ten euros instead of fifteen.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 好，我买一件。
messages.en: Great, I'll take one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mraħħas 和划掉原价、写上更低新价的标签一起记忆，看到降价标签就想到打折的。

gloss_zh: 克制的；受抑制的；被阻住的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Kept under control or prevented from being fully expressed or moving forward.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到控制的，或在表达、行动及发展上受到抑制或阻碍的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżmum taħt kontroll jew imwaqqaf milli jesprimi ruħu bis-sħiħ jew jimxi 'l quddiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 克制的；受到控制或约束的。
被阻住的；受到抑制而未能充分表现或前进的。

formal.mt: Minkejja l-kritika, il-kelliem wieġeb b'ton mrażżan u spjega l-pożizzjoni tiegħu b'mod ċar.
formal.en: Despite the criticism, the speaker replied in a restrained tone and explained his position clearly.
formal.zh: 尽管受到批评，发言者仍以克制的语气回应，并清楚地说明了自己的立场。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Deherli li kont irrabjat fil-laqgħa. Pawlu: Kont, imma żammejt ton mrażżan biex ma nżidx it-tensjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: You seemed angry at the meeting. Pawlu: I was, but I kept a restrained tone so I would not increase the tension.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你开会时好像很生气。保罗：是的，不过我保持了克制的语气，免得气氛更紧张。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你开会时好像很生气。
messages.en: You seemed angry at the meeting.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont, imma żammejt ton mrażżan biex ma nżidx it-tensjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Kont, imma żammejt ton mrażżan biex ma nżidx it-tensjoni.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我保持了克制的语气，免得气氛更紧张。
messages.en: I was, but I kept a restrained tone so I would not increase the tension.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把情绪的音量旋钮往下调，用这个主动收住表达的动作记住 mrażżan 的克制与受控。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small hammer; the diminutive form of martell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小型锤子；是 martell 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Martell żgħir; il-forma diminuttiva ta' martell.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small hammer (the diminutive form of 'martell')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一把小锤子；martell 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a tap with a small hammer

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża mrejtel biex idaħħal musmar żgħir fil-qafas mingħajr ma jagħmel ħsara lill-injam.
formal.en: The worker used a small hammer to drive a small nail into the frame without damaging the wood.
formal.zh: 工人用小锤子把一枚小钉子钉入框架，没有损伤木材。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' tgħaddili l-mrejtel? Toni: Iva, qiegħed fil-kaxxa tal-għodda, ħdejn il-musmar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you pass me the small hammer? Toni: Yes, it is in the toolbox, beside the nail.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：能把小锤子递给我吗？托尼：可以，它在工具箱里，就在钉子旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (一起做手工的朋友)
messages.zh: 能把小锤子递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the small hammer?

messages.speaker: Toni (一起做手工的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fil-kaxxa tal-għodda, ħdejn il-musmar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fil-kaxxa tal-għodda, ħdejn il-musmar.
messages.zh: 可以，它在工具箱里，就在钉子旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it is in the toolbox, beside the nail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在词卡上并排画普通锤子 martell 和小锤子 mrejtel，用大小对照记住这里的指小关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small beam of light; the diminutive form of merżuq.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一束细小的光；是 merżuq 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġġ żgħir ta' dawl; il-forma diminuttiva ta' merżuq.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small light beam (the diminutive form of 'merżuq')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小束光；merżuq 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Mrejżaq ta' dawl daħal minn qasma fil-bieb u dawwal parti żgħira mill-art.
formal.en: A small beam of light entered through a crack in the door and illuminated a small part of the floor.
formal.zh: 一小束光从门缝照进来，照亮了地面的一小块地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara dak il-mrejżaq fuq il-ħajt? Mark: Iva, id-dawl ġej minn bejn il-purtieri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see that little beam of light on the wall? Mark: Yes, the light is coming through the gap between the curtains.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见墙上那一小束光了吗？马克：看见了，光是从窗帘之间的缝隙照进来的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara dak il-mrejżaq fuq il-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara dak il-mrejżaq fuq il-ħajt?
messages.zh: 你看见墙上那一小束光了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that little beam of light on the wall?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, id-dawl ġej minn bejn il-purtieri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, id-dawl ġej minn bejn il-purtieri.
messages.zh: 看见了，光是从窗帘之间的缝隙照进来的。
messages.en: Yes, the light is coming through the gap between the curtains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗帘缝里透进来的一小束光，把画面标成 mrejżaq，再与 merżuq 对照记住指小关系。

gloss_zh: 小甲虫；用于两个田地地名的词

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word for small beetles, also found in the field names Ta' Mrejżba in Mġarr, Gozo, and Ta' Mrejżbiet near Għajnsielem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指小甲虫的词，也见于戈佐岛 Mġarr 的田地名 Ta' Mrejżba，以及 Għajnsielem 一带的田地名 Ta' Mrejżbiet。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma għal ħanfus żgħar, li tidher ukoll fl-ismijiet ta' għelieqi Ta' Mrejżba fl-Imġarr, Għawdex, u Ta' Mrejżbiet fl-inħawi ta' Għajnsielem.

sense_translations.en_definition: occurring in the plural form (toponymy) Ta' Mrejżbiet, name of fields in the limits of Għajnsielem in the nneighbourhood of Borg Għarib
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以复数形式出现于地名 Ta' Mrejżbiet，指 Għajnsielem 辖境内、Borg Għarib 附近的一片田地。
小甲虫。

sense_translations.en_definition: (toponymy) Ta' Mrejżba, name of fields in Mġarr, Gozo
sense_translations.zh_definition: 地名 Ta' Mrejżba，指戈佐岛 Mġarr 的一片田地。

collocations.zh: 名为 Ta' Mrejżbiet 的田地
名为 Ta' Mrejżba 的田地

formal.mt: L-isem Ta' Mrejżbiet jirreferi għal għelieqi fil-limiti ta' Għajnsielem qrib Borg Għarib, filwaqt li Ta' Mrejżba huwa isem ta' għelieqi fl-Imġarr, Għawdex.
formal.en: The name Ta' Mrejżbiet refers to fields within the limits of Għajnsielem near Borg Għarib, while Ta' Mrejżba names fields in Mġarr, Gozo.
formal.zh: Ta' Mrejżbiet 指 Għajnsielem 辖境内、Borg Għarib 附近的田地，而 Ta' Mrejżba 是戈佐岛 Mġarr 一片田地的名称。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawn fil-lista tal-insetti hemm il-kelma 'mrejżba'. Xi tfisser? Pawlu: Tfisser ħanfus żgħar. Il-kelma tidher ukoll fl-isem Ta' Mrejżba.
colloquial.en: Lara: The word 'mrejżba' is here in the insect list. What does it mean? Pawlu: It means small beetles. The word also appears in the name Ta' Mrejżba.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份昆虫词表里有 mrejżba 这个词。它是什么意思？保罗：意思是小甲虫。这个词也出现在 Ta' Mrejżba 这个地名里。

messages.speaker: Lara (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn fil-lista tal-insetti hemm il-kelma 'mrejżba'. Xi tfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn fil-lista tal-insetti hemm il-kelma 'mrejżba'. Xi tfisser?
messages.zh: 这份昆虫词表里有 mrejżba 这个词。它是什么意思？
messages.en: The word 'mrejżba' is here in the insect list. What does it mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser ħanfus żgħar. Il-kelma tidher ukoll fl-isem Ta' Mrejżba.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser ħanfus żgħar. Il-kelma tidher ukoll fl-isem Ta' Mrejżba.
messages.zh: 意思是小甲虫。这个词也出现在 Ta' Mrejżba 这个地名里。
messages.en: It means small beetles. The word also appears in the name Ta' Mrejżba.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做三格词卡：一格画小甲虫，另两格分别写两处田地名与所在地；这是义项整理，不据此推断地名由来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fan held and moved by hand to create a cooling flow of air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拿在手中，通过摇动来扇风纳凉的扇子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li żżommu f'idek u ċċaqalqu biex tagħmel l-arja u tiffriska.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手持扇子；用手摇动来扇风的扇子。

collocations.en: to fan oneself with a hand fan

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja fis-sajf, waħda mill-mistednin użat mrewħa tal-karti biex tiffriska.
formal.en: During the summer ceremony, one of the guests used a paper hand fan to cool herself.
formal.zh: 在夏季的典礼上，一位女宾用纸扇给自己扇风纳凉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu sħun hawn! Għandek mrewħa? Rita: Iva, ħu din u agħmel ftit arja.
colloquial.en: Maja: It's so hot here! Do you have a hand fan? Rita: Yes, take this one and fan yourself a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里真热！你有手扇吗？丽塔：有，拿这把扇扇风吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu sħun hawn! Għandek mrewħa?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu sħun hawn! Għandek mrewħa?
messages.zh: 这里真热！你有手扇吗？
messages.en: It's so hot here! Do you have a hand fan?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din u agħmel ftit arja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din u agħmel ftit arja.
messages.zh: 有，拿这把扇扇风吧。
messages.en: Yes, take this one and fan yourself a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mrewħa 和夏天展开纸扇、用手来回扇风的画面一起记，重点记住它是手持的扇子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rebellious against authority or openly opposed to an established position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反抗权威的，或公开反对既定立场、持有异议的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jirribella kontra l-awtorità jew jesprimi nuqqas ta' qbil mal-pożizzjoni stabbilita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反叛的；起来反抗当局或权威的。
持异议的；公开反对既定政治或组织立场的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi grupp mrid li rrifjuta l-awtorità tal-gvern.
formal.en: The report describes an insurgent group that rejected the government's authority.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一个拒绝承认政府权威的反叛团体。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex sejjaħlu membru mrid? Lara: Għax esprima pubblikament in-nuqqas ta' qbil tiegħu mal-pożizzjoni tal-partit.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did he call him a dissident member? Lara: Because he publicly expressed his disagreement with the party's position.
colloquial.zh: 马克：他为什么称那个人为持异议的成员？拉拉：因为那个人公开表达了对党内立场的反对。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 他为什么称那个人为持异议的成员？
messages.en: Why did he call him a dissident member?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax esprima pubblikament in-nuqqas ta' qbil tiegħu mal-pożizzjoni tal-partit.
messages.mt_standard: Għax esprima pubblikament in-nuqqas ta' qbil tiegħu mal-pożizzjoni tal-partit.
messages.zh: 因为那个人公开表达了对党内立场的反对。
messages.en: Because he publicly expressed his disagreement with the party's position.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mrid 放进两幅画面：团体反抗权威，成员公开提出异议；前者帮助记反叛，后者帮助记持异议。

gloss_zh: 跨坐的；重叠的；架在某物上的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Positioned astride something, overlapping something else, or resting on another object for support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 跨坐在某物上的、与另一物重叠的，或由另一物支撑而架放其上的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imqiegħed b'sieq fuq kull naħa ta' xi ħaġa, jirkeb fuq parti minn ħaġa oħra, jew jistrieħ fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跨坐的；两腿分置于某物两侧的。
重叠的；一部分覆盖在另一物之上的。
搁在某物上的；架放在某物上并由其支撑的。

collocations.zh: 与另一边缘重叠的边缘

collocations.en: a beam resting on two walls

formal.mt: Fit-tpinġija, ir-raġel jidher mrikkeb fuq żiemel, b'sieq fuq kull naħa.
formal.en: In the drawing, the man is shown astride a horse, with one leg on each side.
formal.zh: 图中男子跨坐在马背上，两腿分置两侧。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-tarf għandu jkun mrikkeb fuq l-ieħor? Mark: Iva, ħalli parti żgħira minnu fuq it-tarf l-ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: Should this edge overlap the other one? Mark: Yes, leave a small part of it over the other edge.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这条边应该搭在另一条边上吗？马克：对，让其中一小部分盖住另一条边。

messages.speaker: Lara (手工课学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tarf għandu jkun mrikkeb fuq l-ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tarf għandu jkun mrikkeb fuq l-ieħor?
messages.zh: 这条边应该搭在另一条边上吗？
messages.en: Should this edge overlap the other one?

messages.speaker: Mark (手工课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħalli parti żgħira minnu fuq it-tarf l-ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħalli parti żgħira minnu fuq it-tarf l-ieħor.
messages.zh: 对，让其中一小部分盖住另一条边。
messages.en: Yes, leave a small part of it over the other edge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅位置图记 mrikkeb：人跨在马上、两条边部分重叠、横梁架在墙上；逐一对应三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Full of thyme plants growing in a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某处生长着大量百里香、长满百里香的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih jikber ħafna sagħtar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长满百里香的；遍布百里香植株的。

collocations.zh: 长满百里香的石灰岩灌丛地

formal.mt: Il-mixja tgħaddi minn xagħri msagħtar, fejn jikber ħafna sagħtar bejn il-blat.
formal.en: The walking route passes through garrigue full of thyme, where many thyme plants grow among the rocks.
formal.zh: 步行路线穿过长满百里香的石灰岩灌丛地，岩石之间生长着许多百里香。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ix-xagħri msagħtar, hux? Pawlu: Iva, ara kemm hemm sagħtar bejn il-ġebel!
colloquial.en: Maja: This garrigue is full of thyme, isn't it? Pawlu: Yes, look how much thyme there is among the stones!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这片灌丛地长满了百里香，对吧？保罗：对，你看石头之间有多少百里香！

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步者)
messages.zh: 这片灌丛地长满了百里香，对吧？
messages.en: This garrigue is full of thyme, isn't it?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara kemm hemm sagħtar bejn il-ġebel!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara kemm hemm sagħtar bejn il-ġebel!
messages.zh: 对，你看石头之间有多少百里香！
messages.en: Yes, look how much thyme there is among the stones!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象岩石之间一丛接一丛的百里香，把 msagħtar 作为整片土地的描述来记，突出长得到处都是。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pale or having a dull yellowish complexion, especially in the face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肤色苍白的，或面色暗淡、带有不健康黄色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu lewn ċar ħafna jew safrani, speċjalment fil-wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苍白的；面部等部位缺少正常血色的。
面色蜡黄的；肤色暗淡、呈不健康淡黄色的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel jidħol bil-mod, b'wiċċ msajfar u għajnejn għajjenin.
formal.en: In the story, the man enters slowly, with a sallow face and tired eyes.
formal.zh: 故事中，男子缓缓走进来，面色蜡黄，双眼疲惫。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Qed tidher msajfar illum. Tħossok tajjeb? Mark: Jien għajjien biss; ma rqadtx biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Rita: You look pale today. Are you feeling all right? Mark: I'm just tired; I didn't get enough sleep.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你今天脸色有些苍白。你还好吗？马克：我只是累了，没睡够。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tidher msajfar illum. Tħossok tajjeb?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tidher msajfar illum. Tħossok tajjeb?
messages.zh: 你今天脸色有些苍白。你还好吗？
messages.en: You look pale today. Are you feeling all right?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien għajjien biss; ma rqadtx biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Jien għajjien biss; ma rqadtx biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 我只是累了，没睡够。
messages.en: I'm just tired; I didn't get enough sleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 msajfar 配一张缺少红润血色的脸：偏白时记苍白，暗淡偏黄时记蜡黄，用颜色区别两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Secured with a lock so that it cannot be opened without unlocking it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经用锁锁住，需要先解锁才能打开的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħluq b'serratura, b'mod li jrid jinfetaħ is-serratur qabel ma jkun jista' jinfetaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锁着的；已经上锁而不能直接打开的。

formal.mt: Id-dokumenti jinżammu f'armarju msakkar, u ċ-ċavetta tinsab għand l-amministratur.
formal.en: The documents are kept in a locked cupboard, and the administrator holds the key.
formal.zh: 文件存放在上锁的柜子里，钥匙由管理员保管。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-bieb msakkar. Għandek iċ-ċavetta? Pawlu: Iva, qiegħda fil-but tiegħi. Niftaħlek issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: The door is locked. Do you have the key? Pawlu: Yes, it's in my pocket. I'll open it for you now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门锁着。你有钥匙吗？保罗：有，在我口袋里。我现在给你开门。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 门锁着。你有钥匙吗？
messages.en: The door is locked. Do you have the key?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħda fil-but tiegħi. Niftaħlek issa.
