messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħda fil-but tiegħi. Niftaħlek issa.
messages.zh: 有，在我口袋里。我现在给你开门。
messages.en: Yes, it's in my pocket. I'll open it for you now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 msakkar 就想象转动钥匙后门被锁住，再用门、柜子、抽屉三个物件练习已上锁的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Crumbling or breaking away in pieces, said of a stone building or structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容石造建筑或构筑物逐渐碎裂、剥落或崩坏的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li l-ġebel tiegħu qed jitfarrak jew jinqala' biċċa biċċa, bħalma jiġri f'bini tal-ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐渐碎裂、剥落或崩坏的，指石造建筑。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar il-konservazzjoni jiddeskrivi t-torri bħala msarsar, b'biċċiet tal-ġebel li qed jinqalgħu mill-ħitan.
formal.en: The conservation report describes the tower as crumbling, with pieces of stone breaking away from its walls.
formal.zh: 保护报告指出，这座塔正在剥落崩坏，墙上的石料不断碎落。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ara kemm hu msarsar dan il-ħajt! Lara: Iva, hemm biċċiet tal-ġebel mal-art. Ejja ngħaddu minn hemm.
colloquial.en: Mark: Look how badly this wall is crumbling! Lara: Yes, there are pieces of stone on the ground. Let's go that way.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你看这面墙都剥落成什么样了！拉拉：是啊，地上都是碎石。我们从那边走吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hu msarsar dan il-ħajt!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hu msarsar dan il-ħajt!
messages.zh: 你看这面墙都剥落成什么样了！
messages.en: Look how badly this wall is crumbling!

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm biċċiet tal-ġebel mal-art. Ejja ngħaddu minn hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm biċċiet tal-ġebel mal-art. Ejja ngħaddu minn hemm.
messages.zh: 是啊，地上都是碎石。我们从那边走吧。
messages.en: Yes, there are pieces of stone on the ground. Let's go that way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一座旧石塔不断掉下小块石料，把 msarsar 与石墙逐块碎落的动态画面绑定，记住其石造建筑语境。

gloss_zh: 可怜人；苦命人；令人怜悯的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person regarded with pity because of suffering, hardship, or a pitiable condition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因受苦、遭遇困境或处境可悲而令人同情的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqanqal ħasra minħabba t-tbatija, id-diffikultajiet jew il-qagħda tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可怜人；遭受不幸、处境悲惨的人。
可怜的人；说话者因其困境而同情的人。
处境可悲、令人怜悯的人。
受苦的人；遭受疾病、痛苦或不幸折磨的人。

collocations.en: to show compassion to the suffering person

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-msejken li tilef daru jsib kenn għand familja li tilqgħu b'ġenerożità.
formal.en: In the story, the poor man who lost his home finds shelter with a family that welcomes him generously.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个失去住所的可怜人得到一家人的慷慨接纳，有了栖身之处。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Rajt lil dak il-msejken jistenna fix-xita? Pawlu: Iva, se noħroġ nagħtih umbrella.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you see that poor man waiting in the rain? Pawlu: Yes, I'm going out to give him an umbrella.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你看到那个可怜人在雨里等着了吗？保罗：看到了，我这就出去给他一把伞。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt lil dak il-msejken jistenna fix-xita?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt lil dak il-msejken jistenna fix-xita?
messages.zh: 你看到那个可怜人在雨里等着了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that poor man waiting in the rain?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 看到了，我这就出去给他一把伞。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going out to give him an umbrella.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 il-msejken 想成一句带同情语气的那个可怜人：关注正在受苦的人，四个义项都按指人的名词来记。

gloss_zh: 自鸣得意的；神气轻快的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing excessive satisfaction with oneself, or appearing cheerful and confidently jaunty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人因自我满足而显得自鸣得意，或显得神气、轻快而自信。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher kuntent iżżejjed bih innifsu, jew li għandu dehra ferrieħa u kunfidenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自鸣得意的；对自己过分满意的。
神气轻快的；显得愉快而自信的。

collocations.zh: 他显得自鸣得意或神气十足

formal.mt: Wara li rebaħ il-premju, Mark deher mseqqer, bħallikieku ħadd ma seta' jagħmel aħjar minnu.
formal.en: After winning the prize, Mark looked smug, as though nobody could do better than him.
formal.zh: 获奖后，马克显得自鸣得意，仿佛谁都不可能比他做得更好。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara lil Mark, kemm hu mseqqer bil-kappell il-ġdid! Nina: Iva, miexi qisu sejjer għal festa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at Mark, how jaunty he looks in his new hat! Nina: Yes, he's walking as if he's off to a party.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看看马克，戴着新帽子多神气！妮娜：是啊，他走起路来像要去参加派对一样。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara lil Mark, kemm hu mseqqer bil-kappell il-ġdid!
messages.mt_standard: Ara lil Mark, kemm hu mseqqer bil-kappell il-ġdid!
messages.zh: 看看马克，戴着新帽子多神气！
messages.en: Look at Mark, how jaunty he looks in his new hat!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, miexi qisu sejjer għal festa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, miexi qisu sejjer għal festa.
messages.zh: 是啊，他走起路来像要去参加派对一样。
messages.en: Yes, he's walking as if he's off to a party.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象获奖者昂着头走路：过分得意对应 smug，轻快神气对应 jaunty；用同一画面区分两种语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object used to hold or wind thread, such as a reel, spindle, or bobbin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于承载或缠绕线的器具，可指卷线轴、纺锤或筒管。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jintuża biex iżomm il-ħajt jew biex il-ħajt jitkebbeb fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷线轴；供线缠绕和收放的轴状器具。
纺锤；纺线时用于捻线或绕线的杆状器具。
筒管；用于绕线、容纳线的小线轴。

formal.mt: Qabel bdiet il-ħjata, il-ħajjata poġġiet mserka tal-ħajt abjad fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: Before starting to sew, the seamstress placed a reel of white thread on the table.
formal.zh: 开始缝纫前，女裁缝把一轴白线放在桌上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-mserka tal-ħajt blu? Rita: Fil-kaxxa tal-ħjata; ħdejnha hemm waħda vojta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's the reel of blue thread? Rita: In the sewing box; there's an empty one next to it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那轴蓝线在哪里？丽塔：在针线盒里，旁边还有一个空线轴。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.zh: 那轴蓝线在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the reel of blue thread?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kaxxa tal-ħjata; ħdejnha hemm waħda vojta.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kaxxa tal-ħjata; ħdejnha hemm waħda vojta.
messages.zh: 在针线盒里，旁边还有一个空线轴。
messages.en: In the sewing box; there's an empty one next to it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把线一圈圈绕在轴上来记 mserka：记住绕线这一共同功能，再按具体器具区分卷线轴、纺锤和筒管。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of cleaning or drying a surface by passing a cloth or similar material over it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用布或类似材料在物体表面擦动，以清洁或擦干的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tnaddaf jew tnixxef wiċċ billi tgħaddi ċarruta jew materjal simili fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擦拭；用布等擦净或擦干的动作。
腹泻；排便频繁且粪便稀薄的症状。

formal.mt: Il-msiħ tal-mejda b'ċarruta nadifa huwa l-aħħar pass fit-tindif tal-kamra.
formal.en: Wiping the table with a clean cloth is the final step in cleaning the room.
formal.zh: 用干净的布擦桌子是清洁房间的最后一步。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għad fadal ħafna xogħol? Pawlu: Il-msiħ tal-mejda biss, imbagħad inkunu lesti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there much work left? Pawlu: Just wiping the table, then we'll be done.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：还剩很多活吗？保罗：只剩擦桌子了，擦完我们就忙完了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 还剩很多活吗？
messages.en: Is there much work left?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-msiħ tal-mejda biss, imbagħad inkunu lesti.
messages.mt_standard: Il-msiħ tal-mejda biss, imbagħad inkunu lesti.
messages.zh: 只剩擦桌子了，擦完我们就忙完了。
messages.en: Just wiping the table, then we'll be done.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用抹布擦桌子的画面记住擦拭义；另设一张腹泻义卡片。两义分开记，遇到时靠上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition involving frequent bowel movements with loose or watery stools.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 排便次数增多，并伴随稀便或水样便的症状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha persuna tipporga ta' spiss u l-ippurgar ikun maħlul jew fih ħafna ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腹泻；频繁排出稀便或水样便。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent irrapporta msiħir li beda matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The patient reported diarrhoea that had started during the night.
formal.zh: 患者报告说，腹泻是在夜间开始的。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma ġejtx ilbieraħ? Mark: Kelli msiħir u bqajt id-dar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't you come yesterday? Mark: I had diarrhoea and stayed at home.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你昨天为什么没来？马克：我腹泻了，就待在家里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨天为什么没来？
messages.en: Why didn't you come yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我腹泻了，就待在家里。
messages.en: I had diarrhoea and stayed at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用因腹泻而留在家中的生活情景记 msiħir，再整句记住 Kelli msiħir，表示我当时腹泻了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be crushed or broken into smaller pieces by the teeth through chewing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物等受到牙齿的咀嚼，被嚼碎或嚼成更小的块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitgħaffeġ jew jinqasam f'biċċiet iżgħar bis-snien waqt il-magħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被咀嚼；受到牙齿的嚼动。

formal.mt: Il-ħobż mtagħad bil-mod qabel inbela'.
formal.en: The bread was chewed slowly before being swallowed.
formal.zh: 面包被慢慢咀嚼后才被吞下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'mtagħad' f'din is-sentenza? Toni: Li l-ikel ġie magħdud bis-snien; hawnhekk l-ikel jirċievi l-azzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'mtagħad' mean in this sentence? Toni: That the food was chewed with the teeth; here the food receives the action.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句话里的 mtagħad 是什么意思？托尼：意思是食物被牙齿咀嚼了；这里食物是动作的承受者。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 mtagħad 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mtagħad' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Li l-ikel ġie magħdud bis-snien; hawnhekk l-ikel jirċievi l-azzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Li l-ikel ġie magħdud bis-snien; hawnhekk l-ikel jirċievi l-azzjoni.
messages.zh: 意思是食物被牙齿咀嚼了；这里食物是动作的承受者。
messages.en: That the food was chewed with the teeth; here the food receives the action.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头对准嘴里的面包，记成面包被嚼；让食物站在句子中心，突出被咀嚼的承受关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of land that is not cultivated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有进行耕作的一块土地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa art li mhix maħduma għall-biedja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块未耕种的土地。

collocations.en: a small piece of uncultivated land
a piece of uncultivated land beside the farm
collocations.zh: 农场旁一块未耕种的土地

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi mtajra bejn ir-razzett u t-triq prinċipali.
formal.en: The map shows a piece of uncultivated land between the farm and the main road.
formal.zh: 地图标出农场与主路之间有一块未耕种的土地。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'hemm wara dik is-siġra? Pawlu: Hemm mtajra żgħira; din is-sena ħadd ma żera' xejn fiha.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's behind that tree? Pawlu: There's a small piece of uncultivated land; nobody has sown anything there this year.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那棵树后面有什么？保罗：有一小块未耕种的地，今年没人在那里播种。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.zh: 那棵树后面有什么？
messages.en: What's behind that tree?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm mtajra żgħira; din is-sena ħadd ma żera' xejn fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm mtajra żgħira; din is-sena ħadd ma żera' xejn fiha.
messages.zh: 有一小块未耕种的地，今年没人在那里播种。
messages.en: There's a small piece of uncultivated land; nobody has sown anything there this year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上圈出一块没有耕作的土地，把整个小地块贴上 mtajra 标签；重点记未耕种这一状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To delay doing something that needs to be done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把需要做的事情往后拖，迟迟不开始或不处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tħalli għal aktar tard xi ħaġa li għandha ssir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖延；把应当完成的事情一再推迟。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat mtal għal żmien twil qabel ħa deċiżjoni dwar il-proposta.
formal.en: The committee procrastinated for a long time before making a decision on the proposal.
formal.zh: 委员会拖延了很长时间，才对这项提案作出决定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark lesta r-rapport? Lara: Le, mtal għal darb'oħra u għadu lanqas beda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has Mark finished the report? Lara: No, he procrastinated again and hasn't even started yet.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克写完报告了吗？拉拉：没有，他又拖延了，到现在连开头都没写。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 马克写完报告了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark finished the report?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, mtal għal darb'oħra u għadu lanqas beda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, mtal għal darb'oħra u għadu lanqas beda.
messages.zh: 没有，他又拖延了，到现在连开头都没写。
messages.en: No, he procrastinated again and hasn't even started yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用待办事项不断被推到明天的画面记 mtal；心里配一句又拖了，强调该做却迟迟不做。

gloss_zh: 不透明的；蒙上水雾的；起雾的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not clear to see through, either because it is opaque or because mist has formed on its surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不能清楚透视的，可指本身不透明，也可指表面蒙上水雾而变得模糊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma tistax tara ċar minnu, għax ma jgħaddix id-dawl jew għax ikun hemm fwar fuq il-wiċċ tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不透明的；无法透过看清另一侧的。
表面蒙上薄薄水雾的，因而看起来模糊的。
起雾的；因表面凝结水汽而难以看清的。

collocations.zh: 不透明或蒙上水雾的玻璃

collocations.en: a mirror with a fogged-up surface

formal.mt: Il-ħġieġ tal-bieb huwa mtappan, għalhekk ma tistax tara ċar il-kamra minn barra.
formal.en: The glass in the door is opaque, so you cannot see the room clearly from outside.
formal.zh: 门上的玻璃不透明，因此从外面无法看清房间内部。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ma nistax nara minn din it-tieqa? Rita: Il-ħġieġ mtappan bil-fwar; imsaħu b'ċarruta.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why can't I see through this window? Rita: The glass is fogged up with steam; wipe it with a cloth.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我为什么看不透这扇窗？丽塔：玻璃被水汽蒙住了，用布擦一下。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax nara minn din it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax nara minn din it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 我为什么看不透这扇窗？
messages.en: Why can't I see through this window?

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 玻璃被水汽蒙住了，用布擦一下。
messages.en: The glass is fogged up with steam; wipe it with a cloth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mtappan 配上看不清对面的玻璃：本身不透明对应 opaque，表面起水雾对应另外两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a town and local council in Malta's Northern Region.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他北部地区的一个城镇及其地方议会的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' belt u kunsill lokali fir-Reġjun tat-Tramuntana ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Mtarfa (a town and local council of the Northern Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 姆塔尔法，马耳他北部地区的一个城镇及其地方议会。

collocations.zh: 到姆塔尔法的一次访问

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa mal-Kunsill Lokali tal-Imtarfa se ssir nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The meeting with Mtarfa Local Council will take place on Monday.
formal.zh: 与姆塔尔法地方议会的会议将于星期一举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer illum? Mark: Sejjer l-Imtarfa biex niltaqa' ma' ħabib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going today? Mark: I'm going to Mtarfa to meet a friend.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天去哪里？马克：我要去姆塔尔法见一位朋友。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer l-Imtarfa biex niltaqa' ma' ħabib.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer l-Imtarfa biex niltaqa' ma' ħabib.
messages.zh: 我要去姆塔尔法见一位朋友。
messages.en: I'm going to Mtarfa to meet a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mtarfa 当作地图上的专名来记：看到它，就联想到“去姆塔尔法见朋友”的路线画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have the hair arranged or untangled with a comb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头发经过梳子的梳理，变得整齐或不再打结。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu x-xagħar irranġat jew maħlul mill-għoqod permezz ta' moxt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被梳理；指头发经过梳子的整理。

formal.mt: Ix-xagħar tat-tifel mtaxat bil-galbu qabel ittieħed ir-ritratt.
formal.en: The boy's hair was carefully combed before the photograph was taken.
formal.zh: 拍照前，男孩的头发经过了仔细梳理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ix-xagħar ta' ħuk mtaxat qabel ir-ritratt? Mark: Iva, ommi għenitu jirranġah.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was your brother's hair combed before the photo? Mark: Yes, my mother helped him tidy it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你弟弟拍照前梳过头发了吗？马克：梳过了，我妈妈帮他整理的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xagħar ta' ħuk mtaxat qabel ir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xagħar ta' ħuk mtaxat qabel ir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 你弟弟拍照前梳过头发了吗？
messages.en: Was your brother's hair combed before the photo?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 梳过了，我妈妈帮他整理的。
messages.en: Yes, my mother helped him tidy it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拍照前梳子穿过头发的画面，把 mtaxat 与“头发被梳理过”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move into a lying position, or to lie down for a short sleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使身体处于躺卧姿势，也可指躺下来短暂睡一会儿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu pożizzjoni mimduda, jew jimtedd biex jorqod għal ftit ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 躺下；让身体由坐立等姿势转为躺卧。
小睡；短暂地睡一会儿。

collocations.en: lay down for a short rest after eating
collocations.zh: 饭后躺下休息了一会儿

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja, ir-raġel mtedd fuq is-sodda biex jistrieħ għal nofs siegħa.
formal.en: After the walk, the man lay down on the bed to rest for half an hour.
formal.zh: 散步后，那名男子躺到床上休息半小时。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Mark? Lara: Mtedd ftit wara l-ikel; qal li kien se jorqod għal għoxrin minuta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Mark? Lara: He lay down after lunch; he said he was going to sleep for twenty minutes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克在哪里？拉拉：他午饭后躺下了，说要睡二十分钟。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 马克在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Mark?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mtedd ftit wara l-ikel; qal li kien se jorqod għal għoxrin minuta.
messages.mt_standard: Mtedd ftit wara l-ikel; qal li kien se jorqod għal għoxrin minuta.
messages.zh: 他午饭后躺下了，说要睡二十分钟。
messages.en: He lay down after lunch; he said he was going to sleep for twenty minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用连续画面记 mtedd：先把身体放平“躺下”，再闭眼二十分钟“小睡”，两个义项连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become full of something, or, when referring to a person, to gain weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容器或空间被某物填满；用于人时，也可表示体重增加、长胖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir mimli b'xi ħaġa; meta jingħad għal persuna, jista' jfisser li żdied fil-piż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被装满、填满；由未满变为满的状态。
体重增加；长胖，身体变得更丰满。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita qawwija, il-ġibjun mtela bl-ilma.
formal.en: After the heavy rain, the reservoir filled up with water.
formal.zh: 大雨过后，蓄水池装满了水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-karozza tal-linja kienet vojta meta tlajt? Mark: Iva, imma wara żewġ waqfiet mtela kull post.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was the bus empty when you got on? Mark: Yes, but after two stops every seat was taken.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你上车时公交车是空的吗？马克：是啊，但过了两站，每个座位都坐满了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-karozza tal-linja kienet vojta meta tlajt?
messages.mt_standard: Il-karozza tal-linja kienet vojta meta tlajt?
messages.zh: 你上车时公交车是空的吗？
messages.en: Was the bus empty when you got on?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma wara żewġ waqfiet mtela kull post.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma wara żewġ waqfiet mtela kull post.
messages.zh: 是啊，但过了两站，每个座位都坐满了。
messages.en: Yes, but after two stops every seat was taken.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mtela 配上两个独立画面：水池变满、人的体重增加；用不同主语区分“装满”和“长胖”。

gloss_zh: 未按时付款的理由；逾期付款的辩解

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reason or excuse offered to explain why a payment was not made on time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为解释没有按时付款而提出的理由或辩解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġuni jew skuża mogħtija biex tispjega għaliex ħlas ma sarx fil-ħin.

sense_translations.en_definition: justification for failing to pay on time
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对未能按时付款所作的解释或辩解。

collocations.en: to give a justification for not paying on time
collocations.zh: 就未按时付款给出解释

formal.mt: Il-klijent ta mtil għall-ħlas tard u spjega li kien hemm żball fit-trasferiment bankarju.
formal.en: The customer gave a justification for the late payment and explained that there had been an error in the bank transfer.
formal.zh: 客户解释了逾期付款的原因，说明银行转账出现了错误。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'mtil ta Mark talli ma ħallasx fil-ħin? Maja: Qal li l-bank dam biex għadda l-flus.
colloquial.en: Lara: What reason did Mark give for not paying on time? Maja: He said the bank took a long time to transfer the money.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克对没按时付款给了什么解释？玛雅：他说银行转账花了很长时间。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'mtil ta Mark talli ma ħallasx fil-ħin?
messages.mt_standard: X'mtil ta Mark talli ma ħallasx fil-ħin?
messages.zh: 马克对没按时付款给了什么解释？
messages.en: What reason did Mark give for not paying on time?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal li l-bank dam biex għadda l-flus.
messages.mt_standard: Qal li l-bank dam biex għadda l-flus.
messages.zh: 他说银行转账花了很长时间。
messages.en: He said the bank took a long time to transfer the money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mtil 放在逾期账单旁边记：付款晚了，接着说明原因；记忆重点是“未按时付款的解释”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A furrow in cultivated land, or the strip of ground between furrows in a ploughed field.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 耕地上犁出的沟，也可指已犁田地中两条犁沟之间的地带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kanal magħmul bil-moħriet fil-ħamrija, jew il-medda ta' art bejn kanali bħal dawn f'għalqa maħruta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犁沟；用犁在田地里开出的长沟。

sense_translations.en_definition: space between furrows in a ploughed field
sense_translations.zh_definition: 已犁田地中犁沟之间的空地或地带。

collocations.en: the width of the strip between furrows

formal.mt: Il-bidwi għamel mtira fonda fil-ħamrija bil-moħriet.
formal.en: The farmer made a deep furrow in the soil with the plough.
formal.zh: 农民用犁在土里开出了一道深沟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-linja twila fil-ħamrija x'inhi? Pawlu: Dik mtira; għamiltha bil-moħriet dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this long line in the soil? Pawlu: That's a furrow; I made it with the plough this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：土里这条长长的线是什么？保罗：那是犁沟，我今天早上用犁开的。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 土里这条长长的线是什么？
messages.en: What is this long line in the soil?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.zh: 那是犁沟，我今天早上用犁开的。
messages.en: That's a furrow; I made it with the plough this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画几条平行犁沟来记 mtira：先指沟，再指沟与沟之间的地带；两个义项要结合上下文辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A supply of food prepared or kept for use when needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为旅途、日常需要或其他情况预先备好的食物供应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Provvista ta' ikel imħejjija jew miżmuma biex tintuża meta jkun hemm bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预先准备的食物供应；口粮或食物储备。

formal.mt: Il-grupp ħejja muna biżżejjed għal tlett ijiem qabel telaq għall-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The group prepared enough food provisions for three days before setting off on the journey.
formal.zh: 出发前，团队准备了足够吃三天的口粮。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandna muna biżżejjed għall-vjaġġ? Pawlu: Iva, ħejjejt ħobż, frott u ftit ġobon.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do we have enough food provisions for the journey? Pawlu: Yes, I prepared bread, fruit and some cheese.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我们旅途中的口粮够吗？保罗：够，我准备了面包、水果和一些奶酪。

messages.speaker: Marija (旅伴)
messages.zh: 我们旅途中的口粮够吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough food provisions for the journey?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħejjejt ħobż, frott u ftit ġobon.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħejjejt ħobż, frott u ftit ġobon.
messages.zh: 够，我准备了面包、水果和一些奶酪。
messages.en: Yes, I prepared bread, fruit and some cheese.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 muna 和出发前装满食物的背包联系起来，记住它强调备好供需要时食用的口粮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who climbs mountains, especially as a regular activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事攀登山峰活动的人，尤其指经常登山的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titla' fuq il-muntanji, speċjalment bħala attività regolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 登山者；从事登山活动的人。

formal.mt: Muntanar b'esperjenza mexxa l-grupp lejn il-quċċata u ċċekkja t-tagħmir qabel it-tluq.
formal.en: An experienced mountaineer led the group towards the summit and checked the equipment before departure.
formal.zh: 一位经验丰富的登山者带领团队前往山顶，并在出发前检查了装备。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jiġi magħna fuq il-muntanja? Mark: Ħija; huwa muntanar b'esperjenza u jaf it-triq sew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is coming up the mountain with us? Mark: My brother; he is an experienced mountaineer and knows the route well.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁会和我们一起上山？马克：我哥哥，他是经验丰富的登山者，很熟悉路线。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jiġi magħna fuq il-muntanja?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jiġi magħna fuq il-muntanja?
messages.zh: 谁会和我们一起上山？
messages.en: Who is coming up the mountain with us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija; huwa muntanar b'esperjenza u jaf it-triq sew.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija; huwa muntanar b'esperjenza u jaf it-triq sew.
messages.zh: 我哥哥，他是经验丰富的登山者，很熟悉路线。
messages.en: My brother; he is an experienced mountaineer and knows the route well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象背着绳索走向山顶的人，把 muntanar 牢牢记成登山者这个人物名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having many mountains or a landscape dominated by mountains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有许多山，或地貌以山地为主的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna muntanji jew pajsaġġ magħmul l-aktar minn muntanji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多山的；以山地为主要地貌的。

formal.mt: F'dan ir-reġjun muntanjuż, il-bini tat-toroq jeħtieġ ippjanar bir-reqqa.
formal.en: In this mountainous region, road construction requires careful planning.
formal.zh: 在这个多山的地区，修建道路需要周密规划。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-vjaġġ bil-karozza jieħu daqshekk ħin? Toni: Għax dan ir-reġjun huwa muntanjuż u t-toroq għandhom ħafna liwjiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the drive take so long? Toni: Because this region is mountainous and the roads have many bends.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么开车要花这么长时间？托尼：因为这个地区多山，道路有很多弯。

messages.speaker: Lara (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-vjaġġ bil-karozza jieħu daqshekk ħin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-vjaġġ bil-karozza jieħu daqshekk ħin?
messages.zh: 为什么开车要花这么长时间？
messages.en: Why does the drive take so long?

messages.speaker: Toni (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dan ir-reġjun huwa muntanjuż u t-toroq għandhom ħafna liwjiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dan ir-reġjun huwa muntanjuż u t-toroq għandhom ħafna liwjiet.
messages.zh: 因为这个地区多山，道路有很多弯。
messages.en: Because this region is mountainous and the roads have many bends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 muntanjuż 放在一张满是山峰的地图旁，练说多山的国家、多山的地区，记住它描述地貌。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person from Munxar, a locality on Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自戈佐岛蒙沙尔（Munxar）的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġejja mill-Munxar, lokalità f'Għawdex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自戈佐岛蒙沙尔的人。

collocations.en: a person from Munxar on Gozo
collocations.zh: 来自戈佐岛蒙沙尔的人

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, Munxari tkellem dwar il-ħajja ta' kuljum fil-lokalità tiegħu.
formal.en: During the meeting, a person from Munxar spoke about daily life in his locality.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一位蒙沙尔人介绍了当地的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Int minn liema lokalità f'Għawdex? Pawlu: Jien Munxari, mill-Munxar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which locality on Gozo are you from? Pawlu: I am from Munxar.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你来自戈佐岛的哪个地方？保罗：我是蒙沙尔人，来自蒙沙尔。

messages.speaker: Nina (新朋友)
messages.zh: 你来自戈佐岛的哪个地方？
messages.en: Which locality on Gozo are you from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (蒙沙尔居民)
messages.zh: 我是蒙沙尔人，来自蒙沙尔。
messages.en: I am from Munxar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位自我介绍说来自蒙沙尔的人，把 Munxari 和人物名牌配对，记住这里指当地人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A quantity of things placed together, either in a stack or in a heap.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在一起的一批东西，可以整齐叠成一摞，也可以聚成一堆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd ta' affarijiet imqiegħda flimkien jew waħda fuq l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一摞；由物品上下叠放而成的堆叠。
一堆；聚在一起、未必整齐排列的东西。

formal.mt: Fuq l-iskrivanija kien hemm munzell kotba mqiegħda waħda fuq l-oħra, u fil-bitħa kien hemm munzell ġebel.
formal.en: On the desk there was a stack of books placed one on top of another, and in the courtyard there was a heap of stones.
formal.zh: 书桌上有一摞上下叠放的书，院子里有一堆石头。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-kotba? Ben: Poġġihom f'munzell fuq il-mejda; wara nqegħduhom fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where should I put these books? Ben: Put them in a stack on the table; we will put them on the shelf later.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这些书放在哪里？本：把它们摞在桌上，我们待会儿再放到书架上。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 这些书放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these books?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġihom f'munzell fuq il-mejda; wara nqegħduhom fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġihom f'munzell fuq il-mejda; wara nqegħduhom fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 把它们摞在桌上，我们待会儿再放到书架上。
messages.en: Put them in a stack on the table; we will put them on the shelf later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中并排放一摞整齐的书和一堆散石头，两种画面都配上 munzell，记住它可以表示摞或堆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of placing things one on top of another or gathering them into heaps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品上下叠放，或把东西聚成堆的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li tqiegħed affarijiet waħda fuq l-oħra jew tiġborhom f'munzelli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 堆叠；把物品一件叠在另一件上面的活动。
堆积；把东西聚拢成堆的活动。

formal.mt: Il-munzellar tal-kaxxi għandu jsir b'attenzjoni biex ma jaqgħux.
formal.en: The stacking of boxes should be carried out carefully so that they do not fall.
formal.zh: 堆叠箱子时应小心操作，以免箱子倒下。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Lestejt il-munzellar tal-kaxxi? Samwel: Kważi; fadal żewġ kaxxi, u mbagħad nista' nnaddaf l-art.
colloquial.en: Rita: Have you finished stacking the boxes? Samwel: Almost; there are two boxes left, and then I can clean the floor.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你把箱子堆好了吗？萨姆韦尔：快了，还剩两个箱子，之后我就可以清扫地面了。

messages.speaker: Rita (仓库同事)
messages.zh: 你把箱子堆好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished stacking the boxes?

messages.speaker: Samwel (仓库同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; fadal żewġ kaxxi, u mbagħad nista' nnaddaf l-art.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; fadal żewġ kaxxi, u mbagħad nista' nnaddaf l-art.
messages.zh: 快了，还剩两个箱子，之后我就可以清扫地面了。
messages.en: Almost; there are two boxes left, and then I can clean the floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一段不断把箱子往上放的短片记 munzellar，关注堆叠这项活动，也可联想把石头聚成堆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with a sharp blade used to shave hair, especially facial hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有锋利刀刃、用于剃除毛发，尤其是胡须的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'xafra li tintuża biex jitqaxxar ix-xagħar, speċjalment il-leħja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剃须刀；用于剃除胡须等毛发的刀具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda b'xafra biex titqaxxar il-leħja jew xagħar ieħor.

formal.mt: Wara l-użu, il-mus tal-leħja għandu jitnaddaf u jinħażen f'post xott.
formal.en: After use, the razor should be cleaned and stored in a dry place.
formal.zh: 剃须刀使用后应清洁干净，并存放在干燥处。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn qiegħed il-mus tal-leħja tiegħi? Sara: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-mera; poġġejtu hemm dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is my razor? Sara: In the drawer next to the mirror; I put it there this morning.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我的剃须刀在哪儿？萨拉：在镜子旁边的抽屉里，我今天早上放进去的。

messages.speaker: Mark (丈夫)
messages.zh: 我的剃须刀在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is my razor?

messages.speaker: Sara (妻子)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-mera; poġġejtu hemm dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-mera; poġġejtu hemm dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 在镜子旁边的抽屉里，我今天早上放进去的。
messages.en: In the drawer next to the mirror; I put it there this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mus tal-leħja 整组放进浴室镜前剃胡须的画面，连同工具用途一起记。

gloss_zh: 原未耕作而现已开垦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing land or soil that was previously untilled and has been brought under cultivation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容原先未经耕作、现已开垦并开始用于种植的土地或土壤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal raba' li qabel ma kienx jinħadem u li ddaħħal fil-kultivazzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: previously untilled: soil brought under cultivation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指原先未经耕作、现已被开垦并投入耕种的土壤。

collocations.en: previously untilled land brought under cultivation
collocations.zh: 由未耕地开垦而成的农田

collocations.en: the cultivation of previously untilled land
collocations.zh: 对原未耕作土地的耕种

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi raba' musan li qabel ma kienx jinħadem u li issa qed jintuża għat-tkabbir tal-ħaxix.
formal.en: The report describes previously untilled land that has been brought under cultivation and is now being used to grow vegetables.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一片原先未经耕作、现已开垦用于种植蔬菜的土地。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi jfisser raba' musan? Ġużeppi: Raba' li qabel ma kienx jinħadem u li issa ddaħħal fil-kultivazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does raba' musan mean? Ġużeppi: Land that was previously untilled and has now been brought under cultivation.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：raba' musan 是什么意思？朱塞佩：指原先没有耕作、现在已经开垦种植的土地。

messages.speaker: Lina (农业学生)
messages.zh: raba' musan 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does raba' musan mean?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农业教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Raba' li qabel ma kienx jinħadem u li issa ddaħħal fil-kultivazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Raba' li qabel ma kienx jinħadem u li issa ddaħħal fil-kultivazzjoni.
messages.zh: 指原先没有耕作、现在已经开垦种植的土地。
messages.en: Land that was previously untilled and has now been brought under cultivation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给同一块地画前后两幅图：从前没有耕作，现在开始种菜；把 musan 写在变化后的土地旁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作个人家族姓氏的名称，中文可音译为穆斯卡特。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala l-isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏：穆斯卡特。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Muscat ippreżenta d-dokumenti meħtieġa fl-uffiċċju.
formal.en: Mr Muscat submitted the required documents at the office.
formal.zh: 穆斯卡特先生在办公室提交了所需文件。

colloquial.mt: Marta: B'liema kunjom għamilt ir-riservazzjoni? Daniel: Muscat; ir-riservazzjoni hija għal erba' persuni.
colloquial.en: Marta: Under what surname did you make the reservation? Daniel: Muscat; the reservation is for four people.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你用什么姓氏订的位？丹尼尔：穆斯卡特，订的是四人位。

messages.speaker: Marta (餐厅接待员)
messages.zh: 你用什么姓氏订的位？
messages.en: Under what surname did you make the reservation?

messages.speaker: Daniel (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Muscat; ir-riservazzjoni hija għal erba' persuni.
messages.mt_standard: Muscat; ir-riservazzjoni hija għal erba' persuni.
messages.zh: 穆斯卡特，订的是四人位。
messages.en: Muscat; the reservation is for four people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象餐厅订位簿的姓氏栏里写着 Muscat，再配读穆斯卡特先生，记住这里是姓氏且首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a pale or sallow complexion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人的脸色苍白，或呈现不健康的淡黄色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu wiċċ pallidu jew safrani.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苍白的；面部缺少血色的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu wiċċ pallidu, bi ftit kulur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脸色蜡黄的；肤色呈现不健康的淡黄色的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu lewn safrani f'wiċċu u jidher bla saħħa.

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, ir-raġel jidher musfar taħt id-dawl qawwi tal-kamra.
formal.en: In the photograph, the man looks pale under the room's bright light.
formal.zh: 照片中，那个男人在房间的强光下显得脸色苍白。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum tidher musfar, Mark. Kif qed tħossok? Mark: Għajjien ħafna; se nistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: You look pale today, Mark. How are you feeling? Mark: Very tired; I'm going to rest for a while.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克，你今天脸色很苍白。感觉怎么样？马克：很累，我打算休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum tidher musfar, Mark. Kif qed tħossok?
messages.mt_standard: Illum tidher musfar, Mark. Kif qed tħossok?
messages.zh: 马克，你今天脸色很苍白。感觉怎么样？
messages.en: You look pale today, Mark. How are you feeling?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 很累，我打算休息一会儿。
messages.en: Very tired; I'm going to rest for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张缺少血色、略显蜡黄的脸，用“wiċċ musfar”把两种脸色一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A writing system that uses wedge-shaped signs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用楔形符号记录语言的一种文字书写系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' kitba li tuża sinjali f'forma ta' feles.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 楔形文字书写系统；以楔形符号构成的文字系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema ta' kitba magħmula minn sinjali f'forma ta' feles.

collocations.en: the signs of the cuneiform writing system

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jintroduċi l-musmarija u jispjega kif is-sinjali tagħha jintużaw biex jirrappreżentaw il-lingwa.
formal.en: The chapter introduces the cuneiform writing system and explains how its signs are used to represent language.
formal.zh: 本章介绍楔形文字书写系统，并解释如何用其中的符号记录语言。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi l-musmarija? Pawlu: Hija sistema ta' kitba b'sinjali f'forma ta' feles. Ejja naraw l-eżempju fil-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is cuneiform writing? Pawlu: It's a writing system with wedge-shaped signs. Let's look at the example in the book.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：什么是楔形文字？保罗：是一种使用楔形符号的文字系统。我们看看书里的例子吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是楔形文字？
messages.en: What is cuneiform writing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija sistema ta' kitba b'sinjali f'forma ta' feles. Ejja naraw l-eżempju fil-ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Hija sistema ta' kitba b'sinjali f'forma ta' feles. Ejja naraw l-eżempju fil-ktieb.
messages.zh: 是一种使用楔形符号的文字系统。我们看看书里的例子吧。
messages.en: It's a writing system with wedge-shaped signs. Let's look at the example in the book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一排排楔形符号想象成一页文字，看到 musmarija 就联想整套书写系统。

gloss_zh: 长期患病的；患慢性病的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an illness that continues over a long period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容长期处于患病状态的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ilu marid għal żmien twil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长期患病的；患有持续时间较长的疾病的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jbati minn mard li jdum għal żmien twil.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-appoġġ ta' kuljum li jeħtieġ pazjent musraġ.
formal.en: The report describes the daily support that a chronically ill patient needs.
formal.zh: 报告说明了一名长期患病的患者所需的日常支持。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif inhu missierek? Ġużeppi: Għadu musraġ, imma jieħu gost ħafna meta nżuruh.
colloquial.en: Nina: How is your father? Ġużeppi: He's still chronically ill, but he really enjoys it when we visit him.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你父亲怎么样？朱塞佩：他仍长期受病痛困扰，不过我们去看他时，他都很开心。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你父亲怎么样？
messages.en: How is your father?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu musraġ, imma jieħu gost ħafna meta nżuruh.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu musraġ, imma jieħu gost ħafna meta nżuruh.
messages.zh: 他仍长期受病痛困扰，不过我们去看他时，他都很开心。
messages.en: He's still chronically ill, but he really enjoys it when we visit him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画满许多月份的日历联想 musraġ，重点记住患病状态持续很久。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large tomb building containing one or more burial places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 内设一个或多个安葬处的大型陵墓建筑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini kbir li fih qabar wieħed jew aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陵墓；容纳一个或多个墓葬的大型建筑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bini kbir mibni biex fih ikun hemm qabar wieħed jew aktar.

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi d-daħla tal-musulew u l-oqbra li jinsabu ġewwa fih.
formal.en: The plan shows the entrance to the mausoleum and the tombs inside it.
formal.zh: 平面图标出了陵墓的入口及其内部的墓葬。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dak il-bini kbir x'inhu? Toni: Musulew tal-familja. Id-daħla tiegħu tinsab fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Elena: What is that large building? Toni: A family mausoleum. Its entrance is on the other side.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：那座大建筑是什么？托尼：一座家族陵墓，入口在另一侧。

messages.speaker: Elena (游客)
messages.zh: 那座大建筑是什么？
messages.en: What is that large building?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Musulew tal-familja. Id-daħla tiegħu tinsab fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Musulew tal-familja. Id-daħla tiegħu tinsab fuq in-naħa l-oħra.
messages.zh: 一座家族陵墓，入口在另一侧。
messages.en: A family mausoleum. Its entrance is on the other side.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 musulew 联想成能走到入口前、内部设有墓葬的一整座陵墓建筑。

gloss_zh: 污脏得遮住原有颜色的

teaching_sense.en_definition: So dirty or soiled that the original colours are obscured.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物品沾染污垢，以至于原来的颜色变得模糊、不易看清。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tant hu maħmuġ li l-kuluri tiegħu ma jidhrux ċari.

sense_translations.en_definition: soiled and dirty, with colours obscured
sense_translations.zh_definition: 污秽肮脏的，且污垢遮住了原有颜色的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Maħmuġ u mtebba', bil-kuluri mgħottija mill-ħmieġ.

collocations.en: a cloth so dirty that its colours are obscured
a carpet with its colours obscured by dirt

formal.mt: It-tapit kien muswied, u l-kuluri oriġinali tiegħu dehru biss wara t-tindif.
formal.en: The carpet was so dirty that its colours were obscured, and its original colours became visible only after cleaning.
formal.zh: 地毯脏得遮住了原来的颜色，清洁后才显露出原色。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan id-drapp muswied; bilkemm jidher il-kulur tiegħu. Ben: Ejja naħsluh, ħalli naraw kif kien qabel.
colloquial.en: Rita: This cloth is so dirty you can barely see its colour. Ben: Let's wash it so we can see what it looked like before.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这块布脏得几乎看不出原来的颜色了。本：我们洗一洗，看看它原来是什么样子吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-drapp muswied; bilkemm jidher il-kulur tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-drapp muswied; bilkemm jidher il-kulur tiegħu.
messages.zh: 这块布脏得几乎看不出原来的颜色了。
messages.en: This cloth is so dirty you can barely see its colour.

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naħsluh, ħalli naraw kif kien qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naħsluh, ħalli naraw kif kien qabel.
messages.zh: 我们洗一洗，看看它原来是什么样子吧。
messages.en: Let's wash it so we can see what it looked like before.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象彩色地毯被污垢盖住，洗后才露出颜色；muswied 的重点是脏到遮色。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作家族姓氏的专有名称，书写时首字母大写为 Musù。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala isem tal-familja u jinkiteb Musù.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个姓氏，写作 Musù。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kunjom: Musù.

formal.mt: Is-Sur Musù talab kopja tad-dokument għall-fajl tiegħu.
formal.en: Mr Musù requested a copy of the document for his file.
formal.zh: Musù 先生申请了一份文件副本，以便存入自己的档案。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu l-kunjom tiegħek, jekk jogħġbok? David: Musù. Anna: Grazzi, Sur Musù.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is your surname, please? David: Musù. Anna: Thank you, Mr Musù.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：请问您贵姓？戴维：Musù。安娜：谢谢您，Musù 先生。

messages.speaker: Anna (接待员)
messages.zh: 请问您贵姓？
messages.en: What is your surname, please?

messages.speaker: David (访客)
messages.zh: Musù。
messages.en: Musù.

messages.speaker: Anna (接待员)
messages.zh: 谢谢您，Musù 先生。
messages.en: Thank you, Mr Musù.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象登记表的姓氏栏写着 Musù，记住大写开头和末尾 ù 上的重音符号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having dust on the surface or being covered with dust.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容表面有灰尘或被灰尘覆盖的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-trab fuqu jew hu miksi bit-trab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有灰尘的；积灰的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu t-trab fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被灰尘覆盖的；表面蒙着灰尘的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li hu miksi bit-trab.

collocations.zh: 一个蒙着灰尘的置物架

formal.mt: Waqt it-tindif tal-librerija, instab ktieb mutrab fuq l-ogħla xkaffa.
formal.en: During the cleaning of the library, a dusty book was found on the highest shelf.
formal.zh: 清扫图书馆时，人们在最高一层书架上发现了一本积灰的书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb mutrab ħafna. Ilu hawn? Mark: Iva, ilu xhur fuq l-ixkaffa. Se nimsaħlu t-trab.
colloquial.en: Maja: This book is very dusty. Has it been here long? Mark: Yes, it's been on the shelf for months. I'll wipe the dust off it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书积了好多灰。放在这里很久了吗？马克：是的，在架子上放了几个月了。我来把灰擦掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb mutrab ħafna. Ilu hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb mutrab ħafna. Ilu hawn?
messages.zh: 这本书积了好多灰。放在这里很久了吗？
messages.en: This book is very dusty. Has it been here long?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilu xhur fuq l-ixkaffa. Se nimsaħlu t-trab.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilu xhur fuq l-ixkaffa. Se nimsaħlu t-trab.
messages.zh: 是的，在架子上放了几个月了。我来把灰擦掉。
messages.en: Yes, it's been on the shelf for months. I'll wipe the dust off it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手指划过旧书封面，留下一条清晰的擦痕，用这个积灰画面记住 mutrab。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a lot of hair on the body or on a particular part of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体或身体某个部位长有很多毛的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna xagħar fuq ġismu jew fuq xi parti minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多毛的；长有浓密毛发的。

formal.mt: Il-kelb muxgħar jeħtieġ kura regolari biex ix-xagħar tiegħu jibqa' nadif u ma jitħabbilx.
formal.en: The hairy dog needs regular grooming to keep its coat clean and free of tangles.
formal.zh: 这只毛发浓密的狗需要定期梳理，以保持毛发清洁、不打结。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu muxgħar il-kelb tiegħek! Mark: Iva, irrid infarfar ix-xagħar tiegħu kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your dog is so hairy! Mark: Yes, I have to brush his coat every day.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的狗毛真多！Mark：是啊，我每天都得给它梳毛。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的狗毛真多！
messages.en: Your dog is so hairy!

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irrid infarfar ix-xagħar tiegħu kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irrid infarfar ix-xagħar tiegħu kuljum.
messages.zh: 是啊，我每天都得给它梳毛。
messages.en: Yes, I have to brush his coat every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 muxgħar 和一只需要天天梳毛的狗联系起来，记住它描述的是毛发多，而不是身体胖。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Experiencing pain, or describing a part of the body that hurts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人正在感到疼痛，或形容身体某个部位疼痛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li qiegħed iħoss uġigħ, jew li jiddeskrivi parti tal-ġisem li tweġġa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于疼痛之中；感到疼痛的。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent qal li kien għadu muġugħ wara l-operazzjoni.
formal.en: The patient said that he was still in pain after the operation.
formal.zh: 患者表示，手术后他仍然感到疼痛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu dahrek illum? Mark: Għadu muġugħ, speċjalment meta noqgħod bilqiegħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is your back today? Mark: It's still sore, especially when I sit down.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天背部感觉怎么样？马克：还是疼，尤其是坐下的时候。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天背部感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How is your back today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu muġugħ, speċjalment meta noqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu muġugħ, speċjalment meta noqgħod bilqiegħda.
messages.zh: 还是疼，尤其是坐下的时候。
messages.en: It's still sore, especially when I sit down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 muġugħ 贴在“扶着疼痛的背部”的画面上，连着 dahar muġugħ 一起记住疼痛状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The personal name Muhammad, written Muħammed in Maltese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人名“穆罕默德”，在马耳他语中写作 Muħammed。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' persuna, li bl-Ingliż jinkiteb Muhammad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穆罕默德，人名。

formal.mt: Muħammed bagħat l-applikazzjoni tiegħu lill-uffiċċju qabel l-aħħar jum.
formal.en: Muhammad sent his application to the office before the final day.
formal.zh: 穆罕默德在截止日之前向办公室提交了申请。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jismu l-istudent il-ġdid? Lara: Jismu Muħammed; se joqgħod ħdejna fil-klassi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the new student's name? Lara: His name is Muhammad; he'll sit next to us in class.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新同学叫什么名字？拉拉：他叫穆罕默德，上课时会坐在我们旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 新同学叫什么名字？
messages.en: What's the new student's name?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jismu Muħammed; se joqgħod ħdejna fil-klassi.
messages.mt_standard: Jismu Muħammed; se joqgħod ħdejna fil-klassi.
messages.zh: 他叫穆罕默德，上课时会坐在我们旁边。
messages.en: His name is Muhammad; he'll sit next to us in class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把中文“穆罕默德”、英文 Muhammad 和马耳他语 Muħammed 写在同一张姓名卡上，特别留意 ħ 和双写 mm。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing or covered with many small stones or pieces of gravel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 含有或覆盖着许多小石子、碎石或砂砾的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih jew fuqu jkun hemm ħafna żrar jew ġebel żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 满是砂砾或小石子的；多碎石的。

formal.mt: Il-passaġġ mużrar iwassal sal-bajja, iżda jeħtieġ żraben adattati għall-mixi.
formal.en: The gravelly path leads to the beach, but suitable walking shoes are needed.
formal.zh: 这条多碎石的小路通往海滩，但行走时需要穿合适的鞋。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed timxi daqshekk bil-mod? Toni: Dan il-passaġġ mużrar, u l-ġebel qed jidħol fiż-żraben tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you walking so slowly? Toni: This path is full of small stones, and they keep getting into my shoes.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你怎么走得这么慢？Toni：这条路满是小石子，石子老是跑进我的鞋里。

messages.speaker: Sara (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Toni (徒步者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-passaġġ mużrar, u l-ġebel qed jidħol fiż-żraben tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-passaġġ mużrar, u l-ġebel qed jidħol fiż-żraben tiegħi.
messages.zh: 这条路满是小石子，石子老是跑进我的鞋里。
messages.en: This path is full of small stones, and they keep getting into my shoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mużrar 记成走路时鞋里不断进小石子的路面，抓住满是碎石这一触觉画面。

gloss_zh: 玻璃般的；呈玻璃质感的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling glass in appearance, especially by being smooth, shiny, or clear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外观像玻璃的，尤其指表面光滑、明亮或清澈的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher bħall-ħġieġ, speċjalment għax ikun lixx, ileqq jew ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玻璃般的；具有玻璃般光泽、光滑度或透明感的。

formal.mt: Filgħodu, il-wiċċ mużġieġ tal-lag kien jirrifletti s-siġar ta' madwaru.
formal.en: In the morning, the glassy surface of the lake reflected the surrounding trees.
formal.zh: 清晨，玻璃般平滑的湖面映照着周围的树木。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara kemm hu mużġieġ wiċċ l-ilma llum! Pawlu: Veru, tista' tara s-sħab rifless fih.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look how glassy the water's surface is today! Pawlu: True, you can see the clouds reflected in it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看，今天的水面多像玻璃！Pawlu：真的，都能看见云的倒影。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hu mużġieġ wiċċ l-ilma llum!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hu mużġieġ wiċċ l-ilma llum!
messages.zh: 看，今天的水面多像玻璃！
messages.en: Look how glassy the water's surface is today!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, tista' tara s-sħab rifless fih.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, tista' tara s-sħab rifless fih.
messages.zh: 真的，都能看见云的倒影。
messages.en: True, you can see the clouds reflected in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象湖面平静得像一整块玻璃，用这个画面记住 mużġieġ 的玻璃般质感。

gloss_zh: 偏僻的；搁置的；被排除的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Away from other people or places; put to one side; or excluded from a group or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指地方远离人群、较为偏僻，也指东西被放在一旁，或人被排除在群体、活动之外。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab 'il bogħod min-nies jew minn postijiet oħra; li tqiegħed fil-ġenb; jew li tħalla barra minn grupp jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 僻静的；远离人群或其他地方的。
被放在一旁的；被搁置或留待以后处理的。
被排除在外的；未被纳入群体或活动的。

formal.mt: Il-proġett baqa' mwarrab sakemm il-kumitat seta' jeżamina l-ispejjeż tiegħu.
formal.en: The project remained set aside until the committee could examine its costs.
formal.zh: 该项目一直处于搁置状态，等待委员会审查其成本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma ġejtx magħna lbieraħ? Mark: Ħadd ma stedinni, u ħassejtni mwarrab.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't you come with us yesterday? Mark: Nobody invited me, and I felt excluded.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你昨天怎么没跟我们一起去？Mark：没人邀请我，我觉得自己被排除在外了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你昨天怎么没跟我们一起去？
messages.en: Why didn't you come with us yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadd ma stedinni, u ħassejtni mwarrab.
messages.mt_standard: Ħadd ma stedinni, u ħassejtni mwarrab.
messages.zh: 没人邀请我，我觉得自己被排除在外了。
messages.en: Nobody invited me, and I felt excluded.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用在一旁的画面串联 mwarrab：村庄远在一旁是偏僻，项目放在一旁是搁置，人被留在一旁是受排除。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small weighing scale or balance used to measure the weight of small objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来测量小件物品重量的小型秤或天平；是 miżien 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżien żgħir li jintuża biex jitkejlu l-piżijiet ta' oġġetti żgħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: small weighing scales (the diminutive form of 'miżien')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小型秤或小天平，是 miżien 的指小形式。

collocations.en: to weigh using a small scale

formal.mt: Il-ġojjellier uża mwejżen preċiż biex jiżen iċ-ċurkett qabel it-tiswija.
formal.en: The jeweller used a precise small scale to weigh the ring before the repair.
formal.zh: 珠宝匠在维修前用一台精确的小秤称量了戒指。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu l-mwejżen? Irrid niżen din il-katina. Toni: Qiegħed fil-kexxun ħdejn il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where's the small scale? I want to weigh this chain. Toni: It's in the drawer next to the table.
colloquial.zh: Sara：小秤在哪里？我想称一下这条链子。Toni：在桌子旁边的抽屉里。

messages.speaker: Sara (珠宝店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-mwejżen? Irrid niżen din il-katina.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-mwejżen? Irrid niżen din il-katina.
messages.zh: 小秤在哪里？我想称一下这条链子。
messages.en: Where's the small scale? I want to weigh this chain.

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 在桌子旁边的抽屉里。
messages.en: It's in the drawer next to the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mwejżen 想成抽屉里专门称戒指的小秤，并与 miżien 对照记忆，突出体积小这一点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suffering physical injury or feeling emotional pain because of something that happened or was said.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体受了伤的，或因某件事、某些话而感到情感上受伤的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ġrieħi jew uġigħ fil-ġisem, jew li jħoss uġigħ emozzjonali minħabba xi ġrajja jew kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体受伤的；有伤的。
受伤或感到疼痛的；也指感情受到伤害的。

formal.mt: Il-plejer mweġġa' ħareġ mill-grawnd biex jirċievi l-kura.
formal.en: The injured player left the pitch to receive treatment.
formal.zh: 受伤的球员离开球场接受治疗。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek irrabjat minħabba dak li għedt? Pawlu: M'iniex irrabjat, imma għadni mweġġa'.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you still angry about what I said? Pawlu: I'm not angry, but I'm still hurt.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你还在为我说的话生气吗？Pawlu：我没生气，但心里还是很受伤。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek irrabjat minħabba dak li għedt?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek irrabjat minħabba dak li għedt?
messages.zh: 你还在为我说的话生气吗？
messages.en: Are you still angry about what I said?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我没生气，但心里还是很受伤。
messages.en: I'm not angry, but I'm still hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 mweġġa' 配两幅图：球员捂着伤腿，朋友捂着胸口；分别帮助记住身体受伤和心里受伤。

gloss_zh: 出生的；生于某地或某时的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having come into the world through birth, often with a stated place or date.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经出生的，常与地点或时间连用，说明生于何地或何时。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġie fid-dinja permezz tat-twelid, spiss b'indikazzjoni tal-post jew tad-data.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出生的；生于某地或某个时间的。

formal.mt: L-awtur huwa mwieled f'Malta fl-2000 u jikteb stejjer għat-tfal.
formal.en: The author was born in Malta in 2000 and writes stories for children.
formal.zh: 这位作者于2000年出生在马耳他，创作儿童故事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int mwieled Għawdex? Mark: Iva, imma trabbejt Malta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Were you born in Gozo? Mark: Yes, but I grew up in Malta.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你是在戈佐岛出生的吗？Mark：是的，不过我是在马耳他岛长大的。

messages.speaker: Maja (新朋友)
messages.zh: 你是在戈佐岛出生的吗？
messages.en: Were you born in Gozo?

messages.speaker: Mark (新朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，不过我是在马耳他岛长大的。
messages.en: Yes, but I grew up in Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出生证明上的出生地点和出生日期，把 mwieled 与这两栏绑定，练习接地点或年份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely wicked or cruel, as if inspired by a devil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容行为、想法或计划极其邪恶、残酷，如同恶魔所为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħażin jew kattiv ħafna, bħallikieku ġej mix-xitan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶魔般的；极其邪恶或残酷的

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru ewlieni jikxef pjan mxajtan biex jinqerdu l-għajxien u r-reputazzjoni ta' familja innoċenti.
formal.en: In the novel, the main character uncovers a diabolical plan to destroy an innocent family's livelihood and reputation.
formal.zh: 小说中，主人公揭露了一个极其邪恶的计划，企图毁掉一个无辜家庭的生计和名誉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak il-karattru ried iweġġa' lill-familja kollha apposta. Mark: Iva, kellu pjan mxajtan. Biex tagħmel hekk trid tkun tassew kattiv.
colloquial.en: Lara: That character wanted to hurt the whole family on purpose. Mark: Yes, he had a diabolical plan. You have to be really cruel to do that.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个角色竟然想故意伤害全家人。马克：对，他有个极其邪恶的计划。能做出这种事，真是太残忍了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-karattru ried iweġġa' lill-familja kollha apposta.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-karattru ried iweġġa' lill-familja kollha apposta.
messages.zh: 那个角色竟然想故意伤害全家人。
messages.en: That character wanted to hurt the whole family on purpose.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kellu pjan mxajtan. Biex tagħmel hekk trid tkun tassew kattiv.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kellu pjan mxajtan. Biex tagħmel hekk trid tkun tassew kattiv.
messages.zh: 对，他有个极其邪恶的计划。能做出这种事，真是太残忍了。
messages.en: Yes, he had a diabolical plan. You have to be really cruel to do that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说反派展开一份害人的计划，把 mxajtan 与“恶魔般邪恶”一起记住；这里的程度远超普通的不好。

gloss_zh: 卷起的，尤指袖子；挽起袖子的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rolled up, especially of sleeves; also describing a person whose sleeves are rolled up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指衣袖等被卷起、挽起，也可形容一个人挽着袖子的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bil-kmiem mitwijin 'il fuq, jew li għandu l-kmiem f'din il-qagħda.

sense_translations.en_definition: rolled up (used especially of one's sleeves)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷起的；挽起的，尤其用于衣袖

collocations.en: a worker with his sleeves rolled up
a cook with his sleeves rolled up

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem kien mxammar biex il-kmiem ma jmissux iż-żebgħa waqt ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The worker had his sleeves rolled up so that they would not touch the paint while he worked.
formal.zh: 工人挽起了袖子，以免工作时衣袖碰到油漆。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Qabel tibda taħsel il-platti, itwi l-kmiem 'il fuq. Pawlu: Diġà mxammar! Għaddili l-isponża, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Rita: Roll up your sleeves before you start washing the dishes. Pawlu: I've already got them rolled up! Pass me the sponge, please.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：洗碗前先把袖子挽起来。保罗：我已经挽好了！请把海绵递给我。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qabel tibda taħsel il-platti, itwi l-kmiem 'il fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Qabel tibda taħsel il-platti, itwi l-kmiem 'il fuq.
messages.zh: 洗碗前先把袖子挽起来。
messages.en: Roll up your sleeves before you start washing the dishes.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà mxammar! Għaddili l-isponża, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Diġà mxammar! Għaddili l-isponża, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 我已经挽好了！请把海绵递给我。
messages.en: I've already got them rolled up! Pass me the sponge, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mxammar 配上一幅洗碗前挽起袖子的画面，记住它描述“已经卷起、挽好”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very wet or thoroughly soaked with water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或物被水浸得很湿，已经湿透，而不只是表面微湿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imxarrab ħafna, tant li jkun mimli ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 很湿的；湿透的

formal.mt: Wara li mexa għal nofs siegħa fix-xita qawwija, il-vjaġġatur wasal il-lukanda mxarrab għasra.
formal.en: After walking for half an hour in heavy rain, the traveller arrived at the hotel soaking wet.
formal.zh: 在大雨中走了半小时后，旅客到达旅馆时已经浑身湿透。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dħalt mxarrab għasra! Ma kellekx umbrella? David: Kelli, imma r-riħ kissirhieli. Se nbiddel ħwejġi minnufih.
colloquial.en: Anna: You've come in soaking wet! Didn't you have an umbrella? David: I did, but the wind broke it. I'm going to change my clothes straight away.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你进来时浑身都湿透了！你没带伞吗？戴维：带了，可是被风吹坏了。我马上去换衣服。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dħalt mxarrab għasra! Ma kellekx umbrella?
messages.mt_standard: Dħalt mxarrab għasra! Ma kellekx umbrella?
messages.zh: 你进来时浑身都湿透了！你没带伞吗？
messages.en: You've come in soaking wet! Didn't you have an umbrella?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli, imma r-riħ kissirhieli. Se nbiddel ħwejġi minnufih.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli, imma r-riħ kissirhieli. Se nbiddel ħwejġi minnufih.
messages.zh: 带了，可是被风吹坏了。我马上去换衣服。
messages.en: I did, but the wind broke it. I'm going to change my clothes straight away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mxarrab għasra 整组联想到暴雨后衣服滴水的样子；学习时用“湿透了”作整体提示，记住它强调非常湿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of carding cotton or wool to separate and straighten its fibres before spinning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 纺纱前梳理棉或羊毛纤维，使纤维分开并较为顺直的加工过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih il-fibri tal-qoton jew tas-suf jinfirdu u jitqiegħdu f'ordni qabel l-għażil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 棉或羊毛的梳理加工；梳棉或梳毛

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, l-għalliema spjegat kif il-mxat tas-suf jifred il-fibri u jħejjihom għall-għażil.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the teacher explained how carding wool separates the fibres and prepares them for spinning.
formal.zh: 演示过程中，老师讲解了梳毛如何将纤维分开，为纺纱做好准备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tgħaddi s-suf minn dawk l-għodod? Rita: Qed nagħmel il-mxat tas-suf. Irrid nifred il-fibri qabel nibda nagħżel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you passing the wool through those tools? Rita: I'm carding the wool. I need to separate the fibres before I start spinning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把羊毛放到那些工具上来回梳？丽塔：我在梳理羊毛。开始纺纱前，要先把纤维分开。

messages.speaker: Maja (手工课学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħaddi s-suf minn dawk l-għodod?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħaddi s-suf minn dawk l-għodod?
messages.zh: 你为什么把羊毛放到那些工具上来回梳？
messages.en: Why are you passing the wool through those tools?

messages.speaker: Rita (手工课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel il-mxat tas-suf. Irrid nifred il-fibri qabel nibda nagħżel.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel il-mxat tas-suf. Irrid nifred il-fibri qabel nibda nagħżel.
messages.zh: 我在梳理羊毛。开始纺纱前，要先把纤维分开。
messages.en: I'm carding the wool. I need to separate the fibres before I start spinning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一团杂乱羊毛经过梳理，变成松散顺直的纤维；用这段加工过程记住名词 mxat，而不是把它记成工具名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lightly burned on the surface by flame or strong heat, leaving it singed or scorched.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面受到火焰或强热作用而被燎过、灼焦或烤焦的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħruq ftit fil-wiċċ minħabba fjamma jew sħana qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被火燎过的；表面或毛发被轻微烧到的
被强热灼焦的；烤焦的

formal.mt: Wara li nħareġ mill-forn, il-ħobż instab mxawwat fil-wiċċ minħabba s-sħana żejda.
formal.en: After being taken out of the oven, the bread was found to be scorched on the surface because of excessive heat.
formal.zh: 面包从烤箱取出后，发现表面因温度过高而烤焦了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qed inħoss riħa ta' ħruq. Il-ħobż lest? Lara: Iva, imma ftit mxawwat minn fuq. Ħallejtu wisq qrib il-grill.
colloquial.en: Mark: I can smell something burning. Is the bread ready? Lara: Yes, but it's a little scorched on top. I left it too close to the grill.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我闻到焦味了。面包好了吗？拉拉：好了，不过上面有点烤焦。我把它放得离烤架加热元件太近了。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss riħa ta' ħruq. Il-ħobż lest?
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss riħa ta' ħruq. Il-ħobż lest?
messages.zh: 我闻到焦味了。面包好了吗？
messages.en: I can smell something burning. Is the bread ready?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ftit mxawwat minn fuq. Ħallejtu wisq qrib il-grill.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ftit mxawwat minn fuq. Ħallejtu wisq qrib il-grill.
messages.zh: 好了，不过上面有点烤焦。我把它放得离烤架加热元件太近了。
messages.en: Yes, but it's a little scorched on top. I left it too close to the grill.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 mxawwat：头发尖被火燎到，对应 singed；面包表面烤焦，对应 scorched。共同点是表面受热损伤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fed so as to become fatter; or given money or gifts to influence behaviour dishonestly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过喂养而被养肥的；也指接受钱财或礼物而被收买、受人不正当影响的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġie mitmugħ biex jiżdied fix-xaħam; jew li ngħata flus jew rigali biex jaġixxi b'mod diżonest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被喂肥的；经过饲养而长肥的。
被贿赂的；被钱财或好处收买的。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi biegħ l-għoġol imxaħħam wara diversi xhur ta' għalf regolari.
formal.en: The farmer sold the fattened calf after several months of regular feeding.
formal.zh: 经过数月的定期喂养后，农夫卖掉了那头养肥的小牛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex l-uffiċjal fl-istorja ħalla lill-ħalliel jaħrab? Pawlu: Għax kien mxaħħam; il-ħalliel kien tah il-flus.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the official in the story let the thief escape? Pawlu: Because he had been bribed; the thief had given him money.
colloquial.zh: Lara：故事里的官员为什么放走了小偷？Pawlu：因为他被收买了，小偷给过他钱。

messages.speaker: Lara (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-uffiċjal fl-istorja ħalla lill-ħalliel jaħrab?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-uffiċjal fl-istorja ħalla lill-ħalliel jaħrab?
messages.zh: 故事里的官员为什么放走了小偷？
messages.en: Why did the official in the story let the thief escape?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien mxaħħam; il-ħalliel kien tah il-flus.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien mxaħħam; il-ħalliel kien tah il-flus.
messages.zh: 因为他被收买了，小偷给过他钱。
messages.en: Because he had been bribed; the thief had given him money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张学习卡记 mxaħħam：一张画被养肥的小牛，一张画被金钱收买的官员，分别对应两个义项。

gloss_zh: 歪斜的；摇晃不稳的；醉醺醺的；状况很糟的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Crooked or unsteady; also used of someone who is drunk or of someone or something in a sorry state.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可形容物体歪斜或摇晃不稳，也可形容人喝醉，或人和事物处于很糟糕的状态；具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mgħawweġ jew mhux sod; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd fis-sakra jew lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa f'qagħda ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 歪斜的；不直的
摇晃的；不稳固的
喝醉的；醉醺醺的
状况很糟的；处境狼狈或破败不堪的

collocations.zh: 喝得醉醺醺、站立不稳的男人

collocations.en: a building in a sorry and neglected state
collocations.zh: 状况破败、无人照管的建筑

formal.mt: L-ispettur ordna li s-siġġu mxengel jitneħħa mill-klassi, għax ma kienx sod biżżejjed biex jintuża.
formal.en: The inspector ordered the wobbly chair to be removed from the classroom because it was not stable enough to use.
formal.zh: 检查员要求将那把摇晃的椅子搬出教室，因为它不够稳固，无法使用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan is-siġġu mxengel; kull darba li noqgħod fuqu jitbandal. Toni: Ħu l-ieħor. Dan se nwarrbu sakemm insewwilu s-sieq.
colloquial.en: Sara: This chair is wobbly; it rocks every time I sit on it. Toni: Take the other one. I'll put this one aside until I fix its leg.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这把椅子不稳，我一坐上去它就晃。托尼：用另一把吧。这把我先放到一边，等修好椅子腿再用。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan is-siġġu mxengel; kull darba li noqgħod fuqu jitbandal.
messages.mt_standard: Dan is-siġġu mxengel; kull darba li noqgħod fuqu jitbandal.
messages.zh: 这把椅子不稳，我一坐上去它就晃。
messages.en: This chair is wobbly; it rocks every time I sit on it.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu l-ieħor. Dan se nwarrbu sakemm insewwilu s-sieq.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu l-ieħor. Dan se nwarrbu sakemm insewwilu s-sieq.
messages.zh: 用另一把吧。这把我先放到一边，等修好椅子腿再用。
messages.en: Take the other one. I'll put this one aside until I fix its leg.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 mxengel 画四张语境卡：歪杆子、晃椅子、醉汉、破败建筑；分别记住四个义项，遇到句子再判断具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Spread over different places or across an area instead of being gathered together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物品散落在各处，或原本集中的事物已经分散开来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mifrux f'postijiet differenti jew fuq medda ta' art, minflok miġbur f'post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 散落的；零散分布在各处的
分散的；散开的

collocations.zh: 分散在几个地点的材料

formal.mt: Qabel ma nfetħet is-sala għall-pubbliku, il-persunal ġabar il-materjal li kien mxerred mal-art.
formal.en: Before the hall opened to the public, the staff collected the material that was scattered on the floor.
formal.zh: 大厅向公众开放前，工作人员收拾了散落在地上的材料。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex hemm ir-ross mxerred mal-art? Ben: Il-borża nfetħet meta erfajtha. Se niġbru issa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is there rice scattered on the floor? Ben: The bag came open when I lifted it. I'll pick it up now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：地上怎么撒了一地米？本：我提起袋子时，袋口开了。我现在就收拾。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 地上怎么撒了一地米？
messages.en: Why is there rice scattered on the floor?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-borża nfetħet meta erfajtha. Se niġbru issa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-borża nfetħet meta erfajtha. Se niġbru issa.
messages.zh: 我提起袋子时，袋口开了。我现在就收拾。
messages.en: The bag came open when I lifted it. I'll pick it up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象米袋一开，米粒从一处散到满地，用这个画面记 mxerred；描述眼前零散分布可译“散落”，强调散开可译“分散”。

gloss_zh: 受煽动的；被挑动起来反对某人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stirred up or incited by someone, especially to oppose another person or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到他人煽动或挑唆而情绪激动，尤其指被挑动起来反对某个人或群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imqanqal minn xi ħadd biex jaġixxi, speċjalment kontra persuna jew grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到煽动的；被挑唆而行动的
被挑动起来反对某人的；受煽动而对某人产生敌意的

collocations.zh: 被挑动起来反对委员会的

formal.mt: Il-grupp, mxewwex kontra l-kumitat minn għajdut falz, talab spjegazzjoni waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The group, incited against the committee by false rumours, demanded an explanation during the meeting.
formal.zh: 这个群体受到虚假传言煽动，对委员会产生敌意，并在会议上要求对方作出解释。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu hu daqshekk mxewwex kontra l-kumitat? Mark: Xi ħadd qallu li ħbew il-flus. Għadna ma nafux jekk dan hux minnu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why has Pawlu been so stirred up against the committee? Mark: Someone told him they hid the money. We don't yet know whether that's true.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗怎么被挑动得这么反对委员会？马克：有人跟他说委员会把钱藏起来了。我们还不知道这事是不是真的。

messages.speaker: Maja (协会会员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu hu daqshekk mxewwex kontra l-kumitat?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu hu daqshekk mxewwex kontra l-kumitat?
messages.zh: 保罗怎么被挑动得这么反对委员会？
messages.en: Why has Pawlu been so stirred up against the committee?

messages.speaker: Mark (协会会员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd qallu li ħbew il-flus. Għadna ma nafux jekk dan hux minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd qallu li ħbew il-flus. Għadna ma nafux jekk dan hux minnu.
messages.zh: 有人跟他说委员会把钱藏起来了。我们还不知道这事是不是真的。
messages.en: Someone told him they hid the money. We don't yet know whether that's true.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人听了挑唆后转身反对别人，把 mxewwex 记成“被煽动起来的状态”；再用 kontra 后接对象，记住敌意指向谁。

gloss_zh: 有关联的；具有团体成员身份的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Associated with an organization or group, including through membership.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某个组织或团体有联系的，也可指具有该组织或团体成员身份的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut ma' għaqda jew grupp, ukoll bħala membru tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有关联的；与某人、组织或事物相联系的。

sense_translations.en_definition: having membership in an association or group
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有某个协会或团体成员身份的。

collocations.zh: 具有某个协会成员身份的

formal.mt: Kull min hu mxierek fl-għaqda jista' jieħu sehem fil-laqgħa annwali.
formal.en: Anyone who is a member of the association may take part in the annual meeting.
formal.zh: 凡是该协会的成员，都可以参加年度会议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int mxierek fl-għaqda tal-mużika? Mark: Iva, u mmur għal-laqgħat kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you a member of the music association? Mark: Yes, and I go to the meetings every week.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你是音乐协会的成员吗？马克：是的，我每周都去参加聚会。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是音乐协会的成员吗？
messages.en: Are you a member of the music association?

messages.speaker: Mark (协会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u mmur għal-laqgħat kull ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u mmur għal-laqgħat kull ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，我每周都去参加聚会。
messages.en: Yes, and I go to the meetings every week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象名单上自己的名字与团体连在一起：先记“有关联”，再记更具体的“有成员身份”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of combing hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用梳子梳理头发的动作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tgħaddi moxt mix-xagħar biex tirranġah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳头；用梳子梳理头发的过程。

formal.mt: Il-mxit tax-xagħar għandu jsir bil-mod biex ma jiġbidx ix-xagħar u ma jweġġax il-qorriegħa.
formal.en: Hair should be combed gently to avoid pulling it and hurting the scalp.
formal.zh: 梳头时应动作轻缓，以免拉扯头发、弄疼头皮。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed iddum daqshekk quddiem il-mera? Sara: Il-mxit qed jieħu l-ħin għax għandi ħafna għoqod f'xagħri.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you spending so long in front of the mirror? Sara: The combing is taking time because I have lots of tangles in my hair.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你怎么在镜子前待了这么久？萨拉：我的头发打了好多结，梳起来很费时间。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iddum daqshekk quddiem il-mera?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iddum daqshekk quddiem il-mera?
messages.zh: 你怎么在镜子前待了这么久？
messages.en: Why are you spending so long in front of the mirror?

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mxit qed jieħu l-ħin għax għandi ħafna għoqod f'xagħri.
messages.mt_standard: Il-mxit qed jieħu l-ħin għax għandi ħafna għoqod f'xagħri.
messages.zh: 我的头发打了好多结，梳起来很费时间。
messages.en: The combing is taking time because I have lots of tangles in my hair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上一幅梳子穿过头发的动态图，记住它表示“梳头这件事”，而不是梳子本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Projecting outward beyond the surrounding surface, especially of a stone block.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指石块突出于周围表面之外的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħroġ 'il barra mill-wiċċ ta' madwaru, speċjalment meta jingħad għal blokk tal-ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凸出的，向外突出的（用于描述石块）。

collocations.en: stones jutting out from the wall

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika blokk mzekzek fil-ħajt, qrib id-daħla.
formal.en: The report identifies a projecting stone block in the wall near the entrance.
formal.zh: 报告指出，入口附近的墙上有一块凸出的石块。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ara dak il-blokk mzekzek fil-ħajt. Pawlu: Iva, joħroġ 'il barra aktar mill-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Marta: Look at that stone block jutting out from the wall. Pawlu: Yes, it sticks out farther than the others.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：看墙上那块凸出的石头。保罗：是啊，它比其他石块突出得更多。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 看墙上那块凸出的石头。
messages.en: Look at that stone block jutting out from the wall.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，它比其他石块突出得更多。
messages.en: Yes, it sticks out farther than the others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象平整石墙里有一块石头探出头来，把 mzekzek 和这块凸出的石头一起记。

gloss_zh: 被压扁的；不情愿地被困在某处的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Flattened; also describing someone obliged to remain somewhere against their wishes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被压扁的；也形容某人因不得已而不情愿地滞留在某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħfus sakemm sar ċatt; ukoll, imġiegħel jibqa' xi mkien kontra qalbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被压扁的；被压平的

sense_translations.en_definition: stuck (used in a negative sense, to indicate one's unwilling obligation to be somewhere)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被迫待在某处的，带有不情愿、受困的负面意味

collocations.zh: 不情愿地被困在办公室

formal.mt: Il-kartun mċaftar tqiegħed fil-kontenitur tar-riċiklaġġ.
formal.en: The flattened cardboard was placed in the recycling container.
formal.zh: 被压扁的纸板放进了回收箱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ġej magħna għall-ikel? Mark: Ma nistax, għadni mċaftar fl-uffiċċju b'dan ix-xogħol kollu. Lara: Nifhem, narawk aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you coming to eat with us? Mark: I can't; I'm still stuck at the office with all this work. Lara: I understand; we'll see you later.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你来和我们一起吃饭吗？马克：来不了，这么多工作，我还被困在办公室。拉拉：明白，那晚点见。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你来和我们一起吃饭吗？
messages.en: Are you coming to eat with us?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax, għadni mċaftar fl-uffiċċju b'dan ix-xogħol kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax, għadni mċaftar fl-uffiċċju b'dan ix-xogħol kollu.
messages.zh: 来不了，这么多工作，我还被困在办公室。
messages.en: I can't; I'm still stuck at the office with all this work.

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 明白，那晚点见。
messages.en: I understand; we'll see you later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 mċaftar：纸板被压扁，员工不情愿地困在办公室；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 海面波浪起伏的；波涛不平的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a sea surface with many short, uneven waves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容海面有许多短促、不规则的波浪，水面不平稳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi baħar b'ħafna mewġ qasir u irregolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海面波浪短促而不规则的；波涛不平的

formal.mt: Matul il-vjaġġ, il-baħar kien mċafċaf u d-dgħajsa kienet titbandal kontinwament.
formal.en: During the journey, the sea was choppy and the boat rocked continuously.
formal.zh: 航行途中，海面波涛不平，小船不停地摇晃。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex qed titbandal daqshekk id-dgħajsa? Samwel: Għax il-baħar mċafċaf illum. Rita: Mela nibqa' bilqiegħda.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is the boat rocking so much? Samwel: Because the sea is choppy today. Rita: Then I'll stay seated.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：船为什么摇得这么厉害？萨姆韦尔：因为今天海面波涛不平。丽塔：那我还是坐着吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (乘客)
messages.zh: 船为什么摇得这么厉害？
messages.en: Why is the boat rocking so much?

messages.speaker: Samwel (船员)
messages.zh: 因为今天海面波涛不平。
messages.en: Because the sea is choppy today.

messages.speaker: Rita (乘客)
messages.zh: 那我还是坐着吧。
messages.en: Then I'll stay seated.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 mċafċaf 时想象小船被一阵阵短浪颠动，再用 baħar mċafċaf 把词义和海面连起来。

gloss_zh: 破旧寒酸的；凌乱不整的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Looking shabby or untidy, with a worn or poorly arranged appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外观破旧寒酸，或显得凌乱、不整洁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jidher mikul jew mhux irranġat tajjeb; b'dehra traskurata jew diżordinata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破旧的；外观寒酸的
凌乱的；不整洁的

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel jilbes kowt mċampar li jagħti dehra ta' faqar lill-karattru.
formal.en: In the story, the man wears a shabby coat that gives the character an appearance of poverty.
formal.zh: 故事中，男子穿着一件破旧的外套，使这个人物显得贫困。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi xagħri mċampar? Omm: Iva, irranġah ftit qabel noħorġu. Nina: Sewwa, immur inġib il-moxt.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is my hair untidy? Mum: Yes, tidy it up a little before we go out. Nina: All right, I'll get the comb.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我的头发乱吗？妈妈：是的，出门前稍微整理一下。妮娜：好，我去拿梳子。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我的头发乱吗？
messages.en: Is my hair untidy?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 是的，出门前稍微整理一下。
messages.en: Yes, tidy it up a little before we go out.

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 好，我去拿梳子。
messages.en: All right, I'll get the comb.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mċampar 配上破旧外套和未梳头发两幅图：前者帮助记寒酸，后者帮助记凌乱。

gloss_zh: 被移动的；被移位的；海面波涛不平的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moved or shifted from a previous position; also describing a choppy sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从原来位置被移动或挪开的；也形容海面波浪起伏、不平稳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li nbidel minn postu jew ġie spostat; għall-baħar, li għandu mewġ qasir u irregolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被移动的；位置发生改变的
被挪动的；被移位的
海面波浪短促而不规则的；波涛不平的

collocations.en: a bench moved from its place
a cupboard shifted towards the wall

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, l-armarju nstab mċaqlaq minn postu u eqreb lejn il-ħajt.
formal.en: During the inspection, the cupboard was found moved from its original position and closer to the wall.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，柜子已被移离原位，挪到了更靠近墙的位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Noħorġu bid-dgħajsa llum? Toni: Il-baħar mċaqlaq; nippreferi nibqgħu fuq l-art. Maja: Tajjeb, immorru nimxu ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go out in the boat today? Toni: The sea is choppy; I'd rather we stayed on land. Maja: All right, let's go for a walk by the sea.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天我们坐船出海吗？托尼：海面波涛不平，我更想待在岸上。玛雅：好，那去海边散步吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天我们坐船出海吗？
messages.en: Shall we go out in the boat today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-baħar mċaqlaq; nippreferi nibqgħu fuq l-art.
messages.mt_standard: Il-baħar mċaqlaq; nippreferi nibqgħu fuq l-art.
messages.zh: 海面波涛不平，我更想待在岸上。
messages.en: The sea is choppy; I'd rather we stayed on land.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，那去海边散步吧。
messages.en: All right, let's go for a walk by the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用位置变化记 mċaqlaq 的移动、移位两义，再单独配上海面短浪起伏的图，记住它也能描述海况。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Torn or ripped, especially of cloth, paper, or something made from them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被撕破或扯裂的，常用于布料、纸张及其制品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tiċrita jew tiċrit, speċjalment drapp jew karta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撕破的；扯裂的。

formal.mt: Il-kowt mċarrat intbagħat għand il-ħajjat biex jissewwa.
formal.en: The torn coat was sent to the tailor to be repaired.
formal.zh: 那件破了的外套被送到裁缝那里修补。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ma tilbisx dak il-kowt? Pawlu: Għax mċarrat minn wara. Se nieħdu għand il-ħajjat.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why don't you wear that coat? Paul: Because it's torn at the back. I'll take it to the tailor.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你为什么不穿那件外套？保罗：因为后面破了。我准备拿去让裁缝修补。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不穿那件外套？
messages.en: Why don't you wear that coat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax mċarrat minn wara. Se nieħdu għand il-ħajjat.
messages.mt_standard: Għax mċarrat minn wara. Se nieħdu għand il-ħajjat.
messages.zh: 因为后面破了。我准备拿去让裁缝修补。
messages.en: Because it's torn at the back. I'll take it to the tailor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mċarrat 和外套上的一道裂口一起记：看到布料被扯破，就想到这个形容词。

gloss_zh: 睡眼蒙眬的；两眼惺忪的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having tired, unfocused eyes, often because of sleepiness or lack of sleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因困倦或睡眠不足等原因而双眼疲倦、目光蒙眬的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu għajnejh għajjenin u ma jħarisx ċar, spiss minħabba n-ngħas jew in-nuqqas ta' rqad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 睡眼蒙眬的；双眼疲倦、目光不清的。
