formal.mt: Wara lejl mingħajr irqad, l-istudent wasal għal-lezzjoni mċefċaq u għajjien.
formal.en: After a sleepless night, the student arrived for the lesson bleary-eyed and tired.
formal.zh: 一夜未眠后，那名学生睡眼蒙眬、疲惫不堪地来上课。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għadek kif qomt? Tidher mċefċaq. Luqa: Iva, irqadt ftit wisq. Ħa naħsel wiċċi.
colloquial.en: Maria: Have you just got up? You look bleary-eyed. Luke: Yes, I slept far too little. Let me wash my face.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你刚起床吗？看起来睡眼惺忪。卢卡：是啊，我睡得太少了。我去洗把脸。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 你刚起床吗？看起来睡眼惺忪。
messages.en: Have you just got up? You look bleary-eyed.

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irqadt ftit wisq. Ħa naħsel wiċċi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irqadt ftit wisq. Ħa naħsel wiċċi.
messages.zh: 是啊，我睡得太少了。我去洗把脸。
messages.en: Yes, I slept far too little. Let me wash my face.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚被闹钟叫醒、眼睛还睁不清的样子，把 mċefċaq 记成睡眼惺忪的状态。

gloss_zh: 敲响过的；神志不清的；醉的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a bell that has been rung, or a person who is out of their senses or drunk, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容钟等已经被敲响；形容人时，也可表示神志不清或喝醉，具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi qanpiena li ndaqqet, jew persuna li mhix f'sensiha jew li hi fis-sakra, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经被敲响的，例如钟。
神志不清的；失去理智的。
喝醉的；处于醉酒状态的。

collocations.en: a bell that has been rung
as if he were out of his senses

formal.mt: Wara li xorob wisq waqt l-ikla, ir-raġel deher mċempel u ħabibu akkumpanjah sad-dar.
formal.en: After drinking too much during the meal, the man appeared drunk, and his friend accompanied him home.
formal.zh: 那名男子在用餐时喝得太多，显得醉醺醺的，于是朋友陪他回家。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu jidher mċempel. Xorob ħafna? Mark: Iva. Se mmur miegħu d-dar.
colloquial.en: Sarah: Paul looks drunk. Did he drink a lot? Mark: Yes. I'll go home with him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗看起来喝醉了。他喝了很多吗？马克：是的。我会陪他回家。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗看起来喝醉了。他喝了很多吗？
messages.en: Paul looks drunk. Did he drink a lot?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的。我会陪他回家。
messages.en: Yes. I'll go home with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张语境卡记 mċempel：钟被敲响、人失去理智、人喝醉；先看所描述的对象再选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cart moved by hand for carrying goods or other loads.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 靠人力推动、用于运送货物或其他重物的小车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Karretta li titmexxa bl-idejn biex jinġarru affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 靠人力推动的小车；手推车。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża mġarra biex iġorr il-kaxxi mill-maħżen sal-ħanut.
formal.en: The worker used a handcart to carry the boxes from the warehouse to the shop.
formal.zh: 工人用手推车把箱子从仓库运到商店。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dawn il-kaxxi tqal wisq biex inġorrhom. Pawlu: Ġib il-mġarra u nimbottawha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Mark: These boxes are too heavy for me to carry. Pawlu: Bring the handcart and we'll push it together.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些箱子太重了，我搬不动。保罗：把手推车拿来，我们一起推。

messages.speaker: Mark (搬运工)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn il-kaxxi tqal wisq biex inġorrhom.
messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-kaxxi tqal wisq biex inġorrhom.
messages.zh: 这些箱子太重了，我搬不动。
messages.en: These boxes are too heavy for me to carry.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 把手推车拿来，我们一起推。
messages.en: Bring the handcart and we'll push it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两手扶着车把，把一车箱子往前推；用“人手推、车载货”的画面记住 mġarra。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stony, or characterized by mountains and hills.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布满石块的；也可形容地形多山或多丘陵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih ħafna ġebel, jew li għandu ħafna muntanji jew għoljiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多石的，布满石块的。
多山的，多丘陵的，山地起伏的。

formal.mt: L-istħarriġ jiddeskrivi t-terren bħala mġebbel: il-wiċċ huwa mimli ġebel u madwaru hemm bosta għoljiet.
formal.en: The survey describes the terrain as stony and hilly: its surface is covered with stones and there are several hills around it.
formal.zh: 调查将这片地形描述为多石且多丘陵：地表布满石块，周围有数座小山。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu nimxu malajr hawn? Mark: Mhux wisq; it-terren mġebbel, allura oqgħod attenta fejn tirfes.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we walk quickly here? Mark: Not really; the ground is stony, so watch where you step.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在这里能走快点吗？马克：不太行，地上石头多，注意脚下。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 我们在这里能走快点吗？
messages.en: Can we walk quickly here?

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux wisq; it-terren mġebbel, allura oqgħod attenta fejn tirfes.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux wisq; it-terren mġebbel, allura oqgħod attenta fejn tirfes.
messages.zh: 不太行，地上石头多，注意脚下。
messages.en: Not really; the ground is stony, so watch where you step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 mġebbel 配两张学习图：近看满地石块是“多石的”，远看山丘连绵是“多山、多丘陵的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Crazy or foolish in behavior, judgment, or character.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为、判断或性情显得疯狂、愚傻的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu jew jaħseb b'mod miġnun jew iblah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疯狂的，愚傻的；可用来形容疯疯癫癫或做傻事的人。

collocations.zh: 疯疯癫癫或愚傻的男人

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist jipproponi pjan imġejnen biex jaqsam il-baħar waħdu f'dgħajsa żgħira.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist proposes a crazy plan to cross the sea alone in a small boat.
formal.zh: 小说中，主人公提出一个疯狂的计划：独自乘小船横渡大海。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Se nixtri għoxrin pizza għal erba' persuni! Maja: Int mġejnen? Erbgħa biżżejjed!
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm going to buy twenty pizzas for four people! Maja: Are you crazy? Four are enough!
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们四个人，我要买二十张披萨！玛雅：你疯了吗？四张就够了！

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nixtri għoxrin pizza għal erba' persuni!
messages.mt_standard: Se nixtri għoxrin pizza għal erba' persuni!
messages.zh: 我们四个人，我要买二十张披萨！
messages.en: I'm going to buy twenty pizzas for four people!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你疯了吗？四张就够了！
messages.en: Are you crazy? Four are enough!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象四个人却点二十张披萨，朋友惊呼“你疯了吗！”用这种夸张、欠考虑的行为记住 mġejnen。

gloss_zh: 卷曲的；波浪状的，尤指头发

teaching_sense.en_definition: Curly or wavy, especially when describing hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈卷曲或波浪状的，尤其用于形容头发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu nokkli jew mewġ, speċjalment meta jingħad għax-xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷曲的，有卷儿的，尤其用于形容头发。
波浪状的，呈波浪形弯曲的，尤其用于形容头发。

collocations.zh: 卷曲或呈波浪状的长发

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-karattru, l-awtriċi ssemmi xagħar twil u mġiegħed li jinżel fuq l-ispallejn.
formal.en: In the character description, the author mentions long, wavy hair falling over the shoulders.
formal.zh: 在人物描写中，作者提到一头披在肩上的波浪长发。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Trid ix-xagħar lixx jew imġiegħed? Maja: Imġiegħed, jekk jogħġbok, b'mewġ ħafif.
colloquial.en: Rita: Would you like your hair straight or curly? Maja: Wavy, please, with gentle waves.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你想要直发还是卷发？玛雅：请做成波浪发，卷度柔和一点。

messages.speaker: Rita (理发师)
messages.zh: 你想要直发还是卷发？
messages.en: Would you like your hair straight or curly?

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 请做成波浪发，卷度柔和一点。
messages.en: Wavy, please, with gentle waves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上画一缕小卷发和一缕大波浪，再写 mġiegħed；两种弯曲都能帮助记忆它描述头发的用法。

gloss_zh: 体格健壮的；身材结实的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a strong, solidly built body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容身体结实、体格健壮的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ġisem b'saħħtu u mibni sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体格健壮的；身材结实的

formal.mt: L-atleta mġissem wera saħħa kbira waqt il-kompetizzjoni.
formal.en: The well-built athlete showed great strength during the competition.
formal.zh: 这位体格健壮的运动员在比赛中展现出很强的力量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel mġissem ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Dak ħija; imur il-ġinnasju kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that well-built man by the door? Mark: That's my brother; he goes to the gym every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门边那个体格健壮的男子是谁？马克：那是我哥哥，他每天都去健身房。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel mġissem ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel mġissem ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门边那个体格健壮的男子是谁？
messages.en: Who is that well-built man by the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是我哥哥，他每天都去健身房。
messages.en: That's my brother; he goes to the gym every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mġissem 和肩膀宽厚、体格结实的运动员画面一起记，重点是身体健壮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having work or other activities to deal with and little time available.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有工作或其他事务需要处理、空闲时间很少的；忙碌的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ħafna xogħol jew affarijiet x'jagħmel u ftit ħin liberu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忙碌的；正忙于处理工作或其他事务的。

formal.mt: Il-maniġer huwa mħabbat bix-xogħol u se jwieġeb għall-messaġġi aktar tard.
formal.en: The manager is busy with work and will reply to messages later.
formal.zh: 经理正忙于工作，将稍后回复消息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek ħin għal kafè? Mark: Bħalissa jien mħabbat ħafna. Nistgħu niltaqgħu wara x-xogħol?
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have time for a coffee? Mark: I'm very busy right now. Can we meet after work?
colloquial.zh: Sara：你有时间喝杯咖啡吗？Mark：我现在特别忙。我们下班后见面可以吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你有时间喝杯咖啡吗？
messages.en: Do you have time for a coffee?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħalissa jien mħabbat ħafna. Nistgħu niltaqgħu wara x-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Bħalissa jien mħabbat ħafna. Nistgħu niltaqgħu wara x-xogħol?
messages.zh: 我现在特别忙。我们下班后见面可以吗？
messages.en: I'm very busy right now. Can we meet after work?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mħabbat 放进“现在没空喝咖啡”的场景，连同 mħabbat bix-xogħol“忙于工作”一起记，突出忙碌、没空的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kitchen tool with a rough or perforated surface used to grate cheese into small pieces or shreds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用带有粗糙表面或刨孔的工作面将奶酪擦成碎末或细丝的厨房工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tal-kċina b'wiċċ aħrax jew b'toqob li tintuża biex tħokk il-ġobon f'biċċiet żgħar jew fi strixxi rqaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奶酪刨；将奶酪擦碎或刨成细丝的厨房工具。

formal.mt: Uża mħakka biex tħokk il-ġobon, imbagħad ferrex il-ġobon fuq l-għaġin.
formal.en: Use a grater to grate the cheese, then sprinkle the cheese over the pasta.
formal.zh: 用奶酪刨将奶酪擦碎，然后撒在意大利面上。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hi l-mħakka tal-ġobon? Omm: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-kuċċarini. Oqgħod attenta għal subgħajk.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where's the cheese grater? Mum: In the drawer next to the teaspoons. Watch your fingers.
colloquial.zh: Nina：奶酪擦丝器在哪里？妈妈：在茶匙旁边的抽屉里。小心手指。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 奶酪擦丝器在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the cheese grater?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-kuċċarini. Oqgħod attenta għal subgħajk.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-kuċċarini. Oqgħod attenta għal subgħajk.
messages.zh: 在茶匙旁边的抽屉里。小心手指。
messages.en: In the drawer next to the teaspoons. Watch your fingers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一块奶酪在刨孔上来回擦，细丝落到面条上；把这个工具的画面与 mħakka tal-ġobon 一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作个人家族姓氏的专名，书写时首字母大写为 Mħammed。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala l-isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏；作为姓使用的专名 Mħammed。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, Mħammed għandu jinkiteb fil-kaxxa tal-kunjom fuq il-formola.
formal.en: In this example, Mħammed should be written in the surname box on the form.
formal.zh: 在这个示例中，Mħammed 应填写在表格的姓氏栏中。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Mħammed huwa l-isem jew il-kunjom tiegħek? Adam: Il-kunjom tiegħi huwa Mħammed; jisimni Adam.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is Mħammed your first name or your surname? Adam: My surname is Mħammed; my first name is Adam.
colloquial.zh: Rita：Mħammed 是你的名字还是姓氏？Adam：我的姓是 Mħammed，名字是 Adam。

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mħammed huwa l-isem jew il-kunjom tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Mħammed huwa l-isem jew il-kunjom tiegħek?
messages.zh: Mħammed 是你的名字还是姓氏？
messages.en: Is Mħammed your first name or your surname?

messages.speaker: Adam (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kunjom tiegħi huwa Mħammed; jisimni Adam.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kunjom tiegħi huwa Mħammed; jisimni Adam.
messages.zh: 我的姓是 Mħammed，名字是 Adam。
messages.en: My surname is Mħammed; my first name is Adam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Mħammed 想象成表格“姓氏”栏里的内容，搭配 is-Sur Mħammed“先生”记忆，并留意姓氏首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dug out so that it has the shape of a trench or ditch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过挖掘而呈现壕沟或沟渠形状的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imħaffer b'mod li jkollu l-għamla ta' ħandaq.

sense_translations.en_definition: dug like a trench or ditch
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挖成壕沟或沟渠形状的；呈沟状开挖的。

collocations.en: a passage dug like a trench

formal.mt: Il-passaġġ mħandaq għandu jiġi mmarkat b'mod ċar sabiex il-viżitaturi jkunu jistgħu jaraw it-truf tiegħu.
formal.en: The passage dug like a trench should be clearly marked so that visitors can see its edges.
formal.zh: 这条挖成壕沟状的通道应设置清晰标记，让访客看得见其边缘。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan il-passaġġ huwa daqshekk fond? Toni: Huwa mħandaq, bħal kanal twil. Oqgħod attenta fejn timxi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is this passage so deep? Toni: It's dug like a trench, like a long channel. Watch where you walk.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这条通道为什么这么深？Toni：它挖成了沟状，像一条长长的渠道。走路时留意脚下。

messages.speaker: Lara (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-passaġġ huwa daqshekk fond?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-passaġġ huwa daqshekk fond?
messages.zh: 这条通道为什么这么深？
messages.en: Why is this passage so deep?

messages.speaker: Toni (向导)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa mħandaq, bħal kanal twil. Oqgħod attenta fejn timxi.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa mħandaq, bħal kanal twil. Oqgħod attenta fejn timxi.
messages.zh: 它挖成了沟状，像一条长长的渠道。走路时留意脚下。
messages.en: It's dug like a trench, like a long channel. Watch where you walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条向下挖出的长沟，在旁边写 passaġġ mħandaq；记忆重点是“挖成沟状”，把形状和开挖后的状态一起记住。

gloss_zh: 受过训练的；熟练的；精通的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having received training or gained enough practice and knowledge to perform a task skillfully or understand a subject well.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接受过训练，或通过练习和学习而能熟练完成任务、充分了解某一领域的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li rċieva taħriġ jew kiseb biżżejjed prattika u għarfien biex jagħmel xogħol b'ħila jew jifhem suġġett sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受过训练的；接受过某项技能或工作培训的。
熟练的；具有足够技能、能胜任某项工作的。
熟谙的；对某一领域知识了解充分的。

formal.mt: Kull grupp għandu jkun akkumpanjat minn membru tal-persunal imħarreġ fl-ewwel għajnuna.
formal.en: Each group should be accompanied by a staff member trained in first aid.
formal.zh: 每个小组都应由一名受过急救训练的工作人员陪同。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jista' jurina kif nużaw din il-magna? Mark: Staqsi lil Toni. Huwa mħarreġ sew fl-użu tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who can show us how to use this machine? Mark: Ask Toni. He's well trained in using it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁能教我们用这台机器？Mark：问 Toni 吧。他受过充分训练，很会操作它。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jurina kif nużaw din il-magna?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jurina kif nużaw din il-magna?
messages.zh: 谁能教我们用这台机器？
messages.en: Who can show us how to use this machine?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lil Toni. Huwa mħarreġ sew fl-użu tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lil Toni. Huwa mħarreġ sew fl-użu tagħha.
messages.zh: 问 Toni 吧。他受过充分训练，很会操作它。
messages.en: Ask Toni. He's well trained in using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“受训—熟练—熟谙”三个提示分开记义项：参加培训对应 trained，操作熟练对应 proficient，知识熟悉对应 well-versed。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Morally corrupt, or rotten and no longer sound, especially when describing food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指人在道德上腐化，也可指食物等已经腐烂、变质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-karattru moralment korrott, jew li tmermer u ma għadux tajjeb, speċjalment meta jingħad għall-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腐化的；道德败坏的。
腐烂的；已经变质、失去良好状态的，尤指食物。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru mħassar tal-protagonist jidher fil-mod kif iqarraq b'dawk li jafdawh.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist's corrupt character is revealed by the way he deceives those who trust him.
formal.zh: 在小说中，主人公通过欺骗信任他的人，暴露了自己败坏的品性。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan it-tuffieħ għandu riħa ħażina. Nistgħu nikluh? Pawlu: Le, dan mħassar. Aħjar narmuh.
colloquial.en: Nina: These apples smell bad. Can we eat them? Pawlu: No, they're rotten. We'd better throw them away.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这些苹果有股难闻的味道。还能吃吗？Pawlu：不能，已经腐烂了。最好扔掉。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tuffieħ għandu riħa ħażina. Nistgħu nikluh?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tuffieħ għandu riħa ħażina. Nistgħu nikluh?
messages.zh: 这些苹果有股难闻的味道。还能吃吗？
messages.en: These apples smell bad. Can we eat them?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 不能，已经腐烂了。最好扔掉。
messages.en: No, they're rotten. We'd better throw them away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文“坏”作双场景提示：苹果坏了是 rotten，品性坏了是 corrupt；分别搭配 tuffieħ 和 karattru 记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deep in thought, or looking gloomy and withdrawn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 陷入思考的，或显得阴郁、不愿说话的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mgħaddas fil-ħsieb, jew jidher imdejjaq u ma tantx jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闷闷不乐的；阴沉而不愿说话的。
沉思的；正在认真思考的。

collocations.zh: 若有所思或闷闷不乐的面容

collocations.en: to look deep in thought or sullen
collocations.zh: 显得心事重重或闷闷不乐

formal.mt: Qabel wieġeb għall-mistoqsija, l-istudent baqa' sieket u mħasseb għal ftit sekondi.
formal.en: Before answering the question, the student remained silent and thoughtful for a few seconds.
formal.zh: 回答问题之前，那名学生沉默了几秒，若有所思。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tidher daqshekk mħasseb? Pawlu: Qed naħseb fuq dak li qalilna l-għalliem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you look so deep in thought? Pawlu: I'm thinking about what the teacher told us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么一副若有所思的样子？保罗：我在想老师跟我们说的话。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你怎么一副若有所思的样子？
messages.en: Why do you look so deep in thought?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naħseb fuq dak li qalilna l-għalliem.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naħseb fuq dak li qalilna l-għalliem.
messages.zh: 我在想老师跟我们说的话。
messages.en: I'm thinking about what the teacher told us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个低头不语的人：可能正在沉思，也可能闷闷不乐；用表情和语境区分这两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A disease that affects domestic fowls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种发生在鸡等家禽身上的疾病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda li tolqot it-tjur domestiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种侵袭家禽的疾病。

collocations.en: a case of the poultry disease called mħata
collocations.zh: 一例名为 mħata 的家禽疾病
一只患有 mħata 的母鸡

formal.mt: Il-bidwi rrapporta każ ta' mħata fost it-tiġieġ tiegħu.
formal.en: The farmer reported a case of mħata among his chickens.
formal.zh: 那位农民报告说，他养的鸡中出现了一例 mħata。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qal il-veterinarju dwar it-tiġieġa? Mark: Qal li għandha l-mħata.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the vet say about the hen? Mark: He said it has mħata.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：兽医怎么说那只母鸡的情况？马克：他说它患了 mħata。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 兽医怎么说那只母鸡的情况？
messages.en: What did the vet say about the hen?

messages.speaker: Mark (农场主)
messages.zh: 他说它患了 mħata。
messages.en: He said it has mħata.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进农场词卡：画一只生病的鸡，旁边写“家禽疾病”；材料没有说明具体病种，不必硬配中文病名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Morally corrupt or dishonest in conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 品行败坏的，或行为不诚实、存在腐败的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu mġiba korrotta jew diżonesta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腐败的；道德或品行败坏的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-uffiċjal mħażżen juża s-setgħa tiegħu biex jgħin lil sħabu biss.
formal.en: In the novel, the corrupt official uses his power to help only his friends.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，那个腐败的官员利用权力，只帮助自己的朋友。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak l-uffiċjal fl-istorja? Luka: Għax hu mħażżen u jaċċetta r-rigali biex jagħti l-permessi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why don't you trust that official in the story? Luka: Because he's corrupt and accepts gifts in exchange for granting permits.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么不信任故事里的那个官员？卢卡：因为他很腐败，收了礼才给人批准许可。

messages.speaker: Nina (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak l-uffiċjal fl-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak l-uffiċjal fl-istorja?
messages.zh: 你为什么不信任故事里的那个官员？
messages.en: Why don't you trust that official in the story?

messages.speaker: Luka (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu mħażżen u jaċċetta r-rigali biex jagħti l-permessi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu mħażżen u jaċċetta r-rigali biex jagħti l-permessi.
messages.zh: 因为他很腐败，收了礼才给人批准许可。
messages.en: Because he's corrupt and accepts gifts in exchange for granting permits.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用小说中的贪腐官员作记忆画面：伸手收礼、滥用权力，把这个形容词与“品行败坏”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clothing and personal items prepared for a bride, forming her bridal trousseau.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为新娘准备的衣物和个人用品，即新娘的嫁妆衣物及用品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħwejjeġ u l-oġġetti personali mħejjija għall-għarusa għaż-żwieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为新娘准备的衣物。
新娘的嫁妆，尤其指为婚后生活准备的衣物和个人用品。

collocations.zh: 新娘的嫁妆衣物及用品
准备新娘的嫁妆衣物及用品

formal.mt: Qabel it-tieġ, il-familja ħejjiet il-mħiba tal-għarusa u poġġietha f'kaxxa kbira.
formal.en: Before the wedding, the family prepared the bride's trousseau and placed it in a large box.
formal.zh: 婚礼前，家人为新娘准备了嫁妆衣物及用品，并将它们放进一个大箱子里。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-mħiba lesta għat-tieġ? Anna: Kważi; għad irrid inpoġġi dawn il-ħwejjeġ fil-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the trousseau ready for the wedding? Anna: Almost; I still need to put these clothes in the box.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：婚礼用的嫁妆衣物及用品准备好了吗？安娜：差不多了，我还得把这些衣服放进箱子里。

messages.speaker: Sara (新娘的姐姐)
messages.zh: 婚礼用的嫁妆衣物及用品准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the trousseau ready for the wedding?

messages.speaker: Anna (新娘)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi; għad irrid inpoġġi dawn il-ħwejjeġ fil-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi; għad irrid inpoġġi dawn il-ħwejjeġ fil-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 差不多了，我还得把这些衣服放进箱子里。
messages.en: Almost; I still need to put these clothes in the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象新娘打开装满衣物的嫁妆箱：狭义记“新娘衣物”，整体记“新娘嫁妆”，两层意思共用一个画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of blowing one's nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指擤鼻子这一动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li wieħed jonfoħ imnieħru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擤鼻子；此处按名词理解为擤鼻子的动作。

formal.mt: Wara l-mħit tal-imnieħer, Mark tefa' l-maktur tal-karti fil-landa.
formal.en: After blowing his nose, Mark put the tissue in the bin.
formal.zh: 擤完鼻子后，马克把纸巾扔进了垃圾桶。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Agħtini mument għall-mħit tal-imnieħer. Lara: Ħu l-ħin tiegħek; hawn maktur nadif.
colloquial.en: Mark: Give me a moment to blow my nose. Lara: Take your time; here's a clean handkerchief.
colloquial.zh: 马克：给我一点时间擤一下鼻子。拉拉：慢慢来，这里有一块干净的手帕。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 给我一点时间擤一下鼻子。
messages.en: Give me a moment to blow my nose.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu l-ħin tiegħek; hawn maktur nadif.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu l-ħin tiegħek; hawn maktur nadif.
messages.zh: 慢慢来，这里有一块干净的手帕。
messages.en: Take your time; here's a clean handkerchief.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“拿起手帕、擤一下鼻子”的整套动作当作一个名词画面来记；这里记的是动作名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Food that a mother bird gives to her fledglings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 母鸟喂给幼鸟、雏鸟的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ikel li l-għasfura omm tagħti lill-frieħ tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: food given to fledglings by the mother
sense_translations.zh_definition: 母鸟喂给雏鸟的食物。

collocations.en: the food brought by the mother bird

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-bejta, it-tfal raw l-għasfura omm tagħti l-mżaqq lill-frieħ.
formal.en: While observing the nest, the children saw the mother bird give food to her fledglings.
formal.zh: 观察鸟巢时，孩子们看见母鸟把食物喂给雏鸟。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'qed tagħtihom l-għasfura? Pawlu: Dak hu l-mżaqq, l-ikel li qed tagħti lill-frieħ tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lina: What is the bird giving them? Pawlu: That is mżaqq, the food she is giving to her fledglings.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：那只鸟在给它们什么？保罗：那叫 mżaqq，就是她喂给雏鸟的食物。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 那只鸟在给它们什么？
messages.en: What is the bird giving them?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu l-mżaqq, l-ikel li qed tagħti lill-frieħ tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu l-mżaqq, l-ikel li qed tagħti lill-frieħ tagħha.
messages.zh: 那叫 mżaqq，就是她喂给雏鸟的食物。
messages.en: That is mżaqq, the food she is giving to her fledglings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象母鸟把一口食物送进雏鸟嘴里，用“妈妈喂小鸟的那口食物”记住这个专门名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small dunghill; the diminutive form of miżbla.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一小堆粪便；是 miżbla 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Munzell żgħir ta' demel; il-forma diminuttiva ta' miżbla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小粪堆；miżbla 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small dunghill beside the stable

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem neħħa l-mżejbla minn ħdejn l-istalla u naddaf il-post.
formal.en: The worker removed the small dunghill from beside the stable and cleaned the area.
formal.zh: 工人清除了牲畜棚旁的小粪堆，并打扫了那里。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn għandi nnaddaf l-ewwel? Ġużeppi: Neħħi dik il-mżejbla ħdejn il-bieb, imbagħad aħsel l-art.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where should I clean first? Ġużeppi: Remove that little dunghill by the door, then wash the floor.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我应该先打扫哪里？朱塞佩：先把门边那一小堆粪便清走，再冲洗地面。

messages.speaker: Marija (农场工人)
messages.zh: 我应该先打扫哪里？
messages.en: Where should I clean first?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Neħħi dik il-mżejbla ħdejn il-bieb, imbagħad aħsel l-art.
messages.mt_standard: Neħħi dik il-mżejbla ħdejn il-bieb, imbagħad aħsel l-art.
messages.zh: 先把门边那一小堆粪便清走，再冲洗地面。
messages.en: Remove that little dunghill by the door, then wash the floor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miżbla 与 mżejbla 并排做成词卡，后者画成小小一堆，借大小对照记住其指小意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Oily or coated with oil, including oil applied for lubrication.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有油质、显得油腻的，或已经涂油、加油润滑的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih iż-żejt jew li jkun indilek biż-żejt, ukoll biex jitnaqqas il-frizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 油腻的；表面带油或含有较多油的。
涂过油的；已经加油润滑的。

collocations.zh: 加过润滑油的机械装置

formal.mt: Il-mekkaniżmu għandu jinżamm mżejten biex il-partijiet jiċċaqilqu bla xkiel.
formal.en: The mechanism should be kept oiled so that its parts move smoothly.
formal.zh: 该机械装置应保持润滑，使各部件能够顺畅运转。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ma tridx aktar minn dan l-ikel? Rita: Għax hu mżejten wisq għalija; nippreferi xi ħaġa b'inqas żejt.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why don't you want any more of this food? Rita: Because it is too oily for me; I prefer something with less oil.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你怎么不再吃一点这些菜？丽塔：对我来说太油腻了，我更喜欢油少一点的。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx aktar minn dan l-ikel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx aktar minn dan l-ikel?
messages.zh: 你怎么不再吃一点这些菜？
messages.en: Why don't you want any more of this food?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu mżejten wisq għalija; nippreferi xi ħaġa b'inqas żejt.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu mżejten wisq għalija; nippreferi xi ħaġa b'inqas żejt.
messages.zh: 对我来说太油腻了，我更喜欢油少一点的。
messages.en: Because it is too oily for me; I prefer something with less oil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅油光闪闪的画面记忆：菜肴上是“油腻”，机器零件上是“涂油润滑”，同词覆盖两种用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sloping or inclined, sometimes at a steep angle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈倾斜状态的，也可形容坡度很大、陡峭的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu inklinazzjoni, kultant b'pendenza qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾斜的；与水平面形成一定角度的。
陡峭的；坡度很大的。

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-bini juri saqaf mżerżaq li jħalli l-ilma tax-xita jinżel lejn il-kanal.
formal.en: The building plan shows a sloping roof that allows rainwater to run down towards the gutter.
formal.zh: 建筑图纸显示，屋顶采用倾斜设计，使雨水流向排水槽。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nitilgħu minn dan il-passaġġ? Toni: Hu mżerżaq ħafna; ejja nieħdu t-triq l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we go up this path? Toni: It is very steep; let's take the other route.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们从这条小路上去吗？托尼：这条路太陡了，我们走另一条吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 我们从这条小路上去吗？
messages.en: Shall we go up this path?

messages.speaker: Toni (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu mżerżaq ħafna; ejja nieħdu t-triq l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Hu mżerżaq ħafna; ejja nieħdu t-triq l-oħra.
messages.zh: 这条路太陡了，我们走另一条吧。
messages.en: It is very steep; let's take the other route.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在词卡上画一条斜线，再把斜线越画越陡：普通角度记“倾斜”，角度很大记“陡峭”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Weariness, despair, or oppression, according to context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依语境表示疲惫、失去希望的绝望，或受到压制的压迫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għeja, disperazzjoni jew oppressjoni, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疲惫；身心劳累、精力不足的状态。
绝望；失去希望的心境。
压迫；受到强权压制或沉重束缚的处境。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi l-mżiġ tan-nies taħt ħakma ħarxa u x-xewqa tagħhom għal ħajja ħielsa.
formal.en: The author describes the people's oppression under harsh rule and their desire for a free life.
formal.zh: 作者描写了民众在严酷统治下遭受的压迫，以及他们对自由生活的渴望。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex int daqshekk kwiet illum? David: Għandi mżiġ wara ġurnata twila xogħol; irrid nistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you so quiet today? David: I feel weary after a long day at work; I want to rest a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你今天怎么这么安静？戴维：工作了一整天，实在疲惫，我想休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.zh: 你今天怎么这么安静？
messages.en: Why are you so quiet today?

messages.speaker: David (下班回家的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi mżiġ wara ġurnata twila xogħol; irrid nistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi mżiġ wara ġurnata twila xogħol; irrid nistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 工作了一整天，实在疲惫，我想休息一会儿。
messages.en: I feel weary after a long day at work; I want to rest a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景分别记义：累得垂肩是疲惫，看不到希望是绝望，被强权压制是压迫；阅读时靠语境选择。

gloss_zh: 容易觉得恶心的；挑剔的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Easily disgusted or very particular and difficult to please.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易产生恶心、嫌恶感的，或对食物、物品等十分挑剔、难以满足的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li malajr jitqażżeż jew li jkun diffiċli biex jogħġbu xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易觉得恶心的；很容易产生嫌恶感的。
挑剔的；对细节、食物或选择过分讲究而难以满足的。

collocations.en: a child who is easily disgusted or fussy
collocations.zh: 容易嫌恶或挑剔的男孩

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel huwa mżużi fl-ikel u jirrifjuta kull platt li jkun fih ingredjent ġdid.
formal.en: In the story, the boy is finicky about food and refuses any dish containing a new ingredient.
formal.zh: 故事中的男孩很挑食，凡是含有新食材的菜肴，他都不肯吃。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid tipprova din iz-zalza? Mark: Le, grazzi. Jien mżużi fl-ikel u r-riħa tagħha ma togħġobnix.
colloquial.en: Anna: Would you like to try this sauce? Mark: No, thanks. I'm fussy about food, and I don't like its smell.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你想尝尝这个酱汁吗？马克：不了，谢谢。我吃东西比较挑，而且不喜欢它的气味。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想尝尝这个酱汁吗？
messages.en: Would you like to try this sauce?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, grazzi. Jien mżużi fl-ikel u r-riħa tagħha ma togħġobnix.
messages.mt_standard: Le, grazzi. Jien mżużi fl-ikel u r-riħa tagħha ma togħġobnix.
messages.zh: 不了，谢谢。我吃东西比较挑，而且不喜欢它的气味。
messages.en: No, thanks. I'm fussy about food, and I don't like its smell.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人闻到食物就皱鼻子，挑来挑去不肯吃：皱鼻子提示“容易嫌恶”，挑来挑去提示“挑剔”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who proclaims prophecy or preaches about it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容宣告预言或以预言为内容进行宣讲的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jxandar profeziji jew jipprietka dwarhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: preacher of prophecy. this word-from is used by richard taylor in psalm jum il-ħaqq (day of judgement)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣讲预言的；用于描述预言的宣讲者。

formal.mt: Fit-test, l-aġġettiv 'nabbej' jiddeskrivi predikatur li jxandar profeziji.
formal.en: In the text, the adjective 'nabbej' describes a preacher who proclaims prophecies.
formal.zh: 文中，形容词 nabbej 描述一位宣讲预言的传道者。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'nabbej' hawn? Mark: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jxandar profeziji.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'nabbej' mean here? Mark: It describes someone who proclaims prophecies.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的 nabbej 是什么意思？马克：它形容宣讲预言的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 nabbej 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'nabbej' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jxandar profeziji.
messages.mt_standard: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jxandar profeziji.
messages.zh: 它形容宣讲预言的人。
messages.en: It describes someone who proclaims prophecies.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nabbej 放进一幅宣讲者向听众讲述预言的画面中，记住它描述人的宣讲内容。

gloss_zh: 整平打谷用的土地；观察者；守望者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To level an earthen floor so that it is ready for threshing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为准备打谷而把泥土地面整平。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel wiċċ tal-ħamrija ċatt bi tħejjija għad-dris.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make an earthen floor level in preparation for threshing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把泥土地面整平，以准备打谷。
观察者；进行观察的人。
守望者；负责看守或警戒的人。

collocations.en: levelled the threshing floor in preparation for threshing

formal.mt: Qabel id-dris, il-bidwi naddar il-qiegħa biex il-wiċċ ikun ċatt.
formal.en: Before threshing, the farmer levelled the threshing floor so that its surface would be flat.
formal.zh: 打谷之前，农夫整平了谷场，使其表面平坦。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'għamel il-bidwi qabel id-dris? Toni: Naddar l-art biex tkun ċatta.
colloquial.en: Rita: What did the farmer do before threshing? Toni: He levelled the earthen ground so that it would be flat.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：农夫在打谷前做了什么？托尼：他把泥土地面整平了。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 农夫在打谷前做了什么？
messages.en: What did the farmer do before threshing?

messages.speaker: Toni (老师)
messages.zh: 他把泥土地面整平了。
messages.en: He levelled the earthen ground so that it would be flat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三格记 naddar：农夫整平谷场、有人仔细观察、有人站岗守望；先辨词性，再选意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very clean, with no noticeable dirt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常干净、看不到明显污垢的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nadif ħafna, mingħajr ħmieġ li jidher.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常干净的；干干净净的。

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif, il-paviment tas-sala kien nadif tazza.
formal.en: After cleaning, the hall floor was spotless.
formal.zh: 清洁之后，大厅的地板一尘不染。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Il-paviment għadu maħmuġ? Ben: Le, issa nadif tazza!
colloquial.en: Anna: Is the floor still dirty? Ben: No, it's spotless now!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：地板还脏吗？本：不脏了，现在干干净净！

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 地板还脏吗？
messages.en: Is the floor still dirty?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 不脏了，现在干干净净！
messages.en: No, it's spotless now!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nadif tazza 整组记成“干干净净”；搭配阴性名词时留意 nadifa tazza 的形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bottom or lowest part of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物的底部或最低部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qiegħ jew l-aktar parti baxxa ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 底部；最下面的部分。
地面；底面。
一处景象；所见的景色。
一次目击；一次看见某物的经历。

formal.mt: F'din is-sentenza, 'in-nadir tal-bir' jirreferi għall-qiegħ tal-bir.
formal.en: In this sentence, 'in-nadir tal-bir' refers to the bottom of the well.
formal.zh: 在这个句子中，in-nadir tal-bir 指井的底部。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn 'nadir' ifisser xi dehra? David: Le, f'din is-sentenza jfisser il-qiegħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does 'nadir' mean a view here? David: No, in this sentence it means the bottom.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的 nadir 是指景象吗？戴维：不是，在这个句子里它指底部。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 nadir 是指景象吗？
messages.en: Does 'nadir' mean a view here?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.zh: 不是，在这个句子里它指底部。
messages.en: No, in this sentence it means the bottom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 nadir 做四张情境卡：井底、房间地面、眼前景象、一次目击；用上下文区分各义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of observing or watching something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某物进行观察或注视的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed josserva jew iħares lejn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 观察；进行观察这一行为。

formal.mt: Waqt in-nadra mill-bogħod, l-istudenti nnutaw il-movimenti tal-għasafar.
formal.en: During their observation from a distance, the students noted the birds' movements.
formal.zh: 从远处观察时，学生们留意到了鸟的活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'nadra' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Leo: Tfisser l-att li tosserva, bħal meta tħares lejn l-għasafar bir-reqqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'nadra' mean in this exercise? Leo: It means the act of observing, like watching birds carefully.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这道练习里的 nadra 是什么意思？利奥：它指观察这一行为，比如仔细观察鸟。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这道练习里的 nadra 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'nadra' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Leo (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser l-att li tosserva, bħal meta tħares lejn l-għasafar bir-reqqa.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser l-att li tosserva, bħal meta tħares lejn l-għasafar bir-reqqa.
messages.zh: 它指观察这一行为，比如仔细观察鸟。
messages.en: It means the act of observing, like watching birds carefully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿望远镜观察鸟的整个过程：nadra 记的是“观察这件事”，把动作过程当作一个名词。

gloss_zh: 纳杜尔（马耳他戈佐岛的城市及地方议会）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Nadur, a city and local council in Malta's Gozo Region.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 纳杜尔，马耳他戈佐地区的一座城市及其地方议会的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' belt u kunsill lokali fir-Reġjun ta' Għawdex, Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Nadur (a city and local council of the Gozo Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 纳杜尔，马耳他戈佐地区的一座城市及其地方议会。

formal.mt: Il-programm jinkludi żjara fin-Nadur, f'Għawdex.
formal.en: The programme includes a visit to Nadur, in Gozo.
formal.zh: 行程包括游览戈佐岛的纳杜尔。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn sejrin għada? Sam: Fin-Nadur, f'Għawdex.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where are we going tomorrow? Sam: To Nadur, in Gozo.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们明天去哪里？萨姆：去戈佐岛的纳杜尔。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天去哪里？
messages.en: Where are we going tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.zh: 去戈佐岛的纳杜尔。
messages.en: To Nadur, in Gozo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Nadur 标在戈佐岛的地图上，再配一句“去纳杜尔 fin-Nadur”，同时记住地名和出行表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To swell or become larger through swelling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肿胀；因肿起而变大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żdied fid-daqs minħabba nefħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肿胀；肿起来。
溃烂；形成溃疡。
把某物从嘴里吐出来。

collocations.en: spat the water out of his mouth

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, is-saba' tat-tifel nafa wara d-daqqa.
formal.en: In the story, the boy's finger swelled after the blow.
formal.zh: 故事里，男孩的手指受到撞击后肿了起来。

colloquial.mt: Eva: Is-saba' tiegħek nafa wara d-daqqa? Tom: Iva, nafa ftit.
colloquial.en: Eva: Did your finger swell after the blow? Tom: Yes, it swelled a little.
colloquial.zh: 伊娃：你的手指撞到后肿了吗？汤姆：是的，肿了一点。

messages.speaker: Eva (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的手指撞到后肿了吗？
messages.en: Did your finger swell after the blow?

messages.speaker: Tom (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，肿了一点。
messages.en: Yes, it swelled a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nafa 配三幅独立小图：手指肿起、皮肤溃烂、嘴里吐水；遇到句子先看描述的对象和动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rinse clothes with water to remove soap or remaining dirt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用清水漂洗衣物，洗去肥皂或残留的污垢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Laħlaħ il-ħwejjeġ bl-ilma biex ineħħi s-sapun jew il-ħmieġ li jkun fadal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漂洗衣物。

collocations.en: he rinsed the shirts with clean water

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil, il-ħaddiem nafad il-ħwejjeġ bl-ilma nadif biex ineħħi s-sapun li kien fadal.
formal.en: After washing, the worker rinsed the clothes with clean water to remove the remaining soap.
formal.zh: 洗涤后，工人用清水漂洗衣物，去除残留的肥皂。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min nafad il-ħwejjeġ? Pawlu: Jien. Issa tista' tonxorhom.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who rinsed the clothes? Pawlu: I did. You can hang them out now.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁把衣服漂洗了？保罗：我洗的。现在可以晾出去了。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把衣服漂洗了？
messages.en: Who rinsed the clothes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 我洗的。现在可以晾出去了。
messages.en: I did. You can hang them out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nafad 配上“衣服洗完，再过清水”的画面，重点记住它指漂洗这一步。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To force someone to leave their country or home and live elsewhere as an exile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强迫某人离开自己的国家或家园，到别处流亡或居住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlaq minn pajjiżu jew minn daru u jgħix f'post ieħor fl-eżilju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放逐；强迫某人离开本国或家园。

collocations.en: he exiled the poet from his country
collocations.zh: 他将那位诗人逐出了自己的国家

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, is-sultan naffa lill-poeta minn pajjiżu minħabba l-kritika tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the king exiled the poet from his country because of his criticism.
formal.zh: 在小说中，国王因诗人的批评而将他放逐出境。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-poeta jgħix fuq dik il-gżira? Mark: Is-sultan naffa lill-poeta. Ma jistax imur lura pajjiżu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the poet live on that island? Mark: The king exiled the poet. He cannot return to his country.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那位诗人为什么住在那座岛上？马克：国王放逐了他。他不能回自己的国家。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-poeta jgħix fuq dik il-gżira?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-poeta jgħix fuq dik il-gżira?
messages.zh: 那位诗人为什么住在那座岛上？
messages.en: Why does the poet live on that island?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sultan naffa lill-poeta. Ma jistax imur lura pajjiżu.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sultan naffa lill-poeta. Ma jistax imur lura pajjiżu.
messages.zh: 国王放逐了他。他不能回自己的国家。
messages.en: The king exiled the poet. He cannot return to his country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 naffa 联想“被迫离乡、无法归国”的小说场景，把放逐与普通旅行区分开来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who rinses things, such as clothes, with water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用水漂洗物品，例如衣物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tlaħlaħ affarijiet, bħall-ħwejjeġ, bl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漂洗者；进行漂洗的人。

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività, in-naffad ħa l-ħwejjeġ maħsula u laħlaħhom bl-ilma nadif.
formal.en: During the activity, the rinser took the washed clothes and rinsed them with clean water.
formal.zh: 活动中，负责漂洗的人接过洗好的衣物，用清水将它们漂洗干净。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min hu n-naffad illum? Toni: Jien. Int aħsel il-ħwejjeġ u jien inlaħlaħhom.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who is the rinser today? Toni: I am. You wash the clothes and I will rinse them.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：今天谁负责漂洗？托尼：我。你洗衣服，我来漂洗。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 今天谁负责漂洗？
messages.en: Who is the rinser today?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Int aħsel il-ħwejjeġ u jien inlaħlaħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Int aħsel il-ħwejjeġ u jien inlaħlaħhom.
messages.zh: 我。你洗衣服，我来漂洗。
messages.en: I am. You wash the clothes and I will rinse them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 naffad 画一张“漂洗负责人”的姓名牌，借人物画面记住它是指人的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sudden alarm, the flight it causes, or a tendency to become frightened easily, especially in animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然的惊恐、由此引发的逃散，或容易受惊的特性，尤用于动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biża' għal għarrieda, ħarba minħabba din il-biża', jew tendenza li wieħed jitwerwer malajr, speċjalment fl-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惊恐；突然受到惊吓的状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: flight as a result of sudden alarm
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因突然受惊而逃跑或四散奔逃。
容易受惊、惊跳的特性，尤指动物。

collocations.en: alarm or frightened flight among the horses

formal.mt: Ħoss qawwi qajjem nafra fost iż-żwiemel, li ħarbu lejn in-naħa l-oħra tal-għalqa.
formal.en: A loud noise caused alarm among the horses, which fled to the other side of the field.
formal.zh: 一声巨响惊动了马群，它们纷纷逃向田地的另一边。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'kienet dik in-nafra fost iż-żwiemel? Ġużeppi: Il-bieb ingħalaq b'ħoss qawwi u kollha ħarbu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What caused that frightened rush among the horses? Ġużeppi: The gate shut with a loud noise and they all fled.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马群刚才为什么受惊奔逃？朱塞佩：大门砰地关上，它们就全跑了。

messages.speaker: Sara (农场访客)
messages.zh: 马群刚才为什么受惊奔逃？
messages.en: What caused that frightened rush among the horses?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bieb ingħalaq b'ħoss qawwi u kollha ħarbu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bieb ingħalaq b'ħoss qawwi u kollha ħarbu.
messages.zh: 大门砰地关上，它们就全跑了。
messages.en: The gate shut with a loud noise and they all fled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“巨响—受惊—逃散”三格漫画记 nafra，再把容易出现这种反应联想到“易受惊”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sheep, referring to more than one of the farm animals kept for wool, milk, or meat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 绵羊的复数，指多只为获取羊毛、羊奶或肉而饲养的家畜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimali domestiċi li jitrabbew għas-suf, għall-ħalib jew għal-laħam; il-plural ta' nagħġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绵羊，复数，指多只绵羊。

formal.mt: Ir-ragħaj ħa n-nagħaġ lejn il-mergħa u żgura li kellhom biżżejjed ilma.
formal.en: The shepherd took the sheep to the pasture and ensured that they had enough water.
formal.zh: 牧羊人把羊群赶到牧场，并确保它们有足够的饮水。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Fejn huma n-nagħaġ? Pietru: Qegħdin fl-għalqa wara d-dar. Ejja narawhom.
colloquial.en: Emma: Where are the sheep? Pietru: They are in the field behind the house. Let's go and see them.
colloquial.zh: 埃玛：羊群在哪儿？彼得：在屋后的田里。咱们去看看它们。

messages.speaker: Emma (农场访客)

messages.speaker: Pietru (农场主)

messages.mt_standard: Qegħdin fl-għalqa wara d-dar. Ejja narawhom.
messages.zh: 在屋后的田里。咱们去看看它们。
messages.en: They are in the field behind the house. Let's go and see them.

gloss_zh: 给马钉蹄铁的人；钉蹄铁匠

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work is fitting horseshoes to horses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以给马安装、钉上蹄铁为工作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li twaħħal in-nagħal ma' saqajn iż-żwiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给马钉蹄铁的人
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li twaħħal in-nagħal ma' saqajn iż-żwiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钉蹄铁匠；从事马蹄装铁工作的工匠
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaddiem tas-sengħa li jwaħħal in-nagħal ma' saqajn iż-żwiemel.

formal.mt: In-nagħgħal eżamina n-nagħla qabel ma waħħalha ma' sieq iż-żiemel.
formal.en: The farrier examined the horseshoe before fitting it to the horse's hoof.
formal.zh: 钉蹄铁匠先检查了蹄铁，然后才将它安装到马蹄上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Meta ġej in-nagħgħal? Lara: Għada filgħodu. Iż-żiemel għandu bżonn nagħla ġdida.
colloquial.en: Mark: When is the farrier coming? Lara: Tomorrow morning. The horse needs a new horseshoe.
colloquial.zh: Mark：钉蹄铁匠什么时候来？Lara：明天早上。这匹马需要换一只新蹄铁。

messages.speaker: Mark (马主)
messages.zh: 钉蹄铁匠什么时候来？
messages.en: When is the farrier coming?

messages.speaker: Lara (马场工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada filgħodu. Iż-żiemel għandu bżonn nagħla ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Għada filgħodu. Iż-żiemel għandu bżonn nagħla ġdida.
messages.zh: 明天早上。这匹马需要换一只新蹄铁。
messages.en: Tomorrow morning. The horse needs a new horseshoe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位蹲在马蹄旁安装蹄铁的工匠，用这个人物画面记住 nagħgħal，重点是“做这项工作的人”。

gloss_zh: 使人入睡；催眠入睡的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of causing someone to fall asleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人进入睡眠的行为，例如用轻柔的歌声哄人入睡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jorqod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人入睡；引人进入睡眠
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jorqod.

collocations.en: an example of the use of 'nagħgħas'

formal.mt: F'dan il-glossarju, 'nagħgħas' jirreferi għall-azzjoni li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jorqod, bħalma tagħmel għanja kwieta.
formal.en: In this glossary, 'nagħgħas' refers to the action of inducing sleep, as a gentle song may do.
formal.zh: 在这份词汇表中，“nagħgħas”指使人入睡的行为，例如轻柔的歌曲所起的作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'nagħgħas' hawn? Pawlu: Li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jorqod. Aħseb f'għanja li traqqad tarbija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'nagħgħas' mean here? Pawlu: To make someone fall asleep. Think of a song that lulls a baby to sleep.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的“nagħgħas”是什么意思？Pawlu：使某人入睡。想想一首哄婴儿睡觉的歌。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“nagħgħas”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'nagħgħas' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jorqod. Aħseb f'għanja li traqqad tarbija.
messages.mt_standard: Li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jorqod. Aħseb f'għanja li traqqad tarbija.
messages.zh: 使某人入睡。想想一首哄婴儿睡觉的歌。
messages.en: To make someone fall asleep. Think of a song that lulls a baby to sleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“摇篮曲让婴儿闭上眼睛”的画面记住 nagħgħas，抓住“使人进入睡眠”这一动作含义。

gloss_zh: 令人困倦的；催人欲睡的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing a person to feel sleepy or drowsy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容能使人产生睡意、变得困倦的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss in-ngħas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人困倦的；使人产生睡意的
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss in-ngħas.

formal.mt: Il-ħoss regolari tax-xita kellu effett nagħgħasi fuq is-semmiegħ.
formal.en: The steady sound of the rain had a drowsiness-inducing effect on the listener.
formal.zh: 均匀的雨声使听者渐渐产生了睡意。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ħoss għandu effett nagħgħasi fuqi. Ben: Fuqi wkoll. Qed jingħalquli għajnejja.
colloquial.en: Sara: This sound makes me drowsy. Ben: Me too. My eyes are closing.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这声音听得我犯困。Ben：我也是，眼睛都快睁不开了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħoss għandu effett nagħgħasi fuqi.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħoss għandu effett nagħgħasi fuqi.
messages.zh: 这声音听得我犯困。
messages.en: This sound makes me drowsy.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 我也是，眼睛都快睁不开了。
messages.en: Me too. My eyes are closing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听着均匀雨声，眼皮越来越沉；把 nagħgħasi 贴在“让人犯困的声音或效果”上来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A curved metal shoe fitted to a horse's hoof.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安装在马蹄上的弯曲金属蹄铁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ħadid mgħawġa li titwaħħal ma' sieq iż-żiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只马蹄铁；蹄铁
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ħadid mgħawġa li titwaħħal ma' sieq iż-żiemel.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, instabet nagħla maħlula fuq waħda mis-saqajn taż-żiemel.
formal.en: During the inspection, a loose horseshoe was found on one of the horse's hooves.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，这匹马有一只蹄铁松动了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara, din in-nagħla maħlula. Mark: Rajtha. Se nċempel lin-nagħgħal.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look, this horseshoe is loose. Mark: I see it. I'll call the farrier.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看，这只马蹄铁松了。Mark：看到了。我来给钉蹄铁匠打电话。

messages.speaker: Lara (马场工作人员)
messages.zh: 看，这只马蹄铁松了。
messages.en: Look, this horseshoe is loose.

messages.speaker: Mark (马主)
messages.zh: 看到了。我来给钉蹄铁匠打电话。
messages.en: I see it. I'll call the farrier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nagħla 想成手里拿着的一只弯曲马蹄铁，再与 nagħgħal 这位安装蹄铁的工匠配成一幅图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single sheep; figuratively, a very docile person who readily follows others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一只绵羊；比喻十分温顺、容易顺从他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal domestiku li jitrabba għas-suf, għall-ħalib jew għal-laħam; b'mod figurattiv, persuna ġwejda ħafna li faċilment timxi wara ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绵羊，单数，指一只绵羊。
十分温顺、顺从的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-awtur isejjaħ lill-karattru nagħġa għax dejjem jaċċetta d-deċiżjonijiet tal-oħrajn mingħajr ma joġġezzjona.
formal.en: In the story, the author calls the character a sheep because he always accepts other people's decisions without objecting.
formal.zh: 故事中，作者把这个人物称作“绵羊”，因为他总是毫无异议地接受别人的决定。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dik in-nagħġa bajda dejjem tiġi ħdejk? Samwel: Iva, hi ġwejda ħafna. Ara, qed tersaq lejna.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does that white sheep always come up to you? Samwel: Yes, she is very docile. Look, she is coming towards us.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那只白绵羊总会走到你身边吗？萨姆韦尔：会，它特别温顺。你看，它正朝我们走来。

messages.speaker: Anna (农场访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik in-nagħġa bajda dejjem tiġi ħdejk?
messages.mt_standard: Dik in-nagħġa bajda dejjem tiġi ħdejk?
messages.zh: 那只白绵羊总会走到你身边吗？
messages.en: Does that white sheep always come up to you?

messages.speaker: Samwel (饲养员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hi ġwejda ħafna. Ara, qed tersaq lejna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hi ġwejda ħafna. Ara, qed tersaq lejna.
messages.zh: 会，它特别温顺。你看，它正朝我们走来。
messages.en: Yes, she is very docile. Look, she is coming towards us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一只温顺的绵羊”记 nagħġa，再把温顺形象联想到十分顺从的人，同时记住复数 nagħaġ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to sheep or coming from sheep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于描述与绵羊有关或来自绵羊的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam man-nagħaġ jew li ġej min-nagħaġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绵羊的；与绵羊有关的
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam man-nagħaġ.

formal.mt: It-tikketta tispeċifika li l-ġobon huwa magħmul minn ħalib nagħġi.
formal.en: The label specifies that the cheese is made from sheep's milk.
formal.zh: 标签注明，这种奶酪由绵羊奶制成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ġobon minn ħalib nagħġi? Toni: Iva, minn ħalib tan-nagħaġ. Trid idduqu?
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this cheese made from sheep's milk? Toni: Yes, from sheep's milk. Would you like to taste it?
colloquial.zh: Maja：这奶酪是用绵羊奶做的吗？Toni：对，是绵羊奶做的。你想尝尝吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这奶酪是用绵羊奶做的吗？
messages.en: Is this cheese made from sheep's milk?

messages.speaker: Toni (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minn ħalib tan-nagħaġ. Trid idduqu?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minn ħalib tan-nagħaġ. Trid idduqu?
messages.zh: 对，是绵羊奶做的。你想尝尝吗？
messages.en: Yes, from sheep's milk. Would you like to taste it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nagħġi 想成贴在奶瓶和毛线上的“绵羊的”标签；它描述事物与绵羊的关系。

gloss_zh: 照料炉火；用火焰烹煮；看火工

teaching_sense.en_definition: To look after a fire and keep it burning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 照料火，使其持续燃烧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu ħsieb in-nar u jżommu jaqbad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 照料火；看管并维持炉火。
在火焰上烹煮食物。
看火工；负责照料炉火的人。

collocations.en: cooked the food over the flame

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem najjar in-nar biex iżomm is-sħana fil-forn.
formal.en: The worker tended the fire to maintain the heat in the oven.
formal.zh: 工人照料炉火，以维持烤炉内的温度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min najjar in-nar waqt li konna barra? Mark: Jien; żidt ftit injam biex jibqa' jaqbad.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who tended the fire while we were outside? Mark: I did; I added a little wood to keep it burning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在外面的时候，是谁照料炉火的？马克：是我；我添了些木柴，让火继续烧着。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min najjar in-nar waqt li konna barra?
messages.mt_standard: Min najjar in-nar waqt li konna barra?
messages.zh: 我们在外面的时候，是谁照料炉火的？
messages.en: Who tended the fire while we were outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; żidt ftit injam biex jibqa' jaqbad.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; żidt ftit injam biex jibqa' jaqbad.
messages.zh: 是我；我添了些木柴，让火继续烧着。
messages.en: I did; I added a little wood to keep it burning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象炉边有人添柴、有人做饭：添柴对应照料火，做饭对应火上烹煮；名词义则记为看火的人。

gloss_zh: 与火有关的；与烟火有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to fire or fireworks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与火或烟火有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam man-nar jew mal-logħob tan-nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与火有关的。
与烟火、焰火有关的。

collocations.zh: 与火或烟火有关的工作

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-festa jinkludi spettaklu najjari filgħaxija.
formal.en: The festival programme includes a fireworks display in the evening.
formal.zh: 节庆活动安排包括晚间的烟火表演。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Se mmorru naraw l-ispettaklu najjari llejla? Lara: Iva, jibda fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Toni: Are we going to watch the fireworks display tonight? Lara: Yes, it starts at nine.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：我们今晚去看烟火表演吗？拉拉：去，九点开始。

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmorru naraw l-ispettaklu najjari llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Se mmorru naraw l-ispettaklu najjari llejla?
messages.zh: 我们今晚去看烟火表演吗？
messages.en: Are we going to watch the fireworks display tonight?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 去，九点开始。
messages.en: Yes, it starts at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上画一团火和一束烟花，把它们一起标成“有关火的”；遇到节庆表演时联想到烟火义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be in a state of sleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于睡眠状态；睡觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun fi stat ta' rqad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 睡觉；处于睡眠状态。

formal.mt: Skont in-noti tal-osservazzjoni, it-tifel nam għal siegħa wara l-ikel.
formal.en: According to the observation notes, the boy slept for an hour after the meal.
formal.zh: 根据观察记录，男孩饭后睡了一个小时。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu nam sew ilbieraħ? Mark: Iva, nam għal tmien sigħat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu sleep well yesterday? Mark: Yes, he slept for eight hours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗昨天睡得好吗？马克：好，他睡了八个小时。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗昨天睡得好吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu sleep well yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，他睡了八个小时。
messages.en: Yes, he slept for eight hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短词 nam 写在闭眼睡觉的小人旁，再搭配“睡得好”和“睡一小时”两种短语一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Namibia, a country in Southern Africa whose official name in Maltese is Repubblika tan-Namibja.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 纳米比亚，位于非洲南部的国家，马耳他语正式名称为 Repubblika tan-Namibja。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika tan-Namibja.

sense_translations.en_definition: Namibia (a country in Southern Africa; official name: Repubblika tan-Namibja)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 纳米比亚，非洲南部的国家；正式名称为纳米比亚共和国。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-ġeografija, l-istudenta kitbet li n-Namibja tinsab fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika.
formal.en: In her geography report, the student wrote that Namibia is in Southern Africa.
formal.zh: 这名学生在地理报告中写道，纳米比亚位于非洲南部。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tinsab in-Namibja? Mark: Fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika. Ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Namibia? Mark: In Southern Africa. Let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：纳米比亚在哪里？马克：在非洲南部。我们在地图上找找吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 纳米比亚在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Namibia?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika. Ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika. Ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在非洲南部。我们在地图上找找吧。
messages.en: In Southern Africa. Let's find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Namibja 写在非洲南部的地图位置旁，并与中文“纳米比亚”连线记忆；国家名称首字母大写。

gloss_zh: 挑逗的示意；爱卖弄风情的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flirtatious invitation or come-hither gesture; also a person who behaves coquettishly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示调情、引人靠近的挑逗示意；也可指爱卖弄风情、以调情举止吸引别人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħarsa jew ġest li jistieden lil xi ħadd jersaq bi flirt; ukoll persuna li tħobb tiġbed l-attenzjoni bi mġiba ta' flirt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以调情意味引人靠近的眼神、姿态或示意。
爱卖弄风情、以调情举止吸引他人的人。

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, l-awtur jiddeskrivi ħarsa ta' namriċes li tistieden lill-karattru l-ieħor jersaq eqreb.
formal.en: In the story, the author describes a come-hither look inviting the other character to come closer.
formal.zh: 故事中，作者描写了一个挑逗的眼神，示意另一个人物靠近。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex sejjaħtlu namriċes? Nina: Għax dejjem jipprova jiġbed l-attenzjoni b'ħarsiet u tbissim.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you call him a flirt? Nina: Because he is always trying to attract attention with looks and smiles.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么说他爱卖弄风情？妮娜：因为他总想靠眼神和笑容吸引注意。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他爱卖弄风情？
messages.en: Why did you call him a flirt?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem jipprova jiġbed l-attenzjoni b'ħarsiet u tbissim.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem jipprova jiġbed l-attenzjoni b'ħarsiet u tbissim.
messages.zh: 因为他总想靠眼神和笑容吸引注意。
messages.en: Because he is always trying to attract attention with looks and smiles.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事中一个勾人靠近的眼神，再把镜头移到发出眼神的人：分别记住“挑逗示意”和“卖弄风情的人”两义。

gloss_zh: 对某事十分热衷的；有强烈爱好的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strongly inclined toward or enthusiastic about something, especially a hobby or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事有强烈兴趣或偏好，尤其指十分热衷某种爱好或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ġibda qawwija lejn xi ħaġa, speċjalment passatemp jew attività.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a strong proclivity to sth (especially a hobby or acivity)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某事有强烈偏好或浓厚兴趣的，尤其指某种爱好或活动。

formal.mt: L-istudent huwa namruż għall-mużika u jqatta' ħafna mill-ħin liberu tiegħu jipprattika.
formal.en: The student is very keen on music and spends much of his free time practising.
formal.zh: 这名学生十分热爱音乐，把许多空闲时间都用来练习。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu reġa' mar jistad illum? Toni: Iva, huwa namruż għas-sajd. Imur kull meta jkollu ċans.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has Pawlu gone fishing again today? Toni: Yes, he is very keen on fishing. He goes whenever he gets the chance.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗今天又去钓鱼了？托尼：是啊，他特别迷钓鱼，一有机会就去。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗今天又去钓鱼了？
messages.en: Has Pawlu gone fishing again today?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa namruż għas-sajd. Imur kull meta jkollu ċans.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa namruż għas-sajd. Imur kull meta jkollu ċans.
messages.zh: 是啊，他特别迷钓鱼，一有机会就去。
messages.en: Yes, he is very keen on fishing. He goes whenever he gets the chance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一有空就去钓鱼”的人物画面记 namruż：它描述一个人对活动的热衷程度，是形容词。

gloss_zh: 业余爱好；求爱、恋爱交往

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hobby pursued for enjoyment; also courtship, the activity or period of developing a romantic relationship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为乐趣而从事的业余爱好；也指为发展恋爱关系而进行的求爱或交往。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Passatemp li wieħed jagħmel għall-gost; ukoll iż-żmien jew l-attività li fiha żewġ persuni jsiru jafu lil xulxin f'relazzjoni ta' mħabba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 业余爱好；在闲暇时为乐趣而从事的活动。
求爱；为建立或发展恋爱关系而进行的交往。

formal.mt: Fl-awtobijografija tiegħu, l-awtur jiddeskrivi s-sajd bħala namur u jirrakkonta wkoll żmien in-namur ma' martu.
formal.en: In his autobiography, the author describes fishing as a hobby and also recounts his courtship with his wife.
formal.zh: 作者在自传中把钓鱼描述为自己的业余爱好，也回忆了与妻子恋爱交往的时期。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawnhekk namur ifisser passatemp? Mark: Iva, qed jitkellem dwar is-sajd. Imma namur jista' jfisser ukoll iż-żmien meta koppja tkun qed issir taf lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does namur mean a hobby here? Mark: Yes, he is talking about fishing. But namur can also mean the period when a couple are getting to know each other romantically.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 namur 是指业余爱好吗？马克：对，他在说钓鱼。不过，namur 也可以指情侣彼此了解、发展感情的时期。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这里的 namur 是指业余爱好吗？
messages.en: Does namur mean a hobby here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed jitkellem dwar is-sajd. Imma namur jista' jfisser ukoll iż-żmien meta koppja tkun qed issir taf lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed jitkellem dwar is-sajd. Imma namur jista' jfisser ukoll iż-żmien meta koppja tkun qed issir taf lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 对，他在说钓鱼。不过，namur 也可以指情侣彼此了解、发展感情的时期。
messages.en: Yes, he is talking about fishing. But namur can also mean the period when a couple are getting to know each other romantically.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 namur 画两张记忆卡：一张是闲暇钓鱼，一张是情侣约会；读句子时靠上下文选择“爱好”或“求爱交往”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cream-colored courser, the bird species Cursorius cursor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沙色走鸻，一种鸟，英文名为 cream-colored courser，学名为 Cursorius cursor。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-ispeċi Cursorius cursor, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala cream-colored courser.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙色走鸻，学名 Cursorius cursor。

collocations.en: a sighting of a cream-colored courser
collocations.zh: 一次沙色走鸻的目击记录

collocations.en: a photograph of a cream-colored courser

formal.mt: Fir-reġistru tal-osservazzjonijiet, ir-riċerkatur niżżel nankina bl-isem xjentifiku Cursorius cursor.
formal.en: In the observation log, the researcher recorded a cream-colored courser under the scientific name Cursorius cursor.
formal.zh: 研究人员在观察记录中以学名 Cursorius cursor 登记了一只沙色走鸻。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fir-ritratt? Mark: Nankina. Ejja nqabblu r-ritratt mal-istampa fil-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this bird in the photograph called? Mark: A cream-colored courser. Let's compare the photograph with the picture in the book.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：照片里的这种鸟叫什么？马克：沙色走鸻。我们把照片和书里的图片比较一下吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 照片里的这种鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Nankina. Ejja nqabblu r-ritratt mal-istampa fil-ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Nankina. Ejja nqabblu r-ritratt mal-istampa fil-ktieb.
messages.zh: 沙色走鸻。我们把照片和书里的图片比较一下吧。
messages.en: A cream-colored courser. Let's compare the photograph with the picture in the book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张鸟类图片卡，把 nankina、沙色走鸻和 Cursorius cursor 并排标注，用同一张图连接三个名称。

gloss_zh: 民间故事中的邪恶老巫婆 Nanna Għula

teaching_sense.en_definition: Nanna Għula, an evil old witch who appears in folktales.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Nanna Għula，出现在民间故事中的邪恶老巫婆的名字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' saħħara xiħa u ħażina li tidher fil-ħrejjef.

sense_translations.en_definition: an evil, old witch, occurring in folktales
sense_translations.zh_definition: 民间故事中一个邪恶的老巫婆角色。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tal-ħrafa, l-istudenta tiddeskrivi lil Nanna Għula bħala saħħara xiħa u ħażina.
formal.en: In her analysis of the folktale, the student describes Nanna Għula as an evil old witch.
formal.zh: 这名学生在对民间故事的分析中，将 Nanna Għula 描述为一个邪恶的老巫婆。

colloquial.mt: Mila: Min hi Nanna Għula f'din il-ħrafa? Rita: Hija s-saħħara xiħa u ħażina. Ejja naqraw x'tagħmel wara.
colloquial.en: Mila: Who is Nanna Għula in this folktale? Rita: She is the evil old witch. Let's read what she does next.
colloquial.zh: 米拉：这篇民间故事里的 Nanna Għula 是谁？丽塔：她就是那个邪恶的老巫婆。我们读读她接下来做什么吧。

messages.speaker: Mila (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hi Nanna Għula f'din il-ħrafa?
messages.mt_standard: Min hi Nanna Għula f'din il-ħrafa?
messages.zh: 这篇民间故事里的 Nanna Għula 是谁？
messages.en: Who is Nanna Għula in this folktale?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija s-saħħara xiħa u ħażina. Ejja naqraw x'tagħmel wara.
messages.mt_standard: Hija s-saħħara xiħa u ħażina. Ejja naqraw x'tagħmel wara.
messages.zh: 她就是那个邪恶的老巫婆。我们读读她接下来做什么吧。
messages.en: She is the evil old witch. Let's read what she does next.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Nanna Għula 整体写在故事角色卡上，旁边画一位邪恶老巫婆；按角色名称整体记忆，不拆词猜测来历。

gloss_zh: 摘取、剔取；除草；摘取这一动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pluck or pick something out, for example seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摘取或剔取某物，例如取出种子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqla' jew jiġbor xi ħaġa billi jneħħiha minn fejn tkun imwaħħla, pereżempju ż-żrieragħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摘取、剔取，例如取出种子。
除草；清除杂草的工作或过程。
摘取、拔取或剔取的动作或过程。

formal.mt: L-istudent naqa ż-żrieragħ mill-frotta u poġġiehom f'kontenitur. Fir-rapport, iddeskriva n-naqa taż-żrieragħ.
formal.en: The student plucked the seeds out of the fruit and placed them in a container. In the report, he described the process of plucking out the seeds.
formal.zh: 学生从果实中剔出种子，放进容器里，并在报告中描述了剔取种子的过程。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Min naqa ż-żrieragħ minn din il-frotta? Pawlu: Jien. Poġġejthom f'dik it-tazza.
colloquial.en: Lina: Who plucked the seeds out of this fruit? Pawlu: I did. I put them in that cup.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：谁把这个果实里的种子剔出来了？保罗：我剔的。我把它们放在那个杯子里了。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min naqa ż-żrieragħ minn din il-frotta?
messages.mt_standard: Min naqa ż-żrieragħ minn din il-frotta?
messages.zh: 谁把这个果实里的种子剔出来了？
messages.en: Who plucked the seeds out of this fruit?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 我剔的。我把它们放在那个杯子里了。
messages.en: I did. I put them in that cup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手从果实中取出种子的画面记动词义，再为“除草”和“摘取过程”各做一张名词卡，提醒自己同形词要分词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a hole through something by piercing, puncturing, or perforating it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过刺、扎等方式在物体上弄出贯穿的孔，即刺穿、扎破或穿孔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel toqba f'xi ħaġa billi jgħaddi oġġett minn ġo fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺穿；用尖物穿透某物。
扎破；刺出小孔。
穿孔；在材料上打出一个或多个贯穿的孔。

collocations.en: he pierced the paper with a needle

collocations.zh: 他在金属薄板上穿了孔

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, l-istudent naqab il-karta b'labra u osserva t-toqba li nħolqot.
formal.en: During the experiment, the student pierced the paper with a needle and observed the resulting hole.
formal.zh: 实验中，学生用针刺穿纸张，并观察形成的小孔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħarġet l-arja mill-bużżieqa? Toni: Għax xi ħadd naqab il-bużżieqa b'labra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the air come out of the balloon? Toni: Because someone punctured the balloon with a needle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：气球为什么漏气了？托尼：因为有人用针扎破了气球。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 气球为什么漏气了？
messages.en: Why did the air come out of the balloon?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax xi ħadd naqab il-bużżieqa b'labra.
messages.mt_standard: Għax xi ħadd naqab il-bużżieqa b'labra.
messages.zh: 因为有人用针扎破了气球。
messages.en: Because someone punctured the balloon with a needle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把纸被刺穿、气球被扎破、薄板被穿孔三幅图排在一起，抓住共同画面“物体上出现贯穿的小孔”来记 naqab。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Material that settles at the bottom of a liquid; also, a worthless remnant of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沉到液体底部的物质；也指某物留下的无用残余。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li jinġabar fil-qiegħ ta' likwidu; ukoll, fdal ta' xi ħaġa li ma għandu ebda siwi.

sense_translations.en_definition: sediment at the bottom of a liquid
sense_translations.zh_definition: 液体底部的沉淀物。
某物留下的无用残余或废渣。

formal.mt: Qabel ma jitferra' l-likwidu, il-kontenitur għandu jitħalla wieqaf sabiex in-naqal jinġabar fil-qiegħ.
formal.en: Before the liquid is poured, the container should be left standing so that the sediment collects at the bottom.
formal.zh: 倒出液体之前，应让容器静置，使沉淀物积聚在底部。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tferra' l-inbid daqshekk bil-mod? Mark: Biex in-naqal jibqa' fil-flixkun u ma jidħolx fit-tazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you pouring the wine so slowly? Mark: So the sediment stays in the bottle and does not get into the glass.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把葡萄酒倒得这么慢？马克：这样沉淀物就留在瓶里，不会进入杯子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tferra' l-inbid daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tferra' l-inbid daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.zh: 你为什么把葡萄酒倒得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you pouring the wine so slowly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex in-naqal jibqa' fil-flixkun u ma jidħolx fit-tazza.
messages.mt_standard: Biex in-naqal jibqa' fil-flixkun u ma jidħolx fit-tazza.
messages.zh: 这样沉淀物就留在瓶里，不会进入杯子。
messages.en: So the sediment stays in the bottle and does not get into the glass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naqal 和杯底沉下来的渣连在一起记，再由“留下的渣”联想到“无用残余”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of piercing something; in another sense, the hatching of an egg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刺穿某物的行为；另一个义项指蛋的孵化、幼体破壳而出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tittaqqab xi ħaġa; f'tifsira oħra, it-tfaqqis ta' bajda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿刺；刺穿的行为。
孵化；幼体从蛋中破壳而出。

formal.mt: In-naqba tal-folja tal-metall saret b'għodda adattata, filwaqt li l-folja nżammet f'postha.
formal.en: The piercing of the metal sheet was carried out with a suitable tool while the sheet was held in place.
formal.zh: 穿刺金属薄板时，使用了合适的工具，并将薄板固定在原位。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed tistenna ħdejn il-bajd? Pawlu: Qed nistenna n-naqba; irrid nara l-flieles joħorġu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you waiting for beside the eggs? Pawlu: I am waiting for the hatching; I want to see the chicks come out.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你守在蛋旁边等什么？保罗：我在等它们孵化，想看小鸡破壳出来。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你守在蛋旁边等什么？
messages.en: What are you waiting for beside the eggs?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养鸡人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nistenna n-naqba; irrid nara l-flieles joħorġu.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nistenna n-naqba; irrid nara l-flieles joħorġu.
messages.zh: 我在等它们孵化，想看小鸡破壳出来。
messages.en: I am waiting for the hatching; I want to see the chicks come out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个独立画面记 naqba：工具刺穿薄板、小鸡破壳而出；这是记忆配对，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cleaning something by leaving it immersed in a liquid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品浸在液体中一段时间，以达到清洁目的的处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindif ta' xi ħaġa billi titħalla mgħaddsa f'likwidu għal xi żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过在液体中浸泡来清洗。

collocations.en: a cleansing soak in soapy water

formal.mt: Għat-tindif tad-drapp, hija rrakkomandata naqgħa fl-ilma bis-sapun qabel il-ħasil.
formal.en: For cleaning the fabric, a soak in soapy water is recommended before washing.
formal.zh: 清洁这种布料时，建议先用肥皂水浸泡，再进行洗涤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din it-tebgħa ma tridx toħroġ. Omm: Agħti naqgħa lill-qmis fl-ilma bis-sapun, imbagħad erġa' aħsilha.
colloquial.en: Lara: This stain will not come out. Mum: Give the shirt a soak in soapy water, then wash it again.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块污渍怎么也洗不掉。妈妈：把衬衫放进肥皂水里浸泡一下，然后再洗。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 这块污渍怎么也洗不掉。
messages.en: This stain will not come out.

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħti naqgħa lill-qmis fl-ilma bis-sapun, imbagħad erġa' aħsilha.
messages.mt_standard: Agħti naqgħa lill-qmis fl-ilma bis-sapun, imbagħad erġa' aħsilha.
messages.zh: 把衬衫放进肥皂水里浸泡一下，然后再洗。
messages.en: Give the shirt a soak in soapy water, then wash it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 naqgħa 时想象脏衬衫泡在肥皂水里：重点是“靠浸泡来清洁”这个完整过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool used to scrape material from a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来刮除表面附着物的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex jitneħħa materjal minn fuq wiċċ billi jinbarax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刮刀；用于刮除表面附着物的刮具。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża naqla biex ineħħi ż-żebgħa l-qadima minn fuq il-bieb qabel ma beda jiżbgħu mill-ġdid.
formal.en: The worker used a scraper to remove the old paint from the door before repainting it.
formal.zh: 工人在重新给门上漆之前，用刮刀清除了门上的旧漆。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek naqla? Din iż-żebgħa qed titqaxxar. Rita: Iva, tinsab fil-kaxxa tal-għodda; użaha bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a scraper? This paint is peeling. Rita: Yes, it is in the toolbox; use it gently.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你有刮刀吗？这层油漆起皮了。丽塔：有，在工具箱里，轻轻地用。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek naqla? Din iż-żebgħa qed titqaxxar.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek naqla? Din iż-żebgħa qed titqaxxar.
messages.zh: 你有刮刀吗？这层油漆起皮了。
messages.en: Do you have a scraper? This paint is peeling.

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tinsab fil-kaxxa tal-għodda; użaha bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tinsab fil-kaxxa tal-għodda; użaha bil-mod.
messages.zh: 有，在工具箱里，轻轻地用。
messages.en: Yes, it is in the toolbox; use it gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naqla 贴在工具箱里那把刮旧漆的工具上，借“拿起工具刮表面”的动作记住词义。

gloss_zh: 喉音重的；带明显喉音的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person's voice as having a strong sound produced in the throat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人的嗓音带有明显的喉音，听起来像从喉咙深处发出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi leħen ta' persuna li fih jinstema' ħoss qawwi mill-gerżuma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喉音重的；用于形容人的嗓音。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jitkellem b'leħen naqnieq li jagħmlu faċli biex jingħaraf mid-djalogu biss.
formal.en: In the story, the character speaks in a throaty voice that makes him easy to identify from the dialogue alone.
formal.zh: 故事中的这个角色说话时喉音很重，仅凭对话就很容易辨认出他。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif għaraft lil Toni mingħajr ma rajtu? Ben: Għandu leħen naqnieq; għaraftu malli beda jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did you recognize Toni without seeing him? Ben: He has a throaty voice; I recognized him as soon as he started speaking.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你没看见托尼，怎么认出他的？本：他的嗓音喉音很重，一开口我就认出来了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għaraft lil Toni mingħajr ma rajtu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għaraft lil Toni mingħajr ma rajtu?
messages.zh: 你没看见托尼，怎么认出他的？
messages.en: How did you recognize Toni without seeing him?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu leħen naqnieq; għaraftu malli beda jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu leħen naqnieq; għaraftu malli beda jitkellem.
messages.zh: 他的嗓音喉音很重，一开口我就认出来了。
messages.en: He has a throaty voice; I recognized him as soon as he started speaking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naqnieq 放进 leħen naqnieq 一起记：它描写声音的特点，回答“这个嗓音听起来怎样”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who speaks in a throaty voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话时嗓音带有明显喉音的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem b'leħen li fih jinstema' ħoss qawwi mill-gerżuma.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who speaks in a throaty voice
sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话喉音重的人。

collocations.en: a person with a throaty voice speaking
collocations.zh: 一个喉音重的人在说话

collocations.en: hear someone who speaks in a throaty voice
collocations.zh: 听见一个说话喉音重的人

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-karattri, wieħed minnhom huwa deskritt bħala naqnuq, jiġifieri persuna li titkellem b'leħen naqnieq.
formal.en: In the character list, one of them is described as a person who speaks in a throaty voice.
formal.zh: 在角色表中，其中一人被描述为说话喉音重的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min qed jitkellem fil-kamra ta' ħdejna? Leo: Dak in-naqnuq li ltqajna miegħu lbieraħ; nagħraf leħnu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is speaking in the next room? Leo: That man with the throaty voice whom we met yesterday; I recognize his voice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：隔壁房间是谁在说话？利奥：就是我们昨天遇见的那个喉音重的人，我认得他的声音。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min qed jitkellem fil-kamra ta' ħdejna?
messages.mt_standard: Min qed jitkellem fil-kamra ta' ħdejna?
messages.zh: 隔壁房间是谁在说话？
messages.en: Who is speaking in the next room?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak in-naqnuq li ltqajna miegħu lbieraħ; nagħraf leħnu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak in-naqnuq li ltqajna miegħu lbieraħ; nagħraf leħnu.
messages.zh: 就是我们昨天遇见的那个喉音重的人，我认得他的声音。
messages.en: That man with the throaty voice whom we met yesterday; I recognize his voice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naqnuq 记成“那位喉音重的人”，与描写嗓音的 naqnieq 对照：一个指人，一个描写声音。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a hole through something by piercing, puncturing, or perforating it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过刺入、扎破或打孔，使某物出现穿透的孔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel toqba jew toqob f'xi ħaġa billi jgħaddi minnha b'oġġett jew b'għodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺穿；穿透。
扎破；刺出小孔。
打孔；在物体上穿孔或打出一系列孔。

formal.mt: L-impjegat naqqab il-karti qabel ma poġġiehom fil-fajl, sabiex setgħu jinżammu flimkien.
formal.en: The employee punched holes in the papers before putting them in the file so that they could be kept together.
formal.zh: 工作人员先在文件纸上打孔，再将其放入文件夹，以便把它们固定在一起。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex din il-bużżieqa m'għadhiex minfuħa? Tom: Xi ħadd naqqab il-bużżieqa b'labra, u ħarġet l-arja kollha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is this balloon no longer inflated? Tom: Someone punctured the balloon with a needle, and all the air escaped.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个气球怎么瘪了？汤姆：有人用针把气球扎破了，空气全漏出来了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个气球怎么瘪了？
messages.en: Why is this balloon no longer inflated?

messages.speaker: Tom (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd naqqab il-bużżieqa b'labra, u ħarġet l-arja kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd naqqab il-bużżieqa b'labra, u ħarġet l-arja kollha.
messages.zh: 有人用针把气球扎破了，空气全漏出来了。
messages.en: Someone punctured the balloon with a needle, and all the air escaped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“针穿过去留下孔”记 naqqab：对气球是扎破，对纸张是打孔，共同点都是造成穿孔。

gloss_zh: 除草的人；拔取某物的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who removes weeds; also, someone who plucks something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清除杂草的人；也指用拔取方式取下某物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tneħħi l-ħaxix ħażin; ukoll, persuna li taqla' xi ħaġa billi tiġbidha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 除草的人。
拔取某物的人，例如拔除羽毛的人。

formal.mt: In-naqqaj neħħa l-ħaxix ħażin minn bejn il-pjanti, filwaqt li ħa ħsieb li ma jagħmilx ħsara lill-għeruq tagħhom.
formal.en: The weeder removed the weeds from between the plants while taking care not to damage their roots.
formal.zh: 除草人员清除了植株之间的杂草，同时注意不损伤植株的根部。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min se jneħħi l-ħaxix ħażin minn din ir-rokna? Pawlu: In-naqqaj ġej għada filgħodu; jurina wkoll kif nagħmlu dan aħna.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who is going to remove the weeds from this corner? Pawlu: The weeder is coming tomorrow morning; he will also show us how to do it ourselves.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：谁来清除这个角落里的杂草？保罗：除草的人明天早上来，他还会教我们自己怎么除草。

messages.speaker: Rita (园圃负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jneħħi l-ħaxix ħażin minn din ir-rokna?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jneħħi l-ħaxix ħażin minn din ir-rokna?
messages.zh: 谁来清除这个角落里的杂草？
messages.en: Who is going to remove the weeds from this corner?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园圃志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: In-naqqaj ġej għada filgħodu; jurina wkoll kif nagħmlu dan aħna.
messages.mt_standard: In-naqqaj ġej għada filgħodu; jurina wkoll kif nagħmlu dan aħna.
messages.zh: 除草的人明天早上来，他还会教我们自己怎么除草。
