messages.en: The weeder is coming tomorrow morning; he will also show us how to do it ourselves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位蹲在花圃里拔杂草的人来记 naqqaj，再用拔羽毛的人帮助记住较广的“拔取者”义。

gloss_zh: 爱啄食的；爱一点点啃食的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to peck at food or eat it in small bites.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容有啄食倾向，或喜欢一点点啃食、少量进食的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jnaqqar l-ikel jew jieklu ftit ftit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于啄食或一点点啃食的。

formal.mt: Dan l-għasfur naqqari jiekol iż-żrieragħ ftit ftit matul il-jum.
formal.en: This bird, which tends to peck at its food, eats seeds little by little throughout the day.
formal.zh: 这只爱啄食的鸟在一天中一点点地吃种子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan l-għasfur jiekol ftit kull darba? Pawlu: Huwa naqqari; ara kif inaqqar iż-żrieragħ waħda waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does this bird eat only a little at a time? Pawlu: It tends to peck; look how it picks at the seeds one by one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这只鸟为什么每次只吃一点？保罗：它爱啄食，你看它一粒一粒地啄种子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan l-għasfur jiekol ftit kull darba?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan l-għasfur jiekol ftit kull darba?
messages.zh: 这只鸟为什么每次只吃一点？
messages.en: Why does this bird eat only a little at a time?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa naqqari; ara kif inaqqar iż-żrieragħ waħda waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa naqqari; ara kif inaqqar iż-żrieragħ waħda waħda.
messages.zh: 它爱啄食，你看它一粒一粒地啄种子。
messages.en: It tends to peck; look how it picks at the seeds one by one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naqqari 配上小鸟逐粒啄种子的画面，记住它描述爱啄食、爱小口啃食的习性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who enjoys chiselling material or whittling wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容喜欢用凿子凿刻材料，或喜欢削刻木头的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb inaqqax materjal bi skarpell jew iqatta' biċċiet żgħar mill-injam b'sikkina.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who likes chiseling or whittling
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容某人喜欢凿刻或削刻木头的。

collocations.en: a man who enjoys chiselling or whittling
collocations.zh: 喜欢凿刻或削刻的男子

collocations.en: a friend who enjoys chiselling or whittling
collocations.zh: 喜欢凿刻或削刻的朋友

formal.mt: Dan ir-raġel naqqaxi jqatta' l-ħin liberu tiegħu jaħdem biċċiet żgħar tal-injam b'sikkina.
formal.en: This man, who enjoys whittling, spends his free time shaping small pieces of wood with a knife.
formal.zh: 这位爱削刻的男子把空闲时间用来拿小刀加工小木块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'nista' nagħti lil ħija bħala rigal? Mark: Ħuk naqqaxi; forsi sett ta' skieken għall-injam jogħġbu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What could I give my brother as a present? Mark: Your brother enjoys whittling; perhaps he would like a set of woodcarving knives.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我可以送哥哥什么礼物？马克：你哥哥爱削刻，也许他会喜欢一套木雕刀。

messages.speaker: Lara (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: X'nista' nagħti lil ħija bħala rigal?
messages.mt_standard: X'nista' nagħti lil ħija bħala rigal?
messages.zh: 我可以送哥哥什么礼物？
messages.en: What could I give my brother as a present?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk naqqaxi; forsi sett ta' skieken għall-injam jogħġbu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk naqqaxi; forsi sett ta' skieken għall-injam jogħġbu.
messages.zh: 你哥哥爱削刻，也许他会喜欢一套木雕刀。
messages.en: Your brother enjoys whittling; perhaps he would like a set of woodcarving knives.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naqqaxi 想成闲下来就拿木块削刻的人，重点记住这是爱好倾向，不表示一定以雕刻为职业。

gloss_zh: 倾向于减少的；爱削减的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to reduce an amount, quantity, or extent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容倾向于使数量、数额或程度减少的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jnaqqas ammont, kwantità jew grad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于减少或削减的。

formal.mt: Il-maniġer adotta approċċ naqqiesi u ppropona li jitnaqqsu l-ispejjeż ta' kull dipartiment.
formal.en: The manager adopted an approach inclined towards reductions and proposed cutting the expenses of every department.
formal.zh: 经理采取了倾向于削减的做法，提议减少每个部门的开支。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex kull proposta tiegħu tnaqqas xi ħaġa? David: Għandu approċċ naqqiesi; dejjem ifittex fejn jista' jnaqqas l-ispejjeż.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does every proposal of his cut something? David: He has an approach inclined towards reductions; he always looks for places to cut expenses.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么他的每个提议都要削减点什么？戴维：他的做法偏向削减，总在找能减少开支的地方。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kull proposta tiegħu tnaqqas xi ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kull proposta tiegħu tnaqqas xi ħaġa?
messages.zh: 为什么他的每个提议都要削减点什么？
messages.en: Why does every proposal of his cut something?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu approċċ naqqiesi; dejjem ifittex fejn jista' jnaqqas l-ispejjeż.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu approċċ naqqiesi; dejjem ifittex fejn jista' jnaqqas l-ispejjeż.
messages.zh: 他的做法偏向削减，总在找能减少开支的地方。
messages.en: He has an approach inclined towards reductions; he always looks for places to cut expenses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naqqiesi 与计划表上不断向下的数量箭头联系起来，记住它形容倾向于减少的做法或行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of reducing or taking away, including discounting a price, subtracting a number, or making a deduction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 减少或减去的行为，可指减损、价格折减、数学减法或从总额中扣除。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tnaqqas jew tneħħi xi ħaġa, bħal meta tnaqqas prezz, tnaqqas numru minn ieħor jew tnaqqas ammont minn total.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减损；使价值、评价或声誉降低的行为。
折减；对价格或金额作减价处理。
减法；从一个数中减去另一个数的运算。
扣除；从总额或总量中减去一部分的行为。

formal.mt: Wara naqs ta' għaxar ewro mill-prezz oriġinali ta' mitt ewro, il-prezz finali huwa disgħin ewro.
formal.en: After a deduction of ten euros from the original price of one hundred euros, the final price is ninety euros.
formal.zh: 从原价一百欧元中扣除十欧元后，最终价格为九十欧元。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nasal minn ħmistax għal disa'? Pawlu: Agħmel naqs ta' sitta: ħmistax nieqes sitta jagħmel disa'.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I get from fifteen to nine? Pawlu: Subtract six: fifteen minus six equals nine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎样从十五算到九？保罗：减去六，十五减六等于九。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nasal minn ħmistax għal disa'?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nasal minn ħmistax għal disa'?
messages.zh: 怎样从十五算到九？
messages.en: How do I get from fifteen to nine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħmel naqs ta' sitta: ħmistax nieqes sitta jagħmel disa'.
messages.mt_standard: Agħmel naqs ta' sitta: ħmistax nieqes sitta jagħmel disa'.
messages.zh: 减去六，十五减六等于九。
messages.en: Subtract six: fifteen minus six equals nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用减号串联 naqs 的四个义项：评价减损、价格折减、数字相减、总额扣除，再按上下文选择中文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The amount taken away from an original sum or total.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从原有金额或总数中扣除的那一部分数额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ammont li jitnaqqas minn somma jew minn total.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扣除的数额；从原额中减去的金额或数量。

collocations.en: a deducted amount of ten euros
an amount deducted from the bill

formal.mt: Il-kont oriġinali kien ta' mitt ewro; in-naqsa kienet ta' għaxar ewro, u għalhekk baqa' disgħin ewro x'jitħallsu.
formal.en: The original bill was one hundred euros; the amount deducted was ten euros, leaving ninety euros to be paid.
formal.zh: 原账单金额为一百欧元；扣除额为十欧元，因此还需支付九十欧元。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm hi n-naqsa mill-kont? Rita: Għaxar ewro; issa trid tħallas disgħin.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much has been deducted from the bill? Rita: Ten euros; you now need to pay ninety.
colloquial.zh: 马克：账单扣除了多少钱？丽塔：十欧元，现在你需要付九十欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 账单扣除了多少钱？
messages.en: How much has been deducted from the bill?

messages.speaker: Rita (收银员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaxar ewro; issa trid tħallas disgħin.
messages.mt_standard: Għaxar ewro; issa trid tħallas disgħin.
messages.zh: 十欧元，现在你需要付九十欧元。
messages.en: Ten euros; you now need to pay ninety.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习 naqsa 时盯住账单上被减掉的那笔钱：本词条指扣掉多少这个数额，可用一百减十的十来记。

gloss_zh: 牲畜颈铃；牛羊佩戴的铃铛

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bell worn by an animal, such as a cow or goat, that rings as the animal moves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 牛、山羊等动物佩戴的铃铛，动物移动时会发出铃声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qanpiena li tintlibes minn annimal, bħal baqra jew mogħża, u ddoqq meta l-annimal jiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.en_definition: a bell worn by animals (cows, goats, etc…)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 牛、山羊等动物佩戴的铃铛，通常挂在颈部。

collocations.en: a bell around the goat's neck
the sound of the animal bell

formal.mt: Ir-ragħaj sema' n-naqus tal-mogħża u sabha wara l-ħajt.
formal.en: The shepherd heard the goat's bell and found her behind the wall.
formal.zh: 牧羊人听见山羊的颈铃声，在墙后找到了它。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn marret il-mogħża? Toni: Isma' n-naqus tagħha; qiegħda ħdejn is-siġra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where has the goat gone? Toni: Listen to her bell; she is near the tree.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：山羊去哪儿了？托尼：听它的颈铃声，它在树旁。

messages.speaker: Nina (农场访客)
messages.zh: 山羊去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where has the goat gone?

messages.speaker: Toni (牧羊人)
messages.mt_spoken: Isma' n-naqus tagħha; qiegħda ħdejn is-siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Isma' n-naqus tagħha; qiegħda ħdejn is-siġra.
messages.zh: 听它的颈铃声，它在树旁。
messages.en: Listen to her bell; she is near the tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naqus 与山羊走路时颈部铃铛叮当响的画面绑定，看到词就想到循着铃声寻找牛羊。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of shaping material into a sculpture or carved form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过加工材料，使其成为雕塑或雕刻形体的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li tagħti forma lil materjal biex toħloq skultura jew forma mnaqqxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雕刻；把材料加工成雕塑形体的活动。

formal.mt: Il-kors tan-naqx jgħallem lill-istudenti kif jagħtu forma lill-injam biex joħolqu skulturi żgħar.
formal.en: The sculpting course teaches students how to shape wood to create small sculptures.
formal.zh: 这门雕刻课程教授学生如何加工木材，制作小型雕塑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed titgħallem fil-kors il-ġdid? Mark: In-naqx fl-injam; bħalissa qed nagħmel figura żgħira.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you learning in the new course? Mark: Sculpting in wood; I am making a small figure at the moment.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在新课程里学什么？马克：木材雕刻，我现在正在做一个小人像。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在新课程里学什么？
messages.en: What are you learning in the new course?

messages.speaker: Mark (雕刻班学员)
messages.mt_spoken: In-naqx fl-injam; bħalissa qed nagħmel figura żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: In-naqx fl-injam; bħalissa qed nagħmel figura żgħira.
messages.zh: 木材雕刻，我现在正在做一个小人像。
messages.en: Sculpting in wood; I am making a small figure at the moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一块木头逐渐变成小雕像的连续画面记 naqx，把注意力放在塑造形体的雕刻活动上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of cutting or shaping material with a chisel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用凿子切削、凿刻或塑造材料的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività li taqta' jew tagħti forma lil materjal bi skarpell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凿刻；使用凿子加工材料的活动。

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol ta' naqxa fil-ġebel, l-istudent uża skarpell biex ineħħi biċċiet żgħar mill-wiċċ.
formal.en: During the stone-chiselling work, the student used a chisel to remove small pieces from the surface.
formal.zh: 进行石材凿刻时，学生用凿子从表面凿去小块材料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għal xiex għandek bżonn dan l-iskarpell? Pawlu: Għax-xogħol ta' naqxa fil-ġebel; irrid inneħħi ftit minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you need this chisel for? Pawlu: For chiselling the stone; I want to remove a little from here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要这把凿子做什么？保罗：用来凿刻石头，我想从这里凿掉一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xiex għandek bżonn dan l-iskarpell?
messages.mt_standard: Għal xiex għandek bżonn dan l-iskarpell?
messages.zh: 你要这把凿子做什么？
messages.en: What do you need this chisel for?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (雕刻班学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax-xogħol ta' naqxa fil-ġebel; irrid inneħħi ftit minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax-xogħol ta' naqxa fil-ġebel; irrid inneħħi ftit minn hawn.
messages.zh: 用来凿刻石头，我想从这里凿掉一点。
messages.en: For chiselling the stone; I want to remove a little from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 naqxa 时放大凿尖接触石面的动作：一下下凿去材料，突出用凿子加工这一具体活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Help or relief given to someone who needs support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向需要支持的人提供的帮助或救助。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajnuna jew appoġġ mogħti lil min ikollu bżonnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 帮助；协助。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għajnuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向身处困境的人提供的救助；援助。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għajnuna lil min ikun f'diffikultà.

formal.mt: L-għaqda offriet nasr lill-familji li tilfu djarhom.
formal.en: The organization offered assistance to the families who had lost their homes.
formal.zh: 该组织向失去家园的家庭提供了援助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna bżonn nasr biex inqassmu dan l-ikel. Mark: Jien nista' ngħinkom; minn fejn nibdew?
colloquial.en: Maja: We need help to distribute this food. Mark: I can help you; where do we start?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们需要人帮忙分发这些食物。马克：我可以帮你们；我们从哪里开始？

messages.speaker: Maja (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna bżonn nasr biex inqassmu dan l-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna bżonn nasr biex inqassmu dan l-ikel.
messages.zh: 我们需要人帮忙分发这些食物。
messages.en: We need help to distribute this food.

messages.speaker: Mark (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien nista' ngħinkom; minn fejn nibdew?
messages.mt_standard: Jien nista' ngħinkom; minn fejn nibdew?
messages.zh: 我可以帮你们；我们从哪里开始？
messages.en: I can help you; where do we start?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nasr 连到分发救济食物的画面：有人请求帮助，有人伸手援助，同时记住“帮助”和“救助”两层意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To set traps in order to catch birds or other animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设置陷阱以捕捉鸟类或其他动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed in-nases biex jaqbad l-għasafar jew annimali oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布置陷阱；设下捕捉用的机关。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iqiegħed in-nases.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用陷阱捕鸟的人；捕鸟人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taqbad l-għasafar permezz tan-nases.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, ix-xhud qal li raġel nassab ħdejn l-għalqa.
formal.en: In the report, the witness said that a man had set traps beside the field.
formal.zh: 证人在报告中说，有一名男子在田地旁设置了陷阱。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm dawn in-nases ħdejn is-siġra? Pawlu: Xi ħadd nassab hawn; ejja ma nmissuhomx.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are these traps beside the tree? Pawlu: Someone set traps here; let's not touch them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：树旁为什么有这些陷阱？保罗：有人在这里设了陷阱；我们别碰它们。

messages.speaker: Sara (散步者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dawn in-nases ħdejn is-siġra?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dawn in-nases ħdejn is-siġra?
messages.zh: 树旁为什么有这些陷阱？
messages.en: Why are these traps beside the tree?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd nassab hawn; ejja ma nmissuhomx.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd nassab hawn; ejja ma nmissuhomx.
messages.zh: 有人在这里设了陷阱；我们别碰它们。
messages.en: Someone set traps here; let's not touch them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一幅捕鸟场景分开词性：看动作时记“设陷阱”，看执行动作的人时记“捕鸟人”，同形词不要混成一个词义。

gloss_zh: 容易使人落入圈套的；有欺骗性的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to trap someone or mislead them through deception.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易使人落入圈套或受到欺骗的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jdaħħal lil xi ħadd f'nassa jew iqarraq bih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易使人落入陷阱或圈套的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jista' jdaħħal lil xi ħadd f'nassa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有欺骗性的；容易误导人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jqarraq jew jagħti impressjoni falza.

collocations.en: an agreement that can trap someone
collocations.zh: 容易使人落入圈套的协议

formal.mt: Il-kumitat identifika kliem nassabi li seta' jqarraq bil-qarrejja.
formal.en: The committee identified deceptive wording that could mislead readers.
formal.zh: 委员会发现了可能误导读者的欺骗性措辞。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ftehim jidher tajjeb ħafna. Maja: Aqrah sew; jista' jkun nassabi u jdaħħlek fi spejjeż li ma tistenniex.
colloquial.en: Mark: This agreement looks very good. Maja: Read it carefully; it could be deceptive and lead to costs you do not expect.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这份协议看起来很好。玛雅：仔细读一读；它可能暗藏圈套，让你承担意想不到的费用。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这份协议看起来很好。
messages.en: This agreement looks very good.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqrah sew; jista' jkun nassabi u jdaħħlek fi spejjeż li ma tistenniex.
messages.mt_standard: Aqrah sew; jista' jkun nassabi u jdaħħlek fi spejjeż li ma tistenniex.
messages.zh: 仔细读一读；它可能暗藏圈套，让你承担意想不到的费用。
messages.en: Read it carefully; it could be deceptive and lead to costs you do not expect.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nassabi 想成写着漂亮承诺的圈套：表面诱人，实际可能误导你，由此记住“使人中圈套的、有欺骗性的”。

gloss_zh: 爱在人际间挑起事端的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to cause trouble or conflict between people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于在人与人之间挑起事端或制造矛盾的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza joħloq l-inkwiet jew il-ġlied bejn in-nies.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to create trouble among people
sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱在人群中制造麻烦、挑拨矛盾的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jqajjem l-inkwiet bejn in-nies.

collocations.en: a person who tends to stir up trouble

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-personaġġ nassasi jxerred xnigħat biex iqiegħed lill-ġirien kontra xulxin.
formal.en: In the novel, the trouble-stirring character spreads rumors to turn the neighbors against one another.
formal.zh: 小说中，那个爱挑拨生事的角色散播谣言，使邻居们彼此对立。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex jgħid lil kull wieħed minna storja differenti? Mark: Huwa bniedem nassasi; irid iqegħedna kontra xulxin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does he tell each of us a different story? Mark: He tends to stir up trouble; he wants to turn us against one another.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他为什么对我们每个人说的都不一样？马克：他就是爱挑拨生事；他想让我们彼此对立。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex jgħid lil kull wieħed minna storja differenti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex jgħid lil kull wieħed minna storja differenti?
messages.zh: 他为什么对我们每个人说的都不一样？
messages.en: Why does he tell each of us a different story?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa bniedem nassasi; irid iqegħedna kontra xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa bniedem nassasi; irid iqegħedna kontra xulxin.
messages.zh: 他就是爱挑拨生事；他想让我们彼此对立。
messages.en: He tends to stir up trouble; he wants to turn us against one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nassasi 配上一个在人群间来回传闲话的角色：重点记“挑起人与人之间的矛盾”，而非普通的事情难办。

gloss_zh: 纳坦（男性名字，对应英语 Nathan）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male given name corresponding to Nathan in English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男性名字，中文可音译为“纳坦”，对应英语名字 Nathan。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' raġel li jikkorrispondi għall-isem Nathan bl-Ingliż.

sense_translations.en_definition: a male given name, equivalent to English Nathan
sense_translations.zh_definition: 男性名字“纳坦”，相当于英语名字 Nathan。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem maskili, ekwivalenti għal Nathan bl-Ingliż.

formal.mt: Natan ippreżenta x-xogħol tiegħu waqt il-laqgħa tal-klassi.
formal.en: Natan presented his work during the class meeting.
formal.zh: 纳坦在班会上展示了自己的作品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jismu l-istudent il-ġdid? Sara: Jismu Natan; se jkun fil-klassi tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the new student's name? Sara: His name is Natan; he will be in our class.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新来的学生叫什么名字？萨拉：他叫纳坦；他会在我们班。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 新来的学生叫什么名字？
messages.en: What is the new student's name?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jismu Natan; se jkun fil-klassi tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Jismu Natan; se jkun fil-klassi tagħna.
messages.zh: 他叫纳坦；他会在我们班。
messages.en: His name is Natan; he will be in our class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张同学名牌：马耳他语写 Natan，英语对应 Nathan，中文记“纳坦”；作为人名，正文首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the two rounded fleshy parts at the back of the body below the waist.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 腰部下方、身体后侧两块圆厚肌肉组织中的一侧，即一侧臀部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda miż-żewġ partijiet imlaħħma fuq wara tal-ġisem, taħt il-qadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一侧臀部；半边屁股。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waħda miż-żewġ partijiet imlaħħma tal-warrani.

formal.mt: Wara l-waqgħa, Marta kellha tbenġila fuq in-natka tal-lemin.
formal.en: After the fall, Marta had a bruise on her right buttock.
formal.zh: 摔倒后，玛尔塔的右侧臀部出现了一块淤青。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Waqajt u ħbatt in-natka mal-art. Maja: Jaħasra! Trid kuxxin biex toqgħod bilqiegħda?
colloquial.en: Sara: I fell and hit my buttock on the ground. Maja: Oh dear! Do you want a cushion to sit on?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我摔了一跤，一边屁股撞到了地上。玛雅：哎呀！你要不要拿个坐垫坐？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我摔了一跤，一边屁股撞到了地上。
messages.en: I fell and hit my buttock on the ground.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jaħasra! Trid kuxxin biex toqgħod bilqiegħda?
messages.mt_standard: Jaħasra! Trid kuxxin biex toqgħod bilqiegħda?
messages.zh: 哎呀！你要不要拿个坐垫坐？
messages.en: Oh dear! Do you want a cushion to sit on?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象坐垫上左右两个接触点，natka 指其中一侧臀部；搭配“右侧臀部”记忆，避免把单数直接理解成整个臀部。

gloss_zh: 会用头顶撞的动物或东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: An animal or other thing that butts with its head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会用头部顶撞的动物或其他东西，通常指动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li jagħti daqqiet bir-ras, speċjalment annimal.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. (usually an animal) that butts with the head
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用头顶撞的东西，通常指会顶撞的动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa, ġeneralment annimal, li tagħti daqqiet bir-ras.

collocations.zh: 一只危险的、会用头顶撞的动物

collocations.en: a head-butting animal in the pen
collocations.zh: 圈里会用头顶撞的动物

formal.mt: Il-bidwi żamm lin-nattaħ f'maqjel separat biex ma jweġġax lill-annimali l-oħra.
formal.en: The farmer kept the head-butting animal in a separate pen so that it would not injure the other animals.
formal.zh: 农场主把那只会用头顶撞的动物关在单独的圈里，以免它伤到其他动物。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Dak il-muntun huwa nattaħ? Pawlu: Iva, jagħti daqqiet bir-ras; aħjar nibqgħu 'l bogħod minnu.
colloquial.en: Lina: Is that ram a head-butter? Pawlu: Yes, it strikes with its head; we had better keep away from it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：那只公绵羊会用头顶撞吗？保罗：会，它会用头撞；我们最好离它远一点。

messages.speaker: Lina (访客)
messages.zh: 那只公绵羊会用头顶撞吗？
messages.en: Is that ram a head-butter?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jagħti daqqiet bir-ras; aħjar nibqgħu 'l bogħod minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jagħti daqqiet bir-ras; aħjar nibqgħu 'l bogħod minnu.
messages.zh: 会，它会用头撞；我们最好离它远一点。
messages.en: Yes, it strikes with its head; we had better keep away from it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nattaħ 贴在那只爱用头顶撞的公绵羊身上：natħa 记“撞的那一下”，nattaħ 记“发出顶撞的动物或东西”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's characteristic temperament or natural disposition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人本来的性情或惯常表现出的性格倾向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-karattru jew it-temperament li persuna għandha minn natura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天性；本来的性情

formal.mt: In-natural kalm tal-għalliem jgħinu jittratta s-sitwazzjonijiet diffiċli bil-paċenzja.
formal.en: The teacher's calm disposition helps him handle difficult situations patiently.
formal.zh: 这位教师平和的性情帮助他耐心处理困难情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu dejjem jibqa' kalm? Mark: Iva, għandu natural kalm, anki meta jkun hemm ħafna xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Pawlu always stay calm? Mark: Yes, he has a calm disposition, even when there's a lot of work.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗总是这么镇定吗？马克：是啊，他性情平和，就算工作很多也一样。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗总是这么镇定吗？
messages.en: Does Pawlu always stay calm?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu natural kalm, anki meta jkun hemm ħafna xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu natural kalm, anki meta jkun hemm ħafna xogħol.
messages.zh: 是啊，他性情平和，就算工作很多也一样。
messages.en: Yes, he has a calm disposition, even when there's a lot of work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 natural 和一个人遇事时的性情联系起来：这里是名词“天性”，可用“性情平和”帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of appearing or behaving naturally, without stiffness or artificiality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现、举止或表达自然流畅而不僵硬、不做作的特质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li wieħed jidher jew iġib ruħu b'mod naturali, mingħajr sfurzar jew affettazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自然的特质；自然不做作

formal.mt: In-naturalezza tal-attriċi għamlet id-djalogu aktar konvinċenti.
formal.en: The actress's naturalness made the dialogue more convincing.
formal.zh: 这位女演员自然不做作的表现使对白更有说服力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kienet il-preżentazzjoni tiegħi? Nina: Tkellimt b'naturalezza; dehert komda ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was my presentation? Nina: You spoke naturally; you looked very comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：我的演讲怎么样？妮娜：你讲得很自然，看起来非常自在。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 我的演讲怎么样？
messages.en: How was my presentation?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你讲得很自然，看起来非常自在。
messages.en: You spoke naturally; you looked very comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象上台讲话像与朋友聊天一样自在，用这个画面记住 naturalezza 的“自然不做作”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who studies and observes plants, animals, and other features of the natural world.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过观察和研究来了解植物、动物及其他自然事物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tosserva u tistudja l-pjanti, l-annimali u aspetti oħra tad-dinja naturali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 博物学家；研究和观察自然界的人

formal.mt: In-naturalista rreġistra l-għasafar u l-pjanti li osserva waqt iż-żjara fil-wied.
formal.en: The naturalist recorded the birds and plants he observed during the visit to the valley.
formal.zh: 这位博物学家记录了他在山谷考察时观察到的鸟类和植物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jurina l-pjanti fil-wied? Toni: Naturalista espert; jaf ħafna dwar il-pjanti u l-għasafar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will show us the plants in the valley? Toni: An expert naturalist; he knows a lot about plants and birds.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁会带我们认识山谷里的植物？托尼：一位经验丰富的博物学家，他对植物和鸟类了解很多。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 谁会带我们认识山谷里的植物？
messages.en: Who will show us the plants in the valley?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Naturalista espert; jaf ħafna dwar il-pjanti u l-għasafar.
messages.mt_standard: Naturalista espert; jaf ħafna dwar il-pjanti u l-għasafar.
messages.zh: 一位经验丰富的博物学家，他对植物和鸟类了解很多。
messages.en: An expert naturalist; he knows a lot about plants and birds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位拿着观察笔记、辨认花鸟的人，把 naturalista 记成研究自然的“博物学家”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process through which a person becomes a citizen of a country whose citizenship they did not previously hold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人取得此前并不拥有的某国国籍的过程，即归化入籍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih persuna ssir ċittadina ta' pajjiż li qabel ma kellhiex iċ-ċittadinanza tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 归化；通过入籍程序取得某国国籍

formal.mt: Il-gwida tispjega t-termini użati fil-proċess tan-naturalizzazzjoni.
formal.en: The guide explains the terms used in the naturalization process.
formal.zh: 这份指南解释了归化入籍程序中使用的术语。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi n-naturalizzazzjoni? Pawlu: Hija proċess li bih persuna ssir ċittadina ta' pajjiż.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is naturalization? Pawlu: It is a process through which a person becomes a citizen of a country.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：什么是归化入籍？保罗：就是一个人成为某国公民的过程。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是归化入籍？
messages.en: What is naturalization?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija proċess li bih persuna ssir ċittadina ta' pajjiż.
messages.mt_standard: Hija proċess li bih persuna ssir ċittadina ta' pajjiż.
messages.zh: 就是一个人成为某国公民的过程。
messages.en: It is a process through which a person becomes a citizen of a country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象填写入籍申请、身份成为某国公民的过程，用这个场景记住 naturalizzazzjoni 的“归化入籍”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An approach in literature or art that represents people and life through close observation of reality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 文学或艺术中注重细致观察现实、如实表现人物和生活的一种取向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Approċċ fil-letteratura jew fl-arti li jirrappreżenta lin-nies u l-ħajja permezz ta' osservazzjoni mill-qrib tar-realtà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自然主义；文学艺术中注重如实表现现实的取向，也可指以自然原因解释世界的哲学立场

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddiskuti n-naturaliżmu fir-rumanz u l-mod kif l-awtur juri l-kundizzjonijiet tal-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The study discusses naturalism in the novel and how the author depicts the conditions of everyday life.
formal.zh: 这项研究探讨小说中的自然主义，以及作者如何描绘日常生活的条件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed nitkellmu dwar in-naturaliżmu f'dan ir-rumanz? Mark: Għax l-awtur juri l-ħajja ta' kuljum b'ħafna dettall.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are we discussing naturalism in this novel? Mark: Because the author depicts everyday life in great detail.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么我们要讨论这部小说中的自然主义？马克：因为作者用大量细节描绘日常生活。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nitkellmu dwar in-naturaliżmu f'dan ir-rumanz?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nitkellmu dwar in-naturaliżmu f'dan ir-rumanz?
messages.zh: 为什么我们要讨论这部小说中的自然主义？
messages.en: Why are we discussing naturalism in this novel?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax l-awtur juri l-ħajja ta' kuljum b'ħafna dettall.
messages.mt_standard: Għax l-awtur juri l-ħajja ta' kuljum b'ħafna dettall.
messages.zh: 因为作者用大量细节描绘日常生活。
messages.en: Because the author depicts everyday life in great detail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把日常现实细细写进作品”这个学习画面记住 naturaliżmu，核心对应中文“自然主义”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A blow delivered by striking someone or something with the head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用头部撞击人或物的一下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa mogħtija bir-ras lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用头顶撞；以头部撞击的一下。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Daqqa bir-ras.

formal.mt: Il-muntun ta natħa lill-bieb tal-maqjel u fetaħu.
formal.en: The ram head-butted the pen door and opened it.
formal.zh: 公绵羊用头顶撞圈门，把门顶开了。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Pawlu: Il-muntun ta natħa lill-bieb; ara kif qed jitbandal.
colloquial.en: Lina: What was that noise? Pawlu: The ram head-butted the door; look how it is swinging.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：刚才那是什么声音？保罗：公绵羊用头撞了一下门；你看门还在晃。

messages.speaker: Lina (访客)
messages.zh: 刚才那是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that noise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-muntun ta natħa lill-bieb; ara kif qed jitbandal.
messages.mt_standard: Il-muntun ta natħa lill-bieb; ara kif qed jitbandal.
messages.zh: 公绵羊用头撞了一下门；你看门还在晃。
messages.en: The ram head-butted the door; look how it is swinging.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 natħa 定格为公绵羊用头撞门的那一下：这个名词记的是一次“头撞”，可以连同 ta natħa 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of determining a position and planning or following a route to a destination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 确定所在位置，并规划或沿着路线前往目的地的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih wieħed jiddetermina fejn jinsab u jippjana jew isegwi rotta lejn destinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 导航；确定位置、规划并沿路线行进或航行

formal.mt: Il-kors jgħallem il-prinċipji tan-navigazzjoni bil-baħar u l-użu tal-mapep.
formal.en: The course teaches the principles of navigation at sea and the use of maps.
formal.zh: 这门课程教授海上导航的原理以及地图的使用方法。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Taf kif naslu sal-lukanda? Nina: Iva, is-sistema ta' navigazzjoni turina t-triq.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you know how to get to the hotel? Nina: Yes, the navigation system shows us the way.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你知道怎么去酒店吗？妮娜：知道，导航系统会给我们指路。

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.zh: 你知道怎么去酒店吗？
messages.en: Do you know how to get to the hotel?

messages.speaker: Nina (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, is-sistema ta' navigazzjoni turina t-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, is-sistema ta' navigazzjoni turina t-triq.
messages.zh: 知道，导航系统会给我们指路。
messages.en: Yes, the navigation system shows us the way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“定位自己、查看路线、到达目的地”连成三个画面，帮助记住 navigazzjoni 的“导航”。

gloss_zh: 用来吓唬顽皮孩子的猫

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cat invoked as a warning to frighten naughty children.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在警告顽皮孩子时被提起、用来使他们害怕的猫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qattus li jissemma bħala twissija biex ibeżża' lit-tfal imqarbin.

sense_translations.en_definition: cat, used as a warning to inspire fear in naughty children
sense_translations.zh_definition: 猫，特指在警告顽皮孩子时用来吓唬他们的猫

collocations.en: to frighten children by invoking the cat
fear of the cat invoked in warnings
collocations.zh: 对警告中提到的那只猫的恐惧

formal.mt: F'din l-istorja, in-nawnu jissemma bħala twissija biex ibeżża' lit-tfal imqarbin.
formal.en: In this story, the cat is invoked as a warning to frighten naughty children.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，人们提到这只猫，借此警告并吓唬顽皮的孩子。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhu n-nawnu f'din l-istorja? Marija: Huwa qattus li jintuża biex ibeżża' lit-tfal imqarbin.
colloquial.en: Lina: What is the nawnu in this story? Marija: It is a cat used to frighten naughty children.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这个故事里的 nawnu 是什么？玛丽亚：是一只用来吓唬顽皮孩子的猫。

messages.speaker: Lina (孙女)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 nawnu 是什么？
messages.en: What is the nawnu in this story?

messages.speaker: Marija (祖母)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa qattus li jintuża biex ibeżża' lit-tfal imqarbin.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa qattus li jintuża biex ibeżża' lit-tfal imqarbin.
messages.zh: 是一只用来吓唬顽皮孩子的猫。
messages.en: It is a cat used to frighten naughty children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事里“被大人提来吓唬顽皮孩子的猫”作记忆画面，把 nawnu 的特殊使用情境一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Prone to developing mould.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易长霉或出现霉菌的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħmel il-moffa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易发霉的；有长霉倾向的

formal.mt: Dan il-ħobż huwa nawwari u malajr jagħmel il-moffa jekk jinżamm f'post umdu.
formal.en: This bread is prone to mould and quickly becomes mouldy if kept in a damp place.
formal.zh: 这种面包容易发霉，放在潮湿的地方很快就会长霉。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Dan il-ħobż nawwari? Maja: Iva, malajr jagħmel il-moffa jekk jibqa' fl-umdità.
colloquial.en: Toni: Is this bread prone to mould? Maja: Yes, it quickly becomes mouldy if it stays in damp conditions.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：这种面包容易发霉吗？玛雅：是的，一直放在潮湿环境里很快就会长霉。

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 这种面包容易发霉吗？
messages.en: Is this bread prone to mould?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, malajr jagħmel il-moffa jekk jibqa' fl-umdità.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, malajr jagħmel il-moffa jekk jibqa' fl-umdità.
messages.zh: 是的，一直放在潮湿环境里很快就会长霉。
messages.en: Yes, it quickly becomes mouldy if it stays in damp conditions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面包放在潮湿处容易长霉，用这个画面记住 nawwari 表示“容易发霉”，重点在容易发生的倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who hangs clothes out to dry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把衣服挂起来晾干的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ddendel il-ħwejjeġ biex jinxfu.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who hangs clothes out to dry
sense_translations.zh_definition: 晾晒衣服的人。

collocations.en: a person who hangs out clothes
the person hanging out clothes on the roof

formal.mt: In-naxxar dendel il-lożor fuq il-bejt u ħalla biżżejjed spazju bejniethom biex jinxfu.
formal.en: The person hanging out the washing hung the sheets on the roof and left enough space between them to dry.
formal.zh: 晾衣人把床单挂在屋顶上，并在床单之间留出足够的空间，以便晾干。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu n-naxxar illum? Mark: Jien! Għaddili l-inxir biex indendel il-ħwejjeġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's hanging out the washing today? Mark: I am! Pass me the pegs so I can hang up the clothes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天谁负责晾衣服？马克：我！把衣夹递给我，我来挂衣服。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 今天谁负责晾衣服？
messages.en: Who's hanging out the washing today?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien! Għaddili l-inxir biex indendel il-ħwejjeġ.
messages.mt_standard: Jien! Għaddili l-inxir biex indendel il-ħwejjeġ.
messages.zh: 我！把衣夹递给我，我来挂衣服。
messages.en: I am! Pass me the pegs so I can hang up the clothes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naxxar 和屋顶上拿着衣夹晾床单的人放在同一幅画里，记住它在这里指晾衣服的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person from Naxxar, a locality in Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自马耳他纳沙尔的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna min-Naxxar, lokalità f'Malta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自马耳他纳沙尔的人。

collocations.en: a person from Naxxar who lives abroad
collocations.zh: 居住在国外的纳沙尔人

collocations.en: a person from Naxxar who is proud of his hometown
collocations.zh: 以家乡为荣的纳沙尔人

formal.mt: L-awtur huwa Naxxari u fil-ktieb tiegħu jiddeskrivi l-ħajja ta' kuljum f'raħal twelidu.
formal.en: The author is from Naxxar, and in his book he describes everyday life in his hometown.
formal.zh: 作者是纳沙尔人，在书中描写了家乡的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int Naxxari? Mark: Iva, jien min-Naxxar, imma issa noqgħod il-Mosta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you from Naxxar? Mark: Yes, I'm from Naxxar, but I live in Mosta now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你是纳沙尔人吗？马克：是的，我来自纳沙尔，不过现在住在莫斯塔。

messages.speaker: Maja (新同事)
messages.zh: 你是纳沙尔人吗？
messages.en: Are you from Naxxar?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien min-Naxxar, imma issa noqgħod il-Mosta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien min-Naxxar, imma issa noqgħod il-Mosta.
messages.zh: 是的，我来自纳沙尔，不过现在住在莫斯塔。
messages.en: Yes, I'm from Naxxar, but I live in Mosta now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人举着写有 Naxxar 的家乡名牌，自我介绍说自己是 Naxxari，把地名与当地人配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of bringing a business or industry under state ownership.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把企业或行业转为国家所有的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih negozju jew industrija jgħaddu għal proprjetà tal-istat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 国有化；将企业、产业等转为国家所有。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, in-nazzjonalizzazzjoni tal-kumpanija tfisser li l-proprjetà tagħha tgħaddi għand l-istat.
formal.en: In the report, the nationalisation of the company means that its ownership passes to the state.
formal.zh: 在这份报告中，公司国有化指的是其所有权转归国家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser in-nazzjonalizzazzjoni ta' kumpanija? Mark: Tfisser li l-kumpanija ssir proprjetà tal-istat.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the nationalisation of a company mean? Mark: It means the company becomes state-owned.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：一家公司的国有化是什么意思？马克：意思是这家公司变为国家所有。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 一家公司的国有化是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the nationalisation of a company mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-kumpanija ssir proprjetà tal-istat.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-kumpanija ssir proprjetà tal-istat.
messages.zh: 意思是这家公司变为国家所有。
messages.en: It means the company becomes state-owned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公司所有权文件上的所有者改成国家，把 nazzjonalizzazzjoni 和这个转变过程相连，记住中文的国有化。

gloss_zh: 在全国范围内；在国家层面上

teaching_sense.en_definition: Across the whole country or at the level of the nation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在整个国家范围内，或在国家层面上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-pajjiż kollu jew fuq livell nazzjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全国性地；在全国范围内；在国家层面上。

formal.mt: Il-programm edukattiv se jixxandar nazzjonalment sabiex jilħaq studenti fil-pajjiż kollu.
formal.en: The educational programme will be broadcast nationally to reach students throughout the country.
formal.zh: 这个教育节目将在全国播出，以覆盖全国各地的学生。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kampanja se ssir biss fir-raħal tagħna? Mark: Le, se ssir nazzjonalment, fil-pajjiż kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Will the campaign take place only in our village? Mark: No, it will run nationally, throughout the country.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这项活动只在我们村开展吗？马克：不是，会在全国开展，覆盖整个国家。

messages.speaker: Maja (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kampanja se ssir biss fir-raħal tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kampanja se ssir biss fir-raħal tagħna?
messages.zh: 这项活动只在我们村开展吗？
messages.en: Will the campaign take place only in our village?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se ssir nazzjonalment, fil-pajjiż kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se ssir nazzjonalment, fil-pajjiż kollu.
messages.zh: 不是，会在全国开展，覆盖整个国家。
messages.en: No, it will run nationally, throughout the country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象广播信号覆盖整张国家地图，用 nazzjonalment 回答传播范围有多大，牢牢记住它是表示全国范围的副词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of trimming or dressing stone to give it the required shape or surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过修削、修凿等方式，使石料达到所需形状或表面的加工行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jaqta' jew jirfina l-ġebel biex jagħtih il-forma jew il-wiċċ meħtieġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: the act of trimming or dressing stone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 修削、修凿或整饰石料的行为。

formal.mt: In-naġra tal-ġebel trid issir bir-reqqa biex kull biċċa taqbel sew mal-oħrajn fil-ħajt.
formal.en: Stone dressing must be done carefully so that each piece fits well with the others in the wall.
formal.zh: 修整石料时必须细致，才能让每块石头在墙体中与其他石块妥善贴合。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex għadek ma bdejtx tibni? Leli: L-ewwel irrid inlesti n-naġra ta' dawn il-ġebel biex joqogħdu sew.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why haven't you started building yet? Leli: First I need to finish dressing these stones so that they fit properly.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你怎么还没开始砌？莱利：我得先把这些石头修整好，让它们能贴合。

messages.speaker: Marija (屋主)
messages.zh: 你怎么还没开始砌？
messages.en: Why haven't you started building yet?

messages.speaker: Leli (石匠)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel irrid inlesti n-naġra ta' dawn il-ġebel biex joqogħdu sew.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel irrid inlesti n-naġra ta' dawn il-ġebel biex joqogħdu sew.
messages.zh: 我得先把这些石头修整好，让它们能贴合。
messages.en: First I need to finish dressing these stones so that they fit properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 naġra 就想象砌墙前修凿石块的工序，记住它指“修整石材这件事”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to polish, dress, or trim material into a suitable finish or shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够对材料进行打磨、整形或修削，使其具有合适表面或形状的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li kapaċi jillustra, jirfina jew jaqta' materjal biex jagħtih wiċċ jew forma xierqa.

sense_translations.en_definition: able to polish, dress or trim
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够打磨、修整或修削的。

collocations.en: a worker able to polish, dress, or trim
collocations.zh: 能进行打磨、修整或修削的工人

collocations.en: a man able to polish, dress, or trim
collocations.zh: 会打磨、修整或修削的男子

formal.mt: Għal dan ix-xogħol jeħtieġ ħaddiem naġġari li kapaċi jirfina l-wiċċ tal-ġebla u jirranġa t-truf tagħha.
formal.en: This work requires a worker able to dress stone, refine its surface, and shape its edges.
formal.zh: 这项工作需要一名会修整石材的工人，能够修平石头表面并处理边缘。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min jista' jirranġa t-truf ta' din il-ġebla? David: Toni hu ħaddiem naġġari. Nistaqsuh jekk jistax jgħinna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who can shape the edges of this stone? David: Toni is a worker who can dress and trim material. Let's ask whether he can help us.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁能修整这块石头的边缘？戴维：托尼是会修整材料的工人。咱们问问他能不能帮忙。

messages.speaker: Nina (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jirranġa t-truf ta' din il-ġebla?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jirranġa t-truf ta' din il-ġebla?
messages.zh: 谁能修整这块石头的边缘？
messages.en: Who can shape the edges of this stone?

messages.speaker: David (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Toni hu ħaddiem naġġari. Nistaqsuh jekk jistax jgħinna.
messages.mt_standard: Toni hu ħaddiem naġġari. Nistaqsuh jekk jistax jgħinna.
messages.zh: 托尼是会修整材料的工人。咱们问问他能不能帮忙。
messages.en: Toni is a worker who can dress and trim material. Let's ask whether he can help us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 naġġari 旁画一位把粗糙边角修平的工人，用“有修整能力”记住这个形容词。

gloss_zh: 蜜蜂；蜂群；蜜蜂这一类昆虫

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bees considered collectively, or the bee as a kind of insect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 集合地指多只蜜蜂，也可泛指蜜蜂这一类昆虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-insetti msejħa naħal meqjusa flimkien, jew dan it-tip ta' insett b'mod ġenerali.

sense_translations.en_definition: bee, bees (several insects; the bee as a species)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜜蜂；集合地指多只蜜蜂，也指蜜蜂这一物种
sense_translations.mt_definition: Naħal bħala grupp ta' insetti jew bħala tip ta' insett.

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi introduzzjoni għat-trobbija tan-naħal u għall-produzzjoni tal-għasel.
formal.en: The course includes an introduction to beekeeping and honey production.
formal.zh: 这门课程包括养蜂和蜂蜜生产的入门介绍。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hawn ħafna naħal fuq il-fjuri! Adam: Iva, ejja narawhom minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: There are lots of bees on the flowers! Adam: Yes, let's watch them from here.
colloquial.zh: Nina：花上有好多蜜蜂！Adam：是啊，我们就在这里看它们吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 花上有好多蜜蜂！
messages.en: There are lots of bees on the flowers!

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们就在这里看它们吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's watch them from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象花丛上成群飞动的蜜蜂，用整群的画面记住 naħal；它也能泛指蜜蜂这一类昆虫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flying insect that visits flowers to collect nectar and pollen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种会飞到花朵上采集花蜜和花粉的昆虫，即蜜蜂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett li jtir u jżur il-fjuri biex jiġbor in-nektar u l-polline.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜜蜂。
石灰岩中的杂质。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw naħla tiġbor il-polline minn fjura.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the students saw a bee collecting pollen from a flower.
formal.zh: 在花园进行观察时，学生们看到一只蜜蜂正在花朵上采集花粉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara, hemm naħla fuq il-fjura! Toni: Iva, ħalliha bi kwietha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look, there's a bee on the flower! Toni: Yes, leave it alone.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看，花上有一只蜜蜂！托尼：是啊，别打扰它。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，花上有一只蜜蜂！
messages.en: Look, there's a bee on the flower!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，别打扰它。
messages.en: Yes, leave it alone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张图记忆：花上的小蜜蜂与石灰岩里的杂质；看到花园或石材语境，再选择对应词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to speak with a nasal voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人说话时常带有鼻音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jitkellem b'leħen li jinstema' mill-imnieħer.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to speak through the nose
sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话习惯带鼻音的；说起话来像是从鼻子里发声的。

collocations.en: a man who speaks with a nasal voice
collocations.zh: 一个说话带鼻音的男人

collocations.en: a speaker with a nasal voice

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-karattru, l-awtur jippreżenta raġel naħnuħ li jitkellem bil-mod.
formal.en: In the character description, the author presents a man who speaks slowly with a nasal voice.
formal.zh: 在人物描写中，作者呈现了一个说话缓慢、常带鼻音的男人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu huwa xi ftit naħnuħ meta jitkellem? Lara: Iva, imma nifhmu sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Pawlu speak with a slightly nasal voice? Lara: Yes, but I understand him well.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗说话是不是有点鼻音？拉拉：是的，不过我听得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu huwa xi ftit naħnuħ meta jitkellem?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu huwa xi ftit naħnuħ meta jitkellem?
messages.zh: 保罗说话是不是有点鼻音？
messages.en: Does Pawlu speak with a slightly nasal voice?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，不过我听得很清楚。
messages.en: Yes, but I understand him well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人物介绍卡上写着“说话常带鼻音”；把这个词和说话者的发声特点一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a nasal quality, especially when describing a voice or tone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有鼻音特点的，尤其用于描述声音或语调。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu kwalità ta' ħoss mill-imnieħer, speċjalment meta jiddeskrivi leħen jew ton.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻音的；带有鼻音特征的。

formal.mt: Il-kantant uża ton naħnuħi f'din is-silta biex jagħti lill-karattru leħen distint.
formal.en: The singer used a nasal tone in this passage to give the character a distinctive voice.
formal.zh: 歌手在这一段中采用了带鼻音的音色，使角色的声音具有鲜明特点。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Leħni jinstema' naħnuħi f'dan ir-recording? Maja: Ftit, speċjalment fil-bidu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does my voice sound nasal in this recording? Maja: A little, especially at the beginning.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这段录音里我的声音听起来有鼻音吗？玛雅：有一点，尤其是开头。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这段录音里我的声音听起来有鼻音吗？
messages.en: Does my voice sound nasal in this recording?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 有一点，尤其是开头。
messages.en: A little, especially at the beginning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它贴在录音里的“声音、语调”旁边，记成“声音带鼻音”；可与描述说话者的 naħnuħ 对照练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of slaughtering an animal by cutting its throat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过割断动物喉部而进行宰杀的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li jinqatel annimal billi tinqatagħlu griżmejtu.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of slaughtering an animal by cutting its throat
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过割喉宰杀动物的行为。
一声鼾声；一次打呼噜的声音。

collocations.en: the slaughter of the animal by cutting its throat

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi n-naħra bħala att ta' qtil ta' annimal billi tinqatagħlu griżmejtu.
formal.en: The text describes naħra as the act of killing an animal by cutting its throat.
formal.zh: 该文本将 naħra 描述为通过割喉宰杀动物的行为。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt dik in-naħra? Toni: Iva, in-nannu raqad fuq is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear that snore? Toni: Yes, Grandpa fell asleep on the sofa.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听到刚才那声鼾声了吗？托尼：听到了，爷爷在沙发上睡着了。

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你听到刚才那声鼾声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that snore?

messages.speaker: Toni (弟弟)
messages.zh: 听到了，爷爷在沙发上睡着了。
messages.en: Yes, Grandpa fell asleep on the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为两个义项各设一个场景标签：“动物宰杀”和“睡眠声音”；读句子时先看场景，避免混淆。

gloss_zh: 反复发出驴叫声；接连嘶叫

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a donkey's braying sound repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指驴反复发出叫声，强调接连鸣叫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel l-għajta tal-ħmar għal darba wara l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复发出驴叫声；接连嘶叫
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħmel l-għajta tal-ħmar għal darba wara l-oħra.

collocations.en: brayed repeatedly for a long time

formal.mt: Matul l-osservazzjoni, il-ħmar naħħaq għal diversi minuti ħdejn il-bieb tal-istalla.
formal.en: During the observation, the donkey brayed repeatedly for several minutes beside the stable door.
formal.zh: 观察期间，那头驴在牲口棚门旁接连叫了好几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Smajt il-ħmar? Naħħaq għal ħin twil dalgħodu. Rita: Iva, smajtu mill-kċina.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Did you hear the donkey? It brayed repeatedly for a long time this morning. Rita: Yes, I heard it from the kitchen.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：你听见驴叫了吗？今天早上它接连叫了好久。Rita：听见了，我在厨房里都听到了。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt il-ħmar? Naħħaq għal ħin twil dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Smajt il-ħmar? Naħħaq għal ħin twil dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 你听见驴叫了吗？今天早上它接连叫了好久。
messages.en: Did you hear the donkey? It brayed repeatedly for a long time this morning.

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 听见了，我在厨房里都听到了。
messages.en: Yes, I heard it from the kitchen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中播放驴一声接一声叫的短片，用连续的声音记住 naħħaq，重点是“反复叫”的动作。

gloss_zh: 爱嘶叫的；容易发出驴叫声的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to make a donkey's braying sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容有发出驴叫声的倾向、经常爱叫的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħmel l-għajta tal-ħmar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于发出驴叫声的；爱嘶叫的
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħmel l-għajta tal-ħmar.

collocations.en: a donkey that tends to bray

collocations.zh: 容易发出驴叫声的动物

formal.mt: Il-ħmar ġie deskritt bħala naħħaqi minħabba l-għajjat frekwenti tiegħu matul il-jum.
formal.en: The donkey was described as prone to braying because of its frequent calls during the day.
formal.zh: 由于那头驴白天频繁鸣叫，记录中把它描述为爱叫的驴。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-ħmar naħħaqi ħafna! Pawlu: Veru, spiss nisimgħu leħnu minn ġewwa d-dar.
colloquial.en: Rita: This donkey really does bray a lot! Pawlu: True, we often hear it from inside the house.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这头驴可真爱叫！Pawlu：确实，我们在屋里也常常听见它的叫声。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场工人)
messages.zh: 这头驴可真爱叫！
messages.en: This donkey really does bray a lot!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, spiss nisimgħu leħnu minn ġewwa d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, spiss nisimgħu leħnu minn ġewwa d-dar.
messages.zh: 确实，我们在屋里也常常听见它的叫声。
messages.en: True, we often hear it from inside the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给一头经常叫的驴挂上“爱叫的”小牌，用这个特征记住 naħħaqi；再与 naħħaq 的连续鸣叫动作对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone snore while asleep.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人在睡眠中打鼾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jonħor waqt l-irqad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使打鼾；引起某人打呼噜。
打鼾的人；睡觉时打呼噜的人。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, it-trattament naħħar lill-pazjent waqt l-irqad.
formal.en: According to the report, the treatment caused the patient to snore during sleep.
formal.zh: 根据报告，这项治疗使病人在睡眠中打鼾。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk huwa naħħar? Mark: Iva, kultant inħossu jonħor mill-kamra l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your brother a snorer? Mark: Yes, sometimes I can hear him snoring from the other room.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你兄弟是个爱打鼾的人吗？马克：是的，有时我在另一个房间都能听到他打鼾。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟是个爱打鼾的人吗？
messages.en: Is your brother a snorer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kultant inħossu jonħor mill-kamra l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kultant inħossu jonħor mill-kamra l-oħra.
messages.zh: 是的，有时我在另一个房间都能听到他打鼾。
messages.en: Yes, sometimes I can hear him snoring from the other room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词义画成两格：一格是某物使人打鼾，另一格是正在打鼾的人；用句中角色区分动词和名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take off one's own clothes; also, to leave a religious order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脱去自己的衣服；也可指退出修会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi ħwejġu minn fuqu; jista' jfisser ukoll li jitlaq minn ordni reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱去自己身上的衣服。
退出修会，不再作为该修会的成员生活。

collocations.en: he undressed before getting into bed

formal.mt: Wara ħafna snin fil-kunvent, ir-raġel naża' u beda ħajja ġdida barra l-ordni reliġjuż.
formal.en: After many years in the convent, the man left the religious order and began a new life outside it.
formal.zh: 在修院生活多年之后，这名男子退出了修会，开始了修会之外的新生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark lest biex jorqod? Anna: Iva, diġà naża' u libes il-piġama.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark ready for bed? Anna: Yes, he's already undressed and put on his pyjamas.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克准备好睡觉了吗？安娜：是的，他已经脱下衣服，换上睡衣了。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 马克准备好睡觉了吗？
messages.en: Is Mark ready for bed?

messages.speaker: Anna (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà naża' u libes il-piġama.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà naża' u libes il-piġama.
messages.zh: 是的，他已经脱下衣服，换上睡衣了。
messages.en: Yes, he's already undressed and put on his pyjamas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 naża' 准备两张情境卡：自己脱衣，以及退出修会；第二义需单独记忆，不能把所有脱衣场景都理解成退出修会。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A nosy person who is overly curious about other people's private affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对别人的私事过分好奇、喜欢打听的人，带有批评意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħobb tistaqsi żżejjed dwar il-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱打听别人私事的人；这里用作 bumnieħer 的替代说法。

collocations.en: a nosy person who asks about everything

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġar huwa deskritt bħala nażontes li dejjem jistaqsi dwar il-ħajja privata tal-oħrajn.
formal.en: In the story, the neighbour is described as a nosy person who is always asking about other people's private lives.
formal.zh: 故事把这位邻居描写成一个总爱打听别人私生活的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak in-nażontes reġa' staqsieni kemm naqla' flus! Mark: Għidlu li dik hi ħaġa privata.
colloquial.en: Maja: That nosy person asked me how much I earn again! Mark: Tell him that's private.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个爱打听的人又问我挣多少钱了！马克：告诉他，那是私事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak in-nażontes reġa' staqsieni kemm naqla' flus!
messages.mt_standard: Dak in-nażontes reġa' staqsieni kemm naqla' flus!
messages.zh: 那个爱打听的人又问我挣多少钱了！
messages.en: That nosy person asked me how much I earn again!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għidlu li dik hi ħaġa privata.
messages.mt_standard: Għidlu li dik hi ħaġa privata.
messages.zh: 告诉他，那是私事。
messages.en: Tell him that's private.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个不停问工资、感情和家庭私事的人，把 nażontes 贴在这张人物卡上，记住它指人并带批评语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove all of another person's clothes, leaving that person naked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脱去另一个人身上的全部衣服，使其赤裸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi l-ħwejjeġ kollha minn fuq persuna oħra u jħalliha għarwiena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱光某人的衣服，使其全身赤裸。

collocations.en: he stripped the man of all his wet clothes
collocations.zh: 他脱去了那名男子身上所有湿衣服

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem tas-salvataġġ nażża' lir-raġel minn ħwejġu mxarrbin u minnufih għattieh b'kutra.
formal.en: The rescue worker stripped the man of all his wet clothes and immediately covered him with a blanket.
formal.zh: 救援人员脱去了那名男子身上所有湿衣服，并立即给他盖上毯子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-infermier nażża' lill-pazjent? Mark: Biex jaħslu. Għalaq il-bieb u għattieh b'xugaman.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the nurse strip the patient naked? Mark: To wash him. He closed the door and covered him with a towel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：护士为什么脱光了病人的衣服？马克：为了给他清洗身体。他关上了门，还用毛巾盖住了病人。

messages.speaker: Maja (实习护理员)
messages.zh: 护士为什么脱光了病人的衣服？
messages.en: Why did the nurse strip the patient naked?

messages.speaker: Mark (护理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jaħslu. Għalaq il-bieb u għattieh b'xugaman.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jaħslu. Għalaq il-bieb u għattieh b'xugaman.
messages.zh: 为了给他清洗身体。他关上了门，还用毛巾盖住了病人。
messages.en: To wash him. He closed the door and covered him with a towel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naża' 与 nażża' 并排写成对照卡：前者自己脱衣，后者给别人脱光衣服；用双写 żż 提醒自己检查动作对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be laid, said of eggs produced by a bird or another egg-laying animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指蛋被鸟类或其他产卵动物产下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għall-bajd meta joħroġ minn ġisem għasfur jew annimal ieħor li jbid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被产下，用于描述蛋或卵。

collocations.en: the eggs were laid in the nest

formal.mt: Il-bajd li nbad dalgħodu nġabar u tqiegħed f'kaxxa nadifa.
formal.en: The eggs laid this morning were collected and placed in a clean box.
formal.zh: 今天早晨产下的蛋已被收集起来，放进了干净的盒子里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-bajd nbad illum? Mark: Iva, nbad dalgħodu. Għadni kemm ġbartu mill-bejta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Were these eggs laid today? Mark: Yes, they were laid this morning. I've just collected them from the nest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些蛋是今天下的吗？马克：是的，是今天早晨下的。我刚从窝里把它们收起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些蛋是今天下的吗？
messages.en: Were these eggs laid today?

messages.speaker: Mark (养鸡人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nbad dalgħodu. Għadni kemm ġbartu mill-bejta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nbad dalgħodu. Għadni kemm ġbartu mill-bejta.
messages.zh: 是的，是今天早晨下的。我刚从窝里把它们收起来。
messages.en: Yes, they were laid this morning. I've just collected them from the nest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把视角放在鸡窝里的蛋上：说 nbad 时，关注的是蛋被产下，而不是母鸡做动作；可用今天刚下的蛋这一画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be hated, disliked, or deliberately avoided by others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到别人的憎恨、反感，或被别人有意疏远。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun mibgħud jew mhux aċċettat minn oħrajn, jew oħrajn jevitawh apposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被憎恨；受到强烈的厌恶。
被讨厌；不受别人喜欢。
被有意回避、疏远或排斥。

collocations.en: was disliked or shunned by his companions
was disliked because of his behavior
collocations.zh: 因自己的行为而被讨厌

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel nbagħad minn sħabu minħabba l-imġiba ħażina tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the man was disliked by his companions because of his bad behavior.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这名男子因行为恶劣而受到同伴的厌恶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark nbagħad minn sħabu? Lara: Għax kien jigdeb u ma kienx jirrispettahom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why was Mark disliked by his companions? Lara: Because he used to lie and did not respect them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么马克被同伴讨厌了？拉拉：因为他以前总撒谎，而且不尊重他们。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 为什么马克被同伴讨厌了？
messages.en: Why was Mark disliked by his companions?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien jigdeb u ma kienx jirrispettahom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien jigdeb u ma kienx jirrispettahom.
messages.zh: 因为他以前总撒谎，而且不尊重他们。
messages.en: Because he used to lie and did not respect them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“被同伴讨厌、大家逐渐远离”的画面中记忆，重点记住承受反感的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be sent to a person or place, as a message, an item, or a person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指信息或物品被发送、寄往某处，也可指人被派往某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintbagħat għand persuna jew f'post, bħal messaġġ, oġġett jew persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被发送、寄出或派遣。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport nbagħat lid-direttur qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The report was sent to the director before the meeting.
formal.zh: 报告在会议之前已发送给主任。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-pakkett għadu hawn? Sara: Le, nbagħat bil-posta dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the parcel still here? Sara: No, it was sent by post this morning.
colloquial.zh: 马克：包裹还在这里吗？萨拉：不在了，今天早上已经邮寄出去了。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 包裹还在这里吗？
messages.en: Is the parcel still here?

messages.speaker: Sara (邮局职员)
messages.zh: 不在了，今天早上已经邮寄出去了。
messages.en: No, it was sent by post this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象包裹贴好邮票后被寄出；与 nbagħad 对照，末尾 t 联想发送，末尾 d 联想被讨厌。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be swallowed, or figuratively to become dumbfounded or stunned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被吞咽下去；也可比喻因震惊而一时呆住、说不出话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi mill-ħalq għall-istonku meta jinbela', jew, b'mod figurattiv, jibqa' mistagħġeb u bla kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: bala'（吞咽）的中被动态形式，表示被吞下等意义。
被吞下；被咽下。
惊呆；震惊得一时说不出话。

collocations.en: he was stunned when he heard the news

formal.mt: L-ikel nbala' mingħajr ma ntmagħad sew.
formal.en: The food was swallowed without being chewed properly.
formal.zh: 食物没有充分咀嚼就被吞下了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif irreaġixxa Mark meta sema' l-aħbar? Maja: Nbala'! Għal ftit ma qal xejn.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Mark react when he heard the news? Maja: He was stunned! For a little while, he said nothing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克听到消息时有什么反应？玛雅：他惊呆了！有一小会儿什么也没说。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif irreaġixxa Mark meta sema' l-aħbar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif irreaġixxa Mark meta sema' l-aħbar?
messages.zh: 马克听到消息时有什么反应？
messages.en: How did Mark react when he heard the news?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nbala'! Għal ftit ma qal xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Nbala'! Għal ftit ma qal xejn.
messages.zh: 他惊呆了！有一小会儿什么也没说。
messages.en: He was stunned! For a little while, he said nothing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分开记：食物被吞进肚里，人听到消息后惊得说不出话；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be shaped or smoothed with a file, especially a hard edge or surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指硬质边缘或表面被锉刀削磨，以改变形状或使其平滑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitnaqqas jew isir lixx permezz ta' lima, speċjalment tarf jew wiċċ ta' materjal iebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被锉刀锉削或锉平。

formal.mt: It-tarf tal-metall nbarad bil-lima sakemm sar lixx.
formal.en: The metal edge was filed until it became smooth.
formal.zh: 金属边缘用锉刀锉削，直到变得平滑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan it-tarf huwa daqshekk lixx? Pawlu: Għax nbarad bil-lima qabel ma waħħalnieh.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is this edge so smooth? Pawlu: Because it was filed before we fitted it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个边缘为什么这么平滑？保罗：因为我们安装之前用锉刀锉过了。

messages.speaker: Sara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan it-tarf huwa daqshekk lixx?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan it-tarf huwa daqshekk lixx?
messages.zh: 这个边缘为什么这么平滑？
messages.en: Why is this edge so smooth?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax nbarad bil-lima qabel ma waħħalnieh.
messages.mt_standard: Għax nbarad bil-lima qabel ma waħħalnieh.
messages.zh: 因为我们安装之前用锉刀锉过了。
messages.en: Because it was filed before we fitted it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nbarad 和锉刀来回磨平金属边缘的动作一起记；这里的 filed 指锉削，不是文件归档。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become twisted or move out of its proper alignment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体发生扭曲、扭转，或偏离原来端正的位置而歪斜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitgħawweġ jew idur b'tali mod li ma jibqax dritt jew fil-pożizzjoni t-tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得扭曲；发生扭转。
变歪；偏离端正或对齐的位置。

formal.mt: Il-qafas nbaram waqt it-trasport u ma baqax joqgħod dritt.
formal.en: The frame went askew during transport and no longer sat straight.
formal.zh: 框架在运输过程中歪斜了，无法再端正放置。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-kejbil ma jibqax dritt? Pawlu: Nbaram fil-borża. Ejja niddrittawh bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why won't the cable stay straight? Pawlu: It got twisted in the bag. Let's straighten it gently.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：电缆为什么总是弯着？保罗：它在包里扭曲了。我们慢慢把它理直吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 电缆为什么总是弯着？
messages.en: Why won't the cable stay straight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 它在包里扭曲了。我们慢慢把它理直吧。
messages.en: It got twisted in the bag. Let's straighten it gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用电缆扭曲和相框歪斜两个画面记 nbaram：一个形状被扭，一个位置不正。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have its surface marked or damaged by something sharp or rough.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指表面被尖锐或粗糙的东西刮出、划出痕迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu marki jew ħsara fil-wiċċ minħabba kuntatt ma' xi ħaġa li taqta' jew li hi ħarxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被刮伤；表面被划出痕迹。

formal.mt: Il-bieb nbarax meta l-armarju għadda minn ħdejh waqt it-trasport.
formal.en: The door was scratched when the wardrobe passed beside it during transport.
formal.zh: 搬运时，衣柜从门旁经过，把门刮伤了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'ġara lill-bieb? Sara: Nbarax meta daħħalna l-armarju.
colloquial.en: Mark: What happened to the door? Sara: It got scratched when we brought the wardrobe in.
colloquial.zh: 马克：门怎么了？萨拉：我们把衣柜搬进来时，把门刮伤了。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 门怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the door?

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 我们把衣柜搬进来时，把门刮伤了。
messages.en: It got scratched when we brought the wardrobe in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钥匙在门上划出一道细痕，看到表面留下的划痕就回想 nbarax，重点记“被刮伤”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be put together in a pile or heap.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指材料或物品被集中堆成一堆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed flimkien f'munzell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被堆起；被堆放成堆。

collocations.en: the stones were piled against the wall

formal.mt: Il-ġebel nbaraġ f'rokna tal-bitħa qabel ma beda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The stones were piled in a corner of the courtyard before the work began.
formal.zh: 工程开始前，石头被堆放在院子的一个角落里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-ġebel li ġabu lbieraħ? Mark: Nbaraġ mal-ħajt ta' wara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are the stones they brought yesterday? Mark: They were piled against the back wall.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们昨天运来的石头在哪里？马克：堆在后面的墙边了。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-ġebel li ġabu lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-ġebel li ġabu lbieraħ?
messages.zh: 他们昨天运来的石头在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the stones they brought yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (工人)
messages.zh: 堆在后面的墙边了。
messages.en: They were piled against the back wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象院子里零散的石头被集中堆成小山，将 nbaraġ 与“材料成堆”的结果绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be stated or anticipated in advance as something expected to happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某件事在发生之前就被预测或预料到。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad minn qabel li se jiġri, jew ikun mistenni qabel ma jseħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被预测；被预先料到。

formal.mt: Iż-żieda fil-prezzijiet kienet mistennija, u l-effett tagħha nbasar fir-rapport.
formal.en: The price increase was expected, and its effect was predicted in the report.
formal.zh: 价格上涨在预料之中，其影响也已在报告中作出预测。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-riżultat kien sorpriża? Mark: Le, nbasar minn qabel, għax it-tim kien qed jilgħab tajjeb ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was this result a surprise? Mark: No, it was predicted beforehand because the team had been playing very well.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个结果让人意外吗？马克：不意外，之前就有人预测到了，因为这支球队一直踢得很好。

messages.speaker: Maja (球迷)
messages.zh: 这个结果让人意外吗？
messages.en: Was this result a surprise?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nbasar minn qabel, għax it-tim kien qed jilgħab tajjeb ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nbasar minn qabel, għax it-tim kien qed jilgħab tajjeb ħafna.
messages.zh: 不意外，之前就有人预测到了，因为这支球队一直踢得很好。
messages.en: No, it was predicted beforehand because the team had been playing very well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画预测箭头，再画实际发生的结果；把 nbasar 放在结果旁，记住它表示“事先被预测”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come into existence in the womb through conception.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指孩子经由受孕开始在母体内形成，着眼于被孕育的孩子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibda jeżisti fil-ġuf permezz tat-tnissil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被孕育；通过受孕而开始形成。

formal.mt: Skont id-djarju tal-ġenituri, it-tifel nbatan fir-rebbiegħa.
formal.en: According to his parents' diary, the boy was conceived in spring.
formal.zh: 根据父母的日记，这个男孩是在春天受孕而形成的。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan ir-ritratt ittieħed qabel ma nbatan it-tifel? Pawlu: Iva, konna għadna kemm iżżewwiġna.
colloquial.en: Marta: Was this photo taken before the boy was conceived? Pawlu: Yes, we had only just got married.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这张照片是在孩子被孕育之前拍的吗？保罗：是啊，我们当时才刚结婚。

messages.speaker: Marta (妻子)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-ritratt ittieħed qabel ma nbatan it-tifel?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-ritratt ittieħed qabel ma nbatan it-tifel?
messages.zh: 这张照片是在孩子被孕育之前拍的吗？
messages.en: Was this photo taken before the boy was conceived?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (丈夫)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们当时才刚结婚。
messages.en: Yes, we had only just got married.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定在生命刚在母体内开始的时刻：主角是被孕育的孩子，用此区分出生与受孕。

gloss_zh: 被截短；尾巴被截去一部分

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have part of the tail cut off so that it becomes shorter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指动物的尾巴被截去一部分而变短。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinqata' parti mid-denb biex dan isir iqsar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被截尾；尾巴被截去一部分而缩短。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport veterinarju jindika li denb il-kelb nbatar meta kien għadu żgħir.
formal.en: The veterinary report indicates that the dog's tail was docked when it was still young.
formal.zh: 兽医报告指出，这只狗的尾巴在它年幼时被截短了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan il-kelb għandu denbu daqshekk qasir? Mark: Denbu nbatar meta kien żgħir.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does this dog have such a short tail? Mark: Its tail was docked when it was young.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这只狗的尾巴怎么这么短？马克：它小时候尾巴被截短了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-kelb għandu denbu daqshekk qasir?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-kelb għandu denbu daqshekk qasir?
messages.zh: 这只狗的尾巴怎么这么短？
messages.en: Why does this dog have such a short tail?

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.zh: 它小时候尾巴被截短了。
messages.en: Its tail was docked when it was young.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条尾巴的末端被截去，长度明显缩短；本条英语 docked 对应的是截尾这一画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be begun, as when work, a project, or an activity is started.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指工作、项目或活动被启动，进入开始进行的阶段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jingħata bidu għal xogħol, proġett jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被开始；被启动，开始进行。

formal.mt: Il-proġett nbeda f'Jannar u għandu jitlesta sa tmiem is-sena.
formal.en: The project was started in January and is expected to be completed by the end of the year.
formal.zh: 该项目于一月启动，预计在年底前完成。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ix-xogħol fuq il-kċina nbeda? Toni: Iva, ilbieraħ ġew il-ħaddiema.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has the work on the kitchen been started? Toni: Yes, the workers came yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：厨房的工程开始了吗？托尼：开始了，工人昨天来了。

messages.speaker: Sara (住户)
messages.zh: 厨房的工程开始了吗？
messages.en: Has the work on the kitchen been started?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.zh: 开始了，工人昨天来了。
messages.en: Yes, the workers came yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把项目时间线上的第一个起点圈出来，旁边写“工程已启动”，帮助记住动作已经开始。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be remembered with grief and sorrow after death.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某人去世后受到人们悲痛的悼念与哀悼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun imfakkar b'niket u biki wara mewtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被哀悼；去世后受到悲痛的悼念。

formal.mt: L-għalliem nbeka mill-istudenti u mill-kollegi tiegħu, li ftakru fil-ġenerożità tiegħu.
formal.en: The teacher was mourned by his students and colleagues, who remembered his generosity.
formal.zh: 这位教师受到学生和同事的哀悼，大家都记得他的慷慨。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kien hemm ħafna nies fil-funeral ta' Ġużeppi? Rita: Iva, nbeka minn kulħadd. Kien dejjem jgħin lin-nies.
colloquial.en: Nina: Were there many people at Ġużeppi's funeral? Rita: Yes, he was mourned by everyone. He was always helping people.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：朱塞佩的葬礼上人多吗？丽塔：多，大家都很哀伤。他以前总是帮助别人。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm ħafna nies fil-funeral ta' Ġużeppi?
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm ħafna nies fil-funeral ta' Ġużeppi?
messages.zh: 朱塞佩的葬礼上人多吗？
messages.en: Were there many people at Ġużeppi's funeral?

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nbeka minn kulħadd. Kien dejjem jgħin lin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nbeka minn kulħadd. Kien dejjem jgħin lin-nies.
messages.zh: 多，大家都很哀伤。他以前总是帮助别人。
messages.en: Yes, he was mourned by everyone. He was always helping people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人们围着逝者的照片含泪追念，把词义落在“逝者受到哀悼”这一完整场景上。

gloss_zh: 被建造；被开发成建成区；被建立

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be constructed, to become built up with buildings, or to be created or established.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指建筑物被建造、地区逐渐被建筑开发，或某种事物与关系被建立起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinbena bini, li post jimtela bil-bini, jew li tinħoloq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被建造；建筑物或构筑物被建成。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be built up (used of a location or environment which has become urbanised)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指地点或环境被建筑开发，逐渐成为城市化的建成区域。
被创造；被建立或形成。

collocations.en: the whole area became built up
collocations.zh: 整个地区都被建筑开发了

collocations.en: a sense of trust was created

formal.mt: Il-pont nbena biex jgħaqqad iż-żewġ irħula; bis-saħħa tal-ħidma komuni, nbena wkoll sens ta' fiduċja bejn ir-residenti.
formal.en: The bridge was built to connect the two villages; through their joint work, a sense of trust was also created between the residents.
formal.zh: 这座桥的建造是为了连接两个村庄；共同的工作也让居民之间建立起了信任感。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tiftakar kemm kien hemm għelieqi hawn? David: Iva, issa l-post kollu nbena. Bilkemm għadni nagħrfu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you remember how many fields there were here? David: Yes, now the whole area has been built up. I can barely recognise it.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你记得这里以前有多少田地吗？戴维：记得，现在整个地方都盖满了建筑。我都快认不出来了。

messages.speaker: Anna (老居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiftakar kemm kien hemm għelieqi hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Tiftakar kemm kien hemm għelieqi hawn?
messages.zh: 你记得这里以前有多少田地吗？
messages.en: Do you remember how many fields there were here?

messages.speaker: David (老邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa l-post kollu nbena. Bilkemm għadni nagħrfu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa l-post kollu nbena. Bilkemm għadni nagħrfu.
messages.zh: 记得，现在整个地方都盖满了建筑。我都快认不出来了。
messages.en: Yes, now the whole area has been built up. I can barely recognise it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅图串联记忆：桥被建成、田地变成街区、人与人建立信任；分别对应三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be opened wide, leaving a broad opening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指门或其他开口被大幅打开，呈现敞开的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinfetaħ beraħ u jħalli fetħa wiesgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被大大打开；被敞开。

formal.mt: Il-bieb ewlieni nberaħ sabiex il-viżitaturi jkunu jistgħu jidħlu fis-sala.
formal.en: The main door was opened wide so that visitors could enter the hall.
formal.zh: 正门被大大打开，以便访客进入大厅。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif daħal il-qattus? Ġanni: Il-bieb nberaħ bir-riħ, u daħal jiġri.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did the cat get in? Ġanni: The door blew wide open, and it ran in.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：猫怎么进来了？詹尼：风把门吹得大开，它就跑进来了。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 猫怎么进来了？
messages.en: How did the cat get in?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bieb nberaħ bir-riħ, u daħal jiġri.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bieb nberaħ bir-riħ, u daħal jiġri.
messages.zh: 风把门吹得大开，它就跑进来了。
messages.en: The door blew wide open, and it ran in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门被推到大开、能让人顺畅通过的位置，抓住“大大敞开”的幅度来记忆。

gloss_zh: 被喷洒；被洒上少量液体

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have liquid applied as a spray or scattered over it in small drops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物表面被喷上液体，或被洒上零散的小液滴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixxerred fuqu likwidu bħala sprej jew fi qtar żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被喷洒；表面被喷上雾状或细滴状液体。
被洒上少量液体；表面被零散的小液滴沾湿。

collocations.en: the garden was sprayed with water
the bread was sprinkled with a little water

formal.mt: Qabel it-tindif, il-wiċċ tal-mejda nbexx bi ftit ilma.
formal.en: Before cleaning, the surface of the table was sprayed with a little water.
formal.zh: 清洁之前，桌面被喷上了少量水。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex il-ħobż hu niedi? Ben: Nbexx bi ftit ilma qabel ma daħal fil-forn.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is the bread damp? Ben: It was sprinkled with a little water before it went into the oven.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：面包怎么湿湿的？本：放进烤箱之前，上面洒了一点水。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 面包怎么湿湿的？
messages.en: Why is the bread damp?

messages.speaker: Ben (做饭的家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nbexx bi ftit ilma qabel ma daħal fil-forn.
messages.mt_standard: Nbexx bi ftit ilma qabel ma daħal fil-forn.
messages.zh: 放进烤箱之前，上面洒了一点水。
messages.en: It was sprinkled with a little water before it went into the oven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象喷壶留下细密水雾，再想象手指洒下零星水滴；两种画面都能帮助记住本词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be expelled from something, especially to be spat out of the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某物被向外喷出或排出，尤其指从口中被吐出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintrema 'l barra minn xi ħaġa, speċjalment mill-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被喷出；被向外排出或抛出。
被吐出；从口中被啐出或喷吐出来。

collocations.en: the material was ejected from the machine
the water was spat out of the mouth

formal.mt: Matul it-tħaddim, il-materjal żejjed nbeżaq minn fetħa fil-magna.
formal.en: During operation, the excess material was ejected through an opening in the machine.
formal.zh: 运转过程中，多余的材料从机器的一个开口中被喷出。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm daqshekk ilma mal-art? Mark: L-ilma nbeżaq minn ħalq Toni meta beda jisgħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there so much water on the floor? Mark: The water was spat out of Toni's mouth when he started coughing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：地上怎么有这么多水？马克：托尼一咳嗽，嘴里的水就喷出来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 地上怎么有这么多水？
messages.en: Why is there so much water on the floor?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ilma nbeżaq minn ħalq Toni meta beda jisgħol.
messages.mt_standard: L-ilma nbeżaq minn ħalq Toni meta beda jisgħol.
messages.zh: 托尼一咳嗽，嘴里的水就喷出来了。
messages.en: The water was spat out of Toni's mouth when he started coughing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画一个向外的箭头，再分别连到机器开口和人的嘴巴，记住“被排出”和“被吐出”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change or become different; to be altered or exchanged for something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生变化、被更改，或被拿来与另一事物交换。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir differenti, jiġi mibdul, jew jiġi skambjat ma' xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生变化；变得不同。
被改变；被更改。
被交换；被换成另一件东西。

formal.mt: Il-ħin tal-laqgħa nbidel mid-disgħa għall-għaxra.
formal.en: The meeting time was changed from nine to ten.
formal.zh: 会议时间由九点改为十点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadna se niltaqgħu fid-disgħa? Mark: Le, il-ħin inbidel. Issa se niltaqgħu fl-għaxra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we still meeting at nine? Mark: No, the time has changed. We're meeting at ten now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们还是九点见吗？马克：不是，时间改了。现在我们十点见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们还是九点见吗？
messages.en: Are we still meeting at nine?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-ħin inbidel. Issa se niltaqgħu fl-għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-ħin inbidel. Issa se niltaqgħu fl-għaxra.
messages.zh: 不是，时间改了。现在我们十点见。
messages.en: No, the time has changed. We're meeting at ten now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日程表上的九点被改成十点，再想象手中的物品换成另一件，用这两个画面记住“改变”和“被交换”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive a kiss from someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到某人的亲吻，表示被亲吻者的经历。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi bewsa mingħand xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被亲吻；受到亲吻。

formal.mt: It-tifel inbies minn ommu qabel telaq lejn l-iskola.
formal.en: The boy was kissed by his mother before he left for school.
formal.zh: 男孩出发去学校前，母亲亲了他一下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jitbissem it-tifel? Rita: Għax għadu kemm inbies minn ommu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the boy smiling? Rita: Because his mother has just kissed him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个男孩为什么笑着？丽塔：因为他妈妈刚刚亲了他一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男孩为什么笑着？
messages.en: Why is the boy smiling?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għadu kemm inbies minn ommu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għadu kemm inbies minn ommu.
messages.zh: 因为他妈妈刚刚亲了他一下。
messages.en: Because his mother has just kissed him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把镜头对准被亲吻后露出笑容的孩子：记住这个词关注的是“收到亲吻的人”，而不是主动亲别人的动作。
