teaching_sense.en_definition: Teasing or bothering someone, ranging from playful provocation to unwanted harassment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 逗弄或烦扰他人的行为；根据语境，可以是玩笑式的逗弄，也可以是令人反感的骚扰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba li biha wieħed jittanta jew idejjaq lil xi ħadd; tista' tkun ċajta jew fastidju mhux mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逗弄；戏弄。
骚扰；使人困扰的烦扰行为。

formal.mt: In-nbix ripetut fil-klassi jista' jġiegħel lil xi studenti jħossuhom skomdi.
formal.en: Repeated teasing in class can make some students feel uncomfortable.
formal.zh: 课堂上反复出现的戏弄行为可能让一些学生感到不自在。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan kollu nbix bejn il-ħbieb! Maja: Imma Rita qed tiddejjaq. Aħjar tieqaf.
colloquial.en: Mark: It's all just teasing among friends! Maja: But Rita is upset. You'd better stop.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这都是朋友之间的逗弄嘛！玛雅：可是丽塔已经不高兴了。你最好停下来。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这都是朋友之间的逗弄嘛！
messages.en: It's all just teasing among friends!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Imma Rita qed tiddejjaq. Aħjar tieqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Imma Rita qed tiddejjaq. Aħjar tieqaf.
messages.zh: 可是丽塔已经不高兴了。你最好停下来。
messages.en: But Rita is upset. You'd better stop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一个逗弄场景记两种意思：双方都开心时可理解为逗趣，对方反感却仍被烦扰时则要想到“骚扰”的义项。

gloss_zh: 变得有礼；恢复文明态度

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become polite and respectful in one's behaviour, for example after an angry outburst.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 举止或说话态度变得有礼、尊重他人，例如发脾气后恢复文明的交流方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jġib ruħu b'edukazzjoni u rispett, pereżempju wara li jkun għajjat jew irrabja.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become civil (e.g. following an outburst)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 态度变得有礼、讲文明，例如发作或大喊之后恢复礼貌。

collocations.zh: 态度变得有礼，并尊重地说话

formal.mt: Wara li nbiġel, kompla d-diskussjoni mal-kollegi tiegħu b'rispett.
formal.en: After becoming civil, he continued the discussion with his colleagues respectfully.
formal.zh: 恢复礼貌后，他以尊重的态度继续与同事讨论。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Mark għadu jgħajjat? Maja: Le, fl-aħħar inbiġel u beda jkellimna b'rispett.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is Mark still shouting? Maja: No, he finally became civil and started speaking to us respectfully.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克还在大喊吗？玛雅：没有，他终于恢复了礼貌，开始尊重地跟我们说话了。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 马克还在大喊吗？
messages.en: Is Mark still shouting?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fl-aħħar inbiġel u beda jkellimna b'rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fl-aħħar inbiġel u beda jkellimna b'rispett.
messages.zh: 没有，他终于恢复了礼貌，开始尊重地跟我们说话了。
messages.en: No, he finally became civil and started speaking to us respectfully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人先拍桌大喊，随后放低声音、礼貌交谈；把这个词记成“态度转为有礼”，重点是待人方式的变化。

gloss_zh: 被编织；被编成辫；投身于某项活动

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be woven or plaited; also, to immerse oneself in an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被交织编成织物或被编成辫状；也指全心投入某项活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi minsuġ jew immaljat; jista' jfisser ukoll li wieħed jidħol b'ħiltu kollha f'xi attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被编织；被交织成织物或编织物。
被编成辫子或辫状结构。

sense_translations.en_definition: to immerse oneself in some activity
sense_translations.zh_definition: 全心投入某项活动；埋头从事某事。

formal.mt: Ix-xagħar indafar f'żagarella waħda qabel il-wirja.
formal.en: The hair was plaited into a single braid before the performance.
formal.zh: 演出前，头发被编成了一条辫子。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn hu Mark? Maja: Indafar fix-xogħol u nesa l-ħin.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where is Mark? Maja: He immersed himself in work and lost track of time.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克在哪里？玛雅：他埋头工作，忘了时间。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 马克在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Mark?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 他埋头工作，忘了时间。
messages.en: He immersed himself in work and lost track of time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记线材被编织、头发被编辫的画面，再另记一个人埋头工作忘记时间的画面；这是帮助区分三个义项的学习联想。

gloss_zh: 被收集或归拢；棉花等从荚中被取出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be collected or put together; of cotton and similar material, to be separated from its pod.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被收集、集中或归拢在一起；用于棉花等时，也指从荚中被分离取出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġabar jew jitqiegħed flimkien; meta jingħad għall-qoton u materjal simili, jinfired mill-miżwed.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be put collected or put together
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被收集起来；被放在一起或归拢。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be separated from a pod (used of cotton etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从荚中被分离或取出，用于棉花等。

collocations.en: the cotton was separated from the pod

formal.mt: Il-materjal kollu ndamm f'post wieħed qabel beda x-xogħol.
formal.en: All the material was collected in one place before work began.
formal.zh: 工作开始前，所有材料被集中到同一个地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qoton għadu fil-miżwed? Pawlu: Le, diġà ndamm u issa lest għall-pass li jmiss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the cotton still in the pod? Pawlu: No, it has already been taken out and is now ready for the next step.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：棉花还在棉荚里吗？保罗：不，已经取出来了，现在可以进行下一步了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 棉花还在棉荚里吗？
messages.en: Is the cotton still in the pod?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, diġà ndamm u issa lest għall-pass li jmiss.
messages.mt_standard: Le, diġà ndamm u issa lest għall-pass li jmiss.
messages.zh: 不，已经取出来了，现在可以进行下一步了。
messages.en: No, it has already been taken out and is now ready for the next step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记住两幅图：散放的材料被归拢到一处，棉花从棉荚里被取出。遇到棉花语境时，优先回想第二幅图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For food or drink to have its flavour tried by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物或饮料被人尝过，以了解其味道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal ikel jew xorb meta xi ħadd jipprova t-togħma tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被品尝；被尝味道。

collocations.en: The wine was tasted by the experts.
collocations.zh: 这款葡萄酒由专家品尝过了。

collocations.mt: L-ikel ndaq qabel ma ġie servut.
collocations.en: The food was tasted before it was served.
collocations.zh: 食物在上桌前经过了试味。

formal.mt: L-inbid ndaq mill-esperti qabel ma ġie ppreżentat lill-mistednin.
formal.en: The wine was tasted by the experts before it was presented to the guests.
formal.zh: 这款葡萄酒在呈给宾客之前，先由专家品尝过。

colloquial.mt: Marta: L-ikel ndaq diġà? Pawlu: Iva, ndaq mill-kok qabel ma ġie servut.
colloquial.en: Marta: Has the food been tasted already? Pawlu: Yes, it was tasted by the chef before it was served.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：食物已经试过味了吗？保罗：是的，上桌前厨师已经尝过了。

messages.speaker: Marta（服务员）
messages.zh: 食物已经试过味了吗？
messages.en: Has the food been tasted already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu（厨师助理）
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ndaq mill-kok qabel ma ġie servut.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ndaq mill-kok qabel ma ġie servut.
messages.zh: 是的，上桌前厨师已经尝过了。
messages.en: Yes, it was tasted by the chef before it was served.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ndaq 配上“厨师先尝一口”的画面，记住它说的是食物或饮料“被品尝”。

gloss_zh: 被演奏；被使之减重；棉花被敲打

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a piece of music to be performed or played back from a recording.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一段音乐被演奏，或通过录音被播放出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal innu jew biċċa mużika meta xi ħadd jesegwiha jew idoqq reġistrazzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被演奏；被播放，指音乐等。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be made to lose weight
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被使之减轻体重；在某种作用下变瘦。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be beaten (used only of cotton)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被敲打、弹打，仅用于棉花。

collocations.en: The anthem was played at the beginning of the ceremony.
collocations.zh: 典礼开始时奏响了颂歌。

collocations.en: The waltz was played on the piano.
collocations.zh: 这首圆舞曲用钢琴演奏了。

formal.mt: L-innu nazzjonali ndaqq fil-bidu taċ-ċerimonja, u dawk preżenti qamu bilwieqfa.
formal.en: The national anthem was played at the beginning of the ceremony, and those present stood up.
formal.zh: 典礼开始时奏响了国歌，在场人员起立。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-valz ndaqq diġà? Mark: Iva, ndaqq fuq il-pjanu ftit ilu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the waltz been played already? Mark: Yes, it was played on the piano a little while ago.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那首圆舞曲已经演奏过了吗？马克：是的，刚才用钢琴演奏过了。

messages.speaker: Lara（听众）
messages.zh: 那首圆舞曲已经演奏过了吗？
messages.en: Has the waltz been played already?

messages.speaker: Mark（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ndaqq fuq il-pjanu ftit ilu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ndaqq fuq il-pjanu ftit ilu.
messages.zh: 是的，刚才用钢琴演奏过了。
messages.en: Yes, it was played on the piano a little while ago.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“圆舞曲被钢琴奏响”记住 ndaqq 的音乐义，再分别配上体重下降、棉花被弹打的画面；注意它比 ndaq 多一个 q。

gloss_zh: 被深入研究；被透彻研习

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be studied in detail so that the subject is thoroughly understood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某个主题或材料受到细致、深入的研究或学习，以达到透彻理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi studjat fid-dettall sabiex jinftiehem sewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被透彻地研究或学习

collocations.zh: 经过细致而透彻的研究

collocations.en: the subject was studied thoroughly in class
collocations.zh: 这个主题在课堂上得到了深入学习

formal.mt: Is-suġġett ndar fid-dettall qabel ma l-istudenti kitbu r-rapport finali.
formal.en: The subject was studied thoroughly before the students wrote the final report.
formal.zh: 学生们在撰写最终报告之前，对这个主题进行了深入学习。

colloquial.mt: Lina: It-test ndar sew fil-klassi? Pawlu: Iva, qrajnieh flimkien u ddiskutejna kull parti.
colloquial.en: Lina: Was the text studied thoroughly in class? Pawlu: Yes, we read it together and discussed every part.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：课堂上把这篇课文学透了吗？保罗：是的，我们一起读了，还讨论了每个部分。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 课堂上把这篇课文学透了吗？
messages.en: Was the text studied thoroughly in class?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qrajnieh flimkien u ddiskutejna kull parti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qrajnieh flimkien u ddiskutejna kull parti.
messages.zh: 是的，我们一起读了，还讨论了每个部分。
messages.en: Yes, we read it together and discussed every part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把主题想成一本逐页读透的书：看到 ndar，就联想到“这个内容已经被深入研习”，注意表达的是受到研究的一方。

gloss_zh: 变得熟悉；逐渐成为惯例

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become familiar through repeated experience, or to become customary through repeated use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指事物因反复接触而变得熟悉，或某种做法因反复采用而逐渐成为惯例。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir familjari maż-żmien, jew isir drawwa minħabba użu ripetut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得熟悉；逐渐不再陌生
逐渐成为习惯或惯例

collocations.en: the place became familiar over time
collocations.zh: 这个地方随着时间推移变得熟悉了

collocations.en: the use of the expression became customary
collocations.zh: 使用这个表达逐渐成为惯例

formal.mt: Maż-żmien, l-użu ta' din l-espressjoni ndara fost il-membri tal-grupp.
formal.en: Over time, using this expression became customary among the members of the group.
formal.zh: 随着时间推移，使用这个表达逐渐成为小组成员之间的惯例。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadek tħossok mitluf f'dan il-post? Toni: Le, għall-ewwel kien ġdid għalija, imma maż-żmien ndara.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you still feel lost in this place? Toni: No, it was new to me at first, but it became familiar over time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在这个地方还会觉得找不着方向吗？托尼：不会了，刚开始这里对我来说很陌生，不过慢慢就熟悉了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在这个地方还会觉得找不着方向吗？
messages.en: Do you still feel lost in this place?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għall-ewwel kien ġdid għalija, imma maż-żmien ndara.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għall-ewwel kien ġdid għalija, imma maż-żmien ndara.
messages.zh: 不会了，刚开始这里对我来说很陌生，不过慢慢就熟悉了。
messages.en: No, it was new to me at first, but it became familiar over time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个重复发生的画面记 ndara：一条路走多了就熟悉，一种做法重复多了就成惯例；分别对应它的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suffer a physical injury or wound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体受到伤害或出现伤口；受伤、负伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieħed isofri ġrieħi jew feriti f'ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体受伤；受到身体上的伤害。
负伤；身体受到创伤，出现伤口。

collocations.en: suffered an injury to his hand

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, ħaddiem ndarab f'idu waqt ix-xogħol u ttieħed l-isptar għall-kura.
formal.en: According to the report, a worker suffered an injury to his hand at work and was taken to hospital for treatment.
formal.zh: 据报告，一名工人在工作时手部受伤，随后被送往医院治疗。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu ma ġiex illum? Mark: Ndarab waqt il-logħba tal-bieraħ. Maja: Kif inhu issa? Mark: Aħjar, imma għandu bżonn jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't Pawlu come today? Mark: He got injured during yesterday's game. Maja: How is he now? Mark: Better, but he needs to rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗今天怎么没来？马克：他在昨天的比赛中受伤了。玛雅：他现在怎么样？马克：好些了，不过需要休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗今天怎么没来？
messages.en: Why didn't Pawlu come today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他在昨天的比赛中受伤了。
messages.en: He got injured during yesterday's game.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他现在怎么样？
messages.en: How is he now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好些了，不过需要休息。
messages.en: Better, but he needs to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ndarab 与“比赛后手上缠着绷带”的画面联系起来，整块记住 ndarab f'idu（手部受伤）；用身体受伤的具体场景串起 hurt 和 wounded 两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suffer harm or hurt as a result of something that happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某件事情受到伤害或损害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieħed isofri ħsara jew weġgħa minħabba xi ħaġa li tiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到伤害；遭受损害。

collocations.en: was harmed because of a mistake
collocations.zh: 因一个错误而受到损害

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkonferma li ħadd ma ndarr waqt ix-xogħol ta' manutenzjoni.
formal.en: The report confirms that no one was hurt during the maintenance work.
formal.zh: 报告确认，维修工作期间没有人受到伤害。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt ħoss qawwi fil-garaxx. X'ġara? Pawlu: Waqgħet xkaffa. Sara: Ħadd ma ndarr, hux? Pawlu: Le, kulħadd jinsab tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Sara: I heard a loud noise in the garage. What happened? Pawlu: A shelf fell down. Sara: No one was hurt, right? Pawlu: No, everyone's fine.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我听到车库里一声巨响。怎么了？保罗：一个架子倒了。萨拉：没人受伤吧？保罗：没有，大家都没事。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 我听到车库里一声巨响。怎么了？
messages.en: I heard a loud noise in the garage. What happened?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 一个架子倒了。
messages.en: A shelf fell down.

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 没人受伤吧？
messages.en: No one was hurt, right?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 没有，大家都没事。
messages.en: No, everyone's fine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象架子倒下后大家互相确认平安，把 ħadd ma ndarr 整句记成“没有人受到伤害”；用这一句安心的回应记住 ndarr 的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be laughed at or made fun of by someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成为别人嘲笑或取笑的对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun fil-mira tad-daħk jew taż-żufjett ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被人嘲笑；成为别人发笑的对象。
被取笑；被拿来开嘲弄性的玩笑。

collocations.en: he was laughed at in front of everyone
collocations.zh: 他当着众人的面被嘲笑

collocations.en: he was made fun of because of a mistake
collocations.zh: 他因为一个错误而被取笑

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa ndaħak bih minħabba żball żgħir, u dan ġiegħlu jħossu skomdu.
formal.en: During the meeting, he was laughed at because of a small mistake, which made him feel uncomfortable.
formal.zh: 会议期间，他因为一个小错误被人嘲笑，这让他感到不自在。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark sieket illum? Rita: Għax indaħak bih quddiem kulħadd, u ħassu mweġġa'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Mark quiet today? Rita: Because he was made fun of in front of everyone, and he felt hurt.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克今天为什么不说话？丽塔：因为他当着众人的面被取笑了，心里很受伤。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克今天为什么不说话？
messages.en: Why is Mark quiet today?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax indaħak bih quddiem kulħadd, u ħassu mweġġa'.
messages.mt_standard: Għax indaħak bih quddiem kulħadd, u ħassu mweġġa'.
messages.zh: 因为他当着众人的面被取笑了，心里很受伤。
messages.en: Because he was made fun of in front of everyone, and he felt hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人犯了小错，周围的人笑他，而他低头难过；把注意力放在“被别人笑的人”身上，记住被嘲笑的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive an application of oil as part of a ceremony or blessing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在仪式或祝福中接受涂油，即受膏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi ż-żejt fuq ġismu bħala parti minn ċerimonja jew barka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受膏；接受仪式性的涂油。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jirċievi ż-żejt bħala parti minn rit jew ċerimonja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自行选定自己；选择自己作为人选。

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, ir-re ndehen biż-żejt bħala sinjal tal-ħatra tiegħu.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the king was anointed with oil as a sign of his appointment.
formal.zh: 仪式中，国王接受了涂油礼，以此象征他获任为王。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex ir-re ndehen biż-żejt? Marija: Kien parti miċ-ċerimonja tal-ħatra tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why was the king anointed with oil? Marija: It was part of the ceremony marking his appointment.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：为什么要给国王涂油？玛丽娅：那是他获任为王的仪式的一部分。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么要给国王涂油？
messages.en: Why was the king anointed with oil?

messages.speaker: Marija (老师)
messages.zh: 那是他获任为王的仪式的一部分。
messages.en: It was part of the ceremony marking his appointment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ndehen 联想到“国王在仪式上接受涂油”的画面，先记住“受膏”。遇到“自行选定自己”的另一义时，要根据上下文另行判断，不要硬套涂油的画面。

gloss_zh: 设法挤入；与人混熟；巴结

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get into a place, group, or activity by edging or pushing one's way in.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过挤进去或设法参与，进入某个地方、群体或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidħol f'post, fi grupp jew f'attività billi jsib spazju jew jimbotta ruħu 'l ġewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设法进入；一点点挤进去或参与进去。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isib mod kif jidħol f'post, fi grupp jew f'attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主动与某人熟悉起来；与某人混熟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jersaq lejn xi ħadd u jibda jsir midħla tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴结；讨好某人以博取好感或优待。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jipprova jogħġob lil xi ħadd biex jikseb il-favur tiegħu.

collocations.en: worked his way into the crowd
worked his way into the group

collocations.mt: ndehes mal-kap biex jikseb il-favur tiegħu
collocations.en: ingratiated himself with the boss to gain his favour
collocations.zh: 巴结上司以博取其好感

formal.mt: Minkejja li l-entratura kienet mimlija nies, Pawlu ndehes fil-folla u rnexxielu jasal sal-bieb.
formal.en: Although the entrance was crowded, Pawlu worked his way into the crowd and managed to reach the door.
formal.zh: 尽管入口挤满了人，保罗还是挤进人群，成功走到了门口。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif wasal Pawlu sal-bieb b'dik il-folla kollha? Mark: Ndehes bejn in-nies u baqa' miexi bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Pawlu get to the door with all those people there? Mark: He squeezed in between people and kept moving slowly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那么多人，保罗是怎么走到门口的？马克：他挤到人们中间，然后慢慢往前走。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif wasal Pawlu sal-bieb b'dik il-folla kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Kif wasal Pawlu sal-bieb b'dik il-folla kollha?
messages.zh: 那么多人，保罗是怎么走到门口的？
messages.en: How did Pawlu get to the door with all those people there?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ndehes bejn in-nies u baqa' miexi bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Ndehes bejn in-nies u baqa' miexi bil-mod.
messages.zh: 他挤到人们中间，然后慢慢往前走。
messages.en: He squeezed in between people and kept moving slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个小场景分别记 ndehes：在人群里“挤进去”，在人际交往中“混熟”，为了好处而“巴结”。这是帮助区分词义的学习联想，不表示三个义项之间有已知的历史演变关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become very thin, especially through a noticeable loss of body weight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得十分瘦削，指体重下降后身体明显消瘦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir irqiq ħafna, speċjalment wara li jitlef ħafna piż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得非常瘦；明显消瘦。

collocations.en: became very thin after the illness

formal.mt: Matul il-marda twila tiegħu, ir-raġel ndell ħafna u kellu bżonn iż-żmien biex jirkupra.
formal.en: During his long illness, the man became very thin and needed time to recover.
formal.zh: 在长期患病期间，这名男子变得十分消瘦，需要时间恢复。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajtu lil Pawlu dan l-aħħar? Ndell ħafna. Mark: Iva, kien marid, imma issa qed jirkupra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you seen Pawlu lately? He has become very thin. Mark: Yes, he was ill, but he is recovering now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你最近见过保罗吗？他瘦了好多。马克：见过，他之前病了，不过现在正在恢复。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu lil Pawlu dan l-aħħar? Ndell ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu lil Pawlu dan l-aħħar? Ndell ħafna.
messages.zh: 你最近见过保罗吗？他瘦了好多。
messages.en: Have you seen Pawlu lately? He has become very thin.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien marid, imma issa qed jirkupra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien marid, imma issa qed jirkupra.
messages.zh: 见过，他之前病了，不过现在正在恢复。
messages.en: Yes, he was ill, but he is recovering now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ndell 配上同一个人病前病后的对比图，记住它强调的是“变得非常瘦”这一变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a sound to be heard again as an echo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指声音以回声的形式再次被听见，产生回响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal ħoss li jerġa' jinstema' bħala eku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产生回声；以回声的形式再次响起。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss tal-qanpiena ndewa fil-wied u nstema' mill-ġdid wara ftit mumenti.
formal.en: The sound of the bell echoed in the valley and was heard again a few moments later.
formal.zh: 钟声在山谷中回响，片刻后又传来了回声。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt kif il-ħoss ndewa fil-wied? Mark: Iva, deher li xi ħadd wieġeb minn hemm!
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear how the sound echoed in the valley? Mark: Yes, it sounded as if someone answered from over there!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听到声音在山谷里回响了吗？马克：听到了，听起来像是那边有人回应！

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到声音在山谷里回响了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear how the sound echoed in the valley?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, deher li xi ħadd wieġeb minn hemm!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, deher li xi ħadd wieġeb minn hemm!
messages.zh: 听到了，听起来像是那边有人回应！
messages.en: Yes, it sounded as if someone answered from over there!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在山谷喊一声，声音又传回来；用这一画面把 ndewa 与“回声再次响起”联系起来。

gloss_zh: 钻营以求进入；巴结以求接近

teaching_sense.en_definition: To seek entry into a group or field, or contact with a person, especially by flattering people to gain favour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设法进入某个群体或领域，或设法接近某人，尤其指通过奉承、巴结来谋求接纳或好感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifittex li jidħol f'xi grupp jew qasam, jew li jagħmel kuntatt ma' xi ħadd, speċjalment bit-tifħir biex jikseb il-favur.

sense_translations.en_definition: to seek access (to some group or field), especially through flattery and the like
sense_translations.zh_definition: 设法进入某个群体或领域，尤其通过奉承等手段谋求接纳。

sense_translations.en_definition: to curry favour, to seek contact (with some person)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴结讨好；设法与某人建立联系或接近某人。

collocations.en: sought to work his way into influential circles
collocations.zh: 设法挤进有影响力的人士圈子

collocations.en: sought to curry favour with the boss

formal.mt: B'tifħir kontinwu lill-membri, ir-raġel ndiehes fost nies influwenti bit-tama li jaċċettawh fil-grupp tagħhom.
formal.en: By continually praising the members, the man sought to work his way into influential circles in the hope that they would accept him into their group.
formal.zh: 这名男子不断奉承成员，设法挤进有影响力的人士圈子，希望他们接纳他。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu ndiehes mal-kap il-ġdid? Mark: Ried jikseb il-favur tiegħu; qatta' l-ħin kollu jfaħħru.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu try to curry favour with the new boss? Mark: He wanted to win his favour; he spent the whole time praising him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗为什么设法巴结新上司？马克：他想博得上司的好感，一直在夸他。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么设法巴结新上司？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu try to curry favour with the new boss?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried jikseb il-favur tiegħu; qatta' l-ħin kollu jfaħħru.
messages.mt_standard: Ried jikseb il-favur tiegħu; qatta' l-ħin kollu jfaħħru.
messages.zh: 他想博得上司的好感，一直在夸他。
messages.en: He wanted to win his favour; he spent the whole time praising him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人一边奉承一边往社交圈里挤，用这个学习画面记住 ndiehes 的“巴结求接近、钻营求进入”。

gloss_zh: 害怕；受惊；感到一阵寒颤

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become frightened or startled, or to experience a chill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到害怕、突然受惊，或感到一阵寒颤；具体含义由语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħoss biża', jinħasad jew iħoss tkexkixa, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到害怕；受到惊吓。
突然受惊；被吓一跳。
感到一阵寒意或寒颤。

collocations.en: suddenly felt a fright or chill
collocations.zh: 突然受惊或感到一阵寒颤

formal.mt: Meta sema' ħoss qawwi warajh, it-tifel ndiehex u dar biex jara x'kien ġara.
formal.en: When he heard a loud noise behind him, the boy was startled and turned to see what had happened.
formal.zh: 听到身后传来巨响时，男孩吓了一跳，转身查看发生了什么。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ndiehex Pawlu? Mark: Il-bieb għalaq b'ħoss qawwi u ma kienx qed jistennieh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why was Pawlu startled? Mark: The door shut with a loud bang, and he was not expecting it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗怎么吓了一跳？马克：门砰的一声关上了，他完全没料到。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么吓了一跳？
messages.en: Why was Pawlu startled?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bieb għalaq b'ħoss qawwi u ma kienx qed jistennieh.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bieb għalaq b'ħoss qawwi u ma kienx qed jistennieh.
messages.zh: 门砰的一声关上了，他完全没料到。
messages.en: The door shut with a loud bang, and he was not expecting it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ndiehex 联想到身体猛地一缩：可能因为害怕、突然受惊，也可能是一阵寒颤，阅读时再按语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sorrow for having done something wrong, expressed as remorse or repentance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因自己做错了事而产生的悔恨，或承认过错、愿意改正的悔改之情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dispjaċir għal ħażen li wieħed ikun għamel, li jista' jinkludi x-xewqa li jemenda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悔改；承认自己的过错并愿意改正。
悔恨；因自己的错误行为而内疚、懊悔。

collocations.zh: 表现出悔恨或悔改之意

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-istudent wera ndiema għall-kliem li kien qal u wiegħed li ma jerġax iweġġa' lil sħabu.
formal.en: In his letter, the student showed remorse for what he had said and promised not to hurt his classmates again.
formal.zh: 这名学生在信中对自己说过的话表达了悔恨，并承诺不再伤害同学。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taħseb li Pawlu ħass ndiema wara li gideb? Mark: Iva, skuża ruħu u qal il-verità.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you think Pawlu felt remorse after lying? Mark: Yes, he apologised and told the truth.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你觉得保罗撒谎后感到懊悔了吗？马克：是的，他道了歉，也说出了实情。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li Pawlu ħass ndiema wara li gideb?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li Pawlu ħass ndiema wara li gideb?
messages.zh: 你觉得保罗撒谎后感到懊悔了吗？
messages.en: Do you think Pawlu felt remorse after lying?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, skuża ruħu u qal il-verità.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, skuża ruħu u qal il-verità.
messages.zh: 是的，他道了歉，也说出了实情。
messages.en: Yes, he apologised and told the truth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“做错后心里难受，认错后愿意改正”记 ndiema：前半帮助理解悔恨，后半帮助理解悔改。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be buried, or to hide oneself away from other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被埋葬；也可指把自己藏起来，避开他人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqiegħed f'qabar, jew jinħeba biex ma jarawhx in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被埋葬；被安葬。
把自己藏起来；躲藏。

collocations.en: hid himself away in his room

formal.mt: Skont ir-reġistru tal-parroċċa, ir-raġel ndifen fiċ-ċimiterju tar-raħal.
formal.en: According to the parish register, the man was buried in the village cemetery.
formal.zh: 根据堂区登记簿，这名男子被安葬在村里的墓地。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn mar Pawlu meta waslu l-mistednin? Mark: Ndifen f'kamartu għax ma ried ikellem lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did Pawlu go when the guests arrived? Mark: He hid himself away in his room because he did not want to talk to anyone.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：客人来的时候，保罗去哪儿了？马克：他躲进了自己的房间，因为他谁也不想见。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn mar Pawlu meta waslu l-mistednin?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn mar Pawlu meta waslu l-mistednin?
messages.zh: 客人来的时候，保罗去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu go when the guests arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ndifen f'kamartu għax ma ried ikellem lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Ndifen f'kamartu għax ma ried ikellem lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 他躲进了自己的房间，因为他谁也不想见。
messages.en: He hid himself away in his room because he did not want to talk to anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ndifen 做两张情景卡：墓地里的“被安葬”，房间里的“把自己藏起来”；用地点帮助辨别两个义项。

gloss_zh: 往自己身上涂抹；给自己涂药膏

teaching_sense.en_definition: To smear a substance on one's own body or apply ointment to oneself.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某种物质涂抹在自己身上，或给自己的身体部位涂药膏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidlek ġismu jew parti minnu b'xi sustanza, bħal krema jew ingwent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某种东西涂抹在自己身上。

sense_translations.en_definition: to apply ointment to one's person
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给自己身上涂药膏。

formal.mt: Wara li ħasel u nixxef il-ġilda, ir-raġel ndilek bl-ingwent skont l-istruzzjonijiet.
formal.en: After washing and drying his skin, the man applied ointment to himself according to the instructions.
formal.zh: 清洗并擦干皮肤后，这名男子按照说明给自己涂了药膏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu ndilek bil-krema qabel ħareġ? Mark: Iva, u ħa l-flixkun miegħu wkoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Pawlu apply cream to himself before going out? Mark: Yes, and he took the bottle with him too.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗出门前往身上涂乳霜了吗？马克：涂了，还把那瓶乳霜带上了。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 保罗出门前往身上涂乳霜了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu apply cream to himself before going out?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ħa l-flixkun miegħu wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ħa l-flixkun miegħu wkoll.
messages.zh: 涂了，还把那瓶乳霜带上了。
messages.en: Yes, and he took the bottle with him too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己拿着乳霜往自己手臂上抹，用这个动作记住 ndilek；换成药膏，就对应“给自己涂药膏”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For a harvested cereal crop to be threshed so that the grain is separated from the stalks and ears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指收割后的谷物接受脱粒处理，使谷粒与穗秆分离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal wiċċ tar-raba' bħall-qamħ meta l-ħabb jinfired mis-sbul u mit-tiben bid-dris.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被脱粒；指谷物经处理而使谷粒与穗秆分离。

formal.mt: Wara l-ħsad, il-qamħ indires biex il-ħabb jinfired mit-tiben.
formal.en: After the harvest, the wheat was threshed to separate the grain from the straw.
formal.zh: 收割后，小麦经过脱粒，使谷粒与麦秆分离。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-qamħ indires illum? Pawlu: Iva, dalgħodu. Issa nistgħu niġbru l-ħabb.
colloquial.en: Marta: Was the wheat threshed today? Pawlu: Yes, this morning. Now we can collect the grain.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：小麦今天脱粒了吗？保罗：是的，今天早上脱的。现在可以收集谷粒了。

messages.speaker: Marta (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 小麦今天脱粒了吗？
messages.en: Was the wheat threshed today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dalgħodu. Issa nistgħu niġbru l-ħabb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dalgħodu. Issa nistgħu niġbru l-ħabb.
messages.zh: 是的，今天早上脱的。现在可以收集谷粒了。
messages.en: Yes, this morning. Now we can collect the grain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象麦穗进入脱粒机、谷粒落入筐中：这个词强调谷物“被脱粒”的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unwanted involvement in other people's private matters, decisions, or activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未经欢迎地过问他人的私事，或插手他人的决定与活动；可指爱管闲事，也可指干涉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Involviment mhux mixtieq fil-ħajja privata, fid-deċiżjonijiet jew fl-attivitajiet ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱打听或过问他人私事；爱管闲事。
干涉；插手他人的事务或决定。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat talab li d-deċiżjoni tittieħed mingħajr ndħil minn persuni barra l-organizzazzjoni.
formal.en: The committee requested that the decision be made without interference from people outside the organisation.
formal.zh: 委员会要求在不受组织外部人员干涉的情况下作出决定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Reġa' staqsieni kemm naqla' flus. Dan hu ndħil fil-ħajja privata tiegħi. Mark: Għidlu li tippreferi żżomm dik l-informazzjoni għalik.
colloquial.en: Lara: He asked me how much I earn again. That is meddling in my private life. Mark: Tell him you prefer to keep that information to yourself.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他又问我挣多少钱。这是在打听我的私事。马克：告诉他，你希望把这件事留作个人隐私。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Reġa' staqsieni kemm naqla' flus. Dan hu ndħil fil-ħajja privata tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Reġa' staqsieni kemm naqla' flus. Dan hu ndħil fil-ħajja privata tiegħi.
messages.zh: 他又问我挣多少钱。这是在打听我的私事。
messages.en: He asked me how much I earn again. That is meddling in my private life.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għidlu li tippreferi żżomm dik l-informazzjoni għalik.
messages.mt_standard: Għidlu li tippreferi żżomm dik l-informazzjoni għalik.
messages.zh: 告诉他，你希望把这件事留作个人隐私。
messages.en: Tell him you prefer to keep that information to yourself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ndħil 配两幅图：探头打听私事是“爱管闲事”，伸手左右决定是“干涉”，共同点是越界插手。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To inspire someone with an idea or motivation, or to draw someone's attention to something they should notice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予某人灵感或行动的动力；也指提醒某人注意，使其意识到某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta lil xi ħadd idea jew ħeġġa biex jagħmel xi ħaġa, jew ġibidlu l-attenzjoni għal xi ħaġa li kellu jinnota.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 启发；激发灵感或动力。
使某人察觉或意识到；提醒某人注意。

collocations.en: made the workers aware of the danger

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont nebbaħ lill-istudenti biex jiktbu dwar l-esperjenzi tagħhom.
formal.en: The story inspired the students to write about their own experiences.
formal.zh: 这个故事启发学生写下自己的经历。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min nebbaħ lil Mark dwar it-taraġ miksur? Toni: Jien. Għedtlu joqgħod attent meta jinżel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who made Mark aware of the broken stairs? Toni: I did. I told him to be careful when going down.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：是谁提醒马克楼梯坏了的？托尼：是我。我叫他下楼时小心。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min nebbaħ lil Mark dwar it-taraġ miksur?
messages.mt_standard: Min nebbaħ lil Mark dwar it-taraġ miksur?
messages.zh: 是谁提醒马克楼梯坏了的？
messages.en: Who made Mark aware of the broken stairs?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Għedtlu joqgħod attent meta jinżel.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Għedtlu joqgħod attent meta jinżel.
messages.zh: 是我。我叫他下楼时小心。
messages.en: I did. I told him to be careful when going down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两义想成脑中亮起两盏灯：一盏带来灵感，一盏提醒你注意眼前的事情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To begin growing by producing a sprout or new shoot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长出芽或新生嫩梢，开始生长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Beda jikber billi ħareġ rimja jew l-ewwel parti ħadra tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发芽；萌出新芽或嫩梢。

formal.mt: Il-qamħ nebbet ftit jiem wara li nżera' fil-ħamrija niedja.
formal.en: The wheat sprouted a few days after it was sown in the moist soil.
formal.zh: 小麦播入湿润的土壤几天后便发芽了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-fażol nebbet diġà? Ġanni: Iva, ara kemm hemm rimjiet żgħar!
colloquial.en: Sara: Have the beans sprouted already? Ġanni: Yes, look how many little shoots there are!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：豆子已经发芽了吗？詹尼：是啊，你看有多少小嫩芽！

messages.speaker: Sara (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 豆子已经发芽了吗？
messages.en: Have the beans sprouted already?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara kemm hemm rimjiet żgħar!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara kemm hemm rimjiet żgħar!
messages.zh: 是啊，你看有多少小嫩芽！
messages.en: Yes, look how many little shoots there are!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象种子顶开土壤露出一点绿色，用这个动作画面记住“发芽、萌芽”。

gloss_zh: 芽；萌芽，尤指块茎长出的芽

teaching_sense.en_definition: Buds or sprouts, especially the growths that emerge from tubers such as potatoes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物萌出的芽或嫩芽，尤其指马铃薯等块茎表面长出的芽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rimjiet jew għajnejn li jibdew jikbru fuq pjanta, speċjalment fuq tuberi bħall-patata.

sense_translations.en_definition: buds or sprouts (typically those growing out of tubers)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 芽或嫩芽，通常指从块茎上萌出的芽。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenti nnutaw nebbieta żgħar fuq il-wiċċ tal-patata.
formal.en: During the observation, the students noticed small sprouts on the surface of the potatoes.
formal.zh: 观察时，学生注意到马铃薯表面长出了小芽。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ara kemm għandha nebbieta din il-patata! Mark: Veru! Ilbieraħ ma ndunajtx bihom.
colloquial.en: Rita: Look how many sprouts this potato has! Mark: You're right! I didn't notice them yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你看，这个马铃薯长了好多芽！马克：真的！我昨天还没注意到。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm għandha nebbieta din il-patata!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm għandha nebbieta din il-patata!
messages.zh: 你看，这个马铃薯长了好多芽！
messages.en: Look how many sprouts this potato has!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 真的！我昨天还没注意到。
messages.en: You're right! I didn't notice them yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把马铃薯表面冒出的几个小芽当作记忆图片：这里记的是长出来的“芽”这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who teases, pesters, or harasses other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戏弄、纠缠或骚扰别人的人；具体严重程度由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taqbad ma' oħrajn, tiċċajta bihom jew iddejjaqhom b'mod insistenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戏弄或骚扰他人的人；爱招惹、纠缠别人的人。

collocations.en: a person who teases others in class
a person who keeps pestering others

formal.mt: In-nebbiexi baqa' jdejjaq lill-istudenti l-oħra minkejja t-twissija tal-għalliem.
formal.en: The person harassing the other students continued to bother them despite the teacher's warning.
formal.zh: 尽管老师已经警告，那个骚扰同学的人仍继续打扰其他学生。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm int nebbiexi! Ħallini naqra. Toni: Sewwa, nieqaf. Kont qed niċċajta biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: You're such a tease! Let me read. Toni: All right, I'll stop. I was only joking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你真爱捉弄人！让我看书。托尼：好吧，我不闹了。我刚才只是开玩笑。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你真爱捉弄人！让我看书。
messages.en: You're such a tease! Let me read.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, nieqaf. Kont qed niċċajta biss.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, nieqaf. Kont qed niċċajta biss.
messages.zh: 好吧，我不闹了。我刚才只是开玩笑。
messages.en: All right, I'll stop. I was only joking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象你正在看书，有人不断逗你、打扰你：这个词指那个爱招惹别人的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who inspires others; in a separate sense, an animal that barks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给他人带来灵感或鼓舞的人；另一个义项指会吠叫的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti ideat jew ħeġġa lil oħrajn; f'tifsira oħra, annimal li jinbaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 启发者；给予别人灵感或鼓舞的人。
会吠叫的动物；指发出吠声者。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-għalliem jidher bħala nebbieħ li jħeġġeġ lill-istudenti jiżviluppaw l-ideat tagħhom.
formal.en: In the story, the teacher appears as an inspirer who encourages students to develop their ideas.
formal.zh: 在故事中，老师是一位启发者，鼓励学生发展自己的想法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kelb nebbieħ? Pawlu: Iva, jinbaħ kull meta jisma' lil xi ħadd mal-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this dog bark? Pawlu: Yes, he barks whenever he hears someone at the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这只狗会叫吗？保罗：会，它一听见有人在门口就叫。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 这只狗会叫吗？
messages.en: Does this dog bark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jinbaħ kull meta jisma' lil xi ħadd mal-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jinbaħ kull meta jisma' lil xi ħadd mal-bieb.
messages.zh: 会，它一听见有人在门口就叫。
messages.en: Yes, he barks whenever he hears someone at the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分开记两幅画面：启发学生的老师，以及正在吠叫的狗；遇到这个词先看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inspiration that gives someone ideas, creative energy, or motivation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人产生想法、创作动力或行动意愿的灵感与启发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ideat jew ħeġġa li jwasslu lil persuna biex toħloq xi ħaġa jew tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灵感；促成想法、创作或行动的启发。

formal.mt: Il-pajsaġġ tal-gżira kien sors ta' nebħ għall-pittur waqt il-ħidma fuq is-sensiela l-ġdida.
formal.en: The island's landscape was a source of inspiration for the painter while working on the new series.
formal.zh: 画家创作新系列作品时，岛上的风景成为他的灵感来源。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi bżonn ftit nebħ għal din il-poeżija. Mark: Ejja nimxu ħdejn il-baħar; forsi tiġik xi idea.
colloquial.en: Lara: I need a little inspiration for this poem. Mark: Let's walk by the sea; perhaps an idea will come to you.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：写这首诗，我需要一点灵感。马克：我们去海边走走吧，也许你会想到什么。

messages.speaker: Lara (写诗的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn ftit nebħ għal din il-poeżija.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn ftit nebħ għal din il-poeżija.
messages.zh: 写这首诗，我需要一点灵感。
messages.en: I need a little inspiration for this poem.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nimxu ħdejn il-baħar; forsi tiġik xi idea.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nimxu ħdejn il-baħar; forsi tiġik xi idea.
messages.zh: 我们去海边走走吧，也许你会想到什么。
messages.en: Let's walk by the sea; perhaps an idea will come to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象面对空白纸，忽然从海景中得到一个想法：把这一刻记作名词“灵感”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single bark: a short, sharp sound made by a dog.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 狗发出的一声短促而响亮的吠叫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss wieħed qasir u qawwi li jagħmel kelb meta jinbaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一声吠叫；狗发出的一声叫声。

formal.mt: Nebħa qawwija kisret il-kwiet tal-lejl u ġibdet l-attenzjoni tal-għassies.
formal.en: A loud bark broke the silence of the night and drew the guard's attention.
formal.zh: 一声响亮的犬吠打破了夜晚的寂静，引起了守卫的注意。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Smajt dik in-nebħa? Toni: Iva, kien il-kelb tal-ġar. Xi ħadd għadda minn quddiem il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you hear that bark? Toni: Yes, it was the neighbour's dog. Someone walked past the door.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你听见刚才那声狗叫了吗？托尼：听见了，是邻居家的狗。有人从门前走过。

messages.speaker: Sara (住户)
messages.zh: 你听见刚才那声狗叫了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that bark?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien il-kelb tal-ġar. Xi ħadd għadda minn quddiem il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien il-kelb tal-ġar. Xi ħadd għadda minn quddiem il-bieb.
messages.zh: 听见了，是邻居家的狗。有人从门前走过。
messages.en: Yes, it was the neighbour's dog. Someone walked past the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用耳朵想象突然传来一声“汪”：记住这个词指一声犬吠，并留意它与 nebħ 的拼写差别。

gloss_zh: 传令员；负责公开宣告的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose task is to proclaim news or announcements publicly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以公开宣告消息或公告为职责的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li xxandar aħbarijiet jew avviżi pubblikament.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. whose task is to proclaim
sense_translations.zh_definition: 职责是公开宣告消息的人；传令员。

formal.mt: In-neddej qara l-avviż b'leħen għoli sabiex kulħadd fil-pjazza seta' jisimgħu.
formal.en: The crier read the announcement aloud so that everyone in the square could hear him.
formal.zh: 传令员高声宣读公告，让广场上的每个人都能听见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak li qed iħabbar l-aħbar fil-pjazza? Pawlu: Dak hu n-neddej tal-belt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that announcing the news in the square? Pawlu: That is the town crier.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：在广场上宣告消息的那个人是谁？保罗：那是城镇传令员。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qed iħabbar l-aħbar fil-pjazza?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qed iħabbar l-aħbar fil-pjazza?
messages.zh: 在广场上宣告消息的那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that announcing the news in the square?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当地居民)
messages.zh: 那是城镇传令员。
messages.en: That is the town crier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象广场上高声宣读公告的人，把 neddej 与“负责宣告的传令员”这一人物画面绑定。

gloss_zh: 使某人花钱；让某人破费

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to spend money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人支出金钱，让某人为某事花钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jonfoq il-flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人花钱；让某人产生支出。

collocations.en: made Mark spend a lot of money

collocations.mt: neffaq lil Sara aktar milli ppjanat
collocations.en: made Sara spend more than she had planned
collocations.zh: 让萨拉花的钱超过了计划

formal.mt: It-tiswija tad-dar neffqet lil Mark aktar milli kien ippjana.
formal.en: The house repair made Mark spend more than he had planned.
formal.zh: 房屋维修让马克花的钱超过了原先的计划。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-vjaġġ neffaq lil Mark ħafna flus? Maja: Iva, aktar milli kien ippjana.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the trip make Mark spend a lot of money? Maja: Yes, more than he had planned.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这趟旅行让马克花了很多钱吗？玛雅：是啊，比他计划的还多。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-vjaġġ neffaq lil Mark ħafna flus?
messages.mt_standard: Il-vjaġġ neffaq lil Mark ħafna flus?
messages.zh: 这趟旅行让马克花了很多钱吗？
messages.en: Did the trip make Mark spend a lot of money?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，比他计划的还多。
messages.en: Yes, more than he had planned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 neffaq 时画一条箭头：“维修或旅行这件事→让某人掏钱”，突出“使人花钱”的关系。

gloss_zh: 粗重地呼吸；恼怒地喷气；呼哧呼哧喘气

teaching_sense.en_definition: To breathe heavily, huff and puff, or snort, for example in annoyance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 粗重地呼吸、呼哧呼哧地喘气，或因恼怒等情绪从鼻中喷气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu n-nifs bil-qawwa, jonfoħ waqt li jkun qed jitħabat, jew joħroġ nifs qawwi minn imnieħru, pereżempju bid-dwejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粗重地呼吸。
从鼻中喷气或发出哼声，例如表示恼怒。
呼哧呼哧地喘气；费力地大口喘气。

formal.mt: Wara li tela' t-taraġ kollu, Mark neffaħ bl-għeja u waqaf għal ftit.
formal.en: After climbing all the stairs, Mark huffed and puffed from tiredness and stopped for a moment.
formal.zh: 爬完所有楼梯后，马克累得呼哧呼哧喘气，停下来歇了一会儿。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex neffaħ hekk Pawlu? Mark: Sema' li kellna nerġgħu nistennew u ddejjaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu snort like that? Mark: He heard that we had to wait again and got annoyed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么那样哼了一声？马克：他听说我们又得等，就烦了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么那样哼了一声？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu snort like that?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sema' li kellna nerġgħu nistennew u ddejjaq.
messages.mt_standard: Sema' li kellna nerġgħu nistennew u ddejjaq.
messages.zh: 他听说我们又得等，就烦了。
messages.en: He heard that we had to wait again and got annoyed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 neffaħ 配上两幅画面：爬楼后呼哧喘气、听到坏消息后鼻中哼气；共同点是呼吸明显而有力。

gloss_zh: 吹捧者；使别人自我膨胀的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes someone else feel excessively important through praise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过吹捧使别人过分自视甚高、产生自我膨胀感的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkabbar iżżejjed l-opinjoni li ħaddieħor għandu tiegħu nnifsu permezz tat-tifħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使别人自我膨胀的人；一味吹捧别人的人。

collocations.en: someone who inflates the boss's ego
collocations.zh: 吹捧上司、使其自我膨胀的人

collocations.en: the words of someone who inflates another's ego

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-neffieħ ifaħħar lill-mexxej bla waqfien u jġiegħlu jaħseb li qatt ma jiżbalja.
formal.en: In the story, the flatterer praises the leader constantly and makes him think that he never makes mistakes.
formal.zh: 故事中的吹捧者不停地赞美领导，使领导觉得自己从不犯错。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex issejjaħlu neffieħ? Sara: Għax dejjem jgħid lill-kap li hu perfett, anki meta jiżbalja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you call him an ego-inflater? Sara: Because he always tells the boss he is perfect, even when he makes mistakes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说他是个吹捧者？萨拉：因为他总说老板完美无缺，连老板犯错时也这样说。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个吹捧者？
messages.en: Why do you call him an ego-inflater?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem jgħid lill-kap li hu perfett, anki meta jiżbalja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem jgħid lill-kap li hu perfett, anki meta jiżbalja.
messages.zh: 因为他总说老板完美无缺，连老板犯错时也这样说。
messages.en: Because he always tells the boss he is perfect, even when he makes mistakes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把别人的自我评价想成气球，neffieħ 就是不断用赞美给气球打气的人；这是学习比喻，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 短窄颈鼓腹陶罐；石雕用吹管或吹气器

teaching_sense.en_definition: A kind of amphora with a short, narrow neck and a distended body; also a blowpipe or blower used by stone sculptors.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种颈部短而窄、腹部鼓起的陶罐；也指石雕工作者使用的吹管或吹气器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' anfora b'għonq qasir u dejjaq u b'ġisem minfuħ; ukoll pajp jew għodda għan-nfiħ li jużaw l-iskulturi tal-ġebel.

sense_translations.en_definition: a kind of amphora with a short narrow neck and distended body; blowpipe/blowers used by sculptors in stone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种颈部短窄、腹部鼓起的陶罐；亦指石雕工作者使用的吹管或吹气器。

collocations.en: an amphora with a short neck

collocations.zh: 雕刻师的吹管或吹气器

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi n-neffieħa bħala anfora b'għonq qasir u dejjaq u b'ġisem minfuħ.
formal.en: The catalogue describes the neffieħa as an amphora with a short, narrow neck and a distended body.
formal.zh: 目录将这种陶罐描述为颈部短窄、腹部鼓起的罐器。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din in-neffieħa hi vażun? Pawlu: Le, hawn qed nużaw il-kelma għall-għodda tan-nfiħ li juża l-iskultur tal-ġebel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this neffieħa a vase? Pawlu: No, here we are using the word for the blowing tool used by a stone sculptor.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 neffieħa 是花瓶吗？保罗：不是，这里说的是石雕师使用的吹气工具。

messages.speaker: Maja (雕刻学徒)
messages.zh: 这里的 neffieħa 是花瓶吗？
messages.en: Is this neffieħa a vase?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (雕刻教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn qed nużaw il-kelma għall-għodda tan-nfiħ li juża l-iskultur tal-ġebel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn qed nużaw il-kelma għall-għodda tan-nfiħ li juża l-iskultur tal-ġebel.
messages.zh: 不是，这里说的是石雕师使用的吹气工具。
messages.en: No, here we are using the word for the blowing tool used by a stone sculptor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 neffieħa 做双面图卡：一面画短窄颈鼓腹陶罐，另一面画石雕吹气工具，用场景区分两个指称。

gloss_zh: 容易引起肿胀或膨胀的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to cause swelling or puffing up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使某物或某部位肿胀、鼓起倾向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jikkawża nefħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易造成肿胀或膨胀的。

collocations.en: an effect that tends to cause swelling
a product that tends to cause swelling

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, l-aġġettiv neffieħi jiddeskrivi effett li għandu t-tendenza li jikkawża nefħa.
formal.en: In this text, the adjective neffieħi describes an effect that tends to cause swelling.
formal.zh: 在这篇文本中，形容词 neffieħi 描述的是具有引起肿胀倾向的作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser effett neffieħi? Pawlu: Ifisser effett li jista' jikkawża nefħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does effett neffieħi mean? Pawlu: It means an effect that can cause swelling.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：effett neffieħi 是什么意思？保罗：就是可能引起肿胀的作用。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: effett neffieħi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does effett neffieħi mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser effett li jista' jikkawża nefħa.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser effett li jista' jikkawża nefħa.
messages.zh: 就是可能引起肿胀的作用。
messages.en: It means an effect that can cause swelling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 neffieħi 时在事物旁画“导致鼓起”的箭头，提醒自己它描述引起肿胀的倾向，不只是已经肿起的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gust of wind; also inflation or swelling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一阵突然吹来的风；也指充胀、膨胀或身体部位的肿胀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqqa ta' riħ; ukoll nefħ jew stat ta' xi ħaġa li tkun minfuħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一阵风；阵风。
充胀；膨胀；肿胀。

formal.mt: Nefħa qawwija ta' riħ fetħet it-tieqa u xerrdet il-karti fuq l-art.
formal.en: A strong gust of wind opened the window and scattered the papers across the floor.
formal.zh: 一阵强风吹开窗户，把纸张吹散在地上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik in-nefħa f'idek? Sara: Ħbatt idi mal-bieb dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that swelling on your hand? Sara: I hit my hand against the door this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你手上那块肿起的地方是怎么回事？萨拉：今天早上我的手撞到门了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你手上那块肿起的地方是怎么回事？
messages.en: What is that swelling on your hand?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天早上我的手撞到门了。
messages.en: I hit my hand against the door this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 nefħa 配两张图：风吹开窗表示“一阵风”，手上鼓起一块表示“肿胀”；靠搭配判断具体意思。

gloss_zh: 可协商的；可商议调整的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Open to discussion and possible change by agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可以通过讨论、协商并达成一致来调整的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jiġi diskuss u jinbidel bi ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可协商的；可以商议调整的。

formal.mt: L-offerta tindika li l-prezz huwa negozjabbli u jista' jinbidel bi ftehim bejn iż-żewġ partijiet.
formal.en: The offer states that the price is negotiable and can be changed by agreement between the two parties.
formal.zh: 报价说明价格可以协商，双方达成一致后可以调整。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-prezz hu negozjabbli? Sara: Iva, nistgħu nitkellmu dwaru. Kemm tixtieq toffri?
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the price negotiable? Sara: Yes, we can discuss it. How much would you like to offer?
colloquial.zh: 马克：价格可以商量吗？萨拉：可以，我们可以谈谈。你想出多少？

messages.speaker: Mark (买家)
messages.zh: 价格可以商量吗？
messages.en: Is the price negotiable?

messages.speaker: Sara (卖家)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu nitkellmu dwaru. Kemm tixtieq toffri?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu nitkellmu dwaru. Kemm tixtieq toffri?
messages.zh: 可以，我们可以谈谈。你想出多少？
messages.en: Yes, we can discuss it. How much would you like to offer?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 negozjabbli 写在价格标签旁，想象买卖双方坐下来商量，记住它表示“还有协商调整的余地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The extent to which a price, condition, or proposal can be discussed and changed through negotiation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 价格、条件或提议能够通过协商加以调整的程度或性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-possibbiltà li prezz, kundizzjoni jew proposta jiġu diskussi u mibdula permezz ta' negozjati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可协商性；价格、条件等可以通过谈判调整的性质。

formal.mt: Qabel ma ressqet l-offerta tagħha, il-kumpanija talbet kjarifika dwar in-negozjabilità tal-prezz u tal-kundizzjonijiet.
formal.en: Before submitting its offer, the company requested clarification about the negotiability of the price and the terms.
formal.zh: 公司在提交报价之前，要求明确价格和条款是否可以协商。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Hawn miktub 'negozjabilità tal-prezz'. Xi jfisser? Mark: Ifisser li nistgħu niddiskutu l-prezz u forsi naqblu fuq wieħed aktar baxx.
colloquial.en: Lina: It says 'negotiability of the price' here. What does that mean? Mark: It means we can discuss the price and perhaps agree on a lower one.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这里写着“价格的可议价性”，是什么意思？马克：意思是我们可以谈价格，也许能商定一个更低的价钱。

messages.speaker: Lina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这里写着“价格的可议价性”，是什么意思？
messages.en: It says 'negotiability of the price' here. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li nistgħu niddiskutu l-prezz u forsi naqblu fuq wieħed aktar baxx.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li nistgħu niddiskutu l-prezz u forsi naqblu fuq wieħed aktar baxx.
messages.zh: 意思是我们可以谈价格，也许能商定一个更低的价钱。
messages.en: It means we can discuss the price and perhaps agree on a lower one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象价签旁写着“还能商量”：这个词强调能否协商的性质，而不是谈判这件事本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Discussions between parties who are trying to reach an agreement, often involving several meetings or exchanges.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各方为达成协议而进行的谈判或磋商，常涉及多次会谈或意见交换；本词为复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diskussjonijiet bejn partijiet li qed jippruvaw jilħqu ftehim, spiss permezz ta' diversi laqgħat jew skambji ta' proposti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谈判；磋商；各方为达成协议而进行的一系列商谈（复数）。

formal.mt: In-negozjati bejn il-kumpanija u r-rappreżentanti tal-ħaddiema se jkomplu l-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
formal.en: Negotiations between the company and the workers' representatives will continue next week.
formal.zh: 公司与工人代表之间的谈判将于下周继续。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif sejrin in-negozjati dwar il-kera? Mark: Għadna qed nitkellmu mas-sid, imma nittamaw li naqblu dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Lina: How are the negotiations about the rent going? Mark: We're still talking to the landlord, but we hope to reach an agreement soon.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：租金谈判进行得怎么样了？马克：我们还在和房东谈，不过希望很快能达成一致。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 租金谈判进行得怎么样了？
messages.en: How are the negotiations about the rent going?

messages.speaker: Mark (租客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna qed nitkellmu mas-sid, imma nittamaw li naqblu dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna qed nitkellmu mas-sid, imma nittamaw li naqblu dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 我们还在和房东谈，不过希望很快能达成一致。
messages.en: We're still talking to the landlord, but we hope to reach an agreement soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它配上多轮会谈的画面：今天谈、下周继续谈，用复数形式记住一系列磋商。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who discusses terms with another party in order to reach an agreement, often on behalf of others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一方商谈条件、争取达成协议的人，常代表某个团体或机构参加谈判。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiddiskuti kundizzjonijiet ma' parti oħra biex jintlaħaq ftehim, spiss f'isem persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谈判者；代表一方协商条件、争取达成协议的人。

formal.mt: In-negozjatur ewlieni ppreżenta proposta ġdida biex iż-żewġ partijiet ikunu jistgħu jilħqu ftehim.
formal.en: The chief negotiator presented a new proposal so that the two parties could reach an agreement.
formal.zh: 首席谈判代表提出了一项新方案，以便双方能够达成协议。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Min se jkun in-negozjatur tagħna fil-laqgħa? Mark: Pawlu, għax jaf il-kundizzjonijiet sew u jisma' lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Lina: Who will be our negotiator at the meeting? Mark: Pawlu, because he knows the terms well and listens to everyone.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：会议上谁来当我们的谈判代表？马克：保罗，因为他很了解这些条件，也会听取大家的意见。

messages.speaker: Lina (团队成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jkun in-negozjatur tagħna fil-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jkun in-negozjatur tagħna fil-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 会议上谁来当我们的谈判代表？
messages.en: Who will be our negotiator at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (团队成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu, għax jaf il-kundizzjonijiet sew u jisma' lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu, għax jaf il-kundizzjonijiet sew u jisma' lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 保罗，因为他很了解这些条件，也会听取大家的意见。
messages.en: Pawlu, because he knows the terms well and listens to everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象谈判桌上替团队发言的那个人：这个词回答“谁来谈”，指人而不是谈判过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of discussing terms with another party in order to reach an agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为达成协议而与另一方讨论条件、交换提议的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' diskussjoni ta' kundizzjonijiet ma' parti oħra sabiex jintlaħaq ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谈判；协商；各方通过讨论条件争取达成协议的过程。

formal.mt: Matul il-proċess ta' negozjazzjoni, iż-żewġ partijiet qablu li jirrevedu l-kundizzjonijiet tal-ħlas.
formal.en: During the negotiation process, the two parties agreed to revise the payment terms.
formal.zh: 在谈判过程中，双方同意修订付款条件。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għada għandi negozjazzjoni dwar il-prezz. Kif nipprepara? Mark: Iddeċiedi kemm tista' tħallas u aħseb x'tista' tipproponi.
colloquial.en: Lina: Tomorrow I have a negotiation about the price. How should I prepare? Mark: Decide how much you can pay and think about what you can propose.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：明天我要谈价格，该怎么准备？马克：先确定你能付多少钱，再想想可以提出什么方案。

messages.speaker: Lina (买家)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada għandi negozjazzjoni dwar il-prezz. Kif nipprepara?
messages.mt_standard: Għada għandi negozjazzjoni dwar il-prezz. Kif nipprepara?
messages.zh: 明天我要谈价格，该怎么准备？
messages.en: Tomorrow I have a negotiation about the price. How should I prepare?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iddeċiedi kemm tista' tħallas u aħseb x'tista' tipproponi.
messages.mt_standard: Iddeċiedi kemm tista' tħallas u aħseb x'tista' tipproponi.
messages.zh: 先确定你能付多少钱，再想想可以提出什么方案。
messages.en: Decide how much you can pay and think about what you can propose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把提出条件、听取回应、寻找共识连成一个过程来记；本词是单数，对照复数 negozjati 学习。

gloss_zh: 爱哼哼抱怨的；爱发牢骚的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to moan or whine, especially when expressing dissatisfaction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易通过哼哼、哀怨的语气或反复抱怨来表达不满的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jgerger jew jilmenta b'ton ta' dwejjaq, speċjalment meta ma jkunx kuntent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱哼哼抱怨的；容易用哀怨的语气发牢骚的。

collocations.en: a boy who tends to whine
a man who tends to moan or whine

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-ġar bħala raġel negħgħej li dejjem isib xi ħaġa fuq xiex jilmenta.
formal.en: In the story, the author describes the neighbour as a man inclined to whine who always finds something to complain about.
formal.zh: 故事中，作者把这位邻居描写成一个爱发牢骚、总能找到事情抱怨的男人。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex qed tgħid li Pawlu hu negħgħej? Mark: Għax ilu jilmenta dwar kull ħaġa minn meta wasal.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why are you saying that Pawlu is whiny? Mark: Because he's been complaining about everything since he arrived.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你为什么说保罗爱发牢骚？马克：因为他从到这里开始，就一直什么都抱怨。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħid li Pawlu hu negħgħej?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħid li Pawlu hu negħgħej?
messages.zh: 你为什么说保罗爱发牢骚？
messages.en: Why are you saying that Pawlu is whiny?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ilu jilmenta dwar kull ħaġa minn meta wasal.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ilu jilmenta dwar kull ħaġa minn meta wasal.
messages.zh: 因为他从到这里开始，就一直什么都抱怨。
messages.en: Because he's been complaining about everything since he arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人排队时不停哼哼抱怨，用这个画面记住它描述爱发牢骚的倾向，而不是一次抱怨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work or process of fitting horseshoes to horses, donkeys, or similar animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给马、驴等动物的蹄部安装蹄铁的工作或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol jew il-proċess tat-twaħħil tan-nagħal ma' saqajn iż-żwiemel, il-ħmir u annimali simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给马、驴等动物钉蹄铁；安装蹄铁的工作或过程。

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi dimostrazzjoni tan-negħil taż-żwiemel u spjegazzjoni tal-għodod użati.
formal.en: The course includes a demonstration of horse shoeing and an explanation of the tools used.
formal.zh: 课程包括给马钉蹄铁的演示，以及对所用工具的讲解。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex se jiġi l-ħaddied illum? Mark: Għan-negħil taż-żiemel; in-nagħal tiegħu għandhom bżonn jinbidlu.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why is the farrier coming today? Mark: To shoe the horse; its horseshoes need replacing.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：钉蹄铁的师傅今天为什么要来？马克：来给马钉蹄铁，它的蹄铁需要更换了。

messages.speaker: Lina (马场访客)
messages.zh: 钉蹄铁的师傅今天为什么要来？
messages.en: Why is the farrier coming today?

messages.speaker: Mark (养马人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għan-negħil taż-żiemel; in-nagħal tiegħu għandhom bżonn jinbidlu.
messages.mt_standard: Għan-negħil taż-żiemel; in-nagħal tiegħu għandhom bżonn jinbidlu.
messages.zh: 来给马钉蹄铁，它的蹄铁需要更换了。
messages.en: To shoe the horse; its horseshoes need replacing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象师傅抬起马蹄、装上蹄铁的完整动作；这个词指钉蹄铁这项工作，重点记住过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who moans or sighs, especially someone who does so repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会发出呻吟或叹息的人，尤其指经常这样做的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titniehed jew toħroġ ilfiq baxx, speċjalment meta tagħmel dan ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呻吟或叹气的人；爱发出呻吟或叹息的人。

collocations.en: someone who moans or sighs frequently

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist huwa nehied li jesprimi n-niket tiegħu b'tnehid aktar milli bil-kliem.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist is a person who sighs, expressing his sorrow through sighs more than through words.
formal.zh: 小说中的主人公是个爱叹息的人，他更多通过叹息而非言语来表达悲伤。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'nehied' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Persuna li titniehed jew toħroġ ħsejjes ta' wġigħ jew dwejjaq.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'nehied' mean in this sentence? Mark: A person who sighs or makes sounds of pain or distress.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这个句子里的 nehied 是什么意思？马克：指叹气的人，或发出痛苦、难受声音的人。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 nehied 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'nehied' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna li titniehed jew toħroġ ħsejjes ta' wġigħ jew dwejjaq.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna li titniehed jew toħroġ ħsejjes ta' wġigħ jew dwejjaq.
messages.zh: 指叹气的人，或发出痛苦、难受声音的人。
messages.en: A person who sighs or makes sounds of pain or distress.

cognitive_memory_aid: 听到长长一声叹息后，把注意力放在发出声音的那个人：nehied 是指人的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to moan or sigh, often expressing sadness, discomfort, or weariness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易呻吟或叹气的，常借此表现悲伤、不适或疲惫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jitniehed jew joħroġ ħsejjes ta' wġigħ jew dwejjaq, spiss minħabba niket, skumdità jew għeja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱呻吟或叹气的；有反复呻吟或叹息倾向的。

collocations.en: a man inclined to moan or sigh
a character inclined to moan or sigh

formal.mt: L-awtur jippreżenta karattru nehiedi li jesprimi l-għeja tiegħu b'tnehid ripetut.
formal.en: The author presents a character inclined to sigh who expresses his weariness through repeated sighs.
formal.zh: 作者塑造了一个爱叹息的角色，通过反复叹气表现他的疲惫。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Pawlu jidher nehiedi llum; smajtu jitniehed diversi drabi. Mark: Forsi għajjien. Ejja nistaqsuh kif qed iħossu.
colloquial.en: Lina: Pawlu seems inclined to sigh today; I've heard him sigh several times. Mark: Maybe he's tired. Let's ask him how he's feeling.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：保罗今天似乎总爱叹气，我已经听见他叹了好几次。马克：也许他累了，我们问问他感觉怎么样吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu jidher nehiedi llum; smajtu jitniehed diversi drabi.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu jidher nehiedi llum; smajtu jitniehed diversi drabi.
messages.zh: 保罗今天似乎总爱叹气，我已经听见他叹了好几次。
messages.en: Pawlu seems inclined to sigh today; I've heard him sigh several times.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi għajjien. Ejja nistaqsuh kif qed iħossu.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi għajjien. Ejja nistaqsuh kif qed iħossu.
messages.zh: 也许他累了，我们问问他感觉怎么样吧。
messages.en: Maybe he's tired. Let's ask him how he's feeling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nehied 与 nehiedi 成对记：前者是叹气的人，后者形容爱叹气的倾向；用 raġel nehiedi 记住形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow teeth, especially when a young child's teeth begin to appear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长出牙齿，尤指幼儿开始出牙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħorġulu s-snien, speċjalment meta tifel żgħir jibda jkollu l-ewwel snien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长牙；牙齿开始长出来。

formal.mt: It-tifel nejjeb kmieni, u ommu nnotat l-ewwel sinna meta kellu ftit xhur.
formal.en: The boy grew teeth early, and his mother noticed his first tooth when he was a few months old.
formal.zh: 这个男孩出牙较早，才几个月大时，他的母亲就发现了他的第一颗牙。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Iċ-ċkejken diġà għandu sinna? Rita: Iva, nejjeb kmieni!
colloquial.en: Marija: Does the little one already have a tooth? Rita: Yes, he grew teeth early!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：小家伙已经长牙了吗？丽塔：是啊，他出牙很早！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 小家伙已经长牙了吗？
messages.en: Does the little one already have a tooth?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 是啊，他出牙很早！
messages.en: Yes, he grew teeth early!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nejjeb 配上宝宝露出第一颗小牙的画面，记住它表示“长牙”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To adulterate something or spoil it badly; a coarse way to say that someone has ruined something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物掺假、变坏或受到严重破坏；表示“搞砸、糟蹋”时语气粗俗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħallat xi ħaġa b'mod li jħassarha jew inaqqsilha l-kwalità; b'lingwaġġ vulgari, iħassar xi ħaġa għal kollox.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掺假；败坏或毁掉某物；粗俗地说“搞砸、糟蹋”。

formal.mt: Fil-kitba formali, minflok 'nejjek il-pjan', uża 'ħassar il-pjan' biex tevita lingwaġġ vulgari.
formal.en: In formal writing, use 'ħassar il-pjan' instead of 'nejjek il-pjan' to avoid coarse language.
formal.zh: 在正式写作中，应使用 ħassar il-pjan 代替 nejjek il-pjan，避免粗俗用语；两者在这里都涉及把计划搞砸。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'ġara mill-pjan tagħna? Lara: Xi ħadd biddel il-ħin u nejjek kollox.
colloquial.en: Mark: What happened to our plan? Lara: Someone changed the time and screwed everything up.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们的计划怎么了？拉拉：有人改了时间，把一切都搞砸了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们的计划怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to our plan?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd biddel il-ħin u nejjek kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd biddel il-ħin u nejjek kollox.
messages.zh: 有人改了时间，把一切都搞砸了。
messages.en: Someone changed the time and screwed everything up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象计划表被人乱改后全盘混乱，用“搞砸了”的画面记词，并记住其粗俗语气。

gloss_zh: 私通者；轻浮的人；爱开玩笑的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who has sex outside marriage; also a frivolous person or someone who jokes around, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指发生非婚性关系的人；也可随语境指轻浮、不认真的人，或爱开玩笑的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel sess barra ż-żwieġ; skont il-kuntest, ukoll persuna li ġġib ruħha bla serjetà jew li tħobb tiċċajta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生非婚性关系的人；私通者。
举止轻浮、不严肃或不负责任的人。
爱开玩笑的人；爱逗趣的人。

collocations.en: a frivolous person who lacks seriousness
collocations.zh: 一个毫不认真的轻浮之人

collocations.en: a joker who is always joking around

formal.mt: F'dan id-djalogu, 'nejjiek' tfisser persuna li dejjem tiċċajta, u ma tirreferix għal imġiba sesswali.
formal.en: In this dialogue, 'nejjiek' means someone who is always joking around and does not refer to sexual behavior.
formal.zh: 在这段对话中，nejjiek 指总爱开玩笑的人，并不涉及性行为。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex sejjaħtlu 'nejjiek'? Karl: Għax dejjem jiċċajta, anki meta rridu nitkellmu bis-serjetà.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you call him a 'nejjiek'? Karl: Because he is always joking around, even when we need to talk seriously.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么叫他 nejjiek？卡尔：因为他总爱开玩笑，连我们要认真谈话时也这样。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么叫他 nejjiek？
messages.en: Why did you call him a 'nejjiek'?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem jiċċajta, anki meta rridu nitkellmu bis-serjetà.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem jiċċajta, anki meta rridu nitkellmu bis-serjetà.
messages.zh: 因为他总爱开玩笑，连我们要认真谈话时也这样。
messages.en: Because he is always joking around, even when we need to talk seriously.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个名词画三张人物卡：非婚性行为者、轻浮者、玩笑者；具体选哪张要看上下文。

gloss_zh: 爱开玩笑的；轻浮的；好色的（粗俗）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to joke or behave frivolously; in a vulgar sexual sense, lecherous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 爱开玩笑或表现轻浮、不严肃的；用于粗俗的性意味语境时，表示好色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jiċċajta jew iġib ruħu bla serjetà; f'sens sesswali vulgari, li juri xewqa sesswali eċċessiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱开玩笑的；倾向于逗趣的。
轻浮的；不严肃的；缺乏认真态度的。
好色的；淫荡的（粗俗用语）。

collocations.en: a joking, frivolous, or lecherous comment, depending on context
collocations.zh: 玩笑、轻浮或带好色意味的评论，具体取决于语境

formal.mt: It-ton nejjieki tal-kumment ma kienx xieraq għal diskussjoni dwar problema serja.
formal.en: The frivolous tone of the comment was inappropriate for a discussion about a serious problem.
formal.zh: 这条评论的轻浮语气不适合用于讨论严肃问题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak kien kumment nejjieki? Ben: Iva, kien qed jiċċajta, imma l-ħin ma kienx tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was that a joking comment? Ben: Yes, he was joking, but the timing was wrong.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那是句玩笑话吗？本：是啊，他是在开玩笑，但时机不对。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 那是句玩笑话吗？
messages.en: Was that a joking comment?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)

messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien qed jiċċajta, imma l-ħin ma kienx tajjeb.
messages.zh: 是啊，他是在开玩笑，但时机不对。
messages.en: Yes, he was joking, but the timing was wrong.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它贴在“语气、评论、行为”旁边记作形容词，再用语境区分玩笑、轻浮与好色三义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sexual intercourse outside marriage; also frivolity or unserious behavior, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非婚性行为；也可随语境指轻浮、不严肃或胡闹的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sess barra ż-żwieġ; skont il-kuntest, ukoll nuqqas ta' serjetà jew imġiba frivola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非婚性行为；私通。
轻浮；不严肃；胡闹。

formal.mt: Fl-espressjoni 'biżżejjed nejk', il-kelma tirreferi għal imġiba bla serjetà.
formal.en: In the expression 'biżżejjed nejk', the word refers to unserious behavior.
formal.zh: 在 biżżejjed nejk（别再胡闹了）这一表达中，该词指不严肃的行为。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Ejja nagħmlu ċajta oħra! Lara: Biżżejjed nejk, irridu nispiċċaw ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Toni: Let's make another joke! Lara: Enough fooling around; we need to finish the work.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：我们再开个玩笑吧！拉拉：别再胡闹了，我们得把工作做完。

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 我们再开个玩笑吧！
messages.en: Let's make another joke!

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 别再胡闹了，我们得把工作做完。
messages.en: Enough fooling around; we need to finish the work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个语境盒子记这个名词：一个装非婚性行为，一个装轻浮胡闹；整句话决定打开哪个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To copulate or have sexual intercourse with another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一人发生性交；交合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu x'jaqsam sesswalment ma' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性交；交合。

collocations.en: had sexual intercourse with a female partner
collocations.zh: 与一位女性伴侣发生了性交

collocations.en: had sexual intercourse for the first time

formal.mt: F'din is-sentenza, 'nekaħ ma' sieħba' jfisser li r-raġel kellu x'jaqsam sesswalment ma' sieħba.
formal.en: In this sentence, 'nekaħ ma' sieħba' means that the man had sexual intercourse with a female partner.
formal.zh: 在这句话中，nekaħ ma' sieħba 表示该男子与一位女性伴侣发生了性交。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'nekaħ' hawn? Mark: Ifisser li kellu x'jaqsam sesswalment ma' xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'nekaħ' mean here? Mark: It means that he had sexual intercourse with someone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 nekaħ 是什么意思？马克：意思是他与某人发生了性交。

messages.speaker: Maja (成年学生)

messages.en: What does 'nekaħ' mean here?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nekaħ 放进“性行为动词”词卡，直接对应“性交、交合”，用明确释义帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unpleasantly sharp or malicious toward others, especially through hurtful remarks or deliberately spiteful behavior.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对别人尖刻、不友善或怀有恶意的，尤指用伤人的话语或故意使坏的行为对待别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitkellem b'mod aħrax jew jaġixxi b'ħażen biex iweġġa' jew idejjaq lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刻薄的；说话尖酸、待人不友善的，带贬义。
心怀恶意的；故意使坏或让别人难受的。

formal.mt: Il-kumment nekkej dwar il-kollega ħoloq tensjoni waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The spiteful comment about the colleague created tension during the meeting.
formal.zh: 那条针对同事的恶意评论使会议气氛变得紧张。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dak kien kumment nekkej. Pawlu: Għandek raġun; ma kellux għalfejn iweġġagħha hekk.
colloquial.en: Rita: That was a spiteful comment. Pawlu: You're right; he didn't need to hurt her like that.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：那句话真刻薄。保罗：你说得对，他没必要那样伤害她。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 那句话真刻薄。
messages.en: That was a spiteful comment.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; ma kellux għalfejn iweġġagħha hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; ma kellux għalfejn iweġġagħha hekk.
messages.zh: 你说得对，他没必要那样伤害她。
messages.en: You're right; he didn't need to hurt her like that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句话像小刺一样故意扎人，把 nekkej 与“刻薄、带恶意”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To adulterate something by mixing in another substance, or to damage it and reduce its quality or usefulness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过混入其他物质使某物掺假，或使某物受损、质量下降或失去用途。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħallat sustanza ma' oħra b'mod li jħassar il-purità tagħha, jew għamel ħsara lil xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掺假；向某种物质中混入其他成分，破坏其纯度或质量。
损坏；使某物受到损伤或质量下降。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-bejjiegħ nellaħ il-ħalib billi żiedlu l-ilma.
formal.en: The report describes how the seller adulterated the milk by adding water to it.
formal.zh: 报告描述了卖家如何通过加水在牛奶中掺假。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min nellaħ dan il-materjal? Pawlu: Ma nafx, iżda issa ma nistgħux nużawh.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who damaged this material? Pawlu: I don't know, but we can't use it now.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁把这份材料弄坏了？保罗：我不知道，但现在我们没法用了。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 谁把这份材料弄坏了？
messages.en: Who damaged this material?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)

messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx, iżda issa ma nistgħux nużawh.
messages.zh: 我不知道，但现在我们没法用了。
messages.en: I don't know, but we can't use it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 nellaħ：往牛奶里掺水，以及把好材料弄坏；共同点是使原有质量变差。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Frivolous behaviour, joking around, or foolish conduct, especially when seriousness is expected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻浮、嬉闹或愚蠢的举动，尤指在应当认真的场合出现的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba ħafifa, ċajt jew bluha, speċjalment meta jkun hemm bżonn is-serjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻浮；不够认真严肃的态度或行为。
嬉闹；开玩笑、闹着玩的行为。
愚蠢；欠缺判断力的言行。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, il-kliem ta' nelħ fixkel id-diskussjoni dwar il-problema.
formal.en: During the meeting, frivolous talk disrupted the discussion of the problem.
formal.zh: 会议期间，轻浮的话语干扰了对问题的讨论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Issa biżżejjed nelħ; irridu nispiċċaw ix-xogħol. Mark: Sewwa, ejja nkomplu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Enough joking around now; we need to finish the work. Mark: All right, let's carry on.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：好了，别再闹了；我们得把工作做完。马克：好，我们继续吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)

messages.en: All right, let's carry on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象开会时有人不停嬉笑，旁人提醒该认真了；把这个场景与 nelħ 的轻浮、嬉闹和愚蠢行为联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An ant or ants; small insects that typically live in colonies, often referred to collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蚂蚁；通常群居的小型昆虫，也可用来统称一群蚂蚁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insetti żgħar li normalment jgħixu f'kolonji; il-kelma tintuża wkoll biex tirreferi għalihom bħala grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蚂蚁；可指蚂蚁这种昆虫或一群蚂蚁。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw ħafna nemel ħdejn il-bejta u rreġistraw il-movimenti tagħhom.
formal.en: The students observed many ants near the nest and recorded their movements.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了蚁巢附近的许多蚂蚁，并记录了它们的活动。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm nemel ħdejn iz-zokkor! Ben: Ejja nagħlqu l-vażett u nnaddfu l-mejda.
colloquial.en: Sara: There are ants near the sugar! Ben: Let's close the jar and clean the table.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：糖旁边有蚂蚁！本：我们把罐子盖好，再擦干净桌子吧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tiger, a large wild cat known for the dark stripes on its coat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 老虎，一种体型较大、毛皮带有深色条纹的野生猫科动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal selvaġġ kbir tal-familja tal-qtates, magħruf għall-istrixxi skuri fuq il-pil tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虎；老虎。

formal.mt: L-istampa fil-ktieb turi nemer kbir bi strixxi skuri fuq il-pil tiegħu.
formal.en: The picture in the book shows a large tiger with dark stripes on its coat.
formal.zh: 书中的图片展示了一只毛皮上带有深色条纹的大老虎。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan nemer jew iljun? Adam: Nemer; ara l-istrixxi tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this a tiger or a lion? Adam: A tiger; look at its stripes.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这是老虎还是狮子？亚当：老虎；看它身上的条纹。

messages.en: A tiger; look at its stripes.

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual ant, a small insect that usually lives as part of a colony.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一只蚂蚁，指通常生活在蚁群中的单个小型昆虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett żgħir wieħed li normalment jgħix f'kolonja ma' nemel ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蚂蚁；一只蚂蚁。

formal.en: During the observation, the student followed one ant that was carrying bread crumbs.
formal.zh: 观察期间，这名学生追踪了一只正在搬运面包屑的蚂蚁。

colloquial.mt: Lea: Ara, hemm nemla fuq il-ktieb tiegħek. Sam: Rajtha; se nħalliha titla' fuq din il-karta.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to ants, their life, or their behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与蚂蚁、蚂蚁的生活或行为有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam man-nemel, mal-ħajja tiegħu jew mal-imġiba tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与蚂蚁有关的；涉及蚂蚁的。

formal.mt: Dan l-istudju nemli jiddeskrivi kif in-nemel isib l-ikel u jġorru lejn il-bejta.
formal.en: This study relating to ants describes how ants find food and carry it to the nest.
formal.zh: 这项有关蚂蚁的研究描述了蚂蚁如何寻找食物并将其搬回蚁巢。

colloquial.mt: Eva: Xi jfisser nemli hawn? Toni: Ifisser li għandu x'jaqsam man-nemel; it-test jitkellem dwar kif jgħix.
colloquial.en: Eva: What does nemli mean here? Toni: It means relating to ants; the text talks about how they live.
colloquial.zh: 伊娃：这里的 nemli 是什么意思？托尼：意思是与蚂蚁有关的；文章讲的是蚂蚁怎样生活。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large ant; the augmentative form of nemla, emphasizing the ant's size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一只大蚂蚁；nemla 的增大形式，用来强调蚂蚁的体型大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nemla kbira; forma ta' nemla li tenfasizza d-daqs kbir tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: a large ant (the augmentative form of 'nemla')

formal.zh: 观察期间，这名学生注意到蚁巢旁有一只大蚂蚁，并详细地画下了它。

colloquial.mt: Mia: Ara dak in-nemlun ħdejn il-bieb! Luqa: Kemm hu kbir! Ħallih jgħaddi.

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 饲养并照料蚂蚁的人。

messages.mt_spoken: Għax iżomm in-nemel u jieħu ħsiebu kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Għax iżomm in-nemel u jieħu ħsiebu kuljum.
messages.zh: 因为他养蚂蚁，而且每天都照料它们。
messages.en: Because he keeps ants and cares for them every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人每天照料透明容器里的蚂蚁，把 nemmiel 标签贴在这个人身上，记住它指养蚁者。

gloss_zh: 蚂蚁成灾的；有很多蚂蚁的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Infested with ants, especially of a place where many ants are present.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某个地方蚂蚁很多，已经形成虫患。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih ħafna nemel, tant li jkun hemm problema bih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蚂蚁成灾的；被大量蚂蚁侵扰的

formal.mt: L-ispettur iddeskriva l-maħżen bħala post nemmieli u talab li jitnaddaf.
formal.en: The inspector described the storeroom as ant-infested and requested that it be cleaned.
formal.zh: 检查员指出储藏室有蚁患，并要求进行清洁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-post nemmieli; hemm nemel ħdejn il-ħobż. Pawlu: Ejja nneħħu l-ħobż u nnaddfu l-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: This place is infested with ants; there are ants beside the bread. Pawlu: Let's move the bread away and clean the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里蚂蚁成灾了，面包旁边都有蚂蚁。保罗：我们把面包拿走，再把桌子擦干净吧。
