messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-post nemmieli; hemm nemel ħdejn il-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-post nemmieli; hemm nemel ħdejn il-ħobż.
messages.zh: 这里蚂蚁成灾了，面包旁边都有蚂蚁。
messages.en: This place is infested with ants; there are ants beside the bread.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nneħħu l-ħobż u nnaddfu l-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nneħħu l-ħobż u nnaddfu l-mejda.
messages.zh: 我们把面包拿走，再把桌子擦干净吧。
messages.en: Let's move the bread away and clean the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象储藏室的面包旁爬满蚂蚁，把 nemmieli 与“整个地方闹蚁患”的画面绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 爱窥探的；爱色迷迷盯人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to pry into other people's private affairs or to look at people with an intrusive sexual interest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人爱打探别人的私事，或爱用带有性意味、令人不适的目光盯着别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jindaħal fil-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor jew iħares lejn in-nies b'xewqa sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱窥探别人私事或爱色迷迷盯着别人看的

collocations.en: a man inclined to pry or ogle
collocations.zh: 爱窥探或爱色迷迷盯人的男子

formal.mt: Min jagħmel intervista għandu juri interess mingħajr ma jkun nemmiesi dwar il-ħajja privata tal-persuna.
formal.en: An interviewer should show interest without prying into the person's private life.
formal.zh: 采访者应表现出兴趣，同时避免窥探受访者的私生活。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ġar tagħna nemmiesi; dejjem jistaqsini kemm naqla'. Mark: Għidlu li dik hi ħaġa privata.
colloquial.en: Lara: Our neighbour is nosy; he always asks me how much I earn. Mark: Tell him that's private.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们的邻居真爱打探私事，总问我挣多少钱。马克：告诉他，那是私事。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġar tagħna nemmiesi; dejjem jistaqsini kemm naqla'.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġar tagħna nemmiesi; dejjem jistaqsini kemm naqla'.
messages.zh: 我们的邻居真爱打探私事，总问我挣多少钱。
messages.en: Our neighbour is nosy; he always asks me how much I earn.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għidlu li dik hi ħaġa privata.
messages.mt_standard: Għidlu li dik hi ħaġa privata.
messages.zh: 告诉他，那是私事。
messages.en: Tell him that's private.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nemmiesi 配上两幅画：邻居追问隐私、路人色迷迷盯人，记住它描述令人不适的窥探倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shine unsteadily with small changes in brightness, especially of a candle or lamp flame.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指光亮不稳定地闪动，尤其用于蜡烛或灯的火焰忽明忽暗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jixgħel b'dawl li jinbidel malajr fil-qawwa tiegħu, speċjalment meta jingħad għal fjamma ta' xemgħa jew lampa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to flicker (esp. used of a flame, as on a candle or lamp)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪烁；忽明忽暗，尤指蜡烛或灯的火焰

formal.mt: Meta nfetħet it-tieqa, il-fjamma tax-xemgħa bdiet tnemnem.
formal.en: When the window was opened, the candle flame began to flicker.
formal.zh: 窗户打开后，蜡烛的火苗开始闪动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kif qed tnemnem il-fjamma tax-xemgħa. Pawlu: Hemm ir-riħ mit-tieqa; se nagħlaqha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how the candle flame is flickering. Pawlu: There's a draught from the window; I'll close it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，蜡烛的火苗在一闪一闪的。保罗：窗户那里有风吹进来，我去关上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kif qed tnemnem il-fjamma tax-xemgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Ara kif qed tnemnem il-fjamma tax-xemgħa.
messages.zh: 看，蜡烛的火苗在一闪一闪的。
messages.en: Look how the candle flame is flickering.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 窗户那里有风吹进来，我去关上。
messages.en: There's a draught from the window; I'll close it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 nemnem 时用手指模拟火苗连续闪动，把重复的读音节奏当作“亮一下、暗一下”的学习提示。

gloss_zh: 容易闪烁的；忽明忽暗的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Prone to flickering rather than giving a steady light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容光亮容易闪动、经常忽明忽暗的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jagħti dawl mhux stabbli, b'bidliet żgħar u mgħaġġla fil-qawwa tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易闪烁的；倾向于忽明忽暗的

collocations.en: the flickering light of the candle

formal.mt: Id-dawl nemniemi tal-lampa għamel il-qari aktar diffiċli.
formal.en: The lamp's flickering light made reading more difficult.
formal.zh: 灯光忽明忽暗，使阅读变得更加困难。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan id-dawl nemniemi qed idejjaqni waqt li naqra. Mark: Ejja noqogħdu ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: This flickering light is bothering me while I read. Mark: Let's sit by the window.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我看书时，这忽明忽暗的灯光真让人难受。马克：我们坐到窗边去吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-dawl nemniemi qed idejjaqni waqt li naqra.
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-dawl nemniemi qed idejjaqni waqt li naqra.
messages.zh: 我看书时，这忽明忽暗的灯光真让人难受。
messages.en: This flickering light is bothering me while I read.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 我们坐到窗边去吧。
messages.en: Let's sit by the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nemniemi 写在一盏忽明忽暗的灯旁边：这里给光贴上性质标签，记住它是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fine mesh covering placed around a bed or another space to keep mosquitoes out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围在床铺或其他空间周围、用来阻挡蚊子的细网罩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xibka fina li titqiegħed madwar sodda jew spazju ieħor biex iżżomm in-nemus barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蚊帐；用于阻挡蚊子的网罩

collocations.en: a mosquito net around the bed
to hang up a mosquito net

formal.mt: Il-lista tat-tagħmir għall-kamra tinkludi nemusiera li titwaħħal madwar is-sodda.
formal.en: The room's equipment list includes a mosquito net to be fitted around the bed.
formal.zh: 房间设备清单中包括一顶安装在床周围的蚊帐。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hemm nemus fil-kamra; fejn hi n-nemusiera? Omm: Fil-borża ħdejn is-sodda. Ejja ndendluha.
colloquial.en: Nina: There are mosquitoes in the room; where's the mosquito net? Mum: In the bag beside the bed. Let's hang it up.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：房间里有蚊子，蚊帐在哪里？妈妈：在床边的袋子里，我们把它挂起来吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm nemus fil-kamra; fejn hi n-nemusiera?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm nemus fil-kamra; fejn hi n-nemusiera?
messages.zh: 房间里有蚊子，蚊帐在哪里？
messages.en: There are mosquitoes in the room; where's the mosquito net?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 在床边的袋子里，我们把它挂起来吧。
messages.en: In the bag beside the bed. Let's hang it up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象床外蚊子嗡嗡飞、床内有细网保护，把 nemusiera 与“罩住床的蚊帐”整幅画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called neodymium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素钕的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bl-isem neodimju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钕，一种化学元素

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-istudent kiteb li neodimju huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku.
formal.en: In the report, the student wrote that neodymium is the name of a chemical element.
formal.zh: 学生在报告中写道，钕是一种化学元素的名称。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser neodimju f'din il-lista? Pawlu: Huwa isem ta' element kimiku; bl-Ingliż ngħidu neodymium.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does neodimju mean in this list? Pawlu: It's the name of a chemical element; in English we say neodymium.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张表里的 neodimju 是什么意思？保罗：是化学元素钕的名称，英语叫 neodymium。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这张表里的 neodimju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does neodimju mean in this list?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa isem ta' element kimiku; bl-Ingliż ngħidu neodymium.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa isem ta' element kimiku; bl-Ingliż ngħidu neodymium.
messages.zh: 是化学元素钕的名称，英语叫 neodymium。
messages.en: It's the name of a chemical element; in English we say neodymium.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作三语元素卡，把 neodimju、neodymium、钕并排写，每次先看马耳他语再说出中英文名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called neon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素氖的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bl-isem neon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 氖，一种化学元素

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-elementi kimiċi, l-istudent sab l-isem neon u kiteb it-traduzzjoni Ċiniża tiegħu.
formal.en: In the list of chemical elements, the student found the name neon and wrote its Chinese translation.
formal.zh: 学生在化学元素表中找到了 neon，并写下它的中文译名。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Neon għandu l-istess isem bl-Ingliż? Mark: Iva, bl-Ingliż ukoll ngħidu neon.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does neon have the same name in English? Mark: Yes, in English we also say neon.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：氖的英语名称也叫 neon 吗？马克：对，英语里也叫 neon。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 氖的英语名称也叫 neon 吗？
messages.en: Does neon have the same name in English?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 对，英语里也叫 neon。
messages.en: Yes, in English we also say neon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 neon 写进标有“氖”的元素卡，利用马耳他语与英语拼写相同这一点，三语一起复习。

gloss_zh: 侄女；外甥女；孙女；外孙女

teaching_sense.en_definition: A daughter of one's brother or sister, or a daughter of one's son or daughter, depending on the family context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指兄弟姐妹的女儿，即侄女或外甥女；也可指子女的女儿，即孙女或外孙女，具体由亲属关系语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bint ħuk jew oħtok, jew bint ibnek jew bintek, skont ir-relazzjoni tal-familja fil-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 侄女；外甥女，即兄弟或姐妹的女儿
孙女；外孙女，即儿子或女儿的女儿

collocations.zh: 我的外甥女，即我姐妹的女儿
他的孙女，即他儿子的女儿

formal.mt: Fl-ittra, Marija semmiet lin-neputija tagħha, bint ħuha, li kienet se tibda l-iskola.
formal.en: In the letter, Marija mentioned her niece, her brother's daughter, who was about to start school.
formal.zh: 玛丽娅在信中提到了即将入学的侄女，也就是她兄弟的女儿。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Din in-neputija tiegħek, bint ibnek? Ġużeppi: Iva, jisimha Nina u llum ġiet iżżurni.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is this your granddaughter, your son's daughter? Ġużeppi: Yes, her name is Nina, and she came to visit me today.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这是你的孙女，你儿子的女儿吗？朱塞佩：对，她叫妮娜，今天来看我。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.zh: 这是你的孙女，你儿子的女儿吗？
messages.en: Is this your granddaughter, your son's daughter?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (祖父)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jisimha Nina u llum ġiet iżżurni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jisimha Nina u llum ġiet iżżurni.
messages.zh: 对，她叫妮娜，今天来看我。
messages.en: Yes, her name is Nina, and she came to visit me today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两条亲属线：兄弟姐妹到女儿、自己的子女到女儿；两端都标 neputija，再靠上下文确定是哪一种亲属。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structure in the body that carries signals between the brain or spinal cord and other parts of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 神经：在脑或脊髓与身体其他部位之间传递信号的组织结构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura fil-ġisem li twassal sinjali bejn il-moħħ jew is-sinsla tad-dahar u partijiet oħra tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神经；身体内传递感觉和运动信号的组织结构。
鞭绳；用于抽打的绳条。

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi nerv li jwassal sinjali mill-id lejn il-moħħ.
formal.en: The diagram shows a nerve carrying signals from the hand to the brain.
formal.zh: 图示展示了一条将信号从手部传向大脑的神经。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi din il-linja fid-dijagramma? Mark: Dik turi nerv li jgħaqqad l-id mal-bqija tas-sistema nervuża.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this line in the diagram? Mark: It shows a nerve connecting the hand to the rest of the nervous system.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图里的这条线是什么？马克：它表示一条把手部与神经系统其余部分连接起来的神经。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 图里的这条线是什么？
messages.en: What is this line in the diagram?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik turi nerv li jgħaqqad l-id mal-bqija tas-sistema nervuża.
messages.mt_standard: Dik turi nerv li jgħaqqad l-id mal-bqija tas-sistema nervuża.
messages.zh: 它表示一条把手部与神经系统其余部分连接起来的神经。
messages.en: It shows a nerve connecting the hand to the rest of the nervous system.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nerv 想成身体里的信号线，先记住“神经”；遇到抽打或鞭子的语境，再切换到“鞭绳”义。

gloss_zh: 使烦躁；惹人心烦；容易紧张或受惊的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel irritated or annoyed, especially through something bothersome or repeated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到烦躁或恼火，尤其指烦人的事情或反复出现的刺激惹人心烦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu mdejjaq jew irritat, speċjalment b'xi ħaġa li ddejqu jew li tirrepeti ruħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使烦躁；使恼火。
惹某人心烦；使某人感到厌烦或受不了。
容易紧张、心神不安或容易受惊的人。

collocations.en: the noise got on Mark's nerves

formal.mt: Il-ħoss kontinwu nerveż lill-parteċipanti u fixkel id-diskussjoni.
formal.en: The continuous noise irritated the participants and disrupted the discussion.
formal.zh: 持续的噪声使参与者感到烦躁，并干扰了讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tlaqt mill-kamra? Mark: Dak il-ħoss nerveż lili wkoll; kelli bżonn ftit kwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you leave the room? Mark: That noise got on my nerves too; I needed some quiet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么离开房间？马克：那个声音也把我吵烦了，我需要安静一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么离开房间？
messages.en: Why did you leave the room?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-ħoss nerveż lili wkoll; kelli bżonn ftit kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-ħoss nerveż lili wkoll; kelli bżonn ftit kwiet.
messages.zh: 那个声音也把我吵烦了，我需要安静一会儿。
messages.en: That noise got on my nerves too; I needed some quiet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“反复滴答声把人惹烦”的画面记动词 nerveż；若句子把它当作一个人来称呼，则记名词义“容易紧张的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The body's network of nerves and related structures that receives and transmits signals and coordinates bodily activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 神经系统：由神经及相关结构组成，负责接收、传递信号并协调身体活动的系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sistema ta' nervituri u strutturi relatati fil-ġisem li tirċievi u twassal sinjali u tikkoordina l-attivitajiet tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神经系统；负责接收、传递信息并协调身体活动的系统。

collocations.en: the function of the nervous system

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jispjega kif in-nervitura tirċievi informazzjoni u tikkoordina l-moviment tal-ġisem.
formal.en: This chapter explains how the nervous system receives information and coordinates the body's movement.
formal.zh: 本章解释神经系统如何接收信息并协调身体运动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser nervitura? Mark: Tfisser is-sistema nervuża tal-ġisem, li tinkludi l-moħħ, is-sinsla tad-dahar u n-nervituri.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does nervitura mean? Mark: It means the body's nervous system, which includes the brain, spinal cord and nerves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：nervitura 是什么意思？马克：意思是身体的神经系统，包括脑、脊髓和神经。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: nervitura 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does nervitura mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser is-sistema nervuża tal-ġisem, li tinkludi l-moħħ, is-sinsla tad-dahar u n-nervituri.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser is-sistema nervuża tal-ġisem, li tinkludi l-moħħ, is-sinsla tad-dahar u n-nervituri.
messages.zh: 意思是身体的神经系统，包括脑、脊髓和神经。
messages.en: It means the body's nervous system, which includes the brain, spinal cord and nerves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张连接脑、脊髓和全身神经的网络图，把整张网络标作 nervitura，帮助记住它指整个神经系统。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spell of anger during which someone becomes upset or loses their temper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一阵发怒或发脾气的状态，强调怒气发作的一个时段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' rabja li fih persuna titħawwad jew titlef il-paċenzja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一阵怒气；一次发脾气的发作。

collocations.en: he had a spell of anger

formal.mt: Wara nervjata qasira, il-parteċipant ikkalma u kompla d-diskussjoni b'rispett.
formal.en: After a brief spell of anger, the participant calmed down and continued the discussion respectfully.
formal.zh: 短暂发怒后，这位参与者平静下来，并以尊重他人的态度继续讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadu rrabjat Mark? Lara: Le, għaddietlu n-nervjata. Issa nistgħu nitkellmu miegħu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Mark still angry? Lara: No, his angry spell has passed. We can talk to him calmly now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克还在生气吗？拉拉：没有了，他那阵怒气已经过去了。现在我们可以心平气和地跟他说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克还在生气吗？
messages.en: Is Mark still angry?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għaddietlu n-nervjata. Issa nistgħu nitkellmu miegħu bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għaddietlu n-nervjata. Issa nistgħu nitkellmu miegħu bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 没有了，他那阵怒气已经过去了。现在我们可以心平气和地跟他说话。
messages.en: No, his angry spell has passed. We can talk to him calmly now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nervjata 记作情绪天气里的一阵雷雨：突然发火，随后平息；重点是“一阵怒气”，不是长期性格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of feeling anxious, tense or easily irritated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 焦虑、紧张或容易烦躁的状态；具体含义由当时的情境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' ansjetà, tensjoni jew irritazzjoni faċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 焦虑；因担心可能发生的事情而感到不安。
紧张；面对某种情境时心神不定的状态。
易烦躁；容易因小事而恼火的状态或倾向。

formal.mt: Qabel il-preżentazzjoni, in-nervożità tal-istudent kienet tidher fil-vuċi tiegħu.
formal.en: Before the presentation, the student's nervousness was apparent in his voice.
formal.zh: 演讲前，从这名学生的声音中可以听出他的紧张。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed titkellem daqshekk malajr? Mark: Minħabba n-nervożità. Għandi l-ewwel intervista tiegħi dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you speaking so quickly? Mark: It's because of nervousness. I have my first interview this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么说话这么快？马克：因为紧张。我今天上午要参加第一次面试。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么说话这么快？
messages.en: Why are you speaking so quickly?

messages.speaker: Mark (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba n-nervożità. Għandi l-ewwel intervista tiegħi dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba n-nervożità. Għandi l-ewwel intervista tiegħi dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 因为紧张。我今天上午要参加第一次面试。
messages.en: It's because of nervousness. I have my first interview this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nervożità 配三张情境卡：担心未来是“焦虑”，上台前发慌是“紧张”，一点小事就恼火是“易烦躁”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of anxiety or nervous tension, often while anticipating an event or outcome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 焦虑或紧张不安的状态，常见于等待某件事发生或等待结果的时候。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' ansjetà jew tensjoni, ħafna drabi waqt li wieħed ikun qed jistenna xi avveniment jew riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 焦虑；因担忧某事而感到不安。
紧张不安；心情紧绷、难以放松的状态。

formal.mt: Matul l-istennija għar-riżultati, kien hemm sens ta' nervożiżmu fost il-kandidati.
formal.en: While waiting for the results, there was a feeling of nervousness among the candidates.
formal.zh: 等待结果期间，候选人中弥漫着一种紧张不安的情绪。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif qed tħossok qabel l-intervista? Mark: Għandi ftit nervożiżmu, imma ħejjejt tajjeb u lest biex nibda.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are you feeling before the interview? Mark: I'm feeling a little nervous, but I've prepared well and I'm ready to begin.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：面试前你感觉怎么样？马克：有一点紧张，不过我准备得很充分，已经可以开始了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 面试前你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How are you feeling before the interview?

messages.speaker: Mark (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ftit nervożiżmu, imma ħejjejt tajjeb u lest biex nibda.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ftit nervożiżmu, imma ħejjejt tajjeb u lest biex nibda.
messages.zh: 有一点紧张，不过我准备得很充分，已经可以开始了。
messages.en: I'm feeling a little nervous, but I've prepared well and I'm ready to begin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象坐在面试室外等待叫号，把那种心里悬着、难以放松的感觉标作 nervożiżmu，记住“焦虑、紧张不安”。

gloss_zh: 紧张的；易烦躁的；易怒的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling anxious or tense, or becoming annoyed or angry easily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人紧张不安，或容易感到烦躁、容易发怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss ansjetà jew tensjoni, jew li jiddejjaq jew jirrabja malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧张的；因担忧或压力而心神不安的。
易烦躁的；容易感到不耐烦或恼火的。
易怒的；脾气急、容易发火的。

formal.mt: Il-kandidat deher nervuż fil-bidu tal-intervista, iżda wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The candidate appeared nervous at the beginning of the interview, but answered the questions clearly.
formal.zh: 这名候选人在面试开始时显得紧张，但回答问题时表达清楚。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int nervuż dwar ir-riżultat? Mark: Iva, ftit. Għadni ma nafx kif mort fl-eżami.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you nervous about the result? Mark: Yes, a little. I still don't know how I did in the exam.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在为结果紧张吗？马克：是的，有一点。我还不知道自己考得怎么样。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在为结果紧张吗？
messages.en: Are you nervous about the result?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit. Għadni ma nafx kif mort fl-eżami.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit. Għadni ma nafx kif mort fl-eżami.
messages.zh: 是的，有一点。我还不知道自己考得怎么样。
messages.en: Yes, a little. I still don't know how I did in the exam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nervuż 贴在人物旁作形容词：等成绩时是“紧张的”，遇小事不耐烦时是“易烦躁的”，动辄发火时是“易怒的”。

gloss_zh: 荷兰的；荷兰男子；荷兰语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Netherlands, its people or their language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 荷兰的；与荷兰、荷兰人或荷兰语有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam man-Netherlands, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-lingwa tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 荷兰的；荷兰人的；荷兰语的。
荷兰男子；男性荷兰人。
荷兰语。

collocations.zh: 一位住在马耳他的荷兰男子

formal.mt: Il-mużew organizza wirja dwar artist Netherlandiż u pprovda informazzjoni bil-Malti u bin-Netherlandiż.
formal.en: The museum organized an exhibition about a Dutch artist and provided information in Maltese and Dutch.
formal.zh: 博物馆举办了一场关于一位荷兰艺术家的展览，并提供马耳他语和荷兰语介绍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed titgħallem in-Netherlandiż? Mark: Iva. Ħabib tiegħi huwa Netherlandiż u kultant nipprattika miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you learning Dutch? Mark: Yes. A friend of mine is a Dutchman, and I sometimes practise with him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你在学荷兰语吗？马克：是的。我的一位朋友是荷兰男子，我有时会跟他练习。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在学荷兰语吗？
messages.en: Are you learning Dutch?

messages.speaker: Mark (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Ħabib tiegħi huwa Netherlandiż u kultant nipprattika miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Ħabib tiegħi huwa Netherlandiż u kultant nipprattika miegħu.
messages.zh: 是的。我的一位朋友是荷兰男子，我有时会跟他练习。
messages.en: Yes. A friend of mine is a Dutchman, and I sometimes practise with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个句子位置记 Netherlandiż：修饰 artist 时是“荷兰的”，指一名男子时是“荷兰男子”，放在学习或说话的语境里是“荷兰语”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Neptunium, the name of a chemical element.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 镎，一种化学元素的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku li jissejjaħ nettunju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镎（化学元素）

formal.mt: Fit-test tal-kimika, l-istudenti kellhom jagħrfu n-nettunju bħala element kimiku.
formal.en: In the chemistry test, the students had to identify neptunium as a chemical element.
formal.zh: 在化学测验中，学生需要识别出镎是一种化学元素。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu n-nettunju? Pawlu: Huwa element kimiku; hawn qed nitkellmu dwar il-kimika.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is neptunium? Pawlu: It is a chemical element; we are talking about chemistry here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：nettunju 是什么？保罗：是镎，一种化学元素；这里谈的是化学。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: nettunju 是什么？
messages.en: What is neptunium?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku; hawn qed nitkellmu dwar il-kimika.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku; hawn qed nitkellmu dwar il-kimika.
messages.zh: 是镎，一种化学元素；这里谈的是化学。
messages.en: It is a chemical element; we are talking about chemistry here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nettunju 放进化学元素卡片，和表示海王星的 Nettunu 对照记忆：一个用于化学，一个用于天文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Neptune, a planet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海王星，一颗行星的专名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nettunu huwa l-isem ta' pjaneta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海王星（行星名称）

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-astronomija, l-istudenta inkludiet stampa tal-pjaneta Nettunu.
formal.en: In the astronomy report, the student included an image of the planet Neptune.
formal.zh: 在天文学报告中，这名学生加入了一张海王星的图片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema pjaneta hemm f'din l-istampa? Mark: Dik hija Nettunu; isimha miktub taħt l-istampa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which planet is in this picture? Mark: That is Neptune; its name is written below the picture.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张图片里是哪颗行星？马克：那是海王星；图片下面写着它的名字。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张图片里是哪颗行星？
messages.en: Which planet is in this picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hija Nettunu; isimha miktub taħt l-istampa.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hija Nettunu; isimha miktub taħt l-istampa.
messages.zh: 那是海王星；图片下面写着它的名字。
messages.en: That is Neptune; its name is written below the picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 Nettunu 配一张行星图片，并留意专名的大写字母 N；看到它就联想天文课里的海王星。

gloss_zh: 作物轮作；适宜降雨的时节；结果芽

teaching_sense.en_definition: Crop rotation or the appropriate season for rain; in another sense, a bud that produces fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指作物轮作或适宜降雨的时节；另一义指能够结果的芽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rotazzjoni tal-uċuħ tar-raba' jew iż-żmien xieraq għax-xita; f'tifsira oħra, għajn tal-pjanta li tagħti l-frott.

sense_translations.en_definition: Rotation (of crops), right season for rain
sense_translations.zh_definition: 作物轮作；适宜降雨的时节
能够结果的芽；结果芽

formal.mt: Il-manwal agrikolu jispjega n-newb tal-uċuħ tar-raba' permezz ta' eżempju fejn l-istess għalqa tintuża għal għelejjel differenti fi snin differenti.
formal.en: The agricultural manual explains crop rotation through an example in which the same field is used for different crops in different years.
formal.zh: 农业手册通过同一块田在不同年份种植不同作物的例子，解释作物轮作。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Din l-għajn fuq il-fergħa tagħti l-frott? Ġużeppi: Iva, dan hu newb li jagħti l-frott.
colloquial.en: Rita: Does this bud on the branch produce fruit? Ġużeppi: Yes, this is a fruit-producing bud.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：枝条上的这个芽能结果吗？朱塞佩：能，这是一个结果芽。

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-għajn fuq il-fergħa tagħti l-frott?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-għajn fuq il-fergħa tagħti l-frott?
messages.zh: 枝条上的这个芽能结果吗？
messages.en: Does this bud on the branch produce fruit?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan hu newb li jagħti l-frott.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan hu newb li jagħti l-frott.
messages.zh: 能，这是一个结果芽。
messages.en: Yes, this is a fruit-producing bud.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张农业图记 newb：田块轮换、应时降雨、枝头结果芽；这是三个义项提示，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Rotating: turning around or moving in rotation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旋转的、轮转的，形容事物转动或以轮转方式运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jdur jew jimxi b'rotazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旋转的；轮转的

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-moviment newbi tal-mekkaniżmu permezz ta' vleġġa tonda.
formal.en: The diagram shows the rotating movement of the mechanism by means of a circular arrow.
formal.zh: 该示意图用一个环形箭头表示机构的旋转运动。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser moviment newbi? David: Ifisser moviment li jdur, bħal dan fil-mudell.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does rotating movement mean? David: It means a movement that turns around, like this one in the model.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：moviment newbi 是什么意思？戴维：就是旋转运动，像模型里展示的这种运动。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: moviment newbi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does rotating movement mean?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser moviment li jdur, bħal dan fil-mudell.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser moviment li jdur, bħal dan fil-mudell.
messages.zh: 就是旋转运动，像模型里展示的这种运动。
messages.en: It means a movement that turns around, like this one in the model.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 newbi 写在环形箭头旁，连读 moviment newbi，记住它是描述旋转状态的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of handing something over to another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物递给另一个人的动作；一次递交或交付。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' xi ħaġa lil persuna oħra billi tgħaddihielha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物递交给某人的动作；一次交付

collocations.en: a handing over of the key
a handing over of the book to his companion

formal.mt: Fit-taħriġ, in-newla tad-dokument lil persuna oħra ntużat bħala eżempju ta' kif ngħaddu oġġett minn id għal oħra.
formal.en: In the training session, handing the document over to another person was used as an example of passing an object from one hand to another.
formal.zh: 培训中，把文件递交给另一个人的动作被用来示范如何将物品从一人手中传到另一人手中。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Xi tfisser newla? Luqa: Meta ngħaddilek dan il-ktieb, dik tkun newla tal-ktieb lilek.
colloquial.en: Emma: What does newla mean? Luqa: When I hand you this book, that is an act of handing the book over to you.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：newla 是什么意思？卢卡：我把这本书递给你，这个递书给你的动作就是 newla。

messages.speaker: Emma (马耳他语学员)
messages.zh: newla 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does newla mean?

messages.speaker: Luqa (语言教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta ngħaddilek dan il-ktieb, dik tkun newla tal-ktieb lilek.
messages.mt_standard: Meta ngħaddilek dan il-ktieb, dik tkun newla tal-ktieb lilek.
messages.zh: 我把这本书递给你，这个递书给你的动作就是 newla。
messages.en: When I hand you this book, that is an act of handing the book over to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本书从你的手递到同伴手里，把整个递交动作标成 newla，记住它是动作名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sleepy or drowsy feeling that follows a meal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃完一餐后出现的困倦感或睡意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ngħas li jiġi wara l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 饭后出现的困倦；餐后睡意

formal.mt: Fid-djarju tiegħu, l-awtur jiddeskrivi n-newm li ħass wara l-ikla ta' nofsinhar.
formal.en: In his diary, the author describes the drowsiness he felt after lunch.
formal.zh: 作者在日记中描述了自己午饭后的困倦感。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għala qed tagħlaq għajnejk? Pietru: Għadni kif kilt, u qed inħoss in-newm.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you closing your eyes? Pietru: I have just eaten, and I am feeling drowsy.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你怎么闭上眼睛了？彼得：我刚吃完饭，正犯困呢。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么闭上眼睛了？
messages.en: Why are you closing your eyes?

messages.speaker: Pietru (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni kif kilt, u qed inħoss in-newm.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni kif kilt, u qed inħoss in-newm.
messages.zh: 我刚吃完饭，正犯困呢。
messages.en: I have just eaten, and I am feeling drowsy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 newm 和午饭后的哈欠连在一起记：先吃完一餐，再眼皮发沉，重点是饭后出现的睡意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Drooping, or a state of languishing with little strength or vitality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 低垂、耷拉的状态；也指缺少力量或生气的萎靡、衰弱状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' xi ħaġa li titbaxxa jew tiddendel bla saħħa; ukoll stat ta' dgħufija u nuqqas ta' ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低垂；无力地耷拉着的状态
萎靡；衰弱；失去活力的状态

formal.mt: Fir-rapport dwar il-pjanti, l-istudenta ddeskriviet in-newn tal-weraq u n-nuqqas ta' ħajja fid-dehra tal-pjanta.
formal.en: In the report on plants, the student described the drooping of the leaves and the plant's lifeless appearance.
formal.zh: 在植物观察报告中，这名学生描述了叶片低垂以及植株缺乏生气的样子。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Qed tara n-newn tal-weraq? Ġanni: Iva, il-weraq imdendel u l-pjanta tidher bla saħħa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can you see the drooping of the leaves? Ġanni: Yes, the leaves are hanging down, and the plant looks weak.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你看见叶片低垂了吗？詹尼：看见了，叶子耷拉着，整株植物看起来没什么生气。

messages.speaker: Anna (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 你看见叶片低垂了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the drooping of the leaves?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-weraq imdendel u l-pjanta tidher bla saħħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-weraq imdendel u l-pjanta tidher bla saħħa.
messages.zh: 看见了，叶子耷拉着，整株植物看起来没什么生气。
messages.en: Yes, the leaves are hanging down, and the plant looks weak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用耷拉的叶片记 newn 的低垂义，再用整株植物无精打采的画面记萎靡义，把形态和状态一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Weak or lacking energy; languid in movement or manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体、声音或动作缺乏力量的，也可形容精神倦怠、行动缓慢无力的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dgħajjef jew bla enerġija; li jiċċaqlaq jew jaġixxi b'telqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虚弱的；力量微弱的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dgħajjef, bi ftit saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倦怠无力的；动作或神态慵懒迟缓的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bla enerġija u b'telqa fil-movimenti jew fl-imġiba.

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, ir-raġel wieġeb b'leħen newni u baqa' bilqiegħda biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: In the story, the man answered in a feeble voice and remained seated to rest.
formal.zh: 故事中，那名男子用微弱的声音回答，随后继续坐着休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed timxi daqshekk bil-mod? Pawlu: Illum inħossni newni; ħa nistrieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you walking so slowly? Pawlu: I feel weak today; I'll rest for a while.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么走得这么慢？保罗：我今天感觉没力气，先休息一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum inħossni newni; ħa nistrieħ ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Illum inħossni newni; ħa nistrieħ ftit.
messages.zh: 我今天感觉没力气，先休息一会儿。
messages.en: I feel weak today; I'll rest for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 newni 放进“声音微弱、走路没劲”的画面里：身体力量不足记“虚弱”，动作精神低落记“倦怠”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who rotates or alternates, for example by taking turns with others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与轮替或交替进行某项活动的人，例如与其他人轮流承担同一项任务的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li talterna jew tieħu sehem b'rotazzjoni ma' oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进行轮替或交替的人；轮流参与者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd li jalterna jew jieħu sehem b'rotazzjoni.

collocations.en: a person taking turns within the group
the role of a person who alternates

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, kull newwieb jaqra sentenza meta jasal imissu.
formal.en: In this exercise, each person taking turns reads a sentence when their turn comes.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，每位轮替参与者轮到自己时读一个句子。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi jfisser newwieb hawn? Mark: Xi ħadd li jalterna mal-oħrajn; naqraw sentenza kull wieħed.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does newwieb mean here? Mark: Someone who takes turns with the others; we each read one sentence.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这里的 newwieb 是什么意思？马克：就是跟其他人轮流参与的人；我们每人读一句。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.zh: 这里的 newwieb 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does newwieb mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd li jalterna mal-oħrajn; naqraw sentenza kull wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd li jalterna mal-oħrajn; naqraw sentenza kull wieħed.
messages.zh: 就是跟其他人轮流参与的人；我们每人读一句。
messages.en: Someone who takes turns with the others; we each read one sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小组围成一圈，每人轮流读一句；把 newwieb 贴在“轮到的那个人”身上，记住它指参与轮替的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who weaves on a loom; in another sense, a person who passes something to someone else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在织机上进行编织的人；另一个义项指把某物递给别人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem fuq in-newl; f'sens ieħor, persuna li tgħaddi xi ħaġa lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: a weaver working on a loom
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用织机工作的织工。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tinseġ fuq in-newl.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who passes sth. to another
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物递给另一个人的人；递物者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd li jgħaddi xi ħaġa lil persuna oħra.

collocations.en: a weaver working at the loom
a person who passes the tools

formal.mt: Il-newwiel ħadem fuq in-newl biex jinsiġ biċċa drapp tas-suf.
formal.en: The weaver worked at the loom to weave a piece of woollen cloth.
formal.zh: 织工在织机上工作，织出一块羊毛布。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Newwiel dejjem ifisser persuna li tinseġ? Pietru: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll xi ħadd li jgħaddi xi ħaġa lil persuna oħra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does newwiel always mean a person who weaves? Pietru: No, it can also mean someone who passes something to another person.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：newwiel 总是指织工吗？彼得：不是，也可以指把东西递给别人的人。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Newwiel dejjem ifisser persuna li tinseġ?
messages.mt_standard: Newwiel dejjem ifisser persuna li tinseġ?
messages.zh: newwiel 总是指织工吗？
messages.en: Does newwiel always mean a person who weaves?

messages.speaker: Pietru (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll xi ħadd li jgħaddi xi ħaġa lil persuna oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jista' jfisser ukoll xi ħadd li jgħaddi xi ħaġa lil persuna oħra.
messages.zh: 不是，也可以指把东西递给别人的人。
messages.en: No, it can also mean someone who passes something to another person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 newwiel 画两张人物卡：一人在织机前织布，一人伸手递东西；用上下文选择“织工”或“递物者”。

gloss_zh: 双齿扬谷铲；畜力磨漏斗木轮；地名组成部分

teaching_sense.en_definition: A two-pronged agricultural shovel or fork used for winnowing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种带两个叉齿、用于扬谷的农具，形似铲或草叉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda agrikola b'żewġ snien, bħal pala jew furkettun, li tintuża biex tiddra l-qamħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: a two-pronged winnowing shovel, a kind of pitchfork
sense_translations.zh_definition: 带两个叉齿的扬谷铲，一种草叉状农具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pala b'żewġ snien biex tiddra, tip ta' furkettun.

sense_translations.en_definition: a wooden wheel with a 6" diameter attached to the funnel of an animal-operated mill
sense_translations.zh_definition: 安装在畜力磨漏斗上的木轮，直径为六英寸。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rota tal-injam b'dijametru ta' sitt pulzieri, imwaħħla mal-lembut ta' mitħna mħaddma bl-annimali.

sense_translations.en_definition: (topnymy) ras in-newwiela, name of a headland in the south of gozo
sense_translations.zh_definition: （地名）Ras in-Newwiela，戈佐岛南部一处海岬的名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-ġeografija, Ras in-Newwiela huwa l-isem ta' ras ta' art fin-nofsinhar ta' Għawdex.

collocations.en: Ras in-Newwiela, a headland in southern Gozo
collocations.zh: Ras in-Newwiela，戈佐岛南部的一处海岬

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-għodda tispjega li n-newwiela għandha żewġ snien u tintuża biex tiddra l-qamħ.
formal.en: The tool description explains that the winnowing shovel has two prongs and is used to winnow wheat.
formal.zh: 农具说明指出，这种扬谷铲有两个叉齿，用于扬除小麦中的糠杂。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawn newwiela tfisser l-għodda tal-għalqa? Ġużeppi: Iva, dik b'żewġ snien; f'test dwar mitħna tista' tfisser rota tal-injam, u Ras in-Newwiela huwa isem ta' post.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does newwiela mean the farm tool here? Ġużeppi: Yes, the one with two prongs; in a text about a mill it can mean a wooden wheel, and Ras in-Newwiela is a place name.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的 newwiela 指田里的农具吗？朱塞佩：是，指双齿的那种；在谈磨坊的文章里也可能指木轮，而 Ras in-Newwiela 是地名。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 newwiela 指田里的农具吗？
messages.en: Does newwiela mean the farm tool here?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik b'żewġ snien; f'test dwar mitħna tista' tfisser rota tal-injam, u Ras in-Newwiela huwa isem ta' post.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik b'żewġ snien; f'test dwar mitħna tista' tfisser rota tal-injam, u Ras in-Newwiela huwa isem ta' post.
messages.zh: 是，指双齿的那种；在谈磨坊的文章里也可能指木轮，而 Ras in-Newwiela 是地名。
messages.en: Yes, the one with two prongs; in a text about a mill it can mean a wooden wheel, and Ras in-Newwiela is a place name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅互不混淆的图记 newwiela：田里的双齿扬谷铲、磨坊漏斗上的六英寸木轮、地图上的 Ras in-Newwiela 海岬。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used for handing something over to another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于将某物递交给另一个人的，描述递交物品这一用途。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintuża biex jgħaddi xi ħaġa lil persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于递交某物的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jintuża biex jgħaddi xi ħaġa lil ħaddieħor.

collocations.en: a means used for handing something over
collocations.zh: 用于递交物品的手段或工具

collocations.en: a mechanism used for passing something over

formal.mt: Fil-mudell deskritt, il-mekkaniżmu newwieli jgħaddi l-biċċa lill-ħaddiem.
formal.en: In the model described, the handover mechanism passes the piece to the worker.
formal.zh: 在所描述的模型中，用于递交物品的机构将零件递给工人。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi jfisser newwieli f'din id-deskrizzjoni? Samwel: Ifisser li l-mezz jintuża biex jgħaddi xi ħaġa lil ħaddieħor.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does newwieli mean in this description? Samwel: It means that the device is used to hand something over to someone else.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这段说明里的 newwieli 是什么意思？萨缪尔：意思是这个工具用于把东西递给别人。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 这段说明里的 newwieli 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does newwieli mean in this description?

messages.speaker: Samwel (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-mezz jintuża biex jgħaddi xi ħaġa lil ħaddieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-mezz jintuża biex jgħaddi xi ħaġa lil ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 意思是这个工具用于把东西递给别人。
messages.en: It means that the device is used to hand something over to someone else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 newwieli 写在一张“用途：递交物品”的标签上，再贴到工具旁；这样记住它是描述用途的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing sleepiness; in a separate sense, giving off a faint light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人产生睡意、具有催眠作用的；另一个义项指发出微弱光亮的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib in-ngħas; f'sens ieħor, li jagħti dawl ħafif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 催眠的；令人昏昏欲睡的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġib in-ngħas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出微光的；隐约闪亮的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiddi b'dawl ħafif.

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-ħoss ripetut għandu effett newwiemi, filwaqt li d-dawl newwiemi fit-tieqa jiddi biss ftit.
formal.en: In the text, the repetitive sound has a soporific effect, while the glimmering light in the window shines only faintly.
formal.zh: 文中，反复的声音令人产生睡意，而窗中的微光只隐约闪亮。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Newwiemi jista' jiddeskrivi kemm ħoss kif ukoll dawl? Adam: Iva; ħoss newwiemi jġib in-ngħas, imma dawl newwiemi jiddi biss ftit.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can newwiemi describe both a sound and a light? Adam: Yes; a soporific sound makes you sleepy, but a glimmering light shines only faintly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：newwiemi 既能形容声音，也能形容光吗？亚当：能；形容声音时表示令人困倦，形容光时则表示隐约闪亮。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Newwiemi jista' jiddeskrivi kemm ħoss kif ukoll dawl?
messages.mt_standard: Newwiemi jista' jiddeskrivi kemm ħoss kif ukoll dawl?
messages.zh: newwiemi 既能形容声音，也能形容光吗？
messages.en: Can newwiemi describe both a sound and a light?

messages.speaker: Adam (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva; ħoss newwiemi jġib in-ngħas, imma dawl newwiemi jiddi biss ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva; ħoss newwiemi jġib in-ngħas, imma dawl newwiemi jiddi biss ftit.
messages.zh: 能；形容声音时表示令人困倦，形容光时则表示隐约闪亮。
messages.en: Yes; a soporific sound makes you sleepy, but a glimmering light shines only faintly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象夜里听着重复的声音打瞌睡，窗边还亮着一点微光；用“声音催眠、光线微亮”分别记住 newwiemi 的两个义项。

gloss_zh: 受雇哭丧的女子；女哭丧人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman hired to mourn at a burial.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在安葬仪式中受雇表达哀悼、哭丧的女子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara mqabbda bi ħlas biex tibki u tesprimi n-niket waqt difna.

sense_translations.en_definition: a hired mourner for a burial
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受雇在安葬仪式上哭丧的女子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mara mqabbda bi ħlas biex tibki waqt difna.

collocations.en: a hired female mourner at the burial
collocations.zh: 安葬仪式上的女哭丧人

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-familja tqabbad newwieħa biex tibki waqt id-difna.
formal.en: In the novel, the family hires a female mourner to weep at the burial.
formal.zh: 小说中，这家人雇用了一名女子在安葬仪式上哭丧。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-mara li qed tibki fl-istorja hija qariba? Toni: Le, hija newwieħa; il-familja qabbditilha biex tibki waqt id-difna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the woman crying in the story a relative? Toni: No, she is a hired mourner; the family hired her to weep at the burial.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：故事里那个哭泣的女人是亲属吗？托尼：不是，她是受雇的哭丧人；这家人请她在安葬仪式上哭丧。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mara li qed tibki fl-istorja hija qariba?
messages.mt_standard: Il-mara li qed tibki fl-istorja hija qariba?
messages.zh: 故事里那个哭泣的女人是亲属吗？
messages.en: Is the woman crying in the story a relative?

messages.speaker: Toni (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hija newwieħa; il-familja qabbditilha biex tibki waqt id-difna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hija newwieħa; il-familja qabbditilha biex tibki waqt id-difna.
messages.zh: 不是，她是受雇的哭丧人；这家人请她在安葬仪式上哭丧。
messages.en: No, she is a hired mourner; the family hired her to weep at the burial.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时同时抓住“安葬、受雇、哭丧女子”三个要点；newwieħa 不是泛指任何正在伤心哭泣的人。

gloss_zh: 爱哼哼抱怨的；牢骚多的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to whine or to complain frequently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易用哼哼唧唧的方式表达不满，或经常抱怨、发牢骚的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jeqred jew jilmenta ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱哼哼唧唧地抱怨的；惯于带着委屈口气发牢骚的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jeqred.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常抱怨的；牢骚很多的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jilmenta ħafna.

collocations.en: a boy who tends to whine
a character who complains a lot

formal.mt: L-awtur jippreżenta karattru newwieħi li jilmenta dwar kull bidla fil-pjan.
formal.en: The author presents a character who complains about every change to the plan.
formal.zh: 作者塑造了一个牢骚很多的人物，计划稍有变化就会抱怨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tgħid li l-karattru huwa newwieħi? David: Għax il-ħin kollu jilmenta, anki meta kollox imur tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you saying the character is whiny? David: Because he complains all the time, even when everything goes well.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说这个人物爱发牢骚？戴维：因为他总是在抱怨，连一切顺利时也一样。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħid li l-karattru huwa newwieħi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħid li l-karattru huwa newwieħi?
messages.zh: 你为什么说这个人物爱发牢骚？
messages.en: Why are you saying the character is whiny?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-ħin kollu jilmenta, anki meta kollox imur tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-ħin kollu jilmenta, anki meta kollox imur tajjeb.
messages.zh: 因为他总是在抱怨，连一切顺利时也一样。
messages.en: Because he complains all the time, even when everything goes well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个角色一路哼哼唧唧，对每件小事都抱怨；newwieħi 把“抱怨的口气”和“经常抱怨的习惯”连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sound or act of crying in sobs, whimpering, or wailing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 抽泣、低声呜咽或放声哀号的声音或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biki b'sulluzzu, b'leħen baxx jew b'għajjat ta' niket.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽泣；一抽一噎地哭泣
呜咽；低声而断续地哭泣或哼哭
哀号；放声悲哭

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-newħ tal-omm juri n-niket tagħha wara l-aħbar.
formal.en: In the story, the mother's wailing reveals her grief after hearing the news.
formal.zh: 在故事中，母亲的哀号表现了她听到消息后的悲痛。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tisma' dak in-newħ? Toni: Iva, it-tifel qed jibki. Se mmur ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you hear that sobbing? Toni: Yes, the boy is crying. I will go over to him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你听见那阵抽泣声了吗？托尼：听见了，那个男孩在哭。我过去看看他。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.zh: 你听见那阵抽泣声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that sobbing?

messages.speaker: Toni (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tifel qed jibki. Se mmur ħdejh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tifel qed jibki. Se mmur ħdejh.
messages.zh: 听见了，那个男孩在哭。我过去看看他。
messages.en: Yes, the boy is crying. I will go over to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 newħ 配三种哭声画面：一抽一噎、低声呜咽、放声哀号；用声音场景区分三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who removes something, such as stones, weeds, or obstacles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物移走或清除的人，例如清除石块、杂草或障碍的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tneħħi xi ħaġa, bħal ġebel, ħaxix ħażin jew ostakli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 移除某物的人；清除者。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem kellu r-rwol ta' neħħej tal-ġebel biex il-mogħdija tkun sigura.
formal.en: The worker had the role of removing stones to make the path safe.
formal.zh: 这名工人负责清除石块，以确保小路安全。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'neħħej'? Pawlu: Xi ħadd li jneħħi xi ħaġa, bħal min ineħħi l-ġebel minn mogħdija.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'neħħej' mean? Pawlu: Someone who removes something, like a person clearing stones from a path.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：neħħej 是什么意思？保罗：就是移除某物的人，比如清除路上石块的人。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: neħħej 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'neħħej' mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd li jneħħi xi ħaġa, bħal min ineħħi l-ġebel minn mogħdija.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd li jneħħi xi ħaġa, bħal min ineħħi l-ġebel minn mogħdija.
messages.zh: 就是移除某物的人，比如清除路上石块的人。
messages.en: Someone who removes something, like a person clearing stones from a path.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位工人把路上的石块逐个搬走，用这个人物画面记住“移除者”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deprive someone of something they possess, including a position or office.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 夺去某人拥有的东西，也可指剥夺其职位或职务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċaħħad lil xi ħadd minn xi ħaġa li għandu, inkluża kariga.

sense_translations.en_definition: to strip, rid somebody of; to take (something) away from somebody
sense_translations.zh_definition: 剥夺某人拥有的东西；从某人手中夺去某物。
免去某人的职务；将某人撤职。

collocations.mt: neżża' lill-vittma minn kull ma kellha
collocations.en: stripped the victim of everything she had
collocations.zh: 夺走了受害者拥有的一切

collocations.en: removed the director from his post

formal.mt: Il-kunsill neżża' lid-direttur mill-kariga tiegħu wara li eżamina r-rapport.
formal.en: The council removed the director from his post after examining the report.
formal.zh: 委员会审阅报告后，免去了主任的职务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lill-mara li kienet ħdejn il-ħanut? Pawlu: Ħalliel neżża' lill-mara minn kull ma kellha fil-basket.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the woman who was beside the shop? Pawlu: A thief took everything she had in her bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：商店旁边的那位女士怎么了？保罗：一个小偷把她包里的东西全偷走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara lill-mara li kienet ħdejn il-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara lill-mara li kienet ħdejn il-ħanut?
messages.zh: 商店旁边的那位女士怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the woman who was beside the shop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħalliel neżża' lill-mara minn kull ma kellha fil-basket.
messages.mt_standard: Ħalliel neżża' lill-mara minn kull ma kellha fil-basket.
messages.zh: 一个小偷把她包里的东西全偷走了。
messages.en: A thief took everything she had in her bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把钱包被夺走和职位被撤去两个画面并排记忆：共同点都是某人失去了原本拥有的东西。

gloss_zh: 脱衣者；帮助或使别人脱衣的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who undresses or who helps or causes other people to undress.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自己脱衣，或帮助、促使别人脱衣的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tinża' jew li tgħin jew iġġiegħel lil ħaddieħor jinża'.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who undresses or causes others to undress
sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱衣的人，或使别人脱衣的人。

collocations.en: a person who helps actors undress
works as someone who helps others undress
collocations.zh: 从事帮助别人脱衣的工作

formal.mt: Fit-teatru, in-neżżiegħ għen lill-attur ineħħi l-kostum tqil wara x-xena.
formal.en: At the theatre, the person assisting with undressing helped the actor remove his heavy costume after the scene.
formal.zh: 在剧院里，负责协助脱衣的人在一场戏结束后，帮助演员脱下了厚重的戏服。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jgħin lill-atturi jneħħu l-kostumi? Mark: In-neżżiegħ se jgħinhom wara x-xena.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will help the actors take off their costumes? Mark: The person assisting with undressing will help them after the scene.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来帮演员脱戏服？马克：负责协助脱衣的人会在这场戏结束后帮他们。

messages.speaker: Maja (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jgħin lill-atturi jneħħu l-kostumi?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jgħin lill-atturi jneħħu l-kostumi?
messages.zh: 谁来帮演员脱戏服？
messages.en: Who will help the actors take off their costumes?

messages.speaker: Mark (舞台工作人员)
messages.zh: 负责协助脱衣的人会在这场戏结束后帮他们。
messages.en: The person assisting with undressing will help them after the scene.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象后台有人帮助演员脱下厚戏服，把这个词记成指人的名词，重点落在谁在脱衣或帮人脱衣。

gloss_zh: 使身体裸露的；使树叶脱落的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to expose the body or to cause leaves to fall from plants.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易使身体裸露的；也可形容容易使植物落叶的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jikxef il-ġisem jew li jġiegħel il-weraq jaqa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于使人裸露身体的；容易造成裸露的。

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to cause leaves to fall
sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于使树叶脱落的；具有促使落叶作用的。

collocations.zh: 使身体较为裸露的款式

collocations.en: an effect that causes leaves to fall

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi l-isprej bħala neżżiegħi għax iġiegħel il-weraq jaqa'.
formal.en: The author describes the spray as defoliating because it causes leaves to fall.
formal.zh: 作者将这种喷剂描述为具有落叶作用，因为它会使叶片脱落。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-flokk hu neżżiegħi wisq għal ċerimonja. Pawla: Se nilbes ġakketta fuqu biex inkun aktar mgħottija.
colloquial.en: Maja: This top is too revealing for a ceremony. Pawla: I'll wear a jacket over it to cover up more.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这件上衣太暴露，不太适合典礼。葆拉：我会在外面穿件夹克，多遮住一些。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-flokk hu neżżiegħi wisq għal ċerimonja.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-flokk hu neżżiegħi wisq għal ċerimonja.
messages.zh: 这件上衣太暴露，不太适合典礼。
messages.en: This top is too revealing for a ceremony.

messages.speaker: Pawla (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nilbes ġakketta fuqu biex inkun aktar mgħottija.
messages.mt_standard: Se nilbes ġakketta fuqu biex inkun aktar mgħottija.
messages.zh: 我会在外面穿件夹克，多遮住一些。
messages.en: I'll wear a jacket over it to cover up more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个裸露画面联想：身体少了衣物遮盖，树枝少了叶片遮盖；这个形容词描述促成这些结果的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be trusted or regarded as someone who can be relied on.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到别人的信任，被认为是可以依靠或托付事情的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun meqjus bħala persuna li ħaddieħor jista' joqgħod fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到信任；被人信赖。

formal.mt: Il-kaxxier nfada bil-ġestjoni tal-flus tal-għaqda.
formal.en: The treasurer was trusted with managing the association's money.
formal.zh: 财务负责人受到信任，被托付管理协会的钱款。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-flus tal-ħarġa? Mark: Pawlu nfada bihom, għax dejjem joqgħod attent.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will look after the money for the outing? Mark: Pawlu was trusted with it because he's always careful.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来保管这次出游的钱？马克：大家信任保罗，把钱交给了他，因为他一向很细心。

messages.speaker: Maja (出游组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-flus tal-ħarġa?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb il-flus tal-ħarġa?
messages.zh: 谁来保管这次出游的钱？
messages.en: Who will look after the money for the outing?

messages.speaker: Mark (出游参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu nfada bihom, għax dejjem joqgħod attent.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu nfada bihom, għax dejjem joqgħod attent.
messages.zh: 大家信任保罗，把钱交给了他，因为他一向很细心。
messages.en: Pawlu was trusted with it because he's always careful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家把装钱的信封放心交给一个人，记住句中这个人是受到信任、接受托付的一方。

gloss_zh: 被扼住喉咙；嫉妒得难受

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be squeezed by the throat; figuratively, to feel very intense jealousy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人扼住或勒紧喉咙；也可比喻感到极其强烈的嫉妒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqabad u jingħafas minn għonqu; b'mod figurattiv, iħoss għira kbira ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扼住喉咙；被掐住或勒紧脖子。
非常嫉妒；嫉妒得难受。

formal.mt: Skont ix-xhieda, ir-raġel nfaga meta l-aggressur qabdu minn għonqu.
formal.en: According to the witnesses, the man was throttled when the attacker grabbed him by the throat.
formal.zh: 据目击者陈述，袭击者抓住那名男子的喉咙，将他扼住。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ħassu Pawlu meta ra l-premju ta' ħuh? Mark: Nfaga bl-għira, iżda mbagħad feraħlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu feel when he saw his brother's prize? Mark: He was intensely jealous, but then he congratulated him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗看到哥哥的奖品时是什么感受？马克：他嫉妒得难受，不过后来还是向哥哥道了贺。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ħassu Pawlu meta ra l-premju ta' ħuh?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ħassu Pawlu meta ra l-premju ta' ħuh?
messages.zh: 保罗看到哥哥的奖品时是什么感受？
messages.en: How did Pawlu feel when he saw his brother's prize?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他嫉妒得难受，不过后来还是向哥哥道了贺。
messages.en: He was intensely jealous, but then he congratulated him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用喉咙被紧紧扼住的画面记具体义，再用嫉妒堵在心口的夸张画面记情绪义；这是学习联想。

gloss_zh: 破裂；爆炸；暴怒；哭起来；被过度稀释；吃饱

teaching_sense.en_definition: To burst or explode; also to become enraged, start weeping, become excessively diluted, or have eaten enough, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示破裂或爆炸；依语境也可表示勃然大怒、哭起来、被过度稀释或已经吃饱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqasam f'daqqa jew jisplodi; skont il-kuntest, jirrabja ħafna, jibda jibki, jitraqqaq iżżejjed jew ikun kiel biżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然破裂；胀裂。
爆炸；炸开。
勃然大怒；突然变得十分愤怒。
开始哭泣；一下子哭起来。
被过度稀释，变得过于稀淡。
已经吃够；吃饱。

collocations.en: the tea became excessively diluted with water

formal.mt: Il-pajp nfaqa' matul il-lejl, u l-ilma għarraq parti mill-maħżen.
formal.en: The pipe burst during the night, and the water flooded part of the warehouse.
formal.zh: 水管在夜间爆裂，水淹没了仓库的一部分。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark telaq mill-kamra? Pawlu: Nfaqa' jibki meta sama' l-aħbar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark leave the room? Pawlu: He burst into tears when he heard the news.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么离开房间了？保罗：他听到那个消息后，一下子哭了起来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么离开房间了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave the room?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他听到那个消息后，一下子哭了起来。
messages.en: He burst into tears when he heard the news.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做六格记忆卡：水管裂、装置炸、怒气起、眼泪落、茶太淡、人吃饱。分别配语境记忆，避免把所有意思都译成爆炸。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To emerge from an egg after developing inside it; to be hatched.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在卵内发育后孵化出来，破壳而出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ mill-bajda wara li jkun żviluppa ġewwa fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被孵化出来；从卵中破壳而出。

formal.mt: Il-fellus nfaqas fl-inkubatur wara perjodu ta' żvilupp fil-bajda.
formal.en: The chick hatched in the incubator after a period of development inside the egg.
formal.zh: 小鸡在蛋内发育一段时间后，在孵化器中破壳而出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-fellus għadu fil-bajda? Pawlu: Le, nfaqas dalgħodu u issa qiegħed ħdejn ommu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the chick still inside the egg? Pawlu: No, it hatched this morning and is now beside its mother.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小鸡还在蛋里吗？保罗：不，它今天早上孵出来了，现在就在母鸡旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (农场访客)
messages.zh: 小鸡还在蛋里吗？
messages.en: Is the chick still inside the egg?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nfaqas dalgħodu u issa qiegħed ħdejn ommu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nfaqas dalgħodu u issa qiegħed ħdejn ommu.
messages.zh: 不，它今天早上孵出来了，现在就在母鸡旁边。
messages.en: No, it hatched this morning and is now beside its mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蛋壳裂开、小鸡探出头的完整画面；这个词强调小生命孵化出来，可以和单纯的物体破裂作语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have blood drawn by bleeding; also, to become extremely angry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被施以放血；也可表示变得极其愤怒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittieħed id-demm minn xi ħadd; ukoll, xi ħadd jagħdab ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被放血。
变得暴怒；勃然大怒。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-pazjent nfasad waqt it-trattament.
formal.en: In the story, the patient was bled during treatment.
formal.zh: 故事中，病人在治疗过程中被施以放血。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark telaq hekk? Lara: Nfasad bir-rabja meta sema' l-aħbar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark leave like that? Lara: He became enraged when he heard the news.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark为什么那样走了？Lara：他听到消息后勃然大怒。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark为什么那样走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave like that?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他听到消息后勃然大怒。
messages.en: He became enraged when he heard the news.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面分别记忆：病人接受放血，听到坏消息的人突然暴怒；靠语境区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be weaned, to be divided, or to overcome a bad habit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 断奶；被分开；或摆脱、戒除一种不良习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieqaf jieħu l-ħalib tas-sider, jinqasam, jew jegħleb drawwa ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 断奶；不再依靠母乳喂养。
被分开；被划分。
克服不良习惯；戒除恶习。

collocations.en: The group was divided into two parts.
collocations.zh: 这个小组被分成了两部分。

formal.mt: It-tifel nfatam gradwalment hekk kif beda jiekol aktar ikel solidu.
formal.en: The boy was gradually weaned as he began eating more solid food.
formal.zh: 随着男孩开始吃更多固体食物，他逐渐断奶了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħuk għadu jpejjep? Maja: Le, fl-aħħar nfatam minn dak il-vizzju.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does your brother still smoke? Maja: No, he finally overcame that habit.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你兄弟还抽烟吗？Maja：不抽了，他终于戒掉那个习惯了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟还抽烟吗？
messages.en: Does your brother still smoke?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fl-aħħar nfatam minn dak il-vizzju.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fl-aħħar nfatam minn dak il-vizzju.
messages.zh: 不抽了，他终于戒掉那个习惯了。
messages.en: No, he finally overcame that habit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把断奶、分组、戒烟画成三张学习卡：分别记住脱离乳汁、分成部分、摆脱习惯三个使用场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have blood come from the nose; to have a nosebleed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼻子出血，即流鼻血。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġlu d-demm minn imnieħru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流鼻血；发生鼻出血。

collocations.en: had a nosebleed during the game

formal.mt: It-tifel nfaġar waqt il-lezzjoni u talab l-għajnuna tal-għalliem.
formal.en: The boy had a nosebleed during the lesson and asked the teacher for help.
formal.zh: 男孩在上课时流鼻血，向老师寻求帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lil ħuk waqt il-logħba? Pawlu: Nfaġar, u l-kowċ ħadu jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to your brother during the game? Pawlu: He had a nosebleed, and the coach took him to rest.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你弟弟比赛时怎么了？保罗：他流鼻血了，教练带他去休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你弟弟比赛时怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your brother during the game?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (哥哥)
messages.zh: 他流鼻血了，教练带他去休息。
messages.en: He had a nosebleed, and the coach took him to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和鼻子下方出现血迹的画面一起记忆，准确锁定流鼻血这一具体情况。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be redeemed or bought back; also, for money spent to be recovered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被赎回或赎出；也指已经支出的款项得到收回。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħeles bi ħlas jew jinxtara lura; ukoll, ammont minfuq jerġa' jinkiseb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被赎回；被赎出。
得到收回；得到补偿，用于已经支出的费用。

formal.mt: Il-priġunier nfeda wara li l-familja tiegħu ħallset is-somma mitluba.
formal.en: The prisoner was redeemed after his family paid the requested sum.
formal.zh: 囚犯的家人支付了所要求的款项后，他被赎出了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Irkuprajtu l-flus tal-avveniment? Lara: Iva, l-ammont kollu li nfaq nfeda bil-bejgħ tal-biljetti.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did you recover the money spent on the event? Lara: Yes, the entire amount spent was recovered through ticket sales.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你们收回活动的开支了吗？Lara：收回了，全部开支都通过售票收回来了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 你们收回活动的开支了吗？
messages.en: Did you recover the money spent on the event?

messages.speaker: Lara (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-ammont kollu li nfaq nfeda bil-bejgħ tal-biljetti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-ammont kollu li nfaq nfeda bil-bejgħ tal-biljetti.
messages.zh: 收回了，全部开支都通过售票收回来了。
messages.en: Yes, the entire amount spent was recovered through ticket sales.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个“回来”的画面：人被赎回来，花出去的钱收回来；主语是人还是款项有助于判断词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be understood; also, to be settled or accepted by agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被理解、被领会；也指某事经各方协商而确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħsieb jew it-tifsir tiegħu jinftiehem; ukoll, jiġi stabbilit bi qbil bejn il-partijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被理解；被领会。
经协商确定；得到各方同意。

collocations.zh: 这条信息被正确理解了。

collocations.en: The price was agreed upon beforehand.

formal.mt: Il-messaġġ nfehem sew mill-parteċipanti wara li ngħataw żewġ eżempji.
formal.en: The message was understood correctly by the participants after they were given two examples.
formal.zh: 在获得两个例子后，参与者正确理解了这条信息。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm se nħallsu? Lara: Il-prezz nfehem ilbieraħ: għoxrin ewro għal kull persuna.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much will we pay? Lara: The price was agreed upon yesterday: twenty euros per person.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们要付多少钱？Lara：价格昨天商定了，每人二十欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 我们要付多少钱？
messages.en: How much will we pay?

messages.speaker: Lara (活动负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prezz nfehem ilbieraħ: għoxrin ewro għal kull persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-prezz nfehem ilbieraħ: għoxrin ewro għal kull persuna.
messages.zh: 价格昨天商定了，每人二十欧元。
messages.en: The price was agreed upon yesterday: twenty euros per person.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“信息听懂了、价格谈妥了”配对记忆：前者是理解内容，后者是各方达成一致。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be examined very carefully, with close attention to details.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到细致检查或审查，尤其强调逐项关注细节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi eżaminat bir-reqqa u b'attenzjoni kbira għad-dettalji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被仔细审查；受到细致检查。

collocations.en: The report was scrutinised in detail.

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt nfela bir-reqqa qabel ma ġie ffirmat miż-żewġ partijiet.
formal.en: The contract was scrutinised carefully before it was signed by both parties.
formal.zh: 合同在双方签署之前受到了仔细审查。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-rapport lest biex jintbagħat? Mark: Iva, diġà nfela fid-dettall u kkoreġejna żewġ żbalji.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the report ready to send? Mark: Yes, it has already been scrutinised in detail, and we corrected two errors.
colloquial.zh: Maja：报告可以发送了吗？Mark：可以了，已经详细检查过，我们还改正了两个错误。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 报告可以发送了吗？
messages.en: Is the report ready to send?

messages.speaker: Mark (报告撰写者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà nfela fid-dettall u kkoreġejna żewġ żbalji.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà nfela fid-dettall u kkoreġejna żewġ żbalji.
messages.zh: 可以了，已经详细检查过，我们还改正了两个错误。
messages.en: Yes, it has already been scrutinised in detail, and we corrected two errors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着放大镜逐行检查合同，把这个词与“每个细节都被查看”的画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be borne or endured, as a burden, difficulty, or pain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被承受或被忍受，可用于重担、困难或痛苦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġarrab jew issapportat, bħal piż, diffikultà jew uġigħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被承受；被承担；被忍受。

collocations.en: The burden was borne by one person.

formal.mt: Il-piż kollu tax-xogħol nfelaħ minn persuna waħda matul dik il-ġimgħa.
formal.en: The entire workload was borne by one person during that week.
formal.zh: 那一周，全部工作负担都由一个人承担了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min għamel ix-xogħol kollu meta kont nieqsa? Mark: Il-piż kollu nfelaħ minn Pawlu, imma llum se ngħinuh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who did all the work while I was away? Mark: The whole burden was borne by Pawlu, but today we will help him.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我不在的时候，全部工作是谁做的？Mark：全部负担都由Pawlu承担了，不过今天我们会帮他。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għamel ix-xogħol kollu meta kont nieqsa?
messages.mt_standard: Min għamel ix-xogħol kollu meta kont nieqsa?
messages.zh: 我不在的时候，全部工作是谁做的？
messages.en: Who did all the work while I was away?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-piż kollu nfelaħ minn Pawlu, imma llum se ngħinuh.
messages.mt_standard: Il-piż kollu nfelaħ minn Pawlu, imma llum se ngħinuh.
messages.zh: 全部负担都由Pawlu承担了，不过今天我们会帮他。
messages.en: The whole burden was borne by Pawlu, but today we will help him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象重担被肩膀稳稳托住：句子的焦点是“负担被承受”，也可把重担换成需要忍受的疼痛。

gloss_zh: 变得筋疲力尽；变得虚弱

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become exhausted or to lose strength and become weak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得筋疲力尽，或失去力气而变得虚弱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jegħja ħafna jew jitlef saħħtu u jsir dgħajjef.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得筋疲力尽；累得精疲力竭。
变得虚弱；体力或力量衰弱。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem nfena wara sigħat twal ta' xogħol mingħajr mistrieħ.
formal.en: The worker became exhausted after long hours of work without rest.
formal.zh: 工人长时间工作而没有休息，最后筋疲力尽。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu għadu fis-sodda? Lara: Nfena bil-mard u għad għandu bżonn jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu still in bed? Lara: He became weak through illness and still needs to rest.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu为什么还躺在床上？Lara：他因病变得虚弱，还需要休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么还躺在床上？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu still in bed?

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nfena bil-mard u għad għandu bżonn jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Nfena bil-mard u għad għandu bżonn jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 他因病变得虚弱，还需要休息。
messages.en: He became weak through illness and still needs to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用电池电量下降的画面记忆：工作后耗尽对应筋疲力尽，生病后电量不足对应身体虚弱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become separated or to be kept apart from another person, thing, or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一人、物或群体分开，或被安排保持分离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqasam jew jinżamm separat minn persuna, ħaġa jew grupp ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被分开；与其他人或物分离。
被隔开；被安排保持分离状态。

collocations.en: The group was divided into two.
collocations.zh: 这个群体被分成了两组。

collocations.en: The boy became separated from his friends.

formal.mt: Għall-attività, il-grupp nferaq f'żewġ timijiet, u kull tim ħadem f'kamra differenti.
formal.en: For the activity, the group was divided into two teams, and each team worked in a different room.
formal.zh: 活动中，这个群体被分成两个小组，各自在不同的房间工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Mark? Nferaq minna fil-folla. Lara: Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb. Ejja mmorru ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Mark? He got separated from us in the crowd. Lara: He's by the door. Let's go over to him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克在哪儿？他在人群中跟我们走散了。拉拉：他在门边。我们过去找他吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu Mark? Nferaq minna fil-folla.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu Mark? Nferaq minna fil-folla.
messages.zh: 马克在哪儿？他在人群中跟我们走散了。
messages.en: Where is Mark? He got separated from us in the crowd.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb. Ejja mmorru ħdejh.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb. Ejja mmorru ħdejh.
messages.zh: 他在门边。我们过去找他吧。
messages.en: He's by the door. Let's go over to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一队人分进两个房间：既可记“被分开”，也可记“被隔开”。

gloss_zh: 被诅咒；被生下（用于动物）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be subjected to a curse; also, to be born, when referring to an animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成为诅咒的对象；也可指动物被生下、出生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisfa misħut; ukoll, jitwieled, meta jkun annimal.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be the object of a curse
sense_translations.zh_definition: 成为诅咒的对象；受到诅咒。
被生下；出生，用于动物。

collocations.en: The man was cursed by the witch.
collocations.zh: 那个男人受到了女巫的诅咒。

collocations.en: The lamb was born on the farm.

formal.mt: Fir-reġistru tar-razzett hemm imniżżel li l-ħaruf nferaħ kmieni filgħodu.
formal.en: The farm register records that the lamb was born early in the morning.
formal.zh: 农场记录簿记载，这只小羊出生于清晨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ir-raġel fil-ħrafa kellu daqshekk xorti ħażina? Mark: Għax nferaħ mis-saħħara wara li seraqilha ċ-ċurkett.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the man in the tale have such bad luck? Mark: Because he was cursed by the witch after stealing her ring.
colloquial.zh: Maja：故事里的男人为什么运气那么差？Mark：因为他偷了女巫的戒指后，受到了她的诅咒。

messages.speaker: Maja (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ir-raġel fil-ħrafa kellu daqshekk xorti ħażina?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ir-raġel fil-ħrafa kellu daqshekk xorti ħażina?
messages.zh: 故事里的男人为什么运气那么差？
messages.en: Why did the man in the tale have such bad luck?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax nferaħ mis-saħħara wara li seraqilha ċ-ċurkett.
messages.mt_standard: Għax nferaħ mis-saħħara wara li seraqilha ċ-ċurkett.
messages.zh: 因为他偷了女巫的戒指后，受到了她的诅咒。
messages.en: Because he was cursed by the witch after stealing her ring.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为两个义项分别画卡片：童话人物受到诅咒，农场小羊刚刚出生；通过故事或农场语境判断含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be discharged or released, as gas leaving a container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被排出或释放，可用气体从容器中排出的场景理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinħareġ jew jiġi rilaxxat, bħal gass li joħroġ minn reċipjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被排出；被释放。

collocations.en: The gas was discharged through the valve.

formal.mt: Matul il-proċess, il-gass nfesa mill-valv u l-pressjoni fit-tank naqset.
formal.en: During the process, the gas was discharged through the valve and the pressure in the tank decreased.
formal.zh: 过程中，气体通过阀门排出，罐内压力随之下降。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex waqaf il-ħoss? Rita: Il-gass nfesa kollu, u issa t-tank hu vojt.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did the noise stop? Rita: All the gas has been discharged, and the tank is empty now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：声音怎么停了？丽塔：气体已经全部排出了，现在罐子空了。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.zh: 声音怎么停了？
messages.en: Why did the noise stop?

messages.speaker: Rita (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-gass nfesa kollu, u issa t-tank hu vojt.
messages.mt_standard: Il-gass nfesa kollu, u issa t-tank hu vojt.
messages.zh: 气体已经全部排出了，现在罐子空了。
messages.en: All the gas has been discharged, and the tank is empty now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它配上气体离开容器的画面，记住重点是“被排出”的结果。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have one's shell removed, as a nut does when it is shelled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外壳被剥除，例如坚果被去壳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titneħħielu l-qoxra, bħalma jiġri lill-ġewż meta jitqaxxar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外壳被剥除；被去壳。

collocations.en: The almonds were shelled by hand.

formal.mt: Il-ġewż nfesaq qabel ma tqatta' u żdied mat-taħlita tal-kejk.
formal.en: The walnuts were shelled before being chopped and added to the cake mixture.
formal.zh: 核桃先被去壳，然后切碎，加入蛋糕混合料中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ġewż għadu bil-qoxra? Pawlu: Le, nfesaq kollu. Tista' tibda tqattgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are the walnuts still in their shells? Pawlu: No, they've all been shelled. You can start chopping them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：核桃还带着壳吗？保罗：没有，已经全部去壳了。你可以开始切碎了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 核桃还带着壳吗？
messages.en: Are the walnuts still in their shells?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nfesaq kollu. Tista' tibda tqattgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nfesaq kollu. Tista' tibda tqattgħu.
messages.zh: 没有，已经全部去壳了。你可以开始切碎了。
messages.en: No, they've all been shelled. You can start chopping them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象核桃留在碗里、硬壳落在旁边，用这个结果画面记“被去壳”。

gloss_zh: 被撕裂；脱线开缝；发生疝气

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be ripped or come unstitched; also, to develop a hernia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物品被撕裂或缝线脱开；也可指人发生疝气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċarrat jew tinfetaħlu l-ħjata; jista' jfisser ukoll li persuna tiżviluppa ftuq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被撕裂；被扯破。
缝线脱开；沿缝合处开缝。
发生疝气；出现疝。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tiswija, il-ħajjata sabet li l-but nfetaq tul il-ħjata.
formal.en: During the repair, the seamstress found that the pocket had come unstitched along the seam.
formal.zh: 修补时，裁缝发现口袋沿着缝合处脱线开口了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-but tiegħi nfetaq, u waqgħuli ċ-ċwievet. Rita: Sibthom taħt is-siġġu. Nista' nsewwilek il-but.
colloquial.en: Mark: My pocket came unstitched, and my keys fell out. Rita: I found them under the chair. I can mend your pocket.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我的口袋脱线了，钥匙都掉出来了。丽塔：我在椅子下面找到钥匙了。我可以帮你补口袋。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-but tiegħi nfetaq, u waqgħuli ċ-ċwievet.
messages.mt_standard: Il-but tiegħi nfetaq, u waqgħuli ċ-ċwievet.
messages.zh: 我的口袋脱线了，钥匙都掉出来了。
messages.en: My pocket came unstitched, and my keys fell out.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibthom taħt is-siġġu. Nista' nsewwilek il-but.
messages.mt_standard: Sibthom taħt is-siġġu. Nista' nsewwilek il-but.
messages.zh: 我在椅子下面找到钥匙了。我可以帮你补口袋。
messages.en: I found them under the chair. I can mend your pocket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用口袋开缝记住破裂义，再单独配一张“疝气”词义卡，避免混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Revenge: retaliation for harm or an offence that someone has suffered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 报复或复仇，即因遭受伤害或冒犯而采取的回击。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tpattija għal ħsara jew offiża li wieħed ikun ġarrab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 报复；复仇。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ix-xewqa ta' nfexxa twassal lill-karattru prinċipali biex jitlef il-fiduċja ta' sħabu.
formal.en: In the novel, the desire for revenge causes the main character to lose the trust of his companions.
formal.zh: 小说中，复仇的欲望使主人公失去了同伴的信任。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-karattru kisser it-tieqa? Mark: Kien att ta' nfexxa, għax sid id-dar kien offendieh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the character break the window? Mark: It was an act of revenge because the owner of the house had insulted him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个角色为什么打破窗户？马克：那是报复行为，因为房主之前侮辱过他。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 那个角色为什么打破窗户？
messages.en: Why did the character break the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien att ta' nfexxa, għax sid id-dar kien offendieh.
messages.mt_standard: Kien att ta' nfexxa, għax sid id-dar kien offendieh.
messages.zh: 那是报复行为，因为房主之前侮辱过他。
messages.en: It was an act of revenge because the owner of the house had insulted him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把小说人物受辱后想要报复的情节当作记忆画面，并牢记这是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of puncturing, piercing, thrusting, or penetrating something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刺出孔洞、刺穿、戳刺或穿透某物的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li biha xi ħaġa tittaqqab, tgħaddi minnha ponta, jew tidħol fiha xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刺孔；扎破；使表面出现孔洞的动作。
刺穿；穿刺。
戳刺；向前猛刺的动作。
穿透；进入某物内部。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-arti, in-nfid tal-karta b'labra joħloq disinn magħmul minn toqob żgħar.
formal.en: In the art exercise, piercing the paper with a needle creates a design made of small holes.
formal.zh: 美术练习中，用针刺穿纸张，可以形成由小孔组成的图案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif għamilt dawn it-toqob fil-karta? Pawlu: B'nfid b'labra, toqba waħda kull darba.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did you make these holes in the paper? Pawlu: By piercing it with a needle, one hole at a time.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：纸上这些孔是怎么弄出来的？保罗：用针刺出来的，一次刺一个孔。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 纸上这些孔是怎么弄出来的？
messages.en: How did you make these holes in the paper?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: B'nfid b'labra, toqba waħda kull darba.
messages.mt_standard: B'nfid b'labra, toqba waħda kull darba.
messages.zh: 用针刺出来的，一次刺一个孔。
messages.en: By piercing it with a needle, one hole at a time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象针尖从接触纸面到穿过去的过程，串起刺孔、刺穿、戳刺和穿透。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become paralysed; also, to become extremely tired or exhausted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 陷入瘫痪状态；也可表示累得筋疲力尽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef il-ħila li jċaqlaq ġismu jew parti minnu; f'sens ieħor, jgħejja ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瘫痪；身体全部或部分失去活动能力。
累坏；筋疲力尽。

formal.mt: Wara l-marda, ir-raġel nfileġ u kellu bżonn għajnuna fil-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: After the illness, the man became paralysed and needed help in daily life.
formal.zh: 患病后，这名男子瘫痪了，日常生活需要他人协助。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu mar jorqod daqshekk kmieni? Maja: Nfileġ bl-għeja wara ġurnata sħiħa xogħol fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu go to bed so early? Maja: He was utterly exhausted after a whole day working in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗怎么这么早就去睡了？玛雅：他在花园干了一整天活，累得筋疲力尽了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu mar jorqod daqshekk kmieni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu mar jorqod daqshekk kmieni?
messages.zh: 保罗怎么这么早就去睡了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu go to bed so early?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nfileġ bl-għeja wara ġurnata sħiħa xogħol fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Nfileġ bl-għeja wara ġurnata sħiħa xogħol fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 他在花园干了一整天活，累得筋疲力尽了。
messages.en: He was utterly exhausted after a whole day working in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分别记住病后失去活动能力和干活后累瘫两个场景，靠上下文区分瘫痪与疲惫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The spending of money, or the amount of money spent for a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 花钱的行为，或为某一用途付出的款项；可用于日常开销和正式预算。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-użu tal-flus biex jitħallsu prodotti jew servizzi, jew l-ammont li jintefaq għal skop partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花费；支出，侧重花钱这一行为或整体开销。
为某项用途付出的款项；所需投入的费用。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri żieda fin-nfiq fuq it-tagħmir tal-iskola.
formal.en: The report shows an increase in expenditure on school equipment.
formal.zh: 报告显示，学校设备方面的支出有所增加。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tikteb kemm tonfoq? Mark: Irrid innaqqas in-nfiq ta' kuljum. Lara: Mela nibdew billi nieħdu l-ikel magħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you writing down how much you spend? Mark: I want to reduce my daily spending. Lara: Then let's start by taking food with us.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么在记录自己花了多少钱？Mark：我想减少日常开销。Lara：那我们就先从自己带饭开始吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在记录自己花了多少钱？
messages.en: Why are you writing down how much you spend?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想减少日常开销。
messages.en: I want to reduce my daily spending.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nibdew billi nieħdu l-ikel magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nibdew billi nieħdu l-ikel magħna.
messages.zh: 那我们就先从自己带饭开始吧。
messages.en: Then let's start by taking food with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nfiq 放在记账本的“支出”栏旁记忆：每天买饭是日常花费，购买设备则是一笔专项支出。

gloss_zh: 紧张不安；易受惊的状态，尤指马

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of nervousness or readiness to startle and shy away, especially in a horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 紧张不安、容易受惊并退避的状态，尤其用于描述马的反应。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' nervożiżmu jew ta' tendenza li wieħed jitbeżża' u jitwarrab malajr, speċjalment fil-każ taż-żwiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧张不安；神经紧绷的状态。
容易受惊、惊跳或退避的状态，尤其指马。

collocations.zh: 缓解紧张或易受惊的状态

formal.mt: Waqt it-taħriġ, l-għalliem osserva n-nfir taż-żiemel meta sema' ħoss qawwi.
formal.en: During training, the instructor observed the horse's skittishness when it heard a loud noise.
formal.zh: 训练期间，教练观察到这匹马听到巨响时表现出的受惊反应。
