colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed iżżomm iż-żiemel 'il bogħod mit-triq? Pawlu: Minħabba n-nfir tiegħu meta jgħaddu l-karozzi. Sara: Mela ngħaddu minn fejn hemm inqas storbju.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you keeping the horse away from the road? Pawlu: Because of its skittishness when cars pass. Sara: Then let's go where there is less noise.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么让马远离公路？Pawlu：因为有车经过时，它容易受惊。Sara：那我们就走噪声小一点的地方吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (骑马学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iżżomm iż-żiemel 'il bogħod mit-triq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iżżomm iż-żiemel 'il bogħod mit-triq?
messages.zh: 你为什么让马远离公路？
messages.en: Why are you keeping the horse away from the road?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (骑马教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba n-nfir tiegħu meta jgħaddu l-karozzi.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba n-nfir tiegħu meta jgħaddu l-karozzi.
messages.zh: 因为有车经过时，它容易受惊。
messages.en: Because of its skittishness when cars pass.

messages.speaker: Sara (骑马学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ngħaddu minn fejn hemm inqas storbju.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ngħaddu minn fejn hemm inqas storbju.
messages.zh: 那我们就走噪声小一点的地方吧。
messages.en: Then let's go where there is less noise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象马听到汽车声后紧张、退缩的画面，用 nfir 给这种“紧张易惊的状态”命名；它是名词。

gloss_zh: 分开；脱离；结束感情关系

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become separate from someone or something, or to end a personal relationship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某人或某物分开、脱离，也可表示结束伴侣之间的感情关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqata' jew jitbiegħed minn persuna jew ħaġa oħra, jew itemm relazzjoni ma' sieħeb jew sieħba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分开；与他人或其他事物脱离。
结束感情关系；与伴侣分手。

collocations.en: he broke up with his partner

formal.mt: Waqt il-mixja, wieħed mill-parteċipanti nfired mill-grupp u stenna ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: During the walk, one of the participants separated from the group and waited near the entrance.
formal.zh: 步行活动期间，一名参加者与队伍分开，在入口附近等候。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark ma ġiex ma' Anna? Sara: Mark nfired minn Anna x-xahar li għadda. Lara: Ma kontx naf. Nispera li t-tnejn jinsabu tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't Mark come with Anna? Sara: Mark broke up with Anna last month. Lara: I didn't know. I hope they are both doing well.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 为什么没和 Anna 一起来？Sara：Mark 上个月和 Anna 分手了。Lara：我还不知道。希望他们两个人都过得好。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma ġiex ma' Anna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma ġiex ma' Anna?
messages.zh: Mark 为什么没和 Anna 一起来？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark come with Anna?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark nfired minn Anna x-xahar li għadda.
messages.mt_standard: Mark nfired minn Anna x-xahar li għadda.
messages.zh: Mark 上个月和 Anna 分手了。
messages.en: Mark broke up with Anna last month.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma kontx naf. Nispera li t-tnejn jinsabu tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Ma kontx naf. Nispera li t-tnejn jinsabu tajjeb.
messages.zh: 我还不知道。希望他们两个人都过得好。
messages.en: I didn't know. I hope they are both doing well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“从一起到分开”的画面记 nfired：离开队伍是位置上的分开，与伴侣分手是关系上的分开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become scattered or spread over a wider area, including the spread of substances or information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 散开或扩展到更大的范围，可用于烟雾等物质的扩散，也可用于消息的传播。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinfirex fuq żona akbar jew f'aktar postijiet, bħal duħħan fl-arja jew tagħrif fost in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被分散；散开到不同位置。
被散布或传播；扩散到更广的范围。

collocations.en: the smoke spread through the room
collocations.zh: 烟雾在房间里扩散开来

collocations.en: the dust spread across the floor

formal.mt: Wara li nfetħet il-borża, it-trab nfirex mal-art tal-maħżen.
formal.en: After the bag was opened, the dust spread across the storeroom floor.
formal.zh: 袋子打开后，灰尘散落在储藏室的地板上。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex hemm riħa ta' ħruq hawn? Lara: Id-duħħan mill-kċina nfirex fil-kamra. Mark: Niftaħ it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why does it smell burnt here? Lara: The smoke from the kitchen spread into the room. Mark: I'll open the window.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这里为什么有烧焦的味道？Lara：厨房的烟扩散到房间里了。Mark：我来开窗。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm riħa ta' ħruq hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm riħa ta' ħruq hawn?
messages.zh: 这里为什么有烧焦的味道？
messages.en: Why does it smell burnt here?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 厨房的烟扩散到房间里了。
messages.en: The smoke from the kitchen spread into the room.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我来开窗。
messages.en: I'll open the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一小团烟逐渐铺满整个房间，用 nfirex 记“范围扩大、散布开来”；传言在人群中扩散也可这样联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become entwined, with one strand or object winding around another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 线、绳或其他细长物彼此缠绕，形成交缠的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitgeżwer jew jitħabbel ma' ħaġa oħra, bħal ħajt li jdur ma' ħajt ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被缠绕；与另一物交缠在一起。

collocations.en: the thread became entwined with another thread
collocations.zh: 这根线与另一根线缠在一起了

collocations.en: the rope became entwined around the branch

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol tal-insiġ, il-ħajt l-aħmar nfitel mal-ħajt l-abjad.
formal.en: During the weaving work, the red thread became entwined with the white thread.
formal.zh: 编织过程中，红线与白线缠在了一起。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex il-ħajt ma jiċċaqlaqx? Maja: Nfitel ma' ħajt ieħor fil-kaxxa. Anna: Ejja nisseparawhom bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why won't the thread move? Maja: It became entwined with another thread in the box. Anna: Let's separate them gently.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这根线为什么拉不动？Maja：它在盒子里和另一根线缠在一起了。Anna：我们慢慢把它们分开吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (手工课学员)
messages.zh: 这根线为什么拉不动？
messages.en: Why won't the thread move?

messages.speaker: Maja (手工课同学)
messages.zh: 它在盒子里和另一根线缠在一起了。
messages.en: It became entwined with another thread in the box.

messages.speaker: Anna (手工课学员)
messages.zh: 我们慢慢把它们分开吧。
messages.en: Let's separate them gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 拿两根不同颜色的线想象它们互相绕住，用 nfitel 记“交缠在一起”，重点是两者缠绕后的状态。

gloss_zh: 铺散；摊开，尤指棉花、面团等

teaching_sense.en_definition: The spreading out of a material, especially cotton, dough, or a similar substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将材料铺散、摊开这一过程，尤其用于棉花、面团等材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih materjal, speċjalment qoton jew għaġina, jitferrex jew jinfetaħ fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.en_definition: spreading (especially used of cotton, dough etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 铺散、摊开的过程，尤其用于棉花、面团等材料。

formal.mt: L-għalliem wera n-nfix tal-qoton fuq il-mejda sabiex il-materjal jitqassam b'mod uniformi.
formal.en: The teacher demonstrated spreading the cotton out on the table so that the material would be distributed evenly.
formal.zh: 老师示范了如何在桌上铺散棉花，使材料分布均匀。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' turini n-nfix tal-għaġina? Anna: Iva, ara kif niftaħha bil-mod fuq il-mejda. Lara: Issa nifhem kif nagħmilha aktar indaqs.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you show me how to spread out the dough? Anna: Yes, watch how I gently spread it out on the table. Lara: Now I understand how to make it more even.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你能示范一下怎么摊开面团吗？Anna：可以，看我怎样在桌上慢慢把它摊开。Lara：现在我明白怎么把它摊得更均匀了。

messages.speaker: Lara (烘焙学员)
messages.zh: 你能示范一下怎么摊开面团吗？
messages.en: Can you show me how to spread out the dough?

messages.speaker: Anna (烘焙老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara kif niftaħha bil-mod fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara kif niftaħha bil-mod fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 可以，看我怎样在桌上慢慢把它摊开。
messages.en: Yes, watch how I gently spread it out on the table.

messages.speaker: Lara (烘焙学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nifhem kif nagħmilha aktar indaqs.
messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem kif nagħmilha aktar indaqs.
messages.zh: 现在我明白怎么把它摊得更均匀了。
messages.en: Now I understand how to make it more even.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nfix 配上一团棉花被铺开、一个面团被摊开的两幅图，记住它是表示“铺散过程”的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become confused and have difficulty understanding something or deciding what to do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得糊涂或困惑，一时不明白情况、步骤或该如何行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħawwad u jsibha diffiċli biex jifhem xi ħaġa jew ikun jaf x'għandu jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得糊涂；弄不清楚；陷入困惑。

collocations.en: he got confused while doing the calculation
he got confused by the instructions
collocations.zh: 他被这些说明弄糊涂了

collocations.en: he got confused during the exam

formal.mt: L-istudent nfixel fit-tieni pass tal-kalkolu u talab spjegazzjoni oħra.
formal.en: The student got confused at the second step of the calculation and asked for another explanation.
formal.zh: 这名学生在计算的第二步弄糊涂了，请求老师再解释一次。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu waqaf jimla l-formola? Mark: Nfixel bl-istruzzjonijiet. Sara: Ejja ngħinuh, pass pass.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu stop filling in the form? Mark: He got confused by the instructions. Sara: Let's help him, step by step.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu 为什么不继续填表了？Mark：他被填写说明弄糊涂了。Sara：我们一步一步帮他吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么不继续填表了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu stop filling in the form?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 他被填写说明弄糊涂了。
messages.en: He got confused by the instructions.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 我们一步一步帮他吧。
messages.en: Let's help him, step by step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象填表时看到复杂说明，脑中冒出问号，用 nfixel 记“弄糊涂了”；再配上“一步一步解释”的解决画面。

gloss_zh: 吹气；喷鼻息；奉承；肿胀；囊肿；肿块

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of blowing; also snorting, flattery, swelling, a cyst, or a lump, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吹气的动作；依语境也可指喷鼻息、奉承、肿胀、囊肿或肿块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li toħroġ l-arja min-nifs; skont il-kuntest, jista' jfisser ukoll ħruġ qawwi ta' nifs mill-imnieħer, tifħir żejjed, nefħa, ċista jew għoqda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吹；吹气的动作。
从鼻子猛喷气；喷鼻息。
奉承；讨好性的吹捧。
肿胀；隆起。
囊肿。
肿块；身体上的块状隆起。

formal.mt: Waqt it-tħejjijiet għall-festa, in-nfiħ tal-bżieżaq sar fil-bitħa tal-iskola.
formal.en: During preparations for the celebration, the balloons were blown up in the school courtyard.
formal.zh: 筹备庆祝活动时，大家在学校庭院里给气球吹气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad fadal ħafna bżieżaq? Mark: Iva, u għejejt bin-nfiħ. Tista' ġġibli l-pompa?
colloquial.en: Maja: Are there still many balloons left? Mark: Yes, and I'm tired from all the blowing. Can you bring me the pump?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：还剩很多气球吗？马克：是啊，吹得我都累了。你能把打气筒拿来吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 还剩很多气球吗？
messages.en: Are there still many balloons left?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għejejt bin-nfiħ. Tista' ġġibli l-pompa?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għejejt bin-nfiħ. Tista' ġġibli l-pompa?
messages.zh: 是啊，吹得我都累了。你能把打气筒拿来吗？
messages.en: Yes, and I'm tired from all the blowing. Can you bring me the pump?

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三组做记忆卡：气流动作是吹气和喷鼻息，言语行为是奉承，身体表现是肿胀、囊肿和肿块。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to shy away or become frightened easily, especially when describing a horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遇到刺激时容易退缩、躲避或受惊的，尤其可用于描述马。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jitwarrab jew jitbeżża' malajr, speċjalment meta jingħad għal żiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有退缩或躲避倾向的；容易因不安而退避的。
容易害怕的；容易受惊的。

formal.mt: Iż-żiemel huwa nfuri quddiem ħsejjes qawwija, għalhekk it-taħriġ isir f'ambjent kwiet.
formal.en: The horse is easily frightened by loud noises, so training takes place in a quiet environment.
formal.zh: 这匹马遇到巨响容易受惊，因此训练在安静的环境中进行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nersaq lejn iż-żiemel? Pawlu: Iva, imma bil-mod. Huwa nfuri. Maja: Sewwa, nitkellem bil-kwiet u ma nagħmilx movimenti għal għarrieda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I approach the horse? Pawlu: Yes, but slowly. He's easily frightened. Maja: All right, I'll speak softly and avoid sudden movements.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我可以靠近这匹马吗？Pawlu：可以，不过要慢一点。它很容易受惊。Maja：好的，我会轻声说话，避免突然的动作。

messages.speaker: Maja (骑马学员)
messages.zh: 我可以靠近这匹马吗？
messages.en: Can I approach the horse?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (骑马教练)
messages.zh: 可以，不过要慢一点。它很容易受惊。
messages.en: Yes, but slowly. He's easily frightened.

messages.speaker: Maja (骑马学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, nitkellem bil-kwiet u ma nagħmilx movimenti għal għarrieda.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, nitkellem bil-kwiet u ma nagħmilx movimenti għal għarrieda.
messages.zh: 好的，我会轻声说话，避免突然的动作。
messages.en: All right, I'll speak softly and avoid sudden movements.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给一匹见到突然动作就后退的马贴上 nfuri 标签，记“容易受惊的”；与名词 nfir 的“易惊状态”对照学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be the person, thing, or service that someone complains about.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某人、某物或某项服务成为别人抱怨或投诉的对象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun il-persuna, il-ħaġa jew is-servizz li xi ħadd jilmenta dwaru.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be the object of complaint
sense_translations.zh_definition: 成为抱怨或投诉的对象；被人抱怨。

collocations.en: was complained about because of delays

formal.mt: Is-servizz ngarr minn diversi klijenti minħabba d-dewmien fit-twassil tal-ordnijiet.
formal.en: Several customers complained about the service because of delays in delivering orders.
formal.zh: 由于订单配送延误，多位顾客对这项服务提出了投诉。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex is-servizz ngarr? Pawlu: Għax il-klijenti damu jistennew wisq.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did people complain about the service? Pawlu: Because the customers had to wait too long.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这项服务为什么遭到投诉？保罗：因为顾客等得太久了。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 这项服务为什么遭到投诉？
messages.en: Why did people complain about the service?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 因为顾客等得太久了。
messages.en: Because the customers had to wait too long.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象投诉单上写着某项服务的名字：ngarr 的重点是成为被抱怨的一方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have milk taken from an animal, or to become weak and very thin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指动物被挤奶；也指人或动物变得虚弱、明显消瘦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittieħed il-ħalib minn annimal; ukoll, isir dgħajjef u rqiq ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被挤奶；乳汁被挤出。
变得虚弱消瘦，显得憔悴。

collocations.en: became weak and gaunt after a long illness

formal.mt: Il-baqra ngeżżet kmieni filgħodu, u l-ħalib inġabar f'reċipjent nadif.
formal.en: The cow was milked early in the morning, and the milk was collected in a clean container.
formal.zh: 清晨，奶牛被挤了奶，牛奶收集在一个干净的容器里。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif inhu Pawlu wara l-marda? Toni: Ngeżż ħafna, imma issa qed jiekol aħjar.
colloquial.en: Marija: How is Pawlu after his illness? Toni: He became very weak and thin, but he is eating better now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：保罗病后怎么样？托尼：他变得很虚弱，也瘦了很多，不过现在吃得好些了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗病后怎么样？
messages.en: How is Pawlu after his illness?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngeżż ħafna, imma issa qed jiekol aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Ngeżż ħafna, imma issa qed jiekol aħjar.
messages.zh: 他变得很虚弱，也瘦了很多，不过现在吃得好些了。
messages.en: He became very weak and thin, but he is eating better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ngeżż 配两张学习图卡：一张是奶牛被挤奶，一张是病后消瘦的人，分开记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 被人说谎欺骗；被告知谎话

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have someone tell you something untrue as though it were true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指别人向自己说谎，把不真实的事情当作事实告诉自己。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħadd jgħidlu xi ħaġa li mhix vera bħallikieku kienet vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被别人说谎欺骗；听到别人对自己说的谎话。

collocations.en: was lied to about the price
collocations.zh: 在价格问题上被人说谎欺骗

collocations.en: was lied to by a friend

formal.mt: Il-klijent ngideb dwar il-prezz finali u talab spjegazzjoni bil-miktub mingħand il-bejjiegħ.
formal.en: The customer was lied to about the final price and requested a written explanation from the seller.
formal.zh: 顾客在最终价格问题上遭到谎言欺骗，并要求卖方作出书面解释。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Mark ma jafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ? Luqa: Għax ngideb dwar il-prezz l-aħħar darba.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why doesn't Mark trust that seller? Luqa: Because he was lied to about the price last time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克为什么不信任那个卖家？卢卡：因为上次卖家在价格上对他说了谎。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma jafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma jafdax lil dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.zh: 马克为什么不信任那个卖家？
messages.en: Why doesn't Mark trust that seller?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ngideb dwar il-prezz l-aħħar darba.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ngideb dwar il-prezz l-aħħar darba.
messages.zh: 因为上次卖家在价格上对他说了谎。
messages.en: Because he was lied to about the price last time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ngideb 记成接收谎话的人：画一个人听到虚假价格，提醒自己关注谁被说谎欺骗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be bitten, to be tricked or swindled, or to lose illusions after a disappointing experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被咬伤；也指受骗或被诈骗，或因令人失望的经历而幻想破灭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirċievi gidma; ukoll, jiġi mqarraq jew jitlef l-illużjonijiet wara esperjenza diżappuntanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被咬；遭到咬伤。
受骗、上当，或遭到诈骗。
幻想破灭；因看清实际情况而感到失望。

collocations.en: was swindled in a business deal

collocations.zh: 因空洞的承诺而幻想破灭

formal.mt: L-investitur ngidem f'negozju u tilef il-flus li kien ħallas bil-quddiem.
formal.en: The investor was swindled in a business deal and lost the money he had paid in advance.
formal.zh: 这名投资者在一笔生意中受骗，损失了预先支付的款项。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'ġara lil Mark? David: Ngidem minn kelb waqt li kien miexi lejn id-dar.
colloquial.en: Nina: What happened to Mark? David: He was bitten by a dog while walking home.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克怎么了？戴维：他走路回家时被狗咬了。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 马克怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Mark?

messages.speaker: David (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngidem minn kelb waqt li kien miexi lejn id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Ngidem minn kelb waqt li kien miexi lejn id-dar.
messages.zh: 他走路回家时被狗咬了。
messages.en: He was bitten by a dog while walking home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张情景卡记 ngidem：手臂被咬、交易受骗、期待落空。这只是学习联想，分别对应三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get a scratch on the skin or another surface through contact with something sharp or rough.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指皮肤或其他表面接触尖锐、粗糙的东西后被抓伤或划伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu grif fil-ġilda jew fuq wiċċ ieħor wara kuntatt ma' xi ħaġa taqta' jew ħarxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被抓伤或划伤；出现抓痕或划痕。

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar ngiref f'idu waqt li kien ineħħi l-friegħi niexfa minn ħdejn il-mogħdija.
formal.en: The gardener got scratched on his hand while removing dry branches beside the path.
formal.zh: 园丁清理小路旁的枯枝时，手被划伤了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark għandu marka fuq idu? Ben: Ngiref mill-qattus waqt li kien qed jilgħab miegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does Mark have a mark on his hand? Ben: He got scratched by the cat while playing with it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克手上为什么有一道痕？本：他跟猫玩的时候被猫抓伤了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark għandu marka fuq idu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark għandu marka fuq idu?
messages.zh: 马克手上为什么有一道痕？
messages.en: Why does Mark have a mark on his hand?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngiref mill-qattus waqt li kien qed jilgħab miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ngiref mill-qattus waqt li kien qed jilgħab miegħu.
messages.zh: 他跟猫玩的时候被猫抓伤了。
messages.en: He got scratched by the cat while playing with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ngiref 就想象手背上一道细细的抓痕，用猫爪或树枝留下的痕迹记住被抓伤、划伤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be ground into coarse particles rather than fine powder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指谷物等被磨成较粗的颗粒，尚未成为细粉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħan fi frak oħxon, mhux fi trab fin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被粗磨；被磨成较粗的颗粒。

collocations.en: was coarsely ground at the mill

formal.mt: Il-qamħ ngirex fil-mitħna u nġabar fi xkejjer separati mill-prodott mitħun fin.
formal.en: The wheat was coarsely ground at the mill and collected in sacks separate from the finely ground product.
formal.zh: 小麦在磨坊里被粗磨后装入袋中，与细磨的产品分开放置。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex dan il-qamħ għadu daqshekk oħxon? Ġużeppi: Għax ngirex biss; għadu ma sarx dqiq fin.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is this wheat still so coarse? Ġużeppi: Because it was only coarsely ground; it hasn't become fine flour yet.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这些小麦为什么还这么粗？朱塞佩：因为只经过了粗磨，还没有磨成细面粉。

messages.speaker: Rita (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-qamħ għadu daqshekk oħxon?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-qamħ għadu daqshekk oħxon?
messages.zh: 这些小麦为什么还这么粗？
messages.en: Why is this wheat still so coarse?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (磨坊工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ngirex biss; għadu ma sarx dqiq fin.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ngirex biss; għadu ma sarx dqiq fin.
messages.zh: 因为只经过了粗磨，还没有磨成细面粉。
messages.en: Because it was only coarsely ground; it hasn't become fine flour yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ngirex 画一袋仍看得见颗粒的粗磨谷物，把注意力放在颗粒粗细上，记住被粗磨的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be said or reported, including as a rumour whose truth is not established.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某件事被人说出或提及；也可表示据传如此，内容尚未证实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad jew jissemma xi ħaġa; ukoll, tiċċirkola bħala għajdut mingħajr konferma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被说出；被人说到或提及。
据传；有传闻说，尚未得到证实。

collocations.en: it was said or rumoured that

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ġie rreġistrat dak li ngħad fil-laqgħa dwar il-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ.
formal.en: The report recorded what was said at the meeting about the opening hours.
formal.zh: 报告记录了会议上关于开放时间的发言内容。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Veru li l-ħanut se jagħlaq? Mark: Hekk ngħad, imma s-sid għadu ma kkonferma xejn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is it true that the shop is going to close? Mark: That's the rumour, but the owner hasn't confirmed anything yet.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那家店真的要关门了吗？马克：传闻是这样，但店主还没有证实任何消息。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 那家店真的要关门了吗？
messages.en: Is it true that the shop is going to close?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Hekk ngħad, imma s-sid għadu ma kkonferma xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Hekk ngħad, imma s-sid għadu ma kkonferma xejn.
messages.zh: 传闻是这样，但店主还没有证实任何消息。
messages.en: That's the rumour, but the owner hasn't confirmed anything yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ngħad 放进说话气泡：它表示话被说出；若语境谈传闻，就记成据说，并留意消息是否证实。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be included in the act of counting so that a number or total can be established.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某人或某物被逐一数过，以确定数量或总数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun fost il-persuni jew l-oġġetti li jingħaddu biex jiġi stabbilit in-numru totali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被计数；被逐一数过。

formal.mt: Kull vot ngħadd darbtejn qabel ma tħabbar ir-riżultat finali tal-elezzjoni.
formal.en: Every vote was counted twice before the final election result was announced.
formal.zh: 在宣布最终选举结果之前，每一票都经过了两次清点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb diġà ngħadd? Toni: Iva, ngħadd mal-kotba ta' fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has this book already been counted? Toni: Yes, it was counted with the books on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书已经数过了吗？托尼：是的，已经跟架子上的那些书一起数过了。

messages.speaker: Maja (图书馆志愿者)
messages.zh: 这本书已经数过了吗？
messages.en: Has this book already been counted?

messages.speaker: Toni (图书馆工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ngħadd mal-kotba ta' fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ngħadd mal-kotba ta' fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 是的，已经跟架子上的那些书一起数过了。
messages.en: Yes, it was counted with the books on the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ngħadd 末尾的两个 d 想成两个计数筹码，提醒自己这是被数过；并与表示被说出的 ngħad 区分。

gloss_zh: 得到体谅；受到宽容对待

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be treated with patience or sympathy because one's situation or difficulties are understood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因自己的处境或困难得到理解，而受到耐心、体谅或宽容的对待。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li persuna tirċievi sabar jew mogħdrija mingħand ħaddieħor minħabba l-qagħda jew id-diffikultajiet tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to have patience or sympathy shown to one
sense_translations.zh_definition: 得到他人的耐心对待或同情体谅。

collocations.en: was treated sympathetically by the teacher
was shown understanding because of the circumstances
collocations.zh: 因具体处境而得到体谅

formal.mt: L-istudent ngħader mill-għalliem meta spjega d-diffikultajiet li kellu d-dar.
formal.en: The student was treated sympathetically by the teacher when he explained the difficulties he was having at home.
formal.zh: 那名学生说明家中遇到的困难后，得到了老师的体谅。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Pawlu ngħader meta wasal tard? Rita: Iva, għax il-karozza tal-linja ma ġietx.
colloquial.en: Marta: Was Pawlu shown understanding when he arrived late? Rita: Yes, because the bus didn't come.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗迟到后得到体谅了吗？丽塔：得到了，因为公交车没来。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗迟到后得到体谅了吗？
messages.en: Was Pawlu shown understanding when he arrived late?

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax il-karozza tal-linja ma ġietx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax il-karozza tal-linja ma ġietx.
messages.zh: 得到了，因为公交车没来。
messages.en: Yes, because the bus didn't come.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己迟到后说明困难，老师耐心点头；把这个词与“我得到了体谅”的画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pressed or squeezed physically, or to be placed under pressure by demands or difficulties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到实际的挤压或按压，也可指因要求或困难而承受压力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa tkun magħfusa, jew li persuna tkun taħt pressjoni minħabba talbiet jew diffikultajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被按压、挤压或压紧。
处于压力之下；受到催逼或负担的压迫。

collocations.en: was put under pressure by work

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, il-kartun ngħafas bejn żewġ pjanċi tal-metall.
formal.en: During the experiment, the cardboard was pressed between two metal plates.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，纸板被压在两块金属板之间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark jidher daqshekk għajjien? David: Din il-ġimgħa ngħafas bix-xogħol u bil-ħin limitat.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does Mark look so tired? David: This week he was under pressure from work and limited time.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么看起来这么累？戴维：这周工作多、时间又紧，他压力很大。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么看起来这么累？
messages.en: Why does Mark look so tired?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-ġimgħa ngħafas bix-xogħol u bil-ħin limitat.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-ġimgħa ngħafas bix-xogħol u bil-ħin limitat.
messages.zh: 这周工作多、时间又紧，他压力很大。
messages.en: This week he was under pressure from work and limited time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想纸板被两块板挤压，再想人被工作和期限挤压；用同一个“受压”画面记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short period of sleep or light dozing, often taken during the day.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 短时间的睡眠或浅睡，常指白天的小睡、打盹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raħda qasira ta' rqad jew nagħas ħafif, spiss matul il-jum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小睡一觉；口语中的短暂睡眠。
小睡；通常指白天短时间睡一觉。
打盹；短暂而较浅的睡眠。

formal.mt: Wara l-ikel, Marija ħadet ngħajsa ta' għoxrin minuta qabel kompliet taqra.
formal.en: After the meal, Marija took a twenty-minute nap before continuing to read.
formal.zh: 饭后，玛丽娅小睡了二十分钟，然后继续阅读。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid toħroġ issa? Luqa: Ħa nieħu ngħajsa l-ewwel; qomt kmieni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to go out now? Luqa: Let me take a nap first; I got up very early.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你现在想出去吗？卢卡：让我先小睡一会儿吧；我今天起得很早。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你现在想出去吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go out now?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħa nieħu ngħajsa l-ewwel; qomt kmieni ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Ħa nieħu ngħajsa l-ewwel; qomt kmieni ħafna.
messages.zh: 让我先小睡一会儿吧；我今天起得很早。
messages.en: Let me take a nap first; I got up very early.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象午饭后设置二十分钟闹钟，再闭眼休息；把整个画面与 nieħu ngħajsa“小睡一会儿”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small sheep, expressed with the diminutive form of nagħġa.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小绵羊；nagħġa 的指小形式，用来表示体型较小的羊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nagħġa żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva tal-kelma nagħġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small sheep (the diminutive form of 'nagħġa')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只小绵羊；nagħġa 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small sheep in the pasture

formal.mt: Fil-wirja tal-annimali kien hemm ngħajġa bajda f'maqjel nadif.
formal.en: At the animal exhibition, there was a small white sheep in a clean pen.
formal.zh: 动物展览上，一只白色的小绵羊待在干净的围栏里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik in-ngħajġa ħdejn iċ-ċint! Toni: Kemm hi żgħira! Ejja narawha minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that small sheep by the fence! Toni: It's so small! Let's watch it from here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看围栏旁边那只小绵羊！托尼：它好小啊！我们就在这里看它吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看围栏旁边那只小绵羊！
messages.en: Look at that small sheep by the fence!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hi żgħira! Ejja narawha minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hi żgħira! Ejja narawha minn hawn.
messages.zh: 它好小啊！我们就在这里看它吧。
messages.en: It's so small! Let's watch it from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nagħġa 和 ngħajġa 并排写下，旁边分别画绵羊和小绵羊，用大小对照记住指小意义。

gloss_zh: 遭受压迫；经历困苦匮乏

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suffer oppression or to experience hardship through a lack of basic necessities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到压迫，或因缺少基本生活所需而经历困苦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li persuna jew poplu jsofri oppressjoni, jew jgħaddi minn tbatija minħabba nuqqas ta' ħtiġijiet bażiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到压迫；遭受权力或他人的不公对待。
经历物资匮乏或基本生活需要得不到满足的困苦。

collocations.en: was oppressed under an oppressive regime
collocations.zh: 在专制政权统治下遭受压迫

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-poplu ngħakes taħt ir-reġim u sofra nuqqas ta' ikel.
formal.en: The report describes how the people were oppressed under the regime and suffered a shortage of food.
formal.zh: 报告描述了民众如何在该政权统治下遭受压迫，并经历食物短缺。

colloquial.mt: Nina: In-nannu kellu ħajja diffiċli meta kien żgħir? Omm: Iva, ngħakes bil-ġuħ u spiss ma kellux biżżejjed x'jiekol.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did Grandpa have a hard life when he was young? Mum: Yes, he suffered from hunger and often didn't have enough to eat.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：外公年轻时日子很苦吗？妈妈：是的，他挨过饿，经常没有足够的东西吃。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu kellu ħajja diffiċli meta kien żgħir?
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu kellu ħajja diffiċli meta kien żgħir?
messages.zh: 外公年轻时日子很苦吗？
messages.en: Did Grandpa have a hard life when he was young?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ngħakes bil-ġuħ u spiss ma kellux biżżejjed x'jiekol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ngħakes bil-ġuħ u spiss ma kellux biżżejjed x'jiekol.
messages.zh: 是的，他挨过饿，经常没有足够的东西吃。
messages.en: Yes, he suffered from hunger and often didn't have enough to eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面并记：一个人受到强权压迫，一家人面对空粮袋；共同点是承受严重困苦。

gloss_zh: 关闭；把自己封闭起来；设备关掉

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become closed, to shut oneself away, or, of an electronic device, to turn off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变为关闭状态；也可指把自己关起来，或电子设备关掉、停止运行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li xi ħaġa ssir magħluqa, li persuna tinqata' minn ħaddieħor billi tagħlaq fuqha nfisha, jew li apparat jieqaf jaħdem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被关闭；处于或变为关闭状态。
把自己关起来；避开他人而独处。

sense_translations.en_definition: to turn off (used, e.g. of an electronic apparatus such as a radio)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 关掉、停止运行，用于收音机等电子设备。

collocations.en: shut himself away in his room

formal.mt: Wara li ntemmet il-laqgħa, il-bieb tas-sala ngħalaq u r-radju ngħalaq ukoll.
formal.en: After the meeting ended, the hall door was closed and the radio was turned off as well.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，大厅的门关上了，收音机也关掉了。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Fejn hu Daniel? Karl: Ngħalaq f'kamartu biex jaqra; se joħroġ aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Emma: Where is Daniel? Karl: He shut himself away in his room to read; he'll come out later.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：丹尼尔在哪里？卡尔：他把自己关在房间里看书了，晚一点会出来。

messages.speaker: Emma (姐姐)
messages.zh: 丹尼尔在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Daniel?

messages.speaker: Karl (兄弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħalaq f'kamartu biex jaqra; se joħroġ aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħalaq f'kamartu biex jaqra; se joħroġ aktar tard.
messages.zh: 他把自己关在房间里看书了，晚一点会出来。
messages.en: He shut himself away in his room to read; he'll come out later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“门关上、人关进房间、收音机关掉”三个画面记忆；主语不同，关闭的具体意思也不同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be given food or feed, especially when an animal is fed by a person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被给予食物或饲料，尤其指动物得到人的喂养。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jingħata ikel jew għalf, speċjalment meta annimal jiġi mitmugħ minn persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被喂食；得到食物或饲料。

formal.mt: Skont ir-reġistru tar-razzett, l-għoġol ngħalef darbtejn kuljum matul dik il-ġimgħa.
formal.en: According to the farm record, the calf was fed twice a day during that week.
formal.zh: 根据农场记录，那头小牛在那一周每天被喂食两次。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: L-għoġol diġà ngħalef dalgħodu? Marija: Iva, ngħalef ftit ilu; issa qed jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Has the calf already been fed this morning? Marija: Yes, it was fed a little while ago; now it's resting.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：今天早上已经喂过小牛了吗？玛丽娅：是的，刚喂过一会儿，现在它正在休息。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场工人)
messages.zh: 今天早上已经喂过小牛了吗？
messages.en: Has the calf already been fed this morning?

messages.speaker: Marija (农场同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ngħalef ftit ilu; issa qed jistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ngħalef ftit ilu; issa qed jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 是的，刚喂过一会儿，现在它正在休息。
messages.en: Yes, it was fed a little while ago; now it's resting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象农民把饲料放进食槽，小牛吃完后休息；把注意力放在小牛“被喂食”的经历上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become physically weaker or lose strength.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体变得虚弱，力量或体力逐渐下降。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aktar dgħajjef jew jitlef is-saħħa fiżika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得虚弱；体力衰退。

collocations.en: grew weak because of a lack of food

formal.mt: Wara l-marda, il-pazjent ngħall u kellu bżonn aktar mistrieħ qabel ma reġa' beda jaħdem.
formal.en: After the illness, the patient grew weak and needed more rest before returning to work.
formal.zh: 病后，患者身体变得虚弱，重新工作前需要更多休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu qed jistrieħ daqshekk? Lara: Ngħall wara l-marda, u għadu qed jirkupra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is Pawlu resting so much? Lara: He grew weak after the illness, and he is still recovering.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么休息这么久？拉拉：他病后身体变虚弱了，现在还在恢复。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么休息这么久？
messages.en: Why is Pawlu resting so much?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħall wara l-marda, u għadu qed jirkupra.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħall wara l-marda, u għadu qed jirkupra.
messages.zh: 他病后身体变虚弱了，现在还在恢复。
messages.en: He grew weak after the illness, and he is still recovering.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象病后走几步就要休息的画面，把 ngħall 与“体力变弱”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large flightless bird with a long neck and long legs; the word can refer to an ostrich or ostriches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种脖子和腿都很长、不会飞的大型鸟；本词可表示鸵鸟，也可统指多只鸵鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur kbir b'għonq twil u saqajn twal li ma jistax itir; il-kelma tista' tirreferi għal għasfur wieħed jew għal aktar minn wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸵鸟；可指单只鸵鸟或多只鸵鸟。

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara edukattiva, l-istudenti osservaw in-ngħam u tgħallmu li dan l-għasfur ma jistax itir.
formal.en: During the educational visit, the students observed the ostriches and learned that this bird cannot fly.
formal.zh: 在教学参观中，学生们观察了鸵鸟，并了解到这种鸟不会飞。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'rajt illum fiż-żoo? Mark: Rajt in-ngħam! Kellu għonq twil ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did you see at the zoo today? Mark: I saw an ostrich! It had a very long neck.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你今天在动物园看见什么了？马克：我看见鸵鸟了！它的脖子特别长。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天在动物园看见什么了？
messages.en: What did you see at the zoo today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt in-ngħam! Kellu għonq twil ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Rajt in-ngħam! Kellu għonq twil ħafna.
messages.zh: 我看见鸵鸟了！它的脖子特别长。
messages.en: I saw an ostrich! It had a very long neck.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ngħam 写在长脖子鸵鸟图旁，再配上巨大的鸵鸟蛋，形成一组画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made or produced, or for a task or activity to be accomplished.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物被制作或产生，也可指某项任务或活动得以完成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi magħmul jew prodott, jew jitwettaq meta jkun xogħol jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被制作；被做成。
被完成；某项工作或任务得以完成。

collocations.en: the work was accomplished on time

formal.mt: Il-mudell ngħamel bl-idejn, u x-xogħol kollu ngħamel qabel il-ftuħ tal-wirja.
formal.en: The model was made by hand, and all the work was accomplished before the exhibition opened.
formal.zh: 模型由手工制作，全部工作在展览开幕前完成。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kejk ngħamel id-dar? Mark: Iva, ngħamel dalgħodu minn ommi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Was this cake made at home? Mark: Yes, it was made this morning by my mother.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个蛋糕是在家做的吗？马克：是的，是我妈妈今天早上做的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个蛋糕是在家做的吗？
messages.en: Was this cake made at home?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，是我妈妈今天早上做的。
messages.en: Yes, it was made this morning by my mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到成品想到“被制作”，看到任务打勾想到“被完成”，用两个结果画面记 ngħamel。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be subjected to oppressive power or unjust treatment that restricts freedom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到强权压迫或不公正对待，因而自由受到限制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun taħt oppressjoni jew trattament inġust li jillimita l-libertà tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受压迫；遭受不公正的压制。

collocations.zh: 在外来统治下受到压迫

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-poplu ngħames taħt ħakma inġusta u tħabat biex jikseb il-libertà.
formal.en: In the novel, the people were oppressed under unjust rule and struggled to gain freedom.
formal.zh: 在小说中，民众受到不公正统治的压迫，并为争取自由而斗争。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-poplu f'dan il-film ried il-bidla? Pawlu: Għax ngħames għal ħafna snin u ried jgħix fil-libertà.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did the people in this film want change? Pawlu: Because they had been oppressed for many years and wanted to live in freedom.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这部电影里的民众为什么想要改变？保罗：因为他们受了多年的压迫，想过自由的生活。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-poplu f'dan il-film ried il-bidla?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-poplu f'dan il-film ried il-bidla?
messages.zh: 这部电影里的民众为什么想要改变？
messages.en: Why did the people in this film want change?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ngħames għal ħafna snin u ried jgħix fil-libertà.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ngħames għal ħafna snin u ried jgħix fil-libertà.
messages.zh: 因为他们受了多年的压迫，想过自由的生活。
messages.en: Because they had been oppressed for many years and wanted to live in freedom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事人物被不公正的规则压得无法自由生活，把 ngħames 与“受压迫”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To briefly close and reopen one eye, often to send a playful or private signal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 短暂闭上一只眼再睁开，常用于开玩笑或传递彼此心领神会的信号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħlaq u jerġa' jiftaħ għajn waħda għal mument, spiss biex jagħti sinjal ta' ċajta jew ta' ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眨一只眼示意；使眼色。

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tax-xena, l-attur ngħameż biex juri lill-udjenza li l-kliem tiegħu kien ċajta.
formal.en: At the end of the scene, the actor winked to show the audience that his words were a joke.
formal.zh: 在这一幕的结尾，演员眨眼示意，让观众知道他的话是在开玩笑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark kien qed jitkellem bis-serjetà? Lara: Le, ngħameż u tbissem. Kien qed jiċċajta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was Mark being serious? Lara: No, he winked and smiled. He was joking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克刚才是认真的吗？拉拉：不是，他眨了眨眼，还笑了。他是在开玩笑。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克刚才是认真的吗？
messages.en: Was Mark being serious?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ngħameż u tbissem. Kien qed jiċċajta.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ngħameż u tbissem. Kien qed jiċċajta.
messages.zh: 不是，他眨了眨眼，还笑了。他是在开玩笑。
messages.en: No, he winked and smiled. He was joking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ngħameż 时做一次单眼眨眼，再想象朋友会意一笑，用动作记住“使眼色”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be identified as someone or something familiar, or to become known to others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被辨认出身份或被认作熟悉的人或事物，也可表示为他人所知。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi identifikat bħala persuna jew ħaġa familjari, jew isir magħruf ma' oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被认出；被辨认出来。
为人所知；被人知晓。

formal.mt: Il-kittieb ngħaraf minn leħnu waqt l-intervista, għalkemm wiċċu ma deherx fuq l-iskrin.
formal.en: The writer was recognised by his voice during the interview, although his face did not appear on screen.
formal.zh: 虽然画面中没有出现这位作家的脸，但访谈时人们凭声音认出了他。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif ngħaraf Mark fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Mill-kappell aħmar tiegħu. Dejjem jilbsu!
colloquial.en: Nina: How was Mark recognised in the photo? Pawlu: By his red hat. He always wears it!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：大家是怎么在照片里认出马克的？保罗：靠他的红帽子。他总戴着它！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家是怎么在照片里认出马克的？
messages.en: How was Mark recognised in the photo?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 靠他的红帽子。他总戴着它！
messages.en: By his red hat. He always wears it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象听到声音就认出朋友，再想到人人知道的作家，串起 ngħaraf 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have one's skin lightly touched in a way that causes a tickling sensation, often with laughter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮肤受到轻触或搔弄而产生痒感，常会因此发笑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mimsus ħafif fuq il-ġilda b'mod li jġiegħlu jħoss it-tqanqix, spiss bid-daħk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被挠痒痒；被搔得发痒。

collocations.en: was tickled on the soles of his feet

formal.mt: Fl-istorja għat-tfal, it-tifel ngħarax b'rixa taħt saqajh u beda jidħak.
formal.en: In the children's story, the boy was tickled on the soles of his feet with a feather and began to laugh.
formal.zh: 在这个儿童故事里，男孩的脚底被羽毛挠得发痒，笑了起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex daħak daqshekk Ben? Lara: Ngħarax taħt saqajh waqt il-logħob!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Ben laugh so much? Lara: He was tickled on the soles of his feet while playing!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：本为什么笑得那么厉害？拉拉：玩的时候有人挠他的脚底了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 本为什么笑得那么厉害？
messages.en: Why did Ben laugh so much?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 玩的时候有人挠他的脚底了！
messages.en: He was tickled on the soles of his feet while playing!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象羽毛轻扫脚底、忍不住发笑的感觉，把 ngħarax 记成“被挠痒痒”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pressed tightly, or to have juice extracted by pressing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到挤压，或通过挤压使其中的汁液被榨出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi magħfus sew, jew jinħareġ il-meraq minnu permezz tal-għasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被挤压；被压紧。
被榨汁；汁液被挤出。

collocations.en: the oranges were squeezed for juice

formal.mt: Il-larinġ ngħasar bl-idejn, u l-meraq inġabar f'reċipjent nadif qabel ma ġie servut.
formal.en: The oranges were squeezed by hand, and the juice was collected in a clean container before being served.
formal.zh: 橙子经手工榨汁，果汁装入干净的容器后再供人饮用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-meraq frisk? Nina: Iva, il-larinġ ngħasar ftit ilu. Trid tazza?
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this juice fresh? Nina: Yes, the oranges were squeezed a little while ago. Would you like a glass?
colloquial.zh: 马克：这是鲜榨果汁吗？妮娜：是的，橙子刚榨好不久。你要一杯吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这是鲜榨果汁吗？
messages.en: Is this juice fresh?

messages.speaker: Nina (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-larinġ ngħasar ftit ilu. Trid tazza?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-larinġ ngħasar ftit ilu. Trid tazza?
messages.zh: 是的，橙子刚榨好不久。你要一杯吗？
messages.en: Yes, the oranges were squeezed a little while ago. Would you like a glass?

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象物品被夹紧，再想象橙子受压流出果汁，用“挤压到出汁”串记 ngħasar。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be worked by kneading, or to be moulded into a shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 像面团一样被反复揉捏，或像黏土一样被揉制成某种形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li materjal bħall-għaġina jew it-tafal jinħadem billi jingħafas u jintlewa, jew jingħata forma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被反复揉捏、揉和，尤其指面团等材料。
被塑形；被揉制成某种形状。

collocations.en: dough that was kneaded by hand
clay that was moulded into a round shape

formal.mt: L-għaġina ngħaġnet bl-idejn għal għaxar minuti qabel tħalliet tistrieħ.
formal.en: The dough was kneaded by hand for ten minutes before being left to rest.
formal.zh: 面团用手揉了十分钟，然后放置醒面。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan it-tafal diġà ngħaġen? Ben: Iva, ngħaġen f'forma tonda; issa nistgħu nagħmlu skutella.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has this clay already been moulded? Ben: Yes, it was moulded into a round shape; now we can make a bowl.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这块黏土已经塑过形了吗？本：是的，已经揉成圆形了；现在可以做碗了。

messages.speaker: Anna (手工课学员)
messages.zh: 这块黏土已经塑过形了吗？
messages.en: Has this clay already been moulded?

messages.speaker: Ben (手工课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ngħaġen f'forma tonda; issa nistgħu nagħmlu skutella.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ngħaġen f'forma tonda; issa nistgħu nagħmlu skutella.
messages.zh: 是的，已经揉成圆形了；现在可以做碗了。
messages.en: Yes, it was moulded into a round shape; now we can make a bowl.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手先揉面团、再把黏土揉成圆球；材料是被揉的对象，帮助记住“被揉捏、被塑形”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to reproduce or produce offspring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于繁殖或容易生育后代的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza li jitnissel jew ikollu l-frieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于繁殖后代的；易生育的。

collocations.en: a rabbit that readily produces offspring

formal.mt: Annimal nissieli jeħtieġ spazju biżżejjed għalih u għall-frieħ tiegħu.
formal.en: An animal that readily reproduces needs enough space for itself and its offspring.
formal.zh: 容易繁殖的动物需要足够的空间，供自身及其后代生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-fenek nissieli? Pawlu: Iva, diġà għandu ħafna frieħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this rabbit readily produce offspring? Pawlu: Yes, it already has lots of young.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这只兔子很容易繁育后代吗？保罗：是啊，它已经有很多小兔子了。

messages.speaker: Maja (饲养者)
messages.zh: 这只兔子很容易繁育后代吗？
messages.en: Does this rabbit readily produce offspring?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养兔人)
messages.zh: 是啊，它已经有很多小兔子了。
messages.en: Yes, it already has lots of young.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只兔子身边围满小兔，用这个画面记住 nissieli 表示容易繁殖后代的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element nitrogen, whose symbol is N.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素氮，元素符号为 N。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku bis-simbolu N.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 氮，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: In-nitroġenu huwa element kimiku bis-simbolu N u jinsab fl-arja.
formal.en: Nitrogen is a chemical element with the symbol N and is present in air.
formal.zh: 氮是一种元素符号为 N 的化学元素，存在于空气中。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu s-simbolu tan-nitroġenu? Mark: N. Tista' ssibu fit-tabella tal-elementi.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is the symbol for nitrogen? Mark: N. You can find it in the periodic table.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：氮的元素符号是什么？马克：N。你可以在元素周期表里找到。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 氮的元素符号是什么？
messages.en: What is the symbol for nitrogen?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: N。你可以在元素周期表里找到。
messages.en: N. You can find it in the periodic table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nitroġenu 与英文 nitrogen 和元素符号 N 放在同一张记忆卡上，三者一起对应中文“氮”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pull out feathers or hairs, such as those on a bird or a person's face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将羽毛或毛发拔出来，例如拔除鸟的羽毛或面部毛发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqla' r-rix jew ix-xagħar, bħal dak ta' għasfur jew tal-wiċċ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to pluck (e.g. feathers, facial hair etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拔除羽毛、面部毛发等；拔毛。

formal.mt: Meta tnittef ix-xagħar tal-wiċċ, uża pinzetta nadifa.
formal.en: When plucking facial hair, use clean tweezers.
formal.zh: 拔除面部毛发时，应使用干净的镊子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nittef din ix-xagħra bil-pinzetta? Nina: Iva, imma l-ewwel naddaf il-pinzetta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall I pluck this hair with the tweezers? Nina: Yes, but clean the tweezers first.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我用镊子拔掉这根毛吗？妮娜：可以，不过先把镊子清洁一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我用镊子拔掉这根毛吗？
messages.en: Shall I pluck this hair with the tweezers?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，不过先把镊子清洁一下。
messages.en: Yes, but clean the tweezers first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象镊子夹住一根毛并把它拔出，用这个完整动作记住 nittef 的“拔毛”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who plucks birds; also, a person who cheats other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给鸟拔毛的人；也指欺骗他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tnittef l-għasafar; ukoll persuna li tqarraq b'ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给鸟拔毛的人。
欺骗他人的人；骗子。

formal.mt: In-nittief tal-għasafar neħħa r-rix qabel ma l-laħam tħejja għat-tisjir.
formal.en: The bird plucker removed the feathers before the meat was prepared for cooking.
formal.zh: 拔鸟毛的人先去除了羽毛，随后才进行肉类烹饪前的处理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tafdah lil dak il-bejjiegħ? Toni: Le, nittief. Ħadli l-flus u ma tani xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you trust that seller? Toni: No, he's a cheat. He took my money and gave me nothing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你信得过那个卖家吗？托尼：信不过，他是个骗子。拿了我的钱，却什么也没给我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你信得过那个卖家吗？
messages.en: Do you trust that seller?

messages.speaker: Toni (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nittief. Ħadli l-flus u ma tani xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nittief. Ħadli l-flus u ma tani xejn.
messages.zh: 信不过，他是个骗子。拿了我的钱，却什么也没给我。
messages.en: No, he's a cheat. He took my money and gave me nothing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 nittief 画两张人物卡：一张是拔鸟毛的人，一张是骗子；分别记义，再用上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to cheat other people in order to obtain their money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有骗取他人钱财倾向的；惯于为钱欺骗他人的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza li jqarraq b'ħaddieħor biex jeħodlu l-flus.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to cheat others for money
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有骗取他人钱财的倾向的。

collocations.en: a seller inclined to cheat people out of money
collocations.zh: 惯于骗取顾客钱财的卖家

collocations.en: a businessman inclined to cheat people for money
collocations.zh: 惯于为钱欺骗他人的商人

formal.mt: Bejjiegħ nittiefi jista' juża wegħdiet foloz biex jieħu l-flus tal-klijenti.
formal.en: A seller inclined to cheat people may use false promises to obtain customers' money.
formal.zh: 惯于骗钱的卖家可能利用虚假承诺获取顾客的钱财。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex ma tridx tixtri mingħandu? Mark: Għax nittiefi; dejjem jipprova jqarraq bin-nies biex jeħdilhom il-flus.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why don't you want to buy from him? Mark: Because he tends to cheat people; he's always trying to deceive them to get their money.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么不愿意向他买东西？马克：因为他惯于骗钱，总想欺骗人家，把钱弄到手。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不愿意向他买东西？
messages.en: Why don't you want to buy from him?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax nittiefi; dejjem jipprova jqarraq bin-nies biex jeħdilhom il-flus.
messages.mt_standard: Għax nittiefi; dejjem jipprova jqarraq bin-nies biex jeħdilhom il-flus.
messages.zh: 因为他惯于骗钱，总想欺骗人家，把钱弄到手。
messages.en: Because he tends to cheat people; he's always trying to deceive them to get their money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nittiefi 放在“这个人怎么样”的形容词位置，联想他总想骗走别人的钱，记住其骗钱倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Obscene language, content, or behaviour, or an instance of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 淫秽、猥亵的语言、内容或行为，也可指其中的一例。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem, kontenut jew imġiba oxxena, jew eżempju tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淫秽；猥亵的言语、内容或行为。

formal.mt: L-editur neħħa n-nittinerija mit-test qabel il-pubblikazzjoni.
formal.en: The editor removed the obscenity from the text before publication.
formal.zh: 编辑在出版前删去了文中的淫秽内容。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqqaft il-filmat? Lara: Għax fih nittinerija, u hawn it-tfal.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you stop the video? Lara: Because it contains obscenity, and the children are here.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么把视频停了？拉拉：因为里面有淫秽内容，孩子们又在这里。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把视频停了？
messages.en: Why did you stop the video?

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fih nittinerija, u hawn it-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Għax fih nittinerija, u hawn it-tfal.
messages.zh: 因为里面有淫秽内容，孩子们又在这里。
messages.en: Because it contains obscenity, and the children are here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象编辑在稿件上圈出一段猥亵内容，并标注 nittinerija，用删改场景记住“淫秽内容”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something of very little importance or significance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重要性或意义很小的东西或事情；微不足道之物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa ta' ftit li xejn importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微不足道的东西或事情。

formal.mt: Dan id-dettall huwa nittuf u ma jbiddilx il-konklużjoni tar-rapport.
formal.en: This detail is a trifle and does not change the report's conclusion.
formal.zh: 这个细节微不足道，不会改变报告的结论。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed ninkwieta għax il-kaxxa għandha marka żgħira. Pawlu: Dak nittuf; ir-rigal ta' ġewwa għadu tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Nina: I'm worried because the box has a small mark. Pawlu: That's a trifle; the gift inside is still fine.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：盒子上有个小印子，我有点担心。保罗：那只是小事，里面的礼物还是好好的。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed ninkwieta għax il-kaxxa għandha marka żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Qed ninkwieta għax il-kaxxa għandha marka żgħira.
messages.zh: 盒子上有个小印子，我有点担心。
messages.en: I'm worried because the box has a small mark.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak nittuf; ir-rigal ta' ġewwa għadu tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Dak nittuf; ir-rigal ta' ġewwa għadu tajjeb.
messages.zh: 那只是小事，里面的礼物还是好好的。
messages.en: That's a trifle; the gift inside is still fine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把盒子上的一个小印子想成 nittuf：看得见，却不影响礼物，用来记住“微不足道的小事”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The slow seeping out of liquid, or leakage through an opening or surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 液体缓慢渗出的现象，或液体通过缝隙、孔洞或表面发生的渗漏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħruġ bil-mod ta' likwidu, jew it-tnixxija tiegħu minn fetħa jew minn wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 液体缓慢渗出；渗出的现象。
液体从缝隙、孔洞等处漏出；渗漏。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni ġiet osservata nixa ta' ilma minn xquq żgħir fil-ħajt.
formal.en: During the inspection, water seepage was observed from a small crack in the wall.
formal.zh: 检查过程中，发现水从墙上的一条细小裂缝中渗出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm nixa ta' ilma taħt is-sink. Toni: Qed naraha. Nagħlaq l-ilma u nċempel lill-plamer.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a water leak under the sink. Toni: I can see it. I'll turn off the water and call the plumber.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：水槽下面漏水了。托尼：我看到了。我去关水，再给水管工打电话。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm nixa ta' ilma taħt is-sink.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm nixa ta' ilma taħt is-sink.
messages.zh: 水槽下面漏水了。
messages.en: There's a water leak under the sink.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed naraha. Nagħlaq l-ilma u nċempel lill-plamer.
messages.mt_standard: Qed naraha. Nagħlaq l-ilma u nċempel lill-plamer.
messages.zh: 我看到了。我去关水，再给水管工打电话。
messages.en: I can see it. I'll turn off the water and call the plumber.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象墙缝慢慢冒水，再想到水管接头漏水：前者帮助记“渗出”，后者帮助记“渗漏”，都对应 nixa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be denied or refused, as when permission or access is not granted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被拒绝或不获准许，例如许可或进入某处的资格未获批准。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma jiġix aċċettat jew mogħti, bħal permess jew aċċess li ma jingħatax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拒绝；不获准许或给予。

collocations.zh: 进入或访问的请求被拒绝

formal.mt: Il-permess inċaħad għax id-dokumenti ma kinux kompluti.
formal.en: Permission was denied because the documents were incomplete.
formal.zh: 由于文件不齐全，许可未获批准。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tidħol fl-arkivju? Mark: Le, l-aċċess inċaħad. Għandi nibgħat id-dokumenti l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you enter the archive? Mark: No, access was denied. I have to send the documents first.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能进档案室吗？马克：不能，进入的请求被拒绝了。我得先把文件交过去。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你能进档案室吗？
messages.en: Can you enter the archive?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, l-aċċess inċaħad. Għandi nibgħat id-dokumenti l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, l-aċċess inċaħad. Għandi nibgħat id-dokumenti l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 不能，进入的请求被拒绝了。我得先把文件交过去。
messages.en: No, access was denied. I have to send the documents first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象申请表上盖着“未批准”的印章，门口也没有放行；用申请或许可被拒绝的画面记住这个被动意义。

gloss_zh: 被收集；被修好；安定下来

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be collected or brought together; also, to be repaired or to settle down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被收集或聚拢起来；也可指被修好，或安定下来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinġieb flimkien jew jitqiegħed f'post wieħed; jista' jfisser ukoll li jissewwa jew li jieħu ħajja aktar kalma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被收集；被聚拢。
被修理；被修好。
安定下来；开始过较平静、稳定的生活。

formal.mt: Il-materjal kollu nġabar f'post wieħed qabel ma bdiet l-analiżi.
formal.en: All the material was collected in one place before the analysis began.
formal.zh: 分析开始前，所有材料都被集中到了一个地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kartun kollu nġabar? Mark: Iva, qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb, lest għar-riċiklaġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has all the cardboard been collected? Mark: Yes, it's by the door, ready for recycling.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：纸板都收集好了吗？马克：是的，都在门边，准备送去回收。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 纸板都收集好了吗？
messages.en: Has all the cardboard been collected?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb, lest għar-riċiklaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb, lest għar-riċiklaġġ.
messages.zh: 是的，都在门边，准备送去回收。
messages.en: Yes, it's by the door, ready for recycling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个画面串记：散物被收拢、坏物被修好、生活安定下来；具体词义要看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become curly or wavy, especially when describing hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得卷曲或呈波浪状，尤其用于描述头发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir innukklat jew jieħu għamla ta' mewġ, speċjalment meta nitkellmu fuq ix-xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变卷；变得卷曲。
变成波浪状；出现波浪形的弯曲。

collocations.en: became curly or wavy because of the humidity
collocations.zh: 因潮湿而变卷或起波浪

formal.mt: Wara li nxef, ix-xagħar nġagħad u ħa għamla ta' mewġ.
formal.en: After drying, the hair became wavy and took on a wave-like shape.
formal.zh: 头发干了以后起了弯，呈现出波浪状。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xagħri nġagħad bl-umdità! Nina: Iva, illum għandu aktar mewġ mis-soltu.
colloquial.en: Lara: My hair has gone wavy in the humidity! Nina: Yes, it has more waves than usual today.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：天气潮湿，我的头发都起波浪了！妮娜：是啊，今天比平时弯得更明显。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 天气潮湿，我的头发都起波浪了！
messages.en: My hair has gone wavy in the humidity!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum għandu aktar mewġ mis-soltu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum għandu aktar mewġ mis-soltu.
messages.zh: 是啊，今天比平时弯得更明显。
messages.en: Yes, it has more waves than usual today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象直发遇到湿气后卷起来：小圈对应卷曲，连续弯线对应波浪，两种变化都可用这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be compelled to do something by another person or by circumstances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由于他人的要求或客观情势而被迫做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu jagħmel xi ħaġa għax persuna oħra jew iċ-ċirkostanzi ma jħallulux għażla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被迫；受到强制而不得不做某事。

collocations.en: was compelled to change the plan

formal.mt: Minħabba l-għeluq tat-triq, ix-xufier nġagħal ibiddel ir-rotta.
formal.en: Because of the road closure, the driver was compelled to change the route.
formal.zh: 由于道路封闭，司机被迫改变了行车路线。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu telaq daqshekk kmieni? Ivan: Nġagħal jitlaq għax kellu problema d-dar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu leave so early? Ivan: He had to leave because there was a problem at home.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗为什么这么早就走了？伊万：他家里出了点事，只好离开。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么这么早就走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave so early?

messages.speaker: Ivan (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nġagħal jitlaq għax kellu problema d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Nġagħal jitlaq għax kellu problema d-dar.
messages.zh: 他家里出了点事，只好离开。
messages.en: He had to leave because there was a problem at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“没有选择，只好行动”的场景；把这个词与后面的具体动作连起来，就容易理解“被迫做什么”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gather together, or to be collected into a group or in one place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聚集到一起，或被收集、集中到一个地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiltaqa' jew jiġi flimkien ma' oħrajn, jew jinġieb f'post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 聚集；集合到一起。
被收集；被集中起来。

formal.mt: Il-grupp nġama' fil-bitħa tal-iskola qabel bdiet iż-żjara.
formal.en: The group gathered in the school courtyard before the visit began.
formal.zh: 参观开始前，大家在学校的院子里集合。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nġama' l-grupp? Toni: Ħdejn il-bieb tal-mużew; ejja magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the group gather? Toni: By the museum entrance; come with us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：大家在哪里集合了？托尼：在博物馆入口旁边；跟我们一起去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 大家在哪里集合了？
messages.en: Where did the group gather?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 在博物馆入口旁边；跟我们一起去吧。
messages.en: By the museum entrance; come with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上分散的小点移到同一处：人是聚集，物是被收集；书写时也要记住词尾的撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be torn, especially when skin is scraped or torn through contact with something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被撕破，尤其指皮肤因接触、摩擦等而破损。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitqatta' jew jitqaxxar, speċjalment meta l-ġilda titħakkek ma' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被撕破或擦破，尤其用于皮肤。

formal.mt: Waqt il-waqgħa, il-minkeb tal-istudent nġarad mal-art.
formal.en: During the fall, the student's elbow was scraped against the ground.
formal.zh: 学生跌倒时，手肘碰着地面擦破了皮。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Il-minkeb tiegħi nġarad mal-ħajt. Rita: Ejja naħsluh bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Luca: I scraped my elbow against the wall. Rita: Let's wash it gently.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我的手肘碰着墙擦破皮了。丽塔：我们轻轻洗一下吧。

messages.speaker: Luca (儿子)
messages.zh: 我的手肘碰着墙擦破皮了。
messages.en: I scraped my elbow against the wall.

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 我们轻轻洗一下吧。
messages.en: Let's wash it gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手肘擦过粗糙墙面的画面记忆：重点是表皮被擦破，而不只是碰了一下或觉得疼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be carried or moved from one place to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被携带、搬运，或从一个地方移到另一个地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jittieħed minn post għal ieħor, billi jintrefa' jew jiġi mċaqlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被携带；被抬着或搬运。
被移动；被搬到另一处。

formal.mt: It-tagħmir nġarr lejn il-laboratorju qabel beda l-esperiment.
formal.en: The equipment was moved to the laboratory before the experiment began.
formal.zh: 实验开始前，设备被搬到了实验室。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-mejda għadha barra? Anna: Le, nġarr kollox ġewwa qabel bdiet ix-xita.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the table still outside? Anna: No, everything was carried inside before it started raining.
colloquial.zh: 马克：桌子还在外面吗？安娜：没有，开始下雨前，东西都搬进来了。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 桌子还在外面吗？
messages.en: Is the table still outside?

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nġarr kollox ġewwa qabel bdiet ix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nġarr kollox ġewwa qabel bdiet ix-xita.
messages.zh: 没有，开始下雨前，东西都搬进来了。
messages.en: No, everything was carried inside before it started raining.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象箱子被双手抬起，再从门外搬进门内；“被抬着”和“被移到别处”是两个相连的记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small strand of Bermuda grass; the diminutive form of niġma.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一小条狗牙根草，是 niġma 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira u rqiqa ta' ħaxix tat-tip niġma; il-forma diminuttiva ta' niġma.

sense_translations.en_definition: a strand of bermuda grass (the diminutive form of 'niġma')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小条狗牙根草（niġma 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: a green strand of Bermuda grass
collocations.zh: 一小条绿色的狗牙根草

collocations.en: a strand of Bermuda grass in the garden
collocations.zh: 花园里的一小条狗牙根草

formal.mt: L-istudent poġġa nġejma fuq karta bajda biex josserva l-għamla tagħha.
formal.en: The student placed a small strand of Bermuda grass on white paper to observe its shape.
formal.zh: 学生把一小条狗牙根草放在白纸上，观察它的形状。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'hemm imwaħħal maż-żarbun tiegħi? Toni: Nġejma żgħira mill-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's stuck to my shoe? Toni: A little strand of Bermuda grass from the garden.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我的鞋上粘着什么？托尼：花园里的一小条狗牙根草。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的鞋上粘着什么？
messages.en: What's stuck to my shoe?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 花园里的一小条狗牙根草。
messages.en: A little strand of Bermuda grass from the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 niġma 与 nġejma 配对记忆：后者想成鞋边粘着的一小条草，用“小小一条”的画面记住指小义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To improve in appearance or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外表变得更好看、更整洁，或举止、行为有所改善。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir aħjar fid-dehra jew fl-imġiba tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to improve one's looks or behaviour
sense_translations.zh_definition: 改善自己的外表或举止；变得更好看或更懂规矩。

formal.mt: Matul is-sena skolastika, l-istudent nġela fl-imġiba u beda juri aktar rispett lejn sħabu.
formal.en: During the school year, the student improved in behaviour and began showing more respect towards his classmates.
formal.zh: 这一学年里，这名学生的举止有所改善，也开始更加尊重同学。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu nġela fid-dehra dan l-aħħar. Rita: Iva, qed jieħu aktar ħsieb tiegħu nnifsu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu has been looking better lately. Rita: Yes, he's taking better care of himself.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗最近看起来比以前整洁精神了。丽塔：是啊，他更注意照顾自己了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗最近看起来比以前整洁精神了。
messages.en: Pawlu has been looking better lately.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed jieħu aktar ħsieb tiegħu nnifsu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed jieħu aktar ħsieb tiegħu nnifsu.
messages.zh: 是啊，他更注意照顾自己了。
messages.en: Yes, he's taking better care of himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一组前后对照画面：外表从邋遢到整洁，举止从冒失到得体；两条线都指向“有所改善”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be made to run, for example when a person directs an animal to run.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被人促使或要求跑动，例如动物受人的指挥而跑起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi mġiegħel jiġri, bħal annimal li persuna tqabbdu jiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被促使跑动；被驱赶着跑。

collocations.en: a horse made to run during training
collocations.zh: 训练时被驱使跑动的马

collocations.en: was made to run for a few minutes

formal.mt: Iż-żiemel inġera għal ftit minuti taħt il-gwida tat-trejner.
formal.en: The horse was made to run for a few minutes under the trainer's guidance.
formal.zh: 这匹马在教练的引导下被要求跑了几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex iż-żiemel inġera dalgħodu? Toni: Biex jitħarreġ, iżda għal ftit minuti biss.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why was the horse made to run this morning? Toni: For training, but only for a few minutes.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天早上为什么让这匹马跑？托尼：为了训练，不过只跑了几分钟。

messages.speaker: Lara (骑手)
messages.zh: 今天早上为什么让这匹马跑？
messages.en: Why was the horse made to run this morning?

messages.speaker: Toni (教练)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jitħarreġ, iżda għal ftit minuti biss.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jitħarreġ, iżda għal ftit minuti biss.
messages.zh: 为了训练，不过只跑了几分钟。
messages.en: For training, but only for a few minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象教练发出指令后马才跑起来，把这个词与“受到驱使而跑”的画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suffer bruising or a wound as a result of an impact, accident, or other injury.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因碰撞、事故或其他伤害而出现瘀伤或伤口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġarrab tbenġil jew ferita minħabba daqqa, inċident jew korriment ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到碰伤、瘀伤或创伤。

collocations.en: was injured in his foot or leg

formal.mt: Pawlu nġeraħ f'siequ meta waqa' mit-taraġ.
formal.en: Pawlu injured his foot or leg when he fell down the stairs.
formal.zh: 保罗从楼梯上摔下来时，下肢受了伤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu nġeraħ meta waqa'? Lara: Iva, għandu ferita żgħira f'idu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was Pawlu hurt when he fell? Lara: Yes, he has a small wound on his hand.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：保罗摔倒时受伤了吗？拉拉：是的，他手上有个小伤口。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗摔倒时受伤了吗？
messages.en: Was Pawlu hurt when he fell?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他手上有个小伤口。
messages.en: Yes, he has a small wound on his hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把摔倒后查看瘀青或伤口的画面作为记忆提示，重点记住“已经受到伤害”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive a reward in recognition of an action, effort, or achievement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某种行为、付出或成就而获得奖赏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħata premju bħala rikonoxximent ta' għemil, sforz jew kisba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到奖励；获得奖赏。

collocations.zh: 因自己的工作而受到奖励

formal.mt: Pawlu nġeża bi premju għall-ħidma tiegħu fil-komunità.
formal.en: Pawlu was rewarded with a prize for his work in the community.
formal.zh: 保罗因在社区中的工作而获得了奖赏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu nġeża għall-għajnuna tiegħu? Mark: Iva, tawh premju waqt il-festa tal-iskola.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was Pawlu rewarded for his help? Mark: Yes, they gave him a prize at the school celebration.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：保罗提供帮助后得到奖励了吗？马克：得到了，他们在学校庆祝活动上给他颁了奖。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗提供帮助后得到奖励了吗？
messages.en: Was Pawlu rewarded for his help?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tawh premju waqt il-festa tal-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tawh premju waqt il-festa tal-iskola.
messages.zh: 得到了，他们在学校庆祝活动上给他颁了奖。
messages.en: Yes, they gave him a prize at the school celebration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象付出努力后双手接过奖品，用“努力之后得到奖赏”的场景记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have one's wool or hair removed by shearing or close cutting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身上的羊毛或毛发被人剪去或剪短。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitneħħielu s-suf jew ix-xagħar billi jinqata' bil-ġliem jew b'għodda oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to be shorn of wool or hair
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被剪去羊毛或毛发；被剪毛。

collocations.en: a lamb that has been shorn
collocations.zh: 一只已经剪过毛的羔羊

formal.mt: Il-ħaruf inġeżż fir-rebbiegħa biex jitneħħa s-suf twil tiegħu.
formal.en: The lamb was shorn in spring to remove its long wool.
formal.zh: 这只羔羊在春天接受了剪毛，身上的长羊毛被剪去。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-ħaruf diġà nġeżż? Toni: Iva, il-bidwi neħħielu s-suf dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has the lamb already been shorn? Toni: Yes, the farmer removed its wool this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这只羔羊已经剪过毛了吗？托尼：是的，农夫今天早上给它剪了毛。

messages.speaker: Sara (农场访客)
messages.zh: 这只羔羊已经剪过毛了吗？
messages.en: Has the lamb already been shorn?

messages.speaker: Toni (农夫)
messages.zh: 是的，农夫今天早上给它剪了毛。
messages.en: Yes, the farmer removed its wool this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象羊身上的厚毛被剪下，露出清爽轮廓；把这个词记成羊所经历的“被剪毛”。

gloss_zh: 被拉动；受到吸引；吃惊；摆架子

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pulled or attracted; also, to be shocked or surprised, or to behave pompously, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指受到拉动或吸引，也可依语境表示震惊、吃惊，或表现得傲慢而爱摆架子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġi miġbud jew attirat; skont il-kuntest, jista' wkoll jinħasad, jistagħġeb jew iġib ruħu b'kburija żejda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拉动；受到牵拉。
受到吸引；被某人或某事物吸引。
感到震惊或意外；吃了一惊。

sense_translations.en_definition: to act in a pompous manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 摆出自命不凡的姿态；摆架子。

formal.mt: Il-karru nġibed bil-ħabel sakemm wasal ħdejn il-bieb.
formal.en: The cart was pulled with a rope until it reached the doorway.
formal.zh: 这辆小车被绳子拉着，一直移到门边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu mar ħdejn il-palk? Mark: Naħseb li nġibed lejn il-mużika; waqaf hemm biex jisma'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu go over to the stage? Mark: I think he was attracted to the music; he stopped there to listen.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：保罗为什么走到舞台旁边去了？马克：我想他是被音乐吸引了，他停在那里听。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么走到舞台旁边去了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu go over to the stage?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li nġibed lejn il-mużika; waqaf hemm biex jisma'.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li nġibed lejn il-mużika; waqaf hemm biex jisma'.
messages.zh: 我想他是被音乐吸引了，他停在那里听。
messages.en: I think he was attracted to the music; he stopped there to listen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四格卡片分别画“绳子拉车、音乐吸引人、突然吃惊、昂头摆架子”，逐格记义，再靠上下文选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Contamination or impurity; in a religious context, impiety or a lack of reverence for what is sacred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指污染或不洁；在宗教语境中，也指对神圣事物缺乏敬意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tniġġis jew nuqqas ta' safa; f'kuntest reliġjuż, nuqqas ta' qima lejn dak li hu qaddis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污染；受到污物或有害物质侵染的状态。
不敬神；对神圣事物缺乏敬意。
不纯；不洁；污秽。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi n-nġies fl-ilma tal-bir u jitlob li jitnaddaf il-bir.
formal.en: The report describes contamination in the well water and calls for the well to be cleaned.
formal.zh: 报告描述了井水中的污染，并要求清理水井。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex dan l-ilma mhux nadif? Mark: Fih in-nġies; ara kemm hemm ħmieġ fil-qiegħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why isn't this water clean? Mark: It is contaminated; look how much dirt there is at the bottom.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这水为什么不干净？马克：里面有污染物，你看底下有多少脏东西。

messages.speaker: Sara (住户)
messages.zh: 这水为什么不干净？
messages.en: Why isn't this water clean?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Fih in-nġies; ara kemm hemm ħmieġ fil-qiegħ.
messages.mt_standard: Fih in-nġies; ara kemm hemm ħmieġ fil-qiegħ.
messages.zh: 里面有污染物，你看底下有多少脏东西。
messages.en: It is contaminated; look how much dirt there is at the bottom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用一杯浑水记“污染、不洁”，再另设宗教语境卡记“不敬神”，提醒自己按语境区分三个义项。

gloss_zh: 不敬神的行为；亵渎之举

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act that shows disrespect toward God or something regarded as sacred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对神或被视为神圣的事物表现出不敬的具体行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att li juri nuqqas ta' rispett lejn Alla jew lejn xi ħaġa meqjusa qaddisa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次不敬神的行为；亵渎神圣事物之举。

collocations.en: to regard the act as an impious deed
collocations.zh: 把该行为视为亵渎之举

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-komunità tqis il-ħsara lill-post qaddis bħala nġiesa.
formal.en: In the story, the community regards the damage to the sacred place as an impious act.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，社区把损坏圣地的行为视为亵渎之举。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-karattru jsejjaħ dak l-att nġiesa? Lara: Għax iqisu nuqqas ta' rispett lejn dak li hu qaddis.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the character call that deed an impious act? Lara: Because he sees it as disrespect toward what is sacred.
colloquial.zh: 玛娅：这个人物为什么把那件事称作亵渎之举？拉拉：因为他认为那是对神圣事物的不敬。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-karattru jsejjaħ dak l-att nġiesa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-karattru jsejjaħ dak l-att nġiesa?
messages.zh: 这个人物为什么把那件事称作亵渎之举？
messages.en: Why does the character call that deed an impious act?

messages.speaker: Lara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax iqisu nuqqas ta' rispett lejn dak li hu qaddis.
messages.mt_standard: Għax iqisu nuqqas ta' rispett lejn dak li hu qaddis.
messages.zh: 因为他认为那是对神圣事物的不敬。
messages.en: Because he sees it as disrespect toward what is sacred.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个词配一张写着“某一次不敬行为”的事件卡，记住它指具体举动，而不是泛指污染状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The trimming of stone by removing small portions to give it the required shape or fit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过凿去石料上的少量部分，使其达到所需形状或尺寸的修整工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tneħħija ta' biċċiet żgħar mill-ġebel biex jieħu l-għamla mixtieqa jew jidħol sew f'postu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 石料的修整；通过修凿调整石材形状。

formal.mt: In-nġir tal-ġebel sar b'attenzjoni biex kull ġebla tidħol sew f'postha.
formal.en: The stone was carefully trimmed so that each block would fit properly in its place.
formal.zh: 石料经过仔细修凿，使每块石头都能妥当地嵌入相应位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-ġebla għadha mhix lesta? Toni: Le, għad fadal ftit nġir biex tidħol sew f'postha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the stone still not ready? Toni: No, it still needs a little trimming to fit properly in its place.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这块石头还没弄好吗？托尼：还没有，还得稍微修凿一下，才能放到位。

messages.speaker: Sara (学徒)
messages.zh: 这块石头还没弄好吗？
messages.en: Is the stone still not ready?

messages.speaker: Toni (石匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għad fadal ftit nġir biex tidħol sew f'postha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għad fadal ftit nġir biex tidħol sew f'postha.
messages.zh: 还没有，还得稍微修凿一下，才能放到位。
messages.en: No, it still needs a little trimming to fit properly in its place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象石匠一点点凿掉石块边缘，让它刚好嵌入墙中；把这个修整过程与该名词一起记。
